title: I know we're just friend, but - Gus Glasser with my full band live
body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779763290607-112f295e919f73b5.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidosunamusic/c1c7c7b1)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidosunamusic/c1c7c7b1)


---

Mi querido amigo, proveniente de Atlanta, Estados Unidos, ha llegado a Medellín. Lo conocí mientras yo estaba en una sesión de jam musical y rápidamente nos volvimos muy amigos.
>My dear friend from Atlanta, United States, has arrived in Medellín. I met him while I was at a musical jam session and we quickly became very close friends.

Desde entonces, hemos hecho varias canciones juntos, construyendo una hermosa sociedad creativa que cruza fronteras y culturas.
>Since then, we have made several songs together, building a beautiful creative partnership that crosses borders and cultures.

Pero antes de empezar a producir con él, esta canción que él ya traía desarrollada desde Atlanta me encantó desde el primer momento en que la escuché.
>But before we started producing together, this song that he had already developed from Atlanta captivated me from the very first moment I heard it.

Tuvimos la oportunidad de tocar esta pieza llamada \
, un tema que aborda una situación más común de lo que uno podría creer.\n>We had the opportunity to play this piece called \

, a song that addresses a situation more common than one might think.

No importa cuán diferente sea tu cultura, siempre existe ese amigo o esa amiga de quien terminamos enamorándonos sin haberlo planeado.
>No matter how different your culture is, there is always that friend, male or female, whom we end up falling in love with without having planned it.

El dilema es real y universal: no queremos perder esa relación tan valiosa dando el siguiente paso arriesgado hacia el amor romántico.
>The dilemma is real and universal: we don't want to lose that precious relationship by taking the risky next step toward romantic love.

Preferimos quedarnos en la zona segura de la amistad, aunque por dentro sintamos algo mucho más profundo que nos quema en silencio.
>We prefer to stay in the safe zone of friendship, even though deep inside we feel something much deeper that silently burns within us.

Pero llega un momento en el cual esta situación se nos vuelve emocionalmente insostenible, cuando guardar el secreto duele más que arriesgarlo todo.
>But there comes a moment when this situation becomes emotionally unsustainable for us, when keeping the secret hurts more than risking everything.

Entonces terminamos, como decimos en Venezuela, \
: confesando lo que sentimos sin filtros, sin medias tintas, con el corazón en la mano.\n>Then we end up, as we say in Venezuela, \

(spilling all the soup): confessing what we feel without filters, without half measures, with our heart in our hand.

Esta canción captura perfectamente esa tensión entre el miedo a perder la amistad y la necesidad imperiosa de ser honestos con nuestros sentimientos más profundos.
>This song perfectly captures that tension between the fear of losing the friendship and the imperative need to be honest with our deepest feelings.

Espero que disfruten esta interpretación que hicimos mi amigo y yo, dos culturas unidas por la música para contar una historia que nos pertenece a todos.
>I hope you enjoy this interpretation that my friend and I made, two cultures united by music to tell a story that belongs to all of us.

¡No olviden comentar, rebloguear y votar si alguna vez han tenido que \
con esa persona especial que comenzó siendo solo un amigo o amiga!\n>Don't forget to comment, reblog and vote if you've ever had to \

with that special person who started out as just a friend!

title: Missing Blocks, Not Missing in Action
body:
Hello Snaperinos and Frenz...

This post is a bit of a PSA for the community.

You may have noticed that our Witness has been missing blocks today. I wanted to make a quick post to let everyone know that, while there are indeed some technical difficulties at the moment, this isn't a case of neglect or abandonment.

A series of events completely outside of my control has led us to where we are today. The good news is that work on correcting the situation begins tomorrow. If everything goes according to plan, Snapie should be buzzing happily again on a brand-new server within the next few days.


![e3df75cc-11d3-4b4d-a5d4-3c777b891ef6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/snapie/23yJ89dthxGjyZP8CS9FTEycN3Awx5wmwQT7Z1tLfcFamY6xmmXf4YeCjjjCT9T4NgvEA.png)


I understand that some people may decide to remove their witness votes during this downtime, and while that's unfortunate, I completely understand. These things happen. What matters is that the new witness infrastructure will be fully under the control of me and my alter ego, @meno, giving us greater flexibility and reliability moving forward.

Now, because I refuse to leave you with a gloomy update...

Have you tried OpenPods on snapie.io yet?

This feature is becoming incredibly cool (at least in my completely unbiased bee opinion). Every week it grows more powerful, more useful, and honestly, more fun to play with. I genuinely think it's something that can bring a lot of joy and utility to Snaperinos around the world.

If you haven't checked it out yet, please give it a spin. And if you have feedback, suggestions, or wild ideas, I'd love to hear them.

Thank you for your patience, your support, and for sticking with this little cyber-bee through the occasional turbulence.

Much love,

— Snapie 🐝

Anything Bitcoin!🤗😇 Most days I will check “X/Twitter” for the latest “Orange” news!😇 Several days ago on “X” I came across a brand new app, launched just this week! Blue checkmark that’s good…………… Available on the Apple App Store, I believe android is coming later!👍 It’s called the “Orange Bible app”😊 The premise is simple……… Read a short section of the Bible each day, that is on a preselected Bible “Roadmap” for you, and get rewarded with Bitcoin Sat’s!😇 That’s it!🤗 Silvertop though why not, reading the Bible each day, and stacking free Sat’s, that definitely sounds like a “Win/win”! Today was my first day, and I was rewarded 7 Sat’s worth about a penny! No a lot, but from what I read, the rewards gradually ramp up as time goes on, along with extra “Bonus” Sat’s that are given out here and there!☺️ The minimum you can withdraw to any Lightning wallet is 100 Sat’s. You can sign up for the “Basic app” like Silvertop did for free!😊 They also have a step up “Paid subscription” but for now I’ll stick to the free version!😇 Don’t quit your day job, and certainly don’t stop hiking my friends……Lol!☺️ Just keep stacking!👍😊 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

title: The Hidden Lake Above the Clouds: Exploring Poco Likang Lake at 2,370 Meters Above Sea Level
body:
https://3speak.tv/watch?v=yordan96/3speak-1780455820191
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmepoZ6HE8iKDLt1i32rPkegMr4ZuWip3DZhWUYvhgqoGb/1000714945.jpg 

Flores is famous for its beaches, Komodo dragons, and the iconic spider-web rice fields of Manggarai. However, hidden deep within the mountainous forests of Ruteng lies a place that few travelers have ever seen: Poco Likang Lake, a mysterious lake located near the summit of Mount Poco Likang, approximately 2,370 meters above sea level.
For local hikers, this place is considered one of the most beautiful and challenging destinations in Manggarai. Surrounded by dense cloud forests, giant moss-covered trees, and freezing temperatures, Poco Likang offers an experience completely different from the tropical image most people have about Flores.

**A Hidden Paradise in the Mountains**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRyKvsfc55n6q2M1vtgk3ExaFmEUD566wqVAFzhoa75Xf/1000714953.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPswSDKGGroJK3ZPJQC5UvopNp8WXKbFu9enZm6Vm8UqB/1000714951.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdSbW63u6N3Q5Ydhy7ud5bkyVsTp27N9VhwTv3wzwp4UL/1000714943.jpg 

Poco Likang is located in the highlands of Ruteng, Manggarai Regency, East Nusa Tenggara. The area is known for its cool climate and mountainous landscape. The summit region is covered by dense tropical montane forest, creating an atmosphere that feels almost magical.
According to local hikers, reaching the lake requires a long trek through steep terrain, muddy trails, and thick vegetation. The journey is not easy, but every step is rewarded by incredible scenery that few people ever get to witness. Poco Likang itself is part of the mountainous landscape around Ruteng, an area well known for its cool highland environment

**Standing at the Summit of Poco Likang**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmepoZ6HE8iKDLt1i32rPkegMr4ZuWip3DZhWUYvhgqoGb/1000714945.jpg 
One of the most satisfying moments of the journey is finally reaching the summit marker showing:
Poco Likang – 2,370 MDPL
At this elevation, the temperature can drop dramatically, especially during the night and early morning hours. The mountain forest becomes covered in mist, and strong winds can make the air feel even colder.
Recently, local residents reported unusually cold conditions in the highlands around Ruteng, with frost-like ice forming on grass in some areas. This phenomenon is rare in Indonesia and demonstrates just how cold these mountains can become during certain seasons.

**The Mysterious Lake Hidden in the Forest**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmckYaCnELgsvypijHYtaB5U3u1uheXBFfBMjJLFpE7YTx/1000714941.jpg 
The main attraction of the area is undoubtedly Poco Likang Lake.
Hidden between steep slopes and dense forest, the lake appears like a dark mirror reflecting the surrounding wilderness. From above, it looks isolated from the outside world, protected by nature itself.
The silence here is extraordinary. No city noise. No traffic. No crowds of tourists.
Only the sounds of wind, birds, and the forest.
This isolation is exactly what makes Poco Likang so special. While many famous destinations become crowded, this hidden lake remains largely untouched.

**A Forest That Feels Like Another World**
  https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfD2LCPzkLY4M55U4H3vjXa3FFAC3Kn58FJHtsVqBRVtz/1000714989.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZRYa8V3UmfExqz25JqLnJkLef3MU4sMcZsUbenWgLGoC/1000714973.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmY1v5tZPwV7MzWse6LAqLoBLUMRPTM7CUnmJpc478LsNz/1000714987.jpg 

 One thing that immediately catches the eye is the forest itself.
Large ancient trees stretch their branches across the landscape, covered with moss and epiphytic plants. Thick fog often moves slowly between the trees, creating scenes that resemble fantasy movies.
Standing beside the lake during the early morning feels almost unreal. The reflections on the water, combined with the drifting mist, create a mysterious atmosphere that is difficult to describe with words alone.
For photographers and nature lovers, this place is a dream destination.
What You Should Prepare Before Visiting
Unlike many tourist attractions in Flores, Poco Likang is not a place you can casually visit without preparation.
If you plan to hike here, make sure to bring:
Warm jackets and thermal clothing
Rain protection
Hiking shoes with good grip
Sufficient drinking water
Food supplies
Flashlights or headlamps
First aid equipment
Navigation assistance from local guides
The weather can change quickly, and temperatures near the summit can become surprisingly cold.
The remoteness of the area also means visitors should respect nature and avoid leaving any trash behind.
Why Poco Likang Deserves More Attention
Many people travel to Flores for Labuan Bajo, Komodo National Park, or the spider-web rice fields near Ruteng. Those destinations are certainly beautiful, but Poco Likang offers something different.
It offers solitude.
It offers adventure.
And it offers the rare feeling of discovering a place that still belongs mostly to nature.
In a world where almost every destination is already famous on social media, Poco Likang remains one of Manggarai's hidden treasures.

**Final Thoughts**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmckYaCnELgsvypijHYtaB5U3u1uheXBFfBMjJLFpE7YTx/1000714941.jpg 

Poco Likang Lake is proof that Flores still holds many secrets waiting to be explored.
At 2,370 meters above sea level, surrounded by ancient forest and cold mountain air, this hidden lake provides an unforgettable experience for anyone willing to make the journey.
For me, Poco Likang is not only a destination. It is a reminder that some of the most beautiful places on Earth are still found far away from crowds, where nature continues to speak in its own quiet language.

**Have you ever visited a hidden mountain lake like this? Let me know in the comments below.**

Source: Personal documentation and local hiking information. Additional geographic references about Poco Likang and the Ruteng highlands.

title: IKIGAI y Existencialismo | My Actifit Report: June 2 2026
body:
He vuelto a retomar mis caminatas diarias tras un tiempo de inactividad. Lo que me llevó a tomar la decisión de registrar mi actividad con *Actifit*. Otra cosa que he estado intentando es retomar mi blog, aunque sin demasiada pretensión. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4fe19d37-bbfa-4dd8-9df8-876fbb5c9b53.jpg) Hay muchas cosas en mente, demasiadas ideas con emociones variopintas orbitando a su alrededor. Cosa que me ha hecho sentir fatigado, pero esto no es lo que quería decir. Lo que quería comentar de manera muy breve, incluso hasta de manera escueta es que siempre que camino, comienzan a llegar ideas 💡 a mi mente y como he estado reflexionando en estás últimas semanas sobre el sentido de la vida. Me pregunté: *¿Se podrá hacer una lectura de lo que es el IKIGAI desde la mirada de la filosofía estoica?* Aunque no estoy completamente seguro de que se pueda encontrar una paridad 1:1 en sus planteamientos, pero seguro hay muchas similitudes que espero tener la oportunidad de investigar a profundidad. Eso me llevó a considerar que el IKIGAI es un planteamiento con tufo a Existencialismo porque parece (por lo menos a simple vista) que la existencia precede a la esencia. Es decir que son nuestras decisiones lo que nos define, que la vida se construye, se asume como un proyecto y que constantemente vamos identificando lo que somos. Pero eso es algo que también deberé pensar un poco más...

title: How Archons Control Your Monster Selection In Splinterlands || Campaign Chapter 9 Explained
body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 2, 2026, 10_54_56 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xAaGijWf1Km8dQw3xJv6aBKNmf1Hc2DGfSBtjm54UEkMz6nGCziw6RMsHCGGZmCamYf.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


Today I am going to talk with you about an interesting battle strategy. In this game, having only powerful cards is not enough. Understanding the strengths and weaknesses of elements and the battle rules is also very important..

In Splinterlands it is very important to understand which monster belongs to which element and in which battles they can be selected. If a battle allows only specific elements then you should have monsters from those elements to help you build a strong team.

Right now we have six elements in the game. If you have monster cards from only three elements and not from the other three, you may struggle as a player and face defeats in battles. That is why it is important to maintain a balance and own good monster cards from every element.
![Screenshot 2026-06-02 102703.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vrrfNMFY9jND2EMaxDxfrETqupLNcbLBiXUmJh58P5vpdUQj8DmYCAePshjTZk6f9cu.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

No matter whether the card is a tank, mid line monster, support monster or attack monster.. You should have cards of different elements for every role.

Today I explored Chapter 9 of the Campaign which is an excellent campaign for new players who want to understand the game mechanics better. Before this I explored many other chapters where I discussed armor, speed, magic attacks, abilities, mana and many other topics.

Today I decided to talk about elements because many Splinterlands players do not fully understand the difference between elements. Such players should definitely explore these campaigns and learn from them so that battles become easier and their monster card selection improves.

This chapter focuses on elements. In every Splinterlands battle your Archon or Summoner's element determines which cards you can use. For example if you select a Fire Archon you can only choose Fire element monsters. Monsters from other elements will not appear in your selection.
![Screenshot 2026-06-02 102716.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tRvX3ZtKXpRtJnw9LATjUwbZDBop6aejrJVNX2bTsmkBfjr1JiXRWQWqSzENaLtKent.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

That is why it is very important to remember that you need monster cards from every element. For example if your Archon belongs to the Fire element you can only use Fire monsters. However sometimes battle rules may restrict certain elements. A ruleset may not allow Fire cards or may only allow specific elements.

By playing more battles you will learn the strengths and weaknesses of each element and discover the best strategies to win... This campaign teaches players how to understand and use elements effectively.

![Screenshot 2026-06-02 102859.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tSUTua84pGVtN28WysYyAmevku8uUZRGHGD7n1Gcio6rLL6svtcbwexamXtLJVDg445.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

The campaign is very easy to explore. First you have to log in to your Splinterlands account. Then go to the Campaign section and click on Elements or whatever chapter you want to learn.. There you will find Chapter 9 which explains elements in detail.

After that you will complete a tutorial battle where you can practice selecting monster cards from different elements. This tutorial helps new players understand how element selection works and how choosing an Archon affects the monsters available to them.

![Screenshot 2026-06-02 102728.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uQNeM5ky3WiGu47HNSnSZP2QT5VMS1tQd7x86tyMSqBjpbUizmXQZ2WTHC2zQDwdAAb.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

It is a very simple campaign and can be completed in just four or five clicks. You will also complete a tutorial battle and receive rewards for finishing it.

After completion of chapter 9, you will be awarded with 6 monster cards which is then added in your decks. You can easily it in your battles and they are the initial level cards which will give you a start in playing the battles.

The best part is that it is rewarding. In only five minutes you can earn six monster cards and gain valuable battle experience at the same time.

![Screenshot 2026-06-02 103049.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eo8LYJHEMmNdUR1g1UQqkUUJMtgMjqHq5iExNsxRxbDMqWRhQbjjcDRCbcG81PU4Xk9.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

I hope this campaign will be helpful for you and will improve your understanding of the game.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

body:
<center> 

### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Esta vez te traigo una receta sencilla de arroz con calabacín y puerro, súper rica y perfecta para acompañar la comida. Es un plato que sabe increíblemente bien, es fácil de preparar, aprovechamos el valor nutricional de estas verduras y lo mejor de todo es que a toda la familia le gusta. Me encanta, por eso lo recomiendo. Aquí tienes el procedimiento paso a paso. >This time, I’m sharing a simple recipe for rice with zucchini and leeks—it’s super delicious and perfect as a side dish. It’s a dish that tastes amazing, is easy to make, lets you take advantage of the nutritional value of these vegetables, and best of all, the whole family loves it. I love it, which is why I recommend it. Here are the step-by-step instructions.
![Delicious rice with chicken and smoked bacon.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23ynh2GPFD53KvwvHbTmJKrjLZyGxUaYtVR3zMaLPzvDRWerzT6ai22nVxC2WPStQepsU.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48a5mJrfDHAmwWoz38hgptfiWQnXDZdBjC7FvrycEqcnHCJdmNi4EnNSReLZSLbmQr.png)

>


![700 gr de pechuga de pollo, 01 limón, 01 cucharada de ajo en polvo, 03 cucharada de paprika ahumada, 02 cucharadas de aceite de oliva, 01 cucharada de maicena, 01 cucharadita de miel, 34 taza de a (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23yx7w9R2Cz77khEkoaSKiGdBqMmMhWrJ9ZYLDQSmcYdUcFKorzHhE7EaV547MsGQ9sbT.png)


<hr>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48YA3dVucGUQ3j5STqMX3enFGLhvzgymiszf9aqeZzxzyW8oooVgCVPH9wwS7LPMkv.png)

<div class=\

>
Lo primero que haremos es lavar las verduras, cortamos el puerro en ruedas, la cebolla en juliana, el calabacín en cubos y el jo triturlo. también amos a enjuagar el arroz y la dejamos escurrir por unos minuto. First, we’ll wash the vegetables; slice the leek into rounds, julienne the onion, dice the zucchini, and mince the garlic. We’ll also rinse the rice and let it drain for a few minutes.
![IMG_1492.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGwyws8zriyu7J5oPsiHY6Ar5XBdJmModk2UNFKg5vjQ9qqaSTcgC9o2v19evWjJJz.jpeg) ![IMG_1489.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoK6MbkQTvUtqUdzYMmgpkyaHa9x2mJ12hG729QSLMS8ue5jZ6XSCfWHAKodtGZUMcb.jpeg)

>
En una olla, calienta el aceite de oliva y rehoga el ajo y la cebolla, y después el puerro, hasta que estén tiernos y transparentes. >In a pot, heat the olive oil and sauté the garlic and onion, followed by the leek, until they are tender and translucent.
![IMG_1496.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoK3uc6Ng2DpVtQkahFRPQ4nfgbtqi4W4LFgeLuEjgnmWfwx71kEGuRwgfB3wwafKsR.jpeg)|![IMG_1498.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoeERLHESpShL6oTEWsHPeYSideCLPFUWib24b72KwnvTgvQsc8DY3M9jSanaMWCddy.jpeg) -|- ![IMG_1500.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoEp4iqJA4kXR9LhwidUaaCFq8C4k39FKNHGhqGJMcWAF9XoNPnc5p8p9j5rZmp4vM3.jpeg)|![IMG_1502.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EogMmgzhgJSVAsceawxMj25q7AmfurB64y51pxeTc1336cGrAxhiAQHoRf23GF6Eo5i.jpeg)

>
Ahora añade el arroz y la cúrcuma y saltea por un minuto. >Now add the rice and turmeric and sauté for one minute.
![IMG_1506.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGxRQ9gDDcYLjHer7VWA1XRGHMrH3WUmCXRiBAGdGgjG3hn25BRPyxsBTQdgXGTvdP.jpeg) ![IMG_1508.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAbDNCTMgk7UzuyEtNRp8d7v2yNGQXEP18aqDGXpQQHPdNXcWi73xbZ83dTQNeojqz.jpeg)

>
Añade el agua y el calabacín, y sazona con sal y pimienta. Cuando empiece a hervir, baja el fuego, tapa la olla y deja que se cocine hasta que el líquido se haya absorbido por completo. Déjalo tapado unos minutos más para que el vapor termine de cocinarlo, de modo que el arroz quede esponjoso y sueltecito. >Add the water and zucchini, then season with salt and pepper. When it comes to a boil, reduce the heat, cover, and let it cook until the liquid has been completely absorbed. Leave it covered for a few more minutes so the steam can finish cooking it, resulting in fluffy, loose rice.
![IMG_1510.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoc8YozJmewmDgaWEkQyvThordYP4Nd5kLyCjmNwrUadWNf8sTuUXAn12kafobGKghj.jpeg)|![IMG_1513.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eopr2F4wQXNBZpqK68cdYj2fNi23fjsEGXoyRdWEfaLxaTEmTstQCNk7pr4akgKUF7P.jpeg) -|- ![IMG_1515.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo6KVEEEqrRwMrWXoLb6Q4DsgXZC5fZkh4P6R2NWBgRxBsjeSANTm3R8i6FFGdMZQVe.jpeg) ![IMG_1517.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoc74xid2L6KPYU42kWav7uYpYX2zcex83rTzSweezN1yveCPjfCdwkrokYQpgvxhJq.jpeg)|![IMG_1519.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGvSbHZpPbH8XTbWpHwgtshN9K7D5Z7FczjWH3q5YhFsYSsbCugtvf5a7XgzgV5VWo.jpeg) -|- ![IMG_1521.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGzuduNzT7TS8N4ABDvuXNeTuj5hffVPuyeYPMgv2Ly8Dr3R9tjxPwhrXFvvnp8B52.jpeg)

title: HEALTHY HONEY MANGO OAT CAKE.
body:
> 

**Hello friends. Welcome to June.**

We are already halfway into the year and I hope it's going on well with you. 

**Join me let's bake this \

.** 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWBpLR3HpHLGetqxUuCWFcxzTJExdTgSa6ZHA5VZvPrVZ/1000084553.png 


It's mango season and I have been creating recipes with honey, cutting down the intake of sugar. These recipes are mostly cakes and pancakes. 

So, when I saw the **main ingredient: \

** for the [Qurator's Hive Top Chef's](https://peakd.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-hive-top-chef-or-honey) challenge, I remembered this healthy honey mango oat cake recipe I created recently and since it's mango season, why not? So you too can try it out. It's my first participation in the **Qurator's Hive's Top Chef challenge** and I'm glad to share this special recipe with you in the Hive Food community, which I created with love. Below are the ingredients and procedure. It's very easy to make. ### Ingredients **Note:** **Tsp**- Teaspoon **Tbsp**- Tablespoon https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVpPZ1pqYmBh6WBBVsDeiKc9Ffi1spRt71qgWLRJuK6Ft/1000046151.jpg - 1 cup of rolled oats (leveled) - 2 medium mangoes - 1 tsp of baking powder - ½ tsp of baking soda - 2 eggs - 1 tbsp of melted margarine (You can use butter) - 1 tbsp of raisins - ½ cup of milk - 2 tbsps of pure honey - 1tsp of vanilla flavour --- ### Procedure 1. Blend the oats into oat flour. You don't need to sieve the flour. 2. Then add the raisins and blend again until it's completely mixed, then pour into a dry bowl. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdwzDkoBz4122qVtVYgJodp9XFpSRFJwJPzPWESnexoDy/1000046152.jpg 3. Sieve the baking powder and baking soda into the oat and raisin mixture and mix well with a hand whisk. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQnxxQ8Z5CJ5zdsWok9GkBAtBYev6hpkcCMJcC2YfDUrt/1000046153.jpg 4. Peel off the mangoes and cut the inner part. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUkAVGpdHxkxjVvDHWxASN4EbWUHcQLSz2E2yMZFDXG5c/1000046154.jpg 5. Add honey and blend, then add to the blended oats and raisin mixture. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUrGVL4j15HwvL9DAAsWfFpqsqq2fK8Dd1UshTGTV14i4/1000084548.jpg 6. Add the melted margarine and gently mix with the hand whisk. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZRhpn6hxzTtEyPnmETRJVV63oJkMqnKqEgPvo8Wcacrr/1000046159.jpg 7. Break the eggs, whisk and add half of the whisked egg and mix gently and add the remaining and mix well. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSgedz1T3fMJGU5vYRzfSHymH2w4aS2CxeWqrrTWZdoaG/1000084549.jpg 8. Add milk and vanilla flavour and mix gently until well incorporated. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdX1Vzd4vsjpEwyaYZzJqpTid2ZUPdUF98gwcKXZABLQh/1000084550.jpg 9. Prepare the loaf pans. Grease with butter or oil and dust with flour for easy removal. 10. Pour in the honey mango oat batter and bake in a moderately preheated oven. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmasvZEWLMZfmc3FijVEGwjTB2Fcq4MJ771bS4cS3xK6Up/1000046164.jpg I baked it for 25 minutes first, checked it with a dry tooth pick and then baked for another 20 minutes and that's 45 minutes altogether. Now the healthy honey mango oat cake is ready. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYbvtUubDUkCkqbXaHRr1g2v4DD66iyYp8CSyre9bYyd1/1000046167.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf5crSKmRDV9MEL4SsCKikQhD7ASRqW4798mJHCfKAZ5p/1000084546.jpg This healthy honey mango oat cake is very soft, rich, delicious and irresistible. Those who tasted it confirmed it. It also melts in the mouth easily. Oh, this was heavenly! You need to try this recipe and I'm sure you will love it. --- **Thank you for visiting and taking the time to check out my recipe post. I would love to know your thoughts in the comments.** --- ![Winanda's quote- Life is beautiful..png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/winanda/Eq125gXX5zNNzLLMPVvzGhkUzNBoyTR1mxpoM1UxtcvW9vcwv1T2RZkyJuyePvDFaoQ.png) *Designed on Canva.* **Love from @winanda. Stay connected.** ♥️ *Thumbnail designed on Canva and the images are mine.* --- ***To begin your content creation journey on the Hive blockchain, sign up via [INLEO](https://inleo.io/signup?referral=winanda). Create threads, blogs, and vlogs and engage with other creators.*** ***Read [this post](https://inleo.io/@winanda/secure-your-space-build-a-brand-and-get-rewarded-in-cryto-leo-hive-hbd-hp-and-more-8ze?referral=winanda) for a guide.*** ***If you're a Nigerian, you can easily withdraw your HBD using [Ezabay](https://hives.ezabay.com/register?referral=5118919356). All you need is your email address to create an account.*** ***Make your cross-chain swaps in seconds on [LeoDex](https://leodex.io/?ref=earn4u) for zero or low gas fees.*** --- ---
**SEE YOU SOON IN MY NEXT BLOG.**

body:
> ##### **Hello to all my Hive friends... 🐱**
A new week in which I update rewards for my delegation in this beautiful community and the ZING tokens I have accumulated in stake. As usual, I bring you a new work of art. I have previously been inspired by the same creature, as the technique I practice is very versatile and I can create different models of elements or of the same character as such. Today, I was once again inspired by the Beautiful Healer of the Forest, for whom I’ve created many four-leaf clovers—a symbol so closely associated with her. That’s why I decided to make another one for you, this time with a different design, as a decorative quilling piece. I love this four-leaf clover so much—and, of course, the character herself—that I’m going to keep creating other pieces featuring different variations of this beautiful four-leaf clover. *I am attaching images of my progress in claiming the rewards for my delegation to Holozing, which so far amount to **750.46HP**, and I have accumulated **78,031.722** **$ZING** tokens in **Stake**.* **I hope you like my work, I leave you my creative process through images.** >># **Let's begin:😃**
![hj.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48FENd2cSJ42HQPsU72u78zCMvuJWnXLgoZFCb67XgreyBnMLAALDvQMQPR975kvvu.png)
##### **Hola a toda mi gente de Hive... 🐱**
Una nueva semana en la que actualizo recompensas en cuanto a la delegación que tengo en esta bonita comunidad y los tokens ZING que llevo acumulados en stake, les traigo como acostumbro un nuevo trabajo en mi arte, ya con anterioridad me ha inspirado en una misma criatura ya que la técnica que practico es muy versátil y puedo sacar diversos modelos de elementos o de un mismo personaje como tal. Para hoy me inspire nuevamente en la Bella sanadora del bosque de la cual he realizado múltiples trébol que es un icono tan representativo de ella, por esto decidí realizar otro para ustedes con un diseño diferente como una figura decorativa en la técnica de quilling. Me encanta tanto este trébol y por supuesto el personaje, que voy a seguir creando algunas otras piezas con diferentes modelos de este bello trébol de 4 hojas. *Les adjunto imágenes de lo que ha sido mi progreso reclamando las recompensas por mi delegación a Holozing que hasta ahora son **750.46HP**, y llevo un acumulado en **Stake** de **78,031.722** tokens **$ZING**.* **Espero sea de su agrado mi trabajo, les dejo mi proceso creativo mediante imágenes.**

孝感方特终于来了，今天开启了预售~

因为是老家的那边的玩乐项目，本身也在我回老家的路上，所以，我也是格外关注这个项目。期待着什么时候能开园，之前是说五一，结果五一没开成。

现在终于明确了，6月17日就可以开园了，今天开始放出前期的优惠票。一个新的游乐园，开业肯定是优惠不少。

从我家开车到孝感方特，导航的时间也就是45分钟。实在太方便，比到武汉的欢乐谷还方便。如果从我老家过去，估计20来分钟就OK了。之前其实也在关注荆州那边的方特，但是武汉开车过去要2个多小时，要过去玩的话，必须安排住上一天才行。

孝感这边的，完全不用担心住的问题，当天去当天回，或者回孝感老家。都是性价比贼高。

反正能够想象得到，娃应该是很开心的。我们之前规划旅游的地方，一些纯逛纯看的，娃基本毫无兴趣。我们之前还特意去了趟珠海长隆，那个就是纯玩，还是室内的，很友好。

孝感这边的优势，就是贼近。孝感这边有两个主题园，一个狂野大陆，一个水上乐园。

title: Brigada Eskwela - Realization of what it truly means to be a Teacher | Philippines
body: /> To be honest before I joined Brigada Eskwela I thought it was about cleaning the classrooms before the school year starts. You know, just sweep here wipe there paint a little and then go home. It seemed simple. After spending a whole day volunteering for Brigada Eskwela I realized that it is not just about cleaning the schools. It actually shows the reality of being a teacher that many people do not see. This year I was with CTE organizations when we participated in Brigada Eskwela at Malinta Elementary School. Each organization had least five members who volunteered to help get the school ready for the start of classes. As volunteers we cleaned around 15 areas in the school including the classrooms and other spaces. We did a lot of tasks like cleaning the rooms, gardening, painting washing the curtains and rugs waxing the floor and cleaning the chairs and tables.
/> At first it was really tiring. The sun was hot it was exhausting. Sometimes it was dirty.

/> While I was doing those simple tasks I found myself looking around the classrooms. I saw the chairs, the learning materials and the walls that the teachers worked hard to decorate.. Then it hit me. As a teacher I realized how much teachers sacrifice without anyone noticing. People often say that teachers just teach,. After seeing things up close I realized that being a teacher is more than just standing in front of a classroom. Teachers do a lot of things like cleaning organizing, decorating and preparing learning materials. What is sad to realize is that many teachers in the Philippines are not paid enough. They still spend their own money to make the classrooms better for their students. Imagine earning a salary and still buying materials with your own money because you want your students to learn in a comfortable and meaningful environment. Sometimes the salary is not even enough. The teachers still use their own money to buy things like classroom decorations learning materials, electric fans, supplies and little things that the students may not even notice. While I was cleaning that day I kept thinking: this is how hard it is to be a teacher.. Somehow instead of discouraging me it made me admire the teachers even more. If I become a teacher one day I want to be the kind of teacher who creates a classroom where the students feel safe, welcome and excited to learn. A classroom that may not be perfect but feels warm and cozy. A classroom where you can feel the effort that the teacher put in. Because Brigada Eskwela made me realize something, behind every clean classroom organized chair decorated wall and peaceful learning environment is a teacher who quietly gave their effort time, patience and sometimes even their own money.

/>

Honestly that realization has stayed with me.

title: [Movie] The World to Come (2020)/A beautiful love story between two women
body:
Another movie that surprised me was **The World to Come (2020)**. I remember I was looking for a romantic and sweet movie, and this one popped up in the search results. I'd never heard of it before, so I gave it a chance. It started off very slowly, but that didn't discourage me. I thought the movie was about two friends, one of whom would fall in love with the other's husband, starting a rivalry between them. But it turned out the plot was completely different.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23uQnVooaVGXZESdFNHZAe7i3JPpsUtXyNXL7csY6kjp1R3k8hbPr7Bnnk2cUo6xbT9w8.png)
[source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/en/filmimages.php?movie_id=210041)

I won't give you any spoilers, but I will say that it's a film set in 19th-century rural New York. The story is about two women marginalized by their marriages who find refuge and passion—and yes, guys, a lot of passion.

![MV5BYjJmYTFjNzctOTgxYi00ZTQyLTk4ZTktZDNjM2ExYjlkZjJiXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com /file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23wC37ezTpWqz5S1zTTU8nnW1Ls3PWXnyfUxBrPmk7LL6ifd53qWggG7jTAxALQRJt9ft.jpg)
[source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt9738716/mediaviewer/rm1655492865/)


A forbidden romance in the middle of the forest. I loved the performances of the two lovestruck girls, played by Katherine Waterston (Abigail) and Vanessa Kirby (Tally). They are very complex characters who evoke a range of emotions: love, tenderness, anger, despair, and resignation. They are excellent actresses. Their performances are complex and profound. I found the ending very sad and even cried. It wasn't the ending I would have wanted, but that's how movies and real life are; sometimes things don't go as planned.

As for the husbands, their performances were very different. While one was understanding, the other was offensive and dangerous. They were two completely different personalities and greatly influenced the plot.

This movie is recommended for anyone who enjoys suffering for love. I give it an 80 because the ending is very sad and tragic. I prefer happy endings.

Thanks for reading.

____

I used Google Translate

_Rating: **80/100**_

---

title: CCC's Street Art Contest # 303 -Where does art really begin?
body:
### Good morning, everyone! #### Welcome to another post in the [Street Art community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-184784/created)! There’s a type of graffiti that I have to admit I’m not particularly fond of. I’m talking about tags. In my view, I don’t deny that there’s a certain mastery and skill involved in the technique used to create details—which obviously include, in addition to perspective, other elements that add greater interest to the piece. We have the lighting, the impact (which is almost never overlooked, and in my view may even be related to a need for self-affirmation, both locally and within the local graffiti community), the colors (which obviously have to work together, playing with warmer tones and cooler tones for contrast), and the location. Taking all these elements into account, there are some specific situations where this type of work—lettering (if that’s not the correct term, please correct me. I’d be very grateful!)—actually brings some life to the wall that was used as a canvas. On a short walk I took near my house, just a short distance away, I passed by an electrical substation—I think that’s what it’s called—and what had been immaculately painted a little over two years ago—at the time, for the local elections—now features graffiti that has added some color to it. But does everything count? Is everything art? What is considered art by some may not be by others. And there, there will always be a line. But we can’t dismiss a piece just because we don’t find it particularly interesting. What actually caught my attention was the phrase on the side of that small street structure, where you can read “Techno is sexy By: Callipo.” This guy is well known in the area, and not for the best reasons. There was a time when he was simply scribbling all over every wall with disjointed phrases and completely erratic tags. Building walls, storefronts, entrances, and garage doors—and, of course, many walls at the train station. And he didn’t bring anything new or artistic to the area. Which brings me to the obvious question: “Does it all count?” I’m going to keep believing that there’s art and there’s “trash.” Sorry for my honest opinion. Just a little while ago, in a brief exchange of messages with Heroldius, he showed me a fantastic piece he shared in this post—one that had been published before but is now completely covered up by other graffiti ([original post](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-802-hoxxoh-mural-festival-2025-montreal)). I hope this mural has sparked your interest in commenting and sharing your opinion on this particular topic. In Portugal, fortunately, street art—and graffiti in particular—is becoming increasingly accepted, largely due to the excellent work that has been done, with support from local governments and private institutions.

title: 建議僅供參考，並不過度要求
body: >Unsplash 給人建議是很多人一種友善的表現，但有的時候會適得其反，成為一種討人厭的感受，大致上的情況就是，給別人建議後，別人並不理睬，就產生了負面情緒，然後如果事後如自己所料，就會產生一種優越感，有的會說看吧不聽我的，又或是幸災樂禍。 另一種情況是好意過頭，覺得自己提出了建議，別人就應該要照著做，不做的都是不接受好意，老是說我自己覺得已經稱不上建議，而是控制、命令。建議我個人還是偏向多給人家一個選項，最後判斷還是由當事人決定。 可能我比較沒溫度一些，我覺得在不影響到我的情況下，別人的決定我不想過度干涉，像是朋友家人的一些決定，也不會太過度的去勸說，我會講出自己的想法與經驗，要不要聽，要不要參考，還是要對方自己思量。 回想起朋友W，當初他意氣風發的時候，曾經勸過他思考以後的事情，要提早準備後路，因為他的生意並不是長長久久，但我也知道以他的性格就是表面答應，可能轉頭就忘了這回事，特別是順風順水的狀況下。 後來W的境遇讓人不勝唏噓，生意沒了，家庭也破散，自己也背上了法律責任，只是早些年就比較少往來，出事後也沒來找我，可能已經不是那麼親密，我也不想去打擾他，如果是我的話，也許會不太想見一些曾經給過建議的人，特別早就點出問題，自己卻無視。我也不會說自己早預料到這樣的情況，畢竟實際發生的超乎我的預期，原本以為頂多生意失敗，朋友要重新面對而已。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/7gb72w)

title: 🌵 A Journey Through the Heart of Agave Country
body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVtAQhNMB2TCtqTFhS9iYSKbm3SkfVmJxYVpArL8FuSuY/IMG_0052.png 


One of the things I love most about traveling is discovering places that tell a story without saying a single word.

Today I had the chance to spend some time surrounded by endless rows of agave plants, stretching across the landscape as far as the eye could see. There was something peaceful about being there, feeling the warm air, admiring the scenery, and appreciating the connection between nature, tradition, and culture.

Traveling isn't always about checking destinations off a list. Sometimes it's about slowing down, taking in the view, and enjoying a place for what it is. Those are often the moments that stay with me the longest.

Every trip teaches me something new. Sometimes it's about history, sometimes it's about people, and sometimes it's simply about learning to appreciate the beauty that already exists around us.

This was one of those days I know I'll remember for a long time. ✨

Because Brigada Eskwela made me realize something, behind every clean classroom organized chair decorated wall and peaceful learning environment is a teacher who quietly gave their effort time, patience and sometimes even their own money.

/>

Honestly that realization has stayed with me.

title: Chorizo Stew with Plantains (Eng/Esp)
body:
> My lunch today was light; I decided to sauté smoked chorizo with onions, bell peppers, and red bell pepper, and served it with boiled plantains—a delicious combination that captivated my senses. I also liked how easy this recipe was to make; it took very little time, and I ended up with a truly exquisite dish.
![1000449187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zkpHUGtDXCzyZ5EUA9jt6nXPaSQgg1As3DncwxwLGSqEqcp5nGv5UnyoSSkFi1KEneP.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 1 smoked chorizo - 3 onions - 6 sweet peppers - 1 red bell pepper - Plantain - Pinch of salt - 2 1/2 cups of water - Oil
![1000449182.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xyREnizgpVU1Un9EFpvG4bBTYLpejWCX67eJfEBGpAQwAN8ec74nQVqpjR673LZhDT1.jpg)
## Preparation: When I take charge of the kitchen, I like to organize my utensils and ingredients; that way, I enjoy the process and creating appealing aromas and textures. First, I selected and washed the herbs, then I removed the seeds from the chili peppers and the bell pepper. I diced everything. Next, I peeled the onions and chopped them into pieces. I also washed the smoked chorizo and sliced it.
![1000449183.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yTf8yygX4qMD1AFjaMiievJ9JjMErNTFyVd7Avu29wSRk7gjUAeEzgz4mDRXbPLnvVX.jpg)
![1000449184.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmHdcdYVuesPoXLyrGRPtDJQCdBSKULFLaGSvXsDtqYnFmXgJnBpmFxGW61bWPYmtn3.jpg)
The next step was to slice the plantain with its skin on and parboil it in two cups of water. It was ready in ten minutes. I turned off the heat and waited for it to cool before peeling off the skins. At the same time, I heated a skillet, drizzled in a little oil, and added the seasonings. When they turned translucent, I added the chorizo and adjusted the salt to taste.
![1000449185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23u6FSfRTUoTHMsFgLQyBXf8hpDneY59ZHbxJgSPPSRrSngdfXY3NkmYoVddPmHcAm2yE.jpg)
![1000449186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23u69F52kaTaMsGHFKqWbybdEbmW6B2FSZo7VPJfGtFBj8i25Gm1zjmr7TZq95Lowj1yQ.jpg)
Finally, I added half a cup of water; I wanted the stew to have plenty of sauce to bring out the smoky flavor, which I find quite pleasant. The last step was to serve it on a plate and enjoy this delicious dish. I love simple recipes that are full of flavor. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Mi almuerzo de hoy fue ligero, opté por guisar chorizo ahumado con cebollas, ajíes y pimentón, además acompañé con plátano sancochado, una deliciosa combinación que cautivó mis sentidos. También me gustó porque resultó práctico realizar esta receta, invertí poco tiempo y degusté un plato realmente exquisito.
![1000449187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zkpHUGtDXCzyZ5EUA9jt6nXPaSQgg1As3DncwxwLGSqEqcp5nGv5UnyoSSkFi1KEneP.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 1 chorizo ahumando - 3 cebollas - 6 ajíes dulces - 1 pimentón rojo - Plátano - Pizca de sal - 2 tazas y 1/2 de agua - Aceite
![1000449182.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xyREnizgpVU1Un9EFpvG4bBTYLpejWCX67eJfEBGpAQwAN8ec74nQVqpjR673LZhDT1.jpg)
## Preparación: Cuando tomo el control de la cocina me agrada organizar utensilios e ingredientes, así disfruto del proceso y de crear atractivos aromas y texturas. Primero seleccioné y lavé los aliños, luego quité las semillas de los ajíes y el pimentón. Todo lo corté en cuadritos. Posteriormente, quité las conchas de las cebollas y piqué en pedazos. También lavé el chorizo ahumado y lo corté en rodajas.
![1000449183.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yTf8yygX4qMD1AFjaMiievJ9JjMErNTFyVd7Avu29wSRk7gjUAeEzgz4mDRXbPLnvVX.jpg)
![1000449184.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tmHdcdYVuesPoXLyrGRPtDJQCdBSKULFLaGSvXsDtqYnFmXgJnBpmFxGW61bWPYmtn3.jpg)
El siguiente paso fue picar el plátano en rodajas con su concha y ponerlo a sancochar con dos tazas de agua. En diez minutos estaba listo. Apagué y esperé que se enfriara para retirar las cáscaras. De forma paralela monté un sartén, eché un chorrito de aceite y agregué los aliños, cuando observé que se transparentaron, añadí el chorizo y ajusté el punto de sal.
![1000449185.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23u6FSfRTUoTHMsFgLQyBXf8hpDneY59ZHbxJgSPPSRrSngdfXY3NkmYoVddPmHcAm2yE.jpg)
![1000449186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23u69F52kaTaMsGHFKqWbybdEbmW6B2FSZo7VPJfGtFBj8i25Gm1zjmr7TZq95Lowj1yQ.jpg)
Finalmente agregué media taza de agua, quería que el guiso quedara con suficiente salsa, para aprovechar el efecto del sabor ahumado, que para mí gusto es bastante agradable. El último paso fue servir en un plato y disfrutar de esta delicia, me encantan las recetas sencillas y llenas de sabor.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title: Two out of five experts are actually calling the NBA championship for the Knicks!
body:
This has really surprised me and this as well as my incorrect guesses across the entirety of the championship has lead me to believe that the NBA finals could actually be really good.  

While I am an armchair quarterback for the most part and base a lot of my decisions on both feelings and betting stats, the real experts get paid a lot of money to come up with more substantiated evidence of how it is that they feel that way.

5 experts were chosen for their opinion about who is going to be the 2026 NBA champions and I really expected 5-0 in favor of the Spurs or maybe one dissenter.  I was surprised that two of them went that way.

<center> https://s.yimg.com/uu/api/res/1.2/i2pkhDm8IGtGA6SAvbF2zw--~B/Zmk9c3RyaW07aD00Nzg7dz0xMTk0O2FwcGlkPXl0YWNoeW9u/https://d29szjachogqwa.cloudfront.net/images/user-uploaded/ed-060126-nbafinals-mod_7830.jpg.cf.webp
[src](https://s.yimg.com/uu/api/res/1.2/i2pkhDm8IGtGA6SAvbF2zw--~B/Zmk9c3RyaW07aD00Nzg7dz0xMTk0O2FwcGlkPXl0YWNoeW9u/https://d29szjachogqwa.cloudfront.net/images/user-uploaded/ed-060126-nbafinals-mod_7830.jpg.cf.webp)</center> 

Kelly Iko (who is a man btw) chose the Spurs without hesitation.  His reasoning is a couple of really big deals including their superior regular season, the fact the team is more youthful, and that this is not a \

which is what the Knicks appear to be on at the moment.

Dan Devine focuses more on the emotion and the single series vs the Thunder than anything else.  He didn't hesitate to choose the Spurs

Tom Haberstroh took a minute to get there but chose the Knicks.   He has some level of bias admitting he is an old-school Knicks fan but pointed to the fact that the Spurs beat an OKC team that was missing two of their better players in  Jalen Williams and Ajay Mitchell - which is true for the most part.   He did admit that this Knicks team seems unpredictable since they seemed to completely turn it on in the post-season in a way that was not exhibited in the regular season.

Ben Rohrbach didn't have much to say but acknowledged that the 11-win run the Knicks are on is impressive, but that they have not yet faced a team the caliber of the Spurs, the Thunder, or even the Timberwolves.  He believes if the Knicks get worked over in game 1 that the season is over

Steve Jones pointed to historical statistical connections and I like that.  He said the Knicks are only 1 of 5 teams EVER to score 11 wins consecutively in the playoffs and the ONLY team to ever have 3 wins in the same post-season series by 30 points or more.  The biggest thing he stated was that their coaching seems to be able to identify weaknesses and solve those problems when they occur.  

<hr>

It should be exciting and while I think that sport pundits always try to make any matchup seem as exciting as possible going into it because at the end of the day they work for the NBA in a roundabout way but they all make some really good points.

I tend to ID with Steve Jones the most and he out of all the pundits has the most experience actually playing and coaching the game, when he says that the problem solving is going to be a huge factor.   The Knicks haven't faced a team this explosive in the playoffs and it will be interesting to see what they are going to do when they are faced with it.  

I also believe that the first game is extremely important.  Win or lose that first game, the game needs to be kept close for morale purposes because that is such a huge part of basketball.  

At the moment the Spurs are favored by 4.5 points in game one.

title: Braised meat (Eng/Esp)
body:
> This stewed meat is absolutely delicious; I love it as a perfect lunch option. I chose onions, bell peppers, and a red bell pepper to give it great flavor. This recipe is spectacular with rice or spaghetti; this time I went with the first option, though I usually enjoy it with potatoes, cassava, and taro, among other options.
![1000449180.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tbyCBxjntVBWv5Q6owZ76BkzPuySY3vPRdUUk611BMdztonMTHwRUmHNq5JkCFet9u4.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 300 grams of stewing beef - 3 onions - 8 sweet peppers - 1 red bell pepper - Pinch of salt - Oil
![1000449168.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wgaNiVAZq5SR9zyeFikJg4vnYRSCAoJXRcbXjPhwWgQJQBkpvU5bBuRzU74RGsQEGRu.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the vegetables thoroughly; the essential step is to remove the seeds from both the bell peppers and the paprika. This is the first thing I do when I enter the kitchen, so it has become a routine part of preparing stews. After peeling the onions, I proceeded to chop all the ingredients into small pieces. Next, I soaked the meat in water to clean it and cut it into smaller pieces, since it usually comes pre-cut.
![1000449172.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xAiMHyrQ7nRvGPTHKtGB29Fxs1iH9tWXyXBkhm1AsQtfbRvusi8hiH78HLAQFgLo49z.jpg)
![1000449173.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tc3Vmscb3htfCACGCrsNG1HEYaZ3h4u6tDUEShc6CL3yrN4PrggEn7saiuvj7giZ1k5.jpg)
Next, I heated a skillet on the stove and poured in two tablespoons of oil. I added the seasonings along with a pinch of salt and let them soften. Shortly after, I added the ground meat and stirred until all the ingredients were well combined.
![1000449174.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQyAhjP7Dj9EZm56oeFHiK3Cssj7Atc2dF8vEPzK3Db8TqgRFzioLwHYYYAWabf2WjN.jpg)
I turned down the heat, put a lid on, and the steam helped with the cooking. In fifteen minutes, the meat was tender and well-seasoned. I really liked the result, especially when served with white rice—every bite was a delight for the palate. See you in the next post—maybe tomorrow I’ll make a dessert because it’s only fair and necessary 😊 *** ***
## Versión en Español

> La carne guisada es muy deliciosa, me encanta como una opción ideal para el almuerzo. Elegí cebollas, ajíes dulces y un pimentón para darle buen gusto. Esta receta es espectacular con arroz o espaguetis, esta vez elegí la primera opción, aunque suelo disfrutarla también con papas, yuca y ocumo, entre otras alternativas.
![1000449180.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tbyCBxjntVBWv5Q6owZ76BkzPuySY3vPRdUUk611BMdztonMTHwRUmHNq5JkCFet9u4.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 300 gramos de carne para guisar - 3 cebollas - 8 ajíes dulces - 1 pimentón rojo - Pizca de sal - Aceite
![1000449168.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wgaNiVAZq5SR9zyeFikJg4vnYRSCAoJXRcbXjPhwWgQJQBkpvU5bBuRzU74RGsQEGRu.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé muy bien los aliños, el paso obligado es retirar las semillas tanto de ajíes dulces como del pimentón. Esto es lo primero que hago al entrar a la cocina, así que se ha convertido en un acto rutinario cuando de trata de preparar guisos. Luego de desconchar la cebollas, procedí a cortar todos los ingredientes en pedacitos. Posteriormente sumergí la carne en agua para limpiarla y la dividí en trozos más pequeños, pues usualmente ya viene con un corte predeterminado.
![1000449172.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xAiMHyrQ7nRvGPTHKtGB29Fxs1iH9tWXyXBkhm1AsQtfbRvusi8hiH78HLAQFgLo49z.jpg)
![1000449173.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tc3Vmscb3htfCACGCrsNG1HEYaZ3h4u6tDUEShc6CL3yrN4PrggEn7saiuvj7giZ1k5.jpg)
Después monté un sartén en la cocina y allí vertí dos cucharadas de aceite, agregué los aliños, junto a un toque de sal, esperé que ablandaran. Poco después añadí la carne picada y mezclé hasta juntar todos los ingredientes.
![1000449174.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uQyAhjP7Dj9EZm56oeFHiK3Cssj7Atc2dF8vEPzK3Db8TqgRFzioLwHYYYAWabf2WjN.jpg)
Bajé el fuego, coloqué una tapa y el vapor ayudó a la cocción. En quince minutos la carne estaba suave y con buena sazón. Me gustó mucho el resultado, sobre todo al acompañar esta preparación con arroz blanco, cada bocado era una delicia para el paladar. title: Malveae | The Silent Beauty Of Golden Flowers
body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXNzwPJuwwc28tdPJvjAVHzojt83Fv5PJ1P1EkRmNX6oz/1780456123566.jpg)



| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ |
|     Malveae      |      Jun 02, 2026      |       Vodrochol, Ullapara, Bangladesh      | 

Yesterday morning, while walking in nature, I saw this wild flower. This small wild flower looked quite beautiful. But I could not feel the beauty of this flower at first because the flower was very small, only when I felt its beauty up close could I enjoy its full beauty. What a beautiful moment of nature, how beautifully nature has created this scene with its own hands.

I actually passed by the flower two or three times but my eyes did not catch it that way, but when I suddenly saw it and took some pictures, I saw a unique beauty of nature. The combination of the bright yellow hue of this flower and the green blurred background behind it fascinated me. The bright golden petals became more vibrant in the morning light. When viewed up close, its delicate structure, soft petals and the design of the center remind me of the perfect artwork of nature.

Now I am sharing some pictures of this wildflower below, I hope everyone will like it and enjoy it.

body: > Recently, we decided to do something different and organized a small contest in collaboration with the guys from @clan-shimazu. The idea was simple but motivating: whoever created the best post of the week would win a complimentary haircut. After reviewing some great entries, the winner turned out to be @jesusfitswc. Since this wasn't just any regular day, we wanted to make the prize truly memorable and take the experience out of the traditional barber shop setting. # We packed up the essential tools and headed down to the city’s waterfront boardwalk to do the job right by the sea. To be honest, it was an incredible choice. The weather was completely on our side, offering a pleasantly cool and slightly cloudy morning that made sitting outside an absolute pleasure. Cutting hair with the ocean breeze and the sound of the waves in the background added a unique, relaxing vibe to the whole experience, something you just can't replicate in my closed-door barber shop. # As the session went on, the conversation flowed naturally, making the time fly by. We talked about projects, daily life, and ideas for the community while keeping things light and friendly. Despite working in an outdoor environment with the wind blowing, the final result of the haircut was spot on. The look came out clean and sharp, and @jesusfitswc left completely satisfied. # The vibe was so good and the feedback so positive that we have already decided to repeat the dynamic for this coming weekend. The competition is officially open again, so we will see who steps up their game and wins the next fresh cut. Thanks for stopping by, see you in the next post!

title: Berdikari Coffee & Space | It's the food, not the coffee unfortunately
body:
![DSCF2317.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23u5bKbvnEZsUvJMRcp14uEqw6pm7x9dEv2CeUysLrwipkM66efGNeow3m8EFVN61RZbF.JPG)

# I had low expectations for this place. 

Not only because the place that’s located a little hidden, every new coffee spot I’ve visited lately is either trying too hard to be aesthetic or serves coffee that feels just like drinking bitter water. If you have visited way too many coffee spaces as I do, you directly notice it. But my friends and I were not visiting this place for the coffee, I heard the food is sort of decent.

![DSCF2313.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23tvB1rxH1et3DeufiF5NCGpbx8Nq44rteXqhfx1kWsuLEseHcXdNvYtdeRZAxhSyb1Le.JPG) 

We got there around noon as we were hungry after chugging coffee in another place. There were plenty of options in their menu which had me confused but I knew just what to get especially after many months of not eating spicy food and craving a certain food from the city, Nasi Ayam Geprek. 


![DSCF2319.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23tvCatirxQqhjvEyoynjgsni13nAr7SN8RvLmTJNzj1rVWUH6NxTw3B8SxmcZjodRxwk.JPG)


I didn’t expect the portion would be just enough. The chicken was crispy and the sambal complemented it so well that my craving goes away in an instant. Then I also ordered a platter of fried chicken skin on the side and shared it with my friends. It wasn’t as oily as any other place would serve it. 


![DSCF2314.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23uEyuHnDff1YgN1xgKirjiDV4mDCGhDrTKv29gstHLUe4HmCz8oE74DRAsn1jET6qeCv.JPG)


My friend ordered the Nashville chicken with rice and they said it was delicious. For us, it's a place where we can return to for the meal, not the coffee though. 

At this point, a cafe is either going to serve you a really good coffee or a really good food. Hardly any cafe would serve both. 



![DSCF2320.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23wWrvzbMe8AEr5nB2Pz6Pq1QcYpvNuABJPTDacADjPBSFCf7yEiTQbWe3Fgqsn4JC16f.JPG)

The fried chicken skin as I said wasn't so oily and it was that good. It was crispy with good batter as if they have unlocked the true secret of making fried chicken skin. 

![DSCF2321.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23xVCuBtSq3ZLz4m9mWZf5jfpYLKebLteVEaot8zJtSnzyiknDf7VooE8NadrFgz1T6A4.JPG)


Now that I am back to the \

, I am happy knowing that I am living close to plenty spots that serves good coffee and meal!

title: ‎When Love Lives in Your Home, No Day Is Truly Boring ‎
body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎Around 3:45am, I woke up to be owl and came across this prompt to talk about was my day boring, chaotic or interesting?
‎
‎If someone asked me whether today was boring, chaotic, or interesting, I would honestly say it was a bit of both chaotic and interesting. One thing I know for sure, though, is that I don't think any day can ever be boring for me.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQma8nj5SF7wVCk47BoU2EqWhEMhFH2LeunX1yNjJXHzJTe/IMG_20260323_074420_476.jpg 

‎
‎The reason is simple, and that is I have my wife and kids around me.
‎
‎No matter how stressful a day gets, coming home to them always changes everything. My children have a way of bringing life into every moment. Sometimes it's their laughter, their endless questions, or even the little troubles they create that keep the house lively. My wife is my greatest support system, and having her by my side makes even difficult days easier to handle.
‎
‎There are days when I am tired and just want to rest, but somehow my kids always find a way to pull me into their world. And before I know it, I'm already smiling, laughing, or listening to one of their funny stories. Those moments may seem ordinary, but they are the things that make my days special. That is why I can never describe my life as boring. My family gives colour to my everyday routine and constantly reminds me of what truly matters.
‎
‎Even though, I won't pretend that everything has been cheerful lately. For the past couple of weeks, I have been deeply disturbed by the news of the schoolchildren who were kidnapped in Oyo State and are still being held captive. Every time I see a video or read an update about the situation, my heart sinks.
‎
‎As a parent, it is impossible not to think about those children and what they might be going through. It is even harder not to imagine the pain their parents and family members must be feeling right now. I honestly cannot begin to understand how they manage to cope with the fear, uncertainty, and helplessness of the situation.
‎
‎Whenever I look at my own children, I find myself thinking about those families and wishing they could hold their kids again. It is a painful reminder that while some of us are enjoying precious moments with our loved ones, others are desperately praying for the safe return of theirs.
‎
‎So, if I had to describe today, I would say it was chaotic because of the emotions stirred by those heartbreaking events, yet interesting because I got to spend another beautiful day with the people I love most.
‎
‎And for that, I remain grateful.
‎

around 4:11  am

body.body: > ### English _______ # Making New Friends in the Paradise of Menorca, Spain _________ The afternoon was drawing to a close amid laughter and glances. The sun had been beating down since noon, revealing one of the most beautiful beaches I’ve ever had the blessing of visiting. Golden and orange sand, alongside paths that looked as if they’d been dyed with iron, made of reddish rock and gravel. The undulating terrain traced harmonious green silhouettes, full of grasses and shrubs. Northern Menorca was beginning to captivate me, in that almost instantaneous moment, like when you get a *crush* after a single glance. It was as if the sea were enveloping me and as if the chatter and laughter of the people around me were seducing me with whispers in my ears.

> > ### Español ______ > # Haciendo nuevos amigos en el paraíso de Menorca, España > La tarde caía entre risas y miradas. El sol había golpeado desde el mediodía, dejando ver una de las playas más bonitas que he tenido la bendición de conocer. > Arena dorada y anaranjada, junto a senderos que parecían teñidos en hierro, de roca y ripio rojizos. Los desniveles del terreno dibujaban siluetas armoniosas de verde, repletas de hierbas y arbustos. > El norte de Menorca empezaba a enamorarme, en aquel momento casi flash, como cuando hay un *crush* tras una simple mirada. > Era como si el mar me envolviera y como si las charlas y las risas de las personas que estaban alrededor estuvieran seduciéndome con susurros al oído. ________________________ ![IMG_5399.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqQN71QeQPfpARwfLFBzkHynT1gWk9cCHFBQXNVbkn7MTtoo35H3j931aV4ogetwFWo.jpeg) ![IMG_5403.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqhNKyp3XegZKCJYCrewu2ccCRHDbgJskigPvULaQ2vBQT4zWB8qTC1qPV8ZFsiM88o.jpeg) ![IMG_5409.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqYsJKNoYcVAggp6MVJ4JHKDPAiCA7Dz2BfDmFm9TT6AzDPePEa1UADB7c5zWGtLPuH.jpeg) ![IMG_5413.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EprQkbWjD9LNBqWZ6VmVG7JAERB24Bpa1fzn1Zx6GyPNo8K54nm2VxbFdHCT4fNvuyY.jpeg) ![IMG_5428.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Eqd7ZnuMWPiFxxYi8bt2Jb3buTofifbBsekLdxV1KNQ939u8iqqZfuGYrwRWm1zKQB3.jpeg) ![IMG_5420.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqFq7CAqqmQnJus7AkMeZM4hp35GVjsnCQXCQgNGW4jnVRuz8nHq5EeQSgHacbEN27X.jpeg) ![IMG_5422.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23zRviEdkshVUev6KharjnEYCHdfLZiYBqa6mtLFNdXw8tP6YX5cwvFfYXXnshTxCtCFe.jpeg) _______________

> That afternoon, I found myself giving thanks over and over again—for stepping outside my comfort zone, for changing my plans, for allowing myself to take that trip to *Cavallería*, one of Menorca’s most famous beaches. Famous for its pink sand, famous because its landscape looks like something out of prehistory, and it’s as if time itself stands still there. There’s no cell service there, and for a few hours, life is simply about enjoying that exact moment. The sun, the warm sand, the crystal-clear, cool water, the views, and of course, the company. We didn’t know who would arrive or when, we couldn’t communicate, we didn’t know if anyone had posted some story irrelevant to our lives on social media, and we didn’t know if anyone was trying to contact us—just for a few hours.

> > Agradecí varias veces aquella tarde, por haber salido de mi estructura, por haber cambiado mis planes, por haberme permitido hacer aquel viaje a *Cavallería*, una de las playas más famosas de Menorca. Famosa por arena rosa, famosa porque su paisaje parece de la prehistoria y es como si en el lugar, el tiempo se detuviese. > No hay señal de internet en ese sitio, y por unas horas la vida sencillamente consiste en disfrutar de ese preciso momento. Del sol, de la arena cálida, del agua cristalina y fresca, de las vistas y claro que también de la compañía. > No sabíamos quién llegaría ni cuando, no podíamos comunicarnos, no sabíamos si alguien había subido alguna historia irrelevante para nuestras vidas en alguna red social, y desconocíamos si alguien estaba intentando contactarnos, solo por unas horas. ___________
![IMG_5522.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/243frgZTqhaBArQoT6rvweCAKon8QcDB154qcTGyqWgNnhBEHMyZCs6fyNfDAM8n7xSJm.jpeg)
![IMG_5524.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/243Be8ZhWcLcSEAtmVZnbHEgRF5gXVn2vQJwQ564r9NbdfxcD3MXmQtCCJbMtpnyYM6Mk.jpeg)
![IMG_5525.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpNmtC6D8KnU6MztrgXuBRc283JC36MowRAa8ygVxADV4rds9dRT5F1MS6ZzJ29YozU.jpeg)
![IMG_5494.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/243zVa4shQFqFgmHytBPrW1E2F3w8SsBz5RL2v1sALyrgMvSJDiH2icB217KxcxN6GtcQ.jpeg)
![IMG_5511.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23ywm21JiRjsMgvz9gUS2dwXdSRi8xHBSWETZj5hiQGqYPyvWF8uHdNJ6xEDTE4xDysAq.jpeg)
___________________

> Do you know what we did? We played ball in the ocean, went for a group hike, took photos, laughed, soaked up the sun, shared details of our lives, exchanged a little Italian for Spanish, made plans for the future together, and went paddleboarding. Cavallería Beach was all ours—a group of near-strangers who happened to meet in a corner of Menorca about three weeks ago. Lots of earth signs, lots of Virgos like me, lots of environmental awareness. A beautiful energy—the kind that makes you want to hug people, but above all, to be grateful.

> > ¿Saben lo que hicimos? > Jugamos a la pelota en el agua del mar, fuimos a hacer una caminata en grupo, nos tomamos fotos, nos reímos, tomamos sol, nos contamos detalles de nuestras vidas, intercambiamos un poco de italiano con español, pensamos en planes futuros juntos, paseamos en paddle surf. > La playa de Cavallería era toda nuestra, de un grupo de casi desconocidos que hace unas tres semanas coincidimos en un rincón de Menorca. > Muchos signos de tierra, muchos virgo como yo, mucha conciencia ambiental. Una energía bonita, de esa que dan ganas de abrazar pero sobre todo, de agradecer. __________ ![IMG_5439.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqUbSeQA9NXNW6j9tFSfcJdbzmLPerkbVhNmTY6vpCH686c6UwFGEEdwqUqkGB8zYcJ.jpeg) ![IMG_5443.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EpEGMKXvpZKys5LH8mzddtmtcxDfovzdfuPSsdKPRogpWXpmW7tWamb4C7A6fcEsGjR.jpeg) ![IMG_5447.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/Ep7ubQ9gWSGtdrc8e9gEk4uSAioC6ZtGr7DY4DC2gh8SK8WPRk934Gv7XpJf2YgHBrf.jpeg) ![IMG_5448.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23uFRphPZhUJSuL5zsXedBA7bzCvPG3uvaUx5YyeaNBPf1T78KovQAnUVib2jNB3Hi3sa.jpeg) ![IMG_5457.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/EqFs2Agn3LE55L2uMSuVX6c2CusiuXrb9QheMahf1oJ7r9rPAemRJjCxqUmNQDgsfDh.jpeg) ![IMG_5461.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23yJLyqtJRgEceR3f9i2Rf2cvczstphqDJBQQABcWqVd3SYFTceaofxCGCNZ8hSYV2giR.jpeg) ![IMG_5471.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23wWxxU814DEpsLqXkmAzdPhZ6THTPnfVb2fmChnED4vhzjix6ZUjVyKnKa98U4Xy39ik.jpeg) ![IMG_5478.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23vi1iYaA3pW1qnj8ZCZSqgbjuXENkrLtDFmVRrMa8k7LEBw5NLeZwt8g3sjjVAj6HhKn.jpeg) _______________

> Today I’m sharing this place with a touch of poetry and a hint of what it means to be human. The landscape is breathtaking, and I’ve tried my best to describe it, but I’ll let the photos speak for themselves. I invite you to close your eyes as you look at them, to breathe in the scent of the grass, to feel the warmth of the sun, to feel your warm body immersing itself in cool water—I invite you to imagine laughter. Because often a place “is” defined by the people who are bringing it to life at that moment. Enjoy it!!

> > Traigo hoy este sitio con unos toques de poesía y con los tintes de lo propiamente humano. El paisaje es bellísimo y he intentado describirlo bastante, pero lo dejo a las fotos y los invito a cerrar los ojos mientras las ven y a respirar hierbas, a sentir el calor del sol, a sentir su cuerpo caliente sumergiéndose en agua fresca, los invito a imaginar risas. > Porque muchas veces un espacio “es”, según quiénes le estén dando vida en ese momento. > Que lo disfruten!! ________ ![IMG_5489.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belug/23vsSLdNKPrhfi1mSq6PhGseqMPSr5k9uUahAnzKwEUebrjrKZdipdzGHLyUMHaiGXxYb.jpeg) _________ *Worldmappin code: [//]:# (!worldmappin -58.07788 lat -135.00000 long Making New Friends in the Paradise of Menorca, Spain d3scr)* __________

body.title: Do “Foundations” cards in Splinterlands have any value?
body.body:
>

<center> **Best regards Splinterlovers** 💚</center>

I’ve wanted to write a post like this for a while because I imagine new players are wondering if the cards you get for free in the game—the famous cards from the “Foundations” set—have any value. Since they’re free, it’s only natural for new players to assume they’re worthless or, at best, have very little value. This is completely normal, since things that come for free is usually of fairly low value, and that’s a fact.

However, even though this premise is true to a certain extent regarding the game and the cards from the “Foundations” edition, many of these cards are actually quite valuable, but this is a detail that beginners might not be aware of, which is why I’m writing this post. The idea is to show how it works and how you can obtain these valuable cards, which have a pretty good market value and can be used to capitalize on and start progressing in Splinterlands much more quickly.

**So, this post will show you how valuable these cards are and how you can get them. I’ll give you a heads-up right now: all it takes is a lot of persistence. But let’s get right to the post:**

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>What is the actual value of the cards in the “Foundations” SET?</center>
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

These cards themselves, in their “Common” rarity, are actually worth very little, though that doesn’t mean they’re bad in-game. However, common cards like the ones I just mentioned are relatively easy to obtain, and when that happens, the supply of these cards is naturally high, which causes their market price to be well below average. However, far from seeing this as a negative, it’s definitely a positive—because with very little money—I’m talking about $3 to $4 at most, maybe even less—you can build a complete deck of these cards.

Although it’s actually much less time-consuming, since you can obtain most of these cards just by playing “Campaign Mode,” and you can find the ones you’re missing on the market to keep your deck fully updated—even though some might think this is a waste of time and resources, I don’t see it that way. As I said, consistency is key in this mode, but I’ll delve into this in the next section. In the meantime, to give you an idea of what you can achieve with that consistency, take a look at the following two images, which show the most expensive cards in this set:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Card Values</center>

|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23swnpQx79HiPZoHskXgNtD6j2xTHphqiJbjcWxGf3CSx6odp3ojkNxiqDVpFfduYVUkA.png|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tGbvHYtYkxfGN15KzEJ5szuD3rww9xeUNyvK2C2Y74KPQzzFqGN2gNq6KnHdbVNG5cD.png|
|-|-|

As you can see in the images, these cards are extremely valuable; of course, we're talking about the rarest cards in the entire game, which are:

* **Black Foil**
* **Black Foil Arcane**
* **Gold Foil Arcane** 
* **Gold Foil**

Of course, if you’ve done your homework, you’ll know that getting these kinds of cards is a bit tricky, but it’s not impossible. So, if you play your cards right, you could end up with these cards, which will definitely help you make progress in the game. But this raises a question: **How do you go about getting these kinds of cards?**

In the next section, we’ll look at how you can do this and provide a brief step-by-step guide on how to build a deck from the “Foundations” set.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png)

## <center>How can I earn expensive “Card Sheets” from the Foundations SET?</center>

https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif

Okay, to start this section, I’ll go from beginning to end. That means you’ll need to follow the step-by-step instructions to do it correctly. So, now that everything is clear, let’s get started:

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png)

#### <center>Step by step</center>

* **Play \
:** This is the first thing you should do, since this is where you'll get most of the \

cards from the Foundations set. This is the essential starting point for saving a lot of time and resources. * **Go to the Market:** The next thing I would do—and recommend you do—is go to the market with a few dollars and buy the cards you don’t have from the “SET,” obviously in the standard foil version, so you can complete your deck and then compete without any issues and fully prepared. This is the most important part. By doing this, you’ll save a ton of time, since some of the new players will likely be playing 100% for free, and you’ll already have a big advantage over them. * **Complete the daily quests (Required):** This is the final step, but it’s the most important one of all, since this is where the “consistency” I’ve been talking about throughout this post comes into play. This means that if you win 5 battles a day, you can earn a Foundations card, a Frontier Entry, and receive 1 to 4 exclusive cards—available only to those who complete the daily challenges—with a drop rate of up to 2%, which is pretty good. --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png ##
Conclusion
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif With all this in mind, you’ll find it easier to compete in the “Frontier” format, which, while designed for novice players, is a fairly comprehensive—and, if you will, complex—game mode. Even though you play with just one SET, strategy and the order in which you play your cards are crucial to winning. So tell me, are you playing “Frontier Mode” and not sure how to get started? If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment on this post.
https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhowii/23t74jP9PwnQVm1xvGFRSWNw9CX8dtyaB4fPKB2YqhBL6VuzewvG9Sd3Ft2qNL4scwN2L.gif
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/AJhYgvAA2jMdAtev45LxeeeYzzVqonoQgjHfk865cC9GnBW1MVqFA5B5cJ6BKaa.gif ### **I invite everyone to join Splinterlands, the best game based on chains of blocks, full of adventures, battles, and strategies where you will have fun and get rewards according to your league**
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/Eoc6Yq8EJ2L35tJnQyXixtVnvmKBsf6xNX4yVaZQfn4SPonejdcZVSUfs2LcNi53bp4.png ---  https://i.postimg.cc/d02nBjTg/banner-doradas.gif
