body.body: >🧶Bienvenido al mundo del DIY conmigo,un placer saludarles ✂️🧵🎨. | 🧶Welcome to the world of DIY with me, a pleasure to greet you ✂️🧵🎨. #

>Amigos estaba por compartirles el proceso de este bello vestido, pero motivos de falta de tiempo no les había enseñado el tutorial de este vestido sencillo con capa fruncida abajo en tela de muselina que hice para mi,había mandado a comprar algunas telas con mi mamá ya que recientemente ella fue donde las venden y no pasé la oportunidad para decirle que me trajera una tela para este vestido que tenía en mente,si bien yo llevaba tiempo por querer hacer este diseño abajo de los vestidos no lo habia aprendido a hacer ya que no fruncia por completo esa capa que el vestido lleva abajo y alli es donde veía lo difícil,aunque parece fácil la verdad no lo es ya que hay que hacer este proceso con un poco de paciencia porque trabajar estas telas es un poco complicado pero no imposible,con calma al final pude hacerlo y ya me quedó exactamente como lo queria sencillo pero que se diferenciar de los demas vestidos que tenia,aparte que me estan gustando últimamente los vestidos largos y simples porque son más elegantes y simplemente solo tienes que colocarte una pieza encima a menos que quieras usarla con sobretodo o tops manga larga o corta dependiendo del gusto de cada persona,en mi caso lo hice para variar con varios tops que tengo, escogí una tela de estampado que combinara casi con mis tops,espero les guste y no se pierdan el resultado final ,queda muy lindo✨💗. # > Friends, I was going to share the process of making this beautiful dress with you, but due to lack of time, I hadn't yet shown you the tutorial for this simple dress with a gathered underskirt in muslin fabric that I made for myself. I had sent my mom to buy some fabrics since she recently went to the fabric store, and I didn't miss the opportunity to ask her to bring me some fabric for this dress I had in mind. Although I had wanted to make this design under dresses for a while, I hadn't learned how to do it because I couldn't gather the underskirt completely, and that's where I saw the difficulty. Although it seems easy, it really isn't, since you have to do this process with a little patience because working with these fabrics is a bit complicated, but not impossible. With patience, I finally managed to do it, and it turned out exactly as I wanted: simple but different from the other dresses I have. Besides, lately I've been liking long, simple dresses because they are more elegant, and you just have to put something on over them unless you want to wear it with an overcoat or long- or short-sleeved tops, depending on each person's taste. I made this to mix things up with several tops I have. I chose a patterned fabric that almost matched my tops. I hope you like it and don't miss the final result, it looks really cute! ✨💗 # ---
![IMG_20260529_121423_799.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc67p4Nk8H8kqu82cJ2QiLNkGHpFXJY2Gq1gPbyKLGvWW/IMG_20260529_121423_799.jpg)
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)
## _
Materiales: | Materials:
_ # * **_1.50 metros de tela de muselina(O la de tu preferencia)_** * **_Hilo_** * **_Máquinas de coser_** * **_Patrones_** * **_Elástico de medio centímetro de ancho por el ancho de la cintura_** * **_Alfileres_** * **_Tijeras_** # > * **_1.50 meters of muslin fabric (or your preferred fabric)_** > * **_Thread_** > * **_Sewing machine_** > * **_Patterns_** > * **_Elastic, half a centimeter wide, the width of the waistband_** > * *_Pins_** > * **_Scissors_**
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)
## _
Pasos a seguir: | Steps to follow:
_ #
![InShot_20260602_133657770.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQK1hRzKwg2jpBS7tcsAjgEdQWASFSDPzfD3nXVx4g491/InShot_20260602_133657770.jpg)
### _Paso 01_

>Verán siempre que empiezo a cortar la tela me encanta hacerlo por las piezas de los talles delanteros (La blusa de los vestidos)porque me gusta asegurar ai la tela que me sobra me alcanza para la falda del vestido , entonces una vez corto la blusa delantera y trasera con confianza puedo medir el largo que quiero a la tela que me sobró y proceder a cortar,antes corto las mangas luego la pieza de la falda en este caso hice un cuadro de 70 cm de largo x 100 cm de ancho,luego la capa del vestido abajo es un rectángulo de 150 cm de ancho(todo el ancho que trae la tela ) x 35 cm de largo,por último cortamos el bias por el ancho de nuestro cuello por 2 cm menos de esa cantidad. # > ### _Step 01_ > You'll see that whenever I start cutting fabric, I love to begin with the front bodice pieces (the bodice of the dresses) because I like to make sure that the leftover fabric is enough for the skirt. So, once I've cut the front and back bodice pieces with confidence, I can measure the length I want from the leftover fabric and proceed to cut. First, I cut the sleeves, then the skirt piece. In this case, I made a square 70 cm long x 100 cm wide. Then, the underlayer of the dress is a rectangle 150 cm wide (the full width of the fabric) x 35 cm long. Finally, we cut the bias tape to the width of our neckline, plus 2 cm less than that. ---
![InShot_20260602_133751318.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbKdqxy9gLpEp296kMcbj31QRqwqdgA3EWPWrvJbNGP8z/InShot_20260602_133751318.jpg)
### _Paso 02_

>Vamos a pasar a coser ahora,y empezamos por los hombros uniremos por el revés de la tela frente con frente la pieza del talle delantero de la blusa y la de atras y Coseremos los hombros,luego abrimos la pieza ,ubicaremos las mangas en el centro de la unión de los hombros la mitad de la manga a la sisa y la cosemos por el borde,recuerden aiempre colocar un alfiler en el centro de ambas piezas para coser,luego cerramos la blusa y cosemos para sellar los costados de la punta de la manga hasta abajo de la blusa. # > ### _Step 02_ > Now we're going to sew, starting with the shoulders. We'll join the front bodice piece and the back bodice piece, wrong sides together, and sew the shoulders. Then we'll open the piece, position the sleeves in the center of the shoulder seam, halfway down the sleeve to the armhole, and sew them along the edge. Remember to always place a pin in the center of both pieces before sewing. Then we'll close the blouse and sew the side seams from the sleeve tip to the bottom of the blouse to seal them. ---
![InShot_20260602_133838200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/AJmtyEreguHsFmsK6dLoxZb32B3gYnfdmQ6G8RQP2TmeGoEvFaEfoKFzcc5x4qa.jpg)
### _Paso 03_

>He cosido las piezas con overclock y les he pasado nuevamente una costura recta por los costados para evitar se abra la tela,ahora vamos a coser el borde de la manga oara hacer el ruedo, cosemos también la unión de la falda y fruncimos la parte de abajo del rectángulo,esta pieza es fruncida ,para ello he usado la costura a número 4 de ancho y luego fuí tirando el hilo para ir frunciendo la tela y volverla a coser mueven a la tela del cuadrado de la falda pero abajo con overclock y recta lo he cosido. # > ### _Step 03_ > I sewed the pieces with an overlock stitch and then added a straight stitch along the sides to prevent the fabric from opening. Now we're going to sew the edge of the sleeve to make the hem. We also sew the skirt seam and gather the bottom part of the rectangle. This piece is gathered; for this, I used a number 4 stitch width and then pulled the thread to gather the fabric and sew it again. I moved the fabric from the skirt square, but I sewed it at the bottom with an overlock and straight stitch. ---
![InShot_20260602_133915825.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/AK6YjPSaJsRH82C5GuMJB4PyPG1UiyVhXno2xmSYD4FjPDegaZN7UXzTqRFnbxH.jpg)
### _Paso 04_

>Procedo a coser con costura recta nuevamente en la parte de el lado vertical del vestido de arriba hacia abajo,por el borde del vestido lo cosí con overclock y le hice el ruedo de 1.5 cm aproximadamente yo acostumbro a hacer los ruedos de las prendas de este tamaño.Nos vamos seguido de ese paso a unir las piezas de la falda con la blusa haciendo pequeños fruncidos,si notamos que nos queda ancha está parte de la cintura pues no importa ya que le colocaremos el elástico y eso evitará que nos quede ancha.. # > ### _Step 04_ > I proceed to sew a straight stitch again along the vertical side of the dress from top to bottom. I overlocked the edge of the dress and hemmed it approximately 1.5 cm; I usually hem garments of this size. Following that step, we join the skirt pieces to the blouse, making small gathers. If we notice that this part of the waist is too wide, it doesn't matter, as we will add elastic and that will prevent it from being too loose. ---
![InShot_20260602_133948543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anne002/AK7zEGdkEjUxc5qmR1MdsjnNSnxWDFDTB3fmtMNJGjtfWztzUxSxXG3zoXg2B33.jpg)
### _Paso 05_

>Coseremos el bias uniendo cada extremo y lo ubicaremos por dentro del cuello de la blusa del vestido y cosemos con costura recta no tan ajustada ya que al estirar puede partir el hilo,luego repisamos por encima con costura recta haciendo un pequeño dobladillo para el cuello sencillo,cosemos el borde de la manga y colocamos para finalizar con una costura recta y por el contorno de la cintura el elástico (El ancho va a depender de que tan ajustado quieres tu vestido en la cintura,mayormente yo acostumbro a colocar elástico de 70 cm para talla M 80/90 cm la cintura de la persona a quien tomaremos la medida). # > ### _Step 05_ > We will sew the bias tape by joining each end and place it inside the neckline of the dress blouse and sew with a straight stitch, not too tight since it can break when stretched. Then we will sew over it with a straight stitch making a small hem for the simple neckline. We will sew the edge of the sleeve and finally attach the elastic with a straight stitch around the waist circumference (The width will depend on how fitted you want your dress at the waist; I usually use 70 cm of elastic for size M, 80/90 cm for the waist of the person whose measurement we will take). ---
![1_20260407_225637_0000 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtvSrXmcJDGmvwWr1co4QENqoGzw9U1WFcj1xDGoCpSt/1_20260407_225637_0000%20(1).jpg)

Resultado: | Result:

body.title: (Story) Connecting the Dots on a Rainy Saturday 🌧️ [Eng+Spa] Conectar puntos un sábado de lluvia. 🌦️
body.body:
* * *

* * *

(Versión en español más abajo).
-------------------------------

* * *

* * *

This story is my entry for the \

contest by @freewritehouse. I hope you enjoy it.

* * *

* * *

The Saturday afternoon descended slowly upon Caracas, and the rain tapped against the apartment window with a soft melody, as if someone were tapping their fingers on a distant drum.

In the living room, a father and his son sat on the floor, surrounded by leaves, colored crayons, and a cup of water that had already cooled.

\
the boy asked, looking at the leaf with great seriousness.\n\n\

The little boy held the crayon carefully. His fingers gripped the red tip as he connected the dots with crooked but confident lines, as if he were building a small secret. Little by little, the figure of a fish began to emerge on the leaf.

The father watched him in silence.

And then, as happens with things that touch the heart, a memory came to him unbidden.

_I used to do this with my dad too..._ he thought.

_He would sit next to me, just like I am now. He would tell me it didn't matter if the line was crooked, that the important thing was to finish the drawing. I remember his voice, his patience, the way he would put his hand on my shoulder when I hesitated. How strange... a sheet of dots can hold so much._

The boy looked up.

\
said the father, returning to the present. \

The little boy smiled, proud of his work. Then he continued connecting the dots, focused and happy. The father felt a quiet tenderness in his chest. He wasn't just thinking about fine motor skills, or learning, or the usefulness of the exercise. He was thinking about something deeper.

_These games also offer a kind of embrace_, he told himself.

_They help the hands grow, yes. But they also help the soul. They serve to rest the mind, to talk without haste, to be close. So that a child remembers that his father was there. So that tomorrow, when he has his own children, he will again look for a sheet of dotted paper and repeat this same gesture, this same calm, this same affection._

The rain continued to fall for a while longer, soft and steady. Outside, the sky was gradually clearing, as if the storm also wanted to go to sleep.

Finally, the boy finished his drawing.

\
he said, leaning over to get a better look. \

The boy nodded slowly. Then he rested his head on the sofa and closed his eyes. The rain had stopped, and the room was silent, smelling of paper, crayon, and a shared home.

The father covered him with a light blanket.

\

he whispered. Then he stood up and walked toward the apartment's kitchen. As he opened the cupboards and thought about dinner, he glanced back at the living room. There were the dotted sheets, the red fish, and the trace of an afternoon that, without a sound, had become a memory. And he understood that sometimes love is like that too: slowly, patiently connecting the dots until they form a shape that one day the heart will never want to forget. * * * * * *

> (English version above). ------------------------ * * * Conectar puntos un sábado de lluvia =================================== La tarde de sábado caía lenta sobre Caracas, y la lluvia golpeaba el techo del apartamento con una música suave, como si alguien tocara los dedos sobre un tambor lejano. En la sala, un padre y su hijo estaban sentados en el piso, rodeados de hojas, crayones de colores y una taza de agua que ya se había enfriado. —Papá, ¿este punto va aquí? —preguntó el niño, mirando la hoja con mucha seriedad. —Sí, ahí mismo —respondió el padre, sonriendo—. Ahora sigue con calma. Uno por uno. El pequeño sostuvo el crayón con cuidado. Sus deditos apretaban la punta de color rojo mientras unía los puntos con líneas torcidas, pero seguras, como si estuviera construyendo un pequeño secreto. Poco a poco, sobre la hoja comenzó a nacer la figura de un pez. El padre lo observaba en silencio. Y entonces, como pasa con las cosas que se parecen al corazón, un recuerdo le llegó sin pedir permiso. _Yo también hacía esto con mi papá..._ pensó. _Él se sentaba a mi lado, igual que yo ahora. Me decía que no importaba si la línea salía chueca, que lo importante era terminar el dibujo. Recuerdo su voz, su paciencia, su forma de poner la mano sobre mi hombro cuando yo dudaba. Qué raro… una hoja con puntos puede guardar tanto._ El niño levantó la cabeza. —Papá, mira, parece que ya tiene cola. —Sí —dijo el padre, volviendo al presente—. Y tú le estás dando vida. El pequeño sonrió, orgulloso de su trabajo. Después siguió uniendo puntos, concentrado, feliz. El padre sintió una ternura tranquila en el pecho. No pensó solo en la motricidad fina, ni en el aprendizaje, ni en lo útil del ejercicio. Pensó en algo más profundo. _Estos juegos también abrazan_, se dijo a sí mismo en su mente. _Ayudan a las manos a crecer, sí. Pero también ayudan al alma. Sirven para descansar la mente, para conversar sin prisa, para estar cerca. Para que un hijo recuerde que su padre estuvo ahí. Para que mañana, cuando él tenga sus propios hijos, busque otra vez una hoja con puntos y repita este mismo gesto, esta misma calma, este mismo cariño._ La lluvia siguió cayendo un rato más, suave y constante. Afuera, el cielo se iba aclarando poco a poco, como si la tormenta también quisiera irse a dormir. Al fin, el niño terminó su dibujo. —¡Mira, papá! ¡Un pez! —Te quedó hermoso —dijo él, inclinándose para verlo mejor—. Y lo hiciste tú solito. —¿Lo guardamos? —Claro que sí. Lo guardamos para no olvidar esta tarde. El niño asintió despacito. Luego apoyó la cabeza en el sofá y cerró los ojos. La lluvia había terminado y la sala quedó en silencio, con olor a papel, crayón y casa compartida. El padre lo cubrió con una manta ligera. —Duerme un poco, campeón —susurró. Después se puso de pie y caminó hacia la cocina del apartamento. Mientras abría los armarios y pensaba en preparar la próxima comida, volvió a mirar de reojo la sala. Allí quedaban las hojas llenas de puntos, el pez de color rojo y la huella de una tarde que, sin hacer ruido, se había convertido en recuerdo. Y entendió que a veces el amor también se parece a eso: unir puntos despacio, con paciencia, hasta formar una figura que un día el corazón no querrá olvidar. * * * * * * #Tribe #creative #fiction #writing #creativewriting #creativecoin #pimp #freewritehouse #pictureprompt #freewrite #writingprompt * * * * * *

body.title: Poema # 211 - Un millón de formas/Poem # 211 - A Million Forms
body.body:
>
In many ways, only my “I love you” is like loving you in the unrepeatable, much more authentic than the pure and true gold of your earrings. Because in direction, you are the compass that points north and always points to the place that exists when I name you, and that is why I love you in a million ways, even if all carry a homogeneous mix with your names. That is why I fill myself with the patience of rain that does not know how to wait in drops of dew or with the urgency of fire that seeks wood without asking permission, perhaps with the silence of libraries where dust dances over unread pages, seeking to be found with your chronology.

One must love you equally at night just as in the day, and always miss you with the half that is missing. Almost longing for you in the sacred routine, or like the coffee with hot chocolate that I keep until you return in the word I do not say but that repeats to remind you.
En muchos aspectos, solo mi “te amo” es como amarte en lo irrepetible, mucho más auténtico que el oro puro y verdadero de tus zarcillos. Porque en dirección, eres la brújula que apunta al norte y siempre apunta al lugar que existe cuando te nombro y por eso te quiero en un millón de formas, aunque todas lleven una mezcla homogénea con tus nombres. Por eso me lleno con la paciencia de la lluvia que no sabe esperar en gotas de rocío o con la urgencia del fuego que busca leña sin pedir permiso quizá con el silencio de las bibliotecas donde el polvo baila sobre páginas no leídas, buscando ser encontradas con tu cronología.

Hay que amarte por igual de noche al igual que en el día, y siempre extrañarte con la mitad que falta. Casi anhelarte en la rutina sagrada, o como el café con chocolate caliente que guardo hasta que retornes en la palabra que no digo pero que se repite para recordarte.

>
Every gesture is a new dialect, every look a map without borders, and I seek to reinvent you with every compass rose. Because loving you is the only thing in a verse, it is like letting you breathe in a thousand stanzas that never finish writing themselves, because there is no measure that reaches so much, nor clock that stops our personal time. And without hypocrisy, I am promiscuous with the same person and a thousand ways of loving...
Cada gesto es un dialecto nuevo, cada mirada un mapa sin fronteras y busco reinventarte con cada rosa de los vientos. Porque amarte es lo único en un verso, es como dejarte respirar en mil estrofas que nunca terminan de escribirse, porque no hay medida que alcance para tanto, ni reloj que detenga a nuestro tiempo personal. Y sin hipocresías, soy promiscuo con una misma persona y mil formas de querer…

body.title: Growing Calendula for a Maker's Salve / メイカー軟膏のためのカレンデュラ栽培中
body.body:
![E1B81375-8167-4672-8744-DEFCEDC14608_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EogMRAF2xZ8D55bBVwHNELyoYcqU4HgAkGsyXCUqtXYBHhufDsA4vaWwQrJX1gwGAuE.jpeg)


When you spend a lot of time making things or cooking, your hands inevitably become rough. Whether it's carving wood, working with soil, kneading bread, or washing dishes, our hands go through a lot. In winter especially, my fingertips sometimes become dry and cracked 🥺

This year I'm planning to make a calendula salve and growing calendula in the garden.

During the stay-at-home period of the COVID pandemic, I joined an online workshop hosted by a gardener in New Zealand, where I learned how to make calendula salve. When I looked back the photos, it was 2021.

As a prep, I took petals from dried calendula flowers sold as tea with my daughter. 

![03C61E7A-CDF1-442C-881E-A51BAB63B675_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EogQh3okqp47GAf5x4gSwsTgd6aZ8Us2M4iSJ3WbBLSTmzRJNDhkCXqFK42PrNr93FN.jpeg)

Then in the first session, we learned about calendula and infused the petals in oil.

![247F3B1E-8BA8-4BDA-920B-EAB838EC4190_1_102_o.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/Ep7uX47hfEKkx3Mdnb2iwAMiHMADQyYxurCiNYBp6WxULyZJjjwYjNvh8QjSgzdMoGN.jpeg)

A month later, during the second session, we turned that infused oil into a salve.

![0CBC85DB-AB51-4632-9B15-2CDCBF1F6493_1_102_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EonnuihbhLifzuA6RPgVCmgGDq9h7nJ2T84h7pLSDPRWCV9HMPKwpnjtKBHZ8Vs6VvX.jpeg)

About five years have passed since then, and recently I started looking for the organic dried calendula flower tea that I had used back then. But I couldn't find it anywhere. I checked organic shops in my town, and looked in an organic tea and spice store while traveling in the Czech Republic.

Then I thought why not grow it myself? The gardener who hosted the workshop used calendula she had grown in her own garden. So I sowed some seeds!

I've been transplanting the seedlings as they grow. Now that most of my spring and summer seed-starting and planting work is done, I'm wondering whether to raise a few more seedlings or simply sow some seeds directly into the garden.

I hope to pick the flowers in summer, dry them, and infuse them in oil. With a little luck, by autumn I'll have a salve to protect my hands.

Until then, I'm looking forward to seeing the first calendula flowers bloom in the garden this year.

---

ものづくりや料理をしていると、どうしても手が荒れてしまいます。

木を削ったり、土を触ったり、パンをこねたり、食器を洗ったり。特に冬になると、指先がひび割れて痛くなることも。私は手が体のパーツの中でも特に好きで、荒れてしまった見た目も地味につらいです。そんなときのために、今年はカレンデュラの軟膏を作ろうと思っています。

以前、コロナ禍のステイホーム期間中に、ニュージーランドのガーデナーさんのオンラインワークショップに参加して、カレンデュラの軟膏作りを教わったことがありました。写真を見返してみると2021年のことでした。

私はドイツの自宅から参加し、地球の反対側にあるニュージーランドの庭の話を聞きながら、初回はドライのカレンデュラをオイルに漬けて、一ヶ月後の二回目に軟膏を作りました。当時はまだ子供が赤ちゃんと子供の間のような感じで、ムチムチした足の裏がかわいい 😄

![0CBC85DB-AB51-4632-9B15-2CDCBF1F6493_1_102_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/EonnuihbhLifzuA6RPgVCmgGDq9h7nJ2T84h7pLSDPRWCV9HMPKwpnjtKBHZ8Vs6VvX.jpeg)

それから5年ほどたって、当時使ったオーガニックのお茶用のドライカレンデュラを探したのですが、ない！今住んでいる町のオーガニックショップを見て歩いて、さらに旅先のチェコのオーガニックショップや、オーストリアのお茶専門店Sonnentorの直営店を覗いてもありませんでした。

それなら自分で育てよう。ワークショップのホストのガーデナーさんは自分で育てたカレンデュラを使っていました。

ということで早速種まきをして、都度都度移植して行って、初回に移植したものはずいぶん大きくなってきました。春夏の育苗と植え付けが落ち着いたので、もう少し苗を育て足そうか、それとも種を直播きしようか考えているところです。

夏に花を摘んで、乾燥させて、オイルに漬けて、秋には手を守る軟膏ができあがるといいな。

そんなことを考えながら、今年最初のカレンデュラの花が咲くのを楽しみに待っています。

body.body:
/>

BTC跌穿7萬，不，跌穿6萬7了，我也終於忍不住進市了。

尤記得上年底，我很幸運地在BTC 12萬的時候開始部署退場，成功獲利，而下個目標，自然是部署進場了。我心底預算BTC的低點會是6萬多的，但那時候沒想到熊市才幾個月就已經跌到6萬多了，不過最後我還是沒有進場，因為我是玩長線的，那麼快就進場豈不是要坐船？終於還是忍住了。

後來BTC升到了8萬多，我一度懷疑熊市完了？但我都是相信4年周期，還是會再有一波大跌的，不過我也設了規則給自己，如果BTC升穿8萬5我就認為是牛市開始而進場了，幸好，我又猜中了，這只是一次回調，很快，就回調到7萬多的位置，而這次，我覺得是時候要進了。

這是上周的事，我認為BTC還是會再跌到6萬的，甚至有可能看到5萬多，不過未來沒有人能預料，所以我選擇了在7萬3的時候開始分批進場，第一批資金就在7萬3，沒想到一個星期就跌那麼多了，於是昨晚跌穿6萬8時，我做了第二次進場。

現在連6萬7都穿了，我下個進場點會是6萬5，突然很希望6萬5快點來，如果能跌到5萬就更好了，哈哈哈哈。

body.title: Beef cooked for relatives/Carne de res cocinada para los familiares (EN)(EG)
body.body:
![c56520f8-fb81-46b5-9510-c0499f4c3619.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXNDRFgbhPXanRDQTjin6n3kMz4PpRqrcikSimqsrHoyd/c56520f8-fb81-46b5-9510-c0499f4c3619.jpg)



Friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well, and I am also doing well. Alhamdulillah, today I have brought you a very tasty recipe. I cooked beef because my relatives came to my house. But I will share this tasty beef recipe with you now. Let's get started without further delay.

Beef
 Onion
Garlic
Green Chilli
Bay Leaf, Salt
Turmeric Powder
 Cumin Powder
Dry Chilli Powder
White Oil
Small Cardamom
Large Cardamom
Cinnamon
Cloves
Pepper

The dish I made today has a lot of spices, but it is amazing, and it is very tasty to eat. Today I cooked beef in a different style. Here, I will not boil the beef first; I will fry it first. There, along with onion and garlic, all the spices have to be added one by one.

![cd46880b-3a1e-444e-87c9-1643320fe1a2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeeU5AMCGQnid8J5hbtNtn5XVaMTYgZq9ZyG443wBx6XG/cd46880b-3a1e-444e-87c9-1643320fe1a2.jpg)

To bring back the beauty of cooking, you must add oil, stir, add a little water, and cover with a lid. But it is wrong to think that the cooking will be completed in a short time because to complete this cooking, we must give ourselves forty minutes to an hour. We must add a little water and cook the meat well. Of course, it will take much longer.

![2fb8053e-cc81-4a3c-a0f6-85c7ded5f17e.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNuYgK1VLsx4BPTHuSQTRysARcYfXXUBjCzrb9pH3YX8p/2fb8053e-cc81-4a3c-a0f6-85c7ded5f17e.jpg)

However, before the cooking is finished, it must have a golden color, and then we must fry it again and cook it well, add oil, try different sauces, and finally add 1 spoon of roasted cumin seeds.

![9ba65852-3cd5-4c02-85bb-8bda0b97b298.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSRX6koQJ9dLZr7nv8HdseyzdPGZpqdgV3wJEVDzAaaFR/9ba65852-3cd5-4c02-85bb-8bda0b97b298.jpg)

![354bb4ff-9516-4305-86d7-e206d18caf26.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZZTx9PfYZ6b3HSHKiHzRzfBLvDg5eiqZhc5ZQK6FhHYA/354bb4ff-9516-4305-86d7-e206d18caf26.jpg)

![0a69e969-b72e-4899-9110-bc1034b6cc2c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVXDFWzPR5Y9SAV4nMejz9jwkTes4Tk9zEfWFHutLXo7v/0a69e969-b72e-4899-9110-bc1034b6cc2c.jpg)

![bf1c8b98-a1e9-4fd9-a0a3-c9ccf182c840.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbB3fYZGapDKP9bhFwkdEnCjEwR5uADtrgg3H8qVYaTsF/bf1c8b98-a1e9-4fd9-a0a3-c9ccf182c840.jpg)

This is the end of the cooking, then you have to give it another five minutes, and when it boils well, you will understand that our cooking is complete. Here, a completely fried meat will definitely come out, and it will look good. The fried meat must be eaten with hot roti, paratha, or pulao, and also served at home. This is cooked for 5 to 10 people. The dish I made is made for 6 people, and it is a very tasty dish. I hope you like today's recipe. Until then, stay well. God bless.

![c56520f8-fb81-46b5-9510-c0499f4c3619.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXNDRFgbhPXanRDQTjin6n3kMz4PpRqrcikSimqsrHoyd/c56520f8-fb81-46b5-9510-c0499f4c3619.jpg)

Amigos, ¿cómo están? Espero que estén todos bien, yo también estoy bien. Alhamdulillah, hoy les traigo una receta muy rica. Cociné carne de res porque mis familiares vinieron a mi casa. Pero ahora les compartiré esta deliciosa receta de carne de res. ¡Comencemos sin más demora!

Carne de res

Cebolla
Ajo
Chile verde
Hoja de laurel, sal
Cúrcuma en polvo
Comino en polvo
Chile seco en polvo
Aceite blanco
Cardamomo pequeño
Cardamomo grande
Canela
Clavos de olor
Pimienta

El plato que preparé hoy lleva muchas especias, pero está delicioso. Hoy cociné la carne de res de una manera diferente. En esta ocasión, no la herviré primero; la freiré. Luego, junto con la cebolla y el ajo, se añaden todas las especias una a una.

![cd46880b-3a1e-444e-87c9-1643320fe1a2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeeU5AMCGQnid8J5hbtNtn5XVaMTYgZq9ZyG443wBx6XG/cd46880b-3a1e-444e-87c9-1643320fe1a2.jpg)

Para recuperar la belleza de la cocina, debes añadir aceite, remover, agregar un poco de agua y tapar. Pero es un error pensar que la cocción se completará rápidamente, ya que para ello necesitamos entre cuarenta minutos y una hora. Debemos añadir un poco de agua y cocinar bien la carne. Por supuesto, tardará mucho más.

![2fb8053e-cc81-4a3c-a0f6-85c7ded5f17e.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNuYgK1VLsx4BPTHuSQTRysARcYfXXUBjCzrb9pH3YX8p/2fb8053e-cc81-4a3c-a0f6-85c7ded5f17e.jpg)

Sin embargo, antes de terminar la cocción, debe tener un color dorado. Luego, debemos freírlo nuevamente y cocinarlo bien, agregar aceite, probar diferentes salsas y, finalmente, añadir una cucharada de semillas de comino tostadas.

![9ba65852-3cd5-4c02-85bb-8bda0b97b298.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSRX6koQJ9dLZr7nv8HdseyzdPGZpqdgV3wJEVDzAaaFR/9ba65852-3cd5-4c02-85bb-8bda0b97b298.jpg)

! [354bb4ff-9516-4305-86d7-e206d18caf26.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZZTx9PfYZ6b3HSHKiHzRzfBLvDg5eiqZhc5ZQK6FhHYA/354bb4ff-9516-4305-86d7-e206d18caf26.jpg)

![ 0a69e969-b72e-4899-9110-bc1034b6cc2c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVXDFWzPR5Y9SAV4nMejz9jwkTes4Tk9zEfWFHutLXo7v/0a69e969-b72e-4899-9110-bc1034b6cc2c.jpg)

![b f1c8b98-a1e9-4fd9-a0a3-c9ccf182c840.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbB3fYZGapDKP9bhFwkdEnCjEwR5uADtrgg3H8qVYaTsF/bf1c8b98-a1e9-4fd9-a0a3-c9ccf182c840.jpg)

Este es el final de la cocción. Déjelo reposar otros cinco minutos y, cuando hierva bien, sabrá que está listo. Así, la carne quedará perfectamente frita y con una presentación excelente. Se recomienda acompañarla con roti, paratha o pulao calientes, y también se sirve en casa. Esta receta rinde para 5 a 10 personas. El plato que preparé es para 6 personas y es muy sabroso. Espero que les guste la receta de hoy. Hasta entonces, cuídate. Que Dios te bendiga.

body.title: NC conservatives win suit to remove non-citizens from voter rolls
body.body:
I find it completely crazy that this was something that the conservatives had to even file a suit for.   Unless you stand on the crazy side of things, I don't think this should be a partisan issue at all and don't understand why anyone would contest this or even attempt to fight for the other side of things.   If you aren't a member of something, whether that be a club, a board of directors, a prison shotput team, or a nation or state, you shouldn't be allowed to vote there.  

<center> https://cdn.britannica.com/80/285280-050-AE82016B/North-Carolina-Governor-Roy-Cooper-speaks-Biden-rally-Raleigh-NC-June-2024.jpg
[src](https://cdn.britannica.com/80/285280-050-AE82016B/North-Carolina-Governor-Roy-Cooper-speaks-Biden-rally-Raleigh-NC-June-2024.jpg)</center> 

Is this something that can honestly be contested?   

I'll be a bit more specific as it applies to North Carolina:   The argument was that if someone is summoned for jury duty, and that person states that they are not a US citizen on this summons, then their presence on the voter roll needs to be purged once it is determined they in fact are not a US citizen.  

> The agreement sets a schedule through 2028 for clerks to send the information to the elections board. Within 30 days of receiving it, the board must review voter-registration and citizenship status, send county elections boards reports on any registered voters identified, and refer cases to the State Bureau of Investigation and district attorneys if a person appears to have voted before becoming a U.S. citizen.

Now while I am sure there are some ulterior motives to this, because there always is in politics, that seems about a cut and dry as it comes to me and I don't know how anyone would have any grounds to oppose this.   The district judge certainly didn't because this was settled in an online session in less than 20 minutes.  

I don't want to spend too much time on it but the only reason why this had to be brought in front of judge was become North Carolina Governor Roy Cooper vetoed a bill in 2019 that would have required illegal immigrants from being removed from voter rolls.  I'm not going to look any more into that but this must have been a pressured call on his part, perhaps connected to actors outside of the state.  I say this because while North Carolina does have a Democrat governor every now and then, the state is mostly conservative.  

On this specific issue most North Carolina citizens support removing illegal aliens from the ability to vote, including a majority of registered Democrats.  

I think if you don't want to be involved in jury duty because you are a non-citizen (which is something you are not ALLOWED to do if you are a non-citizen) then you definitely shouldn't be allowed to vote as well.   Cake and eating it too?   

But let's not get ahead of ourselves ok, because even though I am a conservative I know how dirty politics can be.   I think the real reason why this is being brought up is because governor Roy Cooper is running for North Carolina Senate in 2026 and the RNC is looking to stir up as much dirt on the guy as possible.   

For the most part, I feel like the guy was a pretty good governor, even during Covid when he felt the pressure to enforce stay-at-home laws but when conservative counties decided to not comply he didn't make efforts to force them to do so via force.   

I don't really think this is about the actual purging of the voter rolls but if it was, I find it extremely silly that anyone would seriously oppose this.

**“Mundo”** está perfecto como palabra del día porque parece simple, pero tiene mucho juego real en español. No es solo **“world”**; también entra en expresiones muy vivas como **“todo el mundo”** = “everyone” y **“el mundo de…”** = “the world of…” [SpanishDictionary](https://www.spanishdict.com/translate/mundo), [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/spanish-english/mundo).

La frase de tu imagen, **“El mundo es pequeño”**, funciona bien como traducción didáctica de **“This is a small world.”** En uso natural, muchos nativos dirían también **“¡Qué pequeño es el mundo!”**, que suena más idiomático y más cercano a la idea de **“It’s a small world”** [SpanishDictionary](https://www.spanishdict.com/translate/world), [123TeachMe](https://www.123teachme.com/spanish_dictionary/sp2en/mundo).

También me gusta el contraste visual que pusiste: primero el mapa como vocabulario básico, y luego la imagen del universo para ampliar la idea de **mundo físico**. Ese salto de lo cotidiano a lo conceptual le da más peso al post que una simple ficha de diccionario, y además conecta muy bien con tu serie anterior [@aljif7](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-421-mpw1r8lubc9).

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Delicious meat pasticho with cheese and ham.
body.body:
> Feliz noche tengan todos mis queridos amigos un gusto saludarles y desearles que cada uno de ustedes tenga el pan de día a día en sus hogares, esta semana fue una semana bastante importante ya que tengo el cumpleaños de mi hijo mayor, lo cual me lleva a ser un poco creativa en búsqueda de su comida favorita, pues en estas fechas siempre suelo consentirlo y prepararle algo delicioso que sea de su agrado, así que no perdí tiempo y compré todos los ingredientes necesarios para preparar un pasticho de carne. >Good evening to all my dear friends, it's a pleasure to greet you and wish you all a good day's bread in your homes. This week was quite important because it was my eldest son's birthday, which led me to get a little creative in search of his favorite food. On these dates, I always try to spoil him and prepare something delicious that he'll enjoy, so I didn't waste any time and bought all the necessary ingredients to prepare a meat lasagna.
![GridArt_20260602_204921347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK9PujnVjojW7UC8NAQG7a1LbbLFQcxWhvV5Ra8bDoogmH1FT1XsjBuTRNJbZ2k.jpg)
Ingredientes: 2 cajas de pasta para pasticho directo al horno, 400 gramos de jamón, 400 gramos de queso amarillo, 700 gramos de carne molida, 4 tomates, 1 cebolla grande, cebollín, 1 pimentón, color, cubito, hoja de laurel, crema bechamel. >Ingredients: 2 boxes of oven-ready pasticho pasta, 400 grams of ham, 400 grams of yellow cheese, 700 grams of ground meat, 4 tomatoes, 1 large onion, spring onion, 1 bell pepper, color, cube, bay leaf, bechamel cream.
![GridArt_20260602_204355745.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJoJc54fUr9mrQQQqc4UVVRTArQfpqj4L82NCLqEHbJFooFh63m1RVNe7wk1iJj.jpg)
Para preparar la carne molida debemos lavar muy bien nuestros aliños, cortarlo en trozos pequeños y llevarlos a la licuadora con un vaso de agua, licuar y agregar la mezcla de un caldero al igual que la carne molida. >To prepare the ground meat, we must wash our seasonings very well, cut them into small pieces and put them in the blender with a glass of water, blend and add the mixture from a pot along with the ground meat. Mezclamos bien para que toda la carne se desintegre y no queden grumos grandes y luego sazonamos con color cubitos sal hojas de laurel tapamos y dejamos cocinar. >We mix well so that all the meat breaks down and there are no large lumps, then we season with color cubes, salt, bay leaves, cover and let it cook.
![GridArt_20260602_204555541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK6YRi93np2PzAxogWk7Dh1XYbqPEbFAHy4yHxFLv5jvcwnWCsWmkyHBiQ8nUix.jpg)
Finalmente emplatamos colocando una capa de bechamel luego una capa de pasta una capa de carne molida una capa de bechamel jamón queso y repetimos hasta tener varias capas. >Finally, we plate by placing a layer of béchamel sauce, then a layer of pasta, a layer of ground meat, a layer of béchamel sauce, ham, and cheese, and repeat until we have several layers. Tapamos con papel aluminio, llevamos al horno dejamos cocinar por 45 o una hora y listo. >Cover with aluminum foil, put in the oven, let it cook for 45 minutes or an hour and that's it.
![GridArt_20260602_204748074.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJoJdXhPubkhVx5vcRCT8uGcE6PZ6ucwAUytVVK7zGwxJKG2Es4aRLqJUZExDmK.jpg)
![IMG-20210518-WA0013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23vsmbX5FEuYW4QJWvpf9gV1SsdcvFYWz2pdHSV6Rbh7pKEvx1MfBLag9bwed31NV4LFw.jpg)

---
#### Step by step//Paso a paso
---
#### Materials//Materiales:
---

> - Beige, black, white, and brown nylon yarn. - Size 2 crochet hook
ESPAÑOL

- Hilo nailon beige, negro, blanco y marrón. - Aguja crochet Nº 2

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 10.20.03 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AJiyHxtkQy4naadzLQhUseTLpBiexG8AzN8Fqh9PhP6jEzVmv2rtWrBzbxtxVmh.jpeg) ---
#### Abbreviations//Abreviaciones:
---

> ch: chain(s). mp: half point. mpa: half high point. pad: double treble crochet. pat: triple treble crochet. aum: increases. dism: decrease. pa: high point. pr: slipped stitch.
ESPAÑOL

ch: cadena(s). mp: medio punto. mpa: medio punto alto. aum: aumento. dism: disminución. pa: punto alto. pad: punto alto doble. pat: punto alto triple. pr: punto deslizado.

---
#### Process//Proceso:
---

> #### Beige. #### Base. - Work 12 cm of chain stitches, 10 single crochet, 3 single crochet together, 10 single crochet; repeat until you have 15 rows. 5 cm x 20 cm. #### Strip 1. Beige. - 11 rows of single crochet. #### Strip 2. Black. - 11 rows of single crochet. #### Strip 3. White. - 5 rows of single crochet. #### Strip 4. Brown. - 5 rows of single crochet. #### Strip 5. Beige. - 11 rounds of single crochet. #### Strip 6. Black. - 11 rounds of single crochet. Tie off, cut, and weave in the ends, using the tapestry needle to seal the ends. #### Flap. #### Beige. - Chain 12, 10 single crochet, 3 single crochet together, 10 single crochet, 1 chain, turn. - Repeat until you have a strip. #### Black. - Work 4 rounds of single crochet. #### White. - Work 4 rounds of single crochet. #### Brown. - Work 6 rounds of single crochet. - On the 5th round, in the center, make a buttonhole as follows: skip 4 stitches, and continue with single crochet for the rest. #### Handle or cord. #### Beige. - Chain 4, 3 single crochet, chain 3, turn, 1 slip stitch, single crochet, chain 3, turn, repeat until the piece measures 90 cm. Then sew the flap to the top of the bag using slip stitches. Finally, sew on a knitted button. I sewed the cord to the sides.
ESPAÑOL

#### Beige. #### Base. - Hacer 12 cm de chs, 10 mp, 3 mp juntos, 10 mp, repetir hasta tener 15 vueltas. 5 cm x 20 cm. #### Franja 1. Beige. - 11 vueltas de mp. #### Franja 2. Negro. - 11 vueltas de mp. #### Franja 3. Blanco. - 05 vueltas de mp. #### franja 4. Marrón. - 05 vueltas de mp. #### Franja 5. Beige. - 11 vueltas de mp. #### Franja 6. Negro. - 11 vueltas de mp. Anudar,cortar y ocultar hilo, usando el yesquero para el sellado. #### Solapa. #### Beige. - Se hacen 12 chs, 10 mp, 3 mp juntos,10 mp, 1 ch, girar. - Repetir hasta tener una franja. #### Negro. - Hacer 04 vueltas de mp. #### Blanco. - Hacer 04 vueltas de mp. #### Marrón. - Hacer 06 vueltas de mp. - En la 5ta vuelta en el centro se hace un ojal de la siguiente forma, se saltan 04 espacios, y seguimos con mp el resto. #### Asa o cordón. #### Beige. - Hacer 4 chs, 3 mp, 3 chs girar tejido, 1 pa punto relive, pa, 3 chs, girar, repitiendo hasta tener 90 cms. Luego la solapa se cose con punto deslizado pr en la parte superior del bolso. Y para terminar cosemos un botón tejido. Cosí a los lados el cordón.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 6.33.51 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23uQrHEUTiWYo2JzM8eUFZyH69AUUEpge5Edfaz9ptssLdu6njVPDcp9W12KQZVS6m7ep.jpeg) ---

> #### ***... And there you have it—this elegant bag*** I finally managed to finish this project; it took me a long time to knit it in between doing household chores. Dimensions: 22 x 20 x 6 cm. This bag is for me, because the one I have is very worn and faded. I love working with nylon yarn because it’s durable and washable.
ESPAÑOL

#### ***... Y listo este bolso elegante*** Por fin logré terminar este proyecto, duré mucho tiempo tejiendo entre cada labor de hogar. Mide: 22 x 20 x 6 cm. Este bolso es para mi, porque el que tengo está muy usado y descolorido. Me encanta trabajar con el hilo de nailon porque es duradero y lavable.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 10.19.42 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AJoHtbSpBzsUd5aS6UkQ7s5w7nK5GSG2hVcP4H8a8tUpr19W8g8ncqs3g6tiDJw.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 5.36.19 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AK5694gfWEyLuM7LQptGrbu2bhTzFGcnhsoJZZSLF7fB3qTZHooTPbHnABcGUbk.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 5.36.19 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23xep7ZG3N8fDr4rgxF1aXCKZXphycCBtJH1WKX7aX7AtSLjLbnoJENgmtWrYSfC36MkC.jpeg) --- ***Friends, did you like this stylish woven bag 👜? We'd love to hear your thoughts...***

body.body: @chessbrotherpro the beauty of that story isn’t just about moves and scores, it’s about the vibe between two chess giants at different stages of their journey. Tal was already the “Magician from Riga,” dazzling everyone with his fearless, poetic style, while Fischer was still the young prodigy trying to find his footing. And instead of crushing him as just another opponent, Tal treated him with respect, almost like a younger brother he knew would one day rise to greatness.  \n\nThat mix of camaraderie and rivalry was priceless. Fischer soaked up lessons from Tal, and even though he later carved out a colder, more precise style of his own, you can still feel the imprint of having faced someone who inspired and supported him early on. In the end, beyond the board, what really lasts is the friendship between rivals and the mutual respect that makes their story legendary.

body.title: The devil's backbone and the lesson of Its leaves [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRaLoMaFczWrYuAuTKsVe9mMegEuE7joGU7a29nXrXJGx/1780454027470.jpg)



***
***

There is something in my garden that steals my attention every time I walk by, and it is not the ostentatious roses. It is a plant that many know as kalanchoe, but that in my homeland and in the mouths of those who know old plants and home remedies is called by a name that sounds like a legend: devil's backbone.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVYtPfYRVoMEMHrB8aMVurF8QEbHGa77wQU66mKGVWznA/1780454027763.jpg)

***

I confess that at first the name bothered me, but then I understood that popular poetry does not always seek tenderness, but rather vertigo. And this plant, indeed, has something diabolically ingenious about it, something that challenges what I thought I knew about how leaves live and die.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY2d3vDJ9wsxqrWUKMX5VSbfqP7rem6GSuxTMCEdYNLRY/1780454028380.jpg)


***
It all started with a pot that a neighbor gave me. For months I watched it grow upright, with its fleshy leaves, thick as fingers that store water for drought. But what she never warned me about was the moment of the miracle.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNss1PKG4bAsEA8LCgqbkm2K8X2AFkhWnPZ5zVoYywqJp/1780454028230.jpg)

***
One day, while cleaning the lower, oldest leaves, I discovered something that left me suspended and amazed. On the edges of those leaves, as if an invisible hand had dropped tiny seeds, small shoots began to appear. They were not flowers; they were daughters, tiny versions of the mother plant, with their own little aerial roots and their small leaves in formation, hanging from the edge of the old leaf like offspring not yet ready to let go.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNdm45AvNUjBEw5sh5q5yopei3SCKFbMrN38zY1fj62Zq/1780454027992.jpg)

***
My heart skipped a beat because this is not a seed that falls to the ground and germinates blindly, left to chance. This is a mother who gives birth along the edges of her own body, holding her children close to her while they learn to breathe the same air, to harden their tissues, to prepare for the exact moment to leave. It reminded me of small rodents that travel clinging to their mother's back, or marsupials that are gestated twice, once inside and once outside, in the warm security of a pouch.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRcQpsYvXawNctZ9TK4Gfg63Ao22YuwrAcFYGyZqnAGhk/1780454116433.jpg)


***
The devil's backbone does the same, but in vegetal silence. The magic was that even after the children left, the old leaf remained alive, and from its edges, again, more were born, as if the cycle were eternal.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR8BqeoWa3z3rj4aoFiiwC7cggnv9tLB2DvjCPbFmtTc5/1780454116168.jpg)

***
Now, when I walk through the garden and look at the devil's backbone, I cannot help but feel a certain tenderness. That threatening name has almost become a loving nickname for me, because the devil, if he had a plant, would do nothing more terrifying than teach us a form of inexhaustible love. The love of one who breaks into pieces so that others may live, of one who holds on to the edge of her own leaf so that her young do not fall before their time.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXCEaGbPcj6tcirWADeZQnATdq8obL3tcCfEwi7XUJaBz/1780454116703.jpg)


***
Today, as the sun filters through the leaves of my devil's backbone, I think that perhaps the entire garden is just a metaphor. Meanwhile, I will continue counting tiny children on each old leaf and smiling, because I know that there, in that green corner that some call devil's backbone, dwells one of the most beautiful forms of motherhood I have ever witnessed.

<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTeTdEXkKDvQsv1MkcAEMthgQ3dA9hMceEye4t8ViLUQc/1780292702177.jpg)

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>El espinazo del diablo y la lección de sus hojas</center>



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWY7eowTHQnhG2Rfr7iaDbYVqKqatDVTUvTgvSdDD8C8/1780453632657.jpg)



***
***







Hay algo en mi jardín que me roba la atención cada vez que paso cerca, y no son las rosas ostentosas. Es una planta que muchos conocen como kalanchoe, pero que en mi tierra y en boca de quienes saben de plantas viejas y remedios caseros llaman con un nombre que suena a leyenda: espinazo del diablo.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVYtPfYRVoMEMHrB8aMVurF8QEbHGa77wQU66mKGVWznA/1780454027763.jpg)


***
Confieso que al principio el nombre me inquietaba, pero luego entendí que a veces la poesía popular no busca la ternura, sino el vértigo. Y esta planta, en efecto, tiene algo de diabólicamente ingeniosa, algo que desafía lo que yo creía saber sobre cómo viven y mueren las hojas.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY2d3vDJ9wsxqrWUKMX5VSbfqP7rem6GSuxTMCEdYNLRY/1780454028380.jpg)

***
Todo empezó con una maceta que me regaló una vecina. Durante meses la vi crecer erguida, con sus hojas carnosas, gruesas como dedos que guardan agua para la sequía. Pero lo que nunca me advirtió fue el momento del milagro.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNss1PKG4bAsEA8LCgqbkm2K8X2AFkhWnPZ5zVoYywqJp/1780454028230.jpg)

***
Un día, limpiando las hojas bajas, las más viejas, descubrí algo que me dejó suspendida y maravillada. En los bordes de esas hojas, como si una mano invisible hubiera dejado caer semillas diminutas, comenzaban a asomar pequeños brotes que no eran flores. Eran hijas, minúsculas versiones de la planta madre, con sus propias raicitas aéreas y sus hojitas en formación, colgando del filo de la hoja vieja como crías que aún no están listas para soltarse.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNdm45AvNUjBEw5sh5q5yopei3SCKFbMrN38zY1fj62Zq/1780454027992.jpg)

***
Mi corazón pegó un vuelco porque eso no es una semilla que cae al suelo y germina a ciegas, confiada a la suerte. Esto es una madre que pare por las orillas de su propio cuerpo, y que sostiene a sus hijos aferrados a ella, mientras ellos aprenden a respirar el mismo aire, a endurecer sus tejidos, a prepararse para el momento exacto de partir. Me recordó a los pequeños roedores que viajan sujetos al lomo de su madre, a los marsupiales que se gestan dos veces, una dentro y otra fuera, en la cálida seguridad de una bolsa.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRcQpsYvXawNctZ9TK4Gfg63Ao22YuwrAcFYGyZqnAGhk/1780454116433.jpg)

***
El espinazo del diablo hace lo mismo, pero en silencio vegetal. La magia fue que, incluso después de que los hijos se fueran, la hoja vieja siguió viva, y de sus bordes, otra vez, volvieron a nacer más, como si el ciclo fuera eterno.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR8BqeoWa3z3rj4aoFiiwC7cggnv9tLB2DvjCPbFmtTc5/1780454116168.jpg)

***
Ahora, cuando paso por el jardín y miro el espinazo del diablo, no puedo evitar sentir cierta ternura. Ese nombre amenazante se me ha vuelto casi un apodo cariñoso, porque el diablo, si tuviera una planta, no haría nada más aterrador que enseñarnos una forma de amor inagotable. El amor de quien se parte en pedazos para que otros vivan, de quien se sostiene en el borde de su propia hoja para que la cría no caiga antes de tiempo.

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXCEaGbPcj6tcirWADeZQnATdq8obL3tcCfEwi7XUJaBz/1780454116703.jpg)

***
Hoy, mientras el sol se filtra entre las hojas de mi espinazo del diablo, pienso que tal vez el jardín entero es solo una metáfora. Mientras tanto, seguiré contando hijos minúsculos en cada hoja vieja y sonriendo, porque sé que ahí, en ese rincón verde que algunos llaman espinazo del diablo, habita una de las formas más hermosas de maternidad que he presenciado jamás.


<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQA2nwFQo3sZ1vuEqgLphQMjgqrarqB5nhtG2BYMxCbV/1780292702295.jpg)

<sub>🍃 **¡𝑮𝒓𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒂𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝒍𝒆𝒆𝒓!** 🍃
𝑺𝒊 𝒂ú𝒏 𝒏𝒐 𝒎𝒆 𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒐𝒄𝒆𝒔: 𝒔𝒐𝒚 **𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓ó𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒂 𝒚 𝒆𝒔𝒄𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒄𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏𝒂**, 𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒓𝒆, 𝒎𝒖𝒋𝒆𝒓 𝒚 𝒔𝒐ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒒𝒖𝒆 𝒆𝒏𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒕𝒓ó 𝒆𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒖𝒏 𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒎𝒐𝒔𝒐 𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒐 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒗𝒐𝒍𝒂𝒓.  
**𝑬𝒍 𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕𝒐 𝒚 𝒍𝒂𝒔 𝒊𝒎á𝒈𝒆𝒏𝒆𝒔 𝒔𝒐𝒏 𝒅𝒆 𝒎𝒊 𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒐𝒓í𝒂**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒐𝒔 (𝒔𝒊𝒏 𝑰𝑨).  
𝑩𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒊𝒔𝒆ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝑳𝒖𝒎𝒊𝒊.
¿𝑻𝒆 𝒈𝒖𝒔𝒕ó 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂 𝒑𝒖𝒃𝒍𝒊𝒄𝒂𝒄𝒊ó𝒏? **𝑽𝒐𝒕𝒂, 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒂 𝒐 𝒓𝒆𝒃𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒖𝒆𝒂** 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒂𝒚𝒖𝒅𝒂𝒓 𝒂 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒍𝒆𝒈𝒂𝒓 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒔 𝒂𝒍𝒂𝒔. 💗</sub>

>

Las Finales de Conferencia de la NBA de 2026 han concluido y nos han dejado una mezcla de dominio absoluto, drama de infarto y una buena dosis de polémica arbitral. Ahora, con el escenario listo para las Finales de la NBA, repasamos lo sucedido y nos aventuramos con un pronóstico para el gran choque por el Larry O'Brien Trophy.

## Conferencia Este: Barrida Esperada de los Knicks
Como muchos esperábamos, los New York Knicks no tuvieron piedad y se llevaron la serie en cuatro juegos (4-0) ante los Cleveland Cavaliers. Para los fanáticos de los Cavs, el resultado deja un sabor de boca muy amargo: el equipo que dominó la temporada regular simplemente no fue ni la sombra de lo que fueron durante la temporada, desapareciendo en los momentos clave.

Por el contrario, los Knicks demostraron por qué son el equipo a batir en el Este. Su nivel de juego actual es sencillamente arrollador y no nos pareció extraño que les pasaran por encima de esa manera. NY llega a las Finales con hambre, tras tantos años de sequía.

## Conferencia Oeste: Drama en 7 Juegos y \

en San Antonio
Del otro lado, vivimos una serie entre los San Antonio Spurs y el Oklahoma City Thunder que, la verdad, fue de infarto. Se necesitaron los siete juegos completos (4-3 SAS) para definir al campeón del Oeste, en una batalla física y mental que mantuvo a todos al borde del asiento hasta el último segundo del Juego 7.

Lamentablemente, la polémica no faltó. Presenciamos un arbitraje increíblemente descarado a favor de OKC durante gran parte de la serie. Sin embargo, para suerte de la NBA y de la afición, en el Juego 7 pareció que la liga tomó cartas en el asunto y cambiaron a los árbitros habituales. Se hizo justicia y San Antonio pudo desplegar su increíble juego sin obstáculos.

Lo de los Spurs es digno de admirar: un equipo joven en formación para ser una élite a futuro que \

y ha marcado el comienzo de una nueva época dorada en San Antonio. ¡Enhorabuena, SAS!

## Pronóstico Finales NBA 2026: San Antonio vs. New York
Aunque debería ser una serie espectacular y llena de narrativa, yo me inclinaría a decir que los Spurs se llevarán el campeonato.

New York llega con hambre, tras tantos años sin llegar a una final de la NBA. Es innegable que darán batalla con todo lo que tienen. Pero para mí, el talento y la juventud de San Antonio dará la estocada final. La frescura de su juego, el liderazgo de Wemby y la confianza que ganaron tras sobrevivir al drama del Oeste les dará la ventaja decisiva sobre la ansiedad y hambre de los Knicks.

Mi apuesta: San Antonio Spurs, campeones de la NBA 2026.

¡Los leo en los comentarios! ¿Creen que los Knicks pueden romper su racha o el talento joven de SAS se impondrá? 👇

body.body:

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVWtTKH8165gEiAWUo8r1HUQXv7XhkViL22b9qCqq2N5r/image.png)
[fuente](https://www.magnific.com/es/fotos-vectores-gratis/chica-morena-linda)

#

LA MOZA

Una moza muy bonita
me saludó en la mañana
estba yo en la ventana
deshojando margaritas.

Me sonrió muy picarona
con su mirar atrayente
yo le seguí la corriente
a esa sonrisa ladrona.

Mi corazón palpitaba
con un son enamorado
y es que el estar a su lado
con eso nunca contaba.

Murmuraba entre sus labios
sus caprichos de tenerme
no podía evitar que al verme
tener a este monosabio.

La mozita buenamosa
ahora quiere conquistarme
pero no voy a dejarme
hasta que sea mi esposa.

Con ese sabor que tiene
cuando mueve la cintura
va luciendo en su figura
un soncito que va y viene.

Ay, mi moza trigueñita
tu cintura va al compás
con eso me enseñarás
adorable señorita.

#

![photo_2026-02-22_14-00-02.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUb1sGWPGvaAXBKJakS19TEGZ4iDgJbEiMnbJbY1ujn4U/photo_2026-02-22_14-00-02.jpg)

#

THE WOMAN

A very pretty woman
greeted me this morning. I was at the window
plucking petals from daisies.

She smiled at me mischievously
with her alluring gaze. I went along with it
with that thieving smile.

My heart throbbed
with a lovestruck rhythm, for being by her side
was something I never expected.

She murmured between her lips
her desires to have me. She couldn't help but notice me
this clever little fellow.

The lovely young woman
now wants to win me over,
but I won't let her
until she's my wife.

With that sway she has
when she moves her hips,
her figure shows off
a little rhythm that comes and goes.

Oh, my little brunette woman,
your hips move to the beat. With that, you'll teach me,
adorable young lady.

body.title: Martes 2 de junio 2026: ¡Al fin comencé en el gimnasio! [ESP/ENG]
body.body: > ¿Quién dijo que un martes no es un buen día para empezar? Estuve alrededor de un mes posponiéndolo. Le dije a mi hijo: ¡Empecemos el lunes!.. Como te dio gripe te esperaré para comenzar juntos... Como no te has recuperado, mejor empiezo yo primero... ¡Ah! pero es que ya es la última semana del mes, mejor empiezo el lunes, que es primero. Ups, no hay electricidad, mejor comienzo mañana martes. Y llego el martes, sin excusas, sólo con una pesadez tremenda, como si mis pies no se quisieran mover, pero sé que es mi mente la que me mantenía alejada de ese objetivo que me había propuesto en pro de mi bienestar: Ir al gimnasio.

> 
 
Who said Tuesday isn't a good day to start?

I put it off for about a month. I told my son, \

Oops, there’s no electricity, so I’d better start tomorrow, Tuesday. And Tuesday arrived, with no excuses, just a tremendous heaviness, as if my feet didn’t want to move, but I know it’s my mind that was keeping me away from that goal I’d set for myself for the sake of my well-being: going to the gym. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmZiHEoeMRxrYYU6T9Y7iBkxwsSKi4AmL9i6vx5Mda8zvz/20260602_223355.jpg
***

> Ayer vi un video sobre la corteza prefrontal, que está relacionada con el control de la disciplina, concentración y la capacidad de hacer cosas difíciles; entonces entendí, que la única manera de superar esa sensación de pesadez que me inmoviliza, es haciendo eso que quiero evitar. Comprendí que debía entrenar mi corteza prefrontal para ganar fuerza mental y así, conseguir todo lo que me propongo; porque cada vez que hacemos algo incómodo, nuestra corteza frontal se fortalece y aumenta la tolerancia. Además de que no me gusta la idea de no poder gobernar mi propia mente 😅.

> Yesterday I watched a video about the prefrontal cortex, which is linked to self-control, concentration, and the ability to do difficult things; that’s when I realized that the only way to overcome that feeling of heaviness that paralyzes me is by doing the very thing I want to avoid. I realized I needed to train my prefrontal cortex to build mental strength and thus achieve everything I set out to do; because every time we do something uncomfortable, our prefrontal cortex gets stronger and our tolerance increases. Plus, I don’t like the idea of not being able to control my own mind 😅. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmdcWED6WdVbHaLxvop5roRniBKGm51m2yKzb5tGQ5kqd3/20260602_211549.jpg
***

> 
 
Entonces, tomé el impulso que necesitaba y me dije: pues hoy sí voy al gimnasio.

Llegué a casa, me cambié de ropa y me fui, sin darle muchas vueltas, como quien saca una espina de un solo tirón, para que duela menos.

Porque a fin de cuentas, esa tarea sin cumplir me pesaba. Es como ese sapo mirándome, del libro \
, que marcó mi forma de ver mi rutina y que ahora menciono cada vez que dejo de hacer algo que debería.

> So, I gathered the momentum I needed and told myself: “Well, today I’m definitely going to the gym.” I got home, changed my clothes, and headed out without giving it much thought—like someone pulling a thorn out in one swift motion so it hurts less. Because, after all, that unfinished task was weighing on me. It’s like that frog staring at me from the book *Swallow That Frog*, which shaped the way I view my routine and which I now mention every time I fail to do something I should. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmQeKjq6MWu3KSBobfx8mW8LijDqFZ9tqMupkVERHEdysz/20260602_212128.jpg
***

> Como suele suceder cada vez que hago lo correcto aún sin querer, me sentí fenomenal por haber superado mi inercia, además disfruté el entrenamiento. Creo que elegí bien el sitio, pienso que obtendré buenos resultados; en especial, porque estoy cuidando mi alimentación. Anoté mi peso y la medida de mi cintura hoy: 74.55 Kg. y 97 cms. Lo dejo aquí asentado, porque espero poder comparar resultados a final de año 😁.

> As usually happens whenever I do the right thing—even without meaning to—I felt great for having overcome my inertia, and I actually enjoyed the workout. I think I chose the right place; I think I’ll get good results—especially since I’m watching what I eat. I wrote down my weight and waist measurement today: 74.55 kg and 97 cm. I’m noting it here because I hope to be able to compare results at the end of the year 😁.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

> Y estos son mis pensamientos para compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And these are the thoughts I’d like to share with you today, my friends. Every day offers us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, stroke by stroke. To all of you, thank you for joining me on this journey through these words. ***

body.title: Dejarse amar en libertad como tema para Poesía
body.body:
Publicado en Español, Inglés y Portugués.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmexxgPPCU57PtgJuZWpzxerKvN4XkRVFuz9f3YH1SHFmU/1780452933029.png) *Editado en PhotoCollage*

---

Buenas noches y lindos sueños.
¡Que viva el amor y la Libertad!


Le dejo unos versos libres, siéntanlos suyos y disculpen mi atrevimiento.

---

# *LIBRE*




*Ámame cuando me sientas libre.
Cuando no pidas raíz si ves que soy alas.
Ámame hasta el vuelo 
y no en la estatua ungida en el asfalto.
Ámame en el temblor que antecede al nombre,
cuando mi piel desata sus fronteras
y el viento me recorre las esquinas*.

*Siénteme en el sabor que se muda a mi costado
sin el peso de tus ojos en la espalda.
Deseame cual naranjo que idolatra la grandeza del Baobad.
Y fija la ruta hacia el vórtice de un sueño en Do mayor*.

*Si me ves girar sobre mi centro,
esa diana como
flecha que se inventa su destino,
no construyas un lecho en mi cintura.
Construye, más bien, un sendero en 
el abismo.
Allí me encontrarás entera*.

*Ámame como al agua que no sabe
su propia orilla, 
cuando elijo la intemperie de ser solo mía.
Entonces sí: bésame hasta el fin,
que el vértigo es también un acto de fe,
y la libertad, 
su única ceremonia*.

---
**Poema original de** @camelia28
---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---



Good evening and sweet dreams.
Long live love and freedom!

I leave you some free verses, feel them as your own and forgive my daring.

---

# *FREE*

*Love me when you feel I'm free.
When you don't ask for roots if you see that I am wings.
Love me up to the flight
and not in the statue anointed on the asphalt.
Love me in the tremor that precedes the name,
when my skin unties its borders
and the wind runs through my corners*.

*Feel me in the flavor that shifts to my side
without the weight of your eyes on my back.
Desire me like an orange tree that worships the grandeur of the Baobab.
And set the course toward the vortex of a dream in C major*.

*If you see me spinning on my axis,
that target like
an arrow that invents its own destiny,
do not build a bed on my waist.
Rather, build a path into
the abyss.
There you will find me whole*.

*Love me like water that does not know
its own shore,
when I choose the rawness of being only mine.
Then yes: kiss me until the end,
for vertigo is also an act of faith,
and freedom,
its only ceremony*.

---

Original poem by @camelia28

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---
---

# *PORTUGUÊS*

---
---

Boa noite e bons sonhos.
Viva o amor e a liberdade!

Deixo-lhes uns versos livres, sintam-nos como seus e desculpem minha ousadia.

---

# *LIVRE*

Ame-me quando me sentir livre.
Quando não pedir raiz se vir que sou asas.
Ame-me até o voo
e não na estátua ungida no asfalto.
Ame-me no tremor que antecede o nome,
quando minha pele desata suas fronteiras
e o vento percorre minhas esquinas.

Sinta-me no sabor que se muda para meu lado
sem o peso dos seus olhos nas costas.
Deseje-me como laranjeira que idolatra a grandeza do Baobá.
E trace a rota para o vórtex de um sonho em Dó maior.

Se me vir girar sobre meu centro,
esse alvo como
flecha que inventa seu destino,
não construa uma cama em minha cintura.
Construa, melhor, uma trilha no
abismo.
Lá me encontrará inteira.

Ame-me como a água que não conhece
sua própria margem,
quando escolho a intempérie de ser só minha.
Então sim: beije-me até o fim,
pois o vértigo também é um ato de fé,
e a liberdade,
sua única cerimônia.

---

Poema original de @camelia28


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcAhAKwyNZZUJMUA7vdruF54aTShX8Mq1ZCs7xYD3C5Sp/1758337351053.jpg)

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: June 1 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3d0462c1-18fe-4b64-8c51-210b55dcb036.jpg) Hey Actifitters, We're slowly getting into our workweek routine with much less activity due to Kaia's injury. And yesterday was clearly a routine day. Our only real activity once again was a short walk to the small forest behind the front yard. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/78107b21-2d17-4821-9c33-d45da8a59fac.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/42e1184c-344d-4537-8655-e11e12a74ac7.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0a53d3d6-f518-4474-aae7-bbdc5b5b69b6.jpg) We went in for a while but Kaia saw something. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/615d30af-1331-482a-8c38-edfd843189ad.jpg) I was surprised to see Le Chat actually in the forest, looking for us. Now that the entire ground is covered with green, plants and whatnot, she usually waits for us at the edge. And I was even more surprised when Kaia let her lead us out on the way back. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c1d51b8e-04cc-4663-93fb-88fcfecc34f0.jpg) Sorry it's a bit blurry, the light was getting low. But this was funny to me, it's almost like Le Chat knew Kaia wasn't supposed to jump, and she taunted her by jumping over her favorite obstacle. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/352df06e-e09d-4de0-9704-9eb376b26bff.jpg) We finished our walk again with a loop in the neighborhood. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0b420db4-5fcf-48a5-982e-17b2a42da4b2.jpg) Until the last sunset colors on the West disappeared. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/56a7a361-3905-4eec-9442-02861350230a.jpg) As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260603t022749860z)_

body.title: Weekend Diary
body.body:
![1676.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY1eqtraAveuEqg74Escn7aC8YfjbS9pkpkny293WkJRS/1676.jpg)

---

Today was absolutely glorious, one of those perfect sunny days where the world just feels vibrant and full of life. I decided to take my little one out to explore, and we found ourselves on these lovely, expansive grounds. 

 Every step he took was a mini-adventure, his small shadow trailing faithfully behind him on the sun-drenched lawn.The grass itself was a beautiful mix of deep greens, stretching out like a soft, inviting carpet. 

In the distance, the elegant 'PARADISE HOTEL & RESORT' sign stood grandly, hinting at a world of luxury beyond our simple exploration. Magnificent fountains danced in the sunlight, sending sparkling jets of water high into the air, creating a serene backdrop. 

A sleek black car glided by on the road, while closer by, I could see our stroller parked patiently on a charming brick pathway, nestled among wilder patches of greenery dotted with cheerful yellow and tiny white flowers. 

It was a wonderful contrast between the manicured beauty and the natural charm.He was completely absorbed, taking small, determined steps, his head of dark hair bobbing slightly with each movement. 

These are the moments I truly cherish, watching him discover the world, one tiny step at a time. The air was fresh, the sun was warm on my skin, and the peaceful hum of the fountains added to the tranquil atmosphere.

 It reminds me to slow down, to appreciate the simple beauty around us, and to soak in every precious second of his childhood wonder. What a truly perfect day, filled with unadulterated happiness and the promise of many more adventures to come.

body.title: Experience and benefits of the great cards I got by opening the guild pack
body.body:
Today was a very happy day for me in world  Splinterlands. I had been planning  open the guild pack that I had been saving for a long time, and finally got the opportunity today. There is always a kind excitement when opening  pack, because you never know when a valuable card will come out. The curiosity was increasing with each card I turned over. When all the cards came out, I saw that I got some great cards, including two gold foil cards. As a Splinterlands player this is undoubtedly  big achievement.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXPuPJ5VfSf2gSCohjyCW8WorwVwy4omyesLVr2wjhxus/1780453067393.jpg)

The cards I got from this pack are Relenor Cleaver, Alva The Crusher, Katrelba Gobson (Gold Foil), Whistling Damon (Gold Foil) Cutter Brize. Each card has its own characteristics and uses, which will help me build a stronger team future battles.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUEKPKPa38sK2ANmL9j35tqztRt5FnXdM3uzpqbBZHY9L/1780453066782.jpg)

Relenor Cleaver

First of all, let me talk about Relenor Cleaver.  One of the biggest advantages of this card is that it can quickly hit the front line of opponents. In many cases during the battle, a unit that is capable of breaking the enemy's defense is needed. Relenor Cleaver can do that job very efficiently.

The biggest advantage of this card for me is its balanced stats. It can be used in various types of battles due to its good attack, sufficient health, and acceptable speed. I think it will work as an effective card especially in medium mana matches.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUv44LkfUyMyjt4XYSbJ2kHg8vPLNu1ceFXzZghxz8avT/1780453067202.jpg)

Alva The Crusher

Next comes Alva The Crusher. As the name suggests, it is a strong fighter. The main feature of this card is its survivability. Many cards are quickly defeated during the battle, but Alva The Crusher can stay on the field for a long time.

I noticed that its health is relatively good, which allows it to be used as a tank or secondary tank. If there are strong attacking cards in front, Alva The Crusher can support them and continue the battle for a long time. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT1JXXy8VZBGfgGDYRzFMjRKvyg5AfD3TUZ5tTPLmQNAu/1780453066883.jpg)

 I was very happy after receiving this card it will make a significant contribution  strengthening my team future.

Katrelba Gobson (Gold Foil)

The most enjoyable moment of today's pack opening was receiving the Gold Foil Katrelba Gobson. Gold Foil cards always carry special value in Splinterlands. Not only because they look good, but they also provide additional collection power.

Katrelba Gobson is a very popular card. Its attack power special ability make it stand out from the others. One of the biggest advantages this card is that it can quickly weaken the opponent. If used correctly during battle, it can single-handedly turn tide  match.

Being a Gold Foil, this card also has a higher market value than the normal version. As a result, it is not only an important asset on the battlefield, but also in terms of collection. It is a real pleasure to add such a card to my collection.

Whistling Damon (Gold Foil)

Another big attraction of this pack was the Gold Foil Whistling Damon. When I saw card, I was really surprised.  Because chance getting a Gold Foil card is always low.

One of Whistling Damon's biggest strengths is its ranged attack. It can put pressure on enemies from a distance and deal damage quickly. In addition, it has some other important abilities added at higher levels, which makes it even more dangerous.

Being a Gold Foil, this card has a lot of collection power. Such a card is very useful for those who want increase their rank and play in higher leagues. I think this card will become one  most important members my Death Splinter team  future.

Cutter Brize

Finally, there is Cutter Brize. Although it is a Rare card, its usefulness is not at all low. Sometimes we only look at big cards, but in reality, small and balanced cards play a big role in winning matches.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR1h1Ctm8psAne5KuXX2wJwbG3Jv5iJ1rFfnUuxMd4TUG/1780453067059.jpg)

The advantage of Cutter Brize is that it can be used with relatively low mana. As a result, it can be very effective in matches with low mana caps. Due to its fast attack good speed, it helps keep enemy team under pressure.

 I think this card will play an important role in many strategic matches future. Cutter Brize will be a good option, especially when you need build a strong team with limited mana.

Special benefits of getting gold foil cards

The biggest achievement of today's pack opening is getting two gold foil cards. Gold foil cards are very important in Splinterlands. Because:

They provide additional Collection Power.

The market value is higher than normal cards.

When used in Brawl and Ranked Battle, special benefits are available.

Makes collecting more attractive.

It can also hold a good value as an investment in the long run.

So getting two gold foil cards from the same pack is really a blessing.

My feelings

Opening guild packs is always a special experience for me. Every time I flip a card, I feel like maybe a rare card will come out this time. When I finally got two gold foils and a few powerful rare cards, that joy increased even more.

Splinterlands is not just a game, it is a wonderful combination strategy, collection and patience. Today's pack opening reminded me again why I love this game much.  The joy getting new cards, analyzing their abilities and planning future battles—all combined—was a great experience.

Overall, today’s Guild Pack opening was a huge success for me. Relenor Cleaver, Alva The Crusher, Katrelba Gobson Gold Foil, Whistling Damon Gold Foil, and Cutter Brize—each card added to my collection. Getting the two Gold Foil cards in particular was my biggest achievement of the day. Now, my goal will be to gradually level up these cards and ensure maximum use in future battles. I am hopeful that these cards will make my Splinterlands journey more successful and enjoyable.
My i,d

body.title: A Geeky Guy's Guide to Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
body.body:
This movie really seemed like they took four episodes of The Mandalorian and stitched them together to make a feature length film. I'm not saying that is a bad thing, but it is important to know before setting your expectations.

![](https://vulkk.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/The-Mandalorian-and-Grogu-poster-1.jpg)

Because I went into expecting nothing more than a long Mandalorian episode, I was not disappointed. I really enjoy the show and love the characters and relationship between Mando and Baby Yoda... I mean Grogu. I got exactly what I was expecting: a simple plot, fun interactions between Mando and Grogu, Grogu being insanely cute and some cool battle scenes. I got all that.

This was a unique movie. Although it was clearly made for kids, it also includes lots of bad guys actually dying. There are no pilots ejecting and Storm Troopers and other villains actually get shot and die... a lot. In fact there are many scenes of Mando just walking into a room and killing literally everyone. These scenes weren't choreographed that well but it was good enough to keep my interest. 

![](https://imageio.forbes.com/specials-images/imageserve/6a1078b216f8860dbfab7e01/The-Mandalorian-And-Grogu--2026-/0x0.jpg?width=960)

One of the very cool things about this movie was the writer/director John Favreau insisting on using practical effects. I'm sure by now that everyone is aware that Grogu is not CGI. He is an old school puppet. Even in this movie, they stay true to that details. At one point Grogu scoops out a paste-like medicine without bending his fingers, wrists or any other joints. He is a puppet with puppet hands. While some may be annoyed by this, I found it endearing. An even better example is a battle scene between Mando, Grogu and two giant robots. The robots were actually animated using stop motion animation. While some may have found this hokey, I found it cool and nostalgic. 

Not all of the effects were old school. there were plenty of the high quality special effects we have grown to expect from Lucasfilm. There are plenty of action sequences and space battles to allow them to flex their fx muscles. 

But when it comes down to it, this movie (or more likely television show arc) was all about getting to the final act. The first two thirds of the movie was very simple and formulaic. Find the McGuffin. Get the McGuffin. Deal with the problems caused by getting the McGuffin. The only thing I will say about this particular McGuffin is that it is a fantastic call back for fans of the Clone Wars cartoon \

(A three episode arc that was released in theaters... kind of like this one).

So was this movie worth it? If you like The Mandalorian television show and you prefer watching movies in Dolby on the big screen, it is definitely worth it. If you are just as happy watching on your phone, you can wait for this to come to Disney+. 

![](https://static01.nyt.com/images/2026/05/20/multimedia/mandalorian-anatomy1-jvqk/mandalorian-anatomy1-jvqk-facebookJumbo.jpg)

Although I enjoyed Mando and Grogu playing father and son, and I do find Grogu cute and funny, the movie would not have been worth it for me if it weren't for that final act. Clearly Favreau and Filoni wrote some insane battle scenes and then were like \

? Until that final battle, there really were no stakes or excitement. I knew Mando wasn't going to die early in the movie so it was all a formality that in every crowded room he entered, he'd leave behind a pile of dead bodies. But the final battle did actually have me on the edge of my seat a bit. 

So was this movie worth it? If you like The Mandalorian television show and you prefer watching movies in Dolby on the big screen, it is definitely worth it. If you are just as happy watching on your phone, you can wiat for this to come to Disney+. 

​
