links.title: Philippine Senate Playing High Stakes Chess
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRe9TKTFGkewn5BJ8ZvYxRbE4BXJqh3yHCw514T82RoFy/1780448768578.png)

The Senate currently is embroiled in a fierce political battle of strategies. This august chamber has never been this polarized ever in the history of said institution.

Long ago during the time of Neptali Gonzalez and Edgardo Angara, they kept  changing senate presidency but it's all about numbers game. However back then the battle was just about the title of being senate president. But now the battle for senate presidency is not just for the presididng seat, it is about career endings and imprisonment--thats how high the stakes are.

Usually senators would put their swipe at another senator through floor debates but despite the swiping and subtle mudlinging they would still adress their colleagues like \

never forgetting to be respectful at all times no matter how hard they argue. 

So what does our current Senators from 20th congress are going loco over that they tossed aside their collegiality and statesmanship out the window?

In my point of view this all started with the people's initiative. That time the Marcoses and the Dutertes were still good until...

Until the former president Rodrigo Duterte spoke up about BBM's addiction. He straight out said the current president is a user. He made that statement because he got wind that the new administration is pushing for a constitutional amendment. 

At first the president and the vice president were still okay but then the former president was shipped to The Hague. 

Then VP Sara distanced herself from the administration.

Next the impeachment against the VP was initiated but unfortunately for the current administration on the midterm Senate elections majority of the winning senators were the Duterte ticket. 

What happened next then the president opened a can of worms on his state of the nation address by calling out contractors regarding ghost projects causing the massive floods.

This led to the blue ribbon committee to investigate. It was established that lawmakers and contractors along with DPWH high officials were running a scheme to skim off money from the national budget.

Before it was an open secret there is corruption and some government officials would be indicted for several millions. The Napoles scam was the biggest plunder scandal back then amounting to hundreds of millions but the flood control scandal was in hundreds of billons, could be trillion. 

This prompted  BBM to make a separate and independent body to investigate the issue but nothing came out of it. 

Also around this time the Senate had a change of leadership and seated Senator Sotto as the new Senate President along with Senator Lacson as the Blue Ribbon Committee Chairman. 

Along the way the investigation was put on halt when a retired Sgt. Guteza took the witness stand on the Senate floor and stated that he delivered tons of suitcases full of money to certain addresses that allegedly belong to Speaker Romualdez..

The administration focus is now on VP Sara's impeachment, which was derailed due to a technicality, as its chess move. The flood control issue being set aside as Romualdez was named and the Aguado street near the Malacanang Palace as one of the addresses delivered to was dropped on Guteza's testimony.

The Duterte camp however was able to pull a coup on the Senate just as the new impeachment proposal was finally going up the Senate.

The coup was so timed it was like a move that a knight in the guise of Senator Bato double checked the King (BBM) and a rook (Sotto) in one move. Sotto having no choice but to yield the Senate presidency to Senator Cayetano. 

However it was not easy to pull, as more pawns where sent to take out the black knight.The NBI, the police, Trillanes. But the damage was done. Bato's sudden emergence, even if was really arrested, the Senate presidency along with committee chairmanships were now at the hands of the new majority was just a brilliant move.

Admin's next move was to file cases or build up cases en masse to senators belonging to the new majority group, a good counter I would say. Offers of not continuing the case among these senators like Senator Estrada was doled out. Senator Legarda also said she had calls asking her to go back to the majority. Admin just need two senators to get majority. But none budged. The majority stays.

Minority senators then walked out to stifle proceedings and do all they can to stall time until some senators get arrested or go over to their block. 

Senator Estrada was given an arrest warrant making the majority numbers now down 11.

Senator Cayetano then led majority senators not to attend session. 

This was another brilliant move. This move allowed majority senators to block plenary session and effectively not allow minority senators to pull a possible senate dethronement. 

According to SP Alan Peter Cayetano, they did as such t make sure the new Blue Ribbon Committee investigation on flood control can resume. If they went to plenary with 11-11 on the numbers, something might happen and the scheduled blue ribbon committee hearings wll be stalled.

So far that's what I see. I wonder what damage can Senator Pia Cayetano (queen)  and Senator Marcoleta (bishop) as chairman and vice chair respectively can do.

What will be admin's counter move? This really feels like one of those games when grandmasters of Karpov and Kasparov levels playing against each other. 

Although I get what's happening on the political side of things, the real loser is not which personalities go to jail or won't be elected come next elections, it is the people who are the real losers, especially the tax payers. Trillions was lost.

For the admin, the impeachment of VP Sara is imperative because that will mean she cannot run for president on 2028 or if she can the stigma of being impeached is enough for her to lose.

For VP Sara, if she doesn't get impreched, she'll be the next president. All the flood control personalities on the admin side will surely go to jail.

For me and the Filipino people, yet we want accountability but what we really want is the truth on what really happened and put in place a better system to stop corruption in government.

It is a common name and by searching on Google, I found a beautiful name and that is Dark evening brown Insect. I liked it very much and I enjoyed its beauty. It is a very familiar insect to me and I have the name of this insect in my favorite list. I took some pictures and presented the pictures.




There are various types of weed plants near my village house and I see various types of insects sitting in these plants. ဘောလုံးပွဲတွေ မရှိတော့ ပျင်းဖို့ကောင်းသား။ နိုင်ငံတကာ ချစ်ကြည်ရေး ခြေစမ်းပွဲတွေတော့ ရှိပါရဲ့ ဒါပေမဲ့ မကြည့်ချင် ပျင်းဖို့ ကောင်းသလို ခံစားရ၏။ World Cup လာမှပဲ ကြည့်တော့မယ်။ ဒီရက်ထဲ တိုင်းနဲ့ ပြည်နယ် U 18 ပွဲစဉ်တွေ ကြည့် ဖြစ်၏။ ကြည့်ဖြစ်တယ် ဆိုပေမဲ့ 2 ပွဲထဲပါ။ ဆီမီးနဲ့ ဖိုင်နယ်။ အုပ်စု ပွဲစဉ်တွေကိုတော့ သတ်မှတ်ထားတဲ့ ဇုန်ဒေသတွေမှာ လက်ခံကျင်းပပါတယ်။ ရှုံးထွက် အဆင့်တွေကိုတော့ ရန်ကုန်မှာ ကျင်းပပါတယ်။ Live လွှင့်ပါတယ်။ ကြည့် ဖြစ်တဲ့ 2 ပွဲက ရှမ်း U 18 ပွဲစဉ် ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

မနေ့က ဗိုလ်လုပွဲမှာတော့ ကရင် အသင်းကို ၁-၀ ဖြင့် ရှုံးနိမ့်ကာ ဒုတိယနဲ့သာ ကျေနပ် ခဲ့ရပါတယ်။ ကရင်အသင်းက ပထမပိုင်းမှာ ဦးဆောင်ဂိုး ရခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ဒုတိယပိုင်း တပိုင်းလုံး ရှမ်းအနေဖြင့် ခြေပဂိုး ရဖို့ ဖိကစားခဲ့ပေမဲ့ ဂိုးတော့ မရခဲ့ပါဘူး။ ကရင် ခံစစ် ကောင်းနေတာရယ်၊ ရှမ်း တိုက်စစ်က အဆုံးသတ် မသေချာတာတွေကြောင့် အဆိုပါ ၁ လုံးထဲသော ဂိုးနဲ့ ကရင် အသင်း အနိုင်ရပြီး ချန်ပီယံ ဖြစ်သွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ 

ဒီနေ့မှာ မြန်မာ အမျိုးသမီးအသင်းရဲ့ ၃ နိုင်ငံ ဖိတ်ခေါ်ဖလား ပြိုင်ပွဲ ရှိပါတယ်။ AYA Bank Tri-Nation Cup ဟု အမည် ပေးထား၏။ Myanmar, Uzbekistan & Thailand သုံးနိုင်ငံ ပါဝင် ယှဉ်ပြိုင်ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ မြန်မာက အိမ်ရှင် အဖြစ် လက်ခံ ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ ဒီနေ့ ညနေ ၅ နာရီမှာ Myanmar vs Uzbekistan ဇွန်လ ၉ ရက်နေ့မှာတော့ Myanmar vs Thailand တို့ ယှဉ်ပြိုင် ကစားပြမည် ဖြစ်၏။ 

AFF U 19 Championship ပွဲစဉ်တွေလည်း ရှိသေး၏။ မကြည့်ဖြစ်လောက်ပေ။ အမျိုးသမီးပွဲစဉ်တွေတော့ ကြည့်ဖြစ်မည်။ ညီလေးတွေ အစား ညီမလေးတွေကို အားပေးလိုက်ပါဦးမယ်။

links.title: The Fierce Missouri Bald Knobbers – Legends of America
links.body:
# The Fierce Missouri Bald Knobbers – Legends of America

**Source:** https://www.legendsofamerica.com/mo-baldknobber/

Nathaniel Kinney circa 1875.
After the Civil War, Southwest Missouri was a devastated region characterized by a failing economy, high taxes, lawlessness, disorder, and a general breakdown of society, especially in small towns and rural areas.
When Nathaniel N. Kinney settled in Taney County, Missouri, in 1883, he found a deplorable state of affairs.  Outlaws and renegades ruled, most of them holdovers from the bushwhackers and guerrillas that rampaged through Missouri during the Civil War. After the war, the lack of even minimal law enforcement afforded outlaws free rein. Clans elected and controlled the local sheriff, who had the authority to subpoena jury panels. If outlaws or their relatives didn’t sit on the juries, they bribed those who did. As a result, although as many as forty murders occurred in Taney County between 1865 and 1885, not a single suspect was convicted. Taney County includes the towns of Branson, Forsyth, Hollister, Merriam Woods, Rockaway Beach, Table Rock, and Taneyville.

![Image 1](https://www.legendsofamerica.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/NathanielKinney1875_LOAColor-154x300.jpg)

Nat Kinney feared no man, standing 6 feet 6 and weighing more than 300 pounds. After yet another murder on September 22, 1883, Kinney began to consider forming a law and order league patterned after other vigilante groups that were popular during the time. When a biased jury acquitted the murderer, Kinney called together 12 county leaders who met in secret, forming a committee to fight the lawlessness and elect officials who would enforce the law. The group became known as the Bald Knobbers. Though the Bald Knobbers began with “good intentions,” the vigilante group’s violence eventually drew national attention.
The organization grew rapidly, and by the time they met on April 5, 1885, two hundred people attended a meeting on Snapp’s Bald, a hilltop south of Forsyth, Missouri. Kinney, an excellent speaker, was unanimously elected as their leader. Extracting a vow of secrecy from his followers, Kinney instructs them to recruit new members to carry out the group’s goals.

![Image 2](https://www.legendsofamerica.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/BaldKnobber-192x300.jpg)

Bald Knobber.
Within days, the Bald Knobbers made a public display of their force when over 100 of them broke open the door of the Taney County jail and kidnapped brothers Frank and Tubal Taylor. The Taylor brothers were well known in the area for their viciousness and were jailed for wounding a storekeeper during an argument over credit for a pair of boots. The local store owner, John Dickenson, happened to be a Bald Knobber. After breaking the two out of jail, the mob hauled the brothers south of Forsyth and hanged them.
The degree of violence appalled several of the founding members, who quickly dropped out, but the Bald Knobbers continued to grow, and before long, the group had between 500 and 1,000 members.

![Image 3](https://www.legendsofamerica.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/ForsythMissouriOldCourthouse.jpg)

Kinney’s group began to further “correct” the lawlessness by making night rides to scare such “lowlifes” as drunks, gamblers, or “loose” women into changing their ways. They frightened wife beaters, couples “living in sin,” and men who failed to support their families. Sometimes they even called on those they considered “ornery.”
The community began to split into two factions – those who supported Kinney and those who considered him a tyrant and wished him dead.
The violence increased as the group flogged or branded suspected thieves, arsonists, and robbers. They would hang or beat a man to death for assault, disturbing the peace, or destroying property. Some Bald Knobbers began using their menacing power for greedy, selfish purposes, going after men who owed them money or owned land they coveted. They “settled” feuds over fence lines and property deeds, whipped men for disrupting services in their churches, or for supporting the wrong candidate in the election.
Old Taney County Courthouse in Forsyth, Missouri.
However, the harshest punishment was saved for those who talked against them. Some victims who resisted the Bald Knobbers disappeared. Several turned up in the woods, beaten to death. Those who lived to tell claimed that Kinney’s followers killed more than thirty men and at least four women, but estimates that are more realistic place the number between fifteen and eighteen.
As the Bald Knobbers grew in numbers and their violent acts escalated, a vehement resentment festered among a small group of men who called themselves the Anti-Bald Knobbers. However, the vigilantes thwarted every effort to mitigate the situation. The courthouse was burned down when a judge called for a state audit to ferret out corruption among the county’s officeholders.
The nation’s newspapers published stories about the bloody war in Missouri, and the Bald Knobbers were described as the most significant and fiercest vigilante movement in the country. In 1887, the Bald Knobbers killed William Edens and Charley Green, both of whom had been critical of the group, and seriously injured several members of their families. This brought a further outcry from the nation’s newspapers.
Twenty Bald Knobbers were arrested, and most received light sentences ranging from fines to short prison terms. However, four were sentenced to death. On August 20, 1888, Nat Kinney was shot and killed by Billy Miles, a member of the Anti-Bald Knobbers, in a planned assassination. Though Miles was tried for Kinney’s murder, he was found not guilty based on self-defense.
Though the violence continued for a short time, by 1899, the era of the Bald Knobbers had run its course.
Missouri Baldknobbers.
The Bald Knobbers were, in actuality, no different from hundreds of other law and order groups, which increased after the Civil War.

![Image 4](https://www.legendsofamerica.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Baldknobbers-300x180.jpg)

© Kathy Alexander/Legends of America, updated November 2025.

A week of records makes for a good week to dig into gold and silver mining disciplined investing plus some long views on uranium ![May29Trades.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23zGsLfQ6f27icSyKGTc2mRxSnQaggNF8iFCCMNJaA4Bn9W68fgDJGHCGiqV6WZVxWzUU.png)

Portfolio News

In a week where S&P 500 rose 1.45% and Europe rose 0.62%, my pension portfolio rose 2.58%. Heavy lifting came from a few places - nuclear stocks in the big movers list, improving markets lifting sold puts (especially ITA), semiconductors in South Korea and Japan, a few select uranium movers also in the big movers list. Big movers of the week were Solis Minerals (SLM.AX) (41.2%), ASP Isotopes (ASPI) (40.2%), Cettire (CTT.AX) (34.3%), Power Minerals (PNN.AX) (30.4%), Tourism Holdings (THL.AX) (27.2%), Coronado Global Resources (CRN.AX) (25.6%), KMD Brands (KMD.AX) (24.5%), Nufarm (NUF.AX) (24%), TDK Corporation (6762.T) (21.9%), SK hynix (HY9H.F) (21.6%), Atha Energy Corp (SASK.V) (20.8%), Miramar Resources (M2R.AX) (20%), Kogan.com (KGN.AX) (19.4%), Bapcor (BAP.AX) (18.4%), American Pacific Mining Corp (USGD.CN) (18.2%), Haranga Resources (HAR.AX) (18.2%), Jaguar Uranium (JAGU) (17.5%), Fermi (FRMI) (16.7%), Genmin (GEN.AX) (16.7%), Dicker Data (DDR.AX) (16.5%), Metro Mining (MMI.AX) (16.1%), Cauldron Energy (CXU.AX) (15.9%), Forsys Metals (FSY.TO) (15.1%), CleanSpark (CLSK) (14.5%), Northern Minerals (NTU.AX) (14.3%), Vulcan Energy Resources (VUL.AX) (14.3%), Panther Metals (PNT.AX) (14.3%), DevEx Resources (DEV.AX) (13.9%), Atomic Eagle (AEU.AX) (13.9%), Hercules Metals (BIG.V) (13.8%), Stanmore Resources (SMR.AX) (13.6%), Frontier Nuclear and Minerals (FNUC) (13.2%), iShares MSCI South Korea ETF (EWY) (13.1%), Zinc of Ireland (ZMI.AX) (12.5%), AdAlta (1AD.AX) (12.5%), Lithium Universe (LU7.AX) (12.5%), Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH) (12.5%), Web Travel Group (WEB.AX) (12.5%), Equinox Gold (EQX) (11.6%), Anfield Energy (AEC) (11.5%), NuScale Power Corporation (SMR) (11.1%), Skyharbour Resources (SYH.V) (10.5%), Global Atomic Corporation (GLO.TO) (10.4%), Viking Mines (VKA.AX) (10%) 44 stocks in the big movers list makes up for the slow week the week before. The big themes are well represented - from the top: alternate energy (8 stocks), nuclear (3 stocks), uranium (10 stocks), gold mining (5 stocks), rare earths (2 stocks). Interesting to see three travel stocks showing and the South Korea semiconductor moves. ![May29News.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23u6X1AoDPZ8thHqnnqbG8PBFkt1oRUcgwtS2X8WDUkiJQYsgUojbZ8qos5Vvb9PunPEd.png) US markets went back to the tech trade especially led by semiconductors and there fabricators. There seemed to be records every 2nd day - never mind the on-off thoughts of the war. Last week of the month - time to review overall performance of the pension portfolio - rolling 37.67% is something to be happy about with S&P500 just under 30% ![May29Performance.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23twAQEs7SK54AzjH6UKRYM3jwBTaAx7CRqyck55THCv8Ln5P9zidpJFHLkjY5txKbW3a.png) **Crypto Drifts** Bitcoin price kept on the drift lower finishing the week 4.2% lower than the open with a peak to trough range of 7.1%. Seems that the stock market highs sucked cash out of crypto markets ![May31BTC.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23w3EnW5GAud1efwZ5Rhi9USHSnPgwdmtaVG19jGCKWLLrMVCKrbbBXb8rqPDBZqmpokM.png) Ethereum price tried to hold the support (green line) but failed finishing the week 4% lower than the open with a peak to trough range of 8.1% - so much the same. ![May31ETH.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23w3EnW5GAucxokWE852eNazCwmzDHNco9wXByba2ba1Co4tbyyQvNTsznHt6nMtrNrfo.png) A pop in Binance Coin (BNB) after Van Eck launched a new Exchange Traded Product - this gives institutions access to trading the coin. ![May31BNB.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23xAwa5XYJx4Pz9N5vwR6KboyhBpq5JR6asbMuErw2KrfLKoXhPPFMv9cdHnY3BhF7scX.png) https://www.tradingview.com/news/coinpedia:15fef2193094b:0-bnb-price-reclaims-670-after-vaneck-launch-can-bulls-trigger-a-big-breakout/ A pop in Stellar (XLM) after The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) and the Stellar Development Foundation announced plans to connect DTCC’s tokenization service to the Stellar public blockchain, marking the first time DTC-custodied securities will live on a public chain. ![May31XLM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/Ep3kAqC36vcBEztRseuUsT8c4MEoBq141SCTdb1jwWvNZTDZrRVyJiPgtucTe8kx6N6.png) https://www.dtcc.com/news/2026/may/27/tokenization-service-to-connect-with-stellar-public-blockchain-as-dtc-advances-multi-chain-strategy Injective Protocol (INJ) keeps its advance running with another 49% pop. ![May31INJ.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wXNvc4Nzru1Qyb8dkd6NQahD8qZ533pLQt9tCp3SqbBpQRHCakZYd8DNM5y7qzb7U4A.png) Pump and dump for Hive (HIVE) with a 61% pump giving away most of that ![May31HIVE.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wXQcVFSLCa9N4FuKtUjQYdVDpjpXsx9Krir439yEziuPpepRouby3qiMFqJ8FHjWZRZ.png) Algorand (ALGOBTC) gets another surge similar to the one seen two weeks ago - chart is showing a series of higher lows but not holding to a series of higher highs. ![May31ALGO.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EoibaGeUwGoSHRk9bToJ382oYsYR7ieEb6W8ixLuVKxfoc92sMC5dccTf5ygze8gB81.png) **Nuclear Energy Holdings** Week saw only small auto-invest additions and a 4.9% increase in valuations - mostly on the last day of the week. ![May29NuclearChange.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/48PUohhS1esbuaVbCLMHCwkaDEYe71G1xmWmRezYR1mL2ZicgzfyKenKMrzaC6XH7h.png) One change in the ranking of the Top 10 with enCore Energy (EU) and Paladin Energy (PDN.AX) swapping places in slots 8 and 9. Share of portfolios rises 0.7 points to 31.6% - a tad high. Did watch an interview in the week suggesting that commodity holdings could deliver generational profits for the holders - just got to solve the war situation. ![May29Nuclear.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EqfLCbk6byRpeuRYxiTewwosQppJ3K7nJwS4sUYgHykgv6X1gg5Pvm2mxkpaQHdyXtm.png) Holdings by Stage sees minor moves with the biggest 0.4 points drop in Physical and 0.4 points rise in Technology. ![May29NuclearbyStage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vsqqLFSZEp6KxbtCvWod1c2kWLTW3HPi8bC1nsq6uxjgvDVUAHWaR9oYUozx8HL9Ufa.png) **Alternate Energy Holdings** One addition in lithium stocks and a tidy 4.6% increase in valuations ![May29LithiumChange.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EogUB5b3rZ9Z6JxJd3uQEoRhW1tTVKvPZWQP35YP9DGJTUPUhowCeLT1AN6ocSMT17h.png) No change in the rankings of the Top 10 but a 0.7 point in share of top holding JKS. Share of portfolios rises 0.1 points to 5.2% ![May29Lithium.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/2458deSYxk5s4kUv1JjZv5TsKBLyide7LrrzXpCfZjgQ26V6etvHAZRMqrziV5ZXxLe4g.png) **Precious Metals Holdings** A few additions in gold and a silver ETF and a surprising 0.5% drop in valuations. ![May29PreciousChange.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vsojrKymwViK9jVaBH6NGJNz28qKfSfJcc5ChEbTiH7bxxrSifGmpzmnGDaRRjzZcHB.png) Mix of holdings sees one change in rankings with the addition to Amplify Junior Silver Miners ETF (SILJ) lifting it one place into slot 2. Share of top holding UBS ETRACS Silver Shares Covered Call ETN (SLVO) is down almost a point. Main change is an increase of the number of Others from 37 to 40. Share of portfolios rise 0.3 points to 11.1% ![May29Precious.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/245J2Hqf1Qf9FXghkaLsWB98sn6cE2n4znEgt1oMv6QedsaVnaMpCGyBPHG6kWDVgd1d1.png)

Bought

**Flagship Minerals** (FLG.AX): Gold Mining. Watched an interview with CEO, Paul Lock on Crux Investor. Lessons coming out of all these interviews - for junior gold mining companies look for those with 2 million ounces of gold. Tick - 2 million oz and a 10 year life of mine. ![May25FLG.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vsmkEQYaepYmzhDga384Ruk9gyrLgVyLYdcy1LJu7xFwmSgQVdrfLQUucyTuWPaJSNu.png) Look for proximal infrastructure - 3 majors are close by. Look for solid management team with two specific skills - geology and corporate financing. The CEO appears to have the corporate finance expertise and the Chief Geologist has 30 years experience in gold, silver and copper including in South America. The next key box is not to overpay especially in microcap investments - market cap per ounce is a common metric - enterprise value per ounce is the buzzword. At A$36 EV per ounce, Flagship is well below its ASX peers >A GOLD and COPPER company leading with its 2.1Moz Au Isidora Gold Project in the Maricunga Gold Belt, Chile. We focus on projects in well-established and infrastructure-rich mining regions which offer near-term low-capex and low-opex development opportunities. ![May25FLGPeers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vsmxHKvM8ggJWwx4etRajwbPXhn3hqafGGsPvHusXSPwboEwvzaxJaV4R9atrPSqfBA.png) This is the key chart - notably portfolio is invested in only one more of these - the next one up Pilbara Gold (PGL.AX). There are a few more above the 2 million ounces level - maybe time to go shopping. **Harvest Technology Group** (HTG.AX): Software Applications. Next Investors idea ![May27HTG.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/244UxXXTZCiN7bZxzBzWoGjbD5jhri2YetYcf6Q3ahmSxcyZ35LohSsaZQ5AWXBuogAuq.png) >Nodestream™ is an ultra-resilient, low-bitrate streaming platform. Sustain real-time situational awareness over degraded and congested networks, anywhere on Earth. >Project Consilience will deliver an advanced feature set that fuses live asset visibility, high-reliability streaming, and real-time team collaboration so distributed forces share the same operational picture and act decisively anywhere, without switching systems Highlighted as a defense investment opportunity with the growing use of drones for warfare - keep the drone communication working no matter what jamming is done. Added a small parcel in personal portfolio. **Lithium Universe** (LU7.AX): Lithium. Company announced a second university technology licence - this time with the University of Edinburgh - to a breakthrough process that uses a simple, reusable organic diamide to selectively recover gold and copper from waste computers, phones, and circuit boards (e-waste). Added to holding in personal portfolio to average down entry cost. >Iggy Tan and the team at Lithium Universe (ASX: LU7) are on a mission to leverage their mineral processing expertise to develop bold, new technologies and infrastructure projects that are essential to the supply of critical materials, such as silver and lithium, for the transition to a circular energy economy. In one of the silver interviews this last week someone talked about the 3 sources of silver supply - silver mining, by product from other mining and recycling. Recycling for silver production is currently between 15 to 20% of total annual production. Recycling rates are higher when silver prices rise. Solid time to be invested in a business that is working flat out at doing that. Note: Not including this in Precious Metals holdings until there are solid production numbers slated. Went through a Michael Gentile interview covering his investing models for junior miners (principally gold). They are built into the discussion above BUT he did walk through a few of his current investments. He did say that he has been invested for a while and to be wary but the pull back in silver and gold since the Iran War started does give a window. First cut analysis was to compare current price to 52 week high - then buy a few of the cheapest. Here are a few **Amplify Junior Silver Miners ETF** (SILJ): Silver Mining. 28.7% off its 52 week high. Added in personal portfolio as a new holding there. Wrote covered call for 2.9% premium with 9.2% price coverage. **Wheaton Precious Metals Corp** (WPM): Gold/Silver Mining. 21.8% off its 52 week high. With price opening at $129.40 (May 27) put in place a December expiry 130/150/115 call spread risk reversal. This offers maximum profit potential of 173% for 15.9% price move. The sold put (115) fully funds the call spread premium with 11.1% price coverage. Breakeven should the sold put (115) be assigned is $111.34 and $126.34 should the bought call (130) be assigned. ![May27WPM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tcNRVyjByjVvttGLHt5dunFWUzakcoL1J8vCL8fkMK4iEheiRr8aZD1gxz6Du5VPWtL.png) Let's look at the chart which shows the bought call (130) as a blue ray and the sold call (150) as a red ray and the sold put (115) as a dotted red ray with the expiry date the dotted green line on the right margin. Trade idea is simple really - trade up to the recent highs with the momentum of a blue arrow price scenario. The uncertainty is around the timing of the start of the move as it really hinges on the peace treaty discussions. What is certain is the margins in the gold and silver royalties held are better than the market is valuing. This also suggests that a better vehicle would be a risk reversal - do not cap the upside. I asked ChatGPT to assess its margins >WPM effectively represents: “the market’s ideal precious metals exposure vehicle.” That makes it a superb benchmark. When calibrating your juniors, the key question becomes: “How much of the risk discount can realistically disappear if this project succeeds?” That’s where the multibagger potential lives. **Ivanhoe Mines** (IVN.TO): Base Metals. 42% off its 52 week high. Added a small parcel in managed portfolio as a new holding. Wrote covered call for 1.6% premium with 14% price coverage. >The company explores gold, platinum, palladium, rhodium, nickel, copper, zinc, germanium, silver, and lead deposits. Its projects include the Kamoa-Kakula Copper Complex mine located in the Central African Copperbelt; the Kipushi Zinc mine in Southern Haut-Katanga Province, Democratic Republic of Congo; and the Platreef PGM-Nickel mine located in the Northern Limb of South Africa's Bushveld Igneous Complex. It also holds interest in the Western Foreland exploration project covering an area of approximately 2,390 square kilometers located in the Democratic Republic of Congo. **Silver Crown Royalties** (SCRI.NE): Silver Mining. 25% off its 52 week high. Michael Gentile idea - he is a key shareholder through their recent placement. Added parcels in managed portfolio and personal portfolio on successive days. ![May27SCRI.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23x1YuhvWgVgiwgK3hj3eC7dN1k6xURSLvXJWGc33AowtGfTe7Rcm28uBCtraxwhhoRPd.png) He talked about the risk of micro-cap (C$115m) royalty companies - their cost of capital is too high to be competitive bidding for royalties. The company uses a different business model to stay away from the competitive end of the bidding. They look for royalties from projects where silver is only a small part of output (under 5% - e.g., for a gold or copper miner). In this way they give immediate value to the miner/developer ![May27SCRIMode.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wCWmxC36uuemLucujbwacR4NRnq67neRBP89CKq7pkQs24C82JJgVrwcsCumM3TSFLk.png) **American Pacific Mining Corp** (USGD.CN): Gold Mining. 45% off its 52 week high. Added a small parcel in managed portfolio as a new holding. >Advancing the flagship high-grade brownfields Madison Copper–Gold Project in Montana Numerous skarn and porphyry targets slated for drilling in 2026 aim to confirm source of high-grade past-production (up to 35% copper & 16.1 g/t gold) within broad mineralized system Portfolio of high-grade precious metals projects across key mining districts in Nevada Potential to be monetized through joint venture, option or sale, providing additional exposure to discovery **OR Royalties Inc** (OR): Gold/Silver Mining. 25% off its 52 week high. >OR Royalties holds a North American focused portfolio of over 195 royalties, streams and precious metal offtakes. OR Royalties Inc.’s portfolio is anchored by its cornerstone asset, a 3-5% net smelter return royalty on the Canadian Malartic Complex, one of Canada’s largest gold mines. With price opening at $35.88 (May 27) put in place a January 2027 expiry 40/55/35 call spread risk reversal. This offers maximum profit potential of 513% for 53% price move. The sold put (35) fully funds the call spread premium with 2.5% price coverage. Breakeven should the sold put (35) be assigned is $33.50 and $38.50 should the bought call (40) be assigned. ![May27OR.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tcP5TryRHhs2wa9xGi8KB6tYNmC33r6NL9At7R2B85FmVQmMyME5AQNarj4PbLrBUBh.png) Let's look at the chart which shows the bought call (40) as a blue ray and the sold call (55) as a red ray and the sold put (35) as a dotted red ray with the expiry date the dotted green line on the right margin. This trade is a bit more blue sky with the sold call (55) some way above recent highs. It looks like price will need more than the two blue arrow price scenarios to make a winning trade. Thise blue arrows come from the left hand run and are placed on 0.786 Fibonacci level. The sold put level (35) is a bit tight below the previous low - would have been better below the one before that. With a few mining royalty stocks in this week's trades, an interview with Jordan Rusche of Mining Stock Monkey stood out in a discussion of Altius Minerals (ALS.TO) and Royal Gold (RGLD) - both royalty companies. His view was royalty stocks give better leverage to gold price upside with less capital and operational risk. At the end of the interview, he answered a more general question on choosing a royalty investment between the two majors Franco-Nevada Corporation (FNV) and Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. (WPM). The charts tells the story below - what Jordan liked was more growth built into the Wheaton Precious Metals Corp (WPM) model - this chart shows that well ![may29WPMvsFNVgrowth.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tSyuksvFcmwKZbPxocZJRLKZxjj68NCbMJeU8vsF4W2odjdGrVepeHLWoZJ9me9hjeB.png) Now how does that look on the comparative charts. Have put the Top 6 royalty stocks from a Forbes article and mapped them to SPDR Gold Trust ETF (GLD) and also put in S&P 500 (SPY). A few telling lessons from the 2018 chart - Gold has done better than US markets by close to 100 points. WPM has outperformed Gold by 2.5 times ![May27GLDLong.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23w3EVhAaKNScKpvDhFfb4DXvUt8iKJqCa31ZpYzvqzgfKssctupm6kyvpM6wgPUTEKcw.png) Coming into the start of the move upward in Gold from October 2022, the gap to S&P500 is 74 points and Wheaton Precious Metals Corp (WPM) has outperformed by 1.7 times and still the leader by some distance. Of note is only one of the Top 6 has under-performed S&P500 - problems in Panama for Franco-Nevada Corporation (FNV). The next vertical line on the right hand side is a key - the day before the Iran War - what has happened since? ![May27GLDMid.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EoEwjCEHMAai6MVCeNBWfvhzUoWvqeuSmgNVdQxpKnJoMvLHZLJoWMPz4gf6Mhgt1sj.png) Note: the chart is now a daily chart. All but one of the Top 6 are under-performing gold and the one that is out-performing both gold and S&P500 is more than a gold/silver royalty business. Altius Minerals (ALS.TO) just wrapped up a major lithium royalty stream and lithium prices have doubled in the recent timeframe. The trades made this week in Wheaton Precious Metals Corp (WPM) and OR Royalties (OR) were predicated on some good ideas from a few interviews and backed up by the Jordan Rusche interview after the trades were made. As the trade is open-ended and breakeven on the call option at $29, anything above $29 is a good outcome. Breakeven should the sold put (25) be assigned is $24. ![May28SSRM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tcP5UHDoQAy1S2x9wLzDt3r9HQEEr5t2VJvGSeaQeYjkLAPx8Zy7oMWbDgfT3C1fHbb.png) Let's look at the chart which shows the bought call (30) as a blue ray and the sold put (25) as a dotted red ray with the expiry date the dotted green line on the right margin. Simple trade idea - price moves on a blue arrow (light or dark) price scenario anytime after the war story gets decided. The light blue scenario comes from earlier (off the chart). The dark blue comes from a run before the war started and has been shown to be a solid enough scenario three time since. Keep zig-zagging like that with higher lows will make a tidy profit. The sold put (25) is below the last higher low - may have been better on the one lower (say 23) **Uranium Royalty (UROY): Uranium. With price opening at $3.58 (May 28) put in place a January 2028 expiry 3.5/5.5/2.5 call spread risk reversal. This offers maximum profit potential of 304% for 54% price move. First notable part compared to the other trade on the chart is the sold put (2.5) is well below price action - in fact below all prices seen since July 2025. The light blue arrows are clones of the existing dark blue arrows - get a series of those and this trade will hit the maximum before expiry. links.title: Time, Not Pace - My Actifit Report Card: June 2 2026
links.body:
I was up a bit early today to see how the weather was outside as I wanted to go for a long run. While it was humid, it seems like the rain overnight cooled things a bit to make worth going for a job as the Sun was rising. I wanted to focus on the time and not the pace so I started with a slow pace which felt really strong for almost a half hour. However, the sweat started to get uncomfortable and the legs heavy which ended with a raise in my heart rate. A stop at the crossroad for traffic was costly despite the rest as my legs were done when the restart came. I pushed forward to look for time and by the 55 minute mark, I had to stop. I walked the rest of the way which was not much. While I did not achieve the hour, I think today was a good step in getting the long run into my workout arsenal. The challenge will be the heat of the Summer in the coming weeks. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/96E9F396-5CC3-4654-B4B4-2666A3AB37141780450031.0746322)

links.title: 六月高考季
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![JDEQU7xpoM1UiMM6_mmexport1780449944101.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/JDEQU7xpoM1UiMM6_mmexport1780449944101/JDEQU7xpoM1UiMM6_mmexport1780449944101.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今年的高考不知不觉又到了，只是感觉今年比往年冷清了！没有往年的那么紧张气氛了！以前觉得十年寒窗苦读只为今朝！以前全社会都比考生紧张的，现在可能大家都看清了吧！有人说现在高考考好四年后送外卖，考不好四天后送外卖！唉～现在大学生早不如当年的高考了！

想到当年一个大学生就光宗耀祖的，现在大学生烂大街了！什么博士啥的都说送外卖！唉～百无一用是书生吗？以前大学生的含金量和现在的大学生没法比了吗？以前各种补习班兴趣班的，现在也没有了！没有以前那样填鸭式鸡娃！大家都看不到希望了吗？

以前考大学可以实现阶级跨越，现在农民伯伯供完大学生带眼镜回家种地，牧场叔叔供完大学生回村放羊！真的时代变迁啦！一生要强的我们总感觉走时代最端又是走在时代最后！从算盘起，到无人机！那个不是让我们去体验了！从煤油灯到新能源！那个不是我们经历啦！

注定了我们的不平凡，一生都要努力学习！以前高考完感觉人生可以蜕变成自己想要的样子！如今高考完，孩子还是那个孩子！想想我们距离高考好远了也好近！仿佛就在昨天！一切都只能回味，回不去的高考！所谓高考年年有，岁岁年年人不同啊！

---

links.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes un balance de la actuación del equipo de Fundación en El Torneo Municipal Copa Apertura de Fútbol, que se está realizando en el municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to our friends at Hive and @fulldeportes. Today I’m going to share with you a review of the Fundación team’s performance in the Municipal Apertura Football Cup, which is currently taking place in the municipality of Zamora, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260602_205109039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23x1BcPrtgB76kbefBXx1ihSxjKHPEnUc6ZzkNYBYVw9ZsXvWTbGKZ5xw94C5v2Mu5crG.jpg) Cabe destacar que el equipo de Fundación, no ha tenido desde su inicio en este torneo una buena actuación, claro todavía les falta varios partidos para poder pasar a la siguiente ronda, en la categoría Sub 10 hay un total de nueve equipos, en la Sub 12 y 14 hay ocho equipos, Sub 16, cinco y Sub 18 cinco, es decir disminuyó un poco la participación de otras delegaciones, me imagino estaban comprometidos con otras competencias. >It is worth noting that the Foundation’s team has not performed well since the start of this tournament; of course, they still have several matches to play before they can progress to the next round. In the Under-10 category there are a total of nine teams, in the Under-12 and Under-14 categories there are eight teams, in the Under-16 category there are five, and in the Under-18 category there are five; in other words, participation from other delegations has dropped slightly – I imagine they were tied up with other competitions. ![GridArt_20260602_203806314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xezao5chV42Gt697ynvV74pR4jpojrCHoFqheumFqRQ5C2xMm5Zc4YMj3XfqwCWReFL.jpg) De acuerdo con las tablas de posiciones, la categoría Sub10, está ubicada en el cuarto lugar, con un juego ganado y uno empatados, con cuatro puntos, con tres juegos jugados, liderando Perúvilla. En la categoría Sub 12, está en el sexto lugar, con un juego ganado de tres partidos, con tres puntos, ubicándose en primer lugar América. La categoría Sub 14, ha jugado dos partidos, de los cuales no han podido ganar, ubicándose en el octavo lugar. >According to the league tables, the Under-10s are in fourth place, with one win and one draw, on four points from three games, with Perúvilla leading the table. In the Under-12 category, they are in sixth place, having won one of three matches, with three points, whilst América are in first place. The Under-14s have played two matches, neither of which they have won, and are currently in eighth place. ![GridArt_20260602_204009444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23vsf9rkWA8r7YGFfwXwQJzxt4TwgJsm8nBQDbeimA6nnqHUk1HV72mpuLdcx3pifGVha.jpg) Asimismo la categoría Sub 16, sólo ha jugado un solo partido, el cual perdió, liderando Perúvilla y la Sub 18, se ubica en la segunda posición, con un juego ganado, estando en el primer lugar Perúvilla. Con estos resultados Fundación apenas está iniciando el torneo pero debe tratar de ganar los partidos para poder clasificar y avanzar a la siguiente ronda. >Similarly, the Under-16s have played just one match, which they lost, with Perúvilla currently top of the table, whilst the Under-18s are in second place with one win, with Perúvilla in first place. With these results, Fundación are only just getting started in the tournament but must aim to win their matches in order to qualify and progress to the next round. ![GridArt_20260602_204311305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23r23gUyLLyzc4nTKSNXU7xJtEPnp1vBkPDGs47kSV2TvEVW5WDJ9SG2PCgjH5yip1c51.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. links.title: Recent Splinterland Purchases: Poker Update (Doubles No More): 40 Boxes of Hamburger Helper
links.body: **My Recent Splinterland Card Purchases** \n**Image Source:** [**https://peakmonsters.com/**](https://peakmonsters.com/) \n

/>
**Splinterlands - It's been awhile** It's been awhile since I had a battle or twenty but I hope to make some time to do so soon. Splinterlands -- what a ride it has been. Are we going to recapture past peak values? Can we get another influx of players like we experienced in 2020-2021? I certainly believe so. Splinterlands has endless amounts of potential. Although it is the longest running #play2earn game on the Hive Blockchain I view Splinterlands as a game that is still in its later infancy stages. The growing pains are there but without them progress is mute. What makes Splinterlands go boom again? That is literally the million or possibly multi-million dollar question. My opinion: we already had the winning formula. Put cash in the players/ investors pockets and they in return spend it on the game. Of course there are many roads to success and many opportunities (with risks) to be had within Splinterlands. DEC being at its current trade value comes to mind. Always and I mean always check the DEC markets before you make a purchase. More frequently than not you can purchase DEC for below the threshold of $1/1000 DEC on secondary market. Splinterlands accepts DEC at the value of $1/1000. What markets --- ones such as Tribaldex. As I type this out I am reminded of the original SPS airdrop. Something that I liked to call the perfect storm. If we can repeat that I think it would give us a nice leg up. This time from experience of the first one with lower token print rates (SPS-B, SPSB, SPS2, you tell me?). **It's Poker Time** Yesterday during my [HPUD Post](https://hive.blog/hivepowerupday/@rentmoney/reminder-today-is-hive-power), I noted my break from Poker has concluded. I needed to stay dead-fast to my slow burn strategy and to do that I needed a clean slate. Without the break I'd simply keep plucking away as I was. Anyways, we are back at it. Today was planned to be our first venture back. The issue, the poker site I have my remainder bankroll on doesn't offer double up sit n go's. I now am scratching my head wondering what my next move is going to be. As I currently browse their game offerings I quickly learn there isn't much of a selection for traditional sit n go's. I do have an old gift card here with about $15 or $20 on it. I don't imagine I will use it for anything as I had it for 6+ months if not longer. I should probably check the expiry date on it. Depositing will go back on my no deposit footprint I was trying to create. If the date is soon up I'm likely going to use it as I don''t want the funds on it to expire. Sure its just $15 or $20 but leaving in the hands of the bank isn't something that RentMoney wants to do. As it stands I have $27.84 USD in one poker account and some pennies in another. I am going to give it another day or two of thought before I proceed. A slight bummer/ bump in the road but that is ok. The second site I pay on does have double ups. One way or another I will eventually pivot to the second site to implement my double up plan.
**Concluding Thoughts** That's it for now. I got some adulting (is that even a word?) to do around this place but after that its back to the fun stuff like window shopping the many cool assets Splinterlands has available. Before I go I thought I give a quick update on the post titled [The Hamburger Helper Saga (40 boxes and counting)](https://hive.blog/hive-100067/@rentmoney/the-hamburger-helper-saga-40-boxes-and-counting). My shipment arrived today. The box was a hefty one and I'm glad I manage to attain flat rate shipping. If it wasn't for such the shipment would have cost me a pretty penny. The representative that was shipping me my loot was feeling under the weather and was on sick leave. Thus the unusual wait time I experienced. They started the order before clocking out and getting sick and wanted to finish it is what they said. I'm not sure who this grocery stores box packer is but they did an amazing job with packing all the goods I ordered. No space was left unused. Not all of my order came, some was canceled and declared \

. I suspect it was because shipping the rest would have required an additional shippingbox. An additional shipping cost that that wasn't margin friendly for the operators of the grocery store. Well, that is that. This post has come to an end and we thank you for reading it. Stay tuned because more content is on the way. Smash that follow button so you don't miss it.

links.title: People become lonely because of their habits.
links.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/6671668/pexels-photo-6671668.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/person-standing-and-holding-a-poster-6671668/) We see many people around us who are living a very lonely and lonely life. In fact, there is only one reason for all loneliness, which is habits. This habit may be that the person has become lonely because different people have misbehaved with that person. It may also be that the person has become lonely and that person behaves very badly. Because of his bad behavior, everyone has moved away from him. He has become completely alone. Actually, misbehaving is not only about quarreling and speaking harshly. People can behave badly with people in different ways, due to which people move away from people. There are many people who quarrel a lot with every person, due to which other people do not want to talk to that person. Again, there are some people who do not quarrel but behave very badly, do not understand the needs of others, do not give importance to others, like selfish people, they only give importance to themselves and act in their own way. These people are so selfish that they live their own independent lives but completely take away the freedom of others and try to keep others under their control. They always try to dominate others. Although these people give importance to their own likes and dislikes, they never give importance to the likes and dislikes of others. And for these reasons, people around them do not like such people at all and relatives cannot live together. Some people consider themselves important but consider others completely unimportant, due to which their behavior and behavior completely shows complete neglect, humiliation and low mentality. And our human mind has become so active that we can understand very well who is looking at us in what way or what their opinion is about us. We can even understand very well who loves us and who does not. So when we understand that that person is not treating us well at all. Our complete neglect is belittling us. Then we also gradually move away from that person. We increase the distance a lot without knowing it. And as a result, that person falls into loneliness. There are many people who have been hurt a lot in life by relatives and friends. They did not get the company of relatives in times of danger and they themselves have been humiliated, insulted and neglected by different people, due to which they have withdrawn themselves from other people. But seeing all this, it is very good from a mental point of view. When you talk to these people, you can understand that they are a person of good mentality. They know how to mix with people and stand by them in times of danger. Those people who are completely selfish are forced to live a life of loneliness after a while. No person wants to mix with a person who is neglecting them. To keep company with a person who is treating them badly despite being treated badly. Every person always runs away from bad people and from people who treat them badly. Many times, even your dearest relatives, friends, and even the most beloved person in your life moves away because of your bad behavior, words, and behavior. If a person thinks that he has a lot of money, then no one will leave him even if he behaves badly, but some people are very wrong in thinking this. Because people are always stuck in the pull of love and affection. Even if a person is insulted day and night with crores of rupees and treated badly, neglected, and humiliated, that person will never remain greedy for that money because every person has self-respect and love. If you cannot behave well, no person will be by the side of another person and life will become completely lonely. >
A veces he llegado a pensar que venimos al mundo como piezas aleatorias de un rompecabezas, algunos tienen la suerte de llegar al lugar adecuado, dentro de un entorno en donde no es necesario forzar las cosas para encajar, todo parece haber sido creado precisamente para su llegada, sin embargo, ocurre que para muchos no es así,  encajar se convierte no solo en una tarea difícil sino en una obligación o exigencia del entorno, pero que por mucho que se intente no se puede, la mejor virtud del mundo es la adaptabilidad, sin embargo, no se puede usar una pieza de rompecabezas en un tablero de ajedrez.

links.title: De inspiración arrebatada. Poema #1
links.body:
Mi boca es sentencia y el sol irradia mi veneno.
Ya no aguardo tus pasos 
en la carretera,
ni el eco de tu voz 
que antes era sagrada.


Aprendí a ser desierto donde antes hubo lluvia,
a masticar espinas sin hacer muecas.
El amor fue un caballo ciego que me arrastró hasta aquí,
y ahora pastea su olvido en otro pastizal.

Mis manos ya no tejen promesas,
sino nudos para ahorcar recuerdos.
Y aunque duela este oficio de no esperarte,
prefiero la intemperie de mi propia ausencia.

links.title: Retomando el running con trote suave.
links.body: /> * * * Después de estar unas semanas fuera de la pista, hoy en la mañana decidí que ya era momento de volver a trotar. Mi cuerpo lo pedía a gritos y sentí que no podía resistirme más. Así que me aliste con un poco de ropa cómoda y me animé a salir a trotar 50 minutos. Lo mejor de todo es que no fui solo: esta vez salí con mi esposa, y eso hizo que la experiencia fuera aún más especial. Desde el primer paso sentí cómo la energía comenzaba a fluir por mis venas. No fue una carrera rápida ni agotadora, sino más bien un trote constante, el ritmo justo para disfrutar del momento sin perder el aliento. Mientras íbamos de ida y vuelta por la pista, aprovechamos para conversar, reírnos y compartir pensamientos, algo que pocas veces podemos hacer con tanta tranquilidad en medio del ajetreo del día a día. Al llegar a la línea costera, decidimos hacer una pequeña pausa. El lugar era perfecto:, la brisa fresca acariciaba nuestro rostro y el sonido del mar creaba una atmósfera tan relajante que no pudimos resistirnos a tomar unas foticos para recordar ese instante tan lindo. Más allá de la actividad física, lo que me llevo hoy es esa sensación de conexión, tanto con mi cuerpo como con mi compañera de vida. Volver a moverme, a respirar aire fresco, a sentir los latidos del corazón en movimiento, fue algo que necesitaba profundamente. Si estás pensando en retomar la actividad física o simplemente buscas un rato para ti, te animo a dar ese primer paso. No importa el ritmo ni la distancia, lo importante es empezar y disfrutar el camino. * * *

/> * * * After being off the track for a few weeks, I decided this morning that it was time to start jogging again. My body was crying out for it, and I felt I couldn’t resist any longer. So I got dressed in some comfortable clothes and set out for a 50-minute jog. Best of all, I wasn’t alone: this time I went out with my wife, and that made the experience even more special. From the very first step, I felt the energy start to flow through my veins. It wasn’t a fast or exhausting run, but rather a steady jog—just the right pace to enjoy the moment without getting out of breath. As we went back and forth along the track, we took the opportunity to talk, laugh, and share thoughts—something we rarely get to do with such peace of mind amid the hustle and bustle of everyday life. When we reached the coastline, we decided to take a short break. The spot was perfect: the cool breeze caressed our faces, and the sound of the sea created such a relaxing atmosphere that we couldn’t resist taking a few photos to remember that beautiful moment. Beyond the physical activity, what I took away today is that sense of connection—both with my body and with my life partner. Getting back to moving, breathing fresh air, and feeling my heart beat as I moved was something I deeply needed. If you’re thinking about getting back into physical activity or simply looking for some time for yourself, I encourage you to take that first step. It doesn’t matter what pace or distance you choose-what matters is getting started and enjoying the journey. * * *

Este comentario tal vez te parezca algo duro, pero es mi sincera opinión tras años de cultivar nuestra amistad virtual en Hive.

Tu texto tiene los pies en la tierra en cuanto a la resiliencia. Sin embargo, si quieres llenar esa caja de comentarios, debes dejar de escribir solo para ti (como un espejo de tu vida) y empezar a aportar valor a los demás, además de interactuar activamente en blogs ajenos. Esto último es lo que nos enseñaban al principio, lo que yo llamo el lanzamiento del bumerán.

Por otro lado, atravesamos un trance donde el bajo precio de las criptomonedas ha alejado a muchos usuarios. Los pocos que quedan apenas publican, haciendo que interactuar sea menos probable. Es una situación complicada que parece sencilla.

Yo estoy aquí por la plata, no lo niego, pero también porque descubrí un centenar de cosas y conocí a gente linda como tú.

Apostamos por la decepción si publicamos solo por la recompensa. Erramos al escribir únicamente lo que nos gusta a nosotros, o al dedicarle horas a una imagen descuidando el texto. En lo personal, no veo el diseño; me enfoco en el mensaje y en que tenga una estructura limpia en Markdown que facilite la lectura.

Por último, aprendí que los blogs temáticos sin rumbo fijo no fidelizan a la audiencia. Si alguien te sigue por medicina natural, se irá si publicas un poema. Al no mantenerte en un nicho, tú misma diluyes a tu público.

Espero no haber sido duro y haberme sabido explicar. Es algo que estoy practicando en mi canal de YouTube y que me está dando resultados. 

Alicia (@purrix), desde este lado del planeta les envío mi cariño sincero y la bendición para el poderoso Gabo.
