links.title: 还得孩子妈治
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![ZoFs7oDz0MabYyDw_vxt17.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/ZoFs7oDz0MabYyDw_vxt17/ZoFs7oDz0MabYyDw_vxt17.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

昨天是六一儿童节，学校放假，因为周六周天没写作业，昨天就安排孩子在家写作业。我和孩子妈要去上班，奶奶在家看着写作业。按计划孩子要完成学校的语文数学英语作业，还要完成课外辅导班的作业，并且要写一篇作文。下午我下班回到家，孩子说课外辅导班的数学作业找不到了，然后我开始检查学校周末作业。检查完发现错了一大堆，差不多有一半都是错题，然后就让孩子自己检查。

孩子检查了一道题后说什么都不再往后面检查了，考虑到还没洗澡和吃晚饭，只能让孩子先干这两件事。到了晚上9点多，孩子妈回到家，孩子高兴的迎上去。我早就把作业情况汇报给了孩子妈，孩子妈马上询问作业进度，找到丢失作业的电子版，让孩子看着自己把题目抄到本子上再做，并且把没写完的作业统统写完。果然孩子妈的话比啥都有用，孩子马上进屋里写作业了，一直写到晚上11点多才完成。

孩子妈说了，以后书包就让孩子收拾，如果丢了作业本就自己抄写题目。确实要治一治，就连作业写错了也不愿意检查，坏习惯到了不得不改的地步了。不仅仅是学习，还有吃饭也是如此。平常不好好吃饭，只想吃零食喝饮料，5月份体重掉了整整5斤。以后零食，饮料都不能买了，只能吃饭，如果不吃就饿着，直到饿的受不了自己提出来吃饭。

links.title: Making a women's blouse with a V-neck. 🧵🙌
links.body: ![Green Textured Lifestyle Daily Vlog Promotion Youtube Thumbnail (68).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23yxASMUgbY1Nb8xetZAjd2NDC4tKV2tQNDrn4PraQZPLJaD8k7LisG9uKR9uoNsYTJRE.png) ***

> **Saludos queridos amantes de la costura, espero se encuentren de maravilla y estén teniendo una excelente semana.** Está semana comencé a realizar algunas costuras que tenía pendiente del fin de semana pasado, pues les cuento que hice una blusa para una pijama y a la chica que me la pidió le quedó pequeña y corta, no le gustó así que le ofrecí hacerle otra más grande,me puse a trabajar el lunes y hoy la terminé, la verdad quedó muy linda y lo que más me gustó fue el escote en corte V que muy pocas veces lo he hecho pero cada vez me queda mejor, ***así que acompañame a ver el proceso.*** > **Greetings dear sewing lovers, I hope you are feeling wonderful and are having a great start of the week.** This week I started working on some sewing projects I had left over from last weekend, so here’s the story: I made a pajama top, but it turned out too small and short for the girl who asked for it, and she didn’t like it, so I offered to make her a bigger one. I got to work on Monday and finished it today. It actually turned out really cute, and what I liked best was the V-neckline—I’ve rarely made that style before, but it’s getting better and better every time. ***come with me to see the process.*** *** ![IMG_20260602_195833.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/EonnrL4j8rxXpZnhF9yymrnHDdUUmYHtKpjQwTMxt2isfyEY8tUHe2EW2q8qQ8Q7bma.jpg) ***

>
**Para realizar este proyecto utilicé:** - Tela microdurazno - Hilo a tono - Tijera - Cinta métrica - Alfileres - Máquina de coser
**To make this project I used:** - microdurazno fabric - Matching thread - Scissors - Tape measure - Pins - Sewing machine
***
# Paso a paso || Step to step
*** # |![IMG_20260602_200002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23tvuCeaaxHbtaQ73cSs8MUABRJAoSoFEhJDvDo9kGrWGffRxMHThqXDBrSBYJbynh12R.jpg)|![IMG_20260602_200039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23tvuQkpqd5eagqvCBSrDf7mX6hwcjhwvEJ93bVEqcQ3phuvTKT8VDXa62Ji4GZSrvTzf.jpg)|![IMG_20260602_200116.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23tmWP6Hq61ZzxTGkyhCRUKCvMgsnYiQQZfaT5tWpnQ8tFXEg1zaW5Yci3uroSSFqahby.jpg) -|-|- #

> El proceso para hacer está blusa es bastante sencillo, lo primero que hice fué extender la tela doble para cortar las dos piezas de la blusa, la pieza delantera la corté con el escote en forma de V y la pieza trasera si la corté redonda, después de tener la pieza cortadas enfrente derecho con derecho de la tela y cosí por los costados con costura recta y zigzag, también cosí el borde del contorno de la blusa con la técnica de fruncido. > The process for making this blouse is quite simple. The first thing I did was lay the fabric out double to cut out the two pieces of the blouse. I cut the front piece with a V-neckline and the back piece with a round neckline. After cutting the pieces, I placed the right sides of the fabric together and sewed the sides with a straight stitch and a zigzag stitch. I also sewed the edge of the blouse’s hem using the gathering technique. *** # |![IMG_20260602_200146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23wMmWNz8c8yzVDqTxW36upCmATxbh2pVXvqPUcBm6w6kns8dcifq32LycBnRaxVSwYhv.jpg)|![IMG_20260602_200251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23xethY4EWsE3mQB8DQHZQqjPKYkSYhEQgK4mQD1MCt3VaP8R1fnYVegp7nRCSx3D13jg.jpg)|![IMG_20260602_200354.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23t7zFgGAZTHFDQ7Xfjtqp5APgLAFmmg54Tzcu29kLSpdcxww7wxSx4wQnrZ5hnntUzCR.jpg) -|-|-

> Para coser los tirantes y el escote corté una tira de 6 cm de ancho que coloqué doblada en el borde del escote y cosí en la parte interna de la blusa, para hacer el escote en V coloqué las dos tiras de tela enfrentando sus derechos y cosí un triángulo en el borde del doblez luego abrí las dos tiras y ya tenía lista la forma, luego cosí en el escote de la blusa siguiendo la forma, para los tiros usé la misma medida de la tira de ancho y 50 de largo, cosí en las sisas haciendo un bies y ya estaría lista está linda blusa. **Espero les haya gustado éste post, si llegaste hasta aquí mil gracias por leerme, ¡Hasta luego!** > To sew the straps and the neckline, I cut a 6-cm-wide strip, placed it folded along the edge of the neckline, and sewed it to the inside of the blouse. To create the V-neck, I placed the two fabric strips right sides together and sewed a triangle along the folded edge; then I opened the two strips, and the shape was ready. Then I sewed along the neckline of the blouse following the shape. For the straps, I used the same width as the strip and 50 cm in length. I sewed them into the armholes on the bias, and this pretty blouse was ready. **I hope you liked this post. If you made it this far, thank you so much for reading. See you later!** *** ![IMG_20260602_203110.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23u6MsFwCy3H3wwRsmP3rRVXBe5hby5EHHz8YV6tteAdBedsF9D5iyToXnv9dWtrqtncP.png) *** # **¡Gracias por leerme, hasta luego!** > # **Thank you for reading me, see you later !** *** ![Azul y Amarillo Moderno Casero Fiestas y Celebraciones Marco en X Banner.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/EpR24jokeEvQR3QUEz9X8rTnC3FcbrXuJJbxQMzyUMw4ZLHvL91hssCVdwhBH6md97z.gif) ![BackgroundEraser_20230622_211641066.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23tGXZimDv9p8VZsWTwB7zJNGd5212gYvw8Gofk6SDadE3eT2LzD8VoremgFJWy4Fjak5.png)

links.body:
🌊 When the Ocean Becomes My Therapy: A Different Kind of Walk Today was a different kind of day for me. I did my walk near the beach, a place that holds a very special meaning in my life. I didn’t go there just to walk, but also to reflect, organize my thoughts, and release stress. The sea gives me peace. It helps me meditate, clear my mind, and let go of tension. The area was also very quiet, with very few people around, which made the experience even more meaningful. I went with my sister, and we spent a long time talking while walking together. We shared thoughts, ideas, and simply enjoyed the moment. I had to walk a fairly long distance to reach both the beach and my sister’s place. Because of that, I didn’t reach as many steps as I usually aim for, but I still feel it was enough—because today was more about presence, balance, and mental peace than numbers. 🌿 Sometimes it’s not about how many steps you take, but about how those steps make you feel. If you live near the ocean, I truly encourage you to do this more often. Nature—especially the sea—has a powerful way of releasing tension, calming the mind, and restoring energy. 💙 Thank you for reading. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ac1bc1f3-d22e-4ce9-9b14-818e6f1700d6.jpg)![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/97229392-46b3-4f1e-9431-417316041e2e.jpg)![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/acffd5aa-fa78-4b8f-9055-ef5ef84c1099.jpg)

links.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onezetty/23ycuLDBtvYnpWSRHspNM7k1eJosScYXk8U8m45FPo6CntmFSAZSR7e4731V4PawGfLSq.png)

¡Qué increíble experiencia fue asistir al **Crypto Talks by Binance - Pizza Day Experience** el pasado 21 de mayo en la Ciudad de México!. Este evento fue parte de una serie de celebraciones presenciales en toda **América Latina** para conmemorar el **Bitcoin Pizza Day 2026**, un hito que marca la evolución de los activos digitales a nivel global.

Aquí te comparto los detalles de lo que vivimos en esta noche tan especial dedicada al ecosistema cripto:

### **El contexto: ¿Por qué celebramos con pizza?**
La reunión fue una forma de recordar el 22 de mayo de 2010, cuando el programador Laszlo Hanyecz realizó la **primera transacción comercial documentada con Bitcoin**, comprando dos pizzas por **10,000 bitcoins**. Lo que en aquel entonces fue una curiosidad tecnológica, hoy es un episodio clave en la historia financiera, ya que esa cantidad de bitcoins representaría hoy una fortuna multimillonaria.

### **La sede y el ambiente**
El encuentro en México tuvo lugar en el **WeWork de Lago Alberto**, en la zona de Polanco, de las 19:00 a las 22:00 horas. Fue emocionante ver a una comunidad de más de **800 asistentes**, entre usuarios, inversionistas y entusiastas, reunidos para aprender y conectar.

### **Lo que aprendimos y vivimos**
El evento no solo fue una fiesta, sino un espacio de aprendizaje diseñado para entender el mundo cripto de forma clara y divertida. Durante las charlas y actividades, pudimos:
*   **Aprender los fundamentos** de cripto, blockchain y la Web3.
*   **Descubrir usos prácticos**, como el manejo de dólares digitales en el día a día.
*   **Conectar directamente** con el equipo de Binance y otros miembros de la comunidad en espacios de networking.

### **Diversión y Swag**
Fiel a la tradición del Pizza Day, ¡por supuesto que hubo **pizza**!. Además, disfrutamos de **actividades interactivas**, juegos y nos llevamos **swag exclusivo** de Binance como recuerdo de esta edición especial.

Fue inspirador ver cómo Bitcoin ha pasado de ser una idea revolucionaria a un activo relevante comparado incluso con el oro por su reserva de valor. Sin duda, eventos como este fortalecen la presencia de la tecnología descentralizada en México y nos preparan para lo que viene en el futuro financiero.

¡Gracias a los organizadores y a la comunidad por hacer de este Pizza Day una experiencia inolvidable!

links.title: Hace un par de meses atrás  [Esp/Eng]
links.body:
![IMG_20260602_180659.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUDCXwwivUc9w5NMEB3f18G2sBYPTQrogMYPo4g7PBTyy/IMG_20260602_180659.jpg)

Saludos queridos y apreciados amigos, un gusto y un gran placer el saludarlos el día de hoy, iniciando este nuevo mes con mucha fe y esperanza de que sean tiempos mejores quiero compartir con todos ustedes unas fotografías las cuales tenía un poco olvidadas en mi galería pero que son súper hermosas y no quería dejar pasar la oportunidad de compartir con todos ustedes. Se trata de hace un par de meses cuando se llevó a cabo las actividades litúrgicas para celebrar la semana mayor y pues en esa fecha quise salir de casa y cumplir con mi promesa ya que estaba cumpliendo un mes de mi operación y todo iba marchando satisfactoriamente.

> Greetings dear and cherished friends, it's a pleasure to greet you today. Starting this new month with much faith and hope for better times, I want to share some photos with you that I had somewhat forgotten in my gallery, but they are absolutely beautiful and I didn't want to miss the opportunity to share them with you all. These photos were taken a couple of months ago during the liturgical activities to celebrate Holy Week, and I wanted to leave the house and fulfill my promise, as it was the one-month anniversary of my surgery and everything was progressing satisfactorily. ![IMG_20260602_180645.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPeE5TvvD4zs7rxpVBfhuvX6ggcKqA1a38McuXXeFeEoW/IMG_20260602_180645.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_180610.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYf5zSdNuYwxkYM9jt557ievmXgcYdCocAyYkuSuQEPCj/IMG_20260602_180610.jpg)

Mis hermanos y yo crecimos en una familia católica y muy creyente y estás fechas son muy importantes para nosotros, acostumbramos a siempre asistir en familia sin embargo por razones de trabajo mis hermanos y mi madre que se sentía mal, no pudieron asistir sin embargo yo no podía dejar pasar esta ocasión y en compañía de mi hija y mi hermana asistimos para cumplir con nuestra fe. Aquí les comparto algunas fotografías del día miércoles Santo cuando se llevó a cabo la procesión con El nazareno, está este recorrido los realizan saliendo de la parroquia hacia un lado de la población Jesús con la cruz apuesta y hacia el otro lado de la población la virgen dolorosa la virgen dolorosa para luego en algún Cruzarse.

> My siblings and I grew up in a devout Catholic family, and these holidays are very important to us. We usually attend as a family; however, due to work commitments, my siblings and my mother, who was feeling unwell, couldn't attend. Nevertheless, I couldn't let this occasion pass by, and along with my daughter and sister, we went to fulfill our faith. Here I share some photographs from Holy Wednesday when the procession with the Nazarene took place. The procession route shows the participants leaving the parish church, with Jesus carrying the cross on one side of town and the Virgin of Sorrows on the other, before crossing paths at some point. ![IMG_20260602_180627.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXbMvJaR7mpuHfEFNCcc3zTM25xfDZXg9YrGPmLE6P6TF/IMG_20260602_180627.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_180554.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP6BiXm3EtDSvakzxGrSKWwrJr6qboyKe4U16Dkd3xCm7/IMG_20260602_180554.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_175733.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTGUQrvwsgDGsBgwmEXDUBeAtyX1pXsvWAeo6p8sZvHnD/IMG_20260602_175733.jpg)

También les comparto algunas otras fotografías del día siguiente jueves Santo cuando tuve la oportunidad de visitar algunas otras parroquias cercanas a mi población como muestra de fe y agradecimiento. Pidiendo a Dios pidiendo a Dios mucha salud para mí, mi familia y todos los enfermos de mi país.

> I also share some other photographs from the following day, Holy Thursday, when I had the opportunity to visit some other parishes near my town as an expression of faith and gratitude. I prayed to God for good health for myself, my family, and all the sick people in my country. ![IMG_20260602_175745.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeh3yhJm1yPTg45QNMzUjXBLtsKHJFtaEAc7wb7Ks9z4U/IMG_20260602_175745.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_175721.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcKhNDWy3xYrZeLjNfcRYGBSf839HBW8z9NzBZAAo2KYK/IMG_20260602_175721.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_175657.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR4dJcgkSUkpCD7JTnWbhGLGvqGxbdUgp5bqpey2bdeBL/IMG_20260602_175657.jpg) ![IMG_20260602_175708.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPkd57a4ufCjWUQrnWoL6yBdLvLxsKFjA814jnXSWcPfF/IMG_20260602_175708.jpg)

El contenido de esta publicación es completamente original y todas las fotos son mías y fueron tomadas con mi celular Redmi note 13. > The content in this publication is completely original and all the photos are my own and were taken with my Redmi note 13 cell phone.

links.title: The art of not complicating your life and carrying the person you love
links.body: >There are photos that are planned for weeks: the perfect outfit, the exact sunset light, the studied magazine pose. And then there are the real photos. The ones that come from a \
Just when the sky threatens to cloud over and sand gets into your shoes.\n\n
>This photo is the perfect summary of what all vacations (and life itself) should be: pure complicity.\n\n
>The three unwritten rules of a great beach day:\n\n
>The weather doesn't matter: It doesn't matter if the sky is completely clear or if the sea is a little choppy. When you're with the right person, the scenery becomes secondary.\n\n

>Comfort above all: Pairing a tropical leaf swimsuit with black socks and flip-flops on the sand is officially the new must-have beach fashion statement. Why? Because when it comes to having fun, style rules don't matter. What matters is being ready to run if a wave comes.\n\n
>Teamwork: A good relationship (whether friendship, love, or brotherhood) is measured by the ability to carry each other when your legs get tired... and smile while doing it.\n\n

>At the end of the day, the best memories aren't built on grand luxuries, but on these small, everyday snapshots: the smell of sea air, bare feet, a shared cap, and that contagious laughter that assures you that, no matter what happens, you're exactly where you're meant to be.

links.title: Cool Week, New Target Set
links.body:
The night feels shorter this new month, and we woke up late for the third time this week.😄 Unlike yesterday, the sun seems to be having a day off today. The mountainsides are covered in fog, and it's drizzly due to a prevailing monsoon. I don't usually check the weather forecast, but it looks like we'll be experiencing rain showers over the next seven days.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ifarmgirl/23tbMFqz96xfZAMqFDq4mQyCa59Z1GQWBBHtqvsgspwGKh9pixEkDmiz4NTpNtpvrVLpN.png
My mind is already at work, ~~imagining~~ planning what we will do if such weather persists, because we can't just be lazing around most of the days. We are not to become couch or bed potatoes if we want our bones and joints to be healthy😁 Although I used to love a sedentary lifestyle, I realized that being physically and mentally active is so much better. Anyway, it's midweek and time to set a new Slothly goal since we already reached our initial savings target on Sunday. We thought a conservative number would be nice, so as not to put pressure on ourselves. Hence, the 2k HIVE at the end of the year.
||YE Goal| Current Balance| Last Week| Growth |To Go| Note| |-|-|-|-|-|-|-| |New Savings Target (HIVE Savings)|2,000|1,022|||978|| |Initial Target (HIVE)|1000|1,022|932|90|😍|✅| |HBD|200|31.70|31.70|-|-|-| ||||||||
HIVE had a bit of a price action a few days ago, reaching 9 cents. While I didn't catch it, I noticed it at 7-8 cents. My gut was telling me to sell and rebuy when the price dropped, but I just dismissed the thought and went on with my day. Yikes! ~~sometimes~~ Most times, we are stubborn and don't listen to our inner voice. The brain loves to rationalize things, no? That's probably why we tend to miss some really good opportunities. But we are not going to be hard on ourselves this time. We are *slothly* (slowly) learning and growing, and that's okay!

links.title: Electronic Clutter - sifting through it all.
links.body:
I am continuing to cleanup the electronic clutter, shielding wireless devices and making sure they are out of range from my bed.  

<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNbGUQFUQ9j7HBRucQ47SxqJUzBspo42uvooQhwkVvui4/image.png)
[*image*](https://yandex.ru/images/search?pos=3&from=tabbar&img_url=https%3A%2F%2Fentrevue.fr%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2025%2F04%2FLes-interfaces-cerveau-ordinateur-face-a-une-etape-cruciale.webp&text=bci&rpt=simage&lr=10133)
</center>

Most of the unwanted annoyances from the BCI structure that is being released happen at night, as I said, when the mind is near deep sleep.  I recently picked every piece of tech up and looked at it.  I had to ask myself if *this* has any wireless incorporated in it. Then moving on to the next one.  

I changed from a bluetooth mouse and keyboard setup to wired older ones.   and the last think I found was the TV which I use as a monitor.  How do I move that out of the room since I use it so much?  I opted to put it on a switch so I can power it down before attempting to go to sleep.

 > If you cannot block it, shield it, or move it...  Kill its power.

The cloth that I bought to shield against all forms of electronic pollution is now inside a cotton and plastic case because of its corrosion risk.   It is much less of a shield if the metal in the cloth cannot touch itself with the item inside encased.   I have covered my self with the home made blanket assembled by me.  It seems to decrease the electrical vibrations that  arrive at sleep time (only when there is an active device in a nearby apartment).  

<center>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ73QvF4PdfcmvQXED12Rvm11ZredG3VHtvjfxXLdRXeq/image.png)</center>

I had wanted to protect it from corrosion while I test its effectiveness, so that is the phase I am in with specialized materials.  I did not sew the material into its protective glove.  I will if it proves to be helpful in protecting me against strong WiFi or bluetooth signals when they are near.




---

Images and video are no longer invading under my eyelids and I am grateful for that added peace.  I had no defense against them except sleeping pills to put me out. 

<center>Everything I write is my own work unless otherwise noted and referenced</center>

links.title: Letras Inspiradoras: Como no quererlos.... Howzer un terremoto encantador. [ESP/ENG]
links.body:
> Saludos ¡Mujeres a esta tribu! Aquí en nuestra querida plataforma Hive, mi participacion aquí en esta dinamica que nacio de @syllem, que invita a todas, donde @purrix lo hizo y me invito a mi, a contar cualquier anecdota, experiencia que hemos tenido y vivido con alguna mascota sea en casa, de la familia, de algun vecino o los comunitarios. Pues mi vivencia con mascotas en su mayoria han sido con perros, los gatos no me gustan mucho, pero no los odio, persona que no quiere y de paso maltrata a una mascota, no quiere a nadie.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23yd5myFmaWDtxb3boiFe3pWr8e3jf7tcMkRaHA1oPfg9WKpE196inKcgWMkWQAvj4uqE.png)

> En la casa actual donde vivo, me mude aquí con dos mascotas, dos perritos: King y Chooper, pero ya ambos no estan, tanto sufri que dije no querer mas perritos. Y se los dije a mis hijos: **¡No quiero mas PERROS!**, pasaron los años y el año pasado llego la mascota, que digo la mascota, el terremoto de mascota un LOBO SIBERIANO, un Husky, que ya tiene un año, que es un amor con todos, pero tremendo 100 %, la pila nunca se le acaba.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EokddDiUgwMrZvKzGfLTGUPEmnhoXg4jtgbrgDGqbK47qrcr7mH6C5jX34w9P2TvRyX.png)

> En realidad su mama es mi hija, yo soy la abuela, pero gran parte de la responsabilidad recae sobre su mama: alimentacion, cuidados, veterinario y mas, pero que yo le apoyo, cuando ella no esta cuando va a clases, si viaja a veces donde el novio, ella lo llevaba, pero en realidad ya es un perro muy grande que no lo puede llevar a menos que sea en carro propio, porque ella viaja en carros expresos. Son perros de raza que demandan mucha energia, de repente desarrolla una mota de cola, porque no era asi, sera como en mi casa tambien hay aires acondicionados, es el clima ideal para ellos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23tvbtbAXCDncHSF17LXbwrUmZHxSb4KkzYscouA7vYwtdkgGawvfYmHdcBYPFeuLkXLy.png)

> Al principio como todo cachorro las necesidades las hacia dentro de casa, que regaño tras regaños, ya aprendio que es en el patio que lo debe hacer, que si estamos en la cocina o el comedor, el araña la puerta del patio para que se la abran y va al patio, a veces cuando la puerta no esta cerrada con seguro, sino pegada, como tiene un cordon, el hala ese cordon con fuerza que abre la puerta y sale.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23xAbqGrGvv92CiVdpWMfxdfzXUhGubNZRctYhzVdGCrkEpdgwUNfFLoBbj1yUbkSFfZ1.png)

> En las mañanas al despertar rapido se le abre la puerta tambien para que haga de sus necesidades. Cuando mi hija tiene clases, la acompañamos a la parada, claro con su pechera y correa suelto ni de casualidad, porque aunque se que regresan pero luego de una gran carrera, la otra vez, con su gran patota, halo el porton y se salio, pero llego a la bodega del frente, porque sabia, vio que yo estaba ahi, mas bien me asusto, que gracias a Dios en ese momento de cruzar la calle, tampoco paso carro, sino se que hubiese pasado. Me gano ya fue a la Gran Sabana este año en enero, ya que recibio año con sus papas perrunos en El Dorado y de los invitaron para ese magico lugar y disfruto como una persona, desde alla me mandaban fotos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoCicYqZJ9rHXKbgUX8NnCuR9zNw13M8VjtgEFZ1dfq9nGjrGu89bL82MwWGRxGdh2U.png)

> Asi que bueno que les puedo decir es imposible no querer una mascota, sea cual sea esta, porque no se ve como mascota, se ve como uno mas de la familia, todos estamos pendientes de ellos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23tSSXae9Cd7nNWC2EpR4dxzcEdjiJvbUAcY1JickaJdErjh1BG8kpPxaerXCzqH4kgRG.png)

> Invito a @sacra97 @amymari @nayita238 que compartan cualquier experiencia con sus mascotas, para que entiendan como es la dinamica aquí esta el enlace de @syllem https://hive.blog/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-una-experiencia-felina Las fotos tomadas con celular Samsung Galaxy A16, de cualquier momento con el que casi se me olvida se llama HOWZER, que descuido el mio. Portada editada en Canva. Traduccion del contenido con la app DeepL.
![Captura de pantalla 2026-04-06 214059.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/243By7XQ75Ttrq4zhFJujDMZPB5PohFwzDnXVGPhNTJDUyjEkuggMGrdDv8AERjvoLKrQ.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/241tbaEsr14S5QVEtEoBaehWw4HRtp75eNXWsf3J4EXd8H1HzF3pyQvQp3XmbYVKLujYw.png)

> Greetings, women of this tribe! Here on our beloved Hive platform, I’m participating in this initiative started by @syllem, who invited everyone—including @purrix, who invited me—to share any anecdotes or experiences we’ve had with a pet, whether at home, with family, a neighbor, or in the community. Well, my experiences with pets have mostly been with dogs; I don’t like cats very much, but I don’t hate them. Anyone who doesn’t love a pet—and, by the way, mistreats one—doesn’t love anyone.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23yd5myFmaWDtxb3boiFe3pWr8e3jf7tcMkRaHA1oPfg9WKpE196inKcgWMkWQAvj4uqE.png)

> In the house where I live now, I moved here with two pets, two little dogs: King and Chooper, but they’re both gone now. I suffered so much that I said I didn’t want any more dogs. And I told my kids: **I don’t want any more DOGS!** Years went by, and last year the pet arrived—well, not just a pet, but a pet-sized whirlwind: a SIBERIAN HUSKY, a Husky, who’s now a year old. He’s a sweetheart to everyone, but 100% wild—he never runs out of energy.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EokddDiUgwMrZvKzGfLTGUPEmnhoXg4jtgbrgDGqbK47qrcr7mH6C5jX34w9P2TvRyX.png)

> Actually, his mom is my daughter—I’m the grandma—but most of the responsibility falls on his mom: feeding, care, vet visits, and more. But I help out when she’s not around—when she’s in class or sometimes when she travels to see her boyfriend. She used to take him with her, but he’s actually a very big dog now, so she can’t take him unless she has her own car, because she usually takes the bus. These are purebred dogs that require a lot of energy; suddenly he’s developed a bit of a tail wag, which he didn’t do before—maybe it’s because we have air conditioning at my house too; it’s the ideal climate for them.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23tvbtbAXCDncHSF17LXbwrUmZHxSb4KkzYscouA7vYwtdkgGawvfYmHdcBYPFeuLkXLy.png)

> At first, like any puppy, he would relieve himself inside the house, but after scolding him time and time again, he finally learned that he should do it in the backyard. If we’re in the kitchen or the dining room, he scratches at the backyard door so we’ll open it for him, and he goes out. Sometimes, when the door isn’t locked but just closed—since it has a cord—he pulls that cord hard, which opens the door, and he goes out.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23xAbqGrGvv92CiVdpWMfxdfzXUhGubNZRctYhzVdGCrkEpdgwUNfFLoBbj1yUbkSFfZ1.png)

> In the mornings, as soon as she wakes up, we open the door for her so she can do her business. When my daughter has classes, we walk her to the bus stop—of course, with her harness and leash on, not even by chance—because even though I know they come back, it’s after a long run. The other time, with her big pack, she pulled on the gate and got out, but she made it to the store across the street because she knew I was there. or rather, she got scared of me. Thank God, at that moment when she crossed the street, no car was coming, otherwise I know something would have happened. Me Gano already went to the Gran Sabana this year in January, since she celebrated New Year’s with her doggy parents in El Dorado and they invited her to that magical place, and she enjoyed it like a human—they sent me photos from there.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/EoCicYqZJ9rHXKbgUX8NnCuR9zNw13M8VjtgEFZ1dfq9nGjrGu89bL82MwWGRxGdh2U.png)

> So, what can I say? It’s impossible not to love a pet, whatever kind it is, because they don’t just look like pets—they look like part of the family, and we’re all always looking out for them.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23tSSXae9Cd7nNWC2EpR4dxzcEdjiJvbUAcY1JickaJdErjh1BG8kpPxaerXCzqH4kgRG.png)

> I invite @sacra97, @amymari, and @nayita238 to share any experiences they’ve had with their pets, so you can get a sense of what it’s like here. Here’s the link from @syllem: https://hive.blog/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-una-experiencia-felina Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A16 cell phone, at a moment I almost forgot—his name is HOWZER, how careless of me. Cover edited in Canva. Content translated using the DeepL app.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zhanavic69/23ydQz4vkUWhD7SD1cR8oH6m3NnjUmtdKAfmnS8jGVatgrgo7Z8L7JHnVRr92UPX3hRJ9.png)

# The 4-Week Active Onboarder Race is on — 350 HBD on the line
*Bring people to Hive and liketu, keep them creating, and the top three split a prize pool that's already funded on-chain.*

![The 4-Week Active Onboarder Race](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/earn-onboarder-race-01-hero-v7.png)

You already do this for free. You find an app you love, you tell your friends, they sign up — and the company keeps every cent of the value you just handed them.

liketu does it the other way around. Right now there's one live challenge on the **Earn** tab — the **4-Week Active Onboarder Race** — and it pays you to bring real people into the community.

## The prize: 350 HBD, already funded

![350 HBD funded](https://liketu.social/launch-assets/earn-onboarder-race-02-prize-v7.png)

The whole pool is put up by liketu and sitting on-chain in `@liketu.earn` right now — funded, parked, and verifiable. Nothing to \

later.

- 🥇 **1st — 200 HBD**
- 🥈 **2nd — 100 HBD**
- 🥉 **3rd — 50 HBD**

Paid straight to your Hive wallet when the race settles.

## The race: June 3 → July 1

Four weeks. Here's exactly how to win:

1. **Grab your invite link.** It lives at liketu.net/affiliate — share it anywhere.
2. **Bring new people in.** Only *new* users who sign up and join during the race count. No recycling existing accounts.
3. **Keep them creating.** Each week, one of your referrals \

when they do something real — post a photo, leave a comment, record a Speak, share a clip, go live in a Room, or pin to Atlas.

**Your score is the average number of your referrals who stay active each week, across all four weeks.** Not signups — active humans. The three creators with the highest average take the pool. Each podium spot has a minimum score to claim it, so the prizes reward real traction, not a quiet week. Ties go to whoever got there first.

Straight talk: live scores are provisional until the final audit closes. Public leaderboard, fixed rules, no moving the goalposts.

## Why \

Most referral programs reward you for spraying links and racking up dead accounts. This one scores *active* referrals on purpose — because the thing that actually helps is bringing real people into a place they'll love and stick with.

Better for them, better for the community, and, conveniently, that's exactly what wins you the pool.

## It pays twice

The Race is a four-week sprint, but referrals on liketu keep paying long after it ends.

Through the ongoing referral program, every time someone you invited posts and earns rewards, you earn an HBD share too — with tiers that level up the more people you bring.

The 350 HBD pool is the headline; the ongoing earnings are the part that just keeps going.

## Why it's real

Every reward here is real cryptocurrency settled on Hive, a public blockchain. It lands in your wallet, under your keys.

It's cashable — HBD is a real, tradable asset, not points trapped in an app. And it's auditable: the prize pool is already on-chain in `@liketu.earn`, and every payout lands on a public ledger you can check yourself.

So send the invite you'd have sent for free anyway — and this time, race for 350 HBD.

body.title: Mysterious shells left by nature: (Delphacid Planthopper, exuvia)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNozMWG5yJDovnQFgYLhuLNRvddGYR3pN4F3bjtzsmbWC/mix_20260603_024229.jpg)

| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Delphacid Planthopper exuvia,*** | Jun 02, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |


Hello Nature Observer friends. Hope everyone is well and enjoying the wonderful beauty of nature.

​When you look behind the leaves with a macro lens in hand, many unknown secrets of nature unfold before your eyes. Today I am going to share such a magical moment with you. The thing you see on the leaf in the picture, at first glance, is a strange sight, a dead insect. But the surprising thing is, it is not an insect at all. It is an old shell or cover left by an insect, which is called exuvia in scientific language.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfZ28Cq3JPxC6Q7UHAGX4ZgVB6CBryPppRgB2QCGHxfUW/mix_20260603_023943.jpg)

​I checked a little and found that this wonderful shell is actually a nymph or baby of a ***Delphacid Planthopper.*** These insects belong to the **Delphacidae** family. One of the most well-known species among them is the brown planthopper, whose common genus or genus is Nilaparvata and the scientific name is Nilaparvata lugens. There are about 2000 species of insects in this family all over the world, which mainly hide behind grass or leaves.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcmGdiAzVkEKf7mvgreRxykoLbVttvat4acKtP9Nh6LED/mix_20260603_024002.jpg)

Now the question is, how did such a perfect shell form on the leaf? Insects do not have any bones inside their bodies like us, but rather they have a hard shell outside their bodies called the exoskeleton. When insects start to grow in size, their hard outer shell does not grow anymore. So in order to grow or take a full form, they have to break this old skin or shell and come out. This magical process is called molting or ecdysis in scientific terms.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPH8vAKeGAZgDwfzGTjxjX7KdLCo7AVJVKnEDKkzv9xSZ/mix_20260603_024149.jpg)

If you look closely at the macro photos I took, you will find excellent evidence of this transformation process. You will see that the back of the shell has burst right in the middle. The insect came out with its new body through this crack.
The white thread-like parts that you can see right in the middle of the crack are actually the inner part of the insect's old respiratory system or trachea, which came out of the body when it molted.
​An insect leaves its old body on the leaf like a sculpture and emerges with a completely new form, this is truly an amazing phenomenon of nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZVqj3HfPZtnY5dLCST5SxBXBCWoPyra3nQ9NE4hAPms/mix_20260603_024116.jpg)

Be sure to comment on how you liked this macro photo of mine and this story of nature's transformation.

  I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

body.title: Central Railway Station [EN/ES]
body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/244A4q2HTNLnEeuZRZ8ZkVLzNtnxLdiKcRWeoy1nMs3QZUTrqVs1QZLJe7eUNj2Ki4mRB.jpg) # English Version There is a building that always draws attention when we pass in front of it, even when we see it from afar it is impossible not to stop our gaze on its peculiar towers and on the great clock that is located on its front part, right between both. It is the Central Railway Station, inaugurated in the first decade of the past century as a symbol of the development and expansion of the city of Havana. # ![1780318994318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/242XtrZNmtTe1BbmX9CxoTcbtbwUVU45voLGPdspnTzGmuB6krN1GRuvCvht649tLk6iX.jpg) # ![1241470.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23sJrReJvrBXHGwuXntq5kXLSXsqgG6UvMUMxcwLsC3t2jyQCfurjKn9er7JNobgRUB7B.jpg)
The station is located where Arsenal and Egido streets meet, on the grounds where the old Military Arsenal once stood, a place where large ships were built. Navigation was the force that drove Cuba, its commerce and its economy, and that is why this site always had great importance. Very close there is also a fragment of the stone wall that surrounded the city. Today only small remains are preserved of that grand construction that protected Havana for centuries, and one of the most visible is precisely near the Central Station. # ![IMG_20260108_172345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/Epdi6r6kWXKeA7s24jsmsh24MB3UEGZuZwW5T3vGwX1yvQCnbKJZWr7gGPEtiVniT1K.jpg) # ![IMG_20260108_172314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EnmCHdaebVsZeHbpkVgP7Wm9EY7mFWpTMNn9xXrNHmSErfDDdp67XwzqakW3U5dbRY2.jpg) # ![IMG_20260108_172415.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EpJY8BmMAyatwUPFRb9r8nYJMNGkfAXY5DLJgiQbEHcherr1oqWnBgJScZBsikiAP1s.jpg)
The main building is distinguished by its sobriety and monumentality. Its two twin towers crowned with shields and windows give it a majestic air. Inside, the wide halls were designed to receive thousands of travelers every day, becoming a point of connection between the different provinces of the country. The station is also surrounded by history, with old buildings that carry on their walls the weight of the years. Very close to the place, visible from the street where its main entrance is located, you can see the façade of the House Museum where Cuba’s National Hero José Martí was born and lived his childhood and youth. This site loaded with memory and meaning adds even more cultural and historical value to the surroundings of the station. # ![IMG_20260108_171813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/245TBqAUtGPco3QMXezxfVWUgdNnSpBxNGMDnJmzmhyeGKqFFCchQYLYMoCfpW21kKmc6.jpg) # ![IMG_20260108_172819.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/Ep7uAvpTHFi2UjZzG4T9XNNeKpT6vF9L8SPVWyDC53RVTiqk1c48eT8xCmB956PfJV8.jpg) # ![IMG_20260108_172846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EoeFSj3KfVnCzjgfUu9K956Et2TQUdtLG1ou26KkY32FtuKkAw6EVnZXGTCa2gXkoTb.jpg)
For decades the station was witness to the constant movement of trains and passengers. There moments of great social dynamism were lived, for it was not only a place of transit, but also a space where cultures and customs from all over Cuba were mixed. In front of it there is a small park where pieces of old wagons and locomotives are preserved, like an open-air museum that shows us the first passenger vehicles that traveled along these tracks. # ![IMG_20260108_172215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EopsSMqDd9fmDEqdcwt9r5TZsveucUgfEZzDbbBfA8beLski6JxhY542cQCGiVXNWbw.jpg) # ![IMG_20260108_172236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/23vsJFCPmS4kyczDag8zVAhCXvwZC172R9eLYVEY7QUN35wRQHrdAGwaEiSAdZwJ6Nrtz.jpg)
Currently the building remains closed due to restoration works that seek to return to it the splendor of its first years. Declared a National Monument, the Station continues to be an architectural and patrimonial reference, a symbol of the railway history of the island and of its evolution through time. Walking around its surroundings is to go through another chapter of the history of Old Havana, with its countless legacy, which deserves to be preserved for future generations. # ![IMG_20260108_171941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EnqS2kbMVyvMk2oN7WSJX2WQbAvt3zPS2UdjSgnyy373vMgbDxe5Wowy2Aqsu8JBnq5.jpg) # ![IMG_20260108_172731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jordy0827/EnoL7CRoaNM7j3UCC6cgjFBUTURd8k1ncqrjsxeFqTp6PycSLbdfUsCZxjNRHjXirpe.jpg)
Cheers, and until next time! [//]:# (!worldmappin 23.12723 lat -82.35367 long d3scr)
Versión en Español

Hay una edificación que llama siempre la atención cuando pasamos frente a ella, iincluso cuando la vemos en la lejanía es imposible no detener nuestra vista en sus peculiares torres y en el gran reloj que se encuentra en su parte frontal, justo entre ambas. Se trata de la Estación Central de Ferrocarriles, inaugurada en la primera década del pasado siglo como símbolo del desarrollo y la expansión de la ciudad de La Habana. La estación se encuentra donde coinciden las calles Arsenal y Egido, en los terrenos donde antes estuvo el antiguo Arsenal Militar, lugar donde se construían grandes barcos. La navegación fue la fuerza que impulsó a Cuba, su comercio y su economía y por eso este sitio tuvo siempre gran importancia. Muy próxima se encuentra también un fragmento de la muralla de piedra que cercaba la ciudad. Hoy solo se conservan pequeños restos de aquella grandiosa construcción que protegió a La Habana durante siglos, y uno de los más visibles está precisamente cerca de la Estación Central. El edificio principal se distingue por su sobriedad y monumentalidad. Sus dos torres gemelas coronadas por escudos y ventanales, le confieren un aire majestuoso. En su interior los amplios salones fueron diseñados para recibir a miles de viajeros cada día, convirtiéndose en un punto de conexion entre las diferentes provincias del país. La estación además está rodeada de historia, con edificios antiguos que llevan en sus paredes el peso de los años. Muy cerca del lugar, visible desde la calle donde se encuentra su entrada principal, se puede ver la fachada de la Casa Museo donde nació y vivió su infancia y juventud el Héroe Nacional de Cuba José Martí. Este sitio cargado de memoria y significado añade aún más valor cultural e histórico al entorno de la estación. Durante décadas la estación fue testigo del movimiento constante de trenes y pasajeros. Allí se vivieron momentos de gran dinamismo social, pues no solo era un lugar de tránsito, sino también un espacio donde se mezclaban culturas y costumbres de toda Cuba. Frente a ella hay un pequeño parque donde se conservan piezas de antiguos vagones y locomotoras, como un museo al aire libre que nos muestra los primeros vehículos de pasajeros que transitaron por estas vías. Actualmente el edificio permanece cerrado por trabajos de restauración que buscan devolverle el esplendor de sus primeros años. Declarada Monumento Nacional, la Estación sigue siendo un referente arquitectónico y patrimonial, un símbolo de la historia ferroviaria de la isla y de su evolución a través del tiempo. Pasear por los alrededores es recorrer otro capítulo de la historia de La Habana Vieja, con su incontable legado, el que merece ser preservado para las futuras generaciones. Un Saludo, y hasta la próxima!

body.title: Almost nothing is that serious ...
body.body:
>

There are many ways to live life, only some ways do not let you live. Life is a little moment ... and almost nothing is so serious… Sometimes we get it right and sometimes we don't... it's part of life... especially when we feel overwhelmed, sometimes we just have to let things settle down. Not everything is always solved by doing, intervening, saying. At times it's time to stop and see how things turn out. In this sense, to regulate ourselves, it's time to let things settle down. I thought this from a bottle of water with sediment, which becomes cloudy and does not allow to see inside. However, if you stop stirring it then you get to distinguish the sediment from the clear water. The problem is not always the WHOLE of a situation, it can be a part, but being all scrambled it is difficult to distinguish. It's a bad business to complain for attention. Attention is not claimed, born or not. But demanding attention always leaves a bad taste in your mouth, it leaves you feeling (even if you get what you want) that the other did it because of the claim and not of their own free will. Also, I think that one should communicate that things are valuable, and one should not demand attention, that is born, it is done spontaneously, it feels and is enjoyed much better. That is, how to measure the success of a woman or a man by a marital status or by a biological clock imposed by society. Turning over the age of 37 or more without children, without a partner, and without the traditional mold, is not a failure, it is a blessing if it means that we do not confirm ourselves with anyone for fear of society. Sometimes, we stay without these bonds to protect ourselves from half-hearted loves and cheap manipulations, it applies to everyone. Because no threat of *you're gonna be left alone* has any power, when we learn to be our own home. I think the only real fear we should have is that of losing ourselves by trying to fit into other people's expectations. *We are all different and everyone is happy with or without a partner*. To all those spectacular women and men who are walking alone today, I remind you that you are not incomplete, you are maturing, healing and choosing yourself. The love of our life is not the one who comes to save us, it is ourselves, who decide not to negotiate our peace. In addition, recognizing the red flags in a relationship is not paranoia, it is self-love that is not negotiable. Life doesn't end at 40, 50, 60, it just starts when we meet. If there is no attention is it worth sustaining the link? What do you guys think? I'm interested to know. Happy Day! ... Janitze. 🌹

body.title: More than Misery Business:  Hidden gems in Paramore's discography | (🇪🇸 - 🇺🇸)
body.body:
> 

  Saludos, amantes de la música que dan vida a #Music.Hoy es martes y el cuerpo lo sabe: un día especial para compartir con ustedes, aprovechando la iniciativa #TTT propuesta por @ablaze, donde cada martes nos recomendamos buena música. Hoy sigo en la misma onda de la vez anterior, pero esta vez un poco más a mi estilo. Hoy les compartiré música de un grupo que suelo escuchar mucho en cualquier momento; se trata de Paramore y mi lado más punk junto a ellos.


>   Greetings, music lovers who bring #Music to life. It's Tuesday, and I know it! A special day to share with you, taking advantage of the #TTT initiative proposed by @ablaze, where every Tuesday we recommend great music. Today I'm continuing with the same theme as last time, but this time a little more in my own style. Today I'll be sharing music from a band I listen to a lot; it's Paramore, and my punk side with them.

<center>![sepi.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ivannap/23tGc4vNyYEFzw7DodsBBYVypMrmtUcWda5kwCNjkb2fZwzMaNbgnnnYC7NphhmBtqb3C.png)</center>



<center>![39213614_10151160042129963_1084529596436578304_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ivannap/23vsSMg5geyaw9oEydU63Bm7g3ajG2dmSqEUmcUZ2ppD8kQ6UBoDjsuyD2irtiCzxjuAi.jpg)</center>



<div class=\

> Este grupo salió a inicios de los años 2000 y se volvió uno de mis favoritos de manera indiscutible cuando escuché por primera vez su álbum *Riot!*. De todos los que han sacado hasta el momento, este es mi favorito por mucho; para mí, tiene una esencia diferente a la que tiene la agrupación actualmente.

> This group emerged in the early 2000s and became one of my absolute favorites when I first heard their album *Riot!*. Of all the albums they've released so far, this is by far my favorite; for me, it has a different essence than the band's current sound.

> De esta agrupación tengo unas cuantas canciones favoritas, lo que se me hizo complicado para elegir al armar este post, pero me fui por las más clásicas y las que más he escuchado en ciertos momentos de mi vida y sobre todo por cómo me siento hoy.

> I have a few favorite songs from this group, which made it difficult to choose when putting together this post, but I went with the most classic ones and the ones I've listened to the most at certain times in my life, especially because of how I feel today.

> Lo más característico de este grupo es que se ha mantenido en el transcurso de los años con diferentes estilos, pero yo le soy fiel a su primer tipo, el del punk rock. La voz de Hayley Williams junto con los instrumentos tocados por Taylor York en la guitarra y Zac Farro en la batería, los hace increíblemente memorables en aquel álbum que les mencioné al principio, *Riot!*

> The most distinctive thing about this group is that they've maintained their style over the years, but I'm loyal to their original sound: punk rock. Hayley Williams' vocals, along with Taylor York's guitar and Zac Farro's drumming, make them incredibly memorable on that album I mentioned earlier, *Riot!*

> Si bien recuerdan, hace mucho tiempo hice un post sobre el nuevo estilo musical de la vocalista Hayley, en el que ella experimenta para buscar su propio estilo como solista, pero en esta ocasión toca hacer el #TTT o #ThreeTuneTuesday con canciones de esta excelente agrupación.

> If you remember, a long time ago I made a post about the new musical style of vocalist Hayley, in which she experiments to find her own style as a soloist, but this time it's time to do #TTT or #ThreeTuneTuesday with songs from this excellent group.

>\n\nTenía pendiente hacerlo desde entonces y es hoy que finalmente me decidí a armarlo para compartir con ustedes mis tres canciones favoritas de Paramore. Por supuesto que tengo varias de *Riot*, pero para este post quise variar un poco y abarcar diferentes canciones de diferentes discos de ellos, así que a continuación les comparto desde la que \

> I'd been meaning to do this ever since, and today I finally decided to put it together to share my three favorite Paramore songs with you. Of course, I have several from *Riot*, but for this post, I wanted to mix things up a bit and include songs from different albums, so here they are, from my least favorite to my absolute favorite. ---

> La primera que debo recomendar es de mi disco favorito (ya saben cuál es): **Misery Business** es una de las canciones que marcaron mi adolescencia y mi juventud. Esta canción era una de las que escuchaba sin parar mientras estudiaba para la universidad

> The first song I have to recommend is from my favorite album (you already know which one it is): **Misery Business** is one of the songs that defined my adolescence and early adulthood. I listened to this song constantly while studying for university. ---

> Esta canción me define cómo me siento ahorita. No recuerdo cuántas veces la he escuchado ya, pero sé que es una de mis favoritas y la he escuchado, sobre todo cuando me siento como me siento ahorita, juzgada y criticada por los demás.

> This song perfectly describes how I feel right now. I can't remember how many times I've listened to it, but I know it's one of my favorites, and I listen to it especially when I feel like I do now, judged and criticized by others. ---

> Por último, pero no menos importante: **I Caught Myself**. Una de mis favoritas por ser parte de la banda sonora de Crepúsculo, aquella película de vampiros que se volvió un frenesí por sus libros y, por supuesto, por su historia de amor.

> Last but not least: **I Caught Myself**. One of my favorites because it's part of the Twilight soundtrack, that vampire movie that became a frenzy thanks to its books and, of course, its love story.

> Si me ponen a elegir qué estilo me gusta más entre Hayley Williams como cantante solista y como cantante en Paramore, la elijo con su agrupación, porque por más que sea, junto a los chicos mantiene este estilo de chica ruda que me encanta y que me inspira en mis momentos más caóticos de mi vida. Espero que les haya gustado mi #TTT.

> If I had to choose between Hayley Williams as a solo artist and as the lead singer of Paramore, I'd choose her with the band. Because no matter what, with the guys, she maintains this badass style that I love and that inspires me during the most chaotic moments of my life. I hope you enjoyed my #TTT.

body.body:
> Feliz Martes mi gente bella y positiva,hoy estoy animada de estar en esta gran comunidad **EmpoderarTalent**, deseándole muchas Bendiciones. Es grato estar participando en la iniciativa de mi querida amiga @angelica7, la cual invita esta semana en [ Encuentro de Talentos]( https://peakd.com/c/hive-147177/created ), con el Tema **El reino de los posible**. > _Happy Tuesday, my beautiful and positive friends! Today I’m excited to be part of this wonderful **EmpoderarTalent** community, and I wish you all many blessings. It’s a pleasure to be participating in the initiative of my dear friend @angelica7, who is hosting this week’s [Talent Gathering]( https://peakd.com/c/hive-147177/created ), with the theme **The Realm of Possibilities**._
![1001746340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/AKCKb7c7Yd69fEL3KgTitKHxcEDNxSAJv7pxGDocjzpbHPx9vZ2CtaEb9eKhvnL.jpg)

> Cada vez que queremos lograr nuestras metas, debemos manifestar y hacer posible hasta lo mas imposible, luchar y ser constante para alcanzar esos deseos en un momento determinado, llenarnos de paciencia porque nada es mágico, tenemos que esforzarnos y ser perseverante en conseguirlo. > Whenever we want to achieve our goals, we must visualize and make even the most impossible things possible; we must fight and remain steadfast to fulfill those desires at a specific moment; we must arm ourselves with patience because nothing happens by magic—we have to work hard and persevere to make it happen.
![1001739420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoiUgFUkP1R3zU5MCc7t9X7NiLiBe8LLwND2t3QGjQMddHUmroTnkegXPNiRCoPdqrC.jpg)

> El reino de lo posible nos permite pensar e imaginar que podemos hacer realidad nuestros sueños, con claridad, optimismo, perservarancia y mantenernos la valentia antes los obstáculos que se nos presentan, porque la mayoria de las veces, caemos en la primera piedra en el camino, pues pienso que a diario podemos tener muchas oportunidades de alcanzar cosas en la vida. >The realm of possibility allows us to think and imagine that we can make our dreams come true—with clarity, optimism, perseverance, and the courage to face the obstacles that come our way—because most of the time, we stumble at the first hurdle, yet I believe that every day we have many opportunities to achieve things in life.
![1001739384.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoiVi6wdWvjdTn3ciPqjqXjA8X59M3pF3DcGNo1rWC5ahtDYtYF1dfYMor3nShqx5Ut.jpg)

> Uno de la cosas que paralizan es el miedo, que nos bloquea e impide lograr aquello que queremos, así que alejemos de este aspecto negativo, como también quejarnos de todo,más bien tenemos que agradecer por todo, ya que promueve la empatía, fortalece las relaciones interpersonales y mejora significativamente el bienestar emocional. Es por ello que esto nos motiva para alcanzar lo que queremos. > One of the things that paralyzes us is fear, which holds us back and prevents us from achieving what we want. So let’s distance ourselves from this negative mindset—and from constantly complaining about everything. Instead, we should be grateful for everything, as this fosters empathy, strengthens interpersonal relationships, and significantly improves our emotional well-being. That is why this motivates us to achieve what we want.
![1001739409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoK3tYJyiPYVCPdpgYmJwGg24CyxfZD8JKvawSRxDu2qrtjnnsgBc5qfckayKrKbaYj.jpg)

> Una de las cosas que pensaba que era imposible era manejar carro, pues era muy nerviosa, cuando tuve la oportunidad de adquirir un carro, tenia mi chofer me llevaba a todos lados, la verdad que me senti mal por no hacer posible manejar, luego poco a poco y con bastante paciencia mi chofre comenzo a enseñarme por una vialidad no transitada, hasta que aprendí, me senti super orgullosa de mi misma, y aunque no créi en mi al principio, se que cuando uno toma una decisión de lograr algo, nos sentimos motivados. > One of the things I thought was impossible was driving a car, since I was so nervous. When I had the chance to buy a car, my driver would take me everywhere. To be honest, I felt bad for not giving driving a try, but then, little by little and with a lot of patience, my driver started teaching me on a quiet road until I learned. I felt so proud of myself, and even though I didn’t believe in myself at first, I know that when you make a decision to achieve something, you feel motivated.
![1001739893.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/Ep5kgBGPiSTUfpC5sEycKFqjHjZbGzgYL8ZZz4HNbnVsoWZ2kkt2ZBcW6fHLS6rhaVC.jpg)

> Siempre logramos cosas en nuestras vidas, y eso es gracias a la constancia y paciencia que tenemos en ese momento. Fijarnos metas con claridad, se positivo nos conduce a hacer lo imposible posible. > We always achieve things in our lives, and that’s thanks to the perseverance and patience we have at that moment. Setting clear goals and staying positive leads us to make the impossible possible.
![1001739894.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EpQuLDpQEVj9CY46N9mD1UkT9Ee87PdMYz94UKw7M4KXuQ7A9YxtAwDUUMxbAzjDRtQ.jpg)
Me encantó escribir estás líneas dando mi opinión de este tema, que tiene mucha tela que cortar. Invito a participar a @angeluxx **Gracias por su atención, hasta la próxima, mis aventureros.** >I really enjoyed writing these lines and sharing my thoughts on this topic, which has a lot to offer. I invite @angeluxx to join in. **Thank you for reading, and until next time, my adventurers.**

雖然在水東街走著走著開始餓了, 但也不能心急或者將就, 因為我們對吃這方面還是有要求的. 不可能因為餓就去就地取材見啥吃啥呢. 萬一吃飽了才發現自己想吃的呢? 所以還是走多兩個街口再決定.

計劃是這樣, 但實際呢? 我講到這裡, 大家應該都猜到, 後面又意想不到地發現了本來要去吃, 但沒打算刻意找的店了吧? 嘿嘿 ! 在此之前, 我們見到一些手信店,茶葉店, 糖水店, 但這些通通都不是我們要的, 也解決不了我餓的問題. 

然後, 走到去文具店, 見到有只貓 ! 不要誤會, 我不吃貓的, 更不會亂吃流浪的動物, 我不喜歡現場殺生. 也不忍親手殺生 ! 只是見到兩只貓覺得挺可愛就拍一下罷了. 沒對他們做甚麼哈. 不要多想了大家. 

再往前走, 居然就給我們發現在網上找到的那家飲早茶的店, 其實他們已經是落場打烊了, 但我們見到他們還有一些沒賣完的點心, 就問他們還賣不賣? 賣的話就坐下來吃吃吧. 能吃的如圖, 沒多少款東西了. 但也有三四款我們喜歡的, 也夠了. 

我不是早上在香港跟我老媽飲完茶? 是的, 但點心又沒說一天不能吃超過某過量會致病, 所以不管了, 照吃哈. 吃完之後, 在直接又見到另一家吃點心的老街茶樓, 但這家名氣好像沒我們那家龍園的大. 龍園這個名, 很熟是吧? 沒錯, 就是湘娘家小區的名字囉. 感覺, 一切都好奇妙, 好像我們不刻意找它, 它刻意出現在我們面前一樣.

吃完之後, 我們去海鮮街那邊看看, 我的腦海一直回迴著 『一切都好奇妙, 好像我們不刻意找它, 它刻意出現在我們面前一樣』這句話, 是囉. 我現在新的工作, 不是我自己投簡歷的, 是我一開始在整理簡歷時, 有獵頭公司看到我的簡歷主動找我的. 湘說這份工就像主動找上門似的. 

所以, 我還是不要想太多, 當時我最需要做的就是好好交接, 好聚好散, 留個美好回憶給大家. 然後, 大概我最後也勉強做到了這一點了吧? 至於大家以後, 即是到今天為止, 有沒有一丟丟想念我? 我不知道, 但湘說一定會有人想我的. 會拿替代我的那個新人跟我這9年來做對比. 要是覺得新人做得不如我當年的時候, 大家大概也會有那麼幾秒想起我的. 

嗯...要是真的是這樣, 我也很很慰了. 因為, 我到今天為止, 也很想念他們, 想念那裡的一切. 不過我現在更多的專注, 更少的感觸, 一定不能丟了舊公司的臉就是了. 新工作也許對我來說很大挑戰, 但當年我在老頭家也是由啥也不會, 一步一步做到不經意間霸氣側漏, 搞定過一次又一次的大麻煩. 這裡的事, 估計其實難不了多少. 我行的, 只要相信, 就會成真. 嗯. 衝啊. 

2026.6.3

帖子说巴西19岁女生在海边游泳，被鲨鱼咬断一条腿，人还在医院🏥；而前几天已有男生也被咬伤，后被迫截肢……在这之前也陆续有人在浅海游泳受伤……

这种可怕的事情，之前几乎都是在电视中看到，发生在生活中太吓人了，当事人身心还能走出这个阴影吗？景区那里安全防护措施做的不太到位的样子，那里不能直接禁止游泳吗？

记得前段时间，新闻上有报道过，一个追星的女生玩极限运动(空中的项目，忘记啥了)，好像绳索松了，最终导致年纪轻轻的女生丧命。运动开始前，女生有说过自己绳索没绑紧，但工作人员忽视了……

全都好吓人，不管是对当事人还是家属，伤害满满。唉~出去玩有些极度危险的事情，还是得三思而后行，小命要紧啊！

但也不要谨慎过头吧，比如我老妈，连去爬一些陡峭的山(景点常有人爬的那种)都觉得危险，我真的想呵呵……不过也没办法，老妈真的胆子很小，还会自己吓自己，吓队友，凭实力坑队友😂

PS发现一条有意思的路，沿途都有座椅，很安静干净，拍几张嘿嘿

**感谢阅读！祝你阖家安康！财源滚滚🤑**

**The Value of People and New Experiences** Throughout my life, I’ve been fortunate to have the support of many people, especially my family. During difficult moments, when I’ve had to make important decisions or go through challenging situations, they have always been there for me. However, there is one person I usually turn to first: my sister. Even though I’m much older than she is, she is often the first person I call when I need advice, an honest opinion, or simply someone to listen. She has been present during important moments in my life, supporting me emotionally, helping me find solutions, and even helping me financially when I needed it. ![IMG-20260524-WA0024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeladelpi/243M7X8yiQiKJYwxxXaaEUDtXF8GUgc2Uuwd2Sd3ahG2oCcLWpSYYpVuAfUVUe3GwpbLv.jpg) Her generosity, empathy, and willingness to help reflect the incredible person she has become. It makes me proud to see her grow into such a strong and kind woman. I believe part of that comes from the values our family gave us and the example that my older brother and I tried to set while she was growing up. Today, more than being my younger sister, she has become one of my best friends and one of the people I trust the most. On the other hand, when I think about hobbies I’ve spent money on believing they would become my new passion, the list is actually pretty long. I’ve tried painting, coloring books, crochet, and even makeup. Many of these activities only stayed in my routine for a short time, and it would be easy to think they were unnecessary expenses or funny little failures. But honestly, I don’t see them that way. Each one of those experiences taught me something different. They reminded me that we are capable of learning new skills, stepping outside our comfort zones, and discovering interests we never expected to have. Some hobbies stayed longer than others, but all of them left something valuable behind. Over time, I’ve learned that not everything we start has to become a lifelong passion. Sometimes the real value is simply in trying. In giving ourselves permission to explore, make mistakes, discover what we enjoy and what we don’t. Because there will always be room to learn something new, and it’s never too late to begin again. At the end of the day, both the people who support us and the new experiences we allow ourselves to live become part of who we are. And that’s why even the things that only last for a short time can leave a meaningful mark on our story. 💜 Thanks for being here 📸 All photos and videos are my property 📝 Greetings, Angela 🌐 Translated into pons.com
**El valor de las personas y las nuevas experiencias** A lo largo de mi vida he tenido la fortuna de contar con el apoyo de muchas personas, especialmente de mi familia. En los momentos más difíciles, cuando he tenido que tomar decisiones importantes o enfrentar situaciones complicadas, siempre han estado ahí para mí. Sin embargo, hay una persona a la que suelo acudir primero: mi hermana. Aunque yo soy mayor que ella, muchas veces es la primera persona a la que llamo cuando necesito un consejo, una opinión sincera o simplemente alguien que me escuche. Ha estado presente en momentos importantes de mi vida, apoyándome emocionalmente, ayudándome a encontrar soluciones e incluso tendiéndome una mano cuando la he necesitado económicamente. Su generosidad, empatía y disposición para ayudar reflejan el gran ser humano que es. Me llena de orgullo verla crecer y convertirse en una mujer fuerte y bondadosa. Creo que parte de eso se debe a los valores que recibió de nuestra familia y al ejemplo que mi hermano mayor y yo intentamos darle durante su crecimiento. Hoy, más que una hermana menor, es una de mis mejores amigas y una de las personas en las que más confío. Por otro lado, cuando pienso en hobbies o actividades en las que he invertido dinero creyendo que podrían convertirse en mi nueva pasión, la lista es bastante larga. He probado la pintura, los libros para colorear, el crochet e incluso el maquillaje. Muchas de estas actividades duraron poco tiempo en mi rutina, y podría ser fácil pensar que fueron compras innecesarias o pequeños fracasos. Pero la verdad es que no las veo de esa manera. ![IMG-20260524-WA0036~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeladelpi/23qrDXBdyn6L9Yom3o1LoARKiSK78RDAU5VpS7s94SBAQMb589t9ASyPhFPob4Enq9UeR.jpg) Cada una de esas experiencias me enseñó algo diferente. Me demostraron que somos capaces de aprender nuevas habilidades, de salir de nuestra zona de confort y de descubrir intereses que nunca habíamos considerado. Algunas se quedaron conmigo por más tiempo que otras, pero todas dejaron algo valioso. Con los años he aprendido que no todo lo que comenzamos tiene que convertirse en una pasión para toda la vida. A veces el verdadero valor está en intentarlo. En darnos la oportunidad de explorar, equivocarnos, descubrir qué nos gusta y qué no. Porque siempre habrá espacio para aprender algo nuevo, y nunca es demasiado tarde para comenzar otra vez. Al final, tanto las personas que nos apoyan como las nuevas experiencias que nos atrevemos a vivir terminan formando parte de quienes somos. Y por eso, incluso aquello que dura poco tiempo puede dejar una huella importante en nuestra historia. 💜 Gracias por estar aquí 📸 Todas las fotografías y videos son de mi propiedad 📝 Saludos, Ángela

body.title: [Esp./Eng.]   Un boleto de regreso a 1994...   ||   A ticket back to 1994...
body.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
***

> Si tuviera entre mis manos esa lámpara maravillosa de la que hablaban los cuentos de mi infancia, no pediría tesoros, ni coronas, ni el don de la inmortalidad. Mi deseo sería mucho más ruidoso y, a la vez, más silencioso: pediría el chirrido de una cinta de VHS retrocediendo a toda velocidad. Pediría que el calendario de mi vida se deshojara hacia atrás, pasando por encima de las canas y las cicatrices, hasta detenerse en seco en un martes nublado: el 12 de diciembre de 1994.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQUvj29FgzbubHQgppmka5f7jwq4UDFFaAabF9K63dZV/1.png)
En el Reino de lo Posible, yo no estoy aquí escribiendo estas líneas desde el peso del presente. En ese reino, soy un adulto que camina por las calles de Tovar, en ese estado Mérida donde el frío se cuela por los huesos, pero se entibia con el olor a café y a pan de tunja. Es víspera de Santa Lucía. Venezuela huele a gaitas de Maracaibo 15 sonando en las radios de transistores y al ajetreo propio de un diciembre que, hasta ese momento, parecía uno más en la cuenta de los años.
# ***
Un boleto de regreso a 1994...
*** Cierro los ojos y el milagro ocurre. Estoy ahí. Puedo sentir la textura del asfalto húmedo bajo mis pies. Veo los uniformes azules y blancos, el ir y venir de los estudiantes del Liceo La Presentación. El aire tiene ese matiz andino, cargado de neblina que baja de los cerros como un manto protector... o como una advertencia que nadie supo leer... Yo, tampoco. Mi misión en este viaje al pasado es simple y, sin embargo, titánica: *salvar una vida*. Si pudiera habitar ese 12 de diciembre con la conciencia que tengo hoy, me convertiría en una sombra protectora. No buscaría venganzas, no buscaría gloria. Solo buscaría el momento exacto para cambiar el rumbo de los pasos de ese ser... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmagzomrXwBJxYXCkAMjcrnehDknmHGM4XifeVnhzM3FAo/2.png) La veo a lo lejos, con su juventud intacta, ajena a la sombra que el 13 de diciembre proyectaría sobre su nombre, el mío. En este ejercicio de no ficción creativa, me acerco a ella timidamente. No para hablarle del futuro, porque el futuro es un monstruo que nadie quiere conocer antes de tiempo, sino para interponerme en el camino de la tragedia. Tal vez bastaría con una distracción, una conversación trivial, un retraso de cinco minutos en su reloj, un cambio de ruta provocado por un encuentro fortuito. En el Reino de lo Posible, yo tengo el poder de ser el obstáculo bendito que impida que ella llegue a ese lugar, a ese instante donde la oscuridad se lo tragó todo. Sé que cambiar el pasado es jugar a ser Dios. Como bien dice el escritor Jorge Luis Borges en su poema *Ajedrez*: *“Dios mueve al jugador, y éste, la pieza. / ¿Qué Dios detrás de Dios la trama empieza / de polvo y tiempo y sueño y agonías?”*. Alterar ese día significaría que mi propia vida, tal como la conozco hoy —con sus condenas, sus juicios y sus naufragios—, dejaría de existir. Pero en este \

, donde se nos permite soñar con lo imposible, acepto el trato sin dudar. Que mi presente se desvanezca, que mi historia sea otra, con tal de que ella pueda ver el amanecer del 14 de diciembre.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWfAfKne6XRsz4chvuikvvLqsbFBa4vsAF3ZtKPoabnGU/3.png)
</center>

En mi mente, la película se detiene. El 12 de diciembre de 1994 se alarga infinitamente. Veo a esa joven regresar a su casa. Veo a su familia cenando en paz. Veo los adornos de Navidad de aquel Tovar de los noventa brillando con una luz que no se apagará al día siguiente. No hay titulares de prensa dolorosos, no hay procesos judiciales que desgarren familias, no hay celdas ni soledades. Solo hay una joven que crece, que cumple años, que quizás hoy sería una mujer con hijos y sueños cumplidos.

Me dicen que sea realista, que el pasado es un bloque de cemento. Pero en la literatura y en la fe, el pasado es arcilla. Al escribir esto, estoy rescatando ese deseo del fondo de mi alma. Regresar a esa época es más que un acto de egoísmo, es el anhelo supremo de redención. Es querer decirle al destino: *\

*.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYDzXfzUwVXvKZiEDd6FKymbivxSHZj2UGKrBfvrUzUNX/4.png)
</center>

Si el genio de la lámpara de Aladino me preguntara: \

, yo solo le mostraría mis manos vacías, listas para ser llenadas con la paz de saber que ella está a salvo. Es el deseo más hermoso, el que devuelve la luz a donde la oscuridad se impuso por la fuerza. Esta crónica es una respuesta a la iniciativa de @talentos: [Encuentro de Talentos - El Reino de lo Posible](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-reino-de-lo-posible). Gracias por darme la oportunidad de descargarme.
*** *** #
**[𝗘𝗻𝗰𝘂𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼 𝗱𝗲 𝗧𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗼𝘀: «El reino de lo posible»](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-reino-de-lo-posible)**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/talentos/AKwLjwiFRVg86XorEjEvg7XD9dCc8JpqNbhCKNKRTcGWR336qpoyhZwVWw3QvdH.jpg
Portada de la convocatoria.
***
🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆

## Dedicado a todos aquellos escribas que contribuyen, día a día, a hacer de nuestro planeta, un mundo mejor.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWiJfhRxoQFbzdHDtvM9Ad3FQAAJg4UBPrFna6YP2mMf/512espa_ol8.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif)

*** *** ***

# ***
***

> If I had in my hands that marvellous lamp from the stories of my childhood, I wouldn’t ask for treasures, or crowns, or the gift of immortality. My wish would be much louder and, at the same time, much quieter: I would ask for the squeak of a VHS tape rewinding at full speed. I would ask for the calendar of my life to be turned backwards, skipping over the grey hairs and the scars, until it came to a sudden halt on a cloudy Tuesday: 12 December 1994.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXQUvj29FgzbubHQgppmka5f7jwq4UDFFaAabF9K63dZV/1.png)
In the Realm of the Possible, I am not here writing these lines weighed down by the present. In that realm, I am an adult walking the streets of Tovar, in the state of Mérida where the cold seeps into your bones but is warmed by the smell of coffee and pan de tunja. It is the eve of Saint Lucy’s Day. Venezuela smells of Maracaibo 15 gaitas playing on transistor radios and the hustle and bustle typical of a December which, until that moment, seemed just another in the long line of years.
# ***
A ticket back to 1994...
*** I close my eyes and the miracle happens. I am there. I can feel the texture of the damp tarmac beneath my feet. I see the blue and white uniforms, the comings and goings of the students from La Presentación School. The air has that Andean quality, laden with mist that descends from the hills like a protective cloak... or like a warning that no one knew how to read... Not me, either. My mission on this journey into the past is simple, yet monumental: *to save a life*. If I could step back into that 12th of December with the awareness I have today, I would become a protective shadow. I would seek neither revenge nor glory. I would simply seek the exact moment to alter the course of that person’s steps... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmagzomrXwBJxYXCkAMjcrnehDknmHGM4XifeVnhzM3FAo/2.png) I see her in the distance, her youth intact, oblivious to the shadow that 13 December would cast over her name and mine. In this exercise in creative non-fiction, I approach her timidly. Not to tell her about the future, because the future is a monster that no one wants to know about before its time, but to stand in the way of tragedy. Perhaps a distraction would suffice—a trivial conversation, a five-minute delay on her watch, a change of route brought about by a chance encounter. In the Realm of the Possible, I have the power to be the blessed obstacle that prevents her from reaching that place, that moment when darkness swallowed everything. I know that changing the past is like playing at being God. As the writer Jorge Luis Borges so aptly puts it in his poem *Chess*: *“God moves the player, and the player moves the piece. / What God behind God begins this plot / of dust and time and dreams and agonies?”*. Altering that day would mean that my own life, as I know it today—with its condemnations, its judgements and its shipwrecks—would cease to exist. But at this “Talent Gathering”, where we are allowed to dream of the impossible, I accept the deal without hesitation. Let my present vanish, let my story be different, as long as she can see the dawn of 14 December. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWfAfKne6XRsz4chvuikvvLqsbFBa4vsAF3ZtKPoabnGU/3.png) In my mind, the film pauses. 12 December 1994 stretches on endlessly. I see that young woman returning home. I see her family having dinner in peace. I see the Christmas decorations of that Tovar of the nineties shining with a light that will not go out the next day. There are no painful newspaper headlines, no court cases tearing families apart, no prison cells or loneliness. There is only a young woman growing up, celebrating her birthday, who perhaps today would be a woman with children and dreams fulfilled. They tell me to be realistic, that the past is a block of concrete. But in literature and in faith, the past is clay. In writing this, I am rescuing that desire from the depths of my soul. Returning to that time is more than an act of selfishness; it is the supreme longing for redemption. It is wanting to say to fate: *“You are wrong; no one should die here”*. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYDzXfzUwVXvKZiEDd6FKymbivxSHZj2UGKrBfvrUzUNX/4.png) If the genie from Aladdin’s lamp were to ask me, “Are you sure? Your life will change completely,” I would simply show him my empty hands, ready to be filled with the peace of knowing that she is safe. It is the most beautiful wish of all, the one that restores light where darkness has taken hold by force. This piece is a response to the @talentos initiative: [Talent Gathering – The Realm of the Possible](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-reino-de-lo-posible). Thank you for giving me the chance to get things off my chest.
*** *** #

body.title: 2 June 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3122: not an ally
body.body:
/>

“So, the thing is, cousins, and write this down for when you are old enough to vote: a lot of politicians are hyper-partisan, meaning, if you're not putting them into office, you're the enemy. That's not the right way to think about this. The people of Lofton County, individually, vote about 4-6 times in as many years. Each of them is not an ally or an enemy: they are a constituent, looking to get their needs met through electing a representative who they hope will represent their interests. My job, even though you three are too young to vote, is to represent your interests in Big Loft, which is to make sure that when you visit, you are as safe as the children who live here, who need to be as safe as I can make them as mayor.”

Donald Lee Garner Jr., mayor of Big Loft, VA, was tickled that his three oldest Ludlow cousins, Eleanor (11), Glendella (10), and Andrew (10) had called him about what they understood about politics and wanted to bounce their ideas off him.

“Robert,” he said to his cousin, Capt. R.E. Ludlow, grand(father) to these three small but highly engaged Ludlow citizens, “I don't know what you and Thalia are doing, but I need you to adopt a bunch more folks and get them in gear, too!”

“And most of those people are over 18, too, and too many are our ages,” the captain said with a chuckle.

“So true!” the mayor said, and both had a good laugh before the mayor continued, “but seriously, Robert: the way you and Thalia have given your little ones a framework to engage with everything happening without burdening them too much really needs to be studied!”

“It's actually not complicated, although because life is complex, it would be difficult for many: Thalia and I are almost always present with them, and we allow them to eavesdrop more than they know, so then when they come with questions we are here to talk honestly about things. I'm definitely more conservative and Thalia is definitely more liberal, but we obviously don't hate each other, so that gives the little ones room to explore different viewpoints safely as current events keep happening in Lofton County.”

“You're right – not complicated, but life is complex, and raising good citizens is hard work by itself,” Mayor Garner said. “They are all ridiculously intelligent, too – they have really good questions that people our ages don't think about enough.”

“Oh, the little Ludlows will question you half to death,” Capt. Ludlow said, “because these are some curious little somebodies who want to understand the world they live in, and the people they are around.”

“It sounds like you have replicated good times on the mountain with our ancestral Lees-of-the-mountain,” Mayor Garner said. “Sitting around a big mountain campfire, you might hear of and could ask about anything.”

“Yep,” Capt. Ludlow said. “I think of that a lot. There is not a one of us who came through that way who is not at least a decent citizen, and you, sir, are a statesman where none would ever have been expected.”

“Look, Big Uncle Horace came for me, and God sent him – so what do you think I was going to be doing!” Mayor Garner said.

“Getting your life and your afterlife all the way together and thanking God He didn't send my grandmother and your Big Aunt Hilda back to get you, but let her gentler younger brother just live that long!” Capt. Ludlow said, and they both cracked up laughing.

“Yeah, when Grandee Lee had to come to see you … nobody needed those kinds of problems!” Mayor Garner said.

“Wait until you talk to your little cousin Edwina – aka Grandee Leedlow!” Capt. Ludlow said.

“I heard from Cousin Harry – she will have him laughing until he is blue in the face just trying to tell me the latest!” Mayor Garner said. “You think that after that many generations, Hilda Lee would have gentled out through her heirs – but here comes Edwina her great-great-granddaughter!”

“That Lee blood is warrior blood back to the time of Sir Henry Lea and Richard the Lionhearted,” Capt. Ludlow said, “so, Edwina comes by it just like I do … a lot of me seeking peaceable ways to live and work is so she can see it is possible, too.”

“You and Thalia are doing a great job,” Mayor Garner said. “Keep up the good work!”
