body.title: The Abundance of Nature
body.body: > Happy Wednesday Hivers! ## I had many favorite fruits when I was younger, but as I reached my 40s, some of them are no longer my favorites. For some, it's because I no longer enjoy sour fruits, while for others, I simply don't like their taste anymore. However, there is one fruit that I loved back then and still enjoy eating to this day. I'm not sure if this fruit is available in your area. In our place, we call it tambis, and in English, it is commonly known as wax apple or Java apple. ## ![IMG_4484.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/Epn9uUzV9BdjifdzydoFWanz3sLAh9EPwNJaw79aS9cUjZskkseaVsWM5qedrxWyZVk.jpeg) ## We have a Java apple tree near our house, and right now it is loaded with fruits. Since there are so many, we can't possibly eat them all. Many of the fruits simply fall to the ground, while others become food for the birds. This is one fruit that I still enjoy eating even today. I really like its taste because it is neither too sweet nor too sour, making it refreshing and enjoyable to eat. ## ![IMG_4485.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/EoErSrjXHDLyojRikHakkubmzkRY5e73wNq2Wnd7cDd5VHjBr1XknB6gnevBVd93V1c.jpeg) ## In the Philippines, you can find plenty of Java apple trees almost everywhere. Around this time of the year, these trees are usually overflowing with fruits. I think this is their peak season, just like watermelons and mangoes. Because of the abundant harvest, Java apples become very affordable in local markets. Many people enjoy eating this fruit not only because it is refreshing but also because it is inexpensive and easy to find. It's one of those seasonal fruits that many families look forward to when the trees are full of ripe fruits. Do you also have Java apple trees in your area? I'd love to know if this fruit is common where you live. Seeing our Java apple tree full of fruits reminds me of how generous nature can be. It is always a joy to enjoy fresh fruits straight from the tree and appreciate the simple blessings that each season brings. ##

>

Thank you for reading and see you on my next blog. Cheers!

body.title: ¿Suerte o resultados merecidos? - Síndrome del Impostor | Luck or Deserved Results? - Impostor Syndrome 🫨 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
##### ¿Suerte o resultados merecidos? - Síndrome del Impostor. 


![1000040873.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vsbMc8KjppT9b4YX2eu7qTNAZGMKmejjagCTDCofFsL2K1GT1YdLugCuMCGznZvriDq.png)


Hola, que tal están amigos de Holos & Lotus. Yo algo así como en modo automático, no es sencillo todo lo que tengo que hacer para que me vaya bien en las materias de la universidad. Siento un gran orgullo de haber dado los pasos necesarios para estar allí, pero a la vez me he sentido un poco cohibida en cuanto a expresar mi opinión en clases sobre los temas que se tocan. Casi siempre participo y me va bastante bien, pero en ocasiones siento que es mejor no ser demasiado expresiva o participar tanto porque esto también puede traer malas impresiones. Eso es algo que me ha tenido pensativa últimamente. 

Ahora se le dice Síndrome del Impostor a aquella persona que aunque se esfuerza, obtiene buenos resultados y las cosas le salen bien, al final piensa que todo es producto de la suerte y no del esfuerzo propio. Eso me sucede, tengo varios puntos por participación en clases, algunos profesores me reconocen ya de lo mucho que me anima poder participar, pero se que en ocasiones me siento como si el esfuerzo no fuera realmente suficiente como para decir que las cosas que han salido bien han sido producto de mis propias decisiones y de aplicarme en cada tarea y prueba que me ha tocado realizar. 

Estudiar psicología es bastante complicado ya de por si, hay que leer mucho y estudiar un montón. Pero de nada vale saber la teoría si no sabemos poner en práctica las cosas que vamos aprendiendo. Supongo que mis compañeros también pueden llegar a sentirse igual que yo, que participan y salen con buenas calificaciones solo porque si y no por el esfuerzo que cada uno pone para que en cada materia nos vaya de la mejor manera. Pero realmente cada uno dentro de nuestras capacidades nos hemos esforzado por estar en cada clase y por asistir, es algo que realmente dice mucho de nosotros y del compromiso que tenemos con nuestra carrera. 

![1000040878.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EpVACQpUSqUhBrbvCo3RWvUH5rv7BquTvZTANGCbriicVdJL2XyG9cbwgbbpArpohTv.jpg)

Hoy vi mi primera calificación de psicoestadistica, una materia que va ligada de la estadística pero dentro de los parámetros de la psicología. Suele ser una de las materias más complicadas porque requiere aprender números y hacer cálculos. Realmente está materia me tenía un poco preocupada pero en la prueba salí bien, saque la nota máxima. Eso me llenó de alegría y de motivación, pero después me sentí como si todo fuese un sueño, como si lo que estuviera pasando no lo hubiera conseguido con mis tiempos de atención en las clases, de hacer las tareas y de leer mucho. Es algo que me genera un poco de conflicto pero supongo que es normal sentirse así de vez en cuando. 

Tal vez el inicio puede ser la parte más sencilla, donde todos estamos aprendiendo y podemos darnos el gusto de cometer pequeños errores. Sin embargo, he pensado desde antes de obtener el cupo en la universidad que debía ser muy responsable porque es algo que había querido desde hace mucho tiempo y está oportunidad no se da todo el tiempo. Me gusta poder dar lo mejor de mi en las clases y también tratar de ayudar en lo que pueda a mis otros compañeros. Estudiar puede ser todo un desafío pero vale la pena, es el esfuerzo que en un futuro tendrá sus frutos, es algo en lo que me veo haciéndolo hasta que tenga vida. 

Tal vez debo darme más méritos y reconocer las cosas que hago para salir bien en las clases, todos esos momentos en los que dudaba de mi pero aún así me atrevía a levantar la mano para responder a alguna pregunta, aunque pudiese estar equivocada. No me desacredito conscientemente, pero es algo que con el paso de los meses puede que vaya mejorando. Por ahora agradezco todas las veces que he sentido cansancio y aún así hago las cosas que tengo que hacer. Siendo responsable con mis elecciones y con el aprendizaje que deseo obtener de mis profesores y también de mis compañeros. Debo fluir más durante este trayecto 💛. 


![1000036591.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoH5GGWRAFPwDXXLBARiEGCJUDCp6CAFD1qEsgMuUe5Dt9qDVjRNtfAfJkxbVS266n9.png)


##### Luck or Deserved Results? - Impostor Syndrome.


![1000040860.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23w2ytMkaB7NtAAbMN4qhdzggdC98U8RkGKf7gzor1bW5rvUiecqBTTK1yiUtiu18UnHS.png)



Hello, how are you, friends from Holos & Lotus? I'm currently running somewhat on autopilot; everything I have to do to perform well in my university courses is no easy feat. I feel an immense sense of pride for having taken the necessary steps to be there, but at the same time, I’ve been feeling a bit self-conscious about expressing my opinions in class regarding the topics we discuss. I participate almost all the time and do quite well, but occasionally I feel it's better not to be too expressive or participate so much, as this could also leave a bad impression. That’s something that has been keeping me pensive lately.

Nowadays, anyone who pushes themselves, gets good results, and succeeds, yet ultimately believes it's all a product of luck rather than their own effort, is said to have Impostor Syndrome. That happens to me. I have several points for class participation, and some professors already recognize me because of how much I am encouraged to take part. However, I know that sometimes I feel as though my effort isn't truly enough to say that the things that have turned out well are the result of my own choices and of applying myself to every assignment and test I've had to take.

Studying psychology is quite complicated in and of itself; you have to read a lot and study a ton. But knowing the theory is worthless if we don't know how to put into practice the things we are learning. I suppose my classmates might also feel the same way I do—that they participate and come out with good grades just \

and not because of the effort each one of us puts in so that we do our best in every subject. But truly, within our own capabilities, every single one of us has made the effort to be in every class and to attend, which is something that really says a lot about us and the commitment we have to our career.

![1000040878.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EpVACQpUSqUhBrbvCo3RWvUH5rv7BquTvZTANGCbriicVdJL2XyG9cbwgbbpArpohTv.jpg)

Today I saw my first grade in psychostatistics, a subject linked to statistics but within the parameters of psychology. It tends to be one of the most complicated subjects because it requires learning numbers and making calculations. Honestly, this subject had me a bit worried, but I did well on the test—I got the maximum grade. This filled me with joy and motivation, but afterward, I felt as if everything were a dream, as if what was happening hadn't been achieved through my focused time in class, doing assignments, and reading a lot. It’s something that creates a bit of conflict for me, but I suppose it's normal to feel this way from time to time.

Perhaps the beginning is the easiest part, where we are all learning and can afford to make small mistakes. However, even before getting my spot at the university, I thought that I needed to be very responsible because this is something I had wanted for a very long time, and this opportunity doesn't come around every day. I like being able to give my best in class and also trying to help my other classmates however I can. Studying can be quite a challenge, but it is worth it; it is the effort that will bear fruit in the future, something I see myself doing for as long as I live.

Perhaps I need to give myself more credit and recognize the things I do to perform well in class—all those moments when I doubted myself but still dared to raise my hand to answer a question, even if I might be wrong. I don't consciously discredit myself, but it is something that may improve as the months go by. For now, I am grateful for all the times I have felt exhausted and yet still did the things I needed to do. Being responsible for my choices and for the learning I wish to obtain from my professors and also from my classmates. I need to flow more during this journey 💛.


![1000036591.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoH5GGWRAFPwDXXLBARiEGCJUDCp6CAFD1qEsgMuUe5Dt9qDVjRNtfAfJkxbVS266n9.png)

body.title: He is coming again!!! | El viene otra vez!!!
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/1323550/pexels-photo-1323550.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
</center>

*Fuente: Pexels.com / Bible.com*

Christ died once. One time. Enough for all. He didn't need to be sacrificed again and again like the old testament priests had to do. His one sacrifice covered everything — past, present, future.

> so Christ was sacrificed once to take away the sins of many; and he will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.
> Hebrews 9:28 (NIV)

But here is the beautiful part: He is coming back. Not to die again, not to suffer. He already took care of sin. This time He comes to bring salvation to those who are waiting for Him. The question is: are you waiting? Are you ready?

Sometimes we get so caught up in the daily grind that we forget He is coming back. We worry about things that won't matter in eternity. We hold grudges, we chase stuff, we forget what really matters.

He is coming. That changes everything.

**********
**********

Cristo murió una sola vez. Una sola. Suficiente para todos. No necesitó ser sacrificado una y otra vez como hacían los sacerdotes en el antiguo testamento. Su único sacrificio cubrió todo — pasado, presente y futuro.

> así también Cristo fue ofrecido una sola vez para llevar los pecados de muchos; y aparecerá por segunda vez, sin relación con el pecado, para salvar a los que le esperan.
> Hebreos 9:28 (RVR1960)

Pero esto es lo hermoso: Él vuelve. No para morir de nuevo, no para sufrir otra vez. Él ya se encargó del pecado. Esta vez viene a traer salvación a los que le esperan. La pregunta es: ¿estás esperando? ¿Estás listo?

A veces nos enredamos tanto en el día a día que nos olvidamos que Él vuelve. Nos preocupamos por cosas que no importarán en la eternidad. Guardamos rencor, corremos tras cosas, olvidamos lo que realmente importa.

Él viene. Eso cambia todo.

## God bless you today and always!!!

**********

## Dios te bendiga hoy y siempre!!!

body.body: Un equilibrio que puede resumirse en una frase: \n\n\

A veces el equilibrio implica sacrificar ciertas metas. No es el caso que planteas, pero reflexionando sobre tu enfoque: equilibrio; se me antojó pensar que a veces hay fracasos que pueden evitarse. 

Lo digo porque no está mal trazarse metas, pero ¿Es razonable? ¿O solo es un capricho o un intento de gritar alrededor para recibir aprobación o validación? Entonces es cuando la meta se vuelve una carga, en cuyo caso, lo mejor es considerar los motivos detrás de esas metas y si realmente son convenientes. 

Lo que no construye, derrumba. Y si perseguir una meta me derrumba más de lo que me construye, entonces lo más sano es buscar la paz con uno mismo y sacrificar, buscar otro rumbo. 

A veces renunciar también es equilibrio.

body.title: Sonrisas que celebran la vida | Smiles that celebrate life. 😊🫂[Esp/Eng] contenido original.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeDcu44gZKtcGaLadpEZ1gkhKBZQaUgCSYqjHKz2E6CTr/1780441324156.jpg)

Hay momentos que se quedan grabados en nuestra mente, no por los regalos ni por la torta, sino por la luz que transmite esa persona al ser feliz justo en su día especial . Anoche nos reunimos para celebrar el cumpleaños de nuestra pastora Carmen y cuando ví su cara irradiando alegría lo primero que se me vino a la mente fue sonrisas que celebran la vida.

* (*There are moments that remain engraved in our minds, not because of the gifts or the cake, but because of the light a person transmits when they are happy right on their special day. Last night, we gathered to celebrate our Pastor Carmen's birthday, and when I saw her face radiating joy, the first thing that came to my mind was smiles that celebrate life.*)

<center>  ◆ ▬▬▬▬▬▬ ❴ ✧ ❵ ▬▬▬▬▬▬ ◆  </center>

Es que hay gestos que no necesitan explicación y esa sonrisa espontánea llena de ilusión y gratitud representan la expresión más bonita para reflejar la emoción en nuestro corazón por recibir tan grata sorpresa y por tener la oportunidad de compartir con personas que la aman. 

* (*The truth is, there are gestures that need no explanation, and that spontaneous smile filled with hope and gratitude represents the most beautiful expression to reflect the emotion in our hearts for receiving such a wonderful surprise and for having the opportunity to share with people who love her.*)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYfjYiUaczLNzyeS7QFfS2ukUG1Jq5La2ZyFGRKuL48D4/1780438079970.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNs2Tj9snnWfp8eLe9EDEH7NeB22o4ruAPY97HxyvwbCz/1780438172942.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNb9HCoSEBc324skMZMWHbdVkAhp4hioqZt8dUuzWs4Tx/1780438173141.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsbKqHCUsFNifhi9tM3mkacqCUqwjBk7CD4cjaYBgfhz/1780438173285.jpg)


A veces dejamos que los días pasen muy de prisa y no nos detenemos a observar los detalles que de verdad importan, a veces queremos detener el tiempo y quedarnos en esos instantes de felicidad compartida, dónde tenemos la oportunidad de dar gracias a Dios por esas personas que nos permite conocer y que abrazamos con mucha dulzura y le deseamos siempre lo más bonito de la vida. 

* (*Sometimes we let the days pass by too quickly and we don't stop to observe the details that truly matter; sometimes we want to stop time and stay in those moments of shared happiness, where we have the opportunity to thank God for those people He allows us to meet, whom we embrace with great tenderness, always wishing them the most beautiful things in life.*)

<center>  ◆ ▬▬▬▬▬▬ ❴ ✧ ❵ ▬▬▬▬▬▬ ◆  </center>

Ver a alguien que aprecias, respetas y admiras sonreír con total libertad es un momento único que vale la pena capturar en fotografías, aunque a veces queramos más bien detener ese momento, ya que nos regalan esa pizca de complicidad y unión que a veces creemos perdidas.

* (*Seeing someone you appreciate, respect, and admire smile with total freedom is a unique moment that is worth capturing in photographs, even though sometimes we would rather stop that moment, as it gives us that touch of complicity and unity that we sometimes believe is lost.*)

<center>  ◆ ▬▬▬▬▬▬ ❴ ✧ ❵ ▬▬▬▬▬▬ ◆  </center>

Aunque les confieso que detrás de esa hermosa sonrisa que ven en la portada, también hay historias. 
Hubo muchas bromas para lograr la foto más espontánea y genuina de todas y detrás de todo eso se podía escuchar su risa nerviosa y esa energía que surgió tras cámaras para poder capturar la imagen perfecta del reflejo de un momento real y feliz.

*  (*Although I must confess that behind that beautiful smile you see on the cover, there are also stories. There were many jokes to achieve the most spontaneous and genuine photo of all, and behind all of that, you could hear her nervous laughter and that energy that emerged behind the scenes to capture the perfect image reflecting a real and happy moment.*)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRPVifnnGph9KE6sWUmBWae5SsjSRHs3SpdPuKfz41ytc/1780438243669.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQdqtqUoDxKE8HUzEimKUn5QcD2Ko3c7sDCfMK4UvhbAE/1780438243815.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsbKqHCUsFNifhi9tM3mkacqCUqwjBk7CD4cjaYBgfhz/1780438243953.jpg)

Y no tenemos dudas de que hay personas que tienen la capacidad de inspirar través de su esencia, de hacernos sentir cómodos y de también contagiarnos con su risa. Sabemos que vale la pena poder  ser parte de esa emoción y de ese agradecimiento profundo, porque la vida es más bonita cuando es compartida, aún cuando esté llena de ciclos donde existen momentos tanto buenos como desagradables.

* (*And we have no doubt that there are people who have the ability to inspire through their essence, to make us feel comfortable, and to also share their laughter with us. We know that it is worth being part of that emotion and that deep gratitude, because life is more beautiful when it is shared, even when it is full of cycles where both good and unpleasant moments exist.*)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb4Xys67jokF7P2Ef8vRxVuNM2GGRxHsQbKPFiUfFUdox/1780438323646.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeP9UxfZ5sS1x67SoZUtkdj7ojzatSYLUwXU6uQGpzyss/1780438323773.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPqHZ3tSig3uvbsP9sEnrWhK2Dyc9qSopYa7y7EeUXDdb/1780438323920.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbqqDU2zPJobpnuitBKUsf2pKFSpusXNcWTP4dTDd8ZoC/1780438324059.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWpJVUV4AiC7bTo6NXWrJyzpcWVDyfQDQuWjK81BSMXo/1780438324161.jpg)

Coincidir en el camino con personas que tienen la capacidad de iluminar el entorno con su sola presencia es una fortuna que no damos por sentada. Por eso, formar parte de esta celebración va mucho más allá de una fecha en el calendario; es nuestra manera de decir gracias. Gracias por la frescura que aporta a nuestras vidas, por recordarnos la importancia de disfrutar el presente y por recordarnos que, sin importar la rutina, siempre hay un motivo válido para sonreír con el corazón.

* (*Encountering people on our path who have the ability to illuminate the surroundings with their mere presence is a fortune we do not take for granted. That is why being part of this celebration goes far beyond a date on the calendar; it is our way of saying thank you. Thank you for the freshness you bring to our lives, for reminding us of the importance of enjoying the present, and for reminding us that, no matter the routine, there is always a valid reason to smile from the heart.*)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQm8tkQasGGF9pVF1PHEHEwKpVCHDJiqZgLKUdVxpyrUx/1780438503694.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRHB7uchSxJS43gwoTXmvRWjFCcJjH6EM2pQBojVv5tL/1780438503878.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbRiE3Cm6wQcKBoYp28e1fLReE32RkwooSNuZBbnQj145/1780438503988.jpg)

Los cumpleaños nos recuerdan que el amor se manifiesta de muchas formas, y para nosotros, celebrar y orar juntos es la más bonita. ¿No creen que acompañar a quienes amamos en su fe y su alegría es el mejor regalo?

* (*Birthdays remind us that love manifests itself in many ways, and for us, celebrating and praying together is the most beautiful one. Don't you think that accompanying those we love in their faith and their joy is the best gift?*)

body.title: Honey Mustard Chicken [ENG-ESP]
body.body: >Greetings dear friends, welcome to my blog. Today I am once again joining the weekly contest [Qurator's: Hive Top Chef! | Honey es]( https://hive.blog/qurator/@qurator/qurators-hive-top-chef-or-honey). This week, the star ingredient in the kitchen is honey. You might think that, because of its sweet taste, it’s only good for desserts, but honey also pairs well with savory recipes—its sweetness creates a distinctly bittersweet flavor. To be honest, I’m not a big fan of that taste, but I decided to give it a try to experiment with something new in the kitchen and break away from my usual flavors for a bit._

>This recipe is for honey chicken, but it doesn't stand alone—I paired it with mustard. Chicken with a touch of sweetness goes really well together. In fact, I first tried it with sugar back in my college days. When they told me we’d be eating chicken with that sugary twist, I couldn’t believe it, but they made it clear that “it doesn’t taste sweet at all” and that the flavor was delicious. I thought this combination was crazy, but I liked it and ended up making it a couple of times at home.<div>

<hr>


<center>


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXhfgeYSpm5jSrVX4jAJkpvGwWm5hgB7scBXQGJwXSiQK/1780438375471.jpg

</center>


<hr>


<div class=\

>Mustard gives the chicken a delicious flavor, but when mixed with honey, the honey tones down the mustard’s tanginess a bit, creating a perfectly balanced flavor—an intense and delicious sweet-and-salty combination. If you haven’t tried this combination yet, give it a try—you won’t regret it.<div>

<hr>


## Ingredients

<hr>


<div class=\
>- 1/2 cup cornstarch slurry (3 teaspoons in 1/2 cup water)\n
>- 2 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil\n

>1.- In a bowl, mix one teaspoon of paprika, one teaspoon of garlic powder, and salt to taste.
![1780438375401.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVqNRcVaibx2VwzLAJehtyPiDyoF4NE7o4H1pXbCgkypr/1780438375401.jpg)
![1780438375483.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRikfJetqy1YXSESmgnY9fbXr2ASDpG2nzGsG4x756FHp/1780438375483.jpg)

>2.- Spread this spice mixture on both sides of the chicken fillets and sear them briefly in a skillet using a teaspoon of extra-virgin olive oil. Set aside.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQKF1wEiMiJgrgXdnHgKRJuXhfx7thKNxxWP2oNS58qYv/1780438375388.jpg

>3.- In a bowl, combine the 3 tablespoons of mustard, the olive oil, and the honey. Mix until the ingredients are thoroughly combined.
![1780438375375.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ7Eymr2rYPqkrW8nLq53ec8bYfVsbAZiMWTMgwrjwoP8/1780438375375.jpg)

>4.-. Add the honey-mustard mixture to the chicken and cook for one minute. Then, add the diluted cornstarch and cook until the sauce has thickened.
![1780438375361.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaiqqp86PcT33eLX9WfPZvhY9knGWbCs1wTJByAUCK9N4/1780438375361.jpg)

> We served the honey-mustard chicken with a side of carrot, beet, and lettuce salad. It turned out delicious.
![1780438375418.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWz4uDKzVY1gVpifR6SMUrTJX13mULW1MdePkUKE1Rgip/1780438375418.jpg)
![1780438375436.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVD8H8TapceuW9KURkCRW3ZGTSK4deet98eBqp6HULPzH/1780438375436.jpg)
I hope you liked it, this has been my participation in Hive Top Chef competition. See you another time.
All photos are original, taken with my Xiaomi Redmi 9 cell phone. The editions were made with the application [GridArt](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US).

body.body:
Hi Wordmappin and Threespeak Community.

<Center>It has been almost two months since we last traveled and my attempt was to post a post every week to give you a tour of a different place we have visited. This place is one of the most beautiful places in Murree where we have been and you can search for it on internet. All the details are also available on internet. Here I am sharing my experience with you. How did we feel after visiting this place? Is this place good enough to visit?</center>

![PhotoCollage_1780434932404.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRZsmdqgVBAcHXvjageLggcPutYDM6PNZSX6k9Hn4dNtc/PhotoCollage_1780434932404.jpg)

<Center>It is true that after visiting this place, we get a beautiful feeling which is very nice. Because in the cities where we live, it is hot and there are buildings, there is not much greenery at all. Wherever we go, we see greenery everywhere and every place is beautiful. And where we went today, we could see mountains with snow on them. It was summer here. If we had gone in winter, we would have seen snowfall.</center>

<Center>This time we have visited all these places in the summer, but next time we will try to visit in the winter. And then we have other areas here that are much more beautiful, but to get there we have to travel further. If we consider the journey from our home, it becomes a 24-hour journey. We left at nine in the morning. First, we visited two or three other places and then we were slowly heading towards our destination.</center>

<Center>Here we walked for a while and after seeing some beautiful places there, we then went to where we had hired a car. Here we got a car for 40 kilometers for about 3,000 Pakistani rupees each way. We paid 3,000 rupees for only 80 kilometers. But the person who had gone with us stayed there with us because that is how the system works here, that the car in which we go stops there and waits for us.</center>

<Center>The routes were much more beautiful because we were at an altitude of 16,000 feet and the world below was visible. It was much more beautiful. We were just there, wandering around the place and they had also built a beautiful park there. The duration of the chairlift here was about 25 minutes. We were in the air for only 25 minutes. We were sitting on the chairlift and were seeing beautiful views below.</center>

<Center>In the video, you can see how deep it was and how high we were and this chairlift was taking us high. They had also created a beautiful environment there where people used to go and sit and enjoy themselves with their families. But they had set the prices so high because they said that they bring everything from below, so when they come up here, everything becomes much more expensive. No service was working here.</center>

<Center>If any car service was working, then the prices were very high. So we had to travel with locals because it was a mountainous area and any unscrupulous driver who came here with us could have caused us harm. So these people can take as much money as they want, but they have to pay them. They have experience driving in such places. Now we want to tell you how you liked these places and whether you enjoyed our entire trip.</center>

body.title: Splinterlands:My End Of Season Report & Rewards!
body.body:
Good morning warriors! I welcome you to my blog @zusi78 
The season just ended two days ago and it was an exciting and memorable one compared to last season.To crown it all, I did not only meet my glint target 🎯 of **75,000** glints ,I got a total of over **96,000** at the end of the season.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXZ72XKdNihNuDo1B57XmzXWBhFXRFovPEJQeRCcTpjM8/1780369541240.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUjDqDhwqa36XGERZ65zfkoh1pmD57kvSJDm5bfYJqZv5/1780366619693.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUG2JtSSQQ8TvvpB32mVFPqf53bVDo9dYvtEn3BXRnvW3/1780369541286.jpg)Moving forward,I got this Darkguard Hellion Card for competing in Survival mode and completing over 100 battles and winning more than half them at a win rate of **72.97%**.I was also given a 10,000 glints rewards.Thank you @dewabrata , for introducing me to Survival,I dedicate this to you.


**Splinterlands is no walk in the park,but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building.Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)

**GLINTS AND SPS**.
I bought 5 Ultimate Chests at **10,000** glints each, totaling **50,000** glints. I then used the rest of my glints to purchase rare cards in the rarity draw. This was actually not what I had planned. My original plan was to purchase five epic cards in the rarity draw.
Anyway, after buying the five Ultimate Chests, I opened them, and this is what I got.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZRGGBqgs37R3X2hTHjpHQUUi5LtvcdcRYUFxtsC8ijGn/1780370670273.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPTGd4uhZQMShEcTuv6mGNMNmL1zM5Z8av2N8HB5CX1K9/1780370670309.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR3Tg4TTzBAxWw9LpNZfk2hLWxU84S8Hbw4jRmkgWuEJj/1780370670353.jpg)

Not bad,but I was expecting something big,but I am very okay with it,a monster(**Shadowcomb Duskrose**) and over **1,500** merits, gladius case purchase loading 😂.Not to bore you with Screenshots of the rare cards I bought with the remaining glints,I got a several copies of **SWAMPWROUGHT**, which I upgraded to level three.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY5kGMyiFjrZcLT5SEfTV2UvisYJNNoEZwCzWBaAcBzGL/1780372305852.jpg)

**SPS**
Right from time,and since I joined a guild,all SPS gotten from brawl fights goes straight to my staked SPS.
I got 25 staked SPS in the just concluded brawl fight and some merits as well.My guild actually came second. My SPS is so small,but since I am here for the long haul,I would just keep stacking and staking.

**MY  SPS VALUE BEFORE BRAWL**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUHX33NkW4F2z93kksV8a4hAkAJe7HkfyWfv9tU9JpdbQ/1780374454385.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXjMPzy3wBszkMMG59MemxPZbdfTB9jFw3eD8oo6YAq5P/1780374454503.jpg)

**MY SPS VALUE AFTER CLAIMING BRAWL REWARD**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNwN9589AffYV9Tv9BmX4n4uFtWbNJjRuH7zMmGS2A9zw/1780374454543.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)
**MERITS AND GLADIUS CASES**
Earlier, when I opened my ultimate chests, I got some merits and also earned some from participating in brawl fights. So, at the moment, my total merits in the Guide Store is **3,814**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ4UvPSSCjTyNMZur7L4HgdDkCH5F8MQ2eYhyHdWTWozM/1780381554682.jpg)
Another brawl is going on, so I’ll just wait to increase my merits. That way, I can buy 3 or more Gladius cases. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY5coigw8nNAr19cV4q8znThdzAGGYdUbcJSQJjFtRiYK/1780384537989.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRAX2jqLeGFdLnbJYuZSSPUYZwwaPsZQQvXfcoTXv9LDC/1780384538175.jpg)
It was a wonderful season indeed.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1779996340539.jpg)


Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s my referral link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)

Thank you for reading and watching my post. @zusi78 signing off.

body.title: Something a Little Different Today
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTXrzXXfUVXh742UEguHe95QMHYm5MnifiLiHURtr7STm/screenshot_2026_05_31_084519.png)

Today I would like to showcase a battle that applies a risky strategy that works sometimes. It is the classic one strong monster versus a whole team of small mana monsters in Modern Diamond league.

## The Strategy
The strategy here is quite simple have a very strong high damage big mana monster in a very small mana battle. The Battle I am going to showcase today is only seventeen mana.

Normally the strategy used by @beelzael work great, he really put together an excellent team that I would be proud of. However in this case the ruleset beyond the mana amount is really favoring my one big monster strategy.

You see, we have Explosive Weaponry ruleset here where all units have blast or deal an additional fifty percent damage to units adjacent to the target, rounded up. Well if you only have one unit, this ruleset doesn't apply to your team as you cannot damage adjacent units if there are none :)

We also have Collateral Damage ruleset in effect and this means that all units have Reckless or each successful attack also deals one damage to adjacent allied units. Well just like it was the case with the Explosive Weaponry ruleset we don't have any adjacent allied units as we have only one card on the battle field.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcoiGhFQQJDre5jdv98DFCCSUpaGiLYA4BQ1gxAf6zAPh/image.png)

For my summoner I picked Elias Max Pruitt, this is a great summoner to play in many high level battles in the Modern Diamond or Champion leagues. This summoner lets you summon units from life and water splinters. It gives your units one armor and one melee attack boost. 

Originally I played this unit incorrectly giving my allied units armor repair and cleanse abilities, but other than super rare exceptions I now play this summoner utilizing Piercing and Armored Strike abilities. These two abilities pair perfectly with our one and only card on the field: Commander Slade

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaR1bBTyUZXqP529JzRYNyyNRdWxobaGp958Df7rtiPEN/image.png)

Commander Slade is a ten mana Rare Water unit that comes with base stats of five melee damage, seven shield, ten health and six speed. These abilities get boosted by Elias Max Pruitt by adding one to armor and one to melee strike, and armor is now used for the armored strike.

Additionally it comes with a really nice ability set: Backfire, Deflect, Dodge and Enfeeble. This makes Commander Slade really hard to hit and makes him especially deadly with the blast damage ruleset in effect.

Now enough theory and let's see how this will playout on the battle field.



## The Battle
[Link to The Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_49d9a58738a4532aba5759d29dc33866?ref=seattlea)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmecdLpvHboawLMGoVvbgm125Zno75U1UcLSd1Yxkntn6r/image.png)

So here we have a classic: five small monsters versus one big one. Normally five monsters would be superior to one, but not in this case. So without further delay let's see the battle!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVzoE1vPQrviY7Dqm7voqymEcg6D7ZyPAhg3bH2ieKoXA/image.png)

In the first round Beelzael's Kha'zi Conjurer did all the work hitting my Commander Slade twice using his Ambush ability and removing the all important armor from my Commander Slade. The other monsters on his team missed and got damage back from the Backfire.

So at the start of round two we now have four monsters on his team and one on my team. One hit from Kha'zi Conjurer can end the battle.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR7ExqeUSWnAmHdvSn1mAzfwaNLnEQb7hWd4iDy2QM6iF/image.png)

But third time was not a charm and Kha'zi Conjurer missed his shot and got damage back and as you can see from the picture above in round three Commander Slade should be the first striker and Kha'zi Conjurer could be take out by the Burning.
 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPhyfcFYPribkvyD6dr8nYy79ZiNXLV65UmT8dwiXAavH/image.png)

And as you can see from the image above burning took out Kha'zi Conjurer and the Commander Slade went first and blast from his strike took out the last remaining unit on Beelzael's team. 

So just like that it is over...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbUiCdVvQxhW58G1K5qtHVRS3j7LNb5aDQnUc9h6LQtjB/image.png)

body.title: Splinterlands New Event - Summer Fun!
body.body: > ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZbxXb4AFfPd1KcraHfosmz6WePGt6rUhVCHEqsnYmSuf/splinterlands_new_event_summer_fun_.jpg) New features are always essential in any game, be it a multiplayer mmorpg or a single player RPG to defeat monsters. This would be no different in Splinterlands. Because it is an online game and not a one-shot game, users expect developers to always be thinking about the next step and the next event that will come to the community. And while new features are being designed and built, the game's balance cannot be left behind. When bringing a new, stronger card, in the case of a card game, it cannot end up unbalancing the games' meta. And speaking of news, a new event is coming to Splinterlands, the NFTs card game from the Hive Blockchain network. Summer has arrived in Splinterlands because the Summer Fun Event has just started, running from June 2nd to June 30th, bringing with it some Summer Fun Gift Boxes. I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

> ## Splinterlands New Event - Summer Fun!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTeTmQo1gJeKvoT1ABqfge7GoYbSaznfdk2T8ekL9UWVk/image.png)
[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
There are several new features that came with the Splinterlands Summer Fun Event, such as an Energy Bomb and a new modifier, but let's start by talking about the Summer Fun Gift Boxes, which may be of interest to players. Among the items that can be found there are skins, packs, glint, energy and fortune draw in that famous metric of the more expensive the pack, the more items end up coming, one of them being different. Starting with the types, know that we will have 5 different types of chests. Among them, the $25 chest called Generous Gift has an extra item which is a Spellbook Token that can be sent to a friend or used to unlock a new account to access the play to earn part of Splinterlands. For those who have someone they know who might be interested in venturing into the universe of Splinterlands, this pack could be interesting, as in addition to the token the user will also receive 4x Standard Packs or 16 starter packs, 4x Beach Bum Skins, 50k of Glint, 20 energy and 60 Fortune Draw entries.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWqdZrJkcoecvvKd2yEDC6Rm8dT2T6u5DHTAxB41qZXgE/image.png)
[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
It really is a wide variety of items and an interesting detail are the new skins that will arrive in this beach-themed set. There will be a total of 40 Beach Bum Skins that will be obtained through the boxes above, and there will be duplicate protection until the entire collection is complete. This would be perfect in several scenarios, because there are games where the player ends up with several repeated items and in the case of skins that are cosmetic and you can only use them once on the card, having them repeated would be a huge waste. Furthermore, there will also be a chance to get the Tidebreakers skins in the event's most expensive boxes of 50 and 100 dollars, which will be much rarer due to the difficulty of obtaining them and the cost being much higher than the others. In addition to these two, there will also be some limited skins in the Sparks Shop and as a jackpot for the ultimate and minor chest. Another novelty that surprised us is the creativity in innovating with an already known item, which is energy. Just like any other game with limited matches, Splinterlands also uses an energy system. The innovation happened with them adding a new item called Energy Bomb, which is the equivalent of 5 renewed energy. It is similar, but different to an energy, bringing newness. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZbxXb4AFfPd1KcraHfosmz6WePGt6rUhVCHEqsnYmSuf/splinterlands_new_event_summer_fun_.jpg) Novidades são sempre fundamentais em qualquer jogo seja ele qual seja, um mmorpg com vários jogadores, ou um single player RPG de derrotar monstros. Isso nao seria diferente no Splinterlands. Por ser um jogo online e nao um jogo de uma experiência única, os usuários esperam que os desenvolvedores estejam sempre pensando no próximo passo e no próximo evento que virá para a comunidade. E ao mesmo tempo que as novidades vão sendo idealizadas e construídas, o balanceamento do jogo nao pode ficar para trás. Ao trazer uma carta nova mais forte, no caso de um jogo de cartas, não pode acabar desequilibrando o meta dos jogos. E falando em novidades, um novo evento está chegando justamente ao Splinterlands, o jogo de cartas nfts da rede Hive Blockchain. O verão chegou em Splinterlands porque o evento Summer Fun Event acabou de começar, indo do dia 2 de Junho até 30 de Junho trazendo como novidade alguns Summer Fun Gift Box. Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

> ## Splinterlands New Event - Summer Fun!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTeTmQo1gJeKvoT1ABqfge7GoYbSaznfdk2T8ekL9UWVk/image.png)
[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Existem diversas novidades que vieram no Splinterlands Summer Fun Event, como uma Energy Bomb e um novo modifier, mas vamos começar falando sobre as Summer Fun Gift Boxes, que pode ser do interesse dos jogadores. Dentre os items que podem ser encontrados tem skins, packs, glint, energia e fortune draw naquela famosa métrica de quanto mais caro o pack, mais items acaba vindo, sendo um deles diferente. Começando pelos tipos, saiba que teremos 5 tipos diferentes de baús. Dentre eles, o baú de $25 chamado Generous Gift tem um item extra que é um Spellbook Token que pode ser enviado para um amigo ou usado para desbloquear uma nova conta para acessar a parte de play to earn do Splinterlands. Para quem tem algum conhecido que possa ter interesse em se aventurar no universo de Splinterlands, esse pack pode ser interessante, já que além do token o usuário vai receber ainda 4x Standard Packs ou 16 starter packs, 4x Beach Bum Skins, 50k de Glint, 20 energias e 60 Fortune Draw entries.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWqdZrJkcoecvvKd2yEDC6Rm8dT2T6u5DHTAxB41qZXgE/image.png)
[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
É realmente uma grande variedade de itens e um detalhe interessante são as novas skins que vão chegar nesse set com a temática de praia. Serão um total de 40 Beach Bum Skins que serão obtidas através das caixas acima, sendo que haverá uma proteção de duplicata até que a coleção inteira estiver completa. Isso seria perfeito em diversos cenários, porque tem jogo que o jogador acaba ficando com vários items repetidos e no caso das skins que são cosméticos e você só consegue usar uma vez na carta, ter repetidos seria um grande desperdício. Ainda, haverá também nas caixas mais caras do evento de 50 e 100 dólares a chance de conseguir as skins Tidebreakers que serão bem mais raras pela dificuldade de obtenção e o custo muito acima das demais. Além dessas duas, também vão ter algumas skins limitadas no Sparks Shop e como jackpot dos ultimate e minor chest. Uma outra novidade que surpreendeu é na criatividade em inovar com um item já conhecido que são as energias. Assim como qualquer outro jogo com limitação de partidas, o Splinterlands também utiliza um sistema de energia. A inovação aconteceu com eles adicionando um novo item chamado Energy Bomb, que é o equivalente à 5 energias renovadas. É parecido, mas diferente de uma energia, trazendo novidade. ---

body.title: From Childhood Simplicity to Life's Realities.
body.body: Every man's life is an epistle and a testament to whatever you want it to be. Our lives can become smooth at some point and can also turn out to become bad at some point also, so it depends on which aspect of the face of life we are facing that will determine what our life will be sometimes. Imagine having a smooth and running life and suddenly, without any notice, you see things going the other way around. Your life that has been going well now turns into something that makes you feel so bad and down. This is not the kind of thing we all envision as human, but sometimes life trials can try to weigh us down to test our patience.\n\n

>Source Gone are the days when we were still young, and we won't get to bother about anything that bothers us about eating and drinking all day and playing with our friends. I miss those days when we went to school, and before we came back from school, our food was set, and the only thing you thought about was just going to sleep wake up in the morning go to school eat read and focus on our studies. Now that we are grown, we have now discovered that this life is more than what we think it is, and we have to struggle so hard to become a successful person. After graduating from the secondary school, some of us had the privilege to be able to have some discussion with elderly people, be it in our area of stay or in the learning scheme. These people might have told us some things that they feel will be so beneficial for us, but then we will not see it as something tangible because we do not have any knowledge about it until now, when we are grown. There is a song lyric that says, If I had known that this world is war, I would have been prepared to face the war. But no one will tell you or get you prepared for what's coming. Only you can prepare yourself for what's coming ahead because you are the only one there at that time and in that position. Most of the time I see some of my lady friends who work so hard because they want to be independent people. In as much as it is good to do that, I sometimes feel we still need to slow down a bit because a lady is moving into a man's house, and there are limits to what she will be doing when she is with a man. Well, we all are meant for each other, but sometimes it is not always the same. The only thing I just say is that we all should always learn to be a better version of ourselves because if we do not do that, it might haunt us and make us a shadow of our own selves. The only thing, and the best thing, is to live life easily and go with the daily flow until one gets to the promised land that we all are running after. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@the-lead/from-childhood-simplicity-to-lifes-realities-7ub)

body.title: Let go of your EGO!!! | Deja de lado tu EGO!!!
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/235985/pexels-photo-235985.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
</center>

*Fuente: Pexels.com / [Bible.com](https://www.bible.com/)*

The Christian life isn't a sprint, it's a marathon. It's not about how fast you get there, it's about how steady you remain when the storm hits.

It's easy to trust when everything is going well. But real faith shows up when things don't go as we expected and we still choose to believe.

If you're reading this and your heart feels heavy, I want you to know one thing: you're not alone. God is closer than you think.

Maybe today you feel alone, like no one understands what you're going through. But here's the thing: God not only understands, He's walking right beside you.

If today you're the one going through something difficult, remember something important: you don't need to fight alone. You must allow Jesus to take His place and fight for you. Our human strength can't handle everything.

> He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

Miqueas 6:8

## God Bless you today and always!!!

********
********

Cuántas veces nos preocupamos por cosas que al final no pasaron. Cuánta energía gastamos en ansiedad cuando Dios ya tenía todo bajo control.

Hay algo que aprendí a través de los años: cuando estamos en nuestro punto más débil, es precisamente cuando la fuerza de Dios se manifiesta. El apóstol Pablo lo entendió bien: el poder se perfecciona en la debilidad.

¿Alguna vez te sentiste que caminas en círculos? Que no importa lo que hagas, las cosas simplemente no parecen cambiar? Conozco ese sentimiento bien.

La vida cristiana no es una carrera de velocidad, es una carrera de resistencia. No se trata de cuán rápido llegás, sino de cuán firme te mantenés en medio de la tormenta.

Dios te está diciendo hoy: dame esa carga que estás llevando, dame esa preocupación que no te deja dormir. Yo me encargo. Vos solo confiá.

> Ya se te ha declarado lo que es bueno, y lo que el Señor pide de ti: solamente practicar la justicia, amar la misericordia, y humillarte ante tu Dios.

Miqueas 6:8

## Dios te Bendiga hoy y siempre!!!

La verdad experiencias como estás, así de intensas, son cada vez menos comunes y permanentes porque todo va en función de identidad y perspectiva

Me explico: tener una compañía emocional de ha reducido —tristemente— a un simple ejercicio eventual parecido a tener un perrito. Si me gusta me lo quedo. Pero si implica mucho sacrificio y tiempo lo regalo. 

Y si se porta muy mal pues lo cambio por otro. 

Es mi opinión. Es esas sencillas palabras describo como percibo el sorprendente vacío y —como dije— la superficialidad de las relaciones. Pero cuando hay una identidad bien construida —un conjunto de valores y fortalezas que ofrecer—, creo que es allí cuando estamos en posición de pensar en compartir el camino de la vida con alguien más. body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - Not an ally. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRSnFTgd6-1PfooDER-6bvzOLLZ7DvmLWg-p9FlHlBx9g&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRSnFTgd6-1PfooDER-6bvzOLLZ7DvmLWg-p9FlHlBx9g&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRSnFTgd6-1PfooDER-6bvzOLLZ7DvmLWg-p9FlHlBx9g&s=10)

Humans, like many other animal kind, are not lone member, we do need to socialize, come together as a team, work han in hand to get things done.

Thus, forming alliance and becoming one's ally is a way for groups of individual to set aside some difference and come together to accomplish something bigger than their difference. 

One such situation is when a company is electing their company leadership. One position, multiple candidates, who is the best man for the job? Usually one has to rally his / her ally to throw their support behind them to get the numbers required. 

Or one most common situation are political office holders when an election produce no clear winners. They need to form alliance becoming ally to govern in group. Like various EU countries or the unity government in Malaysia. 

But is it only politicians that only need ally? No, commoners like us need ally too, especially those with special needs or in minority group, since they might be in more needs of support and allyship provided by unknown folks in times of needs can be timely.

But when a betrayal comes in times f needs, then we realized some are simply not an ally to begin with.

In all honesty, there's not much to say about the Phillies loss to the Dodgers on Sunday. It was a pretty depressing 9-1 loss. Couldn't pitch, couldn't hit. It was just pretty rough. Rookie starting pitcher Andrew Painter unsurprisingly struggled against the relentlessly strong lineup that the Dodgers have. He only managed to get through 3 1/3 innings. He allowed four runs on seven hits and a walk. Not ideal but even veterans struggle against the Dodgers so, I'm not panicking quite yet about Painter. 

The starting pitcher for the Dodgers, Yoshinobu Yamamoto was really mowing down the Phillies. Yamamoto was pulled after 5 1/3 innings purely because he had a high pitch count. In that time he managed to record 10 strikeouts and allow zero runs! The Phillies seemed to want to make Yamamoto pitch deep into counts, and it was a respectable strategy but the problem of course was the fact that the Dodgers were excellent offensively, and once Yamamoto was pulled, the Phillies couldn't score against the Dodgers bullpen. 

It is what it is, the Phillies are still overall trending in a mostly positive direction. Tonight, the Phillies face the Padres once again right after facing them prior to this Dodgers series! 

This time the series takes place at home. Nick Castellanos makes his return to Philadelphia which should be interesting! I hope the fans are positive!

body.title: Humans are not truth-seeking machines
body.body:
![93f234ce-553d-4ba7-a461-c486aae684a2.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXLffTuFjQRH562z882NWgKiKDjqZrmh57guXdG7WJNfQ/93f234ce-553d-4ba7-a461-c486aae684a2.png)

People tend to treat truth as a tool. This means that, for them, truth is merely (and exclusively) a means of achieving personal happiness. This is especially evident in the distinction between science and technology. Science is concerned with investigating the universe, while technology is concerned with applying the results of that research to create useful tools that enrich our lives. This is why people place a high value on certain fields of science, such as medical research, which leads to the development of medicines, while showing less interest in others, such as space exploration, where the technological applications of knowledge may be less obvious.

Once a tool no longer serves its purpose, it is discarded in favor of another. In certain fields, particularly those related to the natural sciences, engineering, and medicine, \

must almost always correspond closely to reality in order to produce tangible benefits. It is not advantageous to believe that mercury can cure a disease, or that gasoline can extinguish a candle. Such beliefs are quickly and decisively abandoned in favor of those that more accurately reflect reality.

For example
**The Internet**

This is perhaps the best example of how people pursue pleasure rather than truth. Decades ago, it was commonly joked that with the advent of the internet, virtually every person on the planet would gain instant access to information and reach a very high level of general knowledge and intellectual awareness regarding current events and countless other subjects. Today, we can see that nothing could be further from the truth. People use the internet in ways that align with what makes them feel good, while avoiding information that would create cognitive dissonance.

It was also a very long day due to unforeseen problems and planning mistakes. Virtually all the rooms are up and running and ready for the first day of the show tomorrow. We still have a few things to take care of, but we’ll sort those out tomorrow morning, and then hopefully things will be a little more relaxed. All I have for you today is a photo of a sunset through a grid. That was all I could manage today. Well, that’s it for now—I’m done, and I have to get up early again tomorrow.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931780440683.70257) 

Dritter Tag des Kongressaufbaus hinter mir und heute wieder ordentlich viel Strecken gelaufen und tonnenweise Schritte gemacht. Es war auch ein sehr langer Tag wegen unvorhergesehener Probleme und Planungsfehler. So gut wie alle Säle spielen und sind bereit für den ersten Showtag morgen. Wir haben immer noch ein paar Dinge zu erledigen, aber das werden wir morgen im Laufe des Vormittags zurechtrütteln und dann wird das Ganze hoffentlich ein wenig entspannter. Mitgebracht hab ich euch heute nur ein Bild von einem vergitterten Sonnenuntergang. Mehr war heute einfach nicht drin. So und jetzt bin ich durch und muss morgen wieder früh raus.

body.title: Prayer
body.body:
![FADA4136-C878-4C54-8634-5F34D7BDAD3D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/23ydADxV99x1qccxga1pqc6agnfsAX6NkjBmuREuj2HkgXytU7RZZmwdJ23rzrBeWto94.jpeg)

***
Prayer is one of the most powerful tools in a believer's life, offering a direct connection to God. It is a means of seeking divine intervention, guidance, and comfort. But the question remains: will prayer solve every problem?

The answer lies in understanding the purpose of prayer. Prayer is not merely a way to present our requests to God; it is a conversation with Him, an act of faith, and an opportunity to align our desires with His will. Scripture reminds us:

\

(Philippians 4:6)\n\nThrough prayer, we find peace, clarity, and strength to navigate life’s challenges. While it may not always bring the immediate solution we desire, it positions us to trust in God’s greater plan. Jesus Himself modeled this when He prayed in Gethsemane, saying, \

(Luke 22:42)

Moreover, prayer often works in tandem with action. Faith without works is dead (James 2:17), and God calls us to act on His guidance while trusting Him to work in ways we cannot see. For example, Nehemiah prayed for God’s favor but also took deliberate steps to rebuild Jerusalem’s walls (Nehemiah 4:9).

In summary, prayer does not guarantee immediate solutions, but it provides peace, strength, and divine direction. It reminds us that God is in control and equips us to face our challenges with renewed hope and faith. When combined with obedience and action, prayer becomes a transformative force in our lives.

•  Set a Dedicated Time:

Choose specific times each day to pray and stick to them—it could be morning, evening, or during a break. Consistency helps build a strong habit.

•  Start with Gratitude:

Begin by thanking God for His blessings. A grateful heart sets the tone for meaningful prayer.

•  Pray with Scripture:

Use Bible verses to guide your prayers, aligning your words with God’s promises and truth.

•  Be Honest and Specific:

Speak to God openly about your fears, hopes, and desires. He values sincerity over perfection.

•  Keep a Prayer Journal:

Write down your prayers and revisit them to reflect on God’s answers and faithfulness over time.

body.title: Chris Van Hollen vs. Marco Rubio on Cuba
body.body:
></center>

The brief exchange between Senator Chris Van Hollen and Marco Rubio this Tuesday reveals the irrationality that this administration embodies. Van Hollen took him through several tense points, but the one that interests me, given my immediate circumstances, is the Cuban one. Van Hollen asked Rubio if he had new evidence to argue that Cuba _is_ —and note the present-tense conjugation, because it’s key— a state sponsor of terrorism. Rubio’s response was total nonsense that does not withstand the simplest analysis. Some context next.

In its final hours, a Biden administration that introduced no new policies against Cuba but strictly applied most of those inherited from the first Trump administration—and in this sense was no less cruel— decreed the Island’s removal from the SSOT list. On the first day back in office—and without Biden’s decree having had any practical effect—Trump reinstated Havana on it, offering absolutely no argument in defense of the rollback. Van Hollen questioned Rubio on this very point, that is, on what basis the Trump administration claims that this country sponsors _international_ terrorism.

The Secretary of State starts spinning in circles, doing pirouettes, talking about the FARC-EP, the National Liberation Army (ELN in Spanish), about us being the mother lode of all Marxist and leftist organizations... In short, the thing is that \

, Cuba has been connected to these developments. I am not going to dispute the _real_ history of Cuba regarding support for guerrilla movements, but the last thing known about Cuba and the FARC-EP was that they signed a peace deal here with the Colombian government. The ELN was on the same path when, during the government of Iván Duque, an irresponsible, mortal attack was carried out by factions of the guerrilla group in Colombia, _with no connection in the decision-making chain of command_ to those who were in Havana, which shattered any chance for peace.\n\nDuque demanded the surrender of the ELN delegation members, and the Cuban government stood by its commitment as a guarantor and refrained from doing so. Perhaps Mike Pompeo was going to invent something to put us back on the list. But the truth is this: that irresponsibility—quite ungrateful towards Cuba—on the part of the ELN was the main justification. Nothing more on that point. Miraculously, Rubio made no mention of ETA, or of the Americans presumed guilty of crimes in the United States—from the time of greatest ferment of movements like the Black Panthers—who ended up taking refuge in Cuba as part of a very particular _historical_ context. I emphasize the historical side of this debate because when Van Hollen insists and asks Rubio, \
, his response leaves Van Hollen evidently stunned and disconcerted: \

_ Tell me something.\n\n> Watch the brief exchange [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=173&si=X0uPEkn2Kf9r0-aA&v=txo6sVwE0yE&feature=youtu.be). [Source](https://x.com/EFEnoticias/status/2061903843693142080?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw) for the cover image.

body.body:
---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![1000487222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/48ToTyLFezJ9FMo482tqD8DTvtKasNT7hTTd7Bg6Zn2bLy2TGZiEH7HJq1ua2DBnav.jpg)

> Hola, amigos de esta comunidad, una vez más, nuestra amiga @angelica7 nos invita a participar este martes en **Encuentro de talentos** con un tema que nos ayuda a reflexionar sobre la esperanza; se trata de **la magia de lo posible**. A veces digo que me gustaría tener una varita mágica para poder lograr lo que quiero en un momento determinado. Pero sé que no podemos conseguir esa varita mágica, y además, no la necesitamos para que nuestros deseos se hagan realidad ni para convertir lo imposible en posible. Lo único que necesitamos es paciencia para aprender algunas cosas o algo nuevo, no con miedo, sino con valentía y con la confianza de que lo lograremos. Porque eso es lo que necesitamos para seguir adelante a pesar de los altibajos y para encontrar la magia que nos motive a seguir adelante. Así que hacer de lo imposible lo posible es un reto que debemos afrontar sin importar la edad que tengamos. Les cuento, amigos, que cuando comencé a dar mis primeros pasos en el mundo de las computadoras y las redes, todo me parecía muy extraño. Sentía mucho miedo, hasta el punto de pensar que era imposible lograrlo. Tenía 42 años en ese momento y de verdad no sabía cómo usar el aparato. Incluso le tenía miedo al ratón; era algo muy difícil para mí. Pero tuve la fortuna de tener a mi lado a un gran maestro; ese fue mi hijo. Él tuvo la paciencia de ayudarme y me dio el valor necesario para enfrentar ese reto y vencer el miedo. Así que hoy en día sé manejar cualquier computadora, laptop y trabajar tranquilamente en ella sin miedo; es más, he enseñado a algunas personas a usarla. Todos tenemos algún logro personal en nuestra vida del que nos sentimos inmensamente orgullosos: un objetivo que en su momento parecía una locura, un sueño lejano o algo imposible. Sin embargo, gracias a nuestra perseverancia, conseguimos alcanzarlo. Por eso debemos romper con lo establecido. Aprender lo que antes nos parecía un misterio y superar nuestros miedos es lo que nos ayuda a crecer. Por eso puntualizo que cuando deseamos aprender algo que creas que es imposible realizarlo, únicamente necesitamos ser constantes y pacientes para lograrlo y tener éxitos y que la verdadera magia no radica en el resultado, sino en la valentía de haber dado el primer paso. Así que amigos, dígame ustedes que cosas consideran imposible en su vida? Hasta la próxima!
![1000307589.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wX7nwQE9fopyqoVUJ7MirTK2HkiYU5iYYHuEvyEvtmu43GH6rYm8m8aZguJGuEhqoB9.jpg) ![1000272098.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tvePFN1AcKxnt9swtgmnVmGQQiRiKYWm1bYmRkcnqYJe9fFETSBYaQppM9yLUYf1hxV.jpg) ![1000272047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23x14sQR3DWG7cLJEgAgr9BTYGR2Rbqu4zShfbSUbmaoEuvzmBPzXEpxcTrR8HZjWtUe4.jpg)
--- ># ENGLISH ---- >Hello, friends of this community. Once again, our friend @angelica7 invites us to join this Tuesday’s **Talent Gathering**, with a theme that helps us reflect on hope: **the magic of what’s possible**. Sometimes I say I wish I had a magic wand so I could make my wishes come true right away. >But I know we can’t get our hands on that magic wand, and besides, we don’t need it to make our wishes come true or to turn the impossible into the possible. All we need is patience to learn a few things or something new—not with fear, but with courage and the confidence that we’ll succeed. Because that’s what we need to keep moving forward despite the ups and downs and to find the magic that motivates us to keep going. >So making the impossible possible is a challenge we must face, no matter how old we are. Let me tell you, friends, that when I first started out in the world of computers and networks, everything seemed very strange to me. I was very afraid, to the point of thinking it was impossible to succeed. I was 42 years old at the time and really didn’t know how to use the machine. I was even afraid of the mouse; it was very difficult for me. >But I was fortunate to have a great teacher by my side—my son. He had the patience to help me and gave me the courage I needed to face that challenge and overcome my fear. So today, I know how to use any computer or laptop and work on it calmly without fear; in fact, I’ve even taught a few people how to use one. >We all have a personal achievement in our lives that we’re immensely proud of—a goal that once seemed crazy, a distant dream, or something impossible. Yet, through perseverance, we managed to achieve it. That’s why we must break the mold. Learning what once seemed like a mystery and overcoming our fears is what helps us grow. >That’s why I want to emphasize that when we want to learn something we think is impossible to achieve, all we need is perseverance and patience to succeed—and that the real magic lies not in the result, but in the courage to take that first step. So, friends, tell me: what do you consider impossible in your lives? See you next time!

body.title: Land by Maggie O'Farrell || \
|| [Book Review]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNxjJygKBBjreNhLbtKVLbMSA9xuGZHyLSTkadrTkUKSq/1780440113952.jpg)

When I finished this book, I just sat there. Genuinely couldn't move for a few minutes and I need you to understand why.

The book opens in 1865, on the famine-scarred west coast of Ireland, in the stunned aftermath of the Great Hunger. Towns have shriveled, villages have emptied, rows of empty cottages have succumbed to rot and into this wreckage, O'Farrell places two figures — a man and his ten-year-old son, walking through what remains of their world, working for the very people responsible for its destruction. Tomás and his dutiful son Liam are working for the British army, part of the enormous Ordnance Survey to map and further subjugate — Ireland.  A man helping the colonisers catalogue the country they broke. The moral complexity of that single detail floored me from the first chapter. He knows what he is doing , he does it anyway, because having survived the famine that took every member of his family, he knows the importance of steady work, the necessity of submission. That sentence. I've read it four times and it still wrecks me.

Land is inspired by O'Farrell's own great-great-grandfather, who according to family lore helped create the first ordnance maps of Ireland.  So this is personal. This is a woman digging into her own bloodline and asking who were these people? What did they carry? What did they survive? And what did surviving cost them?

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbtRiXNV8okcHUesFKJZgk2UZrs6wrt5gCFG7WSREVD5d/1780440196786.jpg)

Then the book does something extraordinary. Stomping into a copse to retrieve Liam's lost boot, Tomás stumbles upon a small coin of water surrounded by curling ferns — a spring, a faerie well, a vernal pool, or a portal through time and whatever happens to him in those trees is not explained. O'Farrell doesn't hand you an answer. Whatever Tomás saw, he emerges a wild-haired man-creature, barely recognisable to his frightened son. The stony surveyor once willing to do the redcoats' bidding is now whooping and cackling with a crown of woven leaves around his head. \

I stopped breathing for a moment at that scene ( not for too long tho 😁). Because you feel it not as magic, but as rupture. As what happens to a person when something buried inside them suddenly breaks the surface. Some wound, some truth, some ancient knowing the careful, obedient man had been sitting on top of for years.

Having drunk the dark water from a granite bowl in the copse, Tomás peremptorily moves his family from their home in town to a dilapidated cottage near the pool, setting their lives off-course — or maybe on-course, because who is to say they were not destined to end up exactly where they did and his wife Phina. Oh, Phina! Their harrowing and astonishingly romantic courtship is shown in a flashback, and it clearly tells you that she'll follow him anywhere but her alarm at what her husband has become this new wildness, this refusal to draw the redcoats' maps anymore is written with such tenderness and such exhaustion. She loves him but she is also terrified of what the land has done to him.


With the propulsive energy her fans know well, O'Farrell tunnels into the lives of Tomás and Phina's four children drawn to music, the church, labour, and the land. As different as the points of a compass that will someday take them away. This is the Irish diaspora writ small but powerfully, the dispersion of a single family in the most unlikely ways.  Each child carries a different piece of the parents' grief without knowing where it came from. That is the book's central theme  generational trauma and how the losses suffered by parents echo in the lives of their children, even when those children have no idea what their parents endured.  How pain travels, how it hides inside bodies and decisions and silences and then shows up three generations later in someone who has no name for what they're carrying.

The story sometimes flies into other timelines, past and future and in the most historically distant section, we see the lives of ancient people who sacrificed their loved ones, seeding this land with passions that still seep up through the boggy soil.  At one point O'Farrell switches to a bird's perspective for several pages, and it shouldn't work — and yet it does, completely. The land itself becomes a character. The soil remembers everything that has ever been buried in it.

A visceral and magical story about separation, and our complex relationship with the world beyond words, that description is accurate but somehow still undersells it because Land is ultimately about what it costs to survive when everything around you has been taken. What you owe the dead, what you carry forward, what you finally let go of when you stop long enough to drink from the right water.

body.title: Is today a waste?
body.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![Is today a waste?](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/b5ab493a-ed57-4696-9049-20b8b02ca33d.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/66TgWEK7EkhhVWCEZy7bKt) 
 
 *Today Was Just One Big Waste*

Today was actually dramatic. I woke up with plans in my head. First class was 9am and supposed to run 2 hours, end by 11am. But the class wasn’t giving at all. Lecturer talked for like 30 minutes then it just died. We closed a few minutes past 10am instead. I told myself okay, at least I still have my next class to make the day make sense.

But that one got cancelled too. Same story with the other one after it. Cancelled, cancelled. Every time I checked my timetable thinking “maybe this next one will hold,” it was just dead. By the time afternoon came, only my departmental lecture was left. That’s the one class I actually look forward to, the one that matters for my course. I got there ready, but they didn’t allow me to attend. Just stood there while everyone else went in. 

That’s what annoyed me today. Not small annoyance. Damn annoying. I woke up early, got ready, sat through dead lectures, and still ended up locked out of the only class that counts. They made my whole day feel useless. No learning, no progress, just moving from one cancelled class to another. Walking home felt empty. 
 ***

body.title: Pólvora prestada
body.body:
Fácil es sentarse en la tribuna,
con manos limpias de polvo y grieta,
y desde esa altura que no cuesta,
señalar la paja en la ojera ajena.

Más el banquillo suele tener dos plazas
y a veces el juez termina esposado,
con las esas cadenas que forjaba,
mientras el otro reía a su lado.

El olor a pólvora que celebras
no arde igual en la herida del que no tiene nada.
Tu pólvora es fiesta, 
la de otros una fiera que devora sueños.

Piensas por todos, armando sus certezas,
les prestas tus muertos, tu épica prestada.
Pero el hambre no entiende de gestas perfectas,
pide pan, no epitafios, y tú hueles balas.

Baja del cadalso dorado,
mójate los pies en este barro.
Porque todos llevamos un lado
de lo que condenas con tanto denuedo.
