body.title: Labrando los deseos // Shaping desires
body.body:
>

¿Mi primer deseo? El llegar a ser el hombre más poderoso de todo el universo y salvar al mundo y a mis amigos. Se podría decir que es algo bastante razonable para un niño quien se inspira en uno de sus superhéroes favoritos y a quien obviamente desea imitar. Entre juegos y juguetes todo aquello se alimentaba con ilusión y emoción, pero aún siendo niño de manera inconsciente entendía que ciertas cosas eran casi imposible de creer, y por eso cedía a un deseo que me permitiera alimentar mi imaginación y pensar en que algún día me convertiría en todo un superhéroe. Y así, lo que en un momento era un deseo anhelado hoy lo atesoro como un recuerdo envuelto en mis recuerdos como un valioso regalo. Normalmente las personas relacionan los deseos bajo un concepto de \

, pero ante la expectativa que nos lleva a desear algo, lo posible no encaja o carece de sentido porque eventualmente el deseo apunta hacia algo más difícil o imposible de obtener. Si algo es posible, no hay razón para necesitar un deseo por eso. Sírvase el ejemplo que podemos encontrar cuando le preguntamos a un niño sobre lo que desea, ya que en sus respuestas encontraremos una perspectiva en cuanto a la imaginación como la que ahora no llegamos a considerar. Aún sin ser algo demasiado difícil, notarás que es algo que el niño está pidiendo porque entiende perfectamente que aquello ya no está a su alcance. 

>My first wish? To become the most powerful man in the entire universe and save the world and my friends. You could say that’s quite reasonable for a child who is inspired by one of his favourite superheroes and whom he obviously wants to emulate. Amidst games and toys, all of that was fuelled by excitement and enthusiasm, but even as a child I unconsciously understood that certain things were almost impossible to believe, and so I gave in to a wish that allowed me to feed my imagination and think that one day I would become a real superhero. And so, what was once a longed-for wish I now treasure as a memory wrapped up in my recollections like a precious gift.

>People usually associate desires with the idea of something being ‘achievable, possible’; yet, when it comes to the expectation that leads us to desire something, the concept of ‘possible’ does not fit or makes no sense, because ultimately the desire points towards something more difficult or impossible to obtain. If something is possible, there is no reason to desire it. Take, for example, what we find when we ask a child what they want, as in their answers we will find a perspective on imagination that we do not currently consider. Even if it is not something too difficult, you will notice that it is something the child is asking for because they understand perfectly well that it is no longer within their reach. 

![IMG_20260531_172426_970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cajiro/EnaZMikLkfYEumrHhmULfnb1EikGc4UP5jKWGWj6fjy53GWudi2WQvKBuQLCKiPGGMx.jpg)

\

. Desde mi punto de vista, no llega a ser tan verdadero. Y eso es algo que a mí hermano le costó aceptar de niño al ver que su deseo de ser invisible no se hacía realidad, o como en el caso de una amiga quien ya de grande me comentó la forma en la que entendió que su deseo y anhelo de volar jamás se harían realidad: lanzándose por una ventana y entendiendo que lo que si es real y existe es una ley natural que la llevó a experimentar una caída nada grata. ¿Lección? Hasta los deseos más sinceros y nobles necesitan de un fundamento, algo que ya no depende de nosotros sino de lo que está establecido y que por ende nos debe llevar a reflexionar en la clase de deseos a los que apuntamos para alcanzar con verdadero éxito.

Es aquí donde ya empiezo a entender de que, más allá de una petición deliberada, el deseo se convierte en una fuerza y una motivación que podemos cultivar hacia metas confiables y realistas. No se trata de caer en el debate de lo posible y lo imposible, sino que llegamos a centrarnos en la capacidad y en lo que podemos desarrollar desde la clase de personas que somos. Los verdaderos deseos no rayan en el misterio o la ficción, sino que de manera clara y razonable nos guían hacia lo que podemos llegar en base a nuestros esfuerzos y aportes que están al alcance de nuestra mano. No añoramos lo que no tenemos para realizar algo, sino que nos centramos en lo que si tenemos para llegar a una meta ajustada a nuestras virtudes y disposición.

>\

In my view, that isn’t entirely true. And that is something my brother struggled to accept as a child when he saw that his wish to be invisible did not come true, or as in the case of a friend who, as an adult, told me how she came to understand that her wish and longing to fly would never come true: by throwing herself out of a window and realising that what is real and does exist is a law of nature that led her to experience a most unpleasant fall. The lesson? Even the most sincere and noble desires need a foundation, something that no longer depends on us but on what is established, and which must therefore lead us to reflect on the kind of desires we aim for in order to achieve true success.

>It is here that I begin to understand that, beyond a deliberate request, desire becomes a force and a motivation that we can nurture towards reliable and realistic goals. It is not a question of getting caught up in the debate between what is possible and what is impossible, but rather of focusing on our capabilities and on what we can achieve based on the kind of people we are. True desires do not border on mystery or fiction, but rather, in a clear and reasonable way, guide us towards what we can achieve based on our efforts and contributions that are within our reach. We do not yearn for what we lack in order to achieve something, but rather we focus on what we do have to reach a goal suited to our strengths and disposition. 

![IMG_20260330_110946_908.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cajiro/Eq9VmWv9TaepLZA5X3vBTGe3KCYRkzeWt849xXmSmMoYZv5oze2PnDyZjgCfRxnH2Za.jpg)

En la película basada en la obra literaria \

(2010), la misma Alicia habla de algo que ella hace todos las mañanas para empezar el día: pensar en 6 imposibilidades. ¿Y qué tiene que ver esto con los deseos? Ella no lo hacía para desear que fueran posibles, sino que eso le alimentaba la actitud y el carácter para afrontar situaciones reales en su vida. Estando en el país de las maravillas, Alicia comprende que al ver cosas imposibles tomar vida y protagonismo en dicho mundo, también puede lograr que en el mundo real lo posible pueda llegar a materializarse a través de sus acciones. Tal como la protagonista encuentra el verdadero norte de su vida, así el mensaje es claro con respecto a la idea de luchar por aquello que deseas hacer realidad, tal como también quieres verla plasmada en la vida de alguien más. \n\nDeseamos un mundo mejor. ¿Qué estamos haciendo en armonía con eso? Deseamos un cambio en nuestra vida. ¿Estamos poniendo manos a la obra para lograrlo? Incluso al compartir algo como \

, nos damos cuenta que siempre habrá algo en nosotros para que seamos partícipes de nuestras palabras. Una vida llena de deseos no es un mundo imaginario como el de Alicia, ya que la verdadera maravilla es saber que lo posible es lo que nos permite avanzar sin temor y dando lo mejor que hay en cada uno de nosotros. ¿Cuántos deseos necesitarías cumplir para descubrir la gran persona que eres? Aunque pudieras desear la mejor respuesta, tal vez una interrogante abierta sea la mejor excusa para seguir adelante. >In the film based on the novel *Alice in Wonderland* (2010), Alice herself talks about something she does every morning to start the day: thinking of six impossibilities. And what does this have to do with wishes? She didn’t do it to wish they were possible, but rather because it nurtured the attitude and character she needed to face real-life situations. Whilst in Wonderland, Alice realises that by seeing impossible things come to life and take centre stage in that world, she can also make the possible in the real world come to fruition through her actions. Just as the protagonist finds the true purpose of her life, so the message is clear regarding the idea of fighting for what you wish to make a reality, just as you would also like to see it realised in someone else’s life. >We long for a better world. What are we doing to bring that about? We long for change in our lives. Are we taking action to make it happen? Even when we say something as simple as ‘Have a lovely day’, we realise that there will always be something within us that makes us live up to our words. A life full of wishes is not an imaginary world like Alice’s, for the true wonder lies in knowing that what is possible is what allows us to move forward without fear, bringing out the best in each of us. How many wishes would you need to fulfil to discover the wonderful person you are? Although you might wish for the best answer, perhaps an open question is the best excuse to keep moving forward. ![IMG-20260322-WA0016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cajiro/244KENmoBFW3UUsYy1WiuWxABDhQi9UoENdGaPsBbBsdj14rM9kmPWhQsiz62ctcFyx8d.jpg) --- Todas las fotos son de mi propiedad // All the photos are my own. --- ***Gracias por darle valor a esta publicación con tu tiempo y atención.*** ***Hasta pronto.*** --- >***Thank you for taking the time to read this post.*** >***See you soon.***

body.title: [ENG - ESP] Soupy Delicious Paprika Beans For Rainy Day🥙
body.body:
## Greetings dear hivers and community 😍💕.

![5BA3E982-1C7F-4345-8351-456A326FED79.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKtVAbJ7eBQS3kUjAoNGj2Yk9FbhY5r3wThkYLGXYdxHWBbKu6pLUXewGksLJr2.jpeg)

![87829B48-3844-4683-AF19-500F42286A4E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2458XEjATRmNbgLTwcFEEdnnRKLGe2RCLxDXGZ8HKjhUJtmoCTwWQuQwgZ3Ypk94DyX1T.jpeg)

![F75DD232-9418-4880-8C86-97C277EC77CF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244ACyTsuG4rcwF4CPtf5axs5UESLdt3hQS8erYMWKo4dWXn5nFKwwHq42bZMT4kA3YUx.jpeg)

Today I will share a soupy delicious paprika beans I made for lunch this afternoon as it has  continued to rain for weeks now  with some chill weather. Although, it does give a day or two before it bounces back with breezy , windy atmosphere, but it has been quite a season of its own.

And as the rain ☔️ came pouring this afternoon, I thought 💭 something warm to prepare that will suit the weather, then this recipe came to mind. A bowl 🍲 of hot soupy beans that is nicely prepared with some fresh pepper 🌶, tomatoes 🍅, chili 🌶 powder, tomato paste and red palm 🌴kernel oil for that soupy finishing.

Its indeed a lunch nothing can replace with this kind of weather in place due to the hotness it will brings to the whole body. And mildly spicy to help the throat clear any build  up cold 🥶 that can lead to flu 😷. 

![6022E3CC-3417-4518-BC73-D17444F1A1C2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2432WfLX9ReWQhqJwu2P7YgaBEZKEfkqV5a1CqmA2Rym4YwP7GzTJ6Cr7FmozD5m4WcKj.jpeg)

Simple and quick once you have your beans already picked and clean. And another good thing here, is that you don’t need to much of ingredients for this recipe since beans is already nutritional and nourishing to the body. Replacing many of the proteins we miss out on. So, skip all other soup you may want to make on a rainy ☔️🌴afternoon and try this recipe out.

Here below are detailed step by step procedure for this body warming soupy beans lunch 🥙.

## INGREDIENTS:

![CBFEA203-317B-4968-AD34-7DA23F4FAEF0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMajcY2Uogc9ETMT3f8uyXBCRwa9U95MdyXUKdudEYJELpBKQon9SrybxTEZVjwN8rv.jpeg)

2 cups of brown beans (4 Servings)
2 tablespoons of tomatoes paste
2 seed cherry tomatoes 
4 fresh peppers
3/4 teaspoon of chili 🌶 powder 
3/4 teaspoon of salt to taste 
10 ml cap of red palm kernel oil
2 seasoning cubes 

## STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![3B36655B-AB22-4D64-97E5-BD4F20F9723C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245wYnTw1MAYWtLjn2LUSKvh9n3B11MXMbPuheH3iYvqMRo99qKX1Wt1xJwawnqKZSYdB.jpeg)

![B8CBC35F-D6AD-4414-86B2-85384AC0B90B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALD9FB2BqVBLx9VikWmjhpKv1MtSEaWYqjTkZ9sds6ddNuWY26qjknDm1iQ8emK.jpeg)

We start by taking the beans into the pot here above. 

![E925AEBA-D3C1-450A-A02C-C4C428E04A19.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALQcD2rEPULrJWdEVoJLxQpjS6FM7TvmLwSwrg9RbHXEu78V3fttzqhX7mc4FaS.jpeg)

Then set it on the cooker to par boil to release gas we pour away 

Step 2.

![36C19241-C718-4FD0-9316-9FB75A14446F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tv8huYGTcAwfvf2p2HADBUSwYFekNjc81JCdmm6QVtgk2VpG87PfM1hXXNTc4oobEwd.jpeg)

![EAE6DD9C-F196-4C67-A2B7-20A71298547C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tmBQ5KnHgL9A7FMdkYnGPJTGPNQBwdTKfFs5ZYj8UrEmzAousmxzNRrwy37mi1KaWWC.jpeg)

Once the beans boils for about five minutes, we pour and drain the water away. 

Step 3.

![A639347F-1D77-4DD1-B5BD-74514E614881.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALBhRMAEwcw9P9AdRmNDce6w76i4Dssm5jMEdyr6QrhuBTDPSBKC7yNX7QyuepB.jpeg)

We add fresh water into the beans for final cooking above. 

![E4E4D7FC-E9C3-43EB-84B3-D1866E099C3A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL4YBoqh3ieUXfna4dbfCj8fGQHvvvN7AQXwJ3CRe2jC5UM8SW65robaB8JuYsb.jpeg)

![6260183A-306F-462E-A12C-081999AF2856.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uaXpbnMESFgxueLEFQp8UpcB3nE9hUtmu6nLNtvnUJszXsdnNGeYpPZ8QEq2LEHxkAf.jpeg)

And slice the tomatoes and fresh peppers readily.

Step 4.

![F8389711-A7A1-4A67-BC26-AB0C6078259E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK9PZaJUs2CaCj9FFRLzKjNdX7YcNGedYys9HB5xVQkV6j6yhegPo4YAMPkhhGk.jpeg)

![1F41EF97-1017-4389-971F-8011054B9696.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tbnc6kQfk2DHo2dUtJ6KeYzERk7jHBJKyFomx4Mb6cjRXFuFWN7vsVhafsUrRVjnV3h.jpeg)

Once the beans cooks half way, we add the salt, the sliced tomatoes 🍅 and fresh peppers. Stir and cover to cook on.

![84BAFA18-AC92-47C9-932E-7EE86B383D5F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJmrjkB9Jyu9jQm1K9pzHJKa3m4UKaYsEuvmR55Uyym2eEekGUHhpxM2EHnzHp5.jpeg)

In another 20 minutes, we add the tomatoes paste, chili powder and the seasoning cubes.

Step 5.

![A7D15DC8-1148-40A8-8944-7722C179EA83.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2DQY9vRLTJhWXQo7Y4n5oHazgjp6Uq37xbM71GGBKdUv6nA5XxZzG9n6pzwZb.jpeg)

![4E7B7F59-B891-42D8-A3E4-0A494D6CA26C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWvt2G4okq177SgMjVZ4YuqhMBhxjNAEf9a6GJGBfjndP14TQff2ownLhXihdB3dB5M.jpeg)

When it’s finally tender and cooked, we add the red palm 🌴kernel oil. Stir to incorporate them thoroughly.

![416D5FAD-8004-44A0-9742-3B1D0133CD87.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244KT7fUth9RhAQUiZgb4aJqLSPS5ELrkMWuSyNKod5Uj11VkzZaA54Uxtfao5vcf2CcL.jpeg)

As here above .

Step 6.

![15DF0C33-EF57-49A9-A573-DEF51EDDF37E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244Ut1HYusmfBEi7wRcbsg6WhpQf5CW4C5ULSDNHpR2BXsdCwXirTroitwZCPqenNX3M3.jpeg)

We allow the soupy beans to cook for another three (3) minutes and lower heat. Serve immediately.

![96AE1B41-250A-44A5-A0DF-E6BFE92D8931.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244eMFkwocTuE86tZXTtEw9JeCccwaH31pLb19gHmBdbp66BmY2Neg3oEBuMCv1mqkBEX.jpeg)

Make it soupy and delicious that you will really like to scoop every soup without putting the bowl 🥣 down. And the best idea is to enjoy the soup very hot to serve as a heat -up , warming the body with every scoop.

![C4993CEE-6F37-4A9E-8D54-CD043F8AD500.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243zpUbibuogYXivnXPuqxeCUX72d9ut11Nd3YhmyKGAYBDLNBf8AFhVtTcjMCZnpPtTb.jpeg)

I don’t know for those who does not see beams as a regular meal 🥘, but for me , its one nourishing meal I enjoy every now and then especially as it replaces other proteins I may lack from time to time and replenishes the skin while keeping you light at all times. 

Thank you for coming with me through this recipe friends 😍. Sending you hugs 🤗 and blessings 😇

## Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

Images are mine.

![095A7D08-7392-4F32-894C-E157F82A0443.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMwo9dpnWRR6a5qCdw8UPgbcTmU3uyb1RSZx1SzchJyqsdt3XBQwAvLaRCVfYtYN4U5.jpeg)

## Espanol Version

## Hola, queridos hivers y comunidad 😍💕.

![5BA3E982-1C7F-4345-8351-456A326FED79.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKtVAbJ7eBQS3kUjAoNGj2Yk9FbhY5r3wThkYLGXYdxHWBbKu6pLUXewGksLJr2.jpeg)

![87829B48-3844-4683-AF19-500F42286A4E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2458XEjATRmNbgLTwcFEEdnnRKLGe2RCLxDXGZ8HKjhUJtmoCTwWQuQwgZ3Ypk94DyX1T.jpeg)

![F75DD232-9418-4880-8C86-97C277EC77CF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244ACyTsuG4rcwF4CPtf5axs5UESLdt3hQS8erYMWKo4dWXn5nFKwwHq42bZMT4kA3YUx.jpeg)

Hoy voy a compartir una deliciosa receta de alubias al pimentón con caldo que he preparado para comer esta tarde, ya que lleva semanas lloviendo sin parar y hace bastante frío. Aunque suele pasar un día o dos antes de que vuelva el tiempo ventoso y fresco, esta temporada ha sido bastante peculiar.

Y mientras la lluvia ☔️ caía a cántaros esta tarde, pensé 💭 en preparar algo caliente que se adaptara al tiempo, y entonces me vino a la mente esta receta. Un plato 🍲 de frijoles calientes en caldo, bien preparados con pimiento fresco 🌶, tomates 🍅, chile 🌶 en polvo, concentrado de tomate y aceite de palmiste 🌴 para darle ese toque final cremoso.

Es, sin duda, un almuerzo insustituible con este tiempo, ya que aporta calor a todo el cuerpo. Y es ligeramente picante, lo que ayuda a despejar la garganta de cualquier resfriado 🥶 que pueda derivar en gripe 😷.

![6022E3CC-3417-4518-BC73-D17444F1A1C2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2432WfLX9ReWQhqJwu2P7YgaBEZKEfkqV5a1CqmA2Rym4YwP7GzTJ6Cr7FmozD5m4WcKj.jpeg)

Es una receta sencilla y rápida, siempre y cuando ya tengas las judías seleccionadas y limpias. Y otra ventaja es que no necesitas muchos ingredientes, ya que las judías son muy nutritivas y beneficiosas para el organismo, y nos aportan muchas de las proteínas que nos faltan. Así que olvídate de cualquier otra sopa que se te ocurra preparar en una tarde lluviosa ☔️🌴 y prueba esta receta.

A continuación te ofrecemos el procedimiento detallado paso a paso para preparar este almuerzo de frijoles calientes 🥙.

## INGREDIENTES:

![CBFEA203-317B-4968-AD34-7DA23F4FAEF0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMajcY2Uogc9ETMT3f8uyXBCRwa9U95MdyXUKdudEYJELpBKQon9SrybxTEZVjwN8rv.jpeg)

2 tazas de alubias marrones (4 raciones)
2 cucharadas de concentrado de tomate
2 tomates cherry sin semillas
4 pimientos frescos
3/4 de cucharadita de chile 🌶 en polvo
3/4 de cucharadita de sal, al gusto
10 ml de aceite de palmiste rojo
2 cubitos de caldo

## PASOS PARA LA PREPARACIÓN:

Paso 1.

![3B36655B-AB22-4D64-97E5-BD4F20F9723C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245wYnTw1MAYWtLjn2LUSKvh9n3B11MXMbPuheH3iYvqMRo99qKX1Wt1xJwawnqKZSYdB.jpeg)

![B8CBC35F-D6AD-4414-86B2-85384AC0B90B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALD9FB2BqVBLx9VikWmjhpKv1MtSEaWYqjTkZ9sds6ddNuWY26qjknDm1iQ8emK.jpeg)

Empezamos echando los frijoles en la olla que se ve aquí arriba. 

![E925AEBA-D3C1-450A-A02C-C4C428E04A19.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALQcD2rEPULrJWdEVoJLxQpjS6FM7TvmLwSwrg9RbHXEu78V3fttzqhX7mc4FaS.jpeg)

A continuación, lo ponemos en la olla para hervirlo un poco y que suelte el gas, y luego lo escurrimos

Paso 2.

![36C19241-C718-4FD0-9316-9FB75A14446F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tv8huYGTcAwfvf2p2HADBUSwYFekNjc81JCdmm6QVtgk2VpG87PfM1hXXNTc4oobEwd.jpeg)

![EAE6DD9C-F196-4C67-A2B7-20A71298547C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tmBQ5KnHgL9A7FMdkYnGPJTGPNQBwdTKfFs5ZYj8UrEmzAousmxzNRrwy37mi1KaWWC.jpeg)

Cuando los frijoles hayan hervido durante unos cinco minutos, los escurrimos y tiramos el agua. 

Paso 3.

![A639347F-1D77-4DD1-B5BD-74514E614881.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/ALBhRMAEwcw9P9AdRmNDce6w76i4Dssm5jMEdyr6QrhuBTDPSBKC7yNX7QyuepB.jpeg)

Añadimos agua fresca a los frijoles para la cocción final, como se muestra arriba. 

![E4E4D7FC-E9C3-43EB-84B3-D1866E099C3A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL4YBoqh3ieUXfna4dbfCj8fGQHvvvN7AQXwJ3CRe2jC5UM8SW65robaB8JuYsb.jpeg)

![6260183A-306F-462E-A12C-081999AF2856.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uaXpbnMESFgxueLEFQp8UpcB3nE9hUtmu6nLNtvnUJszXsdnNGeYpPZ8QEq2LEHxkAf.jpeg)

Y corta los tomates y los pimientos frescos sin pensarlo dos veces.

Paso 4.

![F8389711-A7A1-4A67-BC26-AB0C6078259E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK9PZaJUs2CaCj9FFRLzKjNdX7YcNGedYys9HB5xVQkV6j6yhegPo4YAMPkhhGk.jpeg)

![1F41EF97-1017-4389-971F-8011054B9696.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tbnc6kQfk2DHo2dUtJ6KeYzERk7jHBJKyFomx4Mb6cjRXFuFWN7vsVhafsUrRVjnV3h.jpeg)

Cuando las alubias estén medio cocidas, añadimos la sal, los tomates cortados en rodajas 🍅 y los pimientos frescos. Removemos y tapamos para que se sigan cocinando.


![84BAFA18-AC92-47C9-932E-7EE86B383D5F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJmrjkB9Jyu9jQm1K9pzHJKa3m4UKaYsEuvmR55Uyym2eEekGUHhpxM2EHnzHp5.jpeg)

Pasados otros 20 minutos, añadimos el concentrado de tomate, el chile en polvo y los cubitos de condimento.

Paso 5.

![A7D15DC8-1148-40A8-8944-7722C179EA83.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK2DQY9vRLTJhWXQo7Y4n5oHazgjp6Uq37xbM71GGBKdUv6nA5XxZzG9n6pzwZb.jpeg)

![4E7B7F59-B891-42D8-A3E4-0A494D6CA26C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWvt2G4okq177SgMjVZ4YuqhMBhxjNAEf9a6GJGBfjndP14TQff2ownLhXihdB3dB5M.jpeg)

Cuando por fin esté tierno y cocido, añadimos el aceite de palmiste 🌴. Remueve para mezclarlo bien.

![416D5FAD-8004-44A0-9742-3B1D0133CD87.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244KT7fUth9RhAQUiZgb4aJqLSPS5ELrkMWuSyNKod5Uj11VkzZaA54Uxtfao5vcf2CcL.jpeg)

Como se ha indicado anteriormente.

Paso 6.

![15DF0C33-EF57-49A9-A573-DEF51EDDF37E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244Ut1HYusmfBEi7wRcbsg6WhpQf5CW4C5ULSDNHpR2BXsdCwXirTroitwZCPqenNX3M3.jpeg)

Dejamos que los frijoles se cocinen en su propio jugo durante otros tres (3) minutos y bajamos el fuego. Servimos inmediatamente.

![96AE1B41-250A-44A5-A0DF-E6BFE92D8931.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244eMFkwocTuE86tZXTtEw9JeCccwaH31pLb19gHmBdbp66BmY2Neg3oEBuMCv1mqkBEX.jpeg)

Prepárala tan cremosa y deliciosa que te encantará saborear cada cucharada sin poder dejar el plato 🥣. Y lo mejor es disfrutarla bien caliente para que te entre en calor y te reconforte con cada cucharada.

![C4993CEE-6F37-4A9E-8D54-CD043F8AD500.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243zpUbibuogYXivnXPuqxeCUX72d9ut11Nd3YhmyKGAYBDLNBf8AFhVtTcjMCZnpPtTb.jpeg)

No sé qué pensarán quienes no ven las espárragos como una comida habitual 🥘, pero para mí es un plato nutritivo que disfruto de vez en cuando, sobre todo porque me aporta las proteínas que a veces me faltan y nutre la piel, a la vez que te mantiene ligero en todo momento.

Gracias por acompañarme en esta receta, amigos 😍. Os mando un abrazo 🤗 y mis mejores deseos 😇

## Un saludo, @sunshine29 🧡

body.title: Does the School You Attend Really Matter?
body.body: Just this afternoon, I was discussing with my friend, who visited me at home, life after school, the study activities in school those days, and more. From all our analysis , education is great , and we don't only acquire knowledge in school, but we also have the opportunity to meet people with different exposure about life, and by so doing, we keep learning. ![17804390322904042773129391776411.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/48Wh6sXoGBngEHr46wGytC61kEDD5jyD2VsYf7ohNTYdxvGhFEVFTjG7YBPErppk1n.png) When I was growing up, I usually heard people say that the school you attend determines how much you will succeed in life and I thought only students in big schools could succeed in life but then I grew up to see great people from different educational backgrounds, including those that attended public school, which is assumed that only poor parents take their children to. In other words, if you are associating with poor parents' children, you have no future , so many thought back then.lol Well, I think the school we attend matters, but not really that much because learning is the same in different universities. For example, the person that studied medicine and surgery in Ph, will end up having the same knowledge with the person that studied saje course in UNN, but then it's a different environment with a different kind of people we will meet. These people we meet also have different exposure in life and obviously , we will learn a different thing from them a schooling in another school. When I looked back, I can vividly remember that it was only one mark that made me not to study physiotherapy in UNN, so later in life,I found myself in dental school and began my tertiary education journey. Funny enough , I sat down one day to think about the kind of people I would have met in UNN if I had gotten admission over there, but I don't think I have any regret . Where I later found myself , I met great minds from diverse backgrounds whose friendship has shaped me to who I am today . It must be different in another school, but that's just it. Whether I would have been better off in life with a different environmental exposure or not , I don't know, but I am grateful for the people around me today , just praying daily for a better opportunity and a better place and life continues If I have the opportunity to go back in time, I wouldn't change my university , it is not necessary. To me what matters is discovering your purpose in life, ask God to direct your path and remain focused while doing your best. At the end of the day , the school you attended may matter, but does it define your future ? No, your commitment and more will have the overall say This post is in response to the Hive Learners community prompt on the topic titled, **THE SCHOOL YOU GO TO**. body.title: Comprando espacio de Boxeo - Gym Tycoom [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>
 
 
![bxoas.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaVgTz6U6fQXhH4hvQjxQENpFHpqfxCC9SB6yScc9P4de/bxoas.jpg)




Saludos amigo, estamos de vuelta con este gran juego de gimnasio, donde las cosas van marchando de la mejor manera y cada semana qué pasa trato de invertir dinero y tiempo para que así el gimnasio siga avanzando y cada una de las personas que llegan puedan entrenar con la mejor calidad y que se pueda ganar más. Una de las cosas que es importante aquí en este gimnasio de tycoom es poder mejorar las máquinas y por eso las caminadoras estaban en el nivel 250 y las llevamos hasta el nivel 400 siendo la inversión más grande, pero con esas máquinas a ese nivel todo cambiará y será ganancia tras ganancia, donde ahora las máquinas de caminadora cuentan con pantalla y allí las personas pueden registrar sus datos, siendo algo que nada más lo puede encorar en este gimnasio.




>Hi there, friend. We’re back with this great gym game, where things are going really well. Every week, I try to invest money and time so the gym can keep growing, and so everyone who comes in can train with the best equipment and earn more. One of the key things here at this Tycoom gym is upgrading the equipment. That’s why we took the treadmills from level 250 up to level 400—the biggest investment we’ve made— but with those machines at that level, everything will change and it will be profit after profit. Now the treadmills have screens where people can track their data, which is something unique to this gym.

<div class=\

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKzZAV9dDUbwRFEq92bKAJqubXN5c23uUV8VLdEKMXDR/image.png) La cantidad de personas que llega a nuestro gimnasio es muy grande y muchas de esas personas tenían que irse ya cada uno de los espacios que tengo están llenos o muchos de ellos hacían colas para poder usar el espacio. Por eso era momento de hacer una gran inversión y por eso compré un nuevo espacio para el gimnasio, espacio de boxeo siendo algo único y a muchas personas le gusta hacer ese deporte, por eso tenía el dinero y el espacio y tocó hacer esa gran compra. Por ahora no nos dará buenas ganancias, pero lo importante es que las personas sepan que contamos con eso y a medida que vaya creciendo tocar ir mejorando, comprar más sacos de boxeo y por llegar a tener un espacio de mucha calidad. >We get a huge number of people coming to our gym, and many of them had to leave because all of my spaces were full, or they had to wait in line to use the space. That’s why it was time to make a big investment, so I bought a new space for the gym—a boxing area, which is something unique, and many people enjoy that sport. Since I had the money and the space, I had to make that big purchase. For now, it won’t bring in much profit, but the important thing is that people know we have it, and as it grows, we’ll need to keep improving—buying more punching bags and eventually creating a high-quality space.

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfRndcqyRNu2RgKNXZw9SUJuGFSdfL9g8pTPmangmGRLR/image.png) Otras de las cosas que va marchando bien ese el proyecto de poder reclutar y entrenar deportistas élites, a pesar de que por los momentos solo tengo uno, se ha cumplido con cada uno de los parámetros y actividades para que así ellos puedan estar cómodo y seguir trabajando. Donde en este caso me toco asignarle ejercicios de agilidad, algo que es fundamental y una vez que el deportista élite tiene que cumplir en un tiempo establecido para así poder ir mejorando cada detalle y puede llegar a ser uno de los mejores. Mi objetivo es poder conseguir a otro y que ese que llegue ponerle ejercicios de fuerza, pero especialmente de boxeo para que así aprenda y que este gimnasio logre grandes deportistas a futuro. >Another area that’s going well is the project to recruit and train elite athletes. Even though I currently have only one athlete, we’ve met every requirement and carried out all the necessary activities to ensure they feel comfortable and can continue training. In this case, I had to assign him agility exercises, which are essential. Once the elite athlete completes them within a set time, he can improve every detail and eventually become one of the best. My goal is to recruit another athlete and have him do strength training, but especially boxing, so he can learn and this gym can produce great athletes in the future.

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmULhHusVVcd5VoBPmzA57ZYQFABhtFeHyh6on5MhVPPHY/image.png) Con toda esas pequeñas cosas que hemos logrado hacer en el gimnasio se puede notar una gran diferencia desde el día uno hasta este momento, la cual son muchas horas de trabajo, por eso es importante poder pagar esas pequeñas cosas como lo es la imagen de marca, que siempre está activa al igual que la campaña de publicidad en la radio, que a pesar de que el precio sube nos da buenos resultados. Además, las estadísticas han mejorado donde todo está en verde, superando marcas del gameplay pasado y así sucesivamente todo va cambiando de una mejor manera, la cual queda mucho por mejorar, pero seguramente con ese espacio de boxeo marcara la diferencia de aquí en adelante. >With all the small steps we’ve taken at the gym, you can really see a big difference from day one until now—it’s the result of many hours of hard work. That’s why it’s important to invest in those small details, like our brand image, which is always front and center, just like our radio advertising campaign. Even though the cost is going up, it’s still delivering great results. Plus, the stats have improved—everything is in the green—surpassing marks from the previous season, and so on; everything is changing for the better. There’s still a lot of room for improvement, but that boxing space will surely make a difference from here on out.

Creo que quienes optamos más por interactuar y conectar estamos muy pero muy desperdigados. De pronto leyendo tus ideas me asaltó una a mí: ¿Y si creamos una comunidad cuyas reglas condicionen más las interacciones y donde los votos pasen a un segundo plano?

by Khing Addy on Adrians Lifestyle 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/adrianslifestyle [![Physical game on efootball super league](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/817bb170-fe4b-46f1-b2bf-360474a21fa2.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/eZT1PYhpHPpS4YbTYXM97A) 
 
 *Super League - My Reality Check*

I honestly thought Super League on eFootball was all virtual. In my head, I’d just set my squad, choose a coach, pick my tactics, and then sit back while the system runs the match. First half score pops up, halftime comes, then full time result. No control, no pressure. That’s how I played it at first and it felt calm, like managing from the bench.

Then I got matched with Manchester City and everything changed. I’m Arsenal, so it already felt like a derby before kickoff. But this one wasn’t virtual at all. It went physical. I had to play it like a normal match - dribble, pass, shoot, defend, everything. I scored first and got excited, but after that my game just fell apart. My passes kept getting cut off, bad timing every time. I smashed the crossbar more than 4 times because I rushed my shots or didn’t aim right. Every miss annoyed me more.

We ended up 1:1 and I was so frustrated. I should’ve won that game. That match opened my eyes to how Super League really works. Some games are virtual, yeah, but others put you on the pitch and it’s just your skills talking. No system to blame. That draw taught me I need to work on my shooting and passing if I want to compete in the physical ones.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/eZT1PYhpHPpS4YbTYXM97A)

body.title: Alirio Díaz [Esp-Eng]
body.body: > Presentamos la vida y el legado de **Alirio Díaz**, el virtuoso larense que llevó el sentimiento del vals y el merengue venezolano a los escenarios más exigentes de los cinco continentes, convirtiéndose en el sucesor del legendario Andrés Segovia.

> We present the life and legacy of **Alirio Díaz**, the virtuoso from Lara who brought the sentiment of the Venezuelan waltz and merengue to the most demanding stages across five continents, becoming the successor to the legendary Andrés Segovia. --------
[English version below!](#contenido-english)
--------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AKApVxQvTC2G2QqSdT4uthdqPtT7KLxiuVHmM6QuoFDrJQDie9CXVDq3gUaoPQ8.png) # Alirio Díaz: El pulso eterno de la guitarra universal

>\n\nEn el universo de las cuerdas, pocos nombres poseen la resonancia y el prestigio de **Alirio Díaz**. Nacido en 1923 en el caserío de La Candelaria, cerca de Carora, estado Lara, su destino estuvo indisolublemente ligado a la guitarra desde su infancia. Lo que comenzó como un despertar intuitivo y autodidacta en las tierras larenses, pronto se transformó en una búsqueda académica rigurosa que lo llevó a establecerse en Caracas en 1945. Allí, ingresó formalmente a la **Escuela Superior de Música \

**, donde tuvo el privilegio de formarse bajo la guía directa de dos pilares de la cultura nacional: el maestro **Vicente Emilio Sojo**, quien influyó profundamente en su visión conceptual de la música, y **Raúl Borges**, pionero de la cátedra de guitarra en Venezuela. Gracias a su desempeño excepcional, el gobierno venezolano le otorgó una beca para continuar su perfeccionamiento técnico en Europa. Su primera parada fue el **Conservatorio de Madrid**, en España, donde estudió con el célebre maestro **Regino Sainz de la Maza**. En esta prestigiosa institución, **Alirio Díaz** no solo obtuvo su diploma de profesor en tiempo récord, sino que fue galardonado con el **Premio Extraordinario**, un altísimo reconocimiento que vaticinaba su futura proyección global. Sin embargo, su consolidación definitiva llegaría en Italia, al ingresar en la **Academia Musical Chigiana** de Siena. Allí se convirtió en el discípulo predilecto del legendario **Andrés Segovia**, quien eventualmente lo nombró su asistente y sucesor en la titularidad de los cursos de guitarra de dicha academia, un honor reservado para los más grandes virtuosos del instrumento. La técnica de **Alirio Díaz** se caracterizó por una limpieza impecable, una pulsación profunda y una capacidad interpretativa que lograba elevar la música popular venezolana al nivel de la gran literatura guitarrística universal. Sus armonizaciones y transcripciones de valses, merengues y canciones tradicionales permitieron que el mundo entero conociera la riqueza sonora y rítmica de Venezuela. Considerado unánimemente como uno de los mejores guitarristas del mundo, el maestro recorrió los cinco continentes, presentándose en los teatros más exigentes y recibiendo innumerables premios internacionales que consolidaron su estatus de leyenda musical. Más allá de su faceta como concertista de élite, **Alirio Díaz** fue un incansable promotor cultural, investigador y pedagogo. Dedicó gran parte de su vida a la creación de cursos y a la organización de concursos internacionales de guitarra, buscando siempre abrir espacios de desarrollo técnico para las nuevas generaciones de intérpretes venezolanos y extranjeros. Su labor investigativa y su producción bibliográfica también son fundamentales para comprender la evolución del instrumento durante el siglo XX. Tras su fallecimiento en Roma en el año 2016, su legado permanece como un puente eterno entre la tradición popular caroreña y la sofisticación de la academia clásica, reafirmando que su guitarra siempre tendrá un lugar de honor en la historia de la música universal. ------

> 


### Alirio Díaz: The Eternal Pulse of the Universal Guitar

In the universe of strings, few names possess the resonance and prestige of **Alirio Díaz**. Born in 1923 in the hamlet of La Candelaria, near Carora, Lara state, his destiny was inextricably linked to the guitar from his childhood. What began as an intuitive and self-taught awakening in the lands of Lara soon transformed into a rigorous academic pursuit that led him to settle in Caracas in 1945. There, he formally entered the **Escuela Superior de Música \

**, where he had the privilege of training under the direct guidance of two pillars of national culture: maestro **Vicente Emilio Sojo**, who deeply influenced his conceptual vision of music, and **Raúl Borges**, pioneer of the guitar chair in Venezuela. Thanks to his exceptional performance, the Venezuelan government granted him a scholarship to continue his technical refinement in Europe. His first stop was the **Conservatorio de Madrid**, in Spain, where he studied with the celebrated master **Regino Sainz de la Maza**. At this prestigious institution, **Alirio Díaz** not only obtained his professor's diploma in record time but was also awarded the **Premio Extraordinario**, a high recognition that foreshadowed his future global projection. However, his definitive consolidation would come in Italy, upon entering the **Academia Musical Chigiana** in Siena. There he became the favorite disciple of the legendary **Andrés Segovia**, who eventually appointed him his assistant and successor to hold the guitar courses at said academy, an honor reserved for the greatest virtuosos of the instrument. The technique of **Alirio Díaz** was characterized by an impeccable cleanliness, a deep touch, and an interpretive capacity that managed to elevate Venezuelan popular music to the level of the great universal guitar literature. His harmonizations and transcriptions of waltzes, merengues, and traditional songs allowed the entire world to discover the sonic and rhythmic richness of Venezuela. Unanimously considered one of the best guitarists in the world, the master toured all five continents, performing in the most demanding theaters and receiving countless international awards that consolidated his status as a musical legend. Beyond his facet as an elite concert player, **Alirio Díaz** was a tireless cultural promoter, researcher, and educator. He dedicated a large part of his life to creating courses and organizing international guitar competitions, always seeking to open spaces for technical development for new generations of Venezuelan and foreign players. His research work and bibliographic production are also fundamental to understanding the evolution of the instrument during the 20th century. After his passing in Rome in 2016, his legacy remains an eternal bridge between the popular tradition of Carora and the sophistication of classical academia, reaffirming that his guitar will always hold a place of honor in the history of universal music. #

body.title: Más allá de Aladdín: Manifestar y cumplir tus sueños
body.body: >Hola hermosa comunidad, es maravilloso para mi escribir este martes y conectarme con ustedes. De niños nos vendieron la idea en las películas de que los sueños dependían de una lámpara mágica, de un frotar de manos y de un genio azul que resolvía la vida en breves deseos. Pero al crecer, te das cuenta que el mundo no es una máquina de conceder deseos aleatorios. Los estándares altos que siempre he tenido para mi vida, no nacieron de la ingenuidad o de vivir en la pobreza; nacieron de la certeza de que el universo no te da lo que deseas solo por capricho, sino que responde a lo que eres capaz de sostener, estructurar y manifestar. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaXPsSUdb1E6ZE2TDuMKDzArjxANoE6uomqBaddamxSYF/1780436841350.jpg)

>Siempre he mirado la vida a través de un lente de ir más allá de lo evidente o lo explorado. Para mí, los sueños y la curiosidad han sido un terreno en el que me siento insaciable, en donde nada es abstracto, sino proyectos en construcción con la fecha de caducidad, que es la que uno elige para finalizarla, y solo se cumple al sentirte listo para convertirte en esa versión ideal. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSis8C7XxdkqH54Mn3nDnAUiih6r1cZ6erJw6oaARrXoo/1780438131981.jpg)

>Existen muchas técnicas de manifestación: desde la escritura reflexiva en un diario donde dejas todo tu caos mental para darle orden a tus metas, hasta la visualización creativa de esos espacios limpios, luminosos y llenos de paz que aspiras habitar y llamar tu propio hogar. Sin embargo, ninguna técnica funciona si no entendemos que todo lo que emprendemos es una mezcla de psicología y energía. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVRuudnrkPDjvUmDZFRTYqBVQCWZW6nz9iNWZFFLPxAxb/1780436971861.jpg)

>Nuestra mente necesita estructura, pero el espíritu necesita vibrar en la frecuencia correcta y es muy fácil no habitarla y experimentarla. Cuando iniciamos un proyecto, la intención con la que sembramos la primera semilla determina el fruto del futuro. Sin emprendes desde la carencia o el miedo, el camino se vuelve tortuoso o pesado. En cambio, si emprendes desde la convicción de que mereces esos estándares altos, el panorama cambia.

>Aquí entra el dinero. Siendo realistas, el dinero es una energía magnifica, pero es un medio para un fin, no el fin en sí mismo. El dinero otorga la libertad de movimiento, tranquilidad plena de crear sin asfixia y el soporte para que lo posible se materialice en el plano físico. Pero el motor real, el que sostiene el negocio, la marca, la idea o el escrito, es la vibración y el propósito que le inyectas. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdafguqKjwi6QHjVVdr6g3hYgQPqeB54HMkM9rkNP4YHX/1780437050105.jpg)

>Si analizo mi propio camino y lo que dictan las energías que elijo, me doy cuenta que mi existencia en este plano no es casualidad, ni algo al azar, nada es una coincidencia. Actualmente estoy transitando unos meses de transformación interna, que me han llevado a replantearme mis hábitos, pensamientos y creencias desde la infancia. Soy creyente de la numerología y cómo reaccionas ante ello, así que yo estoy viviendo un año 9, un período de cierres, de soltar viejas estructuras y de vivir una especie de noche oscura del alma, donde debí poner límites, a sanar la comunicación desde la raíz (incluso dentro de mi propio hogar de crianza) y a entender que para recibir lo nuevo, sembrar y recibir, primero hay que vaciar los espacios llenos de ruido. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVC3XqvhNH9DNUXdjfZUyuDxFHdUiyMoLkzVcTak5rpuz/1780352367062.jpg)

>Esta transición me ha enseñado que el reino de lo posible, no es un lugar libre de retos, desafíos u obstáculos. Al contrario, es el espacio donde decides transformar el caos en claridad a través de la palabra. Como licenciada en comunicación social y escritora desde hace más de 10 años, he aprendido que el lenguaje es nuestra primera herramienta de manifestación. Cuando escribes tus metas, haces un vision board, emprendes el primer paso para creer, sacas del plano etéreo lo que anhelas y las imprimes a la realidad con tu intención. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVieDNDmsarTNGTTEHUJNKU2ct7fChCTLVuE7rmsZVN26/1780437566799.jpg)

>Entonces sí, creo que los sueños se hacen realidad, pero no por arte de magia. Se cumplen porque te atreves a sostener la mirada a los deseos más ambiciosos, porque educas a tu mente a no autosabotearte y porque cuidas tu energía como el tesoro más preciado, desde compartir tiempo con gente tóxica, a combatir la flojera y la procrastinación. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXELtf8JchxenQM3V2BJt6shv8nLJyXFaTT7vuT8P7Hof/1780437729354.jpg)

>No necesitamos un genio en una lámpara. Hay que tener la valentía de empezar con tomar un papel, un bolígrafo, estructurar la visión y empezar a caminar con la certeza de que todo lo que nuestra mente es capaz de concebir y creer, es capaz de manifestar. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNdC3Vnaq8xPGeP7siGZnKginkiUsqwCKqyv6YahkzWci/1780438226425.jpg)

>Hello, wonderful community! It’s wonderful for me to be writing to you this Tuesday and connecting with you all. As children, movies sold us on the idea that dreams depended on a magic lamp, a rub of the hands, and a blue genie who would solve life’s problems with a few quick wishes. But as we grow up, we realize that the world isn’t a machine that grants random wishes. The high standards I’ve always held for my life didn’t stem from naivety or living in poverty; they arose from the certainty that the universe doesn’t give you what you want on a whim, but rather responds to what you’re capable of sustaining, structuring, and manifesting. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaXPsSUdb1E6ZE2TDuMKDzArjxANoE6uomqBaddamxSYF/1780437146427.jpg)

>I have always viewed life through a lens of going beyond the obvious or the explored. For me, dreams and curiosity have been a realm where I feel insatiable, where nothing is abstract, but rather projects under construction with an expiration date—one you choose to end it—and it is only fulfilled when you feel ready to become that ideal version of yourself. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSis8C7XxdkqH54Mn3nDnAUiih6r1cZ6erJw6oaARrXoo/1780438167294.jpg)

>There are many techniques for manifestation: from reflective journaling—where you pour out all your mental chaos to bring order to your goals—to creatively visualizing those clean, bright, and peaceful spaces you aspire to inhabit and call your own home. However, no technique works if we don’t understand that everything we undertake is a blend of psychology and energy. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVRuudnrkPDjvUmDZFRTYqBVQCWZW6nz9iNWZFFLPxAxb/1780437186201.jpg)

>Our mind needs structure, but the spirit needs to vibrate at the right frequency, and it’s very easy to miss that connection and fail to experience it. When we start a project, the intention with which we plant the first seed determines the future outcome. If you begin from a place of lack or fear, the path becomes tortuous or burdensome. On the other hand, if you begin from the conviction that you deserve those high standards, the outlook changes.\n\n

>This is where money comes in. Realistically speaking, money is a magnificent energy, but it is a means to an end, not the end in itself. Money grants freedom of movement, the peace of mind to create without feeling stifled, and the support for the possible to materialize on the physical plane. But the real engine—the one that sustains the business, the brand, the idea, or the writing—is the vibration and purpose you infuse into it. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdafguqKjwi6QHjVVdr6g3hYgQPqeB54HMkM9rkNP4YHX/1780437525673.jpg)

>When I reflect on my own journey and the energies I choose to follow, I realize that my existence on this plane is neither a coincidence nor a matter of chance—nothing is random. I am currently going through a few months of inner transformation, which has led me to reevaluate my habits, thoughts, and beliefs dating back to childhood. I believe in numerology and how it influences your reactions, so I am currently living through a Year 9—a period of closure, of letting go of old structures, and of experiencing a sort of dark night of the soul. During this time, I’ve had to set boundaries, heal communication at its root (even within my own childhood home), and understand that to receive the new—to sow and reap—one must first clear out the spaces filled with noise. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVC3XqvhNH9DNUXdjfZUyuDxFHdUiyMoLkzVcTak5rpuz/1780437472941.jpg)

>This transition has taught me that the realm of the possible is not a place free of challenges or obstacles. On the contrary, it is the space where you decide to transform chaos into clarity through the word. As a graduate in social communication and a writer for over 10 years, I have learned that language is our primary tool of manifestation. When you write down your goals, create a vision board, or take the first step toward believing, you bring what you long for out of the ethereal plane and imprint it onto reality with your intention. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVieDNDmsarTNGTTEHUJNKU2ct7fChCTLVuE7rmsZVN26/1780437595680.jpg)

>So yes, I believe dreams do come true, but not by magic. They come true because you dare to hold your gaze on your most ambitious desires, because you train your mind not to sabotage yourself, and because you guard your energy like your most precious treasure—from avoiding toxic people to fighting laziness and procrastination. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXELtf8JchxenQM3V2BJt6shv8nLJyXFaTT7vuT8P7Hof/1780437710327.jpg)

>We don’t need a genie in a lamp. We must have the courage to start by taking a piece of paper and a pen, structuring our vision, and setting out with the certainty that everything our mind is capable of conceiving and believing, it is capable of manifesting. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNdC3Vnaq8xPGeP7siGZnKginkiUsqwCKqyv6YahkzWci/1780438245712.jpg)

body.title: Paseo por Cracovia en primavera [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
> ## Español Hola a todos! como les contaba en el post anterior, el domingo Pawel, Olivia y yo fuímos a Cracovia y la pasamos super bien allí, y es que además de comer el delicioso Kebab en el restaurante Polenez, estuvimos caminando por la ciudad que por cierto se ve hermosa en primavera llena de mucho verde y flores, y el clima estaba bastante fresco por lo que era el día perfecto para pasear por allí, pero empecemos desde el principio. El plan de ir a Cracovia se decidió ese mismo día, unos minutos antes de ir allí, y como es una ciudad relativamente cerca de Sosnowiec (a una hora aproximadamente) acordamos ir hasta allá en tren, pues hasta Olivia disfruta de viajar en el mismo y se porta super bien, incluso ella y yo estuvimos leyendo algunos libros que llevamos para que el viaje se hiciera más rápido y cuando nos dimos cuenta ya habíamos llegado. Lo primero que hicimos en Cracovia fue ir a comer el Kebab que como les dije estaba muy sabroso, seguidamente visitamos el barrio Kazimierz que es un lugar que me encanta para ir a tomar algo ya que me parece muy bonito y muy tranquilo, en ese momento Olivia decidió tener su siesta en el cochecito y mi esposo y yo pudimos conversar y tomar una cerveza tranquilamente. Más tarde nos fuímos a pasear por el parque y les cuento que Olivia estaba muy feliz caminando de la mano de papá, y mientras caminabamos por allí vimos otro lugar que ya habíamos visitado antes en el pasado pero no recordabamos donde estaba exactamente ubicado y lo encontramos justo en ese momento por lo que nos quedamos tomando algo más allí para finalmente volver a casa, aquí Olivia ya estaba despierta por lo que estabamos también jugando y hablando con ella, finalmente llegó la hora de volver y les cuento que el viaje de vuelta también se hizo corto por lo que todo estuvo genial, nos encanta hacer viajes de este tipo y disfrutar en familia. ## English Hi, everyone! As I mentioned in my previous post, on Sunday Pawel, Olivia, and I went to Krakow and had a great time there. Not only did we eat delicious kebabs at the Polenez restaurant, but we also walked around the city, which, by the way, looks beautiful in spring, full of greenery and flowers. The weather was quite cool, so it was the perfect day for a stroll, but let’s start from the beginning. We decided to go to Krakow that very same day, just a few minutes before leaving, and since it’s a city relatively close to Sosnowiec (about an hour away), we agreed to take the train there. Even Olivia enjoys riding the train and behaves really well—in fact, she and I were reading some books we’d brought along to make the trip go faster, and before we knew it, we’d already arrived. The first thing we did in Krakow was go eat the kebab, which, as I told you, was very tasty. Next, we visited the Kazimierz neighborhood, which is a place I love to go for a drink because I find it very beautiful and peaceful. At that moment, Olivia decided to take a nap in her stroller, and my husband and I were able to chat and have a beer in peace. Later, we went for a walk in the park, and I’ll tell you, Olivia was so happy walking hand-in-hand with Dad. As we were walking around, we saw another place we’d visited before but couldn’t remember exactly where it was—and we found it right then and there, so we stayed for a little while longer before finally heading home. By then, Olivia was already awake, so we were also playing and talking with her. Finally, it was time to head back, and I’ll tell you, the trip home also flew by, so everything was great. We love taking trips like this and enjoying time as a family.

body.title: No time…
body.body: Afternoon everyone…. I have so much to write about and no time to really get it done. I’m so behind on things I’d like to share. It’s really hard finding the time. Silver is just silver right? Wrong. While technically you are correct, but not all silver is created equally. There are hundreds of mints out there that produce silver. Most produce both bars and rounds, while some produce coins as well. But not all mints are created equally. Some take great pride in their work and produce very high quality silver products. They won’t let subpar products leave their facility. Instead they will melt them back down and use the metal again to produce a piece worthy of their name. There are several that meet this standard of excellence. But today I’m going to focus on just one Mint Geiger Edelmetalle. Geiger Edelmetalle dates back to 1218 when its founders worked to establish the first Silver trade in Germany. It started in Leipzig and was embraced by the rest of the world. Now, Geiger has offices near the grand Schloss Güldengossa castle and houses its production facilities in a nearly abandoned 1930s factory. They now have three facilities, two are in Germany and one is in Switzerland. They have been producing fine silver bars since the mid 1930’s. That standard is still true today. They have a special mint mark to prevent counterfeiting, which was one of the first mints to establish this. If you haven’t realized it by now, I’m a big fan of Geiger products, and own a share of them as well. Today I’m going to share with you a poured bar from them. It’s a 500 gram (which is a half kilo) bar. The bar is in the traditional square style which is my favorite design of theirs. The bar comes wrapped directly from the mint, with an assay certificate for authenticity. **_Here it is…._**

body.body:
Following the route of the city's docks, I arrived at the shipyards, the place where ships are kept for repairs. Ships that once served different purposes and are now here, seeking to return to the sea and build a new future.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXWhRZbqhhoH8yHskWUW2RguqPU8qni3j4pGVdqtcJ3AJ/img_20260524_152450_882.jpg)

Long-lived ships that refuse to be forgotten beneath the salt air and the sun that burns their bones. Ships laden with stories and adventures, with memories built by hundreds of families who left their mark on them as they sailed.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQcV2571zDgo9DphXzniJih7z2Z3Vke7afiFb7wCBWGvY/img_20260524_152458_289.jpg)

Eternal and unforgettable ships.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyamEWDM9uTyc2A5csSdSKThaYcqcnJNGYdrwfCRupqm/img_20260524_152615_782.jpg)

Siguiendo la ruta de los muelles en la ciudad, llegué a los astilleros. lugar donde radican los barcos para ser reparados. Barcos que en su momento tuvieron diferentes funciones y hoy están aquí buscando regresar al mar y construir un nuevo futuro. 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXWhRZbqhhoH8yHskWUW2RguqPU8qni3j4pGVdqtcJ3AJ/img_20260524_152450_882.jpg)

body.title: Baron the beauty of our garden, ( Euthalia aconthea)
body.body: HHello, friends, insect enthusiasts, and fellow community members! I hope you are all well and enjoying quality time with your loved ones. During our stay in India, we have been quite busy, but we still make time to connect with nature, take beach walks, tend to our garden, and visit our wildlife friends, including the insects. One day, while I was sweeping our front yard, a familiar visitor appeared after a long time. It circled around me for a bit before starting to search for a place to settle down. In that moment, I grabbed my camera to take photos of it, and it began posing for me. This lovely insect is the Euthalia aconthea, commonly known as the common baron butterfly. Very simple and very calm. Looking at it, we also felt very calm and peaceful.
>\nThank you for stopping by \nThis post is my small contribution to the #fascinatinginsects community by @jaki01. Thank you, admin.

body.title: NOT AN ALLY
body.body:
So the teacher told us to pick one man for the team, but I was surprised, Mary did not pick me, she picked Fred, I thought we were close friends, I thought we studied together, read together, so when it was time to pick the team for the project, she left me and picked Fred.

I felt very bad, but nevertheless, I never bought that into my mind, because if anything can happen, you can be close to someone, and that person can stitch another person over you, I thought she was a friend, I thought she was someone close to me, but now I knew, she's not an ally, she's not a friend, we were just acquaintances, and I left with her.

I would not allow such a minor issue to bother me, but now I've noticed, I thought I needed more, but that is it, that is life, so life goes on.

body.title: 🥰Haciendo una funda para teléfono con retazos de tela📱.//🥰Making a phone case with fabric scraps📱.(Esp-Eng)
body.body:
>Saludos a todos en este hermoso día,y sean bienvenidos a un nuevo Blog de manualidades,aquí amamos lo hecho a mano, como siempre les vengo a mostrar una de mis ideas,y está vez creo que les va a gustar. Entrando un poco en el contexto,les contaré primero porque fue que se me ocurrió la idea,bueno yo tengo desde hace un tiempo el forro de mi teléfono,pero ya con el tiempo se fue desgastando,y más con el uso que le doy a mi teléfono constantemente,y eso que el forro que compre es el más resistente, porque es de anticaida. Así que mi forro no está en buenas condiciones,la idea ocurrió allí,y entonces así fue que me decidí en hacer una funda con tela,la funda será una buena opción para así tapar el desgaste del forro del teléfono,así como una almohada. Hacer esta funda no es fácil pero eso es lo que les voy a mostrar para que vean como fueron los pasos a seguir,y los materiales que utilice.* # > Greetings everyone on this beautiful day, and welcome to a new crafts blog! Here we love handmade things, and as always, I'm here to show you one of my ideas, which I think you'll like this time. To give you some context, I'll first tell you how I came up with the idea. Well, I've had my phone case for a while, but it's worn out over time, especially with how much I use my phone. And the case I bought is the most durable one, because it's drop-proof. So, my case isn't in great condition. That's when the idea came to me, and that's how I decided to make a fabric cover. The cover will be a good way to hide the worn-out phone case, just like a pillow. Making this cover isn't easy, but that's what I'm going to show you so you can see the steps I followed and the materials I used. ---

I chose purple for the surrounding part and fuchsia for the rest. The fabric is plush, so it will give my phone a cute touch. body.title: Dahab - Between Wind, Sand and the Red Sea
body.body: Dahab, Egypt, February 2026 There are places that stay in your memory because of monuments, famous landmarks or spectacular architecture. Dahab is not one of them. Dahab stays with you because of the wind.

/>
February 2026 brought me for the 1st time to the eastern coast of Egypt, to a place where the mountains of the Sinai Peninsula meet the deep blue waters of the Red Sea. Every morning I would do yoga, healthy breakfast and then climb onto my bicycle, place my camera safely in the bag, and start riding through the dusty outskirts of town. The wind was always there. Sometimes gentle, sometimes relentless. More than once it carried fine desert sand directly into my eyes, forcing me to stop, clean my glasses and continue the ride.

/>
\n\n

/>
The lagoon itself has become famous among windsurfers and kitesurfers. For decades, athletes and adventurers from all over the world have been coming here to take advantage of the steady winds and shallow waters. The colorful kites floating above the sea have become part of Dahab's identity just as much as the mountains surrounding it. From a distance it all looks idyllic. Palm trees, blue water, white boats anchored offshore, and tourists enjoying winter sunshine while much of Europe remains cold and grey. Yet the true soul of the region lies beyond the resorts. One afternoon while cycling outside the main tourist area, I came across several camels grazing in the barren landscape between the sea and the mountains.

/>
For many visitors, camels are simply an exotic attraction. For the people of the desert they have always been something far more important.

/>
For centuries these animals were the foundation of life in Sinai. They transported water, food and goods across vast distances where no vehicle could travel. Entire trade routes depended on them. Even today many Bedouin families continue to rely on camels for transportation, tourism and traditional livelihoods.

/>
Watching them move slowly across the dry terrain, perfectly adapted to conditions that would challenge most other animals, it becomes easy to understand why they earned the reputation as the ships of the desert. The desert itself offers something increasingly rare in our modern world: silence. Not complete silence, because the wind never truly stops, but a silence free from traffic, notifications and urban noise. While riding my bicycle along the dusty roads, I often found myself stopping for no reason other than to listen. The sound of the wind, distant waves from the Red Sea and occasionally the bells hanging from a camel's neck were often the only things breaking the stillness.

/>
\n\n

/>
Unfortunately, not everything I saw was beautiful. One aspect of Egypt that continues to disappoint me is the amount of rubbish scattered across otherwise stunning natural landscapes. Plastic bags, bottles, broken glass and various waste can often be found lying in the desert, along roadsides and even close to beautiful coastal areas. The contrast is frustrating. Nature has created extraordinary scenery here: dramatic mountains, crystal-clear water and endless desert horizons. Yet in many places litter has become a permanent part of the landscape. It is not unique to Dahab, but it is visible enough that visitors cannot ignore it. The irony is that tourism depends heavily on preserving exactly those natural environments. Meanwhile, modern tourism continues to reshape the coast. Large buses arrive daily carrying visitors from resorts. Cruise boats and excursion vessels move across the Red Sea. New hotels and tourist developments continue to appear along the shoreline. Some of this development brings jobs and economic opportunities. At the same time, it creates pressure on fragile ecosystems and gradually changes the character of places that once felt remote and untouched. Still, despite these contradictions, Dahab retains a certain magic. Perhaps it is the endless wind filling the kites above the lagoon. Perhaps it is the contrast between sea and desert. Or perhaps it is simply the feeling of riding a bicycle through a landscape where mountains, camels, windsurfers, tourists and Bedouin traditions all exist side by side. As the afternoon light faded over the Red Sea and the silhouettes of the Sinai mountains grew darker, I packed my camera back into the bag and started cycling towards town. The wind was still blowing. In Dahab, it always is.

/>
If you like my work, you could support me by upvoting, reblogging, commenting, following...
Big thanks for stopping by!

body.title: Subscription: Should it be encourage in all businesses?
body.body:
A subscription is a business model where a customer pays a recurring price at regular intervals (such as weekly, monthly, or annually) to gain continuous access to a product or service.

People with active subscriptions often enjoy certain benefits that regular users may not.

While subscriptions are beneficial to both customers and businesses, not everyone can afford the payments nor needs certain advanced features or benefits. Not every business needs a subscription, especially if such a business does not provide financial, emotional, mental, or intellectual benefits to its customers. If a business like WhatsApp initiates a subscription, just a few or none of the users would bother with the implemented features because they gain no financial benefits.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmef1PkZTRsieqNd6amo6QqN1fqEf1Zru2WVFzT3ypv1NS/1780437891360.png)

**Image gnerated using Gemini AI**

But for growth, money realized from subscriptions would help ensure the smooth running of every business, provided there is something customers benefit from. However, customers benefit more when they subscribe to certain businesses than the business itself benefits. Most money realized from subscriptions is not spent on luxuries; it is put back into the business to ensure smooth operation. When a user subscribes, they serve as a stakeholder—their contribution aids in the growth of the platform or business, but the management also invests funds realized from other sales.

Customers, on the other hand, retain all the profit they realize from using the services provided. While both the customer and the business management play a role in ensuring the survival of the business, users benefit more. No one subscribes to a service where they will gain nothing, yet a business still invests money daily and effort to ensure the business survives.

Mein lieber Freund @der-Prophet bat mich ja um einen kleinen Bericht über unser diesjährige s Pfingsten...Pfingsten im Dörfli bedeutet , es ist Sport und Schützenfest ...in diesem Jahr das 66....!

Ich zum Beispiel begann mit 8...9...Jahren mit der Knicker auf verschiedenen Ziele zu schießen und wenn die Schausteller mit der Schießbude da waren, da entwickelten wir Kids viele Geldintensive Wettbewerbe.

Nun hatten wir das 66. Fest, und es war sehr gut gelungen, obwohl oder wegen dem gesperrten Festsaal ein außergewöhnliches Wochenende

Der 3. große Verein, der heute zur Sportgemeinschaft gehört , ist der Spielmannzug

Tja Pfingsten in Pansfelde bedeutet Tradition , Wettkämpfe im Schießsport und Fußball,  Geselligkeit,  Tanzen , viel Lauferei vom Festplatz zum Sportplatz nach Hause und zurück um Festplatz

Natürlich gehört auch der eine oder ander Krug Bier dazu, essen vom Grill oder aus der Schüssel, und auch mal ein Schnaps...aber wir sind nun in einem Alter wo der Exzess dem Genießen weichen mußte

Von den 66 Jahren bin ich nun seit 46 Jahren dabei, seit 1993 sogar im Festkommitee, und ein Ende ist , nicht geplant, mein Dienst an der Gemeinschaft

body.body:
ماهي الثعلبة 
What is Alopecia Areata?
​ظهور بقعة فارغة تماما من الشعر بشكل مفاجئ في الرأس او اللحية هو ما يعرف بمرض الثعلبة حيث تلاحظ ان الجلد في هذه البقعة يصبح ناعما جدا ودون اثار جروح والسبب وراء ذلك يعود الى تراكم اخلاط ورطوبات سمية كالسوداء المحترقة او بلغم مالح تحت جلد الفروة مباشرة مما يؤدي الى وقف امدادات الغذاء عن بصيلات الشعر فتضعف وتسقط الشعرة في الحال
The sudden appearance of a completely hairless patch on the scalp or beard is known as Alopecia. You will notice that the skin in this circular or oval patch becomes very smooth and free of any signs of wounds. The reason behind this is the accumulation of toxic humors and fluids, such as burnt black bile or salty phlegm, directly under the skin of the scalp. This cuts off the supply of pure nourishment to the hair follicles, causing them to weaken and the hair to fall out instantly.
​ولعلاج هذه المشكلة من الداخل وتنقية الدم من تلك الاخلاط يجب الاعتماد على التمر والعسل والتين والهندباء بالاضافة الى تناول اغذية خفيفة وطازجة مثل مرق لحم الضان الصغير او الدجاج المشوي والمسلوق مع خبز النخالة وشوربة الشعير والفواكه الطازجة وفي المقابل تماما يجب عليك طوال فترة العلاج حظر المأكولات التي تسبب جفاف الجسم كالالبان شديدة الحموضة والاجبان القديمة لانها تزيد البلغم البارد وكذلك الوجبات السريعة والبطاطس المقلية واللحوم المصنعة والمجففة والاسماك المملحة والمخللات لانها تفسد الهضم وتسد مسام الاوعية مما يحرم الفروة من التغذية
To treat this problem from within and purify the blood from these harmful humors, one must rely on dates, honey, figs, and chicory. In addition, consume light, fresh foods such as young lamb broth, or grilled and boiled chicken with bran bread, barley soup, and fresh fruits. Conversely, throughout the treatment period, you must completely avoid foods that cause dryness in the body, such as highly acidic dairy and aged cheeses (like Mish) because they increase cold phlegm. You must also avoid fast food, fried potatoes, processed and dried meats, salted fish, and pickles because they ruin digestion and clog vascular pores, depriving the scalp of proper nutrition.
​اما بخصوص العلاج الموضعي المأثور عن ائمة اهل البيت عليهم السلام فيتم عبر خلط كوب من خل التفاح مع كوب من الحبة السوداء المطحونة للحصول على مزيج يشبه العجين ثم يدهن به مكان الفراغ مع التدليك الخفيف ويترك على الراس لمدة اربع ساعات يوميا دون انقطاع على مدار عشرين يوما متتالية
As for the topical treatment narrated from the Imams of Ahl al-Bayt, peace be upon them, it is done by mixing a cup of apple cider vinegar with a cup of finely ground black seed to obtain a paste-like mixture. Then, apply it to the empty patch with light massaging. Leave it on the head for 4 hours daily without interruption for 20 consecutive days.
​كما توجد طريقة اخرى فعالة للغاية من مجربات الحكيم ابن سينا وتبدا بفتح مسام الفروة عبر غسل الراس يوميا بالماء الدافئ ثم وضع مزيج مكون من ملعقة عسل وملعقة من عصير البصل على المكان المصاب وتدليكه برفق وتركه لمدة ساعة كاملة قبل شطفه بالماء الفاتر وبعد تجفيف المكان جيدا يتم دهانه بزيت الاس او زيت الخروع او زيت الزيتون البكر لتقوية البصيلات واللتزام بهذا الجدول ايضا لمدة عشرين يوما حتى ينبت الشعر باذن الله
There is also another highly effective method from the remedies of the wise Ibn Sina. It begins by opening the pores of the scalp by washing the head daily with warm water, then applying a mixture of a tablespoon of honey and a tablespoon of onion juice to the affected area, massaging it gently. Leave it for a full hour before rinsing with lukewarm water. After drying the area well, apply myrtle oil, castor oil, or extra virgin olive oil to strengthen the follicles. Adhere to this schedule also for 20 days until the hair grows back, God willing.
​وخلال فترة العلاج يجب ان تتحول المنطقة الى اللون الاحمر قليلا وهذا يدل على عودة التروية الدموية للمنطقة المصابة ودعواتي لكم بالشفاء من كل مرض
During the treatment period, the area should turn slightly red, which indicates the return of blood circulation to the affected area. My prayers to you for a speedy recovery from every disease.
​ولاي استشارة انا في خدمتكم دوما
For any consultation, I am always at your service.
​

Jutarnja tišina posle kiše.
Nestvaran prizor pred očima. Prazan košarkaški teren u Savskom parku okružen visokim zgradama u kojima žive hiljade stanara.

Čudna i nesvakidašnja slika.

Hvala vam na vremenu koje ste posvetili mojim postovima.

body.title: School is a business
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcjMdEm6b9TU66hUceBhg48dL6oGDs9U3UBH7N57v2ikK/1000199648.jpg 
[source](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/african-american-police-officer-analyzing-criminology-report-checking-crime-scene-files-laptop-computer-private-investigator-working-overtime-arhive-room-looking-investigation-evidence_83352776.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=3&uuid=bdf006a6-1ce3-43cf-8de9-f7897bb04de8&query=data+retention+ai+generated) 
They are giving us admission, they are not giving us [jobs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-job). A big [statement](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-statement) here that I got from a conversation. And the question can be, is it school that is supposed to give you a job or the government? Their duty seems to be to [train](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-train-railroad) you to get a job (or professionally put, [gain](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-gain) needed exposure) so as to help yourself with better [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life) decisions. Let's not anchor here for today, we move.  

Before getting there, let me start from the experience I have had today. Don't [Rush](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-rush-2112-album) to underrate, it can end the reverse. This is me talking about my e-exams today. I thought I got it [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) covered. Actually, it wasn't a failure but I was aiming much higher than the current result. That idea, shoot for the [moon](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-moon-celestial) and at least you will end up within the [stars](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-star-hollywood). In a precise manner, I was shooting for the [sun](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-sun) in this context and at least it was the moon I was planning to land but it ended up to be the [stars](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-star-celestial).   

Just imagine if I were to be shooting for the moon in this context. Departmental courses most [times](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) look like easy picks and while I was able to do better on a borrowed course yesterday, the confidence that I will get the best out of a departmental course turned out to be the reverse. Lesson learnt, step up the seriousness.  

Still anchoring on school issues, it has been an experience in the first one [year](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-year). I can remember when I used to pass by in that study center and just imagined what was actually going on there. The settings from the outside looked boring already. 

At least I have had such an experience on how busy a school campus always was during my ND [days](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day). How are they making [money](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-money) with so few [students](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-student) around and just a few blocks? Isn't it too tight for students….., and the assumption continues  

Fast forwarding and I have to complete my [education](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-education) in that same place that used to look very boring to me. What did I come to discover, I missed it entirely. 

This is an Open and distance learning environment where students study online and show up once in a while on campus for examinations and practicals. Imagine the educational professionality. Adding to that, they gave [branches](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-branch-bank) all of the states of the country.  

Still bothered about how they make money? Their tuition fee is quite much more reasonable than Federal and state [universities](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-university) and people are very satisfied to pay because of their [professional](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-professional) model of education. Should I still add more? They recruit students every semester unlike the traditional tertiary institutions that do it yearly.   

Can you see the gap here? These people have not just set up a schooling system but rather a business and I must comprehend their flywheels that keep spinning in the money. And the lesson still learnt boils back to my first experience, don't be quick to underrate.   

It was something I was discussing with a [friend](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-friend) today on campus and the chances they have to snatch many students from the traditional class [block](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-block) and face to face tertiary education system. I can say that the future of learning is tailored to distance and Open learning institutions.  

In conclusion, let me add, analysis is showing a shift in age difference of those who used to attend Open and distance learning institutions. First attributed to the [adults](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-adult) but it seems youths are [NOW](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-negotiable-order-of-withdrawal-account-now) flooding this institutions. Everyone is looking for where to learn at convenience while also pursuing other important things in life. Didn't I say, education is meant to expose you and beyond joining the cue of job seekers?. 

>This is an [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) covered by dani-EL; a broad niche [writer](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-writer). I write on faith, [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life) facts and daily living, business and [economics](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-economics-social-science), small scale and daily businessing, [cryptocurrency](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/cryptocurrency) and [technology](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-technology). And yes, I do cover articles on financial [education](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-education) and [investment](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-investment) updates. And [note](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-note), if I happen to be a financial adviser to you, the [TOP](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-top-currency) financial advice should be ‘DYOR’ (Do Your Own Research), I can't afford to break your heart.
