body.title: [ESP/ENG] 🏥 Otra jornada en Traumatología: Entre lluvias, hierros y seminarios 🌧️ / Another day in Traumatology: Between rain, splints, and seminars
body.body:
---
<center>

### 🇪🇸 Español

¡Hola, amigos de Hive! Espero que estén teniendo una excelente semana. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes cómo fue otro de mis días de rotación en el piso 3, específicamente en el área de traumatología. Fue un día bastante movido, lluvioso y lleno de aprendizaje.


![20260602_175326.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVkLEP8vF1aCxvjMdEJmk52JJ888U2Fb5imqrecQtaeMC/20260602_175326.jpg)


Empecé el día súper temprano, pero para mi mala suerte estaba lloviendo muchísimo. Así que no me quedó de otra que salir bajo la tormenta; se imaginarán el panorama, parecía un pollito remojado y terminé con el cabello súper esponjado antes de empezar la jornada. 

Al llegar al piso, la rutina no espera. Nos pusimos manos a la obra con todos los pendientes que ya conocen perfectamente: revisión de pacientes uno por uno, la respectiva revista médica, redacción de evoluciones y la realización de las curas. 

<center>


![20260602_173833.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcrgHVBeTSHeMxcLQn7VW4CMypSPEzkX7pgaGQZ5AVuSw/20260602_173833.jpg)


</center>

Para el mediodía ya teníamos absolutamente todo listo. Incluso nos rindió tanto el tiempo que aprovechamos para limpiar y organizar \

(los sistemas de tracción esquelética y férulas) que se utilizan para inmovilizar a los pacientes que lo necesitan. 

Una vez terminadas las labores del servicio, nos sellaron nuestra asistencia y nos dirigimos a la clase del día, que afortunadamente se dicta en el mismo hospital. En esta oportunidad se presentaron varios seminarios por parte de mis compañeros y todo salió muy chévere. Para este punto de la tarde el cansancio ya se hacía sentir, pero sabía que faltaba poco para irme a casa.

<center>


![Screenshot_20260602_174716_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRR4YidN4agR6rKMTx5qACezPX5Zbixdi1ZU2BXoxYHbk/Screenshot_20260602_174716_Gallery.jpg)


</center>

Pero como al que es \

no le toca día libre, al salir del hospital todavía seguía lloviendo. Para completar la condena, no había autobuses disponibles y la cola en la parada estaba súper larga. 

En medio de la espera y el frío, mi compañero decidió que era el momento perfecto para alegrarnos el estómago y compró unos tequeños jajaja. Así que ahí estábamos, comiendo bajo la lluvia para luego ir a cruzar los dedos esperando un milagro para poder transportarnos.

Al final salimos victoriosos y pudimos subir a un bus. Ya en el camino, mi compañero me compró unos caramelos, cerrando este día tan agotador pero con un bonito detalle. ¡Gracias por leerme y acompañarme en otro día de mi rutina médica!


![20260602_174225.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW9cDwEDdS1ofxoXbwm9xf4ntb42EME1cgA4ueuAukBLu/20260602_174225.jpg)


---

### 🇺🇸 English

Hello, Hive friends! I hope you are all having a great week. Today I want to share with you what another day of my rotation on the 3rd floor was like, specifically in the traumatology area. It was a pretty busy, rainy, and learning-filled day.


![20260602_175326.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVkLEP8vF1aCxvjMdEJmk52JJ888U2Fb5imqrecQtaeMC/20260602_175326.jpg)

I started my day super early, but to my bad luck, it was raining cats and dogs. So I had no choice but to head out under the rain; you can imagine the scene, I looked like a soaked little chicken and ended up with super frizzy hair before the day even started.

When I got to the floor, the routine didn't wait. We got to work with all the pending tasks that you already know perfectly: checking patients one by one, the medical rounds, writing evolutions, and performing wound dressings.

<center>

![20260602_173833.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcrgHVBeTSHeMxcLQn7VW4CMypSPEzkX7pgaGQZ5AVuSw/20260602_173833.jpg)

</center>

By noon we had absolutely everything ready. Time was so much on our side that we even took the opportunity to clean and organize \

(the skeletal traction systems and splints) used to immobilize the patients who need it.

Once the service tasks were finished, our attendance was stamped and we went to our class of the day, which fortunately is held in the same hospital. This time, several seminars were presented by my classmates and everything went very well. By this point in the afternoon, tiredness was setting in, but I knew it wouldn't be long before I could go home.

<center>

![Screenshot_20260602_174716_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRR4YidN4agR6rKMTx5qACezPX5Zbixdi1ZU2BXoxYHbk/Screenshot_20260602_174716_Gallery.jpg)


</center>

But since bad luck never takes a day off, it was still raining when I left the hospital. To make things worse, there were no buses available and the line at the bus stop was super long.

In the middle of the waiting and the cold, my partner decided it was the perfect time to cheer up our stomachs and bought some tequeños hahaha. So there we were, eating in the rain and then crossing our fingers hoping for a miracle to get home.

In the end, we emerged victorious and managed to get on a bus. Once on the way, my partner bought me some candies, closing this exhausting day with a sweet gesture. Thank you for reading and joining me on another day of my medical routine!

![20260602_174225.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW9cDwEDdS1ofxoXbwm9xf4ntb42EME1cgA4ueuAukBLu/20260602_174225.jpg)

---

<center>

</center>

body.title: El reino de lo posible - Experimentar esa sensación de fluidez | The realm of possibility – Experiencing that sense of flow
body.body:
![El reino de lo posible - Experimentar esa sensación de fluidez.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/2432Fg6DvJKipWEUGspmT47sGmQ3pXxFyDCC8ECAvqXrfFXxfxaF19Ev6dJf4QnFAp1bM.jpg)


<div class=\

>

En Español

Saludos a todos, amigos de la comunidad de #EmpowerTalent, con el tema que nos traen cada semana, especialmente con nuestra querida @angelica7, para invitarnos a escribir sobre: \

, en esta oportunidad, el ejercicio será pensar en todo aquello que desean e imaginan que puede hacerse posible. Esta invitación es un viaje al mundo de lo que creen que es imposible y se puede lograr a la vuelta de un deseo o pensamiento, a continuación mi participación: Creo que si empiezo a estar más en contacto conmigo misma, aceptar lo que soy y alimentar con mi pensamiento un poder personal con mi propio brillo interior, que no es orgullo ni ego, donde puedo tener la sensación de estar en armonía con ese poder más grande que es Dios, así la vida me parece fácil y fluida.

Experimentar esa sensación de fluidez

Entonces al estar en sintonía conmigo, dejo de nadar contracorriente. Por eso la vida empieza a sentirse más fluida y ligera, no es que los problemas desaparezcan mágicamente, sino que mi forma de enfrentarlos cambia, porque estoy sostenida por mi propio deseo y por mi fe, haciendo incluso que lo imposible se haga realidad. Por ejemplo, cuando me detengo a reflexionar en ese deseo que me parecía imposible, pero después de pensarlo bien, creo que a diario podemos tener muchas oportunidades de lograr cosas en la vida. Así como recordar tener presente todos los días ese momento o cambio en particular que me hizo experimentar esa sensación de fluidez recientemente, fue cuando me mudé junto con mi hija de una ciudad a otra. Pienso que tan solo debemos estar atentos a las oportunidades y no tener miedo para reclamar por eso que me hace feliz al mudarnos, buscando siempre mejorar la calidad de vida y ya hace más de un año que junto a mi hija lo logramos y estamos en nuestra nueva casa. ![El reino de lo posible - Experimentar esa sensación de fluidez (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23zkprfypNzxHpfdfzdqb7JoGLR45fP1oYDz6QxthLZ6ifCjAyYVh2r8QDxjoQQz9V73n.jpg)

Un escenario lleno de opciones

En verdad para mí es un recordatorio poderoso de cómo la perspectiva puede cambiar por completo nuestra realidad. Lo que un día parece una montaña imposible de escalar, al día siguiente se convierte en el camino que ya estamos recorriendo. Lograr dar ese gran paso de mudarnos no fue una decisión fácil, fue el resultado de varios años de trabajo, un esfuerzo que requiere valentía, resiliencia y de vencer el miedo para reclamar la felicidad y la calidad de vida que merecemos. El hecho de que ya haya pasado más de un año y que hoy tenemos nuestra nueva casa es el testimonio vivo de que esa atención a las oportunidades y ese coraje valieron la pena. Es increíble cómo, cuando dejamos de ver los deseos como \

y empezamos a ver el día a día como un escenario lleno de opciones, las cosas empiezan a alinearse. Además de estar dando un ejemplo de vida invaluable a mi hija, donde puede ver de primera mano que el destino no es algo que simplemente se espera, sino algo que se construye con decisión. Aunque sabemos que no fue fácil, disfrutar ahora del hogar y de esa vida que con tanto mérito hemos construido, es una manera de seguir atentas a todo lo bueno que viene, siempre con la fe puesta en nuestro creador. ![El reino de lo posible - Experimentar esa sensación de fluidez (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/244e8Dnc9bh3AR1HUtxy3DiQHxgPHgP18itHbzavdTvpX7THiZuh9M1w6aCZZB5sLkKsp.jpg)

Aprovechar las oportunidades que nos da la vida

Agradezco primeramente a Dios por permitirnos estar en un lugar donde tenemos esa sensación de gratitud y de mejora en la calidad de vida. Es como una motivación para seguir adelante, porque los sueños si se pueden cumplir con trabajo tesonero y aprovechar las oportunidades que nos da la vida. Esa sensación de gratitud que también les comparto amigos lectores, es un motor increíble, pues cuando uno despierta agradeciendo el lugar donde está, la energía con la que afronta el día cambia por completo. Es el círculo virtuoso perfecto: la gratitud te da motivación, la motivación te lleva al trabajo tesonero y ese trabajo es el que nos permite cazar las oportunidades al vuelo. Creo que al final del día, los sueños no se cumplen por arte de magia, sino siendo personas enfocadas en tener la claridad para ver la oportunidad y las manos listas para trabajar por ella, como un proyecto en el cual estuvimos laborando, dándole forma durante mucho tiempo, la alegría de materializarlo hoy en día, nos ha permitido así estar más cerca de la familia y nos llena de alegría. En verdad es hermoso es ver cómo la fe, la gratitud y el esfuerzo propio se unen para dar frutos tan tangibles para ir construyendo un presente hermoso y la esperanza de un futuro prometedor tanto para nosotras como para nuestros seres queridos, siendo un reflejo de que los sueños se hacen posibles. Si desean unirse a la iniciativa y al encuentro de Talentos, deben hacer [Click aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-reino-de-lo-posible). ![HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23uFeSQM6xDrDb7y7LHKxZju22v1aLmzmqmbCBsbDCKQoTVz13Y2bM2eGiuKHFMjDEsiB.jpg) Los diseños y las imágenes en Canva. Las fotografías en mi galería tomadas de mi teléfono Honor Magic6 y editadas en canva Traducido con www.DeepL.com/Translator (versión gratuita) ![El reino de lo posible - Experimentar esa sensación de fluidez (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/2432FbpWT86KifgEigDz2rN1WjTGon3GEKsi5YtuXDH3HEsgj25BTPG9VzDvUzVUrmii8.jpg)

In English

Greetings to everyone in the #EmpowerTalent community. With the topic they bring us each week—and especially with our dear @angelica7, we’re invited to write about: “The realm of the possible”. This time, the exercise is to think about everything you wish for and imagine could become a reality. This invitation is a journey into the world of what you believe to be impossible, yet can be achieved with just a wish or a thought. Here is my contribution: I believe that if I start to be more in touch with myself, accept who I am and nurture a personal power through my thoughts, drawing on my own inner radiance—which is neither pride nor ego—where I can feel in harmony with that greater power that is God, then life seems easy and flows smoothly.

Experiencing that sense of flow

So, by being in tune with myself, I stop swimming against the tide. That’s why life starts to feel more fluid and light; it’s not that problems magically disappear, but rather that the way I face them changes, because I am sustained by my own desire and my faith, even making the impossible a reality. For example, when I stop to reflect on that desire that seemed impossible to me, but after thinking it through, I believe that every day we can have many opportunities to achieve things in life. Just as I remember keeping in mind every day that particular moment or change that made me experience that sense of fluidity recently—it was when I moved with my daughter from one city to another. I think we just need to be alert to opportunities and not be afraid to go after what makes us happy when we move, always seeking to improve our quality of life. It’s been over a year now since my daughter and I achieved this, and we’re settled in our new home. ![El reino de lo posible - Experimentar esa sensación de fluidez (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/23zkprfypNzxHpfdfzdqb7JoGLR45fP1oYDz6QxthLZ6ifCjAyYVh2r8QDxjoQQz9V73n.jpg)

A world full of possibilities

For me, it really is a powerful reminder of how perspective can completely change our reality. What seems like an insurmountable mountain one day becomes the path we are already walking the next. Taking that big step of moving house was not an easy decision; it was the result of several years of hard work, an effort that requires courage, resilience and overcoming fear to claim the happiness and quality of life we deserve. The fact that over a year has now passed and we have our new home today is living proof that paying attention to opportunities and having that courage was worth it. It’s incredible how, when we stop seeing our desires as ‘impossible’ and start seeing everyday life as a stage full of options, things begin to fall into place. As well as setting an invaluable example for my daughter, where she can see first-hand that destiny isn’t something you simply wait for, but something you build with determination. Although we know it wasn’t easy, enjoying our home and the life we have so deservedly built is a way of remaining open to all the good things to come, always placing our faith in our Creator. ![El reino de lo posible - Experimentar esa sensación de fluidez (3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cautiva-30/244e8Dnc9bh3AR1HUtxy3DiQHxgPHgP18itHbzavdTvpX7THiZuh9M1w6aCZZB5sLkKsp.jpg)

Making the most of the opportunities life gives us

First and foremost, I thank God for allowing us to be in a place where we feel this sense of gratitude and an improvement in our quality of life. It acts as motivation to keep going, because dreams can indeed come true through hard work and by making the most of the opportunities life gives us. That sense of gratitude, which I also share with you, my readers, is an incredible driving force, because when you wake up grateful for where you are, the energy with which you face the day changes completely. It is the perfect virtuous circle: gratitude gives you motivation, motivation leads to hard work, and it is that hard work that allows us to seize opportunities as they arise. I believe that, at the end of the day, dreams don’t come true by magic, but by being people who are focused on having the clarity to spot an opportunity and the determination to work towards it. Like a project we’ve been working on and shaping for a long time, the joy of seeing it come to fruition today has allowed us to grow closer as a family and fills us with joy. It is truly wonderful to see how faith, gratitude and personal effort come together to bear such tangible fruit, helping us to build a beautiful present and the hope of a promising future, both for ourselves and for our loved ones, reflecting the fact that dreams do come true. body.title: Privacy is Not a Problem to Be Solved, It’s a Condition to Be Preserved.
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pivx/48JdVEHWV2kQx2LXxUbA3K3W6JpUVXtwwwakT5vkQXxxAnNAhfbqJKZum9qW8Y5W9e.png)

In the modern digital age, privacy is often framed as a technical challenge i.e a problem that engineers, regulators, and institutions must “solve.” This framing, while widespread, is fundamentally flawed. Privacy is not a bug in the system. It is not an inconvenience to be engineered away. Privacy is a foundational condition of human freedom, autonomy, and dignity. Something to be preserved, not negotiated.

To understand this philosophy, we must first reframe how we think about privacy itself.

**Privacy as a Natural State**
Privacy predates technology. Before the internet, before surveillance capitalism, before digital identity systems, privacy was the default state of human interaction. Conversations were ephemeral. Transactions were discreet. Identity was contextual, not globally broadcast.
The digital revolution inverted this reality. Today, transparency is the default, and privacy has become the exception , something users must actively reclaim. This inversion has led many to believe that privacy is an obstacle to innovation, compliance, or security.
But this is a misunderstanding. Privacy is not the problem but the erosion of privacy is.
When we treat privacy as a problem to solve, we implicitly accept that it is negotiable , that it can be traded off for convenience, efficiency, or control. This mindset leads to systems where surveillance is normalized and user autonomy is diminished.

### The Promise and Problem of Blockchain Transparency

Cryptocurrencies were introduced as a way to decentralize power and remove reliance on trusted intermediaries. However, most blockchain networks operate on radical transparency. Every transaction is publicly visible, permanently recorded, and traceable.

While this transparency ensures auditability, it also creates a new form of surveillance one that is global, immutable, and accessible to anyone.

This creates a paradox: a system designed to empower individuals can simultaneously expose them.

### PIVX and the Preservation of Privacy

Within this landscape, PIVX (Private Instant Verified Transaction) presents a fundamentally different approach. Instead of treating privacy as an a regulatory afterthought, PIVX treats privacy as a core principle.

Through advanced cryptographic techniques such as zk-SNARKs, PIVX enables shielded transactions that protect user identities and transaction details while maintaining network integrity and verifiability.

This aligns directly with the philosophy that privacy should not be retrofitted into systems it must be built into their foundation.

In PIVX, privacy is not about concealing wrongdoing. It is about preserving normalcy. It ensures that users can transact without exposing their entire financial history to the public.

**The Ethical Imperative**
The question is not whether we can build systems without privacy- we already have. The question is whether we should.
Treating privacy as a condition to be preserved shifts the ethical responsibility back to builders, policymakers, and communities. It challenges the assumption that more data collection leads to better outcomes.
Instead, it emphasizes restraint, intentionality, and respect for individual autonomy.

**Conclusion**
As digital systems continue to evolve, the choices we make today will define the boundaries of freedom for future generations. If we continue to treat privacy as a problem, we risk designing systems that normalize surveillance and erode trust.
But if we recognize privacy as a condition to be preserved, we can build technologies that empower individuals, protect autonomy, and uphold the fundamental principles of a free society.
Projects like PIVX are not just technological innovations they are philosophical statements. They remind us that privacy is not something to fix rather it is something to defend.

*Written by Sapentia*

# Grok

**Source:** https://grok.com/c/4630693c-c6f6-42d3-a7e5-72ac94930cc3?rid=8f5a60c5-ba05-4fcd-bb46-7b8c1dce2e02

Dr. Edward Henry Dowdye, Jr. (a physicist and electrical engineer with a background in laser spectroscopy, plasma physics, and NASA-related work) proposed the Extinction Shift Principle (ESP) as a purely classical emission theory and alternative to both Special Relativity (SR) and General Relativity (GR). It aims to explain the same phenomena—light propagation effects, Doppler-like shifts, time-related effects, gravitational redshift, light deflection, perihelion advance, and binary pulsar timing—using only Galilean velocity transformations in flat Euclidean space, without spacetime curvature, fundamental time dilation, length contraction, or the postulate that light speed c is constant in all inertial frames.⁠Quantumrealism
Dowdye presented this in his book Discourses & Mathematical Illustrations pertaining to the Extinction Shift Principle under the Electrodynamics of Galilean Transformations (multiple editions, e.g., 2001/2012) and a 2007 paper in Physics Essays: “Extinction Shift Principle: A Purely Classical Alternative to General and Special Relativity.” His website (extinctionshift.com, now largely archival) and related videos promote it as solving problems that made GR/SR famous, via “significant findings” on gravitational lensing and related effects.⁠Extinctionshift
Core Concepts of the Extinction Shift Principle
The theory rests on a distinction between primary (undisturbed) and secondary (observed) waves/photons (or analogously gravitons), plus “extinction” at every interaction:

Primary wave/photon (or graviton): Emitted from a source at speed c relative to that source only (classic emission/ballistic hypothesis). It propagates rectilinearly (straight lines) in ideal vacuum (interference-free space, e.g., deep interstellar voids) at c relative to the source. Its wavelength λ (primary) and exact speed relative to a distant observer are not directly measurable.
Extinction and re-emission: Any interaction with matter—lens, mirror, window, detector, or even tenuous interstellar gas (“cosmic windows”)—extinguishes the primary wave. The interacting medium or apparatus becomes a secondary source that re-emits a new secondary wave at speed c relative to itself (the interference/observer frame). The secondary wave has an adjusted (“extinction-shifted”) wavelength λ_c while preserving the frequency of interference in that frame.
Extinction shift (distinct from ordinary Doppler): This is not a stretching/compression of an existing wave but a complete replacement upon interference. Example formulas (approaching source):λc=λ1+v/c\lambda_c = \frac{\lambda}{1 + v/c}(or equivalently from phase matching: (c+v)/λ=c/λc  (c + v)/\lambda = c / \lambda_c  ). For receding sources, the sign flips. The observed frequency ν (interference rate) and secondary wavelength satisfy ν λ_c = c in the measuring frame.⁠Quantumrealism
Measurable vs. calculable quantities (key distinction from earlier emission theories like Ritz’s):
Measurable/observable: Frequency ν, extinction-shifted secondary wavelength λ_c, and speed c in the observer’s frame (always appears constant because of final re-emission at the detector).
Calculable only (not directly observable): Primary wavelength λ and primary propagation speed (c ± v relative to observer). These are inferred via the axioms and Galilean transformations from known source motion. Direct measurement always extinguishes the primary.


Principal axioms (a single set applied to both electromagnetism and gravitation):

Primary waves are extinguished at every interference/measurement and replaced by secondary re-emitted waves with extinction shift.
Energy conservation holds.
Primary speed is always c relative to its direct source.
Space is Euclidean; Galilean velocity transformations apply.
Undisturbed primaries propagate rectilinearly.
For gravity: Analogous exchange of primary gravitons (from one mass) and secondary gravitons (re-emitted by another mass), with transit-time and phase effects under Galilean rules producing effective attraction or orbital perturbations.⁠Quantumrealism

Wave equation invariance: Dowdye claims the standard wave equation remains form-invariant under Galilean transforms because only the observed (secondary) ν and λ_c adjust to keep ν λ_c = c in the interference frame. No ether or medium is required for the vacuum propagation of primaries.
Applications claimed:

Electromagnetism: Explains Michelson-Morley null result, Sagnac effect, optical gyroscopes, aberration, and apparent constancy of c via re-emission at detectors. Transverse relative time shifts mimic time dilation; effective mass m_eff ≈ m_0 / (1 − v²/(2c²)) arises from transit effects.
Gravitation: Perihelion advance of Mercury and PSR 1913+16 binary pulsar via asymmetric graviton transit times in orbits (yielding the famous 43″/century term classically). Gravitational redshift via “moving windows.” Solar light deflection and gravitational lensing attributed primarily to solar plasma refraction near the limb (plus gravitational gradient) rather than spacetime curvature—claimed observable only at low impact parameters corresponding to the plasma rim.⁠Quantumrealism

The theory asserts that all successes of SR/GR are misinterpretations of these classical emission/re-emission and transit-time effects.
What Is Accurate

Real physical processes it draws upon: In actual optics and quantum mechanics, photons are absorbed and re-emitted (or scattered) by atoms, molecules, or detectors. In refractive media, effective propagation involves continuous interactions (speed c/n). Detectors never “see” a truly undisturbed primary wave in the classical sense. Interstellar plasma and gas do affect propagation (especially radio), and plasma refraction near the Sun is a real correction in deflection measurements.
Classical limits and intuition: Galilean transformations are correct for mechanics at low v/c. Many “relativistic” effects have classical analogs or approximations (e.g., Doppler, aberration, transit-time delays in orbits). Numerical agreement on specific problems (e.g., perihelion advance) can be achieved by construction in tuned classical models.
Distinction between propagation and detection: Philosophically and practically valid—observations always involve interaction. Some older emission ideas (pre-relativity) explored source-dependent speeds.
Partial validity on plasma: Solar plasma does refract radio waves strongly near the limb; models subtract this to test GR. Dowdye correctly notes frequency dependence and rim localization for certain observations.

These elements give the theory surface plausibility as a classical reinterpretation.
What Is Not Accurate (or Unsupported)

Ballistic/emission hypothesis for primary propagation contradicts experiment: Simple (and even modified) emission theories where light speed depends on source velocity were ruled out long ago. Willem de Sitter’s 1913 analysis of spectroscopic binary stars showed that if light from approaching/receding components traveled at c ± v_source, arrival times would scramble orbits, producing non-Keplerian or multiple images—yet clean orbits are observed. Later work (Brecher 1977 and others) tightened limits; any source-velocity dependence must be negligible (k ≈ 0 in c + k v). Laboratory tests with moving sources (pions, lasers, particle beams) confirm speed independence to high precision.⁠WikipediaDowdye’s “extinction by cosmic windows” (interstellar gas resetting speed/phase) is ad hoc and unrealistic for optical light: mean free paths are enormous (photons travel parsecs largely undisturbed). It cannot consistently rescue the theory for controlled lab experiments or nearby sources without intervening matter.
Ad hoc mechanism to mimic SR postulates: Re-emission at c relative to every detector/apparatus effectively forces observed light speed to appear constant in the lab frame while allowing ballistic primaries in between. This is engineered to reproduce SR’s second postulate without its foundations. It risks inconsistencies in coherence, long-baseline interferometry, multi-path interference, resonators, or accelerating frames—none of which are rigorously resolved in the framework.
Wave equation and EM foundations: Standard vacuum Maxwell equations imply c independent of source (from ε₀ μ₀). Galilean transformations do not preserve the wave equation form without a preferred frame or medium. Dowdye’s invariance claim via extinction shift is not derived from first principles of electromagnetism and does not consistently handle polarization, quantum interference, or high-precision tests.
Gravity and GR tests: The graviton-exchange analogy with primary/secondary is speculative and lacks the geometric rigor or predictive breadth of GR. GR has passed an enormous suite of tests with high precision: light deflection (including higher-order terms), Shapiro time delay, gravitational redshift, frame-dragging (Gravity Probe B), gravitational wave waveforms (LIGO/Virgo matching numerical relativity), black hole shadows (Event Horizon Telescope), and cosmological observations. Classical transit-time models can often retrofit the 43″/century perihelion term but fail broader consistency. Dowdye’s solar deflection claim (plasma-only at rim, negligible elsewhere) is overstated: precise optical eclipse measurements, VLBI radio astrometry, and Gaia data match GR’s 1.75″ deflection (with plasma corrections applied); the 1/r falloff and vacuum contributions align with GR, not pure plasma refraction.⁠Wikipedia
Publication and acceptance: Physics Essays has a low impact factor (~0.5) and a reputation for fringe or heterodox ideas (sometimes including extravagant claims). It is not a mainstream venue that confers strong validation. The theory has not gained traction, produced novel confirmed predictions differing from GR/SR, or addressed modern pillars (GPS relativistic corrections, muon lifetime dilation, E=mc² in accelerators, quantum field theory consistency).
Overall empirical status: While internally consistent within its axioms for selected problems, ESP selectively reinterprets data and introduces mechanisms that conflict with well-established tests of light-speed constancy and GR’s comprehensive success. It does not constitute a viable replacement.

Summary Assessment
The Extinction Shift Principle is a sincere, mathematically illustrated attempt by a classically trained physicist to preserve Euclidean space and Galilean relativity while explaining “relativistic” successes through emission, extinction, and re-emission. Its emphasis on measurable vs. calculable quantities and optical interaction physics has intuitive appeal and correctly identifies real processes in detectors and media.
However, it is not accurate as a fundamental theory. It relies on an unsupported ballistic primary propagation (ruled out by de Sitter-type tests and lab experiments), ad hoc extinction to enforce observed c constancy, and an incomplete gravitational model. It does not match the precision, breadth, or predictive power of SR/GR, which remain the experimentally validated frameworks. Plasma effects are real but insufficient to replace gravitational lensing predictions.
Dowdye’s work is best viewed as an interesting historical/alternative perspective in the tradition of pre-relativity emission theories, valuable for highlighting classical intuitions and the role of measurement interactions—but not as a correct or superior replacement for established physics. Mainstream science has not adopted it for these reasons. For deeper reading, consult his 2007 Physics Essays paper or the archived extinctionshift.com materials alongside standard relativity texts and experimental reviews (e.g., on light-speed tests).

I find it hard to believe A.I. can just replace programmers, technical writers, and analysts.

The programming hype seems to collapse in on itself more as task complexity increases, and humans are better at commenting to explain what code does as part of the bigger picture.

I have some experience as a technical writer, and one must know what to communicate for a human reader to understand about a particular task or process. Again, A.I. can probably handle general tasks, but I doubt specific niche and cutting-edge areas are within its scope.

As for analysis, there are horror stories of slop and hallucinations polluting data everywhere. This may vary based on model, but people are predicting that as the A.I. hype wave washes through industry, the next few years will be profitable for humans who know how to clean up and rebuild what the clankers screwed up.

Hello Splinterlands and Hive Fam!


I hope that life is treating you well wherever you are in this part of the world, and the weekend must be going great.


My Splinterlands Game account is - FinPulse9.

Every season, I need to renew the cards from the rental market, and it is such a tough task that I need to do, and it takes a lot of time. The reason why I need to take action every season is that I am dependent upon the rented cards, and I prefer to get the cards on rent that are either on the Max level, or they are available on a higher level so that I can pick them and start playing the battle where my winning ratio is good.

Sometimes, because of this time, I also get started with the battle slightly late because there is no point playing the button unless I get the cards that I want, and similarly, in this season, I have also lost more than one day due to the renewal. Yesterday I bought the Wild Pass, and it's been more than one day when I am finally able to take the cards that I need to play the battles on the battleground.

Now that I have completed the renewal, I am all set to take on the battleground, and the journey in the current season has begun, which I hope will be good, since I am planning to enter the Diamond One League this time. Gaming is fun, and it is even more fun because I don't know how this season will go, which depends on the level of competition I face over there and the winning ratio I can maintain. If it goes well, then I will probably be able to unlock whatever I want, but if it does not, then that's fine because there is always an exception; I can try my best strategy in the next one.


For this season my strategy is simple that I want to unlock the Diamond One League and I hope that this should be done because there is a lot of time left in the season or in a way I can say that season it just started So I have got plenty of time which I can utilise to win more battles and with more beginning I can move forward and unlock the higher league that I want.

body.title: Some Goodbyes Are Like Sunsets; They Mark an Ending, But They Leave Behind Beauty
body.body:
There was a time when I thought every goodbye had to be painful. I believed that whenever something ended, it meant loss. But as I grew older, I started to understand that some endings are not meant to break us. They are meant to teach us, change us, and leave us with memories that stay long after the moment has passed.
A few years ago, one of my closest friends moved to another city. We had spent countless evenings together, talking about life, work, and our dreams. When the day came for him to leave, I expected sadness. Of course, there was some. But what surprised me was the feeling of gratitude. Instead of focusing on the fact that he was leaving, I found myself remembering all the good moments we had shared.
That experience reminded me of a sunset.
When the sun goes down, we do not usually stand outside feeling angry that the day is ending. We stop and admire the colors in the sky. We appreciate the beauty of the moment even though we know it will not last forever.
Life works in a similar way.
Many of us experience goodbyes that are not caused by distance. Sometimes a job ends. Sometimes a project finishes. Sometimes a chapter of life quietly closes without us even noticing it at first. In those moments, we can spend our energy wishing things had stayed the same, or we can appreciate what that experience gave us.
I remember reading comments from different people online who shared similar thoughts. One person said that the hardest part of leaving a workplace was not the work itself but the people who had become part of their daily life. Another said that after moving away from their hometown, they realized that the memories they carried were more valuable than the places they left behind. These stories reminded me that goodbyes are something everyone experiences, no matter where they come from.
Even on Steemit, I have seen users take breaks, move on to new goals, or return after a long absence. The platform changes, people come and go, but the friendships, lessons, and experiences remain. Those are the things that truly matter.
The beauty of a sunset is not that it lasts forever. Its beauty comes from the fact that it is temporary. In the same way, some of the most meaningful moments in our lives become precious because we know they cannot stay exactly as they are.
Today, when I think about goodbyes, I try not to see them only as endings. I try to see them as reminders of something valuable that happened. If a goodbye hurts, it often means that the experience was worth having in the first place.
So the next time life asks you to say goodbye to a person, a place, or a chapter of your journey, remember the sunset. It signals the end of the day, but it also fills the sky with colors that people stop to admire.
Some goodbyes are like sunsets. They mark an ending, but they leave behind beauty.
Have you ever experienced a goodbye that felt more like a sunset than a storm? I'd love to hear your thoughts and personal experiences in the comments. 🌅
#life #thoughts #motivation #steemit

body.title: My Job And I Will Last
body.body:
Will Your Job Exist In Ten Years?

It all depends largely on the nature of the work. Yes, technology and Artificial Intelligence, are advancing. Keeping people worried that technology may replace their work. While some are afraid to be out of work. But there are many professions that I believe that technology can not keep them out of their jobs.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRRno3K4Mco2g19RVTEwNN4vMPvCKUBPDqBHF7NkCqDQs/1780436522400.jpg)

I am a very industrious woman, and I currently have one job and two businesses. Guess what? I believe all three of them will last for as long as I live.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR5mnoZG35XAPjjCMP6LfzaK1FHcHBoZsTb6ebXM9R8Pe/1780436377960.jpg)

My first job is part time teaching. Teaching is a career that never ends. It has been in existence since the beginning of human civilization, and it will continue to exist because every generation needs people to pass on knowledge and values. As a teacher, I will continue teaching until I retire. Even after that, I can still teach through mentoring, guiding, and sharing my experiences with others. No matter how old I become, there will be need for me to continue to teach and impact lives

My first business is my drinks business. I have been in this business for over Ten years, and I am still waxing strong. People will always need refreshments, and businesses like this thrive on human interaction and customer relationships. While AI can help with record-keeping, marketing, and inventory management, it cannot replace the in-person relationship that builds friendship and trust, which are vital in serving customers. AI cannot stand in my shop and sell drinks the way I do.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYaey4tQcwbGd1v2WNakgU5HK4ZWTnD8yHUy7NU5AauV9/1780435877489.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmburDX3mimUxZqgxGVmFUnuS8YXR5N7Bt68o5BH8HsEgB/1780435877571.jpg)

The second business I am involved in is the shortlet apartment business. People will always need comfortable and secure places to stay, whether for vacations, business trips, family visits, or temporary accommodation. Technology can help with bookings and management, it cannot replace the physical property itself or the hospitality that comes with providing a pleasant experience for guests. As long as people travel and need accommodation, the demand for shortlet apartments will continue to exist. This is another reason why I am confident that my source of livelihood will remain relevant even beyond Ten years time.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPw3vRoUDmPfhXTM3RsU2zbHUHfnHRTkfvVT7CJUSs2kQ/1780435698411.jpg)

I am not worried about whether my jobs will exist in ten years. Technology will continue to improve and AI will certainly change the way many people work. But, I strongly believe that careers built on human connection, practical skills, and essential services will continue to remain relevant. To counteract the effect of AI on my business, I will continue to stay adaptable, keep learning, and make the most of the opportunities that comes with change.

body.title: ¿Vamos manteniendo la balanza entre lo posible de manera sana y el miedo a lo imposible? [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
>  

## Spanish
     
Hola a todos, sin duda pensar en la posibilidad de cumplir todo aquello que nos proponemos y queremos sin duda es algo que llega a jugar mucho con nuestras emociones y el cómo nos movemos; tanto puede motivarnos y ayudarnos a encontrar claridad como también desesperarnos y hacernos entrar en un bucle de querer conseguir todo rápido. En sí, la palabra \

es una que buscamos tanto que a veces nos podemos dejar llevar por esta.





Ahora bien, en mi entorno, el miedo a lo imposible llega a estar más presente que la actitud decisiva a lo posible, por lo que suele ser casi un hito y sorpresa cuando cosas que pensábamos que no se dan salen victoriosas, y estas llegan a causar ese pensar de si realmente está ocurriendo. Ojo, no es que se sea pesimista, sino que es algo como la poca fe o una pequeña duda de autocuestionamiento que hace que estar mentalizados en que todo es posible de manera positiva llegue a resultar agobiante. Uno de los ejemplos con los que conecté de lo que es este reino de lo posible que nos da @talento como tema para esta semana es mi hermana; actualmente está en los últimos meses de la primera fase de su carrera como fisioterapeuta, siendo en diciembre su graduación como técnico, y eso podría decirse que ha sido todo un recorrido de dudas e inseguridades, no tanto por ella, sino de quienes la rodean.

<hr></hr>
<center>
https://i.ecency.com/DQmdka2tA5eSQNvcn4Xgyjwnxocsfe9eE7QMh9VbeEUX5Zu/1780436716651.jpg
</center>

<center>
https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgicrWf6FUQajPnRCch1YkxmY5YmVwUJEEqCQsX9zuAf/1780436740018.jpg
</center>

<hr></hr>

En algunos momentos, debido a esto, se encontró muchas veces en ese limbo de lo posible y lo imposible con respecto a cada paso hacia este escalón profesional y sí es verdad que en arte la duda general ha partido del hecho de que al yo no graduarme se genera ese miedo y baja expectativa; con ella, la cosa es que también a veces hay otro punto con respecto al tema de lo posible y es, como mencioné antes, cómo se llega a este y, en ocasiones, la presión puede hacer que en una carrera de ámbito medicinal, más la constante charla de personas que exigen el avance casi de inmediato, hagan la presión perfecta para que el sobreesfuerzo tome la batuta y esto lo he visto reflejado como tercero, tanto en ella como en amigos, que el estrés constante los llega a arrastrar hacia problemas de estrés y demás, por lo que a veces me pregunto si en ocasiones el reino de lo posible lleva en un trasfondo un lado oscuro cuando no caminamos a nuestro ritmo debido.   



Incluso eso mismo me ha pasado con el entrar en esa duda de que si lo que queremos y buscamos sea posible en realidad o no, y más que todo por el tema de la desmotivación. Yo ni niego el hecho de que quiero en algunos momentos poder terminar la carrera y, aparte, conseguir varias de las cosas que escribo en esa lista y, la verdad, a veces dudo, como digo, pero otras me doy cuenta de algo y es que cuando vemos algo realizarse, por más simple que sea, y ver si somos capaces de hacer eso posible, es una satisfacción que logra ser hasta curativa y, cuando lo experimento, me hace querer más, por lo que se podría decir que solo depende de nosotros mantener la balanza correcta entre creer que podemos hacer posible todo lo que nos propongamos y caer en la duda de lo imposible.

<hr></hr>
<center>
https://i.ecency.com/DQmRXVUqQqJSBoWrK72boNdRst1G61Mri5spgvu7VLLZBPR/1780436772576.jpg
</center>

<hr></hr>

Por lo que sin más , siendo esta pequeña reflexión y parte de mis pensamientos, mi forma de conectar con este tema y así mismo esperando sea de su agrado. Muchas gracias por leer.

<hr></hr>

<center>
https://images.ecency.com/DQmXyn4uh9TnKoA8fj9AxiaTWy1Vc13iaPDU5TJxKwK5uEp/1721770434987.jpg
</center>


<hr></hr>

## English
 
Hello everyone, without a doubt, thinking about the possibility of achieving everything we set out to do and want is something that greatly affects our emotions and how we act; it can motivate us and help us find clarity, but it can also lead to despair and trap us in a cycle of wanting to achieve everything quickly. The word \

itself is one we seek so much that we can sometimes get carried away by it. Now, in my circle, the fear of the impossible is more prevalent than a decisive attitude towards the possible, so it's often quite a milestone and a surprise when things we thought wouldn't happen actually do, and this leads to wondering if it's really happening. Mind you, it's not that we're pessimistic, but rather a lack of faith or a slight self-doubt that makes mentally preparing ourselves for the possibility of everything feeling overwhelming. One of the examples I connected with of this realm of possibility that @talento is giving us as a theme for this week is my sister; she's currently in the final months of the first phase of her physiotherapy degree, with her graduation as a technician scheduled for December. It's been quite a journey filled with doubts and insecurities, not so much for her, but for those around her.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmdka2tA5eSQNvcn4Xgyjwnxocsfe9eE7QMh9VbeEUX5Zu/1780436836255.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgicrWf6FUQajPnRCch1YkxmY5YmVwUJEEqCQsX9zuAf/1780436854915.jpg
At times, because of this, she often found herself in that limbo between the possible and the impossible regarding each step toward this professional milestone. And it's true that in the arts, the general doubt stems from the fact that not graduating myself generates that fear and low expectations. With her, the thing is that there's also another aspect to the topic of what's possible, and that is, as I mentioned before, how one gets there. Sometimes, the pressure, especially in a medical field, combined with the constant pressure from people demanding almost immediate progress, creates the perfect storm for overexertion to take hold. I've seen this reflected in her and in friends, where constant stress can lead to stress-related problems and other issues. So, I sometimes wonder if the realm of possibility has a dark side when we don't progress at our own pace. I've even experienced this myself when I've doubted whether what we want and seek is actually possible, mainly due to demotivation. I don't deny that I sometimes want to finish my degree and, besides that, achieve several of the things I've written on that list. And, honestly, sometimes I doubt myself, as I said, but other times I realize something: when we see something come to fruition, no matter how simple, and see if we're capable of making it happen, it's a satisfaction that can even be healing. And when I experience it, it makes me want more. So you could say that it all depends on us maintaining the right balance between believing we can achieve everything we set our minds to and succumbing to the doubt of the impossible.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmRXVUqQqJSBoWrK72boNdRst1G61Mri5spgvu7VLLZBPR/1780436885259.jpg
Therefore, with this small reflection and expression of my thoughts, I hope you enjoy it. Thank you very much for reading.

body.body:
![fpTHhYU8jmfu6LEu_P_20260428_173849.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/fpTHhYU8jmfu6LEu_P_20260428_173849/fpTHhYU8jmfu6LEu_P_20260428_173849.webp) ![OUgk1JIZUOnCkDwh_P_20260428_173857.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/OUgk1JIZUOnCkDwh_P_20260428_173857/OUgk1JIZUOnCkDwh_P_20260428_173857.webp) ![6N7U3I0mYeSh3IPz_P_20260428_173916.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/6N7U3I0mYeSh3IPz_P_20260428_173916/6N7U3I0mYeSh3IPz_P_20260428_173916.webp) ![rC2LnWFxGGoXhZob_P_20260428_173923.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/rC2LnWFxGGoXhZob_P_20260428_173923/rC2LnWFxGGoXhZob_P_20260428_173923.webp) ![3vMednvWPaJWxtng_P_20260428_173955.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/3vMednvWPaJWxtng_P_20260428_173955/3vMednvWPaJWxtng_P_20260428_173955.webp) ![0ySzCGbzMoFPzdpN_P_20260428_174008.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/0ySzCGbzMoFPzdpN_P_20260428_174008/0ySzCGbzMoFPzdpN_P_20260428_174008.webp) ![P46uS1mHw5LWElAt_P_20260428_174027.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/P46uS1mHw5LWElAt_P_20260428_174027/P46uS1mHw5LWElAt_P_20260428_174027.webp) ![mBrtg1PlcbCJRew0_P_20260428_174105.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/mBrtg1PlcbCJRew0_P_20260428_174105/mBrtg1PlcbCJRew0_P_20260428_174105.webp)
某天，中午在商場內的餐廳和朋友聚餐，酒足飯飽之後，大夥兒就各自解散了，反正我沒有甚麼重要的事情要做，就享受難得的悠閒時間，在商場到處逛逛，逛著逛著，我就走進一間樂高專賣店，沒想到，一踏進店門，就像進入了一個充滿想像力與創意的世界，讓我不知不覺待了很長一段時間。 由於低成本和人口密度的關係，摩托機車在這裡非常受到歡迎，而摩托機車密度也是全亞洲最高，統計全台總計有一千三百多萬輛機車，也是我及大部份牛馬的主要代步工具，上班期間的台北橋都會出現海量摩托機車，看上去就像是壯觀的瀑布一樣，被人戲稱為機車海，沒想到，店裡居然用積木拼出機車海的畫面，此外，機車海最前面的積木機車，還有引擎，可以發出喇叭聲。 另外，還有台北的地標，一座高達三百二十五公分的「台北101模型」，以十萬多顆積木拼砌，模型頂部裝設特殊燈效，可以展現猶如真實台北101跨年燈光秀的璀璨視覺效果，當我站在模型前仔細觀察時，不禁佩服設計師的耐心與技術，小小的塑膠積木，竟然能組合成栩栩如生的人物、動物、建築甚至交通工具，此外，店內還有不少代表性街景，貓空纜車以及台灣黑熊等，完全可以打卡留念。 我印象中每一家樂高專賣店都設有體驗區，讓顧客親手拼裝積木，不少小朋友聚集在體驗區，利用現場提供的積木，組裝出自己的作品，如汽車或建築物等，不過，我還是第一次看到迷你人偶工廠，據說，它可以讓樂高迷們親自設計迷你人偶的上身圖案，並搭配不同的表情、髮型、腿部和配件，組合出獨一無二的角色，真是神奇啊！費用為四百四十九元台幣，離開專賣店時，我雖然沒有購買任何商品，卻有了一個愉快的參觀體驗。
---
One day, I met up with some friends for lunch at a restaurant inside a shopping mall. After enjoying a satisfying meal, everyone went their separate ways. Since I didn't have anything important to do, I decided to enjoy some rare free time and wander around the mall. As I strolled from store to store, I eventually walked into a LEGO Store. The moment I stepped inside, it felt like entering a world filled with imagination and creativity, and before I knew it, I had spent quite a long time there. Because of their affordability and the high population density here, scooters are extremely popular. In fact, Taiwan has the highest scooter density in Asia, with more than 13 million registered scooters across the country. They're also the main mode of transportation for me and most working people. During rush hour, Taipei Bridge is often packed with an enormous number of scooters, creating a scene that looks like a flowing waterfall. People even jokingly call it a 'sea of scooters.' To my surprise, the store had recreated this famous scene entirely out of LEGO bricks. Even more impressive, the LEGO scooter at the front of the display had a working engine feature that could play a horn sound. The store also featured a giant Taipei 101 model, one of Taipei's most famous landmarks. Standing 325 centimeters tall and built from over 100,000 LEGO bricks, the model was equipped with special lighting effects at the top, recreating the dazzling atmosphere of the real Taipei 101 New Year's Eve light show. As I stood there examining it closely, I couldn't help but admire the patience and skill of the designers. It's amazing how tiny plastic bricks can be transformed into lifelike people, animals, buildings, and vehicles. The store also showcased several iconic Taiwanese scenes, including the Maokong Gondola and the Formosan black bear, making them perfect spots for photos. As far as I can remember, every LEGO Store has a hands-on building area where visitors can assemble their own creations. Quite a few children were gathered around the play area, using the available bricks to build cars, buildings, and other imaginative creations. However, this was my first time seeing a Minifigure Factory. Apparently, LEGO fans can design their own minifigure torso prints and combine them with different facial expressions, hairstyles, legs, and accessories to create a truly one-of-a-kind character. I thought that was incredibly cool. The experience costs NT$449. When I finally left the store, I hadn't bought anything, but I still walked away with a very enjoyable and memorable visit. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@diochen/exploring-the-playground-of-imagination-again)

body.title: (ESP/ENG) 🧩✍️ El dilema de la pieza que hace falta / The dilemma of the missing piece 🧩✍️
body.body:
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad y amantes de la escritura creativa! Luego de un fin de semana movido debido a mi participación en un mercadillo como stand de ventas, acabé completamente agotada. Aún al día de hoy, siento que no me he recuperado del todo y para colmo, parece que tengo un ligero malestar de gripe 🤧 aunque, no me dejaré vencer, pues hay muchas cosas que quiero hacer ahora que mis stocks de productos, se redujo gracias a las ventas 🙏 Mientras me organizo para seguir echándole ganas a mi emprendimiento, procuro mantenerme activa en mi blog para no perder la costumbre y entre ello, escribir lo que me vino a la mente luego de ver la imagen propuesta para el [concurso](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-5eecaea7dc14a). Eso me permite despejar mi mente, algo atribulada por todas las cosas que quiero hacer al mismo tiempo 😅
![imagen (7).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23viCqxXjahnuCzumYLFHdfuj7rVqQRgZV3nzRbqPBZ3mMac6ViFnh8XcV7oY5f2BtF7m.png)
Desde muy pequeños, se nos ha inculcado la idea de que todos estamos destinados a encontrar una pareja o encajar en la sociedad. Por eso, cuando eres alguien retraído, tímido o extrovertido, es comprensible que llegues a creer que algo en ti, está “mal”, porque a diferencia del resto, no tienes amigos, no has encontrado a tu media naranja o no disfrutas de estar en lugares concurridos.
Es algo que pasa más frecuentemente ahora en la actualidad, en donde el consumo de tecnología a llevado a muchos a refugiarse en el mundo virtual y es comprensible, porque en muchas ocasiones, el precio por \

a un lugar o grupo, es dejar de ser uno mismo; es entonces cuando las personas dejan de ser auténticas por comportarse del modo en que los demás, lo esperan y así, encajar
Pero, yo creo que “no pertenecer”, no tiene nada de malo. Porque en realidad, no todos vinimos a este mundo a enamorarnos o a ser populares, muchas personas encuentran ese lugar al que pertenecen en su interior, por lo que no tienen necesidad de buscar “ese algo”, fuera. El problema radica en cuando no se es capaz de verlo e intentas forzarlo. Es entonces cuando vemos a hombres y mujeres quejarse o lamentarse porque están solos y “nadie los quiere”, cuando primero tienen que lograr esa conexión consigo mismos para poder siquiera pensar en conectar con otros.
Cuando me di cuenta de que así funcionaban las cosas, dejé de preocuparme como lo hacía por encajar y fue entonces, cuando comencé a ser realmente feliz. No es necesario que todos formemos parte del rompecabezas, podemos ser una pieza aparentemente extraviada o permitirnos ser nosotros mismos un rompecabezas incompleto o formado por piezas muy distintas a las que \

originalmente.
### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨
![Sticker-hive-sue-con-taza.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK7w4GdH1MPQStuqcVxKZ7aLEz1CNG33KwxnKAnYGM9U9kSYaEBvhSvZfbHwHty.gif)

#
💚 ¡Hasta una próxima oportunidad! 💚

![Separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCKUob6Veoru2WkSHzGEJYsVaCtXW1faq9AvNDGGoHQ7EK3BnMYaWz3Kvh37TGkuVa.jpg)
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to everyone in this community and creative writing enthusiasts! After a hectic weekend working at a market stall, I ended up completely exhausted. Even now, I feel like I haven't fully recovered, and to top it all off, I seem to have a slight case of the flu 🤧. However, I won't let it get me down, as there are many things I want to do now that my product stock has been reduced thanks to the sales 🙏. While I get organized to keep pushing forward with my business, I'm trying to stay active on my blog to maintain the habit, and among other things, I'm writing down what came to mind after seeing the image for the [contest](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-5eecaea7dc14a). This helps clear my mind, which is a bit overwhelmed by all the things I want to do at the same time 😅
![imagen (7).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23viCqxXjahnuCzumYLFHdfuj7rVqQRgZV3nzRbqPBZ3mMac6ViFnh8XcV7oY5f2BtF7m.png)
From a very young age, we're taught that we're all destined to find a partner or fit into society. That's why, if you're withdrawn, shy, or extroverted, it's understandable that you might start to believe something is \

with you, because unlike others, you don't have friends, you haven't found your soulmate, or you don't enjoy being in crowded places.
This is happening more frequently nowadays, where technology consumption has led many to take refuge in the virtual world. And it's understandable, because often the price of \

to a place or group is ceasing to be yourself; that's when people stop being authentic in order to behave the way others expect and thus fit in.
But I believe that \

isn't a bad thing at all. Because, in reality, not all of us came into this world to fall in love or to be popular. Many people find their place of belonging within themselves, so they don't need to look for \
outside. The problem arises when you're unable to see it and try to force it. That's when we see men and women complaining or lamenting that they're alone and \

when they first need to achieve that connection with themselves before they can even think about connecting with others.
When I realized that's how things worked, I stopped worrying so much about fitting in, and that's when I began to be truly happy. We don't all have to be part of the puzzle; we can be a seemingly missing piece or allow ourselves to be an incomplete puzzle, or one made up of pieces very different from what they \

originally.
### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![Sticker-hive-sue-con-taza.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK7w4GdH1MPQStuqcVxKZ7aLEz1CNG33KwxnKAnYGM9U9kSYaEBvhSvZfbHwHty.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

body.body: > ![español.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23yd9wZPBaPKw5HFDYLUPN9j4qLYrD8Xci2NgBKrFwgWe14NHavfwHUnjC1sQvQXLjGFp.png) Hola hivers de la cocina creativa, ¡Me encantan las arepas! Creo que ya lo he contado en muchos post, tanto que fue inspiración para mi primer libro como periodista: *Las 50 Mejores Recetas del Día Mundial de la Arepa*. Pero sé, que tienden a inflamar mucho y que debemos consumirlas con moderación. Sin embargo, hoy te traigo una receta de arepa saludable, con mucho color y muy nutritiva. Se trata de la **arepa de remolacha**, una verdura rica en antioxidantes, que además, contiene vitamina C, ácido fólico, hierro y potasio. Si la combinas con harina integral libre de gluten aporta un balance nutricional adecuado para nuestro organismo. La primera vez que las hice me encantaron, porque no requiere usar tanta harina para amasar y tiene un sabor dulzón agradable. ¿Empezamos? **```INGREDIENTES:```**

> ![ingles.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23ynYxDZufJebWDsXDADMnf4UrueESVTkKmtp3k8NsBqytTwT4tYy4fXexYVGR6T8BUkp.png) Hello, creative cooking fans, I love arepas! I think I’ve mentioned this in many posts—so much so that it inspired my first book as a journalist: *The 50 Best Recipes for World Arepa Day*. But I know they can be quite filling, so we should eat them in moderation. However, today I’m bringing you a recipe for a healthy arepa that’s colorful and very nutritious. It’s the **beet arepa**, made with a vegetable rich in antioxidants that also contains vitamin C, folic acid, iron, and potassium. When combined with gluten-free whole wheat flour, it provides a nutritional balance that’s just right for our bodies. The first time I made them, I loved them because they don’t require as much flour to knead and have a pleasant, sweet flavor. Shall we get started? **``` INGREDIENTS:```** *** ![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23wCBXXLYuTx4AJqhxZzj1iWZjygp66PdeLveLRKRSuTG1ZZsVgsgx3SNjZxwBuShEcAN.png) ***

> 🫓 1 remolacha 🫓 1 cebolla pequeña 🫓 Sal marina 🫓 ½ vaso de agua filtrada 🫓 1 cucharada de semillas de chía 🫓 Harina de maíz integral sin gluten. Yo usé una marca que se llama Maikel, es muy buena. **``` PASO A PASO:```** 1️⃣ En la licuadora, coloca la remolacha, la cebolla, el agua y la cucharada de chía. Licua hasta obtener una mezcla homogénea.

> 🫓 1 beet 🫓 1 small onion 🫓 Sea salt 🫓 ½ cup filtered water 🫓 1 tablespoon chia seeds 🫓 Gluten-free whole-grain corn flour. I used a brand called Maikel—it’s really good. **```STEP-BY-STEP:```** 1️⃣ Place the beet, onion, water, and tablespoon of chia seeds in a blender. Blend until smooth. *** ![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23w2oQSoxCBaApbAjCcoT8VkUx7B6XbeS1ANESxTNn2W2xwyNR96gq68S4xhChHkJRTJ5.png) ***

> 2️⃣ En un recipiente grande, vierte la mezcla y agrégale sal marina. Luego, agrega poco a poco la harina y amasa hasta lograr una masa consistente para formar las arepas. Yo usé aproximadamente 2 cucharadas de harina para darle forma, ya que la mezcla era bastante gruesa. Lo recomendable es licuar con la menor cantidad de agua para no tener que usar tanta harina para amasar.

> 2️⃣ Pour the mixture into a large bowl and add sea salt. Then, gradually add the flour and knead until you have a dough that’s firm enough to shape into arepas. I used about 2 tablespoons of flour to shape them, since the mixture was quite thick. It’s best to blend the mixture with as little water as possible so you don’t have to use as much flour when kneading. *** ![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23wgPzjFYnFnAhx8dQWcGp53jiveswE81Zh1NLwVgwyw5d4e4hCMbk3HvjjmpP8LsZ3wb.png) ***
> 3️⃣ Para hacer las arepas, forma bolas redondas con la masa y, con las manos, aplástala y moldea poco a poco hasta darle una forma circular, como si fuera un disco.

> 3️⃣ To make the arepas, form the dough into round balls, then use your hands to flatten and shape them little by little until they form a circular shape, like a disc. *** ![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23w2o7embFhjrbmmKpXKq6NsNcRbP8xT2Ws774uh6DUcYEZtPzH5k9QBETuEeEiWUGvyi.png) ***

> 4️⃣ En un budare o plancha, coloca un chorrito de aceite y espera a que caliente. Luego, coloca las arepas y cocina por ambos lados hasta que se forme una capa, aproximadamente unos 10 a 12 minutos por ambos lados hasta que doren.

> 4️⃣ Add a splash of oil to a griddle or skillet and let it heat up. Then, place the arepas on the griddle and cook on both sides until a crust forms, about 10 to 12 minutes per side, until golden brown. *** ![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23vsQfKhV3NE17FpTXsMZaw3P8Db9ydRedprkp5nXNmsNCngPLTX4eypsh5K3TFVRoiTC.png) ***

> 5️⃣ Rellena las arepas de remolacha con el relleno de tu preferencia. Yo las rellené con pollo desmenuzado, queso y trozos de aguacate; también hicimos un relleno de chorizo y aguacate. ¡Sencillamente divinas! Pero, acá en el blog he publicado varios tipos de rellenos que quedan perfectos con estas arepas. También en el libro *Las 50 Mejores Recetas del Día Mundial de la Arepa* hay muchas opciones para preparar, se encuentra disponible en *Amazon*.

> 5️⃣ Fill the beet arepas with your favorite filling. I filled mine with shredded chicken, cheese, and avocado slices; we also made a chorizo and avocado filling. Simply divine! But here on the blog, I’ve posted several types of fillings that go perfectly with these arepas. There are also many options to try in the book *The 50 Best Recipes for World Arepa Day*, available on *Amazon*. *** ![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23wCDrPwZaTx1RAM6ZxGz2CZPYqns5CBSZxhd1mzogNWZKjgb1hmnFqWptAu5SfvZA6JW.png) ***

> Estas arepas son muy fáciles de hacer, incluso puedes hacer la masa y medio cocinarlas un poco en la plancha o budare como para hacerle una media capa; luego la conservas en un envase con tapa en el congelador y ya las tienes listas para cualquier ocasión. Las cocinas en el budare o plancha por apropiadamente 12 a 15 minutos tapadas o si tienes freidora de aire las colocas ahí. Muchas gracias por leerme hasta aquí. ¿Haz probado las arepas a base de diferentes verduras? Me encanta leerte en los comentarios. Nos vemos en el próximo post con otra receta creativa.

> These arepas are very easy to make. You can even prepare the dough and partially cook them on a griddle or in a budare to form a thin crust; then store them in an airtight container in the freezer, and they’ll be ready for any occasion. Cook them on the budare or griddle for about 12 to 15 minutes, covered, or if you have an air fryer, place them in there. Thank you so much for reading this far. Have you tried arepas made with different vegetables? I love reading your comments. See you in the next post with another creative recipe. *** ![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23vsQPS5PKbqFi83pie1Hto5MKfBn62Yxgpo8oigGN4T8euN9TQAjbUqn4WEWLs4ZVooL.png) *** *Versión en inglés traducida con DeepL / English version translated with DeepL *100% contenido original / 100% original content. *Tomas realizadas con mi celular Nokia 2.3 / Shots taken with my Nokia 2.3 cell phone. *** ![banner.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luisacarola/23sxr5U7merW4D381Nx3vGwdkqEoy9iSYNyK5rwzVwogg1x5mkWd7KwPfV6ei4C84BHaS.gif)

body.title: When Love Asks Us to Walk Away
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW2ADQEzGRB4nMpQ3y1f2YKwwdLhYo1Fsj353jc2Ntgid/1780435976845.png)

Not every love story ends because two people stop caring about each other.

Sometimes we walk away because the other person does not feel the same way. We may love someone deeply, think about them every day, and imagine a future with them, yet their heart belongs somewhere else. No matter how sincere our feelings are, love cannot be forced.

Sometimes the timing is wrong. Two people may genuinely care for one another, but life places obstacles between them. Family expectations, distance, responsibilities, financial struggles, or different life goals can make a relationship impossible. In such cases, the goodbye is not caused by a lack of love but by circumstances beyond anyone's control.

There are also moments when fate seems to play its own game. Two people meet, connect, and understand each other in ways that are rare, yet they never get the chance to build a life together. They become a beautiful chapter rather than the whole story.

The hardest goodbyes are often not between people who hate each other. They happen between people who still care but know they cannot continue the journey together. Walking away in those situations requires courage because the heart wants to stay while reality demands otherwise.

That is why some goodbyes feel like sunsets. They are painful, yet beautiful. They remind us that not everything we love is meant to belong to us forever. Some people enter our lives to teach us something, help us grow, and leave behind memories that remain long after they are gone.

body.title: Freewriting Dailyprompt: not an ally
body.body:
Son, you are really going down. You are not doing well again. It's been so many years now and your life has not been progressing. So tell me about your friend. Who is that your friend, Chris? What is he up to?

I found out since when you guys came together. Nothing good has even come out of you guys. I thought he was your friend. I thought he was your hobby. Your body. But he kept introducing you to bad life. You kept going out more. You kept wasting your time going to parties, doing jobs.

I caught you some few times. I advise you some. Leave that to your friend. He is not an ally. He is just an enemy to these guys. He is going to worry you and he is going to bring you down so much. Don't allow him close to you. He is not adding any good to you. He is not useful to you.

I know you might feel that I am rebelling you but that is the best advice I can give you as a son.

Thank you very much, my son. Go and make me proud.

body.title: The Hardest Part of Business is Staying in Business
body.body:
> *I know lack of capital is the reason some people have not been able to start their own businesses, but then, we also have people who had the capital and still ended up shutting down after a few years. Starting a business is easier than maintaining one.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTfVy5Sd9zmzEqrfXpoMJXEXwuyxgVJX3jc8hVH3vzWrN/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/action-collaborate-collaboration-2277292/) *I have seen a lot of businesses close down for one reason or another*. *A woman started a drinks business, selling in wholesale quantities. Within two years, she got tired of everything and decided to quit. She complained that there were not enough customers, retailers were making more money than she was, and she constantly had to worry about products expiring.* *Just today, a lady shared the story of how she started and left three different businesses within six years.* *It is not really easy until you start one yourself.* *This is why I always look differently at people who say that lack of capital is the only thing stopping them from becoming successful. You can have the capital and still fumble it because some things are simply beyond your control.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmefbcf5Mzws8mpwtw32txyZomPgoH9ksqiNjSrdBV72LH/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/man-woman-business-people-business-76202/) **Reasons why some businesses fail in this era:** **Aesthetics Over Goods** *Some of us have come across videos on TikTok where people rent expensive shops and spend millions decorating them, only to end up stocking goods worth less than the amount they spent on rent, decoration, and their CEO's chair.* *This is one of the biggest killers of some businesses because they care more about appearances and how people see them than about selling products and making money.* *Sometimes, too much aesthetics can even drive potential customers away.* *A good example is a mini restaurant and a local “mama put.”* *In certain locations, a mama put is likely to sell more food than a fancy mini restaurant because people assume the food will be cheaper. Many people may not even enter your beautifully decorated restaurant because they automatically believe the food will be expensive.* *This is one reason why one person can make a lot of money from the food business while another person struggles with the same business*. **Competitors** *In my area, we have four people selling the same product in the same location.* *This alone creates a challenge because they all have to share the same customers. It can never be the same as having a single seller serve the entire community.* *And in some cases, competitors go to extreme lengths to force their rivals out of business.* **Management** *This is something I always advise people close to me: if possible, manage your business yourself because no one will take care of your business the same way you would.* *Many businesses have failed due to poor management and dishonest or greedy employees.* *Some workers do not care about the growth or success of the business. Their focus is simply on what they can gain from it, even if it means stealing from the owner or causing losses along the way.* *This is why business owners must be ready to monitor and supervise their businesses closely. Delegating responsibilities is important, but completely abandoning the day-to-day running of your business can be risky.* *Good management may not guarantee success, but poor management can destroy even a promising business.*

Black to play and win

Juegan negras y ganan

body.body:
> ‎Whenever students are seeking admission and they seem to be rushing towards a specific school compared to others, it makes you wonder what exactly is the cause of it. You might even think is some sort of rumor but every rumor has its own source. Every school has its own unique qualities, a fact that becomes known to many after it is too late to make a better choice. ‎ ‎A school is never just a school, each and every academic institution has spent years building their reputation, from their capabilities to impact knowledge and the structure created to ensure there is no room for malpractice. These things might just seem like in-house policy, but it is not. It becomes a known fact after a graduate use his/her certificate to seek employment, they you would see how these employers filter people based on the school they attended. ‎ ‎That is if you are lucky to know, they take one look at your certificate and they already have everything they need to know about the quality of education you have acquired. Every employer also have experience with these institutions and they have gathered enough knowledge, to know which institution has the capability to produce highly qualified students. ‎ ‎For a student, it might seem unfair and you might start thinking, didn't we learn the same thing in school, after all, I attended lectures like they did. The truth is, you are right but the fact that you didn't attend a specific group of institution that qualifies you as good as you believe yourself to be, it automatically disqualifies you. ‎ ‎What about the certificate they offer? There is this strange perspective most employer have about polytechnic students. Only became fully aware of it after I graduated. When i was doing my internship at Lagos traffic radio, I was just a national diploma student but i knew what I was capable of. Compared to people that attended universities and their certificate is already considered as a proof of what they are capable of. ‎ ‎For me, I had to consistently proof how good I was, before I was given the duty and respect I deserved. The funny part is, the practical knowledge known by most polytechnic students, supercede what was learnt by students from universities but I still don't know why most employer still choose to be blind to this. A lot of my friends had to consider direct entry and cross into university. After spending 2 years in polytechnic to acquire national diploma. ‎ ‎I had the opportunity but I didn't, I decided to acquire my higher national diploma. As if the stigma I once experienced wasn't bad enough, the HND  version was worst. The fact that HND is written on your certificate, not BSE, already place you in a difficult spot. A lot of my friends had to undergo a one year program called conversion, just to obtain BSE. I also considered it but eventually I didn't. ‎ ‎Not because I didn't want to and still might but it was because I just wasn't interested in hunting for a job with my certificate. I already had different side hustles. I decided to fully dive into entrepreneurship, and do things my own way. If I could go back in time and change the school I attended, would I? I think I would. I'm grateful for the knowledge acquired and I attended one of the most prestigious polytechnic in Nigeria but as long as what it offers is HND, is till doesn't change anything. ‎ ****** **** ‎_***This write-up was inspired by weekly featured content titled ***The school you go to*** in hive learners community.***_ ‎ ******* ****** ‎_***Cover image - [𝖣𝖾𝗌𝗂𝗀𝗇𝖾𝖽 𝗎𝗌𝗂𝗇𝗀 𝖼𝖺𝗇𝗏𝖺](https://canva.link/00v0l6dnadumuo5)***_ ****** ****** ‎ ‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNhTyUg4Aq2RTHWnTXsaS4758biE3M9xtHurNqYAe8XT/img_0.8353900969042101.jpg) ‎

body.title: 2-june-2026-freewriters-daily prompt : Not an ally
body.body:
He was standing still for so long that he didn't look like a living human anymore. He was like a dull version of himself. He wasn't thinking; his brain was frozen.

Who was this man?
Huh! Another somebody gotten beaten by life!

Suddenly, his legs started moving and independently sent him to a café where some of his friends hung out.

When he entered the place, suddenly his blood found its way to his brain. He started breathing. He looked around, searching for familiar faces.

He found one of his friends standing at the bar, drinking coffee and talking to the bartender.

His friend noticed him, stood up, and walked slowly toward him, as if he wanted to think about his behavior with his friend on the way.

\

The man always thought his friend talked too much, but at those moments it felt like his words magically gave back his ability to breathe and talk.

Those promising companies stole his money with their smooth-talking representatives and fancy offices. All of that was in the sky now.

He was a victim of his simplicity and of big frauds. The reality of  wolves scratched him, and he was bleeding.

He wasn't one of them.

He was just a poor victim.
