The Strength That Remains When Everything Else Disappears

What would you be willing to sacrifice for your family?

It is a question that seems simple until we truly stop and think about it. Many people would answer that they would give their time, their effort, or even their own dreams for the people they love. Others might not have an immediate answer, but they know there is something special about family: a connection that cannot always be explained with words, yet influences a large part of who we are.

We live in a time where people constantly talk about personal success, achieving individual goals, and building their own path. However, there are moments when life reminds us that no accomplishment carries the same meaning if there is no one to share it with. That is where family becomes something far greater than blood ties. It becomes our first home, our first team, and often the place where we learn life's most important lessons.

One of the stories that best represents this idea is that of House Stark in Game of Thrones. In a world where ambition, power, and betrayal seem to rule everyone's destiny, the Starks stand out for something different: the importance of staying united even when circumstances try to tear them apart.

When looking at the Stark family story, it is impossible not to reflect on the meaning of family. From an early age, Eddard Stark's children are raised with values that may sound simple today, but are actually very difficult to uphold: honor, loyalty, respect, and responsibility toward others. These principles do not guarantee them an easy life, but they give them an identity that remains even when everything around them changes.

What is most interesting is that this family's strength does not come from perfection. In fact, much of their story is marked by pain. They suffer losses, face injustice, are separated by war, and endure situations that would have destroyed many other families. Yet every hardship seems to remind them of who they are and where they come from.

Perhaps that is one of the greatest lessons the Stark family teaches us. The true importance of family is not measured when everything is going well. It is revealed during difficult times. When problems arise, when disappointments come, or when life takes an unexpected turn, that is when we truly understand the value of having people who remain by our side.

Each Stark family member follows a different path. Some fight to survive, others seek justice, and others simply try to find their place in the world. Yet despite how much their lives change, they all carry with them a part of what they learned at home. That connection becomes a compass that guides them even when they are completely alone.

And perhaps that is what makes this story so relatable to so many people. Beyond the dragons, wars, and kingdoms, the Stark story is about something deeply human. It is about the need to belong, to have roots, and to know that there are people who remind us who we are when we begin to forget it ourselves.

Family is not always perfect. There can be disagreements, arguments, and difficult moments. But its true value is not found in the absence of conflict; it is found in the ability to stay together despite it. The Starks teach us that the greatest strength does not come from power or wealth, but from the bonds we build with those who share our lives.

In the end, castles may fall, victories may fade, and the years may change everything. Yet the lessons, memories, and love of a family endure far longer than anything else. And perhaps that is why the Stark story remains so powerful: because it reminds us that in a world where so many things are temporary, family can become the strength that remains when everything else disappears.

La fuerza que permanece cuando todo lo demás desaparece
¿Qué estarías dispuesto a sacrificar por tu familia?
Es una pregunta que parece sencilla hasta que realmente nos detenemos a pensar en ella. Muchas personas responderían que darían su tiempo, su esfuerzo o incluso sus propios sueños por aquellos que aman. Otras quizás no tendrían una respuesta inmediata, pero saben que existe algo especial en la familia: una conexión que no siempre se puede explicar con palabras, pero que influye en gran parte de quienes somos.
Vivimos en una época donde se habla constantemente del éxito personal, de alcanzar metas individuales y de construir nuestro propio camino. Sin embargo, hay momentos en los que la vida nos recuerda que ningún logro tiene el mismo significado cuando no hay personas con quienes compartirlo. Ahí es donde la familia adquiere una importancia que va mucho más allá de los lazos de sangre. Se convierte en nuestro primer hogar, nuestro primer equipo y, muchas veces, en el lugar donde aprendemos las lecciones más importantes de la vida.
Una de las historias que mejor representa esta idea es la de la Casa Stark en la serie Game of Thrones. En un universo donde la ambición, el poder y las traiciones parecen gobernar el destino de todos, los Stark destacan por algo diferente: la importancia de mantenerse unidos incluso cuando las circunstancias intentan separarlos.
Al observar la historia de los Stark, resulta imposible no reflexionar sobre el significado de la familia. Desde pequeños, los hijos de Eddard Stark crecen escuchando valores que hoy pueden parecer simples, pero que en realidad son profundamente difíciles de mantener: el honor, la lealtad, el respeto y la responsabilidad hacia los demás. Son principios que no les garantizan una vida fácil, pero sí les dan una identidad que permanece incluso cuando todo a su alrededor cambia.
Lo más interesante es que la fuerza de esta familia no nace de la perfección. De hecho, gran parte de su historia está marcada por el dolor. Sufren pérdidas, enfrentan injusticias, son separados por la guerra y viven situaciones que habrían destruido a muchas otras familias. Sin embargo, cada experiencia difícil parece recordarles quiénes son y de dónde vienen.
Quizás esa sea una de las mayores enseñanzas que deja la familia Stark. La verdadera importancia de una familia no se mide cuando todo va bien. Se descubre en los momentos difíciles. Cuando aparecen los problemas, cuando llegan las decepciones o cuando la vida toma un rumbo inesperado, es entonces cuando comprendemos el valor de tener personas que permanecen a nuestro lado.
Cada miembro de los Stark emprende un camino diferente. Algunos buscan sobrevivir, otros buscan justicia y otros simplemente intentan encontrar su lugar en el mundo. Pero, aunque sus vidas cambian constantemente, todos conservan una parte de aquello que aprendieron en su hogar. Esa conexión se convierte en una brújula que los guía incluso cuando están completamente solos.
Y tal vez eso sea lo que hace que esta historia resulte tan cercana para tantas personas. Porque, más allá de los dragones, las guerras y los reinos, la historia de los Stark habla de algo profundamente humano. Habla de la necesidad de pertenecer, de tener raíces y de saber que existen personas que nos recuerdan quiénes somos cuando nosotros mismos empezamos a olvidarlo.
La familia no siempre es perfecta. Puede haber diferencias, discusiones y momentos difíciles. Pero su verdadero valor no está en la ausencia de conflictos, sino en la capacidad de permanecer unidos a pesar de ellos. Los Stark nos enseñan que la fortaleza más grande no proviene del poder ni de la riqueza, sino de los lazos que construimos con quienes compartimos nuestra vida.
Al final, los castillos pueden derrumbarse, las victorias pueden desaparecer y los años pueden cambiarlo todo. Sin embargo, las enseñanzas, los recuerdos y el amor de una familia permanecen mucho más tiempo que cualquier otra cosa. Y quizás por eso la historia de los Stark sigue siendo tan poderosa: porque nos recuerda que, en un mundo donde muchas cosas son temporales, la familia puede convertirse en la fuerza que permanece cuando todo lo demás desaparece.

--- - **Cortamos y doblamos las pestañas** --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uFM2y8AxmUy7UR2PkpNa5njFuX32FJEMukTdy1m79gbbgr8Bt335652XicgnrKgiFZe.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tH1RSeGYQZAE6ZjVZE5Manmj95tkb9DkD7PYx7v9MXeq2mL7uL2zqAZDSrVjAC5ZDiB.png) |-|-| --- - **Doblamos y pegamos por la contraparte** ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tmBQZNkX7P4g4GaVQKf7q9hErpFewRzcaEkYsXyusZRpnn66eVVYNU8HAiL2f45cZwJ.png)
Este armado lo aremos con ambas partes, confieso que me costo un poco, sobre todo la parte del medio, allí hay que hacer un ajuste, o estar pendiente de hacer bien el recorte y el pegado, pero bueno, si sale nuestra cajita, pequeña con estas medidas, habría que ver como hacen para que les salga mas grande, supongo que al momento de imprimir se puede pedir de otra forma. 😕
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23ywq81EeStznq5J7xHHqYqn2b5xpXDMnC2Szhw7gWXppp9UDBHdwoYp2zcdLeZQh9Add.png)
Bueno se los dejo de tarea jeje, mientras aquí seguimos aprendiendo y mejorando, esperemos, cualquier recomendación, quedo atenta.😉 ---
ENGLISH VERSION

Creative friends, it’s a pleasure to share with you again. Father’s Day is just around the corner, and many of you are already getting ready to give gifts on that special day. Now that we can do everything digitally and create those special little gifts in such a modern way, well, I’m still making my little boxes. A few days ago I shared the template with you; that’s where I was starting out, first creating this template so I could then put together the design and print it. You can see it

> here . At that point, I was experimenting, testing the shape and measurements. This way, I could get an idea of how my box would turn out. However, I’m still making a few tweaks, looking for ways to improve it so that everything fits with the same measurements, but above all, so it’s easy to cut out and assemble. ---
![post hive (91).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xLFqXMLouXJFsxXWHwXtopAptfJ1cWDnpEzFf6YfP4dzk38WpkEmBjfu25hpeK1uH17.png)
I made that template in Canva; I still need to get the hang of the measurements—it’s something that confuses me—but hey, I’m still learning. Once the template was finished, I started putting together the design—something simple—so I could print it out and see how the box would turn out. --- I printed it on photo paper, and I noticed it came out small—very small, haha. As I said, getting the measurements right isn’t easy, and to make it bigger, I think it would require more pages. Since I don’t have a printer, I have to make do with these sizes.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo238QcPwEfWqao9hTATeFCEnnMB3eakRRagDXhgf7CmB3DQSdBo2E7myZunZnkHHwS.png)
## How to make it: *To make this, you will need*: - **Printed paper** - **Scissors** - **Glue stick** - **Ruler** ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo4AeJ7LkbehUQkTfaSKr57weA7rz8b3x5WLhN19ghv1YJpmgEq8966AoGJq2rro6en.png)
--- - **Cut and fold the tabs** --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uFM2y8AxmUy7UR2PkpNa5njFuX32FJEMukTdy1m79gbbgr8Bt335652XicgnrKgiFZe.png) |![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tH1RSeGYQZAE6ZjVZE5Manmj95tkb9DkD7PYx7v9MXeq2mL7uL2zqAZDSrVjAC5ZDiB.png) |-|-| --- - **Fold and glue along the fold line** ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tmBQZNkX7P4g4GaVQKf7q9hErpFewRzcaEkYsXyusZRpnn66eVVYNU8HAiL2f45cZwJ.png)
We’ll assemble this using both parts. I’ll admit it was a bit tricky for me, especially the middle section—you have to make an adjustment there, or be careful to cut and glue it just right. But anyway, if our little box turns out with these measurements, I wonder how they manage to make it bigger. I suppose you can request a different format when printing. 😕
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23ywq81EeStznq5J7xHHqYqn2b5xpXDMnC2Szhw7gWXppp9UDBHdwoYp2zcdLeZQh9Add.png)
Well, I’ll leave that as homework for you, hehe. In the meantime, we’ll keep learning and improving here—let’s hope so. Any recommendations? I’m all ears.😉

body.title: Maybe Africa Is Changing - Turning Resources Into Industrial Strength
body.body:
/></center>

[source](https://www.facebook.com/sa.rainbow.nation1994/posts/here-is-a-list-of-top-10-african-countries-rich-in-natural-resources-1-south-afr/1532455028887490/)

**Over the decades Africa has been looted for it's raw materials due to corruption. Corruption still exists, but the thought process of how the selling of the raw materials is changing. The time has come for Africa to be the manufacturing hub bringing the factories to the raw materials or no supply.**





Africa for decades has been the continent that exports all their raw materials and then imports finished products. This makes no logical sense because manufacturing the product at source would be benefitting those countries far more than a raw material price.

Over the last few months there has been a change of thinking which is one positive that came about when the Straits of Hormuz was shut down. Countries that were exporting crude oil like Nigeria, Ghana and Angola and then importing  finished fuel diesel and petrol for only marginal gains. Nigeria have recently started up their Dangote oil refinery which once expanded doubling it's capacity turn the country into an exporter and not an importer of fuels.

Last year Nigeria imported $1.4 billion of refined petroleum products from the UK which makes very little financial sense. When the Dangote oil refinery began operations back in 2024 this is the start of the turning point making the country self reliant. Why would you ever export a product knowing you will be importing the finished product at a higher price instead of doing the refining yourself. Where Nigeria sits in the middle of Africa they are ideally situated to not only supply Africa, but Europe as well.

Angola has refineries but currently many of those refineries were built using Chinese funding and that debt owed is paid using crude oil. China accounts for 52% of all Angola's crude oil sales, but times are changing. With the Straights of Hormuz closed the opportunity for Angola to become a major player  in supply is happening. Currently Angola has 2 small refineries capable of processing 70K barrels per day but have plans to process 400K barrels per day.

Ghana has also woken up and seen the light realizing that exporting crude is not the smartest move and they need to create value through job creation and refine locally. Ghana for too long has been dependent on imports when it could just do the job themselves instead of sending the crude away. The short term plan is to process 100K barrels per day.

India has been negotiating to buy crude oil from all 3 as they were warned about consequences of buying cheap Russian crude. Buying from Africa was just the logical next step but for how long. With Africa gearing up and being a much shorter distance to market for Europe India would only be left with supplying the Far East or in less of a demand in Europe.

It is not just oil and the change in thinking keeping the crude oil in house, but with other raw materials as well. South Africa and the EU had it's first expo in Johannesburg looking to find alternative raw material suppliers away from China. South Africa has made it clear this week the EU is welcome to purchase the raw materials if the materials are processed in SA and not as a raw material export.

> “Our objective is not to export raw minerals. Our objective is beneficiation, processing, and industrial development,” South African Trade Minister Parks Tau said.

South Africa has an estimated 1700 EU companies operating in the country already and the EU is SA's largest trading partner. For too long African countries have given away their wealth with no real benefits and SA with the high unemployment rate things have to drastically change. It is hard to think of any product that is manufactured locally for export when the country should be self reliant benefiting from all the local resources the country has. The resources is what the other countries need and finally deals can be made bringing manufacturing and industrialization back.

Not long ago I wrote about Chinas new 5 year plan and on this they stated self reliance. The need not to rely on imported raw materials and finding alternative alloys or new developed materials as the window in importing all those raw materials is definitely closing. This has to be seen as really good news because Africa should be a very wealthy continent and not the begging basket they have become.

links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmecTzb7EonPV2CKE53a5n5gJAnPt5gqdcVyyTFUT5tAfB/img_3960.png)
_____________________________________________________
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYFjbbdi1heDQzhU9Nk92dWzqVbiQgyPK1aqH2ertihFe/img_3961.png)
_____________________________________________________
Does super league have a normal match???
Let’s find out…….

Super League - My Reality Check

I honestly thought Super League on eFootball was all virtual. In my head, I’d just set my squad, choose a coach, pick my tactics, and then sit back while the system runs the match. First half score pops up, halftime comes, then full time result. No control, no pressure. That’s how I played it at first and it felt calm, like managing from the bench.

Then I got matched with Manchester City and everything changed. I’m Arsenal, so it already felt like a derby before kickoff. But this one wasn’t virtual at all. It went physical. I had to play it like a normal match - dribble, pass, shoot, defend, everything. I scored first and got excited, but after that my game just fell apart. My passes kept getting cut off, bad timing every time. I smashed the crossbar more than 4 times because I rushed my shots or didn’t aim right. Every miss annoyed me more.

We ended up 1:1 and I was so frustrated. I should’ve won that game. That match opened my eyes to how Super League really works. Some games are virtual, yeah, but others put you on the pitch and it’s just your skills talking. No system to blame. That draw taught me I need to work on my shooting and passing if I want to compete in the physical ones.

links.title: This Month's Chess Bots: Out of This World (Also powered up 15 HIVE)
links.body:
![1000023530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hazem91/23vhqZwPwGtrn4A4juBVYozjc7n7aDhEUXzcihabrDK7mVWep2fd2WUFjyj3bkD7EmiHK.jpg)
![1000023551.jpg](image-2-1000023551.jpg)

As I posted earlier, chess.com (my favorite chess app) gives us new fun chess bots every month with a fun theme. This month's theme is \

And to spice things up even more, they made a game inside the game. Everytime you beat a bot you get some points and you get rewards everytime you reach a milestone.

# It starts with Rooky, a reference to Rocky from the movie \

I happen to have watched the movie a few days earlier so seeing Rooky succeeded to put a smile on my face.

Rooky is a friendly bot who is programmed to talk like Rocky but isn't as smart. It plays the first four to five moves of a real opening then it starts blundering fast.

![1000023533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hazem91/EokfaNhg3yiA9MhETuAdaqDYJSnAMgmmtcT8qjGJMgLE6mfBL4qZxeY2ojTRrvWTfxb.jpg)

# Next there's Chessbacca, a reference to Chewbacca from Star Wars.

Another smile on my face because I love Star Wars.

Chessbacca doesn't chat much it only roars. Or maybe it speaks Wookie, but I can't understand it(probably asking for a rematch here?). It plays better than Rooky but it also blunders fast and hard. Winning it gives more points, so I played a few games against it and unlocked the first gift.



![1000023496.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hazem91/23xybov94NpGR2nF9tMdAiekx3p6yVJ7HjY98r2NMpm4EggdDkPHwtteKu2v4hdFJNwpH.jpg)

# Then comes Gambita and The Green Spawn

I don't know what these bots are referencing. Tell me in the comments if you know american cinema more than me (A guy from Tunisia).
Those weren't so friendly in chat. Menacing to invade Earth if I lose to them. Thankfully I didn't. I managed to beat them both from the first try, to win my second gift and move to the real challenge.

![1000023535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hazem91/EoiY45o1rA4woZK4ZyNn4TiQnGvvjC3xcW7dcQCDcyiQWoywU6cuc99CzSmSd88jdZ6.jpg)

# Finally there's Human Danny

I think I watched the movie they are referencing here but I can't remember its name. It's about an alien that kills humans and impersonates them or something like that. It's a quite old movie if I'm not wrong.

If I **have** to guess the character I'd say it's not the main character of a movie but rather a side story. Maybe from Men In Black or something. Correct me if I'm wrong.

### Danny speaks like a dumb alien life form that fails to pretend it's Human.

![1000023534.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hazem91/EoAd4BE9LYfoiNGjfi5FHqF7SK5xWGkwPhUcECe5cZHSW9RmwsKuGTgPgCL9g7DN2oa.jpg)


 ## It's chess though is not so dumb.


It took me a lot of tries to beat this bot fair a square.

I'm saying this because I manage to beat it when I use take-backs. Meaning when I make a mistake that I know is a mistake, the bot lets me take back the moves and continue the game. I played thirteen game against the bot, winning some of them thanks to takebacks, before I managed to beat it in the forteenth game.

That's how I got the ultimate gift and the chessboard will looks like this when I play during this month.


It was a fun experience overall. Especially when I was beating the easy first bots. It got a little stressful and challenging by the time I got to Danny. But that's part of learning chess. You hit obstacles and you overcome them.

![1000023513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hazem91/23uEwyqSQVEAxXaYX2ieDDeGpbPTxpB9JponZSv2KB2DdvBZTD5wDgXCVMMhkHXZRhC84.jpg)

![1000023518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hazem91/23tSWKprp6r8uPnLgMmxH2vD8jHpN43EFuB73UpzEaqDLzZTgo2SnPKDpiYCBCsJT6HNo.jpg)

In the end to participate in this month's HPUD, I decided to power up 15 HIVE (screeshot below) and I'm thinking about making it a habit to power up some hive everytime I make a post. I've seen some people do it and I like it.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hazem91/23u6ai5ALcBx7DWY3oinQmbEJRmw2Etn2YW3wX1WCNEongxwDPih9jLpgtKZoe8hG41HX.png)

links.body:
In the journey of life, there are some people who are meant to be with you for a short period of time, some are meant for a season, while some are meant to stay with you throughout your existence. The day we succeed to realize this fact is when we would cease to hold unto people who takes the exit path from our lives as a sign of an end to their regime.

![1000719067.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23vYjtJHhXNPjyuYuHt8k3FfSXMi9WERo1QoDaYwutpKdzmZfYxs7WaUyAD5iedvqs1zB.jpg)

No matter what may happen and how funny humans may be, there will still be those set of people that has come to stay permanently in your life to support you and be with you through thick and thin and that person is my Dad.

My Dad has been my greatest supporter through thick and thin and as we would call fathers in my tribe as **MIRRORS **, he's a mirror that mirrors support to me. 
Just when you might begin to think as you read through that **\

** since I'm his daughter then I'm glad to let you know that there are many responsible fathers out there who won't still support a child when they are not bringing food to their tables just like I heard from a woman one day saying **\

links.title: Technology Is Changing Jobs, But Not Opportunity
links.body:
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rayhanhiveman/23w2kpaTTs1oiXqeEPxfmN4oA1eWAKt92jCbHsxZDbBMPWiLVy7EXuDeAmQUxqWuy8vW8.jpg)

Technologies are evolving very faster than before this creates a concern for many people. Everyone is worried if their job will still exist in 10 years? As a businessman I have different kind of thoughts. I believe that some jobs may disappear and it's a good sign because there will be countless new opportunities. At the age of 50 I have seen enough, with my experience I can already tell that technology has changed the way people work now. I think there's nothing to worry about. We should think about how to make an use of the new opportunities. 

Back in the past, it would take hours for a task to complete, but now in 2026 we can use technologies and within few seconds with the help artificial intelligence we can easily complete the tasks faster. People in business they prefer to use automation to reduce costs and improve efficiency. Because of this some traditional jobs may become less common in the future.

Also, I do not think that technologies will be able to replace the humans. As we know, machines can do repetitive tasks, but they can't  create new ones because are not creative. Only a human being has that kind of capabilities. A machine can not do the leadership or solve problems in real life they can only solve maths. Machines can not understand emotions or feel it. In the end these skills will remain valuable no matter how advanced technology becomes.

People think that there will be a disaster if the jobs does not last long, because they are afraid of the adaption. They were not taught you adapt with the current environment as everyone focuses on only one career. But those people who wants to continue learning new skills they will easily adapt with the situation and have higher chances of succeeding. If the world of work is changing, people must be willing to change with it otherwise it's going to be a big loss for them. We should always educate ourselves even if we have graduated, we should have knowledge about new technologies, staying relevant is the only solution to face the future.

As a perspective of a businessman, I see more opportunities than threats. In Bangladesh people only see doctor, engineering as a career but there's more carers now which was not available 10 years ago, for example we have careers such as media manager, online photographer,AI specialist, content creator, influencer, etc. Youngsters are already adapting these careers at an early age and became successful. So, the same thing will happen in after 10 years.

So, even if the jobs continue to change we should be able to adapt. Taking precautions can give us the probability of high success. So, we need to be flexible, always stay ready for new opportunities and not worry.

While trying to connect my headset to the computer, I realized I need to buy a Bluetooth adapter. Just then, I remembered I had to pick up my son from school, and you know what? Being absent-minded is an everyday occurrence for me. I ended up arriving an hour early, and here I am, writing this from a park in the La Unión neighborhood of Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. 
Something I really love—and for the better—is the ability to post from this app from anywhere in the world, with just an internet connection.
___
Intentando conectar mi auricular con la computadora me di cuenta que tengo que comprar un adaptador de bluetooth. En ese momento me acuerdo que tengo que ir a buscar a mi hijo al colegio y saben qué, la falta de atención es algo de todos los días. Llegué llegué una hora antes y acá estoy escribiendo estas líneas desde una plaza en el barrio de la Unión de la provincia de Buenos Aires Argentina. 
Algo que me encanta y para bien es la posibilidad de realizar una publicación desde esta aplicación desde el cualquier lugar del mundo, con tan solo una conexión a internet.

links.body: Hi to all! After a very difficult period, in April I have been in Philippines and Borneo with @mauro-debettio Participating in this journey through the Philippines and Borneo was an intense and deeply authentic experience. From the sea-dwelling communities to the residents of Manila’s cemeteries, and the procession and crucifixion in the northern Philippines, every moment offered profound emotions and extraordinary photographic opportunities. More than a workshop: a human journey that changes you from within and leaves you with unforgettable images and memories. I have chosen only three pictures to show, taken in Borneo. It has been like a dream to be there!

/> Italian translation: Aver partecipato a questo viaggio nelle Filippine e nel Borneo è stata un’esperienza intensa e autentica. Dalle comunità sul mare agli abitanti dei cimiteri di Manila, fino alla processione e crocifissione nel nord delle Filippine, ogni momento ha regalato emozioni profonde e incredibili opportunità fotografiche. Più di un workshop: un viaggio umano che ti cambia dentro e ti lascia immagini e ricordi impossibili da dimenticare.

links.title: Authorities Want To Have Their Cake And Eat It Too
links.body: ![Refuser0786 is the author of this picture/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2021/05/28/07/36/cakes-6290100_1280.jpg) A news story has come out of Utah in which a 14-year-old boy fought off a mugger and assailant insofar as the attacker ultimately died, but the police and prosecutors turned against this poor young boy despite that he had defended himself against a violent crime. In his video below, Norman Michael Achin provides all the details of this news story. Norman Michael Achin Reports That The Authorities Railroaded A 14-Year-Old Boy In Utah For Defending Himself Against Violent Crime https://youtu.be/xC_jvreBE-Y?si=uEDOadRhQBy4Wc5w Fortunately, the police and the prosecutors there in Utah who railroaded the 14-year-old boy have been caught up in their own vicious game, and now they are going to have to answer up to the system themselves. In other words, they will not be getting away with what they did to this young boy, and this young boy will finally be getting his justice. The point that Mr. Achin makes in his video above about the double standard with American statutory-rape laws is valid. Police and prosecutors here in our nation want to have their cake and eat it too. Our criminal justice system will treat a 22-year-old woman who has consensual sexual relations with a 14-year-old boy as a dangerous criminal and charge her with statutory rape no matter how harmless her relationship with him is. However, on the other hand, when a 14-year-old boy defends himself against a violent mugger and assailant who is armed with a deadly weapon, the police and prosecutors will treat the criminal like the victim. How does any of this same stuff make any sense? As Mr. Achin said, how can the former scenario really be worse than the latter scenario as described above? Now, I understand that the assailant ultimately died after the 14-year-old boy fought back against him. However, nobody could have expected for that young boy simply to do nothing while that lowlife tried to overpower him. His actions constituted justifiable homicide in that the assailant was armed with a deadly weapon, and he should never have been arrested in the first place. The people this young boy was locked up with were likely just as undesirable as the mugger and assailant that tried to rob him was. But what did the police and the prosecutors care? They merely wanted to railroad him every way they could. Ladies and gentlemen? This is the kind of crap that has been going on in our criminal justice system for way too long. Internal affairs divisions in police departments throughout the United States and state bars in every jurisdiction of our nation are not doing enough to put a stop to this same kind of corruption. body.title: Freewrite Dailyprompt: Not An Ally
body.body:
I trusted him with all my heart. I loved him.
I gave him my body, gave him my soul, gave him all that I have. But he still went and betrayed me, cheated on me, lied on me, broke my heart. And took everything from me, my trust and everything.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQL23pNj78quLTnHKEkYeqktP62n6QKTrHLd8zUdSG3AT/1780429770336.jpg)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/breakup-separation-heartbreak-8359423/)

Now I'm pained. I thought he was a friend.
But now I knew he's not an ally, but just an enemy that wanted to steal away my joy and my soul. I became depressed for months and years. I'm just recovering.

I've never experienced this kind of heartbeat before. I pray I heal fully. I've been laying curse on him, but I just have to let go because life does not end here. I just have to keep pushing, doing my best, doing what I know how to do best. And nothing more, nothing less. I wish him all the best. And I keep doing my best and trying to improve my life because God knows why this happens all the time.

body.title: Being An Entrepreneur.
body.body:
Entrepreneurship will test every part of your existence. It would test more that your creative, it will rest your patience, faith, resilience, and mental strength.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNVtQqZ3ziBj7aj1Qoy8XA9rDM3BZQAAY4YGgmSrxDZQe/1780433752324.jpg)
>Entrepreneurship will test your mental health.


People feel that being an entrepreneur is so easy and not had stressful as the 9_5 jobs. That's isn't true at all.

The journey is filled with uncertainty. One where you can do everything right and still not know where and when your next client will come from.

As an entrepreneur, the goal is to make profit, but before making that profit as a business owner, you automatically become the manager, marketer, receptionist, stock keeper, content creator and even more just to keep the business alive.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTGtbEB5FR2UYWZ5rDd1fYyrHjBQoPi5oewJWegDUAwAi/1780433841062.jpg)
>There will be days when you will feel like quitting 



Some days, you work consistently for weeks or even months and see little or no results. You go home exhausted, wondering if all your efforts are worth it,or if should just quit and look for a job.
One of the hardest part of being an entrepreneur is the unpredictability.




And that's why I always say consistency alone is not enough. Consistency is important, but businesses also need financial support, resources, visibility, and opportunities to grow.


Unlike a 9_5 where the structure is static and payday is predictable. Entrepreneurship feels like building a road while still driving on it.



You are constantly creating, solving problems, taking risks, and figuring things out as you go.


Entrepreneurship can be rewarding, but  honestly ,it can also be mentally draining.

body.title: Three Tune Tuesday – Recordando a Marilyn Monroe, en su centenario
body.body:
Hace ya 100 años nació una de las mujeres más fascinantes del siglo XX: [Marilyn Monroe](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marilyn_Monroe) (1 de junio de 1926). Ella, quien fuera actriz y modelo, se convirtió en un icono de la cultura del espectáculo, tanto por sus apariciones en el cine,como por su indudable sensualidad, que fuera aprovechada publicitariamente. Fabricada como símbolo sexual y mito moderno, se quiso solamente promocionarla cual emblema de la frivolidad, la “rubia tonta”; sin embargo, muchos han visto en ella y en su trágica pérdida una expresión del desenfreno del mundo comercial, ocultando a la verdadera Norma Jeane Baker, con sus heridas de adolescente, sus fracasos amorosos, su soledad y su visión y práctica feminista. A esa Marilyn consagró el poeta nicaragüense Ernesto Cardenal su hermoso poema [Oración por Marilyn Monroe](https://ciudadseva.com/texto/oracion-por-marilyn-monroe/).
![Marilyn Monroe.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23xKvd2RrQ2vcJNhF7g8PeYMJ3gT8NKxv8h1inWhoura8w4VyjH6X3mLbvto4j2JRBzG9.png)
[Fuente](https://mx.pinterest.com/pin/508836457944688087/)

Fui uno de sus enamorados, como muchos otros. Quise recordarla por algunas de sus canciones –aunque no fue exactamente una cantante–, presentes en varias de las películas que protagonizó.
Every Baby Needs A Daddy (Sub. Español) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_8gMz_pKQKU Película: Ladies of the Chorus (1949)
Lazy https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3x28sT--W4Q Película: There's No Business Like Show Business (1954)
I wanna be loved by you (Sub. Español) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o4qw44Ypvoo Película: Some Like It Hot (1959)
![Vector música-cine.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23xAVKwMuyipzZ4Jy5TvAqF2XKbtd87ujc9vhrZUuKDBpn9W9Nhg3D2uhS1Snpg2y1ZC8.jpg)

[Una buena colección de fotos relativas a Marilyn Monroe](https://www.clarin.com/fotogalerias/dia-hoy-nacia-marilyn-monroe-emblema-revolucion-sexual-epoca-mujer-cambio-hollywood_5_vmVi050KI6.html). [Interesante artículo de la BBC](https://www.bbc.com/mundo/articles/ckgp13e1z96o). body.title: Mi Pueblo de Fiesta Desfile del Natalicio de Villa de Cura . My Town Celebrates Birthday Parade of Villa de Cura
body.body: /> * * * Saludos a los creadores de contenidos, especialmente a la prestigiosa comunidad de EspaVlog. Qué gusto volver a saludarlos y traerles un pedacito de la alegría, el color y la profunda identidad cultural que se vive en las calles de mi amado pueblo, Villa de Cura, en el estado Aragua. _Greetings to all content creators, especially to the prestigious EspaVlog community. What a pleasure to greet you again and bring you a piece of the joy, color, and deep cultural identity that is lived in the streets of my beloved town, Villa de Cura, Aragua state._ * * *

/> ### Tradición, Color y Orgullo Local / _Tradition, Color and Local Pride_ En esta ocasión, tuve la maravillosa oportunidad de salir a la avenida principal equipado con mi teléfono Redmi A5 para capturar y registrar los mejores momentos del gran desfile escolar e institucional con motivo de la celebración del Natalicio de nuestro pueblo. Es un evento que año tras año paraliza de orgullo a toda la localidad, y este año no fue la excepción. _On this occasion, I had the wonderful opportunity to go out to the main avenue equipped with my Redmi A5 phone to capture and record the best moments of the great school and institutional parade celebrating the Birthday of our town. It is an event that year after year fills the entire locality with pride, and this year was no exception._ * * *

/> En el desfile, absolutamente todas las escuelas e instituciones educativas estuvieron presentes para dicha celebración. Lo más hermoso de la jornada fue ver cómo cada plantel se esmeró por presentar un motivo completamente referente a las costumbres, la artesanía y la historia de Villa de Cura. _In the parade, absolutely all schools and educational institutions were present for this celebration. The most beautiful part of the day was seeing how each school strove to present a theme completely related to the customs, crafts, and history of Villa de Cura._ * * *

/> El ingenio popular se desbordó en las calles; muchísimos estudiantes y participantes se disfrazaron de personajes históricos de nuestra independencia, así como de personajes locales emblemáticos que forman parte del ADN y del folklore de nuestro municipio. Desde las representaciones de nuestras raíces indígenas hasta las tradiciones religiosas y musicales, cada comparsa fue un viaje al pasado y un homenaje a lo que somos. _Popular ingenuity overflowed in the streets; many students and participants dressed up as historical characters from our independence, as well as emblematic local characters that are part of the DNA and folklore of our municipality. From the representations of our indigenous roots to religious and musical traditions, each group was a journey to the past and a tribute to who we are._ * * *

/>

Poder documentar estas expresiones con mi dispositivo móvil y compartirlas en plataformas Web3 es un verdadero honor. Los invito a disfrutar de este resumen en video que preparé con mucho cariño para resaltar la identidad de nuestra gente. ¡Espero que les guste! Nos leemos en los comentarios.

_Being able to document these expressions with my mobile device and share them on Web3 platforms is a true honor. I invite you to enjoy this video summary that I prepared with a lot of love to highlight the identity of our people. I hope you like it! See you in the comments._

body.title: Another Month of Reading More, Scrolling Less
body.body: >Image made by me using ChatGPT I felt the month of May flew by, maybe the end of another Football season and the build-up to the much-anticipated FIFA World Cup could be a reason why, at least for me anyway. Despite this month going by quickly, I managed to continue chipping away at my 2026 reading goal of reading 30 books for 2026. This is, of course, my first year of committing to a reading goal and at first I thought 30 would be too high, but it seems 20-30 is the average I see amongst users on book tracking platforms like Goodreads, Fable and StoryGraph. I would rather a challenge too, as I want to push myself.

>

Using both Fable and Goodreads as my two book logging apps, I can easily keep tabs on how I am doing. Goodreads feels outdated but is very popular amongst readers, and despite its flaws, it remains simple to use. Fable, despite its smaller community, has a focus on connecting readers with its book clubs and chat rooms and with a fresher UI compared to Goodreads, I decided to use that too. The photo above is my monthly recap of May from Fable. In May, I found myself reading a variety. Despite Piers Morgan being a very controversial gentleman, I found his book rather insightful into the world of politics and the crazy stuff going on in the US. Another book I read was by Ant Middleton, another controversial gentleman, but with Ant serving in the UK forces for many years, I wanted insight into his mind and his advice on how to achieve things. This read was brilliant. Last on the list is from someone whom I had not really heard about, but Andy Wilman was the man who created the Top Gear people love today and the more recent show The Grand Tour. This was my favourite read of all, it had everything.

For the most part, I am on track to hit my goal. I am a little shocked to be doing this well, but I am thankful, and with some recent changes and habit adjustments, I am actually now confident in hitting this goal. In the past week, I have been speaking to a colleague at work who told me about a series of books and now films called The Hunger Games (yes, I confess I have been living under a rock as I have not read any of the books or seen any of the films). After her talking them up, I gave in and have added all the books to my read list and the films to my watch list. As of writing this post, I am 75% through the first book, so it should be finished very soon. Then I can either watch the first film or read the second book; I am still unsure of the order to do them in. Another part of my reading list includes many books by Jeremy Clarkson; these feature articles he wrote for various newspapers (The Sunday Times) in his early career, during his years on Top Gear, and even now in his farming era. I found his more recent books very enjoyable, and despite his older books possibly being outdated and maybe no longer relevant to today's world, I want to read them regardless. Lastly, I have a big list of Stephen King novels to get through. I am loving Pet Semetary and IT, but both I have yet to finish One of the book clubs I am a member of in Fable is dedicated to books by Stephen King, so that will get me into reading more from him.

Safe to say, I have many, many books to read, so I am definitely not short on inspiration. With my financial situation and current lifestyle, I had to make sacrifices and adjustments, and reading is something that has actually benefited a lot from it. I cancelled most of my streaming subscriptions, keeping to just one compared to the 4-5 I had at the start of the year. Honestly, I am glad I don't watch TV as much; I enjoy using the time to be productive, outdoors, or, in the event I want to crash on the sofa, I actually enjoy grabbing a book and relaxing. I have also set time limits on the very few social media platforms I have and have deleted some too, so instead of doomscrolling and wasting time reading what is often fake news or petty drama, I am reading. I also make sure, regardless of whether I have already read that day or not, I read at least one page when I am in bed. Doing this helps me get off my phone earlier, and most of the time I read more than one page. I have also found that it helps me fall asleep quicker, but that could also be the Magnesium Vitamin doing its thing. Lastly, I now bring my Kindle everywhere. It's so easy to carry in a small pocket compared to a heavy book, and it is easy to pull out to read if I am waiting around or stopping for coffee.

Going forward for this Month, I want to try to take advantage of my recent changes and see if I can read 4 books for the month. I am pushing myself that little bit extra. Not to the point of burnout or something I can't maintain, but just a small push that brings me out of my comfort zone.

This month I would like to explore the Book communities Hive has to offer, as this is an area I have not really looked into as yet. I would also like to sort out my bookshelf at home and have a physical pile of books to read and a finished pile of books that I can maybe swap out, give away to charity or, if it is a book I really like, then maybe a showcase area on my shelf.

With that, I conclude today's post, but I will leave links to my Fable and Goodreads below. Thank you for reading.

body.title: School Is Not School!!!
body.body:
![Blue Abstract Corporate YouTube Thumbnail (49).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQNzfZnbu2w8vLEqGT9NBtaSzccX2foJqrrqLyHkm8ZR4bLVwftznZJR6ZrmijnhDE3.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) Yeah, the school you go to matters a lot, not because of the academic knowledge that you’ll get there, because that is the easiest thing to acquire in school. The electrical engineering that you study in one university will be the same as that which you study in another. No difference. Unless one university has terrible lecturers and an outdated scheme of work, but other than that, it should be quite easy to do the same thing across several universities and colleges. This is why a certified engineer is not asked what school he went to, because as long as he has the certificate to prove it, it doesn’t matter if he learned it in Maiduguri or Lagos, the outcome is the same. Students in both states learned the same thing, and any differences observed would solely be on the students themselves or on the lecturers. But not the system. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) But sadly, this is where the similarities stop. Because every other thing you learn or acquire in the university depends largely on the school you attend, it can determine the environment you’ll be exposed to. It also determines the people you get to meet and how these connections will shape your future. It’s safe to say that if you didn’t go to the school that you did, you would never have met the people you actually met there, and every decision you’ve ever made based on those connections will be gone as well. Replaced my different people and different choices. Take me, for instance, I was still a student when I was introduced to Hive. If I hadn’t gone to Nekede, I would never have met the guy who introduced me. But then, since I’m a writer, and I’ve always wanted to earn from writing, I may have found out about it eventually. But this friend cut through all that red tape, and I had smooth sailing during my early days on this platform. If I hadn’t come to Nekede, I probably wouldn’t be a moderator today. ![IMG_20231030_153635~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23wM4MquN6KCtDcG5HJQCHUbYg1Tmthc7GeMpFU18NNXN1v6p9dcFqKGLpgVQDwPf2HZX.jpg) So, I don’t really know for sure. Life in a different school would have been crazy because I would have had different coursemates and different lecturers who would have given me a totally different picture of what life was. It could have been better than what Nekede showed me, or it could have been worse. I guess I can’t know for sure. So, what am I trying to say? The school you go to matters because it grows you in a way that others won’t. It has something unique to add to your growth, and a different school or even a different department in the same school would expose you to a new path that you’ve never tested, and you’ll be up for a whole new set of discoveries. In a nutshell, for academic brilliance, all schools are basically the same. But for street smarts, emotional intelligence, financial literacy, and all that, the school itself determines it, and also the people you surround yourself with. So much goes into determining what a good school is, and academic excellence is only a fraction of it. ![IMG_20230914_153034~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23sJbTRqSxGoBbn6ZRy8rysu8uCUvAWxe96odjhzCT5SekgKGYHhC52jRSmvGFocFGGMh.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.

body.title: The Uncertainty of Tomorrow
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXGUrQWXRmp36QJU3JR5iFereVbgq5Bq6yZdgrFgyb2By/img_0206.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbqCFisoR3tAwThkukvrgFU4c5ur4U8iECbczR2R8tXJw/img_0204.jpg)
One of the most painful and pathetic things that can happen to a mother is losing her child, regardless of the child’s age, let alone losing a grown-up child. It is not something anyone would even wish on their enemy.

I woke up to the terrible news that a friend who was like a brother to me, and with whom I attended the same secondary school many years ago, had died. It was a sudden death. He was like a family member because we both grew up in the same community. My brother called to give me the update, and I never expected someone like him to die at this stage of his life. He was not even up to 38 years old. It was heartbreaking and difficult to accept. His mother is still alive, which makes the situation even more painful to bear.

Before his demise, his wife had left him for about two years or so. To the best of my knowledge, he was a good man, and my brother could testify to that. Although there is no way anyone can live in this world without making mistakes. No matter how holy a person claims to be, perfection is impossible.

I heard that he was involved with drugs of some kind, but the problem was that his life was not really appealing to him. Perhaps depression made him resort to drugs, which did not help his situation at the time. But today, he is no more. It is painful to think about and sad at the same time.

What is life anyway? We are all going to die one day, whether we like it or not, and it does not matter when. Death will surely come. What matters is what people will say about us when we are no longer here and the good things we did while we were alive. It is a thing of joy that he left behind a son. At least, he has someone to carry on his legacy.

A lot is happening at the same time, and it is no longer funny. People go through pain and hardship, and many resort to whatever means are available to cope with life.

Life is too ephemeral to live recklessly or behave as though you own everything in this world. We should live meaningful lives and make a positive impact on the lives of others because we can never truly tell when our time will come.

All is vanity; it is a chasing after the wind. We came into this world with nothing, and we will surely depart with nothing. No one can tell who will stand by them at their lowest point.

Do good. You never can tell. Life is in phases, and people are in different stages. Do good, and do not wait until you are told before doing what is right. That is what it means to be human.

Hello Actifit community and fitness enthusiasts! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/23d19955-d35c-42b1-8505-c188de6891fc.jpg) ​There is nothing quite like escaping the hustle and bustle of the town center to recharge your batteries in nature. Today is Tuesday, June 2, 2026, and I decided to head back to one of my absolute favorite walking spots: the expansive and beautiful Richmond Park. The weather was absolutely perfect for trekking mild temperatures, soft clouds, and a refreshing breeze that made a long outdoor session pure joy. ​I am proud to share that I've secured another highly active day, closing out my Tuesday evening with an awesome total of 13,040 steps! ​Hit 25 Days in a Row Quarter Century Streak! ​While hitting over 13k steps feels great on its own, the real victory today is on my consistency dashboard. As shown in the app, I have officially reached a 25 day consistency streak! ​Looking at that perfect line of green checkmarks spanning from last Wednesday all the way to today is incredibly rewarding. Reaching 25 days means this isn't just a temporary challenge anymore it is a locked in, healthy lifestyle habit. I also noticed a huge update banner on the app home screen today Actifit Android v0.14.0 Momentum Biggest Update Yet! It’s always exciting to see the platform evolving and adding new features to help us keep our momentum going strong. ​Exploring the Trails and Bridleways. ​Richmond Park is famous for its massive ancient trees, wild deer, and vast open spaces. Today, I spent a lot of my time exploring the quieter paths and trails that run alongside the park's designated horse riding tracks. ​I came across a distinct triangular warning sign on the grass verge illustrating a horse and rider, reminding drivers and cyclists to watch out for horses crossing the road. The backdrop of lush ferns and deep green oak trees stretching into the distance was incredibly peaceful. Walking in an environment like this, where you are surrounded by ancient woodlands and the sounds of nature, makes the distance fly by. Before you know it, your step count has increased by thousands without you even feeling the fatigue. ​Keeping the Momentum Alive into June. ​Starting the second day of June with over 13,000 steps gives me a massive boost of energy for the rest of the week. If you ever find your daily walking routine getting a bit repetitive, my biggest recommendation is to seek out a large nature reserve or national park near you. The changing terrain, wildlife, and sheer scale of the landscape will instantly bring the excitement back into your fitness journey. ​How is your Tuesday going? Did you manage to hit your daily movement goals today? Let me know your numbers and your favorite nature trails in the comments section below!

body.title: I ordered an old picture of me and my mother for my living room
body.body:
My mother gave me a photo album with some pictures of me when I was a baby. I was very happy about it and seeing all the nice pictures I decided to order some of these pictures as larger prints 45x30 cm prints online. I received these prints some days ago and I am very happy how nice the pictures turned out. The original pictures were 15x10 cm in size and I scanned them with my Scanner, I told Gemini to improve the picture quality so I can easily print them on a Poster size 45x30 cm. 

I have to admit that I was really amazed by the outcome. I tried the same with photoshop upscaling the picture and enhancing the quality but I wasn't even close to the Quality that Gemini retrieved from the pictures. I have to admit that I am pretty amazed how good this already works. I also reconstructed some older pictures of my grandmother, some of them black and white, and told Gemini to show me the pictures in color. The results are incredible... AI can bea very helpfull tool to do something like enhancing pictures and upscaling old pictures or even coloring old black and white pictures. 

I don't know how the AI was able to recreate the colors in the black and white picture but I am pretty sure that it was nearly accurate. I have to ask my mother about the colors of my grandmothers cloths (if she remembers) but the living room Armchair was spot on since I still know how it looked. 

![IMG_20260602_221138.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florian-glechner/EogS9tt1xDLqS2wC8vNyk9cY2TDivV18PZUqrDFmNdEzBVKCMVP42aEnkoKUkd8R2AK.jpg)
*I ordered a poster size picture of me and my mother.*

I will defenitlely try to scan some of my older pictures that I still have and improve them with Gemini. Some of them I might order as a big Pictures like this one of my mother and me. I am still perplex what is possible with AI nowadays and we are still at the beginning of AI, I can only Imagine what it will be capable in the future. I am happy about the possibilities it already gives me and this

body.title: Hanging On by Threads
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>


![IMG_5937.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/Ep7uCAUb9SBDysDtKxn2f4EB8AUaZu9FnFkWomLNforj7WzWT3dU5jrUT2FSrF61iai.jpeg)

I used to think rest meant sleeping longer. But I’ve realized there’s an unhinged kind of exhaustion that sleep cannot touch. It surfaces when you’ve carried emotional baggage for too long, lived under the weight of expectations that repeatedly end in disappointment, and spent too many nights awake at 2 a.m. wrestling with thoughts that refuse to quiet down.

In Nigeria today, that exhaustion feels almost collective.

Beyond personal struggles, many people are carrying the burden of living in a country that constantly demands resilience from them. Insecurity has become frighteningly common. Children are kidnapped from schools, families live in fear, and lives are lost with alarming regularity. Meanwhile, those entrusted with protecting citizens often appear powerless, indifferent, or detached from the realities ordinary people face.

Add that to the pressure of providing for families in a difficult economy, navigating workplace stress, managing personal battles, and trying to hold onto hope amid uncertainty, and it becomes clear why so many people are tired in ways that sleep cannot cure.

![IMG_5940.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/2423wzS24TYJQzQKbkx3MsjFde5Ma2vZZATVBi2nUSRi5SFXVCAcCP183uqogNNfxTEVx.jpeg)

The thing about emotional exhaustion is that it often goes unnoticed. The bourgeoisie may not see it. The proletarians still show up. They still laugh, go to work, post online, and keep moving. But internally, many are hanging on by threads nobody notices.

And that is exactly why kindness matters.

You never truly know what someone is surviving quietly. Sometimes people do not need lectures, unsolicited advice, or motivational pressure. Sometimes they need softness. Understanding, space to breathe and maybe a reminder that their efforts are seen and appreciated.

If you’ve been feeling emotionally heavy lately, I hope life becomes gentler with you soon. And if someone around you seems a little withdrawn, or a little worn down, perhaps offer them the kindness you would want on your hardest days.

>Images are mine 



</diva>

body.title: The Side I Chose by Saying Nothing
body.body:
Around 2022, my neighbours wife left him. A lot of people talked about this for weeks. Everyone had their opinion on what the man did wrong and what the woman also did wrong. I was only observing how people moved with different narratives without saying anything. Not because I don't have anything to say. But because throwing in my own narrative felt heavier than I wOtl carry on for that day. ![258105.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/258105.png) I once heard her say some stuff because I usually buy something from her shop. The kind of f thing someone says when they are tired and reconsidering whether it is still safe to say more. I gave her a sympathetic smile and quickly drifted to another conversation because I honestly don't know what to say to what she said because I didn't want to be caught up in-between. What I told myself was to stay neutral because a family affair like that is none of my business in the real sense of it. That just minding my business was the right thing to do. But when the room has already made up it's mind, minding my business has a direction. And because I didn't say much when I went to her shop, that landed me on the side that already had more voices. ![258104.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/258104.png) The word ally sounds very large. Like speeches and protests and deliberate loyalty. But the majority of the moments that needed it were small. Someone deciding to speak up the truth in an environment that does not want to hear what the truth is. A discussion where one person is in need of a single voice beside them and got none. And I am very much convenient and honest because I was not that voice. --- Thank you for reading. >

body.title: Is there protection for Sinners//Mcgi Topic Review ( part 1)
body.body:
https://youtu.be/1vsr_G6DxJE?si=LSwSyZvNZMnE6vMn

Many people wonder whether God's protection is only for believers or if it extends to everyone. The Bible shows that God's goodness reaches all people, regardless of their spiritual condition. His mercy, patience, and provision are available even to those who have not yet chosen to follow Him.

Being a sinner does not mean a person is completely cut off from God's care. While sin separates people from God spiritually, He still demonstrates His love and kindness to humanity. Even those who do not acknowledge Him continue to benefit from the blessings He provides daily.

Jesus explained this truth in Matthew 5:45, saying that God makes His sun rise on both the evil and the good and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous. This teaches that God's common blessings are not limited to a particular group. The air we breathe, the food we eat, and the opportunities we receive are all examples of God's generosity toward mankind.

This universal care reveals God's compassionate nature. He does not immediately destroy those who reject Him but gives people time to repent and come to the knowledge of the truth. His patience is an expression of His love and desire for all to be saved.

However, while God's general blessings are available to everyone, the Bible also speaks of a deeper relationship and a special kind of protection reserved for those who trust and obey Him. 

Thanks for reading.

body.title: Bitcoin: Die nächste Hiobsbotschaft/Bitcoin: The next piece of bad news
body.body:
Der Bitcoin schwächelt bereits seit Mitte Mai, nachdem ein Anstieg der Kryptowährung über die wichtige 200-Tage-Linie gescheitert ist. Inzwischen rückt die Marke von 65.000 US-Dollar immer näher und es gibt die nächsten negativen Nachrichten.

![43160.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd2aSWZYEDYMSZyH1m8shUAuZP7xXdg5KA1YSotvNtf4S/43160.jpg)



Denn bei Krypto-Anlageprodukten ziehen Investoren aktuell immer mehr Geld ab. In der vergangenen Woche flossen 1,67 Milliarden US-Dollar, wie Daten von CoinShares zeigen. Dies ist der zweitgrößte wöchentliche Abfluss im Jahr 2026. Allein 1,44 Milliarden US-Dollar mussten BTC-ETPs abgeben.

James Butterfill, Forschungsleiter bei CoinShares, sagte: 

**„Das Muster erinnert an die Phase im Januar und Februar, die fünf aufeinanderfolgende negative Wochen mit sich brachte.“**

Keine guten Nachrichten also für den Bitcoin, und ob die Abflüsse bald ein Ende finden, ist fraglich. Ansonsten droht erneut ein Kurssturz in Richtung der bisherigen Korrekturtiefs bei 60.000 US-Dollar.

Erstmals seit 41 Monaten hat Michael Saylors Unternehmen Strategy Bitcoin verkauft. Bitcoin reagiert mit einem Fall unter die Marke von 71.000 US-Dollar.

Auch wenn Verkäufe bereits von Saylor angekündigt waren, reagierte die Strategy-Aktie als auch Bitcoin mit deutlichen Verlusten. Bitcoin notiert am Dienstagmorgen nur noch bei 70.676 US-Dollar.

Die 32 verkauften Coins entsprechen lediglich rund 0,0038 Prozent des Gesamtbestands. Der Konzern bleibt damit mit großem Abstand der weltweit größte börsennotierte Unternehmenshalter von Bitcoin.

Ich zitierte aus folgenden Artikeln...

https://www.boerse-online.de/nachrichten/rohstoffe/bitcoin-die-naechste-hiobsbotschaft-20401960.html

https://www.wallstreet-online.de/nachricht/20953081-krypto-schock-bitcoin-stuerzt-erstem-verkauf-strategy-3-jahren

Mein persönliches Fazit:

Der Kryptowinter ist mit voller Kraft zurück gekommen. Wer noch etwas Geduld hat kann meiner Meinung nach in einigen Wochen Bitcoin mit einem weiteren 20% Rabatt nachkaufen. Altcoins werden wohl noch länger ausbluten. Wichtig ist hier darauf zu achten in Altcoins mit starker Community zu investieren.

Ob jetzt die bekannten Kryptoinfluenzer ankündigen Bitcoin zu verkaufen weil sie ihr Vertrauen verloren haben oder die Preise drücken wollen ist mir noch nicht ganz klar.

Oder sie wissen mehr als wir?

---

English 

Bitcoin has been faltering since mid-May, following a failed attempt by the cryptocurrency to rise above the critical 200-day moving average. Meanwhile, the $65,000 mark is drawing ever closer, accompanied by a fresh wave of negative news.


Investors are currently withdrawing increasing amounts of capital from crypto investment products. Data from CoinShares reveals that $1.67 billion flowed out of the sector last week. This marks the second-largest weekly outflow recorded in 2026. BTC ETPs alone accounted for $1.44 billion of these outflows.

James Butterfill, Head of Research at CoinShares, stated:

**\

**

This is certainly not good news for Bitcoin, and it remains questionable whether these outflows will come to an end anytime soon. Otherwise, the cryptocurrency faces the renewed threat of a price plunge back toward its previous correction lows around $60,000.

For the first time in 41 months, Michael Saylor’s company, Strategy, has sold Bitcoin. Bitcoin reacted to the news by falling below the $71,000 mark.

Although these sales had already been announced by Saylor, both Strategy’s stock and Bitcoin reacted with significant losses. As of Tuesday morning, Bitcoin is trading at just $70,676.

The 32 coins sold represent a mere 0.0038 percent of the company's total holdings. Consequently, the group remains—by a wide margin—the world's largest publicly traded corporate holder of Bitcoin.  I cited the following articles...

https://www.boerse-online.de/nachrichten/rohstoffe/bitcoin-die-naechste-hiobsbotschaft-20401960.html

https://www.wallstreet-online.de/nachricht/20953081-krypto-schock-bitcoin-stuerzt-erstem-verkauf-strategy-3-jahren

My personal conclusion:

The crypto winter has returned in full force. In my opinion, anyone who still has a little patience will be able to buy back into Bitcoin in a few weeks at a further 20% discount. Altcoins will likely continue to bleed for even longer. It is crucial here to ensure that you invest in altcoins backed by a strong community.

Whether the well-known crypto influencers are now announcing that they are selling Bitcoin because they have lost faith in it, or simply because they want to drive down prices, is not yet entirely clear to me.

Or do they know something we don't?

Full Metal Ox Day 1920
Tuesday 2, June 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1985
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Super Power Tuesday, Flex’em up mi gente. 

The theme of the day was “no rain,” and sunshine, here in the sunshine state. We made our way down to the Monkey Bars, met up with this cat who we met a couple of years ago, caught up, exchanged some workout tips and eased the vessel into unofficial Summer-mode. 

Since Universe wiped away the ideas I never jotted down today, here’s something from the archives. Apparently the words that assemble upon these digital pages don’t conform to those of, “published authors,” or professional writers, in this space. It’s okay with your boy. I write the way I think, and also the way I talk. By the way, late into the night (10 PM), on the East Coast of the USA, you can hear recordings of this envity actually talking. You’ve been warned. 

What could loosely be called an “education” came by way of an experimental high school that was not housed in a brick & mortal building built in the 1920s. Where, in elementary school, we sat at desks that were so old they had a hole in it, for an ink well. My first class on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays was held in a conference room on the 17th floor of an office building in downtown Philly. I was an academic-vagabond before I even knew the word. Either word. 

Instead of traveling from classroom to classroom, we traveled to different parts of the City. Downtown to University City, to South Philly. Sometimes we could walk it. Run it. Or bus it. But we rarely missed it. Or ditched it. This is where we built our fanatical responsibility for punctuality. 

Anyway, I think in pictures and stories, fables, myths, patterns and movies, & comic books. The way Universe has been downloading apocalyptic “truths” to Mind over the last 5 years reminds me of this scene in Ghost, (1990). Whoopi Goldberg, is Oda Mae Brown, she’s a “psychic,” but more of a con-artist, until Patrick Swayze’s Ghost character, Sam, contacts her and gives her legitimacy in the spirit world. In this memorable scene, there is a queue of “spirits” waiting in line to send their messages via Oda Mae to their loved ones in the corporeal world. 

In my simulation these “spirits” would be ideas for topics. Sometimes it’s  contemporary chaos, institutional stupidity, elite arrogance, or a joke I heard. And sometimes it’s, Orlando. 

Orlando is the spirit that busted out of the queue, and jumped into Oda Mae’s body to talk to his wife. 

This is what it’s like when we get on to one of these subjects, like Alien-intervention theory, Stolen Evolution, Emindcipation, and why is the European diaspora so genocidal. This is when “Orlando” shows up. Everywhere! There are signals, “sign posts,” or “milemarkers” I call them that let me know our Star Ship is still on course. 

As much television as I watched as a kid, there are many more shows I didn’t watch. Especially when cable came online. In the current rationale, we can say, “We only watched the shows we ‘needed’ to watch to guide us along this path.  

One more movie reference. “Paycheck” (2003). 

Note - Just right now learned that this flick was based on a Phillip K Dick story from 1953. Whoa! Directed by John Woo and starring Ben Affleck. Spoiler alert. But I will do my best not to ruin it for you. 

Ben gets this job. 90 million dollar paycheck. He does the job, but afterwards has his memory wiped. It’s part of the contract. When he’s ready to collect his dough, he finds out that he forfeited his remittance. All the company has for him is an envelope full of basic personal items. Stuff that one might find in a “junk drawer.”  

So let’s say our “spirits” have been in this realm before, (repeatedly), and before the last transition, left a lifetime of clues, in the form of vibrations, deja vu, dreams and people you meet briefly but feel like you’ve known in past lives. But memory gets wiped at birth. Let’s call it the superficial memory. But the deeper memory is still, more or less, in tact. Your current incarnation must assemble the clues to, what I am now calling the, “septonomial puzzle,” in order to figure out what this epoch, this yuga cycle,  and your dharma within this realm is all about. 

Interests, opportunities, and so-called, “god-given” gifts, are all a part of what “past self” has sent forward to “now self.” 

Stay strong, stay safe. stay sane, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.  

PEACE.

Apocalypse Year
The reason we’re ruled by psychos is a thousand years deep.

Lane change.

This brings us back to our murderess. I was told, when I first heard this story, that this was a psychopath test. If you answered correctly, you might be a psychopath. 
Keep listening. 
The Covid Plandemic was such a failure, despite the vax-damage, including deaths, (many of which are still being denied), that it severely crippled the WHO, and the World Economic Forum (WEF). Dr Evil, (aka Klaus Schwab), founder of the WEF, resigned from the organization he started. Bill Gates and Albert Bourla, (chairman and chief executive officer of the pharmaceutical company Pfizer),  have been ordered to testify in a civil lawsuit in the Netherlands, but they do not have to appear in person at The Hague. Dr. David Morens, (a minion of Anthony Fauci), has been indicted on federal charges related to concealing communications about COVID-19 research. Nonetheless these psychopaths have not quit in the pursuit of their agenda. There have been the weekly virus mutations, that became as ridiculous as super-hero movies, including the unforgettable, Monkey Pox & Bird flu operation that flopped faster and harder than the reboot of, “Plan 9 from Outer Space.”   
Enter, Hanta Virus Summer. Starring a cast of psychopaths. Opening to empty theaters. This one isn’t even going straight to video. No Nutflix special. No midnight movie. No cult following. Just crickets.
