body.title: Musica italiana da ascoltare davvero oggi, una playlist tutta italiana
body.body:
![32106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lorenzopistolesi/AKAq4c1LZmcYkx3fUarbzSVQJw2nCZpnQfnQBi75ktt2gPeBErFrdpwEP5ZZyEL.jpg)


Se stai cercando musica italiana da ascoltare, probabilmente non ti serve l'ennesima classifica fatta per riempire un algoritmo. Ti serve qualcosa che resti addosso. Una voce che non sembri in prestito, un testo che non abbia paura del silenzio, una canzone capace di tornare la sera, quando la giornata si abbassa e finalmente senti.

La verità è che la musica italiana continua a offrire molto, ma non sempre lo fa nei posti più rumorosi. C'è una differenza netta tra ciò che passa ovunque e ciò che rimane. Non è una questione snob, né una guerra tra mainstream e indipendente. È una questione di intensità. Alcune canzoni funzionano subito e svaniscono presto. Altre entrano più lentamente, ma quando lo fanno cambiano il modo in cui ascolti tutto il resto.

## Musica italiana da ascoltare se cerchi verità

Chi ama il cantautorato italiano spesso non cerca soltanto una bella melodia. Cerca una presenza. Cerca una persona dentro la canzone. È questo che rende certi brani necessari: la sensazione che qualcuno abbia scritto senza difese, senza lucidare troppo il dolore, senza semplificare i dettagli per renderli più vendibili.

La musica italiana più viva, oggi, è spesso quella che accetta le contraddizioni. Romantica ma non ingenua. Elegante ma non fredda. Diretta, eppure piena di ombre. Ci sono artisti che lavorano ancora così: partono dalla parola, dal corpo della voce, da arrangiamenti che non coprono il senso ma lo accompagnano. Quando li incontri, te ne accorgi subito. Non ti stanno intrattenendo e basta. Ti stanno parlando.


https://open.spotify.com/playlist/4mvUje16lZdmQksoyB8m6Q?si=ZHh0r_AtT0CDuCa7ynHrrQ&pi=PSl_zXeMSqaCq

Questo vale soprattutto per chi ascolta con una certa fame emotiva. Per chi vuole testi che non girino attorno al punto, ma lo tocchino. Per chi nella musica italiana cerca ancora la poesia, non come ornamento, ma come forma di verità.

## Dove trovare musica italiana da ascoltare senza perdere tempo

Oggi il problema non è la mancanza di musica. È l'eccesso. Ogni settimana arrivano uscite nuove, singoli, EP, album, live session, versioni acustiche, contenuti rapidi pensati per catturare pochi secondi di attenzione. In mezzo a tutto questo, scegliere diventa quasi un lavoro. Eppure qualche criterio semplice esiste.

Il primo è seguire le canzoni, non solo i nomi. Un artista può avere grande esposizione e pochi brani davvero memorabili. Un altro può vivere in una zona più appartata e avere un repertorio che ti accompagna per anni. Conviene partire da una traccia che ti colpisce e da lì risalire verso il disco, verso la scrittura, verso il mondo che la sostiene.

Il secondo criterio è ascoltare album interi, almeno ogni tanto. La cultura del singolo ha reso tutto più immediato, ma anche più fragile. Un disco, invece, ti dice se un autore ha una visione oppure solo un momento felice. Nella musica italiana d'autore l'ordine dei brani, i respiri, i vuoti, perfino le imperfezioni hanno un peso. Se ascolti tutto, capisci di più.

Il terzo è dare spazio alle scene indipendenti e ai percorsi personali. Non per ideologia, ma perché lì si sente ancora il rischio. E dove c'è rischio, spesso c'è vita. Molta musica italiana da ascoltare oggi nasce proprio in quella zona in cui il budget è piccolo ma l'identità è forte.

### Il cantautorato non è un genere spento

Ogni tanto si dice che il cantautorato italiano sia diventato nostalgia. Non è vero. Semmai, ha cambiato pelle. Accanto ai riferimenti classici esistono autori che scrivono con una lingua nuova, meno monumentale, più quotidiana, ma non per questo meno intensa. Parlano d'amore, di città, di distanza, di corpi, di fallimenti, di desiderio. Lo fanno con un lessico più vicino al presente, senza perdere profondità.

Il punto non è imitare il passato. Il punto è meritarselo. Una buona canzone italiana non ha bisogno di sembrare antica per essere importante. Deve solo essere onesta abbastanza da resistere a un secondo ascolto. E poi a un terzo. E poi a una notte difficile.
https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6Bm67yyFi89vooECRiPIwf?si=OT4OdyPQQJeqkV6gXgm6ag&pi=h9hEQC11RmWQC
### Streaming, playlist e ascolto vero

Le playlist aiutano, ma hanno un limite chiaro: spesso mettono insieme brani compatibili, non necessariamente significativi. Ti accompagnano, ti suggeriscono un'atmosfera, ma non sempre ti portano verso un'identità artistica forte. Se vuoi davvero scoprire nuova musica italiana da ascoltare, la playlist è un inizio, non un arrivo.

L'ascolto vero richiede un po' più di fiducia. Bisogna fermarsi su un brano che ti ha fatto alzare la testa. Leggere il titolo di un album. Tornare il giorno dopo. Magari guardare anche una performance live, perché molte verità emergono lì, senza filtri. Alcuni artisti in studio sono impeccabili, ma dal vivo si spengono. Altri, invece, davanti a un microfono e a pochi strumenti diventano improvvisamente necessari.
https://open.spotify.com/playlist/4mvUje16lZdmQksoyB8m6Q?si=ZHh0r_AtT0CDuCa7ynHrrQ&pi=PSl_zXeMSqaCq
## Cosa rende una canzone italiana memorabile

Non esiste una formula unica, e meno male. Però certi segnali sono chiari. Una canzone memorabile ha quasi sempre una frase che non puoi scrollarti di dosso. Non per forza uno slogan. A volte è un dettaglio minimo, una parola messa nel punto giusto, un'immagine che sembra tua anche se non l'hai vissuta.

Poi c'è la voce. Non la voce perfetta, ma quella riconoscibile. Quella che porta le ferite senza trasformarle in maniera. In Italia abbiamo una tradizione fortissima di interpreti e autori che hanno costruito tutto su questa aderenza tra voce e verità. Quando succede, il brano smette di essere solo ben fatto. Diventa umano.

Conta anche l'arrangiamento, certo. Ma solo quando sa stare al suo posto. Troppa produzione può togliere respiro. Troppa sottrazione può lasciare il brano incompiuto. Dipende dalla canzone. Dipende dall'intenzione. Le scelte migliori sono quelle che sembrano inevitabili, non quelle che vogliono impressionare.

## Se ami le parole, scegli artisti che si espongono

Chi ascolta musica italiana spesso ascolta anche il modo in cui qualcuno abita la propria lingua. È qui che si sente la differenza tra scrittura e posa. Ci sono testi pieni di immagini ma vuoti di esperienza. E ce ne sono altri semplicissimi che aprono una ferita con una naturalezza disarmante.

Per questo vale la pena cercare artisti che non abbiano paura di esporsi davvero. Non quelli che raccontano emozioni in astratto, ma quelli che le fanno passare attraverso scene, oggetti, gesti, contraddizioni. L'amore, per esempio, funziona solo quando smette di essere categoria e torna a essere presenza. Una stanza. Un'assenza. Una chiamata che non arriva. Una pace brevissima.

In questa zona la musica italiana continua a dare molto. C'è ancora chi scrive canzoni come si scrive una lettera che forse non verrà capita da tutti, ma arriverà esattamente a chi deve arrivare.
https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6Bm67yyFi89vooECRiPIwf?si=OT4OdyPQQJeqkV6gXgm6ag&pi=h9hEQC11RmWQC

Forse il punto non è trovare sempre nuova musica. Forse è trovare quella giusta per il momento che stai vivendo. Ci sono periodi in cui cerchi energia, altri in cui vuoi solo una voce che tenga compagnia senza invadere. La musica italiana da ascoltare cambia anche in base a questo. Non esiste un canone valido per tutti i giorni.

Vale la pena costruirsi una geografia personale. Tenere vicini i dischi che ti hanno parlato davvero. Lasciare spazio alle sorprese. Non inseguire per forza ciò che sta salendo, ma nemmeno chiudersi in una comfort zone nostalgica. La sensibilità cresce così: per fedeltà e per curiosità.

E se lungo il percorso incontri un artista indipendente che scrive con cuore, disciplina e visione, fermati. Ascolta un brano in più. Poi un altro. A volte il rapporto più vero con la musica nasce proprio lì, dove non c'è distanza tra chi canta e chi ascolta. È uno spazio raro, ma esiste ancora. Lorenzo Pistolesi, nel suo modo personale e senza maschere, si muove esattamente in questa direzione.

La musica è la mia vita, la poesia è la mia gioia e la pratica è il mio mondo: chi sente propria una frase del genere sa già cosa cercare. Non soltanto canzoni, ma tracce di presenza. Non soltanto uscite, ma incontri.

Se quindi ti chiedi quale musica italiana ascoltare oggi, prova a non partire dal rumore. Parti da ciò che ti commuove, ti ferma, ti somiglia un po' e ti contraddice abbastanza. Le canzoni migliori fanno questo: non ti danno una risposta comoda, ma ti tengono compagnia mentre la cerchi.

https://open.spotify.com/playlist/4mvUje16lZdmQksoyB8m6Q?si=ZHh0r_AtT0CDuCa7ynHrrQ&pi=PSl_zXeMSqaCq

body.title: DIY || Crochet Diamond Bucket Hat.
body.body:
**Hello Everyone✨**

I've seen various designs of crochet bucket hats over the years, but today, I wanted to try out something different. Something I haven't seen before. So, I took out my sketch book, made a sketch and let's just say I'm glad the bucket hat didn't turn out like the sketch because the sketch was unsalvageably *funny*.

![1001451401.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/244xwjvu7CDmJCMKLqL2X83f7g28kqew1F7cEyTqfUozBVnsrQL7eHmXyc9otcBFDqYHw.jpg)

The idea to try out this bucket hat in said pattern came to me today, while I was taking stock of the yarns I have available. Luckily, I had just the right materials for the bucket hat plus, I decided to incorporate  the velvet yarn I had ordered a while back. So, come with me as I take you through the process of making the crochet diamond bucket hat. 
![1001451403.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/Eou9bwtQbSxUiP9LHdRLnuaMErcfU5vrG3Xjx4fgLzCJ8oR6RCCxJwxfrW1jHn5BM3p.jpg)
![2021_02_21_20_04_57.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doze/VUbbU4qs-2021_02_21_20_04_57.gif)
## Materials Needed. 

🤍: Yarns.
🤍: 3.5mm crochet hook
🤍: Measuring tape
🤍: Darning needle
🤍: A cutter
🤍: A sketch book (optional)

![2021_02_21_20_04_57.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/doze/VUbbU4qs-2021_02_21_20_04_57.gif)

## The Process of Creation


For the creation of this masterpiece, I made use of two types of yarn, acrylic yarns and velvet yarn. 

![1001451371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23xpGp7qadEgUAmqqz89x1C7XuuaLsugettHuyjQUXKQGsfedQKJU8QsHfoAPq8GtqtFA.jpg)


To begin, I made a magic circle and into the circle, I made twelve double crochet stitches. To end the first row, I made a slip stitch. This is how I would end every other consecutive row. 

![1001451372.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/241trMpJ2kUi6aqSSYxw73HVCNSm3492VFQjfVcQ9Wa63e9Ap23rkcNQN8U2mWfiwDUeh.jpg)
From rows two  to row five, I made increases. The increases done in row two brought the stitch count to twenty-four and from rows three to five, I alternated the increases. This brought the stitch count to seventy-two at the end of row five.  


Once I got to the sixth row, I stopped making increases. The seventh row was a replica of the sixth row. 

![1001451379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/EouB33C8u784ndg5FQgDM2WqSTRemLt85JgKXs2QLBVdExUEqxiM5znaVyD7QUUuAMg.jpg)

On the seventh row, I started the colour change which was to bring about the diamond pattern.  The diamond pattern followed odd numbers. For row seven, a single colour change, for row eight, three colour changes, for row nine, five colour changes. Rows ten and eleven were mirror images of rows eight and seven. 

![1001451380.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23xAbmwTMUWT65cT6rDFT9MqYLcQENeFipVEcqz1XbSbQTSeKHJmxwMHvTEbNvD6y2P5V.jpg)

At the end of row eleven, the diamonds were fully formed. From there on, I continued making half double crochet stitches into every stitch till they got to the desired length. Then, it was time to begin making the ruffles. 

![1001451381.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/Eoc9wJJjL1feYKHq1vtjRGAMo1gtKJexrMRdyYSGPyLqTrU5eaFSGfgJ8KgP5qgo2sZ.jpg)

There were  three ruffled rows in total. For the first row of ruffles, I inserted three double crochet stitches into every space. This brought the stitch count to about two hundred and sixteen. 

![1001451383.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/EpXKyf2Va6F4xmTmmwN15gsSHMUsen2ZJdgqwZwY8cBcHGgqGr1VV4vS2DMxpMe4Xox.jpg)

![1001451382.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/Eos3AzmFgfxC1NrYvDkB8grNpUR4wZgrHkazW3gQsnh9EzFnY6kSU2Kc4RJMUmcGbxj.jpg)
For the second row of ruffles, I made three double crochet stitches into every space from the previous row. This brought the stitch count to about six hundred and forty-eight stitches. In this row I decided to alternate both colours of the acrylic yarn partly because I wanted to see how it would turn out and partly because I didn't want to run out of yarn. A game of yarn chicken and I actually won. 

![1001451402.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23wMeU8W8wAEG3dTRfQUhJAFc4EFsoZeLWCuWSYsJQe2YmxVkCoiTGi5pH6Hca6s7Vh9w.jpg)

For the final row of ruffles, I changed from acrylic to velvet yarn and then made half double crochet stitches round with no increases. The stitch count stayed the same as the previous row. 

![1001451385.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23xVMCrvnkDfAgLa1cRvEt1Hf3Y482GTpEboAMQDhKYdbnmFeNKa8vKqQXfTTMzcWQFb4.jpg)

The last thing I did was weave in the loose ends, which weren't as many as I had imagined. This brought me to the end of the project. 





![1001451404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/EopvFJkipz78DSXJ4ZaQkfzVPZLhY6MMiSCuAEyYRKUYES9WHfYc74gQXWzQfvmMLjs.jpg)

I really liked how this turned out on completion and to think the idea just came to me this morning. I was initially skeptical about the colour combination but I feel the colours compliment each other. It took me about four hours from the start to the completion of this ruffle hat and like I always say, the ruffles take half the time to make. 


![1001451384.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/242DUoEdpytDyVyJVLmXSxHfojD4ncWx8GM3L47fjHtnLKVN8Qet2G2HXUeGJwac367ZR.jpg)
What do you think of this diamond crochet bucket hat? Do you like the colour combination? I'd love to know your thoughts. 

©TheKanian

body.title: Subscriptions That Bleed Your Wallet Dry
body.body: >This post stems from a question I raised some time ago in Queercoin, which I addressed in a post titled \
In it, I denounced their corporate policy of blocking printer functionality via Wi-Fi if you didn't pay for a subscription plan.

>However, I still had much more to say on the matter, as HP is not the only corporation scamming its customers with forced subscriptions that render equipment or software useless when fees aren't paid. The modern subscription model is the digital version of medieval serfdom: you pay for the right to farm a plot of land (your workflow) that will never be yours, and if you stop paying, the feudal lord keeps the entire harvest.

Currently, many companies have stopped selling products in favor of selling \
that never truly becomes the user's property. This creates a dependency where the customer, upon stopping payment, loses access to their history, data, or acquired functionality.

>This practice is closely tied to planned obsolescence, which previously consisted of manufacturing products that would physically break after a certain amount of time. Nowadays, the tactic is much more sophisticated and less visible: obsolescence through software updates and ecosystem locking. Through constant patches or changes to file formats (making them incompatible with older versions), they force you to update. If you don't subscribe, your old software becomes \

because it is no longer compatible with the rest of the digital world.

Companies have normalized the idea that you are not the owner of your tools, but a client renting them, and that what you create with them is yours only as long as you pay. This, in essence, is a kidnapping: \

These corporate scams are now also being applied to durable consumer goods or software that does not require a constant connection (such as coffee makers that lock their grinding function if you don't pay, or basic productivity tools that used to be a one-time purchase). There are few international regulations in place to stop these extortionate corporate practices.

However, all is not lost. Open source software allows the community to maintain, fork, and continue using the tool if the original company disappears or becomes abusive. If you switch programs, you lose years of technical mastery and have to start from scratch; companies use this to lock you into their software. On the other hand, open source offers you the portability of your skills and guarantees that you own your tools, your files, and maintain total control over your workflow.

There are also \

versions of current programs that allow you to continue working normally when you cannot afford the subscription (and I say this not as an incentive for piracy, but as part of the economic reality of the digital market). Furthermore, more accessible programs are being created for the public on Web3, so that we don't have to live in a perpetual state of updates and abusive subscription payments.

What do you think? Do you believe that, in the face of these extortionate corporate subscription policies, the public will move toward cheaper, less-known alternatives, or will these practices continue to thrive almost unchecked?

>

body.title: NewKoll.com : un média shopping pour suivre les nouvelles collections mode, déco et lifestyle
body.body:
#

Dans un univers digital où les marques renouvellent sans cesse leurs collections, il devient parfois difficile de suivre toutes les nouveautés, les tendances et les inspirations qui apparaissent chaque saison. Mode femme, mode homme, enfant, chaussures, accessoires, décoration, mobilier ou idées lifestyle : l’offre en ligne est immense, mais elle manque souvent de repères simples pour aider les internautes à découvrir ce qui vient d’arriver.

C’est précisément dans cette logique qu’a été créé [NewKoll.com](https://newkoll.com), un média shopping indépendant consacré aux nouvelles collections, aux marques et aux tendances mode, décoration et lifestyle.

NewKoll a pour objectif de rendre la découverte shopping plus claire, plus éditoriale et plus inspirante. Le site ne se limite pas à présenter des produits : il met en avant des univers de marques, des sélections, des nouveautés et des inspirations de saison pour aider les lecteurs à mieux comprendre ce qui se passe dans l’actualité des collections.

Chaque saison, les marques lancent de nouvelles pièces, de nouvelles silhouettes, de nouvelles couleurs et de nouvelles ambiances. Certaines tendances reviennent, d’autres émergent, et les consommateurs cherchent de plus en plus à faire le tri. NewKoll répond à ce besoin avec une approche simple : observer les nouveautés, les organiser et les présenter dans un format facile à consulter.

Le site s’adresse aux internautes qui aiment suivre les tendances, repérer les nouvelles collections et découvrir des idées d’achat en ligne. Il peut s’agir d’une robe repérée dans une collection femme, d’une paire de chaussures, d’un meuble, d’un objet déco ou d’une inspiration lifestyle. NewKoll relie ces différents univers dans une expérience éditoriale cohérente, pensée pour celles et ceux qui aiment découvrir les nouveautés sans devoir parcourir des dizaines de sites différents.

L’un des points forts de NewKoll est son orientation “nouvelles collections”. Là où certains sites se concentrent uniquement sur les promotions ou les catalogues produits, NewKoll met l’accent sur la nouveauté, la saisonnalité et l’univers des marques. Cette approche permet de suivre plus facilement les lancements, les tendances émergentes et les styles qui structurent une saison.

Pour explorer les marques et leurs nouveautés, NewKoll propose notamment une page dédiée aux [nouvelles collections par marques](https://newkoll.com/nouvelles-collections-marques/). Cette page permet de naviguer dans les univers des marques référencées et de découvrir leurs collections récentes, leurs inspirations et leurs sélections shopping.

NewKoll couvre plusieurs grands univers : la mode femme, la mode homme, la mode enfant, les chaussures, les accessoires, la décoration, le mobilier et le lifestyle. Cette diversité reflète la manière dont les internautes consomment aujourd’hui l’inspiration. Une personne intéressée par une nouvelle collection mode peut aussi chercher des idées déco, des couleurs de saison, des accessoires ou des objets pour la maison. Le style ne s’arrête plus à une seule catégorie.

Le rôle d’un média shopping comme NewKoll est donc d’accompagner cette découverte. Il aide à passer d’une offre très abondante à une sélection plus lisible. Il donne du contexte aux nouveautés, met en avant les marques et propose une lecture éditoriale des tendances. Pour les lecteurs, c’est un gain de temps ; pour les marques, c’est un espace supplémentaire de visibilité ; pour l’écosystème du shopping en ligne, c’est une façon de rendre la découverte plus claire et plus utile.

NewKoll.com s’inscrit ainsi dans une évolution importante du commerce en ligne : les consommateurs ne veulent plus seulement voir des produits, ils veulent aussi comprendre les tendances, comparer les inspirations et découvrir les nouveautés dans un cadre éditorial. Le shopping devient plus visuel, plus guidé et plus connecté aux styles de vie.

Avec son positionnement entre média éditorial, guide shopping et plateforme de découverte, NewKoll ambitionne de devenir une référence pour suivre les nouvelles collections mode, déco et lifestyle. Le site propose une approche accessible, structurée et inspirante pour tous ceux qui souhaitent rester attentifs aux tendances et aux nouveautés des marques.

body.title: ¿Fracaso en el contador o calidez en las letras? || Failure on the counter or warmth in the words?
body.body:
<center>

![Post Instagram Promoción Servicio Dental Fotográfico Azul.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf1BLjHvyP8yZ2H23A6RbckQUAna85SYP2NtvqrM5w9Q1/Post%20Instagram%20Promoci%C3%B3n%20Servicio%20Dental%20Fotogr%C3%A1fico%20Azul.png)

</center>


<div class=\

> El [post](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nadie-esta-leyendo-mis-articulos-cuando-el-fracaso-obliga-a-revisarnos-como-evaluar-esen) que compartió hace poco @emiliorios me dejó pensando. Es de esos textos que te invitan a hacer una pausa, tomarte un café y mirar hacia adentro. Emilio puso en palabras un sentimiento que a todos nos ha tocado el corazón en algún momento: esa sensación agridulce que queda cuando publicas algo en lo que pusiste tu tiempo, tus ganas y tu atención, y al final pasa casi desapercibido en el feed general. Como alguien que lleva ya ocho años recorriendo estos caminos, leyendo a otros y compartiendo mis propias vivencias, no pude evitar sentirme identificada con el fondo de su reflexión. Sin embargo, más que verlo como un espacio para el desahogo, me dio ganas de sentarme a conversar sobre lo que significa, hoy en día, mantener vivo un blog a lo largo del tiempo.

> _The [post](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nadie-esta-leyendo-mis-articulos-cuando-el-fracaso-obliga-a-revisarnos-como-evaluar-esen) shared recently by @emiliorios left me thinking. It is one of those texts that invite you to pause, have a coffee, and look inward. Emilio put into words a feeling that has touched all of our hearts at some point: that bittersweet sensation that remains when you publish something where you put your time, your desire, and your attention, and in the end, it goes almost unnoticed in the general feed._ _As someone who has been walking these paths for eight years now, reading others and sharing my own experiences, I couldn't help but feel identified with the core of his reflection. However, more than seeing it as a space to vent, it made me want to sit down and talk about what it means, nowadays, to keep a blog alive over time._
![Post de Instagram Marca Personal y Marketing para artistas Minimalista Aesthetic Blanco.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV9gYTAP75aK7JmD2PrGhX6yku45kjnJtoyFSPDNeqvYn/Post%20de%20Instagram%20Marca%20Personal%20y%20Marketing%20para%20artistas%20Minimalista%20Aesthetic%20Blanco.png)

> ### Un blog que se parece a la vida # Cuando miro hacia atrás y veo lo que he construido en estos ocho años, me doy cuenta de que mi rincón aquí es, por encima de todo, un reflejo de mi día a día. En mi feed convive un poco de todo porque la vida misma es así, polifacética. Un día me nace compartir una receta de cocina, otro día me inspira un paseo familiar, un viaje o un compartir con amigos, y al siguiente me siento a escribir una reseña sobre un libro o una película que me movió el piso. También hay lugar para la medicina natural, el reciclaje, un poema que brotó de repente o esas reflexiones profundas sobre la madurez y las cosas del alma. Eso es lo bonito de un blog personal: no responde a un libreto. Por eso, cuando un artículo no recibe el alcance que uno esperaba, el verdadero aprendizaje de los años no es correr a cambiar quién eres para encajar en una tendencia, sino recordar por qué empezaste a escribir en primer lugar. Escribimos para conectar, para dejar una huella y porque nos apasiona contar historias.

> ### _A blog that resembles life_ # _When I look back and see what I have built over these eight years, I realize that my corner here is, above all, a reflection of my day-to-day life. A little bit of everything coexists in my feed because life itself is like that—multifaceted. One day I feel like sharing a cooking recipe, another day I am inspired by a family walk, a trip, or spending time with friends, and the next day I sit down to write a review about a book or a movie that shook me to my core. There is also room for natural medicine, recycling, a poem that suddenly bloomed, or those deep reflections on maturity and things of the soul._ _That is the beautiful thing about a personal blog: it doesn't follow a script. That is why, when an article doesn't get the reach you expected, the real lesson of the years is not to run and change who you are to fit into a trend, but to remember why you started writing in the first place. We write to connect, to leave a mark, and because we are passionate about telling stories._
![Colores Suaves Minimalista Inspiración Mensaje Positivo Post de Instagram.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU9RBMwcSarfpShcmidHVGDWTwwvLoEyA7f8J8WTtGYBa/Colores%20Suaves%20Minimalista%20Inspiraci%C3%B3n%20Mensaje%20Positivo%20Post%20de%20Instagram.png)

> ### El valor del trabajo que no se ve # Debo confesar que, a veces, me siento como un fantasma, porque escribo, me esmero durante horas, le coloco marcos bonitos a mis fotos, es decir, me fajo y mis publicaciones, al parecer, son transparentes, porque, más allá de los likes, es ver la caja de comentarios completamente vacía. Quienes nos tomamos esto en serio sabemos que una publicación no surge de la nada; detrás de cada post hay un proceso que lleva su propio ritmo. Está el momento de madurar la idea en la cabeza mientras haces otras cosas en casa, el cuidado al redactar para que las palabras transmitan la emoción que deseas que llegue, y esa revisión minuciosa para que la ortografía esté impecable por respeto a quien nos lee.

> ### _The value of unseen work_ # _I must confess that sometimes I feel like a ghost because I write, I strive for hours, I put beautiful frames on my photos—meaning, I work my heart out—and my posts seem to be transparent because, beyond the likes, what I see is a completely empty comment box._ _Those of us who take this seriously know that a post doesn't appear out of nowhere; behind each piece, there is a process that moves at its own pace. There is the moment of letting the idea mature in your mind while doing other things around the house, the care taken when writing so that the words convey the exact emotion you want to reach people, and that meticulous review to ensure the spelling is flawless out of respect for those who read us._
![Blanco y Gris Minimalista Decoración Post de Instagram.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQa9guDX4Kcgtd1mnobtLoyMr42G4iCFbGMb2nzf3P8Pm/Blanco%20y%20Gris%20Minimalista%20Decoraci%C3%B3n%20Post%20de%20Instagram.png)

> A eso hay que sumarle el tiempo que pasamos acomodando el diseño (que, en mi caso, es en lo que más me tardo), buscando entre mis fotos, las que más se puedan parecer a lo que estoy escribiendo o, en todo caso, si no consigo, busco entre mi banco de imágenes, las que me regalen paz, calma. Y si no consigo, entonces voy a las páginas libres de regalías y comienzo a buscar. Como dice Emilio, esto no toma solo 15 minutos. Luego me voy a Canva y busco marcos bonitos a las fotos para que todo se vea limpio y ordenado, el uso del Markdown para la comodidad del lector y traducirlo por bloques para que el mensaje no pierda su calidez al cruzar fronteras. Es un trabajo silencioso que se hace con amor, con paciencia y dedicación, pero debo confesar que, a veces, me siento como un fantasma. Son horas que se emplean en los detalles y, al final, parece que las publicaciones son transparentes porque, más allá de los likes, ver la caja de comentarios completamente vacía, desolada, no es bonito. Ver esa ausencia de interacción genera una inevitable nostalgia. Mentiría si dijera que el apoyo económico no alegra el día; al contrario, es una recompensa justa que a todos nos llena de satisfacción recibir y nos motiva a seguir adelante. Pero junto a ese incentivo, lo que realmente nos enriquece la experiencia y le da vida al blog es el hecho de que nos lean, que se detengan y nos regalen esos comentarios tan bonitos en la caja.

> _To all of that, we must add the time spent setting up the layout (which, in my case, takes the longest), searching through my photos for the ones that best match what I am writing about, or, if I can't find any, looking through my image bank for those that bring me peace and calm. And if I still can't find one, then I head to royalty-free websites and start searching. As Emilio says, this doesn't just take 15 minutes. Then I go to Canva to find beautiful frames for the photos so everything looks clean and tidy, use Markdown for the reader's comfort, and translate it block by block so the message doesn't lose its warmth when crossing borders._ _It is a silent work done with love, patience, and dedication, but I must confess that sometimes I feel like a ghost. These are hours spent on the details, and in the end, it seems as if the posts are transparent because, beyond the likes, seeing the comment box completely empty, desolate, is not nice. Seeing that lack of interaction brings an inevitable sense of nostalgia._ _I would be lying if I said that financial support doesn't make one's day; on the contrary, it is a fair reward that fills us all with satisfaction to receive and motivates us to keep going. But alongside that incentive, what truly enriches our experience and gives life to the blog is the fact that people read us, that they pause and gift us those beautiful comments in the box._
![Skincare de Verano - Post Facebook.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVp5fbB7gHuxSdmNNXWr8ceQFaG9Vidbcd2aSLj7Drr4o/Skincare%20de%20Verano%20-%20Post%20Facebook.png)

> ### Abrazar la reinvención para continuar # El ecosistema de las plataformas cambia constantemente. Las comunidades se transforman, las dinámicas de interacción suben y bajan, y a veces el feed se vuelve un lugar ruidoso y distraído donde es fácil perderse. Ante eso, creo que la respuesta más madura no es la frustración, sino la capacidad de adaptación. A lo largo de este tiempo, he descubierto que para poder continuar ha sido fundamental aprender a reinventarme. Reinventarse no significa traicionar tu esencia ni dejar de publicar lo que te mueve el alma; significa ser lo suficientemente flexible para buscar nuevas esquinas, probar dinámicas distintas o acercarse a comunidades más pequeñas donde la interacción sea más estrecha y cálida. Es mantener el espíritu curioso y despierto para que el viaje no se vuelva monótono. Revisar lo que hacemos siempre es sano. No para transformarnos en algo que no somos, sino para encontrar formas más frescas de conectar. Innovar en los formatos o diversificar los temas es, al final del día, la manera en que mantenemos viva la chispa de la escritura a pesar de los vientos fríos del feed.

> ### _Embracing reinvention to keep going_ # _The ecosystem of platforms is constantly changing. Communities transform, interaction dynamics rise and fall, and sometimes the feed becomes a noisy and distracted place where it is easy to get lost. In the face of that, I believe the most mature response is not frustration, but the ability to adapt._ _Throughout this time, I have discovered that in order to keep going, learning to reinvent myself has been essential. Reinventing yourself doesn't mean betraying your essence or stopping publishing what moves your soul; it means being flexible enough to look for new corners, try different dynamics, or approach smaller communities where interaction is closer and warmer. It is about keeping a curious and awake spirit so the journey doesn't become monotonous._ _Reviewing what we do is always healthy. Not to transform ourselves into something we are not, but to find fresher ways to connect. Innovating formats or diversifying topics is, at the end of the day, how we keep the spark of writing alive despite the cold winds of the feed._
![Neutral Retro Summer Trip Instagram Post.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPyescUgbRp8KsdtcH61Tx9p7A9pSnCTZr4H6KCy4LXvP/Neutral%20Retro%20Summer%20Trip%20Instagram%20Post.png)

> ### Conclusión # Agradezco profundamente a Emilio por abrir esta conversación tan humana. Me quedo con la certeza de que este camino de escribir es un viaje de resistencia y disfrute. Mientras mantengamos el respeto por nuestra propia obra, el orgullo por el trabajo bien maquetado y la puerta abierta para seguir transformándonos, cada línea escrita habrá valido la pena. Al fin y al cabo, las modas pasan, pero las historias genuinas siempre encuentran su lugar. Muchas gracias por leerme y por compartir este rato conmigo.

> ### _To Wrap Up_ # _I deeply thank Emilio for opening this very necessary conversation. I am left with the certainty that this path of writing is a journey of resistance and enjoyment. As long as we maintain respect for our own work, pride in a well-formatted layout, and the door open to keep transforming ourselves, every written line will have been worth it. After all, trends pass, but genuine stories always find their place._ _Thank you very much for reading me and for sharing this time with me._

body.title: Evolución
body.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQcgkPK7fZXDAfcgCbswkBnTvtXLYSRrUpJKGirCWnN5F/20260602_160624.jpg)<sub>[X](https://x.com/i/status/2047730558310944915)</sub></center>


---

Ganar a Tampa es difícil. Los Rays es de los pocos equipos en MLB que apenas pierden, por lo que derrotas como la que tuvieron ante Detroit, son difíciles de ver. Mérito para los Tigers, quienes vieron como en el octavo inning las cosas se le ponían color hormiga, luego de un partido que parecía fácil.

Pues Tampa se quedó a solo una rayita de empatar el marcador en esa entrada, y ya luego en el final no pudieron concretar la remontada. De esta manera los Tigers comenzaron el mes de junio con el pie bueno, luego de un desatroso mayo que los tienen ahora mismo en el fondo de la división central de la Americana.

De parte de los Rays está el cubano Yandy Díaz quien mantuvo su condición de hombre de contacto, y largó 3 imparables en 5 oportunidad al plato, uno de ellos un doble. Con esta actuación se posición 3ro en average, solo por detrás de Otto Lopez y el venezolano Luis Arráez. Temporada excelente otra vez para el cubano.

Otro de los equipos derrotados ayer fue Los Medias Blancas. Minnesota hizo carreras suficientes, pero su pitcheo titubeó y pudo ser más difícil la victoria.  Imagínense que Miguel Vargas se adjudicó para de jonrones e impulsó 4 carreras. Además en el mismo primer inning pegó un doble larguísimo que casi se lleva la cerca, con un compañero además en circulación.

Si esa pelota pasaba, el marcador final hubiese sido 9 por 8 y tal vez la presión hubiese sido mayor.  Lo que pudo ser y no fue, no pasó, pero lo que sí es un hecho es que Miguel Vargas va camino a una temporada de ensueño. El habanero llegó a 15 cuadrangulares en esta temporada y está a solo 1 de su mejor marca, la cual alcanzó en 2025. 

Sin dudas, estamos en presencia de una carrera que evoluciona. No pensé jamás que el muchacho de 23 años estuviera siendo un puntal de su equipo, y que estuvieran luchando en serio por jugar la Postemporada. 

Quizás ahora mismo varios equipos ya lo estén mirando para el futuro cercano, o tal vez los White Sox ya estén pensando en contar con el a largo plazo. Yo apostaría por el. Pero no especulemos más, dejemos que todo fluya de manera positiva

body.title: Branża prawnicza w Polsce – między tradycją a nowoczesnością
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmewhYvW3WKbLkpzCYSE7DDXt6sWiGK6t9kmexLu92vpWH/1780431050046.jpg)


Branża prawnicza w Polsce od wielu lat przechodzi ogromne zmiany. Jeszcze kilkanaście lat temu kancelarie kojarzyły się głównie z ciężkimi tomami kodeksów, stosami papierów i bardzo formalnym podejściem do klienta. Dziś coraz częściej prawnicy muszą odnaleźć się w świecie cyfrowym, mediów społecznościowych, sztucznej inteligencji i rosnącej konkurencji na rynku usług prawnych.

Współczesny klient oczekuje już nie tylko wiedzy prawniczej, ale także szybkości działania, przejrzystej komunikacji i dostępności praktycznie przez całą dobę. To sprawia, że zawód prawnika w Polsce staje się coraz bardziej wymagający, ale jednocześnie otwiera zupełnie nowe możliwości rozwoju.

Rosnąca konkurencja na rynku usług prawnych

W ostatnich latach liczba kancelarii prawnych w Polsce znacząco wzrosła. Coraz więcej młodych osób kończy studia prawnicze i decyduje się na aplikacje adwokackie, radcowskie czy notarialne. W dużych miastach konkurencja jest ogromna, a kancelarie muszą walczyć o klientów nie tylko ceną, ale przede wszystkim jakością usług oraz wizerunkiem.

Jeszcze niedawno wielu prawników opierało swoją działalność głównie na poleceniach. Obecnie coraz większą rolę odgrywa marketing internetowy. Strony internetowe kancelarii, profile w mediach społecznościowych, publikacje eksperckie czy filmy edukacyjne na TikToku i YouTube stają się standardem.

Klienci coraz częściej przed wyborem prawnika sprawdzają opinie w Google, aktywność kancelarii w internecie oraz sposób komunikacji. Dla młodszych pokoleń ogromne znaczenie ma również prosty język i zrozumiałe tłumaczenie skomplikowanych przepisów.

Technologia zmienia zawód prawnika

Cyfryzacja dotarła również do branży prawniczej. Wprowadzenie elektronicznych rozpraw, e-doręczeń czy systemów takich jak KRS online i ePUAP całkowicie zmieniło codzienną pracę wielu kancelarii.

Coraz większą rolę zaczyna odgrywać także sztuczna inteligencja. Narzędzia AI potrafią dziś analizować dokumenty, przygotowywać projekty umów, wyszukiwać orzecznictwo czy pomagać w tworzeniu pism procesowych. Dla części prawników jest to ogromna szansa na przyspieszenie pracy, dla innych natomiast źródło obaw o przyszłość zawodu.

W praktyce jednak technologia nie zastąpi doświadczenia, strategii procesowej oraz umiejętności negocjacji. AI może pomóc w pracy technicznej, ale nadal to człowiek odpowiada za interpretację prawa i kontakt z klientem.

Problemy polskiego wymiaru sprawiedliwości

Jednym z największych problemów branży prawniczej w Polsce pozostaje przeciążenie sądów. Wiele spraw ciągnie się miesiącami, a nawet latami. Dotyczy to zarówno spraw cywilnych, gospodarczych, jak i rodzinnych.

Długie terminy rozpraw oraz częste zmiany przepisów powodują frustrację zarówno po stronie klientów, jak i samych prawników. Wielu przedsiębiorców narzeka na niestabilność prawa oraz ogromną ilość nowych regulacji, które pojawiają się praktycznie każdego roku.

Prawnicy muszą stale się szkolić i śledzić zmieniające się przepisy. W ostatnich latach szczególnie dużo zmian dotyczyło prawa podatkowego, gospodarczego oraz ochrony danych osobowych.

Specjalizacja staje się koniecznością

Jeszcze kiedyś wielu prawników prowadziło sprawy „od wszystkiego”. Dziś rynek coraz bardziej wymusza specjalizację. Klienci szukają ekspertów od konkretnych dziedzin – prawa karnego, rodzinnego, gospodarczego, nieruchomości czy nowych technologii.

Dużą popularnością zaczynają cieszyć się również niszowe specjalizacje związane z kryptowalutami, cyberbezpieczeństwem, sztuczną inteligencją czy ochroną danych osobowych. Rozwój technologii sprawia, że pojawiają się zupełnie nowe obszary wymagające wiedzy prawnej.

W praktyce oznacza to, że współczesny prawnik musi nie tylko znać przepisy, ale również rozumieć biznes, technologię oraz mechanizmy działania internetu.

Czy zawód prawnika nadal daje prestiż?

Mimo wielu zmian zawód prawnika nadal cieszy się dużym prestiżem społecznym. Adwokaci i radcowie prawni są postrzegani jako osoby posiadające specjalistyczną wiedzę oraz wysokie kompetencje.

Jednocześnie rzeczywistość branży nie zawsze wygląda tak idealnie, jak mogłoby się wydawać. Początki kariery bywają trudne, szczególnie dla młodych aplikantów. Wysoka konkurencja, koszty prowadzenia kancelarii i presja odpowiedzialności sprawiają, że sukces wymaga wielu lat pracy.

Największe kancelarie obsługujące duże firmy oraz korporacje osiągają bardzo wysokie przychody, jednak mniejsze kancelarie często muszą mocno walczyć o utrzymanie stabilnej pozycji na rynku.

Przyszłość branży prawniczej

Najbliższe lata prawdopodobnie przyniosą dalszą cyfryzację usług prawnych. Coraz więcej spraw będzie załatwianych online, a klienci będą oczekiwać szybkiego kontaktu i przejrzystych procedur.

Możliwe, że część prostych usług prawnych zostanie w dużym stopniu zautomatyzowana przez sztuczną inteligencję. Jednocześnie wzrośnie znaczenie prawników specjalizujących się w skomplikowanych sprawach wymagających doświadczenia, negocjacji oraz indywidualnego podejścia.

Branża prawnicza w Polsce stoi dziś na granicy dwóch światów – tradycyjnego modelu pracy opartego na papierowej dokumentacji oraz nowoczesnego rynku usług cyfrowych. Jedno jest jednak pewne: prawo nadal pozostanie jednym z fundamentów funkcjonowania państwa, biznesu i codziennego życia obywateli.

Dlatego rola prawników, mimo dynamicznych zmian technologicznych, wciąż będzie niezwykle ważna.

body.title: Nobody Expected This Dragon Strategy to Work !!
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1780430660159-c23760616632dcd2.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=nexo0702/66bb1268)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=nexo0702/66bb1268)


---

**Hello**
**Splinterlands Lovers !!**

**Today, I will be sharing a Splinterlands battle with you. I managed to win a match today, and I would like to point out that the opposing team utilized cards leveled up to Level 8. In contrast, my team consisted mostly of cards at Level 4—or even lower, down to Level 3—which were the ones I selected and deployed for this battle. Now, to be honest, when you watch the battle replay, it might initially appear as though I had already lost, given how incredibly powerful the opposing team's cards were. However, once you view the battle link and video I have provided, you will realize that this was truly an epic encounter. The victory I achieved was quite extraordinary: only a single card of mine remained standing at the very end—and even that card missed its attack twice—yet, ultimately, it was that specific card that secured the win for me. This was because, throughout the entire match, both my cards and the opposing team's cards performed with immense power and intensity. I will share further details regarding this battle in the rest of this post.**


![Screenshot 2026-06-03 005452.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nexo0702/23t7B7C7bTMDq8wZEprYsD95VMnUHfKKtRUErdyDi6q4qRvL89fZXDrrMr4gmGGZTM8LV.png)

[Battle Link](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_d9fd189a407142a4353f51dda793f462)


**Let me provide you with some details regarding the battle. The most powerful monster on the enemy team is named Grum Flameblade. This is the enemy team's standout card, and the card supporting it is called Ferox Defender. This card helped boost Grum Flameblade's armor; consequently, my physical damage—which would typically deplete the armor first before affecting the health—was absorbed by the increased protection. This strategy employed by the enemy team was quite impressive. My team delivered a magnificent performance, making a valiant effort to defeat the enemy squad. One of my cards, named Mindless Snail, dealt significant damage; since each of its attacks inflicts 4 points of damage, it landed a very powerful blow against the enemy team. Finally, regarding the last card—the Night Reaper—it missed two attacks towards the end of the match, which ultimately allowed me to win the battle.**


![Screenshot 2026-06-03 010726.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nexo0702/23tGZrEsHuWRwwKDQ16TATdxc76ijjxfocyxvEypMQQijdg66CHTbLqA8tTZaUdHvqbAK.png)



**This card is named the Night Reaper. It is an Epic card belonging to the Dragon team. This card has a Mana cost of 11. I typically use this card in battles with a high Mana cap. Currently, I possess a Level 1 version of this card. It currently features 3 Magic Attack power, 9 Health, and 4 Speed. This card possesses the Flying ability, which proves useful for preserving its Health during an Earthquake. As you will observe in the battle footage, the final two attacks of the match missed this card, thereby securing the victory. Thus, among the many cards that have the potential to evade attacks—and consequently turn a losing battle into a win—this card is certainly one of them. I hope you enjoyed watching this battle!**

Thank u !

---

body.body: > ![1491.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wWw7VYLjardvLkLx2pT6vpLFuRbSYN5nPgtvXJnsCg8VvmBXpkqBgxpdgtwLRUMD3WA.png) Maj był najsłabszym miesiącem w tym roku, jeśli chodzi o bieganie. Dwie przerwy, spowodowane wizytą gości oraz wyjazdem do Dublina, przełożyły się na prawie dwa tygodnie bez treningów. Aby czerwiec nie wyglądał podobnie, postawiłem na bieganie już od pierwszego dnia miesiąca. Jak zwykle chciałbym połączyć bieganie z odpowiednią liczbą kilometrów na rowerze – zobaczę, czy w tym miesiącu uda mi się zrealizować oba te cele. > ***[ENG] May was the weakest month of the year so far in terms of running. Two breaks, caused by visiting guests and a trip to Dublin, added up to nearly two weeks of missed running. To make sure June doesn't turn out the same, I’ve committed to running from day one. As always, I’d like to combine running with a solid mileage on the bike—we'll see if I can achieve both goals this month.*** ![IMG_5275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23vsBiEg7QWMef5Ghifpyvt3oFt1soh121h6b2iZFiHYeHtmJ8fSXhpN11Jr82bEASua4.jpg) ![IMG_5277.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23vhqCGi13yEdBrtFwYkaHFEpZoyFYZRXdzgPjunEWPfi3P1k6LWUBHaJDYr25WAfio1N.jpg) ![IMG_5280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wqgbEdyhYnK9RL4tc78mUzNCVFkiiHgP4YUNFxEzSxz9M7ZA9dbQGhY5gsGTbLFHd79.jpg) Zrobiłem spokojny bieg po uliczkach wokół osiedla. Miałem trzy dni przerwy, więc nie byłem pewien, czy organizm odpoczął wystarczająco. Po burzach powietrze nieznacznie się oczyściło, ale wciąż było duszno. Na dodatek miałem dość ograniczony czas, ponieważ później byliśmy umówieni ze znajomą na wyjazd na farmę po truskawki. > ***[ENG] I went for an easy run through the streets around the neighborhood. Having had a three-day break from running, I wasn't sure if my body had recovered enough. After the storms, the air had cleared up slightly, but it was still muggy, and on top of that, I was on a tight schedule because we had plans to meet a friend later and drive to a farm to pick up some strawberries.*** ![IMG_5281.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/244eGomr72E8kYSF9hFdNs9u8W8KHjWAfwennDjkYCBohKrydFrw2r2tgwyTbzUEaz7Ag.jpg) ![IMG_5286.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/2423uVtpD3DY6AMqzRXFofW53c6Q38ts5cE7HvWXReM6XrCH2M4sE7rcMAxAYw946BZJQ.jpg) ![0106.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23tkmpdyUJPzJxYhUHdSmHmUQGarVbxUDBdP9iX3QKHQb2CU2C7DamQD2ZSBxgqFz9hRL.png) Wieczorem wybraliśmy się z żoną na krótki spacer i trafiliśmy do centrum Mons, gdzie nadal trwało świętowanie Doudou. Przeszliśmy się tylko wśród tłumów, ale nie czekaliśmy na zabawę i koncert, który miał rozpocząć się około 20:30. Było na tyle głośno, że muzykę słyszeliśmy później na naszym balkonie, trzy kilometry od centrum miasta. > ***[ENG] In the evening, my wife and I went for a short walk and ended up in the center of Mons, where the Doudou festivities were still going strong. We just walked through the crowds but didn't stay for the party and the concert, which was set to start around 8:30 PM. It was so loud that we could actually hear the music from our balcony, three kilometers away from the city center.*** ![IMG_5298.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/244e8EPmXwmKopdgDnPTyryrVG8XN6fTBAARTT8qmVJi1z7rTgA29ynUAoXJfnP9XZDCd.jpg) ![IMG_5299.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/242DLevo42PsycVdgPwQdSpzrG4Uqa8RirGYXUje4kkLcb2F25cYSxq7iQcuYh9e2K5X6.jpg) ---

body.title: ¿Un año más o un año menos de vida? | [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
Hay muchos puntos de vista cuando se trata de cumpleaños y tener un año más, algunos dicen que es un año más de vida, pero otros dicen que es un año menos de vida.

En mi opinión, hay cierta verdad en ambos pensamientos porque, por un lado, aumenta tu edad, te haces mayor, tienes más experiencia sumando a tu vida. Pero por el otro lado, te queda menos tiempo de vida, porque si bien no sabes cuándo te irás de este mundo, en el recorrido de la vida ya has avanzado un buen tanto.

Hoy quise escribir sobre este tema ya que es mi cumpleaños, es un día muy bonito que, a lo largo de los años, he pasado con mi familia feliz y algunas veces con algo de tristeza, pero siempre había un rayito de luz que me alegraba ese día.

![poaps gifs (6).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/AKGcMMhuai2sZx9qoh2VzdfMgHG1cuvtVbATwmSVMtwSXEZ545psRSsuNzi856j.gif)
Recuerdo digital por mi cumpleaños. *(GIF creado con IA y Canva).*

Quizá estos 2 puntos de vista que les comento depende también de la etapa en la que estás, aunque varios dicen que eso también depende de cada persona, algunos maduran más antes que otros, por diferentes motivos.

Yo creo que hay que tener en cuenta ambos, porque por un lado cada año que pasa ves todo lo que has logrado, ves dónde has llegado hablando de metas y objetivos. Por el otro lado también debes tomar conciencia que, si quieres hacer algo más, debes empezar cuanto antes, porque no sabes cuánto tiempo te queda.

Es como una carrera donde puedes mirar todo lo que has avanzado, aprender, sacar todo lo bueno de lo recorrido para así poder llegar a la meta final.

Es complicado este asunto, seguramente algunos lo verán como el vaso medio vacío o medio lleno, seguramente ahora tú, que me estás leyendo habrás pensado de qué “lado” estar y cómo ves el cumplir un año más.

A mí me pasa que en esta fecha suelo recordar cómo lo festejaba con familiares y amigos, comiendo una torta, cantando, comiendo mi plato favorito, pero sobre todo disfrutando el momento.

![33.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EpzxEfdQ8ycY9fcLPemE6XrFFX1tpDvWqjVxQ6xpXEM7CLFTsckjqb2DDfw2crp2rVs.png)
Mi primer cumpleaños. *(Foto del archivo familiar y edición en Canva).*

Desde pequeña siempre fueron así mis cumpleaños, sí o sí compartirlo con mi familia y si se podía al día siguiente con mis amigas. Y este día no será la excepción porque también me espera un rico almuerzo y por la tarde una torta.

Algo que siempre pienso es que el día del cumpleaños es un día muy especial, recibes muchos saludos y felicitaciones, algunos regalos, comida, momentos bonitos.

Y como a veces suelen preguntar cuál fue tu mejor cumpleaños y yo creo que fueron varios, en algunos porque tuve fiestas, otros porque fui al cine, otros por la comida, por los regalos, pero como les dije anteriormente, lo importante al final es pasarlo con tus seres queridos.

Un dato interesante, uno de los mejores cumpleaños que pasé fue en pandemia, ustedes dirán, pero ¿por qué? si todos estábamos encerrados, te podías enfermar, eran días muy complicados. Pero en mi caso es donde más sentí el cariño, porque llegaron mensajes de todas partes del mundo, en más de 3 idiomas, me llegaron regalos a mi casa y lo disfruté con mi familia.

![34.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/Eos49TZQP21cb1LFwE7SeKYY2KaNCFYagJJ9QNLzYw7yZGPWTbjkM2hbWsiHHCJyWov.png)
Mi cumpleaños en pandemia. *(Fotos de mi autoría y edición en Canva).*

A veces no solo depende del contexto sino de con quiénes lo quieres celebrar, creo que eso es lo más importante, al menos en mi caso.

También están quienes no disfrutan celebrar ese día, posiblemente porque vivieron o pasaron por una mala experiencia ese día o simplemente porque no están acostumbrados a celebrarlo.

Sea como sea, creo que es un día muy importante porque sí es un año más que cumples en este mundo, pero también tienes menos tiempo de hacer lo que quieres, de cumplir tus sueños, de alcanzarlo y hacerlos realidad.

No es que quiera asustarlos con todo esto, solo quiero que vean lo que han creado hasta ahora y todo lo que aún pueden lograr si se ponen tiempos, objetivos a corto y mediano plazo, para que no les pase lo que siempre dicen por ahí: “si hubiera hecho eso antes”, “por qué no lo hice cuando era joven”, “ya es tarde para mí” y muchas otras.

![35.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EqHxt8nxtQ7M9NtenuH17Gpj239FLYsHM7cBvaNL8mwaxj5AMmtyj4YYsHXJDixUpkQ.png)
Un año más y un años menos. *(Foto de mi autoría y edición en Canva).*

El momento es ahora, si quieres viajar, comprar una casa, tener tu propio negocio, tener una familia, es momento de ponerte en campaña para cumplirlo.

Sé que no es rápido, pero de a poco puedes ir armando los pasos a seguir, tener en claro qué quieres lograr, qué necesitas para hacerlo, cómo lo vas a hacer y ahora hasta con ayuda de la IA puedes ir armando todo un plan para cumplirlo y con los requerimientos que tú le digas.

La cosa es empezar de una vez y no dejarlo para otro día.

Espero te haya gustado mi post y que tomes acción.

Que tengas una linda semana y ¡feliz cumpleaños para mí!

![36.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EoCfjzw6ubYeGoLbknum9n7Yho6Y3X7NEzctWqfn1rnZMNgpsxJs6Cr4W39HHJ9MsvQ.png)

# One more year or one less year to live?

There are many different perspectives when it comes to birthdays and turning another year older; some say it’s one more year of life, while others say it’s one less year of life.

In my opinion, there’s some truth to both views because, on the one hand, you get older, you gain more experience, and you add to your life’s journey. But on the other hand, you have less time left to live, because even though you don’t know when you’ll leave this world, you’ve already come a long way on life’s journey.

Today I wanted to write about this topic since it’s my birthday—it’s a very special day that, over the years, I’ve spent with my family, sometimes happily and sometimes with a touch of sadness, but there was always a ray of light that brightened my day.

Perhaps these two points of view I’m sharing with you also depend on the stage of life you’re in, although many say that it also depends on each person—some mature sooner than others, for different reasons.

I think you have to take both into account, because on one hand, with each passing year, you see everything you’ve accomplished; you see where you’ve gotten in terms of goals and objectives. On the other hand, you also have to realize that if you want to do something more, you have to start as soon as possible, because you don’t know how much time you have left.

It’s like a race where you can look back at how far you’ve come, learn from it, and take all the good from the journey so you can reach the finish line.

This is a complicated issue; some will surely see it as the glass being half empty or half full. I’m sure that you, reading this right now, have been wondering which “side” to take and how you feel about turning another year older.

For me, on this day, I usually remember how I used to celebrate with family and friends—eating cake, singing, enjoying my favorite meal, but above all, savoring the moment.

Ever since I was little, my birthdays have always been like that: I had to share them with my family, and if possible, with my friends the next day. And this day will be no exception, because a delicious lunch awaits me, and cake in the afternoon.

Something I always think is that your birthday is a very special day—you get lots of greetings and well-wishes, some gifts, food, and beautiful moments.

And since people sometimes ask what your best birthday was, I think there were several: some because I had parties, others because I went to the movies, others because of the food or the gifts. But as I said before, what matters in the end is spending it with your loved ones.

Here’s an interesting fact: one of the best birthdays I ever had was during the pandemic. You might ask, “Why?” since we were all locked down, you could get sick—those were very difficult days. But in my case, that’s when I felt the most love, because I received messages from all over the world, in more than three languages, gifts arrived at my house, and I enjoyed it with my family.

Sometimes it doesn't just depend on the context, but on who you want to celebrate with; I think that's the most important thing, at least for me.

There are also those who don't enjoy celebrating that day, perhaps because they had a bad experience on that day or simply because they aren't used to celebrating it.

Whatever the case, I think it’s a very important day because it’s another year you’ve spent in this world, but it also means you have less time to do what you want, to fulfill your dreams, to reach them, and to make them a reality.

It’s not that I want to scare you with all this; I just want you to see what you’ve created so far and everything you can still achieve if you set deadlines and short- and medium-term goals, so that you don’t end up saying what people always say: “If only I’d done that sooner,” “Why didn’t I do it when I was young?” “It’s too late for me now,” and many others.

The time is now. If you want to travel, buy a house, start your own business, or start a family, it’s time to get moving to make it happen.

I know it’s not quick, but little by little you can start mapping out the steps to take, be clear about what you want to achieve, what you need to do it, and how you’re going to do it. And now, with the help of AI, you can even put together a complete plan to achieve it based on the requirements you set.

The key is to get started right away and not put it off until tomorrow.

I hope you enjoyed my post and that you take action.

Have a wonderful week, and happy birthday to me!

body.title: Institutions matters a lot
body.body:
>

It says that the time of student life is the best time for us, and most of us spend most of our interesting time there. We have many memorable moments as students, and maybe for that reason, all of us miss our life as students. I completed my post-graduation 8 months ago, approximately, and from this perspective, it can be said I am not a student anymore. I agree that student life is the best time for us, but some of us have regrets thinking that if we were in different institutes, it would be better. Do you have any regrets like that? Let me share my thoughts about it. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSKiuBVq6Q4nNe8AQjDf6B6acE4RvH1CQXi48XLvuyjK1/image.png) [ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/white-and-blue-concrete-building-under-blue-sky-during-daytime-0d-z8cJGIR4) From the academic perspective, my student life can be considered a successful one. I ended up as a topper in my students' lives, and I know many people can be envious in case of academic achievement. To be honest, in my childhood I didn’t even think I could go so far if my academic achievement, but somehow, I managed it. I was good at studying, and I managed to study in one of the top universities of my country with the best facilities, and I consider myself lucky in that case, but I worked hard for it also. My result was satisfying, and I don’t have any kind of regret in such a case. But I am sure that I have some regrets for not enjoying my student life as I was fully focused on studying, especially till my XII class. If I have a chance, I would love to enjoy the time before I pass the XII class because I would love to focus on enjoying more besides my studies. I wish I wouldn’t be so obsessed with my studies and missing many important moments. I really regret it sometimes. But fortunately, in my university life, I enjoyed myself quite well besides my studies. So, in university life I don’t actually have any regrets. If I could go back, would I love to change any institution? Does it actually matter where we learn things? In my case, it actually doesn’t matter, but different institutions mean different people, and the experience could be different. Learning can be the same, but learning from two different environments and being surrounded by different people may bring different lessons and experiences. But I don’t want to change anything even if I have any options. I believe that now I can cherish my moments quite well because I understand the value of those moments, and I value them as I don’t want to miss anything more than I missed in the past. I regret my past, and that’s why I am now very serious about repeating the same mistake. So, I believe that which school I go to, where we learn, actually matters, as the people and experience matter a lot.

About a month ago, @konchix and I were invited to the 40th wedding anniversary party—known as the Ruby Anniversary—of her friend Maricela, whom we hold in high regard, especially Konchix, since she worked with her for a long time and they developed a close friendship.

The party was held at the Quinta Padrón in Cholul in Mérida Yucatán, a very beautiful venue with lovely spots for couples to take photos.

Many guests attended; the food was delicious, and there was a wide variety of drinks, including mezcal in various flavors and cocktails made with different spirits and flavors.

The party was very well-entertained with a band, and even a comedian came to entertain the crowd with a very funny show. At one point, the groom took the microphone to surprise the bride and dedicate some emotional words to her that moved us all to tears.

body.title: Ficción: El árbol que era ella.../ The tree that was her... 🌳❤️
body.body: > Mamá contaba que cuando nació la abuela Cleotilde, su papá plantó un árbol. Según las creencias del pueblo, cada persona es un árbol en este universo. Ese árbol estaba detrás de la casa, y aunque mi abuela medía apenas un metro cuarenta, el árbol creció muchísimo, tanto que sus ramas se extendían por encima de la cerca de la casa familiar y se asomaban a las casas de los vecinos. Cuando era niño, recuerdo que ese árbol era el favorito de todos los nietos. Nos subíamos a él y saltábamos de rama en rama como monos en la selva. Recuerdo que todas las tardes nos tumbábamos en la grama y jugábamos a su sombra. Desde allí, veíamos pájaros multicolores que llegaban de todas partes para posarse en sus ramas durante la noche. Con la llegada de esos pájaros, sabíamos que la tarde había terminado y que debíamos entrar a la casa.

>o0o

Por eso nos debimos preocuparnos cuando al árbol le empezó a brotar una pelusa blanca, como si estuviera cubierto de nieve. Mamá decía que era por su edad, que la madera estaba vieja y débil, así que nos prohibió trepar y columpiarnos en sus ramas. Además, antes de que llegara el otoño, sus hojas se marchitaron y empezaron a caer. Dejamos de jugar en el árbol, pero, curiosamente, los pájaros también dejaron de posarse en él. Fue entonces cuando la gente empezó a decir que el árbol estaba enfermo, y siguiendo el consejo de un hombre que venía de muy lejos —nadie sabía de dónde venía—, un día decidieron podarlo: \_El árbol necesita ser podado para que recupere su fuerza, dijo el desconocido, y mamá encontró a un hombre que lo podara.

>o0o

Debimos haber parado con el primer hachazo, porque cuando el hombre cortó, un líquido rojo comenzó a brotar a borbotones de la madera, pero él continuó como si esa savia fuera la sangre del árbol. Debimos haber dicho basta cuando, después de varios golpes, el crujido de las ramas sonó como un lamento, un grito humano eterno e interminable. Pero el hombre siguió cortando frente a nosotros, implacablemente, con mucha fuerza. Cuando la mayor parte del árbol estaba en el suelo, corrimos a avisarle a la abuela, que estaba enferma en la cama, pero no pudimos hablar, porque la abuela ya había muerto. * * * * * * * * *

>The tree that was her... Mom said that when Grandma Cleotilde was born, Dad planted a tree. According to the village beliefs, each person is a tree in this universe. That tree was at the back of the house, and although my grandmother was only about four feet seven inches tall, the tree grew enormously, so much so that its branches reached over the fence of the family home and peeked into the neighbors' houses. When I was a child, I remember that tree was the favorite of all the grandchildren. We would climb it and jump from branch to branch like monkeys in the jungle. I remember that every afternoon we would lie down on the grass and play in its shade. From down there, we would see multicolored birds arriving from all over to perch on its branches for the night. With the arrival of these birds, we knew that the afternoon was over and we should go inside.

>o0o

That's why we had to worry when the tree started sprouting white fuzz, as if it were covered in snow. Mom said it was because of old age, that the tree's wood was old and weaker, so she forbade us from climbing it and swinging on its branches. Also, before autumn had even arrived, its leaves withered and began to fall. We stopped playing in the tree, but strangely, the birds stopped perching there either. It was around that time that people started saying the tree was sick, and on the advice of a man who came from far away—no one knew where he came from—they decided one day to prune it: \
the stranger said, and Mom found a man to prune the tree.\n\n

>o0o

We should have stopped with the first cut, because when the man sliced, a red liquid began to gush from the nadeea, but he continued as if that sap were the tree's lifeblood. We should have said enough was enough when, after several blows, the cracking of the branches sounded like a lament, an endless, eternal human cry. But the man kept cutting in front of us, relentlessly, with force. When most of the tree was on the ground, we ran to tell Grandma, who was sick in bed, but we couldn't speak, because Grandma was already dead.
>La imagen central fue creada en Canva y el texto fue traducido con Deepl
>Gracias por vuestra lectura, comentario y apoyo. Hasta una nueva oportunidad, amigos\n\n

body.title: Freewrite Dailyprompt: Not An Ally
body.body:
We are not an ally, not a friend. We are just workmates. So after work, we have no business together. We look almost good at work, but not when we are outside. And outside, it seems that we never knew each other. We just do our job at its best, make sure it works, take our paycheck and go to our various friends and various family.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVrhEprTrbwFAm1cViL6THF9LodzZGVTRJCewzQvDTVrV/1780428475947.jpg)
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/partnership-connectedness-people-526413/)

People tell us we are that close when they say we are at work, but that is another story. When we are outside, we are never that close. I don't think we won't call each other apart from work-related issues.

When they ask if he is my friend, I am sure of telling them he is not my friend. He is not an ally. We are just doing our work and doing what we have to do best at the right time and at the right place.

We are not an ally, not a friend. We are just doing our job at its best, make sure it works, take our paycheck and go to our various friends and various family.

body.title: Earthwork Sentinel: Protecting Allies, Debuffing Enemies
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXEZXYQ6xddq6958nGCG5mJiwaTEHMpMYx77TqJYG2yuH/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

The Earthwork Sentinel is a rare Earth splinter reward card that specializes in support rather than dealing damage. Despite having no attack, it provides several valuable utility abilities that can significantly improve your team's survivability and control of the battlefield. In today's post, well go through its lore, stats & abilities and show a battle where it's used effectively.

***

# Lore

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaYm8vK1xUUdjy2un8eQdS32aMz25pm5vrH6QChznoUKH/image.png)

Earthwork Sentinels are powerful earth elementals made of roots, stone and soil that excel at defense and battle control. They protect allies by raising barriers, slowing enemy movement and healing injuries. Their connection to the land allows them to sense vibrations and reveal hidden scouts, spies and assassins with ease. Positioned behind the front lines, they strengthen defenses and help hold strategic ground. As long as a Sentinel remains standing, the defensive line remains difficult to break.

***

# Stats and Abilities

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZCkvC87wLV59eNd4zaXAuuNHBiP9gvhPv7a26QjMn4pz/image.png)

The Earthwork Sentinel is a three mana card with no attack. Despite having no attack, it makes up for it by having four useful abilities at maxed level. 

Slow reduces the speed of all enemy monsters by one. 

Reveal exposes enemy monsters with Camouflage, allowing them to be targeted. 

Shield Ward grants the unit directly in front of it the Shield ability at the start of battle. 

Finally, Triage heals the most damaged allied unit in the backline each round.

The Earthwork Sentinel can gain an attack if paired with units with the Weapons Training ability like Bren Palesworn or Shiraza. 

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzrwtf3kB2dMqofsCFKbquduyaoaEeW7CS8HBRocJ8uz/image.png)

The featured battle was one from my own. My Earthwork Sentinel is at level two and has the Slow ability. I paired it with Shiraza to gain two magic damage along with beefy tank Ulundin Overseer. Then my supporting damage dealers were magic and range units. My team has a couple of debuffers, decreasing the enemy's speed and range attacks. I also had a Taunt unit to draw attacks away from my tank.

My enemy was strong, having a legendary archon that grants Resurgence two two units. It's a powerful ability that Resurrects the unit that has the ability once per battle. The archon also grants the Charge ability to Mundane Beasts that's why he had two melee units in second and third positions. The enemy also had Taunt unit and a unit that has the Shadow Focus ability. It grants additional power and Determined ability to all allied units in exchange for losing the chance to attack. The only chink in the enemy's armor was the rather weak first position unit. If he had a proper tank in first position then my team could have lost the battle. 

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_cdb6bf9f01674d7dd1c3e5403cbfd563?ref=logen9f)

***

# Final Thoughts

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNZN4n9XeAZ2nmr5gPMgQKPBffv3aPT2CPvEyCYZCB4aL/image.png)

The Earthwork Sentinel may not be a damage dealer, but it packs four useful support abilities into a very low mana cost. Its combination of Slow, Reveal, Shield Ward and Triage makes it one of the more versatile utility cards available to Earth players, especially in low mana battles where every mana point matters.

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

### Hi there my fellow Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another awesome Splinterlands post guys and gals, and I hope all of you are doing great in your lives and enjoying a fresh and pleasant day with your family and friends. For those of you who are actively grinding in this amazing web3 card game and trying hard to improve your NFT cards and asset collection, I believe most of you are currently busy battling in the season-ranked arena and trying to climb even higher in trophies before this season slowly moves forward. Right now, if we take a look at the ongoing season timer, there are still around 12 days and 18 hours left before the season reset happens, so there is still enough time left for grinding rewards, missions, and leaderboard dreams, so let's dive right in.

![Screenshot 2026-06-03 at 12.02.11 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/Eoe8EtckdP6R3qD4jAX9aF2XPvuu3bhNLbGHnk4rFPy1YUCMAEdWxhexK2CfxLX5pBv.png)

Talking about my own progress in the frontier mode of this game, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league tier with a trophy count of around 3,240. My goal for this season remains simple, reaching at least the 4,200 trophy mark and then seeing how far I can push from there.

![Screenshot 2026-06-01 at 11.25.03 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23t77FNxn61EYtz48b81gHaRL8REyj1kkWZHh8s3Uqcb6YGPwAeYvmK1saDNCG2QtXN24.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/EoCZWqnJT9RRnXrNE7F3rFiuZV9t3f2mXZfh6hR7N9Ek64vbHU8hw31PHZgjLiFadz4.png)
