body.body:
BUSINESS AND ENTERPENURSHIP
Hello #scifimultiverse, Happy new month and new week. Business, as enumerated, involves identifying gaps in society and filling those gaps through the provision of products or services. At one point in my country of origin, a predominant telecom company was billing customers on a per-minute basis. While citizens were crying foul about the tariff plan, there were no other competitors to challenge that status quo. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYv2JThmJ9sXpYRPac8YVgdJfRjqCmskCmR13ciCqFYLE/image.png) Suddenly, a national telecom rose to the challenge after conducting a SWOT analysis and market feasibility study. They launched a per-second billing and swooped their rival by the legs. That single action changed the narrative in the telecoms space in my country of origin. It brought competitive advantages to the new business and millions of subscribers after the launch. The business also attracted customers, while it witnessed sporadic growth. Market gaps like this can bring fortunes to businesses. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRw3aAZdP5d8dP44Ce8JniMMdEpgmq1u5sKm9v6ENasqT/image.png) Secondly, planning, creativity, and leadership skills are needed in running a profitable business. Not long ago, we imported products, and after costing, sales started selling the products. The next thing, we got filtered information that the forex price had fallen drastically. At that point, we were dazed by the options. During the management meeting and brainstorming session, we unanimously agreed to play a waiting game and stopped selling the products on all fronts. We warehoused the products. At that point, we have the time value of money and cash flow issues. The finance was keen and focused on waiting while other products with a reasonable profit margin received approval for sales. After a few months, the product became very scarce in the market. Businesses stopped importing it because of the low price. At that time, it became very scarce in the market. Customers started searching for the products everywhere. This tripled the prices of the products. Our sales personnel did well in alerting the accounts and the warehouse. The products went through cost analysis again using the present market value, and were sold very profitably. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbg4bHzBo26HtKwBAjUPgcZ8FfhA22Yn3pg5oqFTCsZMK/image.png) However, some products cannot really work with this waiting game. This is because of their expiration date. Therefore, the ability to navigate market forces, with a good market combination, while using the tactics of demand and supply, together with the 4Ps of marketing at every point of disposal, will bring the benefits of competitive advantage to the business. Feel free to join [here](https://ecency.com/@scifimultiverse/scifi-multiverse-prompt-edition-1-or-business-and-enterpenurship) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbU2hSgaX1Af4R4dWfwNG3TcPhZMquzbJbmqGKqd7BpTd/1780427533753.gif)

body.title: Mercy: The Quiet Strength of Survival
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWvt4J9ZLMNPUnoeyNeiDdRBMxqbw64zwSDMRChKCfCtx/Mercy%20The%20Quiet%20Strength%20of%20Survival.png 
[AI Images]</center>


Mercy is when you cannot even explain how you are surviving as a person, but for sure you are surviving. You don't have everything figured out, but every day God is showing up for you, and you don't have a choice than to thank God for it. Some people understand that the situation they are in is by the mercy of God.

While some people feel and take it for granted. With mercy, there is enough encouragement, provision even when you need it, and God always shows up quietly and powerful at the same time. Mercy is not a fireworks, it's not something that Hollywood can even explain or made a movie depiction of it.

Mercy might look like a steady hand at your back, helping you through life. It can be a timely word, it can be a closed door when there are more terrible wars out towards them. When life is looking like a chain of events that looks like more and more unanswered questions are coming your way.

Mercy makes life very soft. Persistent answer is that you can wake up and find a meal is in front of you, or a call has come through. Mercy can actually help you to look back and you will see a pattern of provision, whereas if not for mercy, you would do it all alone.

There are levels to seeing the mercy of God, though it can feel mysterious because it resists tidy explanation. You may not be able to trace the causal effect of mercy, it is something that is a little bit kind of spiritual, and that's the point. The place of mercy is teaching dependence and humility, just when you cannot explain what is happening.

Mercy bridge the gap. You can acknowledge if you want, not everybody acknowledge mercy at all time. Not everybody is visible enough to see it.

Some are not even Christian enough to attribute the help of God to him. Some take it for granted. And why does mercy matter in the life of a man? Even if you are not a Christian, we already know that we can beg a church in a court to tender justice with mercy.

So mercy is something that you can see in the hand of God and also in the hand of man. How do you even notice mercy? The first thing is when you slow down, then you look back, then you see some pattern of help from above that is far beyond your ability. Just know that that is mercy.

When you can actually say it out loud. Some people can recognize the mercy of God immediately they see it and they will call it out and thank God for it or they will even thank their luck. Through stories we also learnt that there are mercy in some people's life and it does reinforce the reality of their life into becoming a better person or greater human.

In the Christian point of view, silence and prayer to God in the area of mercy can actually be a thing. Living into mercy means that life is responding to you well and you are receiving it. Mercy goes a long way in dealing with you and making sure that your life is actually secured to the best of everyone's knowledge.

That is how beautiful mercy is.

body.body:
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/newageinv/23u6YZEEWyDC6k8vbfQA6JX6xFn8TKhWoDK7WVJHBidTWyBr88fpTtCiGgFmpVYVmLWvc.png)

The years of excess capital has continued to see money deployed in many asset classes which have provided plenty of great exits for startups. Most have been smaller relative to the Companies that have gained popularity on their disruption, innovation and growth.  With some of those coming to markets soon, I have begun to wonder if it could lead to potential runs on Private Equity capital which could dry up as trillions of dollars could find themselves back on the public markets.

I think this Summer will prove this out as the expectation is that huge IPOs will come to market. It could also mean the proverbial top to a bubble that has raised valuations to highs not seen since previous bubbles that have popped and led to severe declines. Given how the money supply has grown since the last bubble, we really do not know how the markets will remain stable if a severe decline occurs. Recent one have been fast and sharp only to rebound but I wonder what happens if there isn’t enough capital to buy the dip.

body.title: ‎More Than a Teacher: The Woman I'll Never Forget ‎
body.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎When I think about the teachers who passed through my life, one name always stands out, Mrs. Popoola. I met her during my secondary school days, and to this day, I still regard her as one of the most influential people I have ever known.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQma6uC79wJRArt2jQw68JgC5vqcuKBRETUGYMaGuETYknX/file_0000000043f471f493517b85888ef437.png 

‎
‎What actually made her so special was that she never behaved like a teacher who was only interested in teaching her subject and going home. She truly cared about her students. In fact, many of us saw her as a mother rather than just a teacher.
‎
‎Secondary school can be a difficult period for some students. While many of us were dealing with different challenges at home, Mrs. Popoola was always there to offer support in any way she could. She was the kind of person who would notice when a student was struggling and silently step in to help. Sometimes that help came in the form of advice, and other times it was financial support for students who could not afford certain things.
‎
‎One thing that amazed me more about her was her willingness to go beyond what was expected of a teacher. There were stories of students who found shelter and care through her kindness, even when she barely knew their parents. Looking back now, I realize how uncommon that was. Not everyone would make such sacrifices for people who were not their own children.
‎
‎Apart from her generosity, her words of encouragement were powerful too. Whenever a student felt discouraged or wanted to give up, she always had a way of speaking hope into their situation. She constantly reminded us that our background did not have to determine our future. Those simple words stayed with many of us and helped shape the way we approached life.
‎
‎It wasnnot just me who admired her. Almost every student who crossed her path had something positive to say about her. She treated everyone with kindness and respect, and that made her different from many other teachers I knew at the time.
‎
‎The impact Mrs. Popoola had on my life goes far beyond academics. She taught me the importance of kindness, compassion, and helping others whenever possible. Those lessons are still with me today.
‎
‎If I ever have the opportunity to meet her again, I will be genuinely happy. I would love to thank her for everything she did and for the positive influence she had on so many young lives. To me, Mrs. Popoola will never be just a teacher. She will always be a mother, a guardian, and one of the kindest people I have ever met.

body.body:
> ___ Hola, chicos, el día de hoy les traigo una recopilación de historias de risingstar del 2024. No había escrito porque estaba viendo qué iba a hacer para seguir escribiendo, pero volví a esta historia, como les dije, ya es vieja, pero yo voy a escribir la mía para que vean que yo no los abandono, chicos. Espero que la comunidad de risingstar mejore y tenga nuevas publicaciones de concurso y publicasiones. El protagonista se llama WEZ, el protagonista de esta historia.

Inglés

Hi, everyone! Today I’m bringing you a collection of RisingStar stories from 2024. I hadn’t been writing because I was figuring out what to do next, but I’ve come back to this story. As I told you, it’s old now, but I’m going to write my own so you can see that I haven’t abandoned you, guys. I hope the RisingStar community gets better and has new contest entries and posts. The main character is named WEZ—he’s the protagonist of this story. ___

> ___ Él vive en un pueblo lejano, lejos de sus padres, donde él y sus amigos eran una pandilla de chicos soñadores a los que les gustaba cantar en lugares para jóvenes, ya que donde él vivía era muy peligroso para la edad de ellos, pero contra eso estaban los sheriff del pueblo. El lugar estaba callado y quieto el bosque se reflejaba a lo lejos y dos jóvenes caminaban solos, inquietos, porque tenían un toque cerca de un bosque llamado La Aventura. Ellos, junto con su banda, caminaron hasta llegar a una casa vieja donde se suponía que iban a cantar en ese lugar, pero estaba oscuro.

ingles

He lives in a remote town, far from his parents, where he and his friends were a group of dreamers who liked to sing at hangouts for young people, since the area where he lived was too dangerous for kids their age—but the town sheriffs were against that. The place was quiet and still; the forest was visible in the distance, and two young men walked alone, restless, because they had a gig near a forest called La Aventura. They, along with their band, walked until they reached an old house where they were supposed to sing, but it was dark. ___ ___ En ese sitio estaban lo chicos pero dentro de la casa, lo que no sabían que era una sorpresa ellos entraron y se dieron cuenta de que era una sorpresa y empezó la fusión hasta que llegó la policía por desorden público. Wes quería ser un artista reconocido como lo era Michael Jackson y otros de esa época. Wes era un buen cantante, solo que no había cantado con otros artistas; él cantaba solo en casa y en espacios pequeños, pero nunca en una ciudad.

Inglés

The kids were there, but inside the house; they didn't know it was a surprise. They walked in and realized it was a surprise, and the party got started until the police showed up for disturbing the peace. body.title: The Magician of Riga and Bobby Fischer: humor, rivalry and camaraderie on the board
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYTzUYDTgYEPoW2ooUZLnKkYHSYhzTy3mjyCiU2dYG2Q1/1780425366132.jpg)

A warm greeting to TheChessCommunity. I’m glad to be back sharing stories and curiosities from the fascinating world of chess. To set the mood for this post, I’ve included a few screenshots from press coverage of real events where the three great figures I mention here—Mikhail Tal, Robert Fischer and Boris Spassky—were present.  

There was a tournament where Tal pulled off something that seemed almost impossible: he beat Fischer four times in a row. The first three games were a heavy blow for Bobby, who swore he’d get his revenge in the fourth. But Tal, always playful and inventive, had another trick up his sleeve. Fischer opened with his king’s pawn, and Tal, with a theatrical gesture, picked up his queen’s bishop pawn and moved it toward c6, as if he were about to play the Caro-Kann Defense. He held it there for a couple of seconds, then suddenly dropped it on c5, turning it into a Sicilian Defense. That little “troll” move drew laughs and threw Fischer off balance, and once again the Magician of Riga came out on top.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYErs2DozaTJwJ9BnxW34gkmhsmxbezpMrFimWc6dkLzV/1780425400188.jpg)

At the end of the game, Tal showed his spicy sense of humor once more. When asked for an autograph, instead of signing his own name, he wrote “Fischer,” joking that since he had beaten Bobby so many times, he had earned the right to sign as him. It was pure Tal—mischievous, witty, and unforgettable.  

Of course, Fischer eventually got his revenge. In a later game, he secured a significant advantage early on and carried it through to victory. That was his way of proving that, despite those losses, his talent and determination would ultimately take him to the very top of the chess world.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSqiQKTE1YCx2tBy1aa2kzTmMXKLXm6LBVLmE7oijUCtz/1780425437913.jpg)

Stories like these remind us that chess isn’t just about cold calculation and precise moves. It’s also about friendship, humor, and respect. FIDE sums it up in its motto: “Gens una sumus” (We are one family). And it’s true—on the 64 squares you see human attitudes ranging from camaraderie to rivalry, just like in life itself.  

One of the best examples of this spirit came from Boris Spassky. When a journalist asked him what he thought of Fischer, he replied: “Fischer is an excellent player. Arrogant? A little; but he has the right to be!” That answer, with its double exclamation marks, is a gem. It shows the greatness of acknowledging your rival and the nobility that can exist in chess. Spassky, Fischer’s opponent in the legendary 1972 Reykjavik match, always carried himself with dignity, even in defeat.  

And let’s not forget that many grandmasters, despite the tension of tournaments, shared analysis, jokes, and even dinners after games. Tal and Fischer, with their duels and antics, gave us a perfect example of how friendship can coexist with competition. Spassky, with his elegance, reinforced the idea that chess mirrors life: moments of tension, pride, humor, and mutual recognition.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbnncJcAzbpqVwNzr9re1sKuQkpvYZYkp4ftSQFvesFem/1780425480893.jpg)

My fellow players at our local club, though far from the elite, enjoy the magic of the Science Game, the game of the 64 squares, and joke around in the same spirit. Because chess, beyond wins and losses, is a way of living—reflected in the smallest details and the biggest gestures.  

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd6HgGNQ9hTeVe1uGJqAUz5SBDNNDE2vu2q5Kp7FNznf9/1780425533593.jpg)

Tal, Fischer, and Spassky left us not only unforgettable games but also lessons in humor, respect, and camaraderie that continue to inspire all of us who love this noble game.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfKffNs5EWqSF7irjaFD2hnahPFPe6aXdXqp15fNrpmXb/1780425693151.jpg)

***

body.title: ThreeTuneTuesday || Asaf Avidan [ESP-ENG] by @edwardstobia
body.body:
> Que puede decirles, hoy es otro martes de TTT y otro día para seguir disfrutando de la buena música que podemos encontrar en las diferentes plataformas digitales existentes que se encargan de la distribución de la música de forma digital pero si les digo algo, extraño muchísimo ir a una tienda de disco, escoger mientras escuchabas algún disco en específico. Era algo mucho más humano, algo que llenaba de alegría nuestras vidas. Hoy es solo recuerdos cargados de nostalgia pero así es todo, no podemos detener la evolución y el crecimiento de las cosas pues indiscutiblemente todo va a ir cambiando para bien o para mal. Así es el ritmo de la vida. >_What can I say? Today is another TTT Tuesday and another day to keep enjoying the great music we can find on the various digital platforms that distribute music online. But let me tell you something: I really miss going to a record store and browsing while listening to a specific album. It was a much more human experience, something that filled our lives with joy. Today, it’s just memories filled with nostalgia, but that’s just how it is we can’t stop the evolution and growth of things, because undeniably, everything is going to keep changing, for better or for worse. That’s just the rhythm of life._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
[![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23tbRL9CCENTc3A2TsUFTafcjKjgs4CahT6dHzUEJfigQaH9epCDKDFB2e2HesvvwJt3o.png)](https://www.20minutos.es/noticia/5178662/0/asaf-avidan-artista-es-un-chaman-que-transita-entre-visible-invisible/) Hay artistas que siguen construyendo obras musicales increíbles y algunos en un formato como solista. Y es que con tanta tecnología hoy en día, todo es posible para el artista y si tiene una creatividad infinita lo que podemos esperar de ellos son increíbles proyectos involucrando indiscutiblemente la tecnología. Creo que hace mucho tiempo compartí con ustedes la música de este cantante pero como la música es un alimento que podemos digerir con calma cuantas veces la consumamos, no está de más recordar lo maravilloso que es el arte cuando la creatividad está al 100% >_There are artists who continue to create incredible musical works, some of them as soloists. With all the technology available today, anything is possible for an artist, and if they possess boundless creativity, we can expect them to deliver incredible projects that undeniably incorporate technology. I think I shared this singer’s music with you a long time ago, but since music is nourishment we can savor at our own pace no matter how often we enjoy it, it’s worth remembering just how wonderful art is when creativity is at 100%._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQNa4rUkPS774JYQqw5ZQhxWVC3fuXkAwz3YT3xw2uaY4z8sk5bxhu5UWiBXfmMXshp.png Para mí es un gusto hablarles de Asaf Avidan el cual es un artista realmente fascinante y con algo tan único en la forma en que combina una aparente simplicidad con una profundidad musical y emocional que cubre todo lo que necesitamos para admirar cada uno de sus trabajos. Su voz es ese sello distintivo donde casi andrógina en los registros agudos, con un vibrato y un rasgado que parece venir de otro planeta y aunque hay quienes lo comparan con Janis Joplin o Robert Plant, para mí Asaf es algo muy diferente a ellos lo que lo hace realmente inclasificable e incomparable. [Image source](https://www.last.fm/es/music/Asaf+Avidan) > _It’s a pleasure for me to tell you about Asaf Avidan, a truly fascinating artist with something so unique in the way he combines apparent simplicity with a musical and emotional depth that encompasses everything we need to appreciate each of his works. His voice is his signature almost androgynous in the high registers, with a vibrato and a rasp that seem to come from another planet. And while some compare him to Janis Joplin or Robert Plant, to me, Asaf is something very different from them, which makes him truly unclassifiable and incomparable._ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23tbPcHtkaSAA4TSv34FYKjDVHZk8gUqZZHbv388MAL1o444WNfqtgabNfKP3wYDwDTUZ.png)](https://www.mondosonoro.com/criticas/conciertos-musica/asaf-avidan-barcelona/) Una de las grandes virtudes de Asaf es que no necesita sobre producir temas pues sus presentaciones y grabaciones funcionan perfectamente con apenas una guitarra acústica y su voz y es esa economía de recursos la que muchos como yo deberíamos aplicar pero bueno, no todos tenemos la capacidad vocal de Asaf y la manera económica de adquirir tantos pedales que ayuden su creación artística. Pero es esta sencillez lo que lo convierte en una fortaleza. >_One of Asaf’s greatest strengths is that he doesn’t need to overproduce his songs; his performances and recordings work perfectly with just an acoustic guitar and his voice. It’s that economy of resources that many of us myself included should emulate. But then again, not all of us have Asaf’s vocal range or the means to afford so many effects pedals to support his artistic creation. Yet it is this simplicity that makes it a strength._

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23t6zoM2haiRp5iDUmzetAHEJv1xJc8Mhda1nzeVeAtPG11Yjj8ihjiEHhiNPqpd96Dgc.png No hay duda que su evolución como artista después de ser líder y cantante de Asaf Avidan & the Mojos con ese folk-rock más eléctrico ha sido muy evidente que fue trabajo como solista fue en acenso tanto que se ha vuelto más introspectivo y experimental elementos que me llaman mucho la atención del artista. Quiero invitarlos a contagiarse con la magia de Asaf eso sí, mantengan la mente abierta porque lo que están por escuchar es algo que de seguro desgarrará sus sentidos de manera que quedaran anonadado por tanta explosión artística. [Image source](https://revistaladosis.com/asaf-avidan-llevando-el-folk-y-el-blues-a-otra-dimension-madrid-abril-23-2018) >_There’s no doubt that his evolution as an artist after serving as the lead singer and frontman of Asaf Avidan & the Mojos with their more electric folk-rock sound has been very evident. His work as a solo artist has been so compelling that he’s become more introspective and experimental, qualities that really stand out to me about him. I want to invite you to let yourself be swept up in Asaf’s magic just keep an open mind, because what you’re about to hear is sure to overwhelm your senses, leaving you stunned by such an artistic explosion._ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fo-qNzexDWE
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xv_obIKYGN8
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BjZUAI32TK0
Como siempre, me agradó mucho compartir en esta iniciativa del amigo @ablaze. Gracias por leerme. Me gusta #ThreeTuneTuesday así que bueno, seguiré junto a ustedes compartiendo este maravilloso arte. >_As always, I really enjoyed participating in this initiative by my friend @ablaze. Thanks for reading. I love #ThreeTuneTuesday, so I’ll keep sharing this wonderful art with all of you._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQtP2R1a2EhamPWx6xAWC35MDfmvyQ3WiDWuYq1or5Xc4oxGUTBJU4XkY81A5Dqgszp.png) A bordo de la nave me despido, mi querida familia. ❤LOS QUIERO❤

body.title: En busca de las flores perfectas / in search of the perfect flowers
body.body:
Hola amigos feliz día a todos espero que estén super bien, hace unos días mi novio me dió la tarea de ir por unas flores como les he comentado mi suegra falleció hace 3 meses y hace dos semanas hubiera Sido su cumpleaños de vida así que nosotros íbamos a ir a llevarle flores los dos trabajamos así que se nos hacía un poquito difícil el tema de ir a comprar Pero yo le dije que cuando yo saliera iba a comprarlas con mucho gusto.

>Hello friends, happy day to all, I hope you are all doing great. A few days ago my boyfriend asked me to go get some flowers. As I mentioned, my mother-in-law passed away 3 months ago and two weeks ago would have been her birthday, so we were going to take her flowers. We both work, so going to buy them was a little difficult. But I told him that when I got off work I would gladly go and buy them.

![Screenshot_2026-05-31-19-06-06-430_com.canva.editor.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcjZubZx1Jweeo88o3xMshYt2iFrN9dy4mnB8f4RFAgRN/Screenshot_2026-05-31-19-06-06-430_com.canva.editor.png)

Al salir fue a un pequeño puesto donde el señor tenía algunas la verdad no me pregunten mucho por los nombres ya que no se casi de flores 😅 Pero me di a la tarea de enviarle flores y en ese puesto no tenían ningúna que nos llamara la atención se que habían unas blancas pequeñas que se llaman margaritas que me gustaron Pero mi suegra en vida era una mujer muy alegre y colorida así que supe de inmediato que no eran las indicadas .

>On my way out, I went to a small stall where the man had some flowers. To be honest, don't ask me too much about the names since I don't know much about flowers 😅 But I decided to send her flowers, and at that stall they didn't have any that caught our attention. I know there were some small white ones called daisies that I liked, but my mother-in-law was a very cheerful and colorful woman, so I knew immediately that they weren't the right ones.

![Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-59-42-540_com.whatsapp.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTH1h6fBT16LzTaqtBFfhMT4Q98Y8Df5wStPU5xVLyz19/Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-59-42-540_com.whatsapp.png)

![Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-59-30-058_com.whatsapp.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcziesTA17s8iF2kMCWxe2J3EznTS7St6Zca7GSaURqcU/Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-59-30-058_com.whatsapp.png)

Me fui ahora sí a una floristería y si tenían muchísima variedad tanto de flores como de costos , yo sé una vez pensé en llevar rosas o girasoles en el otro puesto habían pero cada girasol costaba 5$ y me pareció un poco caras y allá las rosas no me gustaron como estaban , aquí habían muchísimas y cuando pregunté me dijeron que cada rosa salía 2$ y los girasoles igual quedé súper sorprendida con la diferencia de precios .

>I went to a flower shop and they had a huge variety of flowers and prices. I once thought about getting roses or sunflowers; they had them at the other stall, but each sunflower cost $5 and I thought that was a bit expensive. I didn't like how the roses looked there, but here there were so many, and when I asked, they told me each rose was $2 and the sunflowers were the same. I was super surprised by the price difference.

![Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-59-09-351_com.whatsapp.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVK1nhN3diDgCGzpBCnZoU1d7QwSK7ZP5r3K5XDyPq6eu/Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-59-09-351_com.whatsapp.png)

![Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-58-58-036_com.whatsapp.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRz8Af1jpa6FLpCxAspoz1wTDpBdXz6JsNgJTKzVmoV5N/Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-58-58-036_com.whatsapp.png)

![Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-58-44-062_com.whatsapp.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSgkGLNFXrdvNxwwZGnQMQ7BFBvLKEwCZGUof5LztYywg/Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-58-44-062_com.whatsapp.png)


![Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-58-26-361_com.whatsapp.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ5NNzDgy9VuSYH4UexD9JWpSSFy163ivcVWS1qbku93m/Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-58-26-361_com.whatsapp.png)

![Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-58-02-267_com.whatsapp.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQR8jW5aoBrhNtvjCJ1LtthZkDjc6ncnpTWvf73JCsi2E/Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-58-02-267_com.whatsapp.png)

![Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-57-49-596_com.whatsapp.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXJNaobCSidAVo17qoRVC3r3cM7f94pcCYVMtRUihwpyj/Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-57-49-596_com.whatsapp.png)

![Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-57-36-602_com.whatsapp.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSVAWgzh4sF4WAuyuYzj6JJk9ZYmTP3noNFbNzV2FQ3kT/Screenshot_2026-05-31-18-57-36-602_com.whatsapp.png)

Después de mucho buscar me decidí por los girasoles siento que estaban súper hermosos y escogí un poco de follaje y unas florecitas blancas muy delicadas que le hacían el contraste perfecto , el señor muy amablemente me hizo un pequeño ramo con todas y solo pague el costo de 6$ por todo lo que compre , recordemos que en el otro local un solo girasol me iba a salir en 5$ así que me fui muy feliz y mi novio quedó muy contento.

>After searching for a long time, I decided on sunflowers. I felt they were absolutely beautiful, and I chose some foliage and some very delicate little white flowers that made the perfect contrast. The gentleman very kindly made me a small bouquet with them all, and I only paid $6 for everything I bought. Remember that at the other store, a single sunflower was going to cost me $5, so I left very happy, and my boyfriend was very pleased.

![IMG_20260518_160326.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVz6Mpex3yvFNAWiqH8UyngmYdX3StSf8v1PsxCc1PMp5/IMG_20260518_160326.jpg)

body.title: Из года в год приходит день рождения
body.body:
![1000157682.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPF3iis9had9c3N3NzzcWZeYrTZ9nHnc3Qa1cS6XEEFYd/1000157682.jpg)

Из года в год приходит день рождения.
Я тебя, Господь, за жизнь благодарю!
Этот праздник выпал в воскресенье.
Я его сейчас вдвойне ценю.

О, Господь, как книгу интересную
Вспоминаю годы жизни я своей.
Много сотворил чудес в ней Ты.
Я тебя за всё благодарю.

С каждым годом цифра пишется другая.
Кажется, что с возрастом немного увядаю.
Кажется, что лучшее в жизни уже пройдено.
Иногда так грустно мне, иногда так боязно.

И морщинок на лице с каждым годом больше всё.
И диагнозов новых от врачей ещё.
Кто-то скажет мне: «Ты сейчас другая».
Да, но с Богом душа всегда молодая.

Эту жизнь мне Господь подарил. 
В 40 лет не рубеж, понимаю.
Двери новые Он мне открыл.
Он мой путь в Отчий дом направляет.

Я не знаю, сколько ещё мне осталось.
Я не знаю, что ждёт меня впереди.
Но уверена точно, что всё мне ко благу.
Сердце чистым моё Ты, Господь, сотвори.

Эту жизнь мне Господь подарил. 
В 40 лет не рубеж, понимаю.
Двери новые Он мне открыл.

body.title: ‎‎🔵 Could Malo Gusto Be the Missing Piece for Manchester City? ‎
body.body:
‎The summer transfer window is already beginning to generate plenty of excitement, and one of the latest rumors involves Chelsea right-back Malo Gusto and a possible move to Manchester City.
‎
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfWMKyergjWRLeF7gXsKrL9VhJCKtpoXySdMxyTfzZ6y4/Chelsea-Injury-News-Malo-Gusto-adds-more-problems-for-Blues-after-taken-off-due-to-hamstring-issue-against-Burnley-1749736969582.png 

‎[Source](https://www.sportsdunia.com/football-players/malo-gusto)
‎
‎According to recent reports, incoming Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca has identified Malo Gusto as one of his first major transfer targets. This is not entirely surprising considering the fact that Maresca has previously worked with the young defender during his time at Chelsea and is believed to be a big admirer of his abilities.
‎
‎At just 23 years old, Malo Gusto has already shown that he has the qualities needed to compete at the highest level. Despite Chelsea experiencing an inconsistent season, Gusto remained one of the bright spots in the squad. His energy, pace, and willingness to contribute both defensively and offensively made him an important player whenever he was available.
‎
‎The statistics tell part of the story. Gusto made 49 appearances for Chelsea this season, scoring 3 goals and providing 5 assists. Those numbers are impressive for a fullback and highlight his ability to influence games in the attacking third while still carrying out his defensive responsibilities.
‎
‎Manchester City's interest also makes a lot of sense from a football perspective. Pep Guardiola's team has built its success around players who are comfortable on the ball, tactically intelligent, and capable of playing multiple roles. And Gusto seems to perfectly fit that profile. His ability to overlap, create chances, and maintain possession could make him a valuable addition to City's squad.
‎
‎However, Chelsea may not be willing to let him go easily. Although reports suggest the club is open to offers, they are reportedly seeking at least £31 million for the French defender. With his contract running until 2030, Chelsea are not under  any pressure to sell and can afford to negotiate from a position of strength.
‎
‎As a Chelsea supporters, the thought of losing another talented young player to a direct rival may be difficult to accept. But on the other hand, if a significant offer arrives and the club believes the funds can be reinvested elsewhere, a transfer could become a realistic possibility.
‎
‎Though, the report still remains a developing story for now, but one thing is certain, and that is if Manchester City succeed in signing Malo Gusto, they would be acquiring a young defender with enormous potential and plenty of room for growth. The coming weeks should reveal whether this rumor develops into one of the biggest moves of the summer.
‎

body.title: تحليل دايتونا: رؤية Binance في بوابة Crypto News Portal (@TerraHaberTR) بكرة مستقبل البلوكتشين
body.body:
## مقدمة

في عالم تتسارع فيه التطورات التقنية وتتصاعد المنافسة بين المنصات الرقمية، تبرز **Binance** مرة أخرى كقوة محركة لتوجهات سوق العملات المشفرة. من خلال شراكة جديدة مع **Crypto News Portal** (المعروف على تويتر بـ @TerraHaberTR)، يبدو أن الشركة العملاقة تسعى لتوسيع آفاقها الإعلامية وتعزيز حضورها في الفضاء العربي. في هذا التحليل، سنتعمق في دلالات هذه الخطوة، كيف يمكن أن تُعيد تشكيل مستقبل البلوكتشين، وما يعنيه ذلك لمستثمري Hive.

## دوافع Binance من وراء التعاون الإعلامي

### 1. توطيد العلاقة مع الجمهور العربي
السوق العربي يمثل نسبة متنامية من المتداولين الجدد، ومع تزايد الوعي بالتقنية المالية، تحتاج المنصات إلى محتوى موثوق يجذب هذا الشريحة. إن **Crypto News Portal** تمتلك قاعدة متابعين متخصصة ومهتمة بالمستجدات، مما يتيح لـ Binance توجيه رسائلها بصورة مباشرة.

### 2. تعزيز الثقة عبر الشفافية
في ظل الانتقادات المتتالية حول الشفافية في عمليات البورصات، يأتي التعاون الإعلامي كآلية لتقديم تحليلات ومعلومات مدعومة بأدلة. إذا نجحت Binance في نشر محتوى موثوق عبر القنوات المستقلة، فإن ذلك يُسهم في بناء ثقة أكبر بين المستخدمين.

### 3. استغلال قوة المحتوى لتسويق المنتجات الجديدة
الإعلان عن خدمات جديدة مثل **Binance Smart Chain** أو ميزات متطورة في منصة **Hive** يمكن أن يتم عبر مقالات تحليلية، تقارير أسبوعية، أو حتى بودكاست موجه للجمهور العربي. وهذا يخلق فرصًا لتوسيع قاعدة العملاء دون اللجوء إلى الحملات الإعلانية التقليدية المكلفة.

## ما يعنيه ذلك لمستقبل البلوكتشين

### توحيد الرسائل وتنسيق الجهود
مع تعدد الأصوات الإعلامية في مساحة العملات الرقمية، قد يُحدث هذا التعاون مركزًا موحدًا للرسائل. الفكرة ليست فقط في نشر الأخبار، بل في تنسيق رؤى متكاملة حول **التقنية، التنظيم، وفرص الاستثمار**. 

### تعزيز الابتكار في المحتوى
من خلال الجمع بين خبرة Binance في التطوير التقني ومعرفة Crypto News Portal بالمشهد المحلي، يمكن أن تظهر محتويات متميزة: تحليلات عميقة حول بروتوكولات **DeFi**، مقارنات بين سلاسل الكتل، أو دراسات حالة حول تطبيقات **NFT** في المنطقة العربية.

### دعم المشاريع الناشئة على Hive
منظور آخر هو أن هذه الشراكة قد تفتح بابًا لتسليط الضوء على المشاريع التي تُبنى على **Hive**. إذا تم دمج أخبار المشاريع العربية الناشئة مع التحليلات المتخصصة، فإن ذلك سيعزز من فرص التمويل والانتشار لتلك المبادرات.

## كيف سيفيد هذا المجتمع المستقل (Hive)؟

1. **توسيع قاعدة المتابعين**: من خلال محتوى مشترك يُنشر على القنوات العربية، يمكن لجماعة Hive أن تستقطب مستخدمين جدد يبحثون عن بدائل لامركزية وآمنة.
2. **تحسين جودة المحتوى**: التعاون يفرض مستويات أعلى من الدقة والتوثيق، ما يدفع صانعي المحتوى على Hive إلى رفع معايير البحث والتحليل.
3. **فرص شراكة تجارية**: قد تُفتح أبواب لتكامل بين أدوات Hive (مثل **Hive Engine** أو **HBD**) مع خدمات Binance، مثل توفير سيولة أو حلول دفع عبر العملة الرقمية.

## المخاطر المحتملة والسلبيات التي يجب مراقبتها

- **تداخل المصالح**: إذا أصبحت القنوات الإعلامية مجرد أدوات تسويقية، قد تتآكل مصداقيتها، ما قد يؤثر سلبًا على ثقة المتابعين.
- **التحكم في السرد**: قد تسعى Binance إلى توجيه النقاشات نحو مواضيع تُعزز صورتها، مع إهمال القضايا التنظيمية أو الأمنية الحساسة.
- **تأثير التنظيمات**: مع تشديد الجهات التنظيمية في دول عربية على نشاطات العملات المشفرة، قد يواجه المحتوى المروج للمنتجات المالية قيودًا قانونية.

## خاتمة: بوابة نحو مستقبل أكثر تكاملًا

إن إعلان **Binance** عن تعاونها مع **Crypto News Portal** ليس مجرد خطوة إعلانية، بل مؤشر على تحول استراتيجي يهدف إلى دمج القطاع الإعلامي مع البنية التحتية التقنية. بالنسبة لمجتمع Hive، يمثل هذا التحالف فرصة لتوسيع النفوذ، جذب استثمارات جديدة، وتقديم محتوى أكثر احترافية للجمهور العربي.

المسألة الآن تكمن في كيفية استغلال هذه الفرصة بحكمة: الحفاظ على استقلالية الرأي، تعزيز الشفافية، وتوجيه المناقشة نحو الابتكار الفعلي في مجال البلوكتشين. إذا نجحت Hive في ذلك، فإنها ستحقق ليس فقط نمواً في عدد المتابعين، بل ستصبح منصة رائدة تسهم في تشكيل مستقبل الاقتصاد الرقمي في المنطقة.

body.title: Reflections of Reality
body.body:
<center>
In The Matrix, Neo fought Smith in an epic battle, but at the end it was nearly an even match. Having accidentally inserted his own code into the Agent that was Smith at the end of the first movie, Smith now replicated like a virus across the matrix. Neo was fighting against part of himself.

-------
 
![thematrixrevolutions.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23ywepMkCENR62Weyy4HyeHvutEiFo9CiZ7M6q542vxv8FuBw6a6cNFhFTtHUciFauAYw.jpg)

At the end of the third film, blinded but still sensing wirelessly the machine world around him, Neo negotiated a peace with the system. He sacrificed himself, handing his physical body over to win a truce. Although only a temporary victory, as we learned in Matrix 4, Neo plugged in to the source and reset the simulation. We see his lifeless body, and then The Oracle and The Architect sitting on a bench discussing whether the peace between the human world and the machine world would last.

![Oracle6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/EonpvUtE7R4JLswyWdCPfJbAh8ZCfLvf8pNcDxGsztwbKNXQk4nPkK1zvdFYDMjo9FS.jpg)

What took place in the space between the third film, and the fourth film, was allegedly some of humanity freed from the matrix, although others chose to remain. <a href=\

>Simulacra and Simulation helped inspire cyberpunks of the last century. I wonder what readers then would think if they could see the world as we live it today, and what the future will think of us in another century. ![maxresdefault.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23tSN1Ke77PcWKh5e3YbEWehTQvVYAPdgpXHGaWACYbF9SzphDFAPtjwQzt9JLRM985w3.jpg) #### \

--------------------------

![seraph.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23tv4fAfKzSN1mEM3CtcxhpxwNjPUDzppWkgiRzyLaG6TntTYaBGrQ7EjC27Umatsd86t.png)

In many ways the world we live in is a Matrix, moreso the simulations that we all use to inform and entertain ourselves today. Influencers help make these platforms relevant by creating content that bring people back every day, and make it a place they want to occupy and \

attention to.

![ALgqw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/23w2uCTtL2y16aKCasneT5aCzeZyBgX3fruN3qXgctAXrFmxuPDMSkKipU5tpA3pQrsy5.png)

How much do the maps of reality we have created precede the reality itself? I have been unfollowing pages on Facebook, places that have closed, movements that have been abandoned, it's pioneers who have passed on, yet their groups remain. Where does reality begin, and simulation end?

-----------------------------

body.title: ALL FOR SEER
body.body:
‎Hello pals...it's another moment to read about what is common among the seer.

One of the most dangerous seasons in a seer prophet's life is when a wound begins speaking with the voice of discernment.
‎
‎Because wounds can be convincing. Very convincing.
‎

![Screenshot_20260601-124156.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23wqpa3BBUrB8Fkcagw8jzKKGF9SATMMYv6hGjSnLXXJyJLmJsY83Gy6khsv36UsUHBr3.png)

‎A person reminds you of someone who betrayed you and suddenly you feel uneasy around them. A leader carries traits similar to someone who once wounded you and immediately suspicion rises. Someone corrects you and something inside you reacts before wisdom has a chance to speak.
‎
‎The problem is not that you are sensing something. The problem is that unhealed pain can attach itself to genuine perception. And when that happens, it becomes nearly impossible to tell whether you are discerning the present or reacting to the past.
‎
‎This is one of the quiet battles of prophetic formation, especially for seers. Because seers are naturally sensitive. They notice shifts, atmospheres, patterns, undercurrents. But sensitivity without healing can become dangerous. Not because the gift is false, but because pain can distort what the gift is seeing.

![IMG_20260529_160414_131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKDhbVTZEGYZjNdHKEsQYa7azFaP2Vp1odgxZCgNeTHYpJvmspU9hS6Az5Utq3M.jpg)

‎
‎This is why some seer prophets become increasingly suspicious as they grow older. They call it discernment. But often it is accumulated disappointment looking for evidence.
‎
‎The Lord never intended discernment to make you fearful of people. He never intended prophetic sight to make you cynical. True discernment brings clarity. Wounds produce reactions. And the two are not the same thing.
‎
‎We see this in Elijah after Mount Carmel. Jezebel released one threat and suddenly Elijah expected death everywhere he looked. His emotional state had begun shaping how he viewed reality. The Lord had to pull him aside, not because the prophet had lost his gift, but because the prophet needed restoration.
‎
‎Seer prophet, hear this carefully. Not every strong feeling is discernment. Not every discomfort is a warning. Not every reaction came from the Holy Spirit. Sometimes the Lord is revealing something around you. Sometimes He is revealing something within you. And wisdom is knowing the difference.
‎
‎One of the signs of prophetic maturity is that your healing becomes deep enough that your wounds no longer get a vote in how you interpret what you see.
‎
You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra!
One love.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@johnpetra/all-for-seer-apn)

body.title: Business Success Starts With Knowing If It’s for You
body.body:
I got very interested in this prompt when I saw it, it's a part of what I've been learning deep into for a while now. Not that I'm a business owner or entrepreneur yet but I plan to be one and learning well into what that side of life entails, I believe it's a great start. So this is like sharing a few I know. I'll just go straight into the few truths I want any business owner or entrepreneur to know if they really want to succeed by attracting and retaining customers. And the first truth is, business ownership is not for everyone. A lot fail because they got into it to avoid what they are made for. ![file_00000000ac907246bc7d2bc0dfb95e99.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/48bWnYrmv76Ffc2YUeEMJjUkwqDk4eYAY5fd6Wd9pKwSFpuMqZUXLGiVnKWPTh2Qhs.png) It takes someone with the sense of leadership, risk taking, constant decision making and staying relevant at all times, to become a business owner that has a growing business. And if we are being honest, not everyone are made like that, some prefer to be led or be given the decided opinions. Another thing I've learned as a key quality that contributes to entrepreneurial success is, knowing your target at all times. A business is meant to solve the need of a particular market so an entrepreneur should not lose sight of who these people are and that means, being focused. To attract and retain customers, it requires the business owner to always think up and welcome new ideas that will favour his targeted market more, evolving is very important. A stiff-necked entrepreneur is bound to loss customers who are expecting some new updates or even concern. An entrepreneur who wants to be successful in his or her business must never stop learning, there are a whole lot more to know and apply to making your business grow and give you time to life your life too. A lot of entrepreneurs find themselves struggling even more than they did when they were working 9-5, there's way out of it. Be concerned about your health just as you show concern to the customers you've attracted to retain them. Without your health at good level, you'll struggle in making better decisions and it will affect the customers and ultimately, the business. Another good truth to know is, it takes less to hold a business growing than starting it, if the foundation is laid out well *(having a target)*.

body.title: Después de la lluvia [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![IppjMThha4sglCNG_1000346227.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/IppjMThha4sglCNG_1000346227/IppjMThha4sglCNG_1000346227.webp)
![G5EcgnZxZnpOG3u1_1000346567.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/G5EcgnZxZnpOG3u1_1000346567/G5EcgnZxZnpOG3u1_1000346567.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Hay días en los que el calor pesa más que el cansancio. Ayer fue uno de esos. Todavía ni siquiera llegan julio y agosto, y ya las temperaturas parecen una prueba de resistencia. La casa se siente caliente desde temprano, el aire no corre y ni en esas pocas horas en las que llega el fluido eléctrico los ventiladores logran aliviar del todo. Es como si el calor se pegara a la piel y no quisiera soltarse.


Después de tantos días de sol insoportable, por fin en la tarde llovió. Y no exagero cuando digo que se sintió como una bendición. Ese olor a tierra mojada, el sonido de las gotas golpeando los techos y el ambiente refrescándose poco a poco… era justo lo que necesitábamos. A veces una simple lluvia puede cambiar completamente el ánimo de un día.


Cuando terminó de llover subí a la placa de mi casa para conectarme un rato, aprovechando la señal y el aire un poco más fresco. Entonces miré hacia el cielo y me encontré con un espectáculo imposible de ignorar.


El atardecer parecía pintado a mano. Tonos violetas, rosados y azules se mezclaban lentamente entre las nubes oscuras que aún quedaban después de la lluvia. Todo el cielo tenía una calma rara, como si por unos minutos el calor, los apagones y las preocupaciones hubieran decidido guardar silencio.


En una de las vistas, el agua acumulada sobre la placa reflejaba el cielo como un espejo imperfecto, creando una imagen oscura y brillante al mismo tiempo. Las siluetas de los árboles y los cables eléctricos contrastaban con aquel fondo de colores suaves, haciendo que incluso lo cotidiano se viera hermoso.


La otra imagen tenía algo distinto: más tranquilidad todavía. El cielo parecía infinito, teñido de lila y rosa, mientras las últimas luces del día se escondían detrás de los techos y los árboles. Hasta las nubes se veían delicadas después de tanta lluvia.


Y ahí entendí algo. A veces la belleza aparece justo después de los días más agobiantes. Como esa lluvia inesperada después del calor insoportable. Como esos colores suaves apareciendo después de una tarde gris.


Quizás la vida aquí sigue siendo difícil, quizás el calor apenas comienza… pero hay pequeños momentos que todavía logran salvar el día. Y ayer, definitivamente, el cielo fue uno de ellos.




# English Version





There are days when the heat feels heavier than exhaustion. Yesterday was one of them. July and August haven’t even arrived yet, and the temperatures already feel like a test of endurance. The house starts feeling hot early in the morning, the air barely moves, and even during those few hours when the electricity comes back, the fans are not enough to bring real relief. It feels as if the heat sticks to your skin and refuses to let go.

After so many days of unbearable sunshine, it finally rained in the afternoon. And I’m not exaggerating when I say it felt like a blessing. The smell of wet earth, the sound of the raindrops hitting the rooftops, and the air slowly turning cooler… it was exactly what we needed. Sometimes a simple rain can completely change the mood of a day.

When the rain stopped, I went up to the rooftop of my house to connect for a while, taking advantage of the signal and the slightly fresher air. That’s when I looked up at the sky and found a scene impossible to ignore.

The sunset looked hand-painted. Shades of purple, pink, and blue slowly blended between the dark clouds that still lingered after the rain. The entire sky carried a strange calmness, as if for a few minutes the heat, the blackouts, and all the worries had decided to stay quiet.

In one of the views, the water gathered on the rooftop reflected the sky like an imperfect mirror, creating an image that looked dark and bright at the same time. The silhouettes of the trees and electric wires contrasted against that soft-colored background, making even ordinary things look beautiful.

The second image felt different, even more peaceful somehow. The sky looked endless, painted in lilac and pink while the last lights of the day disappeared behind the rooftops and trees. Even the clouds seemed delicate after so much rain.

And that’s when I realized something. Sometimes beauty appears right after the most exhausting days. Like unexpected rain after unbearable heat. Like soft colors appearing after a gray afternoon.

Maybe life here is still difficult, maybe the worst of the heat is only beginning… but there are still small moments capable of saving the day. And yesterday, the sky was definitely one of them.

links.title: The Secrets of Entrepreneurial Success and Customer Retention
links.body:
A lot of people want to start up a business because of the opportunity to earn more money and build a bigger establishment but are unwilling to give it what it takes to prosper. As a prospective business owner or entrepreneur, there are lots of things that must be put in place to bring about success and well put our business in the spotlight for more consistent patronage. Today I'd be stating some of the qualities that can contribute to the success of an entrepreneur and the various things that should be put in place to not only attract customers for our business but also go on to retain them and ultimately make our business grow, so without further ado, let's get to it. ![1000315446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/23wgMvChTnWyNJHgXimTf3WPQoLz3XitSejmoFaLj8WE1WjsyRmTDuzowt4U5ZQ4Rw4iZ.jpg) To start with, when we talk about the qualities that can contribute to the success of entrepreneurs. First and foremost is the need to have a vision and set clear goals; you can't be an entrepreneur and not have a detailed vision of what you want to achieve. Having a clear goal goes on to guide your action as an entrepreneur. Secondly, having resilience and perseverance, we must understand that any journey in life will face challenges; business is no exception, and that's why we must brace ourselves for the inevitable. The ability to do this is what will fuel our business survival and growth. An entrepreneur must also be innovative and creative in their business. How you can do this as an entrepreneur is by being able to recognize opportunities, solve problems around you, and create unique products and services that meet the needs of those around you. Another important quality is the need to have good leadership skills. As a business owner, this is vital for the growth and stability of your business because you must be able to inspire, guide, and support those around you. One must also be customer-focused as an entrepreneur; we must understand that we live and create the business because of them, and so we must do everything based on their needs. Financial management skills are highly essential to be possessed by an entrepreneur who wants to succeed and stay in the limelight. When I say having financial management skills, I mean you must understand things such as budgets, cash flow, pricing, and the like. ![1000315459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/EoEsRR6jCbdnsRGSFQLU8h4WdP3BmkT2hkrCxghh1S4VwszMxdFJuCumLwTKcFnP8Va.jpg) Now I'm talking about how I believe an entrepreneur can attract and retain customers. Firstly, to attract, I believe an entrepreneur must be willing to create and offer a high-quality product or service. Customers are naturally drawn to high-quality things, and when you offer that, they'll naturally recommend you to people around them. You must also build a strong brand in a way whereby you have a clear identity, such as a name, logo, and motto that helps you stand out from competitors. We're in the era of digitalization, so you just need to know how to leverage it for your business propagation, for instance, by using social media marketing campaigns and advertising to reach potential customers. Other ways to attract customers are providing competitive pricing, like discounts, encouraging referrals, and the like. When it comes to how to retain customers, we can do that by delivering excellent customer services, making sure we maintain consistent quality in our products or services, and not reducing it like many businesses do when they grow. We can also create a loyalty program, basically a kind of reward for customers who come often, like an end-of-the-year gift. We must also listen to customer feedback so we can gather information from their suggestions to better our products. Another is showing appreciation when customers visit and patronize us, and lastly, staying connected to customers via social media pages or sending a personalized message to help us maintain relationships with our customers. *** All photos are mine. ***

links.title: CAN MONEY BUY HAPPINESS
links.body:
Hello everyone, you are welcome to my blog.

It’s hard to stay focused in this age and time, but only those with the capacity to stay focused can really be happy in life. This is because a lot of people assume that money can buy happiness or is equal to happiness, so they do everything to get the money. But then at the end of the day, life happens, and they find out that they are unhappy. Those who think this will begin to wonder why they are unhappy even after getting the money they have been pursuing all along. When people pursue something, they forget the cost of the pursuit and only fix their eyes on what they are pursuing. There is a cost of pursuit that people do not really talk about, and that cost has a way of changing the narrative. When the cost of pursuit becomes high, people tend to lose part of themselves even after getting what they are looking for. By the time they get the money, you will discover that they have lost something—maybe a spark, maybe a smile; it could even be compassion.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmezq1a4f5gFstkdjjxfPZsmKr1JdwcFF9RWaX9bk1SRdJ/33471.jpg 




From childhood, we grow up hearing a lot that money cannot bring happiness. It is very nice to hear, and maybe there is some truth to it. Because money can't buy love, can't buy real relationships, or can't buy complete peace of mind. However, as I get older, I've started to understand one thing: many of those who say money doesn't buy happiness may never have spent the night thinking about the lack of money.

Real life is so hard when you have to worry about rent at the end of the month, the fear of family medical expenses, or the fact that you can't do things just because of money despite your desire. When money doesn't buy happiness, it seems like a far-fetched philosophy.

We all know that money is very important. Without money, we cannot even live a single day. From waking up to the end of the day, every time we need money to survive. Every man is running behind his job or doing his own business to earn money and treat his family well. Basically, money is a tool by which we can stay happy and do whatever we want to do. But sometimes we also feel like when we earn money, we just rush out, we run in a rat race, and forget to live life.

All I want to say is have a happy life and enjoy every single moment. Don't rush behind work; don't take on too much load in life. Enjoy every second because we don't know when things will come to an end. Well, if you have little money and want to live your life to the fullest, I would tell you to enjoy every single moment with your loved ones. Stay with them and make as many memories as you can. This is the only way you can avoid running behind things and enjoy your life. This is what quality life feels like when you don't have money.

Let me prove to you that yes, money brings happiness, and for that, let’s think a little selfishly. Think of a place you love; it could be a place you always go to when you can afford it or a place that is part of your dreams. Where do you feel happy? In a restaurant eating very tasty food, at an amusement park like Disney, on a beach with a beautiful view? Wow, there are so many options that could make you happy, and the resource we need to get there is money, but you only go when money allows it. Doesn’t money bring happiness? Isn’t satisfying desires also a form of happiness?



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNpP7oqzP4EYkPVAAmtXaWrEjrk3493DeA2Qmx5WrUg3S/31496.png 





But let’s put selfishness aside and think about the people we love. Imagine being able to provide the best life experiences for your mother, your wife, husband, or children. Imagine a health problem being taken care of by good professionals—professionals that money can pay for. Isn’t keeping a loved one well a reason for happiness? Anyway, the possibilities money brings are huge. Even so, do you still not believe money is directly connected to happiness?

All the time we are just running behind money and forgetting to take care of our family or ourselves. But still, in today's world, people who have money are facing problems, and even those who do not have money are still facing problems. However, when you don't have money, your problem is only to earn money. But when you have money, you have a lot of problems. So of course, money is important. But the issue is how we can stay grounded whether you have money or not. I think it is a very simple way to live life.

Thank you for stopping by my blog

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@betheloji12/can-money-buy-happiness-gcf)

It is really nice to take morning walks in the garden and learn about new things in life. The flowers are really pretty and so is the person and I also like the red flowers too. My mom would show me different flowers every time I go to see her garden which is full of orchids everywhere.      The next post is made by @daily.life. It is good to prepare for bad weathers and my family would dig up mini canals so the rain from the hill would flow there so when it rains really hard our cabin wouldn't get damaged and also because it rains almost everyday from one to four hours a day and sometimes it rains night and day too.      The last post is made by @djisamsoe. My dad really like jackfruits since forever and I agree but I wouldn't say it was my favorite fruit though. In my country they also protect the jackfruit by wrapping it in rice sacks too and plastic. Even if it is not totally hit here in the Country being prepared is the most important thing to do. We really can't predicted the weather and it must be getting ready always.**

> Greetings, dear [Feel Good](https://ecency.com/created/hive-190931) community! It's always a pleasure to share the photos we take on our phones for this special space. Today, for this Phone Photography contest, [Round #115](https://ecency.com/@untilwelearn/phone-photography-contest-115), I wanted to share this photo of the Chiquinquirá Church in La Florida, Caracas. The circumstances that led me to this place were that my car broke down last week after the intense activity I had in the teaching labs. Although I managed to successfully complete those labs, towards the end of the week the exhaust pipe simply cracked, and the noise it made was deafening. I had to spend money on a replacement, which took me all weekend to gather, and then yesterday I finally got the part replaced. While I waited for the part to arrive and the mechanic to get to work on the car repair, I went to have breakfast at a café right across the street. After breakfast, I stopped to calmly admire the avenue, and there it was: the magnificent Church of Our Lady of Chiquinquirá. This cathedral has always amazed me because, although it was completed and consecrated in 1958, its style has that medieval feel that characterizes the entire urban center of Caracas. And it's no wonder; the architects built it in a Gothic-Romanesque style, which explains its imposing presence, clearly visible even from afar.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdpwbmft1LkcL7bU2kuKbGCEWZRHKTEv2Tk2U151Y653K/photo_7_2026_06_02_06_21_04.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYKUuZ7zDk6HDqxf7zhUhRJt3mRytViTeDjFE6tSfAFMY/photo_6_2026_06_02_06_21_04.jpg) --|--

> However, the reason I took a picture of it with my phone wasn't so much its origins as a Capuchin monastery or its resemblance to a medieval fortress. It was the memories it evoked, because a school called San Antonio de La Florida was also built within this church. This is quite common in Caracas parish churches, which tend to place great importance on values ​​and education. The truth is, my best friend in high school went to that school. I went to a different school, but since we lived in the same building, we always ran into each other there when my dad picked us up. We often met there after school to play arcade games, spending endless hours enjoying that free time after classes. Those were definitely different times, less chaotic than now, which seems like a bizarre episode of Black Mirror.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtn4uH3prQCzhsJPPpxE7YVcS8BqKi9mt2bcJJANUEYh/photo_1_2026_06_02_06_21_04.jpg) --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQfrcZk9ELsm3LW65VtTQSSU6t3CtsJjBH1Hk8SFGeBCW/photo_3_2026_06_02_06_21_04.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo6HzX715sc8y3UTEx29EJRiWo2Dc9jAKUZDHy1aYFb1TV3gnBo5kVKXXA3kcRAZ6yn.png)

>\n\nAt the end of the day, they installed the exhaust pipe on the car, but now I also have to replace the muffler as soon as possible, so my finances are still tied up with car maintenance. But we have time to get the money to buy it by the next pay period. As we were leaving the shop, I took a picture of the front of the church, where I used to meet my friend after school. I hope you liked the photo for this #phonography, which I called \

because of the memories I cherish so much of this place. See you in the next contest. Best regards!
*** # Versión Español ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdq8ZxFFBBCV8iyBXrNFzjubrDaytvMdYwNBPrqvHVgwj/photo_5_2026_06_02_06_21_04.jpg)

> Saludos apreciada comunidad de [Feel Good](https://ecency.com/created/hive-190931)! Siempre es un gusto compartir las fotografías que tomamos en nuestros móviles para este espacio tan especial. Hoy, para este concurso de Phone Photography en su [Round #115](https://ecency.com/@untilwelearn/phone-photography-contest-115) he querido compartirles esta fotografía de la Iglesia de Chiquinquira de La Florida en Caracas. Las circunstancias que me llevaron a este lugar pues fue que mi carro quedó fuera de combate la semana pasada luego de la intensa actividad que tuve en los laboratorios docentes, aunque logre concluír esas prácticas con éxito cuando ya estaba terminando la semana el tubo de escape simplemente se fracturo y el ruido que generaba era simplemente ensordecedor y tuve necesariamente que hacer el gasto en el repuesto, lo que me tomo todo el fin de semana reunir el dinero para entonces ayer hacer finalmente hacer el cambio de pieza. Mientras esperaba que llegara la pieza y el mecánico se pusiera manos a la obra para realizar la reparación del carro, fui a desayunar en una cafetería justo al frente y después de desayunar me detuve a ver con calma la avenida y alli estaba esta magnífica Iglesia de la Virgen de La Chiquinquirá. Esta catedral siempre me ha maravillado porque si bien se terminó de construir y fue consagrada en 1958, su estilo tiene ese aire de una arquitectura medieval en todo el centro urbano de la ciudad de Caracas. Y no es de extrañar, los arquitectos la construyeron con un estilo gótico-románico y es la razón de su imponencia, que claramente puedes verla estando muy lejos.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdpwbmft1LkcL7bU2kuKbGCEWZRHKTEv2Tk2U151Y653K/photo_7_2026_06_02_06_21_04.jpg)|![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYKUuZ7zDk6HDqxf7zhUhRJt3mRytViTeDjFE6tSfAFMY/photo_6_2026_06_02_06_21_04.jpg) --|--

> Sin embargo, la razón que me llevó a fotografiarla con mi móvil, no fue tanto su origen por monjes capuchinos o su parecido a una fortaleza medieval. Fueron los recuerdos que me trajo, porque en esta iglesia también se levantó un Colegio llamado San Antonio de La Florida, esto es algo muy común en las iglesias parroquiales de Caracas, suelen dar mucha importancia a los valores y la educación. Lo cierto es que en ese colegio estudiaba mi mejor amigo en la secundaria, yo estudiaba en otro colegio pero como vivimos en el mismo edificio siempre nos encontrábamos en su colegio cuando mi padre nos buscaba. Muchas veces nos reuníamos aquí después de clases para ir a jugar arcades, horas interminables disfrutando esos tiempos libres después de clases, eran sin duda otros tiempos, menos caóticos como los de ahora que parecen un capítulo bizarro de Black Mirrow.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtn4uH3prQCzhsJPPpxE7YVcS8BqKi9mt2bcJJANUEYh/photo_1_2026_06_02_06_21_04.jpg) --- ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQfrcZk9ELsm3LW65VtTQSSU6t3CtsJjBH1Hk8SFGeBCW/photo_3_2026_06_02_06_21_04.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo6HzX715sc8y3UTEx29EJRiWo2Dc9jAKUZDHy1aYFb1TV3gnBo5kVKXXA3kcRAZ6yn.png)

> Al final del día, colocaron el tubo de escape en el carro pero ahora tengo que cambiar también el silenciador lo más pronto posible, así que todavía mis finanzas están amarradas con el mantenimiento de mi auto, pero tenemos tiempo para la próxima quincena conseguir los recursos para comprarlo. Cuando ya nos íbamos del taller aproveché para tomar una fotografía del frente de la iglesia, donde solía encontrarme con mi amigo a la salida de clases. Espero que les haya gustado la fotografía para este #phonography al que llamé remembranzas por los recuerdos que atesoro con gran cariño de este lugar. Nos vemos en un próximo concurso. Saludos!
![ecency_spring_banner2025_6.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/243fzw92qU1TYGxoTAtzTQ2BAwNmSPvZhpG2EXsZmzEA3t3KtSL88hxURV3sy74U2iX9R.gif) ![ecency_spring_banner2025_10 II.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/245TSwLsaP8B4DpGdfKu1AnCcDxAEpYqNkHS7CjSaz767Qfd9utXB3W5uvaPhkJgcjhys.gif)

> The images for the reviews were taken from my Redmi 9c cell phone. The translation was done with the [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator) translate. > Las imágenes para este post fueron tomadas en mi móvil Redmi 9c. La traducción fue realizada con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator) translate.

links.title: Camión de datos luz blanca
links.body: La idea de descomponer o manipular la luz blanca para convertir un vehículo (como un camión) en un centro neurálgico de datos móviles no solo es fascinante, sino que conecta directamente con la vanguardia de la física óptica, la nanotecnología y las telecomunicaciones modernas.  \n​Si tomamos la luz blanca como origen y la estructuramos a través de la tecnología adecuada, un camión podría transformarse en un nodo móvil de datos masivos (un \

) utilizando dos conceptos principales:  
​1. Li-Fi (Fidelidad Lumínica) a Gran Escala  
​A diferencia del Wi-Fi tradicional que utiliza ondas de radio, la tecnología Li-Fi utiliza la luz visible para transmitir datos a alta velocidad.  
​El principio: La luz blanca es en realidad la suma de todos los colores del espectro visible. Si equipamos el camión con faros o paneles emisores basados en LEDs inteligentes o láseres de luz blanca, podemos modular esa luz a velocidades imperceptibles para el ojo humano (millones de veces por segundo).  
​El camión como antena: Un camión en movimiento o estacionado en una plaza podría proyectar su luz y ofrecer conectividad de gigabits por segundo a cualquier dispositivo, vehículo o sensor que esté dentro de su haz de luz. Al ser luz blanca, el ancho de banda potencial es gigantesco porque se pueden utilizar múltiples longitudes de onda simultáneamente.  
​2. Multiplexación por División de Longitud de Onda (WDM)  
​Para que ese camión maneje un verdadero \

de datos móviles, la clave está en descomponer y codificar esa luz blanca. Esto se logra mediante la tecnología WDM, que es la base de la fibra óptica pero aplicada aquí al espacio libre (Free Space Optics).  \n​Datos por colores: Dado que la luz blanca contiene todo el espectro, mediante nanodispositivos u ópticas cuánticas se puede dividir en cientos de canales independientes (rojo, verde, azul y todas sus frecuencias intermedias).  \n​Procesamiento líquido: Cada \

transporta un flujo de datos único. Un solo haz de luz blanca proyectado desde el camión podría transmitir información financiera, datos de navegación, señales de emergencia y conectividad civil al mismo tiempo, sin interferencias entre sí.  \n​¿Cómo se estructuraría este \

?  
​Para que el vehículo funcione como una estación base móvil de alta densidad, necesitaría tres componentes esenciales en su diseño:  
​A. Chasis y Emisores Cuánticos  
​El exterior del camión no solo llevaría faros convencionales, sino textiles inteligentes o paneles fotónicos capaces de emitir y recibir luz coherente. Estos emisores moldearían la luz blanca para dirigir los haces de datos específicamente hacia donde se necesitan, optimizando la energía.  
​B. El Núcleo de Procesamiento  
​Dentro del camión, los datos no se procesarían solo con electricidad tradicional. Se utilizarían sistemas de procesamiento óptico o fotónico, donde los bits se mueven a la velocidad de la luz antes de ser convertidos en la señal de luz blanca que se proyecta al exterior.  
​C. Ventajas sobre el espectro de radio actual  
​Inmunidad al hackeo convencional: La luz no atraviesa las paredes. La transmisión de datos del camión sería ultra segura; solo quien esté bajo la influencia directa de la luz podría recibir la información.  
​Cero saturación: El espectro de la luz visible es 10.000 veces más amplio que el espectro de radiofrecuencia (Wi-Fi/5G), eliminando por completo los problemas de interferencia o caídas de señal en zonas congestionadas.  
​Hacer de la luz blanca el vehículo para un camión de datos móviles es pasar de la teoría a una infraestructura completamente limpia, veloz y autónoma, capaz de iluminar una comunidad y, al mismo tiempo, conectarla al mundo a velocidades cuánticas.  
​¿Te imaginas este camión operando como un nodo de emergencia en ciudades conectadas, o tienes en mente un diseño específico para el tipo de señal que emitiría?

links.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaiyF9H47DwgPKz4Rfvfqd7qsMKh9tN3tA7F4wPs7jm7v/image.png)

Hoy es otro día en el que he sentido que la procrastinación se apodera de mi, entre ver videos en internet, las famosísimas novelas chinas que te enganchan 2 o 3 horas mirando el celular, es literalmente tiempo perdido, cómo pueden ser tan entretenidas? 
Sin embargo debo reconocer que no apagué el celular, este retrato lo he pintado mientras veía una de esas novelas de fondo. era sobre una chica que viaja a un libro y cambia el destino de la protagonista. Sé que son novelas con una trama repetida, pero simplemente no puedo dejar de verlas, creo que la clave estará en reducir el tiempo en redes sociales. Cómo debería usar ese tiempo para que sea productivo? 

>Today is another day where I've felt procrastination take over. Between watching videos online and those incredibly popular Chinese dramas that hook you for two or three hours staring at your phone, it's literally wasted time. How can they be so entertaining?
However, I must admit I didn't turn off my phone. I painted this portrait while watching one of those dramas in the background. It was about a girl who travels into a book and changes the protagonist's destiny. I know they're dramas with a repetitive plot, but I just can't stop watching them. I think the key is to reduce my time on social media. How should I use that time to make it productive?

links.title: One of My Prized Possessions
links.body:
I bought this game a few months ago, during the second season of the Fallout TV show.

There have been a couple of times over the years where I have spoken/ written about Fallout: New Vegas; it is my favourite Fallout game, and it is definitely in my top 10 favourite games of all time.

Even though it is one of my favourite games, I have never played any of the DLCs, and, miraculously, I have managed to avoid nearly all spoilers for them for the last 16 years, because I have always intended to buy and play them. 

They are available to buy on the Xbox Store digitally, but I prefer owning things physically, and also, there are some additional pieces of content that can only be used on the physical version.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZnJ1JWbx5fjxSrQNtTJbVh6ZYBtdJnZZwB9Bk4eN8UPV/1780423157060.jpg)

#### <center> God ray, please.</center>

****

The ultimate addition of Fallout: New Vegas has always been on my wanted list. But it was always so expensive. 

Throughout the years of collecting, buying and selling, I always told myself to hold off on paying full price, because I'll find it. 

Well, one night, Aimee and I were watching an episode of Fallout, and when it ended, I got into one of my moods where I like to rant and rave about New Vegas, so I got on my phone, and looked on CEX to check the price of the Ultimate Edition.

(I just looked it up, and it's €75, and for the standard normal addition of the game, it's €20)

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPxJfb9vWqC1CgTJZAi6saRAHFB7mwgcRzfBkpP7nenBo/1780423157193.jpg)

#### <center> I have it with the manual, and both discs are in great condition. </center>

****

After checking CEX (at the time, it was about €68, but it was out of stock) I headed over to eBay.

Typically, I find that eBay prices are usually higher than CEX for some reason, but something compelled me to check it this night.

I'm scrolling, and I see it for €10 + €3 postage, being sold by someone here in Ireland. I was shocked, but assumed it was too good to be true. 

I scrutinised the photos to look at the discs, and they seemed fine. The account was new, so I figured it could be a scam or something. 

On the listing, it said there were 3 watchers, and I knew that within a few minutes, it was going to be gone, so I bit the bullet and ordered it. 

Within a few days, it arrived, and I was over the moon.

****

I don't know why the person was selling it so cheap, but I was delighted that I could add it to my collection without breaking the bank.

Also, I've never really come across 'Classics' versions of Xbox 360 games, so it stands out among my other games.

It's strange, because this has happened on many occasions now, where I have been compelled to check a site, or go to a shop at a particular time, only to find something I want, or need for a really reasonable price... or free. 

I have tons of stories similar to this, which I'm going to share over the coming weeks.

links.title: The teacher I will always remember
links.body:
Greetings!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXYHcBPCVD2E4C2uj9JynY7x5UfMUoRSbPTcGcTcacEx1/20241214_091353_0_.jpg)


One thing I love about education is that it is the best legacy and this can of a legacy is the one that would always live on. Learning is a continuum and till death, humans would always learn may be through formal education or otherwise.

Another thing is that as good as learning is, it cannot take place in isolation which means, for learning to take place, there must be some factor being put in place and one of those factors is the teacher.

Without the teacher, learning cannot take place and this is because it's the teacher that would teach and explain to the students what they don't actually know which means, it's the teacher that will explain to the students from what they had known which is from the known and to what they had not known which is the unknown.

So, the work of a teacher is complex work, but one thing I have always found worthy is that the teaching profession is a noble one that has its rewards not only in heaven but also on earth.

Having said this, I would like to delve into the topic of the prompt which is all about, “The teacher or lecturer I will never forget.”

If there's a teacher or lecturer that I will always remember and thank God for shaping my life, that teacher will be my Agricultural science teacher in the person of, Mr. Adekunle. Mr.Adekunle saw in me what other teachers did not see in me and when I knew nothing as a poor student in class, he kept on encouraging and refused to be like others who I would not like to tell their stories today.

With his attitude and care for me, he made me improve not only in his subject but in other subjects as his words of encouragement did the magic in me. He was the one who told me he was once a slow learner like me, but that when he picked up, he was just flying and could not be stopped by his contemporaries.

When I heard this, I gained my confidence back and with the help of God through him, I was able to rediscover myself and where my strength lies in and that is how I became the best not only in the school examination but also in the external examination.

I later studied the same course he studied in the university which Agricultural extension and with that, I have been able to live fine and achieve my dream of becoming great in life.

Mr. Adekunle is my role model and he's more than a teacher to me, I will never forget him in my life and will always remember him for transforming my life.

Thanks for reading.

The picture is mine.
