links.body:
<center>![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNmNYmCNNfkcqUbUBedSMWDrZnt3vwrWf5wUaGLj8wFsq/imagen.png)</center>


Aliado o no aliado a las oportunidades que nos da la vida. No importo en Venezuela que no estuvieras de acuerdo con el gobierno reinante igual causaron que miles  de Venezolanos salieran del país buscando una mejor vida, una oportunidad de salud, trabajo y tranquilidad. 

Supongo que igual sucede en los países en guerra o te unes  a ellos o te largas de allí a pasar trabajo en un lugar extraño. 
No aliado es que no estas de acuerdo con lo que sigue y estarás en problemas sino sigues la linea que ellos te tracen. 

Los muchos que ofrecen sus opiniones diferentes a los sistemas, se enfrentan a serias dificultades. Vaya que si lo saben los venezolanos que tuvieron que dejarlo todo para comenzar en otro país diferente al suyo. Y lo que demostraron fue un trabajo sobrehumano. Hicieron de todo para sobrevivir, atravesaron a pie las selvas más duras, limpiaron baños y sacaron papeleras para no morirse de hambre, hasta que lograron resaltar por su gran trabajo. 

Ahora son reconocidos como no aliados de este gobierno maloso, que dejo seco a un país de gran extensión y belleza natural. 



Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario de los amigos @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano y @mariannewest

[Post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/2-june-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3122-not-an-ally)

ENGLISH VERSION

Allied or not, you embrace the opportunities life offers. In Venezuela, even if you disagreed with the ruling government, thousands of Venezuelans still left the country in search of a better life, a chance at healthcare, work, and peace of mind.

I suppose the same is true in countries at war: either you join them or you leave to suffer in a strange place. Being an ally means you disagree with what's coming and you'll be in trouble if you don't follow the path they lay out for you.

Many who offer differing opinions to the system face serious difficulties. Venezuelans who had to leave everything behind to start over in a different country certainly know this. And what they demonstrated was superhuman effort. They did everything to survive, crossing the harshest jungles on foot, cleaning toilets, and emptying trash cans to avoid starving, until they managed to stand out for their hard work.

Now they are recognized as not allies of this evil government, which left a country of great size and natural beauty dry.




This text corresponds to my participation in the daily challenge of friends @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano and @mariannewest.

\*\*Not an Ally\*\*.

Good day to you all.

\*One of the most challenging lessons we face in life is to learn that not everybody standing next to you is standing with you.\*

\*Some of them vanish when you're challenged, but some applaud you when you're at ease. Others smile around you but secretly their wish for your life is to fail.\*

\*That is the reason you have to start knowing who really is an ally. A real friend will always inspires you when you feel like quitting, celebrates your achievements, and helps you to progresse every single day. They don't steal your value or rival your dreams.\*

\*Someone who constantly dampens your objectives, fuels your insecurities, or just shows up when they need something from you is not an ally. Knowing this is insight, not resentment.\*

\*Avoid wasting your energy in wrong gardring, trying to get over every challenges, never devoted to your success folks. Rather, concentrate on your goals, focuse on the trank, guard your peace, and surround yourself with people who really want to see you flourish.\*

\*\*\*Finally\*\*, knowing who is not an ally is equally as vital as knowing who is. The right individuals person will lift you; the wrong ones will keep you back. Choose your circle with care and never let anyone discourage you from becoming the person you were meant to be. Peace.\*

\*Thank you for your time\*

links.title: Title: Subscriptions: My Honest Take as an Airtel, MTN, and Glo User in Ekiti
links.body: Hello, QC Community. This is my first post here with this account. I'm David, also known as @dreeyor. This is my second account on Hive. My previous account was dealt with for reasons I don't fully understand, and that was about a year ago. But I'm back now. Let me share my thoughts on this week's topic: subscriptions. What is a subscription to me?

/>

A subscription is paying regularly — daily, weekly, monthly — for a service you use often. Sometimes you pay at regular intervals. Other times, if you use up what you paid for faster than expected, you have to buy another before the next interval. It's not always perfectly regular.

My main example is network data subscriptions — MTN, Airtel, and Glo. Here in Ekiti, many people say \

That's not always true for me, but data is still very important.

A good subscription experience: Airtel

I use Airtel and MTN. Airtel has been good to me. Normally, I get 2GB on Airtel and it lasts me at least three days. I remember watching all of Soul Land on YouTube — a very long series — using less than ₦1,500. That's because of Airtel's Smart Cash special offers: ₦300 for 2GB. I also watched TikTok movies in between. The data lasted, and I got real value.

A bad subscription experience: MTN

MTN is different. What I see is not always what I get. I once bought a 30GB plan on MTN, and it didn't even last a full week for normal use. Forget about doing anything serious or fun with it. It finishes too fast. I joke that it's probably due to \

— but really, it's frustrating.

That said, MTN is not totally useless. When Airtel's network is poor, MTN becomes my backup. If I need to download something super quickly, MTN is fast. And for serious things — school assignments, creating digital art, business — MTN takes over. So even the service I complain about has its benefits.

What about Glo?

I used to like Glo. I remember when ₦500 gave me 1GB for a week, and the value felt almost equal to what I paid. But then network issues started. In my location in Ekiti, Glo's service is equivalent to not being available. So I stopped using it entirely. Availability matters. A good subscription is useless if the service is not there when you need it.

Should all businesses use subscriptions?

No. I don't think so.

A business owner must first know their customers before designing any plan. Not every business is suitable for subscriptions. You have to consider feasibility. Can customers trust you? Can you offer stability and regularity?

Take daily meals. Could I get a subscription for my food every day? Maybe. But soon I might realize that cooking for myself locally is better, cheaper, and more flexible. Everyone has their own priorities. Subscriptions work best when they serve the majority's interest and when the business is reliable.

Do consumers benefit from subscriptions?

Yes — but only when subscriptions are well-planned.

A good subscription should:

· Satisfy the customer's real need  
· Not cause financial disaster or backlash  
· Be available in usable condition

The bonuses on Airtel keep me stuck to their service. The speed of MTN saves me when Airtel fails. Those are real benefits. No business is perfect. Every service has flaws. Some customers overlook the flaws. Others get pissed and leave for something better. That's normal.

But as long as a subscription model is honest, stable, and gives value, consumers will benefit. We just have to choose what works best for our own situation.

Final thought

Subscriptions are not evil, and they are not magic. They are tools. When a business uses them well, customers stay. When a business fails to deliver, customers leave. That's how it should be.

Thank you, QC Community, for having me back. And thank you @jlat1412 for suggesting this topic.

links.title: What if governments were more like communities... and less like monopolies? 🧡
links.body:
What if governments were more like communities... and less like monopolies? 🧡

Let's travel back to 1843.
You're standing in Missouri, preparing to cross 2,000 miles of wilderness toward Oregon.

No state. No police. No courts. No infrastructure. Just you and 120 strangers.

So what do you do? You write a constitution.
And that's exactly what many wagon trains did.

They elected leaders. Defined voting procedures. Established rules. Created dispute resolution mechanisms.
And perhaps most importantly... Participation was voluntary.

If you didn't like the rules of one wagon train, you could join another. Or create your own.

Different groups experimented with different governance models.
Some were strict. Some were flexible. Some succeeded. Some failed.

But all of them had something modern governments rarely offer: competition.
The right to exit. The possibility to choose. Today we often assume governance must be:

* permanent
* territorial
* centralized
* imposed from above

History suggests otherwise. For centuries, people have experimented with governance as a service rather than as a monopoly. And here's where things become really interesting.

The Oregon Trail pioneers had paper, horses and trust.
We have the internet. We have cryptography. We have blockchain.

Imagine what becomes possible when:

* rules are transparent
* voting is verifiable
* treasuries are auditable
* membership is voluntary
* governance can be programmed

Suddenly, many of the coordination problems that required large centralized institutions become easier to solve.
Does this mean countries disappear? Probably not.

But it does raise an interesting question: If people in 1843 could create temporary governance systems for thousands of kilometers of uncertainty... What kinds of communities could we build today with global connectivity and decentralized technology?

Blockchain rediscovers that governance itself can be innovated. 🧡

___
# Hi foodie's!
___
Hello friends how are you all? I hope you all are fine. I am also fine. So guys today I have come again with a new blog. Today I have shared a new recipe with you guys. And the name of this recipe is Black Gram Lentils. I made it with tomato curry because this blach gram lentils tastes very delicious with tomato curry. And guys thank you so much for supporting me in my previous blogs. It means a lot to me. So guys now without wasting much time, let's start making this delicious dish.
___
# Ingredients needed
___
Black gram lentils
Tomato
Gree chilies
Tomato
Garlic
Salt
red chili powder
Cumin and Coriander powder
Oil
___
# Cooking the Black Gram Lentils
___
So guys to make this Black Gram Lentils, first I took half kg black gram lentils. Then I washed it well.After that, I took a pressure cooker. In it, I added the black gram lentils. Then I added around 3 to 4 cups of water in it. Then I closed the lid of the pressure cooker and cooked it on medium flame for around 30 minutes.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbvcdXzDapTtMpc9j6SwzJ1BPHKrcoE1Lh5anAwzKFyxg/1780390386107.jpg)

___
# Preparing Tomato Curry
___
Now, while our black gram lentils are cooking in the pressure cooker, I took 8 tomatoes and 5 to 6 green chilies. I washed them well. Then I chopped the tomatoes and green chilies properly. Now I took a pot, added oil in it, and then I fried the tomatoes in it. After that, I added 1 tablespoon tomato paste in it. And in the end, I also added the green chilies in it.

___
# Cooking the Lentils Further
___
After 30 minutes, when I opened the lentils, I felt they were still a little hard. So then I cooked them again in the pressure cooker for 5 more minutes. And then our lentils became nicely soft.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYxPYZ9msGTZ2E594mPyzNhmgWx6pojVZAGK83PL7pMQb/1780390431049.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdxdNSKqSkKdyj3CMc23m3jcXhYzXA5B4sUR59ZtkXxWP/1780390551586.jpg)
___
# Tomato Curry Ready
___
And in the same way, within 5 to 10 minutes, our tomato curry was also ready.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYw3j8wCZKoUanY4ZejQ7c6k4rQrLmjYj86VMZijU5C53/1780390453413.jpg)
___
# Tadka
___
After that, to temper the lentils, I took one garlic clove. I peeled it well and then grated it. After that, I took 1 and a half tablespoon salt, 2 tablespoons red chili powder, and 1 tablespoon cumin coriander. Then I took a pan and added oil in it. Then I added the grated garlic into the pan. When the garlic started becoming a little brown, I added the spices into it. Then I mixed it well and poured it into the lentils. After that, I mixed the lentils well.And in this way, our yummy and delicious lentils with tomato curry are ready.

links.title: That Old Uncle Has Finally Retired
links.body:
![image editing by OpenAI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tvrpqW1cxzaxEaHNfXqmtAmyJgGfNpVR89Xg9PhcGABtoC4awYzGivx7sjqvrtbHbnm.png)

Hello Asean Hive Community

In my neighborhood, we have some regular food carts who walk around the neighborhood to sell their foods. Some of them yell out loud to let people know that they are near, and some use speaker or phone to play the sound. Some even do the old school, they make sound by hitting certain thing such as plate, bowl, or their card, as if they are doing some percussion. So which ever they are, nearby people will notice it by the incoming loud sounds.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23vsQppEZcpL2G9d1mJduF3ZozBLnY5HeJCLSkJqHqVQctjsBYicqg2WFpdrKT6H3wcjf.jpg

In the morning, there was one old guy, we called him the old uncle, who sold congee. We all liked his congee, and he really sold it very cheap. Without any add-on, he sold it around 0.6 USD. I often bought his congee, because if I bought congee near my office, the price at least around 50% higher than this old uncle. 

The taste was good, people liked it however it was just good. It was not special or very good. To be honest, the congee near my office had better taste. However the cheap price and the friendly service and warm attitude he showed while preparing and serving the congee might be the main factor why many of us here chose to buy from him.

I haven't seen him in the last few weeks. I have noticed that the recent Congee cart that wonder around in the morning has different \

sound. He doesn't yell as loud and fired up like this old uncle. I haven't bought any congee from that cart yet, but last week when I was about driving out to my office, that card passed next to me.

I said hello to the young man, asking if he was new in the neighborhood. He said he was selling in different block before, but the old uncle said he had enough and decided to retire, and offered him to replace him in this neighborhood. He would leave our city to come back to his hometown.

So I guess we never see him anymore.

#### THE LAST ORDER

I had tonnes of congee picture from his cart. It is my habit to take some shoots from my meal, either the shoots are good or bad, I will decide it later. Not all bad pictures will be dumped, and not all good pictures will be saved for long time.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EonnxTbdmZnDPPFKzLTopNXobcUciPfhoQw46YokqQYK1zNGz3gFg4cNDWAciQNCFEf.jpg

This was my last order from him, about a month ago. I believed it was after the Eid al-fitr holiday. To be honest, the taste was already decline and I could notice it instantly. However I did not think that he was losing his time that time, I thought it was due to the Ramadhan month. People had a fasting period on that month, and food cart people had to stop selling their food, unless they wanted to have stupid problem with hardliners. 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Ep3fiSTukkyYSydxrE7x2vtM7Tubpv1sMjeq1Q1eoy8FHmpBjLvPr8MB7PFPnbt2udN.jpg

This order was my highest paid one, because I ordered two side dishes which came in skewers. The first one was chicken gizzard, and the second one was chicken intestine. It was a good comfort food lol, this congee was longer healthy... Anyway this cost me around 0.8 USD, still a cheap one.

I am going to miss his congee, regardless the new one taste is better or worse. I hope he would be happy and healthy in his hometown for the rest of his old days.

---

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/48XetgSWyfBM2qUaM6DgxMupc8697f6fQQvnbVnxgvAwbF2DtDg8rzGXSFQs9M5YAX.png

Thank you for coming and reading my post. I live in Jakarta, Capital City of Indonesia.  I used to live by making money online, that's why I like being here, on HIVE, and in #PIMP - (Paper In My Pocket) community. Feel Free to leave any comment below

links.title: Kepler's First Law: Planets Revolve around the Sun in an Ellipse
links.body:
In this video, I derive Kepler's 1st law of planetary motion entirely from Newton's second law of motion and Newton's law of universal gravitation, while making extensive use of the calculus of vector functions, to prove that a planet orbits the Sun in an elliptical orbit where the Sun is a focus. This extensive proof demonstrates the power that calculus is in explaining observational astronomical data directly from the laws of physics.

#math #vectors #calculus #ellipse #keplerslaws   

Timestamps:

- Kepler's Laws of Planetary Motion – 0:00
- Proof of Kepler's first law: Orbits around the Sun are ellipses – 2:51
- Recap on ellipses: The sum of distances from a point to two fixed points (called foci) is constant – 3:08
- Newton's second law of motion: The net force on a body is equal to the mass times acceleration – 7:34
- Newton's law of universal gravitation: Masses attract each other proportional to their masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them – 8:22
- Equate the two laws to get the formula for the acceleration – 12:35
- The derivative of the cross product between position and velocity vectors is zero, so r x v = a constant vector h, thus the orbit is one in a plane – 16:49
- Rewrite the constant vector h using the position unit vector u – 22:18
- Evaluate a x h to get a vector triple product – 28:57
- Recap on the dot product and its properties – 36:32
- The derivative of v x h = a x h = GM u' – 40:39
- v x h = GM u + a constant vector c – 45:49
- v x h, u, and c are on the xy-plane – 47:35
- Choose c to be along the standard basis vector i and get the polar coordinates of the position vector – 53:22
- The dot product between r and v x h yields a formula containing polar coordinates r and θ – 55:54
- Evaluate the formula via the scalar triple product to obtain the polar equation of an ellipse! – 1:01:50
- Compare with my earlier video on the polar equation of an ellipse via the unified conic theorem where the eccentricity is constant and is defined as the ratio of the distance to the focus divided by the distance to the directrix – 1:08:11
- The orbit of a planet is a closed curve, so the conic has to be an ellipse, this proves Kepler's first law – 1:09:41

links.title: [EN/PT] Estância - The Capital of the Fire Boat
links.body: > # [EN] June has arrived, and with it comes one of the most anticipated times of the year: the season of the traditional June festivals. Here in my city, which is known as the Capital of the Fire Boat, the São João atmosphere has already started to take over the streets. Colorful flags can be seen everywhere, bringing that feeling of joy and tradition that only this time of year can provide. Yesterday, while walking through the city's main square, I couldn't resist stopping to take some photos of the June decorations that are already brightening up the area. The square looks beautiful, filled with colors and elements that perfectly represent the culture of Northeastern Brazil. Among the attractions, there is a large ornamental bonfire and also a representation of the famous Fire Boat, one of the city's greatest cultural and tourist symbols. For those who are not familiar with it, this tradition is a source of great pride for us and attracts the attention of both residents and visitors every year. Of course, São João is not just about decorations. It is also the season of traditional foods that everyone loves. Boiled corn, corn cake, canjica, pamonha, and many other delicious treats are part of our tables throughout the month. It seems that during this time of year, everything revolves around corn, and nobody complains about it. Besides the food, we also have the traditional outfits, folk dances, forró music, and fireworks displays that light up the June nights. The sound of accordions and fireworks already becomes part of the city's daily life, creating a unique atmosphere that is difficult to explain to anyone who has never experienced a Northeastern Brazilian São João celebration. Without a doubt, this is one of the most beloved times of the year for Brazilians, especially for those of us from the Northeast. People love the festivities, the music, the dancing, and all the energy surrounding this tradition. It is common to see families gathered together, lighting bonfires in front of their homes, roasting corn, and celebrating simple yet very special moments. I hope you enjoyed this little tour of my city and learning a bit more about how São João celebrations are already beginning here. ----- # [PT] O mês de junho chegou e, com ele, uma das épocas mais aguardadas do ano: o período das festas juninas. Aqui na minha cidade, que é conhecida como a Capital do Barco de Fogo, o clima de São João já começou a tomar conta das ruas. Bandeirinhas coloridas estão espalhadas por todos os cantos, trazendo aquele sentimento de alegria e tradição que só essa época consegue proporcionar. Ontem, enquanto passava pela praça principal da cidade, não resisti e parei para registrar alguns dos enfeites juninos que já estão decorando o local. A praça ficou linda, cheia de cores e elementos que representam muito bem a cultura nordestina. Entre as atrações, há uma grande fogueira ornamental e também a representação do famoso Barco de Fogo, que é um dos maiores símbolos culturais e turísticos da cidade. Para quem não conhece, essa tradição é motivo de muito orgulho para nós e atrai a atenção de moradores e visitantes todos os anos. E claro que São João não se resume apenas à decoração. É também o período das comidas típicas que todo mundo adora. Milho cozido, bolo de milho, canjica, pamonha e tantas outras delícias fazem parte da mesa dos nordestinos durante todo o mês. Parece que, nessa época, tudo gira em torno do milho, e ninguém reclama disso. Além das comidas, também temos as roupas típicas, as quadrilhas, o forró e os shows pirotécnicos que iluminam as noites juninas. O som das sanfonas e dos fogos já começa a fazer parte da rotina da cidade, criando uma atmosfera única que é difícil explicar para quem nunca viveu um São João nordestino. Sem dúvida, esse é um dos períodos mais amados pelos brasileiros, especialmente por nós, nordestinos. O povo gosta da festa, da música, da dança e de toda a energia que envolve essa tradição. É comum ver as famílias reunidas, acendendo fogueiras na frente de casa, assando milho e celebrando juntas momentos simples, mas muito especiais. Espero que tenham gostado deste pequeno passeio pela minha cidade e de conhecer um pouco mais sobre como o São João já está começando por aqui. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@elderdark/en-pt-estancia-the-capital-of-the-fire-boat)

links.title: A True Friend in Hard Times | LOH #291
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWk8iSiQaUvYKbiN245pmT6PcyjkeAitY21GNNW9JAZ2n/1780422088431.jpg)

Today, I want to share my personal experience about how that one person who has supported me during one of the hardest times in my life, it's none other than my best friend Othoi.

So, last year was very challenging for me. I was facing academic pressure as it was our test exams. There were assignments that I could not complete and the time was very short. On the other hand, I was dealing with my family problems and this made me worry about my future. I was not feeling good at all everything made me feel exhausted easily. I was disturbed both mentally and emotionally.

I have anxiety, so dealing with it became harder, even the medicines were not working. I started to feel like a failure and thought my knowledge is less than others and I'm only moving downwards. The more I compared myself, the worse I felt. I had zero motivation and couldn't concentrate on my studies.

During that period, Othoi was always there for me. She never neglected me, she took my problems seriously. I could tell because I can easily detect when someone is being genuine and when they're faking it. Whenever I felt lonely she was there for me. I would call her during midnights but she never complained because knew that I was going through a hard phase. As I'm only talktive around the people I'm comfortable with. She never let me feel that she was annoyed and gave me her company. 

She constantly assured me that everything will get better and I'll find peace. She never judged me for my different perspective instead she listened to me quietly. I was able to vent out my anger and pain. I must say she was a good listener. Othoi always gave me a reminder that everyone faces challenges and that it was okay to feel overwhelmed sometimes.

She motivated me to stay focused on my goals and that helped me a lot. She used to say，”I believe in you. You can do it.\

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: June 2 2026
body.body:
Ever notice how the days you expect to be productive are sometimes the ones that slip away the fastest? I started the morning on the right foot with a walk, some light jogging, and a few exercises to get the body moving. Everything felt normal, and I was pretty sure I'd comfortably reach my daily target. But as the day went on, work, small chores, and random distractions seemed to eat up more time than I expected. I still stayed active through regular daily activities, but when I finally checked my tracker in the evening, it showed 10k steps. Not far off the goal, but just short of the 11k target for Day 5. A few months ago, I probably would’ve ignored the difference between 10k and 11k. Now I’m noticing that setting a target makes me more aware of how I spend my day. Not in a stressful way—just enough to keep me accountable. Day 5/30 complete 👣 Do you set daily goals for yourself, or do you prefer focusing on the bigger picture and letting the days take care of themselves? #actifit #11kchallenge #day5 #morningmovement #stayactive

links.body:
Усім привіт.
Уже червертий рік поспіль в умовах повномасштабної російсько-української війни проходить наприкінці травня сама знакова мистецько-літературна подія  — Книжковий Арсенал. І четвертий рік поспіль я  незмінно відвідую цей фестиваль слова, музики, цікавих зустрічей і теплих обіймів, бо проведення таких подій, особливо в умовах війни, мають важливе значення. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPXscHqZq3ANwg63vd11XYqPhyzt8UauC5UWLTq5VNDJU/1780386054720.jpg)

Нинішня тема фестивалю звучала так: \

. І розділити це відчуття свободи на Книжковому Арсеналі 2026 приїхало чимало закордонних гостей. І не лише з Європи, як-от чимала делегація з Франції, а й навіть з Південної Америки, зокрема, з Перу.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8WDC7ZUcFu5JYZNykxMZKX2sZ5EyEHZEHiry7hZ9JCq/1780386128900.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRqXgTr5RaEZMQGfYkMRfbHx8oEgUVXVkw7jCRE7XAuNj/1780386176193.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVUKTytFVbLrTsAkUyCUQwiCs8p23exvUTYxG11uSZF7n/1780386176408.jpg)

Людей на Книжковому Арсеналі, як завжди, було чимало, і книжки розліталися на деяких видавничих стендах як гарячі пиріжки. А це свідчить про те, що країна читає, принаймні, свідома частина нашого суспільства. І це не може не тішити.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWLYPv2tcJGf31ce1cEmduiaFWH9iYfXsRNp2cMApQt7v/1780386343913.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWwMor6wjDc8MByAmzG5VM9vTCJFJG7KxnQ1p5DW9u9aG/1780387031851.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaJGYi9fz5YzCkJX2FZNLqkYBPSAM1N8Tk1m5B4WAFa1D/1780387032189.jpg)

Не всі новинки, які я планувала придбати на Книжковому Арсеналі, встигли надрукувати до фестивалю. Тож довелося робити передзамовлення. Проте ті, на які поклала око і вони були в наявності, звісно ж, придбала. Але про них розповім в окремому дописі.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR68Hpb6r4FsSWjTepvj6MF32sdwL7AngdRsk8BpvU4iT/1780387076953.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYqjHnZqV3r28Z9zn4LfHFpCxUskWAwJD26RhTBm8iEwY/1780387077254.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYuVuToLgtMowhtPJkpZydFRvCqssrGs3zFvmhf5SaKTd/1780387077538.jpg)

За традицією відвідала виставку ілюстраторів і каліграфічний стенд, які, як завжди, були на висоті. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc1PKZvfr26m9TzraE5dHZ8BG6jHs7ABSS3Fw7N2qm9eY/1780387130950.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ4Gc7QYZwzxbGSNCADJyuukJZaNvMzzUkEsKMuzPZcj5/1780387131207.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR72ojA64KVGyayFxhXekwJdkejPd2G1Eb7xWPrP6pWMV/1780387276116.jpg)

Уривки з поезій наших полеглих воїнів-поетів-письменників особливо щемко було читати. І я безмежно вдячна всім тим воїнам, які зараз тримають лінію оборони і нищать ряди нашого ворога, бо саме завдяки їм ми маємо змогу проводити і відвідувати такі культурні події.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHMa5ReNeiUgKzWyGSRQKXKATda3BooMtkwC3fayBmzi/1780387158163.jpg)

Я пишу цей допис після безсонної ночі через російські ракетні обстріли. І хай би як русня психологічно на нас тисла, безуспішно намагаючись нас залякати, вільних людей їй не здолати. Росіяни ніколи цього не збагнуть. Бо кожен з нас несе в собі ту частку Свободи, яка так запалює серця інших і викликає захоплення (а під час і заздрість) у наших союзників. Тому так багато європейців їдуть в Україну, аби вдихнути її по-справжньому.  Зокрема, і на таких непересічних культурних подіях, як Книжковий Арсенал.

links.title: Two Worlds
links.body: > This road divides space into two different worlds.
> To the right — a spring birch forest: slender white trunks reaching toward the sky, and though the trees still stand bare, warmth already lingers in the air.
> Early spring — the lake remains frozen, yet the sun grows stronger, and nature slowly awakens.
> Everything here feels familiar and natural.

> To the left — a forest after fire. Once, flames moved through this place, leaving their traces behind. Charred trunks still stand among young growth, and the familiar whiteness of birches has in places given way to deep blackened tones.

> It was not the most destructive kind of fire — a ground fire — and the forest is gradually recovering, but the sight still leaves a strong impression. And yet, in its own way, it carries a certain quiet beauty.

> Forest fires can transform, in a matter of hours, a landscape that took decades to form. Plants and animals are lost, and the familiar face of the forest changes. Still, nature has a remarkable capacity for renewal — even where fire once passed, life eventually returns.

> Walking among the birches on the right and looking toward the burned forest on the left, you cannot help but reflect on how fragile the world around us can be. And the road in the first photograph becomes more than a boundary between two sections of forest. It shows how thin the line is between familiar calm and changes that can happen in just a few hours. And how important it is to cherish what nature has taken years to create.

links.title: Crypto Regulation In South Africa Update
links.body:
/></center>

[source](https://www.michalsons.com/blog/cryptocurrency-regulation-in-south-africa/79721)





Yesterday there was another high court ruling with regard to crypto and this ruling was different to the one handed out on May 15th. I will get to these rulings in a moment and how they differ which only highlights how complex non crypto people are making crypto. The judges may be smart in their legal fields, but when it comes to crypto they need to stay in their zone of specialty because crypto is so different on so many levels one needs to fully understand how it can be regulated. 

There have been two crypto rulings in the high court recently and what is obvious is those being caught doing things wrong with their crypto are not innocent parties and have used crypto as a tool to move illicit funds. This to me is right that they have their assets seized as this is not the likes of you and me who try and stay within the laws even if we bend them slightly.

The court ruling on May the 15th in the case against Standard Bank and the South African Reserve Bank was about a client being Leo Cash And Carry transferring 4400 Bitcoin to a Seychelles exchange. The Bitcoin was valued at around $31 million at the time and you can see the problem here. This Leo cash And Carry was an absolute fool because Bitcoin was being used to move funds out the country and not in a smart way. The route should have been having your Bitcoin in a cold wallet for your own protection and never relying on an exchange to store your coins.

The judge ruled in the banks/clients favor stating that crypto could not be stated as conventional currency using the Exchange Control Regulations due to the fact that crypto is not legal tender. Crypto exists as a digital code and that this was not state issued money.

What this ruling did was highlight that the Exchange Control Regulations did not cover crypto as when these regulations were signed into law digital currencies/assets were not around.

This ruling shocked the SARB and why we saw those drastic rules being put forward last month which stated that they were looking at limiting what crypto investors could hold or more so with the amount one could move onto an international exchange outside of SA borders. Again this highlighted a lack of knowledge with regard to how crypto works and how limited the SARB would be in implementing any laws. From a crypto perspective knowing more than they do they are farting into the wind looking like complete fools. 

Now back to yesterdays ruling by another judge in the high court who is again out of his depth with no real understanding of what and how crypto works. The judgement yesterday was with another crypto transaction who used LUNO based accounts in South Africa to send R182 million in crypto to foreign based exchanges outside of SA's reach. The SARB managed to seize R6 million which I would gather was still in the LUNO exchange.

The judge ruled that the crypto was capital with an explanation that any financial asset capable of storing monetary value or a tool for being able to exchange for money was indeed capital. His ruling that if you transfer crypto locally to another exchange then it was an illegal export of capital and that the previous judgement was incorrect in how they saw crypto.

What is crazy is that certain rulings have created more confusion like the NPS act which states that crypto is not legal tender because the SARB only recognizes money for transactions. Crypto was declared a financial product in 2022 more about legitimizing certain exchanges allowing them to provide services. This was never intended to legitimize crypto as a currency.

What this ruling handed out yesterday does is give the SARB certain powers to regulate crypto though having no unregulated export of capital via crypto on digital ledgers.

What these two cases has done as they are similar in their intention as they both sound dodgy in how they acted. These individuals sent money using crypto and just by the nature of the methods used tells you they are up to no good. All this has done is bought in ways of clamping down on everyone else using crypto because of a few bad actors. I am all for regulation of crypto, but it has to be done in such away that it protects crypto and not how the government wants to control it because they are very limited in how they can. Obviously if someone spends millions on crypto in SA and then sends that crypto out the country it is a breach of capital outflow regulations which these idiots did.

We are all waiting on the next phase of crypto regulation as the first proposal was shot down because it was too drastic and some what draconian. The SARB is screwed as we all know someone who wants to send money out the country using crypto can and there are so many ways. The problem is when using the local exchanges you will be flagged which the good news is you have already moved money onto international crypto exchanges then you are in the clear.

links.title: What Size I Was Actually Capable of Standing In
links.body:
![1000166134.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/Eonk3HkWCyubiUyBD3GRgbq9pRpg25VTgDnvPEtM64Tgjje6DUphwMcdbYXxu22NPp3.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)









<center>I have looked up at a sky so large it made every argument I was having with myself feel like something I had borrowed and forgotten to return,
I have looked up and felt the particular regret of realizing how much room I had given to something that the sky above me could hold in one cloud,
I have looked up and understood for a few seconds at a time that I am made from the same material as whatever is out there moving without asking permission from anyone,
Why do I return so quickly to the small and grinding version of myself when the larger one is always available and has never once asked me to earn it,
I have looked up at a sky so large and felt both the relief of being nothing and the unbearable weight of knowing that nothing still means I am here and responsible for what I do from today onwards...





<center>I have stood inside my mind and for once not tried to fix it or argue my way out of it or trade it for something that sounded more dignified,
I have stood inside my mind and felt it open into something I did not expect which was not expected but a kind of permission I had been waiting to receive from somewhere outside myself,
I have stood inside my mind and understood that the vastness I was looking at was not indifferent to me but was in fact the same thing I was made of looking back,
What would change about the way I move through a difficult day, hold onto even a fraction of this feeling past the moment the rain is no longer in front of me,
I have stood inside my mind and found that it was not the enemy I had spent so many years running from but the most honest room I had ever been willing to enter...





<center>I have used the chance of daily worry as proof that I was taking my life seriously when the more uncomfortable truth is that I was just taking it narrowly,
I have used the familiar weight of small grievances as something to hold because holding them made me feel like I was doing something real,
I have used the closed and manageable version of my problems as a way to avoid looking at the ones that were so much bigger and like a stranger that naming them out loud felt like inviting too much in,
Am I choosing the smaller worry because it is the most pressing one or because the larger one asks a version of me to show up that I am not yet sure what I have built,
I have used the chance of daily worry as a place to live and only realized how cramped it had become when something enormous moved across my sky and reminded me what size I was actually capable of standing in...





<center>I have felt the connectedness that comes from being one small thing inside an enormous amount of other things and not knowing what to do with a feeling that is too large to identify,
I have felt it and immediately tried to translate it into something useful and applicable to the specific problem I was carrying at that particular seek,
I have felt the connectedness and then let it dissolve back into the ordinary feeling of the day because I did not have the language for it and I did not trust myself to hold it without shrinking into something easier to explain,
What am I actually afraid will happen if I let myself feel connected to something that big without immediately asking what I am supposed to do with the next feeling,
I have felt the connectedness and turned away from it before it could ask anything of me that I was not prepared to answer and the full cost of the times I have decided to looked away...



<center>Watchwords:
Something I had borrowed and forgotten to return,
The larger version never asked me to earn it,
Smallness was the most honest room I entered,
Taking my life narrowly and calling it seriously,
Turned away before it could ask anything of me...






![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

***

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>


***
***

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>

allowfullscreen></iframe>

According to the DBIR 2026 report 31% of breaches exploited technical vulnerabilities. I expect this number to continuing rising as the next generation of AI models, like Anthropic's Mythos, become available to hackers. Technical exploitation simply becomes easier for a much larger community of adversaries.

Now, let's round out that picture by understanding that 62% of breaches included some element of human risk, because people are still in the loop and have access to important systems and data. We cannot forget that cybersecurity foundations go beyond just technology, as it also involves people and the processes which connect the two.

I created several video shorts, discussing interesting aspects of this year's DBIR, which can be found here: https://www.youtube.com/@CybersecurityInsights/shorts

links.title: Tambi Tea Garden ( Kebun Teh Tambi)
links.body: /> Tambi Tea Garden is located in Dieng, Wonosobo. Tambi is famous for its very large tea trees and the fresh cold air . In the morning, the sunrise is a golden yellow, passing through the rows of tea gardens. It offers a very beautiful natural panorama.

/> Famous spots in the Tambi tea plantation are: • Tea Picking Tour and tea factory, where you can see firsthand the process of picking tea leaves and how black tea is made. • The expanse of 840 hectares of tea trees and a thin morning mist, with a complete view of Mount Sindoro, Sumbing, Prau, and Telemoyo. • The 200m yellow bamboo bridge, a hanging wooden bridge over the tea plantation, with a direct backdrop of Mount Sindoro and a stretch of green tea trees.

/> • The heart -shaped viewing tower, a heart deck in Sikatok. • A café in the middle of the garden. • Adventure trips by bicycle or jeep, with track conditions that are quite challenging for people who enjoy adrenaline.
/> The entrance ticket is also very affordable, ranging from Rp. 10,000 to Rp. 30,000. With beautiful view and fresh air, it makes us happy and wants to come back again.
/>\n\nThank you all readers and wish you healthy, happy and joyfull life.

links.body: > Za mną kolejna dość przyzwoita nocka, która nie dała w kość chodź bez problemów się oczywiście nie obyło. Po jednym z przezbrojeń maszyny konieczna była interwencja utrzymania ruchu. Nie byłem w stanie ustabilizować procesu produkcji tak, żeby każdy detal był przynajmniej akceptowalny. Sprawdzałem trochę radary pogodowe i zanosiło się na ciekawe mgły z rana, które faktycznie były i byłyby z tego dobre zdjęcia. Myślałem, że po odwiezieniu kolegi wyskoczę jeszcze gdzieś w pobliżu na jakieś małe focenie, ale na parkingu zrobił się korek, bo blondynka go zablokowała. Nie żebym powielał stereotyp blondynek, ale to po prostu czyste fakty. Kobieta, blond włosy i wyjazd z parkingu zablokowany. Dodatkowo w lidlu jest promocja na Budweisera 10+10 gratis, więc moje towarzystwo, z którym do pracy jeżdżę nie omieszkało udać się na zakupy. No i się zrobiło 1,5 h powrotu zamiast normalnych 50 min. Zniechęciło mnie to wyjścia z aparatem. Organizm domagał się snu i zrobiłem jedynie kilka zdjęć iPhonem przy powrocie z pracy. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUoRbqkBZ1igAbpXs9PqvUkWVRXCRTajfCaoxpc5Jze5d/img_0054.jpg) Po kolejnym konkretnym odespaniu nocki aż do 15 zostałem zaangażowany w wyjazd do ogrodniczego z żoną i teściową. Żona chciała powiększyć kolekcję kwiatów balkonowych, która do tej pory wyglądała następująco: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRQoN5NzutXTDTzyiBdZDLiEwTXoiDSJBueJukXp8phoS/img_0059.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVU8ZBUD4TGx4u66sKWQujqjjimxroxhxHtNrFai1XYBT/img_0060.jpg) I oprócz tego kupić kwiatki na poręcz przed wejściem do domu i jakieś kwiaty ogrodowe do posadzenia. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNUU3LqNaBeDVqkrxpviiUyfQ9324QPngrQHEpX5bobA3/img_0071.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyjiMSRc8fJcHa2ruC1PEMvus5ntrgVavv6FVdcC2kex/img_0073.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNVSjMvdnGwcrAUtaHe8mjkaqCpdRXHsa7DGKhdoTFRFg/img_0072.jpg) Po powrocie dodatkowo zostałem zobligowany do powieszenia nowego nabytku na balkonie, posprzątania samochodu żony i wyboru nowego tv do salonu teściów, bo stary uległ awarii. Tak jakbym nie musiał jeszcze iść do pracy na ostatnią w tym tygodniu nockę. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNNbC6VmkYkk6Kj16sxCcpbgEoCDphYiCUQDQw1hVoc36/img_0070.jpg) Miałem zamiar wyjechać wcześniej i zatrzymać się po drodze na zdjęcia i spróbować nadrobić niewykorzystaną okazję rano, ale chyba nic z tego nie wyjdzie. Zobaczymy. *** Utwór muzyczny na dziś: **Alesso, Pendulum - Fade** Dość niespodziewana kolaboracja dwóch projektów muzycznych o znacznie różniących się stylach. Alesso, znany od lat przede wszystkim z melodyjnego, mainstreamowego progressive house, połączył siły z Pendulum — ikoną drum’n’bass, łączącą ciężkie elektroniczne brzmienie z elementami rocka i gitarami elektrycznymi. W tym roku stworzyli razem bardzo przyjemny, progresywny utwór z niesamowicie chwytliwą linią melodyczną. Kawałek buduje się powoli na charakterystycznych, nostalgicznych syntezatorach Alesso, by w końcu eksplodować euforycznym, festiwalowym dropem — z tych, które idealnie sprawdzają się na głównej scenie. Sam kawałek jest zdecydowanie bliższy stylistyce Alesso — można powiedzieć, że to popis jego producenckiego kunsztu. Pendulum słychać tu przede wszystkim w wokalu Roba Swire’a, który jest wokalistą i producentem tego legendarnego projektu. Jego szorstki, charakterystyczny głos świetnie kontrastuje z gładką, melodyjną produkcją. Mnie osobiście taka kolaboracja totalnie zaskoczyła. Dwa zupełnie różne światy i style EDM, a efekt naprawdę zadowalający. https://youtu.be/dyNV5WGKJS8?is=DhH4Ev1BLq0zgCQ8

links.title: Hablemos de: El incidente | Let's talk about: The incident
links.body:
> Hola de nuevo! Hoy les traigo un post bastante genial, esta vez de una nueva reseña de una película que vi hace poco, cuyo nombre es El Incidente. Hace poco estuve con mi novio, el cual me acompaña siempre al ver películas, y estábamos buscando qué ver, a veces es muy difícil decidirlo porque hemos visto demasiadas cosas y además, dependiendo de nuestro estado de ánimo y mentalidad de momento, nos dejamos llevar por un género más que otro, Esta vez queríamos ver una película interesante y nos topamos con esta. Aunque solemos ver cine de muchos otros países, nunca habíamos visto algo de cine mexicano y hoy les vengo a hablar de esta peculiar película, intentando no hacer spoilers si quieren ir a verla, comencemos!
Hello again! Today I’m come to you with a pretty awesome new post, this time, a review of a movie I saw recently called The Incident. I was with my boyfriend the other day, he always comes with me to watch movies and we were trying to figure out what to watch. Sometimes it’s really hard to decide because we’ve seen so many things, and depending on our mood and mindset at the moment, we tend to gravitate toward one genre over another. This time we wanted to watch something interesting, and we stumbled upon this one. Although we usually watch movies from many other countries, we’d never seen anything from Mexican cinema before, and today I’m here to talk to you about this unique filmtrying not to give away any spoilers in case you want to go see it. Let’s go!

> ![2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ochitoalreves/23uFPgHU52Nx3QMfJSYmJqnqPk7KkVAozZSMgriUPSmwur5CZL7GNRf8fR5Bgon9JjwDs.jpeg)
Esta película fue estrenada en el año 2014, fue dirigida y escrita por Isaac. Ezban y protagonizada por una buena gama de actores como Raúl Méndez, Humberto Busto, Hernán Mendoza, Nailea Norvind, y Fernando Álvarez Rebeil. Investigando el género la mayoría de las páginas la denominan como ciencia ficción, sin embargo para mí es más como un thriller. Hablar de la trama es difícil sin dar spoilers, ya que para explicar que es lo que sucede es necesario hablar de algo importante que sucede, y es que las historias parecen aisladas entre sí, pero nada más lejos de la realidad. La primera historia trata de dos hermanos que son Oliver y Carlos que parecen tener problemas de dinero, los cuales son increpados por un policía llamado Marco que los quiere arrestar por un supuesto crimen, pero luego de un incidente en la persecución quedan atrapados en las escaleras que parecen infinitas. La segunda historia es de una madre, Sandra y su pareja, Roberto planean un viaje en conjunto a los hijos de esta, Daniel el hermano mayor y Sandra la hermana menor, sin embargo luego de un incidente, la carretera en la que viajan parece ir en un bucle eterno.
This film was released in 2014, it was directed and written by Isaac Ezban and stars a diverse cast of actors, including Raúl Méndez, Humberto Busto, Hernán Mendoza, Nailea Norvind, and Fernando Álvarez Rebeil. Looking at the genre, most websites classify it as science fiction, but to me it’s more of a thriller. It’s hard to discuss the plot without giving away spoilers, since explaining what happens requires mentioning a key plot point: the stories seem isolated from one another, but nothing could be further from the truth. The first story is about two brothers, Oliver and Carlos, who seem to be having money problems. They are confronted by a police officer named Marco who wants to arrest them for an alleged crime, but after an incident during the chase, they find themselves trapped on a staircase that seems to go on forever. The second story is about a mother, Sandra, and her partner, Roberto, who plan a trip together with her children, Daniel, the older brother, and Sandra, the younger sister; however, after an incident, the highway they’re traveling on seems to go in an endless loop.

> [![4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ochitoalreves/23vhno1CS7VzGKXoGS5wfSM17wqwwFKKYMPSQvHbqMmP9Gu5GAMDhjFtqwUSwDuohiah6.jpeg)](https://www.filmelier.com/mx/peliculas/17012/el-incidente)
El incidente ocurre cuando el evento trágico que ocasionará la inminente destino de uno de los involucrados ocurre. Justo después de estos eventos suena una explosión, lo cual indica que el incidente ocurrió y que ahora estarán atrapados en un bucle de cual no podrán escapar, en la primera historia son unas escaleras que no parecen tener un comienzo y un fin, y en la segunda historia, una carretera que parecer ir en círculos. Los días parecen repetirse, todo lo que está en el lugar como alimentos y objetos parecen regenerarse, lo cual ayuda a a la supervivencia, y el tiempo parece estático. Los años pasan pero todo parece igual, pero la realidad es que el tiempo cambia todo. Es difícil narrar esto sin spoilers, pero realmente hay que estar muy atentos a los detalles que se observan para poder entender lo que sucede, que aunque no lo parezca realmente no es tan complicado, pero te hace volar la mente.
The incident occurs when the tragic event that will seal the fate of one of the characters takes place. Immediately after these events, an explosion is heard, signaling that the incident has occurred and that they are now trapped in a loop from which they cannot escape. In the first story, it is a staircase that seems to have no beginning and no end; in the second story, it is a road that appears to go in circles. The days seem to repeat themselves; everything in the place, such as food and objects seems to regenerate, which aids survival, and time seems to stand still. Years go by but everything seems the same, yet the reality is that time changes everything. It’s hard to describe this without spoilers, but you really have to pay close attention to the details you observe to understand what’s happening which, even though it might not seem like it, isn’t actually that complicated, but it really blows your mind.

> [![6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ochitoalreves/23vsNmsrHooQpTuJpHS9gz5bf33vLGQDzdmP6cQao11Khv8jvZZLnrcVN5tBcbsSWWzXV.jpeg)](https://cinescopia.com/el-incidente-una-insufrible-y-surrealista-mentira-mexicana/2015/09/)
Algo que me preocupaba de esta película era no entenderla, porque puede ser fácil perder el hilo conductor que conecta ambas historias, sim embargo la película es clara e incluso, te explica directamente qué es lo que pasa, y nos logramos desesperar con los personajes, y a su vez entender como ceden ante un destino que parece no tener final. Es una película bien hecha, con una historia coherente y que puede hacer que el espectador se mantenga atento a lo que sucede. Sin embargo, aunque la considero una muy buena película, siento que carece de trascendencia, aunque me gustó mucho no creo que sea una película que me haya marcado tanto, no obstante la recomiendo porque considero que a alguien más si la puede marcar, y bastante, porque tiene una buena reflexión y un plot twist bastante bueno que uno no se espera. La dirección me encanta, la fotografía es impecable, y las actuaciones personalmente me gustaron mucho. Espero que la quieran ver y me puedan compartir su opinión, y si la vieron cuéntenme qué les pareció!
One thing that worried me about this movie was that I might not understand it, because it can be easy to lose track of the thread that connects the two stories. However, the film is clear and even explains directly what’s happening, so we end up feeling frustrated with the characters while also understanding how they succumb to a fate that seems to have no end. It’s a good film, with a coherent story that keeps the viewer engaged in what’s happening. However, although I consider it a very good movie, I feel it lacks depth. Even though I really liked it, I don’t think it’s a movie that left a lasting impression on me. Nevertheless, I recommend it because I believe it could have a significant impact on someone else, and quite a strong one at that, since it offers a thought-provoking reflection and a pretty good plot twist that you don’t see coming. I love the direction, the cinematography is impeccable, and I personally really liked the performances. I hope you’ll want to watch it and share your thoughts with me, and if you’ve seen it, let me know what you thought!

> ![divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ochitoalreves/23uQpCCM2XzmBdpEynL1LXipfX2x97hTDT9BnGPC1a8bLdexmQwuJQz1DFTsyWfYHuEg8.png) _Portada diseñada por mí en FilmoraGO | Cover designed by me in FilmoraGO_ _Fuentes de los gifs dando click | Sources of the gifs by clicking_ _[Fuente](https://www.iconpacks.net/free-icon/movie-2802.html) del divisor | [Source](https://www.iconpacks.net/free-icon/movie-2802.html) of the divisor_

links.title: A sudden guest on my wall: a lizard captured on a macro camera in the corner of the room.
links.body:
> ![IMG20260108191609~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTrDim88w7hHKDg9ZGCXhGvfb3UoMHsLKWULrPsHo3QEa/IMG20260108191609~2.jpg) My warmest greetings to everyone. I hope you are all well. Today I am here to share with you a very unexpected moment and some great macro photos. I had just finished my homework, when I suddenly noticed a movement on the wall of the room. I looked and saw a rather large lizard sitting still on the wall. It was much larger than the lizards we usually see at home, and its color and texture were completely different. ![IMG20260108191613~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZGWHdkmzfBRUr1tpuQe2HquxQCiyyJ5knMiDTSpyU4yM/IMG20260108191613~2.jpg) Nature lovers and those who have a passion for photography do not miss such an opportunity. I also took my phone and went very close to take some close-up shots. Surprisingly, even after I got so close, it was completely calm, as if it also loves to pose! The head of the lizard is very well exposed in the close-up shot. Especially note its eye, which is as clear and radiant as glass. I was amazed at how perfectly the rough texture of its skin and the small grainy spots were captured by the macro lens. ![IMG20260108191535~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme3K6L5fJ9oeYXd1Cg9WVm5ssArnxwkZpMKdMeYwmAm5J/IMG20260108191535~2.jpg) From another angle, the shape of its head and the excellent grip of its feet on the grooves of the wall are visible. It is amazing to think what strange ability nature has given them to walk on walls or smooth floors. A full-body shot of its entire body. From the head to the very end of its tail, its long build and slender body structure are clearly visible in this picture. Its tail and body ratio were quite eye-catching compared to a normal lizard. ![IMG20260108191510~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdWqhuCHxR6WBehaBEeApE8jvFvxZ54JsH6iMKuJNtKeB/IMG20260108191510~2.jpg) Many people would have been scared and chased away if they suddenly saw such a large animal inside the house, but it seemed to me that it was a small part of the biodiversity around us. And after seeing it through the eyes of the camera, my fear of it disappeared and a kind of fascination developed. Thank you all for taking the time to read my post. Stay well everyone. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

links.title: Bandeja decorativa para tocador/ Dressing table tray 💗😍
links.body:
> Hello gente creativa de Hive! Qué tal va su semana? Por estos lados finalmente hoy pude terminar una bandeja decorativa para la habitación de Miranda, que al estar elaborada con una pasta de yeso y harina de trigo había que esperar algunos días para que secara por completo antes de pintar, así que se imaginarán como estaba la reina de la ansiedad y la impaciencia esperando para poder ver el resultado final, pero sin dudas valió la pena, ya que amé el resultado y es que es absolutamente bello y se ve muy linda en la mesa de noche de Miri, y lo mejor es que no solo es para decorar, sino para que ella tenga a la mano los accesorios que usa de forma regular.
Hello, creative folks at Hive! How’s your week going? Over here, I’ve finally managed to finish a decorative tray for Miranda’s bedroom today. As it’s made from a mixture of plaster and wheat flour, I had to wait a few days for it to dry completely before painting it, so you can imagine how anxious and impatient I was, waiting to see the final result, but it was definitely worth the wait, as I absolutely love how it turned out – it’s absolutely beautiful and looks lovely on Miri’s bedside table. Best of all, it’s not just for decoration, but also keeps the accessories she uses regularly within easy reach.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXBMQgutjsM3ZSoTwmCLaEuAAQdGSL5ZTcmyfJcNwvYdz/1780420912272.png) *** Estas bandejas decorativas están en tendencia y tienen un sin fin de usos, y las puedes ver en diferentes materiales, de hecho ella tiene una hecha en casa también que está elaborada con cartón recubierto con felpa y que es para que coloque sus lentes, pero yo quería hacer una para que pudiese dejar los accesorios que usa a diario y que los tenga al alcance de su mano, y para esto me busqué un montón de ideas que luego le mosté a ella para que decidiera el modelo, y escogió esta con una forma ovalada y diseño orgánico en color blanco y cerecitas, que me parece no van mucho con la decoración, pero pues, así es mi niña, no le gusta una sola cosa y no le da miedo mezclar como a su mamá, que quiere todo de una misma forma 🤣 Les cuento que no es la primera vez que trabajo con este tipo de masas moldeables, ya que por muchos años trabajé con masa flexible, y hace dos navidades probé con una masa de maicena y bicarbonato, y la verdad es una actividad que disfruto mucho, porque además de relajante me permite crear a mis anchas, y aunque también he trabajado con yeso, nunca había probado esta mezcla de yeso y harina de trigo que me encontré dando vueltas por pinterest, y sin dudarlo decidí intentar y el resultado me gustó muchísimo, y por eso lo comparto con ustedes, así que aquí vamos.
These decorative trays are all the rage and have endless uses; you can find them in all sorts of materials. In fact, she has a homemade one too, made from cardboard covered in plush fabric, which she uses to keep her glasses in, but I wanted to make one so she could keep the accessories she uses every day within easy reach, So I looked up loads of ideas, which I then showed her so she could choose the design. She picked this one with an oval shape and an organic design in white with little cherries – which I don’t think really go with the decor, but hey, that’s my girl for you. She doesn’t like just one thing and isn’t afraid to mix things up, unlike her mum, who wants everything to be the same 🤣 I should mention that this isn’t the first time I’ve worked with this sort of modelling clay, as I used to work with play dough for many years, and two Christmases ago I tried a mixture of cornflour and bicarbonate of soda. To be honest, it’s an activity I really enjoy, because as well as being relaxing, it lets me create whatever I like, and although I’ve also worked with plaster, I’d never tried this mixture of plaster and wheat flour that I stumbled across on Pinterest, and without hesitation I decided to give it a go and I loved the result, which is why I’m sharing it with you, so here we go
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdHPk6W87xxLryVvF9Q9bXzwuKzRS93s5RhSXVpzj6j8z/1780420509524.jpg) *** ## Materiales 1/2 taza de yeso bien fino 1/2 taza de harina de trigo 1/2 cucharadita de aceite Agua Rodillo Cutter Lija Pintura blanca, rosada y menta Lija fina Estecas de punta fina y en forma de bolita Brillo de uñas
## Materials 1/2 cup of very fine plaster 1/2 cup of wheat flour 1/2 teaspoon of oil Water Rolling pin Craft knife Sandpaper White, pink and mint-coloured paint Fine-grit sandpaper Fine-tipped and ball-tipped modelling tools Nail varnish
## Paso a paso/ Step by step Para iniciar lo primero que haremos será elaborar la masa de yeso, y para esto mezclamos en un bol el yeso y la harina de trigo y agregamos agua poco a poco, en mi caso lo fui haciendo por cucharadas para no excederme y una vez estuvo bien mezclada y tuvo un consistencia similar a la masa de modelaje que usan los niños, agregué el aceite y amasé por unos minutos hasta que todo estuvo bien integrado y la masa se sienta suave y flexible.
To begin with, the first thing we’ll do is make the plaster mixture, and to do this, we mix the plaster and wheat flour in a bowl and add water little by little; in my case, I added it by the spoonful so as not to add too much, and once it was well mixed and had a consistency similar to the modelling clay children use, I added the oil and kneaded it for a few minutes until everything was well combined and the dough felt smooth and pliable.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTU6ipgXbsXstqKoAFKcUQcuD6j4TGr3a85ARVqTbV8RE/1780419923671.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUww9dSDBvnutc6SEKAQmWAbF26iCge8qKSU3ePUWTNs6/1780419923859.jpg) *** En este punto la guardamos en una bolsa plástica por 5 minutos, y nos aseguramos que no haya aire dentro de la bolsa y transcurridos el tiempo de espera está lista para trabajar.
At this point, place it in a plastic bag for 5 minutes, making sure there is no air inside the bag; once the waiting time is up, it is ready to use.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNmuzKCSsjW4df4CvQUCnWftyLk5x2ky9spWAzAMFT3Nz/1780419924053.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP5DpPi2ZqdnwXsbE7SRZZf93UBzcdfJQHbpfqwX1bg6o/1780419924261.jpg) *** Seguidamente procedemos a estirar la masa con un rodillo (pueden usar también una botella) dejándola con un grosor de 1 centímetro, y con el cuter corto en forma ovalada, retiro el excedente de la masa y con las manos voy dando la forma curva que tiene en los bordes, y para asegurar que no se mueva usé unas tapas de botellas plásticas y dejé secar por 48 horas que se sintieron como una semana 🤣 Les comento que el paso del secado es sumamente importante, no es algo que debamos apresurar porque les pasará lo que a mí, que en el primer intento, por estar siempre de impaciente la dejé justo frente al aire acondicionado y el resultado fue que la masa se agrietó y terminó quebrándose, así que denle su tiempo y cuando la pieza no se sienta fría y esté muy liviana quiere decir que ha secado por completo. En mi caso, en el segundo intento la dejé en el cuarto de Miranda, donde no hay aire acondicionado y no estaba al alcance de mi vista para evitar tocarla, así que pueden ubicarla en una habitación donde no tengan aire, no reciba sol directo y por favor, resistan la tentación de tocarla hasta que pasen las 48 horas. No sean como yo 🤣 Ok gente, después de la advertencia sigamos!
Next, roll out the dough with a rolling pin (you can also use a bottle) until it’s 1 centimetre thick. Using a craft knife, cut out an oval shape, trim off the excess dough, and use your hands to shape the curved edges, and to make sure it didn’t move, I used some plastic bottle caps and left it to dry for 48 hours, which felt like a week 🤣 I should point out that the drying stage is extremely important; it’s not something we should rush, otherwise you’ll end up like me: on my first attempt, because I’m always so impatient, I left it right in front of the air conditioning, and the result was that the dough cracked and ended up breaking, so give it time, and when the piece no longer feels cold and is very light, that means it has dried completely. In my case, on my second attempt I left it in Miranda’s room, where there’s no air conditioning and it was out of sight so I wouldn’t be tempted to touch it, so you can put it in a room without air conditioning, out of direct sunlight, and please, resist the temptation to touch it until 48 hours have passed. Don’t be like me 🤣 OK everyone, now that the warning’s out of the way, let’s get on with it!
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyW2Ue78BqQvScVPrBziJx5ZmMfahA4BhqG5jobvDTBe/1780419924417.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfXJtNwgPmYcu6BeCiu6znwKpZDGz4Z8dBE7Pf73AHdWj/1780420098865.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme8dCRm6uzntbY7a6g6yJV4PG7gLbB1b47srxMMWeTCEA/1780420099065.jpg) *** Una vez transcurrieron las 48 horas fui a ver mi pieza y tenía algunas grietas pequeñas, así que hice una mezcla ligera con yeso y con la ayuda de un pincel las rellené todas y traté de corregir pequeñas imperfecciones y la dejé secar un día más.
Once the 48 hours had passed, I went to have a look at my piece and noticed it had a few small cracks, so I made a light mixture of plaster and, using a brush, filled them all in and tried to smooth out the minor imperfections, then left it to dry for another day.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZGe7i6be9kDP3z1cNkB93DZnWuZkUkiHTergx3fqk7jT/1780420099204.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS1JsxBdgMcMgNkXP4ifttVxPdJ4nibae1KiFgqbaMFY8/1780420099337.jpg) *** Finalmente llegó el momento de poder pintar, pero previo a ello con una lija fina, lijé toda la superficie para tratar de dejarla lo más prolija posible, aunque como se trata de una pieza artesanal, la verdad no me preocupe mucho por pequeñas imperfecciones, pero sí trate de dejar lo más lisa posible la superficie para luego proceder a pintar.
The time had finally come to start painting, but before doing so, I sanded the entire surface with fine-grit sandpaper to try and make it as smooth as possible. Although it’s a handcrafted piece, I didn’t really worry too much about minor imperfections, but I did try to make the surface as smooth as possible before moving on to the painting.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVSqondJ1Gf8HwpFwdjHpFNULbSDFuP8niyxiHSes6Zkt/1780420234113.jpg) *** Como les comenté arriba, Miranda quería la bandeja de color blanco, así que trabajé con pintura acrílica de color blanco y con un pincel cubrí toda la superficie dando tres manos de pintura, y una vez que ésta secó completamente lijé nuevamente la superficie para eliminar las marcas del pincel.
As I mentioned earlier, Miranda wanted the tray to be white, so I used white acrylic paint and a brush to cover the entire surface with three coats of paint; once it had dried completely, I sanded the surface again to remove the brush marks.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeg9xDHgAKikEUU919dQmLCUeNNaRu6TZVZ4PSfQSrESz/1780420234256.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQdeZXaxjRXGjM1gqLjj34WuRhkfjY2kVC7dYbnBw1TwY/1780420099463.jpg) *** El siguiente paso es pintar las cerezas en la superficie plana de la bandeja, y para esto utilice pintura color rosa para mantener los colores que ya estamos utilizando en la habitación, y me ayudé con una esteca con punta redonda. Si no tienen esta herramienta en su casa, no se preocupen, pueden utilizar la parte trasera del pincel, es decir, la parte opuesta a las cerdas y les va a funcionar de la misma manera. La idea es tomar la esteca, mojarla en la pintura y hacer dos bolitas en la superficie e irlas distribuyendo por toda la bandeja para crear las cerecitas.
The next step is to paint the cherries onto the flat surface of the tray. For this, I used pink paint to match the colours we’re already using in the room, and I used a round-tipped modelling tool to help me. If you don’t have this tool at home, don’t worry – you can use the back of the paintbrush, that is, the part opposite the bristles, and it will work just as well. The idea is to take the paint stick, dip it in the paint, make two little dots on the surface, and spread them across the tray to create the little cherries.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQN2YeBGdpnrobW6wEHe6FN516rkyXGJCHaeqdwUuBNiD/1780420234375.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcRvmuayBAQ5PMHrDwqMQjeX5Gpy5cfW2sG3v3hskTkXM/1780420234475.jpg) *** El siguiente paso es crear la ramitas que unen a las cerezas y para esto utilizamos una esteca de punta fina, ustedes pueden utilizar un palito de altura o un palillo y tendrán el mismo resultado. En este caso yo las hice en color verde menta para continuar la misma paleta de colores que tenemos en la habitación, y lo que hacemos es ubicar la punta de la esteca con pintura verde menta en la cereza y la llevamos hacia arriba haciendo una pequeña curva y la siguiente la hacemos hacia el lado contrario formando una x en la parte superior como pueden ver en las imágenes. Una vez que todo estuvo seco distribuí algunos puntitos de color rosa por el resto de la bandeja para que no se viesen tanto espacios vacíos y estaba lista esta etapa.
The next step is to create the twigs that hold the cherries in place. To do this, we use a fine-tipped paintbrush; you can use a thin stick or a toothpick and achieve the same result. In this case, I made them in mint green to continue the same colour scheme we have in the room. What we do is place the tip of the tool, dipped in mint green paint, on the cherry and move it upwards in a slight curve, then make the next stroke in the opposite direction, forming an ‘X’ at the top, as you can see in the pictures. Once everything was dry, I dotted a few pink dots around the rest of the tray so there weren’t so many empty spaces, and that stage was complete.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRshYwDXZGzsU5Uv11AGiNxaTSoVka6v3HNYKoPSvVhQR/1780420234594.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ8nRsVY5trXPvowTUvZaYg1erm3ZVqtFA6iPtJ2ZvEFg/1780420386515.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPu1V6UdfXzKSWLgmEtyzy8ASmat1wY16kFWAtUGSZSMQ/1780420386774.jpg) *** En este punto y para finalizar con el proyecto decidí darle un toque especial de brillo y volumen a las cerecitas, y esto lo logré con brillo de uñas y lo apliqué únicamente a la cereza como tal y a los diferentes puntitos distribuidos por la bandeja, y lo que hice fue dejar caer en una superficie plana una gota de brillo y con ayuda de la esteca fina, fui dejándolo caer en las cerezas y en los puntitos y de esta forma está finalizando este trabajo que la verdad a mí me encantó y miren lo bello que se ve en la mesita de noche de mi flaquita. >At this stage, to finish off the project, I decided to add a special touch of shine and volume to the little cherries, and I achieved this using nail varnish, applying it only to the cherries themselves and to the various dots scattered across the tray, What I did was place a drop of glitter on a flat surface and, using the fine spatula, I applied it to the cherries and the little dots. And so this project is finished – I absolutely loved it, and just look how lovely it looks on my little girl’s bedside table. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPu1V6UdfXzKSWLgmEtyzy8ASmat1wY16kFWAtUGSZSMQ/1780420509649.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQG8vVw8LRG8tULfMy8AATXqHpr98DfXtbB7wYmf5awWU/1780420386657.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY2LLRiMeEQx3vxRZmKJYGV7rHBFzjGdAnyqz4XbtXKpF/1780420386890.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdHPk6W87xxLryVvF9Q9bXzwuKzRS93s5RhSXVpzj6j8z/1780420387010.jpg) *** Como pueden ver es un proyecto que aunque sencillo, ya que la elaboración de la masa es súper fácil, hay que trabajar con mucho cuidado y, sobre todo, cuidar dos cosas que son el tiempo de secado y el lijado para que nuestra bandeja luzca lo más linda posible, así que sea pacientes y detallistas. >As you can see, although this is a simple project—since making the dough is really easy—you need to work very carefully and, above all, pay close attention to two things: the drying time and the sanding, so that your tray looks as lovely as possible. So be patient and pay attention to the details.
📷*Photography by|Fotografía por:@rlathulerie,🔅 Cover created in/Portada creada en [Canva](https://www.canva.com), [Separator and banner/separador y banner](https://hive.blog/hive-148441/@ikasumanera/eng-es-i-made-hive-free-use-art-of-for-all-of-you-part-1-dividers-and-banners-or-hice-arte-de-libre-uso-para-todos-parte-1), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)*

Hello @plantfuljourney friend!... Fermented elderflower lemonade 🙂 I've never seen that before, but I'm guessing it tastes delicious. As a child, my mother used to give me warm milk with elderflowers before bed, and I still remember that wonderful flavor... Here in Venezuela, they only grow in the mountains because they're colder than the low valleys, but it's common for health food stores to sell the flowers. But that elderflower plant in your garden looks beautiful, so full of blossoms! I loved seeing your post! I hope your lemonade ferments well and doesn't turn into citrus vinegar! 😃🙏

!discovery

links.title: ☕🥐✨ ¡La merienda con compañeros, un momento que vale oro! ✨🥐//☕🥐✨ Snack with colleagues, a moment worth gold! ✨🥐
links.body:
Hola amigos de hive como andan??? después de una jornada llena de trabajo en la escuela tecnica, estudio y desafíos, llega ese momento tan esperado: la merienda compartida con los compañeros. 🤝😊 Entre mates 🧉, café ☕, té 🍵, facturas 🥐, galletitas 🍪 y muchas charlas, se genera un espacio único donde las preocupaciones quedan por un rato de lado y aparecen las risas 😂, las anécdotas 📖 y las historias que hacen más llevadero el día y la tarde y la noche jaja. 🌟

>Hello hive friends, how are you doing??? After a day full of work at the technical school, study and challenges, that long-awaited moment arrives: the snack shared with classmates. 🤝😊 Between mates 🧉, coffee ☕, tea 🍵, bills 🥐, cookies 🍪 and many talks, a unique space is generated where worries are left aside for a while and laughter 😂, anecdotes 📖 and stories appear that make the day and the afternoon and the night more bearable haha. 🌟

![IMG_20260518_182009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeTEa4Lia5KvFx4CemXS9HNC2RZtV57DYvrMdDCw6jiEY/IMG_20260518_182009.jpg)

![IMG_20260518_181959.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSNUcMJNv1Dt8WLJzo3iPUVy8naNiawtyWuSYayAhnqV9/IMG_20260518_181959.jpg)

Lo más lindo de estos encuentros es que fortalecen los vínculos humanos con los compañeros de trabajo. ❤️ Cada conversación, cada chiste six seven ajajaj🤣 y cada intercambio de experiencias nos permite conocernos mejor y construir un ambiente de compañerismo y respeto. 🙌 A veces hablamos de proyectos 🚀, otras veces de la familia 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦, del deporte 🏀⚽ o simplemente de las cosas cotidianas que nos pasan. Todo suma para crear recuerdos que quedan grabados. 📸✨ y obvio les dejo fotos de la merienda , porque no es todo ciencia y tecnologia.

>The most beautiful thing about these meetings is that they strengthen human ties with coworkers. ❤️ Every conversation, every six seven joke ahaha🤣 and every exchange of experiences allows us to get to know each other better and build an atmosphere of camaraderie and respect. 🙌 Sometimes we talk about projects 🚀, other times about family 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦, sports 🏀⚽ or simply about the everyday things that happen to us. It all adds up to creating memories that remain recorded. 📸✨ and obviously I'll leave you photos of the snack, because it's not all science and technology.


![IMG_20260518_182001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX7LSxBnB2YexbP7ZwcB9eLFjSEModf8mzhaW2abGVX6C/IMG_20260518_182001.jpg)

![IMG_20260518_182002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHWZ9jNjMpYd16EQPWJvJUBjKQXikfodQXmd5CFhniQb/IMG_20260518_182002.jpg)

Porque una merienda no es solo compartir comida, sino también compartir tiempo, amistad y buenos momentos. 🧉☕🍪💬 Gracias a mis compañeros por cada charla, cada sonrisa 😊 y cada instante compartido. ¡Que nunca falten los mates, las risas y las ganas de seguir construyendo juntos! 💪❤️🎉

>Because a snack is not just sharing food, but also sharing time, friendship and good times. 🧉☕🍪💬 Thank you to my colleagues for every talk, every smile 😊 and every moment shared. May there never be a lack of mates, laughter and the desire to continue building together! 💪❤️🎉




![IMG_20260518_182006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNR9aXW5fwxyCzaPKTTHHxmh9XUbKZzT4hG1z67ymFjDe/IMG_20260518_182006.jpg)

![IMG_20260518_182007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT894R6fGAhSJpjscdCc4sZD16ES5GBSHYQT2rSARnPrL/IMG_20260518_182007.jpg)

Relacionar a Oneguin con Dorian Gray es muy acertado: ambos encarnan al antihéroe romántico atrapado en su inmadurez. Traer este análisis a @hive es también acertado. Hive Book Club y su comunidad de lectores lo agradecemos.

Me gusta cómo destacas el desarrollo de Tatiana, que pasa de ser una soñadora ingenua a una mujer íntegra y leal. El recurso narrativo de “romper la cuarta pared” le da al libro una profundidad única, casi como un consejo directo al lector. Sin duda, una joya de la literatura universal.
Éxitos @mairene1 ✨
