links.title: Weekend Hill Race
links.body: >\n\nHello everyone. On this occasion, I am going to relate my experience attending a race held last weekend. As a calisthenics coach, I recently went to the local park to lead a routine for one of my students who decided to have a brief training session over the weekend. Upon arrival, we noticed that an organized race to climb \

was about to take place. Without overthinking it, I decided to sign up along with my student to try something different. My student is a 65-year-old man, but he is extremely disciplined in his workouts. Before starting, I gave him instructions on how to maintain a fast and safe walking pace for the climb. Once the event began and we reached the base of the hill, I decided to push ahead. I executed a fast sprint toward the summit to gain distance. It was not an easy climb; after overtaking a large number of participants, I lowered the intensity and walked for a significant stretch before finishing with a short jog at the end. I should note that I am not a runner; my physical conditioning comes entirely from calisthenics. After reaching the finish line and resting for a few minutes, I headed back down the trail to find my student. To my surprise, he was still moving at a very consistent and solid rhythm. During the final stretch, he surprised the crowd by performing a smooth but steady jog for the last 20 meters. Since this was an uphill course, the physical demand was high, making it a significant achievement for someone of his age. I spent the rest of the day reflecting on the activity. It was a productive weekend experience where my student managed to push his personal limits and improve his fitness levels despite his age. It served as a practical demonstration of how consistent training pays off in demanding environments. I am satisfied with our performance and the fact that we broke the usual training routine with a challenging outdoor activity. Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time! ------ ---- |

links.title: [ENG-SPN] The Romanesque Secrets of San Pedro de Villanueva / Los Secretos Románicos de San Pedro de Villanueva
links.body:
![IMG_1617.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoniyuuspU21C8NU1PDpQ2Hn31KAWfReAUntBdUdvuMvpAzAcvYJkPzKRkp7AzSdMLt.JPG)

From those times at the end of the 19th century, thanks to the surprising artistic skills of a peculiar character of German origin, Roberto Frassinelli, who, enamored with Asturias, decided to retire to these solitudes near the Picos de Europa mountains, where he bathed in glacial lakes, we have some evidence of many of those ancient Romanesque structures, lost, for the most part, not so much by the inexorable passage of time, but by that Cain-like desire of man to destroy his heritage.

![IMG_1517.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EogS9ubh3U98CerRMAtQM8PsrPhJ1iyzJYaztkmTGSXhYNiEYH2ubZLPNLHNHLkZx7A.JPG)

Even in those times, Asturias boasted around a hundred similar architectural structures, distributed among hermitages, churches, and monasteries, exceeding one hundred in total. One of the few survivors is this unique monastery of San Pedro, located near the historic town of Cangas de Onís, the birthplace of the first Asturian monarchies, on this side of the banks of the Sella River, whose lively waters still provide the backdrop for one of the most popular festivals in the Principality of Asturias: the Canoe Festival.

![IMG_1519.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoCnwxc7rwTZcuXGaWmLMCmJYafLTp9TaHGjBWtv4R7tSZmsWhegL6osbMKSeg2Le5b.JPG)

Reconverted into the modern Parador de Cangas de Onís, the old monastery of San Pedro de Villanueva preserves, in its ancient surviving stones, not only details of meticulous sculpture, where history and legend generously intertwine, but also the archetypes, biases, virtues, and conditioning factors that characterized a medieval society that did not always manage to replace its ancestral beliefs, and where the anonymous stonemasons masterfully framed them within the new narrative.

![IMG_1550.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23uFRpbc4yNJNjq3b36c4SBKkR6uyHmdohYW1dV7sfXRsNn7Sjr39LYuNTBc7tWb6ZP8w.JPG)

De aquellos tiempos de finales del siglo XIX en los que, gracias a las sorprendentes habilidades artísticas de un peculiar personaje de origen alemán, que, enamorado de Asturias decidió retirarse en estas soledades aledañas a unos Picos de Europa, en cuyos lagos glaciares se bañaba, Roberto Frassinelli, tenemos algunos testimonios de muchas de aquellas antiguas arquitecturas románicas, perdidas, en su gran mayoría, no tanto por el paso inexorable del tiempo, como por ese afán cainita del hombre para destruir su patrimonio.

![IMG_1521.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EopwMDZp6R5FZ5VPsZXJVzsvhhKHowuTx1XQHSTay67S2bbqzU8ySYJSWgQyoRSJRU3.JPG)

Todavía en aquellos tiempos, en Asturias se localizaba la existencia de un centenar de semejantes arquitecturas, que, distribuidas entre ermitas, iglesias y monasterios superaba el centenar, siendo uno de los pocos sobrevivientes, este singular monasterio de San Pedro, situado en las inmediaciones de la histórica villa de Cangas de Onís, lugar, por defecto, que albergó a las primeras monarquías asturianas, a este lado de la ribera de un río, el Sella, cuyas alegres aguas sirven de marco todavía para la celebración de una de las fiestas más populares del Principado de Asturias: la Fiesta de las Piragüas.

![IMG_1577.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EpCCFbGsidMhGQAb1TTXBXv5nPn5dZhdjifx68Y4Hg8yxwtvUrYzwaG1rV3GTkxanGt.JPG)

Reconvertido en el moderno Parador de Cangas de Onís, el viejo monasterio de San Pedro de Villanueva, conserva, en sus milenarias piedras sobrevivientes, no sólo detalles de una escultura esmerada, en cuyo relato historia y leyenda se dan generosamente la mano, sino también, los arquetipos, sesgos, virtudes y acondicionamientos que caracterizaron a una sociedad medieval que no siempre alcanzó a sustituir sus ancestrales creencias y donde los anónimos canteros tuvieron la maestría de saber enmarcarlas en el marco del nuevo relato. 

![IMG_1584.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Enm9rDkJfFUTugEAXLccb6CsZAYgPd84zzBgjXkDqUTotZsuM333Rq66pdqYAC6w5GH.JPG)

links.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands - Report – Season End 160
links.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPKBRhSGjjhAevBgNF6BJh7t8s7bentrgrAgu8u54957U/Portada%20-%20Season%20160.png</center>

<center>On May 31, Season **160** of **Splinterlands** came to an end. It was a highly interesting season as I was able to achieve several goals despite facing obstacles like the power outages in Venezuela, which ultimately makes the completed milestones feel even more rewarding. Although the road was packed with new content like **Lux’s Favor** and the **Sparks Shop**, it was a fairly smooth ride, with the only major shake-up to the meta being the arrival of the **Fallen Legends** ruleset. This forced some tactical adjustments in ranked matches, but outside of that, I ended the season highly satisfied, gathering plenty of **Glints** to spend on **Loot Chests** and clear my objectives for this new cycle.</center>

><center>El pasado 31 de mayo terminó la temporada número **160** de **Splinterlands**, una temporada muy interesante ya que pude lograr algunas metas a pesar de ciertos obstáculos como los cortes eléctricos de Venezuela, lo que hace más satisfactorias las metas completadas. Aunque el camino estuvo lleno de contenido como **Lux’s Favor** y la **Sparks Shop**, fue bastante tranquila, con el único cambio en el meta por la llegada de la ruleset **Fallen Legends**. Esto hizo que cambiara algunas estrategias en ranked, pero fuera de esto quedé satisfecho con la temporada, obteniendo bastantes **Glints** para poder comprar los **Loot Chests** y lograr mis metas en esta temporada.</center>

### <center>Rewards | Recompensas</center>

<center>This season brought another visual overhaul to the end-of-season summary screen, which effectively condenses all the overall metrics. However, I would love for the developers to add a download button for the image to save it directly and use it in these analyses, as well as for social media sharing to grant the game more visibility. Furthermore, it would be ideal if the upper section was split into **4** parts, one for each game mode, showing how far we climbed or explicitly stating if a format wasn't played.</center>

><center>Esta temporada tuvimos otro cambio visual en el resumen del final de temporada que resume de manera efectiva la información total, aunque me gustaría que agregaran un botón para descargar la imagen para guardarla y usarla de manera directa en estos análisis, así como para subirla a redes sociales para darle más visibilidad y compartir el juego con más personas. Además, me gustaría que en la parte superior se separara en **4** partes para cada modo de juego, mostrando qué tan lejos se llegó en cada uno o indicando si no se jugó en ese formato.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbb9EogKv8aZiGxpS58hnwxQHaXwDeriPqy5PKkFv1eoo/Recompensas%20-%20Season%20160%20V2.png</center>

<center>Diving back into the numbers, I managed to secure **3 Foundations Pack** and **5 Entries**, alongside **182,521** Glints from **Ranked Season Rewards**, **98** Glints from the **Survival Bracket Reward**, and **10,000** Glints from the **Survival Leaderboard Prize**, which I claimed by reaching the **104** spot and completing my matches on the very last day of the mode.</center>

><center>Volviendo al análisis, pude conseguir **3 Foundations Pack** y **5 Entries**, además de **182,521** Glints de **Ranked Season Rewards**, **98** Glints de **Survival Bracket Reward** y **10,000** Glints de **Survival Leaderboard Prize**, que pude conseguir llegando a la posición **104** y completando las batallas en el último día en este modo.</center>


<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbWHMXswDfxpKCjPrFL6BBUfc73AMPyBqJkrxdsszTvz5/Separador%20-%20Frontier.png</center>

<center>During this stretch in **Frontier**, I still haven't broken my record of climbing past the 23rd spot. Although I didn't log as many battles as last season, I secured a significantly better winrate of **58.98%**, pushing me to rank **33** with **4,700** points, which yielded **3 Foundations Pack** and **5 Entries**.</center>

><center>En esta temporada de **Frontier** seguí sin superar mi récord de subir sobre la posición 23. Aunque esta temporada no tuve tantas batallas como la anterior, sí registré un mejor winrate de **58.98%**, lo que me llevó a la posición **33** con **4,700** puntos, con los que gané **3 Foundations Pack** y **5 Entries**.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQFAgKjMGwzwci89iYgA4ipsvDvi6M2fe2gJNGuwyXoLo/Frontier%20-%20Season%20160%20V2.png</center>

<center>Even though I will be much busier this season trying to push as high as possible in **Wild** and **Survival**, I will still try to climb hard in **Frontier** to breach the Top **25** again. This time, I'll be deploying my **Aimee Whisperwind**, as I collected enough copies to upgrade her to Level **2**, where her speed outpaces **Vengeful Monk**, granting me a decisive upper hand in multiple matchups.</center>

><center>Aunque en esta nueva temporada esté más ocupado intentando subir lo más que pueda en el formato **Wild** y **Survival**, igual intentaré escalar lo más alto posible en **Frontier** para volver al Top **25**, y más usando a mi **Aimee Whisperwind**, de la que conseguí suficientes copias para subirla a Nivel **2**, donde tiene más velocidad que **Vengeful Monk**, lo que puede darme la ventaja en varias batallas.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ5HSJkwMMFk9FVJoa1gWPm62SSD6xPUz6U3Txg8ZJtAZ/Separador%20-%20Wild.png</center>

<center>This season was dedicated entirely to **Rating Control** to avoid crossing the **3,700**-point threshold into **Champion III**. Consequently, I wrapped up the season with **3,480** points, placing at rank **657** on the leaderboards with a rather low **46.97%** winrate, a direct result of forcing intentional losses to halt win streaks.</center>

><center>Esta temporada fue de control de ranking para evitar subir a los **3,700** puntos y llegar a **Champion III**, por lo que al final de la temporada terminé con **3,480** puntos, llegando a la posición **657** de la leaderboard con un winrate de **46.97%**, bastante bajo por tener que perder varias batallas a propósito para evitar llegar a **Champion III**.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYBXa26JHDjQDiwv5nHsN1ii3E6sJoMckuAwp31HESJ11/Wild%20-%20Season%20160%20V2.png </center>

<center>Following my cyclic strategy, after completing this initial containment phase, it is now time to unleash the offensive phase. Now I can play freely to climb as high as possible, aiming to break into the Top **23** and with some luck, the Top **10** to secure a guaranteed **200,000** Glints. Alternatively, I might sit right at the gates of **Champion III** with **3,680** points to lock down a Top **50** finish in the **Diamond** leaderboard for the next season, ensuring a consistent loop of **50,000** or **100,000** Glints every single cycle.</center>

><center>Como siempre en mi estrategia, después de una temporada de contención como primera fase, ahora toca la otra fase donde sí puedo jugar para intentar subir lo más que pueda, buscando superar el Top **23** y, con algo de suerte, llegar al Top **10** para asegurar **200,000** Glints. O bien, intentar quedarme en la puerta de **Champion III** con **3,680** puntos para buscar quedar en el Top **50** y asegurar **100,000** Glints, para así optar a los premios de la leaderboard de **Diamond** en la próxima temporada y buscar obtener de manera continua **50,000** o **100,000** Glints todas las temporadas.</center>


<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdioiGBmrpUiL7RWt2L2bYgbVmXDXraiTZPWF7k9mzZKU/Separador%20-%20Survival.png</center>

<center>In **Survival**, I finally achieved my goal of completing all **100** required battles to qualify for the leaderboard rewards, landing at spot **104** with **260** points. My winrate was a modest **35%**, which is quite low but proved just enough to capture the **10,000** Glints prize. I must note that while I managed to climb efficiently early on in **Bronze**, subsequent losses triggered a harsh snowball effect. My card pool shrank rapidly with every defeat, to the point where I had to rely on Level **1** **Foundations** Archons to cross the finish line on the final day.</center>

><center>Esta temporada en **Survival** por fin pude completar las **100** batallas para poder entrar en las recompensas de la leaderboard, logrando llegar a la posición **104** con **260** puntos y un winrate de **35%**, lo cual es muy bajo pero lo suficiente para ganar **10,000** Glints. Debo decir que fui capaz de subir bastante en **Bronze**, pero con el pasar de las derrotas se hizo un efecto bola de nieve donde cada vez tenía menos tarjetas, hasta el punto de terminar usando Archons de **Foundations** de Nivel **1** para completar las batallas en el último día.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcANRem32r8wKGfU5Gjtooh2oXcS1qyGfEK8aN16vzts5/Survival%20-%20Season%20160%20V2.png</center>

<center>Now that I have a clearer operational grasp of this mode, I hope to climb much higher this season and claim some reward cards. My plan is to heavily capitalize on the opening days of the season to push as far as possible, then let the cards rest before redeploying them for a second push mid-season.</center>

><center>Espero esta temporada, ya después de probar mejor este modo, ahora sí pueda subir más y obtener alguna de las tarjetas como recompensa. Aprovecharé los primeros días para subir todo lo que pueda, para después dejar descansar las tarjetas y poder volver a usarlas a media temporada.</center>

---

<center>What about you, fellow players? How did Season **160** wrap up for your collections? Did you manage to dodge the snowball effect in the **Survival** format or did you also find yourselves squeezing out wins with low-level cards on the final day? Let me know your strategies in the comments!</center>

><center>¿Y ustedes, jugadores? ¿Cómo cerró la temporada **160** para sus colecciones? ¿Lograron esquivar el efecto bola de nieve en el formato **Survival** o también se vieron obligados a arañar victorias con cartas de bajo nivel en el último día? ¡Déjenme sus estrategias en los comentarios</center>

Here’s how the 12 signs break down across the three categories:

---

**🜁 BODY** — *Instinct, sensation, matter, the physical world*

- **Aries** — pure kinetic force, impulse made flesh
- **Taurus** — sensory pleasure, embodiment, the earth itself
- **Virgo** — the body as instrument, health and refinement
- **Capricorn** — the body as structure, bones and discipline

---

**🜂 MIND** — *Thought, language, pattern, perception*

- **Gemini** — duality, curiosity, the restless intellect
- **Libra** — the mind as mirror, judgment and balance
- **Aquarius** — the mind as vision, abstraction and systems
- **Scorpio** — the penetrating mind, research and obsession

---

**🜄 SOUL** — *Feeling, depth, transcendence, the invisible*

- **Cancer** — emotional memory, the soul’s root and origin
- **Leo** — the soul expressed outward, creative fire and heart
- **Sagittarius** — the soul seeking meaning, faith and horizon
- **Pisces** — the soul dissolving into everything, mysticism and unity

---

A few notes worth mentioning:

- **Scorpio** is placed in Mind rather than Soul deliberately — its energy is investigative and penetrating rather than surrendered or diffuse. It *controls* depth rather than merging with it.
- **Leo** lands in Soul rather than Body because its fuel is *meaning and identity*, not just physical vitality — even though it radiates outward.
- **Virgo** goes to Body over Mind because its orientation is toward *the physical world made right* — healing, craft, the tangible.

Each element is also naturally distributed: Fire splits across all three (Aries/Body, Leo/Soul, Sagittarius/Soul), Earth anchors Body, Air claims Mind, and Water flows into Soul — with Scorpio as the deliberate outlier.

links.title: When the Sea Becomes a Friend
links.body:
Sometimes life takes us to places where there is nothing around us except water. No busy streets, no gatherings of friends, no familiar voices from home. Just the sea... and ourselves.
I once spoke with a sailor who told me:
\

Being away from home for months is not easy. Holidays come and go, birthdays pass, and news of happiness or sorrow reaches you from far away. In those moments, all you can do is stare at your phone screen and wish you were there.
But there is something remarkable about it too.
People who spend their lives at sea learn how to live with loneliness. They find comfort in the sound of the waves. They learn to hear conversations even in silence.
One night, I was watching a video of the ocean. Darkness surrounded everything, and only the waves could be seen. It made me realize that life is very much like the sea. Sometimes calm, sometimes stormy, but always moving forward.
The life of a sailor teaches us an important lesson:
Those who reach their destination are not the ones who have easy journeys. They are the ones who refuse to give up when the journey becomes difficult.
If you are sitting comfortably at home today, spending time with your loved ones, take a moment to remember those who are hundreds of miles away at sea, carrying out their responsibilities.
Every sailor standing in the middle of the ocean is not just steering a ship; he is also guiding his dreams toward their destination.

links.title: Margot's personalities [EN/PT]
links.body:
>

##### <center>(Edited with AI and Canva) </center>

Margot is a dog with a strong personality. She is deeply attached to my girlfriend and, well, she and I are constantly in a love-hate relationship, and of course, the hate comes from her, if you know what I mean. Everything depends on how she is feeling that day. Sometimes affectionate, sometimes frantic and anxious, sometimes pure rage on four legs. It takes a bit of reading between the lines to understand her well and figure out which personality she is in at that exact moment, because she bites. They are bites that do not really hurt, they feel more like her way of saying, \

Most of the day, she follows me around, since I am the one responsible for the food. I am the one she needs to please at times to get what she wants, or at least that seems to be how she thinks when I am in the kitchen. Other times, it depends. Sometimes she just wants her space and does not want anyone bothering her. In others, she asks for affection with nothing in return, just pure affection. There is also her random personality, and some days she is a total drama queen. Eat something near her and do not look at her, pretend she is not there. She cries, sneezes, and even sings! Anything to get attention.

Another side of her personality shows up when my girlfriend is not home. In those moments, she is a completely different dog. She embodies the role of a sad, depressed pup, just staying on the couch, and with every sound of a car on the street, she perks up her ears to listen closely, hoping it is my girlfriend making that noise. I am sure the best news for her is when she finally hears the sound of the key in the gate. Then, from depressed, she turns into a 220-volt dog, running through the house, jumping on everything, and barking at Venus, our other dog, at me, and at the whole world.

Another thing about Margot is her moments of total insanity, which usually happen when I am watching a soccer match. She just goes absolutely crazy, climbing over everything, scratching with her paws, and I know she is in her insane personality not just because of the nonsensical things she does, but because her ears go completely flat and pinned back. It is actually pretty weird. We cannot yell during the game, react to any play, and the TV even has to stay on mute, which forced me to wear headphones to watch the matches. I do not even want to imagine how it will be during the World Cup, which starts next week...

But, anyway, that is Margot, a dog with more than a thousand personalities and someone who, even after four years of living with me, I still have to win over every single day. I have to learn to deal with her moods, her quirks, and her versions of herself, some of which are quite dangerous. Still, as complicated as she may be, she found a very unique way to be part of the family. And maybe it is precisely this mix of chaos, drama, madness, and affection that makes her such a unique and irreplaceable companion.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd9wBjzYRVAHquLGKAKzCVPVkBwZD55u1PgoBTKWcjY6e/image.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPpfkT9mPZGPAJmB169fEKoBKBgbbvVvCFjC8KrpJcHdG/image.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ2kDoq7uYshrdadRqVzYkCrwA5kaKxH36JGmwJJibhXf/image.png)




Margot é uma cadela de personalidade forte, muito apegada à minha namorada e, bem, eu e ela vivemos entre tapas e beijos constantemente e claro, os tapas vem dela, se é que você me entende. Tudo depende de como ela está naquele dia. Às vezes carinhosa, às vezes pirada e ansiosa, às vezes a própria raiva em quatro patas. É necessário um pouco de leitura para entendê-la bem e descobrir em qual personalidade ela está naquele momento, pois ela morde. Mordidas que não machucam de verdade, parecem mais uma forma de dizer: \

Na maior parte do dia, ela está atrás de mim, visto que sou o responsável pela comida. Sou quem ela precisa agradar em algum momentos para conseguir o que quer, ou pelo menos parece ser assim que ela pensa quando estou lá na cozinha. Em outros momentos, depende. Às vezes ela só quer o espaço dela e não quer que ninguém a incomode. Em outras, pede carinho sem nada em troca, apenas carinho. Também existe a personalidade aleatória, e há dias em que ela é uma verdadeira atriz. Coma algo perto dela e não a olhe, finja que ela não está ali. Ela chora, espirra e até canta! Tudo para chamar atenção. Outro ponto de sua personalidade aparece quando minha namorada não está em casa. Nesses momentos, ela é uma cadela totalmente diferente. Encarna o papel da cachorra triste e deprimida, fica apenas no sofá e, a cada barulho de carro na rua, levanta as orelhas para escutar melhor, na esperança de que seja a minha namorada fazendo aquele som. Tenho certeza de que a melhor notícia para ela é quando finalmente escuta o barulho da chave no portão. Então, de deprimida, passa a ser uma cachorra 220 volts, correndo pela casa, subindo em todos os lugares e latindo para a Venus, nossa outra cachorra, para mim e para o mundo inteiro. Outro ponto sobre a Margot são seus momentos de insanidade total, que normalmente acontecem quando estou assistindo a algum jogo de futebol. Ela fica simplesmente maluca, subindo em tudo, arranhando com as patas, e eu sei que ela está em sua personalidade insana não apenas pelas coisas sem sentido que faz, mas porque suas orelhas ficam murchas para trás. É bem esquisito, na verdade. Não podemos gritar na hora do jogo, reagir a qualquer lance, e a televisão ainda precisa ficar no mudo, o que me obrigou a colocar fones de ouvido para assistir às partidas. Nem quero imaginar como será na Copa do Mundo, que começa na próxima semana... Mas, enfim, essa é a Margot, uma cachorra que possui mais de mil personalidades e que, mesmo depois de quatro anos vivendo comigo, ainda preciso conquistar todos os dias. Preciso aprender a lidar com seus humores, suas manias e suas versões, algumas delas bastante perigosas. Ainda assim, por mais complicada que seja, ela encontrou um jeito muito particular de fazer parte da família. E talvez seja justamente essa mistura de caos, drama, loucura e carinho que faz dela uma companhia tão única e impossível de substituir.

links.title: NO PEACE NO LIFE: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN THE WORLD 🌍 GOES QUIET
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdseRRbbEgzZiV3CYZezpdehgFkzm7eZXoX8C5AFcXHZv/1780420258505.jpg)


The words at the bottom are brutal: \

. 
Not a question. A statement. A fact written in wet concrete.

   1. When Peace Leaves, What Remains?
Look at the picture. Rain falls but no one runs. Neon lights glow but no one walks. 
A hooded figure holds a torn teddy bear in the middle of a street. 
The street is not empty by accident. It is empty because noise became too loud.

No peace means: 
1. Time stops moving: Days become repeats. Morning looks like night. Night looks like morning. Nothing changes because nothing is safe enough to change.
2. Sounds turn to echoes: Laughter sounds like warning. Silence sounds like danger. Every footstep is a threat.
3. Things lose their name: Food is just survival. Love is just risk. A teddy bear is not a toy anymore. It is weight. It is memory. It is something too heavy to drop.

       2. Life Without Peace Is Not Life
It is breathing without air. It is watching lights but feeling darkness. 
Red light says \

. But in the picture, both lights are on and no one moves. 

When peace is gone, choices disappear. 
There is no \

.

The rain in the picture does not clean. It blurs. It makes everything look the same - pain, building, shadow, teddy bear. All one color. All one temperature.

     3. The Truth Hidden in Neon
But look closer. The neon is still on. 
Red and green still reflect on the water. 
Even in \
, light refuses to turn off completely.\n\nMaybe \
is not the end of the sentence. \nMaybe it is the middle. \nMaybe the next line, unwritten, says: \

Question for  you readers:
If the world went quiet tonight - no peace, no noise, no movement - what 1 thing would still glow like that neon? 
What 1 thing refuses to die even when everything else does? 

Drop it below 👇 Let’s map the lights in the dark together.

links.title: Emeka And The Chronicles Of Burial Rice
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNfsmqtevHbzpSX6Ek7jidEbFv4RkkCQA8VmPqqW3p7FZ/1780420061308.png)[Generated using OpenAI](openai.com)
Emeka wasn't a man of remarkable stature. His size was what the local man would describe as \

. In fact, one time the village drunk had said that Chukwu Okike's (our creator's) true intention was to create him a dwarf, but he changed his mind halfway. His head sat on his neck like a big ball of watermelon on a stake. He had this small belly that always pressed against his Ankara shirt. You would always wonder if his tailor had never taken his measurements before cutting his clothes. He was that kind of man whose eyes you passed over without stopping. 

Every morning he would trek long distances to the Local Government secretariat, where he worked. Stamping forms nobody truly reads. 

His wife, Ngozi, was just the opposite of him in stature. She was a well-built, tall, beautiful woman whose skin glowed like the sun. Everyone admired her beauty and wondered how Emeka had managed to capture such a goddess. Apart from her physique her character was nothing to write home about. She was that troublesome neighbor who found fault with everything. They had two kids, Nkechi and Obinna, king and queen of mischief, who, at first glance, you'd notice that they had stopped hoping for much.

Except for their father who always hoped for rice. Not the regular homemade rice that tasted like an afterthought Ngọzi always prepared in wide iron pots set over firewood in their backyard, smoke working its way into every grain, stirring with her wrapper knotted at her chest, sweat at her temples, the sharp warm smell of crayfish and stockfish climbing into the air like sacrifice to the heavens. 

But the ones cooked at Burial. It had changed something in him. Every time he tasted burial rice it made Emeka feel whole. Briefly, completely, undeniably whole.

Emeka was nineteen years old when he attended his first burial. That day he thought there was something special in the taste of the rice. He had given accolades to the caterer, but not until he attended a few other burials. Somehow he thought to himself that it was the agony in such moments that added that special taste to the food. From that day, he hunted for the burials of people he knew and even total strangers. He would hunt for obituary posters on electric poles, note the date and address, and arrive with a composed face and a very empty stomach.

Nobody challenged him or asked who he was. In Umueze, you don't interrogate a man's grief.

But by 2022, his cravings for burial rice increased while the number of deaths in Umueze decreased. It was as if the elderly were clinging on. The young showed no interest in leaving. Between funerals, 

\

He had thought in his mind one day. With a heavy weight lodged behind his ribs, heavy and patient and very wrong. Not the kind of thought a man should harbour.

 
He turned the idea over in his mind for weeks before he took his first crazy idea.

First was Odogwu,  his neighbour. A big-voiced man who always played Flavour N'abania's songs in his Sienna packed just outside  Emeka's gate every night without an apology.

Emeka had tampered with the brake cable.

The next day the news of Odogwu's death spread like wildfire. He had died on a slope behind the market. The burial was that Saturday. And Emeka was present, to him the rice was outstanding, the tender and generous meat added a different flavor to it all. He ate three plates and wept at the graveside so that people had to hold him down. Little did they know that his tears were for Odogwu but for the rice. For that particular grief of watching something that tasted so good come to an end.

Within eight months four people connected to Emeka had died. Different causes, different locations, different families mourning. 

The people of Umueze thought the gods had sent them bad luck. Their old women shook their heads and blamed it on generational curses. Nobody was able to connect the dots.

Except for somebody in Umuahia State CID, Detective Amara Nwosu. Amara was a compact woman with natural hair and reading glasses she was constantly misplacing. She had a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when a problem refused to open up.

\
She tapped her pen against her teeth as her eyes hovered over the spread files across her desk. \
she leaned closer to the paper \
\n\nHer partner, Corporal Bulus, shook his head. \
She tapped her pen again and picked up a picture. \
She pressed her finger against her face in a burial photograph. \
\n\nBulus took the picture from the get and studied it with squinted eyes. \
\n\nAmara looked at him over the rim of her glasses. She scoffed. \

And just as she said she set the trap at the burial of Chief Ezeudo, a man who had died genuinely, peacefully, at ninety-one, in his own bed. Amara made arrangements with the family. Plain-clothes officers at the gate. She herself wore a black lace blouse and took a seat near the food tent, a plate in front of her, which she had no intention of touching.

Soon Emeka arrived. Black kaftan. His usual attire. Not long after he signed the condolence register with a name that wasn't his, he settled in a seat near the food tent close to Amara and exhaled slowly. Soon came the food in wide trays of rice moving through the crowd 

Amara picked a plate and Emeka rushed one too.

For minutes Amara stirred at the rice on her plate without eating it. Then she sighed loudly enough for Emeka to hear.

Emeka glanced at her.

Then she said quietly. \
\nEmeka's eyes lit up. He turned to look at her properly for the first time. \
Amara said slowly before taking a spoonful. \
She pressed her lips together like she was searching for the right word.\n\n\
Emeka said.\n\nAmara pointed her spoon at him. \

They sat with that for a moment, two strangers bonded by something they couldn't explain. Then Emeka leaned slightly forward, lowering his voice.

\
\nAmara's eyes widened she was a good actress. \
he kissed his fingers.\n\nAmara laughed softly. \
\n\nEmeka laughed. The tension in his shoulders dropped away. \

There was silence. Amara knew she was getting there but just needed that evidence. 

She adjusted herself and turned to face Emeka this time. In a low voice, she said. \

She gave him a sideways glance and shrugged.

Emeka studied her face. His eyes almost popped out of its socket. On his face was that recognition, relief, that reckless comfort of a man who believed he had finally found his kind.
\
he said quietly.\n\nAmara kept her face perfectly still. She was about to hit the jackpot \

Emeka looked around to be sure they were alone before leaning close. Like a confession he had been waiting years for the right ear, he told of Odogwu and the brake cable, of the generator fumes and the ladder. Down to the shallow well. 

All of it. 

He spilled it all. 

Outside, in a white Hilux parked beyond the compound gate, Corporal Bulus pressed his headphones tight and hit record. 
\

He said over the headphones.

Emeka finally relaxed on his chair, looking lighter than he had in years, Amara set her plate down carefully. She reached into the fold of her blouse and produced a small black wallet. She flipped it open.

A badge. A police badge 

Emeka looked at it in disbelief. His eyes moved from her face, back to the badge. 

\
Amara finally said, her voice no longer warm. \

Emeka didn't shout. He didn't run. He only looked once more at the food tent, at the trays, at the rice cooling slowly in the afternoon air. Then stretched forth his arms as Amara handcuffed him and took him out through the compound gate.

\
Bulus mocked from the driver's side as he drove them to the police station. \n\n\
Emeka replied with completely empty eyes.\n

links.title: Why is the Stock Market doing so Well in this Age of Uncertainty...?
links.body:
I had thought that the stock market didn't like uncertainty, however we've recently seeen three major wars break out, energy markets are on edge, growth being slow, and a shaky housing market and yet the stock market keeps climbing.

Usually, when things get messy in the world, investors get nervous. Oil gets expensive, people stop spending, companies hold back, and shares tumble, but not this time around it would seem! 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23tkjcuokXk1odQ5YDFTHBo66wpNT3NshQ4Q7Q8rMZt4RbgzJAPU9Fm6xxcofsqHAzQ7Z.png)


### Markets Living in Their Own World..? 

Investors these days have this deep-set habit of scooping up stocks whenever prices dip.

Possibly this is a knock-on effect from 2008. Ever since the 2008 financial crisis, whenever markets started wobbling, central banks and governments stepped in—slashing rates, pumping out stimulus, making money cheap and easy to borrow. People learned the drops never lasted long.

So, now the markets are wired for optimism. Even lousy news gets spun into an excuse to buy. If growth is weak, well, maybe interest rates are about to get cut. If there’s war, defense stocks jump. Inflation? Companies simply pass on their higher costs. There always seems to be some story for keeping the party going.

### But this may not last...? 

The numbers on the screen may look good, but take a closer look and there’s a lot of strain. 

Governments are buried in debt after the pandemic and all those energy bailouts. Tensions in the world keep ratcheting higher.

But markets act like none of this matters and Finance feels separate from reality. 

And perhaps it is in a way.... with everyone piling money into anything related to AI, convinced it’s the next big thing. Excitement sends prices soaring, more people jump in, and everyone feeds off each other.

We’ve seen stuff like this before—the dot-com bubble, the crypto rush, housing crazes. Markets can go on acting irrational a lot longer than you’d think.

However markets remain bouyant! 

### Why Do Markets Think Nothing Can Go Wrong?

Investors seem to assume, no matter what, central banks or governments won’t let things spiral out of control. So investors take bigger risks, thinking someone else will bail them out if it all backfires. 

This attitude can stoke bubbles and push people to make riskier bets. It’s fine—until something happens that can’t be papered over. When that day comes, confidence can evaporate all at once.

And at some point there's going to be no money left for those bailouts!

links.title: New Jersey’s Road to Recovery: Programs That Transform Lives
links.body:
## Introduction — The Addiction Crisis and the Need for Structured Recovery

New Jersey, like many states in the U.S., has faced a persistent opioid crisis that has reshaped public health priorities over the past decade. Rising overdose rates, synthetic opioid proliferation, and socioeconomic stressors have made addiction treatment a central policy issue rather than a peripheral concern. Recovery is no longer viewed as a short-term intervention but as a continuous process requiring medical, psychological, and community-based support.

What makes the challenge more complex is that addiction does not affect individuals uniformly. It intersects with mental health disorders, unemployment, trauma, and family instability. As a result, recovery systems must be adaptive, offering layered solutions that evolve with patient needs.

### The evolving opioid landscape in New Jersey

New Jersey’s urban centers and suburban regions have both been impacted, though in different ways. Urban areas often struggle with concentrated overdose clusters, while suburban and rural communities face limited treatment access. This uneven distribution of resources has pushed policymakers toward hybrid care models.

### Why recovery systems must be multi-layered

A single treatment method rarely addresses all aspects of addiction. Effective recovery systems integrate medication, therapy, social reintegration, and ongoing monitoring. This comprehensive approach increases long-term success rates and reduces relapse risks.

## Understanding Addiction Recovery in a Modern Context

Modern addiction recovery is not just about abstinence—it is about rebuilding a stable life. Medical science now recognizes addiction as a chronic brain condition requiring sustained care rather than isolated treatment episodes.

### Medical, psychological, and social dimensions of recovery

Medical treatment addresses withdrawal symptoms and brain chemistry. Psychological support focuses on trauma, behavioral triggers, and emotional regulation. Social rehabilitation helps individuals reintegrate into family, work, and community environments. When these three dimensions align, recovery outcomes significantly improve.

### The role of long-term treatment programs

Long-term programs offer structure and accountability. Instead of short detox cycles, patients engage in ongoing therapy, monitored medication use, and peer support. This continuity is especially critical for opioid dependence, where relapse risk remains high even after initial stabilization.

## Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) as a Foundation

Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) has become a cornerstone of opioid recovery strategies. It combines FDA-approved medications with counseling and behavioral therapies to stabilize patients and reduce cravings.

### Methadone and its role in opioid dependence treatment

Methadone remains one of the most widely used medications in opioid recovery. It helps normalize brain function, reduces withdrawal symptoms, and allows individuals to regain stability without the cycle of intoxication and withdrawal. When administered under medical supervision, it becomes a powerful tool for long-term recovery.

### Expanding access through digital healthcare models

Healthcare systems have increasingly adopted digital tools to improve access to MAT programs. Telemedicine platforms now allow consultations, monitoring, and prescription management remotely, reducing barriers for patients who cannot travel regularly to clinics.

In this evolving landscape, [methadone online prescription](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/methadone-medication-assisted-treatment-program/) has emerged as a critical concept, reflecting how regulated digital systems can extend treatment accessibility while maintaining clinical oversight. In carefully controlled environments, this approach helps bridge gaps between patients and healthcare providers, especially in underserved regions.

## The Rise of Digital and Remote Recovery Services

Digital transformation has significantly reshaped healthcare delivery, and addiction treatment is no exception. Virtual platforms now support therapy sessions, medical consultations, and medication management.

### Telehealth and its impact on accessibility

Telehealth eliminates geographical barriers that often prevent individuals from seeking consistent care. For patients in remote or underserved areas of New Jersey, virtual appointments reduce travel time and increase treatment adherence. It also allows clinicians to monitor progress more frequently and adjust treatment plans in real time.

### Reducing stigma through virtual care platforms

Stigma remains one of the most significant barriers to addiction treatment. Many individuals avoid in-person clinics due to fear of judgment or social exposure. Virtual care helps address this issue by providing privacy and discretion, encouraging more people to seek help earlier.

In this evolving ecosystem, [virtual methadone clinic](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/methadone-clinic-near-me/) models are gaining attention as structured digital environments where patients can receive supervised treatment, counseling, and ongoing support without the need for frequent physical visits. These systems are designed to complement, not replace, traditional care, ensuring clinical safety while expanding access.

## Community-Based Recovery Programs in New Jersey

While digital care is expanding, community-based programs remain essential. Local recovery networks provide emotional support, accountability, and practical assistance that technology alone cannot replace.

### Local clinics, outreach centers, and peer support systems

Across New Jersey, community clinics and nonprofit organizations offer counseling, group therapy, and harm reduction services. Peer support groups, often led by individuals in recovery, play a powerful role in motivating long-term behavioral change. These shared experiences create trust and reduce isolation.

### Integration of housing and employment support

Stable housing and employment are critical determinants of recovery success. Many programs now integrate job training, resume workshops, and transitional housing support. By addressing socioeconomic barriers, these initiatives reduce relapse risk and promote independence.

## Evidence-Based Policy and National Standards

Recovery programs in New Jersey are shaped by both state initiatives and federal guidelines. Evidence-based policy ensures that treatment methods are grounded in scientific research rather than anecdotal approaches.

### Federal guidelines and treatment frameworks

National frameworks emphasize medication-assisted treatment, behavioral therapy, and continuity of care. These guidelines help standardize treatment quality across states and ensure that patients receive consistent care regardless of location.

### External reference integration (authoritative source)

According to the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA), effective opioid treatment programs must combine medication, counseling, and psychosocial support to improve outcomes and reduce relapse rates. Their national guidance highlights the importance of accessibility, regulatory oversight, and patient-centered care.
[ SAMHSA Opioid Treatment Programs Overview](https://www.samhsa.gov/medications-substance-use-disorders)

This framework reinforces the importance of integrating medical and behavioral interventions within structured recovery systems.

## Challenges in Recovery Implementation

Despite progress, significant challenges remain in delivering consistent recovery services across New Jersey.

### Barriers such as stigma, cost, and access gaps

Stigma continues to discourage individuals from seeking treatment. Financial constraints and insurance limitations further restrict access. Even when services are available, awareness gaps prevent many from utilizing them effectively.

### Rural vs urban disparities in New Jersey

Urban centers often have multiple treatment facilities, while rural regions may have limited or no nearby services. This imbalance creates unequal recovery opportunities and highlights the need for mobile and digital healthcare solutions.

## The Future of Recovery in New Jersey

The future of addiction recovery is likely to be shaped by a blend of technology, policy reform, and community engagement. No single solution will be sufficient on its own.

### Technology, policy innovation, and holistic care models

Artificial intelligence, remote monitoring, and digital health platforms are expected to enhance treatment personalization. Policy reforms may also expand insurance coverage for long-term recovery services, making care more accessible.

### Expanding sustainable long-term recovery ecosystems

Sustainable recovery requires integration between healthcare providers, community organizations, and government agencies. When these systems work together, they create a continuum of care that supports individuals from crisis intervention to full reintegration.

## Conclusion — A System Built on Access and Continuity

New Jersey’s approach to addiction recovery reflects a broader national shift toward integrated, patient-centered care. The combination of medical treatment, digital innovation, and community support is transforming how recovery is understood and delivered.

While challenges remain, the direction is clear: recovery systems must be accessible, adaptable, and sustained over time. With continued investment and coordination, New Jersey’s recovery landscape can evolve into a model that not only treats addiction but also restores lives with dignity and stability.

---

links.title: Come With Us to the Great Outdoors (ENG-ESP)
links.body:
The balmy weather is finally upon us, and together as a family, we have been soaking up as much as possible 🌞 Please, won't you join us on yesterday's adventure? 🙏
------------------

----------------

*¡Por fin llegó el clima cálido y, en familia, lo hemos disfrutado al máximo! 🌞 ¿Te animas a acompañarnos en la aventura de ayer? 🙏*
------------------

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUsw8NfwUY9ewY5vvDSiAqoY3qb46yBAYj42b7RnTeS78/1780414931568.jpg)

The day began quite pleasantly -- the sun was beaming down, and a soft wind embraced us everywhere we went. The girls wanted to go to a park (no surprise there! 😂), so we figured a quick trip was in order. 

-------------

***El día empezó de maravilla: el sol brillaba con fuerza y ​​una suave brisa nos acariciaba allá donde íbamos. Las chicas querían ir a un parque (¡para nada sorprendente! 😂), así que pensamos que una escapada rápida sería lo ideal.***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTc3XTJ75WUhirNZbDxq5E3p8i7aoa6MEoAUd5wmCoR3d/1780414931621.jpg)

Our girls LOVE the parks; we've been taking them ever since they were both first born. 

--------------

***A nuestras hijas les ENCANTAN los parques; las llevamos desde que nacieron.***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR2BZGrCEqttXy3RQauKdwDqKm6LMUREkFL4TEaQn6iX7/1780417246292.jpg) **(Baby Riley at about 2-months-old)**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVBPDB7F66iGNPUHAvTok9zuVmFQACp3ieH4BaZ6mD3wN/1780414931677.jpg) **(Riley yesterday 😂)**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW3jQxKpLLbfzjhBw9owE3oxv9MMshvuck1Gpd9mYf8SA/1780414931730.jpg)

They had a great time 🥰 As of late, the girls have been having great luck making friends their age, but unfortunately no one was there this time. 

Well, unfortunately, for the girls -- it was fortunate for us parents! 😂
--------------------

--------------------

***¡Se lo pasaron genial! 🥰 Últimamente, las chicas han tenido mucha suerte haciendo amigas de su edad, pero lamentablemente esta vez no había nadie.***

*Bueno, para su desgracia, ¡fue una suerte para nosotros, los padres! 😂*
---------------------

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTQ5wDU2KswSJqrZqdCijY1WMzkLw7FaCw2nDPVsKvwf1/1780414931786.jpg)

Regardless, the girls had a wonderful time 😁 Riley, our youngest, will be 3-years-old soon, but she is developing so fast. It took her awhile to learn climbing ladders, etc. 

------------------

***De todas formas, las niñas se lo pasaron de maravilla 😁 Riley, la más pequeña, pronto cumplirá 3 años, pero está creciendo muy rápido. Le costó un poco aprender a subir escaleras, etc.***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmen9nTfmjc9BsngkEoNaJS3Dbmj8KzbtJHmA3kXPW9ofH/1780415014901.jpg)

Shortly after the park, clouds started rolling in. However, we still took a chance and decided to venture out onto the trail next. I saw these lovely flowers blooming; these are called *Lavana Camara,* or *Havana Full Moon.* I wonder if anyone here may know of this variety. 

-------------------

***Poco después de salir del parque, empezaron a aparecer nubes. Sin embargo, nos arriesgamos y decidimos continuar por el sendero. Vi unas flores preciosas en plena floración; se llaman Lavana Camara o Lavana Full Moon. Me pregunto si alguien aquí conoce esta variedad.***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZE1hzT45JLoNSWxLDeBhWE2aFayJWd4UK9q6HCSmLG8X/1780415014955.jpg)

We also came across some beautiful lilies 🥺 Lilies hold a special place in my heart; my affection for them inspired our oldest daughter's name! 😄 These are beautiful *Fata Morgana Lilies.*

-----------------

***También encontramos unos lirios preciosos 🥺 Los lirios ocupan un lugar especial en mi corazón; ¡mi cariño por ellos inspiró el nombre de nuestra hija mayor! 😄 Estos son unos hermosos lirios Fata Morgana.***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNUf4kdTqpbCdScGbzRzLSHBRcBVKfsGYaeHxs9wwAuL/1780415015090.jpg)

But the red lilies are perhaps my favorite 😍 These are known as *Red Asiatic Lilies.*
---------------------

------------------

*Pero los lirios rojos son quizás mis favoritos 😍 Se les conoce como lirios rojos asiáticos.*
----------------------

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNcbbv5Jhzr4bABrq7UiF8Mgw68dNCe8jRtprbe1T87KX/1780415015234.jpg)

I took a picture at the girls' favorite perch. It's a little platform that overlooks the street down below. Anytime we approach it, both girls make it their life's mission to climb on top of it 😄 This time there was some graffiti done on the wall, which I thought provided a unique vibe to the photo...

-------------------

***Tomé una foto en el lugar favorito de las niñas. Es una pequeña plataforma con vista a la calle. Cada vez que nos acercamos, se proponen subirse a ella como misión de vida 😄 Esta vez había un grafiti en la pared, lo que le dio un toque único a la foto...***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVveWnf28mm2XHXiiLxUb6rK5YSpDoshJSGDBsdAAQtLj/1780415015381.jpg)

(I caught sight of this sticker on top of an injection needles box/dr*gs. Given the context, I thought this was quite fitting! 😂)

-------------------

***(Vi esta pegatina encima de una caja de agujas de inyección/medicamentos. Dado el contexto, ¡me pareció bastante apropiada! 😂)***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXMrwfiGzGCwkMGaimjJRgZtv1jyzatDDSBSnXfni6cTi/1780415067951.jpg) **(The picture reads, \

)**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfEVWjno8LvfLiZGLxXR3u8bRRce1W5mUUexjKAtmtMSb/1780415068125.jpg)

Along the trail, it started to rain a bit. However, it was no skin off our backs, for we were looking for bugs and salamanders anyway! 😂 Worms love the moist weather, and salamanders love worms, so everything worked out!

----------------

***En el camino empezó a llover un poco. Pero no nos importó, ¡porque de todas formas estábamos buscando insectos y salamandras! 😂 A los gusanos les encanta la humedad, y a las salamandras les encantan los gusanos, ¡así que todo salió bien!***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcVm2drbKoxt5EuFrGaXJKA123gSn7iS8hxvkvi6Fabv9/1780415068348.jpg)

Thankfully, the girls were able to find some lizards. Our oldest used to be terrified of crawling critters when she was a babe, but now she is starting to take it upon herself to pick them up with her fingers!

-------------------

***Por suerte, las niñas lograron encontrar algunas lagartijas. Nuestra hija mayor, cuando era bebé, le tenía pánico a los bichos que se arrastraban, ¡pero ahora está empezando a cogerlos con los dedos!***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme4dhtPiVwUChZLdK7avPAeUQo7FS2jEaunirPb97tw8W/1780415252426.jpg)

They also found... a caterpillar! 😄 This is a *Confused Haploa Moth Caterpillar.* Some caterpillars here can be poisonous, or irritate skin with their rough barbs, but this species is okay 👍 We let the girls take it home for the night, and we are going to release him today 🙏

-------------------

***También encontraron... ¡una oruga! 😄 Se trata de una oruga de la polilla Haploa confusa. Algunas orugas de esta zona pueden ser venenosas o irritar la piel con sus púas ásperas, pero esta especie no causa ningún problema 👍 Dejamos que las chicas se la llevaran a casa por la noche y hoy la vamos a liberar 🙏***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVEMCECz5Prd1jjF8EVqJ4x3M5zXUsHUFyFftidDsJoxF/1780415068591.jpg)

It is fascinating to watch the girls at this age, and see my younger self reflected in them. I used to love scavenging for bugs when I was a little girl. In fact, I was also fortunate enough to have collected caterpillars during my youth. This helps me remember that it is what parenting is all about...
-------------------

------------------

*Es fascinante observar a las niñas a esta edad y ver reflejada en ellas a mi yo de niña. De pequeña me encantaba buscar insectos. De hecho, tuve la suerte de coleccionar orugas durante mi juventud. Esto me recuerda que de eso se trata la crianza de los hijos...*
----------------------

links.title: A little rest and a new beer
links.body:
Maybe I drank too much beer but I don't know if I've written here. I think this is the first or second time.
I came home from work today, the temperature was a high of 27 with a few more clouds. With a light breeze, it was perfect for gardening. Since I'm a passionate gardener, I already had plans for what I was going to do when I got home.
![20260602_171352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/244xwqABS7vvxFLBDEhgR1YzBR7Y9yJQEBfg4vdHtLMbYYWkXMuNWUdjDY8eZFpGos4AZ.jpg)


But my wife was waiting for me with coffee and beer.
She knows I like to have a beer after work. But I had work waiting for me.
Then she told me it is a holiday, among our Orthodox Christians. A saint who is written in red letters in the church calendar. In the people we call it \

, also known as Spirits and Pentecost. This is actually considered the birthday of the Christian church.
Since it's a holiday, we've postponed all the major work, all I have left to do is turn on the irrigation system later.

My wife knows what beer I drink, it's King of the Jungle. She says I grow a beard and look like a lion, lol
It's Lion beer, that's what it's called here.

But she also knows that I always like to try a \
beer.\nActually, a beer I haven't had before.\nIt's \

, I thought it was Italian
That's how it sounded to me, but it's from our country, from Zaječar.

![20260602_171359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/242YDtqoUEJQCBG7SEXZyZzK1ZFte7MnCqPhxVb5T7aNhb5u44xn5aWd22umQGbR8r67D.jpg)

The beer is nice and drinkable but somehow \
, for me I like stronger beers and dark beers.\nMaybe it's a consequence of consuming \
, so if something doesn't burn then we're weak \

,
But since black beer is rarely drunk in my environment, I know it's not about that.

Every day like this is good for me, as soon as the weather is nice I'm working 24/7, I don't have much time
So I can't wait for rain or a holiday to rest a little, recharge my batteries and spend some time with my wife and son.
And I'm writing this post slowly and leisurely with a beer. Vacation is meant to be enjoyed.
![20260602_180742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23uFMBEft5WctrLkvLbXsV64zdvWgubizTNRaxSMS98cUZyXdp8LZYGhU5LBat9nQ2Liu.jpg)

---

Thanks for reading.
Until next time.
Stay healthy.
Markone85.

---

links.title: Camina despacio y con calma [Es-En] Walk slowly and calmly
links.body:
<center>
## Faros y obeliscos

En el reino de lo posible
Conquistar imposibles
Esperar lo mejor, mientras te preparas para lo peor.
O esperar lo peor y celebrar que no sucedió.

Entre la fe y la esperanza, la realidad terca
Mula coceando el aguijón.
Al que tiene se le dará. 
Y al que no, aun lo poco le quitará.

Tropiezan los sabios con el orgullo
Los ignorantes con la codicia

En medio del camino, más casi al final.
¿Cuál será la piedra de mi tropezar?

</center>
<div class=text-justify>

Ayer salí a caminar y, en el apuro por aprovechar las horas de menos frío, se me olvidó el teléfono. 
No fui tan lejos, pero como en horas de la mañana también salí, calculo que sumé suficiente ejercicio. Dormí temprano y me levanté tarde, para lo que es mi costumbre.  
Lo considero un progreso en mis hábitos cotidianos. Tomé café y la pastilla de la tensión con un suplemento nutricional para sentarme a mirar algo de lo que esté pasando más allá de mi nariz. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWTGqm7epHeYERQHGiTbc17pqujfzrxjUcP2GwiZCucom/image.png)[Jabón de glicerina iluminado con linterna]

Luego de algunas lecturas, se me ocurrió escribir las primeras líneas. Y hablando de faros les comparto la imagen de este jabón, en que logré una buena transparencia, pero no la que esperaba. Al menos en todo lo demás se comporta como debe: Excelente suavidad, acondicionado y espuma abundante, pero ligera. Ideal para enjuagarse con rapidez.

Luego, buscando una foto más para amenizar la publicación, me encontré con esta de un nuevo local en una avenida cercana, que bien puede ser una señal.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTPB3EYBHdrUgKaBfcyQHictpBhjSyoKNLc3QGsdD5MoF/image.png)

Bufé libre, comida lista para almorzar o llevar, vendida por peso, donde el cliente elige, se sirve y paga a razón de unos 15 dólares por kilo. 

Bo Xantar, del gallego buen comer, imagino que es el origen del nombre, sin duda con el mismo origen que yantar en español o castellano, que hoy ha caído en desuso y se considera arcaico para referirse al acto de comer, en especial al mediodía que definimos como almorzar. (tengo que ver qué galimatías armará el traductor con esta explicación).

Una tarea de exploración personal. A la luz de las virtudes y pecados que enumeran los teólogos, ¿qué tan acertado es el propio proceder?

### Fe, esperanza y caridad, más prudencia, justicia, fortaleza y templanza contra ira, gula, soberbia, lujuria, pereza, envidia y avaricia.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ6ff9osFdX6u6jGcRerTPYmS8YbRBgdKRP4eHYu5hz76/image.png)
Otra reflexión escrita en español, traducida mediante Google Traductor, acompañada de fotografías tomadas durante mis frecuentes caminatas.

Gracias por acompañarme. Paz y bienestar, o que Dios te bendiga.

### Ahora en inglés / Now in English:

#  Walk slowly and calmly.

<center>
## Lighthouses and Obelisks

In the realm of the possible
Conquering the impossible
Hoping for the best, while preparing for the worst.

Or expecting the worst and celebrating that it didn't happen.

Between faith and hope, stubborn reality
A mule kicking at the goad.

To those who have, more will be given.

And from those who don't, even the little will be taken away.

The wise stumble over pride
The ignorant over greed

In the middle of the road, but almost at the end.

What will be the stone that makes me stumble?

</center>

Yesterday I went for a walk and, in my haste to take advantage of the warmer hours, I forgot my phone.

I didn't go very far, but since I also went out in the morning, I reckon I got enough exercise. I went to bed early and got up late, which is unusual for me.

I consider it progress in my daily habits. I had coffee and my blood pressure pill with a nutritional supplement so I could sit and observe what was happening beyond my immediate surroundings.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWTGqm7epHeYERQHGiTbc17pqujfzrxjUcP2GwiZCucom/image.png)[Glycerin soap illuminated by a flashlight]

After some reading, I decided to write the first few lines. And speaking of lighthouses, I'm sharing this image of the soap, in which I managed to get a good level of transparency, but not the one I was hoping for. At least in every other aspect, it performs as it should: excellent softness, conditioning, and abundant, yet light, lather. Ideal for rinsing quickly.

Then, looking for another photo to liven up the post, I came across this one of a new shop on a nearby avenue, which could very well be a sign.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTPB3EYBHdrUgKaBfcyQHictpBhjSyoKNLc3QGsdD5MoF/image.png)

All-you-can-eat buffet, ready-made lunch or takeaway food, sold by weight, where the customer chooses, serves themselves, and pays at a rate of about $15 per kilo.

Bo Xantar, from the Galician \
(good eating), I imagine is the origin of the name, undoubtedly with the same origin as \

in Spanish, which has now fallen into disuse and is considered archaic to refer to the act of eating, especially at midday, which we define as lunchtime. (I have to see what kind of gibberish the translator will create with this explanation). A task of personal exploration. In light of the virtues and sins enumerated by theologians, how appropriate is one's own behavior? Faith, hope, and charity, plus prudence, justice, fortitude, and temperance against anger, gluttony, pride, lust, sloth, envy, and greed. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ6ff9osFdX6u6jGcRerTPYmS8YbRBgdKRP4eHYu5hz76/image.png) Another reflection written in Spanish, translated using Google Translate, accompanied by photographs taken during my frequent walks. Thank you for joining me. Peace and well-being, or may God bless you. P.S.: There is a noticeable improvement in Google translations, undoubtedly a result of applying AI. >P.D.: Se aprecia una notable mejora en las traducciones de Google, sin duda resultado de aplicar la IA.

A lot of plot points were also altered, like when Paula left Lucas after he was shot because he begged her to leave since her life was at risk—and how this massively affected her. The trauma Paula carried from that moment, having to abandon someone she cared about while he was bleeding and dying, was deeply explored in the novel. In the manhwa, they completely watered down her guilt, her nightmares, and how that event psychologically broke her. They also highly watered down Paula's past and trauma in general. This is why a lot of people find her hiding her looks from Vincent kind of overexaggerated—because without the full context of her trauma, her actions seem irrational.

In the novel, even Joly was her own character. In the manhwa, they cut a lot of her dialogue and her relationship with Violet. Ethan's trauma was also handled horribly. The romance is also worse in the manhwa. Take the reunion scene in ch 92 : they made Vincent kinda pushy, when in the novel he was cautious and respected her boundaries He was so sweet and understanding. He literally asked her permission to touch her before approaching her. I hate that the manhwa made him into this pushy ML kind of trope, when he is completely different in the novel. like This is not my Vincent. They completely butchered his character and his development . The scene was emotional in the novel. In the manhwa, he was kinda cold. the scene in the novel was handled way better than the manhwa. And also, they made him kind of stupid in the chapters before , when he is highly intelligent in the novel. I think that's because they deleted and altered a lot of his moments. Oh yeah, and they deleted a lot of sweet moments between Paula and Vincent The connection between them vincent yearning , him being hurt because she lied to him how much he trusted her and how much they mean to each other were not given justice in the manhwa like the raw deep emotions at their reunion that the novel exploded so much were so flat in the manhwa

And finally, what's also sad is the art decline because of the horrible schedule the artists are faced with. skip season 2 read the novel

---

En
Pour cette 172e édition du concours de LandscapePhotography de @photofeed, je propose ici une photographie de drone depuis l'île de Mayotte. La vue est prise depuis les hauteurs de l'île de Petite Terre et du lac Dziani. Petite Terre est la dernière née de l'île de Mayotte. Comme le reste de Mayotte, elle est d'origine volcanique et c'est ici que le volcanisme de l'île a eu lieu pour la dernière fois il y a de cela... longtemps, huit millions d'années pour être exact ! Petite Terrea grandi depuis le rejet de lave de quatre cratère dont La Vigie, Moya et Papani. Le 4e est en photo ici, le Dziani. Admirez ici le platier corallien frangeant tout autour du cratère, le cratère lui-même et la couleur de l'eau de son lac riche en sulfures. Si le volcanisme est arrêté sur l'île même de Petite Terre, la zone reste encore active puisqu'un volcan sous-marin grandit chaque mois un peu plus à environ 25kms à l'Est de l'île par plusieurs centaines de mètres de fond. Peut-être la 6e île de l'archipel...!
For this 172nd edition of the @photofeed LandscapePhotography contest, I am offering here a drone photograph from the island of Mayotte. The view is taken from the heights of Petite Terre Island and Lake Dziani. Petite Terre is the latest addition to the island of Mayotte. Like the rest of Mayotte, it is of volcanic origin and it was here that the island’s volcanism took place for the last time... a long time ago, eight million years to be exact! Petite Terrea grew up from the lava discharge of four craters including La Vigie, Moya, and Papani. The 4th is pictured here, the Dziani. Admire here the coral reef fringing all around the crater, the crater itself and the color of the water of its lake rich in sulfides. If volcanism is stopped on the island of Petite Terre itself, the area still remains active since a submarine volcano grows each month a little more about 25kms east of the island by several hundred meters deep. Maybe the 6th island of the archipelago...!

links.body:
Greetings!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPk7KR9uGjpj56gg9PVZQYrU2AkttFFnDBZ2eh9kMq2AS/1780419259097.jpg)

One of the greatest things that must be done by a person to achieve greatness in life is to guard one's heart and not only that, but also to stay focused, which means, one must know where one is going as this would help such a person to be able to avoid distraction in life.

If there's anyone that can be easily convinced out of his or her path or way, then such a person would be easily distracted and this if not care would hinder the success of such a person in life as happened to me while growing up.

Although, while growing up or let me say when I was a kid, there were many things in terms of job or profession which I had dreamt of. The first was that I wanted to become a soldier as I loved the military job with so much passion, not just because of anything, but because of the prestige that's being accorded to the job. Although there was the aspect of life saving there which was the main anchor on which the military was based, but as for me, I have neglected the main purpose of the job and cherished only the prestige.

I would have gone for it at the early stage of my life, but for the fear of guns and being killed in battle, I couldn't proceed.

However, other than that, I have always loved to be an investor, most especially when I was of age as I have done my research on how I can invest on land and be a realtor or a land speculator.

It's my research that took me to a street brother who was into the business. When I got to bro. Yomi, I asked him saying,

“Bro Yomi, can I start this kind of business?” When he heard this he smiled and said, “Sam, this our business is good and lucrative as well, but one thing is that you must get capital and mind,” he replied. “Okay, I know that capital, but what does having a mind have to do with your business?” I asked. “Guy, you must get a strong mind so that you will be able to face the numerous challenges associated with our business and so as not to be scammed.” He said. “Can you for a little while put me through?” I asked. “There's no problem about that, whenever you are ready. I'm available for you,” he replied. “I will get in touch with you as soon as possible sir,” I replied.

After a few weeks of our discussion, I went back to bro. Yomi started learning about the rudiment of his real estate business and it's on getting there that I got to know what he meant about huge capital business and getting mind. 

When I got there, I realised that the business cannot be done with small capital as the prices of lands and properties have gone up, so, huge amount of money is really required for the business.

Aside from this, I also realised that if one is not strong in the mind, then the person would just be chased out of the business with ease without him achieving anything in the business.

Having seen how things were being done in the business, I decided to be strong in mind and look for capital to start my own business with after my learning process with bro. Yomi.

Although with the little money I have with me, I have invested it with bro. Yomi company, but since the money wouldn't be enough to start my own firm at the end of the day, I decided to consult people. Out of those I consulted was a good friend of mine, Eben.

I called him and narrated everything to him saying,

“Eben, I have just found out about the real estate business and I saw it's a lucrative business that needs enough capital.” “Yeah, it needs enough capital as I have a friend doing it,” he replied. “Okay, I don't even know you have a friend doing it,” I said. “I have a friend doing it,” he replied. “What do you want me to do for you, Sam?” he asked. “Thank you, I need capital to start the business, can you please be of assistance to me?” I asked. “There's no problem about that, only that I have a better option to that which you have brought before me today,” he said.

It's at this point that he began to tell me about his own piggery business. He told me that I didn't really need a huge capital to start the business other than a small token. When I heard this I was so elated as his sugar coated mouth really did the magic in me.

After he had told me about how the business is being run, I decided to give it a trial and I called bro. Yomi helped me sell the properties I have with him. He was at first reluctant to sell it until I promised to re-invest the money as soon as possible.

After bro. Yomi has sent me the money, I went to Eben who helped me to put the pen in place and got the pigs to get out there. He also taught me some techniques and how to run the business. I thanked him for helping me with the idea even though he had not helped me with money.

However, a few months after I had started the farm, there's an outbreak of swine flu and this flu affected all my pigs and that's how I lost all the pigs and the investment. It's kind of painful to me as I thought I would have stuck to what my mind told me to do rather than what I was convinced to do by a friend. Although, the same flu affected Eben's pigs too but not as much as my own. It's then that I realised that what works for A might not actually work for B.

I'm now back to bro. Yomi’s company and I'm  starting my dream business all over again and this time around, I will not allow any form of distraction.

Thanks for reading.

Picture sourced from metaAi.

links.title: SEQUELS - ABSTRACT PHOTOGRAPHY & DIGITAL TRANSFORMATIONS
links.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AK9SkKAmYEsBLpa4J1gNTwsfuZJWPzxc2fLLNkgad4Y56yRjzw2AU82SMghKMBX.jpg)

----

**I**'ve continued to invest time in digitally transforming some of my recent abstract photographs, most of which were taken on the metal posts supporting the fences of a more or less abandoned sports complex in my town. The photographs I'm sharing with you today, along with their \

as I like to call them, are part of a series of photographs taken around the same time as those in this previous post [(CLICK HERE)](https://peakd.com/hive-158694/@jlinaresp/surfaces-abstract-photography-and-digital-transformations). But this time, I allowed myself some additional creative license and, let's say, \

with the transformations, to the point where some of the digitally altered images are quite different from the visual concept of the originals. But today I felt like doing just that: creating even further than what I'd seen and letting myself be guided by what I intuited in each original photo...\n\n>**H**e seguido invirtiendo ciertas cantidades de tiempo en transformar digitalmente algunas de mis recientes fotografías abstractas, hechas la mayoría de ellas sobre la superficie de postes metálicos que sostienen las rejas de un complejo deportivo más o menos abandonado en mi pueblo. Las fotografías que estoy compartiendo hoy con ustedes, junto con sus \

, como me gusta llamarlas, forman parte de un conjunto de fotografías hechas en la misma fecha que las de esta publicación anterior [(CLICK AQUÍ)](https://peakd.com/hive-158694/@jlinaresp/surfaces-abstract-photography-and-digital-transformations); pero esta vez me permití cierta licencia creativa adicional y, digamos que, \

en las transformaciones, llegando al punto en el que algunas de las imágenes alteradas digitalmente distan bastante del concepto visual de las originales. Pero hoy sentí ganas de eso: de crear más lejos aún de lo visto y dejarme llevar por lo intuido en cada foto original...

----

![T01cats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/Ep7ySdM35YjCvA9txxaPVd1Ti8uYSGuqcV51jK1z5abwEXZrpnA78Crx7LwRw3J131S.jpg)
**📷 01 - \

.. ** ---- **A**s you can see, the original photos are on the left of each diptych, and the transformed ones are on the right. As always, I used various transformation tools without a specific method. I simply use what seems necessary to make each photo look like what it evokes in my mind when I look at it. I use liquify brushes, swirls, oil texture, polar coordinates, image segmentation and overlay, radial and zoom distortions, inversions, and things like that... And today, as always, I've also brought you the transformed photos in monochrome for you to enjoy below... **C**omo pueden ver, las fotos originales están a la izquierda de cada díptico y las transformadas a la derecha. Como siempre, usé diversas herramientas de transformación sin tener un método específico. Simplemente uso lo que me parece necesario para ligar hacer ver cada foto como lo que esta trae a mi cabeza al mirarla. Uso brochas de licuado, remolinos, texturización de oleo, coordenada polares, segmentación y superposición de imagen, distorsiones radiales y de zoom, inversiones y cosas así... Y hoy como siempre, también les traje las fotos transformadas en monocromático para que las disfruten a continuación... ----- ![VT01C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23u69hZoxfKGkmy2df3qKXQHEYpe7uodGRu8YaAMriAukVH2VMp8Pok79G8qs7ErnvcQV.jpg) ![VT02C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23w32FDZXTK8i27rrc4wLTpTKZXmLtLvqYqA14HYh9uVDZbwvCbzEAiEkvpg8RR7dNrv7.jpg) ![VT03C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/242DVGHQrM5mHTmdYipMaXGQ6QtuGmgNBMZXQmb4NmqRTF1GJDH45mLzQVuVKe1NsJbP5.jpg) ![VT04C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xAi5HgbhYyA31HeHUku9pQU5Cpvz4cAuAXCS8NCvNr2wf1woGE3ZPn4rPEmeVjE3sUt.jpg) ![VT05C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xVPJMvu2TNypdECHFgriZFfz5QKmHTvt6G2xuWGpuFjmvRpyGub6c6kXg4cjWASLo7h.jpg) ![VT06C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tcCPZoEjhNkuHaQZ4yKCrh2RoNXy1pHuGNvUMbvRUJehb5519iw6VspNrHAPrj4hHn5.jpg) ![VT07C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23uFcbM6V86yofBn8ZxAvqqRTjMMfhoGdvPR2h428V2M1nmRo5x1WgSk6GoR5XBLhH816.jpg) ![VT08C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23viAKqowGbBzrcrcXheTASBPQxuaTgR1gDCvGZ2uoGstqtuXxXiL4iznUftutD7Le9Y6.jpg) ![VT09C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tvgqQwFArxwS6zV6TT6sh48TUvSD5rQioxcRikUFhnAtvwMcCx67QT5aB8qYcEURXmr.jpg) ![VT10C.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23ydCSi9hxsHhMcUSv3LDPRJ83FDDYTsoPsm8cPnmtcZzTwvGdE1PNo8Tt2xrCS2raeVL.jpg) ----- ##

links.title: How my dogs  live
links.body:
![IMG_2740.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVDEr1XTgDiUD9Lp4dVTkzSR8pfFdKtCpUQ7R8hDSsT11/IMG_2740.jpeg)

I'm coming back from work completely exhausted. Yes, I have to admit that I don't have the easiest life now... I have a dog. They are the embodiment of relaxation, calmness and confidence in the future. I've already said more than once that I envy them. In general, despite the overpopulation in my house, they settled down quite well. And it seems that they are quite happy with life.

My neighbor called me today to tell me about another orphaned dog. I haven't made a final decision yet. We must understand that establishing a balance in my house is a very difficult task. And when I succeed, it reminds me of a miracle. But now the situation is not very stable and the appearance of another dog can trigger unpredictable processes.

On the other hand, I feel very sorry for her. It's a small dog and it will be difficult for it to survive on the street. I'll think about it tomorrow.
