links.title: Büsum
links.body:
Eine geile Teamveranstaltung hatten wir die Tage - dieses Mal auf Büsum.

![IMG_20260518_164032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/23wMguJ73RxYBcowWghoRSr9eRfzKiMnhwWK5pCxg5GFfk3jgvsCj8tPWHjXLRgzt7ZBY.jpg)

Da wir ein versprengter Haufen sind, setzt Cheffe etwa zweimal im Jahr ein Team-Meeting an. Der Veranstaltungsort geht immer reihum, damit jeder mal mehr, mal weniger zu fahren hat. Dieses Mal ging es nach Büsum hoch im Norden.

![IMG_20260518_164709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/EpvivnZ1iRw8UFijJQPwgKWc2sYdKWXZ9wxvZatY1GQHaMg4ofdxF7HE4pSyjVHXcHi.jpg)

Grund ist neben der Begrüßung zweier neuer Kollegen die Verabschiedung eines Büsumer Kollegen in den Ruhestand.

![IMG_20260518_170758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/23zkpF5ULNvqQMxsZp6BBeUsALZeRfzsqNXVxK5te4KRTP48U8DqsDpf4asLrLdvpeUEZ.jpg)

Gleich am ersten Nachmittag haben wir eine kleine Stadtführung bekommen. Selbst über so unscheinbare Orte gibt es am Ende ja immer auch die ein oder andere spannende Geschichte zu bestaunen.

![IMG_20260518_173252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/EqQP1DEAHdrzL4yAXyj73zYgKqCv2ueePDaShYhHEdyroX6woPAsDVsoGL3Uf7BKUFH.jpg) 

So war die alte Dorfkirche von 1492 ein kleines Highlight. Unglaublich, dass dieses Gebäude mit seinen Holzdecken schon über 500 Jahre steht. War recht bedächtige Stimmung, als es während unseres Führung auch hinein ging.

![IMG_20260518_173359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/EoGwWeTtYcUP6LdE6vh5JUFjevhm29Qje9HkVyRr1GQMEpRq6zuAyfF8JAivT91EppR.jpg)

Das bronzene Taufbecken soll noch älter sein, da es der Überlieferung nach aus Pellworm geraubt wurde. Es wird mit etwa 1300 angegeben.

![IMG_20260518_174506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/23vhww719V8FAg1J9ZLuHr1CciMtqaGHqz56gssuVBbD2d9EW1TLyLeYV87kHP5aE3zWG.jpg)

Aus dieser Zeit stammt auch dieser alte Schrein, damit die ältesten Stücke hier im Ort überhaupt. Gefertigt für die Ewigkeit sozusagen.

![IMG_20260518_174516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/23uFKEtsoJXyt8FDyLB4ocw8p9JsS2itkxqnzjjQfheUACCWoPKzw6c1T3Vt7XihP4JJG.jpg)

Den Klotz hier kennt man bestimmt. Das Hochhaus von 1972, Teil eines großen Bauprojekt, dass nie in Gänze realisiert wurde. Nun sind dort Eigentumswohnungen drin und wird eher als Schandfleck angesehen. Immerhin: Laut Wikipedia das höchste Gebäude an der Nordseeküste überhaupt.

![IMG_20260519_220856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/23z6dbteE7FrNq2TTjcXfJgexGmJ2L2ptZgvfoeSbDzYZATcxxqnkh5jkrDo1YwBdDSQU.jpg)

Das hier war übrigens auch ein Foto wert. Die Bretterbude, unser Hotel war mega geil und urig eingerichtet, und was Ihr hier sehr, ist die Örtlichkeit im Keller. So manches Mal aufgesucht, bringt man den goldenen Saft am Ende wieder dorthin, wo es herkommt: In diese zu Urinalen umgebauten Bierfässer.

![IMG_20260519_232518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnboywalton/23yTdBEV7YnhthibCHTjzohCZvixfiXK5xzoZY5ZCeem68SWzJsoCizZ7TUSbc6tFhiCw.jpg)

Kann die Bretterbude nur empfehlen, mega nett die ganze Mannschaft dort!

So, nun wünsche ich eine schöne Zeit und wer hat: ein schönes langes Wochenende!

links.title: Homemade Fry Bread
links.body:
Learn how to make amazing homemade **[fry bread](https://www.inthekitchenwithmatt.com/indian-fry-bread)**. This is an authentic American Indian (Navajo) fry bread. It is simple to make and tastes amazing. You can serve them plain or sweet with honey, powdered sugar, fruit sauce, etc. OR as a Navajo taco with beans, meat, cheese, lettuce, tomato, etc. 

**Ingredients**
- 2 cups of all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp of salt
- 1 Tbsp of baking powder
- 2 Tbsp of shortening, oil, or lard (optional, usually just flour, salt, baking powder, and water are used)
- 3/4 to 1 cup of water. Start with 3/4 cup.
- Oil shortening, or lard for frying (vegetable, canola, coconut, avocado, etc.)

links.title: Before the Storm / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdVzFuEC5t543VW1wAGtHmffDUzmAdq3pZZ9RdbJ293mQ/_7505939_copia.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *
Hello hivers.

Just a few days ago I spent some time on Havana's Malecón and, as I usually do whenever I go there, I took the opportunity to make some photographs. At this time of year, afternoon storms are quite common, and they often create spectacular scenery. Those massive storm clouds make it look as if something huge is approaching, although most of the time it ends up being just a brief downpour.

Today I would like to share some of the photos I took that day. The power of the sky, the sea, and the city came together to create scenes that I found truly impressive. I hope you enjoy them as much as I enjoyed photographing them.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQFrd3x9ZpQfxYKogPFscEL456wupBv2525ujA4MYLRaA/_7505944_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPNXHD5nQ4LuqBnCy2rzx7sB5zoEBVEqovkg2XSz1Xv5R/_7505951_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXXdRnt1PkFvEr52k3Gt3ZhC9TakrieSqkDAPTvXtwqBK/_7505955_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW42VyH9x1UyabfTfQNt24756rnaLjZGn1egYeXb4FueL/_7505958_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaoSBF9Xurs7sP9F9BBWmHKH46cbVjHMWjcw3vQnoezXz/_7505968_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPUxWWXwSdbzmMh3a5DxFUox3LxNYLyCJg2ZPvTsTo1qt/_7505973_copia.jpg)

Saludos hivers.

Hace apenas unos días pasé un rato por el Malecón habanero y, como casi siempre que voy, aproveché para hacer algunas fotografías. En esta época son frecuentes las tormentas por las tardes y eso convierte el paisaje en algo realmente especial. Esas enormes nubes oscuras hacen parecer que algo grande se acerca, aunque la mayoría de las veces todo termina en un simple aguacero.

Hoy quiero compartir algunas de las imágenes que capturé ese día. La fuerza del cielo, el mar y la ciudad se combinaron para regalar escenas que me parecieron impresionantes. Espero que las disfruten tanto como yo disfruté fotografiándolas.


* * *

links.title: MLB:  Enfriados en el desierto  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
links.body:
Si me preguntaran ¿Cuales equipos son dependientes de la conexión entre peloteros venezolanos, quienes los mantienen en la pelea por un cupo en la postemporada? Respondería sin dudar la existencia de 3 equipos ¿A qué conjuntos me refiero? Medias Rojas de Boston, Cerveceros de Milwaukee y los Diamondbacks de Arizona. Y sí, hay otros equipos con venezolanos, pero no tienen la influencia en los resultados concedida a quienes pertenecen a los mencionados. Comencemos con Boston. Sí, están en el sótano del este de la Americana, pero apenas a 3 juegos del último comodín de la liga. Y usted puede achacar los problemas del equipo a quien desee, pero jamás a los venezolanos. Wilyer Abreu, Willson Contreras, Andruw Monasterios, Carlos Narváez y Ranger Suárez han tenido temporadas sobre el promedio respecto a sus compañeros. Así las cosas, cuando el resto despierte, los patirrojos podrían meterse en la postemporada con un regreso de película. Todavía se encuentran a tiempo de reaccionar. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     If you ask me which squads are piggybacking on their Venezuelan connection to stay in the postseason hunt, I wouldn’t hesitate to name three ballclubs. Which teams am I talking about? The Boston Red Sox, Milwaukee Brewers, and Arizona Diamondbacks. And yeah, other teams have Venezuelans on their rosters, but they don’t carry the same weight or move the needle like the guys on these three clubs. Let’s start with Boston. Sure, they are currently sitting in the cellar of the AL East, but they are just three games back of the final Wild Card spot. And you can point fingers at whoever you want for the team's struggles, but you definitely can't blame the Venezuelan contingent. Wilyer Abreu, Willson Contreras, Andruw Monasterios, Carlos Narváez, and Ranger Suárez have all been putting up above-average numbers compared to the rest of the clubhouse. The way things stand, once the rest of the lineup wakes up, the BoSox could easily crash the postseason party with a cinematic comeback. They still have plenty of time to turn things around.

# ---

![Eduardo Rodríguez.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23xyV8nmtibZtLvuZdJrY19AVkee3VmjSVnqHNrwfYimacR4HRVqL7Y5Dao7k7EXFy5v3.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/dodgers-vs-d-backs/2026/06/01/825078/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     El caso de Arizona es relativo, pero no por eso deja de ser interesante ¿Quien cargó con el equipo a inicios de temporada? Ildemaro Vargas ¿Quien estabiliza al cuerpo de pitcheo, además de contribuir a la ofensiva? Gabriel Moreno ¿Quien se ha convertido en el as inesperado de la rotación? Eduardo Rodríguez, quien ayer volvió a brillar, tirando 6 IP, 5 H, 1 CL, 1 BB y 3 SO, para dejar en una carrera a los ¡Dodgers! ¿Quien ha sido la sorpresa más agradable de la temporada dentro del roster? El novato José Fernández, quien tiene un físico parecido al \

y una presencia en el plato que intimida. En fin, los ofidios tiene en su poder el tercer comodín de la postemporada en éste momento y mucho le deben al contingente criollo dentro de sus filas ¿Hasta donde llegarán? Una de las cosas sobre la cual nos equivocamos en las predicciones de inicio de año fue el segundo lugar de los Gigantes. Pues no, los Padres están allí y los \

les respiran en la espalda a medio juego. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      The Arizona situation is relative, but that doesn't make it any less intriguing. Who carried the squad on his back early in the season? Ildemaro Vargas. Who anchors the pitching staff while staying hot at the dish? Gabriel Moreno. Who has turned into the unexpected ace of the rotation? Eduardo Rodríguez, who shoved again yesterday, tossing 6 frames of 5-hit, 1-run ball with a walk and 3 punchouts to lock down the mighty Dodgers. Who’s been the most pleasant surprise on the active roster this year? The rookie José Fernández, who’s built like \

and commands total respect with his intimidating presence in the batter's box. Bottom line, the D-backs are currently holding onto the final Wild Card spot, and they owe a ton of that success to their Venezuelan contingent. How far can this ballclub go? One of the things we whiffed on in our preseason predictions was picking the Giants for second place. No dice; the Padres are sitting there right now, and the Snakes are breathing down their necks just a half-game back.

# ---

![Chourio.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23wMSDevFX6kSAejKW4bj3DGtnBC6Q3Z5Gw42ZUkTxVb5AqM7VrMG7cCvMQpTky52bJeJ.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/giants-vs-brewers/2026/06/01/823781/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Los Cerveceros de Milwaukee están ocupando el liderato de la división central de la liga Nacional. El equipo es un ejemplo de balance perfecto de ofensiva y pitcheo. La manera sobre haber dejado la dependencia del jonrón ocupando el 27mo. lugar en la lista de cuadrangulares de las mayores, es objeto de estudio dentro de los demás conjuntos ¿La razón? Pelota \

Y mucha de ella ha sido favorecida por el juego de los venezolanos, quienes demostraron en el World Baseball Classic la capacidad de ganar juegos y fabricar carreras sin depender de los cuadrangulares. Claro, ayer la ofensiva lupulosa estalló con un segundo episodio de 7 carreras, pero ha sido esta una excepción y no la regla de lo que va de campaña. La conexión venezolana produjo 6 de las 16 rayitas anotadas por Milwaukee en el American Family Field. Y ninguna de las 16 fue producto de un jonrón. Así de frugales se han vuelto los Cerveceros. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The Milwaukee Brewers are currently sitting pretty atop the NL Central, serving as a textbook example of a ballclub with a flawless balance of pitching and hitting. The way they’ve kicked their dependency on the long ball—ranking 27th in big league homers—has other front offices taking notes. The secret sauce? \

small ball. A huge chunk of that success stems from their Venezuelan contingent, who already showed the world during the World Baseball Classic how to manufacture runs and grind out wins without relying on the big fly. Granted, yesterday the Brew Crew’s lineup exploded for a 7-run second frame, but that’s been the exception rather than the rule this season. The Venezuelan connection drove in 6 of the 16 runs crossed at American Family Field, and not a single one of those 16 runs came via a dinger. That’s just how disciplined and scrappy the Brewers have become.

---

![Contreras.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23y8xQn3oWw62PyDPh8Yc7tVtfAAc3ewbsL1fa8hsAE3JA4m5WTZMTXbPXcN9gTLF2Dos.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/giants-vs-brewers/2026/06/01/823781/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Una especie de mezcla entre disciplina en el plato y acoso en las bases, hace que los oponentes comentan errores mentales proveedores de carreras. De hecho son el equipo líder de la mayores en forzar rayitas mediante errores con tiros a las bases. Jackson Chourio produjo 3, William Contreras trajo 2 y Luis Rengifo remolcó una, con diferentes situaciones de juego mezcladas: bases por bolas, sacrificios, hits, además de extra bases, fueron partes de un menú ofensivo que juego tras juego ha hecho que los Cerveceros sean un equipo de cuidado. Y lo más loco, es que desde el primer hasta el sexto puesto de la alineación, tienen la capacidad para sacar la pelota del parque. Pero creemos ha sido parte de una estrategi dejar de buscar el batazo fácil y asegurar, más bien, el embasarse. Como quiera que sea, Los Cerveceros marchan raudos a la postemporada, cuando se suponía iban a tener una temporada discreta entregando el puesto a los Cachorros. Craso error. Los lupulosos están de vuelta. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     It’s a mix of plate discipline and chaos on the basepaths that coaxes opponents into mental gaffes and gifts them runs. In fact, they lead the big leagues in forcing runs via throwing errors. Jackson Chourio knocked in 3, William Contreras plated 2, and Luis Rengifo drove in 1 through a mixed bag of game situations: walks, sacrifices, knocks, and extra-base hits were all part of an offensive menu that makes the Brewers a dangerous squad night after night. The craziest part is that from the one-hole down to the six-spot in the lineup, they all have the pop to leave the yard. But it feels like a strategic shift to stop selling out for the easy long ball and focus on just getting on base instead. Either way, the Brew Crew is cruising toward October, even though they were supposed to have a quiet year and hand the keys over to the Cubs. Huge mistake. The sluggers are back.

#

links.title: THE BIRD FESTIVAL.
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQnKgMmvu347oDPEaZxfPM9v2SAVP7a1x22xj2v4qsapE/1780354726985.jpg)

Dear Hivers! 
In previous posts, I've told you about Finquita del Arte (Little Art Farm). It's a space where the arts and agroecology come together. And it's also been discovered that in April and May, it becomes home to many migratory birds. That's why this year they decided to create the bird festival with community participation.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcG6ngXw6tBgGaFdPjMSoALJN4nbeq3FTnxjXJCnCSRJx/1780354773576.jpg)

Last May 9th, La Finquita welcomed children and adults from the community. When I arrived, I went out looking for the person who was already birdwatching. I ran into a mother who had also arrived with her daughter and Mendiola, my fellow painter who leads the La Finquita del Arte collective.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSamcL61WoKxN65uaMvQvCJKPjzVhJWcjYq28HyS7Bw5H/1780354773650.jpg)

Nearby was the group of observers; Laura and Alieny, from the biology faculty of the University of Havana, had already led the children to the areas surrounding the doctor's lagoon.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXzZ6qTLWWo7anbbCKEYRHwWorhWKeVUKgXhdTJgT9W6M/1780354773715.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmawZV1x3qMM8BNnnxAcedmq7YVntaVkJq6YnXshy6Bibw/1780354773767.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU853Qf3XV738aCxLUMpoTh3gQdBFNEFZewpHqGSNqCnM/1780354773822.jpg)

It was a morning of discovering the birds that inhabit the area and others that visit seasonally. The teachers showed us how to distinguish them by their colors and songs. The tropical sun was very strong and bright, which is why the photos I took with my cell phone show excessive light.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNsKN1K9uGYuabVrERw7sX6QTEhL9PeRuT933zDEKbeA/1780354856639.jpg)

Afterwards, we returned to the classroom at the Finquita del Arte. There, a large mural is on display, made with the children's drawings of birds.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaS8eoBrKrhrQtVGn1xWxgFW7AFDJLEoWBx61HbWP6LHq/1780354856687.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYjmyHArjoDk3M3aDrs78UhQSURtWgrweNAyuVQo414eZ/1780354856740.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWEkr6MPwNJ9rs51oy8ko98xgirXvHZsvWrUowNM72VBG/1780354856775.jpg)

The children created beautiful works of art. Very creative and colorful paintings, made with the imagination and fantasy typical of childhood.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRutn1Zp7WqsnemZ6qwJT9ye2nyccSs3eGXXcNQkr2tMf/1780354973834.jpg)

A few days earlier, Mendiola and I decided to make birds out of recycled materials, and I created this owl with things I found scattered around the farm. Now it's part of the classroom decor.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQbxyBDrz6YktLq6dZH1Sbpa3gbHMDCT1BRQGjNnARKwk/1780354973899.jpg)

The parents were waiting in the classroom. The teachers invited the children to do other fun exercises to help them learn more about birds.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmScW4nWqBbkCXo7fniEzAfn9SsaYmGenFt3cJJ91a123s/1780354973954.jpg)

They made drawings of the birds...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma3xRAEFZVrDD2qeQFehpZLf369ujDZDkmN7HDGfoC2kE/1780354973994.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeyP7iymzjpaDRfVaJRrVcp1mJPgBmrzbCCXLiLF7Q5su/1780354974046.jpg)

And they looked for their names on a piece of paper that contained a word search puzzle where they had to find them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSUCybni7wsgYb9iaqCBrRj62xJmibuxCcmHMnXfEhmim/1780355151448.jpg)

Childrens learned about the characteristics of each bird with cards provided by the teachers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMxteMQZ1ApfEC1s3VEWDXJQVh8pXAV3RSWdTETaiSXM/1780355151520.jpg)

Next to the classroom is this little house, available for the birds to use as a home and to shelter their young.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNo47DfGaBuwuyT3qbXF2Ro7QaWPK1zrHcJAUsAUo5Jku/1780355151584.jpg)

It was a day of fun activities, and I think we all learned a lot about birds. They are wonderful, beautiful creatures. Every day I am more amazed to learn about these friends of nature. And I'm sure the children also had an incredible experience that will help them love nature even more.



The text is my own work. The images were taken with my Motog82 cell phone.

links.title: Mobile Phone Photography Contest Round #115 // Amazing Is Simple, Sky, Rice Fields, and Hills
links.body:
----
Sometimes enjoying a view that provides tranquility does not require going far, does not require taking a plane and does not require tracking for hours, but sometimes the moment comes from an ordinary route that provides a view with extraordinary tranquility.
----

![IMG-20260602-WA0133.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTvz5z7SSQmGLV6scZHPp8hKoVsZeX41g8RWYdK3WkA4e/IMG-20260602-WA0133.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Hello, all my friends in this beloved community. I hope you are all healthy and happy, allowing you to carry out your daily activities as usual. I hope you all have a pleasant day.

This time, I'm back in this beloved community, and this blog is my entry in the contest held within this beloved community for round 115.

So, please continue to follow my simple blog to see some of the images I've created with my mobile phone as part of my participation in this contest.

![IMG-20260602-WA0127.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgxVtUtQHmsD5dbbc3aS2gNdYN6zLfQmSJfNrXadZrS5/IMG-20260602-WA0127.jpg)

![IMG-20260602-WA0130.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR7eo3vyWQgpYafaShnekW4JSprTvaytFugRhM85mKokG/IMG-20260602-WA0130.jpg)

![IMG-20260602-WA0131.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ8M3KgVCRE7rHwdHtzV12ZE98QydpikrsTCvXfExaV5k/IMG-20260602-WA0131.jpg)

![IMG-20260602-WA0122.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQnDX7fP8s7CnY84WgjQXwMLh9vWe4AGDwZcVeovA9xoR/IMG-20260602-WA0122.jpg)

![IMG-20260602-WA0126.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdC7ZsyGfmgVFkZuJGRGxJa6yjq7UfC1i3DN3XhLsSwGk/IMG-20260602-WA0126.jpg)

It was late afternoon, and I took a short walk to enjoy the afternoon atmosphere, a habit I often do on weekends.

My friends...
The above are some pictures I took with my cell phone. During this unexpected journey, I saw stretches of freshly harvested rice fields, expansive skies, and the pleasant weather on both sides. This prompted me to take out my phone and capture some images to share with this beloved community as part of my participation in the event.

There's nothing particularly impressive about these pictures, and I'm aware of that, but the view is extraordinary, and the sense of serenity I feel is indescribable.

![IMG-20260602-WA0128.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRz8AMaqVRFQy2Nxz3vd3KTtxdWoHmbHqmES2Dk36v1qx/IMG-20260602-WA0128.jpg)

![IMG-20260602-WA0123.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXxd3uqBkk6SNabqiPiW5Pwz2Q17ts4DLRq2MpxnRCaLe/IMG-20260602-WA0123.jpg)

As I said above, the view I experienced was truly a feast for the eyes. Although this area isn't a tourist destination, that serenity is sometimes born from ordinary moments on unexpected journeys.

My friends...
In the context of this community, it also serves as a reminder that we don't need equipment like a professional photographer; even with a simple cell phone, we can capture the boundless beauty of nature. The images I share here are proof that we can each experience.

![IMG-20260602-WA0129.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNjaPjYAt2mNigyuvN9dLUCzYvCMg7keb4J2PurJnCZGf/IMG-20260602-WA0129.jpg)

![IMG-20260602-WA0124.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdSQUevaU12owHogSq72isjiocWwhfriXTmbzJXD7Jaex/IMG-20260602-WA0124.jpg)

![IMG-20260602-WA0125.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVowt4vpEC3C2aZ87M64cjyrsG93Xxj7YDxx9ZPETKiGD/IMG-20260602-WA0125.jpg)

What made me choose this image for my entry in the contest wasn't just the scenery, but the feeling of the open air, the gentle breeze passing by, and the thick clouds piled above the mountain like a painting. At this moment, I understood why people call it *Hidden Paradise*, a simple place. The road is paved, but once your eyes catch the landscape, it feels like you've discovered something hidden all along.

Well, my friends, those are some of the images and short posts I've written for this blog as my entry for the contest. I hope you all enjoy and are entertained by what I've shared. I also extend my heartfelt thanks to all of you who have taken the time to view and read my blog to the end.

Please leave your comments, support, and input, as they mean a lot to me as I strive to create a better blog in the future.

That's all for now.
Greetings everyone.
See you in my next blog.

links.title: Some Teachers Are Not Professional
links.body: Hi there. In this education post, I would like to point out some ways that some teachers act in a non-professional manner. This is based on my own experiences and some stuff I have heard from students.   ## Swearing --- Swearing is a big no-no. Especially in front of the younger kids. Teachers have to lead by example and just not swear. (Mistakes are okay once in a while.)

>Image Source   ## Inappropriate Touching --- This one is a huge no-no. Leave the kids alone. There are times where you need to touch to get their attention. Somewhere around the hand, forearm or elbow could be okay. If kids get violent, a teacher may need to break up the fighting by stepping in and push the violent kids aside.   ## Mocking Students --- It is generally not good for a teacher to make fun of a student especially if they have a medical condition or disorder. A teacher should encourage not discourage. A teacher should help and not so much criticize. There may be some kids that may not demonstrate a good ability of learning a certain subject at a certain point in time. In a later time, that struggling student can end up being really good. It does happens sometimes. I was a struggling student at one point trying to figure out the best way to manage time, learn information efficiently and effectively. What worked for me was something similar to a Pomodoro technique for time blocking and using the library quiet zones alot for math practice problems. Focus was key to get more done in less time. One of the reasons behind this post was based on a recent student experience my client told me. My student client wanted to be an engineer but the teacher laughed and scoffed at him. I found out later that this teacher teaches too fast and I found a mistake in her marking.

>Image Source   ## Favourtism --- Favourtism may be hidden sometimes or it can displayed more openly. I have heard of cases where a student got a decent grade despite not doing much work. The geography teacher happened to be a track and field coach in high school. This student was a geography student and track and field participant. I've heard he sent a blank cassette tape as his assignment submission and got a B grade. I worked a lot and produced a poster and got something like an A minus. Humans are not perfect and may play favourites in life. When teachers show too much favourtism towards one student versus the others like the one above, then meritocracy goes out the window. Beyond the classroom, favourtism can occur in the workplace, business and politics.

>Image Source   ## Closing Notes --- There are probably other things that make some teachers unprofessional. These include marking tests really late (after two weeks), not teaching, teaching too fast, giving free bonus marks too often. Unfortunately, there are not so good teachers out there. They may not be focused on actually helping out students. Some may do the bare minimum and are in it for the paycheck. On the bright side, there are some good teachers out there that really want to help out their students do well. With some teachers, you can see the passion in how they deliver the information to the next generation.  
Thank you for reading.

Non repaint signals are trading alerts or indicators that do not modify previous buy or sell signals after a candle closes. Unlike repainting indicators, which can change historical data and create misleading results, non repaint indicators display signals that remain fixed once generated.

This makes them highly valuable for traders who want realistic backtesting and trustworthy live trading signals.

Many beginner traders are attracted to indicators that show nearly perfect historical results. However, some of these indicators repaint their signals, making past trades look more accurate than they actually were.

TradingView non repaint signals offer several advantages:

*   Accurate historical performance

Non repaint signals work well for:

Traders can apply these indicators across different timeframes and currency pairs.

Backtesting becomes far more realistic when signals do not repaint. Traders can accurately measure win rates, drawdowns, and profitability before risking real capital.

## Features of a Good Non Repaint Indicator

*   Real-time signal generation

## How to Use Non Repaint Signals Effectively

While non repaint signals can be powerful, they should not be used alone. Combining them with proper market analysis often produces better results.

Consider using:

*   Support and resistance levels

*   Trend analysis

This combination can help filter weak signals and improve overall accuracy.

## Final Thoughts

[TradingView non repaint signals](https://forexwebstore.com/) are among the most trusted tools for forex traders seeking consistent and reliable trading opportunities. Unlike repainting indicators, they provide transparent and stable signals that remain unchanged after generation. This allows traders to backtest accurately, manage risk effectively, and trade with greater confidence.

links.title: The Teacher I'll Never Forget.
links.body:
>

<center>
![pexels-katerina-holmes-5905440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23xeos7PinZszqS336Gjp9oKx2WgXTcJ4K8UNiF4ZmwnqNTBvagf4ozPkhS371ntaGSs4.jpg)
</center>

Good day, people of Hive! Welcome to my blog. Today's topic is from Hive Student Connect which says:**The Teacher/Lecturer I'll Never Forget**. So let's dive in.

When I saw this topic, it made me remember my secondary school days. The one teacher I will never forget is **Mrs. Funmilayo Onaolapo**, my Christian Religious Studies (CRS) teacher.

I first met her during my first day in schol as a new student. From the very first time she entered our classroom, I liked her instantly. The way she dressed was always neat and decent, and she hated seeing girls wear inappropriate clothes such as mini skirts, leaving their shirts unbuttoned, or dressing indecently. She practiced what she taught, and that made many students respect her, including the other teachers.


<hr>


Mrs. Onaolapo was very passionate about teaching. She explained her subject in a way that made it easy to understand and interesting to learn. I was always happy whenever it was Thursday because that was when we had her class from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM. Anytime we noticed that her class was almost coming to an end, we would tell our class captain to meet our next subject teacher, who was the Government teacher, and ask him to spare us 30 minutes of his time so that Mrs. Onaolapo could continue teaching us, since our Government teacher did not always use up all his class time before leaving the classroom.

Mrs. Onaolapo did not only teach us what was written in our CRS textbook; she also taught us valuable life lessons about honesty, discipline, respect, and good character. Every Thursday, we had to come to class with our Bibles because we would all read from the Bible, including her. 

<center>
![pexels-rdne-8419491.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23yJQuoqKxkU4sYYDSzzryFzxJLZBYfN2BFACqUb4AMBdwjKmDzLp58VcqKHNyA9g6nev.jpg)
</center>

I will never forget the day we were writing our WAEC CRS examination. When she saw the questions we were given, she felt they were difficult and included some things she had not taught us. She became worried because she did not know what to do. But we thank God that when our results came out, all of us scored C3. We were very happy, and so was she when we told her our results.



One thing I loved about her was the way she corrected students. Whenever she heard that a student had done something wrong, instead of embarrassing the student publicly, she would call the person aside and talk to them privately like a teacher and a mother. Although she was a little strict, everyone loved her. 

When my uncle told me that Mrs. Onaolapo had passed away, I was shocked and sad. Because she was one of the teachers who truly believed in me. Whenever she saw me in school, she would be like **\

** which was short for Omoyiwola, my surname. **I want you to become successful, and be among the students who will make our school proud.** Each time she said those words, I would just smile at her. In conclusion, I will always be grateful for the lessons she taught me during my secondary school days. **This is my entry for the Hive Student Connect Week 45 New Prompt.** **Thanks for reading💞💞💞💞💞.** **Images generated from Pexels.**

links.title: Desi Masala Pasta - Perfect Lunchbox Recipe..
links.body:
____________________________________
# <center> Namaste 🇮🇳🙏🏻</center>
____________________________________


Hello Friends, How are you all ?? Wishing you all happy and prosperous life Ahead.

Today i would like to share the recipe of **Desi Masala Macroni** Recipe, it is kind of Pasta prepared specifically to the indian taste buds with a combination of spices & Chopped Veggies. It is perfect recipe for breakfast even ideal for Lunch or Tiffin Box for kids. It is quick & Easy recipe with minimal Ingredients, even you can add more veggies and Herbs depending on your Taste, but i have shared the Indian version of pasta, try this recipe, 'm sure you gonna love it for sure. Masala macaroni is a fun pasta that's super easy to make and if you enjoy continental cuisine, you will definitely love it.


![1000688898.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242YGNtVUbFvMCHNPkWhcf7xWnxs3vxxk6duGUGhyjPGtaK16T3LuqCwyWG66kuUazq1Z.jpg)


____________________________________
# <center> Timming 🕡</center>
____________________________________

|Preparation Time| 10 Minutes|
|-|-|
|Cooking Time |20 Minutes|
|Cuisine|Indian|
|Course|Breakfast|
|Serving|2 Person|




____________________________________
# <center> Ingredients 📃</center>
____________________________________

### Cooking pasta


• 2 litre water.
• 1 tbsp salt.
• 2 cup Macroni.


###  Macroni Masala.


• 3 tbsp Cooking oil.
• ½ tbsp of Cumin seeds.
• 2-4 clove chopped garlic.
• 1 Chopped Green chilli.
• 1 Chopped Onion.
• ½ Chopped Capsicum.
• 1 Chopped Tomato.
• 1 tsp chilli powder.
• 1 Sachet of Maggi Masala.
• ½ tsp garam masala
• Salt to taste.

____________________________________
# <center> Process 👨🏻‍🍳</center>
____________________________________


![1000675955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242NmYr3UMxnFMzDabeCKgQ18pyzpQyFDfAwVsmdJnergy8Lpy1nchE5YFvuoR3ptLtzS.jpg)

firstly, in a large pan take water and then add salt.

![1000675946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/245ccZZS7cxzkSw83R9ae9zAX3LebCyHQUbpGVNdVQMBpeBvM9eUgq9177dizvRvK16Wt.jpg)

get the water to a rolling boil. once the water comes to a boil, add Macroni. Keep stirring in between to avoid sticking from bottom.

![1000675950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/2458SKy58xs5UcwAQi7DSjN1ZF3fv7bFRxzDysHqpfvzmUnDzK2o3djLHJs79TUSyqJeE.jpg)

boil for 7-8 minutes or until the pasta is al dente.

![1000675952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wMcbeF6JPdaQ7CNx1WRmCjF6KBryYQfXeLGUP5mRyAHRqeWAY2tbtZhjt8UpUnkseAS.jpg)


drain off the macroni and rinse with cold water to stop from cooking further and remove the Starch. keep aside.
____________________________________



![1000675957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23yJJY9VoX69rCN4KwSLH283iLsGtBp1coQpFc71sn9digN2RHgrRycCbWNDWRYKvc2da.jpg)

To prepare pasta sauce, in a large kadai/pan heat  oil and Cumin seeds, wait untill it starts crackling.

![1000675960.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/2458NeKaDvm42iTrCbRVmw6QnrvBmLRe8fHzkj2VNPf96wxksT2PLTMjxKUiHwVDDsnuC.jpg)


Then add chopped garlic & Green chilli untill it get aromatic.

![1000675951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/243M4pwM4RZ4kcawAYbMGGCW9ynWG3DmtVLGCggteiehNP9jXjAcnbf1ejbvMQMHpKoS2.jpg)

then add chopped onion & Capsicum, untill it get transculent. Don't over cooked the veggies.

Tip : You can add more veggies - Carrot, beams, mushroom etc depending on your choice or availablity at home.

![1000675958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242Y7X4ibAmQzkGRUjKqmtof7QSH4HF4hccnnWs9dRAHoGEqnp9fw6WEELJBpxPWy3B5b.jpg)

Add Chopped Tomatoes, cook it untill it get mashy n Soft.

Tip : if you don't like tomato then instead of adding chopped tomato, add Tomato Puree, cook untill oil start releasing from it's Sides.


![1000688509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xp8dJ23Dd47Nkf3ptbAHv8o9oRTdk13hCVviSeAdaLx4rjRHfu3Btvu8i5JoW6bRxhd.jpg)


keeping the flame on low, add 1 chilli powder, Maggie masala and Garam Masala. Saute on low flame until the spices turn aromatic.

![1000675947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242rwdMKAtdAf4QiPRgzAoMd5HPU53ks9ahemTdfy26EhahoifLhZUSkAZWjvJF1fN9o5.jpg)

now add boiled Macaroni and mix well making sure the spices is well combined with Macroni.

![1000675954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242ruFSmeCEF5mrTF6TSABLS9Zi7mbTtgzkSkLrpUTmCotCMT8nb3MFi1g2AjephcDotC.jpg)

cook it for a another 2 minutes, so that macroni get it's flavours and get warm.

![1000675961.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23uQw2LkNRdysJDkzXFmDw489qh8nPvjajQuWf7EEi8zeWFxRj47Fw924aWkn55YrwQnR.jpg)

Serve the Desi Masala Macroni with your favourite Beverage.


It's Delicious and easy to cook recipe, try it. 'm sure you are gonna love it. Try this recipe and let me know how it is. For more indian cuisine stay connected to my blogs.


**Don't share my posts or pictures in any other platform without my Permission**

links.title: WATERFRONT ADVENTURE
links.body:
![Kopia – Whispers.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xVXYUtBkEjKMFUkgogRNJUv72WgKEHJFS3TF1RLsVwfS1zynRzRfcbbEwENkatykyeY.jpg)

Today I’m coming back with a continuation of photos from my waterfront walk in Oslo. If someone hasn’t seen my first post yet, I’m leaving the link here and I encourage you to check it out:

https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@ladytruckview/nordic-waterfront-architecture

>Dzisiaj wracam do Was z kontynuacją zdjęć z mojego nadbrzeżnego spaceru w Oslo. Jeśli ktoś nie widział jeszcze pierwszego posta z tej serii, zostawiam tutaj link i serdecznie zachęcam do zajrzenia:
>
>https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@ladytruckview/nordic-waterfront-architecture

In my first post I shared photos taken closest to the ferry. Today I’ll show you a few shots captured a bit further along the waterfront.

>W moim pierwszym poście opublikowałam fotki, które były zrobione najbliżej promu. Dzisiaj przedstawię wam kilka zdjęć, które powstały nad wybrzeżem kawałek dalej.


![20260410_102633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xATXsexnxp5etKXtU6PM2KfzUjjzoM58DBBYU8C39uScxpBzc33wdQhFr76WXZ2bnVd.jpg)

![20260410_102555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/245mtiV6KA7dZxq7ZZorgvDSwp7hwqLDSQwBJX4Ntyu2FF8NHYmoJ9FdrzCJ5iGNaSdkH.jpg)

I walked through the **Aker Brygge** district in Oslo, which felt like a very modern and elegant place. It’s hard to believe that for over a hundred years this area was industrial. One of Norway’s most important shipyards, **Akers Mekaniske Verksted**, operated here and ships were built in this very spot until the 1980s. After the shipyard was closed, the entire area was redeveloped and transformed into a place full of restaurants, apartments and marinas. Today it is one of the most popular waterfront areas in all of Oslo.

>Przespacerowałam się po dzielnicy **Aker Brygge** w Oslo, która sprawiała wrażenie miejsca bardzo nowoczesnego i eleganckiego. Aż trudno uwierzyć, że przez ponad sto lat był to teren przemysłowy. Funkcjonowała tu stocznia **Akers Mekaniske Verksted**, jedna z najważniejszych norweskich stoczni, gdzie budowano statki aż do lat osiemdziesiątych XX wieku. Po jej zamknięciu cały obszar został całkowicie przebudowany i przekształcony w miejsce pełne restauracji, apartamentów i marin. Dzisiaj jest to jedno z najpopularniejszych nadbrzeżnych miejsc w całym Oslo.


![20260410_094350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23qrBk2exFxWtsn8oDnZFq4yaAy6ULN5KVWck1F39nKPL5jL9qihFcS4YbHArmCnWwQzX.jpg)

![20260410_102341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/241tQxn32BWMh6Byf4kBu4EBmVgyhvDTYSrisk4KyeEqVdpTYGRCwYW4zoydgHGoYogKA.jpg)

![20260410_102423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243zVHC8si7Zn4me982wcBVNoUJwxFfaDE2yeYoVLNvzQgJgmoyG8EWLd33gNJmNBEPzQ.jpg)

You could notice a very interesting contrast between the brick buildings of the former port area and the modern office and residential buildings. It shows that Oslo does not completely cut itself off from its history – the old structures are still present and coexist naturally with modern architecture.

>Można było zauważyć bardzo ciekawy kontrast pomiędzy ceglanymi budynkami dawnej zabudowy portowej a nowoczesnymi biurowcami i apartamentowcami. Pokazuje to, że Oslo nie odcina się całkowicie od swojej historii – dawne budynki nadal są obecne i harmonijnie współistnieją z nowoczesną zabudową.


![20260410_102136.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23ryxkVZ2DLGo6tSoFHLMJDHxLyAt5bxR3RdcnD76ccq1Aj9wiHJ1r45rjPfcUiEZPDnr.jpg)

![20260410_103328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242rkZhG6qTNFDggyjPmpBUYQFKtWkF95d61pCnECtP6QmYcvU7mainzhYRJTtc8vx9Mu.jpg)

![20260410_103601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242rneCTT4gncyphris8qpaoHmJgtyvATcF3sBk8GcTJ4gf5aDKRAYPVSjrR5CeBEFcUp.jpg)

In my photos I also captured the City Hall, which is one of the most iconic buildings in the city. It stands out from the surrounding architecture mainly due to its monumental form. I also took some closer shots of the building, but I’ll share those with you in a separate post.

>Na moich zdjęciach uwieczniłam również ratusz, który jest jednym z najbardziej charakterystycznych budynków miasta. Wyróżnia się na tle pozostałej zabudowy przede wszystkim swoją monumentalnością. Zdjęcia ratusza zrobiłam także z bliższej odległości, jednak nimi podzielę się z Wami w innym poście.


![20260410_094327.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/245mpYz6rL5kJmk38F8xwg7VGenQCDy8nAd7bF7kJaPKvdS4LpGRUbFnuoGT2nPFmUTyd.jpg)

It was a short walk, just two hours in total. Still, I’m really glad I managed to see at least a part of this wonderful city. I hope that next time I’ll have a chance to explore more of its corners.

>To był krótki, bo zaledwie dwugodzinny spacer. Mimo to bardzo się cieszę, że udało mi się zobaczyć chociaż część tego wspaniałego miasta. Liczę na to, że następnym razem uda mi się poeksplorować również inne jego zakątki.

links.title: The Value of Words
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNW8r6ZFd1ctrKnmHfrRGL3XtXbmKyCoz8gYXH1AtQ2Hw/1780418018211.jpg)


In today's world, many things have become cheap, but one thing is still priceless: a kind way of speaking.

Every day, we speak hundreds of words. Some make people smile, some give hope, and some leave wounds that stay in a person's heart for years.

I had an elder relative who always paused for a few seconds before speaking. As a child, I thought he was simply searching for the right words. One day, he told me:

\

That sentence has stayed with me ever since.

In the age of social media, we often reply too quickly. We post comments in anger. We make fun of someone's mistake. But we forget that there is a real person on the other side of the screen—a person with feelings, emotions, and a heart.

Life has taught me that being intelligent is a good thing, and being successful is also a good thing. But caring about the feelings of others is even more beautiful than both.

People who carefully choose their words are rare. They think before they speak. They consider whether their words might hurt someone. These people may not make the most noise, but they leave behind peace wherever they go.

In my opinion, true beauty is not found in a face but in a person's tone and manners. And real education is not measured by degrees, but by how we treat other people.

May those people always stay blessed who choose their words carefully out of fear that they might hurt someone's heart. They do more than communicate—they protect the feelings of others.

links.title: Capitalizing on Bitcoin's Volatility: Exploring Leveraged Bitcoin ETFs in the Current Market
links.body:
As of early June 2026, Bitcoin is trading in the $67,000–$73,000 range following a significant pullback from its all-time high above $126,000 in October 2025. This correction phase—common in Bitcoin's post-halving cycles—has created a potentially attractive entry point for bullish investors seeking amplified exposure. One increasingly popular way to capitalize on anticipated rebounds is through **leveraged Bitcoin ETFs**, which aim to deliver multiples (typically 2x) of Bitcoin's daily performance.

### What Are Leveraged Bitcoin ETFs?

Leveraged Bitcoin ETFs are exchange-traded funds designed to provide magnified daily returns relative to Bitcoin's spot price or a related index. Popular examples include:

- **ProShares Ultra Bitcoin ETF (BITU)**: Seeks 2x the daily performance of Bitcoin.
- **Volatility Shares 2x Bitcoin Strategy ETF (BITX)**: Another 2x daily target product that has seen strong interest.
- **T-REX 2X Long Bitcoin Daily Target ETF (BTCL)**: Offers similar 2x exposure tailored for active traders.

These funds typically achieve leverage through futures contracts, swaps, or other derivatives rather than holding physical Bitcoin directly (unlike spot ETFs like BlackRock's IBIT). They reset daily, making them tools optimized for short-term trading rather than long-term buy-and-hold strategies.

### The Opportunity in Today's Con juncture

Bitcoin's market is in a consolidation or corrective phase amid broader macro influences, with the 2024 halving's effects still unfolding and the next one not due until 2028. Analysts are divided: some see potential further downside toward $60,000 support levels, while others anticipate recovery toward $90,000+ later in 2026 driven by institutional adoption, ETF inflows, and potential monetary easing.

**Leveraged funds amplify this dynamic.** If Bitcoin rebounds 10% in a strong week, a 2x fund could theoretically deliver around 20% (before fees and decay). This appeals to traders who believe the current dip represents a buying opportunity in Bitcoin's long-term upward trajectory, fueled by growing mainstream acceptance via ETFs and corporate treasuries.

Advantages include:
- **Convenience**: Trade through standard brokerage accounts without needing crypto wallets or exchanges.
- **Amplified Upside**: Magnified gains in bullish moves with less capital deployed.
- **Liquidity**: Many of these ETFs offer reasonable trading volumes compared to direct leveraged crypto positions.

### Critical Risks and Considerations

Leveraged ETFs are not for the faint-hearted and come with substantial risks:

- **Volatility Decay (Beta Slippage)**: Due to daily resets, these funds can lose value over time even if Bitcoin ends flat or trends sideways. Compounding effects erode returns in volatile, non-trending markets.
- **Amplified Losses**: A 10% drop in Bitcoin could mean a ~20% loss in a 2x fund—potentially devastating in sharp corrections.
- **Not for Long-Term Holding**: These are daily-target instruments best suited for tactical, short-term trades. Holding through multi-week swings often leads to underperformance versus the underlying asset.
- **Fees and Expenses**: Higher management fees than unleveraged spot ETFs, plus costs from derivatives.
- **Market and Regulatory Risks**: Bitcoin remains highly speculative, influenced by regulation, macroeconomic shifts, and sentiment. Past performance (e.g., strong gains in earlier bull phases) is no guarantee.

Investors should use these only with risk capital they can afford to lose and consider pairing with stop-loss strategies or limits on portfolio allocation (e.g., no more than 5% in leveraged crypto products).

### Final Thoughts: Proceed with Caution and Strategy

Leveraged Bitcoin ETFs like BITU, BITX, or BTCL offer a sophisticated way to potentially profit from a Bitcoin recovery in the current environment. For informed, active traders who closely monitor the market and have a high risk tolerance, they can be powerful tools to \

of a rebound.

However, they are advanced products unsuitable for most retail investors as core holdings. Proper due diligence, clear exit plans, and diversification remain essential. As always, consult a financial advisor and remember that while the upside can be substantial, so too can the downside in Bitcoin's notoriously volatile world.

links.title: 99.9: Criminal Lawyer, a lawyer series that reminds me a lot of Ace Attorney. —eng/esp
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWbixcrpAQmyjwwANQHYj8DZTbni3tUAw5GqjYSEPJMBZ/1000442173.jpg [_Source_](https://www.justwatch.com/ar/pelicula/99-9-criminal-lawyer-the-movihttps://www.netflix.com/ve/title/82072564?preventIntent=true)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

Buenos días, buenas tardes o buenas noches, damas y caballeros. ¿Cómo están? ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Espero que muy bien. Yo hoy particularmente me encuentro con ánimos suficientes para venirles a hablar de algunos de los dramas que he estado viendo, sobre todo uno que me gustó mucho porque me recordó bastante a Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, una legendaria saga de videojuegos sobre abogados, donde nuestro protagonista solo se centra en buscar la verdad, buscando la más mínima contradicción en el testimonio de los interrogados, todo para obtener el veredicto de inocencia. No sé si el director de esta obra se basó en serio en esa obra pero es que he notado ciertas referencias, además es una serie japonesa y se nota aún más con el especial de casi dos horas debido a algunos aspectos presentados (un manga de un abogado robot pelopincho y la crítica al sistema judicial japonés) pero sigo sin estar seguro. Podría decir que lo único que no me gustó fueron las referencias a luchadores japoneses o el humor sin sentido aunque después se hace querer. Así que sin más dilación, hablemos un poco acerca de 99.9 Criminal Lawyer.

Good morning, good afternoon or good evening, ladies and gentlemen. How are you? How are you feeling today? I hope very well. Today I personally feel sufficiently motivated to come and talk to you about some of the dramas I've been watching, especially one I really liked because it reminded me a lot of Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, a legendary video game saga about lawyers, where our protagonist focuses solely on seeking the truth, looking for the slightest contradiction in the testimony of those being questioned, all to obtain a verdict of innocence. I don't know if the director of this work seriously based it on that game, but I've noticed certain references; besides, it's a Japanese series and it shows even more with the nearly two-hour special due to some aspects presented (a manga about a blow-up robot lawyer and the criticism of the Japanese judicial system), but I'm still not sure. I could say that the only things I didn't like were the references to Japanese wrestlers or the nonsensical humour, although it grows on you afterwards. So without further ado, let's talk a bit about 99.9 Criminal Lawyer.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPtKMLdaMWf2kk2GtpXNCfecX6PNSf3cyJiu6doeNZ3NN/1000442172.webp [_Source_](https://www.disneyplus.com/es-ve)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

La serie nos pone en la piel de Hiroto Miyama, un excéntrico abogado que tiene como finalidad enfrentarse al complicado sistema judicial japonés, donde parece que la fiscalía siempre tiene la razón, provocando que en el 99,9% de los casos el acusado salga declarado culpable aunque haya posibilidades de que sea inocente. Miyama luchará por encontrar la verdad absoluta en ese 0,1%. Sus métodos no serán para nada convencionales, actuará casi como detective yendo a la escena del crimen y a sus alrededores, investigando cualquier mínima cosa que le sea de utilidad; también querrá conocer todos los detalles acerca de su cliente, desde su infancia hasta la actualidad antes de conocer los hechos del caso, e incluso hará recreaciones a gran escala de eventos que le parezcan extraños hasta encontrar alguna contradicción. Muchos le llamarán loco pero su forma de trabajar hará que termine trabajando en una gran firma de abogados, con otros dos compañeros: Sada (un abogado especializado en civil que termina siendo trasladado a penal por órdenes del jefe) y la abogada de la temporada (cada temporada/especial terminan cambiando de compañera; en la primera es una abogada novata aficionada a la lucha libre, en la segunda es una jueza que termina trabajando de abogada y en el especial es una abogada novata que toma a Miyama como maestro), donde los tres deberán trabajar juntos para alcanzar el veredicto de inocencia aunque parezca improbable.

The series puts us in the shoes of Hiroto Miyama, an eccentric lawyer whose goal is to take on the complicated Japanese judicial system, where the prosecution always seems to be right, resulting in 99.9% of defendants being found guilty even when there might be a chance they are innocent. Miyama will fight to find the absolute truth within that 0.1%. His methods are far from conventional; he acts almost like a detective, going to the crime scene and its surroundings, investigating any tiny detail that might be useful. He also wants to know every detail about his client, from their childhood to the present, before learning the facts of the case, and even carries out large-scale recreations of events that seem strange to him until he finds a contradiction. Many will call him crazy, but his way of working means he ends up working at a large law firm, with two other colleagues: Sada (a civil lawyer who ends up transferred to criminal law on the boss's orders) and the female lawyer of the season (each season/special changes the female partner; in the first series she's a rookie lawyer who loves wrestling, in the second she's a judge who ends up working as a lawyer, and in the special she's a rookie lawyer who sees Miyama as her master). The three of them must work together to achieve a not-guilty verdict, even when it seems unlikely.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXGLPHNTXspmaAi5vtDM8dtZUpwrYnQQG9PeMV7z6NJG5/1000442174.jpg [_Source_](https://mubi.com/en/ve/films/99-9-criminal-lawyer-the-movie)
VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL (click aquí)

El formato de la serie es uno que me gusta bastante: cada capítulo es un caso nuevo, pero esto no quiere decir que no esté relacionado, porque aunque sean casos aislados se puede ver cómo se van desarrollando los personajes y cómo avanzan sus tramas, hasta llegar al punto de ellos mismos verse involucrados en juicios, ya sea queriendo defender a un ser querido o limpiar el nombre de sus propios compañeros. Me encanta la dupla de Sada y Miyama, es un buen equipo y se complementan al ser tan contrarios; además, el saludo que hacen al ganar un juicio al final de la serie se vuelve simplemente un gesto icónico. Una lástima es que no se pueda decir lo mismo de las protagonistas femeninas: no puedes tomarle suficiente cariño porque siempre las terminan cambiando, pero sin dudas la aficionada a la lucha libre es de mis favoritas, aunque la excéntrica del especial de 2 horas también es bastante agradable, es como tener dos Miyamas. Creo que podría decir que es una de las mejores series de abogados que he visto, gracias a su similitud con el videojuego que mencioné antes. Tú ves cómo resuelven los casos y a la mente se te viene ese juego, es que es idéntico: cosas mínimas que hacen que el testimonio sea una mentira. Obviamente no todo es perfecto, los chistes que se hacen son intraducibles; el traductor creo que hizo lo que pudo pero quedaba sin sentido alguno, a menos que usaran juegos de palabras. Aún así, es una serie que recomendaría mucho a los aficionados de Ace Attorney o a los aficionados de series de abogados.

The format of the series is one I really like: each episode is a new case, but that doesn't mean they're unrelated, because even though the cases are self-contained, you can see how the characters develop and their storylines progress, even to the point where they themselves become involved in trials, whether trying to defend a loved one or clear their own colleagues' names. I love the pairing of Sada and Miyama; they're a good team and complement each other by being so opposite. Moreover, the greeting they make when winning a case at the end of the series becomes simply an iconic gesture. It's a shame the same can't be said for the female leads: you can't get attached enough to them because they keep changing them, but without a doubt the wrestling fan is one of my favourites, although the eccentric one from the 2-hour special is also quite likeable – it's like having two Miyamas. I think I could say it's one of the best lawyer series I've seen, thanks to its similarity to the video game I mentioned earlier. You watch how they solve the cases and that game comes to mind; it's identical – tiny things that make a testimony a lie. Obviously not everything is perfect; the jokes are untranslatable. I think the translator did what they could, but it ended up making no sense, unless they used puns. Even so, I would highly recommend this series to fans of Ace Attorney or fans of lawyer series.

___

links.title: Schools Matters But Does Not Decides The Future
links.body:
# Hello’s learners and community 🥰

Does the school one attended matter? This is one nice beautiful question prompt commencing the week. And for me I can say yes to this question when we begin to compare some high caliber schools 🏫 to others , especially schools that rings bells 🔔 with their names. But I will also want to point out here that school one attended does not really matter when ones future is being decided.

# Connections:

Many believed that going to higher standard institutions/schools determines what their future will turn out to be due to how institutions are not just a place for only studying 📚 and learning, but a place with many opportunities created through bonding with people from different homes and calibers of people, connecting with friends after leaving school, relationships that might lead to families becoming friends that can bring job opportunities which helps one to navigate life and achieve greater future.

People see schools with names as a place where they can connect faster and have privileges of all kinds . Some think 💭 that they don’t need to struggle after attending a higher standard university/school since alumni 👩‍🎓 can help one another through old students association and schoolmates relationships, so  their reason is not just attending schools because of names and this I think is one big factor that makes school that one attended matters.

# Intelligence A Gift Of Nature:

Intelligence is one thing I see as a big challenge when we are reasoning in the area of if schools 🏫 one attended matters? Knowledge in itself is impacted in the same way in every student 👩‍🎓, so knowledge is the only determinant factor that can decide every graduate future despite that connection is ruining the world 🌍 where man know man has become the other of the day. But still, many who went to a lower standard schools but studied very hard and gained intelligence can become successful just like those who went higher caliber schools. 

Being intelligent has been one thing that many has used to succeed more than those who went to high standard schools because they gained the same knowledge just like them despite some big schools recruiters more qualified lecturers. But its not all the students that went to higher standard schools that are intelligent. This is where we should see that its not the school one attended that matters. 

I have seen many people whose parents spend so much money 💰 on their education because of the school the went to, but after graduation 👩‍🎓 was not able to even secure a good job. Although, this might be due to course of study 📚 or that they were not intelligent enough to be qualified for a better job. At the same time, others who went to a lower class university and did very well were opportune to gain better employment.

# The Technology And AI Era:

Its very obvious in this recent times that school one attended will not matter so much because of the era we are in. But what will definitely matter most is the course of study 📚which decides ones future due to change and what the world 🌍 is currently anticipating. So with many who has gone to many big schools 🏫 and did not study what the world is looking out for now will also struggle if care is not taken despite their connection and alumni 👨‍🎓.

This is why I don’t believe that a school will determine what someone’s future will be. What matters most is going with time and upgrading with the era so that one will not be caught up in obsolete as change is posing a lot of challenges especially in the area of what the future will be. 

In conclusion, the experiences we gained in the past while hoping for the future is still something that will not leave us , wether good or bad, they will continue to be with us.  We just need to continue to look towards a brighter future by putting in our best in areas that can help us achieve a successful ending. Its never late as long as we are holding onto our breath.

body.title: The task of the wise: They cannot expound discipline or judgment, nor are they found among the rulers. Ben Sira 38:33
body.body: The master of wisdom Ben Sira, wrote in his sapiential book on a question already addressed by the philosopher Aristotle in his book Metaphysics, that leadership as such corresponds to the wise man, that is, the doctor of wisdom. And this is so because wisdom, as Saint Thomas also explained, is the most perfect and elevated science of all. Wisdom is the science responsible for directing other sciences towards good and God's plan. For example, through wisdom, the science of medicine fulfills its function of healing, not of serving as a personal business for those who practice medicine. Through wisdom, politics fulfills its function of guiding society toward the common good, and not of becoming a source of profit for politicians. In other words, when men forget the importance of wisdom and wise men as leaders, the society lacks a safety net to prevent its descent into chaos and its own self-destruction. Personal egoisms are extremely destructive, because in that scheme the weakest of society do not matter. This is why the task of the wise person in society is fundamental to its existence and development.\nAnd so the wise Ben Sira began in his book to explain how a society is built through the efforts of artisans, builders, and farmers, because without them, the most basic tasks of a society would not exist. \nBut then Ben Sira explained that there are tasks that are not for ordinary people, and he explained this fact in this way: \

Ben Sira 38:32-33. And these tasks described by the master Ben Sira are the tasks that belong exclusively to the wise.
An example of this in the Bible was King Solomon, who, through the wisdom that God granted him in Gibeon, exercised spiritual leadership throughout Israel, administering justice, educating his people, and making every citizen of his kingdom prosper. Ultimately, wisdom, the science of upright men, is the science that orders and gives direction to a society.

body.title: [Esp/Eng] ✨Lindo organizador de escritorio. // Cute desk organizer.✨
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

###### <center>✨¡Hola amigos amantes de la creatividad! Espero que estén todos bien.✨</center>

<center>¡Buenas tardes, amigos! Espero que estén pasando una excelente semana. Por mi parte, estoy contenta de pasar por acá a compartir una linda idea con ustedes. En esta ocasión les comparto el paso a paso para elaborar un lindo organizador de escritorio. Quise diseñar algo que tuviera que ver con el mar; pensé en un par de peces, pero al final me decidí por otras cositas marinas, jaja, como un lindo faro junto con un ancla y un pequeño barco de madera, además de algunos elementos extra como estrellas de mar y burbujas.</center>

**🔸Sin más que añadir, a continuación los dejo con el paso a paso:**

> ###### <center>✨¡Hello friends who love creativity! I hope you are all well.✨</center>

> <center>Good afternoon, friends! I hope you're having a wonderful week. I'm happy to stop by and share a lovely idea with you. This time, I'm sharing the step-by-step instructions for making a cute desk organizer. I wanted to design something with a sea theme; I thought about a couple of fish, but in the end, I decided on other marine-themed items, haha, like a cute lighthouse with an anchor and a small wooden boat, plus some extra elements like starfish and bubbles.</center>

> **🔸Without more to add, then I leave you with the step by step:**

---

<center>![portada defi.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoCiB7mAo11gTQtV4gZYf3BR3YYCo3rHxxzzzp7z95wx4Ni8NXg5isarVHXA9Kaf3hV.JPG)</center>

---

<div class=\

> **♥️ESPERO QUE TE GUSTE, ¡Empecemos!**
**♥️I HOPE YOU LIKE IT, Let's start!**
---
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> - Caja de bombilla. - Tela del color o diseño deseado. - Foami blanco. - Foami marrón. - Foami amarillo. - Foami rojo. - Foami azul. - Pinturas y marcadores. - Pegamento. - Tijeras. - Regla. - Hoja blanca. - Lápiz.
- Light bulb box. - Fabric in your desired color or design. - White foam. - Brown foam. - Yellow foam. - Red foam. - Blue foam. - Paints and markers. - Glue. - Scissors. - Ruler. - White paper. - Pencil.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 1: Lo primero que debemos hacer es lo de siempre, amigos, jaja, que es tomar nuestra hoja blanca y dejar volar nuestra imaginación, para dibujar el diseño que más nos guste, que en mi caso, como ya dije, era temática marina, así que pensé en un faro que ocuparía la mayor parte de la decoración y a los lados otros elementos de menor tamaño que serían un ancla y un barco de madera, junto con un par de estrellas extras y burbujas para dar más ambiente. Al estar lista la idea, es momento de transferir a los colores correspondientes de foami, como explico a continuación: ✨Estructura del faro: 8 cm x 3.5 cm en foami blanco. ✨Parte superior del faro: 1.7 cm x 1 cm en foami rojo. ✨Ventanillas: 1.5 cm x 1 cm en foami amarillo. ✨Listones de madera: 3 cm x 0.5 mm en foami marrón. ✨Puerta: 1.2 cm en foami marrón. ✨Ancla: 3 cm x 2.5 cm en foami azul. ✨Barco: 3 cm x 2.7 cm en foami marrón. ✨Velas: 2 cm x 1 cm en foami azul. ✨Estrellas: 1.5 cm en foami amarillo. ✨Burbujas: 1.3 cm, 0.7 mm y 0.5 cm en foami azul.

> ###### ✨STEP 1: The first thing we need to do is the usual, friends, haha, which is to take our blank sheet of paper and let our imaginations run wild, to draw the design we like best. In my case, as I already mentioned, it was a marine theme, so I thought of a lighthouse that would take up most of the decoration, and on the sides, other smaller elements like an anchor and a wooden boat, along with a couple of extra stars and bubbles to add more atmosphere. Once the idea is ready, it's time to transfer it to the corresponding colors of foam, as I explain below: ✨Lighthouse structure: 8 cm x 3.5 cm in white foam. ✨Top of the lighthouse: 1.7 cm x 1 cm in red foam. ✨Windows: 1.5 cm x 1 cm in yellow foam. ✨Wooden slats: 3 cm x 0.5 mm in brown foam. ✨Door: 1.2 cm in brown foam. ✨Anchor: 3 cm x 2.5 cm in blue foam. ✨Boat: 3 cm x 2.7 cm in brown foam. ✨Sails: 2 cm x 1 cm in blue foam. ✨Stars: 1.5 cm in yellow foam. ✨Bubbles: 1.3 cm, 0.7 mm, and 0.5 cm in blue foam.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260521_094028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EogSC75GHMXfqY2vS6wfdagDoW7pBB43WmqXyst5jPR2unwaGaT262jAeZ9WYgcnkoP.jpg)|![IMG_20260521_094152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoK7imbKrriL7XKRr8HS4NQBPVp3oFFWJPGfEvJxnEPAop31EwpPr7dGyhFmaiJbWSx.jpg)|![IMG_20260521_094152.jpg](image-3-IMG_20260521_094152.jpg)| |-|-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 2: Al estar todas las piezas recortadas, es momento de dar color a los bordes con pinturas y marcadores que hagan contraste; en este caso utilicé para algunas piezas colores más oscuros que el tono original y para otras, como el caso del barco, la estructura del faro y las maderas en general, un color negro.

> ###### ✨STEP 2: Once all the pieces are cut out, it's time to color the edges with contrasting paints and markers. In this case, I used darker colors than the original tone for some pieces and black for others, such as the boat, the lighthouse structure, and the wood in general.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260521_100647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoKAdHuRi33CA6gvbxQAb73Jeq8kyAiiuqW5BcZqGqM71fWuoaXNViPq6JhDs3555mF.jpg)|![IMG_20260521_100810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EogSbTaMLWNQbuj1gd5fp344cNMvn1MZo3aW3Y16xwSxw7oBBLTTS1zHNxyn6VX9r56.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 3: Al estar secas las piezas, es momento de dibujar los detalles importantes para definir mucho mejor cada una de las piezas, como serían las franjas rojas en la estructura del faro, las ventanillas, la parte superior que viene siendo una cúpula; la definí mucho mejor, al igual que las maderas del faro y el barco. Además, di detalles al ancho, a las velas del árbol y a las burbujas. Luego, vamos a pegar las piezas, hasta formar el faro y el barco, para ver el acabado final de estas decoraciones.

> ###### ✨STEP 3: Once the pieces are dry, it's time to draw the important details to better define each piece, such as the red stripes on the lighthouse structure, the windows, and the top part, which is a dome. I defined it much more clearly, as well as the wood of the lighthouse and the boat. I also added details to the width, the tree's sails, and the bubbles. Next, we'll glue the pieces together to form the lighthouse and the ship, so we can see the final look of these decorations.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260521_102749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eoc9UDEQxXnikoSWCcnBR62Y3ykrP4wzYx1vA5drY4pTdZU2e5pcmHGDoimBbsuedQg.jpg)|![IMG_20260521_102828.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoEsPoNexd7VaPBY6q2sGTLpe8AgsPLueL9BrYgYKH826mT9YkNDRWXHqmm6mSL1SiU.jpg)| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)

> ###### ✨PASO 4: Ahora sí, vamos con la base del organizador, así que tomamos nuestra caja de bombillo, que en este caso las medidas eran de 12 cm x 8 cm, pero yo le corté el largo, dejándolo a 9.5 cm. Ahora, tomamos la tela con el color y diseño deseado y recortamos 1 cm más grande que la caja de cada lado, pegamos hasta cubrir todas las paredes y la parte superior la pegamos a la parte interna de la caja. Además, pegamos la decoración en el orden deseado a una de las paredes de la caja.

> ###### ✨STEP 4: Now, let's make the base of the organizer. We'll take our light bulb box, which in this case measured 12 cm x 8 cm, but I cut it to 9.5 cm. Next, we'll take the fabric in the desired color and design and cut it 1 cm larger than the box on each side. We'll glue it down to cover all the walls, and then glue the top piece to the inside of the box. Finally, we'll glue the decorations in the desired order to one of the box walls.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
|![IMG_20260521_104835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EokezVTva22XBGYFXmubX4eSSr8eWiG6d9bB3Zo29pCo6uJ5pBJE3PzPQYNobq1dLCQ.jpg)|![IMG_20260521_105548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eoke8WGR7Lc1wGiMPAPer9YKgfxTrJqzL53h1g2v4BEgiiXaYqVURZx84os6eBF8cLs.jpg)|![IMG_20260521_105950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Ep1Xursd5Z5so5o4ViB8sYVufaaxpLyAGbdUT6jcz1zk21gvPdakjR8zd7ah5Ko26Qp.jpg)| |-|-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
||| |-|-|
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
✨Y listo, amigos, así es como pueden elaborar sus organizadores de escritorio de una forma bastante fácil, rápida y reciclando algunos materiales. Espero que les haya gustado el paso a paso y se animen a elaborarlo.
❤️Hasta la próxima publicación.
>
✨And that's it, friends! That's how you can make your own desk organizers in a very easy and quick way, while recycling some materials. I hope you enjoyed the step-by-step instructions and are inspired to make one yourself.
>
❤️Until the next post.
![separador 2023.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23uFnpKyJ7meMSyw1pqmfQu94TYy7tCuEmTPQy9gugnkC5oXaC7gcejs3b2EPAGmUMGRT.PNG)
