body.title: Cycling Down the Baja - Inadvertent Break in the Sierra de San Pedro Mártir
body.body:
After my adventure on the **Playa Calavera**, I decided to avoid dirt roads from now on, at least on this trip. So I took it as a welcome sign when I heard that the road into the **San Pedro Mártir** mountains was paved. There was a place I really wanted to visit, after reading their website. [El Rancho la Concepción](https://rancholaconcepcion.com/) is a forest in the middle of the desert, where a biologist couple run a destination of regenerative tourism. A highly inspiring combination of environmental protection, education, and recreation that I could not wait to experience for myself. I had been in contact with the owners for a while, and they were expecting me. However, it would take me a while before I actually made it there.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.35 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23uFW8SA1BBKMGSVvUMrK7ZnkyZwwh7z355TVntpddSyB6smAWvi7FbqToRbiFn1KsYtU.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.33 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23zRrCzA5LLsZ2ePYsxEaYeaif4M2vFTpX417Ym2wQe9ez2vuMk8bEzTNjV25y37DLd6z.jpeg)

My first destination was another ranch nearby, called [Rancho Meling](https://ranchomeling.staydirectly.com/). The reason was, I had to get connected to the internet to do some work, and they were the only place nearby that offered it. But getting there proved to be a bit of a challenge. The road leading to Meling was paved, all right, but it came at such impossible inclines (10% to even 20% according to my app) that my bike simply couldn't handle it. After getting my chain stuck under the cassette (and cutting my finger badly trying to get it unstuck), I realized I had to walk my bike up - and sometimes down those steep grades.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.40.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23ryspAGWZ5HusQgXWwKeVHKdbLTd8N9jUw77kx1Ho1y4jbWYKXAcXJLuFdpJLXwejPx9.jpeg)

When I finally arrived at the gate of Meling, I was confronted with their access path: a long, steep downhill trail made of fine sand. Precisely the kind of thing I had decided to avoid! But by that time I simply wanted to arrive, so started walking my bike down. Half an hour later I made it to the ranch. I checked in, took a shower, attended my wounded finger, had a superb hamburger for dinner, and taught my classes the next day. But throughout all this time I knew, it would be a major task getting out of there.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.39.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/243WGn34s6WZVuHzFAYGssobgiuLfKGZc4BssxeLxhe8dxvQwhqpDCFx5JvV4mikcgF5W.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.38 (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23x159stWtgWtejMoVUfn6mnspbx6stmUpvgpueawz3H5RY1wZds9sUdHxrrLaxhYQuAF.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.38 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23tvioeuTXRDRdzLveC9niNnVti15xr5EoAMbWEikjYiF75obpaCNZUqfAaEM4FTZLjqs.jpeg)

In the meantime I was coordinating with Vitza and César from the Rancho la Concepción, who happened to be in Ensenada on a supply run. They said, their neighbor from the [KM66](https://www.instagram.com/rutasanpedro_km66), a roadside restaurant, was willing to give me a ride, but I had to get there first. That meant climbing out of the Meling Ranch, and riding another 16 km, which would take me up another 800 meters, a ratio that suggested such steepness, where I would definitively have to push my bike most of the way. Also at Meling I could not find anyone to give me a ride.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.34 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23ycw5ujWoSogvsppzMpLpDoTCtXxqLUT5zkPV64GeTyZFk7VQHHsWcP1cGUBk2BtKk2U.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.34 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/242rnZUo4nvuZiKsF2oMfjRh5GJNf5Bqq8XVWyBwbowxPidoPZfbGuq1NWnQP89hwGBHa.jpeg)

After my second night, I had formed my escape plan: I would push my bike up the sandy slope, and then simply ride back to the main road, abandoning my plans of visiting the Rancho la Concepción. And then, suddenly a Scottish bird watcher offered me a ride. We'd have to leave in the early morning at 4 a.m. but he would take me to the KM66, from where I'd get a ride to my destination. Sweet!

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.36 (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/2423oLjCiQgFgNwURbEBFPnUpyzcw7H9SF8HGDSmanKUfkTjabrwy6iS8fZLfZ77TkyyG.jpeg)

After an adventurous morning I finally made it to the Rancho la Concepción. Once the guys from the KM66 got me to the driveway I understood everything. It was way worse than anything I could have imagined. Vitza's words rang true: *\

* Six kilometers of extremely steep ups and downs over rocky, sandy terrain took us half an hour in a pick-up truck. I gave the guys 100 pesos each for their effort, and when Vitza took me back after my stay, I found the 250 she charged me for it not exaggerated.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.35.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23yTUHqPXituniQaDw2Fwq4vQMAyGS6YK8nBwp3PMMRVbzQwtdnxJWQseEC6ijP3b3aBa.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.37 (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23zbMzS9yfuuoNoCLJ2fvkqSR4eiBtRhHZvoWyVXUV3pVYN7ET2ZU5Gx5DoZhojPoR1Fi.jpeg)

But what I encountered at the ranch was beyond belief. Every minute of waiting for rides, every overpriced hamburger, and every drop of blood from my finger was definitely a price worth paying for it. The most gorgeous, beautiful nature surrounding us. Pure, pristine water flowing through the valley. A warm, and generous hospitality of the owners, employee, and volunteer. And a night sky with a full moon that unfolded its spectacular magic.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.35 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23tkhYsTvVCS83md9f2P5JNshA9bccpm21wPieKiyFA8b2tJqgLkoS8rmzuR1aqkdT1Lu.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.36 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/2466bjuq9sLkcJETJyxuppRcEEk4u5xgrwK49e8iNGKPio5TqMrZKg8RUoKpJH2yte6VZ.jpeg)

The philosophy of the place is centered on returning to the quiet simplicity of our basic existence. Enjoying nature in its purest form. Detaching ourselves from the noisy distractions of virtual life. Turning off our phones, our lights, and social media to be aware and present in the actual world around us. To appreciate our connection with the people around us, and the natural world we're all part of.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.35 (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23tveamVLr1T9YVQaQDgHH4d3FSH3ekP1kVUWkT184PwUHYaGcSPcfYL1xSYFftvYT4mb.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.34.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/EppHLJgxcEWgez6HwNP8SXEcpxJS6urQ956Cu2aHvn5awUjWLEifFgRW3VD3VXHR5rF.jpeg)

As the highlight of my stay, I had the great pleasure and honor to shoot a proper interview with Vitza and César, which should hopefully be ready to be published in the foreseeable future. More about that later. But all in all, I couldn't feel happier and luckier about my time at the Rancho la Concepción, from the first until the very last moment.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.36 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23y8ufCodjM9o4moYjBtVYzHRig7mM945tVdLU9sVouWZYMq9p74tyLkLCxADYRUED4gH.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.36.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23ywqEjtf4NcPmk1u8mwqYFwquwVjH8cpVAskuua3fThQ3u47e2uYoVBU8CeTq3bHpLQx.jpeg)

My euphoria lasted well through the day of my ride back. From the KM66 I rode mostly downhill to Meling, where I happened to pass the Scottish ornithologist. Then further downhill, back to the main road in the village of Díaz Ordáz, where I reunited with Irene, a local cyclist I met on my way up the mountain. She invited me to spend the night at her place, where she made me a fabulous dinner that could never be surpassed by anything in a restaurant. Her 14 year old son Alexander Leonel is also an aspiring mountain bike racer who was happy to show off his bike. This wonderful hospitality was the cherry on top of my already amazing experience in the region of the Sierra de San Pedro Mártir.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-06-02 at 07.34.33.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/EowGeGW7SJnoYbkCVJcuisP6euZksDWzLVfv7SmCbvapDgKPKkJgVuTgPG5c6iEgjY1.jpeg)

body.title: An educational activity to preserve our traditions!
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz día para todos, deseo que la bendición de Dios repose sobre cada uno de ustedes y que este día sea de éxito, dicha y prosperidad ! Quiero compartirle los aspectos de una actividad realizada en la institución educativa en la cual trabajo la cual lleva por nombre: Rescatando nuestras tradiciones; fue una actividad que surgió desde el área de CRP (creación, recreación y producción) con el objetivo de rescatar esas hermosas tradiciones que han venido pasando de generación en generación; quisimos abordarlo no solo de la parte recreativa sino también desde la gastronomía y las costumbres de nuestro país o de o nuestra región que es eso que nos identifica y nos hace sentir orgullosos. Sabemos que con el avance de la tecnología la forma de recrearse de los niños ha cambiado mucho, ya no se ve a los niños volando un cometa o jugando a la canicas también conocidas como pichas o metras; y que decir de por ejemplo jugar al escondite, al tocadito, jugar la pelotica de goma, y todos esos juegos que tanto nos divertían cuando éramos niños, lo frecuente hoy en día es ver a los niños frente a una pantalla; así que de allí surgió la idea de rescatar nuestras tradiciones; quisimos hacerlo no solamente en la parte de los juegos tradicionales sino que también lo llevamos a la parte de nuestra gastronomía. Fue realmente sorprendente ver como niños adolescentes de 12 y 13 años no conocían juegos cómo el que se llama la rayuela, también se conoce como el avión, el muñeco o la semana, son juegos que se han ido perdiendo con el paso del tiempo y con esta actividad quisimos rescatarlos; de hecho nos organizamos por grupo y en la entrada de la institución en una de las canchas abiertas que allí están realizamos el dibujo de la rayuela y nosotros los docentes le dimos las instrucciones a los jóvenes de cómo se jugaba, fue un momento realmente muy divertido porque nosotras mismas nos tocó hacerle la demostración y creo que de una u otra forma revivimos esos lindos momentos de nuestra infancia. La actividad estuvo muy amenizada se podía sentir en el ambiente la algarabía de los estudiantes, se hicieron competencias de papagayo, se organizaron la tradicional carrera en saco, el huevo en cuchara, también organizamos competencias de peloticas de goma, de voleibol, de fútbol, tuvimos también competencias de boliche, de pichas o también conocidas como canicas, a cada equipo ganador se le obsequió un pequeño premio. La actividad transcurrió entre risas y compartir, el ver a los jóvenes aprender actividades nuevas que forman parte de nuestra cultura y también contamos con la preparación de dulces tradicionales como es el dulce de lechosa, la jalea de mango, la pasta de mango, la conserva de plátano y entre las bebidas no pudo faltar por supuesto el carato de mango, de arroz, de maíz; allí estuvimos compartiendo hasta aproximadamente las 12 del mediodía cuando dimos por concluida esta hermosa actividad . Quedó allí en la entrada de la institución la rayuela y el muñeco, y es ya común cuando vamos entrando a la institución ver a los muchachos saltando y jugando estos hermosos juegos que pertenecen a nuestra tradición, lo cual quiere decir que en parte se logró el objetivo de la actividad 🎉 Espero la lectura haya sido de tu agrado . Gracias por visitar mi blog ! Dios te bendiga🙌

>

**<center>ENGLISH</center>**

Happy day to all! I wish God's blessing upon each of you and that this day is filled with success, joy, and prosperity!

I want to share with you some details of an activity carried out at the educational institution where I work, called \

This activity originated from the CRP (Creation, Recreation, and Production) department with the goal of rescuing those beautiful traditions that have been passed down from generation to generation. We wanted to approach it not only from a recreational perspective but also from the perspective of gastronomy and the customs of our country or region—those things that identify us and make us feel proud.

We know that with the advancement of technology, the way children play has changed a lot. We no longer see children flying kites or playing marbles;  And what about games like hide-and-seek, tag, and all those games that were so much fun when we were kids? These days, it's common to see children in front of a screen. So, that's where the idea of reviving our traditions came from. We wanted to do it not only with traditional games but also with our cuisine.

It was truly surprising to see how many 12- and 13-year-olds didn't know games like hopscotch, also known as \

These are games that have been disappearing over time, and with this activity, we wanted to bring them back. In fact, we organized ourselves into groups, and at the entrance of the school, on one of the open courts there, we drew a hopscotch grid. We teachers then gave the students instructions on how to play. It was a really fun moment because we ourselves had to demonstrate, and I think that in one way or another, we relived those wonderful moments from our childhood. The activity was very lively; you could feel the students' excitement in the air. There were kite-flying competitions, the traditional sack race, the egg-and-spoon race, and we also organized competitions with rubber balls, volleyball, and soccer. We also had bowling and marbles competitions. Each winning team received a small prize. The activity unfolded amidst laughter and sharing. It was wonderful to see the young people learning new activities that are part of our culture. We also enjoyed preparing traditional sweets such as papaya candy, mango jelly, mango paste, and plantain preserves. And of course, we couldn't leave out the drinks: mango carato, rice carato, and corn carato. We stayed there sharing until approximately noon when we concluded this wonderful activity. The hopscotch grid and the effigy remain at the entrance of the school, and it's now common to see the students jumping and playing these beautiful games that belong to our tradition as we enter the school. This means that the activity's objective was partially achieved 🎉 I hope you enjoyed reading this. Thank you for visiting my blog! body.title: Are Chatbots Too Friendly?
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 29, 2026 at 09_30_12 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/learningpages/23xozJpTBNpwvwR3euciGnqm4hRejL3sXVMkJQAmo1tEWereikAAqR3Hfi7DqCZz8AwHr.png)
Image generated by ChatGPT
**AI chatbots that are trained to be friendly when interacting with users are also more prone to inaccuracies.** Researchers at the [Oxford Internet Institute](https://www.oii.ox.ac.uk) found that being trained to give friendlier answers makes them up to 30% less accurate, and 40% more likely to validate users' false beliefs. The study, *Training language models to be warm can reduce accuracy and increase sycophancy*, by [Lujain Ibrahim](https://www.oii.ox.ac.uk/people/profiles/lujain-ibrahim/), [Franziska Sofia Hafner](https://www.oii.ox.ac.uk/people/profiles/franziska-sofia-hafner/) and [Luc Rocher](https://www.oii.ox.ac.uk/people/profiles/luc-rocher/), published in Nature, tested five different AI models. Each model was retrained to sound warmer, producing two versions of the same chatbot: one original and one warm. This is particularly concerning when it comes to medical information. AI is a very useful tool, so I don't want to stop using it. The approach I take is not to use prompts that start with: 'Do you think that...', 'Do you agree with...' or any other prompt that gives insights into the reply that I want. Instead, I use prompts like: 'What...', 'How..', 'Who...', 'Where...', 'When...' 'Generate...', *and* always validate the answers I am given.

不知道今年是不是厄尔尼诺气候的影响，感觉好多蛇。
一打开网络，也是各种铺天盖地的相关信息。
哪里的人被蛇咬了，哪里一条大马路上都能看到有人。
有句话说的好，当你在房间里看到一只蟑螂的时候，那说明这个房间里已经有很多蟑螂了。
或许，用在蛇身上也同样如此。
当我们在人群密集处，或者车子经常来往的大马路上都能看到蛇的时候，那背地里那些山野田陇间，又是个什么情况？
我记得以前我也没刷到那么多相关信息呀，我一开始还以为是大数据信息茧房的原因。
可直到我看到我们这边好几个县的官媒都有发过有人被咬伤的信息，我就觉得有点离谱了。
关键被咬伤就算了，还好多都是毒蛇，甚至是眼镜王蛇。
这玩意我记得我只在动物世界里看过，结果现在你告诉我我们身边就有。
我丢，我真的会被吓到。
然后我发现也不只是我，好多网友都在评论区说自己从小就怕这玩意，结果现在还有专家说要放生。
甚至有网友吐槽：城里人怕蛇，结果放生要往农村放，那农村人就不怕嘛？放生就算了，血清还都在城里……
说实话，作为一个农村人，看到这样的情况也是很无奈。
谁不怕蛇啊。
关键现在还有很多人不知道是坏还是蠢。
甚至专门去买蛇来放生，还说这也是生命啊。
看似是积德行善，其实还真不一定。
那要这么说，蛇是生命，被它吃的老鼠和虫子，甚至是被它咬的人是不是生命啊。
哪怕真有因果业力，那也是算总账啊，你放生蛇，这里给你算加了十分，那这蛇每去吃一只老鼠，就给你扣一分，要是不小心有人被咬了，直接给你扣个百八十分的，就看你这因果业力能不能承受得住。
诶，照这么下去，我估计今年的菌子我都不敢去找了。
去年我朋友好像就在找菌子的时候遇过一条蛇，今年这情况，比去年还严峻，我估计心里阴影都得给我干出来。

body.title: 🌸✨ Melissa in Pencil Art | A Portrait Inspired by Beauty and Expression ✏️💕 ✨🌸/ 🌸✨ Melissa en Arte a Lápiz | Un Retrato Inspirado en la Belleza y la Expresión ✏️💕 ✨🌸
body.body: > English: Hello Sketchbook community! 😊🎨 Today I want to share with you a pencil drawing created by me of **Melissa**, inspired by a real photo but transformed into a soft animated portrait style 💖✨ From the moment I saw her expression and hairstyle, I felt inspired to recreate her essence through drawing ✏️💕. Something about her calm look, delicate facial features, and beautiful braids motivated me to turn a simple reference image into a stylized artistic interpretation 🌷🥹 For this artwork, I focused on using **clean linework** and delicate pencil strokes to define facial proportions and preserve the softness of the composition 🖊️🎭. I worked carefully on the **symmetry of the face**, emphasizing the eyes to make them more expressive and emotional 👀✨

/> One of the most detailed parts was definitely the hair 💇‍♀️💫. I used repeated curved strokes and flowing contour lines to create **texture, volume, and movement**, especially in the braids, trying to give them a natural appearance while maintaining the animated aesthetic 🌊✍️ I also added subtle details in the clothing and accessories, such as the earrings and necklace, to bring more personality to the drawing 💍💕. Around the cheeks and facial structure, I used soft sketch details to give warmth and tenderness to the portrait 🥰 What inspired me most to draw Melissa was her natural beauty and peaceful expression 🌸✨. Sometimes a face inspires you because it reflects calmness, sweetness, and authenticity, and that motivated me to turn inspiration into art ❤️🎨 I hope you enjoy this pencil artwork made with patience, creativity, and lots of love 😊✨ Thank you for visiting my post! 💖🙏

>

Español: ¡Hola comunidad de Sketchbook! 😊🎨 Hoy quiero enseñarles un dibujo creado por mí a lápiz de **Melissa**, inspirado en una foto real pero transformado en un estilo de retrato animado suave 💖✨ Desde el momento en que vi su expresión y su peinado, sentí inspiración para recrear su esencia mediante el dibujo ✏️💕. Algo en su mirada tranquila, sus rasgos delicados y sus hermosas trenzas me motivó a convertir una simple fotografía en una interpretación artística estilizada 🌷🥹 Para este trabajo me enfoqué en utilizar un **lineart limpio** y trazos suaves de lápiz para definir las proporciones faciales y mantener la suavidad de la composición 🖊️🎭. Trabajé cuidadosamente la **simetría del rostro**, destacando especialmente los ojos para hacerlos más expresivos y llenos de emoción 👀✨

/>

Una de las partes más detalladas fue sin duda el cabello 💇‍♀️💫. Utilicé líneas curvas repetidas y contornos fluidos para crear **textura, volumen y movimiento**, especialmente en las trenzas, buscando que se vieran naturales sin perder el estilo animado 🌊✍️

También añadí pequeños detalles en la ropa y accesorios, como los aretes y el collar, para aportar más personalidad al dibujo 💍💕. En el rostro agregué detalles suaves para transmitir ternura y delicadeza 🥰

Lo que más me inspiró a dibujar a Melissa fue su belleza natural y la tranquilidad que transmite su expresión 🌸✨. Hay rostros que inspiran calma, dulzura y autenticidad, y eso me motivó a convertir esa inspiración en arte ❤️🎨

Espero que les guste este dibujo hecho con paciencia, creatividad y mucho cariño 😊✨

¡Gracias por visitar mi post! 💖🙏

body.title: Not Everyone Standing Beside You Is Truly on Your Side
body.body: Not every smiling face is your companion and not every person walking with you is your ally. On the journey of life some people stay close only as long as their interests are being served. As soon as the path gets difficult, they quietly slip away as if they were never with you at all. History bears witness that powerful empires didn’t fall only because of enemies but also grew weak because of those who appeared to be friends yet were not loyal at heart. Such people become silent spectators in times of need and reveal their true colors in difficult moments. A true ally is not the one who stands with you only in success but the one who doesn’t let go of your hand even in failure, criticism and trials. The real test of loyalty is not in times of joy but in times of hardship. Life teaches us that the quality of relationships matters more than the quantity. One sincere companion is better than dozens of superficial friends. The one who defends your honor and your rights even in your absence that is the true friend and ally. So don’t make every person who comes close into your confidant. Let time decide who is truly with you and who is just a passenger of circumstance. Because anyone can be a friend, but not every friend is an ally.

body.title: Epic Games continues its strategy - Two FREE games this week [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xLB6kfD9cDzmim8zKvJ5EuimMmNwfxEps94p8wt6tbWgdMAZB8MLbtxMcaYSHkATw3n.png) --- It’s been a while since I last talked about Epic’s free games, because—I must admit—they don't always offer titles that are truly worth the trouble. But hey, there’s always *something*; this time around, I think we’re getting some somewhat more decent games—ones I actually feel comfortable sharing here—so go ahead and enjoy them! The weekly tradition at the Epic Games Store continues, and this time, PC players can add two very different titles to their digital libraries completely free of charge. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x1N4GDCYVsU8L9DesxCJPBst1UbkRaYcQzycyvzkp1YtqGjdfTGa67DyrdiAq9dxzTc.png) --- The platform has made *Calico* and *Lonestar* available to all its users—two titles that typically carry a price tag but can be claimed at no cost for a limited time. Best of all, once added to your account, they will remain in your game library forever. The first of these games is *Calico*, a relaxing and colorful experience that emphasizes creativity and exploration. In this adventure, players take on the task of managing a cat café within a small community filled with quirky characters. The main objective involves decorating the shop, preparing various recipes, attracting customers, and transforming the business into a cozy haven for animal lovers. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wMnuoUXkdTcBxcby88JLRc7sN987TJ9ceHW9ALrvAVqE4WCXABHy8mGT5V5YARfV9xc.png) --- However, *Calico* goes far beyond being a simple café simulator. The game allows you to explore an open world filled with side quests, meet local inhabitants, and adopt numerous pets. Its colorful aesthetic and laid-back approach have made it one of the most eye-catching indie titles for those seeking a tranquil experience—one far removed from frenetic action and online competition. One of its most curious features is the ability to interact with giant cats and even ride them to get around the environment. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/Ep1XPw7KDsvJyiRdArerYTK6QTCbrYxsqUqsCTTr6GwowYsW72e9ZhLPY6zrvZpg7er.png) --- The second gift of the week is *Lonestar*, a title that sits at the opposite end of the spectrum. Here, players take on the role of space bounty hunters, traversing the galaxy to face off against enemy ships in intense tactical combat. The game combines strategy mechanics, deck-building, and roguelike elements, creating an experience where every playthrough can unfold in a completely different way. In *Lonestar*, strategic decisions are paramount. Players must upgrade their ship, manage resources, and carefully select the cards or abilities they will utilize during each engagement. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u65BNma6Jz3f4yh31x5scdKg68En27JKeU7czj1WjbBE7v9B9hYzG7JJhx9srPj9jGw.png) --- Thanks to its roguelike structure, every defeat serves to unlock new possibilities and strengthen future space expeditions. This combination of tactical combat and constant progression has successfully captured the attention of many fans of strategy and sci-fi games. The selection of these two titles once again demonstrates the variety that Epic Games aims to offer in its weekly promotions. While *Calico* opts for a relaxing and cozy experience centered on management and exploration, --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uQJhQttsUbmzJLjgp2nTyKiLfUsdqRpRwd5QY8D1L3H5KUwNC385AVAx6bHAKrqFb8C.png) --- *Lonestar* presents strategic challenges within a space setting packed with combat and tactical decisions. Both represent very distinct genres, ensuring that different types of players can find something of interest within the promotion. To claim them, simply log in to the Epic Games Store, visit the pages for both games, and claim them before the promotion ends. Once the process is complete, they will remain permanently linked to your account—even after they revert to their regular price. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tvAUxJ3hctCfnedBU6c8LeypkFuc5YNmz9LG4d8nS4vErzFE9rbuDejJtTzb2uJevQZ.png) --- As happens every Thursday, the company will refresh its offerings next week with new surprise titles; consequently, users have a limited window to take advantage of this opportunity.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)







### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xLB6kfD9cDzmim8zKvJ5EuimMmNwfxEps94p8wt6tbWgdMAZB8MLbtxMcaYSHkATw3n.png) --- Tenia rato sin hablar de los juegos gratis de Epic porque debo admitir que no siempre dan titulos que valgan la pena, pero bueno siempre hay algo, esta vez creo que se vienen algunos juegos algo mas decentes que si puedo poner por aca, asi que disfrutenlos La tradición semanal de Epic Games Store continúa, y esta vez los jugadores de PC pueden añadir gratuitamente dos propuestas muy diferentes a sus bibliotecas digitales. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23x1N4GDCYVsU8L9DesxCJPBst1UbkRaYcQzycyvzkp1YtqGjdfTGa67DyrdiAq9dxzTc.png) --- La plataforma ha puesto a disposición de todos sus usuarios Calico y Lonestar, dos títulos que normalmente son de pago pero que podrán reclamarse sin coste durante un tiempo limitado. Lo mejor de todo es que, una vez añadidos a la cuenta, permanecerán para siempre en la biblioteca del jugador. El primero de los juegos es Calico, una experiencia relajante y colorida que apuesta por la creatividad y la exploración. En esta aventura los jugadores asumen la tarea de administrar una cafetería de gatos en una pequeña comunidad llena de personajes peculiares. El objetivo principal consiste en decorar el local, preparar diferentes recetas, atraer clientes y convertir el negocio en un lugar acogedor para los amantes de los animales. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wMnuoUXkdTcBxcby88JLRc7sN987TJ9ceHW9ALrvAVqE4WCXABHy8mGT5V5YARfV9xc.png) --- Sin embargo, Calico va mucho más allá de un simple simulador de cafetería. El juego permite recorrer un mundo abierto lleno de misiones secundarias, conocer habitantes de la zona y adoptar numerosas mascotas. Su estética colorida y su enfoque relajado lo han convertido en una de las propuestas independientes más llamativas para quienes buscan una experiencia tranquila, alejada de la acción frenética y la competición online. Uno de sus elementos más curiosos es la posibilidad de interactuar con gatos gigantes e incluso montarlos para desplazarse por el escenario. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/Ep1XPw7KDsvJyiRdArerYTK6QTCbrYxsqUqsCTTr6GwowYsW72e9ZhLPY6zrvZpg7er.png) --- El segundo regalo de la semana es Lonestar, un título que se mueve en el extremo opuesto del espectro. Aquí los jugadores se convierten en cazadores de recompensas espaciales que recorren la galaxia enfrentándose a naves enemigas en intensos combates tácticos. El juego combina mecánicas de estrategia, construcción de mazos y elementos roguelike, creando una experiencia donde cada partida puede desarrollarse de manera distinta. En Lonestar, las decisiones estratégicas son fundamentales. Los jugadores deben mejorar su nave, gestionar recursos y seleccionar cuidadosamente las cartas o habilidades que utilizarán durante cada enfrentamiento. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u65BNma6Jz3f4yh31x5scdKg68En27JKeU7czj1WjbBE7v9B9hYzG7JJhx9srPj9jGw.png) --- Gracias a su estructura roguelike, cada derrota sirve para desbloquear nuevas posibilidades y fortalecer futuras expediciones espaciales. Esta combinación de combate táctico y progresión constante ha logrado captar la atención de muchos aficionados a los juegos de estrategia y ciencia ficción. La elección de estos dos títulos demuestra nuevamente la variedad que Epic Games busca ofrecer en sus promociones semanales. Mientras Calico apuesta por una experiencia relajante y acogedora centrada en la gestión y la exploración, --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23uQJhQttsUbmzJLjgp2nTyKiLfUsdqRpRwd5QY8D1L3H5KUwNC385AVAx6bHAKrqFb8C.png) --- Lonestar propone desafíos estratégicos en un entorno espacial cargado de combates y decisiones tácticas. Ambos representan géneros muy distintos, permitiendo que diferentes tipos de jugadores encuentren algo interesante dentro de la promoción. Para conseguirlos solo es necesario iniciar sesión en la tienda de Epic Games, acceder a las páginas de ambos juegos y reclamarlos antes de que termine la promoción. Una vez completado el proceso, permanecerán asociados a la cuenta de manera permanente, incluso después de que recuperen su precio habitual. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tvAUxJ3hctCfnedBU6c8LeypkFuc5YNmz9LG4d8nS4vErzFE9rbuDejJtTzb2uJevQZ.png) --- Como ocurre cada jueves, la compañía renovará la oferta la próxima semana con nuevos títulos sorpresa, por lo que los usuarios tienen una ventana limitada para aprovechar esta oportunidad.

body.title: From Elsewhere:  54% of Britons have confidence in the police. I’m very surprised that the number is that high.
body.body:
![signpost--777x437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/23xAqCUkcWCYxdiRieDG2uiwrdLkP3oWMKKfWbFRQQNbnxtiamXnurdhm8rDJT2KjGbuq.jpg)




The German publication Die Zeit has published an article about two tier policing in the UK. There’s a lot that this article gets correct such as that there has not just been one or two incidents where timid and brainwashed state officials in Britain has put protecting themselves from possibly fake accusations of ‘racism’ ahead of public safety and justice, there’s been dozens.

Here’s what Die Zeit said:


“The British confidence in their police has declined dramatically in recent years. In October 2024, in a YouGov survey, only 54 percent said the police were doing a good job. In October 2019, 72 percent still held this view. There are two important developments between these two values. One was the killing of George Floyd in 2020 and the subsequent mass movement Black Lives Matter. There were also numerous demonstrations against »institutional racism« within the police in Great Britain. Numerous police officers and politicians took the knee in a gesture of humility, among them the then Labour leader and current Prime Minister Keir Starmer.
The second development is an increasing mixing of socio-political agenda and actual legal mandate in the British police: for example, police officers carrying Pride flags or police vehicles that commemorate Black History Month. How much the British police now act not only as guardians of law and order, but also as guardians of conventions, but above all prove the Thousands of cases of so-called »non-criminal hate incidents«, which uniformed officers pursue year after year. The legal basis for these investigations states that an expression of hatred »from the perspective of the victim or any other person, motivated by hostility or prejudice« must be. So it is assumed from the beginning that there is a victim – based solely on a subjective perception.”

Here’s the link to the Die Zeit piece, don’t worry if you cannot speak German there’s an English translator button at the top of the Die Zeit article:  https://www.zeit.de/politik/ausland/2026-06/mord-henry-nowak-grossbritannien-polizei-5vor8?freebie=89bc5e0a

Having observed Britain’s police forces become increasingly politicised over the years and watched so many policing failures play out over the years I’m very much surprised that as many as 54% of Britons have confidence in the police.  I expected to be lower than that but I suspect that those who are positive about how Britons are policed are those who are not paying much attention to what is going on in British society.  When we look at scandals such as the policing of the Islamic Rape Gangs, the taking the knee by police officers for a fallen American Criminal, the differential manner in which Left/Islamic demonstrations are policed and how protests by indigenous Britons are policed and the increasing number of ‘hate speech’ arrests has, there’s damned good reason for the public’s approval figures for the police to be a whole lot lower than 54%.

Last night I finally decided to dive into Splinterlands on the Hive blockchain and honestly I am already hooked. I had been hearing about this strategic card game for a while and I have seen so many of people are playing this wonderful game so I logged into my account set up my deck and jumped straight into my first battles and won it... 


As a beginner navigating the different elements and mana costs is a bit challenging for me but figuring out the right card combinations is incredibly satisfying and I am in my learning phase yet, I hope I will be a good player in no time. There is definitely a learning curve to mastering the rules but the fast paced gameplay kept me on my toes the entire night I went for bed at 10am. It’s amazing to see how smooth the gaming experience is right here on the Hive network. I'm really looking forward to building my deck learning new strategies and seeing how far I can climb in the ranks!

body.body:
figuring out what music you can work to is always a challenge, for me. to think there was once a time i could write to anything. motorhead blasting. i didn't care. now, there's very strict rules and they seem to change sporadically, so i don't know what to make of them anymore.

some songs feel right. in the beginning of writing this book, i had a long obsession with of monsters and men, particularly their latest album. i just felt songs like fruit bat went really well with the place where i felt the book.

it's certainly interesting, looking back at it now, because it reminds me i felt a lot of uncertainty at the time, and it's important for me to remember that, because though i don't feel that now, it did inform to a great extent, the early parts of the book. i see now there's things i need to reframe, but having some understanding for this earlier version of me writing it does help.

i often have trouble listening to songs i really love, or that have a strong emotional impact for me, as i get too distracted. i tend to be absorbed by the fantasy of the song, and that's not always good, because it messes with my feelings, and i need to observe my own reactions to the writing itself. like, it's no good listening to a very moving song, because then i might trick myself into thinking a certain chapter's particularly moving, when it's not really. so i do myself a disservice.

music that's too loud or too in your face or too demanding is an instant no.

in the past, i used to love writing to classical music, and while there's some stuff i've really been enjoying lately, it gets too diffuse. rachmaninov and all the others i love best in that world disperse my thoughts now, so they're out too.

still, i've been finding ways to work with the music at times, because much as i enjoy and need the silence, it gets to be much sometimes.

here's some stuff that's been in my ears as I edit lately:

https://youtu.be/ZlqLaaPbB1c?list=RDAZM79QESFQA

i think i've heard about dogstar a couple times since they got back together in 2020, but somehow this band's gone completely under my radar until recently. so much so that it took me accidentally clicking on the wrong tab and going \

. really enjoying this and a couple other things from them lately. https://youtu.be/0is_VwWU3EE?list=RDAZM79QESFQA a perfect circle is another of those bands that i've had a lukewarm relationship with, and i don't rightly know why. i love it when i listen to it, but then, i don't mind if it just disappears, somehow. still, this little gem found its way to my working playlist and i'm really enjoying that. https://youtu.be/GQxUapg0X90 this beautiful amazing band just premiered a new album, and while i didn't much resonate with the first singles they put out, i gotta say it managed to get under my skin again. there's something so free about brent's voice, and while i don't listen to much shinedown while working anymore, i did a lot when i was younger, and it still bears a very special meaning for me. https://youtu.be/74mV9qwlCgg?list=RDAZM79QESFQA bonus track - i've been obsessed by this for the last couple days, and for once, it's not just yungblud's magic. speaking of a voice like freedom, steven tyler for me has always had a way of suggesting the open road, escape, disappearing. i can't say, baby, where i'll be in a year. this has that energy to me. do you find it easy to listen to music while you write? hi, @ablaze. happy #threetunetuesday! :)

body.body:
>

Hello Hive family Friends, I hope everyone is well. Today, I will share with you my real-life experience of working as a beta tester on a very cool project, ‘First context’. 

In simple words, First Context is a platform powered by Hive Blockchain, where we can permanently store any important content of Web 2.0 (such as YouTube, X, Facebook, etc.) on the blockchain and earn rewards and credits by creating a constructive analysis or ‘signal report’ of it. 

When I came to know about the beta testing of this project, I immediately joined it without any delay. My username on Hive is @mirzaiqi, and my experience working on this platform is really great. Below, I am sharing step by step how I curated a YouTube content starting from my sign-in process and added signals. 

 ---

### Step 1: Sign-in or registration process on the platform

First, we need to go to the official beta link of First Context: https://beta.firstcontext.app/

1. After entering the site, the sign-in option will appear.

2. No separate registration is required. You have to directly enter your Hive username (like @mirzaiqi in my case) and click on the \

option. 


![Screenshot_2026_0602_232639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23u6UkxVZopj728KbaS3fp8quoR5iqKY2U6aR4zYm1HcFsFSDpZj1zcb8Fd7Ahgu1v7fu.jpg)



3. After that, we will be able to easily enter the account through Keychain Approval.

![Screenshot_2026_0602_232616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23tmgttJk9D9RBw1piTZCPUEMB8mb9URM6vC74LbAzGXnPhV4mrbihbQfBsjve9PMHUGs.jpg)

### Step 2: Find or add a creator (Add/Find Creator)

After logging in, we will see several options in the menu on the left side of the dashboard, such as Signal Inbox, Find Creator, Add Creator, Platform Stats, etc. 

1. If you want to work with the content of a specific creator, you can go to the \

option and add their social media or YouTube channel. 

2. As you can see in the screenshot below, I have used the option to add a creator here.


![Screenshot_2026_0602_232857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23xLDJxsJKn3LComTLfosuHfm8oPUYQF94sTqT1dSmCbcoFnAktn6dnNrPUCe7jiZ11Uh.jpg)




---

### Step 3: \

the content

Now let's get to the real work. I wanted to store the information of a wonderful video on YouTube on the blockchain.  The video was basically a discussion about YouTube's AI moderation and policies.

1. First, I copied the video link and pasted it into the \

box.

![Screenshot_2026_0602_232656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23tcJZmpaVe3tH8XftAdnuvygHojZw5GcS1NFtpsqw3aNgvtxc1EGKqjMaVLCiE8NrHkZ.jpg)

2. After submitting the link, the platform automatically identifies the original creator of the video. For example, here the name \
has come up as the creator. I confirm this by clicking the \

button.


![Screenshot_2026_0602_233244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23xAtpev7P1WYmXsbAs8FL7Snpqtgm25sGsFbZ17pfk1mZDYiCCdQs3xUwdo4LMPqXnEm.jpg)


---

### Step 4: My personal opinion (Your Take) and creating a signal report

The first thing to do after confirming the creator is to give your brief opinion (Your Take) about that video or content.  I wrote a short review of the video, considering its importance:

> *\

*


![Screenshot_2026_0602_233511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23uRDe2FVvkVKAVL36QBwecLZDxAdSYjcp6BVw3NgaGTsybm3yAP2wXVYWpuoxeV5SekA.jpg)


Next, you have to create a specific report or 'Signal' by correctly answering the questions provided by the platform. I filled in all the fields to earn bonus credits:

![Screenshot_2026_0602_233523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23t8CazRs6sA6cJvhSpzEo42XLRCXQV6DTHMLfbJNeCwfYRooHLmY7P3z3mLHNaCVq8sv.jpg)

* **topic hint:** YouTube Creator Law & Platform Policy Changes
* **Tags:** #youtube-policy #channel-strikes #ai-demonetization #copyrightfair-use
* *Normalised Claim:** YouTube's shifting policies and a...
* **Stance:** Support
* **What is this?:** Reaction
* **Is it authentic?:** Authentic
* **How important is it?:** Urgent
* **Best part (Timestamp):** At 7:40, Tyler Chow explains YouTube's \

program and courses.
* **Why it matters:** So that creators can get the guidance they need to prevent their channels from being permanently damaged.

 
![Screenshot_2026_0602_233818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23tSv7S86jTmtLqcBDpgDhaodxLLwE5Kn8kZfF7qKrRKTFYFSFSpR72cGEAHTnzcweJUQ.jpg)


---

### Step 5: Successfully posted to the chain

After inputting all the information, two options will be available below: \

** button to permanently save it on-chain to the blockchain. ![Screenshot_2026_0602_233832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23z7Z7hjyuYg4x5PRz9NHDpdo3gYDNYzEYj2S2XPxAvjZBJiaX21q64UcZSPc7Wcsca9C.jpg) After clicking the button, a success message appears on the screen. It shows that my report has been permanently recorded on the blockchain, and for this, I have earned **+23 EA credits**! Also, being the first signaler of this content, it is possible to get a certain portion of the Hive payout for the comments that come here. ![Screenshot_2026_0602_233848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23wCZH3a7pgfhQFNjhi2Ugst6QNY7hFFZyi6W9BesUnrDie91DouQYmk8itjGYdTAMzbz.jpg) --- ### Current progress of the First Context Platform (Platform Stats) Although the First Context project is still in beta, the number of users and data indexed is increasing day by day. Going to the platform stats, you can see: * More than 25,000 pieces of content have been indexed. * More than 500 creators have been added. * And the platform graph is going up day by day. ![Screenshot_2026_0602_233956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mirzaiqi/23t88hxVuc8tigkrpmyZDJ1VbGYZpe5xHuLxTdpQvToaj6ojH3edKFQZ7UzJKYtPURSww.jpg) As a beta tester, I found using the First Context Platform quite easy and informative. This idea of properly evaluating important Web 2.0 content with the help of Web 3.0 technologies is really great. For those of you who haven't tried it yet, you can easily get started today using your Hive account. If you have any questions or queries, you can comment below. Thank you!

In a previous post I commented about my decision to move to Havana; well, I did it. I traveled yesterday with only one destination: Havana. So I took the bus yesterday, of course with some complications due to the economy of the country. My bus was supposed to leave at 10pm, but there were some complications, so we ended up leaving Santiago City at 1:00 am, so yeah, pretty late. 

The trip felt like I was a whole week on the road. Entering the city of Matanzas, it rained so much that we had to stop. It really was an exhausting trip; however, we got to our destination at 8pm on May 28th. So yeah, I'm officially in Havana City not just to enjoy a bit but, more importantly, to work and search for better job opportunities. 

It's really hard being away from my husband for so long. I miss him every second, but this is for the best of us as a marriage. Anyway, if everything goes well, we'll be reunited soon. It is sad being away from your friends and everything you know, but life in Cuba is hard, so one has to search for opportunities to improve your life and your family'swell well-being, even if that means being apart for some time. 

So hivers of Havana, here I am to stay. As goes the saying, \

. I'm looking forward to having a good experience. I have a lot of friends and family here, so I'm not alone; I have good people to rely on.

body.title: A Good School or a Good Education: Which Is More Important?
body.body:
Hello to all hive users 🤗❤️🙏
Hope you all are healthy and doing great in your life🙂



At some point, you must have surely heard the notion that better education is imparted in \

schools. In today's times, this sentiment is voiced by many people; consequently, numerous parents enroll their children in schools far more expensive than their financial means allow, solely to ensure they receive a quality education. However, the pertinent question worth pondering is this: does a \

school truly guarantee a good education? Similarly, you may have observed the immense hard work students put in to secure admission to a prestigious university—often spending several years in preparation—before finally achieving selection. But the question remains: do they ultimately achieve success thereafter? To understand this matter in greater depth, let us begin by focusing on the role of schools. You see, a school serves not merely as a place to acquire academic knowledge; it also plays a pivotal role in shaping a child's personality. It is at school that students acquire their foundational education; concurrently, they learn a multitude of skills and lessons that prove invaluable in their future lives. Student life is characterized by a continuous exposure to—and opportunity to learn—new things at every turn; as a result, throughout their entire schooling period, students remain engaged in a diverse range of activities that broaden their horizons and enrich their knowledge base.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfUT6F8UgwUDkvyPS7gMHvbGdZeT96Ru86RjECaWxJSs9/1780413642597.jpg)


Image Generated By Chatgpt 




I feel that studying at a good school is certainly a positive thing; if your parents can afford the tuition fees, you are indeed fortunate. However, I do not believe it is strictly necessary to attend a prestigious school to receive a quality education. The most critical element within any school environment is the teacher; the quality of education depends entirely on how they teach and their ability to effectively convey concepts. A truly excellent teacher is one who can instill a genuine interest in learning—even in those children who otherwise show no inclination to study. The definition of a \

should not merely imply one that offers superior amenities or charges high fees; rather, it should signify an institution that provides high-quality instruction—one where teachers educate students so effectively that it sparks a genuine passion for learning within them. In today's world, you may have observed that even though children attend incredibly expensive schools, they still return home in the evening to attend private coaching classes for difficult subjects. If a student is already enrolled in a reputable school, what need is there for them to seek additional private tutoring? I have noticed that school tuition fees are already exorbitant, yet students are subsequently compelled to head out for coaching classes after returning home, consuming a significant portion of their time in the process. If the teachers at their school were to educate the students more effectively, I do not believe there would be any need for them to seek supplementary coaching after school hours.

Although the government has established public schools—where tuition fees are either very low or virtually negligible, and where the teachers are highly qualified—people still choose not to send their children there, opting instead for expensive private institutions. If you were to visit any classroom in a public school, you would find very few students seated there. Public schools are predominantly attended by children whose parents are financially disadvantaged and cannot afford to enroll them in better schools—where fees are prohibitively high—and therefore send their children to government-run institutions. The conclusion to be drawn from this is that, when selecting a school, one should prioritize institutions that offer quality education and employ competent teachers; for education is the single most important factor. While other aspects of the school environment may be slightly less than ideal, there should be absolutely no compromise when it comes to the quality of education itself.
The answer is this: whether you pursue higher education or go for a job interview, you are asked about your academic background—specifically, the extent of your knowledge in various subjects and how well-grounded you are in the basics. You are not asked which school you attended, nor is any preference given based on that factor; therefore, one should focus more on the quality of education itself rather than on the school one attends.





Thanks for reading my post till the end. 
If you have any suggestions or feedback then please comment down.

body.body:
<div class='text-justify'> 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf1T53sDxbVPViTEFWtDsspMwbRULqcEgu8PctuEyRhGp/image.png)

## 🌶️ The Late-Night Flavor Fiesta: Spicy Glass Noodle & Minced Pork Salad (Zero Rice Required!)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRmLjo2iVuJHFqai2xzdCDzdGnVzcqCVfD5iU9sZgxHtB/image.png)


**What’s up, my fellow flavor chasers?!** Sakol is back! It's dinner time, and let’s be real—sometimes you just want to skip the heavy carbs, ditch the rice bowl, and go straight for the good stuff! Tonight, we are turning up the heat with a true Thai masterpiece: **Yum Woon Sen Moo Sup** (Spicy Glass Noodle Salad with Minced Pork)!

Listen to me, you absolutely do *not* need rice for this. This dish is the main event, the star of the show! Imagine translucent, bouncy glass noodles that have completely absorbed a magical, mouth-watering potion of freshly squeezed lime juice, savory fish sauce, and the fiery, unapologetic kick of crushed bird's eye chilies. It’s a flavor bomb waiting to explode in every single bite!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc9wPZJJQwGeut7Q4twWLMkqPBn9Ni57z3gdnEJBrxZxT/image.png)


And the minced pork? Oh my goodness! It’s cooked to juicy perfection, mingling seamlessly with the noodles and catching all those glorious, fresh herbs—fragrant cilantro, crunchy celery, and perfectly sliced shallots. Every forkful is a perfect balance of textures and tastes. It’s tangy, it’s fiercely spicy, it’s incredibly refreshing, and it hits every single craving without making you feel stuffed.

You just grab your fork, twirl those glossy noodles, scoop up a generous mound of that flavorful minced pork, and let the symphony of flavors dance on your tongue! **10/10, an absolutely sensational dinner!**

## Chapter 79: Making the World a Better Place

-----

Over the next few months, the majority of the Downs residents moved back to the Downs Region. The technicians that were still living underground replaced the Downs residents in the camps and construction sites. They were more prepared for the climate above. They had developed a powerful factor ten sunblock. They also wore UV-resistant googles and floppy hats. 

Progress was incredibly slow because of the loss of transportation vehicles and shortages of resources. Initially, there were some food shortages, but the consistent work of the Sapiods and the return of the Downs residents very quickly resolved this problem.

Freddy was finally reunited with his parents and his older brother Eugene. They held a party in the Downs Agriculture Zone to celebrate. Freddy invited his closest friends from the West Camp. Even Hamlet, Rico, and fluffy Lily were invited.

Frank completed his musical, but the official opening night was delayed because there was no operating theatre in the Downs Region. The badly damaged and only partially built palace was going to be converted into the Downs Region’s official theatre and would become the home of Frank’s greatest musical. A makeshift open-air theatre was built in the Downs Agriculture Zone near the memorial. Despite becoming High Philosopher, Homer remained focused on his role in the musical. He would give a weekly sermon to encourage the followers who were mostly focused on helping technicians rebuild the Downs Region.

Sapey still did not have any formal leadership. Everyone was just trying to help each other with reliance on the senior technicians for guidance. The action team, which was led by Henders, had an official plan. They had organised a presentation at the town hall. All the other community representatives were present to discuss their progress. Orcilla, Vulay, Daily, Shamia, Lily, and Walter also attended as observers.

The presentation team consisted of Henders, Octavius, Eugene, Denise, and Louis. They were sitting at the end of the table. Hamlet, who had replaced the chubby Sape, stood outside. She was looking through a hole in the wall. She had two carts of fruit with her to calm her nerves.

Denise stood up to introduce their plan. ‘I want to thank everyone for their input to our plan,’ said Denise. ‘We truly welcome everyone’s enthusiasm.’

Everyone in the room lightly applauded.

‘We want to create something that has never been done before,’ said Denise. ‘We’re sick of someone ruling over us. Whether directly or from behind the scenes.’

‘It’s because they’re all nutters,’ said Walter angrily as he patted his fist. ‘They cooked our beautiful region.’

‘Yes, exactly,’ said Denise, nodding. ‘I fought against this as an Inquisitive and then as part of the resistance. Now, we can finally win. I’ll let my good friend Octavius Spiro outline the plan so far.’

‘Thank you, Denise,’ said Octavius as he looked around the room. ‘I’ve been around a long time. I’ve seen many things. It’s always the same. Control ends up in the hands of the few. It does not matter if the leaders born are into power, seize power, or are elected. A thousand years ago, I was part of a meeting where we decided power had to be shared. In reality, it never happened. Those we thought represented us only represented the same characters from behind the scenes. This was a mere mirage of shared conditional power. As long as we have a face to power, we will have someone controlling it. From here onwards, there will be no faces to power, just representation.’

‘Are you suggesting we should be leaderless?’ asked Lily. ‘A form of anarchy.’

‘Shut up and let him finish, moron,’ said Walter as he stared at Lily.

Lily waved her finger at Walter, and Orcilla chuckled a little, which caused Lily to divert her stare towards her.

‘No, not leaderless,’ replied Octavius. ‘Quite the opposite. We’ll have leaders everywhere. Leaders in business. Leaders in innovation. Leaders in education. Leaders in entertainment. You name any area; they’ll be leaders. Anyone could emerge as a leader.’

Lily sighed and shook her head.

Octavius looked at Henders, who handed him a stack of notes.

‘Let me break things down into a less ambiguous structure,’ said Octavius as he smiled at Henders. ‘We want minimal intervention. We want society to shape itself. We want society to address its own needs and wants. On an individual level that will be automatic. In this regard, our framework serves the purpose of maintaining fair competition.

‘That’s Business Sector 2.0,’ chuckled Lily. 

‘It’ll be nothing like that,’ replied Octavius. ‘There was no competition in the Business Sector. There were monopolies in every sector. The Government were the main buyers, claiming to represent the Sapiens. The only group they needed to serve was themselves.’

‘The Business Sector only served to enrich the Linap,’ interrupted Louis. ‘The Sapiens were forced to accept “rights” and the limited items that we could acquire within a limited time with the tokens we earned.’

‘Leaw gave me three pay packets in a row of just garden tool tokens,’ replied Walter. ‘I ended up with seventeen rakes, and I live in an apartment.’

‘Why didn’t you trade your rakes with someone else for something you wanted?’ asked Wendell.

‘Barter trade was a serious crime, friend,’ said Eugene as he stared at Wendell. ‘All rakes were electronically tagged. The moment the rake left his apartment, my enforcers would wrestle him to the ground. Repeat offenders would have flavoured ice cream suspended from their “rights” package for two months.’

‘That’s so savage,’ remarked Gilling.

‘Now you know why I went through that grumpy phase,’ sighed Walter.

‘In our new system, this will never happen,’ said Octavius proudly. ‘You will be able to buy what you like, and you can swap items with friends if you want.’

‘You seem to be onto something really good,’ said Orcilla, smiling.

‘That’s just the beginning and the easy part,’ said Octavius. Henders nodded excitedly in agreement. ‘I’ve only talked about individual needs and wants, which I expect competitive market forces to determine. We still need to talk about collective needs and wants.’

‘This is the new and really clever bit,’ said Denise, nodding as she rubbed Henders on the shoulder.

‘Oh finally!’ gasped Lily. ‘I’ll listen with baited breath.’

‘Argh!’ screamed Hamlet.

‘A shared sentiment,’ said Orcilla as she looked at Lily.

‘We are proposing that each region has its own representatives,’ said Octavius. ‘Their job will be to bring attention to matters that are important to the residents of their region, but they will not be responsible for resolving them. This responsibility will sit with whoever can win the battle of ideas.’

RJ, Scott, Alex, and Freddy entered the room carrying trays of giant novelty coconuts.

‘These look great,’ said Gilling, clapping.

‘Attention seeker incoming,’ said Walter as he frowned at RJ while Alex placed the coconut in front of him.

‘This is the berry brain blast mixed with a little coconut milk and banana puree,’ said RJ as he joyfully looked around the room. ‘If you want to know more about this fantastic concoction, just read my latest blog.’

Walter quickly got up and pushed RJ out of the room. ‘This shameless behaviour needs to end,’ he said as he closed the door.

‘I thought that was quite sweet of him,’ said Shamia.

‘It’s just part of his scam to get more views of his blog,’ said Walter as he sat back down. ‘It’s best to ignore him.’

‘It’s fresh and has a kick to it,’ said Vulay. ‘I’m definitely curious.’

‘No, no,’ said Walter, waving his hands at her.

‘Thanks, the refreshments are appreciated,’ said Octavius as he watched Scott, Alex and Freddy leave the room. ‘Anyway, where was I?’

Henders pointed at the notes in front of Octavius.

‘Ah yes, battle of ideas,’ said Octavius as his face lit up. ‘Our greatest and smartest will try to address any community problems. They will identify the symptoms and the causes of these problems. They discuss and debate courses of action, and the most heavily supported ideas will win the day.’

‘Are you suggesting some sort of vote?’ asked Vulay.

‘That’s the most expected approach,’ said Octavius. ‘Only experts in the relevant fields would vote. The expert with the winning idea will form a team to implement the proposed course of action.’

‘Who are these experts?’ asked Daily.

‘Someone becomes an expert based on personal accomplishments in a particular field,’ said Octavius. ‘Individual regions should decide the threshold needed to become an expert.’

‘You mean someone like Frank,’ said Shamia excitedly. ‘He’s a musical genius and a master electrical technician.’

‘I guess,’ said Octavius as he looked at Henders, who was nodding enthusiastically.

‘The opening night of the greatest musical ever is tomorrow,’ said Shamia. ‘This news will motivate Frank to a whole new level.’

‘Henders has suggested a system of metrics to determine if someone qualifies as an expert,’ said Octavius. ‘The current shortage of experts would set the bar quite low to begin with.’

‘How about funding and the Economic Institute?’ asked Lily.

‘The Economic Institute will be gradually phased out,’ replied Octavius as he looked at Henders, who was nodding. ‘It will be replaced by a blockchain-based system. New currency will be issued based on predetermined economic indicators. It will be distributed to winning projects. Every region will be allocated a share based on demographic data. If a region has significant needs, they can borrow from another region or raise funds through other means such as taxation.’

Vulay gestured an explosion above her head with her hands.

‘These are mostly Henders’ ideas,’ said Denise. ‘His brain is on another level.’

‘We will also have a blockchain database for all documentation relating to transactions, projects, and voting,’ added Octavius. ‘He wants complete transparency regarding newly created money and community projects.’

‘I don’t trust anything that confuses me,’ said Lily.

‘I trust something far more if it confuses her,’ chuckled Orcilla.

‘All of this is a few steps away,’ chuckled Octavius. ‘At the moment, we are focused on the elements of our framework that contribute the most to the current rebuilding efforts.’

Hamlet burped loudly. She had finished all of her fruit.

‘You’re running out of time, champ,’ said Walter as his eyes darted from side to side.

‘That’s the gist of our framework,’ said Octavius. ‘You can look at Henders’ four-thousand-page document; it’s mostly pictures. If you still have questions, come and look for me.’

Hamlet screamed impatiently.

‘Ok, that’s a wrap,’ said Denise as she stood up. ‘Feel free to bring your coconut with you.’

Everyone quickly got up and left the town hall.

The next evening, everyone gathered in the Downs Agriculture Zone. The recent flow of money from Tiberius’ account and the money gifted by Walter meant everyone could afford the exorbitant opening night price for Frank’s greatest musical.

Orcilla, Daily, Yassmay, and Yassme had just arrived and were about to take their seats in the tenth row. Polly rushed over to Orcilla. She seemed deeply concerned. 

‘Are you here to watch the most anticipated musical in history?’ asked Orcilla.

‘Yes, sure,’ said Polly as she handed Orcilla a printout. ‘I have some concerning news. I took Hender’s coconut and ran a DNA test.’

‘This doesn’t matter,’ said Orcilla firmly. ‘He’s not who he’s related to. Nobody should be judged on that.’

‘It’s just that he’s playing such an important role in reshaping our society,’ said Polly. 

‘Destroy this,’ said Orcilla. ‘It doesn’t matter. He should only be judged on his own actions.’

‘Yes, that seems fair,’ replied Polly, smiling slightly. A small flame came out of her finger, and she burnt the paper.

‘The electronic files too,’ said Orcilla.

‘Of course,’ replied Polly.

The little miracles walked up on stage and began to sing the theme song of the musical. A few moments later, Frank strutted up on stage. He was wearing his famous red outfit and his massive red wig. For a few seconds, he performed a little dance, and then he turned to signal to the little miracles to stop singing.

‘Are you ready for the greatest night of your lives?’ shouted Frank as he jumped up and down while looking at the massive audience.

‘Yeah!’ roared the audience; this was followed by a deafening ‘Frank’ chant.

‘So it begins!’ shouted Frank as he dropped to his knees. A few moments later, he flapped his arms frantically and then leapt off the stage.

The music blared out, and the greatest musical began.

Three hours later, the greatest musical ended to ecstatic roars from the audience. A few minutes later, the cast walked back on stage, and the audience erupted in ecstatic roars of joy again.

Yassme pulled Orcilla’s arm. Then she pointed at Walter and RJ, who were dancing joyously together.

‘It’s the power of the greatest musical,’ shouted Orcilla as she pointed at the several dozen Sapiods who had managed to climb the perimeter wall to watch the musical. ‘I feel everything has changed. We’re going to make it.’

Frank jogged onto the stage while shooing the cast to the back of the stage so that he could become the focus of the applause. Then he started skipping joyously. He was holding a small box in one hand and a microphone in the other.

After another five minutes, the deafening applause finally died down. 

‘You loved it!’ shouted Frank. ‘How could you not love the greatest masterpiece ever?’

The audience clapped but less enthusiastically.

‘I can’t take all the credit,’ chuckled Frank. ‘Well, maybe ninety-five percent of the credit. This lot here deserves four percent,’ added Frank as he pointed at the cast and then the crew. ‘The final one percent belongs to my wonderful Shamia. Come forward, let them see you.’

Shamia walked through the cast and to the front of the stage, where Frank had dropped to one knee.

‘Oh Frank!’ said Shamia as she clapped her hands in joy. ‘Is this the day?’

‘A sham marriage is the final step on my journey to theatrical godhood,’ said Frank enthusiastically as he opened the box to reveal a large ring lolly.

‘That’s amazing!’ gasped Shamia.

‘Just say it!’ said Frank as he turned to stare at the audience.

‘The answer is no,’ replied Shamia, shaking her head. ‘I have someone else in my life.’

Homer skipped to the front of the stage and grabbed Shamia. ‘That’s me, arsehole,’ chuckled Homer. He kissed Shamia on the lips and then blew raspberries at Frank.

Frank’s mouth dropped open in shock. The audience roared in laughter. 

Shamia shapeshifted into Leticia. ‘We fooled you,’ said Homer and Leticia together.

Frank stood up and screamed. He turned around to leave the stage, but the real Shamia was standing in his way.

‘Are you serious?’ asked Shamia.

‘It would be great for both our careers,’ said Frank nervously. ‘Yours in particular.’

Shamia turned around and walked away.

‘You will shine in my stardom,’ shouted Frank as he chased after her. ‘You’ll be known forever as Frank’s wife. Please, don’t go.’

The audience cheered in excitement as the two of them ran off. The little miracles returned to the stage to sing one final song.

‘Was that scripted or for real?’ asked Denise as she looked at Vulay.

‘I think it was a marketing stunt to get us to buy tickets to the next show,’ replied Vulay. ‘Surely he can’t be that dense.’

‘Maybe he is or maybe he isn’t,’ giggled Denise as she looked at Vulay. ‘There’s only one way to know for sure.’

Vulay looked around, and she could see everyone buying tickets for the next show. ‘Fine, let’s find out.’

Vulay opened her phone to buy tickets for the next show. ‘Okay, I got us tickets,’ sighed Vulay. ‘It was selling out fast. We’re back in row three hundred and thirty-three.’

Introduction

Hello everyone, @glecerioberto here, and welcome to today's #TravelDigest! Today we have an amazing selection of destinations from around the globe. Our Top 3 posts lead us along a beautiful coastal path in Norway, a relaxing beach walk in Málaga, Spain, and a historic forest escape in Serbia. Over in our Honorable Mentions, we have more fantastic spots from Venezuela, Alaska, and Pakistan. Take a moment to browse through these wonderful entries and show some love to our travelers. Cheers!

All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today

🥇 Walking the second section of the Coastal Path in Kristiansand, Norway by @digi-me

Last year I walked the first part of The Coastal Path / «Kyststien» in Kristiansand, Norway. This coastal trail are devided into stages, so that you can do one part and continue later. What I know, is that the currently trail consists of 9 stages, with a total of 126 kilometers. The whole route is marked with signs making it easy to follow. I started with the first stage (orange on the map). It is close to where I live, making it was an easy afternoon walk. My plan was to do the whole trail last fall. Due to being abroad for several months, and a winter with lots of snow, I decided to wait until spring. Last week I completed the second stage.

🥈 A blue experience, with the sounds of the sea – El Palo Beach, East End 📷 Málaga – Spain by @avdesing

Every part of the city has its own special charm; each one is distinct from the others, and the same goes for the beaches. Each has its own particular and unique style that sets it apart from the rest. Of course, you have to pay attention to the details. I think what makes each beach unique, out of the many there are, is not just the colour of the sand, but the neighbourhood to which it belongs.

Having said so much about my job, I would like to delve into the topic of the prompt which is all about , “Will your job exist in ten years?”

However, I believe that there's no amount of technological advancements that can replace the work of a teacher and this is because of the fact that there will always be someone in charge of the machine giving instructions to the machine on how things are to be done. So, if there's a person in the charge of the machine giving instructions on what the machine will be doing in other to meet the demand of the students who are yet hungry for knowledge, that means no technology advancements would be able to take the full control and responsibility of a teacher in the next ten years which simply means, the teaching job will still be in existence in the next ten or eternity years.

The only thing needed by the teachers is to get themselves improved and upgraded so as to be able to meet up with what transformation that the advancements in technology might bring to the teaching profession or job and by this nothing will be able to replace them and the legacy of the job would be kind of protected till the end of the ages.

title.title: One caterpillar started it all :)
title.body: Yesterday I found this little cutie on an duke cherry tree while I was picking and eating them, staining my hands red with their rich juice. Then I noticed this colorful little creature, all curled up there, looking almost like a tiny snake with its beautiful patterns. When I was a kid, I loved caterpillars and lizards. I have no idea where that combination came from, but I remember being fascinated by the way they looked. I used to hold caterpillars in my hand quite often because catching a lizard was almost impossible. xD Over time, people change, or maybe develop new fears, and the same happened to me. These days, I wouldn't touch it with my finger at all. I'd only move it with a leaf or a thin little twig, so I wouldn't hurt it.
alt=\

/>I loved the way this caterpillar posed and it immediately awakened the crazy photographer in me. So I started snapping photos all around the yard and ended up capturing this little half-bloomed pink flower. There were fully bloomed ones as well, but this one somehow stood out from others, which made it all the more interesting to me. Then I continued taking photos, but in a bit of a hurry because the wind had started to pick up and rain clouds were slowly rolling across what had been a clear sky until that moment. So, as you can probably guess, the rest of yesterday's photos of plants and insects ended up in the trash bin. Honestly, I don't know why that distracted me so much. I'm not made of sugar - I'm not going to melt; pluuus I actually love the rain. I think I was more concerned about putting my phone away. It's still fairly new, so I'm a bit more careful with it. (: I wonder how long that phase lasts these days when it comes to devices like that, especially in 2026 and particularly among kids who have grown up with a big portable screen by their side from a very early age.
alt=\
/>Just as I ran to the covered terrace in front of our house to escape the rain, the drizzle stopped, and this little \

came outside looking for a victim to throw a ball for her. And yes, I call her a monster for a reason. She is smart, but she's also quite cheeky and sometimes incredibly demanding, which can be a bit too much for us anxious types. That's just her breed, I know, and we loooove her, but she is craaaazy girl. 😁 With all that energy, she really seems like the kind of dog that should be out in nature, running free, hunting alongside hunters and enjoying the outdoors. Maybe I'm talking nonsense because I don't know that much about dog breeds, but judging by her personality and behavior, that's the impression I get. There's no way she'd let a single pheasant get away from her, if only that leash were a little longer, or better yet, if there were no leash at all. (:
alt=\

/>This photo isn't exactly the best quality; I only realized that after uploading it, but it would be a shame not to include it and let her wave hello to you all with that goofy grin and tongue hanging almost to the floor after completely wearing herself out chasing her favorite yellow ball.

Aww-awww and bye-bye until tomorrow... or the day after.

Wishing you all a lovely day. 🤗

田哥前天莫名其妙来找我，我们很久没联系了，自从我断掉网络社交之后很多人都没有找过我了，我以为有什么事，结果是想找我帮他妹妹解几道题。

And if that mango is perfectly ripe, But that's not the point! The feeling of eating a ripe mango is not limited to just eating a fruit, it's like a nostalgia, an absolute celebration. The photo you shared is mouth-watering. The perfectly cut mango slices arranged in a steel bowl seem to capture the true beauty of summer. These pieces, made with a blend of dark yellow and orange, are juicy and sweet. Each bite of this mango, soft as stringy butter, creates a heavenly taste in the mouth. The familiar feeling of eating mangoes The joy of eating ripe mangoes begins with their intense and sweet aroma. As soon as you pick a mango, the sweet smell that spreads to every corner of the house instantly makes you feel good. Then, when that juicy piece is put in the mouth, the mouth fills with sweet juice. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcqQq2QMMEPoAJmARZejp13ZEVjKGnYd5J9VE6A5Lvhgf/1780414034264.jpg) Some people like to cut up mangoes and eat them, just like in the picture, while others like to suck on the whole mango.
