title.title: 10 million trees 🌱 🌳 10 millones de árboles
title.body:
I don't know if this is happening in all countries of planet Earth, but the last two months in Venezuela we've had extremely high temperatures. The heat is intense, and during the hours when the sun is at its peak, you can almost feel the steam in the air. >*No sé si está sucediendo en todos los países del planeta tierra, pero los dos últimos meses en Venezuela hemos tenido unas temperaturas altísimas. El calor está muy fuerte, y en las horas cuando el sol está en su apogeo, hasta se siente un vapor en el aire.*
![IMG_20260518_105915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/243WRoXmvAkCn3frtKjmZvrymSNP2eAhn8JLnuypXmmt6L8Ru29MmakiEJJ95okSqgfGo.jpg)
We've all heard about climate change. For at least the last 30 years, this topic has been making headlines around the world, featured at environmental conferences, and discussed at countless conservation events. It has been identified as a consequence of global environmental degradation, and extreme heat, for example, is one of the most serious problems that has emerged. >*Todos hemos oído hablar del cambio climático. Por lo menos durante los últimos 30 años, este tema ha estado en los titulares de los medios alrededor del mundo, en congresos ambientales y miles de eventos conservacionistas. Se lo ha señalado como la consecuencia del deterioro ambiental a nivel mundial, y por ejemplo, el calor extremo es una de las problemáticas más graves que ha surgido.*
![IMG_20260518_104422A.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23zGeseA91r6xMnbyvM1vKmrt8jVnevLjJMhxCVmyWBCFcbs6riSTngjdCXw5cEX7dAwr.jpg)
Recently, here in Venezuela, the state environmental agencies launched a national campaign with the goal of planting 10 million trees across the country by 2026. People can register on a website to volunteer in the different activities and events, or they can also participate through environmental organizations in their community. >*Hace poco, aquí en Venezuela, las instituciones de ambiente del Estado lanzaron una campaña nacional con el objetivo de sembrar durante 2026, 10 millones de árboles por todo el país. Las personas se pueden registrar en una página web para ser voluntarios en las diferentes actividades y jornadas, o también pueden participar a través de las organizaciones ambientales de su comunidad.*
![IMG_20251121_104318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23xVH5obgkiGPL2jjb7yoYTcHPop2ASPzBAwkyJ1Jh7onQQbSXHZDRVoxr8T8fH9gVLJG.jpg)
![IMG_20251121_104329A.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23xATpcXAc5juVRaWGNztgQjK6n3HsfMbrLnVwMvQYPqxsHi9D8gpzoAQMB2QiJYzz2sZ.jpg)
The figure may sound ambitious at first, but I believe it is possible to achieve this goal. Venezuela has a population of approximately 28 million, and if only 10% of the population participated in the plan, with each person planting several trees, it could be done. I'm always optimistic 😃. >*La cifra puede sonar ambiciosa en un principio, pero creo que sí es posible alcanzar este objetivo. Venezuela tiene una población aproximada de 28 millones de habitantes, y si tan sólo participaran en el plan, digamos el 10% de la población, plantando cada persona varios ejemplares, se logra. Siempre soy optimista 😃.*
![DSCF8654.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EqFsQsZBvhasN7YWxpyf62UbjiS46iXxnZCrJwvstDXxCczEURmbFcsNHDL68Z9ESqB.JPG)
This initiative is being implemented in towns and cities, as well as in protected areas. The species that are prioritized for planting in the different spaces are fruit trees, medicinal plants and trees such as Araguaney (Handroanthus chrysanthus), Chaguaramo (Roystonea oleracea) and Flamboyan (Delonix regia). >*Esta iniciativa se está ejecutando tanto en los pueblos y ciudades, como en las zonas protegidas. Las especies que se priorizan para plantar en los diferentes espacios son las frutales, medicinales y árboles como Araguaneyes, Chaguaramos y Flamboyanes.*
![SAVE_20250807_104900.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EoyMfRmTKvFU7fQmHwc3PPhB1JfwDRdto9oXf3nBvytUmCCcxpUrhfdFGDZAWfh3bcm.jpg)
Me, walking across a bridge surrounded by trees. Photo taken by @gatubela / Yo, caminando por un puente rodeado de árboles. Foto tomada por @gatubela
![IMG_20230221_094838A.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23wqnsdHSwHVkpJj7Np1JAcSGJQ3WK251EcU797Qr5WPzYbnTogxyG2tMUh8DzQfTiYTV.jpg)
Trees not only beautify the environment, but they also lower the temperature and provide habitat for many species. I've participated in reforestation efforts several times, and this time I'm going to do my part for the environment too 😉. >*Los árboles no sólo embellecen el entorno, también bajan la temperatura y son hábitat de muchas especies. He participado varias veces en jornadas de reforestación, y esta vez también voy a hacer mi aporte por el ambiente 😉.*

title.title: Monomad: Bee Macro
title.body:
I find that bees are one of the more macro-friendly insects. If you give them time and space and let them keep at their work, they won't bother you and will more often than not slow down at some point as they gather pollen and give you an opportunity to get some great macros. I also enjoy how furry they are, so in a way, they tend to be cuter than most insects. For monochrome bees like this one, they have some nice contrast as they are a great mix of light and dark so the details are still there without color.

title.title: My 55th HIVE Power Up Day ⚡🔋— May in WOO: Stories, Recovery, and Looking Ahead
title.body:
![power up day.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/242NakELaNWYfhAoAWj2qzRoTrJYUSwzZtzA9eGD1rG4qVjwdpNRcpTXeotXGq92Ph5Qt.png)

HELLO June 2026! 

It's the 1st day of the month and that means it's HIVE Power Up Day again! 🎉🚀 Just like that, **THE FIRST 6 MONTHS** of the year of **2026** has gone past us already! 😱⌛️ 

The past month in crypto felt like a continuation of the battle between hopeful bulls and a market that just could not quite find its footing.

Bitcoin spent much of May trying to reclaim and hold the $80,000 level. At the start of the month, things were looking reasonably constructive with BTC briefly pushing above $80K and ETF assets remaining substantial. Unfortunately, inflation concerns, ETF outflows, and renewed geopolitical tensions gradually sucked the momentum out of the market. By the second half of May, Bitcoin had slipped back into the mid-to-high $70K range before falling further toward the low $70Ks as traders moved into a more defensive stance. Ethereum followed a similar path and generally underperformed Bitcoin, while many altcoins suffered even larger percentage declines. The overall feeling throughout May was that every rally attempt was being sold into rather than chased higher.

What about our very own HIVE? May was another difficult month. HIVE spent much of the month trading around the $0.06 region and remained under pressure alongside the broader altcoin market. This continues the longer term weakness that has been in place since late 2025.

Regardless, I still remain bullish on the long term future of BTC and HIVE. Is this the last opportunity to accumulate more at current prices before it moons beyond no return? Who knows? I believe in the long term and will stick to my regular DCA regardless. 😜📈🚀

*Another month in this year has gone by in a flash! I've joined HIVE since November 2021 and I'm still learning so many new things everyday! I first heard of Hive Power Up Day in January 2022 and all its other acronyms (PUD, PUM, PUH 😂 what a mouthful) and I've participated in HPUD every month since then!*




<center>![hive dividers-12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23t7DF2XUuZsrnxbM3bkiL8r3fbP85LddiyhFBRNXAHqHhEJ3eYVVpuqHnEhi3W73XyLv.png)</center>




<div class=\

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/AK2EgCwtb9LnEA65T3oihkj42xseCK6xaitsGx9zv6kCaLT3rob5Ggy9fjY3T8g.png - I've attained yet another PUM badge for the month! 📅🥳 (at least 1 post/powerup everyday!). *Ever since I started with the HPUM initiative in 2022, I've tried my best to faithfully make one blog post everyday in an attempt to get the Hive Power Up Month badge. I've managed to make it successfully for 9 out of 12 months in 2022, and then improved on it in 2023 with 10 out of 12 months! 2024 saw a similar 10/12 but I managed to improve it to an almost perfect 11/12 in 2025! (Yikes! So near yet so far 😂) I will be attempting to get as many as I can again (perhaps a perfect score?) in 2026! 🥳💯* ---

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23u5ZheLjrPD6rTy5JgrMj8RoMmSbFANKiN2dVH9DEckBjkktT7kvuXifpfdZ1RbJzxB1.png) Another successful month of making at least ONE post a day with 100% to HIVE powered up (or powering up 1 HIVE). 🥳 This makes it 5 months (thus far) where I managed this achievement IN THIS NEW year of 2026. *Blogging regularly and having the HPUM to incentivize me has other tangible benefits too! I've seen my Hive Power grow quite a fair bit. This seems like a good practice which I intend to continue keeping up with!* ---

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23tvAZjzM2e1Rxq331XzzLSgjqsshuVVxdPnKrSN4GcpCRicmTdinxrAdc1QxKFLHqbMv.png *In my VERY FIRST month before before I ever heard about Hive Power Up Day/Month, I was at just 47 HP 😭 (Before Jan 1st 2022).* ---

> ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23uExBUg454HTxVW5ZFcR96vJLJDbq1sAd8L5nF1sQeEXshNeoM5dAKdZVhWdSNnt3bvD.png) This month, before I've even powered up anything at all, I'm already at 23,522.770 HP! 🎉🎉🎉 That's how consistent blogging on HIVE, with (mostly) 100% allocated to Hive Power, improved my HIVE account! ---

> ![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23vhRXrqnd5BafiQ9W6fcgxuFgE5fHGCjBQA9VMKDTZtzCwmJauJEPH631fZ6u71c6P8E.png) And NOW... AND its POWERUP time! ⚡️💪 (1st JUNE 2026) Once again, I only have enough HIVE set aside for a 10HP powerup, but I'm sure with my continued efforts to blog with 100% powered up to HIVE, I will be able to grow my Hive Power even more! ---

> ![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23t76thQGWNv7F5yqyGbZt8xVP487KxWm615t5AQYJsZFbde8K49TsQTVCGc6KesLrXfD.png) *Using https://hivestats.io/, I was able to pull out a chart showing my daily account growth for the past month too. Great to see that orange graph head upwards continually 📈😄! If only my stocks portfolio and the price of HIVE looked like that too 😂🤑.* --- 💰💰💰💸💸💸🤑🤑🤑📈📈📈 As always, I usually make just the minimum powerup of 10 HIVE. This is because there are so many projects that I'm now invested in. The HIVE ecosystem is so much bigger than what I had thought it was when I first joined. I believe my constant allocation of most of my daily posts being 100% powered up is sufficient to grow my Hive Power daily. The rest of any funds from HIVE will usually be kept for other projects that are of interest to me (on HIVE of course 😁). As always, I'll like to explain that the reason why I do not powerup every single bit of HIVE/HBD I get every month from my blogging is because I like to keep some liquidity around to invest in HIVE projects that I feel have some potential.
![hive dividers-12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23t7DF2XUuZsrnxbM3bkiL8r3fbP85LddiyhFBRNXAHqHhEJ3eYVVpuqHnEhi3W73XyLv.png)
It is no secret by now that quite a bit of my extra funds lying around HIVE has been channelled into the Wrestling Organization Online aka WOO project! 🤑 ![Partner_WOO_LOGO_-_light.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/EoK5mqe7Ahj3u5JbwkWxxAaWBpFCcDnBu8KC5rTs4dkNWnqwFMUrFi1sWWhpgiRDXMw.png) *After months of talking about WOO during my HPUD posts, I am glad to say that WOO has FINALLY launched the game proper! All players can use their WOO assets, play the game, and earn $WOO tokens. The game has not yet exploded in terms of player numbers since it is so new, but there are already launch campaigns to give it the boost it needs!* May was one of those months that reminded me that WOO is about much more than just events, matches, and rewards. A big part of the conversation revolved around Perry Saturn, both his ongoing recovery and the content being created around his incredible wrestling career. Through the Shootin’ with Saturn series and other video projects, WOO continued its mission of preserving wrestling history by giving veterans a platform to tell their stories in their own words. As fans, we got to hear first hand accounts from someone who lived through the territory days, ECW, WCW, and WWE. Those stories are the kind of thing that cannot be recreated from a Wikipedia page or a wrestling documentary. They come from experience, and WOO has been doing a great job making sure those experiences are not lost. At the same time, May also felt like a month focused on community and relationships. There was plenty of discussion about Perry’s recovery journey and the support shown by members of the WOO community. It served as a reminder that the people behind WOO are not just usernames on a screen. They are real people who genuinely care about one another. While there may not have been a constant stream of weekend events or major announcements, there was still a lot happening beneath the surface. Between new content, community engagement, and the continued effort to connect wrestling fans to the wider Hive ecosystem, May felt like a month spent strengthening the foundation that WOO has been building for years.
![hive dividers-12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23t7DF2XUuZsrnxbM3bkiL8r3fbP85LddiyhFBRNXAHqHhEJ3eYVVpuqHnEhi3W73XyLv.png)
*I'll see you all again during the next Power Up Day next month with another update! Till then, See you and WAGMI! 💎🙌🏻🦍💪🏻* ---

title.title: Rockford Art Museum
title.body:
Greetings!

Rockford is the 5th largest city in Illinois and is located in the north, near the border to Wisconsin. On a recent 2026 trip, I visited the Rockford Art Museum as well as the Burpee Museum of Natural History. This post is about the art museum.

Since Rockford is neither in downtown Chicago or the outlying suburbs, for organizational purposes I suppose I would roughly group northern Illinois with central Illinois in terms of distance to Chicago.

Other posts I have made for those areas include:

H1: [Peoria Zoo](https://peakd.com/travel/@byzantinecat/peoria-zoo)

H2: [Miller Park Zoo](https://peakd.com/travel/@byzantinecat/miller-park-zoo)

H3: [Scovill Zoo](https://peakd.com/travel/@byzantinecat/scovill-zoo)

H4: Rockford Art Museum (this post)

And upcoming posts include:

- Krannert Art Museum in Urbana-Champaign, IL
- Spurlock Museum of World Cultures in Urbana-Champaign, IL
- Japan House Gardens & Illini Union Art Gallery in Urbana-Champaign, IL
- Burpee Museum of Natural History in Rockford, IL

All of the pictures in this post were taken by me. If you want to use any of my photos, please contact me to first obtain permission. Of course the copyrights to the art itself belongs to the appropriate artists, who I have credited/referenced. If any artists want me to remove images of their work, I will do so.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

![20260321_141215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/byzantinecat/Eos1FvmyV7voWGvtVXKtg7NGGpsCYqBS3Ngbin82Eodqy9m6p9z5RN4yktj2AZJcAHy.jpg)

![20260321_141232.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/byzantinecat/EoAaJiCqfG8G7wKxR6u7bbmHF76TMpuTxw8efHWdYQKgM9BMwHk9ugES5fCWxVWP1UL.jpg)

**ROCKFORD ART MUSEUM**

711 North Main St
Rockford, IL 61103

**Website:** https://rockfordartmuseum.org/

**Hours:**

Thursday - Sunday: 10 AM - 5 PM

Closed on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday.

**Cost (as of 2026): FREE!**

**Estimated Time:** 30 - 45 minutes.

I spent 40 minutes going through the small local art museum.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

**SUMMARY**

The Rockford Art Museum is a small but free local art museum. The first floor hosts the museum's permanent collection. There is one large gallery space (which you can see in the first two pictures of the post) along with a smaller side room with some additional pieces. There is also a downstairs gallery (broken down into 2-4 sections) which seems to be mainly used for special exhibits.

Most of the artwork is contemporary (i.e. from the 20th or 21st centuries) with a handful of modern pieces from the early 1920's. It's a fairly small museum that you can easily walk through in less than an hour - more likely in about half an hour.

On my visit, the bottom level showcased art by local high school students. Some museum patrons may find it refreshing to see developing talent while other visitors might feel it's not up to their artistic standards. Since I like cute animals, I did appreciate that many of the high school artists had animals as their subject matter.

I would rate the museum at 2 stars. Since it's free, it's worth a look if you are in the area and have some free time. But given its small size and limited scope, it probably wouldn't be worth it if there was an admission cost (i.e. if it was paid admission it would probably be closer to 1 star).

Here is how I would compare the Rockford Art Museum to other art museums:

5 stars: 
- Art Institute of Chicago (Chicago, IL)
- Castello Sforzesco (Milan, Italy)
- Philadelphia Museum of Art (Philadelphia, PA)
- Sydney and Walda Besthoff Sculpture Garden (New Orleans, LA, Free)

4 stars: 
- The Ringling (Sarasota, FL)
- Musée des Beaux-Arts de Nice (Nice, France)
- Musée Masséna (Nice, France)
- Musei di Strada Nuova (Genoa, Italy)
- Villa del Principe (Genoa, Italy)
- Pinacoteca Ambrosiana (Milan, Italy)
- Rodin Museum (Philadelphia, PA)
- Indianapolis Museum of Art (Indianapolis, IN)
- San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (San Francisco, CA)
- Legion of Honor (San Francisco, CA)

3 stars: 
- Musée Matisse (Nice, France)
- Palais Lascaris (Nice, France)
- Musée Picasso (Antibes, France)
- Museo Diocesano (Genoa, Italy)
- Triton Museum of Art (Santa Clara, CA, Free)
- de Young Museum (San Francisco, CA)
- High Museum of Art (Atlanta, GA)
- New Orleans Museum of Art (New Orleans, LA)

2 stars: 
- Museum of Contemporary Photography (Chicago, IL, Free)
- Design Museum of Chicago (Chicago, IL, Free)
- Musée de la Photographie Charles Nègre (Nice, France)
- L'artistique (Nice, France, Free)
- Musée Peynet et du Dessin Humoristique (Antibes, France)
- Museo di Sant'Agostino (Genoa, Italy)
- Museo del Novecento (Milan, Italy)
- San Jose Museum of Art (San Jose, CA)
- **Rockford Art Museum (Rockford, IL, Free)**

-----------------------------------------------------------------

**PERMANENT COLLECTION**

**The Juggler***, 2010*

**David J. Foster**

This sculpture is outside the building and technically belongs to the neighboring Discovery Center Museum.

![20260321_140610.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/byzantinecat/245miBGNRN7ZFBSSyB8rSd3TPoTXXnkwbXRHuZES5FfkVADDff4JzCnZon4MaPfBEPH61.jpg)

**Yellow Behr***, 2014*
*Welded found steel*

**Deborah Butterfield**
*American, b. 1949*

*Deborah Butterfield first began creating sculpture in the form of a horse in the 1970s using mud, clay and sticks. In 1977, she moved to a ranch in Montana and in 1979 began using scrap metal and found steel. Later, she began making bronze work, cast from \

Born and raised in San Diego, Butterfield received her BA and MFA from the University of California, Davis. From the mid-1970s through the mid-1980s, she taught sculpture at the University of Wisconsin Madison, and at Montana State University, Bozeman. Since 1976, she has exhibited extensively with more than 50 solo shows at major museums across the country.* 

A NOTE FROM THE DONORS —

*We selected this sculpture to donate to Rockford Art Museum for several reasons. First, the artist, Deborah Butterfield, ranks amongst the top sculptors of our day. Her work is owned by over 100 museums, including some of America's most prestigious; New York's Metropolitan and Whitney, Washington's Hirschhorn, Chicago's Contemporary, and Art Institute, to mention a few. Her work has been acquired by a myriad of America's foremost collectors. Secon the horse is an object all ages can relate to. Third, her ability to use found objects to achieve elegant results is inspirational to art admirers, artists and would be artists. Fourth, the material in this sculpture, like many of her welded horses, came from Joseph Behr & Sons, a scrap yard in Rockford, IL. Finally, in an era where recycling is regarded as essential, what better use of obsolete material to produce a truly beautiful object?* 

*Gift of Lon and Richard Behr*

(I had to line up the right shot to get the camel in the background with the horse in the foreground!)

title.title: La primera reunión en el edificio - Historia [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
Los cuatro seguían parados en ese gran aeropuerto, pero ese hombre que miraron con cada paso que daba parecería acercarse más a ellos. Michelle se asustó y comento —¿Lo conocen? —, nadie respondió y el hombre siguió acercándose, sonreía y hacía que todo pareciera más extraño. Cuando finalmente llegó a ese mismo lugar, el hombre en voz alta dijo —Buenas tardes, bienvenidos a Inglaterra.— Los cuatro se quedaron sorprendidos, ya que primero que nada hablaba en español, la cual fue un gran alivio, puesto que pensaron que ese hombre los podía ayudar. Así que cada uno le dio la mano para saludarlo y el hombre se presentó —Mi nombre es Richard, soy el representante de la banda que los invitó.— esas palabras fueron de gran impacto y la Banda pasó de estar preocupada a estar feliz, ya que esa era la persona indicada para seguir con la aventura. Todos comenzaron a caminar y mientras avanzaban Richard les explicó que la banda que los había llamado era la más importante de Inglaterra, sus conciertos eran de miles de personas, sus canciones sonaban en todo el mundo y tiene muchos años trabajando juntos como banda. Con todo eso sentía más la emoción y Michelle dijo —Tomamos la mejor decisión— >The four of them were still standing in that huge airport, but the man they watched with every step he took seemed to be getting closer to them. Michelle got scared and asked, “Do you know him?” No one answered, and the man kept coming closer, smiling and making everything seem even stranger. When he finally reached them, the man said loudly, “Good afternoon, welcome to England.” # >The four of them were surprised, since first of all he was speaking Spanish, which was a huge relief, as they thought this man might be able to help them. So each of them shook his hand to greet him, and the man introduced himself: “My name is Richard; I’m the manager of the band that invited you.” Those words had a huge impact, and the band went from being worried to being happy, since he was the right person to continue the adventure with. # >Everyone started walking, and as they went, Richard explained that the band that had called them was the biggest in England; their concerts drew thousands of people, their songs were played all over the world, and they’d been working together as a band for many years. Hearing all that made them feel even more excited, and Michelle said, “We made the best decision.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWghkzfFgnkvVaiBaAwPbpXS8vumWmsAoLksb6e7tzotx/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/gente-ordenador-portatil-oficina-trabajando-4872026/) Finalmente, salieron del aeropuerto y afuera todo era distinto, pero no podía conocer más, ya que los esperaba una camioneta, Richard abrió la puerta y todos se subieron. Después de varios minutos de viaje, la camioneta llegó a una parte donde estaba un gran edificio de vidrio, siendo muy grande y toda la banda quedó sorprendida y Lucas pregunto —¿Qué es lugar? — Al llegar a ese lugar había muchas personas caminaban de un lado a otro, otros cargaban equipos, otros revisaban documentos, además toda la banda sintió nervios, pero Richard se bajó primero y dijo —¿Listos para conocer el comienzo de su nueva historia?— toda la banda se paró frente a la gran puerta de vidrio y comprendieron que la aventura apenas estaba comenzando. >Finally, they left the airport, and everything outside looked different, but he couldn’t take it all in, since a van was waiting for them. Richard opened the door, and everyone got in. After a few minutes’ drive, the van arrived at a spot where there was a huge glass building. It was massive, and the whole group was surprised. Lucas asked, “What is this place?” # >When they arrived at that place, there were many people walking back and forth; some were carrying equipment, others were checking documents. The whole band felt nervous, but Richard got out first and said, “Ready to see the beginning of your new story?” The whole band stood in front of the large glass door and realized that the adventure was just beginning. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVsApEtp1LEXjuKisrrriYLMQdJmNw38R4rmEUbFPJtNP/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/vista-arquitectonica-del-centro-historico-de-houston-33189409/)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

title.title: We Need to Stop Glorifying the Hustle
title.body:
I burned out at 24.

Not the kind of tired where you sleep and wake up fine. The kind where you wake up and just stare at the ceiling and feel absolutely nothing. No motivation, no excitement, no sense of direction. Just empty. Like something inside quietly switched off without telling you.

And the worst part is i was proud of myself right before it happened.

I was working long hours, sleeping less, skipping meals, telling myself this is what it takes. Every time someone asked how i was doing i said busy like it was a badge of honour. Because that is what we were taught right. The grind is the goal. Sleep is for people who are not serious. Rest is something you earn after you make it.

Nobody told me that you could work yourself into the ground and still have nothing to show for it except a broken body and a tired mind.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPLFh3mq1AbhUuLQmSszmLrdsTgXQeATgU8bE1jHVvraT/1780411862026.jpg)
[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-in-blue-shirt-sitting-by-the-table-_PXtCCQ4Dj0)

The hustle culture thing is everywhere now. Social media is full of it. Wake up at 4am. No days off. Sacrifice everything. And i get it, the idea sounds powerful. It sounds like discipline and strength. But a lot of it is just noise from people performing productivity for an audience while quietly falling apart behind the screen.

Real life is not a motivational video.

I know people who hustled for years and ended up sick, alone, estranged from their kids, missing funerals and birthdays for work that never loved them back. And society looks at those people and still calls them dedicated. We romanticise the sacrifice without asking what was actually lost.

Hard work is real and necessary. I still believe that. But there is a difference between working hard with purpose and just staying busy because stopping feels like failure. A lot of people are running and do not even remember what they were running towards.

Rest is not laziness. Taking a break does not mean you gave up. Protecting your peace is not weakness. These are things nobody says loud enough.

You are not a machine. You were not put here just to produce and perform until you collapse.

The grind will always be there. But you only get one body, one mind and one life.

At some point you have to ask yourself if the hustle is building your life or just consuming it.

>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

I always enjoy looking back at some of the photos I’ve taken, and I usually come across ones I like that I didn’t edit at the time. Today, I want to share some photos I took of my girlfriend at the beach; I hope you enjoy them as much as I do.

Siempre me gusta revisar algunas de las fotografías que he hecho y normalmente me encuentro fotografías que me gustan y que en su momento no edité, y el día de hoy quiero compartirles algunas fotografías que le hice a mi novia en la playa; espero que las disfruten tanto como yo.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tbrybhABjmkrP8RFstKn4XunwYbKfFEDGCqdfwMTt6HH8AGFCSjxAsjH46oSBZSVz6T.jpg

>

This was the first time I did a photo shoot on the beach, and of course it had to be with my girlfriend; plus, since it’s such a light-filled place, it really helped make the setting more striking, creating some beautiful shadows that add a striking contrast.

Esta fue la primera vez que hice una sesión de fotos en la playa y evidentemente tenía que ser con mi novia; además, al ser un lugar tan lleno de luz, ayudó bastante a que el entorno sea más llamativo, generando así unas sombras muy bonitas y que generan un contraste llamativo.

title.title: Valencia Opera House
title.body: Born just outside Valencia, architect Santiago Calatrava was already a superstar when he started work on the Palau de les Arts Reina Sofía, one of many buildings which comprise the City of Arts and Sciences. Before turning his sights back on his Valencian homeland, he had finished the <a href=\

>Auditorio de Tenerife, The Lyon Airport Railway Station, the Turning Torso skyscraper in Malmö, winning wide praise and a reputation as a maverick, able to pull off wild new ideas with a futuristic, unique flair.\n\n
width=\
height=\

/>\n\nIf you’re a frequent reader of our blog, you might know that we have complicated feelings about Calatrava’s work. We’re far from groupies, but somehow we find ourselves in places where he’s already left a mark. Oviedo (the
>Palacio de Congresos), New York City (the
>World Trade Center Transportation Hub), Lisbon (the
>Gare do Oriente), and most recently Mons, Belgium (the

>new train station). His creations are always a spectacle and each project has its fair share of drama as well. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ReZulsiHER4 And we’re here for the drama! Calatrava is notorious for going over budget and for the opera, he stayed true to this reputation. The final tally was over four times the original budget. And while the white mosaic tiles were certainly striking, they were also capable of striking people: on windy days, they tended to fly off the opera house, and the entire facade had to be redone with a new binding material. The problems went so far, that Valencia dragged the architect in front of the courts. However, instead of learning from this experience, Valencia commissioned him for even more buildings in the

>City of Arts and Sciences: the Science Museum (rumors says he forget to plan in bathrooms) and the L’Àgora (whose minimal floor space makes it nearly impossible to use for any event). And then two more bridges! It seems like working with Calatrava is akin to addiction. Once you’re hooked, it’s hard to get away from him, despite the cost and hassle. Then again, the City of Arts and Sciences is estimated to generate over €100 million per year in revenue from tourism. And we understand why: the construction drama notwithstanding, this is an otherworldly place. The CAC is unlike any other “neighborhood” in the world, and has come in part to define Valencia in the eyes of the world. Wandering around the complex is stunning, especially during the sunset.
width=\
height=\

/> But to loop back to Calatrava’s Opera House, we had long admired its bizarre shape from the exterior — like a massive dragon’s egg just starting to hatch. But finally we had the chance to explore the interior, while attending a concert which was held at L’Auditori, one of four venues inside the complex. From the inside, it’s just as beautiful. Take a look at the photo gallery; we can say with some confidence that you’ve never seen an opera house quite like Valencia’s. From our

>Travel Blog.

>Los martes los voy a designar como mi día favorito, porque es el momento de mostrar mis nuevos electrodomésticos y motivarlos ¡A TODOS! Para que puedan también obtener los suyos 😍.
\n\n
>Cuando vino en marzo \

, que fue una iniciativa de los amigos de Cashea, otorgando beneficios con más cuotas y menos inicial de pago, yo aproveché para comprar algunos instrumentos necesarios y otros no tanto, pero como yo siempre digo: no sabía que los necesitaba hasta que los tuve, y no sabía cómo podía vivir mi vida sin ellos 😊. Entre estos últimos, les cuento que compré un exprimidor de jugo marca Milexus 💯.
\n\n>
>I'm going to designate Tuesdays as my favorite day because it's the time to show off my new appliances and motivate you ALL to get yours too! 😍\nWhen \

(The Harvest) came around in March—an initiative by our friends at Cashea offering benefits like longer installments and lower down payments—I took advantage of it to buy some essential items and others that weren't so necessary. But as I always say, I didn't know I needed them until I had them, and I didn't know how I could live without them 😊. Among the latter, I bought a Milexus brand juicer 💯.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-18 at 6.55.44 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23uFVzhdjwiJD8yxnnjt1XraSfiDpdHVv8psRPxmTusvPvuicm8i6RdbcEZAdML3Qmjmw.jpeg) ![Diseño sin título (29).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wXQYBvSRqMZjt9YLcsjH1EBKZYV2q3oiCZXnzvb2EjmM7tNZtS4mw91aw5cncdKBrNW.png)

>Para hablar de mi maravilloso exprimidor de jugo y cómo ha cambiado mi estilo de vida, tengo que colocarlos en contexto.
\n\n
>Uno de los consejos que sigo de la página de Cashea es precisamente saber \

. Pues, basado en ese consejo, yo no consumía jugo de naranja; solo cuando iba a algún restaurante a desayunar, que me gusta acompañar con este jugo. De resto, cada vez que iba al supermercado, podía comprar otras frutas, pero nunca naranja porque no tenía un exprimidor.
\n\n>

title.title: Splinterlands: End of Season Report Card!🔥
title.body: >\n\n
data-align=\

>Compared to the past several seasons, the most recent one has been quite boring. This wasn't because I lacked good cards, or simply because I suffered mostly defeats—although the latter is indeed true, it cannot be cited as the actual reason for the season's dullness. The real reason was that I was extremely busy with matters outside of the game this time around; consequently, I couldn't even play on most days. Furthermore, during the limited time I did play, I failed to perform well, which meant I couldn't advance beyond Tier 3 of the Gold League this season. All in all, I didn't really find any enjoyment in playing. Yet, despite playing for fewer days and feeling largely bored, I still managed to accumulate 42,000 Glints by the end of the season. This figure accounts for the cost of purchasing two sets of 10 Rare Draws—transactions I had made midway through the season. Additionally, when factoring in the earnings from the season-end loot, I successfully accumulated a total of 65,553 Glints this season. While this amount isn't quite enough for me to purchase a Legendary Draw—as I have done in the previous four seasons—it falls just short of the required sum. Therefore, in this new season, I will strive to bridge that gap within the next few days so that I can once again purchase a Legendary Draw.

\n\n
>
data-align=\

>Speaking of the leaderboard—as far as I recall, I finished somewhere in Tier 1 of the Silver League—so I’m not sure why the ranking system is currently displaying the Gold League. Looking at the scoreboard here, and seeing that I played 225 battles this season, you might be thinking, \

Well, my performance metrics provide the answer to that: whereas my win rate typically hovers between 50% and 55%, this time it dropped to just 45%. Despite playing 225 battles, I managed to win only 102 of them, suffering crushing defeats in all the rest. This was the primary reason why—partly due to personal circumstances limiting my playtime, and partly because the games I did play resulted in back-to-back losses—what was supposed to be fun began to feel like a chore. Thankfully, however, I managed to maintain my standing in Silver 1, which means that following the ranking reset, I will be starting off in Silver 3.

\n\n
>\n\n
data-align=\

>Now, let's talk about the upcoming—or rather, the current—season. First off, I plan to rent a few cards to enhance my gameplay. The very first of these is the Earth Element Archon, Elowen Sylphie. I have tested this Archon across several previous seasons, and its performance is truly exceptional; so, I will definitely be adding it to my lineup, while also looking out for other cards that align well with my strategy. In these initial days of the season, my primary objective is to accumulate 15,000 Glint so that I am ready to purchase a Legendary Draw. However, I am not entirely certain about purchasing a Legendary Draw; even if you manage to extract Legendary cards, the subsequent process of \

them is an extremely expensive undertaking—one that doesn't seem worth the cost to me at all. Consequently, I might decide against purchasing a Legendary Draw altogether; instead, if not Legendary, I will opt for Rare or Epic draws. Regardless of the choice, I will need to amass as much Glint as possible; to achieve this, I must quickly advance beyond the Silver League and climb into the Gold League, as the winning rewards in Silver III and II are simply not that substantial. By the end of this season, my goal is to earn 150,000 Glint or more; furthermore, I will make a concerted effort to finally break my own personal record and—for the very first time—unlock the Diamond League by progressing past Gold I.

\n\n

></center>

title.title: A hidden spot in the Amazon—a well of crystal-clear water [Esp-Eng]
title.body: <div class=\

>

![Collage de fotos horizontal Feliz San Valentín Creativo Multicolor_20260602_100641_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/48QRjVpBBdKa9iPnnpYGk77M3YUMdaVaDJ6MNaVyqQASzVwMWnziZg6xmAR1gk7VeJ.jpg) On the way to Puerto Ayacucho, about 45 minutes before you get there, there’s a really beautiful spot hidden among the trees, at the end of a long road that seems to go on forever. We discovered this beautiful spot, where being there feels so magical, about three years ago. We arrived there after a long hike, having decided to look for a slightly deeper spot to swim during a hot summer in Amazonas. When Pozo Azul is low—and even when it isn’t—we visit this place because it’s secluded and well-hidden in the forest. The pool is quite beautiful and has a lovely color that changes with the seasons. It’s so clear that you can see your feet in the water. What my sister-in-law and my husband like best—which is why we always go there—is that the water is deep. In fact, there are some spots where it’s deeper than you are. >! [Spanish version] >Vía Puerto Ayacucho, unos 45 minutos antes, hay un lugar muy bonito que está escondido entre los árboles, al final de un camino largo que parece no tener fin. Este sitio tan hermoso, en el que estar se siente tan mágico, lo descubrimos hace como tres años. Llegamos ahí después de una larga caminata, tras tomar la decisión de buscar un sector un poco más profundo para bañarnos durante un verano caluroso en Amazonas. > >Cuando Pozo Azul está bajo, e incluso si no lo está, visitamos este lugar porque está apartado de todo y bien escondido en el bosque. El pozo es bastante bello y tiene un color hermoso que cambia según la época del año. Es tan claro que puedes ver tus pies dentro del agua. Lo que más les gusta a mi cuñada y a mi esposo, porque siempre vamos para allá, es que el agua es profunda. De hecho, hay algunas partes en las que te sobrepasa. ![IMG-20260602-WA0003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/243LxzZxwv7zHwdFWaS8bKFKk6SZBUzZorLhCyvna3nqwQ8NXg79v3nVTd5tZmrxEVJYk.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/243fn6u1Ku2TzF16SEfX5PRpPVxFsUJG6QFKxd7WgGvoehkHkz2EmkK7EVDHXc5eNNyEj.jpg) ![IMG_20260326_132235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/EpXJZ6QUNL4fphi17MUUfyoRDLTys9GBKt7xtHXCs6fuXDudGmxynoS6jmouawzTpTP.jpg) ![IMG_20260326_132037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23yJJuHnkBsf36P8fM5j85957RLXgHdxeizeYY1jzH9xADH6x97Cy6gd3bM4iHSUwi8eZ.jpg) ![IMG_20260326_124740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/Eoc61uNLZpBsjQUTKF1qzHVc5fNTvRHdUMEnM9AEchKZLH5Wgfx7PxBDiV7U1cCU7Kq.jpg) ![IMG_20260326_124738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/EogMMKkt6haQYbXhBLZJpHH8YbmqiLAAkHwvSJNzAqAZKMAQyh5ypG1XfxHgZPd8pJd.jpg) ![IMG_20260326_124741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/EoryLjohJXCjN3LcZCe5gp4wpMGCfVi7k5nkBPwjXsBmjkjPGVp3LDE98GoJ1ZMHj9z.jpg) ![IMG_20260326_134427-1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23w2jHHukpGBFXK8oHtjUhj2CxgXyJtnEJVhrZECW4tnqzRpC7jBFWhDTKFiosnDCDYWg.jpg) ![IMG_20260326_124816.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/Eonjbj9aGPSjFEk7Y1R1eVXZAk3sGNngo6k6WMSadvgECD1zTwCRYsjSwA9Fpq9yp81.jpg) ![IMG_20260326_124746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/EoK5HZddTumWSUN737YjokVuFXxT3LxKS8XirarsAMW1ybSfjWhQcjDghHJuzEwFHqe.jpg) This year we wanted to take our friends from here, where we live, so we set out on a long walk under the scorching Amazon sun. It takes us about 15 minutes to walk there, and along the way we pass several smaller pools. However, our goal is always this larger, deeper pool. When we arrived, it was great, since we were super hot, and the first thing we did was jump right into the water. You could say this pool is in the Pozo Azul area, but it’s so far in that we’re a little unsure. It might have another name or be reached from a different location, but we haven’t figured that out yet. Therefore, it’s still part of Pozo Azul, even if it isn’t the main pool. We were a group of about eight people; we stayed there all morning and then went back for a while in the afternoon. >! [Spanish version] >​Este año quisimos llevar a nuestros amigos de aquí de donde vivimos, así que emprendimos una larga caminata bajo el ardiente sol del Amazonas. Nos toma unos 15 minutos a pie llegar ahí y en el trayecto pasamos por varios pocitos más pequeños. Sin embargo, nuestro objetivo siempre es este pozo más grande y profundo. Cuando llegamos fue genial, ya que veníamos súper acalorados y lo primero que hicimos fue meternos al agua de una vez. > >Podría decirse que este pozo está en el territorio de Pozo Azul, pero se encuentra tan adentro que dudamos un poco. Puede que tenga otro nombre o que se llegue a él desde otro lugar, pero por ahora no lo hemos descubierto. Por lo tanto, sigue formando parte de Pozo Azul, aunque no sea el pozo principal. Fuimos un grupo como de ocho personas, nos quedamos toda la mañana ahí y luego volvimos otro rato por la tarde. ![IMG-20260602-WA0007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23wCA6efxnieQgghNQsaWVAMHdTKq7tpHnm6TPBBpnoA1VGCkD1MfNHePxU78ZTwK59nM.jpg) ![IMG-20260602-WA0008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/EowFatxWmG1QiX4m9VZgoD4FmFt2uxFrYrJG27fYS8HN8wX8PF9teSwGwec6UjKsuLj.jpg) ![IMG-20260602-WA0005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/EorzPzs5K8yWnRoQzosaBJCrG3Y8v7mze9cJ7dMb31HQuHD5yH6M2x3o32k3rnAUK7d.jpg) ![IMG-20260602-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/23vsLEtvwa2UMFo3jGir8sxA65fj2kbbk86p2fM5my35iCcxy5VSqTh1sAzKR5BN2fNph.jpg) ![IMG-20260328-WA0167.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/Eo22eFMd2skqdsVY9mHiyTECZLo5F2aXTmwrBuj939Kg9BVc9dSRGC1d3q8bNd5KfFG.jpg) ![IMG-20260602-WA0002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/241tWygKmvRC4KhU2PYg42N1poBPqKQTVtHMQsQKUXc37Fhhas5irMwE5hf5JCQC6ma7N.jpg) What makes this place so special is that you can really swim freely because the water is deep enough. Beyond that, the best part is how beautiful it looks—it has a vivid turquoise color, and the water near the shore is so crystal-clear that you can see fish swimming all around you. Honestly, I love this scenery so much because I feel like there are few places like this, and we really enjoyed the experience. While we were there, none of us had the walk back on our minds. We simply enjoyed ourselves and lived in the moment. In fact, there are several trees and the occasional branch around the pool that we used as a springboard to jump in with more momentum, which was quite fun. My friends from Maracay, whom I mentioned in my previous post, said that of all the places they visited with us, this was the one they liked the most. And it wasn’t because the other places weren’t beautiful, but because this one is truly special. Despite being so simple and so hidden away, it’s absolutely worth it just to spend some time there and relax. >! [Spanish version] >Lo que hace tan especial a este lugar es que realmente puedes nadar libremente porque la profundidad lo permite. Más allá de eso, lo mejor es lo hermoso que se ve visualmente, tiene un color verde agua bastante vívido y en la orilla es tan cristalino que puedes ver a los peces pasando a tu alrededor. Sinceramente, este paisaje me gusta demasiado porque siento que hay pocos espacios como este, y además se disfrutó un montón la experiencia. > >Mientras estábamos allí, ninguno de los que fuimos tenía en mente la caminata de regreso que tendríamos que hacer. Simplemente disfrutamos y vivimos el momento. De hecho, alrededor del pozo hay varios árboles y una que otra rama que utilizamos como trampolín para lanzarnos con mayor impulso, lo cual estuvo bastante divertido. > >Mis amigos de Maracay, de los que les hablé en mi anterior publicación, dijeron que de todos los lugares que visitaron con nosotros, este fue el que más les gustó. Y no fue porque los demás sitios no fueran bonitos, sino porque este es realmente especial. A pesar de ser tan sencillo y estar tan escondido, vale muchísimo la pena solo por estar ahí un rato y relajarte.

![Banner Horizontal Minimalista Joyería (400 x 150 px)_20241205_220827_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jemima1996/242DZCJkjqsqAFYiumZQQ3ztrn1pMQZK9AWwd8kja6ekrSknbNMVppTN8UJPK4LPCP7rg.png) -Content entirely of my authorship and inspiration. -Original text in Spanish, translated at DeepL. -Personal photographs, taken with my Huawei p30 Lite Phone. -Banners designed in Canva Pro. -Contenido completamente de mi autoria e inspiración. -Texto original en español, traducido en DeepL. -Fotografías personales, tomadas con mi teléfono Huawei p30 Lite. -Banners diseñados en Canva Pro. title.title: [ENG/ESP] Investigation in the Paredones Cave: A Geological and Paleontological Treasure
title.body: **A Necessary Introduction**\n\n<div class=\

>The trip to Paredones Cave was a fascinating journey, not only because of its imposing subterranean geography, but also because it is an invaluable testament to Cuba's natural history. Located in the municipality of Caimito, Artemisa province, this cave is considered one of the most important Quaternary paleontological sites in the Cuban archipelago.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1Hsps7BYppXcDRApLPPP5Cn6mwdxk3sRonX987wbAKj/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_2.jpg) It was a trip during which researchers from the Geological Survey of Cuba discovered some of the essential characteristics of Paredones Cave, one of the objectives of our research and development projects. Below, I've listed the main physical, geographical, and geological characteristics that we discovered during our trip to this wonder of western Cuba. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcrc8f1SJYW2yjR5pvSfgejNWkfRejUPyvM3g811TVLpo/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_6.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme3hgx9x6EFmhXWJVrxFqQfcuEM2SWkw773MmLQAH6uVk/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_7.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQvYTjAW7hLuyn2KChfXeaSd8vkVAvzLGLY3jngJLxYYL/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_8.jpg) **Geographic Location** Paredones Cave is It is located specifically in the Southern Karst Plain, formerly part of Havana, and currently situated in the new province of Artemisa. Its main entrance is at the bottom of a sinkhole located about 50 meters above sea level, just 90 meters from the road that connects Ceiba del Agua with Alquízar, in the southern part of the Antonio Maceo neighborhood. This relative proximity to the southern coast places it in a transitional region between the highlands and the plains south of Havana. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNgQ58BhcRXTwk3vVmFXJD7j9YRVZAJcWj4YX6QJRAycn/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_9.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZe6141qf9rVSmYHiqgG4ALH4DyCg3iWSk7Q399Xt8go3/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_11.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeR9iR3SzjRXm5rboyG5G3REQUVyHADFSwi5QkNxE42uR/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_13.jpg) **Some physical and geographical characteristics and geological features we were able to identify** The main geological feature of the site is its phreatic origin, meaning it was formed by the chemical dissolution of rocks due to the upwelling of groundwater rich in carbonic acid. Experts classify it as an Astón-type cave, characterized by a fairly straight succession of chambers. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWtZhG1jMpPhaAgUhd7nPNe1XzvZh7D7FFdXwzsQyAQku/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_27.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvc33S5PkWUVGbL33TBFg7QWrNQXbnydasmwRBEswf51/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_21.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbykyJW3WfNHht3zbKS8FoeB1tYG8jRQiuM4ZdgSo6t3Z/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_34.jpg) The cave is formed in rocks of the The Güines Formation, from the Miocene era (between 5 and 23 million years old), consists of biodetrital limestones and dolomites, ranging in color from white to gray, exhibiting a high degree of fracturing and secondary dolomitization. With an explored length of approximately 600 meters, the cave culminates in a phreatic lake where even species of blind fish adapted to total darkness have been reported. One of the most unique features of the site is the \

illuminated by a natural skylight over 28 meters high, through which the roots of a powerful jagüey tree grow.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVArUamW756jYVuLGMpVwpKaeTUc8113SDr323oLbaMdX/cueva_paredones_nov_2022_2.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmafZUXT382ppNzcEitQ51qpkh9EWJHsjAjHZrN8QcRR1u/cueva_paredones_nov_2022_4.jpg)

**Vegetation and Soils**

The vegetation outside the cave is lush, typical of the evergreen tropical forest, with a high density of trees such as the aforementioned jagüey, whose roots reach for water inside the cave.

As for the soils, the most distinctive feature in the cave's internal strata is the presence of red earth (laterite). This type of soil, characteristic of the red plains of western Cuba, is the result of the decalcification of limestone, leaving iron and aluminum oxides as residue. This clay sediment has been key to the preservation of fossils.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdpLw7AEKaRaD9n1A1aaVThiKwpXUYAwPd4GxpQgwMyRa/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_31.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmah1tzU54ZrCtWzqeUFZpCH9SFqTSxMfHLKewWYUudzTz/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_33.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNMrvMNxgEMZePdRV3gphBb8orBDyrTiwV77eMACmtrXG/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_24.jpg)

**Other points of interest**

The true treasure of the Cave Paredones Cave is filled with fossils. During the Pleistocene, the doline acted as a natural trap (sinkhole) where the remains of animals carried by rainwater accumulated, constituting an invaluable geological heritage.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ6CiGYbXP9niqPC3NFNCWr5baYbKB6VFohgrsnPBrFTw/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_25.jpg)

**A final comment**

Visiting Paredones Cave is much more than a caving tour; it's a journey to prehistoric Cuba. Its karst geology, its red fossil-rich soils, and its impressive natural history solidify its status as a priority Site of Geological Interest that deserves to be preserved as a National Monument.

*Note: I used DeepL Translate*.
*The photos are my own*.










***ESPAÑOL***


**Una introducción necesaria**

El viaje a la Cueva Paredones constituyó una travesía fascinante no solo por su imponente geografía subterránea, sino por ser un testimonio invaluable de la historia natural de Cuba. Ubicada en el municipio de Caimito, provincia de Artemisa, esta cavidad es considerada uno de los yacimientos paleontológicos más importantes del Cuaternario en el archipiélago cubano. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1Hsps7BYppXcDRApLPPP5Cn6mwdxk3sRonX987wbAKj/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_2.jpg)



Fue un viaje en el que los investigadores del Servicio Geológico de Cuba descubrimos algunas de las características esenciales de la Cueva Paredones, uno de los objetivos de nuestros proyectos de investigación y desarrollo.

A continuación,les dejo sus principales características físico-geográficas y geológicas que pudimos descubrir en este viaje a esta maravilla del occidente de Cuba.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcrc8f1SJYW2yjR5pvSfgejNWkfRejUPyvM3g811TVLpo/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_6.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme3hgx9x6EFmhXWJVrxFqQfcuEM2SWkw773MmLQAH6uVk/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_7.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQvYTjAW7hLuyn2KChfXeaSd8vkVAvzLGLY3jngJLxYYL/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_8.jpg)



**Ubicación Geográfica**

La Cueva Paredones se localiza específicamente en la Llanura Cársica Meridional, antiguamente perteneciente a La Habana, y actualmente enclavada en la nueva provincia de Artemisa . Su entrada principal se encuentra en el fondo de una dolina situada a unos 50 metros sobre el nivel del mar, a solo 90 metros de la carretera que conecta Ceiba del Agua con Alquízar, en el sur del reparto Antonio Maceo . Esta relativa cercanía a la costa sur la sitúa en una región de transición entre las alturas y las llanuras del sur habanero .

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNgQ58BhcRXTwk3vVmFXJD7j9YRVZAJcWj4YX6QJRAycn/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_9.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZe6141qf9rVSmYHiqgG4ALH4DyCg3iWSk7Q399Xt8go3/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_11.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeR9iR3SzjRXm5rboyG5G3REQUVyHADFSwi5QkNxE42uR/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_13.jpg)



**Algunas características física, geográfica y geológicas que pudimos identificar**

El principal elemento geológico del lugar es su origen freático, lo que significa que fue formada por la disolución química de las rocas debido al ascenso de aguas subterráneas cargadas de ácido carbónico. Los expertos la clasifican como una cueva tipo Astón, caracterizada por una sucesión bastante rectilínea de salones .

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWtZhG1jMpPhaAgUhd7nPNe1XzvZh7D7FFdXwzsQyAQku/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_27.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXvc33S5PkWUVGbL33TBFg7QWrNQXbnydasmwRBEswf51/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_21.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbykyJW3WfNHht3zbKS8FoeB1tYG8jRQiuM4ZdgSo6t3Z/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_34.jpg)



La cueva se desarrolla en rocas de la Formación Güines, de la era Mioceno (entre 5 y 23 millones de años). Se trata de calizas biodetríticas y dolomitas, de colores que van del blanco al gris, que presentan un alto grado de fracturación y dolomitización secundaria . Con una longitud explorada que ronda los los 600 metros, la cavidad culmina en un lago freático donde incluso se han reportado especies de peces ciegos adaptados a la oscuridad total .

Uno de los elementos más singulares del lugar es el \

, iluminado por una claraboya natural de más de 28 metros de altura, por donde ingresan las raíces de un poderoso árbol de jagüey . ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVArUamW756jYVuLGMpVwpKaeTUc8113SDr323oLbaMdX/cueva_paredones_nov_2022_2.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmafZUXT382ppNzcEitQ51qpkh9EWJHsjAjHZrN8QcRR1u/cueva_paredones_nov_2022_4.jpg) **Vegetación y suelos** La vegetación en el exterior de la cueva es exuberante, típica del bosque tropical siempreverde, con una alta densidad de árboles como el mencionado jagüey, cuyas raíces buscan el agua en el interior de la espelunca. En cuanto a los suelos, el rasgo más distintivo en los estratos internos de la cueva es la presencia de tierra roja (laterita). Este tipo de suelo, característico de las llanuras rojas de Cuba Occidental, es el resultado de la descalcificación de las calizas, dejando como residuo óxidos de hierro y aluminio. Este sedimento arcilloso ha sido clave para la preservación de los fósiles . ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdpLw7AEKaRaD9n1A1aaVThiKwpXUYAwPd4GxpQgwMyRa/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_31.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmah1tzU54ZrCtWzqeUFZpCH9SFqTSxMfHLKewWYUudzTz/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_33.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNMrvMNxgEMZePdRV3gphBb8orBDyrTiwV77eMACmtrXG/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_24.jpg) **Otros elementos de interés** El verdadero tesoro de la Cueva Paredones es su relleno fosilífero. Durante el Pleistoceno, la dolina funcionó como una trampa natural (sumidero) donde se acumularon los restos de animales arrastrados por las lluvias que constituyen un patrimonio geológico invaluable. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ6CiGYbXP9niqPC3NFNCWr5baYbKB6VFohgrsnPBrFTw/recuerdos_cueva_paredones_nov_2022_25.jpg) **Un comentario final** Visitar la Cueva Paredones es mucho más que un recorrido espeleológico; es un viaje a la Cuba prehistórica. Su geología kárstica, sus suelos rojos fosilíferos y su impresionante historia natural la consolidan como un Sitio de Interés Geológico prioritario que merece ser preservado como Monumento Nacional. *Nota: He utilizado el traductor DeepL Trasnlate*. *Las fotos son de mi propiedad*.

Hello, everyone.

Hi everyone! I hope you're all doing great. Even though I've been busy with other things, I haven't stopped posting blogs so I don't lose the habit. Join me as I tell you about this cleaning day. It’s important to keep the place you spend time in clean, and that’s exactly what I did: I cleaned the desk where my computer sits—which I’ve been using mostly at night lately to give my laptop a break from the day’s work. I had bought a really good vanilla-scented disinfectant that a neighbor sells, and that’s what I used to clean—besides getting rid of the dirt, it left a pleasant smell. To avoid unplugging all the cables, I thought I’d roll it toward the bed so that when I was done cleaning, I could just put it back in place. Obviously, I also cleaned the monitor and the CPU since everything was covered in dust. Once I had cleaned the entire computer, I moved on to cleaning the TV, which was also dusty. These devices tend to accumulate dust very quickly; ideally, you should clean them every two weeks. It’s important to do this because, even though it might seem counterintuitive, things eventually stop working—dust can clog a device’s ventilation openings, preventing air from circulating. An example of this is the CPU and some other appliances that require ventilation. I haven’t had any problems with that since I’m always on top of it. And even though you might wonder where all that dust comes from, one possibility could be split-type air conditioners, which trap all the dust in the room—that’s why they get dirty faster than traditional window units. Well, at least that’s what I’ve noticed. but the cleaning was a total success. I hope you liked it. See you later. Thank you all Note: These photos were taken from my phone and edited In: Canva

title.title: The Day of Brigada Eskwela 2026-2027 at Buhawen Elementary School
title.body:
The opening of another school year also marks the beginning of preparation, teamwork, and service inside every school. One of the most-awaited annual activities before the formal opening of classes is Brigada Eskwela. This program brings together teachers, parents, volunteers, and community members with one common goal — to prepare the school for a safe, clean, and welcoming learning environment for the learners. Today, I would like to share our meaningful and productive first day of Brigada Eskwela for the School Year 2026-2027 at Buhawen Elementary School.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/48GhfH5hG9xqfh8qcMRE9HscsrrJCvKLAAQtT4dno94ajy1YBxjgVtepmeP8MUY8ag.jpg)

As early as morning, the school was already filled with energy and excitement. Teachers arrived early, carrying cleaning materials, gardening tools, paintbrushes, and smiles on their faces. Despite the warm weather, everyone was motivated because we knew that our efforts would greatly help our learners once classes officially begin. The school grounds, which had been quiet during the vacation, slowly grew lively again as volunteers and teachers worked hand in hand.

![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoGxQR3b1wVW5rZfmDaqEVSJJAcBkpsSp1LPQwzsXkpBts9YKaj5wCd16qi3Wdb9uWr.jpg)

The first activity of the day was the opening program. Our school head warmly welcomed everyone and expressed gratitude to all the volunteers who willingly gave their time and effort to the school. Parents, barangay officials, youth volunteers, and even some former pupils participated in the activity. It was heartwarming to witness the unity and bayanihan spirit among the community's members. Brigada Eskwela truly reflects the Filipino culture of helping one another without expecting anything in return.

![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/Ep1YtKsAkJ8593RKq955vcdQZUzV6T4andPP8ZPXxvNp7Cdghjqov6nZsZbfAMNKJc7.jpg)

After the short program, we immediately started our assigned tasks. Some teachers focused on cleaning the classrooms while others worked on the school surroundings. Inside the classrooms, we swept the floors, dusted the chairs and tables, arranged learning materials, and cleaned the windows to make the rooms brighter and more comfortable for the pupils. Old decorations were removed and replaced with new, colorful classroom displays that would inspire learners as they entered their classrooms.

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoiX8ndz9GRBce7GDRAPiy7eJNdKBoPqdSm22fAAsVGXReyPtdk5KxfSF5x69478XBF.jpg)

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23uQxbSzCqzSbYKYZHDANBY9JrjjW8udSuAh8FXMTP2YkLzUGoD93eP1Jaw6RDr1iUqRj.jpg)

Meanwhile, some volunteers worked outside by clearing dried leaves, trimming grasses, and cleaning drainage areas around the school. Others repainted classroom walls and repaired broken chairs and armchairs. It was truly amazing to see everyone cooperating and sharing their talents. Even simple tasks became easier through teamwork and cooperation. The laughter and conversations while working made the atmosphere more enjoyable and less tiring.

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoeENbxAYMKyzt4UnjRhqWqmLLCHPjab95pM3iR6AMdDPDiXsXyc2HU1WFpbHeDm5q6.jpg)

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23wqnVxiu511uRcMuok3Kqu4V1Wy38DNXJLExFdWftenSAkDacm7LhAcQSiVmPzbZdrYh.jpg)

One of the highlights of our first day was seeing the parents actively participating in the activity. Some mothers helped with cleaning, while fathers assisted with repairing damaged facilities and carrying heavy materials. Their presence reminded us that education is not only the responsibility of teachers but also a partnership between the school and the community. When parents support school activities like Brigada Eskwela, learners become more inspired and motivated to study.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23yThUxM83rnoAB1mkFtfqBHhwKJKcEGEWYeNjfRAvc2qBT7EfznsnmJMTvhvRGC8yssE.jpg)

Aside from cleaning and repairs, we also prepared the classrooms to become more learner-friendly and organized. Bulletin boards were arranged properly, instructional materials were prepared, and learning corners were improved. We wanted our pupils to feel excited and comfortable when they returned to school. A clean and organized classroom creates a positive environment that encourages learning and discipline among children.

Despite the physical exhaustion from cleaning and organizing, our hearts were full of happiness and fulfillment. There is something rewarding about seeing the school slowly transform into a more beautiful and welcoming place. Every sweep of the broom, every wiped window, and every repaired chair symbolized our dedication and love for the learners of Buhawen Elementary School.

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23xyZf4k3bgwoihdU4Dcv5WRhnobhnRZPwf3huh3Kj3Wt8zskDHbGj4dYJuCapjCm5BRS.jpg)

Brigada Eskwela is more than just a cleaning activity. It is a reminder that education flourishes when people work together. The success of the first day was not only due to the completed tasks but also to the unity, cooperation, and kindness shared by everyone involved. Through this activity, relationships among teachers, parents, and community members become stronger.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EogPJToNtBVqtmSPUHPG2ctmwps5grqK5NoBRjxc3jxLb4Ce2QXSDQYaktBBY6Ew8Um.jpg)


As we ended the first day of Brigada Eskwela, we felt tired yet satisfied with what we had accomplished together. There may still be many tasks to complete in the coming days, but the successful start has already shown everyone's commitment to preparing the best learning environment for our pupils.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EonmYmwoQ6LGifCVahWvtM3hd75iFEVSGYHkk3zGeBkFBw9QXgkx6uxsBQHUvEuWj96.jpg)

Indeed, our first day of Brigada Eskwela for School Year 2026-2027 at Buhawen Elementary School was productive, meaningful, and inspiring. It reminded us that when people unite for a good purpose, great things can happen. We look forward to welcoming our learners into a school that is prepared not only with clean classrooms and facilities but also with hearts full of dedication, care, and hope for a successful school year ahead.

# English

Good morning to all my readers—I hope you’re all doing great. After several weeks away, I’m back to tell you about an incredible experience my friends and I had.

From May 29 through June 7, the Dessert Trail kicks off in my city, with the goal of finding the best dessert in town. Nestlé is sponsoring the participants, so these desserts are made with some of their products. Nine businesses are participating in my city, and I tried four of them.

We started with Moa’s Chevere dessert, a delicious treat that I’d rate an 8/10. Then we went to Primos, where we tried their famous Torrija; it was incredible—a 10/10 for me. Then we went to Candy Market, where we tried a red fruit cheesecake that was also incredible—another 10/10. Finally, we went to Candylove, which was the worst for me; it was a combination of three ultra-sweet cookies with little difference in flavor—a 4/10 for me. 

The important thing was doing this part of the tour with my friends. We had an amazing time and enjoyed voting on each dessert. 


We'll read you in the comments! 💛

Nestle esta como patrocinante de los participantes, por lo tanto, estos postres estan hechos con algunos de sus productos. En mi ciudad estan participando 9 negocios, de los cuales probe 4.

title.title: HIVE: Potencial de rebote a corto plazo en medio de la incertidumbre regulatoria, atención a la resistencia de 0.068-0.069
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcEPDtuuNhSw6cTA4BLxtxBsEJz2LetyM3tYP3AHKdrNy/img_20260602_103309_446.jpg)
Tiempo de análisis: 2026-05-31

HIVE muestra señales técnicas de un posible rebote a corto plazo, con indicadores como MACD y KDJ sugiriendo un impulso alcista. Sin embargo, la presión de venta en niveles de resistencia clave y el bajo volumen de operaciones actual indican que la fuerza del rebote es incierta. A largo plazo, el mercado de criptomonedas enfrenta desafíos regulatorios y de liquidez, lo que podría limitar el potencial alcista. Se recomienda precaución y monitorear los niveles de resistencia y el volumen para confirmar la dirección.

Análisis detallado:
📌 Ciclo a largo plazo (diario/semanal)
Análisis de mercado:
HIVE ha mostrado una tendencia bajista general, pero los datos recientes de 1 día y 7 días sugieren un posible cambio de tendencia. El MACD ha formado un cruce dorado en ambos marcos temporales, y el volumen de operaciones ha aumentado significativamente, lo que indica un creciente interés de compra. Sin embargo, la presencia de largas sombras superiores en las velas y los indicadores RSI en sobrecompra sugieren una fuerte presión de venta en los niveles más altos, lo que podría llevar a una corrección a corto plazo antes de una continuación alcista.

Posición clave:
Resistencia clave en el rango de 0.089-0.096, donde la presión de venta es significativa.
Soporte clave en el rango de 0.055-0.056, que ha demostrado ser un área de rebote.

Indicadores técnicos:
Alcista: MACD (1d): 
El MACD ha formado un cruce dorado en los gráficos de 1 día y 7 días, lo que indica un posible cambio de tendencia alcista.

Alcista: Volume (1d): 
El volumen de operaciones ha aumentado significativamente en los marcos temporales de 1 día y 7 días, lo que sugiere un creciente interés de compra.

Bajista: RSI (1d): 
El RSI en el gráfico de 1 día está en la zona de sobrecompra (77.8), lo que indica una posible corrección a corto plazo.

Alcista: Moving Average (1d): 
Las medias móviles de 1 día y 7 días muestran un cruce dorado, lo que refuerza la señal alcista a largo plazo.

Noticias de largo plazo (últimos 7 días)
Bajista: 
El avance de la computación cuántica plantea una amenaza creciente para la seguridad criptográfica de Bitcoin y otras criptomonedas, con el riesgo de que una parte significativa de los activos se vuelva vulnerable o inactiva. La inversión en tecnología cuántica y la aceleración del desarrollo impulsada por la IA intensifican esta preocupación, lo que lleva a la necesidad de soluciones criptográficas post-cuánticas. Estos desarrollos subrayan un riesgo sistémico a largo plazo para la integridad de la red y la seguridad de los activos digitales. 

📌 Período de corto plazo (línea de 1/4 de hora)
Análisis de mercado:
HIVE muestra un potencial de rebote a corto plazo, con el KDJ indicando un cruce dorado en niveles bajos y el MACD mostrando una reducción del impulso bajista. Sin embargo, el volumen de operaciones es relativamente bajo, lo que sugiere una falta de convicción en el movimiento actual. La resistencia clave en 0.068-0.069 necesita ser superada con un volumen significativo para confirmar una tendencia alcista sostenida. El precio se encuentra por debajo de la banda media de Bollinger, lo que indica una posible presión a la baja si no logra romper al alza.

Posición clave:
Resistencia inmediata en el rango de 0.068-0.069, donde el precio ha encontrado presión.
Soporte clave en el rango de 0.065-0.058, que ha actuado como zona de contención.

Indicadores técnicos:

Alcista: KDJ (1h): 
El KDJ en el gráfico de 1 hora muestra un cruce dorado en niveles bajos, lo que sugiere un posible rebote a corto plazo.

Alcista: MACD (1h): 
El MACD en el gráfico de 1 hora muestra que el histograma negativo se está reduciendo, lo que indica una disminución del impulso bajista.

Neutral: Volume (1h): 
El volumen de operaciones en el gráfico de 1 hora es relativamente bajo, lo que sugiere una falta de fuerza en el movimiento actual.

Bajista: BOLL (1h): 
El precio se encuentra por debajo de la banda media de Bollinger en el gráfico de 1 hora, lo que indica una posible presión a la baja.

Tendencias de noticias (clave en 24 horas)
Neutral: 
El mercado de criptomonedas enfrenta una confluencia de desafíos regulatorios, presiones de liquidez y volatilidad de precios. La legislación propuesta, como la Ley CLARITY, genera fricciones entre las finanzas tradicionales y las criptomonedas, mientras que las salidas de capital y la disminución de la demanda impactan la estabilidad del mercado. Estos factores colectivamente apuntan a un período de incertidumbre y reajuste en el ecosistema cripto. 

III. Consejos de operación

📈 Estrategia a largo plazo
Considerar la posibilidad de una corrección a corto plazo debido a los indicadores de sobrecompra en el gráfico de 1 día, especialmente si el precio no logra superar la resistencia de 0.089-0.096.
Monitorear el soporte clave en el rango de 0.055-0.056; un rebote desde este nivel podría confirmar la tendencia alcista a largo plazo.
Mantenerse alerta a las noticias sobre la computación cuántica y su impacto en la seguridad criptográfica, ya que representa un riesgo sistémico a largo plazo para los activos digitales.

📊 Estrategia a corto plazo
Observar el nivel de resistencia de 0.068-0.069; una ruptura con volumen significativo podría indicar una continuación del rebote a corto plazo.
Si el precio no logra superar la resistencia y el volumen sigue siendo bajo, podría haber una reversión o consolidación en el rango de 0.065-0.058.
Considerar la volatilidad del mercado debido a los desafíos regulatorios y de liquidez; establecer órdenes de stop-loss para gestionar el riesgo.

Esto para nada es sugerencia de inversión, haga usted su popio análisis con precaución.

title.title: Forest Healer Art on Ice Cream Stick
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUa3xXku2L4rfQB92iDAkaAEeH9RiSeawqYbY3e9qbpZS/1780382719082.png)
___
# Hi friends
___
Hello friends how are you all? I hope you all are fine I am also fine. So guys, today I have come again with a new art of mine, and Today I have drawn something related to Forest Healer on an ice cream stick because I felt that I should do something a little different. Usually I do the whole drawing on a sketch book. By the way guys, you all gave me a lot of support on my previous art, thank you so much for that it means alot to me. Now without wasting much time, let's start making this art on an ice cream stick.
___
# Materials needed
___
Green color marker
Brown color marker
Black color pointer
brown color pointer
green color pointer
Ice cream stick
Pencil
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRUSuMHpys93q3giDH7sZeFFnMLLdf6SRMRP43ah4ciB5/1780382609000.jpg)
___
# Sketching 🍀
___
So guys, to make this art first I took an ice cream stick then I took a pencil and with the help of the pencil I drew the Forest Healer logo on it.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZvGS4L99M75LC3Y4L22J4oSCg7ZRx9574Bao88h4ydwG/1780382609132.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNaiJPrwUgxoGyE2XzQUgX45VBFworfiH8mq3dFDbn53f/1780382609283.jpg)
___
After I sketched the Forest Healer logo with a pencil, I took a green color pointer and then I did the outline with that green color pointer, because if I directly color inside with a marker then there were chances of it coming out, like marker is a little hard to handle like this, because on an ice cream stick when we draw with marker it spreads.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPGD7dvGcxQAeq3UnPmvkk3dX3ynGuFBHu2ad6cv6NiSA/1780382609418.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ5THTQ4nwYuy8kRSYAzdJKJeadsDjELatPS82H7GoRKA/1780382609547.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX3ewnbfJ4mi2NTKAdjT1WEEAsX8JrJswZBGYF7neaxGM/1780382671035.jpg)
___
# Tree branch
___
After outlining with the green pointer, I colored it's inside with a green color marker, then I made a branch of tree on the ice cream stick with a brown color pointer. Then I filled that also with a brown color marker.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbAAW5rwpAmjUXrh1i8NwnVGmBqT26vxUFH6qZyktraq4/1780382671178.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUFhnbJhD5gEhM7StpmeuaZGe2Mfg3otujHJ7x2T49rJT/1780382671330.jpg)
___
Then I made small leaves on the branch with a green color pointer then after that I outlined all of them with a black color pointer so that it would give a neater look.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfEMEHhTKfNs6AjvF2DW1Q9aKWgKL8NgnZZJrD5R5rDMU/1780382671488.jpg)
___
# Final steps
___
Now our art is almost ready. After that I wrote Forest Healer with the help of a pencil then I filled it with a green color pointer. Then at last I also made the Holozing and hive logo which looked very beautiful on this ice cream stick, and in this way our art is completed.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeEv64rTeh8doMMi7e1bwZFuB84947zor4R1drY91Jnxn/1780382671634.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVWxrLPnnQ5yg3CrkkS8ob5KcdexjLj6JVrDX49jMC7uM/1780382689156.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeAt6XM77oMMuhPX61hogWzsGYWKNu9yekbT1qngTkYVT/1780382689294.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcnragk5teearr12PY3e8dhVfwoL1fdh5R6VMgDiKgcGT/1780382689427.jpg)
___
# Final result 🤩
___
So guys, this is the final result of the Forest Healer art which is made on an ice cream stick. It looked very nice it is very beautiful. We can also use it as a bookmarker. And if you guys want I can bring its series I have a lot of ice cream sticks, so i will make one Holozing related drawing on an ice cream stick every day If you guys want me to do that, then definitely tell me in the comment section. So guys, if you liked my today's art, then support me as always. Thank you so much and bye byeee. 💛
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX1f7pufaG31PACPWPb1MzCr3jWw4FX74bwsA5zHWgVeS/1780382689575.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYWLhURdre1APj14299eG9C3jXgeQdW1B1qC5iR6vzg8C/1780382689706.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf71uWqMq4fHVMnhxRRoSQYE3E8QA2vppmvZmgTp4TF2L/1780382706177.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRHYo8AxuEjxeNQshcfzyikVe44z8G8wQNe9pinSnsQDS/1780382706299.jpg)
___
***That’s all for today. I will be back soon with something new to share. Until then, stay happy and keep supporting*.**
___
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1vti72jskVair5xqGJQzXLvVJv3AkyGzhRspyS9X9Ta/1760280731982.jpg)

How are you all? I hope you are all doing well. Today, I am sharing a small analysis of another new token with you. I hope you will like it. I have been keeping an eye on AI (Artificial Intelligence) based projects in the crypto market for quite some time. In continuation of this, the 'Pieverse' (PIEVERSE) token came to my attention. Currently, it is showing quite good price action. I have analysed the current data and charts of the token and put forward some of my personal observations below, which will help me in making my next decision.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRQMoMwJQgQiJEBagaDqSeGD1d9cUA6pYDccZWAMkDN9R/Screenshot_2026_0602_222400.jpg 

The current price of the token is around $1.07, which has increased by about 36.4% in the last 24 hours. Its growth against Bitcoin (BTC) is slightly higher, around 43.2%. title.title: Yellow begonia flowers.
title.body:
Yellow begonia flowers.

Today I was cleaning the garden and a neighbor invited me to have tea with her. I happily agreed. While the water was heating, she gave me a tour of her yard. She, like me, has many flowers. One of them is a begonia. A beautiful flower. She says it's not easy to grow because it's so fussy.

It definitely requires care. This means watering, and proper watering. It likes moisture, but doesn't like waterlogged areas, and it also doesn't like drought. It needs occasional fertilization with a special root fertilizer, such as nitroammophoska or a special fertilizer for flowering flowers. It also doesn't like neglect; it loves space, a good place to absorb the beneficial nutrients from the soil. Therefore, it's important to remove weeds. The flower loves the sun, but not the hot rays. It's best planted in the garden, in a flowerbed, somewhere free of iron and other weeds that attract the hot rays.
All plants, bushes, flowers, and trees require care. If you're planning to plant something in your yard or in a pot inside your home, read the instructions on how to properly care for it. Then you'll be delighted with its beauty.
