title.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 76: The Storm Ends
title.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 76: The Storm Ends

![Storm_Power.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23uQn8gEpghpwEqHTuiaFbUigRG4GSqyx2hqqS5EavEwVPp5xGMYfH8G1Y4vAzSRo8JvK.jpg)

Inside the House of Divine Knowledge temple, the technicians were curled up on the floor in terror. August was crouched down guarding the main entrance to the temple. He appeared mostly unfazed by the loud claps of thunder outside.

‘What’s happening?’ blubbed Felix as he looked at August.

‘Intense dark energy is disturbing the atmosphere,’ replied August. ‘I felt something like this once before, but this is something far more extreme.’

‘Is it the monster?’ gasped Felix as his eyes bulged.

‘Something different,’ replied August. ‘Stay calm. This will pass.’

Julio was staggering further up the main road past the Industrial Zone. He was moving in and out of invisibility as the poison was starting to take effect on him. Demadrian had placed the Hat Lady down and was pursuing Julio. 

Demadrian roared ferociously as he charged towards Julio. Julio waved his claws erratically to keep Demadrian away.

Demadrian leapt at Julio. Julio swatted him down with his claws. Demadrian charged forward again. This time, Julio swatted him with his tail. Demadrian kept charging, forcing Julio further up the main road and closer to the back of the region.

Angelo and Volo walked down the main road towards the fight between Demadrian and Julio. Razor shapeshifted into himself and ran after them. The senior guard slammed his hand on his badly damaged vehicle in anger as he watched Razor run off.

Demadrian and Julio roared ferociously at each other. Julio took a swipe at Demadrian with his right claw. Demadrian ducked and advanced forward. He slashed Julio across the chest, causing him to bleed. Julio spun around and knocked Demadrian off his feet using his tail. Julio immediately became invisible.

Demadrian slowly got back up. He roared ferociously. A short distance down the road, Julio became visible again. He was in his Linap form. He was hoping the deep cuts from Demadrian would heal, but that did not happen.

Demadrian charged towards Julio. Julio shapeshifted back into his Sentray form.

Lightning struck the building next to Demadrian. It startled him. Julio lunged forward, slashing Demadrian hard across his chest. Demadrian screamed in agony as blood spurted out from him. Julio followed up by smashing Demadrian with his tail, knocking him down.

Julio tried to crush Demadrian’s head with his huge foot, but Demadrian shapeshifted into his Linap form to avoid him and then became invisible. Julio roared ferociously. Angelo, Volo, and Razor had now caught up with him.

Julio stared into Angelo’s red, glowing eyes.

‘I’m so sorry,’ mumbled Julio.

The thunder continued to roar, and lightning was striking in several places in the Downs Region.

‘My mentor, my guide,’ said Angelo as he looked up at Julio.

Julio felt an intense burning feeling inside himself. The poison was draining his strength, and his healing ability was no longer working. 

‘Let me help you,’ said Angelo as he walked towards Julio.

Julio tilted his head back and gasped. Angelo reached out to touch Julio. Suddenly, Demadrian leapt at Julio, knocking him to one side. This caused Julio to stagger as he struggled to remain standing. The poison was affecting his balance and coordination.

Demadrian charged into Julio. He began rapidly slashing at him, causing his blood to splatter everywhere. Angelo screamed at Demadrian. Thunder roared and lightning was striking all across the region.

Julio fell to his knees. Demadrian repeatedly slashed at Julio’s throat. Julio gasped in pain. He was struggling to breathe as blood spurted from his neck and gushed from his mouth. Demadrian continued with his assault. Julio shapeshifted into his Linap form to duck the onslaught of slashes. 

Julio tried to escape from Demadrian but was too injured to move or become invisible. With one huge swipe, Demadrian cut Julio’s head off.

Julio’s head rolled towards Angelo. Angelo screamed in rage, and then he charged towards Demadrian. Demadrian swung to slash him, but Angelo ducked and grabbed Demadrian’s thigh.

‘Now!’ screamed Angelo.

A powerful lightning bolt struck them. A few seconds later, another followed this. Then more and more rapidly, the lightning struck them. The force of the lightning was so intense that buildings on either side of the road were blasted to pieces. 

The force was so powerful that the whole region shook. The windows in the House of Divine Knowledge temple shattered. The technicians screamed in fear as glass fell all around them. August stood up as the glass fell all around him. He could see the intense blasts of light flash past the window.

The partially constructed palace started to collapse. Duffo was screaming in terror and panic as he pounded on the cell door. The ceiling began to collapse on them. Lily was able to move out of the way. Unfortunately, the bricks that fell through the ceiling crushed the enforcer. Lily used the bricks to climb out of the cell to reach the room area above. Duffo followed her.

Maskameera had run into the Downs Agriculture Zone to avoid collapsing buildings. Orcilla was running towards the lightning strikes, but the force knocked her unconscious. The followers stared and watched the lightning strikes as if they were in some kind of trance.

Inside the tunnel, not far from the lightning strikes, Benny was screaming while slapping himself. Hermon was frantically chewing on his own arm. Eric was sitting down cross-legged while sucking his thumb. Gilling was curled up in a ball. Wendell was trying to shield her.

Outside the region, the powerful lightning strikes and intense roaring thunder had frightened the Sentray away, just leaving Octavius and Ducky. Ducky was lying on the ground, and Octavius had his arms wrapped around her, trying to calm her down even though he was terrified himself. The West Tribes’ guards sprinted past him in fear. They desperately wanted to get as far away from the region as possible.

Polly, Jennifer, Bellamy, and Bastion were hiding inside the workshop. The intense vibrations caused by the lightning strikes were causing the warehouse it was in to shake violently. Pieces of the roof crashed through the ceiling of the workshop. A piece of metal was heading towards Polly. Jennifer knocked Polly out of the way. The piece of metal pierced through Jennifer’s head. Polly gasped in shock. Bastion grabbed Polly’s hand. The three of them escaped the workshop as it completely collapsed.

The power of the lightning could be felt in the resistance camp. Daily hugged the twins tightly, and they buried their heads into his chest. The little miracles were huddled together; Sophie, Arthur, and Louis were shielding them from the intense roaring of thunder and explosions from the lightning. Vulay and Denise were holding Henders, who was crying. Eugene was standing up watching the explosions. He was joyfully clapping. He looked around and was confused why they were all terrified.

Suddenly, everything stopped. There was silence. The lightning no longer struck, and the thunder no longer roared. The rain continued to fall, but it did not make a sound. The heavy choking feeling of evil in the air had gone. A fresh, cool, gentle, and silent breeze replaced it.

Orcilla slowly opened her eyes. She looked up at the sky as the dark storm clouds changed to lighter, fluffier clouds. She sat up. Just ahead of her was a huge crater in the road. She slowly stood up and walked towards the crater. The rain had been reduced to just a light drizzle. She looked into the deep crater. There was no sign of Angelo, Demadrian, or even Volo and Razor.

Suddenly there was gunfire. Tiberius and the enforcers had begun firing at the followers. Orcilla became invisible and then ran back towards the town square. 

‘Get them, now!’ shouted Tiberius from the ruins of the construction site of the palace.

The enforcers managed to shoot and kill several followers. However, the followers returned fire. With their superior numbers, they were soon able to overcome the enforcers, forcing them to surrender.

Tiberius became invisible, and then he tried to escape. Lily was nearby, and she saw his footsteps forming in the dust as he ran. She ran into him, knocking him down. Tiberius became visible as he got back up. He took a swipe at her with his fist, but Lily responded quickly with a hard kick to his groin. He bent forward in pain. Duffo ran over and kicked him hard in the head, knocking him out.

Orcilla ran over to them. ‘Got him… again,’ she panted as she looked down at Tiberius.

‘We need to make sure it’s for good this time,’ replied Lily.

‘The prince can rightly claim his throne,’ said Duffo as he patted his chest.

Lily rolled her eyes, and Orcilla stared angrily at Duffo, who raised his eyebrows and smiled back at her. 

Several followers ran over to Tiberius. They placed restraints on his hands and feet.

‘That’s it,’ chuckled Duffo. ‘Time to take out the trash.’

‘Take him too,’ said Orcilla as she looked at a senior follower and pointed to Duffo.

Two followers grabbed Duffo.

‘You can’t arrest me!’ shouted Duffo as a third follower placed restraints on his hands. ‘I’m royalty.’

Orcilla turned around and looked at the destruction caused to the Downs Region.

‘We can fix all of this,’ said Lily in a reassuring tone.

Orcilla turned to look at Lily. Lily held her hand out to Orcilla. Orcilla looked at Lily’s hand. She shook her head and then turned around and walked away.

‘Oh no!’ called out Felix, who had poked his head around the temple door and was staring at the destroyed palace. ‘It’s not supposed to look like that.’

title.body:
Got the boys to school yesterday morning then once home I went to go for a ride but looked at the doppler and decided to just do a trainer ride inside. ![Screenshot_20260601-081635.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xoS5abWB1ZZZGigvkAwSjFW82fymBkeCad2uVXSEAdZYQnSPkm4MuPDytnT3sMB7daV.png) I was trying to keep speed and cadence up which got me 21 miles in 45 minutes. ![bike 6-1 Trainer.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23swk8EwqrkNRcyzGHvU2WGhxe3ed5MeKS2f8X38EfCyfMAcL44TL4iJ76irFTuEyuKkj.JPG) ![bike 6-1 Trainer stats.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23swfwJfbZ9vY1G2ikDijww93DA5UjNYz8LthXTDoLAqj43ZJho6LGxM426zCUfxLvQAL.JPG) The rain took its sweet time materializing so I guess I could have gone out for the ride, but whatever, I had stuff to do around the farm for the day. The scapes needed to be picked which are beginning to slow down finally. Still a few rows putting them out that I need to keep an eye on. I try to cut them as soon as possible to eliminate the growth going to the flower so all the energy can go to the bulbs. ![IMG_20260601_105110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWs6fJMyHCp5in6arzzLo9583KWMHRpZxPZSi61dK7o23vwTFUtHjs9HL25AduDRtWf.jpg) Then I went through the greenhouse and picked another fat bag of spinach leaves. Some huge ones all the way down to baby leaves on the flower stalks. ![IMG_20260601_110208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmBLMdKV5x21DRUcLo5uknCiZwmR5zfRnTE72HzSci7HhWoSRyYZrJpn7bivVHVbXRm.jpg) The bridge across the creek had broken and required a new support. I realized I have the pile of logs in the yard so grabbed on of them and used it as the new beam. I removed half the plank boards, then lifted the end with them still attached to the side and slid the new log into place. Reset the board and planks to overlap the log then attached the planks back. ![IMG_20260601_115208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u5y2KZVXGeLibvC1NC6KobYuNUcNtGGdFqE44X64jrS737QCLmDZHjbfUmZvP6zAain.jpg) ![IMG_20260601_115214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWrtgG7hREiSrkMj5dnwzo38x9hFiPuMGe43AADBt4GNdrxTpqe3sSZiCanmVr4ieu1.jpg) What rain we got over the day was pretty light but it kept it nice and cool for the day. ![Screenshot_20260601-113612.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vhPnDg8r66HCSdJPuBavespkmaWwoFYXXNHbubycGbWiQpZixNJWcZR8D3U5cPyd8jL.png) The bridge is SOOO much stronger now and feels good and solid to walk across. ![IMG_20260601_120512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vsKyocCT1cNE8mxd6HK2Qkz4APMNDNvdBLodWYZUUKMj3PT2f371KVQ8V3rCnaRNkm5.jpg) I had to sort last years potatoes out for the still solid ones which got bagged and taken to the house to eat. The wheelbarrow is full of plantable but I have to devise a place to put them still... ![IMG_20260601_135348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uFU3nCQP223SfJTieZgVbVbSq3j8to3HohdB9jHqskmY2dgbJSir7E1Q4inoRSwxLgW.jpg) The boys got home from school and I went out to the greenhouse to weed. The tomatoes are doing good and I have a few cucumber plants that managed to grow. I need to reseed them then likely just buy my pepper plants as none sprouted. The boys went out and hauled the piles to the animals. ![IMG_20260601_163740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xVGeB8HSgA6iKz8L2S2eswq2yVeAZAk5mNoYpjaM6TAmYDoxSkQWCS2c5Whg7ygzw7N.jpg) They sliced the potatoes for me and I made the scalloped potatoes for dinner. ![IMG_20260601_181048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23ydA1wpS9FR2pjWRtoxAUAYcmwUwQympLNgMHvzZDwihs5Z9EiLbPLcuH8YmSbnx7uQp.jpg) Today I get the boys to school, have my weekly session, stop at North 40 for a new tool and pepper plants, will stop at client's house(s) regarding the irrigation, work around the farm, then this evening is J's last school concert of the year. ---

title.title: MM Ribbon, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
title.body:
![g.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoATyf4CYY57HBTcnoYZPApH8GHz95ANN2VRUjduJRWVyhkDecuu8DZn4wFGTZ61qYY.jpg)


Colleagues, my drawing for today is inspired by the R648 MM Ribbon card. This card represents a microphone from the game. It's a microphone with a somewhat classic, or almost retro, design. It has a strong brown color that makes it very elegant, in my opinion. Well, today I'm going to show you from beginning to end how I made it.

So let's get down to business. I started by creating a canvas in the IbisPaint app on Windows. By the way, this app is also available for Android if you'd like to share your drawings with the community. After creating the canvas, I drew two squares that form the inner frame of the card, the one that contains the microphone.

<div class=\

> ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BTut2nd6jF4H2mva2JBVqzTzr3ix5A1BMtLwBFx8jhC6cMSRKU6hMVuUtijMXmh3.jpg) The next step was to start drawing the microphone. To make the straight lines and avoid imperfections, I used the straight line tool. Then, with the pencil tool, I drew the curved parts. I started by drawing what would be the microphone handle and then moved on to drawing the top part. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8DHkUMDrm2BWh6M3hGKBEUai4r3hj85MXBZmKoqbqzWArDS48DKdrKeowj.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BM1YUX8DHkTQvmBvn3JkuDQxwZV5CZ9VcMEL9i3htkyPY1FWurU1Ks7AVoBWT2Zu.jpg) In the details section, I finished the microphone and part of its cable connection area, the one with the stepped design. I drew it exactly as it is in the original card because I wanted it to look similar. I also drew the remaining internal divisions. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWi9G1QoiHGhHPB8V7i2GxqVZTnF9fa91zHvVXaGwRDWoiBT7dTJPjyTmkGZe.jpg) The next step, friends, is painting. I'll show you the whole process in the following screenshots. As you can see, I started drawing from the outside in. This includes the outer background, then the frame, the inner background, and finally the microphone. I used a color palette very similar to the original card so it would look like it. On top of the microphone's dark brown color, I drew what would be the reflection in a light brown. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoAgVEvDgpmy1gbC6vpwB5oTcBCuAPzybKgBu1ymYEtQZmuP5Dpz411Ji8JWeFNSsWH.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqQPYTiTNL3NLkhLgGCU6brhVZVybWv4kqvsFTR9eFGxMpxDY9Hu7PmnMFqFECRJmSP.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EnYRunh7QbMShtFcsP1A9q3CqhVkyn26HTzkMSEm1BLo8HytPtXZWeeTPzMtmXLjyL4.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EnmCGDHoj3DUs6PRY72iFxs37ufapfseNvNs76BE5y26Pjy6nN6RcBwMJpKzajFEkid.jpg) Colleagues, and to finish up, here's the completed drawing. That's all for today. See you in the next drawing, blessings to all, and good health. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/242hgpTfNVYop5d64FT46BqirJGgiAK2HY7QE92rJCMaBXkBGzBr7NziCAzi7781Yqfxt.jpg)

title.title: ANALYSIS OF THE WORK MADAME BOVARY (En - Es)
title.body: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqWNsgwcjh5JzxNpUXmNZU9cA1vFQsyYDAunYRxdoQeV/0179401a_98d2_4f70_88c5_746d98f8e323.jpg)

> ###
***ENGLISH***

Hello, good morning to all book lovers. I picked up my reading habit again a few months ago, but I'm taking it slow. I must confess that I don't finish a book as quickly as I used to. Today I wanted to start posting my first analyses, even though I haven't finished reading any of the selected books. I should mention that I'm already familiar with the books and their context. I read some of them many years ago during my school years, but I've been taking the time to reread them at a leisurely pace, in the comfort of my free time. I started with \

and I'm already quite far along. I haven't made the mistake of reading several books at once, but rather I'm waiting to finish one before starting the next. Of course, this delays my goal of completing this year's selection of books. But that's okay, I'll take it easy. The point is to enjoy the reading experience, not to finish them in record time.
![rosa sepia oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23wXQLC3kCrcN6p9LiPXeFrqWt4pEZCcMUNurQvYqufMNin2hjXBtKGpbBDQ4FTUczDY4.png)

##
**MADAME BOVARY**

💕 **Biography of Gustave Flaubert** # *Gustave Flaubert was a French writer born in Rouen, France, in 1821. He is the third of the great novelists of French realism and was the most demanding and perfectionist in terms of objectivity and style.* *The son of a doctor, he studied law in Paris, where he met Maxime du Camp, whose friendship remained with him throughout his life and who accompanied him on many trips. Flaubert spent his entire life at his estate in Croisset, dedicated to writing. Between 1847 and 1856, he had a relationship with the poet Louise Colet, although his great love was Elisa Schlésinger, who inspired the character of Marie Arnoux in Sentimental Education and who never became his lover.* *Travel played an important role in his development as a novelist, due to the value he placed on observing reality. Flaubert did not base anything in his works solely on pure inspiration; he first meticulously crafted the style of his prose, in which he desired nothing that was not real. But this reality had to possess the beauty of unreality, so that he revealed no personal experience in his writing nor expressed his own opinions.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhyQVfuSiGFsr2oJLwPWB1XTTCexZWm1wkjwPneD3gNn/hdi6dqcdj5cvjcdgaksbq4e5m4.jpeg)

*His first published novel, and his masterpiece, was Madame Bovary in 1856. This publication brought him rapid literary acclaim, but it also created serious problems for him, as he was attacked by moralists who condemned his approach to adultery. He was even put on trial, which led him to embark on a fantastical and baroque project, as far removed from his reality as possible. This work was Salammbô (1862), which told the story of the impossible love between a princess and a barbarian mercenary in ancient Carthage.* *Gustave Flaubert died in Croisset, France, in 1880. Croisset is a village located on the banks of the Seine River in France, within the Rouen district of the Normandy region. This celebrated writer lived there for 35 years and it was the place where he wrote many of his works, including the novel Madame Bovary.* [Gustave Flaubert – Biographies and Lives](https://www.biografiasyvidas.com/biografia/f/flaubert.htm)
![rosa sepia oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23wXQLC3kCrcN6p9LiPXeFrqWt4pEZCcMUNurQvYqufMNin2hjXBtKGpbBDQ4FTUczDY4.png)

💕 **What theme does the novel “Madame Bovary” address?** # *The main theme of this novel is the dissatisfaction Emma Bovary feels within a monotonous marriage, lacking the attention she, as a woman, requires from her husband, which leads her to commit adultery.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNQBC1T4jh7nisu1yUwNnoVhXPPPsbxBcvvqPY9kacex/859efe3e_2143_4c25_8a7f_4e03cf9b47b0.jpg)

*The protagonist is fond of romance novels, which further reinforces her romanticism, leading her to harbor many unfulfilled romantic expectations. She copes with these expectations through romantic fantasies, but these vanish when she returns to face her reality, which she considers an empty and mediocre life with a boring man.* [Main theme of Madame Bovary – Google](https://www.google.com/search?q=tema+principal+de+madame+bgovary&oq=tema+principal+de+madame+bgovary&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIJCAEQABgNGIAEMgoIAhAAGKIEGIkFMgcIAxAAGO8F0gEINzg0NGowajeoAgCwAgA&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8)
![rosa sepia oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23wXQLC3kCrcN6p9LiPXeFrqWt4pEZCcMUNurQvYqufMNin2hjXBtKGpbBDQ4FTUczDY4.png)

💕 **Summary of “Madame Bovary”.** # *Charles Bovary was a small-town boy whose parents waited until he was a teenager to enroll him in school. He was far more attached to his mother than to his father, a doctor who spent more time visiting bars than practicing medicine. He graduated as a doctor amidst a series of missteps, and soon after, his parents married him off to a wealthy widow who turned out to have lied about her dowry. The marriage lasted little more than a year, as the woman died.* *Before becoming a widower, Charles met Emma, ​​the daughter of a patient who took a liking to him. He began spending more time with the family, and eventually married the girl. Emma soon realized she had made a mistake in agreeing to marry Charles, as he turned out to be an absent, puritanical, and spineless husband. She felt ignored and bored. She fell ill, and her husband decided to move to another town, where she gave birth to their daughter, Berthe.* *Little by little, she became more integrated into life in that place and befriended the pharmacist, who encouraged her to take advantage of Charles's profession, pressuring him to take risks that could bring him more income. Meanwhile, she went into debt with a vendor, buying a large quantity of luxury items that she later couldn't pay for.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWaRugBNtYbb6etfH9idEewsSbRbSaymsob6f1fsP8sHn/739c1756_b6e1_4535_96b0_e25435f1b23b.jpg)

*Dissatisfied with her marriage, she began a clandestine affair with a womanizer who ultimately abandoned her. Amidst all this, she fell ill with depression, and to cheer her up, her husband convinced her to take piano lessons with Léon, a young law intern she met the day she arrived in town.* *Emma ended up being foreclosed on due to her debts, and when she sought help from her two lovers, who refused, she decided to commit suicide. Her husband, consumed by grief, slowly faded away, and one afternoon, his little girl went looking for him to play and found him dead. Thus, the girl was left in the care of an aunt, as her paternal grandmother died shortly afterward, and her maternal grandfather was paralyzed.*
![rosa sepia oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23wXQLC3kCrcN6p9LiPXeFrqWt4pEZCcMUNurQvYqufMNin2hjXBtKGpbBDQ4FTUczDY4.png)

💕 **Analysis of the Work** # *First, the protagonist, Emma Bovary, was a dreamy and imaginative woman who experienced an internal conflict between her fantasies and her reality. Her desire to recreate in real life a love affair like those in the novels she used to read led her to discover that her marriage was as boring as her husband, and she sought in extramarital affairs the passion that resided in her romantic fantasies. On the other hand, Charles Bovary was a quiet, faithful, and boring man who did not perceive his wife's dissatisfaction.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeNjbtyFxwGWGq1fAUpYAz7AQw1fEKYifQY9matz7DMhZ/846d49e1_5c96_4812_b568_4d7a1ee7abf6.jpg)

*In psychological terms, this work gave rise to \

which is a disorder characterized by chronic dissatisfaction and the need to feed on illusions and fantasies about oneself that contrast with reality.* [Analysis by Madame Bovary - Google](https://www.google.com/search?q=analisis+de+madame+bovary&oq=an&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUqBggAEEUYOzIGCAAQRRg7MgYIARBFGDkyBggCEEUYOzIGCAMQRRg8MgYIBBBFGDwyBggFEEUYPNIBCDU4ODJqMGo5qAIIsAIB8QW3OKM8QET6qg&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8)
![rosa sepia oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23wXQLC3kCrcN6p9LiPXeFrqWt4pEZCcMUNurQvYqufMNin2hjXBtKGpbBDQ4FTUczDY4.png)

Thank you very much for visiting my blog. I hope you enjoyed this review and give me your impressions.
![annafenix dorado.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23zvVzWUjzwX6GfkmDqzRVG8x1TVgF1er2QQ5d1nBVkiU4U46ABxsQmDi45pDuxsRNvzK.png)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvgGL4n5NVH5vUPURsmQ5TDPWA3Ksvpgm5uJkbDCW4M7/c6102292_9661_4c26_9606_07138fb9a1af.jpg)

###
***ESPAÑOL***

Hola, buenos días a todos los amantes de los libros. Ya hace unos meses que retomé mi hábito de leer, pero voy lentamente, debo confesar que no culmino una obra con la misma rapidez de tiempo atrás. Hoy quise ir publicando mis primeros análisis aunque no he culminado la lectura de ninguna de las obras seleccionadas. Hago la salvedad, de que las obras ya las conozco y también su contexto, algunas las leí hace muchos años durante mis actividades escolares, pero me he dedicado a hacer nuevamente estas lecturas con tranquilidad, en la comodidad de mis momentos de relax y descanso. Inicié con la obra “Madame Bovary” y ya la llevo bastante adelantada. No volví a cometer el error de leer varias a la vez, sino esperar culminar una para iniciar la siguiente. Por supuesto, eso dilata más mi meta de concretar la selección de obras de este año. Pero no importa, lo tomaré con calma, se trata de disfrutar los momentos de leer, no de culminarlas en tiempo record.
![rosa sepia oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23wXQLC3kCrcN6p9LiPXeFrqWt4pEZCcMUNurQvYqufMNin2hjXBtKGpbBDQ4FTUczDY4.png)

##
**MADAME BOVARY**

💕 **Biografía de Gustave Flaubert** # *Gustave Flaubert fue un escritor francés nacido en Ruán, Francia, en 1821. Es el tercero de los grandes novelistas del realismo francés y fue el más exigente y perfeccionista en materia de objetividad y estilo.* *Era hijo de un médico, estudió derecho en París, donde conoció a Maxime du Camp, cuya amistad conservó toda la vida y lo acompañó en muchos viajes. Flaubert pasó toda su vida en su propiedad de Croisset, entregado a la escritura. Entre 1847 y 1856 mantuvo una relación con la poetisa Louise Colet, aunque su gran amor fue Elisa Schlésinger, quien inspiró el personaje de Marie Arnoux de La educación sentimental y quien nunca llegó a ser su amante.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhyQVfuSiGFsr2oJLwPWB1XTTCexZWm1wkjwPneD3gNn/hdi6dqcdj5cvjcdgaksbq4e5m4.jpeg)

*Los viajes tuvieron un papel importante en su aprendizaje como novelista, por el valor que concedía a la observación de la realidad. Flaubert no plasmaba nada en sus obras basado únicamente en la pura inspiración, primero trabajaba con precisión el estilo de su prosa, en las que no deseaba nada que no fuera real; pero esa realidad debía tener la belleza de la irrealidad, de tal forma que no dejaba ver en su escritura ninguna experiencia personal ni expresaba opiniones propias.* *Su primera novela publicada, y su obra maestra, fue Madame Bovary en 1856. Esta publicación supuso su rápida consagración literaria, pero también le creó serios problemas, ya que fue atacado por los moralistas, que condenaban su forma de abordar el adulterio, incluso fue sometido a juicio, lo cual lo conllevó a emprender un proyecto fantasioso y barroco, lo más alejado posible de su realidad. Esta obra fue Salambó (1862), que relataba el amor imposible entre una princesa y un mercenario bárbaro en la antigua Cartago.* *Gustave Flaubert muere en Croisset, Francia en 1880. Croisset es una aldea situada a orillas del río Sena, en Francia, y se encuentra dentro del distrito de Ruan en la región de Normandía. Allí vivió este célebre escritor durante 35 años y fue el lugar donde escribió muchas de sus obras, incluyendo la novela Madame Bovary.* [Gustave Flaubert – Biografías y Vidas](https://www.biografiasyvidas.com/biografia/f/flaubert.htm)
![rosa sepia oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23wXQLC3kCrcN6p9LiPXeFrqWt4pEZCcMUNurQvYqufMNin2hjXBtKGpbBDQ4FTUczDY4.png)

💕 **¿Qué tema aborda la obra “Madame Bovary”?** # *El tema principal de esta obra es la insatisfacción que siente Emma Bovary dentro de un matrimonio monótono y sin la suficiente atención que como mujer, ella requiere de parte de su esposo, lo cual la conlleva a cometer adulterio.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVNQBC1T4jh7nisu1yUwNnoVhXPPPsbxBcvvqPY9kacex/24be1cea_3587_43c2_aad9_1cf6152800b0.jpg)

*La protagonista es aficionada a las novelas rosa, eso afianza más su romanticismo por lo que tiene muchas expectativas amorosas sin plasmar, y las mitiga con sus fantasías románticas, pero éstas se desvanecen cuando vuelve a enfrentar su realidad que considera una vida vacía y mediocre junto a un hombre aburrido.* [Tema principal de Madame Bovary – Google](https://www.google.com/search?q=tema+principal+de+madame+bgovary&oq=tema+principal+de+madame+bgovary&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIJCAEQABgNGIAEMgoIAhAAGKIEGIkFMgcIAxAAGO8F0gEINzg0NGowajeoAgCwAgA&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8)
![rosa sepia oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23wXQLC3kCrcN6p9LiPXeFrqWt4pEZCcMUNurQvYqufMNin2hjXBtKGpbBDQ4FTUczDY4.png)

💕 **Resumen de “Madame Bovary”.** # *Charles Bovary, era un chico de pueblo a quien sus padres esperaron que fuera un adolescente para ingresarlo en la escuela. Demasiado apegado a su madre más que a su padre, un médico que más se dedicaba a visitar bares que a su profesión. Se graduó de médico en medio de una gran cantidad de desaciertos, y al tiempo, sus padres lo casaron con una viuda millonaria, que resultó mintiendo con respecto a su dote. Poco más de un año duró el matrimonio, ya que la mujer murió.* *Antes de enviudar, Charles conoció a Emma, la hija de un paciente que le tomó cariño. Comenzó a frecuentar más la familia, y al tiempo estuvo casado con la chica. Emma, no tardó mucho en sentir que se había equivocado al aceptar casarse con Charles, ya que resultó ser un marido ausente, puritano, sin carácter, se sentía ignorada y aburrida. Terminó enfermándose y su marido decide mudarse a otro pueblo, allí da a luz a su hija Berthe.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXN39sb3L4JWRWdTSmcF9M9gHR4Xhr9x3CZqa6WjNnB7u/213d9d91_86e3_49fa_a82e_2831c8ea579a.jpg)

*Poco a poco se va integrando más a la vida de aquel lugar, y hace amistad con el boticario, quien la impulsa a sacar provecho de la profesión de Charles, presionándolo para tomar riesgos que le pudieran traer más ingresos económicos. Por otro lado, se endeudó con un vendedor, al comprarle una gran cantidad de artículos lujosos que luego no pudo cancelar.* *Por su inconformidad matrimonial, inició un romance clandestino con un donjuán que al final la dejó plantada. En medio de todo, cae enferma de depresión, y su esposo para animarla la convence de tomar clases de piano con León, un joven pasante de abogacía que conoció el día que llegó al pueblo.* *Emma terminó siendo embargada por las deudas que tenía, y al buscar ayuda en sus dos amantes, y ellos negársela, decide suicidarse. Su esposo, sumido en la tristeza se fue apagando poco a poco, y una tarde, su niña lo buscó para jugar, y lo encontró muerto. De esta manera, la niña queda al cuidado de una tía ya que su abuela paterna murió al poco tiempo, y su abuelo materno, estaba paralítico.*
![rosa sepia oscuro.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/annafenix/23wXQLC3kCrcN6p9LiPXeFrqWt4pEZCcMUNurQvYqufMNin2hjXBtKGpbBDQ4FTUczDY4.png)

💕 **Análisis de la obra** # *En primer lugar, la protagonista, Emma Bovary, era una mujer soñadora y fantasiosa que presenta un conflicto interno entre sus fantasías y su realidad. Su deseo de plasmar en la vida real una relación amorosa igual a las de las novelas que acostumbraba a leer, la conlleva a comprobar que su matrimonio era tan aburrido como su marido, y buscó en relaciones extramaritales, esa pasión que habitaba en sus fantasías románticas. Y por otro lado, Charles Bovary, era un hombre tranquilo, fiel, aburrido, y no percibía la insatisfacción de su esposa.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaSiyiGFReFiB24bz66cghS4mWdXZmVhGXmSsFJxp4Q21/999634d2_f9a9_4490_bc11_39d6f28a71ec.jpg)

*En términos psicológicos, de esta obra surge el \

, que viene a ser un trastorno caracterizado por la insatisfacción crónica y la necesidad de nutrirse de ilusiones y fantasías sobre uno mismo que contrastan con la realidad.* [Análisis de Madame Bovary - Google](https://www.google.com/search?q=analisis+de+madame+bovary&oq=an&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUqBggAEEUYOzIGCAAQRRg7MgYIARBFGDkyBggCEEUYOzIGCAMQRRg8MgYIBBBFGDwyBggFEEUYPNIBCDU4ODJqMGo5qAIIsAIB8QW3OKM8QET6qg&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8)

title.title: My favorite teacher in primary school who will never be forgotten.
title.body: <div class=\

>
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUycf3idthXv4dKetH3W7kx9VJoSbv2zHEmQP7hj4rjyq/1000070656.jpg 




Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. A teacher is a person who teaches us. It can be our academic education, any education about our life or our ethics and morals. A teacher must make his students study well. By doing this, he may feel proud one day. His students will remember that teacher.

There are many teachers who influence our lives a lot. We may have many teachers in our school life or college level who encourage us in our life, how we will move forward. How we will do something good in life. A good teacher must teach us something good, this is a natural thing.

I remember my primary school when I was in class five. I had a favorite teacher. I have told about my teacher in another post before. We respected him a lot, which is why he loved us a lot. Sometimes his words influenced me a lot. The things he taught us in our class really affected our lives. I still remember when I was in class five, he told me one thing \

I still remember this advice of his. I definitely try to follow his advice. He knew me personally a lot. My father had a very good relationship with him at one time. Also, my grandfather had a very good relationship with him. Because of which he loved me a little more. Sometimes he would buy me food. I still remember the memories of that time and we will never forget him. He is still alive. Sometimes I meet him. I really like meeting him. When I talk to my favorite teacher, we both go back to those previous memories. Although I was young then, I had a very good relationship with my teacher. However, there are many such teachers in our lives whom we can never forget. I hope you will like this post of mine. Thank you all. *** ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) --- Divce | realmi c67 -|-| [Source]( https://pixabay.com/photos/school-teacher-education-asia-1782427/) ### Kind Regards @nahid43 ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nahid43/my-favorite-teacher-in-primary-school-who-will-never-be-forgotten-ggw)

title.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23uFcH8GDdYWRsixYPTsvDPf9JmL6DpTYvChjYcXZmXabsdzQYzVvDcjqjtdZzdBqG3cQ.png)</center>

Time flies! Just completed the 275th brawl with my awesome guild, which is none other than Pizza 2 The Deep Dish!

***

- *Moving Back To Bronze Fray*

Had 7 battles this time and it was not an easy round, especially when they have recently introduced 3 rulesets for each battle. Moreover, I have rented out most of my cards because I was playing lesser these days.

- We Got 8th!!!

So for the final result, we were 8th out of 10 guilds and got 150 Merits and around 3 SPS! Who knows how much one SPS would go to in this market?
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tRzjpkoHh9fPAirisey8U8LbKfRRhJ3wUFrfNPtC4pBZHdugz1zSifoToesVGAxR18D.png)</center>



Individually, I had 7 fights this time and I won 4 of them this time! Finished 2nd within the guild. Due to change in format, wins are actually awarded to the players present in the fray if guilds decided to skip the fray. For this round, there were 2 additional wins for me.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tRvMtZTjwd8ToVN5ij1M726k4AFrJKgfVufVJhoPisxgSk3rUn71iZhmVkS5M2mfHtQ.png)</center>


***
**Battle 1 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: None*

This was somehow an easy win as my opponent didn't have many attacking cards, while mine was a full Magic team.

**MVP: Magi Of Chaos**




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23t7BUnreVYzrRcs4Zt1atEvhtSnynMqz2iryZJrm5iBWiqXmiZRoNnzbL2uW7oPS9dYE.png)










***
**Battle 2 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: Flagulon Reine*

Flagulon Reine was due for a comeback performance it got it right for this battle. Finally I was able to maneuver through this tricky Burning battle so that was something positive to take back.

**MVP: Flagulon Reine**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGbnfuU8m82nP3m8ZuzppYM1mGD8SCyGNyarwFBr3j7CDX4tY4MYsD7fF4PYhTFcY9Z.png)


***
**Battle 3 - WIN**


*Gladius Card Used: Trapp Falloway*

Trapp Falloway is one of the strongest cards for Little League and this time this was almost a one card show as Trapp Falloway wiped out the entire opposing team.

**MVP: Trapp Falloway**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23t7BBrw68r7iQLmPGH79Gx6PaWjASbxaZGSCHi1334drma97JFi5A8KzL6bnWAwooq5k.png)






***
**Battle 4 - LOSE**

*Gladius Card Used: None*

My experiment was a big card Chaos Dragon didn't work out as my team came out short due to the lack of card advantage.

**MVP: None**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGY57yehkgmgd81d4CWpqTScPcz2UweTwv3Nh4yK2hoJ12akTzgZCejS4mqh7Rx55mU.png)





***
**Battle 5 - LOSE**


*Gladius Card Used: None*

As usual, fighting against Quora Towershead over here is just a waste of my effort.

**MVP: None**




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23t7BGjgkCrTCUxQvsxSopstT2BhBTkcnPgFyuYt4tiVPJHmYkQg5LqWjsR711v2nqDUx.png)




***
**Battle 6 - LOSE**


*Gladius Card Used: Larissa Kerato*

Once again. Quora Towershead. Skip.

**MVP: None**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23t78nhE9RPs6cWe4PhcF5snTMuZrT9TeW2n275j5zC4N9xowoghTHCWm2G578QDgW136.png)




***
**Battle 7 - WIN**


*Gladius Card Used: None*

3 Quora Towersheads in a row. Fortunately, Sea Monster and Tide Biter combined very well to counter her effectively and snatched a win in this battle.

**MVP: Sea Monster**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23t79FZYheGTWSLXhfoRtp22nVUqBee1nbcfpbPYGbgwSw5vv65UCoazuoohhC2DY6s1r.png)



So that sums up my 7 battles for this brawl! 57% win rate this time, considering having to fight against 3 Quora Towersheads, definitely a good result! Let's keep fighting PIZZA 2!

title.title: A Explosão dos Modelos de Raciocínio: o3, DeepSeek R1 e a Nova Era do Thinking
title.body: Em setembro de 2024, a OpenAI lançou o o1-preview com uma premissa simples e revolucionária: antes de responder, o modelo pensa. Dezesseis meses depois, o raciocínio explícito deixou de ser diferencial e virou requisito. Todo modelo de fronteira em 2026 inclui alguma forma de thinking. A pergunta deixou de ser \
e passou a ser \

O Que São Modelos de Raciocínio
-------------------------------

A diferença técnica é direta. Modelos convencionais geram tokens em uma única passagem — recebem o input e produzem o output diretamente. Modelos de raciocínio alocam tokens de \

antes da resposta final: o modelo escreve para si mesmo, decompõe o problema, considera alternativas, verifica inconsistências, e só então produz a resposta visível.

Esse processo é chamado de chain-of-thought estendido ou test-time compute scaling. A intuição: se o treinamento define o que o modelo sabe, o compute em inferência define quanto ele aplica esse conhecimento a um problema específico. Mais tokens de pensamento permitem resolver problemas que exigem múltiplos passos de lógica, verificação de resultados intermediários e exploração de caminhos alternativos.

o3 e o4-mini: A Linha de Produção da OpenAI
-------------------------------------------

O o3 e o o4-mini, lançados em abril de 2025, consolidaram o modelo de raciocínio como produto mainstream. O o4-mini com uso de ferramentas chegou a 99.5% pass@1 no AIME — o principal benchmark de matemática avançada usado na competição americana de Olimpíadas. O o3 marcou 96.7% no mesmo benchmark.

A diferença entre os dois é primariamente econômica: o o4-mini custa metade do o3 e entrega resultados semelhantes em matemática e código. O o3-pro, a versão mais capaz, chega a 36 vezes o custo do o4-mini — justificável apenas para casos onde cada token de resposta tem alto valor de negócio.

Ambos foram absorvidos pelo GPT-5 em agosto de 2025, que unificou o pipeline: um único modelo que seleciona automaticamente a profundidade de raciocínio com base na complexidade do problema.

DeepSeek R1 e R2: A Versão Open Source do Thinking
--------------------------------------------------

A DeepSeek lançou o R1 em janeiro de 2025 sob licença MIT — o primeiro modelo de raciocínio open source com desempenho comparável ao o1 da OpenAI. O impacto foi imediato: qualquer empresa pode hospedar um modelo de raciocínio em infraestrutura própria sem pagar por token.

O R1 usa 671 bilhões de parâmetros totais (37B ativos via Mixture of Experts). Foi treinado com o algoritmo GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization), que reduz o custo de treinamento por reforço em aproximadamente 50% em relação às abordagens anteriores. O custo total de treinamento foi inferior a 6 milhões de dólares — menos de um décimo do custo estimado de modelos comparáveis de laboratórios ocidentais.

O R2, lançado em abril de 2026, tomou uma direção oposta: 32 bilhões de parâmetros densos (todos ativos em cada inferência), sem arquitetura MoE. A razão é pragmática — um modelo denso de 32B roda em uma única GPU de consumo com 24GB de VRAM. Para equipes que querem raciocínio local sem dependência de cluster, o R2 é a opção mais acessível disponível. Marca 92.7% no AIME 2025 — acima de muitos modelos proprietários com custo por token dezenas de vezes maior.

O Que Raciocínio Resolve Melhor (e Pior)
----------------------------------------

Os ganhos de modelos de raciocínio são concentrados em domínios específicos: matemática, código, lógica formal, análise de documentos longos e raciocínio científico estruturado. Problemas que se decompõem em etapas verificáveis se beneficiam diretamente do thinking.

Para tarefas conversacionais, síntese de texto, classificação e geração criativa, o ganho é marginal e o custo extra raramente justificado. A heurística que emergiu em 2025-2026 é direta: use raciocínio quando a resposta errada tem custo alto e o problema tem estrutura lógica verificável. Use modelos diretos para tudo que exige velocidade e o erro tem baixo custo.

Test-Time Compute: A Nova Fronteira
-----------------------------------

A descoberta mais importante de 2025 não foi um novo modelo — foi a confirmação de que alocar mais compute em inferência é um eixo de melhoria tão real quanto aumentar parâmetros de treinamento.

Isso tem implicações econômicas profundas. O paradigma anterior era: treinar um modelo maior custa bilhões, mas a inferência é barata. O novo paradigma adiciona uma dimensão: você pode gastar mais em inferência em troca de qualidade superior — sem retreinar nada. Para use cases de alto valor, como descoberta de fármacos, geração de código de produção ou análise jurídica complexa, isso justifica economicamente um custo por consulta significativamente maior.

A questão em aberto para 2026-2027 é se o scaling de test-time compute encontrará retornos decrescentes, ou se há ainda ordens de magnitude de ganho disponíveis alocando mais tokens de pensamento por consulta.

title.title: Happy Italian Republic Day!
title.body:
Hello hivers, an happy June 2th to you! Today here in Italy we celebrate the Festa della Repubblica (it means Republic Day). The main celebration taking place in Rome, but there are celebration in every city, included the city where I live. Like every June 2th, today we commemorate the 1946 Italian institutional referendum (universal suffrage), when Italian people were called to the polls to decide on the form of government (monarchy or republic) following the Second World War and the fall of Fascism. As you can understand, people decied for a republic. Another important thing about that day of the 1946, it was the first time to vote for italian women! Today a group of our friends from a city not so far from us came here to visit an exhibition and to spend some time together, so this morning we went in the main square of my city to drink a coffee and to see a part of the celebration. The moment more touching was when the italian flag was place on the bell tower. ![DSCN0508.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/23z7HdfPvdiHi7aqMUQbftofoUgTbkQUdF335D13v5s5xSwAwGtsC1Y9hLDVVsqTNc1ms.JPG) The tower is 66 meters tall (around 216 ft) and soon in the morning the firefighters placed there the long long flag. I don't have pics of that moment because when we arrived in front of the towel the flag was already there, but I was happy (and proud) to meet there one of my old schoolmate who is a firefight since a lot of years and he was part of that climbers team. ❤️ ![DSCN0514.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EqSXxBWDTRhaysbfpTwvpGTnq5wgazLFVU6jzWwezWQpKdzAaZzabf2ra6U78d9pAqi.JPG) ![DSCN0524.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/241F4ZhPVgDSgm1q6gYpfduh4Xy5t6VqnrjvRtmC7qP36zt5EsvFmUNERgbZcAsC7wmeY.JPG) In the following pic you can see the tower after tha flag was lowered: ![DSCN0553.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EpnDqVooT4FcMJbnrWezDFaqC38GvJDTNTuaFXxZYcp4HnhZiADmAy1RReGhm2z8LBk.JPG) I also took a lot of pics along the walk with my friends, because one of them is a poet and artist who use to hang poems along the streets of different cities, but I'll tell you more in one of my next content. 😁 See ya soon and stay safe, Silvia

\n\nI’m a cook . I sell jollof, fried fish, and soup for events. My \

     1. Vision = Your Recipe Book
Every spaceship needs coordinates. Every business needs vision. 
When I started cooking for people, I didn’t just sell \
. I sold \
. \nEntrepreneurs fail when they sell products. They win when they sell solutions. \nKey quality: \

. Know what problem you’re solving before you light the fire.

   2. Adaptation = Adjusting the Pepper
Space changes. Markets change. Customers change. 
Last year everyone wanted extra spicy jollof. This year pregnant women + old people want mild pepper. 
I lost customers when I refused to adapt. I gained 20+ customers when I started asking \
\nKey quality: \

. Successful entrepreneurs read the room. If the market shifts, your recipe must shift too.

   3. Customer Relationship = Taste Testing
In SciFi movies, aliens build trust before trade. In business, customers return when they feel valued.
I don’t just sell food. I remember names. \
\nI give free small chops to customers who bring referrals. \nHow to attract + retain: \

. 
People don’t buy from businesses. They buy from people they trust.

       My SciFi Take on Earth Business
If my kitchen was a spaceship traveling 10 years into 2036:
1. Robots can cook rice, but they can’t ask \

2. AI can give recipes, but it can’t taste if salt is too much. 
3. Technology can deliver food, but only humans can deliver care.

Entrepreneurship isn’t about having big capital. It’s about having big heart + smart plan.

        My question is:If your job/skill was a spaceship, what 1 quality would keep it flying for 10 years? Drop it below 👇 Let’s build this multiverse together.

title.title: L’Evolució del Mercat de Bons el 2026: Estabilitat amb Volatilitat i Oportunitats en un Entorn de Rendiments Elevats
title.body:
Durant el 2026, el mercat de bons ha experimentat una evolució marcada per la normalització dels rendiments, la influència persistent de factors geopolítics i macroeconòmics, i un augment significatiu de l’emissió de deute, especialment vinculada a la intel·ligència artificial (IA) i les infraestructures. Fins a principis de juny, els inversors han navegat entre preocupacions inflacionàries, expectatives sobre les polítiques dels bancs centrals i un fort volum d’oferta que ha mantingut els rendiments en nivells relativament elevats.

### Rendiments dels Bons Sobirans: Estabilitat al voltant del 4%

Als Estats Units, el rendiment del Tresor a 10 anys ha oscil·lat principalment entre el 4% i el 4,6%, tancant prop del 4,45-4,51% a finals de maig i principis de juny del 2026. Això representa una certa estabilitat respecte a pics anteriors, però amb episodis de volatilitat provocats per tensions al Pròxim Orient i dades econòmiques mixtes. Els rendiments a llarg termini s’han mantingut elevats a causa de l’augment de l’oferta de deute públic i les preocupacions per una inflació persistent per sobre de l’objectiu del 2%.

A Europa, els rendiments dels bons sobirans han seguit una tendència similar, amb el Bund alemany al voltant del 2,9-3% i el bo espanyol a 10 anys prop del 3,4%. El mercat europeu ha afrontat un augment notable de l’emissió (prop d’1,4 bilions d’euros previstos), impulsat per dèficits fiscals elevats a països com França i Alemanya. Malgrat això, la demanda s’ha mantingut sòlida, especialment en bons sostenibles.

Els índexs amplis de renda fixa, com el Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate, han registrat guanys modestos en els primers mesos (al voltant del 0,1-0,8% YTD en alguns períodes), impulsats principalment pel rendiment del cupó més que per apreciacions de preu. Els bons han actuat com a element de diversificació, tot i una correlació més alta amb les accions en escenaris inflacionaris.

### Augment de l’Emissió i el Paper de la IA

Un dels fenòmens més destacats del 2026 ha estat el fort increment de l’emissió corporativa, especialment per finançar projectes d’IA i centres de dades. Grans tecnològiques com Meta han col·locat emissions rècord, i es preveu que el mercat d’inversió grade superi els 1,8 bilions de dòlars en emissions, amb centenars de milers de milions vinculats directament a la IA. Això ha generat pressió alcista sobre els rendiments, però també ha ofert oportunitats d’ingressos atractius per als inversors.

El mercat de bons sostenibles (verds i ESG) ha continuat consolidant-se, amb un creixement esperat impulsat per inversions en infraestructures renovables i energia.

### Perspectives i Reptes

Fins ara, el 2026 ha estat un any de “normalització” per als bons: rendiments més alts que en la dècada anterior, però amb menys xocs de preus que en períodes anteriors. Els bancs centrals, com la Fed i el BCE, han mantingut una postura prudent, amb poques retallades de tipus a causa de la inflació “enganxosa” i riscos geopolítics. Això ha beneficiat el carry (rendiment) dels bons, tot i que la sensibilitat a les dades econòmiques i els esdeveniments internacionals ha generat volatilitat.

**Reptes principals:**
- Augment de l’oferta de deute públic i corporatiu.
- Incertesa geopolítica (Pròxim Orient) i inflacionària.
- Correlació variable entre bons i accions.

**Oportunitats:**
- Rendiments atractius en bons corporatius d’alta qualitat i emergents.
- Gestió activa essencial en un entorn de corbes de rendiments variables.
- Bons sostenibles i vinculats a megatendències com la IA.

En resum, el mercat de bons el 2026 ha evolucionat cap a un escenari més madur i rendible des del punt de vista del cupó, però que exigeix una selecció acurada i una vigilància constant dels riscos macro i geopolítics. Els inversors que han prioritzat la qualitat creditícia i la diversificació han pogut beneficiar-se d’un ingrés estable en un any marcat per la incertesa global. Les perspectives per a la segona meitat de l’any dependran en gran mesura de l’evolució de la inflació i les decisions dels bancs centrals.

Emerging from Springfield, Massachusetts in the mid-1990s, Staind became one of the definitive voices of the post-grunge and nu-metal eras. The band—consisting of frontman Aaron Lewis, guitarist Mike Mushok, bassist Johnny April, and drummer Jon Wysocki (later succeeded by Sal Giancarelli)—caught their big break after a chance encounter with Limp Bizkit’s Fred Durst. Though initially polarized by their heavy sound, Durst was blown away by their raw talent and helped secure them a record deal. Staind's early work blended aggressive, jagged guitar riffs with deeply personal lyrics, but it was their ability to pivot into melodic, emotionally charged rock that ultimately launched them into mainstream superstardom.
The band’s commercial peak arrived with the 2001 release of their multi-platinum album, Break the Cycle. Driven by the massive success of the acoustic-driven ballad \

the album showcased Aaron Lewis's signature vocal delivery: a haunting transition from a vulnerable whisper to a cathartic, powerhouse roar. Throughout the 2000s, Staind dominated rock radio with a string of hits like \
and \

carving out a legacy built on themes of angst, depression, and redemption. After a few extended hiatuses and Lewis pursuing a successful career in country music, the band proved their enduring resilience by reuniting to release new music and tour, reminding fans of the raw, introspective power that defined a generation of alternative rock.

The significance of these picks lies in their connection to the peak of live performance culture across the continent. <div class=\

> Hola, queridos de la comunidad de @motherhood. Hoy quiero compartirles una parte de nuestra rutina que se ha convertido en una distracción dentro de mi maratón de maternidad. Ser mamá es como correr un maratón que nunca termina. Cada día está lleno de carreras, responsabilidades, tareas y momentos que parecen no dar tregua. Pero en medio de esa rutina intensa, he aprendido que también es bueno tener tiempo para el esparcimiento y la recreación, tanto para mis hijos como para mí. Les quiero compartir algo que forma parte de nuestra semana y que me llena de alegría. Los martes y los jueves, mi hijo Santiago tiene sus clases en el gimnasio y entonces esos días, cuando se puede, aprovecho el viaje para llevar a mi hija Gaby a un lugar muy especial, un parque bonito que está justo al lado, en un pueblito cercano al gimnasio. Este parque está en el municipio Gómez, en la ciudad de Santa Ana. Es un espacio grande, bien cuidado, lleno de juegos súper especiales para los niños, columpios, ruedas, pasamanos, sube y baja, todo lo que hace que Gaby se divierta con entusiasmo. Lo más bonito es que son dos horas disponibles para esta actividad, lo que nos da tranquilidad y libertad para disfrutar sin apuros. El parque está ubicado en una placita muy pintoresca, rodeada de estudiantes que se reúnen allí porque cerca hay un liceo. Esa mezcla de energía juvenil con la alegría de los niños jugando crea un ambiente único, lleno de vida. A mí me encanta sentarme un rato, observar a Gaby mientras se balancea en el columpio o corre de un juego a otro y sentir cómo ese espacio se convierte en un respiro dentro de mi maratón de maternidad. Esos momentos me recuerdan que la maternidad no solo se trata de cumplir con deberes y rutinas, sino también de regalarles experiencias sencillas que se convierten en recuerdos felices. Para Gaby, ir a ese parque es una aventura, probablemente poque donde vivimos no tenemos ningún parque parecido y para mí, es magnífico porque además de que disfruto al ver su felicidad, yo también me relajo mucho admirando todo lo que nos rodea, me permito respirar, observar el entorno y agradecer por tener cerca lugares tan bonitos y cuidados. La maternidad puede ser agotadora, pero cuando encontramos estos pequeños momentos, todo se siente más ligero. Así que, queridas mamás de esta comunidad, quiero animarlas a buscar esos momentos de recreación en medio de la rutina. A veces solo basta con descubrir un parque cercano, una plaza tranquila o un rincón especial donde nuestros hijos puedan jugar y nosotros podamos descansar un poco. Gracias amigos por siempre apoyarme en mis historias. Saludos y Bendiciones. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)
**ENGLISH**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)
Hello, dear members of the @motherhood community. Today I want to share with you a part of our routine that has become a welcome distraction in my motherhood marathon. Being a mom is like running a marathon that never ends. Every day is filled with running around, responsibilities, chores, and moments that seem to never let up. But in the midst of that intense routine, I’ve learned that it’s also good to make time for fun and recreation, both for my kids and for me. I want to share something that’s part of our week and that fills me with joy. On Tuesdays and Thursdays, my son Santiago has his classes at the gym, and on those days, when I can, I take advantage of the trip to take my daughter Gaby to a very special place—a beautiful park right next door, in a little town near the gym. This park is located in the Gómez district of Santa Ana. It’s a large, well-maintained space filled with really special playground equipment for kids—swings, merry-go-rounds, climbing frames, seesaws—everything that keeps Gaby happily entertained. The best part is that we have two hours to spend there, which gives us the peace of mind and freedom to enjoy ourselves without feeling rushed. The park is located in a very picturesque little square, surrounded by students who gather there because there’s a high school nearby. That mix of youthful energy and the joy of children playing creates a unique atmosphere, full of life. I love sitting there for a while, watching Gaby as she swings on the swing or runs from one game to another, and feeling how that space becomes a breath of fresh air in the midst of my motherhood marathon. Those moments remind me that motherhood isn’t just about fulfilling duties and sticking to routines, but also about giving them simple experiences that turn into happy memories. For Gaby, going to that park is an adventure—probably because we don’t have any parks like that where we live—and for me, it’s wonderful because, in addition to enjoying seeing her happiness, I also relax a lot by taking in everything around us. I allow myself to breathe, observe the surroundings, and be grateful for having such beautiful, well-maintained places nearby. Motherhood can be exhausting, but when we find these little moments, everything feels lighter. So, dear moms in this community, I want to encourage you to seek out those moments of recreation in the midst of your routine. </liketuimages>

晚上和同事们在喝茶边聊天着，都是在讲一些以前的物价跟现在的物价对比。
Something以前的工资跟现在的工资按比例来看。物价确实是有一些差距。
比如说在2000年左右的时候，我们的工资也就是几十块钱。几十块钱是一天的工资。

但聊到了以前的快餐，一盒是多少钱的时候，大致上就不一样了。
有的年纪稍微小一些的时候都说是10块钱到8块钱。这些都是三十多岁的人，
只是想起我们那时候在外面吃快餐的话，一盒饭要五块钱，

这时候他们就感觉有点不可思议了。因为2000年左右那一款的物价确实挺低的。
而且当时的工资也不高。不上工地的工资，当时的白领也就是2000多到3000块钱。
工地上的工资就比较少了。学徒工的话，应该是在30块钱左右。

如果能够当个师傅。2000年差不多也就四五十块钱。转眼之间，一下子就恍惚，就这么多年过去了。
对比之下50块钱的时候。买一个盒饭要5块钱，相当于去掉了公司的1/10。
然后跟现在对比一盒快餐，也就是25块钱之内。按照我们工地的工资一天，现在是300块钱左右。

这一个对比之下，很明显就出来了。大部分都是在1/10。
当然，我说的快餐。25块钱是相对比较好一些，对不对？如果是算便宜的一些就不用了。
正常的情况下，在外面随便吃，应该是20块钱之内。

所以我们今天晚上聊的最多的也就是这个话题。工资高了，物价也贵了。
一切都是有成正比例的来。不会完全和社会脱钩。

---

title.title: The Only Thing That I Regret
title.body:
![12096.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbjBMKZGFEUCnujmFjjXAVWi6FNiewnVkeT52YE1nPomP/12096.jpg)


I decided to quit smoking again. This is not my first attempt, and I really hope it will be my last.

I downloaded an app called Smoke Free, which is the same app I usually use whenever I decide to quit. When I opened it, I noticed that it was still set to my previous quit date. That was almost a year ago, maybe a year minus ten days or so.

Seeing that date made me think. I started wondering what my life would look like today if I had actually stayed smoke free all that time. If I had stuck with it, I would have been approaching twelve months without smoking. That thought hit me harder than I expected and made me regret going back to smoking more than I normally do.

Several months ago, I wrote an article about mistakes. I said that I have made plenty of them, and some of those mistakes cost me months or even years of my life. Still, I never truly regretted any of them because every mistake taught me something valuable. That is how we learn and how we grow.

There was only one exception. Smoking.

Smoking is the one thing I genuinely regret. I started at a very young age, around sixth grade, and it has cost me more than I can put into words. It damaged my lungs, affected my health, and took much more from me than just money.

Speaking of money, sometimes I try to estimate how much I have spent on smoking over the years. The number is honestly shocking. When you consider how long I have been smoking and add even a modest interest rate, the total easily reaches thousands of dollars. It might sound exaggerated to some people, but I do not think it is.

And when I say smoking, I am not talking only about cigarettes. Over the years, I tried many different forms of smoking, including drugs. Looking back now, I can clearly see how much those choices cost me.

Maybe that is why seeing that old quit date affected me so much. It reminded me that every day I stay smoke free is something I gain back, while every day I continue smoking is something I lose. This time, I hope I finally get it right.

title.title: Nuggets de Pollo (Esp/Eng)
title.body:
![1780348508163.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/EppR4cL8hz5SaYw9ADyPsg6JUtfw8o4gG48GKU5w8yovnNKSCQzigYECNxfERbdv4a6.jpg)

<div class=\

> ¡Hola amigos de Hive Food! Un saludo bien grande para cada uno. Deseo que tengan un día maravilloso. En esta ocasión quiero compartirles una receta exquisita y bien sencilla de hacer: nuggets de pollo. Estoy segura que como yo, una vez que la preparen van a querer hacerla siempre.

> > *Hello, Hive Food friends! A big hello to each and every one of you. I hope you’re having a wonderful day. Today I’d like to share a delicious and very simple recipe with you: chicken nuggets. I’m sure that, just like me, once you’ve made them, you’ll want to make them all the time.*
![1780271947970.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/AKVWBCevMoW1aGEktgTM3xgeATDNCkNrcyvy52RQSXQiRVPXm3jSpbPPm9Chxjt.jpg)

> # Ingredientes: 3 muslos de pollo 1 cucharada de mostaza 1 cucharada de vino seco 1/2 cucharada de vinagre 1/2 cucharada de pasta de tomate 1 hoja de orégano 10 dientes de ajo 1 huevo Migas de pan Aceite para freír Sal al gusto

> # Ingredients: > *3 chicken thighs 1 tablespoon mustard 1 tablespoon dry white wine 1/2 tablespoon vinegar 1/2 tablespoon tomato purée 1 sprig of oregano 10 cloves of garlic 1 egg Breadcrumbs Oil for frying Salt to taste*
![1780348323387.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/AKCJ16UY1UabcNNEK2K7tPfSaXmapLBBKbxYu8WY6nhAhHn2NTRE7jqwkvvSJ51.jpg)
> # Paso a paso ## Paso 1 Primero le quité el pellejo al pollo y separé la masa del hueso para poder luego cortarla a mi gusto.

> # Step by step ## Step 1 > *First, I removed the skin from the chicken and separated the meat from the bone so that I could then cut it to my liking.*
![1780348367469.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/AJkVQmaWF5GfXUpQG26z6MqWCaJGRd1QCNGoKd7nnGU5ZyHNDSQethcFj9DwfFn.jpg)
> ## Paso 2 Corté en pedazos de igual tamaño toda la masa del pollo.

> ## Step 2 > *I cut all the chicken meat into pieces of equal size.*
![1780271282379.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23wMcxutP5ph6tfrEYCsC4mrwDz37nkKE3qcUjViWoyXHkHczfNyPYjXEneyDgeK6RXDr.jpg)

> ## Paso 3 Sazoné con vinagre, vino seco, pasta de tomate, ajo, mostaza, orégano y sal al gusto. Mezclé bien el pollo con todo el adobo para que absorba los sabores de forma homogénea. Puse a reposar el pollo en el refrigerador durante 1 hora.

> ## Step 3 > *I seasoned it with vinegar, dry wine, tomato purée, garlic, mustard, oregano and salt to taste. I mixed the chicken thoroughly with the marinade so that it absorbed the flavours evenly. I left the chicken to rest in the fridge for 1 hour.*
![1780271749382.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/AK7zEGNM9KzuhsM1SDYgQgRp4zhpz6hcq599Q6d6gVzQJNKW3d2wpPZ4e3UPfSQ.jpg)
> ## Paso 4 Una vez transcurrido el tiempo cubrí el pollo con huevo y migas de pan. En caso de que tengan harina en casa también pueden usarla y da aún mejores resultados.

> ## Step 4 > *Once the time is up, coat the chicken in egg and breadcrumbs. If you have flour at home, you can use that too – it gives even better results.*
![1780348084630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/Ep5p8H6xhtRGpr5hrG1dqPRS92u3V9sZXv5QCLL6W6uLciTm1Rj4ySgJgNwbuDZ7wUF.jpg)
> ## Paso 5 Freír en aceite caliente y colocar encima de un papel o servilleta para escurrir la grasa excedente.

> ## Step 5 > *Fry in hot oil and place on kitchen paper or a napkin to drain off any excess fat.*
![1780348040917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/EouD7BSXBq8rLt7xTw2VdV9TKdV4YpKmxBcUiK7f1WHyXWWP23cFRMQmWH1GK9d7ZC3.jpg)

> # Resultado Para acompañar estos deliciosos nuggets hice un arroz blanco y freí tajadas de platano maduro. Mi familia se sorprendió de lo ricos que quedaron los nuggets y otra cosa que nos impresionó fue que aunque eran solo 3 muslos de pollo la receta rindió muchísimo más de lo que esperábamos. Me hace feliz ver que mi familia disfrutó tanto este platillo, ya que el pollo queda crujiente, con un intenso y rico sabor. Espero que les haya gustado la receta, es una buena opción para variar el menú de casa. Saludos, gracias por leerme.

> # Result > *To go with these delicious nuggets, I made some white rice and fried slices of ripe plantain. My family were amazed at how tasty the nuggets turned out, and another thing that impressed us was that, even though we only used three chicken thighs, the recipe made far more than we expected. It makes me happy to see that my family enjoyed this dish so much, as the chicken comes out crispy, with an intense and rich flavour. I hope you liked the recipe; it’s a great option for adding some variety to your home cooking. Best wishes, and thank you for reading.*
![1727200831373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lagoticaderocio/23xpK5kpZ75tEsz4233k9kmVifKKpMkFC3xzzHxhDNCZLaaWbSm2ctz27wonuzWvWULae.jpg)

title.title: XAIGPUARC /// NPU (Neural Prozessing Unit) Integrierung. CPU+dGPU+iGPU+NPU
title.body:
Neural Prozessing Units finden sich auf allen halbwegs aktuellen Intel Prozessoren. Ich glaube die 10er Reihe hatte auch schon welche dabei. 

Diese Recheneinheiten liegen bisher von XAIGPUARC ungenutzt in der Weltgeschichte herum, weswegen ich ihren Nutzen bei den Inferenzen mitzuhelfen einfuege.

Leider kann ich das bisher nur ueber Drittabieter machen hier in dem Fall eine OpenVino Sache. Mit SYCL komme ich da naemlich nicht weit und muss mir entsprechende Rechenkerne auch hier ueber die Zeit selbst auf die klassische Art schreiben.

Erstmal reicht aber auch der Drittabieter sicherlich.

Damit kann das System dann CPU + iGPU + dGPU + NPU benutzen.

Schwierig ist in dem Falle vor allem die richtige Aufgabenverteilung, welche ich aber wie schon angekuendigt auch Automatisiert einbaue derzeit.

Salve

Alucian

title.title: 邂逅商场里的漫画展&品茶
title.body:
自从我知道了云闪付上可以上传发票且能抽奖之后，我就一直忙着攒发票，然后准备抽奖，大连地区只要上传符合要求的票根最低的红包是10元，也就是说保底是10元，而且有50次的机会呢， 这么好的挣钱方式咋能不用呢？这样一算下来也是小500元呢！这对我来说绝对是一笔巨额资金，太有诱惑力了！

于是我便开始跑商场，近两年买东西的发票争取都开出来，有的如果有商场会员，就可以直接在线开票，比较方便，可有的在线不行，就的到柜台去开，为了这个红包我也是拼了， 而且每次刷卡用到红包的时候，那种当时跑断腿的感觉顿时化为了动力，现在红包已经到了100元左右，但还有400向我招手呢！😍🤭

这不在友谊商场刚消费了一笔，但是线上这么也没开出发票，只好到会员中心来，原来有的时候线上的确有点问题，但是会员中心就容易多了，只要拿着收据，立马就开了出来！不过这商场我已经多少年没来这个会员中心了，而且是在9楼，坐电梯上来，发现这里大部分是餐饮区，有很多美食店。

走过一个角落的时候，还发现了一个漫画艺术展，没想到商场有艺术展，摆上那些名家的画，顿时感觉这个商场的艺术氛围感就来了！逛商场真是不寂寞，顺带着也享受了一下艺术人生哈哈！

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTNUnnZwQTKA3nGBxdf2bP1hZb6BuJtTMuNMuU6tCSQUF/art.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcFB8yGxqiURtpQ6h2PLyiDSNoNyWW1HoSTctUSkqJ7Up/9.jpg)
这几张我很喜欢，画的惟妙惟肖，有些夸张确不失神韵，诙谐幽默的风格让普通游客顿时眼前一亮，原本商业气息浓厚的商场竟然有了艺术的底蕴。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRwpMjJku8nmEWRvSWeMX9oDnyh3oRCsZFszTubGFQsVx/44.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNTogAKkip2be5SEWzEx3KDyvUynoHqTEzNwTLfcndLmu/5.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQXuL8AWkQmR7j4vVDjFjoE4EzGf53xXzrSaBVY1XGX7V/6.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZTPvvB6ePAKoya41zjhcj7c7JPiucLmcstyXHcDEauPT/22.jpg)

会员中心开完发票之后，有个免费品茶在5楼，带着好奇的小心思下去看看什么样的茶点。虽然现在不怎么逛商场了， 但是偶尔逛一下感觉还挺好的， 现在的商场现在都是多元化，有休闲区，娱乐区，餐饮区，茶店也是商场里的常见的区域，如果累了，坐下来喝点茶，解解乏还真是不错。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPaX4sZ9tMckWuWcHX5MdxQtKfowDUxCx9Xkc3rwWcjKZ/tea.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWNLwR6e8ie7CgKu9L6wXjQiLXr5SiQj47TngP99xc8hE/_.jpg)


这个茶馆的设计是新中式的，穹顶是悬挂的一卷卷水墨山水书法长卷，墨字苍劲有力，山水写意，加上茶具茶品等等，行走期间，非常雅致。柜台上还有精致的茶点可以自选，茶的品种也很多，我挑了一个墨红玫瑰，老板说这个好，女人喝了养颜活血，还不影响睡眠。 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaoU4ziXqGEkebh2Q19e9QNxCbddVbVFoDGFPPNRypsed/tea1.jpg)
老板将茶泡好，给我端到了方桌上，又拿了小点心，我选了大枣，花生，瓜子和香蕉片。很精致，一个人也小资一下😊😉

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZr9VGru1qdeDsC3MWd4Jeo84uzfMLwELvtAwa3c6PAtw/rose.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSvjQ4Agwt4oUT5KbZozTin6EWNzRuPoGokWJVVa9fD8r/dian.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVfqSCXzgAvmQfnsmRtJmqv3QrdVENSguwEspt69NPddn/_.jpg)

如果约上两个好闺蜜逛逛街，之后在品品茶那可就太完美啦！独自一个人还是有点浪费了😂 不过这种感觉还是挺好的，可以休息一下刷刷手机，偶尔的放松一下，就算是对自己阶段性的奖励吧！

一个人也好，几个人小聚也罢，只要情绪稳定，每天不焦虑，不内卷，内心平静，我觉得就是当下最好的，一切看淡，从容，慢慢的享受生活，这也许是我最喜欢的生活样子吧！

title.body:
**English**


<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjqHrUSNqezAAbAg29vyTJLHpDYwNTpRySEnWcbLnSaL/1780095536023.jpg)</center> 

Hello everyone. In this photo, I captured an everyday scene on the streets of Cuba: everyone, in a chaotic way, getting by and managing their lives the best way they can. Nowadays, life in Cuba is extremely hard for everyone, and it’s common to see this kind of scene near state banks. They have less and less money, and now the pressure is increasing even more because the power constantly goes out for long hours, and not all institutions that provide services to the public have generators or solar panels. Although everyone is struggling, the elderly are the most affected. It seems like in Cuba, nobody cares about the elderly anymore.

For the photos, I used my Xiaomi phone with the following settings:
**​Aperture**: f/2.2
**​Shutter Speed**: 1/630s
**​ISO**: 100. 

***
***

**Español**

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjqHrUSNqezAAbAg29vyTJLHpDYwNTpRySEnWcbLnSaL/1780095536023.jpg)</center> 

Hola a todos. En esta foto capturé una escena cotidiana en las calles de Cuba: todo el mundo de forma caótica resolviendo de la mejor forma posible su vida. Hoy por hoy la vida en Cuba es extremadamente dura para todo el mundo y es común ver este tipo de escena cerca de los bancos estatales. Cada vez tienen menos dinero y ahora la presión aumenta aún más porque se va contastemente la corriente por largas horas y no todas las instituciones que prestan servicios a la población tienen plantas o paneles solares. Si bien todo el mundo está pasando trabajo, los más perjudicados son los ancianos. Parece que en Cuba ya a nadie les interesan los ancianos. 

Para las fotos utilicé mi celular Xiaomi y usé los siguientes parámetros:
