# ESPAÑOL</center>

---

<div class=\

>El día de hoy vengo con un anime que, probablemente se les haya pasado por debajo del radar, pero que se merece toda su atención, donde no es la típica historia de magia a la que estamos acostumbrado, bueno, así la sentí al respecto, más con una protagonista bastante tímida, pero que tiene su toque, por lo que se divertirán con esta historia. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-02_074835_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23wC1a3EPLDG8vf1GfeKT7yJYNujCG3mYcWuXTdJCxod2kEntpnUNwVznBJpoDKBi6wHP.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33317800/mediaviewer/rm1408930306/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_3) ---
> # Silent Witch: Chinmoku no Majo no Kakushigoto (サイレント・ウィッチ 沈黙の魔女の隠しごと)… ---

>Fue estrenada en Julio del 2025, bajo la dirección de Takaomi Kanasaki y Yasuo Iwamoto, el estudio de animación a cargo fue Studio Gokumi y su creador es Matsuri Isora. Esta historia llena de aventuras, fantasía, espada y brujería contó con un total de 13 episodios. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-02_074907_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xpCdhaCUJqeos6gV72W6c4UZ67L4G4YW4xXqfyhErusELJbdRY1P6wXEKZbjNaCrbwg.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33317800/mediaviewer/rm2316726017/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_2) ---
> # En cuanto a la trama… ---

>La historia sigue a Monica Everett, una joven extremadamente tímida y con una severa fobia social, tanto así, que, por este hecho, hizo que desarrollara una habilidad única: lanzar hechizos en absoluto silencio y sin necesidad de recitar conjuros, convirtiéndola así en uno de los Siete Sabios, los magos más poderosos del mundo. Aunque ella solo anhela una vida tranquila y aislada en el campo dedicada a sus amadas matemáticas, su paz se ve interrumpida cuando le encomiendan una misión de alto secreto: infiltrarse en una prestigiosa academia de nobles para proteger desde las sombras al segundo príncipe del reino, quien es el blanco de constantes amenazas de asesinato. ---

>El verdadero reto para Monica comienza al cruzar las puertas de la escuela, ya que debe camuflarse como una estudiante común y corriente mientras lidia con las estrictas normas de la alta sociedad y sus propios e incontrolables nervios, lo cual la pondrá en momentos sumamente graciosos, sin embargo, ¿será capaz de afrontar sus miedos y heridas del pasado, dejando entrar a su vida nuevas personas y, a su vez cumplir la misión exitosamente? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-02_075002_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23w31p6wAJbPjYBUEy1qwVymK3YMwCqoskKsUMiJnUn6G9wEJxBHsaCso7Mhu6DKmscNz.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33317800/mediaviewer/rm901231106/?ref_=ttmi_mi_4_2) ---

>Lo primero que me atrajo de esta historia fue su protagonista, además de graciosa se me hizo única, porque a pesar de que aquí ya nos presenta con una magia extraordinaria y fuerte, su personalidad es bastante real, en el sentido de que esa fobia tiene una causa, es decir, surge por algo y nos explica ese hecho, validando así su comportamiento. No obstante, no solo nos presenta esto, también nos muestra que tener miedo o colapsar ante la interacción social no te hace débil, más el tener el apoyo adecuado y el impulso propio de superarte, así sea en pasos pequeños, hacen la diferencia: ella no deja de tener ansiedad de la noche a la mañana, pero aprende a dar la cara por lo que le importa a pesar del miedo. ---
>Ahora bien, otra de las cosas por las que quizás atraiga a muchos es su animación, me resultó hermosa, aunado que visualmente, el estudio logra que la \

de Monica se sienta poderosa mediante efectos de luces, distorsiones del aire y la velocidad de los trazos. El diseño de personajes es limpio, acorde a las personalidades de cada uno; los uniformes de la Academia Serendia tienen ese aire elegante y aristocrático que la historia necesita, y las escenas de acción (cuando los asesinos atacan) tienen una fluidez y un ritmo excelentes que contrastan de maravilla con la vida cotidiana de la escuela. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-02_075028_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/242NmU9kfeSHtscAnbkcq6m2MFACcBHHtBur9jrEXAWY2ckXu33J47EdywEKTPok2Dnfc.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33317800/mediaviewer/rm3426211074/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3_2) ---

>

- Una protagonista sumamente entrañable: El mayor acierto es Monica. Es un personaje refrescante que rompe con el molde del protagonista cliché, su lucha interna con la ansiedad social se siente genuina.
- El ingenioso sistema de magia: La idea de la \

basada en el cálculo matemático rápido es fantástica. - Un misterio que te mantiene enganchado: El contraste entre la comedia escolar y la tensión de un thriller político funciona a la perfección. - Crecimiento personal a fuego lento: La protagonista no es que a la noche a la mañana ya supero su fobia, más bien aún con el miedo latente, busca hacer bien las cosas y ayudar a los otros y poco a poco y, a través de ello, va apoyándose en los demás. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-02_075109_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tvgDnTa4yLED4yn9eKhYh4DEewoNQbt54XfgFKuEXPcvuKPB4kzuRsqLqvwmaQn1rka.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33317800/mediaviewer/rm1176812546/?ref_=ttmi_mi_6_1) ---

> - El ritmo en la academia puede sentirse lento: Para aquellos que busquen acción constante, pueden resultarles aburrida esta historia. - Ciertos tropos escolares predecibles. - Dependencia del monólogo interno: Como Monica casi no habla debido a su timidez, la serie depende muchísimo de sus pensamientos. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-06-02_075138_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/242Nt11WSdmMD4KsHMdWU6QzHFBFot6xg1jXkrZxwG8vvrSi8UydbYQyQMXqKc2fygw3D.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33317800/mediaviewer/rm3610760450/?ref_=ttmi_mi_3_1) ---
>8.5/10 Historia │ 10/10 Animación │ 8/10 Sonido │ 10/10 Diseño de personajes │ 8.6/10 General ---

>Silent Witch es una entrada de aire fresco en el género de fantasía; se sabe perfectamente lo que es: una historia atrapante, con un misterio bien construido y un desarrollo de personajes entrañable, no es el anime del año, pero sin un anime que busca empatizar con su protagonista. ---

body.title: Bitmine buys $52M ETH; Vitalik proposes DeFi without liquidations
body.body:
Good Morning Lions,

Bitmine just dropped $52 million on Ether, bringing it **90% of the way toward holding 5% of total circulating supply**. That's not passive accumulation anymore — that's a statement. Tom Lee, the chair, said ETH prices aren't reflecting Ethereum's strengthening fundamentals, which is the kind of thing someone with $52 million in the trade tends to believe.

Vitalik published a research proposal yesterday that caught my eye: options contracts instead of collateralized debt positions in DeFi. Liquidations are sudden, oracle-dependent, and they blow up positions when markets move. Options would smooth that out. It's the kind of structural rethink that matters more than price action.

Add MicroStrategy selling their first Bitcoin since 2022, TON rebranding to Gram, and Galaxy Digital launching an institutional prediction markets desk, and you're watching capital repositioning across multiple vectors. Let's get into it.

> Bitmine buys $52M ETH, now 90% toward 5% supply goal. Vitalik pitches options contracts to replace liquidations. MicroStrategy sells first BTC since 2022. DonAlt calls $60K floor. TON rebrands to Gram, token surges 15%. Galaxy Digital opens prediction markets desk.

body.title: A Day of Challenge on the Village Road: A Palm Fruit Truck Breakdown
body.body:
Hello ASEAN Hivers!

Today I want to share a moment that happened on a village road when a truck carrying oil palm fruit suddenly experienced a mechanical problem. The incident temporarily disrupted transportation, but it also showed the spirit of cooperation among people in the area.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWtRz8PM2GH76ww5phPSUWCEb3kEMosmKLh2ZBqK3dksX/1780401263418.jpg)

From the photos, we can see a large truck loaded with freshly harvested oil palm fruit parked on the roadside. The truck was unable to continue its journey due to a mechanical issue. The driver stopped in a safe location while checking the condition of the vehicle.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRNG22PkYSiTq2TsB4gScda2hWHakC6KUBonqwS168ZdQ/1780401341121.jpg)

Despite the unexpected situation, the atmosphere remained calm. The bright weather and clear blue sky made the surroundings look beautiful, with green trees lining both sides of the road. While waiting for repairs, workers stayed near the truck and monitored the cargo.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmez8Jx65PRjk6kdtpNNWu1ePVbNRYFkPMPMUKQ4wkmqaz/1780401411775.jpg)

For communities that depend on agriculture and plantations, transportation plays an important role. A vehicle breakdown can delay deliveries and affect daily activities. However, situations like this are common reminders of the importance of regular vehicle maintenance, especially for trucks that carry heavy loads.

body.title: BTC below 70k, didn't you expect it?
body.body:
![282293.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23wMaSEeQoKvof9FqDrxRF5wWG7dYSbNjCq5mpvvymV5fB8jo4h6YRzWLuL951eaMgKLd.png)


<Hr>


So Microstrategy sold 32 BTC, after Michael Saylor vowed that they'd never sell BTC, and a lot of people are beginning to lose their minds over this, infact people would usually associate that sale with the BTC dump we've had today, but 32 BTC is like dropping a pin in a ocean. 


Of course there's also no other hidden sales. Their wallet is transparent and infact a lot of people are currently tracking their wallet with tracker bots and everything is transparent on the blockchain to see. 

In reality I think people are also more concerned that he actually (Saylor) sold BTC even when he said he won't, but I just think people are being paranoid. 


For example. If someone is throwing their hard earned money into a digital asset, and hoping that they could be part of a futuristic global revolution where they make billions in dollars of profit if BTC can hit 500k for example, does this mean I cannot sell in the short term and actually use the money? 


I understand that $2.5 million in BTC is not a lot of money for Microstrategy and perhaps they're going to have to sell more BTC to raise more money, but I don't think this the \

that people are actually calling it. 


I don't think Saylor is panic selling BTC, they're also not selling it to take profit, I also don't think they're selling it because of financial gains because they'd actually be in loss since they've once bought BTC at 100k.


 This might just a blockchain experiment, something to show something, maybe selling to do something other than to actually make the money. 


For a smart business venture, I don't think they'll be panic selling, and I don't think Microstrategy is in any financial mess at this point, even if they were they'll probably be waiting for 2028 when they know that BTC will be selling above 100 to 150k again to actually make profit. 










While the people in charge are humans, I think these guys are far beyond the \

novices. I also don't think they're selling because they're predicting a dump to maybe the 45k range, Saylor is currently at loss, and I don't think he'll mind being at loss in the short term if it means being in massive gain in 2 to 5 years time. 


![282292.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23tbMFvP5Fbx6tm4HdoTx33nuXppUQD5tHdZgBibHYvPXsTCoKZ4HyHYDD7LQo7HViKgj.jpg)

<hr>

### BTC dump to 69k 

A lot of people are currently not understanding that to win with BTC, you definitely need to be in, long-term.

 BTC is not a life-changing asset if you're not putting in a lot of money or waiting for you investment to mature in 6 to 12 years, and this is probably why we/a lot others are sticking to alts, since that's where the money is, and that's where real things are being built, unfortunately we now have oversaturation and greedy founders.


 However, this is a topic for another day. BTC is currently at 69k and I must say, I'm not surprised, but is this the dump to 45k that we've been predicting, probably not, but maybe a dump to 60 to 65k is possible, an even bigger dump to 50k range is possible and I think this is probably where it might bottom and this will probably happen before the end of the year and might possibly extend to early 2027.


### Conclusion 

 However I think this cycle is going to see less of pain if we actually bottom out and some other alts that didn't do well in the last cycle might just do a little bit better this time *(this is just me speculating)* but I don't think anyone would be worked up with these dumps, anything till 50 to 55k is apparently expected and we just have to just watch and see how it all unfolds. 



As for Saylor, the man didn't get rich by being emotional. Do you know why he actually tells people to buy BTC at all time?


 It's not the love for the tech, he's simply shilling his bags and definitely leading by example, he's been recognized as a public BTC figure and a lead investor, and he'll do everything to shill his bag, this sell is just an investor doing something random, and people are merely just reading meaning into it.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![2n5grBe9nDLr96rW_4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/2n5grBe9nDLr96rW_4/2n5grBe9nDLr96rW_4.webp)

![OFQ2UA0FM9eww6yj__20260602155747.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/OFQ2UA0FM9eww6yj__20260602155747/OFQ2UA0FM9eww6yj__20260602155747.webp)
![tjtOqZc9wrkBqDR6_2.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/tjtOqZc9wrkBqDR6_2/tjtOqZc9wrkBqDR6_2.webp)
![nkAX0qGUSrQLpc9U_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/love5200/images/nkAX0qGUSrQLpc9U_1/nkAX0qGUSrQLpc9U_1.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

路过一家甜品店，暖暖的灯光下摆着刚出炉的蛋挞。走近一看，正做活动：买一盒四个才16.5元，真的很划算。我瞄了一眼旁边金黄酥脆的大可颂，心里突然冒出一个念头——于是笑着问工作人员：“能不能买一盒蛋挞，送个可颂呀？哈哈哈……”

没想到，可爱的店长小妹爽快地回了一句：“可以呀！”那一瞬间，我乐开了花。要知道，那个可颂一个就要7.9元，刚好我也正想吃呢。本来只是随口一问，压根没抱什么希望，结果真成了！心里满是感恩的小惊喜。

这让我想起八年前去青岛旅游的事。当时订了香格里拉的标间，到了酒店办入住时，我鼓起勇气多问了一嘴：“能不能帮忙升级一下房间呀？”前台工作人员几乎没有犹豫，爽快地答应了——直接给我升级成了行政套房，还送了一份免费的自助早餐！那种“赚到了”的快乐，到现在都记得清清楚楚。

其实，很多生活中的“隐形彩蛋”，都藏在你主动多问的那一嘴里。问一问，最差也就是被拒绝，没什么损失；可如果连问都不问，对方也不会主动告诉你。试试看，也许下一个惊喜，就在你开口的那一刻等着你呢。

嘿嘿，路遇两只小野猫，其中一只看到我，一溜烟就跑没影了，另外一只小花猫，它躲进了一个装修屋内，我喊它喵喵喵，这小家伙居然和我对视起来，能看出来它有点怕生，不过呢，貌似它对我也充满了好奇吧，就这样我看着它，它看着我，对视了大概两分钟左右。

哈哈哈，最后，我对着它喵喵喵了几声，表示再见，小家伙，也给我回应了喵喵喵，然后就走了，，今后有缘再见吧，小猫咪。

路过KFC，买了一支花淇淋，话说好久没吃它家冰淇淋了，话说这原味的奶香味比麦麦要更浓郁一些，价格也贵了一元，6元一个，这天气热の冒烟了都，吃一口冰淇淋可真降火啊。

OK，今天先分享到这儿哈，祝福大家周二愉快，喜乐平安。

> Hello friends, happy start to the week, today I share with you my recipe for fried beef meatballs. >Hola amigos, feliz inicio de semana, hoy les comparto mi receta de albondigas de carne de res fritas.

![1001022592.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maricrochets/1001022592.jpg)

> 🍖 **Ingredients:** Ground beef. White onion. 1 egg. 1 clove of garlic. Salt and pepper to taste. Rolled oats. Wheat flour. >🍖 **Ingredientes:** >Carne molida de res. Cebolla blanca. 1 huevo. 1 diente de ajo. Sal y pimienta al gusto. Hojuelas de avena. Harina de trigo.

![1001022342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maricrochets/1001022342.jpg) ![1001022345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maricrochets/1001022345.jpg)

> 🍖 **Preparation:** Season the meat with salt, pepper, grated onion and garlic, and rolled oats. Mix well, then form the meat into small balls and coat them with flour to help them hold their shape. Heat enough oil for frying in a pan or pot. Add a sprig of scallion to the oil to prevent sparks, then add the meatballs one by one. Fry until golden brown and tender. Serve these delicious meatballs with rice and corn, and a tomato and carrot salad. body.title: How to Use a Mini Chainsaw Safely for Wood and Branch Cutting
body.body:
##

![How to Use a Mini Chainsaw Safely for Wood and Branch Cutting (1).jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/46605df252ae2f5c6eff3bd6a26691545d8466e79886e627a03dcf928138d6dc)



A mini chainsaw is a compact and powerful tool that makes wood cutting, branch trimming, and garden maintenance easier. However, using it safely is important to prevent accidents and ensure efficient performance. Choosing a high-quality mini chainsaw can also improve safety and cutting efficiency.

Before starting, always wear protective gear such as safety gloves, goggles, and sturdy footwear. Check the chainsaw to make sure the chain is properly tightened and the battery or fuel system is in good condition. A well-maintained [chainsaw for wood cutting](https://www.chandakagro.com/product/electric-and-petrol-chainsaw) performs better and reduces safety risks.

When cutting, hold the mini chainsaw firmly with both hands and maintain a stable stance. Keep your body balanced and avoid overreaching while trimming branches. Start the chainsaw according to the manufacturer's instructions and allow the chain to reach full speed before making contact with the wood. Using the right tree branch cutting tool helps achieve cleaner and safer cuts.

Always cut away from your body and keep other people at a safe distance from the work area. Avoid cutting branches above shoulder height, as this can reduce control of the tool. If the chain becomes stuck, switch off the chainsaw before attempting to remove it. Following proper [mini chainsaw safety tips](https://chandakagro.blogspot.com/2026/05/how-to-use-mini-chainsaw-safely-for.html) can significantly reduce the risk of accidents.

After use, clean the chainsaw, inspect the chain for wear, and store it in a dry place. Regular maintenance of your portable chainsaw helps extend its lifespan and ensures reliable performance. Following these simple safety tips can help you complete wood and branch cutting tasks safely and efficiently.

\#minichainsaw #chainsawsafety #woodcutting #branchcutting #gardentools #treetrimming #chainsawtips #farmtools #powertools #gardening

body.title: Summer Job Diaries:  Day Three A Busy Day at Work and Watching My Brother Play Basketball
body.body: > **Summer Job Diaries: Day Three A Busy Day at Work and Watching My Brother Play Basketball** ![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23zGeWNckC7KeB1nYQvqRGaTUbaN7TKKaHAwwejQbLuEr2frUXpB4CZjsyyfzJboCAVwp.png) The days really pass so quickly, I can't believe I'm already on Day 3 of summer job. I still clearly remember my first day when I felt so nervous and unsure of everything. I didn't know what kind of tasks I would be assigned, and I was also overthinking a lot about who my co-workers would be and how I would fit in. Everything felt knew and a little overwhelming that time, I kept doubting myself if i could really handle the work. But now, on my third day, I can already feel a big difference in myself. I've slowly become more comfortable with my surroundings, my tasks, and the people I'm working with. I'm starting to adjust to the routine, and I no longer feel so lost as I did during my first day. It feels hood to see this small progress in myself, knowing that I'm slowly gaining confidence and learning more each day. **Bible Study** ![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/242Y5Qi23uTmZtwEyCgJcwG7Gx1SYqrZ2LUrtv6Efkg3614BaGiuLYZ5Yq4twQ68bZbhV.png) On the second day, we had a Bible study with Ate Maricho, Airha, and Ate Roczan. Kuya Clark was late again as usual, which made the moment a bit funny. This time, Ate Maricho brought a Bible with her. It felt really good starting our day with the Word of God. The atmospjere was calm and peaceful as we listened together. It gave a meaningful and positive feeling before beginning our work. **First Task of the Day** ![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23wC9oHCYz9JwJQ4D5b8bKEh9tXvxaAayPnkco8gWmdHRWLKY1bPmoQJkjP5vPPytYLPA.png) After the Bible study, we suddenly feltt nervous when Sir Ron called us to the Treasurer's Office. We went there and he just told us to go back to our office right away. We were all confused because he did not say the reason why we were called. It made us wonder what was going to happen next. When we returned to the office, Sir Ron showed us a large amount of money and askedd us to count it. It was 250,000 pesos, and it was my first time ever holding such a huge amount of cash. I was really shocked and a bit nervous while holding it. He explained that it was for the cash prize for the basketball awarding related to our work from the first and second day. While counting, Airha and I were very careful because we were scared that we might miss even a single peso. **Second and Last Task of the Day** ![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/23vsLdUuw4ZkYFJcn2huiUJs1wa8EB2VLDHE7StAyJpRUJbXG6dm9XotjdxDR7BvYtPjM.png) During the second day, we were still in the trial-and-error stage of completing the whole program with the exact schedules for the annual fiesta. Now that our work had been checked, we were asked to make 25 copies of the document, back-to-back, with 34 pages each. The task was actually simple, but it became stressful because there was only one printer available. It also took a verry long time because the pages had to be printed one by one. While waiting for the printing, we just spent time talking and sharing stories about our personal lives. It turned into a light and fun moment despite the slow progress of our work. That was also when we found out that Kuya Clark actually has a girlfriend. We noticed how sweet they are with each other, which made the waiting time more interesting and fun. So we were not able to finish printing everything. We barely even reachd one fourth of it, since we only managed to print about three back-to-back pages. The printing process was really slow, and it took so much time per page. In the end, we were still far from completinng the 25 copies. **My Brother's Basketball Game** ![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/242NYNTqyFQjHT3hhDnmdMsNfQgyc4bWD8YhZ9oy2bLcuRaMXuDmA2toy6bjoa1BzjX5s.png) After work, Airha and I were picked up by my father. Ever since the summer job started, my dad has always been the one fetching and dropping me off, and I really appreciate it, love you, Papa. He told us that my younger brother had a basketball game, so we immediately went there after work. It was a 3x3 game since the space was small, and it was just for fun. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/khirstin/EoK6Kx56ZiBwBuDfV5Y3CVNqVZq1QY738r5sHbQ6aEPLKyEByBo4vhkXt7FZUMzH5Vo.png) This wasn't their first game, its actually their second game already. During their first game, they actually won, and they were really happy about it. For this game, their opponents were much stronger, but they still gave their best effort. In the end, they unfortunateely lost, but they still played with heart and determination. **That would be all, Thank You for reading!!**

body.title: Calamar Gigante y Crustáceos: Un fascinante ecosistema bajo las profundidades del mar[Esp-Eng]
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** En esta ocasión, los invito a acompañarme en un maravilloso recorrido por el museo, donde aprenderemos sobre el calamar gigante, considerado una criatura legendaria de las profundidades marinas. Conocido comúnmente como calamar gigante, cuenta con una ficha informativa, al igual que muchos de los animales del museo, que proporciona información precisa sobre este ejemplar. Se trata de un molusco con una cabeza bien desarrollada y un pie modificado en una corona de apéndices tentaculares que poseen ventosas o ganchos semicirculares como dispositivos adhesivos extraordinariamente eficaces. Estos cefalópodos pueden cambiar de color en segundos, adaptándose a su entorno al imitar no solo el color, sino también la forma y la estructura del lecho marino. Su dieta consiste en peces y otros calamares. Son dioicos (tienen sexos separados). El órgano copulador del macho suele ser un brazo modificado a través del cual el macho inserta el aguijón seminal en la hembra. Ella luego adhiere los huevos a rocas y plantas hasta que eclosionan los pequeños calamares. Este ejemplar fue donado al museo por la familia Ramos y ha estado expuesto durante varios años. Por lo que se puede observar, su piel parece lisa y sus tentáculos son bastante grandes. Me impresionó verlo en el museo; se asemeja a una especie de esponja o a una hogaza de pan.

> **
ENGLISH
** This time, I invite you to join me on a wonderful tour of the museum where we will learn about a giant squid, considered a legendary deep-sea creature. Commonly known as giant squid, it has an information card, like many of the animals in the museum, that provides precise information about this specimen. It is a mollusk with a well-developed head and a foot modified into a crown of tentacular appendages that possess suckers or semicircular hooks as extraordinarily effective adhesive devices. These cephalopods can change color in seconds, adapting to their surroundings by mimicking not only the color but also the shape and structure of the seabed. Their diet consists of fish and other squid. They are dioecious (having separate sexes). The male copulatory organ is often a modified arm through which the male inserts the seminal sting into the female. She then attaches the eggs to rocks and plants until the tiny squid hatch. This specimen was donated to the museum by the Ramos family and has been on display for several years. From what can be observed, its skin appears to be smooth, and the tentacles are quite large. I was impressed to see this specimen in the museum; it resembles a kind of sponge or a loaf of bread. ![1000482272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoGwSuXRmvZnPj7qSDQTGANVXX1bnifN5sKkS2GKYJXyQQ9i4Ro1HmskUgmVDFDqNeE.jpg) ![1000482273.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep1V3KAWQuYMqXkHjdU9n1xdWxw8zhTMsScU1fJS6TM2x9yYAJiLnjSCLzE5zbaF3Ag.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

>


Continuando, nos topamos con los crustáceos, también organizados en vitrinas para su conservación y protección. El primer ejemplar que encontramos fue una navaja, que destaca por sus patas delanteras y pinzas. Luego vimos una cucaracha marina, varios cangrejos, incluyendo el cangrejo azul y el cangrejo ermitaño, entre otros. El cangrejo azul es muy común en la ciudad y, según la guía, en la zona de San Luis se suelen encontrar muchos cangrejos azules de tonalidad azul grisácea. Por la tarde, se podía observar un gran grupo de cangrejos caminando por la orilla de la playa; de ahí el nombre de un conocido lugar turístico llamado \
, ubicado en la playa mencionada.

>

 
Moving on, we came across the crustaceans, also organized in glass boxes for their preservation and protection. The first specimen we found was a razor clam, notable for its front legs and pincers. Then we had a marine cockroach, several crabs, including the blue crab and the hermit crab, among others. The blue crab is very common in the city, and according to the guidebook, in the San Luis area, many blue crabs with a grayish-blue hue were often found. In the afternoon, a large group of crabs could be seen walking along the shore of the beach; hence the name of a well-known tourist stop called \

(Blue Crabber), located on the aforementioned beach. ![1000482268.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EogKyFvxVQnkvniD7eZLP4tC6ei3sqQR7HXRU1wC8xHjGsvMT51hwDocpzZFwmEHpBw.jpg) ![1000482263.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoniypRGaimBkUy3kDAquSAWrrxjTKz6hTv84jJ8ALjFTeYKxhWVzGfJWdcD8RozzDY.jpg) ![1000482264.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eo8RLmNBCnayWv6gwCwoQHfS4TVs4DLKzgVpnrH2RJg2jmp9NKVHzDWzt33UT8oyyGZ.jpg) ![1000482265.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoEp5gZ7SBMrU3aHBzbDeMXMN4N8WP6ox2CmDumQeizZYQzs4tev8NH7TwN8Y97XNzw.jpg) ![1000482266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EopsTNiiwcjfbX1dDi4VeFFA4Y6SSpwQ7tkAT8ZTEqZD2CT96h9iMFaWdP5Z3qDAe7n.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Continuando nuestro recorrido por el museo, llegamos a la zona de las langostas. Las langostas pertenecen al grupo de los moluscos, junto con los cangrejos. Entre las langostas expuestas se encuentra la langosta moteada, que se asemeja a un círculo aplanado con varias puntas que son sus patas. Estas puntas emergen de la parte frontal, posterior y laterales. Luego tenemos la langosta común, con sus características patas y puntas frontales. Sus colores varían del marrón oscuro al beige claro y al negro. Están cuidadosamente colocadas sobre rocas calizas con tierra de fondo. A continuación, tenemos una exhibición de corales y una muestra de sedimentos tomados de la laguna de La Restinga. Estos se recolectan periódicamente para comprender en detalle la estratificación del paisaje submarino. Estas hojas informativas son muy útiles para que los visitantes aprendan sobre los aspectos importantes y relevantes del lecho marino y la fauna que lo habita. Después, vemos algunos restos fósiles. Aquí me detuve un buen rato observando cómo estos animales y conchas han dejado sus huellas en la roca; parecen moldes para reproducirlos muchas veces. Tras observar estos impresionantes fósiles, les tomé una foto, intentando enfocar la mayor cantidad posible. Es increíble la huella que han dejado en esta roca a lo largo de los años. Gracias por acompañarme en esta fascinante aventura, aprendiendo sobre el calamar gigante y algunos moluscos como las langostas y los cangrejos.

> Continuing our tour of the museum, we arrive at the lobster area. Lobsters belong to the mollusk group, along with crabs. Among the lobsters on display is the spotted lobster, which resembles a flattened circle with several points that are its legs. These points emerge from the front, back, and sides. Then we have the common lobster, with its characteristic legs and front points. Its colors range from dark brown to light beige to black. They are carefully positioned on limestone rocks with soil in the background. Next, we have a coral exhibit and a sample of sediments taken from the La Restinga lagoon. These are collected periodically to understand the stratification of the underwater landscape in detail. These information sheets are very helpful for visitors to learn about the important and relevant aspects of the seabed and the fauna that inhabits it. Then we have some fossil remains. Here I paused for a long time observing how these animals and shells have left their marks on the rock; they look like molds for reproducing them many times. After observing these striking fossils, I took a picture of them, trying to focus on as many as possible. It's incredible the shapes they have left on this rock over the years. Thank you for joining me on this fascinating adventure, learning about the giant squid and some mollusks like lobsters and crabs. ![1000482267.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep1VuDjnHu2gypLuSTLWD3XCxthD7rzNy8MUX3uzaHw7vsD5Cbq7MWADdw5gjBfPfpf.jpg) ![1000482271.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep1VWVuZSk5EmfcsCH53FMd8uWjQjfP4ihLyM7RVh47T5585JEHtjEMeQvvjUnrj7De.jpg) ![1000482269.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpC8Tksw7ticcMEKAb9w24oYHEpAAU24W7XoeM1bm6oRnoFwZpTsP5qLS4ZZNnUiAZu.jpg) ![1000482270.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpNmw1beaESHqyk1oPy7H91RQt2kTRyC42Xk2HPHhdFgy2nCsWRPTLEKZ5SCYpdj2fr.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

body.title: 一声叹息：年少抛人容易去呀
body.body:
好多好多年前，一个天气晴朗阳光明媚的下午，我在大学《马哲》（大概是）课上感到百无聊赖，一丁点也听不进去老师在讲些啥。


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPrmuZUhGp5ND7MffVn9trjMtMmjGrCCUYwTSHV2wBYKs/image.png)
(图源 ：[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/text-letter-old-letters-retro-4095909/))


脑子里思绪飘飞，突然想起了北宋·晏殊的《玉楼春·春恨》：
>绿杨芳草长亭路，年少抛人容易去。楼头残梦五更钟，花底离愁三月雨。
无情不似多情苦，一寸还成千万缕。天涯地角有穷时，只有相思无尽处。 

突然就想把它翻译成白话，于是就在《马哲》书页的空白之处，潦草地写下了我的翻译。

![47c50fe82e6c3cd3a3168e431abdf545.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdDrAiMakEAU34Q3hEsuJNJFekWMUQNxWt5ku2QoYwSTv/47c50fe82e6c3cd3a3168e431abdf545.jpg)

大概是觉得自己翻译得挺好，后来就把《马哲》的这页撕了下来，夹在了某本笔记中。

好多年来，每次再读到《玉楼春·春恨》，我都会想起那个让我百无聊赖的午后课堂，以及我曾经翻译过这首词，并且翻译得很好（自我感觉），但是遗憾的是我已经完全记不得的翻译内容了。

前些天对自己乱七八糟的收藏进行大扫除，竟然无意中发现我收藏的书页，才发现自己的字迹实在是太难看，自己的翻译实在是太离谱。

不过那又怎样呢？那可是我的青春啊。我把原稿和我的翻译贴上来，祭奠一下我逝去的青春吧。

我的翻译的文字版
>十里长亭的路边，绿杨挺拔，芳草逶迤。
春景尚好，而年少的时光却抛人一去不返。
五更天的钟声惊醒小楼中词人的残梦，
三月里的小雨淅淅沥沥更增添了花底离愁的感伤。

>毕竟多情的人总比无情的人更容易受情感的煎熬，
小小的别离也可以织成千丝万缕的愁绪。
天涯地角纵然遥远终可抵达，
而相思之苦却绵绵不绝、浩渺无际！


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ63naNRxCHUf3toAzpjutNuDeNKSEqBPP48Ly42qseKr/image.png)
(图源 ：[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/filmstrip-negatives-photography-1850277/))

话说，如果当年读《玉楼春·春恨》时，让我感触最为深切的是***只有相思无尽处***，多年后再读，最让我想哭的则是***年少抛人容易去***呀！哎，一声叹息！

body.title: Changes to @v4vapp frontend
body.body:
**[Vote for Brianoflondon's Witness KeyChain or HiveSigner](https://vote.hive.uno/@brianoflondon)
[Support Proposal 342 on PeakD](https://peakd.com/me/proposals/342)**

***This is a value for value post: see the explanation in the footer.***

---

## Behind the scenes changes

**TL;DR You may have to re-login to @v4vapp** 

I've just completed a security audit and some internal upgrades to the way the log in and account system works in the frontend for @v4vapp at [v4v.app](https://v4v.app/). 

I did the whole AI thing and asked it for vulnerabilities and it pretty much told me about a corner I knew I cut when I built the system for the first time.

It wasn't really very significant because at the heart of it, you still need to sign most transactions with a set of Hive keys, but for some of the operations involving KeepSats, there was a lingering problem with the way I was storing a long term cookie in your browser.

That's been changed for a modern refresh token system and the only reason I'm even posting about this is that it will probably force you to log in again when I deploy the new version in the coming hours (soon after this post.

## Magi Sats

As I previously wrote, you can now deposit and withdraw from and to Magi Sats on the @magi.network via Lightning. This is way quicker than Bitcoin main chain and usually cheaper (I say usually because there is a fee going in and out but it's probably less than main chain fees.

## New Credit Card Images


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brianoflondon/EopxC7qrCQ57ybtfdbweanLoJWL6HmPGtb5YVGYJJgapW6ErTNRot8daE2Q1tGvjevq.png)


And I added a few new credit card images, just for fun.

-------

## Value for Value

For the last few months while building @v4vapp I was generously supported by the DHF. Going forward I have a much more modest support which covers direct server costs and a little of my time.

If you appreciate the work I do on and around Hive, you can express this directly: upvoting posts on Hive is great. Also consider a direct donation (there's a Tip button on Hive or a Lightning Address) on all my posts.

body.title: Catching Fresh Tilapia and Cooking Pinaksiw Recipe with My Daughter Using Fresh Santol from Our Backyard
body.body:
![Monochrome Modern Minimalist Inspiration Moodboard Photo Collage  (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48RsqF8ynCkeMZvmw7zJngKiHJS8LcbaWEqKRy5XqJf5d3o5VWgcwFXgqSwA2SR4pY.jpg)

We live a simple life here on our farm, and most of the time, our food comes from our surroundings. Behind our farm house, there is a small sapa. Sometimes we go there to get fish for our ulam. Today, we were able to catch tilapia, so that is what we cooked.

![IMG_20260602_110228.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vsG6LZukp4ZZuxhac2dWAnf2FLFou9qoGE1uyb1PUrzbQ7ncrNAXfjRq246kpjtAuNB.jpg)

Tilapia is very common for us, and it is also my daughter’s favorite fish. We usually cook it in different ways like fried, sinugba, sabaw, and pinaksiw. For today, we decided to cook pinaksiw na tilapia because it is simple and easy to prepare.

![IMG_20260602_110731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2ieAQ9nuKEQHSBgLtb5mrrd5XqQXd97fR3VvNEEJ7egs2hV8yiM1gMVNCdGiEKnhaJ.jpg)

After catching the fish, we went to our backyard to get some santol. We have a santol tree there, and it has many fruits. Some of them are high, so we only pick the ones we can reach. We got enough santol to add to our dish.

![Monochrome Modern Minimalist Inspiration Moodboard Photo Collage  (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48SMNyBMJ1DiGv71TqXTymLL7UoVFFszRfpWMbRbAmYg47V7GxHiswhgEPgzeeQTHg.jpg)

We brought everything home and started preparing. First, we washed the tilapia using water from our pump. Then we cleaned it properly. After that, we prepared the ingredients like onion, garlic, ginger, and santol.

![IMG_20260602_113602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tbsG3yxBFLuT6JEuMSAcNgLSnsG9b13h8J4yTzZpQZr4rAq4et4eVjVAUTty21si5bd.jpg)

My daughter always wants to help me whenever I cook. I let her join because I want her to learn simple tasks at home. She is always excited when she is included in cooking. She helped me put the ingredients into the kaldero while I supervised her.

![IMG_20260602_154548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zGY3mvuQuLhJEzW8ATFSozVDT7SCpq9yFbKxd2vCJneH1vBzeDh57oVKgHrj87XZ3jx.jpg)

We then started cooking the pinaksiw. We just let it boil and waited for the fish to cook well. The smell of tilapia mixed with ginger, garlic, and santol filled our small kitchen while cooking.

![IMG_20260602_121810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23y8qrNDXGfU2Mn4pgWjkeVvTgeqGXEsFiJeaCrBx7pHb6cNJsrxoGXKmSGHR6EWNGzba.jpg)

![IMG_20260602_122217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xVGnriaDqEtVksBqT3B1Q2nTbdaFX7uyXgTzsja4hG3aXnyNqD2bfvT4GztjLsVrWjt.jpg)

After a while, the food was ready. We served it and ate together. My daughter was very happy because she helped prepare the food. She enjoys it more when she is part of the process.


![IMG_20260602_124809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wC9vXSEB8BSV1p2LwNYikZCNBK3vkHELV3psz4y2xcXMFCKhs55nvMSWd19Sd1NExWD.jpg)

The taste was simple but fresh because the fish came directly from the sapa and the santol from our backyard. We did not need to buy everything from the market.

Thank you for reading my story, this is my owned picture and experience. This is our simple life here on the farm. We rely on what is available around us. Simple food, simple living, and time with family is what we have every day. Have a nice day! 💛

body.title: Cómo transformar cualquier texto en una expresión visual única en la era digital
body.body:
La forma en que nos comunicamos en internet ha cambiado de manera notable durante los últimos años. Ya no basta con escribir un mensaje simple o publicar una frase común en una red social. En un entorno donde millones de personas comparten contenido cada segundo, destacar visualmente se ha convertido en una necesidad para quienes desean captar atención, transmitir personalidad o reforzar una identidad propia.

Las palabras siguen siendo el elemento principal de la comunicación digital, pero la presentación de esas palabras tiene un impacto cada vez mayor. Un texto con un estilo atractivo puede despertar curiosidad de inmediato, mientras que una publicación visualmente genérica suele pasar desapercibida entre cientos de contenidos similares. Por esta razón, muchas personas buscan nuevas formas de personalizar sus mensajes y hacer que sus publicaciones tengan una apariencia diferente.

La evolución de las plataformas digitales ha impulsado la creatividad de los usuarios. Hoy es común encontrar nombres decorados, biografías personalizadas, mensajes con símbolos especiales y frases escritas con estilos llamativos. Estas pequeñas modificaciones permiten transmitir una imagen más original sin alterar el contenido del mensaje. Lo interesante es que esta tendencia no está limitada a un grupo específico de usuarios; estudiantes, creadores de contenido, jugadores, emprendedores y profesionales utilizan recursos visuales para mejorar su presencia en línea.

Uno de los métodos más populares para lograr este objetivo consiste en transformar el texto convencional en versiones estilizadas que conservan su legibilidad, pero adquieren una apariencia completamente distinta. Gracias a los avances tecnológicos y a los estándares modernos de codificación de caracteres, es posible generar letras decorativas, símbolos creativos y variaciones tipográficas que funcionan en numerosas aplicaciones y plataformas.

En este contexto, existen herramientas especializadas que permiten convertir palabras comunes en diseños visuales atractivos de manera rápida y sencilla.

Estas soluciones han ganado popularidad porque eliminan la necesidad de instalar programas complejos o descargar fuentes adicionales. Todo el proceso puede realizarse desde un navegador, permitiendo a cualquier usuario experimentar con distintos estilos hasta encontrar el que mejor se adapte a sus necesidades.

La clave detrás de esta transformación se encuentra en Unicode, un sistema internacional diseñado para representar caracteres de diferentes idiomas y símbolos dentro de un mismo estándar. Gracias a esta tecnología, los usuarios pueden generar textos con apariencias elegantes o creativas que mantienen la compatibilidad con una gran variedad de servicios digitales. Esto significa que las letras modificadas pueden utilizarse en perfiles sociales, aplicaciones de mensajería, videojuegos, foros, blogs y muchas otras plataformas.

El atractivo de los caracteres decorativos va más allá de la simple estética. En muchos casos, ayudan a reforzar la identidad personal o de una marca. Cuando una persona utiliza un nombre distintivo o una descripción visualmente llamativa, aumenta las posibilidades de ser recordada por otros usuarios. Del mismo modo, los creadores de contenido pueden utilizar [estilos tipográficos originales](https://cambiadordeletras.net/) para destacar títulos, frases importantes o elementos clave dentro de sus publicaciones.

Otro aspecto interesante es la enorme variedad de opciones disponibles. Algunas personas prefieren estilos elegantes y sofisticados, mientras que otras buscan diseños modernos, divertidos o inspirados en tendencias populares. También existen usuarios que desean incorporar símbolos especiales relacionados con videojuegos, especialmente en comunidades donde la personalización del nombre de usuario forma parte de la experiencia. Esta flexibilidad permite que cada persona encuentre una alternativa acorde con su estilo.

La facilidad de uso representa otro factor importante. No se requieren conocimientos técnicos avanzados para generar letras decorativas. Generalmente, basta con escribir un texto en un campo determinado para obtener múltiples versiones estilizadas listas para copiar y utilizar. Este proceso rápido y accesible ha contribuido a que millones de usuarios adopten estas herramientas como parte de su actividad diaria en internet.

Además de las redes sociales, las letras creativas también tienen aplicaciones en ámbitos profesionales. Algunos emprendedores las utilizan para destacar promociones, llamar la atención sobre productos o presentar mensajes de forma más atractiva. Cuando se emplean con moderación y buen criterio, pueden convertirse en un recurso útil para mejorar la presentación visual de determinados contenidos.

La creciente competencia por la atención en el entorno digital ha demostrado que los pequeños detalles pueden marcar una gran diferencia. Un texto cuidadosamente presentado tiene más posibilidades de generar interacción que uno que pasa inadvertido. Por esta razón, cada vez más personas exploran nuevas alternativas para diferenciarse y expresar su creatividad a través de la escritura.

La personalización visual continuará desempeñando un papel relevante en la comunicación digital. A medida que surjan nuevas plataformas y tendencias, los usuarios seguirán buscando formas innovadoras de destacar sus mensajes sin perder claridad ni funcionalidad. Las herramientas de transformación tipográfica responden precisamente a esa necesidad, ofreciendo una manera sencilla de convertir textos comunes en composiciones visuales con mayor impacto.

En definitiva, la capacidad de modificar letras y generar estilos únicos representa una combinación perfecta entre creatividad y tecnología. Gracias al estándar Unicode y a las soluciones disponibles en línea, cualquier persona puede dar un aspecto especial a sus palabras y transmitir una imagen más original. En un mundo donde la primera impresión suele producirse a través de una pantalla, contar con recursos que permitan destacar visualmente puede convertirse en una ventaja significativa para quienes desean dejar huella en el universo digital.

body.title: The Path to the Future Is Not What It Seems
body.body:
![GreatMigration.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYFynjemyjgYWEA2mTBbFMRMS1dN54JiFvpNAnWhWcRB6/GreatMigration.png)

We seem to be on the brink of many unCivil Wars.
The Wokeians want to killall the Not-Cs
Bad people, that shouldn't be in our country, are running around our cities doing awful things.
Politicians are getting caught with their hands in the cookie jar, and worse, far worse.
And rumors of world war 3…

Lots of fighting, lots of battles, lots of deaths

Our future appears to be one of fighting the bad guys.
Or of fighting a war.
Or of fighting the govern-cement.

But, fighting is not really necessary.

We need to remove our support for the evils that govern-cements do.
We need to take back our power.
And create a new life with our \
, our tribe, where we are mostly self sufficient. We do not have to fight the old dinosaurs. They are already dying. We need to avoid being trampled by dinosaurs in their death throws.

></center>
## Your task, should you choose to accept it

All you have to do is find your tribe, find your \

. That's it. (well, of course that's not everything, else this would be a really short post) You have to find your tribe, move to be with them, build a multi-family homestead / small community. Start growing your own food. Build a greenhouse (or several), with hail shields. We will also need to figure out how to live politely in a big group. Our current, degraded standards, we use in a city will not suffice. A 51% vote is not adequate to decide anything and keep group coherence. What marriage is, will be greatly redefined. And a rule, that will be quite shocking at first, and then seem normal, is that children born in the community/tribe belong to the community. (not the state, never the state) The children do not belong to the mother. She may leave, it is her free will to do so, but she may not take the children with her. We only view this through the broken rules of modern divorce law, which gives the children to the mother, unless the child's safety is in question. (The Tender Years Doctrine) Children used to be given to the father, who was supporting them. Now, the children will be seen as part of the tribe, who is supporting them. Further, it is the tribe that is raising the child. We will not leaving the mother to fend for herself. There will be others to help with midnight feeding and diaper changing. Many women will be involved in raising a baby. And when older, there will be many adults involved in raising, feeding, teaching. The child will be a part of the tribe. And it will be considered very bad to separate the child from its support network. (Especially for the selfishness of one woman)

></center>
## Clearing out psychopaths and sociopaths from positions of power.

In the last paragraph, you might have been thinking, what about the mother who finds herself in a cult?  She should grab her child and run away.

And this may be a problem as \
start forming.  We have heard of such groups happening all over.  Especially when speaking of communes, and \

. As a person looking to find your tribe, it is really important to know if you are joining a cult. Fortunately, that is very easy, if you know what a narcissist is. A narcissist is a being who does not have warm empathy. A creature who cannot love you. Although, they can pretend… really well. Narcissists are masters of lies, and once you get into their group, they will pit you against other people, triangulating so that you feel that the narcissist is your only friend. All others are enemies. If you find yourself feeling this way, you really need to get help, and fix your view of reality. (narcissists destroy your connection with reality. Gas lighting you all the time. Telling so many lies that you do not know what is true anymore) We learn what is the patterns of narcissists and cut them out when we find these patterns. A narcissist can only exist when they operate in the shadows. When only one person can see them, that person is in danger. But when multiple people see them, then the narcissist is easy to weed out. And, truly, just ask them to demonstrate their ability to show compassion. The narcissist can only pretend, and will do so badly. There are all kinds of tests we will create that will catch most narcissists before they get their hooks in your community. AND!! as we get rid of them from our communities, we will also apply these tools to anyone who wants to run for office. When we clear out government of these destructive creatures, we will find that government actually works a LOT better.

></center>

As you see, we do not really need to fight.   We need to stop supporting the rots-childs puppets.

We need to grow our own food.  The narcissist with their black hearts and black thumbs will have a very hard time doing this.  They need us, we don't need them.

We will produce our own products.  Each \

will have a product they make for trade.  The corporations will crumble as no good hearted person will deal with them.  And no person has to deal with them when they have a good alternative.\n\nWe will not live in tightly packed cities.  The \
will live dotted all over.  Being along rivers or freeways will no longer be necessary.  Each \

will find land that is a good fit for them.

The future is very different.  And no shots need to be fired to get there.  Although there will probably be a lot of fighting. Those who believe in controlling others, do not like to give up that control.  Once we recognize our own authority over our own lives, things will greatly change.  (don't worry, those old dinosaurs are already dying.  We do not have to fight them.  We have to stay out of the way of being trampled.)

So, find your \

, your tribe. The getting out of the city part will take care of itself. The growing food to feed your tribe will follow. People will no longer live lonely lives, surrounded by people who are not the friends. We will be living with surrounded by friends, who really want to see your succeed. Things are really about to change.

>\n
All images in this post are my own original creations.

body.title: Phoenix Car Accident Lawyer | Trusted Legal Help After a Crash
body.body:
A [Phoenix car accident lawyer](https://www.bigchadlaw.com/phoenix-car-accident-lawyer/) can provide valuable legal guidance and representation for individuals who have been injured in vehicle collisions caused by another party’s negligence. Car accidents can lead to serious physical injuries, emotional stress, medical expenses, lost wages, and long-term financial challenges. Navigating the legal and insurance processes alone can be overwhelming, especially while recovering from injuries. An experienced attorney helps accident victims understand their rights, gather evidence, negotiate with insurance companies, and pursue the compensation they deserve.

After a car accident in Phoenix, one of the most important steps is seeking medical attention and documenting all injuries. Even injuries that seem minor at first can develop into more serious conditions over time. Medical records often play a crucial role in supporting an injury claim. A lawyer can help collect and organize this documentation while also obtaining police reports, witness statements, photographs, and other evidence that strengthens the case. Thorough preparation is essential for proving liability and demonstrating the full extent of damages suffered by the victim.

Insurance companies frequently attempt to minimize payouts or settle claims quickly for less than their actual value. While insurers may appear cooperative, their primary goal is often to protect their financial interests. A skilled attorney understands insurance company tactics and works to ensure that clients are treated fairly throughout the claims process. By handling negotiations on behalf of the injured party, a lawyer can help prevent costly mistakes and improve the chances of obtaining a fair settlement.

Compensation in a car accident case may include medical expenses, rehabilitation costs, lost income, reduced earning capacity, property damage, pain and suffering, and other related losses. Every case is unique, and the amount of compensation depends on factors such as the severity of injuries, the impact on daily life, and the degree of negligence involved. An attorney carefully evaluates all damages to pursue the maximum recovery available under the law.

Many car accidents result from distracted driving, speeding, reckless behavior, impaired driving, or failure to obey traffic laws. Establishing fault is a critical component of any personal injury claim. A Phoenix car accident lawyer can investigate the circumstances surrounding the collision and identify all potentially liable parties. In more complex cases involving multiple vehicles, commercial vehicles, or disputed liability, legal representation becomes even more important.

Beyond legal advocacy, an attorney provides peace of mind during a difficult period. Accident victims often face mounting medical bills and uncertainty about their future. Having a knowledgeable legal professional manage the case allows clients to focus on recovery while their attorney handles communications, paperwork, deadlines, and negotiations.

Choosing the right lawyer can make a significant difference in the outcome of a case. Individuals seeking legal assistance should look for a law firm with experience in personal injury litigation, strong communication practices, and a commitment to client service. A dedicated Phoenix car accident lawyer can guide injured individuals through every stage of the legal process, helping them pursue justice and financial recovery after a serious accident. With proper legal support, victims can protect their rights and work toward rebuilding their lives following a collision.

body.title: Tour of Marigüitar and a beautiful cactus garden (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Greetings fellow travelers! It's a pleasure to share my journey along the Cumaná-Marigüitar highway, which is known for its beaches and mountains, as well as beautiful landscapes for nature lovers. Located on National Highway 9, it leads to the Paria Peninsula and the Gulf of Cariaco. Marigüitar is a beautiful town in Sucre State, the capital of the Bolívar Municipality. It's just a few minutes from Cumaná, and along the way, you can enjoy incredible views of the beaches. My visit to this area was for personal errands, and I took advantage of the opportunity to take a short drive along the main avenue during our stop at the gas station to refuel and have breakfast. The drive was in the morning, which saves time to complete my errands and return home early. In the landscape, the sun's rays are visible as they pass through the clouds. We also see billboards indicating the remaining kilometers to reach Carúpano, Maturín, and Cumanacoa, taking a detour via Santa María. What caught my attention in this area were the hills along the roadside and the houses built on top. In the photograph, we see several houses: one white, another blue, and a partial view of the gas station. Then we see the houses and the surrounding trees, including a very large ceiba tree. There's also a curious green house on the hilltop, surrounded by vegetation and a beautiful palm tree swaying in the wind.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Saludos amigos viajeros, es un placer compartir mi recorrido por la carretera nacional Cumaná - Marigüitar, la cual destaca, por la presencia de playas y montañas, además hermosos paisajes para quienes aman la naturaleza, la carretera se ubica en la troncal 9 y conduce a la Península de paria y Golfo de Cariaco, Marigüitar es una hermosa población del estado Sucre, capital del municipio Bolívar, se encuentra a pocos minutos de Cumaná y en el trayecto puedes disfrutar las increíbles vistas de las playas. Mi visita a esta zona tenía como objetivo realizar diligencias personales y aproveché para hacer un pequeño recorrido por la avenida principal durante la parada que hicimos en la estación de servicio, para surtir combustible y desayunar; el recorrido fue en horas de la mañana, ya que así se gana tiempo, para hacer las diligencias y regresar a casa temprano; en el paisaje se observa la incidencia de los rayos solares en las nubes, tenemos también las vallas publicitarias que indican los kilómetros restantes para llegar a Carúpano Maturín y Cumanacoa, tomando un desvío por la vía de Santa María, me llamó la atención en esta zona, los cerros ubicados a la orilla de la carretera y las casas construidas en la parte superior, en la fotografía observamos varias casas, una de color blanco otra de color azul y tenemos una vista parcial de la estación de servicio, luego observamos las casas, los árboles alrededor entre ellos uno de ceiba, muy grande también una casa muy curiosa de color verde en la cima del cerro rodeada de vegetación y una hermosa palmera movida por el viento. ![cactus (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqNEmdmyb7BN2UQrZC2u2mjXSq19vet81c4SLvbYzQC2bXYKms3XDfyDiscoNiPnf7y.jpeg) ![cactus (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EnWJ2ekNWXXjsNT572dRvsLSbShQGbWm2CzqHCkg7UGWUHFRwB2S11cWiq6FDiBQKSg.jpeg) ![cactus (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoMEjMtqmsPCS1jaiTRXpWY5cvKv2MhQdyfabpeDWeKM9tLeaz1UztyPJAi32AtBN4a.jpeg) ![cactus (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpXJ4nm9bgYwJGykTdnBgh6jPNJduX66mLtJoCmznSsfqTtQX8MZZDRWTZT3kVssPTA.jpeg) ![cactus (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EnaYEJXUSd1SJc7i45NAxJrRE9BArQ5LMXTAQ9A7N9DAuobJu1QPGr23rTmr5nafJPu.jpeg)

> Next, a partial view of the Marigüitar High School. It's a two-story building with a large grounds and a perimeter fence. It's located on the side of the national highway, next to several government institutions. During my visit to the gas station, a beautiful garden with white flowers caught my eye, as did the view of the large stairs leading to the top of the hill. I had wondered how people got to their homes, and the answer lies in these stairs. They are made of concrete and have railings on the sides for added safety. The stairs are several meters high, and these railings allow you to descend safely and ascend safely as well. In addition to the white flowers in the garden near the gas station, there were some beautiful cacti with fuchsia flowers. The green of their leaves varied slightly: dark green, light green, and one very close to yellow. These plants, given their habit of inhabiting warm climates, are very common in this part of the state. Along the highway, one can see different types of cacti with upright stems, flattened leaves, and other characteristics. Being a tropical region, they thrive in these environments.

> Luego una vista parcial del Liceo de Marigüitar, es de dos plantas, cuenta con un amplio terreno y cerca perimetral, se ubica a la orilla de la carretera nacional y al lado quedan varias instituciones gubernamentales; durante el recorrido por la estación de servicio, me llamó la atención un hermoso jardín con flores de color blanco, también la vista de las grandes escaleras que conducen a la parte superior del cerro, ya me había preguntado cómo hacían las personas para llegar hasta su casa y la respuesta está en estas escaleras, son de concreto y a los lados tienen barandas para que al subir las personas tengan mayor seguridad, la altura es de varios metros y estas barandas le permiten bajar con tranquilidad y de igual manera subir. Además de las flores blancas en el jardín ubicado cerca de la estación de servicio, habían unos hermosos cactus con flores de color fucsia, el verde de las hojas tiene una pequeña variación, verde oscuro, verde claro y uno muy parecido al amarillo, estas plantas dada su condición y característica de habitar en climas cálidos es muy común en esta parte del estado, a lo largo de la carretera se observan diferentes plantas de cactus con tallos verticales, hojas aplanadas, entre otras, al ser una región tropical, ellas crecen muy bien en estos espacios. ![cactus (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqFpeyqo2ngxnE7xy5YYuBNYx4QZNaSPiHYfKX2zmRHwnykffTmVJPm6yuB2NmkiFuX.jpeg) ![cactus (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23y8qwh5DUgFRpByMnEcUTS6DQGH4MhokWHhJLoJcmtZ2E3911tarts7xvgE2gVNZN5JJ.jpeg) ![cactus (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23s9R7PyT4Q1tMn2hdjHiWCJVpqhxXFxEX4CACaCBz6JVk8oznTi8b7gWEQ6d352d78sL.jpeg) ![cactus (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep9zYCw3v9vW3MwGQQJx3oqcPRzpsVzGPamcZH8yzcn15rxTEAbp9QFwF6ioCH2MgcC.jpeg) ![cactus (16).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep7ubWoVSmRtq6UtFoVNi97SJ7Yi6AdAYkeGnEBvAyZCNTwt2ZXtx7XQMAvgGHukrvS.jpeg)

> Looking closely at the garden, several aloe vera plants are framed by an oval-shaped yellow wall. The aloe vera plant is one of the largest, and next to it is a cactus plant with holes where flowers may have once been. In the next view, the long, oval cactus leaves are visible, and again we see the fuchsia flowers. I had intended to touch one of these flowers, but I remembered that their spines aren't exactly friendly, so I decided to just observe them and take some pictures. Next, we observed the cactus plants; one had flowers, another several fruits, and the one in the middle hadn't yet bloomed. Moving on, we could see the shape of the leaves, the stems, and other plants like fiscos, but the most abundant were the cacti and aloe vera, perhaps due to their ability to survive in dry areas. There was also a fruit on the ground and some dry branches, as the rainy season, which brings greenery to the landscape, hadn't yet arrived. We also saw the aloe vera with small flowers, and in the last photograph, a curious cactus fruit on the upper part of a leaf, notable for its red color and white spots, which closely resembled the mushrooms from the Super Mario Bros. animated series. After exploring this small garden and observing the houses located at the top of the hill, we took the path back to continue with our errands. I've passed through this road on several occasions, but this time we decided to take a short break to observe this area, the striking hill, and the small garden in detail. It adorns the entrance of the gas station; my son was delighted with the cactus flowers and its red fruit.

> Observando de cerca el jardín, se aprecian varias plantas de sábila y están enmarcados en un muro de color amarillo con forma ovalada, la sábila es una de las más grandes y al lado de ella se ubica una planta de cactus, en la cual se observan orificios donde posiblemente estaban las flores, en la siguiente vista se aprecian las hojas de cactus ovaladas, largas y nuevamente vemos las flores de color fucsia, mi intención era tocar una de estas flores, pero recordé que sus espinas no son las más amistosas que digamos, por ello decidí solo observarlas y tomar alguna fotografías. A continuación, observamos las plantas de cactus, una tiene flores, la otra varios frutos y la que está en el medio aún no ha florecido, avanzando se aprecia la forma de las hojas, los tallos y otras plantas como fiscos, pero las que más abundan son los cactus y la sábila, tal vez por su capacidad de sobrevivir en zonas secas, también hay un fruto en el suelo y algunas ramas secas, debido a que todavía no ha llegado el período lluvioso, que reverdece el paisaje, vemos también la sábila con unas pequeñas flores y en la última fotografía, un curioso fruto de cactus en la parte superior de la hoja, destaca por su color rojo y manchas blancas, que se parece mucho a los hongos de la serie animada super Mario Bros, luego de hacer mi recorrido y exploración por este pequeño jardín y observar las casas ubicadas en la parte superior del cerro, tomamos el camino de vuelta para seguir con nuestras diligencias, en varias oportunidades he pasado por esta arteria vial, en esta oportunidad decidimos hacer una pequeña pausa para observar en detalle esta zona, el llamativo cerro y el pequeño jardín que adorna la entrada de la estación de servicio, mi hijo quedó encantado con la flores del cactus y su fruto de coor rojo. ![cactus (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23wCDinVzA2PfXW64oj15WkWSxDSAkGqQ5pyRYkXRmSgp5jZ1xw8fug3fYKAqfbgWSBwh.jpeg) ![cactus body.title: Un día de actividades especiales/ Letras Inspiradoras: La historia detrás de una fotografía. [ESP/ENG]
body.body: > Hola queridos amigas de @Womentribe, saludos y feliz día, en esta ocasión vengo para participar en la [Iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-la-historia-detras) de @syllem e invito a @yaslenysofia a participar en ello. --- ![IMG_20260416_104223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/Ep3epmRUzJxeiZ1tbeteaEfbWnY77bj9SthgJkhdUxjrvXD6eAYPM9PKMapPh82ZHy7.jpg) **Imagen de mi Autoría** ---

>Bueno revisando mi galería encontró una foto que recientemente viví junto a mi hijo, un día lleno de actividades, en el que tenía la presentación de su proyecto correspondiente al segundo momento de sus estudios, tenía que llevarlo temprano pero como estaba avanzando con el trabajo primero termine con ello, lo desperté y arregle lo más rápido que pude para que estuviéramos lo más pronto posible, aunque cuando llegamos recién estaban acomodando las cosas para la presentación, así que mientras mi hijo estaba con sus compañeros y la maestra, aproveche de ayudar a los otros representantes acomodar el stand que se usaría para presentar el tema que nos había tocado. --- ![IMG_20260416_101158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23uQrWhSiVgv3LTGobHKC1AUe62iT99axYojZCqRSEg5DM7C5rw3n59snPuadJ2XMRmax.jpg) **Imagen de mi Autoría** ---

>Aprovechando que habían laminas que ellos habían hecho de sus exposiciones antes de ello resultaba bien para apoyarnos y decorar en conjunto con la comida que se había hecho sobre todo unos dulces caseros que junto con la decoración hacía que todo se viera mejor, entre que se hacía ello comenzó a llover aunque eso no impidió que no pudiéramos avanzar con todo para que cada sección pudiera armar todo y así presentarlos, mientras se hacía ello aprovechamos de acomodar a los niños para que bailaran, aunque a mi hijo no le llamaba mucho la atención ello, tenía algo de sueño, pero igual se acomodó para hacer algo con los demás. --- ![IMG_20260416_101811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/242Y3q9Mm3Qx4iYt4Dgwn2L1WZT7zcWVR6ugCqNwQVY7uBc8fJLPCYRhCaSFAb3EWCtys.jpg) **Imagen de mi Autoría** ---

>Todos los niños disfrutaban estar ahí, aunque estaba lloviendo y haciendo algo de frío, pasar un rato en la escuela con sus padres les hacía feliz, ciertamente es bueno porque hace que uno se involucre más con las cosas que hacen, me parecía excelente, en el momento de presentar los bailes aunque mi hijo no quería en ese momento hacerlo, al menos por un momento se paró ahí para presentarse con su grupo y listo, no más de ello jeje, ya después lo que quería era comer aunque los platillos que habían no eran del todo a su gusto, ya que era que si dulce de lechosa o mango, había también salado como cachapa con eso, pero no quería ello, ps menos mal había llevado cereal por sia acaso para que comiera mientras todo terminara. --- ![IMG_20260416_104241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EopuS8mAeQK3jhKRJMu2gWRXV8nXuuuw1Y7vkx8iur2z6te81CRLJvoM7DMS3bE59Bd.jpg) **Imagen de mi Autoría** ---

>Ya después compartimos otro rato, también se aprovechó ese día para ver el resumen de las actividades que habían tenido del lapso escolar, así mismo hablar sobre el nuevo proyecto que se estaría planteando para los próximos días, resulto ser un día lleno de varias actividades y momentos bonitos para todos, eso es lo bueno de las fotografías nos dejan grabados momentos que quizás con el pasar del tiempo se olviden ciertos detalles pero que de alguna manera otros quedan. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png)

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBUvDS4VGUSKXZtnq7Ra7tfg5djZFshgd11HGrP2RvQ1PutmYjxStDen15aEed2vLg.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello, dear friends at @Womentribe Greetings and have a great day. Today I’m here to take part in the [Initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@syllem/letras-inspiradoras-la-historia-detras) from @syllem, and I invite @yaslenysofia to join in. --- ![IMG_20260416_104223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/Ep3epmRUzJxeiZ1tbeteaEfbWnY77bj9SthgJkhdUxjrvXD6eAYPM9PKMapPh82ZHy7.jpg) **Image by me** ---

>Well, while looking through my photo gallery, I came across a picture from a recent day I spent with my son—a day full of activities. He had a presentation for his second-semester project, and I had to take him there early. But since I was making progress on my work, I finished that first, woke him up, and got us ready as quickly as I could so we could get there as soon as possible. Even so, when we arrived, they were just setting things up for the presentation, so while my son was with his classmates and the teacher, I took the opportunity to help the other parents set up the booth that would be used to present the topic we had been assigned. --- ![IMG_20260416_101158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23uQrWhSiVgv3LTGobHKC1AUe62iT99axYojZCqRSEg5DM7C5rw3n59snPuadJ2XMRmax.jpg) **Image by me** ---

>Since they had posters they’d made for their presentations earlier, we were able to use those to help us out and decorate along with the food that had been prepared—especially some homemade sweets—which, together with the decorations, made everything look even better. While we were doing that, it started to rain, but that didn’t stop us from moving forward so that each section could set everything up and present it. While that was happening, we took the opportunity to get the kids ready to dance. Although my son wasn’t very interested in it—he was a little sleepy—he still joined in to do something with the others. --- ![IMG_20260416_101811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/242Y3q9Mm3Qx4iYt4Dgwn2L1WZT7zcWVR6ugCqNwQVY7uBc8fJLPCYRhCaSFAb3EWCtys.jpg) **Image by me** ---

>All the kids enjoyed being there; even though it was raining and a bit chilly, spending time at school with their parents made them happy. It’s definitely a good thing because it gets you more involved in what they’re doing. I thought it was great. When it came time to perform the dances, even though my son didn’t want to do it at that moment, he at least stood there for a second to perform with his group—and that was it, nothing more, haha. Afterward, all he wanted was to eat, even though the dishes they had weren’t quite to his liking—there was sweet stuff like dulce de leche or mango, and there were also savory options like cachapa, but he didn’t want any of that. Thank goodness I’d brought some cereal just in case, so he could eat while everything else was being wrapped up. --- ![IMG_20260416_104241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EopuS8mAeQK3jhKRJMu2gWRXV8nXuuuw1Y7vkx8iur2z6te81CRLJvoM7DMS3bE59Bd.jpg) **Image by me** ---

>Later on, we spent some more time together. We also took advantage of the day to review the activities that had taken place during the school term and to discuss the new project we were planning for the coming days. It turned out to be a day filled with various activities and beautiful moments for everyone. That’s the beauty of photographs—they capture moments for us. While certain details may fade with time, others somehow remain. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png)

> **Thank you very much for reading. I hope you enjoy it. I’d be happy to answer any questions you may have, and if you’d like to learn more about me, here’s my:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBUvDS4VGUSKXZtnq7Ra7tfg5djZFshgd11HGrP2RvQ1PutmYjxStDen15aEed2vLg.jpg)
**Translated Using Deepl** ![separadoryasma2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23t7FGcw1y2pTi43pMTQS2Uf1P9xBf6q2kKE6KtQauS4SiaTXef14CAYFekYSHP5WkfUy.png)

body.title: Having fun created a clicker
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23swfvk2kFgJpq1N3MCB236KitfthuTDpXNEqbycQufRb2E5GkvNGpkJdU1ZbrW65Q1R9.png)


Right now we're having fun learning how to make a mini-game in clicker mode; here are the rules.
This is just the beginning, I'm testing things out

# https://thepoormana-cyber.github.io/testgame-/

Good Game 

---

🐝 **Hive Clicker — Game Guide & Rules**

Welcome to **Hive Clicker**, an idle/incremental game where you build your own bee empire and produce as much honey as possible!

---

### 🍯 **Goal of the Game**
Your objective is simple:
- Produce honey 🍯
- Grow your hive 🐝
- Unlock upgrades and achievements 🏆
- Become a legendary beekeeper 👑

---

### 👆 **Core Gameplay**
- Click on the bee to generate honey
- Each click consumes energy ⚡
- Run out of energy? Use **Rest** to recover

---

### ⚡ **Energy System**
- Clicking costs energy
- Energy regenerates over time
- You can upgrade your **max energy** and **regen speed**

---

### 🐝 **Production System**
Increase your passive income with:
- Bees → basic production
- Hives → stronger production
- Queens → major boost + extra bees
- Flower gardens → global multiplier 🌸
- Royal apiaries → massive production boost 🏰

---

### 🛡️ **Defense System**
- Buy shields to protect yourself
- Upgrade armor to reduce damage ⚔️
- Guardians increase shield capacity and regeneration 💂

⚠️ If your shield is down, you are vulnerable!

---

### 🐻 **Random Events**
Every ~20 seconds, an event may occur:
- 🌼 Honey bonus
- 🐝 New bees join
- ☀️ Energy boost
- 🍀 Production boost
- 🐻 Bear attack (danger!)
- 💠 Shield bonus

👉 Be careful: if your shield is empty, the bear will damage your energy and reduce production!

---

### ⭐ **XP & Levels**
- Gain XP by producing honey and clicking
- Level up to unlock ranks and progression titles
- Higher levels = prestige and status

---

### 🏆 **Achievements**
Complete objectives to unlock achievements:
- Reach milestones
- Produce large amounts of honey
- Survive attacks
- Expand your hive

---

### ✨ **Prestige System**
Once you reach enough honey:
- Reset your progress
- Gain a permanent multiplier (×1.5 each prestige)
- Grow faster every run

---

### 💾 **Offline Progress**
Even when you're away:
- Your bees keep producing honey
- Come back to collect your earnings

---

### ✅ **Tips to Progress Faster**
- Balance clicking and passive income
- Upgrade energy early
- Always keep a shield active
- Invest in multipliers (flowers & apiaries)
- Prestige as soon as it becomes worth it
