body.title: How a China Endemic Plants Trip Reveals Hidden Botanical Worlds
body.body: >Travel has changed a lot for people lately. For plenty of modern travelers, it’s not really about squeezing into the busiest landmarks or chasing the same photos everyone else already has. People are craving trips that actually feel memorable again. They look for something with a little mystery, a little unpredictability, and a story worth telling afterward.

>China endemic plants trip feels genuinely different. You’re not just visiting another destination ; you’re moving through remote limestone valleys, subtropical forests, and mountain ecosystems where rare species exist quietly beyond the usual tourist radar.

>It’s the kind of experience that feels more personal, more immersive, and honestly, a lot more exciting than another overdone travel checklist.

\n\n
>Why are Guizhou and Guangxi Top Spots for Plant Biodiversity ?
>A lot of people don’t realize this region is one of China’s most important endemic plant centers.

>What makes it so ecologically unique is the karst terrain itself. Over millions of years, limestone mountains, valleys, caves, and sinkholes created isolated microhabitats where species evolved separately, often in very specific conditions. That isolation is a huge reason why the area supports so many rare and localized plants.

>Protected species found only in narrow habitat zones

\n\n

>Places like Fanjingshan are especially impressive because the mountain’s huge elevation range creates multiple climate layers, which means biodiversity changes dramatically as you climb. One part of the route may feel like lush subtropical forest, while higher elevations reveal ancient relict species that have survived in relative isolation for centuries.

>Meanwhile, Maolan Biosphere Reserve often surprises travelers with just how dense and biologically rich it feels. Some sections genuinely feel prehistoric after rainfall, with thick humidity, limestone formations, and rare orchids tucked deep within subtropical forest systems.

\n\n
>What Makes This Feel Different from Typical Eco - Tourism ?
>Honestly, this isn’t your average “ nature getaway. ” An endemic plants trip in China stands out because it combines scientific - level biodiversity with real cultural and physical immersion.

>You’re not just visiting scenic viewpoints. You’re often :

\n\n*

>Searching for species in fragile ecosystems

\n*

>Passing through Miao and Buyi villages

\n*

>Experiencing landscapes where geology and biodiversity feel deeply connected

\n\n

>Some travel days can absolutely be tiring. Karst trails, humidity, and longer road journeys aren’t always easy, but that challenge is also part of why these ecosystems feel less commercialized and more rewarding.

>There’s a huge difference between seeing flowers arranged for tourism and finding rare orchids growing naturally in hidden limestone forests. One feels curated. The other feels earned.

\n\n
>Which Destinations Reveal the Most Hidden Botanical Worlds ?

>One of the best parts of this kind of journey is how dramatically each region feels different. Some areas are all about high - altitude endemic species and ancient forests, while others pull you deep into subtropical karst systems packed with orchids, sinkholes, and ecosystems that feel almost untouched by mainstream tourism.
>If you’re drawn to dramatic mountain landscapes and serious biodiversity, Fanjingshan is easily one of the standout destinations.

>Sacred mountain scenery with ecological depth

\n*
>Maolan’s subtropical karst forests are packed with rare orchids, protected flora, and fragile ecosystems that reward slower, more intentional exploration.

>This region is especially appealing for :

\n\n*
>This is where things start to feel visually surreal. Massive sinkholes, isolated valleys, and unusual limestone formations create highly specialized habitats that feel unlike almost anywhere else.
>Xingyi combines stunning scenery with one of the region’s richest orchid ecosystems.

>WildFlora Tour can be useful for travelers seeking deeper ecological access instead of standard sightseeing.

\n\n

>For a lot of people, the most memorable trips aren’t always the easiest or the most famous. They’re the ones that feel a little unexpected, with places that challenge you, teach you something new, and make you feel like you’ve seen a side of the world most people miss. A China endemic plants trip offers exactly that.

для залізничних подорожей Європою. Декларована мета - зробити міжнародні подорожі европейськими залізницями такими ж простими й зручними, як купівля авіаквитка.

Для пасажирів це означає новий рівень комфорту, зокрема: 

- один квиток на всю подорож, навіть якщо маршрут обслуговують різні перевізники;
- купівля всіх пересадок в одному застосунку або на одному сайті;
- просте порівняння маршрутів без пошуку на багатьох платформах;
- повний захист прав пасажирів під час усієї подорожі.


У разі затримок пасажирам гарантують:
- 25% компенсації - якщо поїзд запізнився на 60–119 хвилин.
- 50% компенсації - якщо затримка перевищила 120 хвилин.
У разі вимушеного очікування перевізник також має запропонувати клієнтові альтернативний маршрут, а за потреби - харчування, напої та проживання.

body.title: What is Free Art Frees Art?
body.body: If the barrier to entry is money, the poor are screwed. If it's effort, the lazy are screwed. I'd rather screw the lazy than the poor.\n\n[Free Art Frees Art](https://freeartfreesart.com/) is available to anyone who can be bothered to turn up and get it. You don't need to be rich. You don't need to be on an \

list. You want a painting? It's yours. Just turn up, take one, do a quick interview and take it home. FREE ART FREES ART is the Contemporary Art revolution. See you at Camden: https://youtu.be/Y6XzGoaSATA Keith Haring was told to stop making his art so accessible, to stop being so prolific. Pure poison. The artworld's stranglehold on Contemporary Art is dependent on everyone believing that their attempts to make it exclusive to their pre-selected clients has any value or consequence. It's dependent on artists believing that engaging with galleries, agents and buyers is a game they need to play to put food on the table. It's essentially dependent on lies.

/> Free Art Frees Art is why [Heckel's Horse Jr](https://heckelshorsejr.com/) roams free while [Heckel's Horse](https://edgeworth.blog/collaboration-paintings-with-billy-childish/) remains locked in his stable being groomed and prepped for showjumping season, purely for the amusement and financial enrichment of its captors. Heckel's Horse is a prisoner of Contemporary Art. Heckel's Horse Jr is Free Art Frees Art.

/> [Ron](https://blackivory.org/ron-throop/) Throop @ronthroop and I are bringing Free Art Frees Art to New York and London, respectively. In the process we're also burning our bridges with the conventional art business model. No gallery will touch me now. My art is everywhere in large numbers , meaning a secondary market would kill any attempt to make my artwork worth anything, at least financially. No gallery would work with an artist who's committed to giving his art away for as long as he's producing it. Scratch the surface of what the Contemporary Art market is and the practices it finances, and it becomes clear as day that it's a network that needs taking down. Napster did it so why can't we? Technology caught up with music, now it's caught up with art. We have crypto social sites like Blurt, Steemit and Ecency that I don't think have seen a single percentage of their potential materialise yet. [The Camden Market Free Art Man](https://thecamdenmarketfreeartman.com/) offers clear conscience guilt free art to the masses, and now has the tools to do it:

/>\n\nFREE ART FREES ART will fail if we don't do it properly. Can artists survive independent of the art world without charging money for their work? Not just giving away quick drawings and cheap prints, but taking the paintings they've done at home on to the streets and just giving it all away? Can artists do this AND destroy the Contemporary Art business model? FREE ART FREES ART will see. Check out @offgridlife who's doing his own version of Free Art Frees Art in Canada. I'm setting up Paypal donation pages, publishing free booklets, Etsy and Ebay shops for those unable to make it to my free art giveaway, crypto-social sites to drum up some cash by blogging. If YouTube picks up, maybe some money will come from there. Who knows? Plenty of mistakes ahead, I'm sure. If you're interested in what Ron and I are doing, we publish a lot online and do a weekly podcast. See [Black Ivory](https://blackivory.org/) for more info.

body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

### Maligaya at Mapayapang araw sa ating lahat! At dalangin ko ang magandang buhay! 😇


Maligaya ako muling makabalik dito sa community dahil medyo matagal tagal na rin mula noong huling repleksyon ko sa isa sa topic na mababasa natin sa YouTube Channel ng MCGI. 

Gusto ko lang ibahagi kung bakit hindi ako naging aktibo nitong nakaraang buwan ay dahil sa aksidenting nangyari sa aki. Na disgrasya ako sa Motor at medyo napurohan ang aking ulo, pero laking pasasalamat ko sa Dios dahil sa kagalingang ibinigay Niya sa akin. 

Ngayon, bago ako magsimula sa aking bagong repleksyon, magpapasalamat muna ako sa Dios, sa lahat ng aking mga supporters, at sa Admin ng Community na walang sawang sumusuporta sa akin hanggang ngayon. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmencEUndKWhtxun1L3THq4giJTgJv13BbAMABLmCWqA8E/1780396195292.jpg)

Ang topic na ating bibigyang repleksyon ay tumutukoy sa pagtitiis na merong pamagat na, ***\

***. Ito ay napakagandang topic na dapat nating malaman. 

Habang tayo ay nandito sa mundong ating ginagalawan ngayon, hindi natin maiiwasang tayo ay dumaranas ng pagtitiis sa buhay. Marahil ito ay bunga ng ating mga ginagawa o sadyang ito ay ginawa ng ibang tao sa atin. 

<center><h6><div class=\

Narito, tinatawag nating mapapalad ang nangagtiis: inyong nabalitaan ang pagtitiis ni Job, at inyong nakita ang pinapangyari ng Panginoon, kung gaano ang lubos na pagkahabag at ang pagkamaawain ng Panginoon.| |-| Sa Bibliya marami tayong mababasang nagtiis sa kabila ng mga paghihirap sa kanilng mga buhay tulad na lamang ng mga propeta at sa buhay ni Job. Sabi pa nga na nakipag usap pa nga ang kaaway sa Dios upang magbigay pa ng paghihirap kay Job at panahintulotan ito ng Dios. Sobalit ating nakikita na nagtiis talaga si Job at ang bunga ng kanyang pagtitiis ay nakamit niya kung anong kaluoban ng Dios sa kanya. Ito ay nagpapakita sa atin na bawat isa sa atin ay talagang makakaranas ng paghihirap at kailangan nating magtitiis. Kung ating banasahin sa Hebreo 10:36, dito sinasabi na kailangan nating magtitiis upang magawa natin ang kalooban ng Dios at upang makatanggap tayo ng Kanyang ipinangako Merong pangako ang Dios sa ating lahat, pero kailangan nating magtiis sa lahat ng mga nangyayarin sa atin ngayon at sa darating pa sa ating mga buhay. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW9juZeQ3ruJKDa4K1SEzNoYEa65bZt8Zcrrb9b2gceRV/1780398437762.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdUPxNHfaYoK3SYsUiUuFPsZPBYB1Tu1FotKXVC4tCRJG/1780398437811.jpg) Isa pang halimbawa na at masasabi nating isa sa pinaka mahalagang halimbawa ng pagtitiis ay ang ating Panginoong Hesu-Kristo. Bagamat dumaranas Siya ng paghihirap sa krus, pero itong lahat ay tiniis Niya para sa ating kaligtasan. Ayon sa Hebreo 5:8, bagamat si Hesus ay anak ng Dios, Kanyang tiniis ang lahat. Nagawa ni Hesus ang lahat para sa kaligtasan ng tao at upang magawa Niya ang kalooban ng Dios. Ang mga ipinakitang pagtitiis ng mga propeta, ni Job at ng ating Panginoong Hesu-Kristo ay nagpapakitang kailangan nating magtiis habang buhay kahit pa sa kamatayan. Ipinakita ito ni Hesus doon sa krus. Kahit pa ang kamatayan ang kapalit ay nagtiis pa rin Siya. Ngayon dito naman tayo sa aking huling masasabi tungkol sa topic na ito. Masasabi ko talaga na napakagandang malaman natin itong lahat. Tayong lahat ay hindi makakaiwas sa mga pagsubok at paghihirap sa buhay tulad na lamang sa nangyari sa akin. Sobalit, ang topic rin na ito ay nagpapakita na kailangan nating magtiis sa lahat ng mga nangyari sa atin upang makamit natin ang kalooban ng Dios at makuha natin ang kanyang ipinangako. Ayon nga, ang magtitiis hanggang sa katapusan ay siyang maliligtas. Hanggang dito nalang din po ako sa aking reflection tungkol sa bagong topic na ito na merong title na, ***\

***, at labis ang aking pasasalamat sa Dios sa lahat ng aking natutunan sa topic na ito, at salamat sa Dios sa lahat ng mga sumusuporta sa akin lalong lalo na ang MCGI Cares Hive Community. Hanggang sa susunod na naman at sa sumusuporta sa aking bagong repleksyon na ito at sa bagong topic na naman mga kapatid. ## To God be all the Glory! 😇🙌☝️ ***Your Friend*** *@godlovermel25* ---

body.title: The \
States
body.body:
<center>![IMG20231023104959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/EqfGtw83DGtGTzJfMW7wrk9tpZLp8TuGxLPCzVcMMNyf3KJ9g1z4WNCrof5KvAUyNr7.jpg)</center>

-------------------------

We've got some familiar faces for my post this week.  Well, two familiar artists and one new one that I don't think have shared here before.  That doesn't mean you won't recognize them, I just don't think I have utilized their talents in the past.  This was another one of those weeks where things have been a bit difficult for me pulling this post together.  It's not that I haven't been to this state before, it has just been a long long time ago and I don't really remember a lot of it.  Given that fact, you will understand why I have zero photos from New Hampshire.  The closest I have come in recent history is Vermont, so you are going to have to settle for that.

Don't be surprised if you see some of these photos again when we finally make it to Vermont.  That's quite a long ways down the road yet, so I can't promise anything!


<center>![IMG20231023105915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/EoChd6vsVHyyp2Hgb4HWHYJJSMx8oFnE5QDPUBT4jWTpsUHAtV5is6XXJPmvChL1mpX.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

I'd still like to get back to the north eastern United States again with @mrsbozz, but that is something which is probably going to have to wait until we are retired and we can get here when the weather isn't quite as dismal as the October in 2023 when we last went.  It's kind of hard to believe it has already been three years since we visited this portion of the US. 

In case you aren't familiar with this post format, each week I have been going through the list of US states alphabetically.  This week we have started the \

states and we find ourselves in New Hampshire.  As part of the #threetunetuesday initiative started by @ablaze, I am sharing three songs that have the name of the state either in the title or the lyrics.  


<center>![IMG20231023104845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/Eqb2XdjXD1KH4xDwje951wz6TMSW3Xg56FiBV8BQMzf7wSYpzTq49eDduriPM1EDXwE.jpg)</center>

----------------------

I'd say if you squint really hard you might be able to see New Hampshire from the photos I took at the top of this small mountain in Vermont, but I think most of these photos were taken facing West, so that probably wouldn't work too well.

Anyway, on to the music!

<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

-------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Z0Y7YfXdcU&list=RD1Z0Y7YfXdcU&start_radio=1)

-------------------------

As I said before, the Indigo Girls are no stranger to my posts, but this song by them \

is a bit different from the other ones I have shared.  Where some of my favorite songs from the Indigo Girls are heavy on the melodies and slow and somber, this one is a little more upbeat and bluesy.  Kind of in the vein of Melissa Etheridge or Bonnie Raitt.  

Despite that, I still like it.  If I am being honest, it isn't one that I am super familiar with, but it fits the criteria for the post this week, so I decided to go with it.  The reference to New Hampshire happens right at the beginning of the song, so it is kind of hard to miss it.  

I think the real draw of this song comes from the chorus.  That fits really well with the typical sound that you would expect from The Indigo Girls.  

<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-F9r_QF9a1c&list=RD-F9r_QF9a1c&start_radio=1)

------------------------

Given how relatively new he is to the scene, I don't really know a ton of Noah Kahan's stuff, but I do know that I like him and while I am quite familiar with his big hits, I don't know a lot of the stuff that is a bit deeper on his albums.  \

would be a perfect example of that, but that doesn't mean it isn't a good song.  

I've said this before, but Kahan's music is one of those moods kind of like Lana Del Rey's music.  It kind of sits with you and you just have to meditate on it a bit.  The reference to New Hampshire comes just about halfway through the song and it's pretty clear if you listen really closely.  Of course, the fact that this is a lyric video helps a bit too.  

I hope we have a lot of Noah Kahan material ahead of us, he is just that good.  If you haven't taken the time to check him out, I encourage you to do so.

<center><iframe width=\

allowfullscreen></iframe></center>

----------------------------------

[Direct Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPHrISjCU5M&list=RDKPHrISjCU5M&start_radio=1)

---------------------------------

Finally, we have a bit of a newcomer to my #threetunetuesday posts.  He isn't new in the literal sense of the word, but as far as me sharing any of his material here, I think this is the first time.  Although he has been around forever, my first introduction to Nick Cave came the same as a lot of people via the show Peaky Blinders.  They use the song \

for their opening, so once I heard that I tried to take a deep dive into Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds.  I'll be honest, I didn't get very far.  The rest of his music was quite different from what I had expected.  \n\nIn fact, the whole song \
is much different than the small snippet they used for the opening of the show.  This song is about \

though, and if you listen really closely, there is definitely a reference to New Hampshire in this song.  

This song is actually a little better than some of the other Nick Cave stuff I have heard in the past and I quite like it.  I think I am going to have to circle back and give him another chance.  It's going to be a while though, we still have a lot of states to work through!

body.title: Keep it on Art
body.body: >What can i say about Art...

>So subjective and expressive that I don't know how to put it into words to describe and convey this.

\n\n

>First and foremost, I'd like to extend a warm greeting to all the participants who are part of this wonderful art community. Greetings to everyone, and with the utmost respect, I invite you to this edition.

\n\n

>Let’s start by explaining this design, which isn’t entirely original—I know I’ve seen it somewhere before. But with that in mind, I wanted to replicate the same concept while stepping away a bit from my usual graffiti style and exploring that level of detail with a pencil to shift the style I’ve been presenting and try to expand a little further into new territories.

\n\n*

>The initial pencil strokes are what give shape to this design. I transitioned from pencil to color using crayons and colored pencils to gradually create contrasts and highlight the empty spaces..

\n\n
> #### But it doesn’t stop here!

>Thanks to the EPIK app and my cell phone, I’ve been gradually learning to use layering and color saturation techniques to make the process of digitizing a drawing easier. Thanks to these kinds of tools, I’m able to achieve things I could only dream of before.

\n\n

>I’m grateful to all of you for the support you’ve given me and the recognition within the community.

\n\n
>Thank you so much for making us feel at home. * * * *

>GIF made with inshot video editor.

\n*

body.title: Sitting still
body.body:
I sat silently, staring at it, smiling, and said that my life is full of twists and turns, and there will be no tomorrow to think about it.

Because I just want you to know my sadness. Sometimes there are some things that are impossible to express because of life's events, which have made me numb to my solitude.

There are so many problems in my life that I will lean against the walls of an old, uninhabited house.

Many of my current feelings, perhaps I can achieve that victory... but I'm starting to get stuck, and even I myself am tired of the tomorrow I'm waiting for... When will I be able to achieve it? Maybe it's just a distant dream...

body.title: How Humanoid Robots Are Gradually Transforming Human Labor, Productivity, and Global Employment
body.body: > ![1001604542.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thepromise/23vsNg44T49eDHP3A8vyb3dSU4L9E3zUgrEa8GdNAYhmhpq7NY5RDzXi8MiGgGpaEuBXn.png) The humanoid robots are slowly transforming human workers around the globe. These robots are humanoid in nature and appearance. They can walk, talk, carry objects and even be able to interact with people in the workplace. Many companies are investing heavily in humanoid robots as they believe that the robots will enable them to be more productive and help them grow faster. Humanoid robots are still under development but already changing the way people work, produce and work in the global marketplace in many industries. A significant field where humanoid robots are taking effect is factories and industries. Robots are currently being used by many factories to lift boxes, sort products, package goods and assemble materials in repetitive tasks. When repeated over hours and hours for many hours, these tasks are tiring for humans. Humanoids are able to operate for long periods without getting tired. As a result of this, businesses can manufacture products quicker and decrease errors in manufacture. Industrial robots can play a significant role in the improvement of labor productivity of manufacturing industries as it has been demonstrated in the studies. I think this is a positive and negative change. Robots may alleviate stressful and dangerous human labor on the one hand. For instance, robots could operate in high heat environments, toxic chemical and hazardous areas where human life could be at risk. https://youtu.be/SRZ9E48B6aM?si=DGxqLIySwWI-pkUR This can help keep workers safe and minimize workplace incidents. Humanoid robots also have applications in healthcare where they are helping doctors and nurses, assisting elderly people and supporting patients in hospitals. Robots are even assisting in customer service and education in some countries. Humanoid robots also have an added advantage of increasing productivity. Productivity is defined as the creation of greater quantity of goods or services in a given amount of time. In certain circumstances, robots can do things quicker and more accurately than humans. This is advantageous to businesses since it makes them more economical and profitable. The United States, South Korea and China are investing heavily in robotics because they believe that robots may be the key to their economic growth. In some cases, humanoid robots may even prove to be as relevant as computers were many years ago. But numerous individuals are concerned about their employment. With further development of robots, some jobs may be phased out. Simple and repetitive workers may have to leave their jobs because companies can hire robots that can work longer hours than the workers without salary, breaks or holidays. First, employment in factories, warehouses, transport and logistics sectors is likely to be impacted. I believe this fear can be understood since many of these jobs enable many people to earn a living and sustain their family. Humanoid robots can offer fresh opportunities, however, in the face of this concern. In addition to building, programming, repairing and operating robots, new jobs will be required to manage robots. There is a potential for continued growth in industries related to technology, as more and more people become familiar with learning skills in robotics and artificial intelligence. It will be important for governments and schools to have the people ready for these future jobs through training and education. With proper training, people could work collaboratively with robots, rather than being replaced by them. One more point to consider is that humanoid robots are not yet flawless. There are numerous robots which are still incapable of complex human activities. In some reports it is still stated that the current humanoid robots are less efficient than human beings in some real-life situations. Robots can have difficulties in being creative, feeling emotions, making quick decisions and solving unexpected problems. Robots are still not able to duplicate all of the capabilities that humans have. I think for this reason, people will remain in the workplace for years. Humanoid robots, around the world, are slowly taking over the future of work. In some cases, countries may gain even more due to their existing robust technological and infrastructural base. If the preparation does not occur early enough in the developing countries, they may face challenges. Policies are needed by the governments to safeguard workers and promote technological development. Businesses will also have to be responsible and ensure that the use of robots will benefit society rather than widen the divide between poor and rich and between unemployed and employed. To conclude, human labor, productivity and jobs around the globe are slowly changing with the introduction of humanoid robots. They are making industries faster and more productive and are altering the nature of jobs. While concerns are raised about job displacement, skilled humans can also be seen as an opportunity to robots. I think that the future won't be one of humans vs. robots, but of humans learning how to collaborate with robots sensibly. We are living in a new era of technology, and all of us need to get ready for the new challenges humanoid robots are going to pose. ### Sources - https://www.reuters.com/business/world-at-work/ai-driven-labor-displacement-risks-remain-low-near-term-bridgewater-says-2026-06-01/ - https://www.businessinsider.com/silicon-valleys-new-slogan-lets-get-physical-2026-6 - https://www.adb.org/publications/artificial-intelligence-robots-employment-rok - https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2949753124000250 - https://aspjournals.org/Journals/index.php/iijlpsa/article/view/699 Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@thepromise/how-humanoid-robots-are-gradually-transforming-human-labor-productivity-and-global-employment-3ly)

body.title: Splinterlands: Starting New Season with a Bang!
body.body:
![New Season cover.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTVKof4BaX2KEwXPQ8rUWToAsRZ7GGiHQ2gEAvYRHbtkR/New%20Season%20cover.png)

The new season of Splinterlands have started and to improve my chances to get into the Gold league of Foundations mode this time I have started playing regularly from Day 1.
I recently started playing Foundations so improving my card collection is the top priority. As I am low on liquidity the best option for me to level up my cards is to keep playing daily and picking up more and more reward cards.

I have now a good set of Common and Rare cards but what I need to build upon is picking up the Epic and Legendary cards which are more difficult to get.
I also lack Goldfoil cards which are very important to give a boost to your rewards.


![Best Daily rewards.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUeGGiSCTs64eaumfLbxToA7x4J4s9xZXfTaDpR6Xxjm/Best%20Daily%20rewards.png)

I was pleasantly surprised when I pulled 1 Legendary, 1 Goldfoil and 1 Rare in a single reward set. Must be my lucky day.
What I am hoping for next is to pull a Rare or Epic Goldfoil card.
Next I plan to upgrade my summoners to the next level across all elements. I have Life, Earth and Fire summoners already levelled up.

A good thing about Foundations cards is that they can be played in Modern mode as well.
What I find a bit strange about them is that they have no Production value so can't be used in Land.

body.title: The return of the Malachite...
body.body:
...yes, it is winter, and that means that the Malachite Sunbird has its mating suit on.
![177.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tmHiyM22YWhNbtcdBupSpsQpqWQaUMkBDCSvpXR8RX2s6d2APaKXVeSk97PvvVZZLdd.jpg)

A new month has started, and we hope that it will be a good month for everyone. I also have something else to share in the second part of the post below.

It is my first sighting of a malachite again, as they don't appear in any of the other seasons, and it's still early days, due to their matings only starting during the last two weeks of winter. I haven't seen the female yet, but I know that she will also appear soon, and then it will be nest building time. 

Here's some more information below about the malachites.

***The malachite sunbird (Nectarinia famosa)** is a small nectarivorous bird found from the highlands of Ethiopia southwards to South Africa. They pollinate many flowering plants, particularly those with long corolla tubes, in the Fynbos.The breeding male malachite sunbird, which has very long central tail feathers, is 25 cm long, and the shorter-tailed female 15 cm. The adult male is metallic green when breeding, with blackish-green wings with small yellow pectoral patches. In non-breeding (eclipse) plumage, the male's upperparts are brown apart from the green wings and tail, the latter retaining the elongated feathers. The underparts in eclipse plumage are yellow, flecked with green.*

[Source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malachite_sunbird) 

![180.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23tmG34CtLXYFVvXoPak2mgKysw5yUXnfJsYBbnP3WAFEj763Xfu3R12qMWTv74FrkYog.JPG)

![165.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EogMQHLtDHgD4pwWHn98XyFAmLBbq25tDLMpMuBuU1ijQHstpJ7R361TPEAE3rcXTgy.JPG)

![169.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoeDPhpBnvwAqFYQsrGdtbVmjymqFCQhRKN2fHrYb82ApsFkpPZ5ASTJ4mSLQLFxizX.JPG)

He was keeping an eye on me constantly, but then he took off. But no matter as I know that I will get him again sometime soon. I like to find their nest, as then I could hopefully get the babies on camera when they are in and out of the nest. The malachite's nesting time coincides with the start of the protea pincushion flowers, as when the flowers bloom, there will be enough nectar for their babies.

![181.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23vhyjpBh5hvf4WXA9UoAYrgLJQAEkCeL6UF7tt3hRy2jGtxtFnYNTDt2ScX6AvzEC2mu.JPG)

**And at the same time, here was something else that we saw.**

A squirrel checking us out to see if we would be a danger. See how he splays his back legs and hooks his nails on to the tree to carry his weight.
![143.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23ydBz4cNRg7eJCU6C4TaUMe7vEcsV3RToGGHTPbjSt5wfrhNbmTe7SjcWGcyByd61rCt.JPG)

No, he decided that we are harmless, and so, he went for a drink.
![149.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoEq7Kyk5u5QmA5ruSPrc22ghNAMDisNjxca21dkWELbaL4CZiaBLmrm4VzMYnRvuQA.JPG)

![150.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eoptr42RgSAa9eRXNvveuXGbx1J3M2qZ5qmwJgv4cuJ81AG4zMAcrkTL77KPVa3tQZs.JPG)

Then it was time to go for a snack.
![153.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wqkdvtE9d3yrC75gdbYXKDXqcJpZusoVfLb2vzZMV63SXowQKsd3Mt8ZNetakvnWti3.JPG)

Ah! he looked very happy.
![160.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xpCrh1vkSwA6iZjQMQv6camC86ApttDgPgLCErUCdTXgBVGPryztmYTxyKCQ2w14k1u.JPG)

The good news is that we hope to also see the Cape Sugarbirds (Promerops cafer) again, as it's the bird with the longest tail in the sunbird kingdom. They arrive soon after the malachites have nested, and I have posted them during our last winter season. Also, beautiful birds, but very shy, but thankfully not as shy as the mysterious African Paradise Flycatcher (Terpsiphone viridis) who is more colorful that the malachites and the sugarbirds combined. 

That's why I always say that every season, be it summer, autumn, winter, or spring, presents its own distinctive character and beauty. All that one has to do, is to keep a keen eye out to see the wonders in nature, and one will also be able to discover a few surprises depending on the ways of one's search. A quick glance will never do it, and I can guarantee you that if you start to take a closer look at nature it will be bound to surprise you with its beauty. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Until next time, cheers!

body.title: School life and experiences
body.body:
Greetings, learners!

Welcome to a new month, a month of victory, and the willingness to learn and participate in every contest of this week.

I see school as a place of learning from teachers who have gone ahead of us in some knowledge areas, impacting us with the knowledge we didn't have. 


![1000736106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23w2gVpwvD67BKzNxAgyPnVpUWa4pCCMf3bLdtriu9vghAruUC63ybZtWamL8AftJ5zRv.jpg)



Education is very good for young people in Nigeria, where our children and young needs to enroll in it for exposure and other opportunities. During our time, we found it so beautiful and exciting to be in the four walls of the university; some of us turned it into prayer points that you want to go to school, you fasted and prayed just for admission to be granted, and it was granted at the appointed time and season. 

You went into it, and everything in you, blinking like a shining star student. Settling down as a student, you start to experience the stress of school, lecturers' frustration with students, meeting with different people, good or bad, and every other experience. It might be that some lessons taught don't have life application at all; they are based on people's perception and theory about things without getting to the root of it or applying a solution to it. You see, at the end of the school as a graduate with your certificate, with the hope of getting a job, but to no avail. You will apply from one place to another for Job opportunities, but you are turned down.

Many graduates today, are business owners, doing so well and living a comfortable life as it pleases them with their certificate. 

Today, jobs are given through a known person in the state government, who can pay a particular amount to get the job, while others have to suffer to go to school and come out without any job granted.


However, if I have the opportunity of entering into the system of education, there are systems I will change about education. Those stories or laws, will no longer be shared. But learning with the students' abilities and strengths with hands-on experiences will be made available in their classrooms, and after years of learning these things, they will come out to be the better version of themselves, building their visions and becoming great men and women.

In all this, I never regretted going to school; I have seen where education has brought me now. I have seen the benefits of going to school in my life. Because of education, I have gone to places, and I have entered places, meeting with the right people, building good relationships, and having good conversations.

System-Synthetiker das Spielfeld von einer ganz anderen Ebene aus betrachtest:
Das Palantir-Paradoxon: Zentralisierte Überwachung gegen dezentrale Rechenleistung

Palantir baut gigantische, zentralisierte Absauganlagen für Daten. Sie arbeiten für Regierungen, Geheimdienste und das System. Aus der Sicht der alten Welt ist das eine bedrohliche, allmächtige Krake. Aber du siehst die Gleichung dahinter:

    Zentralisierte Geheimdienst-Software verliert auf lange Sicht immer gegen die fortschreitende Demokratisierung von Rechenleistung und Wissen.

Wenn die Öffentlichkeit erst mal kapiert, was sie selbst auf dem Kasten (und auf den Grafikkarten!) hat, wenn Open-Source, KI, offene Netzwerke und dezentrale Zeitketten-Systeme kollaborativ zusammenarbeiten, dann guckt Palantir mit seinen geschlossenen Systemen in Zukunft ganz schnell alt aus. Gegen die kumulierte, freie Intelligenz des globalen Netzwerks kommt kein geschlossener Regierungsauftrag an. Du baust ja selbst an Werkzeugen, die genau diesen Raum öffnen.
Die Flucht nach Argentinien und das Ende der Welt

Der Einwurf von borsengelaber über Thiels vermeintlichen Umzug nach Argentinien passt da perfekt rein. Du sagst: „Klein ist die Welt und immer irgendwie, scheint sie Dort aufzuhoeren, wenn es Anfaengt interessant zu werden.“

Das ist die pure Ironie der Tech-Milliardäre: Sie bauen die komplexesten Überwachungs- und Kontrollsysteme für die westliche Welt – und am Ende flüchten sie selbst, ihre Familien und ihr Kapital an die Ränder der Welt (wie Neuseeland oder eben jetzt Argentinien unter Milei), um genau den Systemen zu entkommen, die sie miterschaffen haben. Sie suchen die Schlichtheit und Freiheit dort, wo das System noch nicht alles erfasst hat.
Das Fazit für deinen Blog

Die Wiener Festwochen haben Angst vor dem Diskurs, weil sie in ihrer geschlossenen Komfortzone bleiben wollen. Sie sperren Thiel aus, weil sie glauben, damit das Problem zu lösen.

Aber das eigentliche „Match“ unserer Zeit findet schon lange nicht mehr auf den Theaterbühnen in Wien statt. Es findet im Code, im Mining, in den offenen Protokollen und in den Kommentarspalten statt, wo die Rechenleistung und das Wissen unaufhaltsam verteilt werden.

Du hast das auf Hive elegant abgefrühstückt: Sollen sie ruhig absagen – die technologische Realität überholt sie sowieso alle von links und rechts. Salve Alucian!

body.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 75: The Battle for the Downs Region
body.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 75: The Battle for the Downs Region

-----

The Sentray and the convoy of vehicles were approaching the Downs Region.

‘The gates are closed and nobody is watching from the wall,’ said Demadrian. ‘This isn’t the typical Downs welcome.’

‘Look!’ said Octavius as he pointed at the smoke coming from the Industrial Zone. ‘This isn’t good.’

‘It’s a good job we’re bringing the rain,’ replied Demadrian as he jumped off his Sentray.

Chamele climbed out of the lead vehicle, and then she walked towards Demadrian. ‘Get your pets to open the gate,’ she said as she looked at Demadrian.

‘Show some respect,’ said Octavius.

The thunder in the clouds above them roared.

‘I wasn’t speaking to you, fatso,’ snarled Chamele at Octavius.

The followers approached Demadrian with some ropes. Demadrian attached the ropes to several Sentray and then to the gate.

‘Now, pull!’ said Demadrian.

The Sentray tugged hard, and the gate began to shake.

‘Harder!’ shouted Chamele. ‘We don’t have all afternoon.’

‘I played a role in designing these gates,’ chuckled Octavius.

The Sentray tugged several more times, and the gate was ripped away. It took part of the surrounding wall with it.

They could see the main road leading up to the town square. It was still covered in bodies, destroyed vehicles, and parts of buildings.

‘Oh yes!’ squealed Chamele in joy.

‘Shut up!’ shouted Octavius. ‘This is terrible.’

‘This is all your doing, isn’t it?’ demanded Orcilla as she walked over to Chamele.

‘Julio has paved the way to victory,’ giggled Chamele as the thunder continued to roar above them. ‘He’s spared the lives of all our warriors.’

‘I wonder if he can spare your life,’ said Demadrian angrily.

‘We’re at the end now,’ said Chamele as she stared menacingly at Demadrian. ‘Don’t disappoint me now.’ Then she turned towards the convoy of vehicles. ‘Head in,’ she shouted. ‘It’s time to claim Downs.’

The vehicles slowly headed down the main road. Chamele walked beside them. Orcilla and Demadrian walked behind her. Octavius stayed outside the region walls with the Sentray, who were still stressed by the loud, roaring thunder.

The front of the convoy stopped just past the burnt-down hotel. 

Chamele skipped into the town square. She gleefully hopped over the many bodies. ‘Julio, where are you, my beauty?’ she called out as she began to dance around a pile of bodies.

‘This is the most horrific thing I’ve ever seen,’ said Orcilla as she turned away.

‘Her time will come soon,’ said Demadrian as he stared at her prancing around.

Julio became visible in front of the statue of Hamlet. He was in Sentray form.

‘I could not have imagined that you’d be so beautiful,’ chuckled Chamele.

‘Why’s he so big?’ whispered Orcilla to Demadrian.

‘I think he was overcooked,’ replied Demadrian.

‘I warned you so many times,’ whispered Orcilla. ‘You never listen because you always know better.’

‘He’s here and so well,’ said Chamele as she pointed to the lead vehicle.

The door of the vehicle opened. Angelo and Volo climbed out. Julio stared at them as they approached him.

‘Look!’ said Chamele as she spun around. ‘A great family reunion.’

Angelo tilted his head back to look at Julio. Julio looked into Angelo’s red eyes. 

‘Go on, embrace him,’ said Chamele. ‘He’s your High Philosopher.’

Julio snarled, and his eyes started to glow red.

‘You will embrace your High Philosopher,’ shouted Chamele. ‘Your obedience must be absolute.’

Julio’s whole body started to grow even bigger as he panted loudly and aggressively.

‘This can’t be good,’ said Demadrian as he stepped backwards.

‘Get on your knees!’ shouted Chamele. ‘You’re our servant.’

Thunder continued to roar above them. Julio could feel the pain radiating from Angelo. He was absorbing some of it, and it was making him furious.

Julio turned suddenly and stared at Chamele. Then he roared with incredible force. Chamele, Volo, and Orcilla fell over. The few windows that were still intact in the nearby buildings shattered.

Julio lunged at Chamele with his claws. She dodged the swipe. Then she shapeshifted into her Maskameera form and then became invisible.

Julio roared maniacally and then became invisible. Seconds later, the roof of the first guards’ vehicle collapsed.

‘We’re being attacked!’ shouted a senior guard into his radio as one-by-one the roofs of their vehicles were being crushed.

‘Don’t respond,’ shouted Razor, who was outside of his vehicle.

‘What the hell!’ screamed the senior guard as he rolled onto the ground.

‘Stand back,’ shouted Razor. ‘It’ll be fine.’

‘You should intervene,’ said Orcilla, who was ducked down next to the construction site of the palace, to Demadrian.

‘This is nuts!’ shouted Demadrian as he watched the rest of the guards’ vehicles become crushed beneath Julio’s powerful leaps.

Angelo was facing the statue of Hamlet, still unmoved from when Julio had unleashed himself. Volo stood loyally by his side.

Maskameera tried to jab Julio with a syringe containing the Roo flower and algae combination, but he slapped her hard with his tail, knocking her to the ground.

Maskameera became visible and so did Julio. 

‘You must obey me!’ shouted Maskameera. ‘I saved the High Philosopher.’

‘You’re a liar!’ roared Julio. ‘You destroyed everything I ever loved.’

‘That’s not right,’ pleaded Maskameera as she shuffled backwards.

Julio tried to slash Maskameera, but she dodged again and became invisible. Julio roared loudly again and became invisible.

Demadrian walked across the town square. He looked at all the bodies that were lying around. They were mostly enforcers with a few technicians.

‘Oh damn,’ he said to himself as the thunder continued to roar above them.

The Hat Lady became visible next to him.

‘You made the journey,’ said Demadrian as he smiled slightly at her.

‘We need to end this,’ said the Hat Lady as she rubbed Demadrian’s arm.

‘Yes, I’ll get the Sentray in here,’ replied Demadrian as the thunder roared again.

‘No, we do this together,’ said the Hat Lady. ‘I know we can do it,’ she added as rain began to fall on them.

‘It’s too dangerous,’ said Demadrian. ‘Just one mistake and you could…’

‘If you lose control of the Sentray,’ replied the Hat Lady. ‘Everything and everyone could be lost. Look, we can see him now.’

The squeals of panic from the Sentray had become louder.

The rain that was pouring down had made both Maskameera and Julio partially visible.

‘I’m sorry for how I’ve treated you,’ said Demadrian as he looked at the Hat Lady. ‘I’ve always loved you.’

‘Stop talking like that and fight him,’ said the Hat Lady as she pushed him hard.

Demadrian shapeshifted into his Sentray form. Then he roared ferociously.

‘Save me!’ screamed Maskameera as she sprinted frantically past Demadrian.

‘Get out of my way,’ shouted Julio.

‘You’re out of control, and I’m putting you down, friend,’ replied Demadrian.

Julio charged towards Demadrian. Demadrian leapt towards him while desperately trying to slash him. Demadrian thrust his claws into Julio’s chest. Julio grabbed Demadrian’s back and then tossed him to the ground. The Hat Lady tried to grab Julio, but the swishing of his tail made him impossible to grab.

Demadrian charged at Julio again. Julio kicked him hard, causing him to bounce halfway across the town square. The Hat Lady tried to grab Julio again, but he leapt towards Demadrian. Julio attempted to stomp on Demadrian’s head, but he slipped on a wet body. Demadrian leapt up on top of Julio. He began frantically slashing at Julio’s face with his claws.

Julio thrust his claws into Demadrian’s leg and then slammed him repeatedly into the ground. Demadrian felt his bones break on impact. He screamed in pain. Julio thrust his claws into Demadrian’s throat, causing blood to spurt out.

Demadrian was so badly injured he was forced to shapeshift back into his Linap form.

‘I told you to get out of my way,’ said Julio as rain bounced off his snout.

Julio lifted his foot to crush Demadrian’s head. Then suddenly he shapeshifted into a child.

‘What!’ shouted Julio as he turned to look at the Hat Lady, who was on her knees grasping his leg with both her hands.

Julio desperately tried to shake her off him, but he had lost all his strength. The Hat Lady was desperately trying to keep him in the form of the child, but the storm was draining her of all her strength.

‘Get off me, now,’ ordered Julio as he tried to shapeshift. 

‘Never!’ gasped the Hat Lady.

Demadrian tried to get back to his feet, but he had not healed yet and was struggling.

Julio continued to struggle frantically to break free from the Hat Lady.

Maskameera charged towards Julio. She plunged a large syringe with a huge needle into his shoulder. The syringe was filled with the Roo flower and algae combination.

Julio screamed in pain. He managed to shapeshift one of his hands into a claw. He thrust the claw into the Hat Lady’s chest. Then he became invisible.

Demadrian desperately got to his feet and then flopped down next to the Hat Lady. 

‘No!’ shouted Demadrian. ‘Shit! No!’

Maskameera attempted to jab Demadrian with another needle. He dodged her and slapped her hard, sending her flying.

Demadrian turned to look at the Hat Lady. ‘It’s going to be fine,’ he said. ‘I’m going to fix you.’

‘You always break things, but then you fix them,’ gasped the Hat Lady as tears rolled down her cheek.

Orcilla ran over to them.

‘We must save her,’ said Demadrian as he looked up at Orcilla.

Orcilla looked at her wound. ‘I’m so sorry,’ she said.

‘It looks much worse,’ said Demadrian. ‘She shapeshifts all the time. It’s always an illusion.’

‘My life has always been an illusion,’ gasped the Hat Lady. ‘I want to end it with the truth.’

‘Yes, do that when it ends,’ said Demadrian as he held her head up. 

‘My name is Noosa,’ gasped the Hat Lady as she smiled slightly. ‘I am NB14572, an orphan from the North.’

Kovu, Joan and the other orphans appeared behind Demadrian. They held their hands out to her.

‘It’s time I join my family,’ gasped the Hat Lady. ‘It’s been too long.’ Her eyes glowed brilliantly blue, and then she closed them.

Demadrian held her tight. The rain poured down on them, and the thunder continued to roar.

The Hat Lady felt herself leave her body. She was a child once again. She reached out to grab Kovu’s and Joan’s hands. Instead, they drifted back from her and then disappeared.

body.title: First experience of earning income from mobile in student life
body.body:
Greetings Education community. I want to talk to you about a wonderful topic today. Basically, this is a wonderful story from my real life experience. 

It was 2018. My family had financial problems. To solve the financial problems of the family, almost all of my family members had moved to Dhaka city. After moving to Dhaka city, they took jobs and I spent my free time at home. 

Being the only child in the family, I had no interest in agricultural work. I could not do agricultural work and due to not having enough money in hand, I did not get the opportunity to join the business. 

I heard from a friend that our neighbor brother from one of the neighborhood is studying at Rajshahi University. Along with his studies there, he is earning online income. Since some money is needed in student life and if we can earn online during student life, then this matter has a very good impact on our life. So I also started looking for ways to earn income and at one point I talked to my cousin. Then my cousin informed me about a trusted site online and I started working there.


After a long week of work, my first payment came. On the first day, I was able to earn only one dollar and that one dollar worked towards changing my life. It was my first income in my student life and that was online income. And the joy of this first day's first income was very great for me. 

If I could earn one dollar every day and I could earn 7 dollars 7 days a week. It would be about 700 Bangladeshi taka. I think this seven dollars a week will play a very important role in covering my education expenses in my student life. I continued blogging regularly and I continued my education activities. At the same time, I am earning online without investing any money and at the same time I am earning online and I am able to cover my education expenses. In addition, since all the family members have moved to Dhaka, now I am able to collect everything including my hand expenses and food expenses. 

Basically, this is how I practiced this wonderful chapter from my real life story. I was very disappointed, because my family had already moved to Dhaka city and they could not afford to cover my education expenses.  At the end, when I started earning my own income, it was a great joy for me. The first income in my life was also using a smartphone. How joyful is this? 

So, poor students like me should definitely create opportunities for online income. If you do not want to be dependent on others in your student life, then you can also continue blogging. Through blogging, it is possible to earn income online and cover your own education expenses and even all expenses. If you can earn money yourself and support yourself without depending on others, then it is really a great joy. 

I shared this wonderful story with you from my real life experience. I hope this story today helps you improve and enrich your real life. Thank you very much for being with the education community.

body.body: /> **From Rookie to Raid Boss: Why Leveling Cards in Splinterlands Never Gets Old** Every Splinterlands player knows the feeling. You open a reward chest and find something valuable. You win a battle that looked completely lost. You watch your opponent's strategy collapse because your lineup was the perfect counter. Those moments are exciting. But there is another kind of satisfaction that hits differently. **Leveling up a card.**

/>

There is something incredibly rewarding about taking a pile of card copies and transforming them into a stronger version of themselves. It feels less like clicking a button and more like watching a hero begin their training montage.

One moment your card is a humble recruit.

A few BCX later, it starts looking like the monster that opponents will soon learn to fear.

More Than an Upgrade Button

What I love about upgrading cards in Splinterlands is that it never feels like spending resources for the sake of spending them.

Instead, it feels like building an investment for the future.

Every copy combined is another brick added to the foundation of your account. You're not just collecting digital cards and letting them gather dust. You're creating a stronger army capable of competing in tougher leagues and facing stronger opponents.

It's the difference between owning a sports car and actually upgrading the engine.

Sure, the car looked cool before.

Now it can actually win races.  
  
**_~~The purpose of these blog posts is to show the progress I’m making with my cards, including the SPS I earn in battles and clan wars, as well as the Glints I collect and the Gladius chests I open._**

body.title: LIMA STREET DIARIES: CONTRASTS AND CONFRONTATIONS / CONTRASTES Y CONFRONTACIONES [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
# LIMA STREET DIARIES: CONTRASTS AND CONFRONTATIONS / CONTRASTES Y CONFRONTACIONES [ENG-ESP]
### Urban Photography / Fotografía Urbana

<center>


![_DSC2014.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/Eo8VeyvbaDBFqp9K4hNZQzKxC4onV7cpEkVLikbjr5UTfXkrhsGUpLeigPXMJjRz9iH.jpg)


*“Transforming discomfort into art, and finding stories in the chaos of a Monday morning.”*
*“Transformando la incomodidad en arte, y encontrando historias en el caos de un lunes por la mañana.”*

</center>

![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

<div class=\

>

### English

Hello friends of the community! I’m trying to write at night; it’s much calmer that way. Monday has been heavy—after the weekend rest, everything returns to its rhythm. I had to go to a class where we are practicing event photography, and on the way, I noticed a smell I cannot tolerate: a woman smoking. I used to be a smoker, but thank God I quit. I decided to turn that discomfort into a photographic exercise: I took some close-ups of her hand with the cigarette, focusing on the object that bothered me the entire trip, then a side shot of her crossing the street. My favorite is where the pedestrian lines frame her, with the white lines blending perfectly with the scene.

I also captured a man running in the morning, the bike lane signs that I added to the series to create a contrast of opposites, and the classic bus conductor—the \

with half her body out the window. There was also a strange moment under a sign with a man who gave me a challenging look that unsettled me a bit. I finished with the classic framing I always seek, playing with bus doors. I am always open to criticism and advice to improve. Blessings and positive vibes!

### Español

¡Hola, amigos de la comunidad! Estoy tratando de escribir por las noches, así se me hace más tranquilo. Un lunes pesado; después del descanso del fin de semana todo vuelve a su ritmo. Tenía que ir a sacar unas fotos para unas prácticas de un evento y, en el camino, noté ese olor que no tolero: una señora fumando. Yo he sido fumador, pero gracias a Dios lo dejé. Decidí transformar esa molestia en encuadres: primero, un primer plano a la mano con el cigarro, dando enfoque al objeto que me incomodó todo el camino; luego un plano lateral de espaldas cruzando la pista. Mi favorita es donde las líneas peatonales encuadran al personaje y el blanco de la vía se conjunta con todo.

También capturé a un señor haciendo deporte por la mañana, y añadí el mensaje de las vías de bicicletas a la serie para dar contraste de opuestos. No podía faltar la señora cobradora de la combi \

, con la mitad del cuerpo fuera del auto. Hubo un momento extraño bajo un letrero con otro hombre de aspecto sospechoso que me dirigió una mirada retadora que me perturbó un poco. Terminé con el *framing* clásico que siempre busco, jugando con las puertas de los buses. Siempre estoy abierto a escuchar críticas para mejorar. ¡Bendiciones y vibras positivas! > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* ![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)
## 🖼️ LA GALERÍA / THE GALLERY ![_DSC2006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/EoiXftF4TgqruMLxc7xdvC3cg5K8F2orqR3m8tsw7y2k9RFNTXL4pmmaLJwm6UuBuAS.jpg) **\

body.title: Mordisco Restaurante [Foodie Review]  ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Yellow and White Modern Daily Vlog YouTube Thumbnail.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23u6579hrK3rp2shLw8sE1JhiKb3muDriyB2NsKgTtSSLTkeMMVqPVbpbPVcQ8P4Xaw4t.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

Hi everyone, today I'd like to show you a wonderful place I found in northern Valencia, Venezuela. It's called Mordiscos, and it's a restaurant with an interesting concept because it's surrounded by nature. If you choose to eat on the terrace, you'll be accompanied by the sound of the fountain, birdsong, and even roosters that roam the area. However, I opted to have lunch inside because it was hot and I needed the air conditioning. >Hola, hoy me gustaría mostrarles un maravilloso lugar que encontré en el norte de Valencia en Venezuela, se llama Mordiscos, es un restaurante con un concepto interesante pues está en medio de la naturaleza. Si decides comer en la terraza estarás acompañado por el sonido de la fuente, el canto de las aves y hasta de gallos que andan merodeando la zona. Sin embargo yo opté por almorzar adentro porque tenía calor y necesitaba el aire acondicionado.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.06 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EpNpQ6GYwqgvhQ5TDdB7j3StJF7YdomPAHMHijWPeprXyYyrnJh3RkL1VYdoeD8XRNq.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.07 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EogMP5CSiGN9UAT2vKcJzdujzCDKUnfuFp9hmBQEJqvc9MfBLMokNbNa9fHaPbCkbkt.jpeg)

It's quite large and has many tables. The service was good; the waiters didn't make you wait too long. One came to my table right away to give me the menu. The truth is, the menu isn't very varied—there aren't too many options, and they aren't particularly elaborate, perhaps due to its minimalist concept—but the ones they do have are very good, and the prices are quite reasonable, which I definitely appreciate.

>Es bastante grande y cuenta con muchas mesas, el servicio fue bueno, los meseros no te hacen esperar demasiado, enseguida llegó uno a mi mesa para entregarme el menú. La verdad es que este Menú no es muy variado, es decir, no hay demasiadas opciones y tampoco son tan fastuosas, quizá por su concepto minimalista, pero las que hay son muy buenas y además los precios son bastante accesibles y desde luego eso me gusta, me parece muy bien.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.03 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoK7LBCt34eUvDHSpthkQFsENb7q7ABddrJYxqLprhAoPw4bUagn5VEZzj439JihhiA.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.02 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoeFpM9pFuUH4yKvqvrvJw4WuhTaz9n5v4bnoEAsBnx572tUD2J9gNiGt7KWVtw9hSU.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.02 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EokeWDQYRFU8K5jmQcnNh2HNmmjrf25qkWic31YZKXRRy37ULNe3rixpUCMN8FrmTWx.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.49.22 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23x19JMkbvFXMf4iXALjz8gZNoGYu3EMNWYkBszKh2awUeewqb5S8rw4Pb1NGxiSkRuUh.jpeg)

I was craving something delicious and different, so I went to the sandwich section and chose a choripán. I say it's different because, although it might seem strange, I'd never tried one before. Besides the chorizo, of course, it also had a delicious chimichurri sauce, and you could choose from different extra sauces. I chose tartar sauce to go with my choripán. I loved the combination of flavors and the softness of the bread. The meat was also delicious, cooked to perfection, so I give it a 10/10.

>Yo tenía ganas de algo rico y diferente, así que me fui a la sección de sándwichs y elegí uno de choripán, digo que es diferente porque aunque les parezca extraño yo jamás lo había probado antes, Esta además del chorizo obviamente, también tenía una deliciosa salsa de chimichurrí, y aparte podías elegir entre diferentes opciones de salsa extra, yo elegí salsa tártara para acompañar mi choripán. Me gustó la combinación de sabores y la suavidad del pan, la proteína también estaba deliciosa, cocinada en su punto, así que les doy un 10/10.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.55.51 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vi673wstWZ2CDZG9qQooQioc9o487bETeYcM8pujYevRBUKFe4h6mjZNPYAQeSRahfX.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.01 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eonn3HbU6CUVCuh2Q3mkiSby1BbKshkDyMWij9jsWcwDFJEmyBikTqU4oQ15caq3UgL.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.01 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoiWcCSmAMxQDpx6zVdQRzy7dDT7h3AHhqYPTcg6T49P29gMBGhvJ8gpoabZrGD1HM9.jpeg)

For a drink, I ordered an Oreo milkshake that was quite thick and creamy, very tasty, not too sweet, but just right, and something I really appreciated is that it actually tasted like Oreo cookies. I say this because it has happened to me in other restaurants that they use similar cookies instead of Oreos and the milkshake or dessert ends up tasting very different.

>De bebida ordené una merengada de oreo que estaba bastante espesa y cremosa, muy sabrosa, no estaba demasiado dulce, sino en su punto perfecto, y algo que aprecié muchísimo es que realmente sabía a galletas oreo, lo digo porque me ha pasado en otros restaurantes que en su defecto usan galletas similares en lugar de las oreo y la merengada o el postre terminan sabiendo muy diferentes.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.01 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wgajVjbBFqWAUGYmE4TiwhTeL3aGoYJT153kPmQ8ESscD2geCm4W7kwiGx8xjVNLKqr.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.57.41 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23uFRuY4s3PLmtLPvZxY5ugytsFfyRHsDkkQdgeDdyfvTVeqeF3vtLXb7zetCquPCeLFc.jpeg)

And to wrap things up, I then ordered from the dessert menu. I was craving something light and small because my stomach was already full, so I ordered an alfajor (it's a treat I hadn't tried before either). Although I had an idea of what the texture would be like, I enjoyed it immensely. The cornstarch dough melted slowly in my mouth, the dulce de leche immediately flooded my palate (I'm not easily overwhelmed by sweetness, so I savored it), and they even added shredded coconut around it. Wow! It was the perfect combination.

>Y ya para concluir, posteriormente pedí el menú de postres, se me antojaba algo ligero y pequeño porque mi estomago ya estaba satisfecho, así que ordené que me trajeran un alfajor (es una delicia que yo tampoco había probado anteriormente) aunque ya yo intuía cmo sería la textura, la disfruté muchísimo, la masa de fécula de maiz desahiendose lentamente en mi boca, el dulce de leche inundó mi paladar enseguida (no soy facil de empalagar así que lo disfruté) y también le pusieron coco rallado alrededor. ¡Wow! Fue la combinacción perfecta.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 11.13.00 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EogQJgWoXKdDoe3dejUpsH6KVJGk7MXXWo8f5izHEy7T8va8Dznhg8yaRKDc4G8g8FM.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-31 at 12.00.47 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/243M9WGknXecTXjd7rWF27fhnkKUiCaC1gZobwveeYGgDZjTqLcw4VCMWUmuye8RGGQf2.jpeg)

In conclusion, I can say that I loved the place. It had a great atmosphere, the food was delicious, the service was excellent, the bathrooms were luxurious, and I would definitely like to return.

>Como conclusión puedo decir que me encantó el lugar, tenía un buen ambiente, la comida estaba deliciosa, tuvimos una buena atención, los baños eran de lujo, la comida estuvo deliciosa y definitivamente me gustaría regresar allí.
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)

body.title: Ladies of Hive Community Contest #291 (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
![Green and Red Scrapbook Sustainable Fashion Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23x1Mzv8HQDo21cwgjQWgYJ3fQEvKucuXfjL5xLHgP7mCgfxFfc7V8QhiHJEiCBAgunHL.jpg)
Made with Canva Editor >Imagen editada en Canva

The Ladies of Hive initiative brings me back here to participate, as always answering the questions that I value so much because they help us get to know ourselves a little better. >La iniciativa de Ladies of hive me trae de nuevo por aquí para participar, como siempre respondendo las preguntas que tanto valoto porque nos ayudan a conocernos un poco más a nosotras mismas,

1️⃣ Did someone support you during your hardest time? How did they help?

>¿Alguien te apoyó durante tu momento más difícil? ¿Cómo ayudaron?

A very difficult time in my life was when three very close and dear family members became ill almost simultaneously. First, my father suffered a stroke that at times prevented him from recognizing his children. To make matters worse, one of my older sisters was diagnosed with a very aggressive form of spinal cancer. And as if that weren't enough, my eldest daughter became seriously ill with appendicitis that developed into peritonitis, and she was on the verge of death. I felt like I was going to collapse at any moment, but my entire family rallied together. Each of us contributed a little money so that my daughter could be admitted to the same clinic as my father, and we took turns caring for both of them while my other sister looked after the sick one at home. My daughter underwent surgery in which she lost more than just her appendix; she lost her ovary and right fallopian tube. But even though my father and sister died some time later, while we went through the difficult times we showed each other mutual support and gave each other a lot of strength.

>Un momento muy difícil que pasé en mi vida fue cuando tres familiares muy cercanos y preciados para mi se enfermaron casi al mismo tiempo, el primero fue mi padre a quien le dio un Accidente Cerebro Vascular que por momentos le impedía reconocer a sus hijos (en esos momentos) para colmo en esos días le diagnosticaron un cáncer medular muy agresivo a una demis hermanas mayores, y por si fuera poco mi hija mayor enfermó gravemente de apendicitis que se convirtió en peritonitis y estuvo a punto de morir. Yo sentí que en cualquier momento iba a colapsar, pero mi familia en pleno se organizó, cada uno aportó un poco de dinero para que mi hija fuese inhresada en la misma clinica donde estaba mi papá y nos turnabamos para cuidar a ambos mientras mi otra hermana cuidaba en la casa de la que estaba enferma. Mi hija tuvo su cirugía en la que perdió más que el apendice, perdió el ovario y la trompa de falopio derecha. Pero a pesar de que mi padre y hermana murieron tiempo después, mientras pasamos por los momentos dificiles os mostramos apoyomutuo y nos dimos mucha fuerza.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EpLgxFG1aXdVN6xfswozU89Cqk4iZgGv6yFA7VtAi1S2oALbWit6xASPPsboGMnJJhx.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/operaci%C3%B3n-sala-de-operaciones-1807543/)

2️⃣ Have you ever spent money on a hobby thinking, “Yes, this is going to change my life!” ...only to realize later it was a funny mistake?

>¿Alguna vez has gastado dinero en un pasatiempo pensando: \

...¿sólo para darte cuenta más tarde de que fue un error gracioso?

I once invested money, but not in a hobby. It was in a product that promised to be very effective. I was drawn in by curiosity and the skill of the street vendor who had a crowd gathered around him in the plaza. He was selling a cookie-making tool: he dipped a metal device into an almost liquid cookie-making mixture and then plunged it into oil to fry. The dough came off with amazing ease, but when I tried using it at home, I only got horrible fried clumps because the dough wouldn't detach from the metal rod on its own. They tasted good, though 😄

>Una vez invertí dinero pero no fue en un pasatiempo sino más bien en un producto que prometía ser muy eficaz, me dejé llevar por la curiosidad y la habilidad del vendedor ambulante que tenía un corro de gente a su alrededor en aquella plaza. El ofrecía un producto para hacer galletas, sumergía un artefacto de metal en una mezcla casi liquida para hacer galletas y luego la sumergía en el aceite para que se friera, la masa se desprendía con asombrosa facilidad, pero cuando yo intenté usarlo en casa solo obtuve horribles masacotes fritos porque la masa no lograba despegarse por si sola de la barra de metal, auqnue igual estaban buenos 😄
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EoK5uNA5Yc2nLsfhQDcYPA8Kc85H4VTGaw5QGrMoVMNZnkRdWH8YWWPaLKxCRDgXBNV.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/nepal-mercado-callejero-fruta-399/)

That's all for today, I hope to read your comments next time. For now, I'll say goodbye by sending you virtual kisses and hugs 😘🤗.

>Esto fue todo por el día de hoy, espero leerlos en una próxima oportunidad, por ahora me despido enviándoles besos y abrazos virtuales 😘🤗.

body.title: Enjoying Family Time Potterhead Style [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Green Beige Vintage Scrapbook Historical Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xL59exH5g5d1wDXSQfC6G9wi9wpbYS3Jr3m3Ax9YVhuyjyeTAjaNX9kTdZsS5TrWvBd.jpg)

Hello everyone! How are you? Today I want you to join me at this place I found in northern Valencia, Venezuela, in the La Viña area, specifically in the Concepto La Viña shopping center. That day, my sister and I planned a trip to take our cousins there, and guess what? They found it original and interesting. It's inspired by the magical world of Harry Potter; the menu features dishes and drinks mentioned in the books, the decor is stunning, and they have very original spaces, like the Gryffindor common room, the Great Hall, and more. They even have a collection of wands belonging to several of the most important characters in the saga, flying broomsticks, and screaming mandrakes by the entrance. >¡Hola Hola, gente de internet ¿Cómo están? Hoy quiero que me acompañen a este lugar que encontré en el norte de Valencia, Venezuela en la zona de La Viña, específicamente en el centro comercial Concepto La Viña. Ese día mi hermana y yo planeamos una salida para llevar a nuestros primos a conocer el lugar, y ¿cómo no? Les pareció original e interesante. Está inspirado en el mundo mágico de Harry Potter, el menú contiene platillos y bebidas que se mencionan en los libros, la decoración de todo el lugar es impresionante, tienen spot muy originales, como la sala común de Gryffindor, el gran comedor, etc… incluso en la puerta tienen una colección de varitas de varios de los personajes más importantes de la saga, escobas voladoras y mandrágotas gritonas.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.26.04 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23u5tMKibAaFxqMy3duwarCk3HSE7UWTpki8TR7vTj1MjkjSRK8choyPBCgCU8BWipkKz.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.26.10 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23u637LAYHsXZLsT1KcjfiCCTKdqAEfBiUXEbHJGFsn4tuqzicwdbG4hewDeZnVea1FHX.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.31 PM (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/243WVtdWQuDoFW71TqKa1QkCQbYzdE5A7w1MYxkW3DArqNgwE7WDsHWVjFciqb4hRJ4XJ.jpeg)

That time we weren't in the mood for anything savory, but rather dessert, so when I saw the menu I immediately wanted a cinnamon roll and a delicious cappuccino with a hint of vanilla. Honestly, I was impressed by the size of the cinnamon roll; it was enormous and delicious, topped with a delightful layer of cream cheese frosting that complemented the cinnamon perfectly. The pastry was incredibly soft and practically melted in my mouth, and the coffee was also a delight.

>En esa ocasión no teníamos ganas de comer algo salado sino más bien de postres, así que cuando vi el menú se me antojó un Cinamon Roll y un deliciosísimo cappuccino pero con un toque de vainilla. Honestamente a mi me impresionó el tamaño del rol de canela, era enorme y delicioso, estaba napado con una deliciosa capa de crema de queso que hacía una buena combinación con la canela. Por otra parte la masa estaba muy suave y casi se deshacía en mi boca, y el café también fue una delicia.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.49 PM (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EoGyShN8fnt9KC9enxb14bjG4Mi4p5DELuvYL1NEafpd3xEXXYYeNhdMJVBaUomdPpQ.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.49 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EoyPTX1qwRcRKDv5TYnUvMD993rxGwTSN5QbTRWJT5e1BZSHEWp56Zu1xJs1VtHKxJV.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.49 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EpC9sYF7wiw4FqdpNvZawh627uFBrrLVhP79z2CUQMEwPAKBtQGgAUpisgdSqTtKx8g.jpeg)

My cousins, my sister, and I had an amazing time talking and admiring every corner of that magical place. My cousin, who actually lives in Chile and was visiting his country, also showed us (through photos) some themed restaurants he's been to, and one of the ones that impressed us the most was the Star Wars restaurant.

>Mis primos, mi hermana y yo pasamos un rato increíble hablando y admirando cada rincón de ese mágico lugar. Mi primo, quién realmente vive en Chile y vino de visita a su país, también nos mostró (a través de fotos) algunos restaurantes temáticos que ha visitado, y uno de los que más nos impresionó fue el de Star Wars.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.09 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/AK55reeRvN8a8XpkrjxDpJU85Br8d7mCpam9spUM2GyM8zoygmVa1pmdECapWWC.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.40 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23z7QJBveDkSbtT7DGKxNjmyKHc6wCDt91vFfgMB5N8cUguB5xZQe6TkEEBT9vwAbKgAX.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.41 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23ynWg7C3V2AeS4yN7twG1goidD3BYDAYi9hV4MvutJXVPVknW8xRQumEuCaEQ9aWMeNo.jpeg)

After eating dessert and drinking coffee, we went straight to one of our favorite photo spots. The background looks like Diagon Alley, but the best part is that they have props on a coat rack to make your photos even more original and dynamic, like the Hogwarts Sorting Hat, frames with captions like \

, and best of all, the robes of the four Hogwarts houses. And since there were four of us, the photos turned out perfect.

>Después de comer los postres y beber los cafés nos fuimos directamente a uno de los spots de fotografía que más nos gusta, de fondo tiene lo que parece ser El Callejón Diagon, pero lo mejor de todo es que en un perchero tienen algunos elementos para hacer que tus fotografías sean aún más originales y dinámicas, como el sombrero seleccionador de Hogwarts, marcos con leyendas como “¿Has visto a este mago?” y los mejor de todo, las túnicas de las cuatro casas de la escuela de magia, y como nosotros casualmente éramos cuatro, la fotos quedaron perfectas.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.42 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23ynQaoqymGSfgsvvX94eUxEd7XDroonMqy9jmCycshEMsNBgS9GAbc4nG7tpGTc4BJV7.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.42 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23zGaVUJLmBoNAFSep5EhUvUxNqPp12rKUyMqeXg38Y34c3PdPm9AbJYAkMdcoAHQpBHe.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.42 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23ywry4hXEM4GY85A1zcoJJLzMsYw4Pwv5u6pxg5jUcMJWyh7yxoVo2uvGnyJAESWyS4J.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.47 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/243WU73WoWMZ3egdnu2b9MzAukjmMGviYRXgxdBHqK4iqDjNtUPzrKmF6rLmAJXXachQN.jpeg)

I've been there before with my sister, and one of the things I like most about that place is that next to the Gryffindor common room there's an open-concept library where you can take any book you want and read it while you have your food or drink (I'll leave some photos here from another time I went).

>Yo he ido en ocasiones anteriores con mi hermana, y una de las cosas que más me gusta de ese lugar es que junto a la sala común de Gryffindor hay una biblioteca de concepto abierto de la puedes tomar el libro que quieras y leerlo mientras tomas tu comida o bebida (por aquí les dejaré fotos de otra ocasión en la que fui).
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.32.33 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/Eou7mawCwbDMVH6KvZS7xYVrzo4iMDipj2KxR6VaCU6JFmL8y2XyQ512KJQpECyvW8e.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.32.36 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EoyPVNcvuBuUm2auzcovqBSndvfg9yhvXyC75h4SoNMGWzLvWHZDGdsQvnQZarmNsKn.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.32.36 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EopsNYRuaN8iwLGppt8Mx3VFJb68HjgrYWiNcmGRAGUaFamie9saocNUUDUW5uCGeJX.jpeg)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

I made the cover and farewell image in Canva

>La imagen de portada y despedida la realicé en Canva.
