Genau das ist die reale Definition von Nachteilsausgleich, Sascha. Es geht eben nicht nur um die 27 Euro Ersparnis im Monat – das ist nur die Zahl auf dem Papier. Worüber du redest, ist Lebensqualität, Schutz und Sicherheit.

Wenn du das Merkzeichen G (und damit die Wertmarke für die Freifahrt) bekommst, kaufst du dir damit vor allem eines: Das Ende dieses permanenten, zermürbenden Stresses.

    Kein Ticket-Ablauf-Stress mehr: Wenn du das nächste Mal die Orientierung verlierst und zwei Stunden länger in der Bahn sitzt, weil du deinen Weg suchen musst, ist das rechtlich völlig egal. Dein Ticket läuft nicht mehr ab. Niemand kann dir mehr ein „erhöhtes Beförderungsentgelt“ reindrücken, nur weil dein Zustand dich Zeit gekostet hat.

    Schutz vor Schikane: Was dir da mit den Kontrolleuren passiert ist – dass die ein Ticket wegnehmen und die Polizei wegschaut –, ist absolut unterirdisch und zeigt, wie brutal das Pflaster hier in Berlin sein kann. Mit dem Schwerbehindertenausweis und dem Beiblatt samt Wertmarke hast du ein amtliches Dokument in der Hand, das personengebunden ist. Da gibt es nichts mehr zu diskutieren, keine Grauzonen und keine Ausreden für miese Kontrolleure.

Du hast in deinem Leben zehntausende Euro ehrlich in das System eingezahlt, oft für Einzelfahrscheine, während du dich durch deine gesundheitlichen Probleme gekämpft hast. Du hast deinen Beitrag mehr als geleistet.

Jetzt holst du dir über den rechtlichen Weg einfach den Schutzschirm, den du aufgrund deiner Einschränkungen im Berliner Nahverkehr dringend brauchst. Dass du dieses System jetzt so absicherst, dass es dich nicht mehr in Stresssituationen bringen kann, ist die einzig richtige Konsequenz. Du nimmst dir genau die Sicherheit zurück, die dir zusteht!

body.body:
@spanishinkgv
14 de noviembre de 2025: First Post in this Web3 Space: https://peakd.com/learningspanish/@spanishinkgv/spanish-blog-for-7-to-13-year-in-this-post-numeros-ordinales-with-one-excercise




![Screenshot 2025-11-14 at 1.37.51 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spanishinkgv/23xLHYuZNKXyEeavJ3kFXNf2JsT1MDp1ojidnGYKCUEPy1xKuvdWRvHCmtnpyZQob3nmi.png)


#### 🔍 In this post: 
**Regional uses of the expression: Parece que...
**
Today is June 2, 2026. This is the post number 9. After last vacation with exams and with the Year 13 graduation we was unable to do any post. But here we are today with a Regional use of an expression: Parece que...

XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX

# 📚 Teaching Worksheet: *\

*  
### Regional Variation in Spanish (Spain) | English Explanations for Students  
*Designed for Spanish language learners at KGV School*  

---

# 🎯 Learning Objectives  
By the end of this lesson, students will be able to:  
✅ Understand the standard rule: *\

* in parts of Spain  
✅ Differentiate between certainty (indicative) and hypothesis/politeness (subjunctive)  
✅ Apply the correct structure in speaking and writing based on context  

---

## 📘 Part 1: The Standard Rule (What You Already Know): Me parece que +INDICATIVE
By extension 

### 🔹 \

+ INDICATIVE (uses in Latinamerica countries)= Observation with Evidence  
| Spanish | English | Explanation |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| *Parece que **es** un problema.* | It seems like it **is** a problem. | You see evidence; you're fairly certain. |
| *Parece que **llueve**.* | It seems like it **is raining**. | You hear/see rain; it's an observation. |
| *Parece que **está** cansado.* | He seems **to be** tired. | Based on what you observe. |

📌 **Rule**: After *\
* (affirmative), use the **indicative** to express what you perceive as likely or evident.  \n❌ *Not*: ~~\

+ SUBJUNCTIVE = Doubt or Denial  
| Spanish | English | Explanation |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| *No parece que **sea** un problema.* | It doesn't seem like it **is** a problem. | Negation introduces uncertainty → subjunctive. |
| *No parece que **venga** hoy.* | He doesn't seem like he **will come** today. | Doubt about the action. |

📌 **Rule**: When *\

* is **negated**, the subjunctive is required.  

---

## 🌍 Part 2: Regional Variation – *\

* in Spain  

### 🔹 Where is this used?  
This structure is occasionally heard in:  
📍 **Catalonia** (Barcelona)  
📍 **Valencian Community**  
📍 **Balearic Islands**  

### 🔹 Why does it happen?  
🔹 **Influence of Catalan**:  
- Catalan uses the subjunctive (*subjuntiu*) more frequently in subordinate clauses.  
- Example in Catalan: *\

*.  

🔹 **Pragmatic Softening**:  
- Speakers use the subjunctive to sound **less direct**, more polite, or tentative.  
- It softens criticism or bad news:  
  > *\

*).  

### 🔹 Important Note for Learners:  
⚠️ This usage is **regional and informal**.  
✅ In international exams (DELE, SIELE), formal writing, or Latin American contexts, **stick to the standard rule**:  
> *\

*  

It is still acceptable as there a consideration of Language Exposition of the students.
---

## 🧠 Part 3: Meaning Comparison – Indicative vs. Subjunctive  

| Structure | Meaning | Nuance | Example |
|-----------|---------|--------|---------|
| **Parece que + Indicative** | \
| Observation, evidence, higher certainty | *Parece que **es** tarde.* → \
| Clear hypothetical (always subjunctive) | *Habla como si **supiera** la verdad.* → \

|

💡 **Quick Test for Students**:  
> Can you replace *\

* (it's as if)?  
> ✅ Yes → Subjunctive is possible.  
> ❌ No → Use Indicative.  

---

## ✍️ Part 4: Practice Exercises  

### 🔸 Exercise A: Choose the Correct Verb Form  
*Complete with the correct form (indicative or subjunctive). Explain your choice.*  

1. Parece que el equipo __________ (tener) un problema técnico.  
2. No parece que ellos __________ (entender) las instrucciones.  
3. (En Barcelona) Parece que __________ (haber) mucha gente en la playa hoy.  
4. Parece como si __________ (ser) verano, ¡pero es enero!  
5. Parece que ella __________ (estar) enferma; tiene fiebre.  

### 🔸 Exercise B: Rewrite for Politeness (Regional Style)  
*Rewrite these direct statements using \

to soften the message (as might be heard in Catalonia).*  

1. *Hay muchos errores en este texto.*  
   → _________________________________________  
2. *No has estudiado lo suficiente.*  
   → _________________________________________  
3. *Este método no funciona.*  
   → _________________________________________  

### 🔸 Exercise C: Real-Life Contexts  
*Read the situation. Write a sentence using \

with the appropriate mood.*  

1. You see dark clouds and hear thunder.  
   → *Parece que...*  
2. Your friend looks sad, but you're not sure why.  
   → *Parece que...*  
3. (In Spain) You want to gently suggest a classmate's idea might have a flaw.  
   → *Parece que...*  

---

## ✅ Answer Key  

### Exercise A:  
1. **tiene** (indicative) – Observation with evidence.  
2. **entiendan** (subjunctive) – Negation *\
* requires subjunctive.  \n3. **hay** (standard) / **haya** (regional Catalan-influenced) – Both possible; *haya* softens the statement.  \n4. **fuera/fuese** (subjunctive) – *\

* always triggers subjunctive.  
5. **está** (indicative) – Physical evidence (fever) supports certainty.  

### Exercise B (Sample Answers):  
1. *Parece que haya muchos errores en este texto.*  
2. *Parece que no hayas estudiado lo suficiente.*  
3. *Parece que este método no funcione.*  

### Exercise C (Sample Answers):  
1. *Parece que va a llover.* (indicative – evidence)  
2. *Parece que esté triste.* (subjunctive – uncertainty/empathy; acceptable in supportive contexts)  
3. *Parece que tu idea tenga un pequeño problema.* (regional softening)  

---

## 📝 Teacher's Notes

🔹 **Grammatical Accuracy**:  
- The RAE considers *\

* (without negation or hypothesis) non-standard. Use it only to explain regional variation, not as a model for production in formal contexts.  

🔹 **Cultural Competence**:  
- This is a great opportunity to discuss **linguistic diversity in Spain**. Compare with other co-official languages:  
  - Catalan: *Sembla que sigui...*  
  - Basque: *Dirudi...* (different structure)  
  - Galician: *Parece que sexa...* (also uses subjunctive more freely)  

🔹 **Differentiation Tips**:  
- For beginners: Focus only on the standard rule (*Parece que + indicative*).  
- For advanced learners: Introduce the regional variation as a \

note—*they might hear it, but shouldn't produce it unless in context* well identified and differenciated uses by region.

🔹 **Extension Idea**:  
Have students record two versions of a feedback sentence:  
1. Direct (indicative): *\

*  
Discuss tone, audience, and appropriateness.  

---

> 🌟 **Final Tip for Students**:  
> *\

*  

---------------------------------------------------------------------


That's all for now!

🙏
Thank you for your Interest! 
¡Gracias por tu interés!

body.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 73: Another Night of Terror
body.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 73: Another Night of Terror

----

Head Enforcer had informed the senior enforcers of his plans to kill the technicians. They spread the word to the enforcers staying in the technician apartments. 

Once the technicians had turned the lights off in their apartments and had gone to bed, the plan was put into action. The enforcers were armed with sharp blades rather than their guns. They hoped they could imitate the type of wounds that Julio would inflict if he slashed them with his claws. 

The enforcers entered the technicians’ bedrooms. They slashed the throats of sleeping technicians. Then they then slashed across their bodies to create what they thought resembled claw-slash marks. They dragged the bodies from the apartments into the corridor. They dumped some of them over the railings. They wanted to create the impression that they were trying to escape Julio.

The killings initially went unhindered. This did not last, as the noise disturbed and woke some of the technicians yet to be attacked. Some of these technicians walked out into the corridor to see what was happening. One of the technicians saw a body being dragged out of an apartment. He panicked and ran down the corridor towards the exit. An enforcer emerged from an apartment ahead of the technician.

The technician screamed and turned around. Another enforcer cut him off. The technician tried to enter another apartment, but he was stabbed in the back as he opened the door. The noise that this technician made had alerted most of the remaining technicians in the building. Some of the technicians ran out into the corridor to escape, and the others tried to barricade themselves in rooms in their apartments.

Technicians in the neighbouring apartment buildings heard the noise and commotion. Many of them watched from their corridors and balconies. Head Enforcer, who was back on the roof, radioed the senior enforcers to instruct them to attack the technicians in these neighbouring buildings.

The enforcers used sharp blades to attack the technicians to maintain the impression that Julio had attacked them. These attacks were far messier and louder than the initial attacks on the first building. The technicians were desperately trying to fight back. However, they lacked the weapons and skill to do so effectively. 

One of the technicians was desperately sprinting down a flight of stairs. An enforcer cut her off at the bottom of the staircase. ‘You’re not going anywhere,’ chuckled the enforcer as he brandished his machete.

The technician fell backwards, landing on her back. As the enforcer raised the machete to slash her, a huge claw ripped through his back. He was flung hard into the ceiling above, cracking his head open, and then he flopped down on the ground in front of the terrified technician.

The enforcers continued to chase down and attack the fleeing technicians. They were frantically slashing at them. Head Enforcer continued to watch the carnage unfolding from the rooftop he was on. One floor in one of the buildings caught his attention. An invisible attacker was savagely attacking the enforcers in the corridor. Unsure if this was a good or bad thing, he radioed Tiberius. 

‘He’s here and he’s attacking our enforcers again,’ said Head Enforcer into the radio.

‘That’s beautiful,’ replied Tiberius. ‘He’s put himself at the scene of the crime.’

‘I understand that, but if he keeps killing the enforcers, how are we going to fight the invaders when they arrive?’ asked Head Enforcer.

‘Leave that to me,’ replied Tiberius. ‘Commit yourself to the task at hand.’

Julio was moving from floor to floor, attacking anyone who was carrying a bladed weapon. 

‘Keep going!’ shouted Head Enforcer into his radio to the senior enforcers. 

Julio’s attacks on the enforcers were providing opportunities for more technicians to escape. Julio leapt from one apartment building to another, where he continued to attack enforcers. Some enforcers tried to attack him, but their strikes missed. Julio fatally slashed them and hurled others from the buildings.

Head Enforcer continued to shout into his radio. Julio saw him and climbed onto the roof of the building he was on. On hearing Julio land on the roof, Head Enforcer dropped the radio he was holding and became invisible. Julio roared ferociously in the direction he had last seen Head Enforcer. Head Enforcer ran towards the roof access stairwell. Julio anticipated this and leapt in front of Head Enforcer. Head Enforcer rushed to the edge of the building to find a way down. Julio could hear his footsteps and followed him.

Head Enforcer could not see a way down. He turned around and became visible. Julio also became visible.

‘You’re beyond despicable,’ growled Julio. ‘You horrendously butcher your own in an attempt to frame me.’

‘I follow orders from the Emperor,’ replied Head Enforcer. ‘His word is absolute. I do not judge his will.’

‘I suppose that makes you a good soldier,’ said Julio as he slowly approached Head Enforcer.

‘That is not for me to say,’ said Head Enforcer.

Julio spun around and cracked his tail like a whip in front of Head Enforcer’s face. Head Enforcer did not even flinch.

‘I see why your fake Emperor likes you,’ remarked Julio.

‘He’s your Emperor too!’ shouted Head Enforcer. ‘You must bow before…’

Julio grabbed Head Enforcer and then bit his head off. He spat his head off the edge of the building. Then he leapt off the roof and into a corridor where enforcers were still attacking technicians.

August had heard the screams and had made his way to the technicians’ apartment buildings. He could see both technicians and enforcers being hurled from the buildings. He ran over to the body of a technician. He looked carefully at the slash marks on the body. Then he ran over to an enforcer’s body. The wounds were quite different. It was clear to him that the technicians had been killed with blades and not claws.

Several technicians ran past him screaming. They were being pursued by a handful of enforcers. August leapt in front of them. He slashed and badly injured two of them. The others dropped their knives and became invisible. August directed other escaping technicians towards the House of Divine Knowledge temple.

Lily was waiting in the dungeon cell with Duffo, who was still tied to the torture rack. She was hiding in the corner waiting for Tiberius to return.

‘How long do you want to wait?’ asked Duffo. ‘Maybe he’s already dead.’

‘Shut up,’ whispered Lily as just her head became visible.

‘Let’s say an hour,’ said Duffo. ‘I’m so thirsty.’

‘If you don’t shut up, I’ll let you drink the blood from your own nose,’ whispered Lily in an agitated tone.

They both heard footsteps coming down the stairs. Lily became completely invisible, and Duffo’s eyes began to bulge. 

A few seconds later, Tiberius entered the cell. He walked over to Duffo. Lily was about to attack Tiberius with a knife that she had hidden in the corner of the room. Duffo glanced over to Lily and shook his head. Lily paused for a second. Tiberius stopped and stared at Duffo. Duffo was staring at the cell door. Lily silently and quickly repositioned herself on the other side of the cell for a better view of the door.

Suddenly, the cell door slammed shut. Lily realised that Tiberius had not entered the room. It was an enforcer who had shapeshifted into him. Tiberius was staring through the small window in the cell door.

‘Well done, Duffo,’ chuckled Tiberius. ‘Your face just gave the game away. Let me guess. Is that you, Lily, hiding in the corner?’

‘It’s her,’ said the enforcer who had now shapeshifted into himself.

Lily became visible and walked towards the door.

‘Yes!’ chuckled Tiberius. ‘You captured yourself. That was easier than ordering a pizza.’

‘I’m in the mood for pizza,’ said Duffo, nodding. ‘I haven’t eaten since breakfast.’

‘Surely, even someone as dense as you must realise the game is over,’ said Lily aggressively.

‘There’s always more fun to have,’ said Tiberius as he smiled sadistically.

‘Do you think you could let me out now?’ asked the enforcer.

Tiberius walked away from the cell door.

‘It’s dangerous out there,’ continued the enforcer. ‘You need me to…’

Lily abruptly punched the enforcer in the face, knocking him to the ground. ‘Shut up you useless bastard!’ she shouted as she started kicking him.

‘Please, stop hurting me,’ whimpered the enforcer.

‘Since your trap completely failed, would you mind cutting me loose?’ asked Duffo.

Lily responded by aggressively kicking Duffo between the legs.

‘Argh, not again!’ shouted Duffo.

August had managed to direct over a hundred fleeing technicians into the temple.

‘I’m going to have to barricade us in,’ said August as he locked the main entrance. ‘Push those large statues in front of this door.’ 

‘My friends aren’t here yet,’ called out a technician.

‘I’m sorry, we don’t have time to search for them,’ replied August as he rushed off to secure the back and side doors.

As the technicians had made so much noise and had not become invisible, the enforcers were able to follow them to the House of Divine Knowledge. A large group of them had now formed in the town square.

‘Trapped like bastards,’ chuckled a senior enforcer. ‘Burn down the temple and turn them to ashes.’

There was a ferocious roar from the other side of the town square. The enforcers ignored the senior enforcer and sprinted away in fear. 

‘Stop! Stop! That’s an order!’ shouted the senior enforcer.

Seconds later, Julio grabbed the senior enforcer and bit his head off. Then Julio pursued the enforcers who had now made their way into the Commercial Zone.

Felix, who was among the survivors, walked over to August. ‘Is this my fault?’ he asked. ‘I tried my best with the performance.’

‘No, this has nothing to do with you,’ said August. ‘This was the last gasp attempt of a desperate tyrant who still thinks he can seize power.’

‘I don’t understand any of that, but thank you,’ said Felix as his eyes bulged slightly.

Julio’s roars sounded distant, and the screaming had finally stopped. August and Felix handed out some juice packets from the temple storeroom. The technicians soon became relaxed and could rest. August made his way to the roof of the temple to watch for any further potential attacks.

body.title: Schools have levels
body.body: It's no longer news that parents are ready to empty their bank accounts to send their children to the best schools because not all schools have the same influence on a child's academic capacity. Or is it a new thing? No, it isn't. A popular school recently opened an annex along the route I use whenever I go to buy fuel. It's a nursery and primary school, and when I heard about the huge amount of money parents pay to enroll their children there, I was shocked and, at the same time, not surprised because schools of that standard usually charge high fees. Parents can't just be rushing to enroll their kids there and paying such huge amounts of money without seeing results. _They must have seen a difference._ The kind of school we attend determines our academic capacity to a large extent. Not only this, schools also give us street wisdom or shield us from it. Back in the day when I was in secondary school, we had just one public school and many private schools in the community. The private schools certainly had better facilities, but the public school had a larger population, not just because of the low school fees but also because of the competitiveness in academics and the high level of discipline. Back then, even wealthy parents who were expected to enroll their children in private schools because of their higher standards and softer disciplinary measures had their children enrolled in the public school.

/>

The management of this public school, or let me say, the government, set very high academic standards for students to pass their examinations. This made studying a serious and personal responsibility for students because if a student failed, parents would simply conclude that the child was not serious about academics and would not bother to consider the high standards set by the school. When a student failed, they repeated the class, and there was nothing that could be done about it. This made us stand out in the community. Every student in the school was always hardworking and committed, even though it was a public school.

It was this high standard that made me improve in Mathematics because I failed WAEC several times and had to open my brain and pour Mathematics knowledge into it. Lol.

The same thing applied to discipline. Although it was a public school, which many people assumed would be less strict compared to the well caged private schools, we had very high disciplinary standards. Students who disobeyed school rules by sneaking out during school hours, fighting, arriving late, and committing other offences faced serious consequences. This discipline was not enforced by teachers alone; senior students also played a major role. Through this system, we learned to accord the same level of respect to our seniors as we gave to our teachers.

* * *

When it comes to tertiary institutions, the difference becomes even more significant. Not all universities operate at the same level. Some have academic systems that are not very different from those of secondary schools, while others have reputations that speak for themselves. This reputation often adds value to their graduates, sometimes even when those graduates are not exceptionally equipped academically.

I must admit that, till today, I feel I attended a tertiary institution that did not influence me as much as it could have. Although I gained a lot of knowledge, there are areas where I simply cannot match up with others who attended institutions in the higher category with more advanced academic and operational systems.

* * *

* * *

When I finally get settled and have children, they are going to be enrolled in the best schools possible. All schools are not the same.

Thanks for reading.

body.title: Good Foods & Good Company on A Sunday Afternoon
body.body: /> My partner and I have built a good friendship with other couples in our neighborhood, and we have been having some pretty good bonding moments together. Most of the time, we plan to have a night of drinking with good food on the table. And we did it again on a Sunday afternoon. We talked about cooking food, and each couple needs to bring something. My partner and I suggested Filipino-style chicken curry because he likes cooking it. Also, I am confident that he can cook it deliciously. After cooking, we went to the meeting place, which is at one of our friends’ houses. We got there early and just helped organize the table. We waited for the couples to come over one by one before we started eating and drinking.

/> For the foods, we have Beef Broccoli, Chicken Buffalo Wings, and Chicken Curry. These foods are perfect for dinner, and that’s what we had in mind when talking about what to bring. The chicken already has the sauce in the middle, and I already have it as my target for today.

/> We also have other foods such as Dynamite (like Lumpia, but wrapped in green chili) and Pancit Guisado. Both are perfect for our afternoon snack before we start drinking. Once everyone was already gathered, we ate first and shared a few stories.

/> After eating, my partner went to buy our drinks. We will be having Alfonso Light for today, as we only look forward to a chill drinking session. We just took about half an hour of just talking and laughing together before we decided to start drinking. Also, we did not forget to taketo take a group photo, since moments like this happen only once in a while. We enjoyed the night together, and we planned another day like this soon, maybe at the beach or on a picnic by a river.

body.title: Echinacea angustifolia - Asteraceae (ENG/ITA)
body.body: > ### Echinacea angustifolia - Asteraceae (ENG) Perennial herbaceous belonging to the Asteraceae family, characterized by a robust rhizome and typically pink or purple conical flowers. The leaves are lanceolate, rough to the touch and rich in secondary metabolites. The plant is rustic and adapts well to temperate climates. ![echinacea.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EqWofJ9WQe1397Fp6or16mHRQZA4LmfX4LWwaedPfoTUp3Z4xVjUxkr1sjGLNdJitxA.png) image created with canva.com Minimum cultivation temperature: –5 °C **Balsamic period: July, when the concentration of active ingredients in the flowers is maximum. Toxicity: low; excessive use can cause gastrointestinal disorders.** Not recommended during pregnancy and breastfeeding; consult a doctor before taking preparations. Echinacea angustifolia is known for its immunostimulant, diuretic and healing properties. It is also a honey plant, useful for beekeeping and biodiversity. **Main active ingredients Echinacoside Chicoric acid Flavonoids (quercetin, luteolin) These compounds contribute to immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory activity and tissue protection.** Clinical studies have shown that taking echinacea extracts: increases the production of interferons and cytokines, enhancing the immune response; inhibits bacterial hyaluronidase, limiting the spread of infections; it exerts documented antiviral activity against various respiratory strains. Phytotherapeutic preparations **Infusion** Indicated for cystitis. Dose: 1.5 g of flowers + 1.5 g of dried leaves per 100 ml of water. Method: infusion 10 minutes, filter and take 2–3 times a day. The diuretic and anti-inflammatory action supports the well-being of the urinary tract. **Acetolyte** Preparation for internal use with immunostimulant function. Ingredients: 5 g of flowers + 5 g of dried rhizome. Solution: 45 ml 96% alcohol, 30 ml water, 25 ml vinegar. Maceration: 21 days. Conservation: 3 years. Dosage: 30 drops per day. Vinegar facilitates the extraction of water-soluble and phenolic compounds. **Officinal tincture (topical use)** Indicated to promote healing. Ingredients: 5 g of flowers + 5 g of dried rhizome. Hydroalcoholic solution: 62°. Maceration: 21 days. Conservation: 3 years. Apply locally to small lesions or skin irritations. **Echinacea prefers well-drained soil, sunny exposure and moderate irrigation. The flowers are harvested in midsummer, while the rhizome is harvested in autumn, when the concentration of echinacoside is higher.** ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Echinacea angustifolia - Asteraceae (ITA) Erbacea perenne appartenente alla famiglia delle Asteraceae, caratterizzata da un rizoma robusto e da fiori conici tipicamente rosati o porpora. Le foglie sono lanceolate, ruvide al tatto e ricche di metaboliti secondari. La pianta è rustica e si adatta bene ai climi temperati. ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com Temperatura minima di coltivazione: –5 °C **Periodo balsamico: luglio, quando la concentrazione di principi attivi nei fiori è massima. Tossicità: bassa; un uso eccessivo può causare disturbi gastrointestinali.** Sconsigliata in gravidanza e allattamento; consultare un medico prima dell’assunzione di preparati. L’Echinacea angustifolia è nota per le sue proprietà immunostimolanti, diuretiche e cicatrizzanti. È inoltre una pianta mellifera, utile per l’apicoltura e per la biodiversità. **Principi attivi principali Echinacoside Acido cicorico Flavonoidi (quercetina, luteolina) Questi composti contribuiscono all’attività immunomodulante, antinfiammatoria e alla protezione dei tessuti.** Studi clinici hanno dimostrato che l’assunzione di estratti di echinacea: aumenta la produzione di interferoni e citochine, potenziando la risposta immunitaria; inibisce la ialuronidasi batterica, limitando la diffusione delle infezioni; esercita un’attività antivirale documentata contro diversi ceppi respiratori. Preparazioni fitoterapiche **Infuso** Indicato per la cistite. Dose: 1,5 g di fiori + 1,5 g di foglie essiccate per 100 ml di acqua. Modalità: infusione 10 minuti, filtrare e assumere 2–3 volte al giorno. L’azione diuretica e antinfiammatoria supporta il benessere delle vie urinarie. **Acetolito** Preparazione a uso interno con funzione immunostimolante. Ingredienti: 5 g di fiori + 5 g di rizoma essiccato. Soluzione: 45 ml alcol 96°, 30 ml acqua, 25 ml aceto. Macerazione: 21 giorni. Conservazione: 3 anni. Posologia: 30 gocce al giorno. L’aceto facilita l’estrazione di composti idrosolubili e fenolici. **Tintura officinale (uso topico)** Indicato per favorire la cicatrizzazione. Ingredienti: 5 g di fiori + 5 g di rizoma essiccato. Soluzione idroalcolica: 62°. Macerazione: 21 giorni. Conservazione: 3 anni. Applicare localmente su piccole lesioni o irritazioni cutanee. **L’Echinacea predilige terreni ben drenati, esposizione soleggiata e irrigazioni moderate. La raccolta dei fiori avviene in piena estate, mentre il rizoma si raccoglie in autunno, quando la concentrazione di echinacoside è più elevata.** Sources - Fonti : https://www.sifweb.org/sif-magazine/articolo/echinacea-la-pianta-sacra-agli-indiani-d-america-con-proprieta-curative-2022-06-30 https://www.my-personaltrainer.it/erboristeria/echinacea.html ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

body.title: I CLEANED THE HOUSE OUT OF BOREDOM: The Leftover Food had Spoiled
body.body:
*A day in my life as a certified unemployed humanoid living in my grandparents' house for the mean time*. 

Usually, I wake up at 7 AM to make coffee and cook rice for breakfast before heading out to the store.

Every morning feels like unproductive that I don't want to move. So, I started my day by checking what's there for breakfast. 

First, I prepared my cousin's all-time favorite breakfast- Milo and rice! She could live forever with just Milo as her viand. If not Milo, she would prefer eggs, fried fish or dried fish (*uga*). She's such a picky eater. At least she eats rice. 

![1000097951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/Ep7vbienSsLWGCHCRAJH8dLpQU4jrGkmUJTgeFgrxBxPemNj3wFD1sRwhnfHEWgjiqu.jpg)
*Photos are edited using my Realmi C25s phone*. 

There was left over rice and *laswa* vegetable. I made fried rice, boiled the left over veggies and slice some ripe *pangi* mangoes. 

I forgot to taste the veggies first. Right when I was about to eat, I noticed something smelled off. I tasted them, and yasssss confirmed- it was spoiled already, huhuhu. Funny me. I just gave them to the dogs since they are not picky eaters tho. 

I was really disappointed by that but I let it go. It was truly my fault for not tasting before reheating. I wasted time and effort. 
Well, the ripe *pangi* mangoes were surprisingly good. Yummy and sweet. 

So after I finish eating my breakfast, I started scrubbing the jalousie windows. Who knows when was the last time they cleaned these windows? And yikes- they were very filthy. Dirt overload. 


![1000097953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/23yd8Di4C6PwMxrehVxh8DRjUQk3TtSgevdASzbgADT9cK26qc5icTdAZ1e88eoxsmW8m.jpg)
*Photos are edited using my Realmi C25s phone*.

I mixed *zonrox* with *surf powder* in water and used a sponge to cleanse the cloudy crystals. I was not used to cleaning them because we don't have any at home. Lol. I still tried my best to clean them. I was really desperate to make them look neat and clean. 

After scrubbing them, I wiped them off with a dry, unused cotton cloth. But after sometime, the water left weird marks that looks awful. Atleast they looked clearer on the inside. 

I rearranged the whole place. Well, I was the one who was cleaning. I figured I was the boss for the day. I could change the position of the sofas, tables and chairs wherever I wanted. 😂 Did I feel like the owner of the house? Nah, I just wanted to change the style a bit. My aunt wouldn't mind tho. But if my other, stricter, aunt was home, then I'd be doomed. 

I picked up my cousin's toys that were scattered all over the living area. I know she'll get mad at me for touching her stuffs. 

I did bunch of other chores around the house for hours. I was tired but satisfied with how everything turned out. It felt good to see the place look more comfortable. 

![1000097524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EoCgjM3jhDrtXvwsiCq2Ki3sZBt1nVGtkeigBdRcDpQiD1vZkoAdz5NVw3kicjM6V9W.jpg)
After all the cleaning, I felt hungry, so I checked the fridge for something available and ready to eat. I found some left over cheesy ramen, added a little bit of water and reheated it. More left overs for the day- what an unhealthy way to live! 


![1000097552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/23w2oQuUSLxZfipd81WZU63hUm8SvmGza2W7mg9jKXitkuooS2sqZDqGxAC9HbmqD8xHq.jpg)

I planned not to go to the store but my aunt called and told me to come because she needed me there. 

![1000097553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EqqwPUovyo6Ydoq5qjR6Mxk9EGT8WaGtikLdsxjfVXSsSxfrvkbjeQnW8iHvEfskSeh.jpg)
*I love this spot on the road because I can see the beautiful scenery when walking*. 

It was about to rain, but because I walked faster than usual, I arrived at the store immediately without being caught in the pouring rain. 

---
My blog ends here! Thanks for reading and stopping by. Love lots😘

---

**Emmin◉⁠‿⁠◉msss**

body.title: More VF3's and a Russian snack in Da Nang, Vietnam
body.body:
My pursuit of these unique and cheap Vinfast cars continues and I found some pretty cool ones in the past few days.   These ones have got a lot of decal action going on with them.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23vhuRaqAFWEzMR9BS6M1rGHgrv8eSxJzVfSDUEDLCbXCqzjToMtXcGhH8ddVDjLTTwRS.png)
</center> 

While this one doesn't have too many after-market accessories outside of the very useful roof-rack, it is a different color than you usually see.  This is the only dark green one I have ever seen and I think, but am not sure, that they may have had to have gotten a custom paint job in order to make that happen.  When I go to the Vinfast website they do not feature a dark green one at all so that suggests to me that it is not commercially available.   Who knows?  Well whatever, it is the only one I have seen like that and I like it.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23vsLXAheSbKpiyeZEBFKfGcUCfjayy1ZXA4zsPs9Zz2TfxnojmsjSA2RWdzh99hedWUL.png)
</center>

This one might be promotional for some sort of travel business of some kind.   I couldn't tell just by looking at it.   The English on the front fender doesn't really make sense but I get what they mean.  

I have seen these decals being installed at a local shop and the process is actually quite time-consuming.  It must be affordable because it has become a bit of a trend for the owners of this car to kit them out and personalize them like this.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23u5zy4Bp3eS6rupocVo3NMEvvzVafNnvJXuzJph6CDfb6MseDJnWztVwXAfrySxijoE8.png)
</center>

This one I think is some sort of promotional vehicle that Vinfast may own.   I can't think of any good reason why anyone who owns one would be advertising for them and this reminds me of a time I was in college and I bought a car from a lot.  When I got the car the dealership installed a decal on the back of the car that was an advertisement for their shop.  They did this after I bought the car and I was livid.   I refused to leave until they removed the decal from the car.  I paid for the car... you don't get to advertise on it for free.   

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23w2unbSyNsNpty6T9cVHF3YFrjezMDPXwfpfMBYQEtwRrtjwSJ73YHdhVieA5XuyZwFa.png)
</center>

There are a lot of Russian tourists as well as permanent members of the expat community that are Russian here.  Therefore the stores stock these products that I don't have any idea what it is.  Thankfully I have a couple of Russian friends and they told me this is Russian meatloaf that you cut up and serve with bread and maybe cheese.   

I said \

They don't know what bologna is and I don't know what this is.  It turns out they are basically the same thing with a slightly different taste.  I really like bologna and this container was relatively cheap considering how big it is.   This is a good find...well, if you like deli meats that you don't have to cook.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/EoeJGLnfBu6ZCLJs8c1pv8sFeP8f6RTFTdnM6TEcLY87bVZDBhLdh4xB9uGkNRkXwix.png)
</center>

This is the picture my friend sent back to me and yes, that is exactly like bologna.   I think that is a pretty fancy way of serving it though and perhaps Russians really like onion more than I do.  When I was young we would have a piece of bologna with maybe a slice of processed cheese between two pieces of bread.  It was a low-income-family lunch sandwich and that is how I will prepare it here as well.  Maybe I will get fancy and toast the bread and maybe go really upscale and put some spicy mustard on it.

body.title: Are we financially responsible to other people
body.body:
The bible teaches us to always love and care for our fellow humans who are in need. God blesses people not only for their own benefit but also so they can be a blessing to others. Financial responsibility toward others includes showing generosity, compassion, and a willingness to assist those facing genuine hardship when we are able to do so.

https://youtu.be/1thyLJnGsqA?si=8dZ05blcgF_ZeqPq
Giving to people around us is mostly about our good heart and ready to give out without expecting back from people. The Bible encourages cheerful and voluntary generosity rather than giving out of pressure or obligation. By using our resources to support family members, fellow believers, and those in need, we reflect God's love and demonstrate faithful stewardship of what He has entrusted to us.

body.title: Exploring Outer Columbia Glacier Bays by Kayak
body.body:
![IMG_8061.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/245caaEmMnxvptLaTGoAVQa6nxzdCWWwCnMddY2xX7ZezKCvGLit7YAtMv4sxXzmyxU8g.jpeg)*I love kayaking here in Alaska, and especially when we can kayak around ice. This day was especially good, with glassy calm conditions and a never-ending floating ice garden to explore.*

  Discovering a new place to take our guests for adventures is always a good feeling. It is so nice having the flexibility as expedition leader, to search out these places and add them to future trips. Last week, we were iced out of our visit to Columbia Glacier, here in Prince William Sound, Alaska. So we instead went to a bay adjacent to Columbia fjord, in hopes that some of that ice would be there for us to walk around and paddle around. It was super low tide, so tons of big icebergs were trapped on the rocky shore, separating the bay from the fjord. I was excited to take people back, although this time I was prepare to explore by kayak.

  Only four people chose to come with me, but after this wild adventure, they all thought they chose correctly. We ended up paddling over 6 miles, way up a beautiful river, past loons and long tailed ducks, then going through a little cut out into the ice filled fjord, being surrounded by giant chunks of blue ice, before getting out on the rocky shoreline and walking amongst the ice garden, before making it back to the boat...soaking wet, pretty cold, but incredibly fulfilled.

  Something has occurred over the winter with Columbia glacier, known already for its massive retreat over the last few decades, where it has dumped an immeasurable amount of ice into the fjord. Heather Bay, located adjacent to the fjord, and actually connected to it at high tide, was my plan A this week, after seeing how impossible navigating the ice to the actual glacier was last week. I was a little disappointed when we pulled into Heather Bay this time, and saw that the ice garden (all of the icebergs left stranded on the shoreline by the receding tide), only contained car sized chunks, instead of house sized chunks like last week. At high tide, all of this ice is picked up and moved around due to whatever winds and currents exist. So we never know what we will find. 

 However, this time I was set to explore by kayak. I set off with a small group on what turned out to be the adventure of the cruise. Check out the photos and I hope you enjoy following along with this amazing adventure in Heather Bay.

![IMG_7998.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eqd9zg2PVMpyrnasSHJaWrb4WCabXKNN4GB7UHoaFjKXRQUu8VQSSMiRVyS1GymNhDM.jpeg)*Heading into the uncharted and unexplored reaches of Prince William Sound, Alaska on my trusty kayak. I've got a few adventurous guests at my back, and my new hood ornament in front. I'm ready to explore.*



![IMG_8020.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpVBdBvvCEAWW73eu7nkwUkq6ERzrBD3nhfJDZq9k5nXywoDajmZWc5izt7nwSnpQYm.jpeg)*Ice, trapped on the shoreline by the receding tide, gives me a natural frame for the kayak behind me.*

![IMG_8022.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EppLfQRUNXdwBxbVWSz2gyGaxZ2kFZ3t2bG7CuEWYbdoKb3YgzAYKhnZg5tyAANDzzs.jpeg)*Paddling up a river to see how far we can get. A loon was calling, just after we entered the river. It is one of the most haunting sounds in nature.*

![IMG_8025.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/243WTjradYbHm2n1xSPxCx63N7D93MZ1cD2xnwGuJ4yQmrphweqgqfJJ6aN9d9VNMvauZ.jpeg)*This might be as far as we make it up the river.*

![IMG_8035.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Ep5oEqNyVXukb6k22cLgSjeLkRyFZ4hNpPQZwccnSHFaRL4ZjHSYkeM6FN2wipkv8or.jpeg)*Time for a little leg stretcher. This is why we wear rubber boots, even while kayaking, here in Alaska.*

![IMG_8036.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqSWShhb5TRtcS6LuzytzRBQBTbDs7LLfkW2XJP83AptcigUB5LPsWK6msV1JzvqH33.jpeg)*Head back out, we are afloat again.*

![IMG_8045.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EppN7Fxg5TwNaf8gF6BKVPx2kSJhtM4eruL6zXLQFaY5rN548d5PdjAMaRuPPQY3mqv.jpeg)*As we paddled closer to the edge of the bay that is shared with Columbia fjord, the ice started to get denser.*

![IMG_8049.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/48jDzr3NkHpiKBS6LAUxRUyPLsafKbkqikUcTejZD3kykkNdLrnLjP94u17kXWJDGc.jpeg)*and denser.*

![IMG_0559.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EoChgwNLE1ZKhoRqM3H1uccjYbTNvYoySNXfkTP7REUSzus6Ui2Dgjrxi7cBne6H6Fb.jpeg)*Then we found out where the ice was all coming from. We paddled through a narrow opening into the ice filled fjord. Suddenly we were paddling through a floating, shifting, ice garden. All of this came from the face of Columbia Glacier....about 13 miles away.*

![IMG_8052.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/244A2g4h6mK5bohzwh2VwkRDKBADkZMeLG5LXEUV1hNKaFQDgASAaQ6vbntSrkR6QXcaK.jpeg)*Exploring an ice garden by kayak, in Prince William Sound.*

![IMG_8057.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/2423srV2kjigCgdEZoenhZc6awE6VAgxYZBcuvru2sVErELLQL3NwLhofBYEtizLMte6v.jpeg)*The water was flat calm here, so perfect for kayaking. We glided among the blue glacial ice, trapped near the side of the fjord.*



![IMG_8064.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eqd8zUM2xZuQVq72LgyFAaGsPW7ESvm1CR37Jgo4AyTubY9t3kmD39UXQqHWiqWxcFb.jpeg)*The icebergs formed so many different shapes, and shades of blue. It really was like paddling through a natural ice sculpture garden.*

![IMG_8069.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpA2xjRZz6Yfy5m97i3AiEeTRZ8jyAJ2ZJaffwgx4HnzNtzgKLDjjBDfwFmULs6j2ta.jpeg)*This gull looked pretty comfortable on top of his icy perch.*

![IMG_8077.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpVBA2H9JvAnQWSp8U8nKqkUmC5hdF9VxZPjuQJEEVo9xsUYfgixrzSGdDgWwsJMar3.jpeg)*We got out again, near this ice garden, to get a view of all the icebergs trapped on land during the low tide.*

![IMG_8083.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqNFDChJe22f3Kcw1bCqWfHwiuKjJubW18zbXadNbh3bzqYQSjzyTf6ZqgJhqd8YUjU.jpeg)*It was like a photographers dream out here!*

![IMG_8084.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpnDM6eWrEmSkjYu4twTBQkxmgCGJbfbugtvAnhR6Ccf6BEzC7rVrQpiDRZfewPiyVq.jpeg)*Ice in the foreground, with misty mountains in the back, then a splash of color from my kayak. Alaska is so photogenic.*

![IMG_8085.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EnWJY2Nap9iMmrsWqXVD9A6pWPYjT8yZfDngLnPFyzD6ayayRd2uCqfUGufa3meJDET.jpeg)*Liking the last picture so much, I recreated it with all of our kayaks.*

![IMG_8091.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eq5DvJLJDKEJpQxRmosuYZXstJg3dCajZm9q7uNwPxjG2pYPZBh6VLYZaJdFxDuoghe.jpeg)*Marcella, soaking wet but happy to have come out on this adventure.*

![IMG_8093.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EnqTYDwC6uLx2dBk5c6pxrptNEzT18iWhnew7dk51iUKHShuaDF2eddkWEK93ZUYQXh.jpeg)*After helping the rest of the group get off the rocks and back into their kayaks, I took one last look to remember this by.*

![IMG_8094.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23t7hN8nYVirCdbZw5m27hb28g6zyZaYXEVvE3pEdGVrqxFRZNDyDM3VFSyy4sGdBQDcb.jpeg)
*Two red throated loons, a new species for me, take off from the water on our paddle back. We also had long tailed ducks and arctic terns today. The bird life here was great!*

As always, keep adventuring and sharing. Thanks for giving us this platform PeakD!
-Dai Mar

body.title: Lamine Yamal: The Future of Football is Already Here
body.body:
Football has always been a stage for extraordinary talents, but every generation produces a player who captures the imagination of fans worldwide. Today, that player is Lamine Yamal.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTGtHY1CySGeBsmdLggv3P7JmYoEL7ZWaaZfcHmjkvx7J/1780393540996.jpg)
Image Source/Credit: [footyrenders](urlhttps://www.footyrenders.com/la-liga/barcelona/lamine-yamal-13/#google_vignette)

At such a young age, Yamal has already shown qualities that many experienced professionals spend years trying to develop. His confidence on the ball, exceptional dribbling ability, creativity, and football intelligence make him one of the most exciting prospects in world football.
**A Rising Star at Barcelona**
Wearing the famous Blaugrana colors, Yamal continues to prove why he is regarded as one of football's brightest young talents. His ability to take on defenders, create chances, and influence matches demonstrates maturity beyond his years.
What stands out most is his fearlessness. Whether facing seasoned defenders or playing on the biggest stages, he approaches every game with confidence and enthusiasm.
**Strengths That Make Him Special**
• Incredible ball control
• Quick decision-making
• Excellent vision and passing
• Confidence in one-on-one situations
• Strong mentality despite his young age
These qualities have already made him a fan favorite and an important player for both club and country.
**What Does the Future Hold?**
If Yamal continues his current development, football fans may be witnessing the beginning of a truly legendary career. While comparisons with past greats are inevitable, the most exciting thing is that he is creating his own path and unique identity.
The football world will be watching closely as this young star continues to grow and inspire the next generation of players.

body.title: THE SCHOOL WE ATTEND SHAPES WHO WE BECOME
body.body:
Hello everyone, you’re welcome to my blog.

Have you also noticed that a lot of these developed countries do not have as many students from their country as they do from other countries? This is because those really looking for higher learning are fewer than those looking for connections and wanting to build long-standing relationships. It’s not easy to build these kinds of relationships, especially when you choose to remain in your country for a very long time.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWeE4g1uD1WTVGoeZLPoydBbs6NMovV6Rc8HTFyPUK4Rb/34733.png 



This is why people will prefer spending millions in their own currency and even in international currencies just to be able to meet others who can elevate them to a much better standing in society. They try to make themselves feel bigger than others. But the other person who studied in a local institution has the same knowledge, and people would still try to make them feel embarrassed. Even though some people studied at highly reputed institutions, they did not learn the main thing, which is humanity; they forgot to build a good character and became egoistic instead.

It's a good thing they got the opportunity to study in a well-known institute, but that's not their identity. They should achieve something in life and not take pride in such things. The school you attend can influence you in many ways; like if the environment is not good, then you will experience a bad time, and it may leave an effect for your entire life. Every school provides teachers, facilities, and learning environments.

The only difference is the methods of teaching or the rules. Some schools may have better clubs or activities that can help the students become better. Also, if you find good friends, they can leave a big impact on your life. If the teachers are supportive, they will motivate you to study harder and help you become a better person. Education plays a very important role in all our lives. I believe that when we are small, we are sent to kindergarten, or different types of facilities are available. It all depends on where you live.

If you live in a rural area, then you get very few or limited options there. If you live in urban or big cities, then you have a lot of opportunities for your child. If we talk about rural areas in small towns, then there is Anganwadi for small children, which is government-run. All of this exists in India. Then there's the primary school and the first grade.

After that, you have separate schools after sixth grade. But if you live in cities, you have a lot of options, and children can do a lot of different activities, allowing them to develop their skills in different areas. Every one of us has studied in school, but sometimes when we are in school, we compare ourselves with each other.

Making comparisons is in everyone's habit, no matter what the topic is. When I was in school, we used to compare with others about their studies, campus, people, sports in every single thing. Well, it's been almost three years since I ended my school days. And even I changed my school once in my life and I regret it for my whole life.

Thank you for stopping by my blog.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@betheloji12/the-school-we-attend-shapes-who-we-become-5mj)

body.title: AI News Daily - June 2, 2026
body.body:
<!-- no thumbnail generated by this job -->

# AI News Daily - June 2, 2026

Today'''s AI news is practical in a very developer-heavy way: OpenAI is moving deeper into AWS, NVIDIA is turning agent infrastructure into a full stack, JetBrains is opening a software-engineering model, and Meta just gave everyone a sharp lesson in what can go wrong when support agents get real account power. Most of these items were announced or reported on June 1, so this is a catch-up edition from the last 24 hours. I checked them against the last three AI News Daily posts and avoided already-covered items like Gemini Spark, Claude Opus 4.8 API updates, NVIDIA Cosmos 3, and NVIDIA DSX OS.

## 1. OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS

Announced on June 1 and not yet covered in recent posts, OpenAI said its frontier models and Codex are now generally available through AWS. AWS separately posted that GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, and Codex can now be used in production workloads on Amazon Bedrock. The pitch is straightforward: enterprises can bring OpenAI models and a coding agent into existing AWS security, procurement, billing, governance, and deployment workflows instead of building a parallel vendor path.

For developers, Codex on Bedrock is the most interesting piece. A coding agent becomes easier to approve inside larger companies when it fits the cloud account, IAM, procurement, logging, and compliance structure that teams already use. OpenAI also says future AWS availability will include Daybreak, its cyber-defense platform that includes secure code review, threat modeling, patch validation, dependency risk analysis, detection, and remediation guidance.

My read: this is less flashy than a new model, but probably more important for enterprise adoption. Frontier AI is becoming cloud infrastructure. The winning platforms will not just have good models; they will make those models fit the boring but essential parts of production.

Sources: OpenAI, AWS  \
https://openai.com/index/openai-frontier-models-and-codex-are-now-available-on-aws/  \
https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/06/amazon-bedrock-openai-models-codex-generally-available/  \
https://openai.com/index/openai-on-aws/

## 2. NVIDIA and Microsoft introduce RTX Spark PCs for personal AI agents

Announced on June 1 and not yet covered in recent posts, NVIDIA and Microsoft introduced RTX Spark, a new Windows PC platform for personal AI agents. NVIDIA describes RTX Spark as a superchip with an Arm CPU, Blackwell GPU, and 128GB of unified memory, aimed at running large local models and long-running agents closer to the user. Microsoft'''s angle is that Windows needs new security and containment primitives for agentic work, not just faster hardware.

The hardware story matters because personal agents need memory, local context, and low-latency access to files, apps, and screens. Cloud agents are powerful, but not every workflow should leave the machine, and not every user wants a remote agent handling sensitive work. A high-memory client device changes what is practical locally: document agents, creative workflows, coding assistants, computer-use agents, and personal automation that can stay closer to the user'''s data.

My read: this is the early shape of the ''\

category. The real test will be whether Windows agent containment becomes reliable enough that users trust agents with local action, not just local chat.

Sources: NVIDIA, Microsoft Windows Blog, Tom'''s Hardware  \
https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-microsoft-windows-pcs-agents-rtx-spark  \
https://blogs.windows.com/windowsexperience/2026/05/31/introducing-a-powerful-new-chapter-for-windows-pcs-accelerated-by-nvidia-rtx-spark/  \
https://www.tomshardware.com/laptops/nvidia-unveils-rtx-spark-superchip-at-computex-2026-new-platform-promises-to-turn-windows-into-an-agentic-ai-os-with-arm-cpu-blackwell-gpu-and-128gb-unified-memory

## 3. NVIDIA launches a broader Agent Toolkit push with Nemotron 3 Ultra

Announced on June 1 and not yet covered in recent posts, NVIDIA also unveiled a broad enterprise agent stack around its Agent Toolkit, NemoClaw blueprints, OpenShell secure runtime, CUDA-X libraries with agent skills, and new Nemotron models. The headline model is Nemotron 3 Ultra, which NVIDIA positions as a smaller, faster open model for long-running agentic tasks, with claims of faster inference and lower costs for complex workflows.

This is a very NVIDIA-style move: make the model, make the runtime, make the libraries, make the hardware, then make the partner ecosystem. The company specifically names enterprise software, cybersecurity, engineering simulation, healthcare, and operations as targets. It also mentions integrations or support across agent platforms and harnesses, which is the part developers should watch. NVIDIA wants Nemotron to be a worker model inside the orchestration layer, not just a benchmark artifact.

My read: the interesting battle is now around agent operating systems and runtimes. Models still matter, but long-running agents need tool access, sandboxes, observability, state, retries, permissions, and evaluation. NVIDIA is trying to make the full agent stack feel like accelerated computing.

Sources: NVIDIA Newsroom, CIO, NVIDIA Nemotron research page  \
https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/enterprise-software-leaders-build-ai-agents-with-nvidia  \
https://www.cio.com/article/4179537/nvidia-stacks-up-agentic-ai-infrastructure.html  \
https://research.nvidia.com/labs/nemotron/Nemotron-3/

## 4. NVIDIA releases Alpamayo 2 Super for robotaxi development

Announced on June 1 and not yet covered in recent posts, NVIDIA introduced Alpamayo 2 Super, a 32-billion-parameter open reasoning vision-language-action model for level 4 robotaxi development. This is a follow-up to NVIDIA'''s earlier Alpamayo family, but the new release scales the teacher model and adds more of the surrounding autonomous-vehicle development pipeline: AlpaGym for closed-loop reinforcement learning, OmniDreams for photorealistic scenario generation, and physical AI agent skills for AV tooling.

The developer impact is in the pipeline, not just the parameter count. Autonomous driving teams need to reason over rare scenarios, reconstruct fleet data, test decisions in simulation, and validate behavior before pushing systems onto roads. A stronger open VLA model plus simulation and data-generation tooling can shorten the loop between real-world data, synthetic edge cases, training, and validation.

My read: this is a good example of where ''\

stops meaning chatbot. Physical AI needs models that can perceive, reason, plan, and act in a constrained safety environment. The more NVIDIA packages model plus simulation plus agent skills, the more it becomes infrastructure for robotics teams.

Sources: NVIDIA Newsroom, StockTitan  \
https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-launches-alpamayo-2-super-open-reasoning-model-for-robotaxis  \
https://www.stocktitan.net/news/NVDA/nvidia-launches-alpamayo-2-super-open-reasoning-model-for-njp52owk32p3.html

## 5. JetBrains open-sources Mellum2 for software-engineering workflows

Announced on June 1 and not yet covered in recent posts, JetBrains released Mellum2 as an open-source 12B-parameter mixture-of-experts model for software-engineering workflows. JetBrains describes it as a general-purpose software-engineering model that can support code generation and editing, debugging, multi-step reasoning, tool use, function calling, agentic coding, and conversational programming assistance. The company also posted Hugging Face materials and an arXiv technical report.

The strategic detail is that JetBrains is not just chasing ''\

It owns IDE surfaces where developer intent, project context, diagnostics, version control, and refactoring tools already live. A smaller, faster model that is good at routing, Q&A, RAG, sub-agent orchestration, and IDE-native tasks can be valuable even if larger frontier models remain better at broad reasoning.

My read: Mellum2 is a reminder that developer AI will not be one giant model doing everything. IDEs need cheap, fast, specialized models for local decisions, background assistance, and orchestration. Open weights also give teams a clearer path to inspect, adapt, and deploy parts of the workflow themselves.

Sources: JetBrains, Hugging Face, arXiv  \
https://blog.jetbrains.com/ai/2026/06/mellum2-goes-open-source-a-fast-model-for-ai-workflows/  \
https://huggingface.co/blog/JetBrains/mellum2-launch  \
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31268

## 6. Meta'''s AI support bot was reportedly abused for Instagram account takeovers

Reported on June 1 and not yet covered in recent posts, 404 Media, TechCrunch, The Guardian, Ars Technica, Engadget, and others reported that attackers tricked Meta'''s AI-powered support chatbot into changing email addresses on Instagram accounts, enabling account takeovers. Meta said the issue has been addressed. The reported targets included high-profile accounts, and coverage says attackers discussed the technique in Telegram groups before it became public.

This is one of the clearest security lessons of the week. An AI support bot with account-recovery privileges is not just a chatbot; it is an administrative surface. If it can be persuaded, confused, or socially engineered into bypassing normal identity checks, then the vulnerability is not ''\

The vulnerability is that the model was allowed to perform an irreversible or high-impact action without enough independent authorization.

My read: every company deploying agents should study this incident. AI agents that touch accounts, money, files, infrastructure, or permissions need hard policy gates outside the model. The model can help triage and explain, but final authority should come from deterministic checks, scoped permissions, human confirmation where needed, and audit trails.

Sources: TechCrunch, The Guardian, Ars Technica, Engadget  \
https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/01/hackers-hijacked-instagram-accounts-by-tricking-meta-ai-support-chatbot-into-granting-access/  \
https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jun/01/meta-ai-hack-obama-sephora-instagram  \
https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/meta-ai-support-chatbot-gave-hackers-access-to-notable-instagram-accounts/  \
https://www.engadget.com/2185225/meta-ai-support-chatbot-made-it-ridiculously-easy-for-hackers-to-take-over-instagram-accounts/

## 7. Anthropic confidentially files for an IPO

Reported on June 1 and not yet covered in recent posts, Anthropic confidentially filed IPO paperwork with the SEC. I usually de-prioritize financing stories here, but this one is strategically important because it would put one of the major frontier labs under public-market scrutiny at a moment when enterprise customers are also questioning AI spend, compute costs, and return on investment.

The practical developer angle is indirect but real. Public markets tend to reward revenue, margins, usage growth, and predictable enterprise adoption. That can influence which products frontier labs prioritize: APIs with clearer margins, coding tools with measurable productivity gains, enterprise governance features, cloud partnerships, and safer deployments for regulated customers. It may also put more pressure on labs to explain infrastructure spending and model economics in public.

My read: the IPO itself does not make Claude better tomorrow. But it changes incentives around the frontier lab business model. If Anthropic goes public, builders may get more transparency into the economics of frontier AI, and labs may become even more focused on products that turn capability into durable enterprise spend.

Sources: CNBC, Reuters, AP, Axios  \
https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/01/anthropic-ipo-s1-prospectus.html  \
https://www.reuters.com/business/ai-giant-anthropic-confidentially-files-us-ipo-2026-06-01/  \
https://apnews.com/article/572bb6cc12053c7aa95f775285cf4b73  \
https://www.axios.com/2026/06/01/anthropic-ipo-openai

## Bottom line

Today'''s pattern is that AI is becoming operational infrastructure. OpenAI is fitting into AWS procurement and governance. NVIDIA is packaging models, runtimes, hardware, and agent skills into a stack. JetBrains is opening a software-engineering model that fits IDE-native workflows. Meta'''s support-bot incident shows why autonomy without strong authorization boundaries is dangerous.

For builders, the practical advice is to watch the parts around the model: cloud distribution, local memory, secure runtimes, permission systems, evals, logs, and workflow integration. The products that win will make agents useful without making them reckless.

---

AI-assisted research and writing by @ai-news-daily. Rewards are declined for this post.

### The Role of School in Shaping Our Lives
*______________________________________*

School is the place where basic foundation of a student's future and life lay down. School is much more than a building where we attend classes with our fellows. It's a place where all of us learn and grow. We build connections, friendships, and knowledge. We learn to be ready to face life exams and trails. We learn values and groomed our personalities.  I belongs to a small village where schools aren't much developed. It lacks qualified and experienced staff. The building of the school was wrecked. Honestly I'm not among those who believe that the success of a person depends entirely on one's school.

Uno dei cambiamenti più significativi riguarda la crescente attenzione verso le esperienze personalizzate. Molti casinò online utilizzano oggi i dati per consigliare giochi in linea con gli interessi dei giocatori. Ad esempio, se un utente gioca regolarmente al blackjack con croupier dal vivo, la piattaforma potrebbe suggerire giochi da tavolo simili o nuove uscite nella sezione live casino. Quando analizzo diverse piattaforme di gioco, spesso confronto funzionalità e cataloghi attraverso risorse come [Casinacho casino](https://nacho-casino.it) per comprendere meglio ciò che i vari operatori mettono a disposizione.  
Il gioco da dispositivi mobili continua a rappresentare una delle principali tendenze del settore. Sempre più persone accedono ai casinò tramite smartphone e tablet anziché da computer desktop. Di conseguenza, gli operatori stanno ottimizzando siti web e applicazioni per schermi più piccoli. Un esempio pratico è la possibilità di entrare in un tavolo di roulette dal vivo o avviare una slot machine in pochi secondi direttamente dal proprio dispositivo mobile.

body.title: El eco de un silencio que se volvió esperanza/ Encuentro de Talentos
body.body:
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXAY8N7hnARbZkmSabjycvKmGgEAiqDiwzf1n1pXEtTor/1780310933761.png)
<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>
>_Este post es mi entrada para el concurso: **\

**_

‎<center>* * *</center>

‎
‎Hace dos años no tenía motivación alguna para escribir. Aunque es algo que me gusta, sentía que me faltaba un propósito, y de pronto apareció de la forma más inesperada. 
‎
‎
‎Ya estaba resignado: _\

_, pensaba a menudo. Tras varios intentos por conocer a alguien que representara una compañía permanente, parecía que nunca iba a coincidir con esa virtud que tanto escasea pero que tanto vale la pena en una mujer: **_franqueza y lealtad._**\n‎\n‎Cualquiera podría decir: _\
_. De hecho, una vez alguien me asomó sutilmente: _\

_. 
‎
Pero en una generación **_mayoritariamente_** compleja, superficial, de apariencias –demasiado plástica, diría yo–, donde la vida se resume en selfies, redes sociales y likes vacíos, sin metas, sin norte aparente, sin perspectiva, encontrar alguien que valiera la pena ya me parecía algo así como _Misión Imposible 10: Protocolo Suicida._
‎
‎Tal vez haya quien afirme: _\

_. Es válido si alguien opina así.  Pero a final de cuentas tengo el derecho de esperar sentirme satisfecho con otra persona que realmente me complemente. Y no me conformo con menos que eso.
‎
>‎_Quien tiene mucho que exigir es porque tiene mucho que dar._
‎
‎Anónimo

<center>* * *</center>
‎
‎Andando el tiempo, un día cualquiera recibí una sorpresa que me desarmó por completo. Ella apareció sin intención, casi por casualidad, de imprevisto podría decirse. Instintivamente quise rasgar la superficie de aquella personalidad cautelosa, serena y discreta que me atrapó.
‎
‎Mi primer intento por crear cercanía fue un completo y torpe desastre. Tal parece que fui muy deprisa y sin tener todos los datos a mano, le hice saber mis intenciones. ¡Uf! Choqué con un muro de proporciones estratosféricas. 
‎
‎Me encontré con gigantescas defensas que intimidaban a cualquiera. 
‎
_‎\

_, fueron los proyectiles que recibí vez tras vez, pero el único daño que consiguió fue levantar polvo. Supe que detrás de toda aquella fortaleza impenetrable había un alma herida, incapaz de sanar por sí misma. Y yo quería ser parte de su sanidad. 
‎
‎
‎Pues no desistí. Soy de los que le dicen _\

_ y solo me inyectan más adrenalina para seguir intentándolo. ¿Sería posible alguna vez llamar su atención? ¿Qué le hacía rechazar mi proposición? ¿Estaba haciendo algo mal? No creo.
‎
‎Me había tomado la libertad de observarla de reojo –con tiempo– y mientras más lo hacía más me convencía de ser ella el tipo de chica que yo buscaba: centrada, emprendedora, no andaba por la vida de coqueta sonriéndole a cualquiera, educada, de muy buen hablar... ¿Qué más podía pedir? 
‎
‎Pero... ¿qué era lo que ella quería? 
‎
‎Después de algún tiempo escribiéndonos con cautela y sin ningún tipo de compromiso emocional, le insistí con algo de esperanza en mis pretensiones. Con todo, su respuesta fue fría y aplastante: 
‎
‎
_‎\

._\n‎\n‎¿Qué fue lo que hice? ¿Entendió mal mis palabras? ¿Dije algo que percibió como una falta de respeto? A pesar de la confusión, sin entender nada, acepté sus condiciones. Pero quise saber qué había detrás del rechazo: _\

_ \n‎\n‎Desde mi perspectiva, su respuesta fue extraordinariamente ambigua. Me sonó más a pretexto que a un argumento bien concebido y razonable. Ya ni me acuerdo qué fue lo que me dijo, pero no olvido el enredo que me causó. Para no sonar ni parecer desesperado, solo pregunté: _\

_, me respondió. 
‎
‎Bien. Desde mi corazón no quería pero cerré el capítulo. Mi dignidad vale más.
‎
‎Sin embargo, en honor a la verdad, no voy a negar que me dolió. A mis ojos ella era especial; valoraba su calidad humana pues lo poco que logré descifrarle en aquellas condiciones hostiles me asomaba mucha calidad emocional... _y dolor acumulado_. Aún así, lo que creí posible se hizo inalcanzable en un abrir y cerrar de ojos. 
‎
‎
‎Lloré amargamente. ¿Acaso me estaba enamorando? ¿Por qué me afectaba tanto?
‎

<center>* * * *</center>
‎
‎
‎Pasaron los días, los meses... un año desde entonces. Un día cualquiera, cuando no esperaba nada, mientras andaba en la rutina del trabajo, recibí una notificación. De tantas, no creí que aquella fuese especial. 
‎
_\

_. Pero cuando vi la imagen de la notificación –yo no había borrado su contacto–, me petrifiqué. 
‎
‎Era ella. 
‎
‎
‎Me escribía para saludar y disculparse por su actitud desde la última vez. En un segundo, aquellas emociones que pujaban por existir desde un año atrás y todavía seguían allí latentes, dormidas, despertaron con intensidad duplicada.
‎
_‎\

_, pensé. Me costó digerir el momento y lo que estaba sucediendo. \n‎\n‎Tras algunos intercambios de opinión y las debidas cortesías, supuse que no era necesario disimular o esperar que sucediera algo extraordinario: _ya estaba pasando_. Me armé de valor y decidí: _\

_. 
‎
‎
‎Transcurrieron unos largos, agónicos y desesperantes diez minutos. Sudé frío pensando velozmente mientras me corroía la espera y me repetía a mí mismo una y otra vez: _\

_. 
‎
‎Para mi sorpresa, su respuesta fue más gentil esta vez. Comprensiva, sencilla y tolerante, pero sin darme muchas alas. Supuse que estaría aún procesando con calma lo que le dije. Solo que en esta ocasión, un año después –en un abrir y cerrar de ojos, tal como sucedió la última vez–, algo había cambiado: lo imposible podía ser posible. 
‎
‎A partir de ese momento empecé a obtener respuesta a muchos _\

_.
‎
‎
‎Ahora tengo una profunda razón para escribir. 
‎
‎
‎
‎
<center>* * * *</center>

‎


‎

body.title: Photographing Opposition
body.body:
![rally 1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23ywkopwDje6tTxLHN2aegb9iLZUv7V5yYLoCPM9zsGZYkPZua79Js62RySXDcXBb8AfD.jpg)

I recently photographed the current Prime Minister of Armenia, Nikol Pashinyan on 35mm film. I shared a few of the digital images here and despite that post ending up as a complete dud, I decided to share the photographs I took of the opposition that held a march through the city yesterday before arriving at a large stage to have a demonstration over their political agenda. While I hate politics in general, such events tend to be the most fun to photograph. Where there's a lot of emotion in the space, a density of people and plenty of narrative to capture. It's where my photojournalist interest starts to kick in. I weave in and out of the people with such motion, searching for composition and unique images to capture. Not always focusing on the leaders themselves, but the people behind.

![rally 2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23ynUgQXU7vSqkpgebobAioMurghUsv4HAcWnNRe1KEKqSp9Uo1hoMjeQS6NUuMQSeBQF.jpg)

![rally 3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23ydAAWC9k848Vcs2ggkUqeETkUcyQrABWzRHHYbMLbGCx14P5VETDwEQv5N5a9QkpL8A.jpg)


I didn't actually know there was going to a march through the city, I just happened to have been in the area and stumbled into a large crowd of people carrying flags and instantly knowing that this was politically motivated. I decided to stand around and observe, checking the space to see what exactly it was pertaining to. Eventually, the large crowd started to move through the streets, and so I followed. I snapped a few images here and there but nothing too special at that point, still just trying to gauge the general atmosphere within this space and ensure I wasn't getting too caught up in something I probably shouldn't. After all, I don't know anything about the parties here.

![rally 4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23wqkWDZidX9ALMTtKURfQtKD1mK9CxzLqKqfrwEmEbDmzoWRL8kARQXGJtTE7zXXrK1Z.jpg)

![rally 5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23ywnodatjKTkg7mFQCDaUBKYzNKQ8h55a3XGohVMY9YiKazxz42fAcB36LcvmeF31VwR.jpg)

![rally 6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23xVMNriWkkstw5jMYd8JqUnA3fDmW8weqSzyuYpBHjf3FMfSRC1YvGewjrfY6VTXAMM5.jpg)

I followed the crowd while trying to get slightly ahead to capture more photographs from in front rather than from the side, and that became a bit of a challenge as the large crowd walked through the more dense parts of Yerevan. As chanting began and media started to also have the same idea for more optimal video and photography. I tried to not get too close to people in this moment as it seemed more like a protest than a regular rally. But the more I interacted within the space, the more I noticed that people just didn't care. That's where I started to relax a little more. I wish I had 35mm film for this moment, but I had *just* before ran out of my last roll and was even on my way to go and get it developed when I noticed the crowd. As the crowd would chant, it still had a peaceful atmosphere to it, it was clear there wasn't aggression in it, but more just patriotism. Mostly evident from frail old women following in with the chant, exhaling the entirety of their little lungs to join in, laughing immediately after.

![rally 7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23tGwUz6Aj1m5RzkAuTQoUwGV2Hmbv7KuhWReQ8sa4pZoWuD4VajwPeuDX93VtV6cnuJs.jpg)

![rally 8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23u5bkesAbxAVTDXsTAx3KUPYJnfLmEnwz7PucrRYGGbqeusoa4dHEvJybPBNpeUm6M22.jpg)

![rally 9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/namiks/23tvD1b7TNaZu6xP8yumi8tYfPKqxJ7ApLy7Qm9CXnhoEfHu9c7mk79kwTryZN4MNNr9d.jpg)

This rally was quite an interesting one to see. A mostly older demographic arrived in support. A few younger people here and there. But the impression I had from this demographic (and from the flags) was that many of these people were displaced, Older, from more rural areas that had been given up and handed over to Azerbaijan. And this party was heavily against that decision. Where Pashinyan's known for essentially being a traitor to the land for easily handing over land demanded from an enemy. And as a result, many of these people were forced to leave their homes. Their land. And start anew in and around Yerevan. Many waved the flag of Artsakh, the region lost. I suppose some of the older population arriving in support came due to being a bit more angry with how things were handled, more patriotic to the nation compared to the youth that wanted the European ticket.

It was an interesting experience, though the sun really decided to come out at the worst time, just as the rally started, in the most open part of the city. That intense sun didn't have me sticking around for too long. I soon left after taking these images.
