body.title: Sapien Loop 3 - Chapter 72: High Stakes Performance
body.body:
![Sapien_Loop_3_Cover_HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23wC7hkTDDpnHvZegULctqg6Mrrd9t72byH8zWkVgfNiHGiHqm7aVAeGi9PiELYyYAuVf.jpg)

## Chapter 72: High Stakes Performance

![Technicians_high_stakes_Performance.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spectrumecons/23swdkXT5Ej7Bp6xC8vLaBABX93kr9rvep9RX6PcK9mUv7gn4gpeKhHdf9sz6sw11N1f1.jpg)

Felix and Head Enforcer had arrived at the apartment where the senior technicians were hiding. Felix did the special technician's knock on the door. A senior technician let in both Felix and Head Enforcer. There were about a dozen senior technicians sitting and standing around in the lounge. Most of them were nervously sucking on juice packets.

‘I’ve got great news,’ said Felix as his eyes darted from side to side.

‘Is the monster gone?’ asked a senior technician as he pulled the juice packet away from his face.

‘I don’t know about that, but I can tell you that we’re going to put on a grand performance,’ said Felix. ‘The Emperor insists I lead.’

‘That’s amazing,’ said another senior technician. ‘Your career is going to soar.’

Felix nodded excitedly.

‘Hold on a second,’ said a senior technician. ‘If that monster is still out there, we might be murdered.’

‘I have that exact same fear,’ said a senior technician standing at the back of the room.

‘Oh come on,’ said Felix as he gestured expressively with his hands. ‘You know the power of music and dance can overcome all.’

‘I’m not sure that has been scientifically proven,’ said a senior technician scratching his chin.

‘I say we do it for Henders,’ said Felix. ‘I say we do it for Frank.’

All the senior technicians cheered.

‘Well, get on with it,’ said Head Enforcer angrily. ‘The Emperor has called upon you.’

The senior technicians rushed out of their apartment to organise the other technicians for the performance.

An hour later, Polly arrived at the resistance’s campsite in the Central Agriculture Zone. Henders and Morgan were dancing with the little miracles. Everyone seemed nervous and concerned, as they could still see smoke coming from the Downs Region.

‘Haha, yes,’ said Eugene as he ran towards Polly.

‘Things are really bad,’ sighed Polly. ‘There’s death and destruction everywhere.’

‘Just one of them could do all of that,’ said Vulay.

‘Yes, this creature has the powers of both the Linap and Sentray,’ said Polly. ‘His rage is fuelled by vengeance for what the enforcers have done to his tribe.’

‘There must be something we can do to stop him,’ said Yassme.

‘Help could be on the way,’ said Polly. 

‘So we wait,’ said Daily as he looked around for Yassmay. ‘Yassmay!’

Everyone looked around, but they could not see Yassmay.

‘She was here when you arrived,’ said Yassme as she looked at Polly.

Henders pointed to the sky. They looked up. They could see Yassmay disappear in the distance. She was heading towards the Downs Region.

‘I’ll get her back,’ said Polly as she sprinted towards the Downs Region. Yassme sprinted after her.

‘Wait, please!’ shouted Daily.

The technicians had made their way to the Downs Agriculture Zone. They were facing the north Residential Zone. They had arranged themselves in formation for their grand performance. A dozen enforcers, who were invisible, had positioned themselves behind the technicians to provoke an attack on them.

Felix was at the front of the technicians. He was marching energetically on the spot. He was wearing a bright, colourful outfit. The senior technicians formed one row behind him, and the remaining technicians made up the rest of the rows. 

All the technicians were marching on the spot. The technicians’ work theme tune blared out. It could be heard all across the region. 

August, who was still in the tunnel, shook his head in frustration.

‘Oh no,’ said Gilling. ‘They’re being so silly.’

‘This is classic technician behaviour,’ said Hermon energetically. ‘Their mad obsession for these performances is built into their genetics.’

‘It’s a fundamental part of our routine,’ said Benny, waving his arms around. ‘It’s like brushing your teeth before bed.’

‘I don’t get the analogy,’ said Hermon, scratching his head.

‘Maybe we could use…’ said August as he pounced on a shimmer he saw moving towards Hermon, ‘a valuable bait.’

‘Get the hell off me, you mad pervert!’ shouted Lily as she became visible.

‘G.O.A.T. bait, beautiful,’ said Hermon, clapping his hands while August climbed off Lily.

‘I’m sorry I thought you were someone else,’ said August as he offered his hand to help Lily off the ground. Lily grabbed August’s hand, and he pulled her up.

Lily slapped August hard across the face. ‘I was left in a locked room inside a burning hotel,’ she said angrily. ‘You didn’t do a single thing to help me, you bastard.’

‘That explains why you look filthy and disgusting,’ giggled Hermon.

Lily stormed over to Hermon and punched him hard in the face. Hermon flopped limp to the ground.

‘Wow, someone actually did it!’ said Gilling as she looked in amazement at Hermon, who was lying unconscious on the ground.

‘Oh no,’ said Benny, shaking his head. ‘I know he’s going to blame me.’

The music from the performance continued to play uninterrupted.

‘Listen, he hasn’t attacked them yet,’ said August. 

‘He’s anticipating it’s a trap,’ sighed Lily as she angrily stared at August.

‘I’m going to take a look anyway,’ said August.

‘I’ll join you,’ said Lily.

The two of them ran off towards the ladder to the hatch that gave them access to the Downs Agriculture Zone.

Tiberius was still in the dungeon with Duffo, who was still tied to the torture rack. He was growing frustrated that the technicians had not been attacked yet.

‘Your stupid plan isn’t working,’ chuckled Duffo. ‘Their performance sucks so bad it’s scared him away.’

‘It’s making a strategic move,’ sighed Tiberius. ‘Something that your so-called genius mind can’t seem to grasp.’

‘He has found out about Henders’ noise-cancelling headphones,’ chuckled Duffo.

Tiberius punched Duffo hard in the stomach. 

Julio was in the Downs Agriculture Zone but had chosen not to attack the technicians. Instead, he decided to sneak up behind them. He had sensed the presence of the enforcers. One by one, he silently slit their throats. As they died, they became visible. The technicians, who were oblivious to what was happening behind them, continued to perform with great enthusiasm.

Head Enforcer had been watching the performance from the roof of an apartment building. He had seen the bodies of his enforcers become visible. Feeling frustrated, he climbed down off the roof into the apartment building.

Julio had shapeshifted into a junior technician so that he could blend in with the other technicians. Yassmay was invisible and flying above the Downs Region. She saw the immense damage that had been caused to the buildings. The performing technicians captured her attention. She scanned the area around and near them with her infrared goggles but could not find the monster she was trying to locate.

The performance finally ended. The technicians jumped for joy.

A senior technician walked over to Felix, who was extremely happy. ‘That was brilliant!’ he said to Felix, patting him on the back. ‘This is the biggest performance I’ve ever been part of, and you managed to put it together in under an hour. You need to be promoted from just hitting things with a hammer. In my opinion, you should work with industrial machines.’

‘That means so much coming from you, sir,’ replied Felix joyfully.

‘Excuse me,’ said a junior technician. ‘This performance was truly brilliant. What do I need to do to get an opportunity like this one?’

‘Oh well, I was just lucky that I met the Emperor when I was working with my hammer,’ replied Felix.

‘That sounds so cool,’ said the junior technician. ‘Where did you meet him?’

‘He was in the dungeon of his new palace,’ replied Felix.

‘That is amazing, thank you,’ said the junior technician.

The junior technician ran off towards the town square.

‘Look at him go,’ said a senior technician to Felix. ‘You’re inspiring generations.’

‘I see you now,’ said Yassmay as she looked down at the dispersing technicians.

August and Lily had arrived in the Downs Agriculture Zone.

‘It doesn’t look like he’s here,’ said Lily, looking around.

‘I think he’s just left,’ said August as he watched the junior technician hop over the fence. 

Out of the corner of her eye, Lily caught a slight shimmer in the sky. ‘I think Yassmay might be pursuing,’ she sighed in a slightly distressed tone.

‘We’ll have to intervene,’ said August as he ran after the departing technician. Lily followed close behind him.

Felix entered the cell in the palace dungeon. Duffo was still on the torture rack.

‘Hey, great to see you,’ said Duffo. ‘I need a bit of help here.’

Felix shapeshifted into Julio.

‘Oh no,’ gasped Duffo.

‘Where is he?’ asked Julio casually.

‘Who are we talking about?’ asked Duffo.

‘Don’t play games with me!’ shouted Julio as his head partially shapeshifted into a Sentray.

‘He didn’t tell me anything, I swear,’ said Duffo in a desperate tone.

‘Then, I suppose you’re not much use to me,’ said Julio as he walked over to the torture rack.

‘Please, don’t!’ begged Duffo as he watched Julio grab hold of one of the handles on the torture rack.

‘Stop this now!’ shouted Yassmay as she rushed into the cell.

‘Stay out of this,’ said Julio as he looked at Yassmay.

‘No, I won’t stay out of this!’ shouted Yassmay. ‘You’re destroying our region. It ends now!’

‘I’m not finished with them,’ said Julio. ‘They need to suffer for what they’ve done.’

‘By doing that you’re killing yourself,’ said Yassmay. ‘You’ll become the evil that you hate so much.’

Julio looked down. A tear formed in his eye.

‘It’s okay,’ said Yassmay as she rubbed Julio’s arm. ‘It’s not too late. I know you can stop.’

Julio let go of the handle, and then he put his arms around Yassmay.

‘Excuse me,’ said Duffo. ‘You need to let me go. I’m starving. I haven’t eaten since breakfast.’

‘Let’s go,’ said Yassmay. ‘This place is depressing.’

‘Hey, let me go,’ said Duffo angrily as he watched them leave the cell. ‘I’m your new ruler.’

In the corridor of the dungeon, Julio and Yassmay encountered August and Lily, who had just rushed down the stairs. 

‘We saw you at the Agriculture Zone,’ said Lily. ‘We were worried you were in grave danger.’

‘No, it’s all okay now,’ said Yassmay.

‘There’s still Tiberius,’ said Julio. 

‘You need to take a step back,’ said August firmly. ‘You’ve done enough damage.’

Julio growled angrily at August.

‘I know this is difficult, but this must stop now,’ said Yassmay as she hugged Julio’s arm. 

‘Seeing him could cause you to lose control of your Sentray instincts,’ said August. ‘I know what it feels like, and I don’t have as much in me as you.’

‘You must promise me you’ll spare him no mercy,’ said Julio, trembling slightly.

‘He’ll be begging for death when I’m done with him,’ said Lily.

Julio closed his eyes and then he nodded.

‘Please don’t leave me here,’ called out Duffo.

Lily poked her head around the cell door. She looked at Duffo and smiled. Then she turned to look at the others. ‘If you don’t mind,’ she said with a twinkle in her eye. ‘I might hang around here for a while.’

Julio growled and then stepped back and became invisible.

The technicians were making their way back to their apartments. Head Enforcer was watching from the end of the corridor. 

‘Hey,’ said a voice from the stairwell. Tiberius emerged from the darkness. ‘What’s going? What’s happening?’ he asked.

‘He had no interest in the technicians,’ said Head Enforcer. ‘He did manage to kill another dozen enforcers.’

‘That’s not any good,’ said Tiberius. ‘Luckily I’m here to remedy this problem.’

‘What do you suggest, Your Imperial Majesty?’ asked Head Enforcer. 

‘We take care of business ourselves,’ said Tiberius. ‘You have enforcers embedded in their population within this building?’

‘Yes, we do,’ said Head Enforcer.

‘Tonight let the massacre begin,’ chuckled Tiberius.

Head Enforcer nodded as he watched a senior technician dish out packets of juice to the junior technicians.

August and Yassmay had arrived in the tunnels. Hermon was awake. He was sitting on the ground with his arms folded and was staring angrily at Benny, who was sitting behind Eric, Gilling and Wendell to avoid his piercing gaze.

‘Hey, tunnel-dwellers,’ chuckled Yassmay as she approached them. 

‘I’m not a tunnel-dweller,’ said Hermon angrily. ‘Don’t you recognise greatness when you see it?’

‘Haha, you’re so funny,’ replied Yassmay.

‘Yassmay, you’re okay,’ said Polly as she ran towards her.

‘Better than that,’ replied Yassmay confidently. ‘I just saved the Downs Region.’

‘That’s nice, but you gave everyone a fright,’ said Polly. 

‘As if you cleaned that monster’s clock,’ said Hermon as he pointed at Yassmay.

‘There are other ways to resolve conflict,’ sighed August. ‘Even with Yassmay’s valiant effort to calm the storm, I fear we are quite far from saving the Downs Region.’

‘Yassmay!’ called out Yassme as she ran towards them. ‘How dare you fly off and have fun without me.’

‘You haven’t earned your wings yet, dullard,’ remarked Yassmay as Yassme hugged her.

‘I’m taking you both back,’ said Polly. ‘I know Daily must be having a meltdown.’

Later that evening, Polly returned both Yassmay and Yassme safely to the camp. 

Daily rushed over to them. ‘You’ve both been very silly,’ he said sternly to the girls.

‘I rushed off to get her back,’ said Yassme angrily.

‘I saved the Downs Region by calming an emotional monster,’ said Yassmay angrily.

‘She played an important part in saving the Downs Region,’ replied Polly. ‘You should be proud of both of them.’

‘Oh yes, I’m very proud now that they’re safe,’ said Daily.

‘The words of a hopeless fool,’ sighed Yassmay.

Henders ran over to them. He was carrying two flowers.

‘That’s how you show appreciation,’ said Yassme as she accepted one of the flowers.

Yassmay accepted the other flower, and the three of them joyfully skipped off together.

‘He always knows how to put a smile on everyone’s face,’ sighed Daily.

‘He’s just so great,’ smiled Polly as she watched Yassmay, Yassme, Henders, Eugene, Morgan, Denise, Louis, and Vulay dancing in a circle together.

body.body: > On that steel table, there it was. All her work. The finished round sweets, were placed on that wooden plate. This was her hobby, that became a recognized talent. The first desert was a beautiful flower, placed in the middle of the round dough. The second one has three flowers. It is so similar, yet people see them totally different and prefer one over the other. She was working on the third one, and she was just putting the pistachio to make the cakes. She was a painter. One that kept all of her work at home. She did not share any of them with anyone. She knew that, at her home town. She would be famous. But, it will not make a living. That is when the idea of transforming her mother's desert business into her art gallery. That is when, the small business, turned into a fixed income to the family. Something that, they all can rely on. Her work, did all the marketing. But, to her, all that mattered was that she continued to practice her hobby. # PT

>

Naquela mesa de aço, lá estava. Todo o seu trabalho. Os doces redondos prontos estavam dispostos naquele prato de madeira. Este era o seu hobby, que se tornou um talento reconhecido. O primeiro doce era uma linda flor, colocada no centro da massa redonda. O segundo tinha três flores. Tão parecidos, mas as pessoas os viam de forma totalmente diferente e preferiam um ao outro. Ela estava trabalhando no terceiro, e estava colocando o pistache para finalizar os bolinhos.

Ela era uma pintora. Uma que guardava todo o seu trabalho em casa. Não compartilhava nenhum deles com ninguém. Sabia que, em sua cidade natal, seria famosa. Mas isso não lhe daria sustento. Foi então que surgiu a ideia de transformar o negócio de doces da mãe em sua galeria de arte. Foi assim que o pequeno negócio se tornou uma renda fixa para a família. Algo com que todos podiam contar. Seu trabalho fazia todo o marketing. Mas, para ela, tudo o que importava era continuar praticando seu hobby.

body.body:
Just looking back at your postcard message again. I find the first question involves a lot of thinking, do I, don't I, and stops the flow of the message. It reminds people that they're living with this condition and brings on a bit of negativity. Or if they answer no, I'm perfectly healthy, that would be the end of the outreach for them.

Would it be better to ask questions where people can quickly answer yes yes yes without thinking much, in order to hook them in?

Something like this but phrased better 
- live better with less
- be independent 
- life healthy 
- small changes in life for the long term
- etc

Yes I want this, yes this sounds great, yes this is for me, yes I'm in. I think this sounds a lot more positive.

Also, @tinabrezpike did a great post on first aid training recently that got me thinking about my lack of first aid knowledge. And also how my aunty was on an outing with her elderly friends a while back and suddenly felt very dizzy (she was ok in the end). It would be worth having a post about what to do if you or someone next to you feels unwell, and how you can help

Just my 2c worth

body.title: My First Time Trying Pandan Ice Chocolate
body.body:
> ![20260602_161300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/AKAr67aAWNj9MQGfJwJLDHAUP8AkBiy63eaTGWDRN6GkveCzTaWSrSUY6kyQ1ar.jpg)
That afternoon, I accompanied my husband as he left for work; the plan was that during my lunch break, we would head to my sister’s house. We left together that morning, intentionally setting out a bit earlier since the drive from our house to his workplace takes an hour. To save time, we decided to leave together. While waiting for him, I stopped by one of his favorite cafes. He’s invited me here a few times, but I rarely come—usually, he’s working and I’m just tagging along.

> ![20260513_124450.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EonkvHEuutvprigzSXKNf41G3F9ewycq6dgAbu6M3s5avzy81yQsjgY93ADk1D9a5TT.jpg)
The café isn’t far from his office, so it’s very safe to wait here. The place is cozy, and definitely cool since the indoor area is air-conditioned. The outdoor area is also quite spacious, so smokers can choose the comfortable outdoor atmosphere.

> ![20260513_091906.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EpT5ZeHHVSv2iXvWEg5UME1HW5y6qAd4PVTAA9yEM7UYu4rzpsum3D6QjJ8kisnXeC8.jpg)
Besides that, the menu is very diverse, but this time I just had a light snack and a simple drink I’d never tried before. It was pandan chocolate ice—it seems like this will be a unique treat to savor later. Here, they don’t just serve drinks; there are also some snacks available, usually served in the afternoon. Since it was early afternoon and the weather was starting to get hot, I intentionally ordered a cold drink.
![20260513_092653.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23z7QHdcDN7fz6kgJfgqAy8HSf32DPcgyKKpPep2oST1p3Ht76g1TigG15CcwBUMGvVTS.jpg) The pandan chocolate ice cream was originally meant to satisfy my curiosity; it was quite affordable at IDR 20,000—just over $1—which I thought was a very reasonable price for a city café. ![20260513_092535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23u6BhMNWa4GVh6Hez4nWtqYrjNHq5jFVBfZRwSKAxw8EaeYxARknVtQVxWzxRbUQ9AgE.jpg) My order arrived shortly after, and I was so curious about the taste that I gave the drink a shake. I immediately opened the plastic cup so I could get a better look at the contents.

> ![20260513_093358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zS9YSHtuhy5QZq8PTWk5UbRz2Ryo5dxVzG3xdgXVxpxHjcUF1wPoZTipEFPwQtXCSBr.jpg)
The chocolate flavor was more dominant than the pandan, and they added just a little pandan paste. I think if the pandan flavor were just a bit more prominent, oh, this would definitely taste absolutely delicious. Not that it’s not good—the drink is tasty, the sweetness is just right, and the flavor is unique—but in my opinion, the chocolate still tends to dominate; I think they’re trying to make the chocolate flavor stand out more in this drink. As for its unique appearance, it’s quite simple; if I hadn’t tried it, I would’ve just thought it was regular chocolate ice. I think the final presentation plays a big role in its appearance—they should add pandan syrup as a topping in the cup so the green hue comes through. It would look even prettier and more appealing, and customers would definitely notice that this drink combines two flavors. ![20260513_093146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23zbYMyQf4YcWVrv6eRGCX4jGW5YwWLnfmGHKMZ4i596mmUcRVHryzGU12v6XGULMy9zy.jpg) Well, since it’s hard to find snacks here in the morning, I brought some from home—specifically “rubek kelapa,” a traditional Acehnese market snack. It’s really delicious; it’s one of my favorites, and I’ve never made it myself. I think I should try making it at home.

> ![20260513_093818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vsUqmNgy1NVj18tf73pvW5Kt5UEhWhZ6Q1epzuhHtAaesaEnYYS3qy4PSGo7svyLZjP.jpg)
I highly recommend this place for you to visit; it’s very comfortable, and the drinks and food are incredibly diverse. Plus, all the dishes here are delicious, and the coffee here is perfect for coffee lovers. This place is located in Lhokseumawe City, at the Panglateh intersection in the Banda Sakti subdistrict.
![20230813_094117_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23ynhM4HY26LsJBc56VnzHwHASWwNh2k6eRFsTW3ZB37BNXHsDPbYNJn7HniS1Ky4w7Ki.png)

> ![20241110_164553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xybj68W4PzCf6q2cCpyCdsGmJaexi9a1JPxV3yZ6JsQa5yMoDS7eKgLrF2oJD5hTQsL.jpg)

, who comes from Indonesia. I have several hobbies, reading, writing, gardening, I also love food and cooking, even art related.  And the most interesting one is spending the whole day traveling. body.body:
Ich kann den Zettel also Brauchen, auf Deutsch gesagt.

Sowohl fuer meine Vergangenheit, als auch meine Zukunft.

Der Zettel da, macht mir naemlich in genau dem das Leben leichter, wo ich echt auch Probleme hatte und immer haben werde.

Amtszeug zum Beispiel die Fristen und so weiter. Das ich mich entsprechend auch leichter wehren kann, und ich will mich wehren,^^ in Zukunft, wenn mir einer wieder mit seinem Zettel auf den Geist gehen moechte.

Nu und das ich dadurch auch fuer meine Vergangenheit ein paar Sachen klaeren kann, die mich einfach nicht mehr Loslassen, waren auch wegen Fristen und Chaos im Kopf ein Problem fuer mich, das kann ich ja mal Frei Schnauze so sagen.

Das ich mir die Vorteile auf eine besondere Art wiederhole, ist damit nur Bestaetigung, in der Sache, auch positive Effekte dabei zu haben.

Ich meine ich bin Schwerbehindert, aber nicht Nur, nicht wahr?

Also wenn ich dann das hinbekomme, was ich nie fuer moeglich gehalten haette naemlich unabhaengiger von Hilfen zu sein, dann waehre das ja auch noch ein guter Arbeitsweg, den Zettel trotzdem noch zu behalten.

Fuer alle Faelle.

Damit ich ruhiger Schlafen kann sei es nur darum.

Aber wuerde ich nicht so viele Vorteile darin sehen, wuerde ich den auch nicht Beantragen.

Ich ueberlege mir sogar, ob ich jetzt noch, einen \

Buchstaben mit reinschreiben lasse. 

Weil ich bin schon Verwirrt, egal wie Gut ich noch fahren werde im Verkehr des oefteren.

Also das ich mal wo rumstehe, und net weis wo ich bin, was ich bin, und wer ich bin, meine ich, geschweige denn, wieder da wegzukommen.

Das hatte ich oefter in meinem Leben, als einem Lieb ist und es wurde nur Schlimmer, dafuer, weniger Oft.

Schlimmer weil es laenger und schwerer gedauert hat und weniger oft, weil ich die Anzeichen fuer solche \

besser erkenne und gegensteuern kann als Frueher.

So Zeug hilft dann weiter, das ich mich net komplett Verloren fuehle im Zweifel.

Außerdem muss ich viel Geld sparen in Zukunft, das bedeutet ich nehme mir jede Verguenstigung die ich bekommen kann mit. :-)

Salve

Alucian

In today's fast-moving digital world, users expect online platforms to be simple, responsive, and easy to access. Whether using a smartphone, tablet, or desktop computer, people want a smooth experience that allows them to complete tasks quickly without unnecessary complications. [BHT Club ](https://bhtclubs.in.net)has gained recognition by focusing on these important expectations and creating a platform designed around user convenience.

The growth of digital entertainment has created a highly competitive environment where platforms must continuously improve to attract and retain users. BHT Club stands out by emphasizing accessibility, organized navigation, and a straightforward user experience that appeals to both new and experienced users.

## Understanding Modern User Expectations

Internet users today have different expectations than they did a few years ago. Fast loading times, mobile compatibility, and intuitive navigation have become essential rather than optional features.

People no longer want to spend time learning complicated systems. Instead, they prefer platforms that provide clear instructions, easy account access, and responsive functionality. BHT Club reflects this shift by focusing on simplicity and efficiency throughout the platform.

## Easy Access for New Users

A platform's first impression often determines whether a user will continue using it. BHT Club makes the onboarding process easier by providing a straightforward registration system that allows users to get started quickly.

Simple account creation reduces confusion and helps users feel comfortable from the beginning. This user-friendly approach contributes to a more positive overall experience.

## Mobile-First Experience

Smartphones have become the primary way people access online services. As a result, platforms that fail to optimize for mobile devices often struggle to meet user expectations.

BHT Club is designed with mobile accessibility in mind. The responsive layout adapts to different screen sizes, ensuring that navigation remains comfortable regardless of the device being used. This flexibility allows users to access the platform from virtually anywhere.

## Clean Design and Organized Navigation

An organized interface can significantly improve user satisfaction. BHT Club utilizes a structured layout that makes it easier to locate important sections and navigate between different features.

Clear menus and logical organization reduce the learning curve for new users while helping existing users find what they need more efficiently. This focus on usability is one of the reasons the platform continues to attract attention.

## Performance and Reliability

Speed and stability are critical components of a successful online platform. Users expect pages to load quickly and interactions to feel responsive.

BHT Club prioritizes performance by maintaining a smooth browsing experience across devices. Reliable functionality contributes to greater user confidence and encourages continued engagement with the platform.

## Account Security and User Trust

Security remains one of the most important concerns for online users. A platform must provide users with confidence that their account information is protected.

BHT Club encourages responsible account management through secure login practices and user awareness. By promoting account security, the platform helps create a safer environment for its community.

## The Importance of Customer Support

Even the most intuitive platforms benefit from effective customer support. Users occasionally encounter questions or technical issues that require assistance.

BHT Club provides support resources designed to help users resolve concerns and gain a better understanding of platform features. Accessible support strengthens user trust and contributes to a more positive experience.

## Why Users Continue Choosing BHT Club

The popularity of BHT Club is closely linked to its focus on convenience and accessibility. Rather than relying on complex systems, the platform emphasizes features that make daily use easier and more enjoyable.

Users appreciate platforms that save time, reduce confusion, and provide consistent performance. By addressing these priorities, BHT Club continues to attract a growing audience.

## Looking Ahead

The future of digital platforms will be shaped by user experience. As technology evolves, platforms that prioritize accessibility, simplicity, and reliability are likely to remain competitive.

BHT Club appears committed to these principles, positioning itself as a platform that adapts to changing expectations while maintaining a focus on usability.

## Final Thoughts

[BHT Club ](https://bhtclubplay.com)demonstrates how simplicity and user-focused design can contribute to long-term growth. Through its mobile-friendly interface, organized navigation, reliable performance, and commitment to accessibility, the platform offers an experience that aligns with the needs of modern users.

As digital engagement continues to increase, platforms that emphasize convenience and ease of use will remain highly relevant. BHT Club is an example of how these qualities can help build a strong and loyal user base.

昨天刚坐高铁回，现在又在高铁上，正在前往出差的途中。咱再接着聊聊长沙旅行。

31日出门这天小宝身子不太舒服，老是喊肚子疼，还时不时拉肚子，出门我就带了纸尿裤以备不时之需，在车上前后换了两片还没省心。我愧疚不该在她不舒服时带她出门，好在她的精神状态都还不错。

一个半小时车程过得挺快，我们就出去玩两天一夜，收拾得特别简单，一家四口就一个背包，洗漱用品酒店全都有，只带几件夏天薄衣裳就行，再装个空水杯，走到哪接到哪，不用拎一堆矿泉水。
 
约好了下午一点半在省博物馆集合，十点多下车后我们坐地铁去博物馆旁边的商场吃饭。刚进地铁站，大宝要上洗手间，问了工作人员本站竟然没有卫生间非得上去乘车入口才有，孩子爸带着大宝过去。我则带小宝等着地铁。

这时小宝又闹肚子，我也拉着她去往卫生间，刚走到匝道口，孩子爸带大宝进来了，我问他扣了钱没，他说扣了一块八，我也得刷1.8元带小宝去卫生间了，一直以为每个站内都有卫生间，却没想本站没有。

顺利坐上地铁，小家伙直接睡着了，全程都是孩子爸爸抱着。下车后，宝爸抱着睡着的小宝懒得走远，就近找了家门口的小馆子。我习惯性打开美团看看优惠，店里有套餐券，但我没选套餐，打算单点。店家大众点评收藏好评能送一碗冰粉，大宝想吃，我就连店里WiFi下了软件帮忙点评换甜品。
 
点菜宝爸爱吃辣，特意点了一份爆辣油浸鱼，剩下的菜我来安排。我想吃清淡的，点了清炒丝瓜，再给娃点了份糖醋凤梨鸡米，三个菜刚刚好。小宝一觉睡到吃完饭，午饭一口都没吃上。不吃也好，这会儿先让她排空肠道。
 
吃完没多久大宝闹肚子要上厕所，我带着她去商场，也搞不清是冰粉太凉，还是凤梨鸡米吃坏了肚子。大宝还说上菜的时候菜上面飘了小飞虫，我当时吃饭压根没留意，立马疑心菜品不干净。结账跟服务员说了这事，店长马上过来沟通，一直说这道菜卖得挺好，不过我既然提出疑虑，她还是给我们免单了，并说让厨师自己尝尝。原本算完七十，我再用了美团券，最后三道菜只付了59，店家态度蛮好，有事好好解决。
 
带大宝上厕所的时候碰巧遇上商场少儿模特走秀，小朋友个个打扮精致，走路大方又自信，我家女儿看得满眼羡慕。

body.title: 魂を抜かれそうになった話
body.body:
皆さん、こんばんちは、マルコです。

ベテランと自負している自分が、暗号資産のフィッシング詐欺に引っ掛かりそうになったので、注意喚起も兼ねて共有します。

事の発端は、つい先日サービス終了を発表したブロックチェーンゲーム通称『ファンキルオルタナ』のEarnしたトークン『姫札』を出金しようとした際に起こりました。

サ終発表→https://x.com/PK_Alterna_JP/status/2059911582386455020?s=20

この発表を知った時は、告知文を全部は読まず、サービス終了の7月末まで、残っているEarn能力をできるだけ使って姫札を稼ぐぞ！っと数日間頑張っていたんですが、後からとんでもないルールに気づいてしまったんです。
それがコレ↓


![ファンキルオルタナ姫札交換.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marcomedia/23tSxBXxpaxc56S4nJVuG9vE55QSY6kU42Le3iGACx77Rypny3rHXMLoUXLPppXShJ9Va.png)

ちょっとそれはないでしょ（怒）
サ終発表当日のゲーム内にある姫札残高によって出金枚数が制限されるというふざけたルール。
自分はその時1千枚未満しかゲーム内に所持しておらず、100枚までしか出金して換金できないってことです。

まだ、最大約2万枚ほど姫札をEarn可能で毎日頑張ればサ終まで5千姫札ほど稼げそうと見積もって3日間連続で毎日150枚くらい稼げていて、これならけっこう回収できそうだと思っていたところにこの仕打ち。
ということは、サ終日までどれだけ頑張っても意味がないってこと。

ちょうどPolygonのガス代のPOLがなかったので、この100姫札（100円相当）を出金してHimeトークンにし、POLにスワップして賄おう。それでファンキルとはおさらば、はいバイバイ～ってムカつきながら作業をしました。

〇やったこと

1.連携してるMetamaskをファンキルオルタナのサイトに接続
2.100姫札を出金し100Himeトークンに変換
3.UniswapでHimeトークンをPOLにスワップ

この3.の工程で普段ならやらないミスを犯してしまいました（ファンキルオルタナ運営のサ終対応に腹立ってたせいです）。

それは、**ブラウザでuniswapを検索して検索結果の一番上に表示されたリンクからuniswapに入ってしまう**という愚行です。

UniswapのURLは、
https://app.uniswap.org

なのですが、

自分が訪れたサイトのURLは

sites.googleで始まるuniswapとは全然関係ないアドレスでした（もちろんその時は全然確認してなかった）。

普段使っているuniswapと寸分の違いもないUIで少しも疑うことなく姫札の出金先のアカウントでサイトに接続、swap元とswap先のトークンを選択し、数量を入力。
そしてSwapボタンを押した。

MetamaskがポップアップしApproveのトランザクション確認ボタンを押そうとしたところ”偽のコントラクトの可能性がある”とアラートが表示される。

ん？なんかおかしいのかな？サイトを隅々まで確認すると、なんと！
ブラウザのURL欄のアドレスが	uniswapじゃないではないか！？違和感に気づき速攻でトランザクションキャンセルした。

「危っな！」

間一髪のところで資産失うのを免れました。

さんざん初心者サポートで、スキャムや今回のようなフィッシング詐欺に気を付けましょうって言ってるのに、危うく自分が引っ掛かりそうになるなんて...

気を引き締めなければいかんな、と自分の脇の甘さを戒めました。

今回のようなトラップを『暗号資産ドレイン』といいます。

～以下、AIさんの説明～

暗号資産ドレイン（Crypto Drainer / Wallet Drainer）とは、被害者の仮想通貨ウォレットを文字通り「空（ドレイン）にする」ことを目的とした、非常に巧妙で危険なフィッシングツールや悪性スクリプトのことです。

従来のハッキングのように「パスワードや秘密鍵を盗み出す」のではなく、「ユーザー自身を騙して、資産を移動させる許可（署名）を与えさせる」というWeb3特有の仕組みを悪用しているのが大きな特徴です。

その仕組みや手口、対策について分かりやすく解説します。

1. どうやって盗まれる？（仕組み）
ドレインの多くは、スマートコントラクト（自動契約機能）の「Approve（承認）」や「Permit（許可）」という仕組みを悪用します。

偽サイトへの誘導
有名プロジェクトの公式サイト、NFTの無料配布（エアドロップ）、限定ミント（発行）などを装ったフィッシングサイトにユーザーを誘導します（Xの公式バッジ付きアカウントが乗っ取られ、そこでURLが拡散されるケースが多発しています）。

ウォレットの接続
ユーザーが「接続（Connect Wallet）」を押すと、ドレイナースクリプトがそのウォレット内にある一番価値の高い資産（高額なNFTやトークン）を瞬時にスキャンして特定します。

悪意ある署名の要求
画面には「無料受け取り（Claim）」や「確定（Confirm）」と表示されますが、裏で要求されているのは「攻撃者にあなたの資産を自由に動かす権限を与える」という契約への署名です。

一瞬での持ち去り
ユーザーが内容をよく確認せずにメタマスクなどで「署名（Approve）」してしまうと、その瞬間にプログラムが作動し、ウォレット内の主要な資産が自動的に攻撃者のアドレスへ一斉に転送（ドレイン）されます。

2. なぜ、ベテランでも騙されるのか？
暗号資産に慣れている人ほど、「秘密鍵やシードフレーズ（復元パスワード）さえ教えなければ安全」と思いがちですが、ドレインはそこを狙いません。

本物そっくりの UI：サイトのデザインだけでなく、ウォレットがポップアップする挙動まで完璧に模倣されています。

焦りを生む心理誘導： 「先着100名限定！」「あと残り3分！」といった文句でユーザーを焦らせ、署名画面の細かい英文を読ませないようにします。

DaaS（Drainer as a Service）の台頭： 現在、ダークウェブではプロのハッカーが作った高性能なドレインツールが「キット」として犯罪者に貸し出されており（サイバー犯罪のサブスク化）、素人犯罪者でも簡単に極めて洗練された詐欺サイトを作れる環境になってしまっています。

3. 被害に遭わないための防衛策
ドレインに一度資産を抜かれてしまうと、ブロックチェーンの性質上、取引を取り消して資産を取り戻すことは不可能です。 以下の対策を徹底する必要があります。

「Approve（承認）」の画面を必ず読む
ウォレットが立ち上がった際、単なる「接続（Connect）」や「署名（Sign）」なのか、それとも「資産の利用許可（Approve）」を求めているのかを必ず確認してください。見覚えのないコントラクトへのApproveは絶対に避けてください。

不審なリンクは踏まない・検索からアクセスしない
公式X（旧Twitter）やDiscordのアカウントが発信したリンクであっても、「乗っ取り」の可能性を常に疑ってください。ブックマークした公式サイト以外からはウォレットを接続しないのが鉄則です。

ウォレットを用途別に分ける
長期保有する重要な資産（ガチホ用）を入れる「メインウォレット」と、日々のNFTミントやDeFiツールを触るための「捨てウォレット（少額だけ入れる）」を完全に分離してください。

定期的にリボーク（Revoke）する
過去に怪しいサイトにApproveしてしまっていないか、Rabby Wallet の機能や Revoke.cash などのサービスを使って、定期的に与えた権限を解除（リボーク）する癖をつけましょう。

ハードウェアウォレット（コールドウォレット）の導入
LedgerやTrezorなどの物理デバイスを導入し、メイン資産はネットから切り離して管理するのが最も安全です。

～以上～

恐ろしいですね。
ベテランでもちょっとした気のゆるみや、急いでいたり、冷静じゃなかったりで普段の自分と違うと簡単に引っかかってしまうリスクがある。

やはり、この業界は魔界ですねｗ

皆さんも大いに気を付けて、暗号資産やNFTのトランザクションが発生する行為をする場合は、ブラウザやSNSのリンクからではなく、ブックマークからサイトに入るようにしましょう！

手に入れた暗号資産やNFTはただの資産ではなく、いろんな思い出や努力が詰まった『魂』だと僕は思ってます。

資産を抜かれて魂が抜かれてしまうことないように、防御力高めて行きましょう！

body.title: Popular Nigeria myth: whispering at night and itching on the right palm.
body.body:
Most Nigeria families and communities beliefs on this popular Nigeria myth or traditional belief before the existence of science and technology came invoked. This Nigeria myth has been there with our ancestors and still passing from one generation to another till date. Among this popular Nigeria myths is whispering at night it is believed that it attracts bad spirits and witches, another is itching on the right palm it is a sigh that someone is about to receive money or blessing.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPaG1aFG5rNcRTW7FBcicAVnxHaN9ajSzBq3irmZSZrDf/1780254074104.png)

In Nigeria families there's this belief that people shouldn't whisper at night. Back then at home when we are still kids, my parents would warn I and my siblings not to whisper at night, that evil spirit listens to the conversation and then hurt the person whispering. That it is as well related to witchcraft or evil plans, so because of it children are warned by elders to always take openly rather than to whisper at night. But it just an honoured cultural tradition belief that still exists in some homes.

Another well known Nigeria myth is itching on the palm. It is believed that when our right palm starts itching us, that we are about to receive money,  salary, gift, good news call or deals and the person having the itchy palm became so happy and hopeful that they will soon receive money or good fortune. While in the other hand when someone is having an itching hand on the left palm the person will loss something or spend money. 

Funny enough I believe in this Nigeria myth, last week I had an itchy hand on my right palm, all of a sudden I became happy and hopeful that I will receive money or something amazing soon. So two days later I received money and some gifts from husband for my birthday presents. But science did not belief on this myth that when someone it's having itching that it means that the person it's having skin dryness, bites or allergies than the assumption of future blessings.

This popular Nigeria myth about whispering at night and itching on the palm are traditional beliefs and might not be recognised by scientists but these myth  reminds us of wisdom and values that has been in existence right from the time of our ancestors and it has moved down to us and most families beliefs it till today.

Thanks for stopping by and reading through my post.  It still remains your one and only@amara24 blog. Love you all 🥰💕.

body.title: How to Fix a Canon Printer That Stopped Working After a New Router
body.body:
Getting a new router should be a straightforward upgrade. You swap the hardware, reconnect your devices, and everything works. Then you try to print something and the Canon printer shows offline, cannot be found, or produces error after error. The printer that worked perfectly for two years is suddenly broken — and the only thing you changed was the router.

[This resource](https://printersolved.com/ij-start-canon-setup/) at PrinterSolved covers the complete fix process for this exact scenario for Canon Pixma printers in the United States and Canada — addressing every reason a Canon printer fails to reconnect after a router replacement.

The printer did not break. The connection information stored in three separate locations became outdated the moment the new router came online. Here is what needs to be updated and in what order.

<h2 style=\

>The First Problem — WiFi Credentials Changed Even if you gave the new router the same network name and password as the old one, the Canon printer may not automatically reconnect. The printer stores connection credentials including the network name and password in its own memory. A new router with a different hardware MAC address and potentially different DHCP range is treated as a different network by the printer even when the name matches. The fix is reconnecting the printer to WiFi manually. On the printer control panel go to Settings then Device Settings then LAN Settings then Wireless LAN Setup then Standard Setup. Select your 2.4GHz network from the list and re-enter the password. Wait for the WiFi indicator light to go solid and confirm the connection by printing a network status page — hold the Stop or Reset button for five seconds. If your new router is a WiFi 6 model check two additional settings before reconnecting. Band steering on WiFi 6 routers automatically pushes devices to 5GHz. Canon Pixma printers only support 2.4GHz. Disable band steering or give your 2.4GHz and 5GHz networks different names so you can connect the printer specifically to 2.4GHz. Also check whether the new router is set to WPA3-only security — Canon Pixma models manufactured before 2022 do not support WPA3 fully. Switch to WPA2/WPA3 transition mode to restore compatibility.

>The Second Problem — The IP Address Changed When the old router was replaced its DHCP address pool reset. Even if the printer reconnected to WiFi successfully it received a new IP address — different from the one it had on the old router. The Canon driver on your computer still has the old address stored from when you originally installed the printer. The driver sends every print job to a location that no longer exists. This mismatch is the most common reason a Canon printer shows offline despite being visibly connected to the network. Update the driver port to the printer's current address. Print the network status page by holding Stop or Reset for five seconds and note the IP address shown on the printout. On Windows go to Control Panel then Devices and Printers then right-click the Canon then Printer Properties then Ports then select the active Canon port then Configure Port then update the IP address to match the status page. Click OK and Apply. On Mac go to System Settings then Printers and Scanners then remove the Canon by clicking the minus button then re-add it by clicking the plus button. macOS automatically detects the printer at its current address.

>The Third Problem — The Address Will Keep Changing If you only update the driver port without doing anything else, the printer will go offline again the next time the router restarts. The new router is assigning addresses dynamically and will eventually give the printer a different address again. The permanent fix is creating a DHCP reservation in the new router's settings. Find the printer's MAC address on the network status page — it appears in the format XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX. Log into the new router's admin panel at 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.0.1, find the DHCP reservation or address reservation section, and bind the printer's MAC address to a fixed IP address. After saving the reservation update the driver port one more time to match the reserved IP. After this three-step process — reconnect to WiFi, update the driver port, create the DHCP reservation — the printer reconnects correctly after router restarts and the offline error does not return. The router change that caused two years of reliable printing to fail suddenly requires about fifteen minutes to resolve completely and permanently. For the complete [ij start canon connect](https://printersolved.com/ij-start-canon-setup/) walkthrough covering router-specific DHCP reservation instructions for Xfinity, Spectrum, Bell, Rogers, Telus, Asus, Netgear and TP-Link alongside the full driver installation and WiFi configuration process for all current Canon Pixma models in the United States and Canada visit PrinterSolved at printersolved.com/ij-start-canon-setup/ — free with no registration required. Canon Pixma models covered: TS3522, TS3520, TR4520, TR4722, TR8620, MG3620, MG2522, G3410, G3411, G3420, E470 and all current Canon Pixma inkjet models sold in the United States and Canada.

body.title: Завершила кашпо
body.body:
![IMG_20260528_112302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23xyVRpUfpF3JdaSFXnXLLbukMRXykGb5caqEuVPgUwWd9y9prjXXcEh5MmCBJNSDwGMr.jpg)

Друзі, вчора я нарешті завершила своє кашпо, яке почала робити ще минулого четверга.

Технологія для мене вже відпрацьована, адже минулого року я також плела кашпо зі штучного ротангу. Це такі декоративні горщики з дренажними отворами для стікання води, як і в усіх звичайних вазонах. У них можна висаджувати квіти, троянди чи будь-які інші рослини та ставити на ганку або біля будинку, щоб було красиво.

Сам процес досить простий у теорії: береться звичайне пластикове відро, у ньому свердляться отвори через певні проміжки, а потім через них пропускаються направляючі зі штучного ротангу і починається плетіння. Але на практиці все трохи складніше. Особливо важко правильно розрахувати довжину кожної направляючої.

Цього разу мені допомогли поради з інтернету. Дівчата, які вже займаються таким плетінням, ділилися власним досвідом і підказували, як краще розрахувати матеріал. Можливо, є й чоловіки, які плетуть кашпо, але мені траплялися переважно відео майстринь. І мушу сказати, що їхні поради дуже допомогли. Минулого разу ротангу мені ледь вистачило, а завершувати плетіння в таких умовах було дуже незручно. Цього ж разу все вдалося значно краще.

Плела я кашпо кілька днів. Самі розумієте, коли маєш трьох дітей, які постійно чогось потребують, а ще потрібно щодня готувати їсти, та ще й не один раз на день, то на творчість залишається не так уже й багато часу. ☺️

Але мені це справді подобається. Я отримую задоволення від самого процесу. Хоча розумію, що якщо така робота людині не до душі, то й починати не варто. Все-таки це доволі копітка справа. Тим більше що готове кашпо такого розміру можна купити приблизно за 600–700 гривень.

Чоловік постійно підштовхує мене: «Давай робити кашпо на продаж». Але я поки що не знаю. Для цього потрібно або мати більше вільного часу, або щоб хтось узяв на себе частину хатніх справ і догляд за дітьми (хоча чоловік мені і помагає, проте іноді він надто багато питає, що де лежить і це теж дратує 😄).

З іншого боку, мені завжди подобалося створювати щось власноруч. Вінки, композиції із сухоцвітів, кашпо та різні інші поробки. Чоловік постійно каже: «Давай спробуємо продавати».

Моя кума, наприклад, виготовляє свічки. Вона сама робить керамічні форми, сама заливає їх воском і продає через інтернет. Каже, що великих прибутків це не приносить, але в невеликому плюсі вона точно залишається.

Тож чоловік не перестає мене переконувати спробувати. А я поки що думаю, експериментую і намагаюся зрозуміти, що саме хотіла б робити найбільше.🤔

body.body:

La versione in italiano èè subito dopo

Hello everyone, another Splinterlands season has ended, and I want to share my results with you. They certainly aren't mind-blowing, and I still have a long way to go, but I can say I'm satisfied.

Leaderboard and Points
----------------------

This season I managed to play much more than usual. Unfortunately, between work, family, and various commitments, I usually have very little time to dedicate to Splinterlands.  
However, to my regret, I missed out on the general leaderboard that unlocks at the 100th match. I was convinced I would manage to qualify, but time slipped away from me, and I only realized it when it was too late.  
As for my score, I came very close to the threshold to enter Silver 3—I was missing just a few points, but I didn't make it. I need to buy Conclave Arcana and Escalation cards because these sets are not present in my deck.  
Thanks to the income coming from SPS delegations and staking, I will take steps to catch up with these sets.

Glint and Shop Purchases
------------------------

At the end of the season, I earned enough glint to buy an epic card—the exact one in the screenshot. I had been aiming for this result for a long time, but as I said before, I couldn't manage it until now. Besides buying the card, I still have about 3,200 glint left, which I will use for my next purchases in the shop.  
There aren't many epic cards in my deck, and fortunately, I won one that I didn't own: a 10-mana card, Kazira Vaelstrik Jinn, a Dragon card that possesses the flying and immunity powers.

¬¬## SPS and Current Situation ##

As of today, I have reached  
he milestone of 8,000 staked SPS. This level allows me to earn about 1.1 SPS per day and 0.156 vouchers. I still remember when I used to imagine this moment and it seemed unreachable; yet, with patience and commitment, here I am.  
The next step will be to reach 10,000 staked SPS. Even though the token value has dropped a lot today, nearing all-time lows, I believe in this project. The developers keep working to improve the game, so I believe in a recovery—or rather, a rebirth.

Thank you all, and see you next time.

Yours,  
Zumzulik

* * *

Ciao a tutti, è finita un’ altra stagione di **Splinterlands**, e voglio rendervi partecipi dei miei risultati. Sicuramente non sono eclatanti, ho ancora molta strada da fare, ma posso ritenermi soddisfatto.

Classifica e punti
------------------

In questa stagione sono riuscito a giocare molto di più del solito, sfortunatamente, tra lavoro, famiglia e impegni vari, mi ritrovo poco tempo da dedicare a Splinterlands.  
Tuttavia, ho mancato, e questo mi rammarica, la classifica generale che si sblocca alla centesima partita, ero convinto di riuscire a classificarmi, ma il tempo mi è sfuggito, accorgendomene solo troppo tardi.  
Per quanto riguarda il punteggio sono arrivato a sfiorare la soglia per entrare in Silver 3, mi mancavano veramente pochi punti, ma non ci sono arrivato. Devo acquistare carte **Conclave Arcana** e **Escalation** perché questi set non sono presenti nel mio deck.  
Grazie agli introiti derivanti dalle deleghe sei **sps** e dallo stacking provvederò a rimettermi in linea con questi set.

I Glint e l’ acquisto nello shop
--------------------------------

A fine stagione ho guadagnato abbastanza **glint** per acquistare una carta epica, proprio quella nello screen shot, era da tempo che puntava a questo risultato, ma come detto prima, non riuscivo in questo intento. Oltre ad aver acquistato la carta, mi sono rimasti ancora circa 3200 glint, che utilizzerò per i prossimi acquisti nello shop.  
Nel mio deck non sono presenti molte carte epiche e fortunatamente ne ho vinta una che non possedevo, la carta è da 10 mana, Kazira Vaelstrik Jinn, che possiede il potere di flying e immunity, una carta Dragons.

SPS e situazione attuale
------------------------

Ad oggi sono arrivato al traguardo dei 8.000 sps in stacking. Questo livello mi permette di guadagnare circa 1,1 sps al giorno e 0,156 vaucher. Mi ricordo ancora quando immaginavo questo momento, mi sembrava irraggiungibile, invece con pazienza ed impegno eccomi qua.  
Il prossimo step sarà quello di raggiungere i 10.000 sps in stacking, anche se oggi, il valore del token si è abbassato parecchio, sfiorando i minimi storici, ma credo in questo progetto, gli sviluppatori continuano a lavorare per migliorare il gioco, quindi credo in una ripresa, anzi, ad una rinascita.

Vi ringrazio e alla prossima.

Il vostro  
Zumzulik

body.title: Paper Collages
body.body:
Making paper collages is a lot of fun.
You have endless possibilities, and there are all kinds of different collage techniques and approaches.
First, I cut out the individual pieces.
Then I start arranging, combining, and tweaking....
Only when I’m satisfied do I take a photo.
Then everything is taken apart again, and after that, I glue it down.
I use the photo as a guide so that the collage ends up looking exactly as I arranged it beforehand.
However, it does happen that changes are made while gluing (sometimes unintentionally).
There are also times when I just can’t make up my mind.
That’s happened to me again.
In that case, I set the piece aside for a while, look at the photos, let some time pass, and then try to decide.
Which one do you like best?

Es macht sehr viel Spaß Papier-Collagen zu machen.
Man hat unbegrente Möglichkeiten und es gibt völlig unterschiedliche Collage-Techniken und Vorgehensweisen.
Ich schneide zuerst die einzelnen Teile aus.
Danach lege ich erstmal, kombiniere, ändere....
Erst wenn ich zufrieden bin, mache ich ein Foto.
Dann wird alles wieder auseinandergenommen und danach wird geklebt.
Dazu benutze ich dann das Foto, damit die Collage auch hinterher so aussieht, wie ich das vorher gelegt habe.
Es kommt allerdings auch vor, dass beim Kleben doch noch Änderungen vorgenommen werden (manchmal auch unfreiwillig).

Dann lege ich das Werk erstmal weg und schaue mir die Fotos an, lass etwas Zeit vergehen und versuche mich dann zu entscheiden.
Welches gefällt dir am besten?

body.title: 𝐌𝐘 𝐇𝐎𝐍𝐄𝐒𝐓 𝐑𝐄𝐕𝐈𝐄𝐖 𝐎𝐅 \
(𝐍𝐎 𝐒𝐏𝐎𝐈𝐋𝐄𝐑𝐒)
body.body: />When people talk about horror novels one name keeps coming up that is Stephen King for years I heard readers praise his storytelling his characters also his ability to create fear without relying on cheap scares. So I pick up The Shining. I am excited to see what hype is about. After finishing it, I can honestly say that this book deserves its reputation. So what surprised me most is that The Shining isn't just a horror novel, it's scary but also a story about people and relationships and, isolation as well as how fear grows when you're trapped with your thoughts.

> Going into the book I expected constant horror on every page but Stephen King takes his time. The story builds slowly. So some readers might find the pacing slow in the beginning, but I appreciated it, and the slower pace helped me get familiar with the characters and the setting before things started becoming more intense. One thing King does well is atmosphere. There were moments where nothing frightening was happening yet I still felt uneasy it's hard to explain. The book gives a sense something’s off. Even during calm scenes. There is tension hiding underneath the surface. That feeling stayed with me throughout the entire novel.

> So another thing i really liked was the characters, too often in horror storeys characters exist only to move the plot forward. In The Shining they feel like people. They have flaws, emotions, fears, in addition to personal struggles. I found myself caring about what happened to them. Stephen King spends time developing their personalities , relationships, and this makes the storey feel more meaningful, &, the horror works better because the people involved actually matter, ya know. I did not care about the characters. The moments would not have had the same impact. So the writing is easy to read, I expected it to be more difficult because of the book's reputation but King's style is straightforward and engaging. The pages move quickly. I often found myself reading one more chapter. Before I knew it, an hour had passed. That is always a good sign.

> What impressed me most was how psychological the storey feels because the fear doesn't just come from external events. A lot comes from uncertainty. There is tension. People react under pressure. So as a reader you start questioning things alongside the characters & sometimes the scariest moments are not the obvious ones. You can feel something building. The novel shows that fear often grows stronger as it builds over time. So the setting deserves special mention as it almost feels like a character itself. Stephen King uses the environment well. He creates a feeling of isolation. It gets stronger with each chapter. The location feels alive. In a strange way. It adds a lot to the book's atmosphere.

></center>

If I had a small criticism, the book is longer than it needs to be in a few places because I felt some sections could have been a bit shorter. This never became a big problem for me. The characters kept me interested. The atmosphere kept me interested.

So I think readers who expect nonstop horror might be surprised because The Shining is more patient than that. It's a story. It focuses on tension. It doesn't deliver scares.

That makes it better.

But the novel feels carefully constructed and every chapter adds something whether it's character development, atmosphere, or suspense. By the time I reached the later parts of the story. I was completely invested.

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Overall, I really enjoyed The Shining as my first Stephen King novel and, it definitely won't be my last. The combination made reading fantastic. Characters were strong. Atmosphere was memorable. Tension was psychological. Writing was accessible.

I recommend it.

So even if you do not usually read horror, you will probably find something here to appreciate because it is not just about being scared. It's about atmosphere. It's about human nature. And, it's about the feeling that something is going wrong.

For me, The Shining lived up to its legendary reputation.

Well, I guess this is it for this post. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

**_THUMBNAIL IS EDITED IN CANVA_**

After all the chaos and pressure of time in my previous gameplay video, today's post follows one of those calmer moments in the overall game story, which is surely a rare thing. But along with all the calmness before the storm, there is also one of my favourite moments in **Life is Strange: Reunion**, bringing Chloe and Max together after quite a few hours spent in the game with separate stories.

I won't get into details again about what their story is because I want to avoid revealing spoilers to those of you who haven't played the other games of the series before, but for whoever knows these games, I am sure you can understand my excitement of seeing them together and finally making sense the \

word from the title of the game.

This actually is the continuation of the little moment that concluded how the previous episode ended, where Chloe goes after Max at the Fremont House, but where things felt like ending abruptly. Happily, that was not the case as I got to enjoy a full episode just with the two, without being bothered by too many aspects.

https://youtu.be/uSwx1fzaUTY?si=FU1s0b5d1o72Dn4Z

I was happy to see two full grown women who, even if they both share common parts of their pasts, you could observe them at a way chiller pace. Also, the option to play with Max before Chloe wakes up and get ready the breakfast and coffee felt like a personal moment compared with what I got to enjoy in the game so far.

But what I loved even more was exploring the wall with all the pictures and memories gathered from all the games, where Chloe could check them individually and reconnect with moments of the past. 

However, as love stories or relationships between people in general are not the easiest to understand, you will observe a lot of emotion in today's gameplay shared, which shows a vulnerable Chloe that tries to settle into Max's world again, but who is not fully back just yet. But even so, the two do a great job trying to share the same space and learn to go along together, even if no one knows how long. 

Anyway, if you thought that the video was going to end with no abrupt interruption, then keep an eye out for the sudden appearance of Noelle at the door, a moment where it's very important what dialogue options you will pick for Max, because each response comes with consequences, just like the game already got us used to.

body.title: Challenge #04902-M153: Strictly By Chance
body.body:
![sebastian-unrau-sp-p7uuT0tw-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23u5bkjF8GAuW4BddFBNp1yNLq2aqJL2gYQL1Sc9pupoHqtSvN5prEPRizUSLew1d3XeE.jpg)

> Wraithvine had two new adventurers to train. One, a person who is able, in small bursts, to stop time, one who was willing to risk their life to save hirs, and another, a terrified child who was alone in the forests and almost entirely feral. The immortals, Wraithvine and Birbid, and that fully immortal cat, Lilbit, were now a new adventuring party with these two young wonders. No prophecy, no destiny, just family. Which is nice for a change.
> [https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04878-m129-unexpected-rescue](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04878-m129-unexpected-rescue)
> [https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04882-m133-taming-the-wild-child](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04882-m133-taming-the-wild-child) -- Anon Guest

[AN: Those stories _were_ unrelated. Not any more]

Bibrid had been examining Scramble's ability through his Dragon eyes to see if anything was different to true Draconic senses. Irritatingly, everything remained the same. He _still_ couldn't unriddle what sort of spellwork was going on behind Scramble's eyes. He sighed and resumed his accustomed Gnomish guise. \
Scramble helped hirself to one of the good berries. All the better to restore hirself. \
Scramble pointed to Wraithvine's return, and the small creature in the Eternal Wizard's tow.\n\n\

Wraithvine dug out something small and edible from hir pockets and fed the Hellkin child.

Who froze, clinging to Wraithvine's coat, when they saw Bibrid and Scramble.

\

The Hellkin was small, dangerously thin, and completely filthy. Horns and hair were matted together with twigs, feathers, and bits of fur. They had hooves instead of feet, but lacked the thick fur most of that body type had on their legs. Or... the poor creature could also have a bad case of mange.

Scramble carefully walked closer, crouching when this newcomer bared their fangs to hiss. \

Bibrid remained very, _very_ still. He remembered a lot of trouble with Hellkin at some point in his multiple millennia of life. Then again, Dragons like him had had trouble with _every_ kind of intelligent life that wasn't other Dragons. Even then, it was a close call. He therefore decided to wait and let the Hellkin approach him. All while making faces at Wraithvine that said, _What the flying hells are you doing?_ without uttering a word.

\

said Wraithvine, gently encouraging the Hellkin away from hir immediate contact.\n\nScramble won the Hellkin's curiosity, at last. Staying still and calm as the small and scrawny devilborn risked a tap. A touch. Some sniffing. They flinched away when Scramble tried a gentle touch of hir own against the child's filthy skin. \
decided Scramble, getting the devilborn used to hir touch. \
\n\nAs if in answer, the small scrap of a Hellkin turned to Scramble and said, \

Chance was in for many changes. The concept of a bath, for starters. At least Wraithvine had several spells to rid Chance of vermin. Inside _and_ outside. They adapted to clothing via the simple relief of staying warm and safe from any breeze.

Clean and clothed, Chance was the exact hue of a green olive. Their hair the deep, dark green of dried kelp, and their horns were tiny stubs near their hairline. Chance had yet to say a word. Well. A word that was more than a grunt that _could_ be a word. They tended to hunker near Wraithvine, and warily watch Bibrid.

Who was warily watching them.

It was Wraithvine who said, \

Bibrid scowled, not wanting to admit that the Eternal Wizard was right. He stared at Chance as they scurried about the campsite, using both hooves and hands to move around. Listening to the yips and barks as they poked or prodded at everything and anything.

\

he announced. He approached with all care, and gently took Chance's hands in his. Helping them up. They were of a height, for the moment. Good food and care would soon have them shooting up to a height far beyond Bibrid's current Gnomish dimensions. \

Four wobbling steps had Bibrid finding out what kept Chance on all fours. A minor birth defect that gave them weak tendons in their hocks. An easy fix, once Bibrid got his magic flowing.

The magic necessary for their _mind_... That would take a little longer. Slow, delicate, and careful work to unlock the way for Chance to learn by themselves. But it _could_ be done.

That night, Bibrid had a Hellkin's purr in his ear when they were all safe in their bedrolls.

**Hello Hive Fam!** Warm greetings to my ever-supportive Hive Friends all over the world 🌍💙. I’m truly grateful for this community that continues to inspire me daily.

Today, I want to share something simple yet meaningful, a little comfort food moment captured for the **Picture A Day** Community.

I seldom eat junk food, but when I do, I always choose **Piattos Cheese Flavored Potato Crisps**. There’s something about that cheesy goodness that feels like a hug in snack form.

I know junk food isn’t the healthiest choice, which is why I rarely indulge. But right now, while I’m trying to fight my overthinking self and the personal challenges I face daily, I just wanted something simple, something that brings me a bit of joy.

This crisp, cheesy snack may be small, but it reminds me that even in tough times, we can find comfort in little things.

**Thank you so much, Hive Fam, for always being here to read my thoughts and share in my journey.** Your support means the world to me. Until my next post, may we all continue to find joy in life’s simple pleasures. 💛

It seems there are important differences between Hive Blurt and Steemit - Whilst the similarities remain prominent.



They are all solving the same issue - Censorship Resistant Decentralised and Incentivised Blogging.  Justin Son's takeover of Steemit triggered the formation of Hive, and the Hive Downvote triggeres the formation of Blurt.org.    

I trust this will be the foundation of healthy competition in the growing space. 

You can now earn Tron on Steemit, whilst Hive is experiencing a growing number of independent appr on the blochchain, whilst Blurt is venturing into Media and integrating with the Fediverse.

MAny like myself, have been forked over from Steemit, and would rather have posts cross over to all three chains in one effort.



As I use the Actifit app on hive to simultaneously monitor steps, make activist blogs and earn rewards, this is a sweet spot for me. Particularly as Actifit automates the posts on to Blurt, without any further input from myself.

body.title: A Guide to Boosting Retail ROI with Connected Stores
body.body:
![Scaling-Connected-Stores-The-Executive-Guide-to-Retail-ROI-768x432.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/630bf718e41035476e4f4f6826b1d966a7f79bc34eacfa39edadd7057261e86f)

Retail is undergoing a profound transformation. Modern consumers expect seamless experiences across physical stores, digital channels, mobile applications, and customer service touchpoints. To meet these expectations while maintaining profitability, retailers are increasingly investing in connected store ecosystems.

[Connected stores](https://cybertechnologyinsights.com/whitepaper/scaling-connected-stores-the-executive-guide-to-retail-roi/?mtm_campaign=connected_stores\&mtm_kwd=rethink_retail\&mtm_source=marketing\&mtm_medium=cta_read_more\&mtm_content=marketing\&mtm_cid=IA\_061\_26\_05\_017\&mtm_group=whitepaper\&mtm_placement=marketing) leverage technologies such as IoT, artificial intelligence, cloud platforms, analytics, computer vision, and real-time data sharing to create smarter retail environments. More importantly, they enable organizations to improve operational efficiency, increase customer satisfaction, and maximize return on investment (ROI).

For retail executives, the challenge is no longer whether to adopt connected technologies - it is how to deploy them effectively to generate measurable business outcomes.

## What Are Connected Stores?

Connected stores are retail environments where systems, devices, employees, and customer touchpoints work together through a unified digital infrastructure.

These ecosystems typically connect:

*   Inventory management systems

*   Point-of-sale platforms

*   Customer engagement tools

*   Smart shelves and sensors

*   Supply chain systems

*   Workforce management platforms

*   Analytics dashboards

The result is a highly visible and data-driven retail operation capable of responding quickly to changing customer demands and market conditions.

## Why Retailers Are Prioritizing Connected Store Strategies

Traditional retail environments often struggle with:

*   Inventory inaccuracies

*   Stockouts and overstock situations

*   Long checkout queues

*   Limited customer insights

*   Fragmented shopping experiences

*   Inefficient workforce allocation

These challenges directly impact profitability.

Connected stores address these issues by providing real-time intelligence that enables faster, more informed decision-making.

Retailers gain visibility across every stage of the customer journey, allowing them to optimize operations while enhancing shopping experiences.

## Key Areas Where Connected Stores Drive ROI

### Improved Inventory Accuracy

Inventory management remains one of the biggest challenges in retail.

Connected technologies enable:

*   Real-time inventory tracking

*   Automated stock monitoring

*   Predictive replenishment

*   Demand forecasting

When inventory data is accurate, retailers reduce stockouts, minimize excess inventory, and improve customer satisfaction.

This directly contributes to stronger revenue performance.

### Enhanced Customer Experiences

Today's consumers expect personalized interactions and frictionless shopping experiences.

Connected stores support:

*   Personalized promotions

*   Smart recommendations

*   Mobile-assisted shopping

*   Contactless checkout experiences

These capabilities increase engagement, strengthen loyalty, and encourage repeat purchases.

Customer experience has become a critical competitive differentiator in modern retail.

### Workforce Optimization

Labor costs represent a significant operational expense for retailers.

Connected systems help managers:

*   Forecast staffing requirements

*   Monitor store performance

*   Optimize scheduling

*   Reduce manual administrative tasks.

Employees spend more time assisting customers and less time managing repetitive processes.

This improves productivity while lowering operational costs.

### Data-Driven Decision Making

Connected stores generate vast amounts of valuable data.

Retail leaders can analyze:

*   Customer traffic patterns

*   Product performance

*   Conversion rates

*   Shopping behaviors

*   Peak demand periods

These insights help organizations make informed decisions regarding merchandising, staffing, promotions, and inventory investments.

Better decisions lead to stronger financial outcomes.

## Emerging Technologies Powering Connected Stores

Several technologies are accelerating connected retail adoption.

### Artificial Intelligence

[AI](https://cybertechnologyinsights.com/newsletter/your-ai-pilot-worked-now-what-the-gap-no-one-talks-about/?mtm_campaign=turing\&mtm_kwd=ti100\&mtm_source=marketing\&mtm_medium=cta_read_more\&mtm_content=marketing\&mtm_cid=IA\_178\_26\_05\_016\&mtm_group=newsletter\&mtm_placement=marketing) enables predictive analytics, personalized customer experiences, and intelligent demand forecasting.

### Internet of Things (IoT)

Connected sensors provide real-time visibility into store operations, inventory levels, and customer movement patterns.

### Computer Vision

Retailers use computer vision to analyze shopper behavior, reduce shrinkage, and enhance security.

### Cloud-Based Platforms

Cloud infrastructure enables seamless communication between systems, locations, and operational teams.

Together, these technologies create a unified retail ecosystem that supports continuous optimization.

## Common Mistakes Retailers Should Avoid

Many connected store initiatives fail to achieve expected ROI due to:

*   Lack of clear business objectives

*   Poor data quality

*   Inadequate employee training

*   Siloed technology implementations

*   Weak cybersecurity controls

Retailers should focus on business outcomes first and technology deployment second.

Success depends on strategic alignment rather than technology adoption alone.

## Measuring Connected Store Success

To evaluate ROI effectively, organizations should monitor:

*   Sales growth

*   Inventory turnover

*   Customer retention rates

*   Labor efficiency metrics

*   Average transaction value

*   Operational cost reductions

Tracking these KPIs helps retailers quantify the value generated by connected store investments.

## Final Thoughts

[Connected stores ](https://cybertechnologyinsights.com/whitepaper/scaling-connected-stores-the-executive-guide-to-retail-roi/?mtm_campaign=connected_stores\&mtm_kwd=rethink_retail\&mtm_source=marketing\&mtm_medium=cta_read_more\&mtm_content=marketing\&mtm_cid=IA\_061\_26\_05\_017\&mtm_group=whitepaper\&mtm_placement=marketing)represent the future of retail operations. By integrating intelligent technologies, real-time data, and customer-centric strategies, retailers can create highly efficient environments that drive sustainable growth.

Organizations that embrace connected retail ecosystems gain more than operational visibility - they unlock opportunities to increase profitability, improve customer experiences, and strengthen competitive positioning.

In an increasingly digital marketplace, connected stores are no longer a luxury. They are becoming a foundational component of retail success and long-term ROI optimization.

body.title: [ENG/ESP] LOH # 291 The value of family help / El valor de la ayuda familiar
body.body:
> During my most difficult time, when I received the news that I would not be able to have children, I felt like the world stopped. It was a blow that not only affected my body, but also my identity and my dreams. However, in the midst of that darkness, my family became the light that allowed me to move forward. My mother, my brothers and my husband were the ones who sustained my spirit when I needed it most, and thanks to them I learned that life always offers alternative paths to love and be loved.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSc4h5dansQ9YR4PkcYcJMJr5EH4giJx5MnVLa8K6BZeu/img_20260114_wa0036.jpg) My mother was the first to be by my side. With his tenderness and wisdom, he reminded me that a person's value is not measured by their biological capacity, but by the quality of their heart. She accompanied me in therapies, listened to me without judging and offered me unconditional love that restored my self-confidence. His presence was a balm that helped me heal the deepest wounds. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWGZ5hoTAxdKuCCh4iAdts8YX3QKMQMexAVB9a7viGPy/img_20161116_101646.jpg) My brothers also played an essential role. Each one, in their own way, provided me with emotional support. One made me laugh to relieve the tension, another offered me practical advice, and another simply accompanied me in silence, proving that sometimes the company without words is enough to feel understood. They made me see that the fraternity is a refuge where you can always return. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRyFUUbanynNWhtPqVJG6WXjP1iWoGAdA9BDeVB4J7rty/dscf1276.jpg) My husband, for his part, was a pillar of love and patience. Instead of being overcome by sadness, he showed me other life options. He told me about the possibility of adoption, about how we could open our home to a child who needed affection. It also reminded me that love for my nephews could be a way of exercising motherhood from another angle, sharing time, teachings and affection with them. His vision helped me broaden my horizon and understand that family is built in many ways. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsJfcgQKgukFBxPt5PUg59PxkAEZLf77nd2ECiJ6ybhH/img_20260114_wa0041.jpg) The therapies I underwent, accompanied by the constant support of my family, gave me tools to accept reality without feeling defeated. I learned to transform pain into resilience and to value the opportunities that life still offered me. The love I received was so great that it allowed me to see beyond the loss, recognizing that the ability to love does not depend on biology, but on the willingness to give the best of oneself. Today I can say that, although the news of not being able to have children was devastating, my family helped me turn that moment into an opportunity for growth. Thanks to them I understood that true wealth is in the bonds we cultivate, in the love we give and receive, and in the ability to reinvent our dreams. Their support taught me that I was never alone, and that life, even in its most painful turns, can open paths to new forms of wholeness. Credits: Images belong to me. I used a Google translator. ESPAÑOL Durante mi momento más difícil, cuando recibí la noticia de que no podría tener hijos, sentí que el mundo se detenía. Fue un golpe que no solo afectó mi cuerpo, sino también mi identidad y mis sueños. Sin embargo, en medio de esa oscuridad, mi familia se convirtió en la luz que me permitió seguir adelante. Mi madre, mis hermanos y mi esposo fueron quienes sostuvieron mi espíritu cuando más lo necesitaba, y gracias a ellos aprendí que la vida siempre ofrece caminos alternativos para amar y ser amado. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSc4h5dansQ9YR4PkcYcJMJr5EH4giJx5MnVLa8K6BZeu/img_20260114_wa0036.jpg) Mi madre fue la primera en estar a mi lado. Con su ternura y su sabiduría, me recordó que el valor de una persona no se mide por su capacidad biológica, sino por la calidad de su corazón. Ella me acompañó en terapias, me escuchó sin juzgar y me ofreció un amor incondicional que me devolvió la confianza en mí misma. Su presencia fue un bálsamo que me ayudó a sanar las heridas más profundas. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWGZ5hoTAxdKuCCh4iAdts8YX3QKMQMexAVB9a7viGPy/img_20161116_101646.jpg) Mis hermanos también jugaron un papel esencial. Cada uno, desde su manera particular, me brindó apoyo emocional. Uno me hacía reír para aliviar la tensión, otro me ofrecía consejos prácticos, y otro simplemente me acompañaba en silencio, demostrando que a veces la compañía sin palabras es suficiente para sentirse comprendido. Ellos me hicieron ver que la fraternidad es un refugio donde siempre se puede volver. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRyFUUbanynNWhtPqVJG6WXjP1iWoGAdA9BDeVB4J7rty/dscf1276.jpg) Mi esposo, por su parte, fue un pilar de amor y paciencia. En lugar de dejarse vencer por la tristeza, me mostró otras opciones de vida. Me habló de la posibilidad de la adopción, de cómo podríamos abrir nuestro hogar a un niño que necesitara cariño. También me recordó que el amor hacia mis sobrinos podía ser una forma de ejercer la maternidad desde otro ángulo, compartiendo con ellos tiempo, enseñanzas y afecto. Su visión me ayudó a ampliar mi horizonte y a comprender que la familia se construye de muchas maneras. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcsJfcgQKgukFBxPt5PUg59PxkAEZLf77nd2ECiJ6ybhH/img_20260114_wa0041.jpg) Las terapias que realicé, acompañadas por el apoyo constante de mi familia, me dieron herramientas para aceptar la realidad sin sentirme derrotada. Aprendí a transformar el dolor en resiliencia y a valorar las oportunidades que la vida aún me ofrecía. El amor que recibí fue tan grande que me permitió ver más allá de la pérdida, reconociendo que la capacidad de amar no depende de la biología, sino de la voluntad de entregar lo mejor de uno mismo. Hoy puedo afirmar que, aunque la noticia de no poder tener hijos fue devastadora, mi familia me ayudó a convertir ese momento en una oportunidad de crecimiento. Gracias a ellos entendí que la verdadera riqueza está en los vínculos que cultivamos, en el amor que damos y recibimos, y en la capacidad de reinventar nuestros sueños. Su apoyo me enseñó que nunca estuve solo, y que la vida, incluso en sus giros más dolorosos, puede abrir caminos hacia nuevas formas de plenitud. Créditos: Las imágenes me pertenecen.
