body.title: Sounds Good And That's All
body.body:
It's been ages since I have my eye on solar energy and have been thinking of doing something in this regard. When the Iran - US war broke out and fuel shortages made price sore and the immediate future looked quite worrying, I saw an article about people setting up solar panels on their balcony and there was a post on Hive as well in this regard.

![nuno-marques-0GbrjL3vZF4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/243qAgWPvUdLBLo66rzzHEST61LsPFBa5PShEXFF5Hic8iSnTGe3pzuGWqWimtLng3Hu9.jpg)
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash For me, this would be the only available solution because I live in an apartment building, so the roof is not exactly mine, in order to install anything on it, would need the approval of all inhabitants, which I would never get. The funny thing is that as I said, they would instantly say no to such a request as they don't benefit and I'd be using their space too to some extent, but if I propose for them to join, they would say no to that as well as investing means spending money and paying for something that benefits us all has always been a problem. Yes, tell me about it, it's pure headache each time, but this is how people are and I still can't complain as so far the major issues have been solved one way or another. ![anders-j-hxUcl0nUsIY-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wMWWmpuUpULuRCPCVxG7j2tBLARjbWE9HPm9KNNfg8z6FmcVpQiMmrRKXnZKoUY8iqm.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash Back to the topic of the post, solar power that is, I wanted to know what my options are with a limited space, which is my balcony basically and asked a friend who's working in the energy industry. Kind of new we're not yet where other countries are with solar energy, but what I've been told shocked me. First of all, I would not get an authorization to install the panels because from aesthetic point of view it would ruin the look of the building. You can always skip this step, but you'd last a day or two, till someone notices it and then you not only would be fined, you'd have to take the whole thing down as well and you'd be left with the loss. ![soren-h-1PKAYeA_nZ4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23s9NxWGhyJB6cFQUN8cHMtZmxnorZmihqxUihjitMWnxEhhKqpwyDdSSUhAL3e7c7qQb.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash For the sake of the argument, let's skip this step and disregard it, as if it wouldn't be an impediment and let's go on. Talking to a person well versed in this regard helps a lot, so I was told that even if I'd be allowed to install some panels, with the available space I have and the size of panels I could use, the max power I could produce per day is 1kW, which is nothing honestly, compared to the consumption usually I have. Then comes the tricky part, or the f**kery, if I want to be brutally honest. I'm not sure if the term *smart consumption* is used in this case, but that's what I'd call it now, that I know how it works. In my vocabulary, this term would mean you consume what you produce and the reason to do so is the terms and conditions the energy supplier is offering to those connecting to the grid with solar power. ![red-zeppelin-UVGE-o757-g-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EoAZkjQXXB7ptvbCubFzpsGrHBmP5a4inj6Aj34W6oCNDw3vz2t7aDaebNzGgCM27qf.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash Basically you can feed the power you don't use into the system and the company pays you for that, but ... as there's always a but, they pay you 0.4 RON for it while they sell what you consume from the grid at around 1.5RON. Now do the math. Did I mention this is f**kery? Yes, I did. I'm an economist and understand they need to make some profit too, but from 0.4 to 1.5 there's a long way. Storing the access energy is out of the question as literally there's no way I could install the necessary batteries due to lack of space, which leaves me with organizing my day in a way to be able to use what I consume, but this is also out of the question. I have no intention to be the slave of such system and live my life focusing on this. Hell no! Honestly, I was hoping to find a solution that can help me join the solar world, but at the moment it is only profitable, if you have enough panels and batteries to be self sufficient. Otherwise you can't even get back your investment it seems, let alone be profitable. It's a shame things stand like this and knowing how things work in this sector, chances to see some change in the right direction are slim. I'm not saying slim to none as sooner or later the EU is going to put some pressure on countries lagging in the renewable energy sector, but in a country where governments last for a year or two and politicians are busy fighting for positions and power, you can't expect much. So problem solved. Solar energy sounds good, but that's all as no way I can use it where I live.

body.body:
Hi Hivelearners friends.

<Center>I hope you all are well, I am well too. We all have seen difficult situations in our lives, we have seen good times and we have also seen such truths that if our lying can save the life of a person or if our own life can be saved, then this lie will not be called a lie. The way we are seeing here is that we are standing on the road and thieves are after a person and if he hides in our house, this person is not at fault. body.title: A blue experience, with the sounds of the sea – El Palo Beach, East End 📷 Málaga – Spain
body.body:
> --- >Every part of the city has its own special charm; each one is distinct from the others, and the same goes for the beaches. Each has its own particular and unique style that sets it apart from the rest. Of course, you have to pay attention to the details. I think what makes each beach unique, out of the many there are, is not just the colour of the sand, but the neighbourhood to which it belongs. --- ![Image_1780357697216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVGsFiFwg9RxFuRFmFRXvYeGVnN1yPVuvYb4PyC9JsqCGGUsVJVnE9482vLXUpRLHdx.jpg) --- I’ll start by saying that I think this is one of the beaches I’ve liked the most, because although it isn’t as remote as Peñón del Cuervo beach where there are no longer any houses and it’s on the outskirts of the city this one is very quiet and family friendly. It’s in another neighbourhood that used to be a fishing village, to the east of the city. It is very similar to the beach that follows it, Pedregalejo Beach, but in my opinion I think there are fewer people, and the views from the different sections of the beach are more idyllic. The beach I’m telling you about today is called El Palo and stretches for 1,200 metres, although this time I only explored the eastern section, which is next to El Dedo Beach. --- ![20260217_153844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fi69JyZ7b87RbDXuwqpFVnZhAxXCriQL3fN78K224rzri83zPvn8cM87P1T73WLYa6.jpg) ![20260217_153857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zkdpb6LKXLx2KGd2Znnq7ab1g3G5eAedMgqRPjAuEkrgnZEChLKfGpzsd73KbrykAjP.jpg) ![20260217_153901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGWMSt15kV4CbY3dGb4ngy8RcPEnP9hjTYP11SFknL3VesDYYKA98DKB7TJTxsZdqyZ.jpg) ![20260217_153926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zRxjM4EaRkQ2XX7aE7h582PW2thta4z9Xkj4ebJqNkEnnAs27xC9vVeGbcHUwjz3zTq.jpg) ![20260217_153936.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2449r5dSDUDdbW77nDGLmZcsZ5ydpCtngqrZ8m5LNYr1xxKdDSh9H2tZRGT31LFS4SRAM.jpg) ![20260217_153939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243271xvY3rzFji982UcGSzRNkMG94Ch7gYhCc5Z56xm2YY1Yj1eZ6VYKntGhbc4tPeHX.jpg) ![20260217_154444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244UfZBcLcGHtvYGeruoT18eaYqqrAaxb9sdfZXmw9ozTyHs6pATKZrCkZyMKhTBVkNdJ.jpg) --- That’s why the walk began at the 2013 monument to Emilio Prados, created by the artist Andrés Montesanto as a tribute to the poets of Málaga. It is made of white reinforced concrete, with some colour on the face and the other side of the book. As I mentioned, every beach seems to have different sand, both in terms of grain size and colour. This reminds me of when I first arrived and my friend who lives in Argentina told me that the sand I was showing her, from La Malagueta beach, was just like the sand in the town where she lives, even though to me they looked very different. That sand was white or very light in colour, whereas the sand at El Palo beach is much darker and, in this case, does resemble the one she mentioned. It’s incredible how, within the same city, there are so many beaches that differ from one another. It’s a type of sand you can walk on without sinking, which doesn’t hurt your feet because it’s so soft, and where you can spend hours enjoying yourself. --- ![20260217_154854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242riRSG2xmJyKqJKEJtZrvw8TCP4EiBsZwrgMLiLec5CUcBmXmA5z6AZWcgrHazs6pXw.jpg) ![20260217_154931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245wBWV5Jv2rHDJrnkpuhyk1Mxe8eWZxHB7Awq3gXfKp3NXQAS36dLtahsLe3QzysarLh.jpg) ![20260217_155345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2458GBmbuKRkZJPTTB77GoaqYVrbAzUgCQ9fF2KDVnj9wnYpGm67jmA2TdSDAjy6TpL89.jpg) ![20260217_155447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmBQgVZygjK6L75y3shMx6bJ49omhSCi4s5XMdBaw88kUzajBKiaHchb31LJFVh8Yug.jpg) --- The whole seafront promenade is full of restaurants, some very large, with a village-like feel and, as I said, a family atmosphere, although there are tourists too, though not as many as on the beaches closer to the centre. The buildings are one or two storeys high and each one is different. You can tell they’ve been renovated over time, from simple fishermen’s cottages to more modern homes, yet still simple and beautiful. --- ![20260217_160232.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zRrhqPPFqWCWXwtX2TA74PyKUAJAMrcPookmgQFM5FzcKiBgtawXuLnQVnCFUHSymhP.jpg) ![20260217_160247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyT4uTUDvVQrg7wHGx7LKtitaCZQYjQ15x5qBhjxHU7uzvEy9mhWsGVDEc4XnzPri3S.jpg) ![20260217_160258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKmc7vF4NEsjR2zmiCiF5rHiDXqEgVxyk5N6RrCFPpv1xbEzskLDhGJkCjioSif2sE3.jpg) ![20260217_160325.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243LtmgYSiu26o31KtKLCYKwpC7qczg9CrXcyfDPqCn6CALTE6zu55U8BQbDKCN1eYA6Q.jpg) --- There’s something that characterises this neighbourhood, which I’ll show you another time when we take a stroll through these parts: between the houses on the beachfront and those in the second row, there’s a street where no cars pass, as if it were a long, wide pedestrianised street; and furthermore, between each terraced house there are narrow passageways through which you can access that pedestrianised street and enjoy a completely different stroll, where the locals have pots of plants at their doorsteps, tables and chairs, and chat amongst themselves. It’s something I believe is very old, dating back to other eras, and I love that. --- ![20260217_160336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244KBwXiMVhnMCH2XwZd3DBMfk4Q9ZtKcYAWFtHNUd5PGaRusAuhPL7zSz2LkEspiweSd.jpg) ![20260217_160405.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243WM9zM4CaAiFwoTevCGsxK1ntqzRdynNWz1hys6p3dnpjZQiT1MprLcmKWcBicdkHmL.jpg) ![20260217_160421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243WEnErF2Vhf4C1yHbBfYJkZXG19Uod4HLrXbBX97fzMyGxxBrdxRvk1sn4csHNimU1A.jpg) ![20260217_160434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ycu82ArCYGrQtHX4qydjKk8Z6o8xVkNrQj4M3p5AdGXiyS4Dp6iHWoE3DrZmPyMbdPM.jpg) ![20260217_160554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGWGijZXWvPZbWgq3fCJYtQknXDXTYzuT6cT7Bk5qtd19o9BWVB4YyQLZENhUrmZEig.jpg) --- It doesn’t feel like a stroll through a big city, let alone a tourist one, but rather like a quieter, more secluded spot, even though there were plenty of beach bars serving fried fish, a great tradition around here. --- ![20260217_154532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243LvvbC3c52gixMcXZtG4YWN1RmB7kGich8J54FYdbzeyb8JCtsiYg8ZSEMxdVWHe1QT.jpg) ![20260217_154546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wC5LNntzXgQbFyyZbbCpCTp9KwbewGKzMV7Sdq3xYXEtz76tpRZDVmMVj7bkb2qe98S.jpg) ![20260217_154550.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243LthL3S9YfdfZLxvkjp6uWxgarqrqcPeD2HAjCcXLT7os4x9mK4uN4NF1mN9kmmLi35.jpg) ![20260217_154556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243BVpvHpB2jwTQoqEexYqsBA7WgCQnhs6kXn17KjXyzNAdxYZM5KgoenQZSufGXVVpTM.jpg) ![20260217_154634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zbF6KYhL3BJPwZBmx5TaGJDuLdeHjfLc2x31RvQewZREx54F6BLv4kVkD11BXz6Eazt.jpg) ![20260217_154735.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243BXtwgdr67FvkWmh2THaRUzi1ZzWPrEPuSNJLUHtcQM47crG2GheobuUmyygBgRitWm.jpg) ![20260217_154830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fhfaLQxUztKz6D7sN1becqLSRdrpnYb5e6UWsN9FednE8PR4BNibmHysNpZqEoE7oS.jpg) --- The sun was shining high in the sky, and another feature of this beach is that it seems to be divided into several smaller sections; there are sort of little beaches because there are paths leading out into the sea, and you can stroll along them close to the waves and far from the buildings. In fact, in this first part, I ventured quite far down one of the paths, leaving the city far behind, and it was wonderful, you can only hear the sea. Of course, as with all the city’s beaches, the beach huts are always adorned with beautiful murals, in colours that stand out against the blue, white and green of the surroundings, and I love that, because I can find art at every turn. --- ![20260217_155842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243BTWUToPBBbsXH62XRrZGsu8BjuxTBPVF3FcBeDb6bD4KD73h9gYmuzt4Vx6ochoq9H.jpg) ![20260217_155930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243BVbz8nCsNGCKd85oP6sPFcYzTXUDJGTugoW8iNueTpRtcKsxkXEnqnoN9fLsFRGWj1.jpg) ![20260217_155954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2449seeMHdvQnK4jHLG7oD3QvDw5D7S57isQZRKMDq2MPoDW9PftgABeCqXRywT9rnCPQ.jpg) ![20260217_160017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243271xbBbHtxrb6U4VcopS5fv3rMHLuXFe51ZVxhdgLWGzkLviPedCGm8DBFkwfzv4Pt.jpg)
![20260217_160028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8m6jcmFhWia3vTy2ipoEezdCSaiXBWJYfcrpUXzoJnDnXvifN9tu2DzxgzfKhHKKsx.jpg)
--- As I usually do when I visit a beach area, my walk takes me along the promenade, then down onto the sand, where I head towards the sea, because I love it, especially watching the foam caress the sand. Then I return to the promenade and take photos, not just of the sea view but of everything around me, right down to the houses, the restaurants, everything. Another feature that’s particularly common on the beaches to the east of the city is the number of boats and ships often seen on the sand. There are many places that hire out boats for trips and water sports, and I often spot them on my walks in all sorts of sizes and colours. --- ![20260217_160037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244Ud38Np4m7QTTvZMWSYN21XQqnCAjGZm5tw8dzeE2sLtg9VYe6Bxz3kpVsi5FYsP2MP.jpg) ![20260217_160126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244e1uYoERjnEyobk9sVNCJjfEVwZRUXHBn2B5wXMF2c1dLiigWsBcNCR57GWzKGkLbt9.jpg) ![20260217_160158.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyJg4yFvpKa2DSD6hMJU62e2UASgwiP8hP5BSjnoQr28WVQT6YwCaJFfaoGcNaeFAK2.jpg)
![20260217_160216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ynL5UPGrfV7E27nyRGtynFiNziPQf6FzQ2VdC3AFcS2NfvbE3asCvCZGYsaxW9t4bPD.jpg)
--- Something I’d like to highlight and which I loved was seeing signs with quotes, like this one. “The sea also chooses harbours where it can laugh, like sailors, the sea of those who are.” Hernández, Gilabert, Miguel. (1910–1942) --- ![20260217_160725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244KGX7HVNRd62JNRZGRGbcgZFQsxM4WFFXpjo14pb59UwWWR7TjGdw1ciFecj1abb8iG.jpg) ![20260217_160751.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xAMEypkiEBjdqg8MgXEXR9p2XyMHbajPMovRBpJLzFtT9zTnhy6f6WTdto4F9AepFNu.jpg) ![20260217_160852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQmt9v1SThnnmWpD6d7AAU9usc3NduKTvsT6AVwa2C6LPd9SJTQjJxmccaSTPLsPc3K.jpg) ![20260217_160913.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKQo3tqLngEp8rZ6Wsh9cJmGEjpf3tB9VGq9SFvsyAbbeK7Bp6XXc1j2yCy2y1VQN2p.jpg) --- And as I walked, I came to a beautiful pergola that provided some shade thanks to the vegetation around it, and right there was another entrance to the sea, so of course I headed there to explore it. --- ![20260217_161040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uQxp3aXLk22qKWCY8rAmoB5XxRjjVD4e9z4pZrDAU343H8w7A8JT65PNrBiRqCUejNp.jpg) ![20260217_161259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2449tER8geAfc8yjb6X8QPnNYfXKUpyzmFFG4XT3qXi3tuG587JLivUDCZbuVqD6o9hFm.jpg) ![20260217_161304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244oQE6wPY4ywMwmtQQKqoCxGuDwjBjCXaBahzS4dB66EEpWRh6t2zZ3dqkvTihhD8iB6.jpg) ![20260217_161341.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242rneDYiXptyybFnZsvYzGixZREW64wZvEJvxr3Ja2tTcCkyrfcZqLj33mZLJYx3KzuA.jpg) ![20260217_161418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245mnr9uLztSScpxFRepXLtzjg8WVjdeVji2tTWtJDNjnEyQbAdxogN3L6bWVMtoHrvaa.jpg) ![20260217_161602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23w2qZLVkwR2D7r8RMxV2w2DunsVCAwjQovwbkMSZFKhqmXTMswvMd3EnVvYrVKtTiPyt.jpg) ![20260217_161715.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKonr4iuGcM4B4tMTWJF2tRjDtv9VwgkTruJcWdGzxw3XY4FxYBUfBxvHYHmVwXsorv.jpg) ![20260217_161814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244KGpRUEi3LH7MLXMEjfSJwfsZcUng9wdRC91UfKtrdyXnvsufnunQPq3zsLkKSxWAwX.jpg) ![20260217_162024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xozPhJD4JJK3bkb7kM7Km6sDXM4WTAK379dax2CL6AaKRr96Qt3M3zZrxQAVA9YLXXE.jpg) --- The sand was soft and fine; it felt great to touch it, and above all, it was lovely to see the beautiful things the sea brings to the shore. What’s more, I spotted a boat on the shore one of the many there and that entrance to the sea struck me as even more beautiful than the previous one. I don’t know how many more entrances there are from here on; the beach seems to be much longer and wider than the signs suggest, and it’s lovely to take it all in. --- ![20260217_162245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23z77XYTBoNtKWEQPCZ9yLHY51ZdzVj88Hr9PfpGAicnqyHvCxkKL9ebZZhA1yASMMMEo.jpg) ![20260217_162315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi3sQ4jtLSBtVdnhzk79Wbq8VLbBUgpcw5QfxCUB7pL5zgCiSPyFaDojqhdNjrHxVYC.jpg) ![20260217_162330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyR3hoDsqh9xBYjqLa7htCqy32etSVp17aPssz4VKNELhC6vD4YRoevZSTZsK41HtrG.jpg) --- When I returned from that short walk to the pergola, I noticed a strange monument, if I can call it that, which had some inscriptions on it. If you glance at it quickly, it looks like the writing is upside down, but it could also be in another language. What do you think? I’ve already figured out what it says. On this occasion, my tour ends here; I’m taking a break to come back another day and continue the long journey. Thank you very much for joining me today; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- ---

body.body: Space and crypto share an interesting structural parallel — both require massive upfront capital with long time horizons before returns materialize. The difference is that crypto has found product-market fit in financial primitives, while space is still largely government-funded R&D with sporadic commercial wins (Starlink being the obvious exception).\n\nWhat I'd add to this: the real convergence might be in tokenized satellite data markets, not in 'crypto on Mars' narratives. Earth observation data, orbital bandwidth auctions, and satellite insurance are all markets that benefit from on-chain settlement without requiring space tourism to scale. That's where I'd watch for the first meaningful crossover.

*Disclaimer: My voice was not at its best today, cause after work meetings stuff.*

body.title: Cancel Culture: Talk with Peter Thiel canceled at the Vienna Festival (Wiener Festwochen) after inviting him to the arts festival.
body.body:
Bei den Wiener Festwochen hätte es eine Diskussionsveranstaltung mit Peter Thiel, dem deutsch-amerikanischen Investor und Gründer von paypal und der Analystics-Firma Palantir gegeben.

Palantir bietet Überwachungssoftware, die vor allem von Regierungen und Geheimdiensten verwendet wird, an, positiv gesehen zur Terrorismusbekämpfung, negativ zur Massen-Überwachung der Bürger.

Aus politischem Druck und weil zahlreiche Künstler wegen Thiel die Teilnahme an den Festwochen ihrerseits abgesagt hätten, haben die Festwochen jetzt die Diskussionsveranstaltung mit Peter Thiel wieder abgesagt, nachdem sie ihn eingeladen haben. Cancel Culture.

Finde die Absage schade, da es eine interessante Diskussionsveranstaltung gewesen wäre, auch wenn man die Meinung von Thiel nicht teilen würde, so ist Thiel unbestritten ein sehr einflussreicher Unternehmer und Investor, dessen Firmen auch in der EU tätig sind.

Was sagt ihr zur Absage? Gerechtfertigt oder woke Bubble der Festwochen, die keine andere Meinung zulassen?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/23tw9kF8m5RhF53a8EVVpf4A51jEe5xbKTWLAQko5E1j3biwSgXYXo4GVH1St7EP3rMfn.png)

https://x.com/a_nnaschneider/status/2060786760313970692

## Vienna Festival cancels debate with Peter Thiel

https://www.diepresse.com/27219493/wiener-festwochen-sagen-auftritt-von-peter-thiel-ab

## Mainstream Media opposing Peter Thiel in Austria, calling him \

https://www.derstandard.de/story/3000000243890/tech-investor-peter-thiel-schattenpraesident-der-usa-und-feind-der-demokratie

## Will Peter Thiel be appearing at the Vienna Festival soon? Little dissent in the preliminary debate.

https://www.derstandard.de/story/3000000322810/peter-thiel-bald-bei-den-festwochen-wenig-widerspruch-bei-vorab-debatte

## English

The Vienna Festival in Austria was set to host a panel discussion with Peter Thiel, the German-American investor and founder of PayPal and the analytics company Palantir.

Palantir offers analytics and surveillance software that is primarily used by governments and intelligence agencies, positively viewed as a tool to counter terrorism, negatively as a means of mass surveillance.

Due to political pressure and because numerous artists had canceled their participation in the festival over Thiel, the festival has now canceled the discussion event with Peter Thiel after having invited him. Cancel culture.

I think the cancellation is a shame, as it would have been an interesting discussion, even if one doesn’t share Thiel’s views, Thiel is undeniably a very influential entrepreneur and investor whose companies also operate in the EU.

What do you think of the cancellation? Justified, or is it the Festival’s “woke bubble” that doesn’t allow for differing views?

The interesting part isn't that Saylor sold — it's that he wanted the disclosure to be deliberate and controlled. That's consistent with someone who manages billions in institutional capital, not a retail whale dumping into an exit.

What I'm watching is whether this is portfolio rebalancing (MicroStrategy has been running an ATM program) or a signal that BTC as a corporate treasury asset has peaked in its current form. The fact that Saylor explicitly controlled the narrative around this sale tells me he's still bullish on the asset class — just maybe not on the premium MSTR commanded over NAV.

Either way, this is the first real test of the 'Bitcoin is a corporate reserve asset' thesis since the ETFs launched. If MSTR's bitcoin holdings can absorb this without structural damage, that's actually a good sign for BTC as an institutional asset.

body.title: Huawei Qiankun ADS technology has been integrated into vehicles, and the Dongfeng eπ M7 will be unveiled in May. - BitAuto Global
body.body:
## دمج تقنية Huawei Qiankun للقيادة الذاتية في المركبات وتقديم Dongfeng eπ M7 في مايو  

### مقدمة  
في خطوة تُظهر تسارع تبني حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي المتقدمة في قطاع النقل، أعلنت شركة Huawei عن توظيف منصتها **Qiankun ADS** (القيادة الذاتية الذكية) في سلسلة من السيارات التجريبية. وفي الوقت نفسه، كشفت شركة Dongfeng عن موعد إطلاق نموذجها الكهربائي المتقدم **eπ M7**، المقرر عرضه في مايو القادم. الجانبان يشكلان مظهرًا واضحًا للتقارب المتزايد بين مزودي التكنولوجيا المتخصصة ومصنعي السيارات، ما قد يُعيد صياغة معادلة التنقل الذكي في الصين والعالم.

### ما هي تقنية Qiankun ADS؟  
Qiankun هي بنية متكاملة تضم ثلاثة محاور رئيسية:

| المكوّن | الوظيفة |
|--------|----------|
| **المستشعرات المتعددة** | دمج LiDAR،Radar،كاميرات عالية الدقة، ومستشعرات دقيقة للبيئة المحيطة. |
| **المعالجة السحابية والمحلية** | خوارزميات تعلم عميق تستند إلى منصة Huawei Cloud، مع قدرة تشغيل وقتية على وحدة التحكم في السيارة (ECU). |
| **نظام اتخاذ القرار** | أساسيات القيادة الذاتية المستوى 3‑4 مع تحسينات للسلامة الفورية وتكيّف سلوكيات السائق. |

ما يميز Qiankun عن حلول منافسيها هو تركيز Huawei على **المرونة البرمجية** وتكامل **شبكة 5G** لتقليل زمن الاستجابة وتوفير تحديثات OTA (Over‑The‑Air) بصورة سلسة. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، تستفيد المنصة من خبرة Huawei في **معالجة البيانات الضخمة**، ما يسمح للسيارة بالتعلم المستمر من القواعد المرورية المتغيرة والظروف المناخية المتقلبة.

### تأثير الدمج على سوق السيارات الذكية بالصين  
1. **تسريع دورة الابتكار**: التعاون مع Huawei يتيح لمصنعي السيارات الاعتماد على بنية تحتية تقنية مرفوعة المستوى دون الحاجة لتطوير حلول داخلية مكلفة.  
2. **تحسين الثقة التنظيمية**: الدعم من شركة تملك سجلًا موثوقًا في معايير الأمان والاتصالات يعزز فرص الحصول على تصاريح التشغيل للقيادة الذاتية من الجهات الصينية.  
3. **تعزيز تنافسية الشركات المحلية**: مع تصاعد حضور العلامات التجارية الأجنبية (مثل Tesla وVolkswagen) في سوق السيارات الكهربائية، يصبح التميز التكنولوجي عنصرًا حاسمًا للعلامات الصينية مثل Dongfeng.

### Dongfeng eπ M7: ما هو الجديد؟  
يُتوقع أن يحمل النموذج eπ M7 مميزات تجعل منه نقطة ارتكاز لفئة السيارات الفاخرة الكهربائية في الصين:

- **مدى قيادة**: يقدر المصنعون أن يصل إلى **550 كيلومتر** بشحنة واحدة، بفضل بطاريات عالية الكثافة من سلسلة **Huawei Smart Battery**.  
- **قوة محركية**: مُزوَّد بمحرك كهربائي مزدوج يولد **350 حصان** مع عزم فوري يُمكّن السيارة من الانطلاق من 0 إلى 100 كم/س في أقل من **4.5 ثانية**.  
- **تكامل Qiankun ADS**: ستُطبَّق نسخة مخصَّصة من النظام لتقديم وظائف **المستوى 3** (القيادة شبه الذاتية) داخل المدن الذكية، مع إمكانية الترقية إلى **المستوى 4** عبر تحديثات برمجية مستقبلية.  
- **تصميم داخلي**: واجهة تفاعلية تعتمد على **Huawei Mobile Services (HMS)**، مما يسمح بالتحكم الصوتي، وربط الأجهزة الذكية المنزلية، وتجربة مريحة بفضل نظام تكييف ذكي يتفاعل مع بيانات الطقس الفعلية.

### لماذا يهم هذا الإعلان للمستثمرين والمهتمين بالبلوكشين؟  
إن دمج حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي المتقدمة في بنية السيارات يُعيد تعريف قيم الأصول الرقمية المرتبطة بقطاع النقل. من منظور **Hive blockchain**، يمكن تصور سيناريوهات حيث تُسجَّل بيانات الرحلات، واستهلاك الطاقة، وسجلات الصيانة على السلسلة، ما يُخلق سجلاً غير قابل للتلاعب يُسهل:

- **تقييم الأصول**: تمكين منصات التمويل اللامركزي (DeFi) من تقديم قروض مضمونة مقابل بيانات تشغيلية موثوقة.  
- **تحفيز السلوك المستدام**: من خلال نظام مكافآت يعتمد على توكنات Hive لتشجيع السائقين على استخدام المسارات الأكثر كفاءة أو تقليل استهلاك الطاقة.  
- **سوق البيانات**: بيع أو تأجير بيانات البيئات الحضرية بشكل آمن ومجهول، مما يفتح فرصًا جديدة للشركات الناشئة في مجال المدن الذكية.

### التحديات المتوقعة  
- **الإجراءات التنظيمية**: ما زالت السلطات الصينية تُجري تجارب قياسية للقيادة الذاتية؛ أي تأخير في الموافقة قد يؤثر على جدولة الإصدارات.  
- **نشر البنية التحتية 5G**: رغم التقدم السريع، لا يزال هناك فجوات في تغطية الشبكات عالية السرعة في بعض المناطق الريفية.  
- **المنافسة**: شركات مثل Baidu Apollo وTencent Autonomous Driving تسابق Huawei في شراكات مشابهة؛ لذا سيتعين على Huawei وDongfeng المحافظة على حافة الابتكار عبر تحسين الخوارزميات وتوسيع قاعدة البيانات.

### خاتمة  
إن إعلان Huawei عن دمج منصة Qiankun ADS في السيارات وتحديد موعد كشف Dongfeng eπ M7 في مايو لا يمثل مجرد حدث تسويقي؛ بل هو إشارة واضحة إلى تحول جذري في الطريقة التي تُصنَّع وتُدار بها المركبات الذكية. للمهتمين بالبلوكشين، يمثل هذا التكامل فرصة لتقريب تقنيات السجلات الموزعة من عالم النقل، مما يفتح آفاقًا جديدة للتمويل اللامركزي، ومكافآت السلوك المستدام، وتداول البيانات الحيوية.  

المراقبة المستمرة لتطورات هذه الشراكة ستكون محورية للصحفيين والمستثمرين على حد سواء، إذ ستحدد ما إذا كانت الصين ستقود مرحلة جديدة من **التحول الرقمي للسيارات** على مستوى العالم.

*

*Screen shot from Coinmarketcap*

While it is always fun to *watch,* I've learned not to pay much attention to these events, as an indicator of *anything.*

Whenever one of these *\

* events take place, there's always a chorus of voices suggesting that these people should use their Hive accounts for something other than *pump-and-dump* games.

Frankly, I don't think these folks even *have* Hive accounts.

Remember, you can hold Hive on a centralized exchange without ever even knowing what Hive *is.*

Speculation and day trading does not require anyone to know anything about the security/crypto they are trading!

![CCP-000-Considers.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curatorcat.pal/Eqb2xeGPahB99LSEN4vYthJ55yRRgTqxbmVvwfrGeB6Kn4SismXtN4hLmJUUdjTn3xK.JPG)

I remember this quite well from my own days *(in the distant past)* of day trading tech stocks.

While I definitely knew what Dell, Gateway, IBM, Iomega and others *were,* I had zero vested interest in those companies or their products. I was mostly interested in their stocks because of their daily *volatility. I was just watching *\
* and acting accordingly, sometimes making several thousand dollars in a matter of 30 minutes... and that was pretty much *\
*\n\nI guess my point here is that I just want to say to those questioners: *\

*

They are operating in a whole different world from those of us who are here as content creators *(and consumers)*, committed to Hive in the long run. I am not saying this to rain on anyone's sunshine, just to kick in a *reality check.*

Naturally, I do hope we end up enjoying a sustained rise in the price of Hive, but I just don't think it's going to come from these sporadic moonshots.

body.title: Another trip to Oleron Island (part 2) - Lightpainting on Hive
body.body:
Hello,

As I live close to the ocean, I have instant access to a lot of beautiful islands on the atlantic coast. A friend of mine has a holiday mansion on one of them and we have the habit to meet there a couple of times a year to spend good time together and celebrate.

As May 1st is a day-off in France (National Labor Day), I drove my way to Oleron Island. As we found many abandoned buildings there in January, we took a couple of hours to do a lightpainting session in one of them.

![_MG_1375.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dawnoner/23tSKwQbtxQbpHwiMcmq4VZR4vgnwAiofFWVohtNEJAbyUYJbJot8SxefwY7qFZtrRFeh.jpg)
<center>338s 20mm f/6.3 100 ISO</center>

![_MG_1378.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dawnoner/23tvCfHQ1cKWKmtBB9cJUjT2zj91dgHWpccP7T36HRWhDVcGcaQyBcrfHK8ZQUHw8pWqy.jpg)
<center>400s 16mm f/4 200 ISO</center>

![_MG_1376.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dawnoner/23tmBh2rbYj7kQd6o9FTJm3p7dzX3v6Vc7mnKkmbtLGu8yWyvgkHqc6H7dLFuQo2J94uF.jpg)
<center>328s 20mm f/6.3 100 ISO</center>

I had a sore knee so walking in this kind of environnement was a bit tricky but it was worthy 😎

Lightpainting created in real time, captured to the camera in single photographic frames. SOOC
No layers /no Photoshop / no editing except minor adjustments (lens correction profite, WB, contrast (+12)) and addition of my logo.

Gear :
Canon EOS 6D body
Canon EF 16-35mm f/4L IS II USM lens
Canon RC-E6 IR remote 
Zomei carbon tripod

May 2026

![Small Orange Divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lightpaintershub/EqQRymroVQGs2UcR1yGuXSx28smWccGYDQBnhkV4Savw1DL738xeitn5bbmiRMydoWx.png)

<center>**WHAT IS LIGHTPAINTING?**</center>
Lightpainting is a photographic technique in which exposures are made by moving a hand-held light source while taking a long exposure photograph, either to illuminate a subject or to shine a point of light directly at the camera, or by moving the camera itself during exposure. Nothing is added or removed in post processing.

<center>**Single exposure Light Art Photography
/nolayer /notricks /nophotoshop**</center>

![Divider 5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lightpaintershub/23xVEcaSEcACVXNajKEE1o7WZT8waYwyX6Frn2zscPzosaSbEdJNBkXsmkramYTrnHH9q.png)

title.title: XLM Smashes XRP in Savage Rally: Stellar Blasts Towards 100% Gains on Historic Wall Street DTCC Integration
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSZE3cdjJpbvJ4AW3CC7PjL3A1jENgcYZcoAn8nQLFhNz/xlmxrp.png 


The cryptocurrency market has just witnessed an aggressive tactical divergence, with Stellar’s native asset, XLM, registering an exponential rally that heavily outpaces its historical counterpart, XRP, as well as Bitcoin. This macroeconomic macro-shift is directly attributed to a fundamental development involving the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), the financial behemoth underpinning the core market infrastructure of the United States. The DTCC has finalized plans to utilize the public Stellar blockchain network for its Digital Custody Trust (DTC) tokenization infrastructure, targeting a structured rollout within the first half of 2027.

This infrastructure integration is significantly distinct from the standard, superficial \

(RWA) marketing hype frequently observed in digital asset ecosystems. Under this cleared regulatory framework—which originally obtained an SEC no-action letter in late 2025—the platform is designed to process regulated tokenized versions of institutional-grade securities, including Russell 1000 equities, major exchange-traded funds (ETFs), and U.S. Treasury instruments.\n\nFrom an empirical data perspective, the market reacted with immense volatility. XLM's price experienced a single-day appreciation of roughly 30% to 50%, localizing multi-month highs near the $0.218 to $0.224 horizontal threshold. This price appreciation resulted in massive liquidation metrics across derivative markets. Quantitative data indicates that a crowded short trade heavily catalyzed this upward expansion. The Open Interest (OI) parameter nearly doubled to $292.11 million, while the OI-weighted funding rates collapsed into deeply negative territory, hovering around -0.0270%. This architectural divergence confirms that a textbook \

occurred, wherein bears holding heavy leveraged positions were systematically forced into market buy-backs to close out failing risk.

While retail sentiment on sentiment aggregation engines like Stocktwits remains aggressively bullish due to XLM’s lower valuation profile relative to XRP's $81.98 billion market cap, high-level professional scrutiny dictates extreme risk mitigation. Historically, XLM possesses a documented structural pattern of fading news-driven expansions; its November 2024 political rally and July 2025 institutional upgrade both culminated in catastrophic retracements of 68.6% and 73.8% respectively. Currently, the asset is testing a heavily clustered long-term resistance corridor bounded by the 50-week, 100-week, and 200-week Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs) between $0.198 and $0.228. Failure to print a clean structural close above this zone risks a swift mean reversion toward the primary liquidity support zone at $0.143 to $0.150.

title.title: El que te guarda
title.body:
<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://images.pexels.com/photos/34234384/pexels-photo-34234384.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
[LINK](https://images.pexels.com/photos/34234384/pexels-photo-34234384.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)</center>

## No estas solo en esto

Ayer reflexionabamos sobre como Dios es nuestro protector, y nos quedamos en el versiculo 3 del Salmo 121. Hoy el salmista sigue desarrollando esa idea y la lleva un paso mas alla: Dios no solo nos sostiene, tambien nos guarda constantemente.

> He aqui, no se adormecera ni dormira el que guarda a Israel. Jehova es tu guardador; Jehova es tu sombra a tu mano derecha.
> Salmo 121:4-5

Que imagen poderosa. Dios no duerme. No tiene pausas, no toma vacaciones, no cierra los ojos un segundo. Su vigilancia es permanente. Y no es una vigilancia distante, fria, desde lejos. Es una presencia cercana: \

. Como cuando caminamos al sol y alguien se pone a nuestro lado para darnos sombra. Asi de cerca esta Dios de nosotros.

> El sol no te fatigara de dia, ni la luna de noche. Jehova te guardara de todo mal; El guardara tu alma.
> Salmo 121:6-7

El sol representa los peligros visibles, los que vemos venir. La luna representa los peligros ocultos, los que acechan en la oscuridad, los que no esperamos. Dios nos guarda de ambos. No hay amenaza que escape a su cuidado, ya sea evidente o disimulada.

Y el versiculo 7 es una promesa hermosa: \

. No solo tu cuerpo, no solo tus circunstancias. Tu alma. Lo mas profundo de tu ser esta bajo su cuidado.

> Jehova guardara tu salida y tu entrada desde ahora y para siempre.
> Salmo 121:8

Nuestro Protector nos acompania en cada paso. En cada salida, en cada entrada. Ayer, hoy, mañana, siempre. No es un cuidado temporal, es eterno.

*****
*******

*Muchas Gracias por compartir esta lectura, deseo que el Espiritu Santo de Dios traiga revelacion de su palabra a nuestras vidas.*

<center>![](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYH4hAwopGmcAs8LgkwPjZ16zjiUAzunvLxFfFWRpGGfr/image.png)</center>

vivamos por la palabra de Dios
</center>

title.title: June: Remembering GOOD Things!
title.body:
Even though it's — tangibly speaking — a pretty arbitrary shift from one day to the next, the fact that we have entered the month of June somehow made me feel more positive about life, when I got up this morning.

![1130-Shasta4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23vYQBWB1KmWwVXP5D8GDgDP4kbAcUTiyiszVGZW6KBTzek66bNQxwvJ9tLQJeZHzveps.jpg)

That feeling made me think about the ways in which we attribute positive connotations to things based on our memories from similar situations.

June was almost always a good month pretty much throughout my childhood and subsequently a substantial part of my adulthood.

June meant that school was going to be out, and chances were that I would get to go stay with my auntie for several weeks — if not a month or more — and it was a whole different and more loving lifestyle than I was used to at home. It also meant that I got to pretty much live in nature... helping out with the garden or helping out by cutting firewood and cleaning up around the forested area in the property.

It was also positive in the sense that my auntie treated me like *an actual human being,* rather than a fancy piece of furniture to be moved around, at will.

In retrospect, I was definitely very blessed to spend a fair amount of my childhood and youth on a remote country property with 24 acres of land around it. Part of the joy was that life *slowed down* while I was there, because my auntie basically hated being rushed and she was very much an introvert just like I am.

![0936-MockOrange.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/denmarkguy/23wMcXJKcR81LRQuDu3GWKqW8t4NfooNseCTNBLwDrLzsUPmp3T8TtgM8Z2LMLA49YopU.JPG)

After University, during the years I had my import export business and store, June was always one of the busiest months *(other than December)* and so I felt good about the fact that business was good. There was something *hopeful* about it, a sense that what I was doing was actually worthwhile.

Of course, I have retained my youthful love of nature and gardening and so I still look forward to June and the summer because it is the time of the year when I get to be outside and we *grow things.*

And it's strawberry season!

Occasionally, I have more specific little snippets dance through my mind... like that very special feeling of riding my bike home after midnight when *\
* on a clear day means nothing more than *\

* because the sun is only a few degrees below the horizon. Sometimes there would be ghostly ground fogs in the hollows, giving the dusky landscape an otherworldly feeling.

title.body:
If there's one thing we're all still entitled to, it's our own opinions—although, here in Europe, governments seem increasingly keen to police even these.

I grew up in some of the roughest parts of Dublin and  knew plenty of Rogers and Jacks . If I thought for a moment that these boys were deterred by government or the law, I'd  be first in line at the ballot box but experience has proved to me otherwise.  I won't bore you with stories of our local men trying to protect their neighbourhoods only to find the authorities taking Roger and Jack's side, or of people being pursued more vigorously for their political affiliations than for acts of  violence, for, as you say, our world view is shaped by experience, and mine has convinced me that Roger and Jack rarely pay much attention to government or the law.  
So no apologies necessary. Mutual respect is far more important and I think *we* do have that.

* * *

**Starlink and the potential countdown for a market cooldown**

There have likely never been more regulations changed for an IPO than for this hype stock with its famous CEO. Likewise, there has never been a stock with a higher valuation at its debut. The world seems to be falling apart, if you glance at the news and economic data, but the stock markets are partying non-stop.

However, a potential date for a cooldown of all this could occur approximately 60 days after the launch of this stock. Thanks to the new regulations, insiders who got in at a much lower price will be able to dump their positions back onto the market, instead of waiting the usual 180 days.

Thanks also to passive investments in ETFs and the like, the stock is set to be catapulted towards Mars, because every month, funds flow largely into the SpaceX stock. Valuations seem to no longer matter at all, and the hype alone feeds the hype. But we now have a potential date for a crash, and when insiders cash out and retail traders start crying, then it might be time to buy a one-way ticket heading South.

* * *

### 1\. Valuation and Entry Risk

> **Huge expectations vs. real numbers**

*   **Highest level**: SpaceX is aiming for a valuation of **$1.75 trillion** – almost as much as Apple or Microsoft.
    
*   **No more growth returns**: Early investors in Tesla or Amazon made thousands of percent – with SpaceX, you enter directly at the trillion-dollar level.
    
*   **Excessive multiples**: SpaceX is valued at 110 times its revenue (more expensive than Palantir).
    

* * *

### 2\. Earnings Weakness: Users are becoming less valuable

> **More customers – but each pays less**

Starlink und der mögliche Countdown für eine Abkühlung am Markt
===============================================================

Es wurden wohl niemals mehr Regularien geändert für ein IPO wie bei dieser Hypeaktie mit ihren berühmten CEO. Ebenfalls gab es auch nie eine Aktie die höher bewertet war zu ihrem Erscheinen. Die Welt geht gerade unter so könnte man meinen wenn man die Nachrichten und Wirtschaftszahlen mal überfliegt aber die Aktienmärkte feiern Party ohne Pause.

Ein mögliches Datum für eine Abkühlung von dem ganzen könnte aber ungefähr 60 Tage nach Start dieser Aktie eintreten. Dank der neuen Regularien ist es möglich dass sie Insider die zu einem weitaus geringeren Preis eingestiegen sind ihre Position wieder auf den Markt schmeißen, anstatt die regulären 180 Tage abzuwarten.

Auch dank passiven Investments in ETFs und Co soll die Aktie Richtung Mars geschleudert werden, denn jeden Monat fließen hier Gelder zu einem großen Teil in die SpaceX Aktie. Bewertungen haben keinerlei Bedeutung mehr so wie es aussieht und allein der Hype füttert den Hype. Ein mögliches Datum für einen Crash haben wir aber nun erfahren und wenn Insider Kasse machen und die Retail Trader das Weinen anfangen, dann ist es Zeit eventuell eine Fahrkarte Richtung Süden zu lösen.

We need to be prepared for more downside, guys. The next major support sits in the $60–63k range, which was the previous low of this correction.

Do I think we’ll fall below $60k? It’s possible. Do I think we’ll drop into the $40k range? Very unlikely, in my opinion.

Their fur is pale silver-gray, darkening to charcoal at the extremities, and carries a faint static charge at all times. The fur crackles audibly and produces brief, visible arcs of electricity between the guard hairs. In the Machair's wet, low-lying marshlands, the effect intensifies considerably.

Lightning foxes generate electricity through specialized cells called electrocytes, distributed in dense clusters beneath the skin along the spine, flanks, and tail.

title.body:
我一直琢磨着给老大找一个适合他练习英语的工具或软件，偶然在网上，发现了一款这样的软件，如下图，


![000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTVfodsSVWs2d6RM4M2cPEL9E7diEd654Hsqrj8EHXDJi/000.png)

![001.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQLKr1PVf27ec76vsLFKKs7aoqXw5FHrvjTLzxbdPYWqx/001.png)

![002.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZp8DNfgj4fdxNxe2j2zGY8A7Tq1wwtVPb4qRSzvL76UX/002.png)

![003.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcJMKX4bV4a857UuPWXkiqRVfED3zpBE6LkuasjLcVPPr/003.png)

看了下，目前还没有windows版本，但手机版本ios和安卓倒是有的，于是下载下来试下。


![04-01.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfZpw295RLmSLiATTUYFgCDWSXmtCMmTmX7gdxKi7G7kn/04-01.jpg)

点击进入后试下。

分个盲听和看字幕两种方式，随时可以切换显示字幕。

![04-02.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmakeGH3dfZ6qDKaN5LTLTegD315KqkCTPAg2v3675cfJN/04-02.jpg)

![04-03.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPeCwp1QPtWtXmo1eqpR66wdUEEB721eooXd1ASnzHC4J/04-03.jpg)

有没有适合小学生的音频学习呢？

答案自然是有，在合集里添加即可。

![06-01.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd7LGN6sS5m1oDZMqhVaw3NaQto7HsiuM2kQ7HY6vsKgC/06-01.jpg)

![05-02.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcXjeWVUR1KpcvachUdMQengBLgtcKvTCumxBy6Bpg4Tt/05-02.jpg)

![05-03.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQMfq2MpjhPyNGJ7ythQLYMCXoxGAPavSkiyhF8wbGwWg/05-03.jpg)

![05-04.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY7z4SYz41yxL6bEtuXhRXq4cb8i8fHTooCQ87QKRiop6/05-04.jpg)

![05-05.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTcGfZYQuCJGPWZ6dawcArbTHdqvdcfpZjfhE1r49LKHB/05-05.jpg)

不仅有适合小学生，中学生、大学生，还有适合成人学英语，旅游等。

将你要学习的合集添加；

![06-02.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUVufcMz34vEnaZFGNdQR5X6j32RwyZzUTnVLomxeZQzh/06-02.jpg)

每（初）次学习时，会自动下载到你手机里。

![06-03.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRZgY99bFnrkDAejna1PtR18ZUM2mvrddLiZqC61gyPDK/06-03.jpg)


![06-04.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR6JKjRibb3pou8tEhXMvywp3cx749DvwiRTkq8Mi8UWs/06-04.jpg)


![07-01.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSctJxY4AdvdMYsb2umswj3ojHT6LEn1KnEZ44TDMcE3s/07-01.jpg)

不仅如此，还可以自行上传音频，通过AI自动添加字幕，这个功能很好，可以将一些绘本的音频加进来。


![08-01.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXKHQ3FPDLmVP3uuSRcNUQuLMX1ov2kxga3DibpGhQUhg/08-01.jpg)

![08-02.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQPq6CTLM4Fp9NpttELhE9XNssLm2n8Cv3MoNr7xBHtLJ/08-02.jpg)

![08-03.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZoaNCi4cLaqrJp4gBfj5utjRvMRtoq9aGXEohdvbpmk2/08-03.jpg)

比如我将这篇《穿靴子的猫》加进来了。

通过自带的AI，自动加上字幕，很方便。

有点小遗憾的是，自带的AI每次最多只能转15分钟，超过这个长度的音频，需要自己分割后再转。

不知道这个软件孩子用起来如何？我自己倒是觉得挺不错的，打算让孩子试下先。:)

title.title: 1 June 2026 @marinnewest's Freewrite Writing Prompt Day 3121 : Spill Your Guts
title.body:
![1000767901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ubglo17/23u5tRDu69iRxeVvTQcfbhAuGPCwde82yT2N5wiaJxJgoweJeHsnLhnBJo1jEWuasS1Tg.jpg)[source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/person-holding-a-ceramic-cup-spilling-drink-10774217)


This is my post on #freewriters3121 #dailyprompt spill your guts hosted by @marinnewest's.

The midday sun scorched the red earth of Anambra, but Emeka didn’t flinch. He stood perfectly still, his eyes locked onto the horizon where the dusty road met the sky. Beside him, Adamma clutched a woven basket of kola nuts, her knuckles white, her breath shallow. They were waiting.
​\
Adamma whispered, her voice barely audible over the distant hum of a motorbike.\n​\
Emeka replied, his voice a low, steady rumble. \

​They were engaged in a silent, agonizing standoff with their future. For weeks, they had planned this confrontation, a moment to settle an ancestral land dispute that had haunted their families for generations. To yield now was to lose everything—their dignity, their lineage, their foothold in the village.
​Sweat beaded on Emeka’s forehead, tracing a path down his weathered skin, but he refused to reach up and wipe it away. He stood like an Iroko tree, rooted and unyielding. Adamma mirrored his posture, her gaze unwavering. The village square grew quiet around them, the usual chatter of market women and playful children fading as if the very air had thickened with their tension.
​When the dust finally settled and the village elders emerged from the shade of the ancient mango tree, Emeka didn't flinch. He tightened his grip on his resolve. Their guts held firm, their silence speaking volumes louder than any plea. The battle for their heritage had begun, and they were ready.

title.title: Trump vs Netanyahu: When Even the Closest Allies Begin to Disagree
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVvF1rY4wktTKf7DyJmLjyXhYqKwqRLFEJn95FGpyWW7X/1000714265.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ16ihv2yvZXkADMi3E5TRzfJpPjUYTMeEzJarRQNBcdq/1000714263.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcqnWQtNh2iJKFPBoPxDrSynVsvkGPW729c9chT1eab6n/1000714267.jpg 
For decades, the relationship between the United States and Israel has been considered one of the strongest alliances in modern geopolitics.
That is why recent reports suggesting that President Donald Trump became furious during a phone call with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu immediately attracted global attention.
According to multiple media reports, Trump was reportedly angered by Israel's military actions in Lebanon and expressed his frustration in unusually strong language. While details of the conversation remain based on media sources rather than an official transcript, the reports have raised an important question:
What happens when even the closest allies start losing patience with each other?
The answer could have consequences far beyond Washington and Tel Aviv.

**Why Did Trump Reportedly Lose His Temper?**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSS89LnKafL2HGCzw9GxowbY2eEiAvTCLD7NCWud4oGTw/1000714269.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNVdVQYSGJJjLin2mAQB2AhSbys6pEf5sNtSbE8SW5p1E/1000714271.jpg 
Reports indicate that Trump's frustration was linked to concerns that Israel's military operations could undermine ongoing diplomatic efforts in the region.
At a time when tensions involving Iran, Lebanon, Hezbollah, and Israel remain extremely high, any major escalation carries significant risks.
From Washington's perspective, an expanding conflict could make negotiations more difficult and increase the possibility of a wider regional war.
Even countries that maintain strong alliances do not always agree on strategy.
History has shown that allies can share common goals while disagreeing on how those goals should be achieved.
If the reports are accurate, Trump's reaction may reflect concerns that military actions are moving faster than diplomatic efforts can keep up.

**A Sign of Growing Frustration or Just a Temporary Disagreement?**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNS3iMcBQV6x5UnNjWAHrMgBf111B88HoufPaKNedKZgK/1000714275.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYq2GsHGGXXjSKiVRxDrBhZ5AUAdfhUjrhVs8fF95j8QZ/1000714273.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPXBhEvSF5EbRFmUGfLJYhAjCCGtaG536J4CuRqwRD3gA/1000714277.jpg 
The important question is whether this incident represents a temporary disagreement or something more significant.
The United States and Israel have experienced policy differences before.
Different administrations have often disagreed with Israeli leaders over settlements, military operations, and regional diplomacy.
However, public reports of unusually harsh language between leaders naturally attract attention because they suggest that tensions may be rising behind closed doors.
Still, it would be premature to assume that the alliance itself is weakening.
Both countries continue to share deep strategic, military, and political ties.
The more realistic interpretation may be that both sides are trying to balance security concerns with growing international pressure for stability.

**Why The Global Economy Is Watching**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTPEhZBf4k5yyhhXBDpUmo88Z262t87kpDYYZYQeYTxsG/1000714283.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQgU5hkkYu2xmgfZHkoXvCadeex1DFD8iuMBnDo6uNmx1/1000714281.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc3aeU5kCV5QqANFiMee6GpuTSvTV77WwfwkGY8CrVxWf/1000714289.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYxpEBdiubkwHiuWF1NmRNdqBfiEnZ9wzCwu4cZdvNzNA/1000714287.jpg 
Many people may wonder why a political disagreement in the Middle East matters to the rest of the world.
The answer is simple:
Energy.
The Middle East remains one of the most important regions for global oil production and transportation.
Whenever geopolitical tensions rise, markets immediately begin calculating potential risks.
Investors worry about:
disruptions to energy supplies,
higher shipping costs,
inflation,
and slower economic growth.
Even before any actual disruption occurs, uncertainty itself can push prices higher.
And when oil prices rise, the effects eventually reach consumers through transportation, food, and everyday goods.

**Gold, Crypto, and Investor Psychology**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPHU8PM1ztzr15hvBtjdBcTvCFtGyEBGXkuM4fwvJmH6V/1000714291.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRCAj32sukKM8pTdxmcpgLo61E7WEYXF3MRY8YgidiZ4f/1000714293.jpg 
Periods of geopolitical uncertainty often influence investor behavior.
When confidence weakens, many investors seek assets perceived as safer.
Historically, gold has served this role during times of international instability.
Cryptocurrencies can also experience increased attention, although they remain more volatile and unpredictable.
The most important factor is often not the actual event itself but how people react to it.
Markets move on expectations.
And expectations are heavily influenced by confidence, fear, and uncertainty.
That is why even a single diplomatic dispute between major leaders can generate headlines across financial media worldwide.

**The Bigger Risk: Regional Escalation**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQxJgA5mstn4iiPSp6ATUQugScD8Gma3U4brpfJwjLQjY/1000714297.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUSnSxvVmEno9oXCYuXwx7vR9DjM5ozZgcDYSHtrXmvtp/1000714295.jpg 
The greatest concern is not an argument between leaders.
The greatest concern is what that argument represents.
The Middle East remains one of the world's most sensitive geopolitical regions.
Any escalation involving Israel, Lebanon, Hezbollah, or Iran has the potential to affect neighboring countries and draw additional actors into the conflict.
Diplomacy exists precisely to prevent these situations from spiraling out of control.
When diplomatic efforts become strained, the risk of misunderstanding and miscalculation increases.
And history shows that many major conflicts began with smaller crises that were not properly contained.
**What Should Ordinary People Pay Attention To?**
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSHxFskWiDfuDfzzH6P39Za4v6KAJ9uZKc8iJkso1DuET/1000714303.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcYuFXs4AP5GSLYfhX9zUfYSKQp2YJ7xM9Q7KEzRsenno/1000714301.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW6xwzeaYJBziYT9Sv2ZNyUjjiseFpDNSNW7EdRDeBfnA/1000714307.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTjqR92TeDuHAuQbZ78Xcs4o6z1tqWUvQENnoSis9BaXR/1000714299.jpg 
For ordinary people, the key issue is not the political drama itself.
It is the potential economic consequences.
If tensions continue rising, people should monitor:
Oil prices.
Inflation trends.
Global market reactions.
Gold and safe-haven assets.
Supply chain disruptions.
Staying informed is often more valuable than reacting emotionally to headlines.
Many geopolitical crises create temporary market volatility, but some eventually develop into larger economic challenges.
Understanding the difference is essential.

**Final Thoughts**

Reports of Donald Trump's anger toward Benjamin Netanyahu may ultimately prove to be a temporary diplomatic disagreement.
Or they may become an early warning sign of deeper tensions surrounding the future of the Middle East.
What makes this story important is not the strong language reportedly used during a private conversation.
It is what that frustration may reveal about the growing challenges facing diplomacy in an increasingly unstable region.
As investors, policymakers, and ordinary citizens continue watching developments unfold, one thing remains clear:
When even close allies begin expressing frustration, the world pays attention.
Because sometimes the most important geopolitical signals are not found on the battlefield, but in the conversations taking place behind closed doors.

title.title: Lifestyle
title.body:
First impression is the last impression. In the world, people noticed each other Alot like their dressing sense, communication skills, personality etc.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWPTmFHNLcZPbVxtujhMxYBB8N8NyZnXj1gruwPKSxg6D/1780388448264.jpg)

Personality is not just about looks, it reflects our habits. Habits create a long lasting impression on others. It defines our personality. It matters alot in today's world.
Once upon a time, I remembered that I was in a bank with my uncle, there I saw people are treated according to their personality, if you are well dressed then you are politely otherwise bad behavior.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZNCDCEDqbkj8z4J6GWzjKyEQhzsNL6TEtgGcnDVcnryk/1780388488975.jpg)

The main purposes of university is grooming of youth. I am university student, in childhood I doesn't know about the what is dressing sense, it matters or not but later when I came to university I learned a lot and try to improve myself.
A clean appearance, watch or a good fragrance reflects self respect. It increases confidence of a person. These things trained us for the practical life.
We should work on ourselves. Too much expensive clothes doesn't matter only clean appearance matters. These small choices shape our lifestyle and image. For our lifestyle, managing time and staying organized is necessary.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUoNaAi2fZhqb7b3YuByPMCB3USWDiNY2YPTk7GWUga4f/1780388509463.jpg)

Looking at my watch always remind me the value of time. I like fragrances alot.
A strong personality cannot be created in a single day, but it can be built by small daily actions, good habits and a mindset focused on growth.

title.title: Green park, Noakhali, Bangladesh
title.body:
​
![IMG_20260601_202818.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTWreRFrGtSmRECZrpS2c6usHEgajDXiDVqRX3ZJGGN1p/IMG_20260601_202818.jpg)

<div class=\

>

( pictures together) 

Assalamu Alaikum.  how are you  Today I will share with you some pictures of a park and give details about the park.

Green park of Noakhali is a popular entertainment and family outing place in Noakhali. Various rides and children's play facilities, paddle boats and, boat rides nagardolas, amusement rides with bumper cars flower gardens and green surroundings Picnic spot. Beautiful place to spend time with family and friends. Illumination at night.

Green Park is located in Barogaon area of ​​Noakhali district, next to B151 road. It falls in Noakhali District of Chittagong Division.


![IMG-20260601-WA0006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYhsKEaCo4g7UBFKgVWdNcPxBZE49y1hEfoEhy9jtH6GZ/IMG-20260601-WA0006.jpg)

(the first  signboard) 

The signboard of Green Park has been made in the middle of the road so that tourists do not mistake their destination here. People come from far away, some may know the place and some may not know the place, so this signboard is very useful for strangers. 

As it is large and on the main road, it is easily visible to people and no one gets lost. Again the signboard is very useful to enhance the beauty of the park.

![IMG-20260601-WA0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTGZazvxo5qufDeDz2pXeAYBWkUT7X9hJ9gx1AAcsxGy7/IMG-20260601-WA0000.jpg)

(Park gate)

This is the entrance or gate of the Green Park. This gate is as beautiful as it is to look at. It attracts tourists. If the first presentation of something is good, people are more interested in it. 

The entrance of the park attracts tourists and many people take pictures of themselves and their loved ones in front of the park gate. The gate enhances the beauty and dignity of the park and gives a warm welcome to incoming tourists.

![IMG-20260601-WA0012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdezCc95E68ByyFuarkF9nVDjmw2BtL2u96bZy3UphPWz/IMG-20260601-WA0012.jpg)

(Elephant sculpture) 

There is a very large elephant sculpture in front of Green Park even though the elephant is an animal. It is a very beautiful elephant sculpture outside the animal park to enhance the beauty of the park and increase the tourist attraction. 

Everyone, young and old, takes pictures with this elephant sculpture to keep as a memory. The elephant sculpture doubles the beauty of the entrance to the park.

![IMG-20260601-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSTbrJRaEMwYhhg2DQebxsXuwNPWfLGtoPmumT4S3F5YZ/IMG-20260601-WA0001.jpg)

( ticket counter) 

Tickets are required to enter the green park. Tickets are priced at Tk 100 per person which means one has to purchase a ticket at Tk 100 to enter.

 Children aged one to five years do not need any cricket or any other expenses. The ticket counter has to be purchased from here. The ticket counter is very well constructed. And it is built outside the park next to the park.

![IMG-20260601-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc1JXaBvZLS6636Abzp7AjXeJCj1B5VmmZxxCPoYB7azG/IMG-20260601-WA0002.jpg)

(ticket)

We four went for a walk.  As two of them were under the age of one to five years, they didn't need tickets, we needed two tickets. Here are two tickets.

![f87bf8349cd44ca312b1a74684a72682_1.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcBEwJJvThhwsQmTxgj2xbZwm5XZJ7V9RvVYC7wPZKsAh/f87bf8349cd44ca312b1a74684a72682_1.jpeg) 

(Picture of the inside of the park)

![dbb40653e6cc4676a628cbdd0477c08b_0.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNezTSEvzxoFVo4tD8oHj85uEZ1nNVQJvHftuxp2YTwKP/dbb40653e6cc4676a628cbdd0477c08b_0.jpeg)


(Picture of the inside of the park)

![9aca1e4729232b2180812bba4964a888_2.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVhjo9u7BVyHveTaS8ZEdzXPtG6dtAqzQLMwvQDdZ82nu/9aca1e4729232b2180812bba4964a888_2.jpeg)

(Pictures of the inside of the park.) 

As beautiful and interesting as the outside of the green park, the inside is more beautiful and interesting, the more you enter inside, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery, you can take pictures and keep it as a memory. Here are some pictures after entering the park. Hope you like it. I especially like these places.

![IMG-20260601-WA0010.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSAtwsq9SdQEMsZAmtChvAcG4kJWpyP3vCvpbBMqV3Cfp/IMG-20260601-WA0010.jpg)

(Snake sculpture)

The snake sculpture is another interesting thing in the park. The snake looks huge at 9 feet or 10 feet long and some people find.Some people find it scary and some people like it. Many people take photos with snakes to keep as memories and many people sit on top of snakes. 

![IMG-20260601-WA0033.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeiiFDzenQ1hbzBzi7XL5J4f3uo1TifS89cWxhr6b1gAi/IMG-20260601-WA0033.jpg)

(Frog house)

We call it frog house or frog umbrella. Below is a frog and on top of the frog are built some umbrella-like things. Since we were little, we thought of the frog's nest as a frog's umbrella, although in the book it is called a mushroom. It is very beautifully constructed and tourists have a lot of fun taking pictures with this sculpture and keep the pictures as souvenirs.


![IMG-20260601-WA0004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSDESe25FFu4ZQqi8mmt3DBKxnSdnbX3mJQFgHbAg6Co/IMG-20260601-WA0004.jpg)

(Stun)

Here in the eastern part of the tree, the stands look like they are made of tree roots. If you stand next to the stand and take pictures, the pictures are very interesting and beautiful. Again Stunty looks much nicer in the part of the park where this place is located.

![IMG-20260601-WA0008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRkxvF4BRBUrxXwV18beh8DA5B5tZHMpExcr2C5pPLhcr/IMG-20260601-WA0008.jpg)

(the shower)

An artificial spring has been built inside the green park. Many people don't have the luck to see natural scenery in real life. They are delighted to see this artificial fountain, the fountain is beautifully constructed. It is also a tourist attraction. 
Here people stand next to the storm and take many pictures. The pictures are very beautiful and attractive.

![IMG-20260601-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYHYimdiYU7egnb5ADmnqY81yd2MBsNzyqhquLUC3mtAw/IMG-20260601-WA0005.jpg)

(Shower water)

The water from the artificial fountains created in the park is exceptional or flows through this path which looks very beautiful.

![IMG-20260601-WA0009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ1b1jijZDqAnkCAveWbyCvzBAZ4jTdCaCGZ6gPQUS2q9/IMG-20260601-WA0009.jpg)

(Way to Wu)

The trail on the north side of the park is a beautiful and well-maintained trail. Through this path, visitors can easily go to different parts of the park. Green plants on both sides and landscaped surroundings make the route more attractive. 

Walking on this path in the morning and afternoon can enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of nature. Many people come here to walk and take pictures. It serves as an important and scenic link in the park.


![IMG-20260601-WA0036(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcJtnXULJjgw5pkcbNtr92q7Wc37P1pqVpXbzmyVAD25s/IMG-20260601-WA0036(1).jpg)

(the bridge) 

The bridge inside the park is a beautiful and interesting structure. As it is built over water, visitors can easily move from one side to the other. Standing on the bridge, the surrounding scenery is very beautiful. 

It gives a great experience especially with the shower and green surroundings. Many people stand here and take pictures and enjoy the time. The bridge adds to the beauty and attraction of the park.



![IMG-20260601-WA0037.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY5KSs5hqGuZqxz4topyvpFtQSjMvz7h1W6QkXJ87pC2A/IMG-20260601-WA0037.jpg) 

(East road)

The eastern side of the park is a beautiful and well-planned walking trail. Visitors can easily travel to different parts of the park through this route. The route looks very attractive with green vegetation on both sides and pleasant surroundings. 

The beauty of nature can be better enjoyed by walking on this path in the soft light of morning and afternoon. Many visitors spend time walking and taking pictures here.

![IMG-20260601-WA0026.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQymfCQdq8Wg2mYWANMg2xea5bAuUNqszvqqMrpn9KRuS/IMG-20260601-WA0026.jpg)

(South way)

The trail on the south side of the park is very quiet and scenic. Walking through this road, the surrounding green nature and open environment calms the mind. It looks more beautiful as there are plants and clean environment on both sides of the path. 

The feeling of walking on this path in the soft afternoon light and light breeze is really enjoyable. Visitors like to spend time here, relax and take pictures. This path on the south side adds to the beauty of the park.


![IMG-20260601-WA0027.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTB5a7vLaoD81YrAsWWYSH8RT8WmoaN8FuVgC6MAZUSVX/IMG-20260601-WA0027.jpg)

(Green field)

![IMG-20260601-WA0018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaMVPxVNdAp5zpnicqVqeJ3EB9euvxKEWqw98ua2YV88C/IMG-20260601-WA0018.jpg)

(Field) 

The green field inside the park is an enchanting beauty of nature. Surrounded by grass, this vast field is known to visitors as a place of peace and tranquility. Children run and play here, while adults sit and enjoy the beauty of nature. 

Green grass and open sky combine to make the field a great environment.  You can sit on the green grass and chat. The ground is very big and beautiful.  One of the most interesting places in the park, where people love to spend their free time and also love to take pictures.

![IMG-20260601-WA0021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPMJ8mdqzgm1KUhpLL8CC9k7ZUirtptT16ZDpuyPwgKm9/IMG-20260601-WA0021.jpg)

(Photo of the field pass) 

The field looks very beautiful from here. So the pic has been taken. You can stop here and take pictures. Video can be done.

![IMG-20260601-WA0025.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaJ6QxR7Pgfpr8Xqmo3Dzg6zM8VwEFR143VA8NSvC1qtF/IMG-20260601-WA0025.jpg)

(Children's sleeper)

It is designed for children. No ticket is required to get here. It enhances the beauty of the park and children enjoy it. Taking photos of babies is also much more beautiful.

![IMG-20260601-WA0022.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPJxFkdQSVYQHDV976bjx59kTrDd342d4DqvTePcY2epq/IMG-20260601-WA0022.jpg)

(Bullock cart)

Bullock carts are not seen now. People of the 19th century are more familiar with bullock carts. The bullock cart sculpture here is a reminder of the olden days. And the beauty of the park is enhanced by the tourists taking pictures on top of the carts.

![IMG-20260601-WA0011(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdaJCr4uvcYoEJzuqFvCM5N9hpNHt5Rkh6Z9rCWBpZZ4E/IMG-20260601-WA0011(1).jpg)

(The ghost)

The ghost sculpture built inside the park is an exceptional attraction for visitors.  It is located next to Fuska Shop and near Nagordola. The eerie and mysterious design of the sculpture attracts everyone's attention. Especially children and youngsters feel joy and thrill to see the sculpture. 

Many visitors like to stand in front of it and take pictures. The ghost sculpture plays an important role in making the recreational environment of the park more interesting and exciting.


![IMG-20260601-WA0016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXUVDshnKdSxhWYNVR9wgnRyHYYBwh2wcqsDvQcNEJ49j/IMG-20260601-WA0016.jpg)

(The whale)

The whale sculpture located inside the park is a unique attraction for visitors. This gigantic sculpture depicts the beauty and majesty of the whale, the largest animal in the ocean. 

Its charming design has made the environment of the park more attractive. Children and adults love to take pictures standing next to the sculpture. The whale sculpture adds to the beauty of the park as well as creating interest in marine life.


![IMG-20260601-WA0013(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYKyHi29bFTnqApqpPxBQ5amZXQ39RNuM82mvGM4xaVkq/IMG-20260601-WA0013(1).jpg)

(The gorilla) 

The gorilla sculpture located inside the park is a special attraction for the visitors. The massive shape and realistic design of the sculpture grabs everyone's attention. Many visitors, especially children, like to stand in front of the gorilla sculpture and take pictures. 

The sculpture not only enhances the beauty of the park but also increases people's interest in wildlife. It is one of the most popular sculptures in the park.


![IMG-20260601-WA0014(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNcZgMEsSthpzajaj5pVspWDBHttWVCrhcSiVUkGEHD1e/IMG-20260601-WA0014(1).jpg)

(kangaroo)

The kangaroo sculpture located inside the park is an attraction for the visitors. The sculpture looks like a real kangaroo, which attracts the attention of children and adults. Its beautiful design and perfect construction style enhance the beauty of the park.

 Many visitors stand next to the sculpture and take commemorative photos. It is a source of joy and curiosity especially to children. The kangaroo sculpture is known to be one of the most popular attractions in the park.

![IMG-20260601-WA0015(1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcaxeQuBttb1LQS9Y6aUCR3QaxjsarFuigN9pJVdRfvns/IMG-20260601-WA0015(1).jpg)

(The dragon)


![IMG-20260601-WA0034.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSvuGuUbfrZRQwgQzykmxgdg1tfB2HZ41GzcRn3jYwr1Z/IMG-20260601-WA0034.jpg)

(The dragon)



![IMG-20260601-WA0035.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWpZYfPGvr9MPWiF2EfDaHGeCwouzCfvmhAZaBiorBaRa/IMG-20260601-WA0035.jpg)

(The dragon)

Dragon is an extinct animal. It does not exist anywhere in the world. The dragon sculpture built inside the park attracts the attention of the visitors. 3 types of dragon sculptures have been constructed here. The sculpture is beautifully crafted by skilled artisans. 

Its attractive design and huge shape add to the beauty of the park. Many visitors like to stand in front of the sculpture and take pictures. Dragon sculpture is very interesting and fun especially for children. It is known as one of the attractions of the park.

![IMG-20260601-WA0030.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSYdY6WR6tpS2DLapparaQGsaxMGunHiJApKXhYENY29s/IMG-20260601-WA0030.jpg)

(Butterfly)

![IMG-20260601-WA0023.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSRrpT1HF1yns6kDkxPoth6uh6tmjCAJTy8pRb7LdH3gH/IMG-20260601-WA0023.jpg)

(Butterfly)

There are 2 sculptures of Prajaprati. Which increases the attraction of people. It adds to the beauty of the park. And you can stand and take pictures here. Many visitors like to stand and take pictures in front of the sculpture.

 Dragon sculpture is very interesting and fun especially for children. It is known as one of the attractions of the park.



![IMG-20260601-WA0032.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcxAr1ZkAWvEarhQF8BBtELVjfRkYf7bfWBBwms8vb4eS/IMG-20260601-WA0032.jpg)

( Rickshaw)

This rickshaw has been built to enhance the beauty of the park. A beautiful pic can be taken next to the rickshaw. And video can be done.

![IMG-20260601-WA0029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXVDVbsEQkDT7Nx7re6P3GWXfYcnCjLwkioLw4iF2Rjaa/IMG-20260601-WA0029.jpg)

(Roller ride)

Roller rides are for adults. Children between 1 and 6 years old cannot climb here. It lifts people up and brings them down. Sometimes even those who are older get scared. So it is better not to raise the children.

![IMG-20260601-WA0028.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmamoAd3UUgzpScAXvPRwXFPdiFYiC6G2U8aduCXGSGpEV/IMG-20260601-WA0028.jpg)


(Jump ride)

Here children can jump. It's a ride for kids only. A ticket is 50 taka per person. You can jump for 10 minutes with one ticket.

![IMG-20260601-WA0031.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUDciiibpoqbxj7gEqYUm9bSmPtXGKqieVygr9HbN64xn/IMG-20260601-WA0031.jpg)

(Chair Whirlpool Ride)

Chair Whirlpool Ride This is a very popular ride for kids. When it sits on the chair, the children start to spin round and round. Children from 3 to 15 years can sit here for a ticket of 100 taka per person.

![IMG-20260601-WA0017.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRpFtznoG9iAStwMSG8oBuGDJu7fBS3yA4BpCJ65Aqpqx/IMG-20260601-WA0017.jpg)

(Nagardola)

Nagordola Park and Fair is one of the most attractive entertainment facilities. It rotates like a big wheel and one can sit on it and enjoy the beautiful view of the surroundings. From children to adults also enjoy riding the Nagordola. 

Decorated with colorful lights, Nagordola looks even more beautiful at night. Nagordola is a popular means of entertaining the visitors to the park. Jan here charges Tk 100 per ticket.


![IMG_20260601_20330165.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeMMv3ApCXULQThLUgShMZRZzYrpWGoiVJLzzgu7hwPTw/IMG_20260601_20330165.jpeg)

(Blister Shop)

![IMG_20260601_21344877.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaEDsxSJAUPxZUoegGuVaaEjD3b7L8bsAHUiuT6s3R5Tq/IMG_20260601_21344877.jpeg)

(Blister Shop)

The Fuchka shop inside the park is very popular with the visitors. Tourists visiting the park come here to eat fuchka. The burst of sour, salty and sweet flavors attracts everyone.

 Friends and family members sit together and have a good time eating fuchka. The shop adds to the ambiance of the park and is known to be a popular dining spot for visitors. Fuchka is one of the most popular streets in Bangladesh.


![IMG_20260601_20323037.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbJ4mNxZ6Q1Yah7j4VY2EV7Ex3Gf1wrHX4pC8V3uNmmgx/IMG_20260601_20323037.jpeg)

(Dighi)

In the middle of the park there is a Bur Dighi. The Dighi looks very big. Here some tollers are lowered for kids which are used as kiddie rides. A ticket costs 100 rupees. 5 minutes on the water can ride on the toller.

![IMG-20260601-WA0019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcYvzMuQMNaCtuL4L87QQJPzXtQDV95Tcu3DwJKDEtLRR/IMG-20260601-WA0019.jpg)

 (Cosmetic shop)

Here you can find various things for girls. Like Clips, Hair Bands Churi Kajal etc. Everything needed for girls is available.


![IMG-20260601-WA0024.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXY8jxAfUPqdL9xXKiaxAUaZxM7w3wVewpepdBd1RER6h/IMG-20260601-WA0024.jpg)

(Handicraft shop)

A variety of handicrafts, showpieces, bamboo and cane products, earthenware, jewelery and home decoration items are available here. Each product has its own unique beauty and value as it is made with care and effort.


![IMG_20260601_18074991.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQLppYnHERn2TJaDxJw6qKjQinq6ZrSFGCZ453QBCZMKV/IMG_20260601_18074991.jpeg)

(Glitter balloons)

Glitter balloons are a very attractive toy for children. These colorful and shiny balloons are sold outside the park.  Glittering balloons swinging in the air attract everyone's attention and create a joyful atmosphere. There is nothing more than a pair of glittery balloons to put a smile on children's faces, especially.

![f810aa77013a3ccd72ee156a482c2452_0.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf6Mb97gKogUJzsqnE6GwbRXXe57QfhFLp1NiihYBFaGw/f810aa77013a3ccd72ee156a482c2452_0.jpeg)

(Tea shop)

Tea shop is a familiar and popular place in our daily life. Different types of tea are available here, such as milk tea, red tea, ginger tea and lemon tea. People come to tea shops to drink tea as well as chat with friends and spend leisure time. 

Many times the tea shop also serves as a meeting place for the local people. A beautiful and clean tea shop becomes more attractive to customers. Since we didn't eat any food in Bitar, we came outside the park to have Malay tea. The food is very delicious.


![206232e3d2ee4b252e1632371b0fc8c7_3.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRLoTnrmDZCYV9NVDkJYULB4Gu7xDCzzpUfajX8X5suQ3/206232e3d2ee4b252e1632371b0fc8c7_3.jpeg)

(Menu card) 

A menu card is a list that lists the names and prices of various foods and beverages available at a restaurant, park, or eatery. A beautiful and well-designed menu card helps the customers to choose the food of their choice. Besides, it shows the service quality and professionalism of the organization. Here, the menu card is printed as a poster and placed in front of the store.

![ce618c1db709b1a2a518dd3c0ad3ffdf_1.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPwKc2DBZ4vsJsEvge24tcSbquwWCBiDBXtJaMEHYtyiA/ce618c1db709b1a2a518dd3c0ad3ffdf_1.jpeg)

(Malay tea) 

The feeling of sitting outside the park at night and drinking a cup of hot mala tea is really wonderful. Every sip of tea soothes the mind amid the beautiful surroundings.


Giving time to yourself is very important in human life, because it is good for both mental and physical aspects. We are busy every day with studies, work, family, problems. If you don't give yourself time in the midst of this busyness, then stress increases, the mind becomes tired and interest in life may decrease. Taking time for yourself calms the mind and clears the mind. So taking some time for yourself means making your life more beautiful and balanced.
