title.title: Streetlights where dreams can be hung | My entry for #Monomad Challenge [ENG-ESP]
title.body:
<center>![162168.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/Ep5o8jAGmW6gdS7U9mkqGgqP7NLNRfg6XDLGA9CUP2rCm1ofSprTAJ8faExo3haP2rg.jpg)</center>

***
<div class=\

> Hello black and white photography lovers! Hanging dreams on lampposts in a park, in my country, is associated with utopias and dreams that many are sometimes unable to even imagine because of the prevailing darkness between columns and clouds that might echo such innocence, and before which time seems to remain impassive. ***
![162169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EoCbMmwLRpQhrsNpBXtWgnat1fbCz7tPvmfBS4aDR7eRMHA1bnGskYEkgv5sd84vg5j.jpg)
*** In my case, I try not to lose the hope of dreaming and to continue hanging my heart on those clouds, in the open sky and even on streetlights in order to illuminate whoever is capable of deserving the light offered. *** |![162164.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EprSajHCHcyTW6kzssxEaHBQ7SiPwf7TagdeHpNirjGH3xCnC5GmBpR8u5aRM6bjaNq.jpg)|![162165.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EoAS7LQbSRQENzxiUZ3Y4uSqRt7YmTaK5GfEH8mpZpmw51bEL5QxpvmjZaupSvDPHcd.jpg)|![162161.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EoAT2iGYpEaZVZ4g7p8DtWfPLueZaEP6QsTSfLTxaBrDiSV6xjvpLsmxTWZ94fKvMWU.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Angles, contrasts, and diverse viewpoints for focusing or capturing frames become reflections of everyday actions, but I attribute other essences to them. It remains to the will and imagination of the viewer to reformulate their conception or simply to ignore it. I hope, at least, that the imagination takes flight and that black and white embraces its paths with all the nuance it offers. ***
![162159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EoJz3e6H4dU4UQhFKJHWcVRbBJghU3DwZk1zK66z9vWoRjq8SYvqbmfzwvRkxL5jXqh.jpg)
*** So, all that's left is to dance and smile until the next frame. Meanwhile, each of you receive a hug of light!
> This is my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest. *** ###

>Thank you very much for your visit!

***
©Copyright 2026 Roswel Borges Castellanos. All rights reserved.
This post was partially translated using Google Translate and photos taken with a Nikon D500 camera and 70-200 mm f/2,8G VR II lens.
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemv7NkRRqBthL7pUe5BkDEVs2mvN5N2jVLiFnaDt5b5J/blanco_y_negro_en_ingl_s_peque_o.jpg)
*** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTyMxkMRWLHkhLP9LT7W6ZDESXY5WK94hxMYNtDXYQMgk/en_espa_ol_blanco_y_negro.jpg)
*** ***
![162168.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/Ep5o8jAGmW6gdS7U9mkqGgqP7NLNRfg6XDLGA9CUP2rCm1ofSprTAJ8faExo3haP2rg.jpg)
***

> ¡Hola amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro! Colgar sueños en farolas de un parque, en mi país, viene junto a utopías y sueños que a veces muchos no son capaces siquiera de imaginar por la oscuridad imperante entre columnas y nubes que pudieran hacerse eco de tal inocenciay ante la cual Cronos parece tornarse impasible. ***
![162169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EoCbMmwLRpQhrsNpBXtWgnat1fbCz7tPvmfBS4aDR7eRMHA1bnGskYEkgv5sd84vg5j.jpg)
*** En mi caso, intento no perder la ilusión de soñar y seguir colgando mi corazón en esas nubes, en el cielo abierto e incluso en las farolas con el fin de iluminar a quien sea capaz de merecer la luz ofrecida. *** |![162164.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EprSajHCHcyTW6kzssxEaHBQ7SiPwf7TagdeHpNirjGH3xCnC5GmBpR8u5aRM6bjaNq.jpg)|![162165.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EoAS7LQbSRQENzxiUZ3Y4uSqRt7YmTaK5GfEH8mpZpmw51bEL5QxpvmjZaupSvDPHcd.jpg)|![162161.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EoAT2iGYpEaZVZ4g7p8DtWfPLueZaEP6QsTSfLTxaBrDiSV6xjvpLsmxTWZ94fKvMWU.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Ángulos, contrastes, puntos de vista diversos para enfocar o capturar fotogramas, se convierten en reflejo de acciones cotidianas pero a las que atribuyo otras esencias. Queda a la voluntad e imaginación de quien las perciba, reformular su concepción o simplemente ser alguien que la ignore. Espero vuele al menos la imaginación y el blanco y negro abrace sus caminos con todo el matiz que ofrece. ***
![162159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/EoJz3e6H4dU4UQhFKJHWcVRbBJghU3DwZk1zK66z9vWoRjq8SYvqbmfzwvRkxL5jXqh.jpg)
*** Entonces, solo queda bailar y sonreír hasta un próximo fotograma. Mientras, reciban cada uno de ustedes, ¡un abrazo de luz!
> Esta es mi entrada al concurso #monomad de @monochromes y @brumest. *** ###

>¡Muchas gracias por tu visita!

title.title: GOD ALWAYS HAS PLAN 💯🤗_Jer 29:11
title.body:
FOR I HAVE FOR YOU THOUGHT OF GOOD AND NOT OF EVIL SAYS THE LORD.......


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZHhtepDNU159Q7MpvBjXi7d9CS4RtCT8neyuHJcrF1PP/1780388287810.jpg)


Shalom Kingdom Family 👋

5 things this picture reminds me today:

   1. Plans Written in Sand Fade
Our plans fail. Doors close. Promises delay.
But when man’s writing fades, God’s plan stands. 
Prov 19:21 - \

2. Delay Is Not Denial
What looks like “nothing is happening” is often God preparing.
Joseph waited in prison. David waited in the field. 
God’s timing > our timing.

   3. God Sees The Full Picture
We see the sand and the wave. 
God sees the ocean, the tide, and the shore ahead.
He knows what you cannot see yet.

  4. Trust > Understanding
We want answers now. God wants trust first.
Isaiah 55:9 - \

5. His Plan Is Always Good
Even when it hurts. Even when it’s slow.
Jer 29:11 - \

My Take:
Stop fighting the delay. Start trusting the Planner.
The God who writes in sand can also write your name in the Book of Life.

Kingdom Family, which of these 5 points spoke to you most today? 
Drop the number 1-5 below 👇 Let’s encourage each other.

image is graphic design by me✨

yours truly

title.title: “The Drama” – How Skeletons from the Past Affect the Present
title.body: USA, drama, director: Christopher Borgley, starring: Emma Zendaya, Robert Pattinson, Zoe Winters. He is madly in love and writes her a touching wedding vow. She admits that he is her first love. But one day, in a circle of friends and a little tipsy, she tells that in childhood... she almost shot her classmates. The company made a shocking decision to reveal the darkest secrets and most terrible deeds from her past, and what came out was truly astonishing. Compared to this stunning confession, all the other hidden secrets and surprises seemed insignificant and pale in comparison, like minor issues that hardly mattered anymore. “What a tie,” I thought. As the story unfolds, the groom-to-be will be forced to confront some tough questions, and we, the audience, will be right there with him, wondering what he'll discover. Isn't it scary to live with a person who almost killed a bunch of other people? What could have pushed her to such a decision? Why didn't she finish what she had planned? Is everything okay with her psyche? What if one day she ends up harming you? Can you be judged for intentions that were never implemented? You're probably expecting a lot of questions to come up, and it's unlikely that the answers will be straightforward or easy to figure out. Things might get a bit complicated, and we'll have to think carefully to find the right solutions. What's going to happen to the couple - will they be able to make their relationship work? Is the wedding still on, and if it is, will they actually be happy together in the long run? I mean, the wedding is just the starting point, everything that really matters happens after that. #cine #cinema #film #moovie

title.title: The Only Person Who Stopped Interviewing Me #291
title.body:
I used to hate seeing or hearing my phone ring. Not because I was occupied with work. It was actually the opposite then. There used to be a period when work was not coming. Every day always starts with a good plan but nothing to show for it at the end of the day. I would send a series of applications, check my spam, and refresh my emails countless times and always assure myself that tomorrow will be a better day. But tomorrow kept on being the same with disappointment. The most difficult part then was not the lack of money. But it was all this series of conversations. And all those calls felt like I was being interviewed. “Have you gotten anything yet?” “What is the update for now?” “What are the plans you are working towards?” Yeah, those were it. And to be honest, they all cared because no one was trying to be cruel now that I understand better. But after every single call of asking me the same question in different forms all over, I had no choice than to stop avoiding some calls. I even had to save up an auto response in my head because I know someone will eventually ask me when we physically see each other or at a family function. But one evening, I paid a visit to one of our close family friends from way back. I already had a detailed explanation in my head. But instead, he just asked me if I could help him bring down a pack of water he just went to the store to buy from his car. And that's how my visit started. For the next few hours I spent there. We were talking about life. Bantering about each other's football club. And then my club, Arsenal, hadn't won an EPL cup then, school memories, and how the big goat we had been planning to kill for Christmas some time ago just went missing with no traces. We made a lot of jokes and laughed more than I can recall laughing in months. And when I left his space to return to mine. Taking my night shower, I noticed something strange. No one had told me to defend my existence. And that realization hit harder than I ever expected. ![257316.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/257316.png) The support this man gave me then was not money; it was not a long minute talk. He gave me something that I didn't even know I was starving for. And that is a place where I was not even being measured. Taking a flashback now, I believe that it is not only financial problems that a lot of struggling people are only carrying. Some are overwhelmed with this thing I call exhaustion and concerns of constantly trying to overexplain and prove that they still deserve patience. And I will say that back then, the only person who helped me most during my hardest time was this family friend who was the only person that let me rest from that burden. Even though it was just for a few hours one afternoon evening. --- Thank you for reading. >

title.body:
https://i.postimg.cc/4x317qZ0/Diapositiva2.jpg

\

Galileo Galilei (1564-1642)

Saludos a toda la comunidad de HIVE, con el fin de promocionar el contenido matemático dentro de nuestra querida red social, a continuación les presento la siguiente sección en la cual se estará publicando un problema matemático a ser resuelto, los problemas abordarán diversas áreas de la Matemática (Aritmética, Álgebra, Geometría, Análisis, entre otros).

Los invito a compartir sus soluciones, sin más preámbulo les presento el problema

¿Cuántos números positivos de tres cifras existen cuya suma de cifras es mayor o igual a 20?


La matemática es la ciencia de la abstracciones, que presenta cierta belleza austera para todo aquel que decide dedicarse a su estudio.

Me despido deseándoles feliz blogging.

links.title: Our little flower pots =/= Unsere kleinen Blumentöpfe 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
links.body: ![IMG_9234.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoK7FNJgyHgLFZevRUmzUFwtkuT6FM5K2GScejM6af6WfmYBmPxDYJkiGSGAP9qg9mw.JPG) It’s not just the parks and gardens outside where things are in bloom right now; things have gotten a little more colorful in front of our house too. Unfortunately, we don’t really have much space to plant anything here, so we mostly just have a few small flower pots that we can set out. Right now, it’s yellow and pink that are brightening up the area in front of our house. On the left, we see a few Delosperma, known in Japan as “three o’clock flowers.” This plant is characterized by its many small, bright yellow blossoms and thick, succulent leaves. It is a tought little plant that loves sunny spots, and always opens its flowers in the afternoon. On the right, you can see a gerbera, a popular ornamental plant that produces large, eye-catching flowers. Gerberas are popular worldwide as garden and potted plants and often symbolize joy and happiness. Probably precisely because there isn’t much color in front of our house otherwise, we find our flowers to be a nice eye-catcher. Together, they create a beautiful, vibrant combination and show how even just a couple of small flower pots can make a place much friendlier and livelier. Hopefully, they’ll stay with us for a long time to come... ![IMG_9235.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoeHFUGC89LLWx1Y5euuUED6sYTHM98n3eXcHXNSD89fkVC3dbZKooSGzL7Gh2ZE8EW.JPG) DEUTSCH Nicht nur draußen in den Parks und Gärten ist es derzeit am Blühen, auch bei uns vor dem Haus ist es ein klein wenig bunter geworden. Leider haben wir nicht wirklich viel Platz, um hier etwas anzupflanzen, uns so sind es meist nur kleinere Blumentöpfe, die wir uns hinstellen können. Zur Zeit ist es Gelb und Rosa, was bei uns vor dem Haus leuchtet. Links sehen wir ein paar Mittagsblumen (Delosperma), die in Japan als Drei-Uhr-Blumen bekannt sind. Typisch für diese Pflanze sind ihre vielen kleinen, strahlend gelben Blüten und die dicken, sukkulenten Blätter. Sie ist besonders robust, liebt sonnige Standorte und öffnet ihre Blüten immer erst am Nachmittag. Auf der rechten Seite sieht man eine Gerbera, eine beliebte Zierpflanze, die große auffälligen Blüten bildet. Gerbera sind weltweit als Garten- und Topfpflanzen beliebt und stehen oft symbolisch für Freude und Fröhlichkeit. Wahrscheinlich gerade weil es sonst nicht so viel bunt vor unsrem Haus gibt, sind unsere Blumen für uns ein richtiger Blickfang. Zusammen bilden sie eine schöne farbenfrohe Kombination und zeigen, wie schon ein zwei kleine Blumentöpfe einen Ort viel freundlicher und lebendiger machen können. Hoffentlich bleiben sie uns noch lange erhalten... ![IMG_9236.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EouAgim5f1GdqYNy5CJgccUfBoraAFaMm913qD8obKVNLmQqB45udpzJ1is4q9ACzZg.JPG) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

Liebe Leser und Naturfreunde,
vor 3 Jahren hatte ich schon [hier](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@stayoutoftherz/im-wiener-alpengarten) über den Wiener [Alpengarten](https://www.bundesgaerten.at/belvederegarten/alpengarten.html), eine Oase der Ruhe nahe des Hauptbahnhofs, berichtet, aber dieses Mal war ich Mitte Mai dort, nicht im August, und im Frühling ist er noch bunter und schöner!
![IMG_5529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23xVEe4NFbkRVsz4VVbxxH3Sojg31WEwjdfGiz5gianEuhB3AmDvYE9foJ2kiRWwr9Nz7.jpg)


Eine kleine Sonderausstellung widmete sich den Tieren, die diesen ca. 2500 m<sup>2</sup> großen Garten bevölkern, gern gesehene wie Fuchs, Igel und Eichhörnchen, Erdkröte und Grasfrosch, Heupferdchen und mehrere Libellen-, Bienen-, Hummel- und Schmetterlingsarten.
![IMG_5492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wMky6FHbDBtpo41ZxKaisPsaJWrrf4athcdLR7YsyKB4qyoJ1kBhJPTPPmXnE21w7CH.jpg)

Daneben gibt es auch weniger gern gesehene Tierarten wie die Marmorierte Baumwanze (=Stinkwanze, ein Neozoon und landwirtschaftlicher Schädling, der sehr giftresistent ist) oder die Spanische Wegschnecke, die sich irgendwann einmal hier eingefunden hat (erstmals 1972 in Österreich fußgefasst) und nun auch Dauergast ist. 

Der [Stängellose Enzian](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kochscher_Enzian), auch Kochscher Enzian genannt, ist eine typische Gebirgspflanze. Auf dem Schild noch in der alten Schreibweise, mit \

.
![IMG_5560.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23tbnPXtF5L61pqpSRKEtieyqCs1ULsg2qcsSpTzefcHK1MzLQnjWiuwCL23YwP3mmwrf.jpg)
Eine der wunderschönen Blüten.
![IMG_5559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23uFRYjjVRDmhpjD3jNgBRbadR4uZFHmrYxkeD7zonFENe6P9ygUDJVRWyRowM7s7KXFJ.jpg)


Nicht nur Alpenpflanzen blühten gerade, sondern auch so \

wie die [Hundsrose](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundsrose), die häufigste wild wachsende Rosenart in Europa.
![IMG_5587.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wgHkoXNMg53yfGLdD9f5iVgmt2xE4AuXLSCtnp8tkpyNMh82PcDqg2MjxNk6xKa6UTj.jpg)

Die zu den Hahnenfußgewächsen zählende [Gemeine Akelei](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gemeine_Akelei), unten im Bild sind auch Blütenstände des [Echten Beinwell](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Echter_Beinwell) zu sehen. Die Akelei gilt in D. als gefährdet, laut Wikipedia ist \
, was seltsam ist, da sie in unserem Garten wild wächst (meist nur 1-3 pro Jahr). Da wir sie \

, sind wir somit kriminell?
![IMG_5514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23xoxAX8qEtzWAsFWzbBCupDQuGYWjpqoZztg2GqTB3jyntv28xbBFQLaspCAxcznThcR.jpg)

Hier sitzt ein [Trauer-Rosenkäfer](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trauer-Rosenk%C3%A4fer) an einer schon verblühten Pflanze. Diese Käfer sind an sich wärmeliebend und erst seit einiger Zeit in unseren Breitengraden anzutreffen, wohl eine Folge der Klimaerwärmung, wie bei der [Borstigen Dolchwespe](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@stayoutoftherz/die-borstige-dolchwespe-ein-klimawandelprofiteur).
![IMG_5553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23w2nzQrSvqwvB31xJ3d82XNCbNgAFkto8KnXkNyQeo2XdVHk1uLE9hgzACBZwcJi4WHP.jpg)

Bei dieser Honigbiene in einer Pfingstrosenblüte kann man das \

gut erkennen.
![IMG_55644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wCNDo12PTbJWyKNxzorgk3gJvw1aoh8944RUPB69g8DqPFJsbxBTXgCftwNnWQWTPKx.jpg)

Eine andere arbeitet sich durch die vielen Einzelblüten eines [Riesen-Lauchs](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riesen-Lauch).
![IMG_5500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wMYapKtEQLHHQAcU1poY1jxmfDp5dbdUR7JZyAPSFK15199hERbh4XQJ6UiZzQFFzat.jpg)

Erblühende [Indische Kermesbeere](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indische_Kermesbeere). Sie kommt in Ostasien vor und ist eine alte Heilpflanze. Schon 1000 v.Chr. war sie in China als Arznei bekannt! In der TCM wird sie unter anderem zur Behandlung von Tumoren und Ödemen verwendet, die Wurzel kann als Ersatz für die Tollkirsche verwendet werden (und wurde fallweise zum Sake gegeben😲).
![IMG_5508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23x12UXvbWM2iKq7539rQetLAzuMYUnHnAtBPtxXdhKCGBh5sc59w6Nep1GmKBZJhvZ2N.jpg)


Der sehr auffällig blühende, aber giftige [Diptam](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diptam) gilt in Mitteleuropa als gefährdet und ist in manchen Regionen schon ausgestorben. Er steht seit 1936 unter Naturschutz.
![IMG_5532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23xAVtkF6zmi7hPQswmQx3jjrtn2nvec7XwwWzr1BYQDDE4fiYJcHoxyu5VpmomqLa5QK.jpg)
Der Diptam kann große Mengen ätherischer Öle produzieren, z.B. das hochentzündliche Isopren. An extrem heißen Tagen können sich die Dämpfe auch selbst entzünden, durch die Brennglaswirkung von abgesonderten Tröpfchen. Daher wird er auch \

genannt. Diese Selbstentzündungen sind aber nur kurz und schaden der Pflanze nicht.

Gemeine Pfingstrose bzw. einer der vielen Hybriden dieser Art.
![IMG_5515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23vsNJsZLvTEGrEkhFGJDJfjX9oYJGSUGh9nehEM7mUNTAxy5GiFozwTVTZhzLHpSCQ9r.jpg)

Blütenstand einer [Bunt-Wolfsmilch](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vielfarbige_Wolfsmilch) mit einem [Gemeinen Bienenkäfer](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gemeiner_Bienenk%C3%A4fer) als Besucher.
![IMG_5546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wX5LidVURcW9aEApAiQ4FWxsyRm9TJ7GR2hc18B6SD5PYrx4BjkEbMRQhEaAnA1qX5q.jpg)

Ein [Tagpfauenauge](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tagpfauenauge) an einem Gewöhnlichen Flieder. Dieser hat seine besten Tage schon hinter sich. Er stammt sicher noch aus dem vorigen Jahr und hatte erfolgreich überwintert. Die neue Generation fliegt erst ab Juni.
![IMG_5586.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23u64xL35G16rhyKhh8foZp9Y3vNUWJmRp8MCwRnt7f763aYtUuttAkiNbgkrCADStVir.jpg)

Manche Wege führen über Holzstege, hier flankiert von bunten [Rhododendren](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhododendren).
![IMG_5581.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23wC9v4Dts3g6Qswqaeee2xTSKA4WvcCjRfzjdWewecYDthw3hwRNuc7bWJfpdtSuf8DW.jpg)

Rhododendren sind eine Gattung mit über 1000 Arten (auch die [Almrose](https://peakd.com/hive-121566/@stayoutoftherz/alpenflora) gehört dazu)! Hier eine Indische [Azalee](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Azalee).
![IMG_5506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23w2ksyGNo4kGSFt1FJeWKfdP3juDJg7uRcQ69KUzgdiyXvC9eXpJNhFNtJVkkEFwxDYt.jpg)

Mein absolutes Lieblingsplätzchen: Eine Sackgasse, abseits der Hauptwege mit einer Bank - ideal zum Verweilen und Eins mit der Natur werden.
![IMG_5582.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23uQpaLZmHdcKWa8d2mkXtU379qon6n7A6WodVtCTCzMYrfAv7pdMZufAWeiS56bnDEn3.jpg)

Die [Deutsche Schwertlilie](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deutsche_Schwertlilie) kann man auf den ersten Blick leicht mit der [Sibirischen Schwertlilie](https://peakd.com/@stayoutoftherz/re-peaksnaps-tf91rl) verwechseln. Ob auch der Nektar gleich gut schmeckt?
![IMG_5536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23xyQqdK8jvSoyPjs6tNZeLghDmDkK4pDsGefH7QLLXEkwuPWVPqd8nk9GdcbxUh1CGvX.jpg)

Dieses Eichhörnchen wurde von einem Besucher mit Walnüssen angelockt.
![IMG_5601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23xVGqBvd5kQ7DXvjn7ic3TZCNzCPHjfVvWTSr2hTVVM8UUc1saSrGbtDLzyxNREsgc88.jpg)

Und schon ist der kleine Rundgang wieder vorbei, sicher nicht mein letzter 😃.
![IMG_5518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stayoutoftherz/23ywgifVJHNn6rm2keEayByjk8Xr73ddm6JjsS5Y2xo162YDtfgYJTTnqpxZQp9dE4BGc.jpg)

body.title: 𝐆𝐑𝐀𝐘𝐇𝐀𝐌𝐌𝐄𝐑 𝐏𝐀𝐈𝐍𝐒𝐌𝐈𝐓𝐇 || 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐌𝐎𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍𝐀𝐋 𝐄𝐕𝐄𝐍𝐓 𝐂𝐀𝐑𝐃 || 𝐂𝐑𝐀𝐙𝐘 𝐀𝐁𝐈𝐋𝐈𝐓𝐈𝐄𝐒
body.body: />Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Today I wanted to do another card spotlight, and this time the card is a promotional event card named, Grayhammer Painsmith. This is a Common Death/Earth unit from the new set and honestly, it is one of the most unique common cards I have seen recently. At max level (Level 10), Grayhammer Painsmith gets five different abilities, which is pretty crazy for a common card. It starts looking like a normal ranged attacker, but once you read all the abilities, you realize there is much more going on here. Before talking about the abilities, let's take a quick look at the card.

> 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐭 𝐌𝐚𝐱 𝐋𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥 ========================================== * Mana Cost: 8 * Ranged Attack: 2 * Speed: 3 * Health: 13 The first thing that stands out to me is the huge health pool. For a ranged unit, 13 health is quite impressive. Most ranged cards are usually fragile, but this one can survive for a long time. The speed is not amazing, but it is decent enough. The real value comes from the abilities. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟏: 𝐂𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐑𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞 ======================================== **Close Range**: Can use ranged attacks from the first position.

> This is always a useful ability for ranged monsters. Normally when a ranged unit gets pushed into the front line, it becomes almost useless. With Close Range, Grayhammer Painsmith can continue attacking even after reaching the first position. This makes the card much harder to shut down. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟐: 𝐏𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐞 ===================================== **Painforge**: +1 power when damaged by Poisoned or Burning or hit by an ally.

> Now this is where things get interesting. Most monsters hate taking damage. Grayhammer Painsmith actually benefits from it. If the card gets damaged by Burning, Poison, or certain friendly effects, it gains additional power. In battles with status effects everywhere, this ability can snowball pretty quickly. Suddenly a monster that started with only 2 ranged attack can become much more dangerous. I really like abilities that reward unusual strategies and Painforge definitely does that. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟑: 𝐑𝐮𝐬𝐭 =========================== **Rust**: -2 armor to all enemy units.

> This is one of my favorite support abilities. A lot of players rely heavily on armor. Rust instantly removes 2 armor from every enemy monster, making them easier to kill. It may not look flashy, but it provides value from the very first round. Especially against Life teams or armored tanks, Rust can make a huge difference. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟒: 𝐒𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐨𝐰 𝐅𝐨𝐜𝐮𝐬 ========================================== **Shadow Focus**: When in the last position, gains Camouflage, cannot attack, and all allied units gain +1 Power.

> This ability is probably the most unique part of the card. When Grayhammer Painsmith sits in the last position, it basically turns into a support unit. It loses the ability to attack, but every ally gains +1 power. That is a massive team-wide buff. The Camouflage effect also protects it from direct attacks, making it harder for opponents to remove the bonus. Honestly, this ability alone can completely change how you position the card. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟓: 𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐥 =========================== **Heal**: Each round, restores 1/3 of max health.

></center>

And finally we get Heal.

With 13 health, healing one-third every round is pretty strong.

This helps Grayhammer Painsmith stay alive longer and continue supporting the team.

Combined with its already large health pool, it can become surprisingly annoying to eliminate.

𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐈 𝐋𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐝
====================================

What I like most about Grayhammer Painsmith is how flexible it feels.

You can use it as:

*   A ranged attacker thanks to Close Range.
    
*   An anti-armor support monster because of Rust.
    
*   A team buffer through Shadow Focus.
    
*   A scaling damage dealer using Painforge.
    
*   A durable support card because of Heal.
    

That is a lot of utility packed into a common card.

Personally, I think Shadow Focus is the most interesting ability. Giving every ally +1 power can completely change the outcome of a battle, especially in longer matches.

The card is not the fastest and does not start with huge damage, but its value comes from everything it brings to the team rather than raw stats.

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Grayhammer Painsmith is one of those cards that gets better the more you understand it. At first glance it looks like a simple ranged monster, but after looking at all five abilities, it becomes clear that it can fill several different roles.

For a common card, the amount of utility is honestly impressive.

I think this card has a lot of potential in both Death and Earth lineups, especially in battles where armor, status effects, and long fights are common.

Anyway thats it for today’s #splinterlands grind. More battles tomorrow and hopefully more crazy moments too. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: Using bare Hands || Using a washing machine || Carrying Out Laundry
body.body:
**Welcome to today's blog**


![IMG_20260601_115411_236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23wCE9LqadA8ozupEiDsk5A9UaxGrNcXmBdrRFrFrkm4bC5fgPJAyN2gPbNxvy5zKzZqr.jpg)


Ever Lived in a location where you find it a bit difficult to get little things you need for the moment. Well, I know that most people who are financially buoyant, go out to the shopping mall to buy all the things they will need for their house which will last for a period of about a month.

I know some people who have every pin in their houses even to the extent that even if they wanted to prepare a meal in the middle of the night, they will do that without having to go out to buy anything or be found wanting for lack of ingredients or proteins. I hope to get there sooner in life.

On this day, I needed soda soap to do laundry, so I went to buy the soap outside. Only for me to trek miles just for a single soap of 200 Naira. The street looked so empty, that I barely found any available store to buy something. 


![IMG_20260601_090958_935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23wWyFnJYwDnkZeBR7hUFhuxaa9oBhvRrc9e2TqyMfkXphHREMtBRkXSfofSbdU4iMqYa.jpg)

*Empty street*

I entered from corner to corner and later I felt very hungry and felt I should buy biscuits to snack on, I saw a small shop and there I bought the soda soap also.


![IMG_20260601_090746_850.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23wgTrUa2RfMucGhMqGK3unF87urFwP57Ke3GYqD7toL252TcELoCwAitYnq8PLf5GoDW.jpg)
*Kiosks*

Actually, I saw one kiosk before I went to this other shop but they did not have what I wanted so I decided to check the next place. The distance of these shops was really far away from my house. If I were to take a bike ride (okada) I would have paid the sum of N300 to get to those shops just to buy 200 Naira soda soap.


![IMG_20260601_090627_725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23y8x2Y5HVVZEQhecKFvdijt9tADZz89gLajnNhyxc3JjE3tbhZ96jS2L11Cv9JDq9hxU.jpg)
*Provision shop*

After buying my soap, I trekked back home and began to do my laundry for the day. I washed lots of clothes and the soda soap I used in washing also caused slight irritation on my hands. I do not know if the soap was not cooked well, because it is only where the soap is not cooked well that it will cause irritation to the skin.


![IMG_20260601_115354_851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23w2kyCRQop8xetMQ6b6cLtANPwmqr3TKpgLonhMWQ5FmB9oW2FPgmu7JZ12HagPjJszk.jpg)
*Doing laundry (washing clothes) with soda soap*

This soda soap is a locally made soap in my community. It is made mainly from palm oil and caustic soda then other ingredients. It is very foamy although I combined the soda soap with a detergent I already had at home to do the laundry.

I finished washing on time and I spread my clothes out on the line, they dried up earlier than expected because the sun shone greatly. Most of the clothes that did not dry, I had to spread them again for them to dry properly.

Over here, most people are lucky to have washing machines in their houses but we do not have one now so we use our bare hands to do laundry. Most traditional women say using the hands to wash clothes is the best because it removes more dirt. I don't know how true that saying is.

Most people in the deep rural communities go to the stream to carry out their laundry. Most people do not even use soap to wash, all they do is use big stones by the stream to wash. They soak their clothes in the stream and then hit it on stones until all the dirt is out of the cloth, then they rinse and spread it in the bushes for it to dry. This method of doing laundry is also interesting in its own way.

How do you do your laundry, do you use your hands or you use a machine or you give your clothes to the laundry man. Just do what is more comfortable for you. You can also share your thoughts in the comment section.


![20260522_200556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23uQrdsjhRwt8Eq4afqJnL3JLPfbuR8q7WpNuG3LU8oMYwkUCToAh7dA4DwoAWdkjA9pC.jpg)


Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@pinkbeee/using-bare-hands-using-a-washing-machine-carrying-out-laundry--4ig)

body.title: The Systems Song 🎵🎶🎵🎶🎵🎶
body.body:
'Syyyyysssteeemmms, I love syyyyssstemmmmms' 🎵🎶🎵🎶 Jamie's singing. Dickhead. He's made up a daft song as he tidies up. 

But we are totally *crowing* about all the new systems we have to make life easier, simpler, more *minimal*. 

It's easy in the new house. We bring the old house's lessons here, a lifetime of things that don't work tossed out, and some pretty great systems for ensuring things run smoothly and easily so we aren't overwhelmed and can have more free time doing things we love. 

So there's a reason to sing, I suppose - it's all so easy and smooth and *flowy*. Yay. 

#### System 1 - Bedding

We sleep in separate rooms - we get far better sleep that way. We have a rule that the beds are made before we go into the kitchen for breakfast. It took me a while to train this habit in Jamie. I believe it sets the mood for the day and makes everything feel calmer and organised, and I think there's nothing *worse* that going to bed in a messy room with an unmade bed. I like to open the windows to air it out (better hygeine, less smells) and put any clothes away.

This morning we changed the bedding - I strip the bed and put the pillow slips on, and Jamie does the sheets and doona cover. Takes us five minutes to do it together. The rest goes in the washing machine. We have this system down to an art so we don't even have to talk to each other as we do it, unless I'm berating him for not putting the pillows together straight.


![b384e77d-7665-4142-bdf7-633989d2a67d-1_all_1604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23u652m8KFMikosM6ZZ1xsuRjwmLMoh6ZLmrSFFQPdJJ6a8KMdoPnfjLdkwECsTVVtB2A.jpg)


Oh, and I got these little zip/velcro boxes from Kmart to put the doona/sheet/pillowcases in, so I don't have this pile of crap fall on me when I open up the cupboard. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fb2q141rMNE&t=3s

> Home is where I want to be
But I guess I'm already there
I come home, she lifted up her wings
I guess that this must be the place

### System 2 The Next Day bench

This used to be a basket, but this bench is now agreed as a 'next day' bench. Anything we have to remember to take out of the house for work or whatever goes on this bench as we think of it the night before - library books, lunches, towels to go back in the van, sunglasses, reading glasses, handbag, car keys - whatever, particularly if we have a busy morning to come. It means we rarely forget anything as we know to pick things off the bench as we leave the house. 


![2036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/Eou8fyWoA4jVbuMEF1vxpEZofnbcfdemwvDRmy8zcrsRZWko9rWAqhphEWLRnr7aPJ9.jpg)


> You may ask yourself, \

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5IsSpAOD6K8


### System 3 Coffee

This is my favourite system. We don't argue about who's getting out of bed to make coffee, because it's *always* Jamie. The night before, we rinse out the moka pot, put water in it, put coffee in it ready to go. All Jamie needs to do is turn the kettle and the moka put on and go back to bed for more snuggles before getting up to pour. 

The coffee grounds go in a knock box ready to go out to the compost or the garden. 

It's also his job to make *second* coffees - he drinks his, mine goes in a takeaway cup for the drive, but we also make it for a flask for morning tea. 



Don't worry - I'm not being lazy. I'm the one, whilst he's doing this, picking up clothes from the floor and sorting washing ready to go on in the arvo whilst the solar's on. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YuSsCRUXGOU

> Heaven
Heaven is a place
A place where nothing
Nothing ever happens
Heaven
Heaven is a place
A place where nothing
Nothing ever happens

Ah, divine simplicity. The anti chaos machine of minimalism. 


##### Systeeemmmmss, I love sysssteemmms 🎵🎶🎵🎶🎵🎶

Oh my goodness, is that me singing that stupid song? Yep. WE're just happy because these systems make life easier. It's a minimalist hack that is less about 'less' junk and more about ditching all those tiny stupid stresses that can pile up in a working week, and having to do it all when you're tired when you get home or on the weekend. 

Because we've got these little habits and routines sorted, the house stays calmer without loads of effort and arguing. Everything just flows better. We trust each other to get the jobs done - I don't need to say 'did you make me a coffee?' or 'can you put the doona cover on' or 'where are the keys to the van' or 'where's the snacks for work' because we know our place, our role, in these little banal domestic duties.

Systeeemmmmss, I love sysssteemmms 🎵🎶🎵🎶🎵🎶

body.title: Mouth-Watering Seekh Kabab at Your Favorite Pakistani Restaurant
body.body:
![b0564e4f-9a34-4f9f-bcd7-e73a2888809f.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/c485c30e47ee674195110065c7a7ff7234b798895fbcc606673ffefa7a2bea86)



If you are craving authentic desi flavors, nothing hits the spot quite like **seekh kabab** from a trusted **Pakistani Restaurant**. These succulent, spiced meat skewers are a staple in Pakistani cuisine, offering a perfect balance of juicy tenderness and aromatic spices. Whether you are dining in Canada, the USA, or Pakistan, the experience of biting into a freshly grilled seekh kabab is unparalleled.

The popularity of this dish is not just about taste it’s about culture, tradition, and the joy of sharing food with loved ones. A perfect seekh kabab showcases a blend of textures, from the crisp outer char to the juicy, tender inside. Restaurants like Pakistani Restaurant take pride in maintaining authenticity by using fresh ingredients and traditional cooking techniques. From marination to grilling, every step is carefully executed to ensure maximum flavor in every bite.

## What is Seekh Kabab?

**Seekh kabab** is a traditional South Asian dish made from minced meat, usually beef, lamb, or chicken, blended with aromatic spices and herbs. The mixture is molded around skewers and grilled over charcoal or open flame. The result is a perfectly charred exterior with a juicy interior, packed with flavor that makes it a favorite among food enthusiasts worldwide.

### Ingredients

A traditional seekh kabab requires a thoughtful combination of ingredients:

*   Ground meat (beef, lamb, or chicken)

*   Fresh herbs such as cilantro and mint for freshness

*   Spices including cumin, coriander, garam masala, and red chili powder

*   Onion and garlic paste to enhance flavor

*   Salt and pepper for seasoning

*   Lemon juice for a subtle tang

Using fresh and high-quality ingredients ensures that each skewer delivers an authentic taste experience.

### Cooking Method

The preparation of [seekh kabab](https://karahiboys.com/menu) is both an art and a science:

1.  Marinate the meat: Combine the meat with spices, herbs, and onion-garlic paste; allow it to rest for 2–4 hours or overnight for deeper flavor.

2.  Shape the mixture: Press the marinated meat evenly onto metal or wooden skewers.

3.  Grill: Cook the skewers over medium-high heat, rotating to ensure uniform char.

4.  Serve immediately: Traditionally paired with naan, raita, or mint chutney.

## Cultural Significance

Seekh kabab is more than a meal—it’s a reflection of Pakistani culinary heritage. It is commonly served during weddings, festivals, and family gatherings, bringing people together over delicious, shared meals. Every bite of seekh kabab carries the essence of centuries-old recipes, blending spices, herbs, and grilling techniques passed down through generations.

At Pakistani Restaurant, chefs continue this tradition with a focus on authenticity, offering kababs that not only satisfy hunger but also provide a cultural experience. The careful selection of spices, herbs, and the cooking method ensures that every skewer remains true to its roots.

## Global Variations

While seekh kabab has its origins in Pakistan, variations have emerged around the world, each adding a unique twist:

### Pakistani Version

*   Robust spices including garam masala, cumin, and chili

*   Served with soft naan or flaky paratha

### Indian Version

*   Slightly sweeter and milder in spice

*   Incorporates yogurt for a softer texture

### Middle Eastern Inspired

*   Uses ingredients like sumac or tahini

*   Served with pita or flatbreads, blending South Asian and Middle Eastern flavors

Despite regional differences, the skewer’s iconic shape and smoky grilled taste remain the hallmark of seekh kabab.

## Why Seekh Kabab is Popular

The enduring popularity of seekh kabab is driven by several factors:

*   Flavor Complexity: Combines aromatic spices with tender meat

*   Versatility: Works as a snack, appetizer, or main course

*   Protein-Rich: Offers essential nutrients, particularly from lean meats

*   Social Dish: Often enjoyed during communal gatherings, making it a dish for sharing

Restaurants like Pakistani Restaurant excel in delivering these qualities consistently, which is why customers keep returning for more.

## Perfect Pairings

To elevate the dining experience, pairing seekh kabab with complementary sides is key:

### Traditional Pairings

*   Naan or Roti: Soft, warm bread that complements the kabab

*   Raita: Yogurt-based dip that balances spiciness

*   Mint Chutney: Adds freshness and zest

### Modern Twists

*   Grilled vegetables for a colorful, healthy touch

*   Quinoa salad for a fusion-style meal

*   Hummus or Baba Ganoush for a Middle Eastern flair

Each pairing enhances the flavors of seekh kabab, creating a well-rounded dining experience.

## Choosing the Best Seekh Kabab

When dining out, a few tips can help you select the best kababs:

*   Fresh Meat: Always opt for lean, high-quality meat with minimal fillers

*   Herbs & Spices: Fresh cilantro, mint, and authentic spices elevate the taste

*   Grilling Method: Charcoal or wood-fired cooking imparts smoky flavors

*   Presentation: Well-presented kababs indicate care and attention in preparation

At establishments like Pakistani Restaurant, attention to these details ensures every meal is satisfying and authentic.

## Cooking at Home

For food enthusiasts who want to try seekh kabab at home:

1.  Mix Ingredients: Combine 500g minced meat, ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, cumin, coriander, and salt.

2.  Add Herbs: Finely chop cilantro and mint; mix thoroughly.

3.  Skewer & Shape: Press the mixture onto skewers evenly.

4.  Grill: Rotate skewers over medium heat until golden brown and charred.

5.  Serve: Pair with warm naan, raita, and a wedge of lemon.

Homemade kababs can capture the authentic taste with proper preparation.

## Health Benefits

Seekh kabab is not just delicious but also nutritious:

*   High Protein: Supports muscle growth and repair

*   Low Carbs: Ideal when served with yogurt instead of bread

*   Rich in Iron & Zinc: Boosts immunity and energy

*   Healthy Fats: Lean meat reduces saturated fat intake

Consuming kababs in moderation can be part of a balanced, protein-rich diet.

## Enhancing Flavor Tips

Small adjustments can significantly enhance flavor:

*   Marinate meat overnight for deeper taste

*   Add a touch of ghee for juiciness

*   Use charcoal or wood fire for authentic smoky aroma

*   Serve immediately to preserve flavor and texture

These tweaks can transform homemade or restaurant kababs into an exceptional meal.

## FAQs About Seekh Kabab

### 1. What is the main ingredient in seekh kabab?

Ground meat beef, lamb, or chicken blended with spices and herbs.

### 2. How is seekh kabab traditionally cooked?

Skewered and grilled over charcoal or open flame.

### 3. Can I make seekh kabab at home?

Yes, with the right ingredients, herbs, and skewers, it can be made easily.

### 4. What sides complement seekh kabab best?

Naan, raita, mint chutney, grilled vegetables, or quinoa salad.

### 5. Is seekh kabab healthy?

Yes, it’s high in protein and rich in essential nutrients when prepared with lean meat.

### 6. Can vegetarians enjoy seekh kabab?

Yes, lentils, paneer, or vegetables can replace meat for a delicious vegetarian option.

## Why Pakistani Restaurant Stands Out

[Pakistani Restaurant](https://karahiboys.com/) has perfected the art of seekh kabab. Chefs adhere to authentic recipes while ensuring consistent quality and hygiene. The kababs are char-grilled to perfection, seasoned with traditional spices, and served with thoughtfully paired sides. Whether it’s a casual meal or a festive gathering, the restaurant delivers a memorable dining experience.

## Conclusion

In summary, **seekh kabab** is more than a dish it’s an authentic culinary experience that blends spices, herbs, and expertly grilled meat. Its rich flavors, versatility, and cultural significance make it a must-try for food enthusiasts. For the ultimate kabab experience, visiting **Pakistani Restaurant** guarantees freshly prepared skewers, impeccable taste, and an unforgettable meal. Treat yourself today and enjoy the true essence of Pakistani cuisine.

body.title: Why Manual Payroll Processing Is No Longer Sustainable for Growing Businesses
body.body:
There was a time when a spreadsheet, a calculator, and a stack of paper checks were enough to run payroll. For a micro-business with two employees and no plans to grow, manual processing might still work—in the same way a horse and buggy works on a modern highway.

But for a growing business, manual payroll isn't just inefficient. It's a ticking time bomb that threatens your finances, your compliance, and your employee trust.

As your headcount climbs from 5 to 15 to 50, the cracks in manual systems become canyons. Here is why clinging to spreadsheets and handwritten calculations is no longer sustainable.

## 1. The Error Rate Scales Exponentially

When you process payroll manually, every single entry is an opportunity for human error. A misplaced decimal, a transposed number, or a missed overtime hour might cost you $50 today. But when you have 30 employees with varying salaries, commissions, and deductions, one mistake can cost thousands.

Worse, errors compound. An incorrect tax withholding this month means an incorrect W-2 at year end, which means amended filings, angry employees, and IRS penalties. According to industry data, manual payroll processes have an error rate of up to 8%, while automated systems reduce that to near zero.

## 2. Compliance Is a Moving Target

Payroll compliance in 2026 is a labyrinth. Federal tax rates change. State minimum wages rise. New paid family leave programs launch. Local sick leave ordinances appear overnight.

A manual system depends entirely on you—the business owner or office manager—to track every single change. Miss one state withholding update, and you are non-compliant. Forget to file a quarterly unemployment report, and you face late fees.

Automated payroll systems update their tax tables and forms in real time. Manual systems do not. For a growing business, keeping up manually is not a matter of effort; it is mathematically impossible.

## 3. You Are Burning Your Most Valuable Asset: Time

Ask any small business owner who processes payroll manually: \

It includes collecting timesheets, verifying hours, calculating taxes, printing checks, distributing pay stubs, and filing reports.

For a business with 20 employees, that can easily consume 6–8 hours per pay period. That is nearly two full workdays per month—time you could spend on sales, strategy, or customer service.

As you grow, the time required does not increase linearly. It explodes. What took 8 hours at 20 employees will take 20 hours at 50 employees. Manual payroll is a growth tax you cannot afford.

## 4. Employee Expectations Have Changed

Today's employees expect direct deposit, online pay stubs, and self-service portals where they can update their withholding or download tax forms. Manual processing typically means paper checks, printed stubs, and asking the owner to change a W-4.

When you cannot meet those expectations, you send a message: your business is stuck in the past. Top talent will notice—and they will leave for employers who respect their time and convenience.

## The Bottom Line

Manual payroll might feel \

on the surface. But when you add the cost of errors, penalties, wasted hours, and lost talent, it is far more expensive than any [payroll software or service](https://www.tankhapay.com/payroll/payroll-software).

Growing businesses need systems that scale. Automate payroll now, or watch manual processes hold you back.

***

This content is for educational and informational purposes only and does not constitute legal, tax, or financial advice.
You should consult with a qualified professional regarding your specific business circumstances.

娃去理发店剪头发，为了避免理发师一直推销，避免大家浪费口舌，我选择不去店里，我到旁边便利店里吹着空调等。现在的理发店我都害怕进去，一进去就是有卡的充值内卡的推销办卡，真受不了。

找了半天全家便利店，店呢？仔细看了一下，地址没错啊，后来才反应过来之前的全家变成了罗森，虽然还是便利店，名字换了，我说我记忆好像没偏差啊，的确是换了。然后旁边还多了一个瑞幸，我的天，真的哪里都有瑞幸，有个小角落都能给你开个店。

我记得瑞幸这个位置以前是小超市，门面不大，夫妻俩经营的，里面日常杂货还是蛮全的，我儿子小时候，大概二年级，想买泡泡糖，但是他没钱，家里有那种硬币一毛一毛的，他给全带来了，都给了老板，数完以后发现还差两毛，老板也算了，还是给了我娃三颗泡泡糖。我也是后来他同学说了我才知道此事。

现在大环境不好，这一条街上好几个小超市，竞争也是有的，但是具体什么原因不做了就不得而知啦，只是现在换成了瑞幸，慢慢就习惯了，估计过两天蜜雪冰城也要开起来了 反正我是发现了，有瑞幸的地方必有个蜜雪冰城，相爱相杀。

剪完头发不知道晚饭吃什么，我说去买点卤味吧，回家煮点米饭随便吃了，这天热的完全没胃口，也不知道想吃啥。儿子说可以啊，那我们就去卤味店，这家店食材新鲜，每天都是早上四点夫妻俩就开始准备食材汤底啥的，然后十点开门，我看他家后厨那里两个大锅子，每天要卤好几锅。

味道好自然客人就多，我娃喜欢吃他家的猪耳朵，今天挑了一只瘦一点的，还买了点鸡胗，回家也不用做饭了，直接开吃。

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbqypUnYTCu5wgj95ZmABrdM6UrWHth99DVrz7J1DmoqB/20260601_154109.jpg)
Asi takovéhle zvětšení by bylo ještě únosné ... Je na něm \

hudebního tělesa. Včetně hudební pedagožky. Ale nebudu psát ani o svém geniálním a skvělém synovi ... (Všichni rodiče si myslíme, že naše dítě je geniální a úžasné, není-liž pravda?)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeyYuaeHeU4F5vjtSi5y4RmyTBbbYMkuRua43RMfRrxaM/20260601_153845.jpg)
A tohle je (skoro) celé těleso. Flétnová sekce a kytarová sekce. Flétnovou sekci vede paní a kytarovou pán )úplně vpravo). Dohromady jsou manželé. A o tom to dnes bude.

Jasně, že Vás nikoho nezajímá, jestli se napřed stali manželi a potom začali učit hudbě, nebo naopak. Já si myslím, že naopak. A zkusím to zobecnit.

Taky jste chodili do tanečních, která vedl manželský pár? Chodí dnešní mladí vůbec do tanečních? Já chodil ve druháku na gymplu ... Ale neměl jsem 9.třídu ... Což zas odbočuju.

A včera jsem se dozvěděl, že kolegyně ze sborovny začala žít s kolegou. No, dozvěděl ... Potvrdil jsem si to. Něco už jsem i já tušil ... Jo, zobecnění!

Když se narodíte ve vesnici za polárním kruhem, kde jsou přibližně stejného věku tři chlapci a tři děvčata, ono se to spáruje ... Tak nějak si na sebe zbudou. No, to platilo spíše v dobách dřívějších ... Dnes už někteří mladí svoji rodnou vísku během života také opouštějí ... Věřili byste tomu?

A na pracovišti vznikají i nepracovní vztahy. Někdy přátelství. Někdy nevěra. Někdy přechodné poblouznění, někdy trvalý vztah.

Pokud má někdo home office, má to z hlediska seznamování se zase o něco složitější. Nejen tedy zábava přes sociální sítě, ale i současná moderní forma práce vztahům a růstu populace nenahrává ... Vedle mnoha a mnoha jiných faktorů.

Mimochodem. Zase odběhnu ... Když mám jakýkoliv zdravotní problém, lékaři diagnostikují, že za to může, že jsem tlustej ... Zatímco kolegyně, která kouří, tvrdí, že podle jejích doktorů za všechno může to její kouření. No a děti uvádějí, že podle jejich doktorů za všechny jejich neduhy může čas trávený na PC, tabletech a mobilech. Tak nevím, co je největší zabiják lidstva ... Postřeh ze života.

Zpět. No a pokud nechodíte ani na nákupy a všechno si necháte dovážet kurýrní službou, když nejezdíte MHD ... Neříkám, že nemáte možnost se seznámit. Jistě, existují prý seznamovací aplikace. Já jaksi nikdy neměl tu potřebu je využít ...

Zkrátka, když se nestýkáte napřímo s lidmi, Vaše dovednosti v oblasti komunikace Vás budou handicapovat při navazování vztahů ... Což může být příčina velkých problémů zejména mladé generace. 

Ti, kteří byli v dětství a dospívání postiženi distanční covidovou výukou, jsou toho příkladem. Ne všichni, samozřejmě. Každý máme nějakou genetickou výbavu, nějaké vzorce chování z rodiny ...

Abych to shrnul, všiml jsem si včera, jak často člověk na pracovišti naváže vztah. Není to objev Ameriky, ani léku na rakovinu. Ale za zaznamenání si na blockchain mi to stálo.

Přes sociální sítě to jde jistě také. Hive je toho příkladem. Ale na množství uživatelů je počet spárovaných uživatelů poněkud malý. Což trochu potvrzuje moji teorii.

body.title: Stylish Name Creation: A New Way to Build a Strong Digital Identity
body.body:
In today's online world, a name is more than just a collection of letters. Whether someone is competing in gaming tournaments, growing a social media audience, or simply expressing their personality online, the way a name appears can create a lasting impression. A distinctive and visually appealing name often becomes a person's digital signature, helping them stand out among millions of users across different platforms.

As online communities continue to expand, the demand for personalized usernames and stylish text formats has increased dramatically. Players, content creators, influencers, and social media enthusiasts are constantly searching for creative ways to make their profiles memorable. Traditional usernames often look plain and fail to capture attention, especially in highly competitive environments where individuality matters.

The rise of modern typography tools has transformed the way people approach online identity. Instead of using ordinary text, users can now convert standard names into artistic designs using decorative Unicode characters. These characters allow names to appear elegant, bold, mysterious, futuristic, or even royal, depending on the chosen style. The result is a name that immediately attracts attention and reflects the personality of its owner.

Gaming platforms have played a major role in [popularizing stylish names](https://stylishnamemaker.net/). Games such as battle royale titles, multiplayer shooters, and role-playing adventures encourage players to develop unique identities. A creative name often becomes part of a player's reputation. Opponents remember it, teammates recognize it, and followers associate it with gaming achievements. As competition grows, players seek increasingly creative ways to make their names stand out.

Social media platforms have experienced a similar trend. Users want profiles that look different from the crowd. A stylish display name can instantly improve profile aesthetics and create a stronger first impression. Whether someone is building a personal brand, managing a fan page, or growing an online business, a visually appealing profile often attracts greater engagement and curiosity from visitors.

One of the biggest challenges users face is finding a reliable solution that offers a wide range of styles while maintaining compatibility across devices and platforms. Many text generators produce designs that work only in certain applications, leading to frustrating experiences when names appear incorrectly. This makes compatibility a critical factor when choosing a name styling tool.

A dedicated platform for stylish name generation solves this problem by providing hundreds of carefully designed typography options that function across popular games, social media networks, messaging applications, and mobile devices. Instead of manually searching for symbols and experimenting with character combinations, users can instantly generate multiple variations of their desired name and select the one that best matches their personality.

Another advantage of modern name styling technology is convenience. The process typically requires only a few seconds. Users enter their preferred text, and the system instantly creates numerous stylish versions. This eliminates the need for advanced design skills or technical knowledge. Anyone can create a professional-looking name regardless of age or experience.

The growing popularity of Unicode-based typography has also opened new possibilities for self-expression. Different font styles can communicate different moods and identities. Some people prefer elegant and sophisticated designs, while others choose bold and aggressive lettering for gaming purposes. There are also artistic, minimalistic, decorative, and futuristic styles that cater to a wide variety of personal preferences.

Beyond aesthetics, a unique name can contribute to better recognition within online communities. In environments where thousands of users may have similar usernames, a distinctive style helps create separation. Followers, friends, and fellow players are more likely to remember a visually unique name than a standard text-based username. This added memorability can be especially valuable for streamers, content creators, and aspiring influencers seeking audience growth.

The availability of hundreds of font variations further enhances creativity. Rather than settling for a single design, users can explore numerous categories and experiment with different looks. This flexibility allows individuals to adapt their names to different situations. A player may use one style for competitive gaming, another for social networking, and a third for content creation platforms.

As digital communication becomes increasingly visual, presentation matters more than ever. Profile customization has evolved beyond profile pictures and banners. Names themselves have become part of the overall visual identity. A carefully styled name can complement other profile elements and create a cohesive appearance that reflects personal branding goals.

The influence of stylish typography extends beyond gaming and social media. Many users incorporate decorative text into bios, status updates, nicknames, and online communities. Creative typography helps content stand out in crowded feeds where attention spans are limited. Small visual details often make a significant difference in attracting viewers and encouraging interaction.

Security and ease of use are also important considerations. Users generally prefer tools that do not require complicated registrations or lengthy processes. Instant generation combined with simple copy-and-paste functionality allows people to create stylish names quickly and efficiently. This accessibility has contributed significantly to the widespread adoption of name styling platforms.

As trends continue to evolve, demand for fresh and innovative typography options is expected to grow. Online audiences constantly seek new ways to express individuality and creativity. Platforms that offer extensive collections of stylish fonts, symbols, and decorative text styles remain valuable resources for users who want their online presence to leave a lasting impression.

A memorable name often serves as the foundation of a strong digital identity. Whether used in gaming arenas, social media profiles, streaming channels, or online communities, a unique presentation can help individuals establish recognition and showcase personality. Modern name styling solutions provide an easy and effective way to transform ordinary text into something extraordinary.

The future of online identity will likely place even greater emphasis on personalization and visual distinction. As more users compete for attention in digital spaces, the ability to create eye-catching and platform-compatible names will remain highly desirable. Stylish typography offers a practical and creative solution, empowering users to make stronger impressions and build memorable identities wherever they go online.

body.title: My neighbor's photos of lotus flowers are so beautiful and delicate.
body.body: /> Hello everyone... The evening atmosphere is lovely, and I'm taking the kids for a walk at the playground, just like usual. It sounds boring and routine, but my youngest daughter loves going to the playground in the evenings. Sometimes I'm busy, so on my days off I take her for about an hour or half an hour, depending on when I finish work early. Today, the children had about an hour to play at the playground. They were so happy! I slowly led them along the village street, which is quite quiet with not much traffic. Most of the neighbors have their houses closed and are inside, but they have trees and flowers planted in front of their houses, outside their fences. I walked slowly, observing everything. One house had large pots of colorful bougainvillea. Another had lotus flowers and other ornamental plants in front of their house. It's quite late now, so the lotus flowers should be closed, but I still saw some blooming. I walked closer and stopped to admire them. There were two pots of lotus flowers. I went to the larger pot, where two lotus flowers were protruding from the water. They were a beautiful deep pink. I glanced over to see if there were any tiny peacock tails in the pot, but there weren't. In Thailand, peacock fish would usually be kept there too. But it's understandable, because the lotus pot is outside, and when it rains, the water overflows, making it impossible for the fish to stay there.

/>\n\nAnd that one flower was purple, my favorite color, haha! It was so cute. I walked over, looked left and right, and when no one was around, I took out my phone and took many pictures. It was really beautiful, wasn't it? What do you all think? Sometimes, admiring beautiful things is a way to relax and enjoy yourself. After stopping for a while, I followed the children to the playground and sat waiting for them to play happily. This is an activity that my child and I do together in the evening. Thank you for reading this article, and see you again in the next one. Bye everyone!

之前我去过武汉好几家万象城门店，昨天说了后面和娃一起去了武昌万象城，整体体验同样很不错。商场一楼新开了一家宝可梦专卖店，而且一至三层随处摆放着大量宝可梦手办模型，逛起来氛围感拉满。
 
展品里最惹眼的的，就是大家耳熟能详的初代宝可梦：皮卡丘、小火龙、杰尼龟、妙蛙种子这四款经典鼻祖角色。除此之外还有动画中后期登场的各式宝可梦，不少款式我都叫不出名字。大批学生和小朋友专程赶来打卡拍照，宝可梦专卖店里更是人头攒动。是不是小学生们都放假了吧！？
 
我进店简单逛了一圈，正品定价不低。巴掌大小的迷你玩偶就要七十元一个，尺寸更大的款式价格还要往上翻。不过一分价钱一分货，专柜正版玩偶和别处售卖的盗版质感差距明显，做工严格按照动画形象1:1还原，细节做得很精致。
 
逛完宝可梦门店，我们去往其他楼层，偶遇一家名叫抓小鱼的门店。一开始我十分好奇，难不成还是老式儿童项目，用小网兜徒手捞鱼？走近才发现，店家改良了抓娃娃机的玩法，机器内部改成储鱼缸，抓手替换成大号塑料网兜，按键就能操控网兜前后左右移动，靠网兜打捞缸里的小鱼。
 
现场有位爸爸带着女儿体验，手法格外娴熟。他先操控网兜在左侧驱赶鱼群，把鱼儿聚拢到鱼缸右侧，再迅速把网兜落向另一边，成群小鱼轻轻松松就被捞起。没多久就装满一小桶渔获，小女孩兴奋地不停拍手，爸爸也玩得开怀大笑。我和娃也在旁边拍手叫好，哈哈！
 
沿路还看见了一家史莱姆专营店，一开始我并不清楚史莱姆是什么，还是儿子告诉我，它是类似橡皮泥、质地软黏像果冻鼻涕的儿童玩具。😓囧！！！进店后能看到各色带香味的成品史莱姆，还有各式各样配套装饰配件，店里挤满学龄前孩童，小女孩占了绝大多数。恰逢六一儿童节，满场都是陪同出游的家长，商铺客流火爆。我不由得感慨，过节当天居然有这么多家长抽空陪孩子出门玩耍。

---

<div  class=text-justify>

I saw a random clip of a man who planning a proposal with three little girls, for their mother. He wants to get married to their single mum and the girls are so happy, showing that they approve already. The engagement made me  emotional especially with how the girls kept helping him.

I wanted to see how that scene came about, I wanted to see more of the single mum who I've seen her movies and loved before, I wanted to know how their story goes after the proposal so I checked out the movie and downloaded to watch it... What I saw surprised me more than I can tell.

It turns out that **\

** isn't really about a single mum who won the heart of an amazing man and it's not even a movie about how a single mum have 3 beautiful girls who loves and wants the best for their mum. There was more to the story and it was an unexpected.

![MV5BY2RhNDRhNzctZTllMy00NTc2LWJjZmUtMzg3MTNiNjhhODMxXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_FMjpg_UX1000_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/24248PTQTC1xLX6kHYydCMQFkU9xRnQyb4KJ7utwBDvFvBSzsxhUk1Tp1JeJfyAjnZLrV.jpg)

**\

** is a biography drama released in the year 2016 starring *Taraji P. Henson, Octavia Spencer, Janelle Monáe, Kevin Costner, Mahershala Ali and Glen Powell*. A movie based on the book with the same name  \

and based on a true story that is untold.

It's a story that didn't get told enough because of the circumstances around it but having a book and a movie out about it is a good credit to the achievers involved and I feel so good to be a part of those who knows about such great women that lived and made their lives so worth living.

### **About the story and the main characters.**

Briefly, the story is about three black *(African-American)* women working in NASA as computers *(a job description then)* when there was a shortage of manpower as the American technology try to get to space for the first time in history. The story tells about the women being great contributors to having John Glenn land an orbit on space using their brains and strength. 

### **Taraji P. Henson**

![MV5BNDllOTExZDMtNmE2NC00YjJjLTk4NjctMDZjZDM5NTAzZmI2XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23wC5QfUZ6j2SPcxLqytAP1Lp1DWYCiGVQYqR4k9KhrXVEen9MoawLL9CQmfS4V5vmcAF.jpg)

Played the role of **Katherine G. Johnson**, a super brained mathematician who can calculate huge numbers. She is a black woman who works at NASA with her other black friends in a segregated space at the company. She got a promotion to work as a calculator on the inside, where the discussions and works are done to make an orbit land on space. Her grit and speed gives her the opportunity to work in the midst of *\

* and is acknowledged as one who contributed greatly to the success landing. And yeah, she is the single mum with 3 beautiful girls who found love again and got married for another 56 years with a black man Colonel. ### **Octavia Spencer** ![MV5BMGVjNGI0NWYtMzlkYi00MGM3LWE3ZmItN2VkZDNlMjhmOGJjXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_QL75_UX654_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23y8xEgnbrv1cNqpdxgnCeog6xYQTFsdTmLrTwhYmUEugTL7uKk3KX8gVrpkAu7rybFBw.jpg) Played the role of **Dorothy Vaughan**, the first African-American mathematician woman to get the role of a supervisor at NASA, a role that had been met for a White man until she proved relevant as she learnt ahead of a problem with a new machine. Her story is inspiring because even though she had to face discriminations at the library, she somehow found a way to study from the book she no access to and got ahead to a promotion where she took in other black women. ### **Janelle Monáe** ![MV5BNWNlZjg0MTMtZjAyMi00ODZiLTlmOWItYjY2MTA1NmY5NGI3XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_QL75_UX654_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23vsV83GU71omV699WG7jp9DfsWiY5rUjHJXi8RS7gJ5WkZ1XkVmj6UhwDh284BZSoTHo.jpg) Played the role of **Mary Jackson**, the first African-American mathematician who became an engineer after attending a segregated school, and engineering schooling was only met for men back then. I especially love how she handled her own case in court *(she couldn't even get the privilege to have a lawyer to plead her case)* and I found her confidence in her first day at school as the only female in her class. She graduated and got more relevant as she become an engineer. https://youtu.be/RK8xHq6dfAo?si=tla8p22oD34Cjh_e
The story is an inspiring one, exposes how the blacks fought through racial and gender discrimination to becoming figures who contributed to one major success in America. I would recommend you see the movie too, for a more detailed understanding of how inspiring and eye opening to history, this movie is. **10/10**.
**Images are from Imdb.** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@merit.ahama/three-women-one-mission-and-history-that-was-ignored-review-2bm)

links.title: Our Chill Sunday Night: Drinks, Snacks, and Family Time
links.body:
![1000063231.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayt/23w2wrgzXfda5AKtLkxXpt3seGMJW3QZBwDdQZwYw7tsSg9pb7SUbNwQziSVvNvJYT7d6.png)

‎Hello, dear friends here in the Daily Blog community! 🫰🏻🥰🫰🏻
‎
‎Today, I want to share with you how my hubby and I spent our Sunday night. It was just a simple and quiet evening.
‎
![1000063160.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayt/EouA52YUe6y3AM5dNiU9a7jSYA5KDCTcD2uW6mqETfGzCnuaonviVTXbNsNxdpp2o9b.jpg)
‎
‎We decided to buy a few drinks to enjoy together. I picked San Mig Hard Seltzer in Citrus Mix and my hubby chose a can of San Mig Light. 
‎
![1000063150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayt/EoyQyCXTQ3cA8DRM1CYb5TrC42YQBNzjwBx6oAGX1ZTq6AnZsYXjR2r2jEwtswieZSZ.jpg)
![1000063151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayt/23yJM3f2xUop73ThJKGqWp7dWb16MR3UDXn6uYFseSAQTmFRMufv18w85vPiBxwG3Jvfi.jpg)
‎
‎I was really excited about the Citrus Mix because I have tried their other flavors like apple, lemon, and lychee, but this one was completely new to me. I love trying new things, so I chose that one immediately. It tasted sweet, refreshing, and just like a fruit juice, so you won't notice the alcohol in it.
‎
‎Of course, we also got something to eat. We bought simple pulutan like some plain peanuts and a pack of our favorite chips. 
‎
![1000063152.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayt/EoeHMZWoq6k4esR6goudmW9DPdUAUZb8GcoBe6Fa7bRq3nAy6YMtGcqxKtUMu6GiB3H.jpg)
![1000063153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayt/EoGztSo4ioXXwuWeBqFVcJEN55vu4LoeDxw9gYMsuFEqgbvqfgzY1U19qHDhuXfvAMq.jpg)
‎
‎Usually, by this time, our kids should be fast asleep. Ryzen was already asleep in bed. But Aiden? He's joining us. 
‎
‎He actually fell asleep very early in the evening, so when we started settling down, he was wide awake and full of energy again.  😅 
‎
‎He wasn’t drinking, of course. I gave him some breadsticks as his snack. 
‎
![1000063155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayt/EprV2Ap9kCMzDXPGLfCy1kpRfx6EFpJBqEri6NNEdykeCxMfrspFBFVvoinNrNBggzs.jpg)

‎He sat right beside us, having his own chill time while watching his favorite show, D’Billions. 
‎
‎It was so cute seeing him enjoy his own little version of his night.
‎
‎I told my hubby that we should watch a movie together while we drink. But we ended up scrolling through our phones, laughing at funny videos, and sharing interesting things we saw online. 
‎
‎How about you, friends? How did you spend your last Sunday? Did you go out, stay home, or have a fun night too? 🍒🌹🍒
‎
‎Until my next story...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎
![1000031062.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayt/EpxuCJV23tpo2GPp2d9w7FzQQamsf1J7pxQdiNxRtQ3TFC9wdjckgB8Ttn8ZpTMyd5z.png)

title.body:
#1163 - Bokod Benguet Shots for Tuesday. 


A cheerful Tuesday fellow dearest amazing Hive family everywhere! I hope today finds you in great spirits, remember that every small step forward counts. Wishing everyone a productive and smooth Tuesday. Stay awesome and enjoy your day🤗. 

Now for our daily shots after completing our Hike with my wife, a couple of friends and I while on the road back to Baguio City, we made a stopover at the famous Ambuklao Dam in Bokod, Benguet. It was a good place to stretch and admire the engineering marvel built in the mountains. As soon as we parked, we walked toward the flood gates but when we got there, only a small amount of water was released, bummer!
![1000018413.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EoiVmqDjTcTqZ6CfTVcq9bxnERgirjUGyppvbJtGUAeZ74pkgjqKgBaRPHZYAMkoX5d.jpg)

We gathered together near the railing to take some selfies. It was a great way to commemorate our trip here with our smiling faces and the concrete giant behind us. 
![1000018446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23wWrUXxxC5VECtxih2FG7wcVm4rejr9upMkh6Dui2oYWKuNEsmrXzoWk2pKEMWHJYXkL.jpg)

![1000018473.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tvbtXoYh7gB6P6YqudsGZGzFQUnjtzXunqph2zsQakbqZC1KH6nnM2piY2WMn3LLmds.jpg)

After the group shots, I wanted a solo shot of the place so I sat on a low concrete wall near the water's edge. I asked my wife to take a picture of me in this same spot as before our last visit with the dam's  water right in front of me. 
![1000018511.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EpLg4PxL419AcaiiMuZ4iXbSqXiqH4iFZA4pr35QZ1ZgZTCMpUWV4BnHvC9s33657fG.jpg)

![1000018537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EprU5g5cT621U3eorCzjeV8n6GiYYoZfZvMoE3jR9j9KF8KEn2aGVbdVXPEdqwExev6.jpg)

![1000018544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EpviqyuN7u891PB99NE2V3h9oAVA2EvJ7S5159YsfaCzirUJgbK9DtxLgi924aRoQ7G.jpg)

We spent a good amount of time just walking around the area afterwards while taking more shots of the surroundings. I thought it was such a cute scene that we include the dog in here. Then we hopped back in my Isuzu Crosswind 2017 XL feeling refreshed for the rest of the drive back to Baguio.
![1000018547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EpxrKzsfSonSJ8B9NnrJPbA4EKygcusxNqhyqtPE4TGmf9KwBisCNBcoWrEJNgthWjG.jpg)

title.title: Back-to-School Shopping and Family Dinner at Graceland!☺️
title.body:
***A Beautiful and Wonderful day to each and everyone!***👋😊

Hello to all of my friends here and of course to all my dear fellow hivers in this lovely @hiveph community!😍

How are you all today? I hope everyone is doing well and happy right now. Here I am again, @lj1728 to share another simple life story with you all.💕

![April 2026 Blogs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23x1Kyj78P5wd7YyUYuBmjaH2umqXXFSGbC823FNJkUz8T3d47DxzySdYZDR9eecvm596.png)

Last weekend, my husband, my son, and I decided to visit the bookstore to buy some school supplies since classes will officially start on June 8. We did not have a long shopping list because we were thankful that my son’s school bag and shoes were still in good condition. Since those items could still be used, we only needed to buy a few basic supplies for the upcoming school year.

![IMG_8687.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vi8XjG9UFuY6F2SvBSDaiuArDJ5odEhpL5mM75K8TU8SMtw7sCHvvPcy6FWvviEkQvK.jpeg)

![IMG_8685.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23u6BZgzZV5UfK6PoEt9qAa4jKDysJbvggbc9R8vQnwJjRig5LKaHacPvvs4RVKvWPqjK.jpeg)

We chose to go in the afternoon so we could avoid the intense heat of the day. The weather was much more comfortable, making our little family trip more enjoyable. When we arrived at the bookstore, there were not many shoppers around, which was nice because we were able to browse peacefully without feeling rushed. 

![IMG_8686.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoAbiQbs8jSrx1Qn7GYoCYa9VxHBJ8GsM8QiFfKAEYpPzd4mBDDvVtu9WK15KniPTNp.jpeg)

![IMG_8688.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wgRzqhfdcqLLCdWscLNMxCqysYGgaYp61bdH4mQf8qQgT7dLC3odSwJf4aPZzTHG4E1.jpeg)

One of the things I enjoyed most was letting my son chose some of his school supplies. He was excited to look around and pick the items he liked. It was fun to see him happily exploring the aisles and checking different notebooks, pencils, and other school essentials. His excitement made the shopping trip even more special for us.

![IMG_8684.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xemxeGaF1Xj96mhkPPmsHdH86AD3bVV9KJzcZ23rZMRerJ58uF7d8eASpeNp1GfJjCR.jpeg)

![IMG_8683.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoGzuZ8TayAhyMBMn6vFsY5C2WSg66k9XJPKezZLCdrrctobxp5PuSgPC5SA2fRZYJm.jpeg)

![IMG_8682.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMePHALN4Xpwu8PfhDtkqQgneRvyJhh6RzMdctDu6XsYz7snD8kihKDScMoLuz8cGgx.jpeg)

After we finished shopping, we paid for our purchases, we decided to invite my parents to join us for dinner. It had been a while since we had eaten together in a restaurant, so we taught it would be a nice way to spend the evening. We met at “Graceland” and enjoyed a wonderful family dinner.

![IMG_8704.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/EoiY4NjjpfXwHXY6qyTHwLLdZ7cEX1ZACQNLAK1eoF4HLdXqtQJ1ukNuMCkERTDhNC4.jpeg)

![IMG_8702.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wgTrRHjGn8Ve9uYWKk2k6XTmmqCrCp69agEvAsXo2bHZag62w4yBEmkx8SRH7Crzfy2.jpeg)

The food was delicious as always! I really liked dining there because the dishes have a comforting, home-cooked taste that reminds me of family gatherings. My son and I ordered our favorite chicken and barbeque combo, which he happily finished. My husband chose the asado lomi and veggie rolls, while my parents had bistek and sizzling burger steak. Everyone seemed satisfied with their meals, and we spent the evening sharing stories and enjoying each other’s company.

And that's it for today's blog! Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story. This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.😍

***These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.***✍️👩‍💻

**Lots of love,
LJ**💗

title.title: When Caring Isn’t Enough: Letting Others Learn Their Own Lessons
title.body:
Lately, I've come to understand a lesson that took me a long time to learn, seriously, once I realise that you cannot change someone who is not willing to change themselves, I learnt my lessons.

This realization became very personal for me because I genuinely tried to help someone close to me. I cared deeply about her and wanted the best for her. I spent a lot of time explaining, advising, encouraging, and hoping she would see things differently. But no matter how much I tried, she remained determined to do what she wanted.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf259TFf3H7L4k1bvzAPMLShYhj6auBNX2x8ACvPGzkDM/1000223138.jpg 

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/change-decision-choice-direction-2930404/)

What made it even harder was seeing people around her, people who were even closer to her than I was, encourage the very behavior I believed was hurting her. Their reasoning was that it was normal for the times we live in. According to them, this is just how things are now, and there was nothing wrong with it. Watching that happen was frustrating because it felt like every attempt to guide her toward a different path was being cancelled out by voices telling her otherwise.

For a while, I carried that burden on my shoulders. I thought that if I cared enough, spoke enough, or stayed patient enough, eventually something would change. Instead, I found myself becoming emotionally exhausted. I was investing so much energy into someone else's choices that I was neglecting my own peace of mind.

That's when I realized something important: support and responsibility are not the same thing. We can support people, encourage them, and be there for them, but we cannot take responsibility for their decisions. We cannot force growth, maturity, or self-awareness on another person. Those things have to come from within.

Sometimes, the most difficult thing to do is step back. Not because you stop caring. Not because you give up on them. But because you finally accept that their life is theirs to live, and their lessons are theirs to learn. Some people only understand certain truths after experiencing the consequences of their own choices.

I've learned that constantly trying to save someone who doesn't want to be saved can leave you drained and disappointed. It can make you carry weights that were never yours to carry in the first place. There comes a point where I have to release that burden and focus on what I can actually control, my own actions, growth, and well-being.

This experience taught me that real change begins when a person decides they are ready for it. No amount of love, advice, concern, or sacrifice can replace that personal decision. Until someone reaches that point on their own, all you can do is offer support from a healthy distance and allow them to walk their own path.

And sometimes, the greatest act of love is not trying harder to change someone, it's accepting that their journey is theirs, not yours.





**Thank for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**
