title.title: Chapter 3: The Wrong Gauls
title.body:
**Chapter 3: The Wrong Gauls**

Without looking back even once, Fakir Antantos and Fukur Salamantan finally found themselves far away from the Village of the Brave Resistance.

They had been walking for hours.

Their feet were covered in blisters.

Their clothes smelled of mud, hay, and pigs.

And to make matters worse, their mission had been a complete failure.

Fukur sat down on a large rock.

The pain from the wooden dummy head that had struck him earlier still hadn’t faded.

“We are officially the worst spies in the world.”

he muttered.

Just then, a familiar sound echoed through the forest.

Grrrrrrrr…

Fakir Antantos’s stomach was once again performing its famous hunger march.

Fakir looked around.

He had absolutely no idea how to find food.

So, as always, he looked at Fukur.

And, as always, Fukur had no solution either.

The two continued walking hopelessly until Fakir noticed a thin column of smoke rising in the distance.

He immediately jumped to his feet.

“Fukur! Smoke from a fire!”

Fukur raised his head.

“So?”

“People make fires!”

“What an incredible discovery.”

“That means there are people over there!”

Fukur thought for a few seconds.

Then he stood up.

“You know… this time you might actually be right.”

So they began walking toward the smoke.

As they got closer, they heard drums.

Then laughter.

Then music.

And finally, they saw a large camp.

Around fifteen warriors were gathered around a bonfire, celebrating.

At first glance, they looked like Gauls.

But they looked nothing like the people from the Village of the Brave Resistance.

They looked tougher.

More heavily armed.

And definitely far more dangerous.

A bad feeling crept into Fukur’s mind.

“Antantos… don’t make a sound.”

“Okay.”

“Don’t shout.”

“Okay.”

“Don’t draw attention to us.”

“Okay.”

Fukur turned around.

At that exact moment, Antantos cupped his hands around his mouth and yelled:

“HEY, GAUL FRIENDS! WE COME FROM THE VILLAGE OF THE BRAVE RESISTANCE!”

Silence.

The drums stopped.

The music ended.

All fifteen warriors turned and stared at them.

Fukur closed his eyes.

“Why am I not surprised?”

he whispered.

But the attack they expected never came.

Instead…

Huge smiles appeared on the warriors’ faces.

They began looking at one another.

Their leader stood up.

“You come from the Village of the Brave Resistance?”

Antantos proudly puffed out his chest.

“Yes!”

Meanwhile, Fukur had already begun praying internally.

Because there was something he didn’t know.

These warriors were not allies of the Village of the Brave Resistance.

They were a rival Gaul tribe.

And that very night, they were planning to attack the village.

The leader smiled slyly.

“The gods are helping us today.”

“What nice people.”

said Antantos.

Fukur, however, shivered when he saw the expression on the leader’s face.

The warriors welcomed them like honored guests and invited them to sit by the fire.

They served them food.

They gave them drinks.

For the first time in his life, Fakir believed a mission was actually going well.

But there was one thing they didn’t know.

The tribe’s battle plan now contained a new item:

**“Use the two foolish soldiers as living shields.”**

And at that very moment, the leader was pointing at the Village of the Brave Resistance on a map.

However, standing near the entrance of the tent, Fukur’s eyes accidentally drifted toward the map.

And for the first time in his life…

He noticed something truly important.

Perhaps the intelligence they had been searching for all along…

Was right in front of them.

**To Be Continued…**

title.title: Eumerus figurans fly
title.body: > On a gently curled blade of grass, I found a Eumerus figurans fly perched there. It stood there very calmly, seemingly waiting for the morning sun to warm its body. It was a very cold morning. I, wearing a jacket, felt very cold, especially the fly, whose entire body was covered only by fine, thin hairs. I'm sure the fly felt the cold more than I did. But it never complained, remaining relaxed there, as if it had a deep understanding of life. It seemed fully prepared for whatever situation lay ahead.

> Judging by the combination of colors covering its body, it didn't look like a fly. Its costume was very similar to a bee. The only two things that easily distinguished this fly from a bee were its antennae and wings. This fly has very short antennae, while bees have long ones. Likewise, its wings only have one pair of wings, while bees have two pairs. Everything else, I found, was similar. One more thing you should know: despite its bee-like costume, this fly doesn't sting. It doesn't have a stinger. So it is very safe to approach it.

title.title: Encuentro de Talentos: Lo imposible se vuelve posible
title.body:
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaWq6GS62PrApQdmQ4Q9na6hu9wWxRJrmihM9WVFsN9qA/imagen.png)
Está en nuestra mente volver lo imposible algo posible. Muchas veces soñamos despiertos por realidades que deseamos tener pero al darnos cuenta son exagerados los patrones del deseo. Alistarse a verdaderos encuentros por lograr metas que nos parecen imposibles. Cuando planificamos muchas veces no tomamos en cuenta las fallas que podríamos tener. En la programación siempre se incluye esa tecla, esa posibilidad de reiniciar donde nos quedamos sin tener que ir muy atrás y perder lo alcanzado. > It's in our nature to make the impossible possible. We often daydream about realities we long for, but upon closer inspection, we realize our desires are exaggerated. We must prepare ourselves for real challenges to achieve goals that seem impossible. When we plan, we often fail to consider potential pitfalls. Our planning always includes that option, that possibility of restarting where we left off without having to go too far back and lose what we've gained.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ8q2k4XLkTn9MzYHPLLVvuiy1b1Eqt6joa3YoPWy6CRy/imagen.png)
Trabajamos incansablemente para lograr a veces cosas imposibles y complicadas, las vemos allá a lo lejos y cuando las tenemos allí tan cerca simplemente no las disfrutamos, estamos pensando en un próximo logro. Yo no pedi este viaje porque se que es costoso pero ahora que se hizo posible algo con tanta dificultad debería disfrutarlo y atrapar sus recuerdos y enseñanzas más valiosas. > We work tirelessly to achieve things that are sometimes impossible and complicated. We see them far away, and when they're right there, so close, we simply don't enjoy them; we're already thinking about the next achievement. I didn't ask for this trip because I know it's expensive, but now that something so difficult has been made possible, I should enjoy it and capture its most valuable memories and lessons.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUuZMt8htRiHjCYScc3rM959ZFSGx8eC6hopjgBj4HegM/imagen.png)
Mis hijos se vuelven mis maestros y esto se volvió posible al empeño y trabajo familiar. Mantenerlos en un contacto permanente con la realidad diaria. No son perfectos, pero lo imposible de tener tres hijos profesionales tan pendiente de su madre se ha vuelto posible. Por esos detalles vuelvo mi rostro a disfrutar lo alcanzado, a pesar de las dificultades, de los esfuerzo, me permito soñar con un imposible y disfrutarlo, porque yo soy así pendiente de todo y de todos. Sigo sufriendo por los parientes en Venezuela, leo sus mensajes y no puedo hacer mucho por ellos. Allí si quiero un soñar posible, un cambio, una mejora para todos. Disfrutar aquí de cosas buenas y ellos allá pasando trabajo. Que gran aprendizaje que nos queda y espero que eso nos haga más fuertes. > My children have become my teachers, and this has been made possible by the family's dedication and hard work. Keeping them in constant contact with daily life is key. They aren't perfect, but the seemingly impossible feat of raising three professional children so devoted to their mother has become a reality. > It's these little things that allow me to appreciate what I've achieved, despite the difficulties and the effort. I allow myself to dream of the impossible and enjoy it, because that's just who I am—always attentive to everything and everyone. I still worry about my relatives in Venezuela; I read their messages and can't do much for them. There, I long for a possible dream, a change, an improvement for everyone. I want to enjoy good things here while they struggle there. What a valuable lesson we've learned, and I hope it makes us stronger.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQUqzq1WxUNn8h2g29QKudB6xwVn4heJFVVaZE8k6rfHN/imagen.png)
¿Será posible que mis flores aguanten mi ausencia? No lo sé pero yo espero que se vuelva posible, que mi hijo haga lo mejor posible por ellas, se que les dará agua, pero nunca les hablará. Sé que la mascota Malta todavía me busca en mi cuarto y que cuando caen truenos se mete en mi closet buscando protección. Era difícil que logrará volver a España no había vuelos, todo se veía cerrado en los cielos y hoy estoy aquí pisando el otro lado del charco. Lo imposible de lograr se volvió posible, las dificultades se hicieron a un lado y lo planificado anteriormente regreso a su cause. Lograr lo imposible es soñar en grande, tener ideas creativas, mirar un futuro posible y desear estar presente en él. > Will my flowers be able to endure my absence? I don't know, but I hope they will, that my son will do his best for them. I know he'll water them, but he'll never speak to them. I know that Malta, my pet, still looks for me in my room and that when thunder crashes, she hides in my closet seeking shelter. > It seemed impossible for me to return to Spain; there were no flights, everything seemed closed off in the skies, and today I'm here, standing on the other side of the ocean. The impossible became possible, the difficulties faded away, and what I had planned fell back into place. > Achieving the impossible means dreaming big, having creative ideas, envisioning a possible future, and wanting to be a part of it.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQfNftgEFuSzf6CbdVxZEvbmHjKpYt2txdP8vvWA7zLMi/imagen.png)

Esta es mi participación en el tema de la semana en la comunidad de encuentro de talentos de la mano de nuestra @angelica7 [Post Encuentro de Talentos: \

](https://hive.blog/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-el-reino-de-lo-posible). > Everyone is invited to share this realm of possibility with us, wherever they are, from any reality or space. It has never been easier to dream and desire change, instead of sitting idly by waiting for others to act.
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXNjPmKX7DtF43RFmf9natLJbsoLekvpJN9SeREYCBz7X/imagen.png)

title.title: Three Tune Tuesday ~ Fabrizio Moretti ~ Birthday Boy #93
title.body:
### Welcome to my #TTT #ThreeTuneTuesday entry! Good morning, friends! This week is going to be a whirlwind for me. Tomorrow I have a bus to catch very early in the morning. I’m going to a ceremony in Porto. I’m going to take advantage of the holiday on Thursday. I know that a lot of people won’t be celebrating the holiday, right, Oleg? Hang in there, friend! I wish you a great conference and good luck with your work. Being away for five days out of the week clearly requires some planning for the things I’ll need to do during the three days I won’t be as connected. Hive will certainly be one of them, so please excuse my extended absence in advance. I hope to catch up on all the comments you’ve been leaving on my posts. Today I woke up, and for the first time in a while, I didn’t feel this way anymore… I just wanted to stay in bed longer. My body was sore, and I was exhausted. I think this may very well have been due to the fact that yesterday I ate a meal with more calories, and especially more carbs than I should have. It was already late, and even though I slept better because my stomach was full, I paid the price this morning. Maybe today, I’ll try to fast a little longer to make up for this lack of energy. I’m sure I’ll feel much better throughout the day if I gradually lower my blood sugar and insulin levels naturally and gradually. It looks like the weather is going to be a lot cooler than it was toward the end of last week. And I might even get a few light showers. But now, I’m going to get to the main topic of my post and stop rambling on about my day! Fabrizio “Fab” Moretti, who is celebrating his 46th birthday today, was born in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and is a member of the band “The Strokes,” with whom he has released six albums. This drummer identifies not as Brazilian, Italian, or American, but as a New Yorker, and has brought a breath of fresh air to the current music scene. From a very young age, he began to make his mark, starting his journey with the drums at age 5, when he began playing. But it wasn’t until high school that he took his musical side more seriously. His very clean and poignant style showcases a maturity that is highly appreciated by the band’s fans. I’m going to share three songs here that I particularly like from this group, whose performance I saw at NOS Alive 2022! I hope you enjoy them! https://youtu.be/b8-tXG8KrWs https://youtu.be/ewOPQZZn4SY https://youtu.be/2KSpDNlsVF4

title.title: Understanding Hive Power Leasing and Current APR Trends || Hive-Engine HP LEASE
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image Jun 2, 2026, 12_15_19 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23t74beqPL6kf2HxTEutkErBVk1e9FBdEAJchVZGAj64YCDFsfWH95LzxMyPCBCiKUWsK.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


These days the price of Hive is very volatile. For almost two weeks we have been seeing that Hive sometimes makes a 30% spike and sometimes a 40% spike and then cools down again. This means that accumulation and distribution are still going on. A good momentum can be seen and a proper trend line is forming which is bullish.

We will see in the coming weeks whether it breaks the 0.068 resistance level and forms an accumulation zone there or not. If that happens then we may see further bullish momentum.

Keeping this in mind if we look at the lease market on Hive Engine its APR is also fluctuating. As I mentioned before I have often noticed APR fluctuations with Hive price changes. Whenever the Hive price starts increasing we usually see an increase in APR and whenever the price falls, APR becomes lower.

Previously, we saw the APR around 8.5% but if we look now the maximum requested lease APR is around 7.97%. This means that at the moment you can take an HP lease at a very good APR.

![Screenshot 2026-06-02 115333.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23wgYjqqpfD3oWxGRkE7jD4jwzDnT8tJ97gdLMbqu6s3wbjbRyMYN7o14PUy5CnaCazTQ.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

Remember that taking an HP lease increases your influence in the ecosystem. It helps your account growth. You can start curating good content which can increase your followers and friends and there is also a higher chance that you may start receiving vote backs.

Overall, the disadvantages of taking an HP lease are fewer while the benefits are greater. Keeping this in mind today I thought I would explain a short lease tutorial for new users so that they can easily take a lease from the Hive Engine market.

---
### For this you need to follow a few important steps.
---

![Screenshot 2026-06-02 115345.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tmar2RSk8Y2Rs2e6ZNbmmtsDpsBM8mNALUHgoLUh96puKk846XQiVp3gTemopK2MEAh.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

First, open Hive Engine. There at the top, you will see the Lease option. Simply click on Lease. You will then see two options, Request Lease and Fill.

Request Lease means that you want to take an HP lease which is possible at different APR rates. Fill means that you want to provide HP on lease. It is important to understand the difference between these two options.

Since we want to take a lease at a lower APR we simply click on Request Lease. There, it will ask for some details about the lease.

You need to select HP 
enter your account name
and then specify how much HP you want to lease?? 
let's say I write 20,000 HP..

Next, choose the number of weeks. Remember that the more weeks you select, the more APR concession you may receive.

Finally enter how much SWAP.HIVE you will pay every week and set your APR accordingly. For example, if the current APR is 7.97%, which I think is very good then based on that rate, for a 12 week lease you would need to pay around 432 SWAP.HIVE in total.

![Screenshot 2026-06-02 115437.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/Eo2BJ5WgGj8Byj4yiDFst1o62omSYcwLRc51o4mTheNiKSVWWL7pjMj83EQvtdYLMjx.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

This process is very simple. After that proceed to the next step and complete the transaction through Hive Keychain.

What happens then? If there is a leaser available immediately, your request will be filled and the HP will be delegated to your account. You can then use that HP to increase your influence and support your account growth.

Remember that if you lease HP for yourself, you should use it properly for the improvement of the Hive ecosystem. Avoid bid bots, vote-circling and similar activities that may result in downvotes.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

title.title: What is our fate in the next 10 years?
title.body:
This has become an issue of a particular concern to most people including me.
If my answer to that question is “YES” then I must be a great joker because the presence of AI and the level of its advancement in carrying out tasks is overwhelming.
We can't just help but agree to the efficacy and the power of that bot in delivering tasks without error, but in the long run there is something I as human can control and manage which might not be possible with the AI.

I have sat to examine my kind of job and from all observation the work will partially be there in future time. There is this part of the job I believe the AI might not be able to handle which is the human emotions and reactions when those emotions are triggered. In such a case I believe even the AI itself will be in danger if there is such an occurrence.

I have come across so many cases of impatience among customers and a case where the inferior is always oppressed and in such cases the only thing that can come through for such a case is the presence of empathy, that feeling that can only be felt by humans. There are cases when the rich will always want to oppress the poor just because they drove some exotic cars.
Most of these cases might not be well handled by the AI because they are being programmed to respond to certain commands knowing fully well that the human emotions are dynamic in nature.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeHVhV4EjZwoN68ivjRRRF2KrwjM5wWCeu893JoZSmB1g/1780384278762.png)

*Ai generated image*

We dispense gas products to automobiles. I can imagine the work being carried out by some AI, how efficiently they will carry it out with zero stress and well coordinated.


What I think will happen in the next 10 years is a supportive hand from the AI to assist humans and make the work easy to carry out.

Then humans will be there to give command to the AI on what to do so that there won't be any form of malfunction in the system. The humans will also serve as some kind of protecting system to avoid system from been compromised by tech gurus, you all know what I mean by this.

As much as they are agents of good and great work, let's not also forget that they are made by humans and can be destroyed.

So the presence of humans will also be a necessity for close observation and maintenance.


The [Indianunited](https://ecency.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-ae0ff15b5f76c) gave us a reason to think, do well to participate.

Namaste🙏

title.title: Angels Don’t Always Have Wings .
title.body:
Life has a way of showing you how valuable people truly are... like you will just see/experience things at times and be you will glad that you have people around you at such a time.



![1000089710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/EpLeXqH8kVcTvEYyrAg91rb5zzDjK2aUpqpg4Du2vqzM6w5dj1iZJLEAGju2vKa6fgn.jpg)



For me, that moment was when I was sick and on the sick bed for years. I was always in and out of the hospital while undergoing different tests and surgeries. And I can tell you that that season of my life stretched me, stretched my family and been tested us.... It was a trying moment.




It got to a point that things began to take a turn around, my family went into debts, sold stuffs and did all they could just so to keep me alive. And I'm grateful to them, they did stood by me, I'm grateful to the friends and relatives who made themselves available as well. Their prayers, faith, kindness, love, and care paid off.



Today, I will love to talk about this two people I will ask well never forget. One is a complete stranger, and the other was my doctor 




![1000089681.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23y8yoouSGv9uGZWTamndiq37KhLRm8qTnvV9hCjQ2bJjmJSffhn1wW6xwzWB7mML5Gu4.jpg)


I was just alone that night at the hospital, the pain wouldn't allow me to sleep and I can't very well recall where my mum, dad, or brother went to, I just knew I was alone with other patients in the ward. My bed was among the top three closest to the nurse's stand in my ward and that is where he went to directly, I couldn't hear them though and I couldn't see his face because there was no light. After he had discussed with them, he looked around the hospital ward and went to random beds to drop an envelope, I was lucky to be a part of the few he came to.



I was glad he came through for us then, because it was a time when all hope was lost and we couldn't even think of any other thing. Just sad that he didn't say his name or who he was so I could really appreciate him and so my family could find him and thank him. Because he was obviously an answer to our prayers at that time.




Like I said earlier, the other person was my doctor. It was a tough time for us too, and I was scheduled for another surgery, and there were list of the things I was to buy aside from the surgery and anesthesia fee. The. The night before that particular surgery, he came by. It was a time we couldn't even think of what else to do, I was just laying there on the hospital bed blaming myself for putting my family in such a situation.


![1000718641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23y8vEvDG6aVZZk4fjv2B6pqSPtFWiUjwHoMZFFm6tvjACqAcCmNVXbZxf3u5FJtciqSL.jpg)




He came in with stuffs. Im Short, he has help gotten every single thing I will be needing for the surgery. Even though he's my doctor, he does not have to do it, but he did.





That act changed how I began do see medical personnel. Not as if I don't admire and love them before, but I saw beyond all of that, I saw them, they are indeed very caring, forget about the way they act, their job just entails that they be like that sometimes.




And that was how I was able to survive the hardest seasons of my life. A lot of people stood by me then and I'm grateful to them, but this support from a total stranger and from my doctor is what I still think about a lot. I am a living proof of their kindness.



🌹

**Images are mine.**

**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

❣️❣️❣️

title.title: What questions should you ask an elevator company about their service response time before signing?
title.body:
![_What questions should you ask an elevator company about their service response time before signing.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/51ea60668c5b597ddace0dd7705c4ba396b1c29e1db0d2c2813999ef4bed5063)





Most people negotiate price and cabin specifications when buying a home elevator. Very few negotiate or even ask about service responsiveness until they are stuck between floors at 10pm and the service line is unmanned.

Here are the exact questions you should ask any elevator company before signing, and the answers that separate the best elevator company in Delhi from the rest:

1\.   What is your guaranteed response time for breakdown calls?- Anything above 8 hours for Delhi NCR is not acceptable. Attico commits to a 4-hour response window.

2\.   Do you have a 24/7 emergency line or does it go to voicemail after hours?'- Ask them to call the number with you present. If it goes to voicemail on a weekday afternoon, it will go to voicemail at 11 pm.

3\.   How many certified technicians do you have based in Delhi NCR?- A company with one technician servicing 200 elevators cannot provide genuine responsiveness.

4\.   What is included in your AMC versus chargeable?- Clarify: Are spare parts covered? Labour for emergency calls? Annual safety inspections?

5\.   Can I speak with three existing AMC clients as references?- Any company confident in their service will provide this immediately.

6\.   What is your parts availability for my specific model?- If parts are imported, breakdown repair can take weeks. Confirm Indian inventory.

Attico Elevators' service infrastructure for [residential elevators in Delhi NCR](https://atticoelevators.com/residential-elevators-in-delhi/) includes a dedicated team of 30+ certified technicians across Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, and Faridabad- with a parts warehouse stocked for all models they install. Their response commitment is documented in the AMC agreement, not just verbal.

>[Financial News] It has been reported that U.S. President Donald Trump, who visited China for the first time in nine years last month, asked Chinese President Xi Jinping to help negotiate the end of the war in Ukraine. Xi's reaction is unknown.

>The South China Morning Post (SCMP), an English newspaper in Hong Kong, quoted officials on the 1st that Trump discussed Ukraine with Xi Jinping during his visit to China from July 13 to 15. At the time, Trump asked Xi Jinping to help Russian President Vladimir Putin return to the negotiations, saying that negotiations between Ukraine and Russia over the end of the war have stalled. He then urged Putin to cooperate so that he can talk with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
The SCMP pointed out that Trump has made the war in Ukraine the core of his foreign policy agenda since the inauguration of the second administration last year. At the same time, he claimed that the request reflects the clear need of the U.S. to involve China in efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

> Negotiations for a ceasefire on the war in Ukraine, which began in 2022, have effectively collapsed since they contacted Turkiye in July last year. Trump put pressure on Zelensky to speed up negotiations in March.
China's state-run Xinhua News Agency reported on Monday that the leaders of the U.S. and China exchanged views on major international and regional issues including the situation in the Middle East, the crisis in Ukraine and the Korean Peninsula. The White House made no mention of Ukraine in the explanatory materials for the summit that were released afterwards. Trump said he discussed the Ukraine issue at the meeting with Xi, only mentioning that it is an issue that he wants us to resolve. Xi's response to the Ukraine issue has not been confirmed.
China has not publicly supported the war since the start of the war in Ukraine, but it supported Putin by purchasing large quantities of Russian oil and supplying electronics to Russia that have blocked trade due to Western sanctions. title.title: The Lower ground of Duden falls
title.body:
I wrote about the Duden waterfalls of Antalya, and shared the upper ground of the falls. Today I will share with you the lower grounds of the falls which are located in the heart of Antalya city flowing through the city and plunging from a height of 40 meters in to the Mediterranean sea. It is one of the natural wonders that truly gives a very captivating sight. There is a park area also where I saw that many people came for day picnics. It is little far from the city center, but from where we stayed it was close-by. Our hotel was closer to the airport and far from the city center.

Best is that there is no entry fee to this sight and it's all free. The upper ground falls did have a fee but this one is free. Only there are parking charges for private vehicles, which is also nominal fee. As a tourist, we normally prefer having a tour guide, but for this particular place there is no requirement of a tour guide.

This was the first sight that we started our day with and it really felt very good. The falls are not as huge as Niagara or something like that, but they are still very impressive. And what I enjoy the most is the sound of the gushing water from the hill falling into the sea. It's roaring and fierce. We spent quite a lot of time here and also clicked loads of pictures. There were some local stalls serving chai and some of their local foods. The chai was made in the sand, which gave a very good flavor. Well, I am not a tea drinker, but hubby had and he relished it.

That's a good view of the falls

I loved the manta ray; it swims so calmly. The sea turtle also looks beautiful, as do all the animals and plants, but the eagle is definitely my favorite. The presentations were excellent.*

*These kinds of activities are essential for promoting environmental awareness and respect for animal species in children. They also give them the opportunity to work in groups and give presentations outside the classroom.*

*Have a great day!*

title.title: Desire
title.body: <center>\n\n<div class=\
> Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. ***

> Hello my dear friends. I am @rasel72. From #Bangladesh. *** ![6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzmjzejb5fomYEwGLiXFwfNTggg38DtG2CczGPoxe4hwtdy2KPgpQoaA7rtLFBJBvhZNfJe1jAAXMyzEar.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSj4tbHoTU9yVXmnwUZuxPCnN1dBABSFmaP46VKyMtXuq/6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzmjzejb5fomYEwGLiXFwfNTggg38DtG2CczGPoxe4hwtdy2KPgpQoaA7rtLFBJBvhZNfJe1jAAXMyzEar.jpeg)
Thumbnail

>



How are you all? I hope you are all well. I am also well, Alhamdulillah. I have appeared among you again, with another new post of mine.  

The word \

is special to every one of us. Because without a mother, we could not have come into the world. Mothers endure thousands of hardships and keep their children with a smile on their faces. Children demand the most from their mothers. However, there may be exceptions in some cases. However, many people say that no one can fill the lack of a mother, this is true. Those who do not have a mother understand how difficult it is to lack a mother. No matter how bad the mother is, she prays for her child, the mother suffers the most in any hardship of the child. That is why our religion says \

. How much hardship a mother endures while carrying her child in her womb for 10 months, and finally brings him into the world. Which perhaps no man can do. That is why Almighty Allah has given more respect to mothers. When I come home from outside, my mother hugs me in her arms. This moment is the happiest and most memorable moment of my life. If I didn't have a mother, I would never have been able to enjoy this peace and happiness. After my mother, the most loved one is my elder sister, some say that after my mother, the most loved one is my aunt. But I can't say about others, my case is a little different. My younger aunt and older aunt love me the most than my elder sister. They fulfill my needs. My sister also loves me a lot and takes care of me. But after my mother, the person who loves me the most and fulfills all my needs is my younger aunt and uncle. I also had an older aunt, but she passed away about a year and a half ago. Basically, my older aunt and younger aunt don't have any children, that's why they love me like their own child. They fulfill my needs. It's been about 2 months since I got married, my younger uncle has borne 90% of my wedding expenses. Which even a father doesn't do very often. But he thinks very well of me, that's why he does everything for me. Sometimes I think my younger aunt thinks more about me than my mother. ![1000055370.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmex8mXCuDRvCxBgvzLCgzB4xzRBW35Ra1nYoUkQURgNGS/1000055370.jpg) ![1000055385.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmS31RSkbmg1bMGfYYrHVkHT3qGG4EwF3k2FM3x97RcMvr/1000055385.jpg) ![1000055378.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcQw9z2tbSCYTjB6fdKsdfWf2dtuNSXrtcGUVvxLEXowp/1000055378.jpg) ![1000055396.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmdM8TWvzMwDJ39fnLk5GxxMkRAPZeRugN7ZXxnxEudpLH/1000055396.jpg) I first discuss all the issues of my current life with my younger aunt and uncle and then make a decision. On the 20th, the day after I returned home from Dhaka, my wife and I went to my younger aunt's house. As soon as I went, I insisted that Auntie make luchi and eat it. I had been wanting to eat luchi since Dhaka, so I went to my aunt's house without telling my mother. And when I said yes, my aunt would definitely make it and feed it to me. As soon as I said so, she started making luchi. She also cooked a curry of boot daul. First, my wife was making luchi and Auntie was frying them and giving them to me hot to eat. Actually, no mother can refuse a child's request. I love my aunt like a mother. After making luchi, we all ate them together. Then Auntie cooked chicken and rice bread for us again. ![1000055455.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeaZiDwVwKQWyreTK1B5f1MUbUMB4DdVvrPLh79Wy99Jr/1000055455.jpg) ![1000055451.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYrWR9jAb2kT5Ef4EBVT5CEuYNBNTrh3je4a7m5JCUtk1/1000055451.jpg) At night, we all sat down and ate. Only those who eat together can understand the joy of sitting and chatting with everyone at home. In fact, the happiness of nature can be found in the village, in a small house with parents. For this happiness, a luxurious house and a lot of money are not needed. It is necessary to have willpower and time. Today, we have forgotten to enjoy the real happiness of life after chasing the mechanical world. That is why every child should spend some time in life with their parents and loved ones, so that they can forget their troubles at least a little. And the prayers of parents for their children are the greatest. If any parent prays for their child, then Allah Ta'ala will definitely accept it. I shared a small part of my life with you. I hope you will also spend time like this with your loved ones. Everyone will pray for me, stay well, stay healthy. I will see you again with a new post of mine. #
>Thank you very much everyone for reading today's post.

Later in the afternoon, I spent some time strolling along the boardwalk under a beautiful blue sky. Seeing the water so close, feeling the breeze, smelling the scent, and breathing in the fresh air made me appreciate how exciting it is to live and travel. Every trip teaches me something new, whether it’s about the world or about myself. 🎡🌊

Traveling has become one of my favorite ways to recharge my batteries, connect with others, and meet new people. It helps me escape the routine, enjoy myself, and create memories that stay with me long after the trip is over. 💫

Sometimes that’s all it takes to make a day special. 🤍

I was at a little mini festival in Ireland recently and these guys headlined it.

I've been into them for a while, but this was my first chance to see them live and they didnt disappoint!

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday </center>

#

That's right, it's Tuesday folks and for our merry little band of ladies and lads, that means sharing tunes, good vibes and engagement. As another week disappears in the rearview mirror, we have loads of engagement and tunes flying around on Three Tune Tuesday and sure isn't that bloody fantastic! I hope you're ready to share three tunes from wherever you find yourself on this magical spinning lump of rock that we all call home and sure you might even sing us a tune if we're lucky?

It's a time of the week when lovers of music, tunes and craic bring their blockchain community three of their finest and brightest tunes to share and celebrate, so let's roll on and let the tunes flow free.

This is my 262nd week waxing lyrical for Three Tune Tuesday and we are still going strong.

It started off with me just sharing tunes into what seemed like a void, but little by little others joined and now I'm thrilled that we have a little corner of Hive where we come and share our tunes every Tuesday, and long may it continue. I almost stopped posting the songs and thoughts a few times, but I stuck with it and now interestingly it is my favorite thing about Hive. I love music and now I have a network of folks around the world who love music too and we share our tunes and catch up with each others tunes and discuss them each week. We get Pop, Metal, Rock, Gospel, Folk, Jazz, Rap, Hip-Hop, Trip-Hop, Reggae, Bippy bappidy Flange Hop. Ok I made that one up, but you get the idea, we are all learning about new artists, bands, back stories and sure isn't it just mighty!

Something that excites me the most is that we even get musicians sharing their covers of famous songs and even their own songs from time to time here on #ThreeTuneTuesday, which is a real favorite of mine, as that takes talent, time and dedication.

We are adding New posters and retaining our core of regulars here on #TTT which is fantastic. Let's keep it growing. Over the years, I have listened to fantastic music shared from like-minded folk from around the globe and interacted with their posts. This has led me to genres I don't know well and to some amazing new bands and artists and has even introduced me to some musical instruments I did not know existed. It also allows me to upvote smaller accounts and find some really interesting people from all over the world, which is heartening.

I hope you enjoy the tunes - be sure to tell me all about it in the comments below and above all else, please enjoy the rest of your Tuesday - smile at a stranger, rub a dog, be a nice human to someone who was not expecting it - peace out.

For those unfamiliar with TTT or Three Tune Tuesday....

# <center> The jist is as follows </center>

#

Every Tuesday I'm going to share 3 songs which I like to listen to and I invite your feedback in the comments below. Better still, why not have a blast of your own Three Tune Tuesday and mention me in the post and I'll come and find the post and upvote it. If you could also use #threetunetuesday tag that would be great, as that is what I use when sifting through all the entries every Wednesday. It'll be a sweet way for us all to discover new music. You'll also be in with a chance of winning the prize - more on that later.

# <center> HBI contest - win up to 6HBI </center>

#

Share your Three Tune Tuesday songs below or create a post with #ttt or #threetunetuesday and mention me so I can find the post.

I'll pick the three songs I enjoyed the most each week as the winner and transfer 1 share of HBI to the winner when this post pays out 7 days from now, but wait there's more...

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday Sponsors </center>

#

We have a sponsor list of six people who selflessly offer HBI in addition to my one. They are as follows @tengolotodo @bozz @coquicoin @ablaze @seki1 @inthenow

Due to a very busy life on my side, the winner posts often come after a delay and may come over 4 to 8 consecutive days. That's just how I do it, so please be patient while awaiting HBI and understand that only my 1HBI is guaranteed. The others are dependant on our lovely sponsors seeing these posts and sending on the HBI. That means some weeks winners may get 3 shares and other weeks they may get more.

Thanks a million to our sponsors above once again and any winners please bear in mind that some people only pop on here every few months, so be patient while waiting for the HBI.

# <center> Sin é, That's all folks, thanks for stopping by. </center>

That's it for another week. Those are your three songs for this week. Let me know what you think - good, bad or indifferent? Did you like them all or just one or two?

Also, as I said before, I love getting good steers for new tunes, so please tell me about the latest and greatest from your playlist below and I'll be sure to check em out.

title.title: 북리뷰 - 오십에 읽는 자본론
title.body: 어릴적 딱딱하게만 생각되었던 자본론을 아주 쉽게 풀어 낸 책입니다.\n\n
alt=\

/> 너무 재밌게 읽어서 임승수 작가에 대해서 찾아봤습니다. 네이버 인물사전에 올라온 작가의 사진은 삼십대라고 생각될 정도로 젊은(?) 사진이었습니다. 그런데 프로필을 보니 오십대 중반 정도의 나이였습니다. 작가의 취향정보란을 보니 취미가 피아노, 와인.. 으로 되어 있고, 좋아하는 도서는 마르크스의 자본론으로 기록되어 있네요. 이런 정보를 보니 책에서 자본론을 설명하는 과정에서 나오는 여러가지 에피소드들이 실제 작가가 경험한 것일 수도 있겠구나 싶어서 더 재밌게 봤던 것 같습니다. 작가는 한고등학교에 가서 자본론에 대해서 강연을 합니다. 그 강연에서 의대생을 꿈꾸며 공부하던 학생이 감명을 깊이 받았나 봅니다. 마크르스의 자본론을 읽고, 사회주의에 대해서 관심을 갖게 되고... 그는 진로를 의대가 목표가 아니라 사회학과를 목표로 수정을 합니다. 여기에 충격을 받고 그 학생의 아버지는 작가를 찾아옵니다. 그리고 진지하게 아들을 말려줄 것을 부탁합니다. 그러는 과정에서 작가는 아버지에게 아들에게 설명했던 자본론에 대해서 이야기를 풀어갑니다. 자본론에 대해서도 아주 쉽게 잘 설명을 해주었습니다. 오십에 읽는 자본론이 아니라 열다섯살이 읽어도 될만큼 아주 쉽게 풀어져 있습니다.
alt=\
/>그런데 자본론 보다 작가가 설명하면서 비유로 들었던, '죽을 때 가장 후회하는 것 다섯가지' 에 대해서 가장 기억에 남네요. ㅎ\n\n
alt=\

/>

> 1.  다른 사람이 아닌, 내가 원하는 삶을 살았더라면
>     
> 2.  내가 그렇게 열심히 일하지 않았더라면
>     
> 3.  내 감정을 표현할 용기가 있었더라면
>     
> 4.  친구들과 계속 연락하고 지냈더라면
>     
> 5.  나 자신에게 더 많은 행복을 허락했더라면
>     

내게 주어진 시간이 얼마일지는 모르지만, 후회없는 삶을 살아야겠다는 생각입니다. ㅎ

**Introduction to Derivatives**
I'll try to quickly explain what a derivative is using simple terms.
First, we need to understand the concept of a function; otherwise, we'd lack the foundation for understanding what a derivative is.
So, let's review the concept of a function.
We can say that a function is a mathematical machine into which a value is input and, through a rule, a single output value is produced.
Below is an example.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYB4LiNErSdDvtsLEaZ6yi6s2fQrYYJhH4o376ooZL4aD/image.png)
Let's assume that x=4, so we input the number 4 into this mathematical transformation machine and perform the operation.

In practice, we have various concepts that can arise from derivatives depending on the scientific context in which we are working.
Below is a practical interpretation in three different fields:
-geometric: slope of the tangent line to the graph
-physics: instantaneous velocity;
-technical/industrial: sensitivity of one quantity to another.

**Practical Applications**
Derivatives are everywhere, even if we often don't realize it:
1-In physics applications, the derivative allows us to know the speed of a car at any given moment.
2- In industrial applications, used to control production and calculate marginal costs.
3- In financial applications, to understand the sensitivity of an investment's value.

***Conclusions***
Derivatives are one of the most important tools in mathematical analysis because they allow us to study how one quantity varies with respect to another. From a geometric perspective, the derivative represents the slope of the tangent line to a curve at a given point. From a physical perspective, it describes the instantaneous speed of a phenomenon. In technical and industrial settings, it allows us to evaluate the sensitivity of one variable to variations in another.

-geometrica: coefficiente angolare della retta tangente al grafico
-fisica: velocità istantanea;
-tecnica/industriale: sensibilità di una grandezza rispetto a un’altra.

**Applicazioni pratiche**
Le derivate sono ovunque, anche se spesso non ce ne accorgiamo:
1-Nelle applicazioni fisiche, la derivata permette di sapere la velocità di un auto in ogni istante.
2-Nelle applicazioni industriali, usate per il controllo della produzione e calcolare i costi marginali.
3-Nelle applicazioni finanziarie per comprendere la sensibilità del valore di un investimento.



***Conclusioni***
Le derivate sono uno degli strumenti più importanti dell'Analisi Matematica perché permettono di studiare come una grandezza varia rispetto a un'altra. Dal punto di vista geometrico, la derivata rappresenta la pendenza della retta tangente a una curva in un determinato punto. Dal punto di vista fisico, descrive la velocità istantanea di un fenomeno. In ambito tecnico e industriale, consente di valutare la sensibilità di una variabile rispetto alle variazioni di un'altra.

After our long hours of reflection, we moved outside the sanctuary and had some photo opportunity on the beautiful architectures of the monastery. And here's what I'm amazed of, this fountain of faith added so much serenity and peacefulness of the place.
alt=\
> From afar, I can see already the fountain's beauty and serenity. It so much caught my attention. And as a pilgrim it was an opportunity to not to be missed visiting the fountain..
alt=\
>\n\n

alt=\

> There's also a lot of devotees who were attracted and visited the fountain area.

It was indeed an uplifting and a religious significant visiting the monastery ground.

title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPe5kvFxzRjjysnLVPdRcYcWnTEF7z9wRySEmQQHYkeBp/IMG_8695.jpg 

Starting the week strong at the gym always gives me a different kind of energy. It’s like setting the tone for everything that’s coming — discipline, focus, and a positive mindset. Even if I feel a little tired at the beginning, once I start moving, everything changes and I feel more alive and motivated.

Mondays are the perfect opportunity to reset and remind myself why I’m doing this. Every workout is a step closer to my goals, and showing up today means I’m already winning. It’s not about being perfect, it’s about being consistent and giving my best with what I have.

Today I chose to start strong, to push myself, and to keep building the best version of me. Because when you begin your week like this, everything else starts to fall into place. 💪✨

Iniciando fuerte la semana en el gym siempre me da una energía diferente. Es como marcar el ritmo de todo lo que viene — disciplina, enfoque y mentalidad positiva. Aunque al inicio me sienta un poco cansada, en cuanto empiezo a moverme todo cambia y me siento más viva y motivada.

Los lunes son la oportunidad perfecta para reiniciar y recordarme por qué hago esto. Cada entrenamiento es un paso más hacia mis metas, y el simple hecho de venir hoy ya es una victoria. No se trata de ser perfecta, sino de ser constante y dar lo mejor con lo que tengo.

Hoy elegí empezar fuerte, exigirme y seguir construyendo la mejor versión de mí. Porque cuando comienzas así tu semana, todo lo demás fluye mejor. 💪✨

title.title: Chapter 3: The Woman and the Rose
title.body:
Hi #FreeWriters,

A receipt started it.

A warning pulled Elijah in.

A meal called The Neeba Special pulled Neeba back.

Now this week’s #pic1000 image becomes Chapter 3, and I’m starting to think the real question is not **where** they are.

It’s *who* they are.

____________________________________________

**Follow the trail here:**

Chapter 1: https://ecency.com/@wordsofwealth/the-receipt
Chapter 2: https://ecency.com/@wordsofwealth/chapter-2-the-neeba-special

What do you think is happening here…

____________________________________________

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmansfuQeGQ544947uJJNakUtQx3pfPsKfkqbDckFkdJxF/img_7203.png)

The secret in the sausage was not paper.

Neeba had expected paper.

A strip of numbers.

A name.

A place.

Something small enough to swallow if the room turned dangerous.

Elijah had always been practical in emergencies, which was deeply irritating because he was also the sort of person who once tried to caramelise onions with a candle.

But this was not paper.

It was a petal.

Small.

White.

Too delicate to belong inside anything as ugly as a sausage.

For one ridiculous second, Neeba simply stared at it in her palm while the café moved around her.

A chair scraped.

Someone complained about milk.

The man in the grey coat stepped toward her.

Then stopped.

Because Neeba smiled.

Not kindly.

Not warmly.

The kind of smile people mistook for surrender right before learning they had misunderstood the room.

She slipped the petal into her sleeve, lifted the plate with both hands, and turned as though she had nowhere else in the world to be.

The grey coat followed.

Of course he did.

Men like that always followed.

They confused movement with control.

Neeba crossed the café, passed the counter, and dropped the entire Neeba Special into the bin.

The cashier gasped.

Neeba looked back.

“Trust me,” she said, “it was what the sausages wanted.”

Then she walked out into the rain.

By morning she had changed coats, changed shoes, changed names, and crossed into a part of the city that did not appear on tourist maps.

The petal had dried against her skin.

At first she thought it was sugar.

Then ceramic.

Then something stranger.

It was soft like icing, but it did not melt.

Thin like porcelain, but warm when held too long.

And across one side, almost invisible unless tilted toward light, were three shallow marks.

Not letters.

Fingerprints.

Someone had made this by hand.

Not printed.

Not moulded.

Made.

The address came from an old contact who owed her a favour and hated being reminded of it. He sent one line and then vanished from the network as if his phone had suddenly remembered better manners.

A flower workshop.

Third floor.

Blue door.

Do not knock twice.

Naturally, Neeba knocked twice.

Some warnings deserved to be tested.

The woman who opened the door was younger than Neeba expected.

Not young exactly, but too calm for a person who should have been afraid.

Her hair was pinned carelessly at the back of her neck. Her hands were dusted white. Behind her, round boards lay across a long table, each one covered with flowers so delicate they looked grown rather than made.

Roses.

Leaves.

Soft pink petals.

Green stems pressed into pale surfaces with the patience of someone who knew beauty could be used as a hiding place.

The woman looked at Neeba.

Then at the petal in her hand.

Then back at Neeba.

“You took longer than I thought,” she said.

Neeba hated sentences like that.

They made people sound superior without earning it.

“I was followed.”

“You are always followed.”

“That sounded personal.”

“It was observational.”

Neeba stepped inside.

The room smelled of clay, sugar, rain, and something faintly metallic.

On the table nearest the window, the woman had been working on a circular piece. A pale surface. Green leaves. A rose just beginning to form beneath the careful pressure of her tool.

Neeba moved closer.

Slowly.

There it was again.

Recognition.

Not loud.

Not dramatic.

Just a small cold hand closing around the back of her neck.

She had seen this pattern before.

Not in a museum.

Not in a file.

Not in any of the safe houses.

On a plate.

Years ago.

A plate Elijah had broken by accident and spent three weeks trying to repair badly enough that the repair itself became the joke.

The woman watched her notice.

“You remember it,” she said.

Neeba did not answer.

The woman smiled sadly.

“Good. That means they did not take everything.”

Neeba looked at her then.

The room seemed to tilt slightly, though nothing had moved.

“Who are you?”

The woman picked up a small brush and dusted powder from the edge of a rose.

“That depends who is asking.”

“I am.”

“No,” the woman said softly. “Neeba is.”

Silence settled between them.

Outside, rain tapped against the window with patient fingers.

Neeba felt the name move through her.

Once, it had been armour.

Then a warning.

Then a target.

Now, in this woman’s mouth, it sounded like something borrowed.

The woman reached beneath the table and placed a second petal in front of her.

This one was not white.

It was red.

Deep red.

At its centre, written so finely it looked like a flaw in the glaze, was one word.

Not Elijah.

Not Neeba.

A different name.

A name Neeba knew.

A name she had not heard since childhood.

A name she had been told never to answer to.

The woman leaned closer.

Her voice dropped.

“He found the first petal. You found the second.”

Neeba stared at the red petal.

“What happens when we find the third?”

The woman looked toward the unfinished rose on the table.

Then, for the first time, her hands began to tremble.

“You remember who you were.”

title.body: Всі так \

з тими путінськими перемир'ями, наче сподіваючись, що кацапи його будуть дотримуватись, в після цього щось зрушиться в плані завершення війни. \n\nТа щойно годинник перетнув 00:00 завершення дводенного \

It’s been a long cold crypto winter and we forgot the joy of green candles. The kind of cataclysm  that tests conviction and forces builders to keep their heads down while the noise fades.

“Build in the bear,” they say and that’s exactly what [FanForce](https://myfanforce.com/onboarding?ref=NV00OP4Z) been doing. After months of grinding they are finally ready to share the new thing they prepared... Spotlights! 

In a digital economy increasingly driven by attention, the [FanForce](https://myfanforce.com/onboarding?ref=NV00OP4Z) introduction marked a turning point for AttentionFi! They challenged long-held assumptions about how information, influence, and incentives should flow.

Rather than treating users as passive consumers or extractive data points, the campaign demonstrated a new model where participation, transparency, and aligned incentives took center stage.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYm8ufuNonvH5mqeQBFKVNsKQDpFekKbDENM26a79KpdM/image.png)


By fusing [FanForce](https://myfanforce.com/onboarding?ref=NV00OP4Z)’s community-first engagement mechanics with the onchain infrastructure we are done with shady algos. Now both creators and their supporters can share the bounties! 

This is the new way to recognize creators who back startups at the very beginning. It’s about shining a light on those who show up first, when projects are still fragile and unproven.

Enter Spotlight... where we win together! Curious how it works? Users choose a startup, and there are already have 30+ early-stage founders on board since day one! 

Post in your own voice and share something authentic that shows you understand what they’re building. After a quality check you’ll receive a badge marking you as an early supporter.

Unlock perks! Founders are offering product access, airdrop allocations, fee discounts, and priority on future sponsorships. Your post won’t vanish into the void.... projects will see it and respond.

Early support is more than symbolic. It gives founders confidence, momentum, and visibility when they need it most. For you it means being part of the story from day one...  with real rewards attached.

To kick things off [FanForce](https://myfanforce.com/onboarding?ref=NV00OP4Z)  is adding a $1,000 USDC lucky draw. Every badge you earn is another entry, so consistency means you will be stacking your chances.

The movement begins! The [FanForce](https://myfanforce.com/onboarding?ref=NV00OP4Z) Spotlight is a recognition system for the people who believe early. It matters to the founders, it matters to us, and eventually it will matter to you! 

When these projects find their footing... you will have a spot in the front seats! Don't think about the badges... or the raffle... think about the chances to be early before ... being early!

** Happy start to the week to all my foodie friends! ** pork, white rice, bayo beans, ripe plantains, garlic, chili peppers, onions ![1000923646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/Eos1kEAWZeuxpMVZhWPVekmN79pLvJSd3yNEbXSRVGuBPVoi9aGmz5kPgVYxGy1meJA.jpg)

# Learn AI Series (#85) - Generative Images - Diffusion Models (Part 2)

### Solutions to Episode #84 Exercises

**Exercise 1:** Noise schedule comparison tool.

```python
import torch
import numpy as np


class ScheduleComparator:
    \

def linear_schedule(self, T, beta_start=1e-4,
                        beta_end=0.02):
        betas = torch.linspace(beta_start, beta_end, T)
        alphas = 1.0 - betas
        alpha_bars = torch.cumprod(alphas, dim=0)
        return alpha_bars

    def cosine_schedule(self, T, s=0.008):
        steps = torch.arange(
            T + 1, dtype=torch.float32)
        f = torch.cos(
            (steps / T + s) / (1 + s)
            * np.pi / 2) ** 2
        alpha_bars = f / f[0]
        # Drop the extra element to get T values
```

### On to today's episode

Welcome back! In episode #84 we built a diffusion model that denoises in pixel space -- a 512x512 image means the U-Net processes a 512x512x3 tensor at every single step. That works fine for something like 64x64 MNIST digits, but becomes prohibitively expensive at higher resolutions. A thousand forward passes through a U-Net operating at 512x512? Your GPU memory consumption goes through the roof, and the wallclock time becomes... impractical, to put it diplomatically ;-)

The researchers at LMU Munich (Robin Rombach, Andreas Blattmann, and others) realized something important: most of the perceptually relevant information in an image lives in a much lower-dimensional space. You don't need to denoise every single pixel -- you can denoise a compact _representation_ of the image instead. That insight gave birth to **latent diffusion**, and latent diffusion gave birth to **Stable Diffusion**.

This episode covers how we get from the \

DDPM framework of episode #84 to the actual text-to-image systems people use every day. We'll walk through the full architecture piece by piece.

## Latent diffusion: compressing first, denoising second

The core idea behind latent diffusion is deceptively simple: instead of running the diffusion process in pixel space (which for a 512x512 RGB image means operating on a 512x512x3 = 786,432-dimensional space), first compress the image into a much smaller **latent representation** using a separately trained **VAE** (Variational Autoencoder), then run the entire diffusion process in that compressed latent space.

A well-trained VAE can compress a 512x512x3 image down to a 64x64x4 latent -- that's a **48x reduction** in dimensionality. The diffusion model never sees raw pixels. It only sees (and generates) latent vectors, which the VAE decoder then expands back to full resolution:

```
Text prompt --> Text Encoder --> text embeddings
                                      |
                                  (cross-attention)
                                      |
Random noise --> [Denoise in latent space] --> clean latent --> VAE Decoder --> image
                      U-Net x N steps
```

The VAE is trained once, on a large image dataset, then completely frozen. Here's a conceptual implementation -- real ones like the one in Stable Diffusion are much deeper with residual blocks and attention layers, but the principle is identical:

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn


class SimpleVAE(nn.Module):
    \

def __init__(self, in_ch=3, latent_ch=4,
                 base_ch=128):
        super().__init__()
        # Encoder: (3, 512, 512) -> (4, 64, 64)
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_ch, base_ch, 3,
                      stride=2, padding=1),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(base_ch, base_ch * 2, 3,
                      stride=2, padding=1),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(base_ch * 2, base_ch * 4,
                      3, stride=2, padding=1),
            nn.SiLU(),
        )
        # mean + logvar (double channels)
        self.to_latent = nn.Conv2d(
            base_ch * 4, latent_ch * 2, 1)

        # Decoder: (4, 64, 64) -> (3, 512, 512)
        self.from_latent = nn.Conv2d(
            latent_ch, base_ch * 4, 1)
        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(base_ch * 4,
                               base_ch * 2, 4,
                               stride=2, padding=1),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(base_ch * 2,
                               base_ch, 4,
                               stride=2, padding=1),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(base_ch, in_ch, 4,
                               stride=2, padding=1),
            nn.Tanh(),
        )

    def encode(self, x):
        h = self.encoder(x)
        params = self.to_latent(h)
        mean, logvar = params.chunk(2, dim=1)
        # Reparameterization trick
        std = torch.exp(0.5 * logvar)
        z = mean + std * torch.randn_like(std)
        return z

    def decode(self, z):
        return self.decoder(self.from_latent(z))
```

The reparameterization trick (episode #55 touched on this for GANs) is what makes the VAE trainable with backpropagation. Instead of sampling directly from a distribution (which is not differentiable), you sample from a standard normal and then shift/scale using the predicted mean and standard deviation. The gradient flows through the mean and std parameters cleanly.

Having said that, the VAE's reconstruction quality is not perfect. There's always some information loss -- subtle textures might get slightly smoothed, very fine details might shift. In practice the quality is excellent for photographic content but you can sometimes spot VAE artifacts if you zoom in very carefully. Stability AI's VAE for Stable Diffusion was trained with both reconstruction loss and a perceptual loss (comparing VGG features rather than raw pixels), which significantly improves visual fidelity at the cost of more complex training.

## Text conditioning via cross-attention

_So we have the diffusion process running efficiently in latent space. But how does a text prompt like \

actually guide the image generation?_\n\nThrough **cross-attention** in the U-Net, exactly as we covered in episode #51. Remember: in cross-attention, the **queries** come from one source and the **keys/values** come from another. In latent diffusion, the queries come from the U-Net's intermediate spatial features (representing what the image currently \

at this denoising step) and the keys/values come from the text embeddings (representing what the image _should_ look like):

```python
class CrossAttentionBlock(nn.Module):
    \

def __init__(self, dim, context_dim=768,
                 num_heads=8):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        self.to_q = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.to_k = nn.Linear(context_dim, dim)
        self.to_v = nn.Linear(context_dim, dim)
        self.to_out = nn.Linear(dim, dim)
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.scale = (dim // num_heads) ** -0.5

    def forward(self, x, context):
        # x: (batch, seq_len, dim)
        #    -- flattened spatial features
        # context: (batch, text_len, context_dim)
        #    -- text embeddings from CLIP
        b, n, d = x.shape
        h = self.num_heads

        x = self.norm(x)
        q = self.to_q(x).view(
            b, n, h, d // h).transpose(1, 2)
        k = self.to_k(context).view(
            b, -1, h, d // h).transpose(1, 2)
        v = self.to_v(context).view(
            b, -1, h, d // h).transpose(1, 2)

        attn = (q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale
        attn = attn.softmax(dim=-1)
        out = (attn @ v).transpose(
            1, 2).reshape(b, n, d)
        return self.to_out(out)
```

At each U-Net block, the spatial features are reshaped into a sequence, cross-attended with the text embeddings, then reshaped back into a spatial grid. The attention weights form a kind of \
-- different spatial positions in the image attend to different words in the prompt. When the model is denoising the top portion of the image, it might attend heavily to \
and \

and \

should appear ;-)

The text encoder used in Stable Diffusion is **CLIP** (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training, from OpenAI). CLIP was trained on 400 million image-text pairs with a contrastive objective: make the embeddings of matching image-text pairs similar, and non-matching pairs dissimilar. This produces a text encoder that understands visual concepts at a deep semantic level -- not just keyword matching, but actual understanding of composition, style, atmosphere, and spatial relationships:

## Classifier-free guidance (CFG)

Training the U-Net with text conditioning is straightforward: at each step, pass the text embeddings alongside the noisy latent. But at inference time there's a remarkably clever trick that dramatically improves how well the generated image matches the prompt: **classifier-free guidance**.

During training, the text conditioning is randomly dropped (replaced with null/empty embeddings) some percentage of the time, typically around 10%. This means the model learns both **conditional generation** (with text) and **unconditional generation** (without text) simultaneously.

At inference, you run the model _twice_ per step -- once with the real prompt, once without. Then you extrapolate _away_ from the unconditional prediction _toward_ the conditional one:

```python
def guided_denoise(model, xt, t, text_emb,
                   null_emb, guidance_scale=7.5):
    \

# Unconditional prediction (no text)
    noise_uncond = model(xt, t, null_emb)
    # Conditional prediction (with text)
    noise_cond = model(xt, t, text_emb)

    # Guided prediction: move AWAY from
    # unconditional, TOWARD conditional
    noise_guided = (noise_uncond
                    + guidance_scale
                    * (noise_cond - noise_uncond))
    return noise_guided
```

The `guidance_scale` parameter is what you're adjusting when you set \

in Stable Diffusion UIs. At scale=1.0, you get the raw conditional prediction -- the model's natural output given the prompt, unmodified. At scale=7.5 (the widely used default), the text has strong influence and images closely match the prompt while still looking natural. At scale=20+, the image becomes oversaturated and artifact-heavy but _extremely_ prompt-adherent. There's a surpringly narrow sweet spot where you get both good prompt following and visual quality.\n\n_Why does this work so well?_ Think of it geometrically. The unconditional prediction represents \
The conditional prediction represents \
The difference between them is a vector pointing in the direction of \
By scaling that vector beyond 1.0, you're pushing the image further in the \

direction than the model would naturally go. You're amplifying the text's influence beyond what the model learned, which is why high CFG values can produce artifacts -- you're pushing beyond the model's training distribution.

## Faster sampling: DDIM and modern schedulers

DDPM (from episode #84) requires 1000 steps to generate one image. That's 1000 forward passes through the U-Net, which even on a fast GPU takes many seconds. **DDIM** (Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models, Song et al., 2021) made a critical observation: you can rewrite the reverse process as a _deterministic_ mapping that allows skipping steps. Instead of taking tiny stochastic steps through all 1000 timesteps, DDIM selects a subset (say 50 timesteps, evenly spaced) and takes larger, deterministic jumps between them:

```python
@torch.no_grad()
def ddim_sample(model, schedule, shape,
                num_steps=50, eta=0.0):
    \

# Select a subset of timesteps
    step_size = schedule.T // num_steps
    timesteps = list(
        range(0, schedule.T, step_size))[::-1]

    x = torch.randn(shape)

    for i, t in enumerate(timesteps):
        t_batch = torch.full(
            (shape[0],), t, dtype=torch.long)
        pred_noise = model(x, t_batch)

        alpha_bar_t = schedule.alpha_bars[t]
        if i + 1 < len(timesteps):
            alpha_bar_prev = schedule.alpha_bars[
                timesteps[i + 1]]
        else:
            alpha_bar_prev = torch.tensor(1.0)

        # Predict x0 from current xt
        pred_x0 = (
            (x - torch.sqrt(1 - alpha_bar_t)
             * pred_noise)
            / torch.sqrt(alpha_bar_t))
        pred_x0 = pred_x0.clamp(-1, 1)

        # Direction pointing to xt
        dir_xt = (torch.sqrt(1 - alpha_bar_prev)
                  * pred_noise)

        # DDIM step (eta=0 = fully deterministic)
        x = (torch.sqrt(alpha_bar_prev) * pred_x0
             + dir_xt)

    return x
```

50 steps instead of 1000. Nearly identical quality. The `eta` parameter controls stochasticity: at eta=0 (DDIM default), the same initial noise always produces the same image -- fully deterministic and reproducible. At eta=1.0, you recover the original DDPM stochastic sampling.

More advanced schedulers have pushed this even further. **DPM-Solver** and **DPM-Solver++** use higher-order ODE solvers to get good results in 15-25 steps. **Euler** and **Euler Ancestral** are popular for their simplicity and good quality at 20-30 steps. The **PNDM** (Pseudo Numerical Diffusion Model) scheduler is what the original Stable Diffusion demo used. Each makes different tradeoffs between speed, quality, and whether the output is deterministic:

```python
# Using HuggingFace diffusers, switching
# schedulers is trivial:
from diffusers import (
    DDIMScheduler,
    DPMSolverMultistepScheduler,
    EulerDiscreteScheduler,
)

# DDIM: 50 steps, deterministic
# DPM-Solver++: 20-25 steps, high quality
# Euler: 25-30 steps, good balance
```

The practical impact is enormous. Going from 1000 steps to 25 steps means generation times drop from minutes to seconds on consumer hardware. This is what made Stable Diffusion viable for real-time interactive use.

## ControlNet: structural guidance beyond text

Text prompts are expressive but imprecise. \

will give you a person with arms raised, but you can't control the exact pose, the exact camera angle, or the precise composition. **ControlNet** (Zhang et al., 2023) adds structural conditioning: alongside the text prompt, you provide an edge map, depth map, pose skeleton, normal map, or other spatial guide.

ControlNet works by copying the encoder half of the U-Net and training the copy to incorporate the structural input, while keeping the original U-Net weights completely frozen. The copy's outputs are added to the original network via **zero-initialized convolutions**:

```python
import copy


class ControlNet(nn.Module):
    \

def __init__(self, base_unet_encoder,
                 encoder_channels):
        super().__init__()
        # Copy of the U-Net encoder (trainable)
        self.control_encoder = copy.deepcopy(
            base_unet_encoder)

        # Zero-initialized output projections
        self.zero_convs = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Conv2d(ch, ch, 1)
            for ch in encoder_channels
        ])
        # Initialize to output zeros at start
        for conv in self.zero_convs:
            nn.init.zeros_(conv.weight)
            nn.init.zeros_(conv.bias)

    def forward(self, control_image, t_emb):
        features = self.control_encoder(
            control_image, t_emb)
        # Project through zero convolutions
        return [
            zc(f) for zc, f
            in zip(self.zero_convs, features)
        ]
        # These get added to base U-Net's
        # skip connections
```

The zero-initialization trick is elegant: at the start of training, the ControlNet outputs all zeros and has zero effect on the base model. As training progresses, the zero convolution weights gradually move away from zero and the control signal gets injected more strongly. This prevents the structural conditioning from destroying the pretrained model's capabilities during the early, unstable phase of training -- a problem that plagued earlier attempts at adding conditioning to pretrained diffusion models.

In practice ControlNet is extraordinarily versatile. With a Canny edge map as input, you can redraw an existing image in a completely different style while preserving its structure. With an OpenPose skeleton, you can precisely control the pose of a generated person. With a depth map from a 3D scene, you can generate photorealistic renders of virtual environments. And because the base model stays frozen, a single Stable Diffusion checkpoint can work with many different ControlNet adapters simultaneously.

## The complete Stable Diffusion pipeline

Putting all the pieces together, here's what happens when you generate an image with Stable Diffusion:

```python

import torch

pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
```

Behind that simple API call, four things happen in sequence:

1. **CLIP** encodes the prompt (and the negative prompt) into text embeddings -- 77 tokens, 768 dimensions each
2. A **random latent** is sampled from a standard normal distribution -- shape (1, 4, 64, 64) for a 512x512 output

4. The **VAE decoder** expands the clean latent from (4, 64, 64) to a full (3, 512, 512) pixel image

The dilemma at my workplace: who's gonna be fired first by AI?
title.body:
Just had a meeting with the boss and entire team at work and as usual he prepared a short PowerPoint with few slides about current projects and what's next. And while there is a lot of uncertainty about the project and company future, on one of the slides was a question like this: who's gonna be fired first by the introduction of AI in the company? The first look over it was quite shocking, but with all the AI agenda being pushed everywhere I guess that's the new reality. And while the boss started laying down the order from which departments people will be fired, he said that we might be through the last ones to worry about. Should we believe him or not?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/behiver/23uQDtnQMX7YWb4eTYgfgQKxmPv7CY2yFzqBXMoH2fiAtLRmzS7uSU1qHq7J5FPgmsTPa.png)

### Down the rabbit hole
I am a software test architect and the team I am in handles QC and Testing in the company. The feedback was that first in line to get fired are the Business Analysts, next the Technical Writers, after that some of the Development team and us as the Testing team are the last or maybe none of us will be fired. Truth or dare? Well, the boss said that will happen under some conditions.

### The mirage
It seems that the conditions not to get fired is if we reach by the end of the year a round 80% automation testing on specific apps from the portfolio. That's quite doable, but let's not open the champagne too soon. What do you think it will happen at the end of it? Well, with such a high coverage I assume we all can get fired easily. Why I believe so? Just because when you reach that level  of automation that can be executed periodically through a pipeline, it simply doesn't make sense to keep the entire team.

### Can you truly believe anyone?
Managers or team leaders sometimes tend to distort the truth or simply lie in order to reach their own goals. This could be a lie that he served us in order to reach his targets that the upper management set for him. And in order to reach that he tries to motivate us through fear and by saying that if you automate almost everything we will not need to worry about the future. That simply doesn't make sense, right?

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/behiver/Eondk12tESHujq13YN4Z4oWwFKjW6AcEsrb6JPuy7HTX4Fo5VaR9FNmzfnqDRJYS9MH.png)

I am lucky enough to be in a good financial situation with some investments and cash reserves regardless of how this story will end. But what's bothering me is the way managers think they can manipulate others and simply not being truthful. There is a chance that he might have not lied about it ( I give it like 1 or 2% chance), but that's hard to believe. In the end this is the AI effect or how the company leaders see it, even if I don't see that in the same ways. But we need to understand the new space, accept and adapt to it and find solutions for the future. Expect the unexpected (in this case something negative to happen), allows me to weather this more easily and even start looking for other collaborations before this reaching an end. If you can find else before getting fired by AI, I guess it is the best outcome.

1) AllCoins Season Index (ACSI) :  0 to 100 scale.

 a) If ACSI < 25 = BTC season is at its best .

To best position your portfolio, under this circumstance, increase your holdings of BTC by swapping your All Coins for BTC.

b) If ACSI > 75 = ALL Coin season is at its best.

To best position your portfolio, under this circumstance,  increase your holdings of your All Coins.

If you are confident that your investment will grow in price in the future, then use Dollar Cost Average (DCA) to neutralize volatility by purchasing at pre-defined and regular intervals a set amount of the asset.

2) Crypto Quant: Data analytics tool to see the in-flow and out-flow of funds from crypto exchanges.

a) If BTC-All exchanges Net flow' chart shows in-flows very high, there is a high probability of a drop in the Market (people are selling)

b) If BTC-All miners Outflow,  Inter-Entity and All Miner to All exchanges flow' Charts shows miners sending big amounts of coin, then this is also indication of selling.

3) CoinmarketCal : Crypto market calendar to find all events and important updates about a particular crypto over a particular period of time.

4) Glassnode : Market indicator.

a) NUPL (Net Unrealized Profit or Loss) : Show how much of a crypto' circulating supply is at profit or loss at a given time.

If the market mostly presents unrealized profits at that given time, there is a good time to sell; If it shows loss, then it is time to buy.

b) Number of New and Active addresses : Value growth of total crypto market

5) CoinDance : Monitor of hash rates, transactions, network nodes and wider crypto environment and level of adoption in many countries.

6) BTC and Blockchain' search & volume on Google : High levels translate in growing figures.

7) 3Commas : Paper trading allows to test your crypto trading strategy for free.

8) CryptoPanic : Crypto news and events aggregator.

9) Messari : Real trending, analytics, prospects and customizable features to screen coins.

10) TradingView : Top charting and social networking platfor
