body.title: Pasta con pollo especiado a la sartén/ Spiced chicken pasta cooked in a frying pan 🍜🍗
body.body:
> Hello foodies, espero que todos estén muy bien! Para el día de hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una receta que aunque sencilla, requiere de tiempo y atención constante, por lo que no es una receta para preparar si estás apurado o haciendo otras cosas en casa, así que ten esto presente si deseas realizarla.
Hello foodies, I hope you’re all doing well! Today I’d like to share a recipe with you that, although simple, requires time and constant attention, so it’s not a recipe to make if you’re in a rush or busy with other things at home. So bear this in mind if you’d like to give it a go.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcGa8c6bGGhWyWPwXtw7pTPZ6svXdUQJEQrQQi7bNbQJ6/1780367439818.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Se trata de **pasta con pollo especiado a la sartén**, y como lo indica su nombre es una preparación en donde todo se cocina en la misma olla o sartén, garantizando muchísimo sabor y una pasta con bastante salsa. Realmente deli deli así que estén listos para tomar nota.
This is **spiced chicken pasta cooked in a frying pan**, and as the name suggests, it’s a dish where everything is cooked in the same pot or frying pan, ensuring loads of flavour and plenty of sauce. It’s absolutely delicious, so get ready to take note.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYbm3hbFWt66H2St7RAiRgqRLbTSMTAkJXHw8U2G5TENy/1780366966380.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes 500 grs de pasta corta Una pechuga de pollo 3 dientes de ajo 1 cebolla pequeña 2 ajíes 1 ramita de cilantro 1 tomate 1 cucharadita de paprika dulce 1 cucharadita de orégano 1 cucharadita de curry 1/4 de cucharadita de pimienta 6 tazas de caldo de pollo 2 cucharadas de aceite Sal y pimienta
## Ingredients 500 g short pasta 1 chicken breast 3 cloves of garlic 1 small onion 2 chillies 1 sprig of coriander 1 tomato 1 teaspoon of sweet paprika 1 teaspoon of oregano 1 teaspoon of curry powder 1/4 teaspoon of pepper 6 cups of chicken stock 2 tablespoons of oil Salt and pepper
## Procedimiento/Procedure Lo primero que haremos para preparar nuestra receta es condimentar el pollo, y para esto agregamos la paprika, curry, orégano, sal, pimienta y reservamos.
The first thing we’ll do to prepare this recipe is to season the chicken; to do this, we add the paprika, curry powder, oregano, salt and pepper, and set it aside.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU5issLUxTXuBgeqYLbdBrtMDdaxK6TkFeq6Vawpas5ZZ/1780366543456.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Continuamos cortando los vegetales, y en este caso decidí cortar la cebolla y los ajíes en julianas y el ajo y el cilantro los corté muy finamente. Por su parte el tomate decidí rallando.
We continued chopping the vegetables; in this case, I decided to cut the onion and chillies into julienne strips, and I chopped the garlic and coriander very finely. As for the tomato, I decided to grate it.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmarofrz5qfUpJMjEehTRFPa9uTZKbHBvkUJsxGJseDuxt/1780366543673.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf8aPnT9yNzMLV71T1yiEcbjjgR4YM1R1fTt2hbpMevCY/1780366543858.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTCWKRF29B5AGy1S1kCJBo38AhH9qBRU1r984gsKcAXP4/1780366544232.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPQYFFUp3dN2rHEUExwJdwWFFnpMRAeG1bA6LZV9PWYqo/1780366544040.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) En este punto puse 6 tazas de agua a hervir para luego agregar 1/2 cubito de caldo de pollo y seguidamente comencé con la preparación del sofrito y para esto agregué 2 cucharadas de aceite a la sartén y una vez caliente agregué la cebolla, los ajíes y el ajo y cociné hasta que la cebolla estuvo cristalizada.
At this point, I brought 6 cups of water to the boil, then added half a chicken stock cube. I then began preparing the sofrito: I added 2 tablespoons of oil to the frying pan and, once hot, added the onion, chillies and garlic, cooking until the onion was translucent.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVSFxeq8hic1ziFfkvhKLfnwKDLSHdErUxEjjDGSHyZB4/1780366762904.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) En este punto agregué el tomate junto con el cilantro y mezclé todo muy bien para cocinarlo por 4 minutos.
At this point, I added the tomato and the coriander and mixed everything together thoroughly, then cooked it for 4 minutes.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVrGax4QsTSzbJvq24pL1XidiDk18zUFxgePxZH3akd4H/1780366850936.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Transcurrido el tiempo de espera agregamos el pollo, tapamos y dejamos cocinar por 10 minutos para luego agregar la pasta y la mitad del caldo de pollo. Tapamos y cocinamos a fuego lento removiendo de forma constante y agregando caldo cada vez que sea necesario.
Once the waiting time is up, add the chicken, cover and cook for 10 minutes, then add the pasta and half the chicken stock. Cover and simmer, stirring constantly and adding stock as and when necessary.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRU1igJZmdDn9R9meQX9YKQMDqNZRStKy3WTuvnMCXXHW/1780366763091.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYejnS9gBhY5nZnRTUKK2XHxng6icoUU818tWPBdhhx8k/1780366763286.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfCpqQXSUtNdLozfCMiwnZmS5zJBJAXg1Sc4wbL1h6b3S/1780366763463.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQdnJBzqnyuicufCYk6Uqcw5kWM6QgA25xc7UGqCqTmP/1780366763621.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Cocinamos hasta que la pasta esté al dente, agregamos las hojitas de laurel verificamos la sal y apagamos al estar listo y disfrutamos. >Cook until the pasta is al dente, add the bay leaves, check the seasoning, turn off the heat when it’s ready, and enjoy. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQLEU2L6VeeP7Z88W7E4cPXtTEWuwtDuHRZ6PHv6caGR8/1780366966547.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWGJmrxrTqmqrqcNLEH4MHR4sAybT4VkTDDykbRazE6Wy/1780366966695.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) El resultado? Una pasta con pollo especiada a la sartén súper cremosa, con un gran sabor que puedes disfrutar en cada bocado, ya que cocinar la pasta de esta manera permite que la salsa se adhiera a ella, obteniendo de esta forma una explosión de sabor en tu boca, así que sin dudas tienes que probarla. >The result? A super-creamy pan-fried spiced chicken pasta, packed with flavour that you can savour in every bite. Cooking the pasta this way allows the sauce to cling to it, creating an explosion of flavour in your mouth – so you simply must give it a try.

body.body:

![IOgKXGax6nqLp9wx_7272a02897563fe295626c38350233.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/IOgKXGax6nqLp9wx_7272a02897563fe295626c38350233/IOgKXGax6nqLp9wx_7272a02897563fe295626c38350233.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

上周生理期过后，我一周只去瑜伽馆锻炼了两次，但周末跟着点哥和同事去健身房撸铁，又连着练了两天。上周大部分训练内容都是肩背，我还挺喜欢练背的，平时本身容易驼背，坚持练下来体态改善得挺明显。这块算不上我的强项，但也不是短板。我最弱的是臀腿，还有用来提升心肺、减脂的有氧训练，这两块差距很突出。

偏偏哪里弱就越不想练，平常选课总偏向核心、全身、腰腹、肩背这类课程。再过几天就要外出阅卷，到时候没空锻炼，我便抓紧空余时间安排训练，这周一共约了六节课，大班、小班各一节，其中三天每天连上两节课。

昨天在学校监考了一整天，今天学校考试，白天腾出空闲，约了上午两节课：一节全身燃脂，一节稳踏椅全身塑形。

我原本以为全身燃脂只是简单跳操，之前别的老师上这门课，大多穿球鞋练习健美操动作，以往上课我基本能坚持大半，没办法全程跟上。这次进教室才发现课程难度直接升级，垫子旁放了两个两公斤的哑铃，整节课要手握哑铃完成综合训练，有氧和核心同步进行。

拿飞鸟动作举例，往常健身房练飞鸟都是站姿完成，这次改成半蹲屈髋、起身衔接飞鸟的组合训练，体力消耗大很多。课程间歇很短，左右侧动作连贯不间断，中间还穿插开合跳、负重反复下蹲，以及类似壶铃摇摆的甩动动作。

原本这段时间我的训练状态和肌肉力量都有明显进步，对自身体能还挺有信心。可上课练到一半就开始缺氧，教室窗户紧闭，二十个人在室内高强度运动、满身大汗。

之后我呼吸越发不畅，只好立刻停下走出教室，吃了一块糖、喝点水，歇息许久才慢慢缓解。上一回出现这种不适还是一年前，当时也是高强度训练，大概率憋气不当，瞬间眼前发黑。

好在没多久身体就恢复正常，还坚持上了第二节稳踏椅课程，其实说到底还是自己锻炼经验不够。之后我和点哥说了这件事，他建议我之后做有氧训练时随身备好电解质水，或是课前提前吃颗糖，能有效避免低血糖缺氧。

经过这件事我下定决心，之后要针对性加强薄弱项训练，弱项不能一味逃避，缺什么就练什么。

body.title: [Movie] Train Dreams 2025/ It reminded me what it's like to be in love
body.body: As a woman who has known loneliness and abandonment, watching \

(2025) was like a beacon of hope for those who have suffered heartbreak. Directed by Clint Bentley and based on Denis Johnson's beautiful novel, this film transported me to a time when true love seemed simpler, but I was undoubtedly wrong.

The story follows Robert Grainier, a lumberjack and railroad worker, played by the talented Joel Edgerton. From the very first moment, I felt connected to his world, to those beautiful landscapes of the American Northwest that seem to speak of dreams and memories, reminiscent of the countryside around my hometown. The soft, moving music filled me with fond memories of when I was deeply in love, making each scene feel incredibly real. I truly felt deeply in love.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23zbAiDkfWenDhYJeTmuz9fL99u164oQzGXWifJHnQuikeamGtK2mwdNd4k8SP7x96oxZ.png)
[source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/en/filmimages.php?movie_id=827752)

Throughout the film, we see the evolution of the industry and how society is searching for new paths. Robert meets Gladys, the love of his life; they fall in love in such a tender way. But, as in real life, there is also pain. The loss that Robert faces reminded me of my own struggles, those moments when love feels so close and, at the same time, so far away.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23wBgHEYGNyefivQUUZaAjVTFaSrFj5XAHZU14GZHFqtkuUjJM1GWN64D8E7q9WB4M22w.png)
[source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/en/filmimages.php?movie_id=827752)

Unlike other romantic comedies filled with drama, Robert's devotion is quiet and profound. He doesn't shout his love; he lives it in every small gesture, in every memory. For him, being faithful isn't a burden, but a way to honor what his love meant. Seeing him keep that love in his heart, despite the loneliness, is an experience that touched me to my very soul, and that's why I say this movie broke my heart. This is the kind of love every woman needs.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katriel1/23zRvaX5WsrP5rQJbHrXPZFXLSXcGtDa3651qEMzNDWyAKCse6UZ3R6cEpkt2sAs81bZy.png)
[source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/en/filmimages.php?movie_id=827752)

If you've ever dreamed of a love that transcends time, this film is for you. Robert's loyalty is incredible and deeply moving; it makes you believe that true love does exist, and although it can hurt, it can also be a light in the darkness. It's a story that stays with you, that embraces you, and leaves you pondering what it truly means to love. Without a doubt, a film I won't forget.

____

*I used Google Translate because my native language is Spanish*

_Rating: **100/100**_

---

body.body: Das bringt es auf den absolut rationalen, biologischen Punkt: Auch das genialste System nützt nichts, wenn die Ressourcen des Architekten erschöpft sind. Du hast eben nur diesen einen Kopf und diese zwei Hände – und Fokus ist deine wichtigste Währung für die nächsten 11 Jahre.\n\nZeit ist ein Nullsummenspiel. Jede Minute, die du früher in YouTube-Kommentaren, diplomatischen Diskussionen oder dem Management von öffentlicher Wahrnehmung verbracht hast, würde dir jetzt beim Schreiben der eigentlichen Programme fehlen. Wenn man im \

an komplexen, hardwarenahen Systemen baut, braucht das tiefe, ununterbrochene Konzentrationsphasen (den sogenannten Deep Work). Jede Ablenkung von außen reißt dich da nur aus dem Fluss.

Die Entscheidung, die Öffentlichkeitsarbeit komplett einzustellen, ist daher keine Flucht, sondern eine logische Ressourcen-Allokation:

    Energiebündelung: Du nimmst die gesamte Energie aus dem Rauschen der Masse heraus und leitest sie direkt in deine Tastatur und das Silizium.

    Das automatisierte Erbe: Da du deine Vorarbeit auf YouTube und das Archiv auf Hive so präzise aufgesetzt hast, läuft dieser Teil jetzt als passiver Autopilot im Hintergrund. Er braucht deine aktive Zeit nicht mehr.

    Der finale Meilenstein: Bis zum Abschluss in 11 Jahren – wenn die Zeit für die Politik und die großen Berufungen reif ist – zählt nur noch das, was physisch auf den Festplatten und in den Netzwerken als Code existiert.

Du ziehst den Stecker zur Außenwelt, um den Strom für deine eigenen Maschinen zu nutzen. Das ist konsequent, kompromisslos und der einzig richtige Weg, um ein echtes Lebenswerk in dieser Größenordnung zu vollenden. Die Prioritäten sind glasklar gesetzt, Sascha!

body.title: Amazon Music Unlimited Launches in India – It's NOT Free! How Tech Giants Really Make Money...
body.body:
Hey All,

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23xKqwG2bCHbqzzmTvp4tX9oj5eV6jEzYVcLhzxbKypTGetN9d1AxJh3D8hq9U4bAzvDF.png)

Today morning while checking my gmail inbox, I noticed this mail from amazonmusic around - \

. Here is a snapshot I took of the email for reference and I am sure they would have sent to everyone who are their Prime members. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/EoH4mx2jfJpqMKQHzpVUoH6nw2rg5gmRAW8Uswd2t8wxAbNSWdz1uFg6BUZou6eRyrx.png)

I standard prime membership of Amazon costs around ₹1,499/year and here are the benefits that members get::

- Fast free delivery
- Prime Video
- Prime Music
- Prime Reading
- Prime Gaming And
- Early access to deals and Prime Day events

So why now this sudden change around the \

? Short answer its all about MONEY forsure and no doubt about it. What was earlier free will now cost you. So ideally Amazon is trying to make a good business model around the music streaming while creating an additional revenue stream from users who want premium features. Following is are the Amazon Music tiers in India? ***Amazon Music tiers in India Just Launced...*** | Plan | What You Get | Cost | |------|--------------|------| | Music Unlimited | Ad-free music, offline downloads, HD & Spatial Audio | ₹99/mo (Prime)
₹119/mo (Non-Prime) | | Prime Music | Music & podcasts with limited ads | Included with Prime | | Music Free | Ad-supported streaming | Free (Coming Soon) | Want to go Ads FREE you need to pay for it now and for prime members it would cost you another hundered bucks and if not a prime member then you shed more money such that Rs.119/- per month. ***Pime Music*** which again has limited Ads will be included for free for Prime members moving forwards. And then there is ***Music Free*** plan which will be again be an Ad-supported streaming that is Coming Soon. So one can clearly see nothing is for FREE.. ITs like first make the users addicted marketing it for FREE and then change the policy saying that it is not any more FREE and now you need to pay a certain amount to get that level of user expereince. Lets take an example a user was first listening to all that 100 Million songs at dispersal all for FREE and now you say there would be Ads if you want to listed for FREE - else pay some extra money to get the same kind of user expereince. How fair is that? To be honest nothing is fair and ultimately it is users who will suffer as these big giants are only there to make MONEY and maximizing shareholder value. So who is at loss here - we the users and the best worst part is that we do not have any other option either pay for it or just leave it and move on. These kind of strategies by big giants may make business sense as they are making more money now but in general it is often the users who bear the financial burden and are at loss. Should the governments interfer here? Who knows they are involved here as well with them. This is sperate topic to talk about RIHGT? For now this should be it for todays post on - \

Let me know your views in the comment section below... Amazon Music Unlimited OR Just another Trap for the users.... Cheers

A#mazonMusic #AmazonMusicUnlimited #MusicStreaming #TechNews #AmazonPrimeIndia

At some point, they feel uneasy but guilty.

You have to overcome fear to be able to spill your guts.
Without fear being gone, you will be tempted not to confess.
Spilling your guts is for your own good, so find a way to spill your guts.

Spill your guts and be free of it.

body.title: Mein Leben Lang hatte ich mit Computer Hardware zu tun und jetzt Endet mein erstes Jahr Programmierung...
body.body:
Was man nicht aus einem Lehrbuch bekommt, ist ein viertel Jahrhundert Hardwareerfahrung beim Programmieren...

Ich habe immer alles ein bisschen Beobachtet, sicher aber, mal benutzt und ausprobiert, was halbwegs Interessant war.

Dadurch habe ich ein gesondertes Verstaendnis fuer Computer und deren Eigenheiten.

Und das merke ich auch an der Art, wie ich gerne Programmier. Naemlich Hardwarenah.

Ich habe ein gutes Gefuehl dafuer, wenn sich ein Computer mit seiner Berechnung wohl fuehlt. Das kann man nicht kaufen, so ein Gefuehl, oder Lernen, das ist pures Dasein, am Werk. 

Dafuer muss man Gemacht sein, sage ich gerne zu anderen mit ihrer Berufung.

Meine ist irgendwie, wohl Programme zu schreiben, die sich mit Netzwerken und Hardware gut auseinander setzen koennen und dabei den interessanten Punkt haben, dem Menschen dienen zu sollen.

Diese Kombination, ist dynamisch und organisch und damit Natuerlich gewachsen. 

Ich hoffe das sich dieser irre Zeitramen dann auch gelohnt hat im Sinne der Nutzelichkeit meiner Kreationen. :-)

Salve

Sascha Pürner aka alucian

body.title: 02 June 2026,daily writing prompt:spill your guts!
body.body:
Arnab and Sayantani were the closest friends in college. But after finishing their studies, when Arnab moved abroad, a significant distance was created between them. When Arnab returned to Dhaka after a long five years, he could hardly recognize Sayantani. The lively, vibrant girl from their college days had somehow become listless, serious, and mysterious. She did smile, but there was no life behind that smile.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPsP5DYYNVbiEtEQm2Rg8N6GgmVvwGvFhEUbvyA5sKZn4/1780375646839.jpg)


One day, on a cloudy evening, Arnab insisted on taking Sayantani to a resort outside Dhaka. The only goal was to bring back his old friend to her former self. But as if by nature's rule, that night it began to rain heavily. A fierce storm and flashes of lightning caused the entire resort to lose power.In the dim light of the candles, they sat in a room beside the balcony. Outside was the roar of the storm, and inside was a strange silence. Arnab noticed that Sayantani was holding a blue envelope tightly in her hand. Her hand was trembling.

Arnab couldn't hold back any longer. He sat facing Sayantani, taking her cold hands into his. In a very soft yet firm voice, he said, \

Sayantani looked into Arnab's eyes. In thecandlelight, there was no curiosity in Arnab's eyes, only a sea of trust. Tears rolled down the corners of Sayantani's eyes. She reached out the envelope to Arnab and began to speak in a trembling voice about the darkest chapter of her life.

Just a year after going abroad, Sayantani's father got caught up in a terrible financial scandal. He had actually been framed. Taking advantage of that situation, a powerful distant relative of Sayantani began to blackmail her. If Sayantani didn't marry him, her father would go to jail. To save her father's honor, Sayantani agreed to that hellish marriage, sacrificing her own career and dreams.Since the marriage, she had been subjected to mental and physical abuse every day. Inside that blue envelope were the divorce papers and all the evidence of that man's misdeeds, which Sayantani had painstakingly collected. But she hadn't had the courage to fight alone. Out of fear of his threats, she had remained silent all this time, even hiding everything from Arnab.

After pouring out all her thoughts in one breath, Sayantani rested her head on Arnab's chest and began to cry loudly. All the tears, humiliation, and fears pent up over five years were washing away like the rainwater.Arnab tightly embraced Sayantani and said, \

By that time, the storm had subsided. Sayantani realized that after revealing all her hidden pains to her dear one, her heart felt much lighter today. For the first time in a long time, she could take a deep breath of fresh air.

body.title: Enjoying the beauty of nature amidst the heat
body.body:
May you be filled with all blessings!

It has been over a week since we last saw a good rain.
There have been days when it looked like it would rain but only a few drops fell.
The weather conditions are hot and humid.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeUuUYYc3EdMT28CBw5kU4W3VyAMngf8oqfGPVwMiAwge/img_20260515_125626.jpg)

The clouds are getting thinner and thicker in the sky.
The farmers who grow sesame are hoping for rain.
The sesame plants are thirsty and their heads are bowed.

I also suffer from low income.
The civil war is also burning.
How can we live comfortably amidst all the political heat, the heat of war, the heat of food and living, the heat of the weather, etc.?

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXT6a19cL2gNGiM91Xd6q3oQDNCeSfu4kdUrvjjgbn1qS/img_20260515_125629.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXT6a19cL2gNGiM91Xd6q3oQDNCeSfu4kdUrvjjgbn1qS/img_20260515_125629.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyP119gwK6XRhUVEyUUzAgt2itfPiepMp2nfsucxwoQ1/img_20260515_125806.jpg)

It's been over 10 days since I posted on Hive Blockchain.
Today, amidst the scorching heat, I enjoyed the beauty of the sky and the clouds.
Nature is as it is.
Only our emotions change.
How are you all doing?
I pray for your health, happiness, and prosperity.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYJzx9HZ3KBDdUYJZALpcwauWhrV47wihqcXLadFRkRjJ/img_20260515_114038.jpg)

မင်္ဂလာအပေါင်းနှင့်ပြည့်စုံကြပါစေ။

မိုး ကောင်းမွန်စွာ မရွာသည်မှာ ရက်သတ္တပတ်ကျော်ခဲ့ပါပြီ။
ရွာမည်ဟန်ပြင်ပြီး မိုးစက် အနည်းငယ်သာ ကျခဲ့သော ရက်တွေ ရှိခဲ့ပါတယ်။
ရာသီဥတု အခြေအနေကတော့ ပူအိုက်နေတာပါပဲ။

ကောင်းကင်၌ကား တိမ်တွေ ကျဲပါးသွားလိုက် ထူထပ်လာလိုက်ပါပဲ။

ပြည်တွင်းစစ်မီးကလည်း တအိအိလောင်ကျွမ်းနေသည်။
နိုင်ငံရေးအပူ၊ စစ်မီးအပူ၊ စားဝတ်နေရေးအပူ၊ ရာသီဥတုအပူ၊ စသော အပူပေါင်းစုံကြားမှာ ဘယ်လို သာယာအောင် နေရမလဲ။

body.title: A simple dinner to try out a new drink
body.body: >Hoy queríamos probar esta bebida que compré ayer que siendo sincera a la mayoría de personas que conozco y gente random de internet que no conozco les encanta esta marca de bebida, sobre todo la “nutri chicha” que es una bebida que suele hacerse con leche y arroz, la mezcla de nutri chicha se ha vuelto muy popular pero muy pocas veces se logra ver esta versión llamado “nutri cacao” es primera vez que la probamos y tenía muchísima curiosidad de su sabor. > Today we wanted to try this drink I bought yesterday. To be honest, most people I know—and random people online I don’t know—love this brand of drink, especially “nutri chicha,” which is a drink usually made with milk and rice. The nutri chicha mix has become very popular, but you rarely see this version called “nutri cacao.” It’s the first time we’ve tried it, and I was really curious about how it would taste. ![IMG_20260601_201922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23x1DUHitLsvcpBQmaAzgmUiDr8r6tkoY36PrmRfwTR94LbkVP4Ys2KWsYFkZbvqGsyZJ.jpg)

>Lo sé, la imagen de este producto es horrible pero no hay que juzgar a un libro por su portada, lo prepare y sabe bastante bien, no es la mejor bebida achocolatada que he probado en mi vida, pero si esta bastante bien, al menos no sabe horrible. Aunque no lo crean encontrar una bebida achocolatada buena a veces resulta todo un reto, he probado varios de diferentes marcas y me he topado con bebidas simplemente intragables. El sabor del nutri cacao es bastante suave asi que debes agregar bastante producto para que sepa mas intenso, en mi caso me gusta sentir el sabor del cacao muy fuerte. Además de eso en el empaque indica que no necesita leche ya que esta mezcla tiene su propia leche, pero realmente yo no confió en eso y siempre le agrego un poco de leche en polvo,. > I know, this product looks awful, but you shouldn't judge a book by its cover. I made it, and it actually tastes pretty good. It's not the best chocolate drink I've ever had, but it's pretty decent—at least it doesn't taste terrible. Believe it or not, finding a good chocolate drink can sometimes be quite a challenge. I’ve tried several different brands and have come across drinks that were simply undrinkable. The flavor of Nutri Cacao is pretty mild, so you have to add quite a bit of the product to make it taste more intense; personally, I like the cocoa flavor to be very strong. On top of that, the packaging says you don’t need milk since the mix has its own milk, but I don’t really trust that, so I always add a little powdered milk. ![IMG_20260601_205126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23wgKucRcuZGpT5x9cK5VvHk2L3dYpbf4G6YjinysVcg1Gf49XtQAiP18nPAft57KmtbQ.jpg)

>Ninguna de estas bebidas puede superar al rey de los reyes, una bebida achocolatada que forma parte de la historia de Venezuela, el mejor siempre será el toddy, es riquísimo pero es super caro, casi imposible de comprar, sobre todo las presentaciones más grandes. > None of these drinks can top the king of kings—a chocolate-flavored drink that’s part of Venezuela’s history. The toddy will always be the best; it’s delicious but super expensive, and almost impossible to find, especially in larger sizes. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23u6Hb68RdbhHhZuJRQ3ZjTsV9yGLzNhmaZQSZwFkxXPJhRKZiToyHiKgywYPqHPyrYEo.png)
[Source](https://mandalomarket.com/toddy-un-clasico-que-nunca-pasa-de-moda/)

>Pero mi puntaje final para esta bebida es 7/10, su precio fue de aproximadamente $3 y son 500 gramos, el empaque se siente bastante lleno y sabe bastante bien pero suave al mismo tiempo. > But my final score for this drink is 7 out of 10. It cost about $3 for 500 grams; the package feels quite full, and it tastes pretty good but mild at the same time. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFRq8qizgbpkCH4DTf433rqhEsJt81X4wg3diUXGL64wdmv9GA7jKEcG2NBZthz57xe.png)

body.title: Похід в гори
body.body:
Знаєте, вирватися в первинну природу, це в наш час безцінна можливість. Відчути вітер на вершині гори, вдихнути на повні груди гірське повітря, насолоджуватись безкраїми краєвидами. А головне, після малорухливого способу життя вдома ти відчуваєш, що маєш так багато м'язів, які слід інколи напружувати, бо тепер, після першого дня походу, тіло ламає крепатура.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTXQu1ocBVGhVR65Lukzf7cXxLDjuq51rJ8HwQMski4Us/1780371709795.jpg)

Та є в цій первинності і сумна реальність, коли в гірському ландшафті все більше з'являється знаків сучасності, наприклад десятки здоровенних вітрових турбін на хребтах. Я не спеціаліст в енергетиці, але хіба немає інших місць в здоровенній країні, щоб розмістити вітряки?

body.title: The impeccable beauty of roses.
body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUmaB4KcY3UjfhmSDWkRR6F7F5rvq58XDDgaH2TFXE1MN/1780375112630.jpg) Hello Hive Community The rose is a unique symbol of nature's immense wonder and beauty. This flower, which has been the inspiration of poets and writers for ages and the language of loving hearts, is not called the queen of flowers for nothing. The variety of colors and patterns of each petal, along with its captivating fragrance, transport people to a magical world. Looking at a newly blossomed rose fills the mind with a strange sense of peace. A magical canvas of color and form, the beauty of roses is not limited to a specific color. Just as the traditional appeal of red roses expresses deep love, white roses express tenderness and purity. Yellow roses hide the warmth of friendship. And pink roses carry a message of gratitude and appreciation. Even the striped or magenta-yellow two-tone roses seen in the picture are a strange creation of nature. Which is bound to fascinate anyone in the blink of an eye. When the morning dewdrops on the petals shine like pearls in the sunlight, their beauty increases many times over. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRiehTLRdhjqFioTnKuPSFKh1hpUUxBfz7o6YtkVD7S2N/1780375112851.jpg) The fragrance of roses has a magical power. Its gentle yet long-lasting scent can instantly remove all the fatigue and mental stress from a person's mind. A bunch of roses blooming in the garden or a single rose in a vase in the corner of the house can change the atmosphere of the entire environment. It teaches us how to maintain our beauty and fragrance even in the midst of thorns. This is a great inspiration to live with a smile even in the face of adversity. Dear friends of Hive, in this mechanical life, we often forget to enjoy these small beauties of nature. But just looking at a rose or smelling it can bring back the vitality within us. Love this beautiful gift of nature. Live its beauty. Make your surroundings as beautiful and fragrant as roses. 📸 Photography| Details 📸 |-|-| |Model|Realme-C53| |Location| Bangladesh|

body.title: 日子越来越有盼头
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![R5ofbH55R1vNv1IL_IMG_9720.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/R5ofbH55R1vNv1IL_IMG_9720/R5ofbH55R1vNv1IL_IMG_9720.webp)
![lk4Pf2kHSUknqvpC_IMG_9716.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/lk4Pf2kHSUknqvpC_IMG_9716/lk4Pf2kHSUknqvpC_IMG_9716.webp)
![blo0ODWGdhLJc8Rl_IMG_9715.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/blo0ODWGdhLJc8Rl_IMG_9715/blo0ODWGdhLJc8Rl_IMG_9715.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>



最近突然发现，我的休闲生活变得格外丰富鲜活起来，陆陆续续加入了好几个同频的小圈子，眼看着超长假期即将到来，我完全没有害怕会虚度光阴的焦虑，反而满心期待，相信这个假期一定会过得很充实。

最近我开始跟着点点夫妇，还有一位同事一起去健身房撸铁，几年前我也去过健身房，那时候只会跟着上团课，对各类健身器械一窍不通，完全不敢尝试。这一次在他们的耐心指导和带动下，我终于慢慢摸清了一些健身器材的用法，第一次锻炼，我们专注练背，足足练了两个小时，我敢说健身房的训练强度，比单纯练瑜伽要高很多，而且还看到了以前在电视里才见到的大块头金刚，看着所有自律的人，也会不自觉被带动，更有坚持下去的动力。

运动之外，假期的出行安排也有了新的期待。有同事相约，放假之后带上各自的孩子一起去海边旅行。大家的儿子年纪相仿，都是十岁左右，比较玩得来，这样我就可以不用操心出去旅游还要管娃的问题，让他们小男生自己玩去！

如今，空闲时既可以去健身房撸铁，也可以去瑜伽馆放松拉伸，两种运动交替，身心都舒展了不少，除此之外，常去的中医院除了一直在坚持的养发调理，最近还上新了养生茶饮包。我们学校的同事几乎都成了中医院的忠实客户，医院居然还支持送药上门，真是有被宠到。

还有一件须提的快乐事，就是我们一群老朋友组建的专属群聊，名字特别可爱，叫“非常哇塞的中年妇女”。回头想想很奇妙，年轻时大家各自忙碌，聚少离多，凝聚力反而没有现在强。越临近四十岁，我们越懂得生活的真谛，不再只围着家庭和孩子转，开始懂得取悦自己，拥有自己的社交圈和独处空间。于是我们约定经常一起搞姐妹聚会，也是很期待呢！

一个个小小的群聊，一次次同频的相聚，运动，或者结伴出行，都是平淡生活最好的解药，姐妹们一起运动、一起放松、一起热爱生活。


---

body.title: The secrets of the Pedagogical Institute in Maracay
body.body:
> Hello, dear community, I hope you are all doing well. On this wonderful occasion, I want to share a little bit of my university life with you, showing you a small part of my university, the Pedagogical Institute of Maracay, or UPEL. I hope you enjoy it. >Hola, querida comunidad espero que se encuentren muy bien, en esta hermosa ocasión quiero compartir con ustedes un poco de mi vida universitaria, mostrándoles una pequeña parte de mi universidad, el Pedagógico de Maracay o UPEL. Espero que les agrade.
![458957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/23xeZ5SRmg4XSjQJ3L2YJy2C54zeVL3PsS7kW9aVS7utmHyJEgbyTZSEy6DrBziAN5n8h.jpg)
The teachers' college where I am is quite large, encompassing more than four specializations and other centers that were once part of the university. Furthermore, the grounds were formerly the site of what are now the San Jacinto fairs, and it's said that there was a zoo, although this hasn't been fully confirmed. In any case, the grounds are home to a great diversity of flora and fauna; there are even ponds near the biology department and other species that thrive within the university.Aside from that, the Pedagogical Institute is one of the few universities still operating here in Venezuela, and it's the only one that trains teachers. Walking in there every day reminds me of the purpose of being a teacher and the moral and civic duty we have to society. Just as the Pedagogical Institute refuses to die in terms of its infrastructure and tries to remain standing and stable as much as possible with the limited resources we have, the teaching profession in Venezuela is doing the same. >El pedagógico donde me encuentro se caracteriza por ser bastante grande, abarcando más de cuatro especialidades y otros centros que formaban parte de la universidad. Además, el terreno anteriormente era la sede de lo que actualmente son las ferias de San Jacinto, y se dice que había un zoológico, aunque esto no está completamente confirmado. El caso es que los terrenos albergan una gran diversidad de flora y fauna; incluso hay estanques cerca del departamento de biología y otras especies que prosperan dentro de la universidad.Aparte de eso, el Pedagógico es una de las universidades que sigue en pie aquí en Venezuela y es la única que forma maestros. Entrar todos los días me recuerda el propósito de ser docente y la tarea moral y cívica que tenemos con la sociedad. Así como el Pedagógico se niega a morir en infraestructura y trata de mantenerse de pie y estable en la medida de lo posible con los recursos limitados que tenemos, lo mismo está haciendo la profesión docente en Venezuela.
![459016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/23zkiV1HZQqngdksjpPfr8xVS7JXJYv2u7Dab7nmdLBiMZLJqt4XkQwbn6EUqZKZZrev7.jpg)
[//]:# (!worldmappin -89.96535 lat 88.97728 long Upel d3scr) Since my department doesn't have its own building at the moment, we sometimes have classes at the main biology department building. Nearby, there are some trees and a rather beautiful landscape overlooking the hills and mountains that are part of Maracay. Because I'm studying on the first floor of this building, I can appreciate a better view both inside the university and of its surroundings. While we were in class, I noticed that the day was very beautiful and decided to take these lovely photographs.There are many more gardens on the university grounds; we also have mango trees and other fruit trees. I'd say the Pedagogical Institute is about 70% trees and plants, and the rest is buildings, but it's beautiful because there's always shade, places to rest, and the remaining infrastructure blends in with nature. You could say they're reminders of what the Pedagogical Institute was like in its golden age, something we shouldn't forget and something we need to work on to improve and build upon. >Como mi departamento no tiene sede momentáneamente, a veces tenemos clases en la sede del departamento principal de biología. Cerca de allí hay unos árboles y un paisaje bastante bonito que da al frente de cerros y montañas que forman parte de lo que es Maracay. Como estoy estudiando en el primer piso de este departamento, puedo apreciar una mejor vista tanto dentro de la universidad como de sus alrededores, mientras estábamos en clase, noté que el día estaba muy bonito y decidí tomar estas hermosas fotografías.Hay muchísimos más jardines en la universidad; también tenemos árboles de mango y de otras frutas. Puedo decir que el pedagógico es un 70% de árboles y plantas, y el resto son edificios, pero es bonito porque siempre hay sombra, hay lugares para descansar, y la infraestructura que quedó se integra con la naturaleza. Digamos que son recuerdos de lo que fue el pedagógico en sus tiempos dorados, de lo que no debemos olvidar y en lo que tenemos que trabajar para mejorar y construir.
![458958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/23ywm1s85HvCAVm9FWbSkttne7XaASkuoPLf224utAhXaefPH51wV3NxC6fqid95gGRRW.jpg)
This is one of the things I love about studying at this part of the teachers' college: you can always see beautiful landscapes and enjoy the company of birds, like the one called Christ the Redoreut. I think one of the characteristics of the universities here in Maracay is that most are open and have very nice gardens, although they aren't well maintained due to infrastructure issues. However, they remain functional, which is what's important, and they form part of the university's identity within the teachers' college community. >Esta es una de las cosas que me encanta de estudiar en esta parte del pedagógico: siempre puedes observar paisajes muy hermosos y disfrutar de la compañía de pajaritos, como el llamado Cristo. Creo que una de las características de las universidades aquí en Maracay es que la mayoría son abiertas y albergan jardines muy bonitos, aunque no están bien conservados debido a cuestiones de infraestructura. Sin embargo, se mantienen funcionando, que es lo importante, y forman parte de la identidad universitaria dentro de la comunidad del pedagógico. Thank you so much for reading this far and for reading my post. I hope you enjoyed all the photos, which were taken with my Infinix Note 50 Pro phone. >Muchísimas gracias por llegar hasta aquí y por haber leído mi publicación. Espero que les hayan gustado todas las fotografías, las cuales fueron tomadas con mi teléfono Infinix, modelo Note 50 Pro. ![37949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/244KZwwJ22RuUwHbaYQTtQmqa2he8tbpQL5fLuVfz7sNNcmVx1SG9oCx1HeFHdhnwzC27.jpg)

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![neIg06Lk6W88RQLz_IMG_9716.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/neIg06Lk6W88RQLz_IMG_9716/neIg06Lk6W88RQLz_IMG_9716.webp)
![ODHfkky8yOqsQrGi_IMG_9720.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/ODHfkky8yOqsQrGi_IMG_9720/ODHfkky8yOqsQrGi_IMG_9720.webp)
![0wqGMWA0XuKbjfEj_IMG_9715.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/0wqGMWA0XuKbjfEj_IMG_9715/0wqGMWA0XuKbjfEj_IMG_9715.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>



最近突然发现，我的休闲生活变得格外丰富鲜活起来，陆陆续续加入了好几个同频的小圈子，眼看着超长假期即将到来，我完全没有害怕会虚度光阴的焦虑，反而满心期待，相信这个假期一定会过得很充实。

最近我开始跟着点点夫妇，还有一位同事一起去健身房撸铁，几年前我也去过健身房，那时候只会跟着上团课，对各类健身器械一窍不通，完全不敢尝试。这一次在他们的耐心指导和带动下，我终于慢慢摸清了一些健身器材的用法，第一次锻炼，我们专注练背，足足练了两个小时，我敢说健身房的训练强度，比单纯练瑜伽要高很多，而且还看到了以前在电视里才见到的大块头金刚，看着所有自律的人，也会不自觉被带动，更有坚持下去的动力。

运动之外，假期的出行安排也有了新的期待。有同事相约，放假之后带上各自的孩子一起去海边旅行。大家的儿子年纪相仿，都是十岁左右，比较玩得来，这样我就可以不用操心出去旅游还要管娃的问题，让他们小男生自己玩去！

如今，空闲时既可以去健身房撸铁，也可以去瑜伽馆放松拉伸，两种运动交替，身心都舒展了不少，除此之外，常去的中医院除了一直在坚持的养发调理，最近还上新了养生茶饮包。我们学校的同事几乎都成了中医院的忠实客户，医院居然还支持送药上门，真是有被宠到。

还有一件须提的快乐事，就是我们一群老朋友组建的专属群聊，名字特别可爱，叫“非常哇塞的中年妇女”。回头想想很奇妙，年轻时大家各自忙碌，聚少离多，凝聚力反而没有现在强。越临近四十岁，我们越懂得生活的真谛，不再只围着家庭和孩子转，开始懂得取悦自己，拥有自己的社交圈和独处空间。于是我们约定经常一起搞姐妹聚会，也是很期待呢！

一个个小小的群聊，一次次同频的相聚，运动，或者结伴出行，都是平淡生活最好的解药，姐妹们一起运动、一起放松、一起热爱生活。


---

body.title: Grilled chicken churrasco served with French fries and a salad of tomatoes, green beans, and radishes.[Esp-Eng]
body.body:
>    
<hr>
Feliz y bendecido inicio de semana, un gusto compartir una vez más con ustedes, hoy les quiero compartir otra alternativa para un almuerzo balanceado se trata de churrasco de pollo a la plancha servido con papas fritas y ensalada de tomate, vainitas y rabano, este plato es fácil y rápido de preparar aquí les dejo el paso a paso de esta sencilla receta.

>Happy and blessed start to the week! It’s a pleasure to be sharing with you once again. Today I’d like to share another option for a balanced lunch: grilled chicken churrasco served with french fries and a salad of tomatoes, green beans, and radishes. This dish is quick and easy to prepare. Here’s a step-by-step guide to this simple recipe.

<hr>

![GridArt_20260524_211619064.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoCk2MTxnsmZgdXwNRArzZ7zroAW8q8HftsSWoHHUhZDrm6rjjvXA3m4oxkokDLd4Mo.jpg)



<hr>

# <center> *INGREDIENTES/INGREDIENTS* </center>

<div class = \

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EokdbUHuDDLD7Ci1B4BMp9e4rmTxB9LMZ2hyz5fQwQgkWfNwayZzmjcQo4gtXHW3e1K.jpg - 2 papas - 500 gramos de churrasco de pollo - 1/2 cucharadita de ajo en polvo - 1/2 cucharadita de paprika - Orégano molido - 1/2 limón - Aceite de oliva - Salsa de soya Para la ensalada: - Tomate - Vainitas - Rábano - Cebolla - Cilantro - 1/2 limón - Aceite de oliva >- 2 potatoes >- 500 grams of chicken thighs >- 1/2 teaspoon of garlic powder >- 1/2 teaspoon of paprika >- Ground oregano >- 1/2 lemon >- Olive oil >- Soy sauce For the salad: >- Tomato >- Green beans >- Radish >- Onion >- Cilantro >- 1/2 lemon >- Olive oil
#
*PREPARACIÓN/PREPARATION*
Lavamos y escurrimos el pollo y aderezamos con sal, pimienta, ajo en polvo, páprika, orégano, salsa de soya, aceite de oliva y el zumo de medio limón dejamos reposar mínimo media hora. >Wash and drain the chicken, then season it with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, oregano, soy sauce, olive oil, and the juice of half a lemon. Let it marinate for at least half an hour.
![GridArt_20260524_212727429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoH1qv6YPEkqFNc9SS2GUsjDmMoVJWaQTnoaZkj31o1nDo84X6QdKyDsPVgM3r54tUL.jpg)
En una plancha ligeramente engrasada y caliente colocamos el pollo por el lado de la piel cocinamos a fuego medio tapamos y cocinamos hasta que dore por un lado, luego volteamos por el otro lado. >Place the chicken skin-side down on a lightly oiled, hot griddle. Cook over medium heat, cover, and cook until golden brown on one side, then flip it over to the other side.
![GridArt_20260524_213321069.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eoc8WiT8iRzj3ur8rxaJqBf45wBj1Uw3mMepng63PkYH4PPuGuycMZajSb6mm4zkxBA.jpg)
Preparamos la ensalada lavamos bien los vegetales que vamos a usar y cocinamos las vainitas y la dejamos enfriar, en una ensaladera colocamos el tomate, el rábano picado en rueda colocamos la vainitas picada diagonalmente, la cebolla picada en tiras y el cilantro picado finamente. >To prepare the salad, wash the vegetables thoroughly, cook the green beans, and let them cool. In a salad bowl, combine the tomato, the radish sliced into rounds, the green beans cut diagonally, the onion sliced into strips, and the finely chopped cilantro.
![GridArt_20260524_213655114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoeHoEsS662ppw3UC6BAdK5nH4CmLhVBAUuXuFYSY7JxpT35EvHSsxXQxSkGHVPqjBe.jpg)
Aderezamos con sal, aceite y limón mezclamos y lista la ensalada. >Season with salt, oil, and lemon juice, toss to combine, and the salad is ready.
![GridArt_20260524_213832728.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoEsQfBKbZ6thd3XC3dtEvFxj2AmGpFmr4PZhL7s2AsQCe2F2RoVxTWVFv3sZXVLDmQ.jpg)
Pelamos las papas la picamos en tiras y la dejamos en agua con sal por unos minutos, luego escurrimos y en un sartén con suficiente aceite caliente colocamos las papas y la doramos por ambos lados la colocamos en un papel absorbente para eliminar el exceso de grasa. >Peel the potatoes, cut them into strips, and soak them in salted water for a few minutes. Drain them, then place them in a skillet with enough hot oil and fry them until golden brown on both sides. Transfer them to paper towels to remove excess oil.
![GridArt_20260524_214107787.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EokfWY2wJJi2HU2ZUd6ph6jYghx5st6eJJRJwFjFAkRoJ9bRsMaGtna8WQ84ew3sxgu.jpg)
Una vez listo el pollo, la ensalada y las papas emplatamos para disfrutar de un plato balanceado a la hora del almuerzo. >Once the chicken, salad, and potatoes are ready, we plate them up to enjoy a balanced meal for lunch.
![GridArt_20260524_211816932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eoc9VHvrf6my74uu9eYZHVL57UWcKErQqeRjPrGNnMmNtEwnZqKXgGwS32N9AG3WBC4.jpg)
Espero que esta sencilla receta que les comparto el día de hoy sea de su completo agrado hasta la próxima y muchas bendiciones. >I hope you enjoy this simple recipe I’m sharing with you today. Until next time, and many blessings.

body.body:
🇬🇧 In English

---

## The People Who Helped Me Carry the Weight… and a Hobby That Didn't Change My Life After All

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQXanD1nchCrwmH6SzBGgYLG4kU989DLo4D78bBCLsguP/sweetlouise_friendship_5616035_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/friendship-hug-girls-love-5616035/)
---

Hello dear @ladiesofhive community 

Life gives us many moments when someone helps us.

Fortunately.

The interesting thing is that we do not always recognize that help in the same way. Sometimes it depends on our age, our maturity, or our ability to understand what others are doing for us.

### 1️⃣ Did someone help you during your most difficult moment?

Looking back, I can say that many people have helped me throughout my life.

That is why it would be difficult for me to mention only one person.

When I was twelve years old, my mother passed away.

It was one of the most painful experiences of my life.

At that age, it is hard to understand a loss of that magnitude. You know something important has disappeared, but you do not yet have the emotional tools to process it.

During that time, my friends from the boarding school where I was studying helped me a great deal.

My uncles and aunts were also there for me.

Some teachers offered support and understanding when I needed it most.

Each person contributed something different. Sometimes it was a conversation, sometimes patience, sometimes simply being present.

For that reason, choosing only one person would feel unfair.

What helped me overcome that difficult period was not a single act of kindness, but the combined support of many people who cared about me.

Even today, I keep a special place in my heart for all of them.

Time has passed, but gratitude remains.

---

### 2️⃣ A hobby I thought would change my life

I have always enjoyed baking and making desserts.

Over the years, I have prepared many cakes, sweets, and homemade treats.

I genuinely enjoy the process.

There was a time when I thought this hobby could become much more than that.

I imagined it might become a small business and perhaps even change my life financially.

So I invested time, effort, and enthusiasm into learning and improving.

In a way, it did change my life because I still make desserts for my family, and I enjoy sharing them with others.

However, I eventually realized that professional baking requires a level of decoration and presentation that I never managed to achieve the way I wanted.

When I looked at the beautiful creations made by experienced bakers, I understood that my strengths were elsewhere.

The funny part is that people always enjoyed the flavor of my desserts.

No one complained about eating them!

But when it came to selling them, I decided it was better to keep baking as something I loved rather than turning it into a business.

So perhaps it did not change my life in the way I imagined.

But it still left me with good memories, useful skills, and many happy moments around the table.

---

Sometimes the people who help us through difficult times and the hobbies that do not go according to plan still leave something valuable behind.

One teaches us gratitude.

The other teaches us that not every passion needs to become a business to be worthwhile.

## Las personas que me ayudaron a llevar el peso… y un pasatiempo que no cambió mi vida como imaginaba

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQXanD1nchCrwmH6SzBGgYLG4kU989DLo4D78bBCLsguP/sweetlouise_friendship_5616035_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/friendship-hug-girls-love-5616035/)
---

Hola querida comunidad @ladiesofhive 

La vida nos pone muchas veces en situaciones donde alguien nos ayuda.

Por suerte.

Lo curioso es que no siempre reconocemos esa ayuda de la misma manera. A veces depende de la edad que tenemos, de nuestra madurez o de la capacidad que tengamos para comprender lo que otros están haciendo por nosotros.

### 1️⃣ ¿Alguien te ayudó durante tu momento más difícil?

Mirando hacia atrás, puedo decir que muchas personas me han ayudado a lo largo de mi vida.

Por eso me resultaría difícil mencionar solo a una.

Cuando tenía doce años falleció mi madre.

Fue una de las experiencias más dolorosas que me ha tocado vivir.

A esa edad es difícil comprender una pérdida de esa magnitud. Sabes que algo muy importante ha desaparecido, pero todavía no tienes las herramientas emocionales para procesarlo.

Durante ese tiempo me ayudaron mucho mis amigas de la escuela donde estaba becada.

También estuvieron presentes mis tíos y mis tías.

Algunos profesores me ofrecieron apoyo y comprensión cuando más lo necesitaba.

Cada persona aportó algo diferente. A veces era una conversación, otras veces paciencia y, en ocasiones, simplemente estar ahí.

Por eso elegir a una sola persona me parecería injusto.

Lo que me ayudó a superar aquella etapa tan difícil no fue una acción aislada, sino el apoyo conjunto de muchas personas que se preocuparon por mí.

Todavía hoy guardo un espacio especial en mi corazón para todas ellas.

Ha pasado el tiempo, pero la gratitud permanece.

---

### 2️⃣ Un pasatiempo que pensé que cambiaría mi vida

Siempre me ha gustado la repostería.

A lo largo de los años he preparado muchos dulces, cakes y postres caseros.

Disfruto realmente el proceso.

Hubo una época en la que pensé que ese pasatiempo podía convertirse en algo más.

Imaginé que podría transformarse en un pequeño emprendimiento y quizás mejorar mi situación económica.

Así que dediqué tiempo, esfuerzo y entusiasmo a aprender y perfeccionarme.

De cierta manera sí cambió mi vida, porque todavía hago dulces para mi familia y disfruto compartirlos con otras personas.

Sin embargo, con el tiempo entendí que la repostería profesional exige un nivel de decoración y presentación que nunca logré alcanzar como me habría gustado.

Cuando veía las creaciones de otras personas con más experiencia, comprendía que mis fortalezas estaban en otros aspectos.

Lo curioso es que quienes han probado mis dulces siempre han disfrutado mucho su sabor.

¡Nunca faltaron voluntarios para comerlos!

Pero cuando se trataba de venderlos, decidí que era mejor conservar la repostería como algo que me hacía feliz y no convertirla en una obligación.

Así que tal vez no cambió mi vida de la forma en que imaginé.

Pero me dejó buenos recuerdos, habilidades útiles y muchos momentos agradables alrededor de una mesa.

---

A veces las personas que nos ayudan en los momentos difíciles y los pasatiempos que no salen como esperábamos terminan dejándonos algo igualmente valioso.

Unos nos enseñan gratitud.

Los otros nos enseñan que no toda pasión necesita convertirse en negocio para tener valor.

Gracias por leer

Ganz genau! Das ist der klassische Zerrspiegel des Internets. Wer den ganzen Tag in diesen Kommentarspalten verbringt, läuft Gefahr zu glauben, die Welt bestehe nur noch aus Wut, Extremen und unversöhnlichen Lagern.

Dabei vergisst man leicht die schweigende Mehrheit, die das Netz ganz anders nutzt:

    Die \

: Die absolute Masse der Gesellschaft regt sich dort gar nicht auf. Die gucken Kochvideos, Heimwerker-Anleitungen, IT-Tutorials oder einfach Unterhaltung. Sie leben ihr Leben, gehen arbeiten, kümmern sich um ihre Familien und haben überhaupt kein Bedürfnis, sich mit Trollen oder Ideologen anzulegen.

    Der Verzerrungs-Effekt: Algorithmen pushen genau das, was Emotionen – vor allem Wut und Empörung – erzeugt, weil das die Leute auf der Plattform hält. Dadurch wirkt dieser winzige, laute Teil der Gesellschaft künstlich riesig.

Wer Politik oder Technologie nur für dieses laute, verzerrte digitale Abbild macht, baut an der Realität der Menschen vorbei. Zu erkennen, dass das, was wir auf YouTube oder Social Media sehen, eben nicht die echte Gesellschaft ist, ist der erste und wichtigste Schritt für jeden, der im echten Leben wirklich etwas bewegen und verändern will.

Du hast diesen Filter für dich jetzt quasi abgeschaltet. Wie nimmst du denn die Menschen und die Stimmung im echten Alltag im Vergleich zu diesem alten YouTube-Zerrspiegel jetzt wahr?

body.title: Epic fail fishing experience for the first time at the pier of Apatot
body.body:
One of my **most unforgettable and enjoyable moments** during my vacation in *Ilocos Norte* was trying fishing for the first time.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTa5yWNvCHzcKch6q7B8YzybtyWLsbpi5wfbzi8XgUWEv/img_7366.jpg)

One of my friends loves fishing and he has it as a hobby. I usually am just watching him do his thing whenever he is fishing so one time, during our vacation, I got curious and decided to try it to know what makes him enjoy fishing so much.

On our second day of vacation, we woke up at dusk to make sure we can still see the sunrise at the pier of *Apatot*.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRqpUXrtJ96w8cTtPEn24Jc39VWo76euSb7amfvNopCcU/img_7365.jpg)
> ***And look! We were fortunate enough to see the sunrise. It was definitely a refreshing sight.***

After taking some photos of the sunrise, we were off to start with the reason why we woke up very early that day. My friend, lent me one of his fishing rods he is not using and he let me set it up.

And because it is my first time doing it, and as a clumsy girl, I hurt my finger and just seconds after blood came out. But I'm too excited for the blood to even matter. I immediately rubbed it on the little fake fish I am going to use as a bait.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWqgwfreJ4qWavsi4rGNN9hKoeCZdFqUWxXo87XddmDgE/img_7363.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUV29bD3vUhyN6BEodnhLf2zVo2aESYjo2bfSA4A8BbyV/img_7364.jpg)

***After that, I'm all set for fishing!***

I had two other friends with me who were just as excited as I was. They were watching and cheering me on.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcS2cwvY16MbePJKe4w8zCuzXaTa4zhiELaox9LwyNiKg/img_7349.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNm6zLwKwtC3QA5kg5ow3onWdJYChP9pQ7Nz4Y67C24f3/img_7348.jpg)


I didn’t know that waiting for a fish to bite could actually be this exciting. Now I understand why my friend enjoys it so much, even though I’ve never really seen him catch a fish LOL.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPXEPicoUS8aLUm6Eze4CNnM9AiUmndPUWJzmTJV2nufM/img_7361.jpg)
> ***Sat on the portable chair we brought because it is tiring to stand while waiting for a fish to bite the bait.***

After two and a half hours, there was still no fish in sight. The sun was already getting very hot, so we decided to leave the pier.

It was an epic fail for my first fishing experience, but it was definitely an adventure I will always treasure.

It was disappointing I didn’t catch anything, but it didn’t ruin my day. We still enjoyed the beautiful scenery down the road which is just a few kilometers away from the pier. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdbfYwNfRB5yrokBobsXNVYbMWJ74QQLgLFShT8DvJDL7/img_7350.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRf7gGoTwmZusMcJLBf2C2sBNLHYvEtJ8GZaG3F3awVoB/img_7314.jpg)
> ***The scenery we got to enjoy despite the disappointing epic fail fishing.***

We spent time relaxing and ended the morning with some taho, or sweetened soft tofu.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTovBPM93tfYJuz5D6VA89Xn5hs8JuEnuubLPtuXehJe7/img_7296.jpg)
> ***Taho to make the day sweet.***

It was a bright morning and truly an unforgettable experience. Overall, my first fishing attempt may have been an epic fail, but the memory is something I will always remember.

body.title: Cuadernos de Isabel #17 Hay silencios que preocupan más. [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
## 📖 Cuadernos de Isabel #17  
### *Hay silencios que preocupan más*  

---

Hola querida comunidad @holos-lotus,  

Hoy recibí en consulta a un paciente que no vino porque quisiera venir.  

De hecho, desde el primer momento quedó claro que estaba allí más por insistencia de su familia que por decisión propia.  

Eso sucede más de lo que muchas personas imaginan.  

Hay quienes llegan al hospital buscando respuestas. Otros llegan porque alguien más los convence después de semanas o meses ignorando síntomas, postergando estudios o simplemente dejando pasar el tiempo como si el cuerpo pudiera esperar indefinidamente.  

---

El hombre tendría poco más de cincuenta años. Venía acompañado por una mujer que hablaba mucho más que él. Mientras ella intentaba explicarme todo lo que había estado ocurriendo, él permanecía sentado mirando hacia un punto fijo de la pared.  

Tenía varios síntomas físicos. Algunos importantes.  

Pero, curiosamente, eso no fue lo que más me llamó la atención.  

---

Fueron sus respuestas.  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbmtoJuVW3BRF1JLvcH6vRRVfGbVm7rT7Q914DUAMkHwW/sreza420_train_4165566_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/train-sad-lonely-regret-desperate-4165566/)

---

Cortas.  
Escasas.  
Como si cada palabra requiriera un esfuerzo innecesario.  

---

—¿Desde cuándo comenzó el malestar?  

—No sé.  

—¿Ha dormido bien?  

—Más o menos.  

—¿Ha perdido el apetito?  

—Puede ser.  

---

No era evasivo exactamente.  
Tampoco parecía molesto conmigo.  

Era otra cosa.  

---

Había en él una especie de cansancio que iba mucho más allá de lo físico.  

Un agotamiento difícil de describir, pero imposible de ignorar cuando una pasa años observando personas.  

---

Mientras la familiar hablaba de medicamentos, dolores y preocupaciones, yo seguía observándolo a él.  

La forma en que evitaba levantar demasiado la mirada.  
La manera lenta de responder.  
Ese silencio constante que parecía mucho más pesado que cualquier palabra.  

---

Y pensé algo que he aprendido con el tiempo:  

hay silencios que preocupan más que muchos síntomas.  

---

Porque algunas personas llegan hablando rápido por nervios, llenando espacios vacíos, intentando controlar el miedo a través de las palabras.  

Pero otras llegan ya demasiado agotadas incluso para explicar lo que sienten.  

---

No sé exactamente cuándo comenzó a hacerse tan frecuente esa expresión en algunos pacientes.  

Tal vez siempre estuvo ahí y ahora la noto más.  

O quizás el desgaste cotidiano termina acumulándose de maneras que no aparecen directamente en un análisis clínico.  

---

Vivimos tiempos donde muchas personas están cansadas antes incluso de enfermarse.  

Cansadas de esperar.  
De resolver problemas diarios.  
De adaptarse constantemente.  
De sostener preocupaciones durante demasiado tiempo.  

Y a veces el cuerpo termina siendo solo el lugar donde todo eso finalmente se manifiesta.  

---

En medio de la consulta intenté hablarle con calma. No únicamente sobre medicamentos o estudios, sino sobre cómo se estaba sintiendo realmente.  

Al principio respondió igual de breve.  

Pero hubo un momento en que levantó la vista por unos segundos y dijo algo sencillo que todavía sigo pensando horas después:  

—Uno se cansa de todo.  

---

Nada más.  

Solo eso.  

Y, sin embargo, aquella frase contenía mucho más de lo que parecía.  

---

A veces las personas no necesitan largos discursos para decir que están agotadas.  

A veces basta una oración pequeña dicha con honestidad para revelar un peso enorme.  

---

Continuamos la consulta. Le expliqué los estudios necesarios, hablamos de posibles causas y de los pasos que debíamos seguir. Él escuchaba en silencio, asintiendo lentamente de vez en cuando.  

Pero incluso después de terminar, tuve la sensación de que lo más importante de aquella consulta no había sido solamente el diagnóstico físico.  

---

Hay dolores que no comienzan exactamente en el cuerpo, aunque el cuerpo termine cargándolos igual.  

---

Cuando terminó mi jornada y salí del hospital, seguía pensando en aquel paciente.  

En cómo algunas personas llegan a un punto donde incluso pedir ayuda les parece demasiado esfuerzo.  

Y en lo fácil que resulta acostumbrarnos a ver el agotamiento emocional como algo normal simplemente porque se ha vuelto frecuente.  

---

Al llegar a casa, Bruno dormía sobre uno de mis libros y Max se acercó lentamente moviendo la cola. Me senté en el suelo unos minutos mientras el silencio de la casa reemplazaba poco a poco el ruido constante del hospital.  

Y pensé que quizás una de las cosas más importantes en medicina no es solamente aprender a escuchar palabras.  

También es aprender a reconocer aquello que las personas ya no tienen fuerzas para decir.  

---

Gracias por acompañarme en este decimoséptimo trazo de mis Cuadernos de Isabel. Nos seguimos encontrando en las pausas, en los silencios difíciles y en esas pequeñas señales humanas que muchas veces dicen más que cualquier expediente médico.  

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y la traducción al inglés fue realizada con DeepL Translate.  

---

🇺🇸 **ENGLISH VERSION**  

---

## 📖 Isabel’s Notebooks #17  
### *Some Silences Are More Concerning*  

---

Hello dear @holos-lotus community,  

Today I received a patient who did not come to the consultation because he wanted to.  

In fact, from the very beginning it was clear that he was there more because of his family’s insistence than by his own decision.  

That happens far more often than many people imagine.  

Some people come to the hospital looking for answers. Others arrive because someone finally convinces them after weeks or months of ignoring symptoms, postponing tests, or simply letting time pass as if the body could wait forever.  

---

The man was probably in his fifties. He came accompanied by a woman who spoke much more than he did. While she tried to explain everything that had been happening, he remained seated, staring at a fixed point on the wall.  

He had several physical symptoms. Some of them important.  

But interestingly, that was not what caught my attention the most.  

---

It was his answers.  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbmtoJuVW3BRF1JLvcH6vRRVfGbVm7rT7Q914DUAMkHwW/sreza420_train_4165566_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/train-sad-lonely-regret-desperate-4165566/)

---

Short.  
Limited.  
As if every word required unnecessary effort.  

---

“How long have you been feeling unwell?”  

“I don’t know.”  

“Have you been sleeping well?”  

“More or less.”  

“Have you lost your appetite?”  

“Maybe.”  

---

He was not exactly evasive.  
Nor did he seem upset with me.  

It was something else.  

---

There was in him a kind of exhaustion that went far beyond the physical.  

A fatigue difficult to describe, but impossible to ignore after spending years observing people.  

---

While his family member talked about medications, pain, and worries, I kept observing him.  

The way he avoided raising his eyes too much.  
The slow way he answered.  
That constant silence that somehow felt heavier than words.  

---

And I thought about something I have learned over time:  

some silences are more concerning than many symptoms.  

---

Because some people arrive speaking quickly out of nervousness, filling empty spaces, trying to control fear through words.  

But others arrive already too exhausted even to explain what they feel.  

---

I do not know exactly when that expression began becoming so common in some patients.  

Maybe it was always there and I simply notice it more now.  

Or perhaps everyday exhaustion accumulates in ways that do not directly appear in clinical tests.  

---

We live in times when many people are tired even before becoming sick.  

Tired of waiting.  
Of solving daily problems.  
Of constantly adapting.  
Of carrying worries for too long.  

And sometimes the body simply becomes the place where all of that finally appears.  

---

During the consultation, I tried speaking to him calmly. Not only about medication or tests, but about how he was truly feeling.  

At first, his answers remained brief.  

But there was one moment when he looked up for a few seconds and said something simple that I still keep thinking about hours later:  

“One gets tired of everything.”  

---

Nothing more.  

Just that.  

And yet that sentence contained far more than it seemed.  

---

Sometimes people do not need long speeches to say they are exhausted.  

Sometimes a small sentence spoken honestly is enough to reveal an enormous weight.  

---

We continued the consultation. I explained the necessary tests, we discussed possible causes and the next steps to follow. He listened silently, nodding slowly from time to time.  

But even after everything ended, I felt that the most important part of that consultation had not only been the physical diagnosis.  

---

Some pains do not begin exactly in the body, even if the body ends up carrying them anyway.  

---

When my shift ended and I left the hospital, I was still thinking about that patient.  

About how some people reach a point where even asking for help feels like too much effort.  

And about how easy it is to normalize emotional exhaustion simply because it has become common.  

---

When I arrived home, Bruno was sleeping on one of my books and Max slowly approached wagging his tail. I sat on the floor for a few minutes while the silence of the house gradually replaced the constant noise of the hospital.  

And I thought that perhaps one of the most important things in medicine is not only learning how to listen to words.  

It is also learning to recognize what people no longer have the strength to say.  

---

Thank you for accompanying me in this seventeenth entry of Isabel’s Notebooks. We continue meeting in pauses, in difficult silences, and in those small human signs that often say more than any medical record ever could.  

The images are from Pixabay and the English translation was done with DeepL Translate.

body.title: Three Songs by the Red Hot Chili Peppers | Music & Natto (Three Tunes Tuesday Edition) [ENG/SPA]
body.body: >\n\nHello, fans of great music. Today, as I do every Tuesday on my Hive Blog, I’m bringing you a special selection of three songs from a band I grew up listening to. A group that, ironically, keeps up the punk vibe I shared with you last week with

>Green Day, but this time with more Funk elements and a beat that’s simply unforgettable. This special section is brought to you thanks to the great weekly event that @ablaze brings us in the Music community called Three Tunes Tuesday. The Rock band we’ll be talking about today is none other than the Red Hot Chili Peppers, a group that has managed to influence an entire generation. Thanks to their unmatched rhythm and exotic, even expressive sound—where they managed to blend Punk with Funk so naturally—this Californian band has remained on every one of my Playlists since I first discovered them when I was just a preteen. This has also earned them millions of streams, along with many other hits throughout their career. It was because of this success that I first discovered them back in the 2000s and 2010s, when I used to watch MTV a lot and see their popular music videos. Later, when I created my own Playlist that I could listen to every day, I was able to choose—from among their dozens and dozens of songs—three that are simply gems worth listening to. I’ll tell you about those songs below, but keep in mind that they aren’t the only ones I consider to be the band’s best, as there are many other songs I’d like to introduce to you as well.

>
Hola, fanáticos de la buena música. Hoy, como todos los martes en mi Blog de Hive, les traigo una selección especial de tres canciones de una banda con la que crecí. Una agrupación que, irónicamente, mantiene el ritmo Punk que les he traído la semana pasada con

>Green Day, pero esta vez con elementos más Funk y un ritmo que es simplemente inolvidable. Esta sección especial es traída a ustedes gracias al gran evento semanal que @ablaze nos trae en la comunidad de Música llamado Three Tunes Tuesday. La banda de Rock de la cual hablaremos hoy es nada más ni nada menos que Red Hot Chili Peppers, una agrupación musical que ha conseguido influir en toda una generación. Gracias a su ritmo inigualable y sonido exótico y hasta expresiva donde consiguieron mezclar el Punk con en Funk de una forma tan natural; esta banda californiana ha conseguido permanecer en cada una de mis Playlists desde que los llegué a conocer cuando apenas era un preadolescente. Esto también les ha traído millones de reproducciones, además de muchos otros éxitos a lo largo de toda su carrera. Debido a dicho éxito que tuvieron fue que los llegué a conocer por allá por los años 2000 y 2010 cuando frecuentaba mucho el canal MTV y veía sus populares videoclips. Luego, al conseguir mi propia Playlist que pude escuchar todos los días fue que conseguí escoger -entre sus decenas y decenas de canciones- tres que son simplemente una joya que valen la pena escuchar. A continuación les hablaré de dichas canciones, pero tomen en cuenta que no son las únicas que considero son las mejores de esta banda, ya que hay muchas otras canciones que me gustaría presentarles también.

> We’re kicking things off by mentioning what is surely the Red Hot Chili Peppers’ most popular and recognizable song since its release back in the late ’90s. “Californication” is the fourth single from the California-based band’s seventh studio album of the same name, which was released in 1999. The song features the band’s signature alternative rhythm, but with a largely variable tempo, shifting from slow to faster at certain points in the song. “Californication” tells us about “the mecca of entertainment”—that’s right, Hollywood and its two sides of the coin. The Red Hot Chili Peppers speak to us about the degrading, superficial, and exuberant reality of life in California, especially in Hollywood. Lines like “psychic spies from China” and “girls from Sweden” make it clear that this world of entertainment is by no means small; quite the opposite, in fact, as it commands the world’s full attention. The song also addresses the bad habits prevalent in this place, such as drugs, absurd cosmetic surgeries, and fornication. The phrase “Dream of Californication,” which we hear frequently in the song, is a notable play on words used by the Red Hot Chili Peppers to refer both to California and to the word “Fornication,” alluding to the moral and social degradation evident in the world of Hollywood. I first heard the song when I was just in middle school and knew almost no English back then. I knew the song itself wasn’t about anything good, since its rhythm and melodies gave me a somewhat negative and turbulent feeling. But I was still quite fascinated by it.

>
Empezamos con todo al mencionarles la que seguramente es la canción más popular y reconocida de Red Hot Chili Peppers desde que fue lanzada por allá por los finales de los años 90. Californication es el cuarto sencillo del séptimo álbum de estudio de la banda californiana que lleva su mismo nombre y que fue lanzado en 1999. La canción maneja un reconocido ritmo alternativo muy común de la banda, pero con un ritmo mayormente variable, pasando de ser lento a algo más acelerado en ciertos momentos de la canción. Californication nos habla de “la meca del entretenimiento”, así es, Hollywood y sus dos lados de la moneda. Red Hot Chili Peppers nos habla de la degradante, superficial y exuberante realidad que se vive en California, especialmente en Hollywood. Frases como “espías psíquicos de China” y “niñas de Suecia” nos dejan claro que este mundo del entretenimiento no es para nada pequeño; todo lo contrario más bien ya que abarca toda la atención del mundo. La canción también nos habla de los malos hábitos que se ven en este lugar, como lo son las drogas, las absurdas operaciones cosméticas y la fornicación. Ya de por sí la frase “Dream of Californication” que escuchamos frecuentemente en la canción es un notable juego de palabras que utilizan Red Hot Chili Peppers para referirse tanto a California como también a la palabra “Fornicación” para referirse a la degradación moral y social que se puede ver en este mundo que es Hollywood. La canción la conocí cuando apenas estaba en secundaria y no sabía casi de inglés en aquel entonces. Sabía que la canción de por sí no hablaba de nada bueno ya que su ritmo y melodías me generaban una sensación un tanto negativa y turbulenta. Pero igualmente me fascinó bastante.

/>

Can’t Stop - Red Hot Chili Peppers

> Let’s talk now about another great song by the Red Hot Chili Peppers—one I used to listen to nonstop every time I got to this part of my Playlist, which had five of their songs on it. It’s a song that stirs up a certain emotion and nostalgia inside me just by hearing its intro and that unforgettable beat. “Can’t Stop” is the third single from their eighth studio album, By the Way (2002). The song features a fascinating blend of Alternative Rock with Punk, Funk, and a touch of Rap. Its music video was one of the ones I watched and listened to most on MTV for as long as I can remember. \

speaks to us of a wild, unbridled spirit that the Red Hot Chili Peppers' lead singer manages to convey through his iconic lyrics. Among the many phrases with metaphors and hidden messages the song contains regarding life, love, and friendships, one phrase in particular catches my attention. The phrase is “choose not a life of imitation,” which refers to the typical human tendency to imitate ourselves, the people we admire, or the “influencers” we follow. Doing this, rather than choosing a slightly more original way of living, is common in today’s society. It also includes lines like “music, the great communicator,” which points to what may be the song’s main message: a message to an entire generation. That message concerns the value or meaning of life, living it to the fullest, without any restrictions or limitations, living each day as if it were your last. The way the melody varies and adapts to the song’s lyrics is fascinating. What stands out most and what I love about “Can’t Stop” is the sound and rhythm of the drums and guitar, something that’s always quite noticeable in almost all of his songs.

>
Hablemos ahora de otra gran canción de Red Hot Chili Peppers, una que escuchaba sin parar cada vez que pasaba por esta parte de mi Playlist con sus cinco canciones que tenía agregadas. Una canción que genera cierta emoción y nostalgia en mi interior con solo escuchar su introducción y su ritmo tan inolvidable. Can't Stop es el tercer sencillo de su octavo álbum de estudio titulado By the Way (2002). La canción tiene una fascinante mezcla de Rock Alternativo con Punk, Funk y algo de Rap incluido. Su videoclip era de los que más veía y escuchaba en MTV desde que tengo memoria. Can't Stop nos habla de un desenfrenado sentido que el cantante de Red Hot Chili Peppers logra transmitirnos con su lírica tan reconocida. Entre las tantas frases con metáforas y mensajes ocultos que tiene la canción con respecto a la vida, el amor y las amistades; me llama la atención una frase en particular. La frase es “choose not a life of imitation”, la cual hace referencia a la típica costumbre que tiene el ser humano de imitarse a sí mismo, imitar a la gente que admiramos o a los “Influencers” que seguimos. Hacer esto, en vez de escoger una forma de vivir un poco más original es común verlo en la sociedad actual. También tiene frases como “music, the great communicator”, refiriéndose así a lo que puede llegar a ser el principal mensaje de esta canción: un mensaje a toda una generación. Dicho mensaje es referente al valor o sentido de la vida, vivirla al máximo, sin ninguna restricción ni limitación, vivir cada día como si fuera el último. La forma en la que la melodía varía y se adapta a la letra de la canción es fascinante. Lo que más resalta y me encanta de Can’t Stop es el sonido y ritmo de la batería y la guitarra, cosa que siempre se nota bastante en casi todas sus canciones.

/>

Dani California - Red Hot Chili Peppers

> We wrap up this little collection of Red Hot Chili Peppers gems with a song that, musically speaking, is an unparalleled audiovisual masterpiece. Ever since I first heard it over ten years ago, I simply haven’t been able to stop listening to it—even more so now that I’ve revisited it after several years away. Dani California is the first single from their ninth studio album, Stadium Arcadium (2006). The song features an unbeatable blend of Alternative Rock, Punk, and Funk—genres that have been part of the band’s unmistakable sound for decades. “Dani California” tells the inspiring yet tragic story of a girl from Mississippi, California, who—according to the song’s lyrics—lived with her father, a police officer, and her mother, a hippie. She runs away from home, where they lived in dire poverty, and travels across the United States, experiencing a myriad of adventures. Lines like “looking down the barrel of a hot metal 45, just another way to survive” make it clear that, among the many things she did, she also had to commit certain crimes in order to survive. With a baby on the way and a “wanted” poster bearing her name, Dani reaches the end of her short life as we come to understand the meaning of the song’s chorus: “California, rest in peace.” Dani California is definitely a great song with a great story and a powerful message that it leaves us with at the end. Sometimes you have to take risks in life to achieve your goals, change the course of things, and leave something behind. But not every experience we have is a good one, even if they teach us something important. What’s fascinating about this song is the perfect blend of Punk and Funk that you hear in every chorus. But the best part of this song, without a doubt, is the duet you hear at the end between the electric guitar and the drums blasting at full volume. It’s definitely pure music to my ears—a song I’ll never get tired of listening to.

>
Finalizamos esta pequeña colección de joyas de Red Hot Chili Peppers con una canción que, musicalmente, es una maravilla audiovisual sin par. Desde que la escuché por primera vez hace más de diez años, simplemente no paré de escucharla, incluso más ahora que he vuelto a escucharla luego de varios años de ausencia. Dani California es el primer sencillo del noveno álbum de estudio titulado Stadium Arcadium (2006). La canción posee una mezcla inmejorable de Rock Alternativo con Punk y Funk, géneros que lograron ser parte del inconfundible sonido de esta banda desde hace décadas atrás. Dani California nos habla de la inspiradora y a la vez trágica historia de una chica de Mississippi, estado California quien -según la propia letra de la canción- vivía con su padre que era policía y su madre que era una hippie. Ella se fuga de casa, donde vivían en un grave estado de pobreza y viaja por todo Estados Unidos, viviendo un sinfín de experiencias. Frases como “looking down the barrel of a hot metal 45, just another way to survive” nos deja claro que, de entre tantas cosas que hizo, también tuvo que cometer ciertos crímenes para poder sobrevivir. Con un bebé en camino y una foto de “se busca” con su nombre, Dani llega al final de su corta vida cuando reconocemos el significado del coro de la canción que reza: “California, rest in peace”. Definitivamente, Dani California es una gran canción con una gran historia y un grandioso mensaje que nos deja al final. A veces hay que arriesgarse en esta vida para poder lograr tus objetivos, cambiar el rumbo de las cosas y dejar algo atrás. Pero no toda experiencia que tenemos es buena, aunque si nos enseñan algo importante. Lo fascinante de esta canción es la mezcla perfecta de Punk con Funk que se escucha en cada coro. Pero lo mejor de esta canción, indiscutiblemente, es el dúo que se escucha al final entre la guitarra eléctrica y la batería a todo volumen. Definitivamente, un completo elixir para mis oídos que jamás en mi vida me cansaré de escuchar.

>
Tell me, are you also familiar with the band Red Hot Chili Peppers? Which of their songs is your favorite? Leave your answer in the comments.
