links.title: Alive & Thriving Goals Monday : Hello June! 🎉|| AATYr7 || Prompt A Day 😊
links.body:
![sad rain.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/AK7xJ1RuwZpXQKfjWfSrtERzzuJiFUeU2uL9ais2B3qSY3cMXQT9eki9CqiJSb9.png)
Good-bye and thank you month of May! So is the hot season over yet? I'm honestly not sure. If I remember correctly, it extended until the whole month of June last year. The first of the month though was welcomed with intermittent rains throughout the day. 🙌 Thanks to the outgoing typhoon #DomengPH that pulled in the southwest monsoon rains. It made the flat livable for the moment. Imagine the room temp went from 36C to 32C. How I wish it stayed less than 30C though. 😒
![mamsy5thdeathanniv.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/23vi1sirLr2B5h8cyq6xzi2XqQB1DdekEBeMNY66QUhKL2quZTkLaXcYqq2pVqHQhevTw.jpg)
First, an update for the weekend that passed. I commemorated Mom's fifth death anniversary with a takeout order from Saturday night. If the meals seem a lot, I'm still enjoying leftovers up to now. 😅 The top right was Mom's favorite -- shrimps with cashew nuts and quail eggs. 😉
![mamsyflowers.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/23xVTXaM4u1fiaiKQRwDdLVyW3RjkJfWpmjUnrqeq3FGoBBEiLC7ZKqKB14SwkV36KSfy.jpg)
I ordered flowers for Mom's vault. Seriously, where did five years go??? 🙄 Can't believe time just flew by quickly. I do not miss her any less. 😔 Life goes on however... and main focus is survival... for now 😆🙏❤️💡 ___ ### Prompt A Day : QUOTE **“No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.” — Aesop** *shoutout to @shadowspub for the daily prompt (subscribe to her newsletter)* IMO, the world today needs more kindness going around. We also need more kind people spreading them. In a way, it makes me glad I grew up in my generation when the world is not so fucked up. 😝 May sound harsh but for me it is true. Plus I do wish more folks would be less materialistic. I think we're doing harm to the planet by having more and more stuff.. some of which we do not really need. Tsk! I do believe in this.. *create a life that feels good on the inside, not just one that looks good on the outside.* 😉
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/RyEGHZNaoBQAAAAC/cliphy-kindness.gif)
--- ### Hive Goals Here are the updated figures for the week: Hive Power: 15938.389 --> 15970.554 HBD Savings: 222.853 --> same Alive Power: 350.071 (liquid); staked 52.1K; 23K delegated --> 400.385 (liquid); staked 52.2K; 23K delegated STARBITS: 3380634 (game on hiatus) LEN:LENM = 113.232 --> 113.973 ALIVE:ALIVEM = 1007.183 --> 1009.082 ALIVE:SWAP.HIVE = 275.118 --> 282.218 ALIVE:HEARTBEAT = 1373.533 --> 1640.465
One sad news I got for the week is Rising Star game going on a break for now as it awaits what's coming next for the game. It's one game that I played from the beginning. I don't know what Blockchain Gaming is so... wait and see I suppose. On the Hive front, I managed to grow slowly for another week. Next target : 16K HP, 300 HBD. AP target was reached last week but I will continue my staking weekly. Plus add a little growth to my few diesel pools. 😉 That's it for the tracking this week. See you for the next one 👋 ___
![happy june.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/AKDgFUMbYLJRmaRS6dt4Ne6uxsJdimLUp37rFCnSByP9XG6V25pLJWuX9BeE4Ak.png)
Hey, it's my birthday month! Stay tuned for some happenings soon. Right now I'm just filling in the days with tasks that need to be accomplished. Seriously, what's with today?? I've been packed with interruptions here and there that this post took too long to complete. 😅 Oh well, that's just day two...
![fafycredits.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/23yJdpqWttXUc4QMgc65YAuDyiKCYNdQ56Ja1oizsiUXWuME2dimuEfUtR4Jn1uPXMxjx.jpg)
Completed another month on FAFY so I got bonus credits for promoting my LL coop link. I hope that brings in more earnings too. I'd need that as I might go on some vacation soon.

Completed another month on TAB too. I seriously need to fix some tech stuff soonest. I've been meaning to fix it but don't know where to start. UGH! **Below are the affiliate sites I actively work on daily.** ___

links.title: Had a moment of realization about a drunk idiot friend
links.body:
She's been my friend for years and I have well, kind of enjoyed her company for the amount of time that I have known her but it was over the weekend that she got in touch with me to tell me that she was going down to the beach and the place she was headed to is one of the places that I actually like going to because it is far enough away from hotels that it isn't completely overrun with tourists. We all know that it is much easier to just stay at home in the air con, particularly when it is a billions degrees outside like it is now but I like to be a good friend and said I would go and meet her. It wasn't easy to get to her though and I could sense that something was not right from the start because she wasn't typing messages anymore, she was trying to call me and sending voice clips, which I don't really like. Sorry/not sorry but I am one of those people that feels as though there really isn't very many good reasons to ever call someone these days. Anyway, it was pretty evident to me when I got the voice clip that she was already drunk and this was surprising to me because it was 2 o'clock in the afternoon.
https://www.shutterstock.com/image-vector/cheerful-drunk-beautiful-woman-party-600nw-2446194951.jpg [src](https://www.shutterstock.com/image-vector/cheerful-drunk-beautiful-woman-party-600nw-2446194951.jpg)
I was still going to follow up on my plan to go and meet up with her but this wasn't going to be easy because I couldn't make any sense of the voice messages that she sent to me... neither could the transcribing feature on whatsapp that I believe is powered by AI and is probably better than I am at understanding drunk-ass.

>
</center>

If that looks like a bunch of nonsense trust me, the reality is much worse than that.   When the transcribe feature, that is versed in all languages and accents, can't make heads or tails of what you are saying.   You are not understandable.  

I kind of knew the general area that she was going to and there is a coffeeshop that I like there and used to take Nadi to before dogs were banned there so I figured that the worst case scenario was that I would get there, have a coffee, have a walk on the sand, then go back home.

I was drinking my coffee when the call came in and even though I was sitting less than 50 meters from where she was, she couldn't figure out where I was.  I could see her, I told her to turn around, was waving my arms, and she still couldn't see me.   

I could tell even from that distance that she was sloppy drunk.   

If you don't get drunk all the time let me tell you what sloppy drunk means. 

* you are loud
* you laugh, or more like cackle, at your own unfunny jokes
* you are aggressive and tend to interrupt others
* you think you are being suave or charming or funny but you are really just annoying
* people tend to avoid you
* you are seriously sensitive while also being quite mean to others 

She was all of these things but I am no punk so I went down there to talk to her anyway.  It wasn't much of a talk because she was indecipherable for the most part.  I had to ask her to repeat herself over and over again and then she started to get frustrated and accuse me of having bad hearing.  That's another aspect of being \

you get emotional and insulted rather easily even though it is you that is being insulting.  

I also noticed that she was kind of harassing this younger couple that was nearby and I could tell that she thought she was being smooth (she wasn't) and I could also tell that they really just wanted her to leave them alone.   They would end up moving to some other chairs before I left as well.   

Take a hint lady, why don't ya?  

This is a beach city and she was on the beach wearing a bikini.  This is something else that was well, kind of gross.  The years of alcohol abuse have taken its toll on her and her skinny fat belly which probably hasn't seen a situp in a decade just looked disgusting.  She was completely shameless about it though.   

I didn't bother to bring up any of this at the time though because I knew that it would just spiral out of control and she would get loud and abusive.   

I didn't last for very long.  I made up an excuse that was a lie about meeting some other people somewhere else and how I was already a few minutes later and needed to get going.  I had no plans.. I just didn't want to be there anymore.  It was embarrassing to be near this obnoxious woman who was about to fall out of her ill-fitting swimwear at any moment.  There was absolutely nothing attractive about it either.  This lady is in her 40's and behaves like she is a 22 year old on Spring Break.  

I would later pop her a message saying \

I'm no saint when it comes to alcohol but I am never like this.   I can sense when I am losing the ability to speak and if I ever catch myself being loud even by accident I take stock of the situation and normally will leave.  

I had noticed that this woman doesn't really have a lot of friends anymore and I don't think she is very happy either.  I just don't know if anyone can do anything for her because the booze has completely taken control of her... I think this is true of anyone that manages to be that smashed just after noon time.   

I think I will approach her about this some weekday when she is sober but I am sure it will be met with defensiveness.  She will probably try to accuse me of being a drunk as well or judging her or whatever.  

What do you think?  Should i just leave it alone?  Should I say \

should I intervene.  

Like I said, I am no stranger to booze.  I am a borderline alcoholic myself but this woman, she is well over the border already.  I'm just amazed that she hasn't managed to destroy her worklife, she must just stay at home during the week and never go and do anything.  At the moment she has one of the best and high-paying jobs in Da Nang but if her bosses were to ever see her like this, especially on a work night, I think that could quickly change.  

Some people just shouldn't drink.  once you are no longer fun \
perhaps it is time to put the sauce down.

links.title: Decorated letter \
(Esp/Eng)
links.body: > [Esp] ¡Saludos comunidad! Este modo artístico ha sido terapéutico para mí, no es solo expresar mi creatividad dibujando es tambien relajar la mente, el cuerpo y en el último proceso de revelar la letra, es mi parte favorita pues me divierte ver lo que reveló todo ese trabajo sobre el lienzo. Es una letra C a la que se me ocurrió dedicársela al nombre de Caroline... Cuando trabajo con mi carpeta de color negro es un poco más difícil dibujar, quiero dominar este elemento, ya que con el lienzo blanco tengo más oportunidad de dibujar y hacer otras cosas. Lo que más procuro es: Disfrutar del proceso. Espero te guste.

> [Eng] Hello everyone! This artistic process has been therapeutic for me; it’s not just about expressing my creativity through drawing, but also about relaxing my mind and body. The final stage of revealing the lettering is my favourite part, as I really enjoy seeing what all that work on the canvas has brought to light. It’s the letter C, which I decided to dedicate to the name Caroline... When I work with my black sketchbook, it’s a bit harder to draw; I want to master this medium, as with a white canvas I have more scope to draw and do other things. What I strive for most is: to enjoy the process. I hope you like it. ---

> [Esp] Había dibujado el boceto de la letra con un color amarillo, sin embargo a ponerle la cinta ya no pude ver la línea guía por lo que lo hice de nuevo, pegué la cinta de enmascarar haciendo la forma de la letra y luego corté la forma con un cutter. Luego comencé a dibujar las flores pintarlas, no importa si sobre pasa la cinta de enmascarar, es la idea.

> [Eng] I had sketched out the outline of the letter in yellow, but when I went to apply the tape, I couldn’t see the guide line anymore, so I did it all over again. I stuck the masking tape down to form the shape of the letter and then cut out the shape with a craft knife. Then I started drawing the flowers and painting them; it doesn’t matter if the paint goes over the masking tape – that’s the idea.
---

No pude grabarme por temas de servicio eléctrico pero, este dibujo me ayudó a pasar las horas calurosas en la ausencia de la electricidad. Espero se animen a practicar actividades relacionadas con el arte que les ayude a relajarse cuando se sientan estresados. Es una buena terapia.

> [Eng] I add dark areas to simulate shadows. The reveal... Peeling off the tape is quite satisfying. It reminds me of the videos I used to make for visual satisfaction. I couldn’t film myself due to power cuts, but this drawing helped me pass the time during the hot hours without electricity. I hope you’ll be inspired to try art-related activities that help you relax when you’re feeling stressed. It’s good therapy. ---

links.body:
>
Deliciosos helados en 3D🍦 Días atrás con deseos de comer helados; bueno se dio la oportunidad en nuestro viaje a la ciudad de Lecheria; visitamos la heladeria 4D recomendada por un amigo.
Delicious 3D Ice Cream 🍦 A few days ago, I was craving ice cream; well, the opportunity arose during our trip to the city of Lecheria. We visited the 4D ice cream shop recommended by a friend.

>
La heladeria es amplia; es un sitio agradable para venir a compartir un momento diferente.
The ice cream shop is spacious; it's a pleasant place to come and share a different kind of moment

>
Aquí entre muchos sabores; elegimos chocolate con Nutella; realmente estos helados son deliciosos.
Among many flavors, we chose chocolate with Nutella; these ice creams are truly delicious.

>
Estaba sabroso y cremoso / It was tasty and creamy
---

>
Ordenamos nuestro sabor favorito de helados: chocolate; mientras comiamos y conversamos sobre nuestro viaje y que haríamos el siguiente día; igualmente esperamos a nuestro amigo con su familia; también andaban de paseo como nosotros. Sin duda fue una excelente idea venir a comer helados en 4D. GRACIAS POR LEER.
We ordered our favorite ice cream flavor: chocolate. While we ate, we chatted about our trip and what we would do the next day. We also waited for our friend and his family, who were out for a stroll like us. It was definitely a great idea to come and eat ice cream at 4D. THANKS FOR READING.

>

links.title: Ayam Geprek Keprabon with Besties
links.body:
>Hello, foodies…


It turns out there’s a new, delicious restaurant near where I live that’s really taking off. So, we’d just come from the hospital to visit a friend from my community who was ill. After that, my friends and I were starving and tried to find somewhere to eat. At first, we were going to eat in Pamulang, where we usually go. 

But because of the terrible traffic and the fact that we were absolutely starving, I finally mentioned that I was curious about Ayam Geprek Keprabon. Do you know what their reaction was? They were absolutely on board and immediately responded cheerfully: Devina, Adang and Kaifin really love Ayam Geprek Keprabon. So we ended up at the Ayam Geprek Keprabon branch at UIN Syarif Hidayatullah. 

----


![IMG20260326194937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23uFPYcs8TMxEkmANQd8ixN9bdpXTBJapDYFn5aaLajdC2Gygr5ihYahFW4qCNJe3xztC.jpg)

---

We ordered a few different dishes: the boys each ordered the Jumbo Geprek, whilst the rest of us ordered the standard-sized Geprek. I ordered the standard-sized grilled Geprek. As for drinks, some ordered sweet iced tea and others ordered unsweetened iced tea, whilst I ordered an iced Americano. 

---


![IMG20260326195255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23tmS6Hv4W72PTUnFZUyTTigHtVYVtkUxXQjmHc39CB8r1xeuwTAZAjHR4U42Lj2XprWQ.jpg)

![IMG20260326195252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23tHLvRuTD2TGKpFW92AL5fmSP354zsniVJ4kuoTNxSL4LhPRdpkinrhrg7Uh7QGAKPjW.jpg)

---

Although this UIN branch isn’t very spacious—perhaps because it’s an express branch dominated by online orders—I still found dining here quite comfortable. There are a few tables and chairs for those who wish to dine in, like us. That evening, our order took a while to arrive because I could see there was already a long queue of people ordering for takeaway and online. However, we were patient; whilst waiting, we chatted and asked each other questions. We talked and shared stories about all sorts of things. We’re always like that. Even though we’re sometimes busy with our own activities, once we meet up, we can really spend time together. 

---

![IMG20260326195304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23zGgjX8bs7pT6fxH4DhDdebhUFZem3epXfCCCARC7EQ7k6Qgcuq95mFYgf5L6MbNkayT.jpg)

![IMG20260326195054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23xL2nm95TAo9mJJ4ysNxGVG2uTxeMrjp92jEH6RPyHhPekftxwErr6ym1YU1iRiryxGc.jpg)


---

Before we knew it, our orders started arriving one by one. I noticed the original Geprek dish. The chicken was pounded until it was very fine, almost like shredded chicken, but it wasn’t. It had indeed been pounded in a mortar. When I tasted my friend’s portion, seriously, it was delicious. The chicken was already seasoned, and with their sambal served in a separate container—it was incredibly spicy and absolutely delicious. 

---


![IMG20260326203919.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23vsZ4WBzLPzZg9LaJAnbjqSpVFHB8CZktXWpAKQnKJR6CSVHNqoobCzfXtQ67m21BpQs.jpg)

![IMG20260326203916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23xAiDXP117gCbpWbm9EgQjPThid3dmee9s17kFEFa7NipUr84MKsxfBL8gZn3UTTdCCS.jpg)


---

You know what? My order arrived last. Perhaps because mine was the grilled Geprek chicken, so the grilling process took a while. But I was patient because, you know, once my order arrived, it turned out to be absolutely delicious. The chicken, although a fillet, was tender and juicy. Especially as it was grilled, so there was an added smoky aroma. Unlike the original version served as pounded chicken, mine wasn’t like that. Mine looked more like a standard pressed chicken dish. And there was no sambal. Why? Is this menu discrimination? Of course not—mine didn’t have sambal because I’d ordered it at the spiciest level. So I enjoyed that portion of Ayam Geprek Keprabon with great pleasure and relish. 

----

![IMG20260326203927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23yToaFnw4g9XdJ7nUMfPgvsy8qbMy6139ywfYcDXaJFNeEDPmkfZfC1ZaGxcRkTsNq5a.jpg)

![IMG20260326203953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23vsYuNAUW4W4up6oieFhF2EW4ekuAhpc8WSUnZ4eXcLovUVkmKaBfaKQk88q3RW4Zkbg.jpg)

![IMG20260326203929.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/243fxmupwbgwGEJYb4jozpg2Kaw1Esu3FQo3fN6RD5CxnJBTvuzwgxddwugZRXVkdSYm9.jpg)

![IMG20260326202128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23yd8NPe35dN3mwPaJ2P98VSCwdGeQL1JwW5diiwGty7Prg7jFf5owMA2848ckZUuaZzp.jpg)


---

And so we spent that evening together with friends and a portion of Ayam Geprek Keprabon… thank you for reading my post. See you soon.


---

![IMG-20260326-WA0092.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23yTjj6BQi7uL4oggVtgsttuYvbFrJK9nbeyRxuzmBRh2YxrruWwUQBUpuA59ECUh1s4D.jpg)

![IMG-20260326-WA0075.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23x1Dbc25BajREcDbxafzmDwc3mcHHzWX67kYNf1ySG6UsA5zU3nGWhKNfoURe8M35Z1t.jpg)


---

I want to be a novelist, but my works are only short poems that are included in anthology books. please share my content if you feel my content is good for everyone to read. Thank you. Let's be friends!

links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![qWElul33GNLvYXvX_MEITU_20260502_173956933.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/qWElul33GNLvYXvX_MEITU_20260502_173956933/qWElul33GNLvYXvX_MEITU_20260502_173956933.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

整个5月份，我围绕着“萝卜塔”拍拍棒，或者叫拍拍掌，这一类做了各种形势的创新。

把我能想到的各种形状，都做成了“拍拍棒”的样子。

最近有一个用户在我的小红书给我留言，她打印了很多星星造型的拍拍棒，5元一个在六一儿童节这天去售卖。说挺受学生喜欢的。

星星棒火了，现在火成了一些人的“摆摊货”了。

然后，最近这个“梅花”花瓣造型的，也突破1K了，跟星星棒，其实算是同一类型的。

然后，我MakerWorld网上也看了下，好像没有这个门类的，我算是开创了一个新的玩法。

这个5月份给我的感受就是，一方面感觉很幸运，只要一直努力，一直“出摊”，幸运是可以提高概率的。另外一反面也感受到，从0~100很难，走过那么艰难后，从100~500好像比较容易，而从500~1000其实很快。

我那个星星棒的，从1K现在到2.8K了，就是很快达到的。突破了某个临界值，剩下的都是趋势。

幸运如此，不幸的是，我似乎再想不出来更多“萝卜塔”的造型了，灵感要枯竭了~~~

---

links.body:
![1000012958.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sinistry/23wMh6zXUZE3VGxRcT2XXj5yGYNvo1BUKEFy6MW54uqJm81PT79tXCFNmBA9V5nZMjiCK.png)



The argument for treating consensual human taxidermy as a legitimate, inheritable financial asset rests on two foundational pillars: **absolute bodily autonomy** and **unlocked generational wealth**.
If an individual has the legal right to dictate the distribution of their liquid wealth, the donation of their organs, or the scattering of their ashes, they should logically possess the right to convert their physical remains into a preserved, high-value artistic or historical artifact. By legally reclassifying a masterfully preserved human body from \

a person can transform their physical vessel into a tangible economic engine for their descendants.
In a mature market, an expertly taxidermied individual—especially one preserved within a specific aesthetic tradition, like intricate steampunk biomechanics or classical renaissance poses—becomes a scarce, irreplaceable historical artifact. Over generations, the appreciation value of such an artifact can far outpace traditional equities, turning a post-mortem choice into a profound act of familial preservation and financial legacy.
## Case Studies: Generational Wealth Unleashed
The following *case studies* illustrate how the strategic sale of taxidermied ancestors radically altered the financial trajectories of their families.
### 1. The Living Loom: Alistair Vance
 * **The Artifact:** Alistair Vance, a visionary master watchmaker, left instructions to be taxidermied in a seated position at his original 19th-century workbench, with his own skeletal hands meticulously retrofitted with polished silver gears and clockwork mechanisms.
 * **The Transaction:** Two generations later, the Vance family faced severe financial hardship due to shifting industrial markets. Alistair’s granddaughter, Clara, put the piece up for auction through a high-end antiquarian house specializing in eccentric mechanical art.
 * **The Outcome:** A decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) focused on preserving horological history purchased the piece for **$3.2 million**. The liquid capital allowed Clara to clear all ancestral debt, purchase a commercial property outright, and establish a permanent trust fund that fully covers the college tuition for Alistair's great-great-grandchildren.
### 2. The Living Historical Archive: Commander Helena Vance-Ross
 * **The Artifact:** Commander Vance-Ross was a pioneer in deep-sea saturation diving and marine archaeology. She consented to be preserved in her vintage, brass-heavy atmospheric diving suit from her historic 2038 trench expedition, maintaining a stark, commanding standing posture.
 * **The Transaction:** Sold by her son to a private oceanic museum and research institute seeking an authentic, iconic centerpiece for their permanent historical pavilion.
 * **The Outcome:** The sale fetched **$1.8 million** alongside a 5% secondary-sale royalty clause embedded in the smart-contract bill of sale. This capital injection allowed her son to break the cycle of predatory renting, purchase a homestead, and self-fund his own independent engineering firm.
### 3. The Avant-Garde Heirloom: Silas \

Thorne
 * **The Artifact:** Silas Thorne, an eccentric philosopher and patron of the dark-metallic aesthetic, spent his final years collaborating with an avant-garde sculptor. Post-mortem, he was preserved with obsidian-polymer coated skin, integrated with intricate filigree ironwork wings, posing as a stylized gothic guardian.
 * **The Transaction:** Kept privately in the family estate for forty years until a major modern art museum launched a retrospective on mid-century neo-gothic movements.
 * **The Outcome:** The bidding war between private collectors and the museum drove the final price to **$5.4 million**. The Thorne family utilized the windfall to establish a localized venture capital fund, investing in community-level manufacturing and tech start-ups, transforming their family into prominent regional philanthropists.
> **The Legal Reality Check:** While current frameworks largely treat human remains under strict sanitary and public decency laws, the evolution of property law toward absolute expressive conduct suggests that a structured, consensual framework could easily treat these artifacts with the same rigorous provenance and deed tracking used for high-value real estate or fine art.

links.title: Silver on a bed of iceSilver hilsa on a bed of ice.
links.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfLjikPmTyue3uPRGRzHokRher9wk3TudVs2rXFVDKGGr/1780372419243.jpg) There are thirteen festivals in the twelve months of Bengali calendar, and if there is any fish at the center of those festivals, it is undoubtedly our national fish, Hilsa. Buying Hilsa is not just a simple market activity. This is a true Bengali festival and emotion. Today, when I went to the market, I encountered a similar experience, which I couldn't help but capture in the camera frame. The silvery, sparkling hilsa that you see in the picture are covered in ice. These are the biggest achievements of my market today. As soon as I entered the market, the familiar and captivating aroma of hilsa hit my nose. The joy of going to the fish market during the hilsa season is different. All around, there is only the shouting of sellers and the bargaining of buyers. Crowds overflowing at each fish shop. Everyone's eyes are on the shiny silver hilsa. Identifying good hilsa and buying it at the right price is quite an art. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSzwBzxqWWhMF4UHceBKHFaE2faRAjHmt1k2ombQiRQbZ/1780372419436.jpg) After much searching, I went to a fishmonger and my eyes fell upon a shiny, fresh hilsa fish, just as you can see in the picture, lying on a bed of white ice, piled on blue polythene. The silvery body of the hilsa seemed to stand out among the ice cubes. We haggled with the seller for a while. Half of the joy of buying hilsa for Bengalis lies in this haggling. Finally, I packed a bag of hilsa to my heart's content. The feeling of returning home with hilsa in my hand is different. It feels like I'm returning home victorious from a battle. Everyone's faces were wide with smiles as they stepped into the house. Now all they had to do was decide whether they wanted to have a light, black cumin-green chili-infused soup or a mustard-based hilsa paturi for lunch. The taste and smell of hilsa can instantly transform any ordinary day into a festive one. This is the true happiness of Bengalis.

links.title: (🇪🇸/🇬🇧) Cuando el Paraíso 🌴se vuelve un Infierno 🔥/Capítulo 6 | When Paradise 🌴 Turns into Hell 🔥/Chapter 6
links.body:
​![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWZia4btc3dnzPSJJCzfyp6aKkzrvEfaAdq3m9w5i9aZ/1780037115055.png)
<center>_Portada_</center>
<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>
___

‎
‎Iba a la Iglesia frecuentemente para aliviar la incomodidad de vivir con mi familia. 
‎
‎¿Quién lo diría no? Prefería estar en otro sitio que con mi propia familia. 
‎
‎El mundo al revés.
‎
‎
‎
‎En la Iglesia donde asistía conocí a Keiber: un chico alegre y servicial. Era dos años menor que yo, así que podía ser mi hermano menor fácilmente. Rápidamente empatizamos porque conectábamos en puntos de vista y expectativas comunes. Pronto andábamos juntos para todas partes. 
‎
‎Era un jovencito muy devoto y entregado a su fe. Compartíamos experiencias, leíamos la biblia y conversábamos por largo rato sobre nuestras percepciones y lecciones extraídas.

___

<center>![px-downloadgf6264662e8b0e4f5d392e44c95c77845d721a96f1b3ab7a05d28f559b13c66111a71bbad6f9cad989b0747144ea4875fe874e81c91db6e851d867be9bb805c1667429c0e9f8dbc3fe0b9bd9404172a69_640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcWyTtwmCEynv2qFUgHtRRLA1ZcCQjL4vQvSbh4cC9cQz/px-downloadgf6264662e8b0e4f5d392e44c95c77845d721a96f1b3ab7a05d28f559b13c66111a71bbad6f9cad989b0747144ea4875fe874e81c91db6e851d867be9bb805c1667429c0e9f8dbc3fe0b9bd9404172a69_640.jpg)</center>
<center>*Fotografía de [doungtepro](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/las-manos-orando-adoraci%C3%B3n-creencia-5441201/) en Pixabay*</center>
___

 Entre una conversación y otra le conté lo que me sucedía con mi familia. 
‎
‎–*La verdad no encuentro qué hacer, Keiber* –le confesé– *Regresar con mis padres no es una opción. Aquí en La Guaira hay oportunidades que allá no existen. Pero el único lugar que tengo para vivir es con mi familia y la verdad lo que gano no me alcanza para pagar un alquiler y mantenerme a la vez.* 
‎
‎Él me escuchó atentamente con la expresión de quien medita seriamente en el asunto. Al cabo de un momento, me preguntó:
‎
‎–*¿Qué te parece si te vienes a vivir a mi casa?*
‎
‎–*Había considerado seriamente proponértelo* –le confirmé.
‎
‎<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>
‎
‎Unos años antes sus padres se habían divorciado y cada quien siguió su camino. Su padre volvió a enredarse con otra mujer y su madre se fue del país por una oportunidad única que no desaprovechó. La casa donde vivían antes del divorcio habían decidido dejársela a Keiber como herencia. Luego él se puso a vivir con una concubina –antes de ser evangélico– que le dió una hija poco después. 
‎
‎Andando el tiempo –previo a conocerme a mí– los problemas no tardaron en aparecer. Las diferencias, la falta de comunicación, asuntos no resueltos... en fin, un cúmulo de cosas que fueron acumulándose hasta que la chica no aguantó más y decidió devolverse con sus padres, pero llevando consigo a la hija que tuvo con Keiber. 
‎
‎Desde aquel momento él vivía solo. Era una casa espaciosa de varias habitaciones y casi no paraba en ella. Prefería pasar el día con su papá y, con cierta incomodidad, con su madrastra, pero ¿qué otra opción tenía? No le gustaba vivir solo. A fin de cuentas, algo de compañía le vendría bien. 
‎
‎
‎Después de aquella conversación donde arreglamos mi mudanza, volví a la casa, empaqué mis cosas y las trasladé a la suya. 
‎
‎
‎El movimiento de maletas despertó la curiosidad de mis tíos que fingieron sorpresa y honda tristeza mientras me preguntaban por qué me iba. No dejaban de sorprenderme con su irónica hipocresía. Recuerdo cuando me dijeron: 
‎
‎\

, me dije a mí mismo.

___

<center>![px-downloadga53e104d01bde652d6f0e9a502bcce828e1d223cc0367cc646aa86446be9aa0a4e90aef86f884705bce2f6a633c45c0309ee393d3409ca60c429b6ad198e7e0d0825435dca7212e5d5ec4352b5946e99_640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmREjh7wJKXcjPZNFyp5VYvbySmhavhksXVD5jsjMgDgKb/px-downloadga53e104d01bde652d6f0e9a502bcce828e1d223cc0367cc646aa86446be9aa0a4e90aef86f884705bce2f6a633c45c0309ee393d3409ca60c429b6ad198e7e0d0825435dca7212e5d5ec4352b5946e99_640.jpg)</center>
<center>*Fotografía de [wall_172619](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/viajar-atuendo-ropa-equipaje-4208389/)en Pixabay*</center>
___

‎
‎En la víspera de aquellos días pasaron dos cosas que colmaron la medida de mi paciencia por completo. 
‎
‎No recuerdo exactamente por qué, pero una de mis tías cargaba una rabieta encima –*no por mi causa*– y en un intercambio de palabras empezó a gritarme. Yo le pedí que bajara la voz, no había necesidad, y se alteró más. Le dije que el respeto es algo que se gana y eso bastó para hacerla explotar. 
‎
‎En su opinión, yo tenía que respetarla así ella hiciera lo que hiciera: así me gritara o me ofendiera, tenía que respetarla. Mis padres me habían enseñado una cosa muy diferente: un sentido equilibrado del juicio. Pero el resto de mi familia opinaba otra cosa. Para ellos bastaba con solo ser tíos –o abuelo– para llevar el respeto pegado en la frente como una etiqueta y exigirlo a diestra y siniestra sin hacer absolutamente nada para ganárselo. ¡Qué maravilla!
‎
‎El otro desacierto que me empujó a salir de allí más rápido, fue una ocasión en la que mi tío Noé hizo comida y repartió, menos a mí. 
‎
‎\

, pensé.\n‎\n‎El asunto no es que no me diera de comer, de hecho ninguno de ellos tenía la obligación de alimentarme, pues para eso tenía un empleo. El punto es que yo aportaba para la alacena de la casa, para todos, de mi bolsillo. Eso no me pesaba la verdad. Hacía mercado y colocaba las compras en el mismo escaparate donde estaba la comida de todos. De modo que no tenía exclusividad, no era como que \

. Todos comíamos del mismo plato y me parecía un trato justo. 
‎
‎La cosa es que Noé era un individuo especial: él sí sustraía de la alacena de la casa, preparaba y comía. Pero sus propias compras de mercado las guardaba bajo llave en su habitación.
‎
<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>
‎
‎
‎Cuando me mudé con Keiber transcurría diciembre de 2013 y se aproximaban las fiestas de Navidad y Año Nuevo. En ese tiempo todavía trabajaba en el Aeropuerto Internacional de Maiquetía y la rutina estaba comenzando a hastiarme porque no me permitía un horario estable durante la semana para estudiar, que era una de mis metas a corto plazo.
‎
‎La dinámica de trabajo era un desastre: laboraba cuatro días y descansaba dos. Pero cuatro días en la mañana (de 5:00 am a 1:00 pm) y los siguientes cuatro días en la tarde (de 1:00 pm a 9:00pm) o hasta que saliera el último vuelo programado que casi siempre se retrasaba alrededor de una hora o dos. Un completo desastre. 
‎
‎No tenía la más mínima intención de quedarme en ese trabajo mucho tiempo. Resolví cambiar de empleo antes de Año Nuevo.
‎___

<center>![px-downloadg8e183e2d416c1a95e4ece74cc7119dff16c22b7299f7448e2e81b9e08ce8ac50027f5a5419b5a2460ee25a2e0b88efff7d9d4c10fb40454e03897d37c2c101ac61e57dd7f51aaab08ce2a88346da5529_640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVLvYwcnJ3LwgxorQiHdDM5NcNWWR7euv5rFh6mbPAx2W/px-downloadg8e183e2d416c1a95e4ece74cc7119dff16c22b7299f7448e2e81b9e08ce8ac50027f5a5419b5a2460ee25a2e0b88efff7d9d4c10fb40454e03897d37c2c101ac61e57dd7f51aaab08ce2a88346da5529_640.jpg)</center>
<center>*Fotografía de [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/aeropuerto-aeronave-salida-viaje-1105980/)*</center>

‎
‎
‎Después de mudarme sentí que había recuperado mi tranquilidad. O eso creí. 
‎
‎Comencé a asistir con regularidad a los servicios en la iglesia y a participar activamente. Allí conocí personas de una calidad humana increíble. Nos reuníamos en un local propiedad de una de las mujeres que se reunía también allí, y que lo había habilitado para ese propósito. 
‎
‎De inmediato hice buenas amistades. Tanto la dueña del local como Keiber, otras dos vecinas evangélicas que vivían cerca y yo, solíamos encontrarnos todas las tardes para orar, leer la Biblia y procurar la hermandad. Pronto hicimos como grupo vínculos muy fuertes. 
‎
‎Con el pasar del tiempo comencé a notar fracturas e incongruencias. La pastora solía mostrar actitudes y comportamientos muy cuestionables: arrogancia, intransigencia, absolutismo y una particular tendencia a controlar las decisiones de los feligreses a través de la sugestión. Era muy hábil manipulando.   
‎
‎Además observé muchas contradicciones e interpretaciones equivocadas de las enseñanzas que impartía, y así las alarmas comenzaron a sonar en mi cabeza. Compartí algunas de mis impresiones con Keiber quien también me comentó haber ocultado mucho tiempo ciertos desacuerdos por miedo. Con las otras mujeres pasaba lo mismo. 
‎
Supe que tiempo atrás, cuando quisieron manifestarle sus incomodidades a la pastora por las mismas cosas que yo había notado, solía intimidarlos con absurdas amenazas como:
‎
‎\

\n‎\n‎Era una mujer altanera y soberbia. En más de una ocasión quiso lucirse conmigo pero yo solo evité enredar más el asunto haciéndome el loco. Lo más sorprendente de todo, es que aunque los feligreses estaban descontentos y emocionalmente oprimidos por su carácter y su rigidez, lo que ella decía, eso era \

. 
‎
‎Solía basarse mucho en supuestas visiones y presuntas revelaciones que sustituían por completo la enseñanza de las Escrituras. Técnicamente, para ella la revelación tenía más peso que la enseñanza. Allí sí percibo peligro porque la Biblia dice todo lo contrario. Pero en fin. 
‎
‎Dejé de asistir a los servicios poco a poco. Ella lo notó y de inmediato inició una cruzada de desprestigio. 
‎
‎Por Keiber me enteré que comenzó a decir una sarta de barbaridades mediante supuestas revelaciones donde \

le mostraba que yo estaba siendo un instrumento del maligno para  desviar a los fieles y desmotivarlos de ir a la iglesia. ¡Bah!
‎
‎Le dije:
‎
‎—*Lo que falta es que un día aparezca diciendo que \

le mostró que yo soy el anticristo.*
‎
‎La lógica señalaba que ella se dio cuenta que sus hechizos no me intimidaban y temía que otros abrieran los ojos. Era una persona enferma de poder, le gratificaba la sensación de controlar a los demás a través de su religión. 
‎
‎
‎En el entretiempo, pasaron las fiestas de Navidad y Año Nuevo, llegó el 2014 y tras analizar y buscar consejo en la Biblia sobre mi situación en relación a ese lugar, rápidamente encontré las respuestas y dejé de asistir definitivamente. 
‎
‎Un día supe por Keiber que esa tarde tendrían una reunión especial en la iglesia y que él iría. Llegó la noche y tardó en regresar. Cuando por fin apareció lo hizo tocando la puerta como si lo vinieran persiguiendo. Abrí y noté que traía una expresión desencajada, como furioso. Supuse que algo le había pasado en aquella reunión. 
‎
‎Alterado, con la mirada extraviada y sudando me dijo: 
‎
‎—*Necesito que te vayas de mi casa.* 
‎
‎Quedé en modo piloto automático congelado. 
‎
‎—*Ya va, ¿qué?* —le pregunté sorprendido. 
‎
‎De inmediato comprendí. La pastorcita le había lavado el cerebro, bueno, a todos. Poco después confirmé que aquella reunión era para contarles a los fieles \

sobre mí donde le mostraba que debía tomar medidas por mi frialdad. 
‎
‎Desde aquel día quedé condenado al ostracismo absoluto. Todas las amistades que hice allí se fueron al retrete. Si me veían, bajaban la cabeza y hacían como que no me conocían. Keiber me dio una semana para irme. Así de sencillo. Sin esconder nada, eso fue lo que sucedió. 
‎
‎Me senté en una silla y respiré profundo. Solo cuatro meses después de haber llegado allí, ya me estaban corriendo como a un hereje por el imperdonable pecado de no doblegarme al miedo, no regalar mi conciencia y tener criterio propio. 
‎
‎Con la mente en blanco y la cara apoyada entre las manos con los codos sobre las piernas, solo tenía lugar para una cosa: 
‎
‎—*¿Y ahora para dónde me voy?* —susurré.
‎
___

</center>![px-downloadg032a8849d60a842a318b88b2be0fe10254cc739c96865c223aeb8ea9e322663c9375341d81deab706a5346643f19aa25e22128ce36c8f1dc8e70910b4b116233224ac98b14429437a1cdd6aba9dfb77b_640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZsTFCqfoBa1wbiPwRtz3yuoKcSEdmhFfBvKNW3Eq5nTu/px-downloadg032a8849d60a842a318b88b2be0fe10254cc739c96865c223aeb8ea9e322663c9375341d81deab706a5346643f19aa25e22128ce36c8f1dc8e70910b4b116233224ac98b14429437a1cdd6aba9dfb77b_640.jpg)</center>
<center>*Fotografía de [StockSnap](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/chico-hombre-gente-oscuro-sombra-2617866/) en Pixabay*</center>

___

![Versión en Español_20260510_140151_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZXfCucYNgi4CPCSufsmqZKeQuYWT5pC9RNrcDHmGfbfx/Versi%C3%B3n%20en%20Espa%C3%B1ol_20260510_140151_0000.png)

![CUANDO_20260523_023428_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeG6YBqNELwyUEn4n76AL8hPH9DhkPgjjSt3uGD8ZP4AA/CUANDO_20260523_023428_0000.jpg)
<center>_Front page_</center>
<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>
___

‎
‎I used to go to church frequently to escape the discomfort of living with my family. 
‎
‎Who would have thought it? I’d rather be anywhere else than with my own family. 
‎
‎The world turned upside down.
‎
‎
‎
‎At the church I attended, I met Keiber: a cheerful and helpful lad. He was two years younger than me, so he could easily have been my younger brother. We quickly bonded because we shared common views and expectations. Soon we were going everywhere together. 
‎
‎He was a very devout young man, devoted to his faith. We shared experiences, read the Bible and talked at length about our insights and the lessons we’d learnt.

___

<center>![px-downloadgf6264662e8b0e4f5d392e44c95c77845d721a96f1b3ab7a05d28f559b13c66111a71bbad6f9cad989b0747144ea4875fe874e81c91db6e851d867be9bb805c1667429c0e9f8dbc3fe0b9bd9404172a69_640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcWyTtwmCEynv2qFUgHtRRLA1ZcCQjL4vQvSbh4cC9cQz/px-downloadgf6264662e8b0e4f5d392e44c95c77845d721a96f1b3ab7a05d28f559b13c66111a71bbad6f9cad989b0747144ea4875fe874e81c91db6e851d867be9bb805c1667429c0e9f8dbc3fe0b9bd9404172a69_640.jpg)</center>
<center>*Photo by [doungtepro](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/las-manos-orando-adoraci%C3%B3n-creencia-5441201/) on Pixabay*</center>
___

 Between one conversation and the next, I told him what was happening with my family. 
‎
‎–*I really don’t know what to do, Keiber* –I confessed– *Going back to my parents isn’t an option. Here in La Guaira there are opportunities that don’t exist there. But the only place I have to live is with my family, and the truth is that what I earn isn’t enough to pay rent and support myself at the same time.* 
‎
‎He listened to me attentively, with the expression of someone giving the matter serious thought. After a moment, he asked me:
‎
‎–*What do you think about coming to live at my place?*
‎
‎–*I’d actually been seriously considering asking you that* –I confirmed.
‎
‎<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>
‎
A few years earlier, his parents had divorced and gone their separate ways. His father got involved with another woman and his mother left the country for a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity she didn’t want to miss. They had decided to leave the house where they had lived before the divorce to Keiber as an inheritance. He then went to live with a partner – before becoming an evangelical Christian – who gave him a daughter shortly afterwards. 
‎
‎As time went on – before he met me – problems soon began to arise. Differences, a lack of communication, unresolved issues... in short, a whole host of things that piled up until the girl couldn’t take it any longer and decided to go back to her parents, but taking with her the daughter she’d had with Keiber. 
‎
‎From that moment on, he lived alone. It was a spacious house with several rooms, and he was hardly ever there. He preferred to spend the day with his dad and, somewhat awkwardly, with his stepmother, but what other choice did he have? He didn’t like living alone. After all, a bit of company would do him good. 
‎
‎
‎After that conversation where we arranged my move, I went back home, packed my things and moved them to his place. 
‎
‎The sound of suitcases being moved aroused my aunt and uncle’s curiosity; they feigned surprise and deep sadness as they asked me why I was leaving. Their ironic hypocrisy never ceased to amaze me. I remember when they said to me: 
‎
‎“*The doors of this house will always be open to you. Don’t forget to come on Christmas Eve.*” 
‎
‎“*Yeah, right. Of course *,” I said to myself.

___
<center>![px-downloadga53e104d01bde652d6f0e9a502bcce828e1d223cc0367cc646aa86446be9aa0a4e90aef86f884705bce2f6a633c45c0309ee393d3409ca60c429b6ad198e7e0d0825435dca7212e5d5ec4352b5946e99_640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmREjh7wJKXcjPZNFyp5VYvbySmhavhksXVD5jsjMgDgKb/px-downloadga53e104d01bde652d6f0e9a502bcce828e1d223cc0367cc646aa86446be9aa0a4e90aef86f884705bce2f6a633c45c0309ee393d3409ca60c429b6ad198e7e0d0825435dca7212e5d5ec4352b5946e99_640.jpg)</center>
<center>*Photo by [wall_172619](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/viajar-atuendo-ropa-equipaje-4208389/) on Pixabay*</center>
___

‎
‎On the eve of those days, two things happened that completely exhausted my patience. 
‎
‎I don’t remember exactly why, but one of my aunts was in the middle of a tantrum –*not because of me*– and during an exchange of words she started shouting at me. I asked her to lower her voice, saying there was no need, and she got even more upset. I told her that respect is something you earn, and that was enough to make her explode. 
‎
‎In her view, I had to respect her no matter what she did: even if she shouted at me or insulted me, I had to respect her. My parents had taught me something very different: a balanced sense of judgement. But the rest of my family thought otherwise. For them, simply being an aunt or uncle – or a grandparent – was enough to have respect stuck to their foreheads like a label, and to demand it left, right and centre without doing absolutely anything to earn it. How wonderful!
‎
‎The other blunder that pushed me to get out of there as quickly as possible was an occasion when my Uncle Noé cooked a meal and served it to everyone—except me. 
‎
‎“That’s it,” I thought.
‎
‎The issue wasn’t that he didn’t feed me; in fact, none of them had any obligation to feed me, as I had a job for that. The point is that I contributed to the household larder, for everyone, out of my own pocket. That didn’t bother me, to be honest. I did the shopping and put the groceries in the same cupboard where everyone’s food was kept. So there was no exclusivity; it wasn’t as if “*this is mine and that’s yours*”. We all ate from the same plate and it seemed like a fair deal to me. 
‎
‎The thing is, Noé was a bit of a character: he would take things from the kitchen cupboard, cook them and eat them. But he kept his own shopping locked away in his room.
‎
<center>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/23tGwQ9PTdcLGhdgdVToYFZeRnY1T3ux5FhspwX5hhXgM2TeSzAz4RQzmDPSHuziMPTmv.png</center>
‎
‎
‎When I moved in with Keiber, it was December 2013 and the Christmas and New Year holidays were approaching. At that time, I was still working at Maiquetía International Airport and the routine was starting to wear me down because it didn’t allow me a stable schedule during the week to study, which was one of my short-term goals.
‎
‎The work schedule was a nightmare: I worked four days and had two days off. But four days in the morning (from 5:00 am to 1:00 pm) and the next four days in the afternoon (from 1:00 pm to 9:00 pm) or until the last scheduled flight departed, which was almost always delayed by an hour or two. A complete mess. 
‎
‎I had absolutely no intention of staying in that job for long. I decided to change jobs before New Year.

___

<center>![px-downloadg8e183e2d416c1a95e4ece74cc7119dff16c22b7299f7448e2e81b9e08ce8ac50027f5a5419b5a2460ee25a2e0b88efff7d9d4c10fb40454e03897d37c2c101ac61e57dd7f51aaab08ce2a88346da5529_640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVLvYwcnJ3LwgxorQiHdDM5NcNWWR7euv5rFh6mbPAx2W/px-downloadg8e183e2d416c1a95e4ece74cc7119dff16c22b7299f7448e2e81b9e08ce8ac50027f5a5419b5a2460ee25a2e0b88efff7d9d4c10fb40454e03897d37c2c101ac61e57dd7f51aaab08ce2a88346da5529_640.jpg)</center>
<center>*Photo from [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/aeropuerto-aeronave-salida-viaje-1105980/)*</center>

‎
‎
‎After moving house, I felt I had regained my peace of mind. Or so I thought. 
‎
‎ 
‎
I began attending church services regularly and getting actively involved. There I met people of incredible character. We used to meet in a room owned by one of the women who also attended the church, and which she had set up for that purpose. 
‎
‎I made good friends straight away. The owner of the room, Keiber, two other evangelical neighbours who lived nearby, and I used to meet every afternoon to pray, read the Bible and enjoy each other’s company. We soon formed very strong bonds as a group. 
‎
‎As time went on, I began to notice rifts and inconsistencies. The pastor often displayed highly questionable attitudes and behaviour: arrogance, intransigence, absolutism and a particular tendency to control the decisions of the congregation through suggestion. She was very skilled at manipulation.   
‎
‎I also observed many contradictions and misinterpretations of the teachings she imparted, and so alarm bells began to ring in my head. I shared some of my impressions with Keiber, who also told me she had long kept certain disagreements to herself out of fear. The same was true of the other women. 
‎
I learnt that some time ago, when they tried to voice their concerns to the pastor about the very same things I had noticed, she used to intimidate them with absurd threats such as:
‎
‎\

‎
Or else:
‎
‎“*Do you think the Lord will listen to you when you pray to Him whilst plotting against me in your mind?*” 
‎
‎Or this one: 
‎
‎“*The Lord shows me His will; you must obey*” 
‎
‎She was a haughty and arrogant woman. On more than one occasion she tried to show off in front of me, but I simply avoided complicating matters further by playing dumb. The most surprising thing of all is that although the congregation were unhappy and emotionally oppressed by her character and her rigidity, whatever she said was \

. 
‎
She used to rely heavily on supposed visions and alleged revelations that completely superseded the teaching of Scripture. Technically, for her, revelation carried more weight than teaching. That is where I perceive danger, because the Bible says the exact opposite. But anyway. 
‎
I gradually stopped attending the services. She noticed and immediately launched a smear campaign. 
‎
‎Through Keiber I found out that she started spouting a string of nonsense based on supposed revelations where ‘the Lord’ showed her that I was being an instrument of the devil to  lead the faithful astray and discourage them from going to church. Bah!
‎
‎I said to her:
‎
‎—*The only thing missing is for you to turn up one day claiming that ‘the Lord’ showed you I’m the Antichrist.*
‎
‎Logic suggested she’d realised her spells weren’t intimidating me and feared others might see the light. She was a power-hungry person; she revelled in the feeling of controlling others through her religion. 
‎
‎
‎In the meantime, the Christmas and New Year holidays passed, 2014 arrived, and after analysing my situation in relation to that place and seeking guidance in the Bible, I quickly found the answers and stopped attending for good. 
‎
One day I heard from Keiber that there would be a special meeting at the church that afternoon and that he was going. Evening came and he was late returning. When he finally turned up, he knocked on the door as if he were being chased. I opened it and noticed he looked distraught, as if furious. I assumed something had happened to him at that meeting. 
‎Upset, with a dazed look on his face and sweating, he said to me: 
‎
‎—*I need you to leave my house.* 
‎
‎I was frozen, on autopilot. 
‎
‎—*What do you mean, what?* —I asked, surprised. 
‎
‎I understood immediately. The little pastor had brainwashed him—well, everyone. Shortly afterwards, I confirmed that that meeting was to tell the faithful about “*a revelation from the Lord*”  concerning me, in which He showed him that he had to take action because of my coldness. 
‎
‎From that day on, I was condemned to absolute ostracism. All the friendships I’d made there went down the drain. If they saw me, they’d lower their heads and pretend they didn’t know me. Keiber gave me a week to leave. It was that simple. I’m not hiding anything; that’s exactly what happened. 
‎
‎I sat down in a chair and took a deep breath. Just four months after arriving there, they were already casting me out like a heretic for the unforgivable sin of not bowing to fear, not surrendering my conscience, and having a mind of my own. 
‎
‎With my mind blank and my face resting in my hands, my elbows on my legs, there was only room for one thought: 
‎
‎“*And where do I go now?*” I whispered.
‎
___

<center>![px-downloadg032a8849d60a842a318b88b2be0fe10254cc739c96865c223aeb8ea9e322663c9375341d81deab706a5346643f19aa25e22128ce36c8f1dc8e70910b4b116233224ac98b14429437a1cdd6aba9dfb77b_640.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZsTFCqfoBa1wbiPwRtz3yuoKcSEdmhFfBvKNW3Eq5nTu/px-downloadg032a8849d60a842a318b88b2be0fe10254cc739c96865c223aeb8ea9e322663c9375341d81deab706a5346643f19aa25e22128ce36c8f1dc8e70910b4b116233224ac98b14429437a1cdd6aba9dfb77b_640.jpg)</center>

links.title: Probando unordened_map en C++
links.body:
Mientras continúo programando con c++ sigo aprendiendo nuevas estructuras de datos y a decir verdad tiene muchísimas cosas para aprender. Tiene una gran cantidad de funciones y estructuras de datos increíbles que decir verdad no sé qué uso se le puede dar a la mayoría pero por el momento lo mejor es familiarizarme con la lógica y estructuras de datos.
While I continue programming with C++, I'm still learning new data structures, and to be honest, there's a lot to learn. It has a huge number of incredible functions and data structures, and frankly, I don't know what most of them are used for, but for now, the best thing is to familiarize myself with the logic and data structures.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmNuRaDdSukdS5AgP9A9YQXwehEqK3fSMhf9iJexG1pZDr/nomap.png Voy a implementar la misma manera con la que aprendí a desarrollar en javascript que es practicando muchos problemas por más que sean sencillos o parezcan que no enseñan nada a estos problemas los practico de manera manual intentando hacer herramientas con ejecuciones cortas sin muchas restricciones pero con el poco conocimiento que tengo.
I'm going to implement the same method I used to learn to develop in JavaScript, which is by practicing many problems, even if they are simple or seem to teach nothing. I practice these problems manually, trying to make tools with short execution times without many restrictions, but with the little knowledge I have.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmV7Z1tuQorx8xg9e5m3JrCKcteWpfbomkdEtdD5AXETzG/nomap1.png Forzarme a tratar de resolverlo indagando en el código sin recurrir a inteligencia artificial me sirve bastante aunque a la vez utilizo la inteligencia artificial para que me informe sobre cómo funcionan ciertas estructuras de datos y luego yo voy modificando algunas cuantas cosas para poder hacer algo más aceptable.
Forcing myself to try to solve it by digging into the code without resorting to artificial intelligence helps me quite a bit, although at the same time I use artificial intelligence to inform me about how certain data structures work and then I modify a few things to be able to make something more acceptable.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmf5zqYKncNiWxaxvVewzKUi7XS1AW3FprBjHwvDMgRijS/nomap2.png

links.body:
> Hello everyone, I hope you are all well. Today I am going to share with you my personal experience and opinion about **Lunaki Howler** a great and interesting card in the Splinterlands game. This card catches the attention of players at first sight with its terrifying appearance and powerful presence. Its presence on the battlefield can sometimes also create mental pressure on the opponent. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCtiktDotmsFmKVAdZRJ8RzhvUj29fYARquGcC8KM7qG/image.png) This is a card that basically combines power and strategy. There are many cards that are effective in certain situations but there are some cards that can exert their influence in different types of matches. A card that is capable of showing extraordinary effectiveness with the right team combination. It is a unit that can help not only in attack but also in maintaining the strategic balance of the entire team. The biggest good thing about this card is its reliability. Many times, it is seen that its presence disrupts the opponent's plans and creates advantageous situations for its own team at crucial moments of the match. Its strong performance and consistent contribution make it a valuable card. This card can be a great addition, especially for those who like to play medium to long-term strategic matches. However, it also has some limitations. It may not be equally effective in all types of battle rulesets. In some cases, its mana cost or coordination with other cards in the team becomes important. If not used correctly, it is not possible to use its full potential. It can also sometimes come under pressure against fast and very aggressive teams. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcRyJP2U5FDewPcChmMzGbdEc1vQuW6nACgLyH4gEH4gk/image.png) In my personal experience, it is a card that can give the best results with patience and proper planning. This is not a card that will guarantee victory just by being put on the field, but its true power is revealed when it works as part of a well-organized team. This card is definitely worth considering for those who want to make their deck more balanced and strategically strong. It is a strong, reliable and strategic card that can make a significant difference in many matches if used correctly. I think it is an interesting card for both new and experienced players. I'm ending this review here for today. I hope you liked my review and it gave you a clear idea about this card. Thank you all.

links.title: Our Own Neighbor Is A Monster: 'The Devil Next Door' by Netflix...
links.body:
>Sometimes we think we know our neighbors. And if you stop and think about it, that assumption makes perfect sense. They're people who, in many ways, share life alongside us. They live in the same neighborhoods, deal with roughly the same everyday struggles and advantages, and belong to the same community. What's fascinating is that appearances can be incredibly misleading. Not everything is what it seems. This is precisely what makes the real and thoroughly documented story of Ivan the Terrible feel stranger than fiction itself.

*\n\n*

>For decades, he lived legally in the United States. He worked at General Motors, retired after years of employment, raised a family, and built what appeared to be a perfectly ordinary life. The kind of life you or I might have lived under similar circumstances. The catch was his past. That's what the Netflix documentary series reveals almost immediately. Episode by episode, it carefully reconstructs what actually happened in the case of Ivan Demjanjuk, a Ukrainian man accused of actively collaborating with the Nazis during World War II. What follows is a meticulous investigation that slowly peels away the layers of a life built upon secrets.

* ![1000242773.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wWyURRwstMHeuuYsC26i7TT9Fxhq1PzRe3oyMqMgUMUhbtsN8ortPDTsH3tuvg4RGHT.jpg) ![1000242772.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23zbRaa2z9w4RoFajEyn5kqyAEiyuBmTruqVXG3pMQoJj6xiN5mFEWXPMxhp8j7H8Hw6B.jpg) *

>People often say that the sins of the past eventually catch up with us. In Demjanjuk's case, that old saying feels disturbingly accurate. The documentary shows how the declassification of Soviet archives opened the door for investigators to pursue suspected war criminals who had disappeared across the globe after the war. Once those documents became available, researchers, prosecutors, and historians began assembling the pieces. Little by little, the image of a hardworking retiree, devoted family man, grandfather, and faithful Orthodox Christian started to crumble under the weight of the evidence.

*\n\n*

>What emerges is deeply unsettling. On one side stands a man accused of participating in a system built on cruelty, abuse, and the industrialized murder of human beings. The documentary explores allegations connecting Demjanjuk to Nazi camps operating throughout occupied Eastern Europe, including parts of Poland and other territories under German control. His greatest mistake wasn't necessarily choosing the losing side of history. It was believing that the truth could remain buried forever. Across its three episodes, the series follows the legal battles that sought to determine his role and responsibility, while Demjanjuk and his family continued to maintain his innocence despite the growing body of evidence presented against him. It's not a true crime series in the traditional sense, but it is a sobering examination of what justice looks like decades after unimaginable atrocities have taken place.

* ![1000242774.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wWuAkpQ1fs6zEMMP8dsqGKSjk6n8GSd92NL5BnCpYbhi7qWo9LGEyHjEaRbHL3dS8dR.jpg) ![1000242771.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/243MLMx3RXH8ksxuYw3m8Hgsq5ayh2qzYGyibAe9kZbLWsGZMV2ZC5jbVgEDSJM2zecTS.jpg) *

>The legal process itself is almost unbelievable. At times it feels less like a courtroom proceeding and more like a historical reckoning unfolding in public view. The documentary remains remarkably restrained, avoiding easy conclusions and allowing viewers to form their own opinions. Still, it's difficult not to ask uncomfortable questions as the story progresses. Demjanjuk became associated with some of the most infamous chapters of the Holocaust, including allegations linked to camps such as Treblinka, Sobibor, Majdanek, and others. Whether viewed as a study of justice, memory, or accountability, the series leaves behind a lingering sense of unease. It reminds us that history rarely disappears. Sometimes it simply waits, quietly, for the truth to catch up.

* https://youtu.be/J8h16g1cVak?si=M1upCDgVZ0qJ7dXR https://youtu.be/pPq0HXWRf48?si=ZPUkRUqxR-9_0vh6

links.title: XAIGPUARC /// Endlich wieder Stabil /// Patch 7 a + b /// 10 c /// 11 + 12 = 500+ Zeilen aufwaerts.
links.body:
Ich habe am Wochenende und gestern noch weiter an den ganzen Patches gearbeitet, die noch reinkommen sollen.

Einen dualen Arbeitsgruppenmodus in Patch 7 a und b sind das Neueste, was ich vorbereitet habe fuer den Einbau. Bisher konnte man nur eine Arbeitsgruppe waehlen, dannach, kann man zwei auswaehlen. Je nach GPU, groeßer oder kleiner. Das soll schlicht eine kleine Ecke Performance und bessere Layerverteilung bringen.

Im Patch 10 C geht es um die Penible XMX Kernverwaltung, was eine Zicke, bekomme ich den 10er Patch dann auch noch durchgejag. Der C Teil des 10er Patches hat mich am meisten Arbeit gekostet bisher.

Der sieht auch so aus, als waere das nicht so einfach gewesen, kann ich sagen.

Diese SED Injektionen sind Zicken, da wenn was nicht genau richtig dort steht mit allem drum und dran wo es soll, passiert einfach garnichts. 

Im Grunde wir da ein Custom Kern Neu gebaut. Das ist Schoen, bis ich meine eigenen Kerne Fertig habe, gibt es den neuen Automatismus in XAIGPUARC.

Patch 11 und 12 sind dann auch so langsam soweit, konnte ich die auf 240 Zeilen runterdruecken, immerhin von 298 zuvor. Aber weniger, wirds wohl leider auch da nicht werden.

Insgesammt ist die neue Patchreihe so Groß, das sie einen signifikaten Anteil in XAIGPUARC haben wird.

Ab dem Punkt, gleiche ich nochmal alles an, mach es huepscher, und dann schau mer mal, ob sie auch funktionieren.

Salve

Alucian

Edit:

Bisher, muss ich meinen Computer Neu Starten, wenn XAIGPUARC nicht richtig funktioniert, weil der Speicher vollgelaufen ist.

Das kann also noch passieren, das merkt man schon, wenn der Speicher vollgelaufen ist. Dann zuckelt alles, und man moechte Neu Starten. :-)

links.title: 🃏 Final Fantasy VIII EP 6 | The Card I Couldn't Leave Behind 🎮✨
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmU1ePr5ZoLvcmkyTDKCkXCYW4PAY16wS32d8YyhzRGxUi/FF8.png 


There are two kinds of Final Fantasy VIII players.

Those who rush through the story...

And those who spend an hour challenging random people to cards because they know something valuable is waiting.

I proudly belong to the second group. 😆

In this episode, I took a small detour from saving the world to obtain one of the game's most iconic cards: **Zell's Card**.

And honestly? It was absolutely worth it.

---

## 🎴 Triple Triad Was More Than a Mini-Game

One of the reasons *Final Fantasy VIII* remains so unique among RPGs is Triple Triad.

Most games include mini-games as simple distractions.

But Triple Triad is different.

It becomes its own adventure.

You start by collecting cards just for fun, then suddenly you're planning strategies, hunting rare cards, and challenging every NPC you meet.

Before you realize it, you're more excited about finding a new card player than the next dungeon.

---

## 👩‍👦 Visiting Zell's Home

To obtain Zell's card, I had to pay a visit to his hometown and challenge someone very special: his mother.

It's one of those details that make the world of *Final Fantasy VIII* feel alive.

The rare cards aren't hidden inside treasure chests or dropped by powerful bosses.

Instead, they're connected to the people and relationships around the characters.

That small design choice gives these cards so much more personality.

---

## 🧠 Every Match Feels Like a Battle

What I enjoy most about Triple Triad is that it rewards thinking rather than grinding.

You don't need stronger weapons.

You don't need higher levels.

You just need a better strategy.

Every turn matters.

Every card placement matters.

And when a rare card is on the line, the pressure becomes surprisingly real.

I may have fought giant monsters in this game...

but losing a rare card match still hurts more. 😂

---

## ✨ Why I Never Skip These Moments

Some players see card collecting as optional content.

For me, it's part of the soul of the game.

These little moments create memories.

Years later, I might forget some random battles.

But I still remember searching for rare cards, building my deck, and feeling that satisfaction when a difficult card finally became mine.

That's exactly the feeling I got again in this episode.

---

## 🎬 Watch the Episode Here

👇 Join me as I obtain Zell's legendary card:

https://youtu.be/u9d4r290l90

---

## 💭 Final Thoughts

One of the greatest strengths of *Final Fantasy VIII* is that it constantly rewards curiosity.

Sometimes the reward is a powerful Guardian Force.

Sometimes it's a breathtaking cinematic.

And sometimes...

It's a simple card that somehow becomes one of your favorite memories from the entire adventure.

Today was one of those days.
